abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for rock burst induced secondary disaster chain disaster effect, and belongs to the field of coal mine disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of establishing a FLAC three-dimensional numerical model to simulate the distribution characteristics of supporting pressure in the advancing process of a working surface, dividing an advanced stress influence range, dividing an impact dangerous area according to impact critical intensity, extracting advanced stress, collecting a coal body sample, carrying out Hopkinson pressure bar test on the coal body sample, testing the void ratio of the coal body sample by using a CT scanning technology, calculating gas flow under different impact intensities, establishing a Fluent three-dimensional numerical model according to geological conditions of a target mine mining engineering, checking a model according to on-site actual measurement data, simulating an spontaneous combustion three-band distribution rule, and finally ascertaining the secondary disaster chain disaster effect induced by impact compression. The method has simple steps, effectively discovers the mutual influence relation of secondary disaster chains induced by rock burst leading, helps the synergistic prevention and control of disasters, and reduces the occurrence probability of multiple dynamic disasters.
assignees: SHANDONG ENERGY GROUP NORTHWEST MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Digital twin previewing submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method, device and program product based on deep learning, wherein the digital twin-forward submerged disaster assessment method comprises the following steps of collecting basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of training a convolutional neural network deep learning model by using basic geographic data, natural resource investigation data, geological data, meteorological data, water conservancy basic data and rainwater condition monitoring data, creating a terrain three-dimensional model according to image data and terrain data, extracting key features from the image data and the terrain data, constructing a digital twin base three-dimensional model based on the extracted key features and the terrain three-dimensional model, performing submerged disaster simulation and previewing by using the hydrodynamic model, the digital twin base three-dimensional model and the trained convolutional neural network deep learning model, evaluating based on simulation and prediction results, and visually displaying simulation results and evaluation data.

title_en: Evacuation system and evacuation method
abstract_en: To provide an evaluation system and an evacuation method that enable quick and smooth evacuation to a highly safe evacuation site, during a drill or in the event of disaster.SOLUTION: An evacuation system includes: means for a business operator or a specialist designated by the business operator to determine, at or before the start of construction at a construction site, an evacuation site for a drill or in the event of a disaster; a plurality of IC cards each storing unique ID number, distributed to participants in the drill or refugees in the event of the disaster at the evacuation site; and an information terminal 20 which is managed by the administrator. The information terminal 20 includes: input means for inputting location information of the construction site or the evacuation site; reading means which reads the IC cards in proximity; and save means which saves the location information and ID numbers of the IC cards. The information terminal 20 reads the IC cards distributed to the participants or the refugees at the evacuation site in proximity, to store entry records of the participants or the refugees entering the evacuation site in the information terminal 20, in association with the ID numbers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Flood disaster propagation simulation method based on bus-subway double-layer traffic network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood disaster propagation simulation method based on a bus-subway double-layer traffic network, which comprises the steps of constructing the bus-subway double-layer traffic network according to bus nodes, bus node connection relations, subway nodes, subway node connection relations and bus-subway transfer nodes, introducing disaster disturbance into the bus-subway double-layer traffic network, simulating the influence of the flood disaster on the double-layer traffic network, obtaining a node state update formula and a flood disturbance formula, iteratively calculating the node states at all moments through the node state update formula and the flood disturbance formula, and obtaining a disaster chained propagation path based on dynamic evolution of the node states in time. Compared with the prior art, the invention fills the blank of complex network disaster propagation research, and the proposed dynamic model can comprehensively reveal the dynamic behavior of the bus-subway system in extreme weather.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting linkage control method for oil-gas module fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting linkage control method for an oil-gas module fire disaster, which comprises the steps of arranging multiple sensors in a space of the oil-gas module, constructing a fire prediction neural network model, training the fire prediction neural network model, outputting the probability of the fire disaster, then performing fire-fighting numerical simulation analysis on carbon dioxide fire-fighting equipment, determining equipment parameters with the optimal fire-fighting effect under the same fire condition, generating a fire-fighting linkage decision by the obtained equipment parameters with the optimal fire-fighting effect under the same fire condition, and making a series of collaborative fire-fighting linkage schemes. According to the invention, excessive sensors are used for monitoring, so that the fire data of the oil-gas module can be comprehensively and accurately obtained. The fire prediction model constructed based on the neural network can comprehensively analyze the history and real-time data and scientifically predict the fire.

title_en: Network security active defense honeypot system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security active defense honeypot system which comprises a centralized management and control module and a threat perception module, wherein the centralized management and control module is used for centralized monitoring, maintenance and inquiry of honeypots and providing access entrance, the threat perception module comprises a honeypot management module, a threat analysis module, a report generation module and a linkage defense assisting module, the honeypot management module is used for managing honeypot simulation scenes, honeypot virtual machines, honeypot mirror images, trapping node equipment, disguised agent node equipment, network asset equipment and honeypot bait delivery, the threat analysis module is used for analyzing threat data reported by honeypots, the report generation module is used for making reports according to the analysis data, and the linkage defense assisting module is used for sharing the threat data with a third-party security system to conduct cooperative defense. The invention deploys the high-sweetness honeypot in the enterprise network, improves emergency response and defense level by virtue of camouflage, zero false alarm, high disposition and traceability, and can be independently deployed in multiple scenes without influencing the service.
assignees: YONGXIN ZHICHENG TECH GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING WUYI JIAYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Searching method for determining double-critical sliding surface of side slope of heterogeneous soil layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search method for determining a double-critical sliding surface of a side slope of a heterogeneous soil layer. The method utilizes Monte Carlo random simulation to combine with genetic algorithm to generate and screen parameter samples, and determines optimal parameter set assignment to a model through multi-index similarity function. Two groups of sliding surface candidate sets are synchronously generated based on an improved NSGA-II algorithm, a collaborative safety coefficient is constructed by combining a strength folding method and an energy method, and the mechanical response of a side slope is comprehensively considered. And solving failure probability through Monte Carlo simulation, and judging the double-critical sliding surface. And finally, locking the optimal critical sliding surface by using a particle swarm optimization and tabu search collaborative framework. The algorithm can accurately capture the double-critical sliding surface, is widely applicable to various geological and load conditions, improves calculation accuracy and efficiency, and provides key data support for slope engineering design, safety evaluation, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Power grid risk identification method and medium based on pre-training transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid risk identification method and medium based on a pre-training transducer model, which are characterized in that specific risk indexes under three risk dimensions of a future overhaul plan, load prediction data and natural disasters are selected, corresponding fusion risk indexes are designed, risk thresholds of the indexes are set according to limited operation information in a power grid and normal operation indexes of all equipment, a specific risk index value is calculated according to the risk indexes by the current power grid operation state, the specific risk index value is compared with the corresponding risk threshold, and the indexes exceeding the thresholds and the corresponding power grid operation data are screened out, so that superimposed risk power grid data are obtained. And taking key information such as a topological structure, voltage and current of each node and the like of the power grid in the running state as input characteristics of a transducer model, carrying out risk identification on potential factors in the power grid, and finally obtaining various risk identification results, and matching with planned daily scheduling maintenance so as to accurately identify potential various risks in the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ANHUI POWER CO LTD CHUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: Waterproof disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting a flood, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining rainfall, topography and hydrologic data of a predicted point, carrying out standardized processing, generating continuous data on the standardized topography and hydrologic data by adopting an interpolation algorithm, calculating a topography gradient, constructing a runoff model based on the standardized rainfall, the continuous hydrologic data and the topography gradient to obtain the predicted point runoff, constructing a flood evolution model by combining the runoff and the topography gradient, predicting flood arrival time and water level, and calculating a flood risk index according to the flood arrival time and the water level. According to the method, by constructing the runoff model and the flood evolution model, dynamic simulation of flood occurrence, development and propagation processes is realized, complex hydrologic conditions can be better adapted compared with the traditional static model, and more accurate technical support is provided for flood risk assessment.

title_en: Campus fire monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a campus fire monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring smoke values sent by all smoke sensors in a campus and image information sent by a camera device; the method comprises the steps of judging whether a fire disaster happens or not based on smoke values and image information, determining a fire disaster occurrence area based on position information of a corresponding smoke sensor and image information sent by a fire disaster camera after the fire disaster is judged to happen, dynamically simulating a fire disaster spreading trend based on a digital twin model and combining a smoke spreading prediction algorithm to generate a dynamic thermodynamic diagram, dividing an affected area and a safe area based on the dynamic thermodynamic diagram, controlling display equipment and broadcasting equipment in the affected area to broadcast first warning information, controlling the display equipment and the broadcasting equipment in the safe area to broadcast second warning information, and monitoring escape conditions of personnel in all areas and updating the first warning information in real time. The application has the effects of enabling personnel in different fire areas to acquire targeted information and improving the efficiency of the personnel in coping with the fire.

title_en: Geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological drilling investigation device based on geological disaster prevention and control, which belongs to the technical field of geological drilling investigation and comprises a walking assembly, wherein a drilling assembly is arranged above the walking assembly, an adjusting assembly used for adjusting the position of the drilling assembly is arranged at the top of the walking assembly, a bearing assembly used for installing the drilling assembly is arranged on the adjusting assembly, a positioning assembly used for fixing the position is arranged at the bottom end of the walking assembly, the adjusting assembly comprises a rotating mechanism, a displacement mechanism and a lifting mechanism, the rotating mechanism is rotatably arranged on the top surface of the walking assembly, the displacement mechanism is arranged at the top of the rotating mechanism, the bearing assembly is movably arranged above the displacement mechanism, a deviation correcting assembly used for correcting the drilling angle of the drilling assembly is arranged at the top of the displacement mechanism, the lifting mechanism is movably connected with the top of the rotating mechanism, and a limiting assembly used for limiting the drilling depth of the drilling assembly is arranged on the lifting mechanism, so that the geological drilling investigation device is suitable for various complex geological environments.

title_en: Active control method for structure for internal positioning wave elimination of wave water tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structure actuation control method for internal positioning wave elimination in a wave water tank. The control method comprises the steps of obtaining time sequence motion characteristics of feature points of a structure, constructing a data set, training a machine learning model by using the data set, collecting wave heights of the feature points to be damped and immersion depths of the feature points of the structure in real time, predicting real-time motion amplitude values of the structure according to the real-time wave heights of the feature points to be damped, the real-time immersion depths of the feature points of the structure and the distance between the feature points to be damped by using the trained machine learning model, and controlling the motion of the structure according to the real-time motion amplitude values of the structure so as to damped the feature points to be damped. The control method can realize the efficient wave elimination of single-point position waves, realize the construction of the structure parameter mapping radiation wave relation so as to achieve the function of active wave elimination, and has important significance in the field of wave elimination and disaster reduction.

title_en: Highway geological disaster risk early warning method and system based on BIM and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a highway geological disaster risk early warning method and system based on BIM and numerical simulation, which mainly combines an unmanned aerial vehicle close to a photogrammetry technology and a BIM technology, establishes a three-dimensional geological model of a highway and a geological environment along the highway, and uses ABAQUS software and PFC discrete elements to simulate different working conditions to analyze the geological disaster damage range under external conditions at high speed. Unmanned aerial vehicle survey and drawing, BIM technology, numerical simulation (ABAQUS and PFC) and GIS platform (ArcGIS) are integrated, and accurate and dynamic risk early warning of in-service expressways is achieved. The invention can realize multi-level geological disaster risk early warning from a static structure to a dynamic environment, analyze the damage range and the movement process of geological disasters, and display the interrelation between the geological disaster influence range and the expressway in a live-action model, and has remarkable innovation advantages in the aspects of slope landslide, roadbed settlement and the like.

title_en: Multi-fault linkage simulation electric fire early sign monitoring and identifying device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early sign monitoring and identifying device for an electric fire disaster by multi-fault linkage simulation, which relates to the technical field of electric monitoring and comprises the steps of monitoring to obtain thermal parameter distribution, gas parameter distribution and optical parameter distribution, carrying out discrimination analysis to obtain thermal discrimination distribution, gas discrimination distribution and optical discrimination distribution, then combining to obtain a plurality of discrimination distribution combinations, carrying out discrimination alignment treatment to obtain a plurality of alignment position distribution, calculating thermal alignment deviation degree, gas alignment deviation degree and optical alignment deviation degree, carrying out electric arc prediction to obtain thermal prediction electric arc parameter, gas prediction electric arc parameter and optical prediction electric arc parameter, and carrying out weighted calculation to obtain electric arc parameter as a monitoring and identifying result. The invention solves the technical problems of low accuracy and delayed early warning response of the early recognition of the electric fire faults in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of improving the accuracy and the reliability of the recognition of the electric fire faults.

title_en: Mud-rock flow intelligent early warning method and system by combining physical model with algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow intelligent early warning method and system by combining a physical model with an algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, performing an indoor soil physical mechanical test, constructing a physical model, and calibrating parameters of the physical model by combining a stability criterion equation of rainfall infiltration-matrix suction coupling effect; the method comprises the steps of S2, simulating different conditions, generating and outputting debris flow generation process data under different working conditions by a physical model, S3, constructing a dual-channel input network by taking the generation process data and real-time monitoring data as inputs, training a correction model to obtain corrected response data, S4, constructing a multi-source heterogeneous data-driven Bayesian probability early warning model based on an SHAP interpretability framework, S5, triggering real-time early warning of the early warning platform according to the real-time generation probability of the debris flow at a monitoring point, and constructing a mapping relation between soil deformation and critical parameters by dynamically simulating soil mechanical behaviors by the physical model.

title_en: Mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response system based on scene-quick response chain-coping
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response system based on a scene-quick response chain-coping, and belongs to the technical field of mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response. The system comprises modules for multi-element information acquisition and input, multi-chain data fusion, disaster situation analysis and evaluation display, knowledge graph-based emergency knowledge center, command scheduling and emergency capability evaluation display, intelligent emergency information receiving and release, emergency exercise and training and the like. The emergency management closed loop based on knowledge, expert group intelligence, emergency flow and intelligent decision rule sets is realized. The invention can effectively improve the scientificity, compliance and timeliness of mine safety emergency management decision and linkage response, and improve the level of mine safety service guarantee and the working efficiency.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Mine Safety Service Guarantee Center

title_en: Respiratory state real-time monitoring and emergency response system based on AI algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of respiratory state monitoring and emergency response systems, and discloses a respiratory state real-time monitoring and emergency response system based on an AI algorithm, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model training and generalization module, a real-time processing module, a multi-mode information comprehensive evaluation module, a hierarchical early warning and emergency response module and an improvement module. According to the AI algorithm-based breathing state real-time monitoring and emergency response system, a flexible piezoelectric sensor, a band-pass filter and a self-adaptive noise elimination algorithm are used for ensuring that high-quality breathing signals are captured, a vivid abnormal breathing pattern sample is generated by combining an antagonism generation network, an intelligent model is built by applying a migration learning technology, accuracy and robustness of abnormal breathing pattern recognition are improved, a lightweight neural network architecture and an edge calculation concept are adopted, primary data analysis and abnormal detection tasks are executed on local equipment, data transmission delay is reduced, and dependence on a cloud server is reduced.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Multi-stage emergency treatment scheduling method for heating system with large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage emergency treatment scheduling method of a heating system with a large model, which comprises the steps of forming the large model of emergency treatment scheduling of the heating system, constructing a multi-type emergency event question-answer database of the heating system by utilizing the large model in an emergency prevention preparation stage, carrying out intelligent question-answer of emergency knowledge, analysis of reasons of emergency events, inquiry of risk hidden danger and recommendation of emergency treatment scheduling measures, guiding the large model to output optimal characteristic combinations representing various types of emergency events in an emergency response stage, carrying out identification of various types of emergency events by utilizing machine learning, evaluating heating loss caused by the emergency events by utilizing the large model, setting a multi-stage emergency treatment scheduling strategy to obtain an optimal emergency treatment scheduling scheme, analyzing an emergency treatment scheduling process by utilizing the large model in an emergency treatment post-stage, establishing an emergency treatment scheduling pre-scheme library, carrying out pre-scheme simulation by utilizing an intelligent body, and identifying potential vulnerabilities and strengthening an emergency treatment scheduling flow.

title_en: Coastal erosion susceptibility interpretable evaluation method based on random forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a coast erosion susceptibility interpretation assessment method based on a random forest, which comprises the steps of selecting a disaster-prone factor, obtaining disaster-prone factor data, extracting coastline data, dividing coast erosion areas based on coastline changes to obtain coast erosion area distribution conditions, preprocessing the disaster-prone factor data and the coastline data to construct a coast erosion data set and divide the coast erosion data set into a training set and a test set according to a proportion, constructing a coast erosion susceptibility assessment model based on a random forest algorithm, comprehensively evaluating and comparing the model to screen out an optimal model, quantifying contribution of each factor in coast erosion by characteristic importance analysis based on the optimal random forest model obtained by screening, identifying and obtaining factors contributing to coast erosion, and using partial dependence and SHAP to perform interpretation analysis on the model to interpret influence of different disaster-prone factors on model prediction.

title_en: Coal mine pressure data joint monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine pressure data joint monitoring system which comprises a multipoint displacement meter, an anchor rod dynamometer, laser displacement meters and a drilling stress meter, wherein the multipoint displacement meter is installed in a coal mine tunnel roof through drilling, the anchor rod dynamometer is installed on an anchor piece of the coal mine tunnel roof or/and a tunnel side wall, the laser displacement meter is fixedly installed on two sides of a coal mine tunnel bottom plate or/and the tunnel side wall, the drilling stress meter is installed in the coal mine tunnel side wall through drilling, the multipoint displacement meter, the anchor rod dynamometer, the laser displacement meter and the drilling stress meter are respectively in communication connection with a data acquisition instrument, the data acquisition instrument is in communication connection with an underground monitoring information processor, and the underground signal processor is in communication connection with a ground monitoring server. The utility model realizes the integrated monitoring of various mine pressure data of the coal mine tunnel, guides the coal mine safety production, is suitable for the coal mine tunnel monitoring of different geological conditions, reduces the data processing cost of the coal mine safety monitoring, reduces accidents caused by coal mine rock burst disasters, and ensures the coal mine underground safety production.

title_en: Hydraulic driving drilling injection fire extinguishing device and method for electric automobile chassis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy automobiles and particularly relates to a hydraulic drive drilling and spraying fire extinguishing device and method for an electric automobile chassis, wherein the hydraulic drive drilling and spraying fire extinguishing device comprises a moving and lifting unit, a limiting and fixing unit, a hydraulic drive unit and a rotary cutting spray head; the moving and lifting unit is a moving and lifting mechanism of the hydraulic driving drilling and spraying fire extinguishing device of the electric automobile chassis and is used for lifting the hydraulic driving unit and the limiting and fixing unit, the limiting and fixing unit is used for guaranteeing stability of the device and the positioning and subsequent operation device of the automobile chassis after the moving and lifting unit lifts, the hydraulic driving unit is located below the limiting and fixing unit, and the rotary cutting spray head connected with the hydraulic driving unit is used for drilling and spraying fire extinguishing agent to the electric automobile chassis to extinguish fire. The fire extinguishing device and the fire extinguishing method are efficient and convenient for fire disaster or potential thermal runaway caused by the out-of-control of the battery of the new energy automobile.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Disaster comprehensive management method, system and computer program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive disaster management method, system and computer program, which comprises the steps of obtaining a historical natural information data set, constructing a training decision tree to identify disaster types to obtain a disaster type identification model, constructing a training fully-connected neural network to predict disaster evaluation scores to obtain a disaster evaluation score prediction model, monitoring and obtaining natural information data in real time, carrying out standardized processing and feature extraction, analyzing through the trained disaster type identification model and the trained disaster evaluation score prediction model to obtain disaster types and disaster evaluation scores, obtaining disaster severity grades, and adopting a preset strategy to treat. The technical scheme provided by the invention integrates a plurality of functions, improves the management efficiency and response speed, realizes real-time data acquisition and processing, can timely find disaster risks and make corresponding early warning and countermeasure, analyzes disaster data by utilizing an artificial intelligent algorithm, assists decision making, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of disaster treatment.
assignees: SHANGHAI HAIBO SHUKE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale unmanned cluster game strategy construction system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale unmanned cluster game strategy construction system and method, wherein the system comprises a simulation environment module, a centralized training module and a distributed execution module based on the simulation environment module, the simulation environment module is used for simulating a dynamic interaction environment of a large-scale unmanned cluster, the centralized training module adopts a cluster game countermeasure reinforcement learning algorithm MAPPO and combines a strategy network and a value network to realize the strategy optimization of the large-scale unmanned cluster through centralized training, and the distributed execution module applies the strategy generated by the centralized training module to the large-scale unmanned cluster to enable each intelligent agent in the large-scale unmanned cluster to independently execute the strategy and independently select action distribution based on local observation information of the intelligent agent. The invention can cope with dimension disasters caused by excessively high state space dimension in a large-scale scene and make up for the defects of the existing simulation system in the aspect of modeling a real task scene.
assignees: NANQI XIANCE NANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Turbine blade geometric structure uncertainty quantitative analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative analysis system for uncertainty of a turbine blade geometry, which comprises a CAD model building module, an uncertainty sampling module, a CFD batch calculation module, a DNN model training module, an uncertainty analysis module and a turbine performance optimization module. On one hand, the analysis system greatly improves the efficiency and stability of CFD calculation of a large number of uncertainty design sample sets, and is beneficial to promoting the application of uncertainty optimization design technology in the aspect of actual engineering. On the other hand, by means of the system, the structure of the geometric model of the turbine blade is parameterized, sampling calculation of uncertainty design can be carried out on up to dozens of parameters at the same time, and then relatively important parameters are screened on the basis of sensitivity analysis to achieve a dimension reduction target, so that the problem of dimension disaster in traditional uncertainty analysis is solved, and the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the uncertainty analysis of the turbine blade are improved.

title_en: Gridless simulation method, device and medium for calculating landslide surge of soil body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dike geological disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a gridless simulation method, a gridless simulation device and a gridless simulation medium for calculating landslide surge of a soil body, which solve the problem of inaccurate inversion of local water pressure and soil body contour development process of a coupling interface, can effectively characterize the biphase coupling effect between a landslide body and a water body, reasonably simulate the pressure distribution of the coupling interface, eliminate non-physical high-pressure gaps, accurately predict the large deformation movement process and the surge propagation process of the soil body, accurately invert the local water body impact rolling flow state and provide visual analysis materials. The gridless simulation device for calculating the landslide surge of the soil body can accurately simulate various working conditions such as rapid and slow landslide surge and the like, is applied to relevant research and analysis in a typical section and an area, and provides guidance for clear soil body landslide surge evolution law and surge disaster prevention. The invention can accurately simulate the whole process of the landslide surge of the soil body.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery firewall control method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a disaster recovery firewall control method, a disaster recovery firewall control device, disaster recovery firewall control equipment, disaster recovery firewall control storage medium and a program product, and relates to the field of financial science and technology or other relevant fields. The method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster recovery requirements of an application system when the application system is put into production or updated, determining disaster recovery scenes corresponding to the disaster recovery requirements based on the disaster recovery requirements, constructing a firewall strategy adapting to the disaster recovery scenes based on the disaster recovery requirements, transmitting the firewall strategy to firewall equipment corresponding to the application system, and transmitting a strategy effective instruction to the firewall equipment when the disaster recovery scenes are in exercise of the disaster recovery scenes to the application system so as to trigger the firewall strategy to be effective, so that the firewall equipment performs access control based on the firewall strategy. The method improves the efficiency of disaster recovery drilling.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Safe production virtual training method and system for mine underground scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safe production virtual training method and system for underground mine scenes, which comprises the steps of creating a model library, storing preset part models through the models, acquiring the space orientation of each part model based on an underground mine hole excavation design diagram, generating underground mine virtual training scenes, acquiring the virtual training scenes from the scene library according to the received training instructions based on the received training instructions, displaying the virtual training scenes on an interactive module, adjusting and transforming the virtual training scenes based on operation feedback signals of a training miner, marking the part models with high dangerous coefficients in the virtual training scenes, judging the safety condition of each part model in the underground mine, calculating the average marking number in the virtual training scenes, and comprehensively judging the mine safety coefficients. The invention has the advantages that the mine underground environment is simulated by the virtual reality technology, the safety operation training of miners is helped under the condition of no risk, and the safety consciousness and the emergency response capability of the miners are improved.
assignees: MINGCHUANG HUIYUAN GUIZHOU MINE DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Small-sized snow tank physical experiment device
abstract_en: The invention provides a small snow trough physical experiment device which comprises a chute system and a measuring system. The chute system comprises a chute main body and auxiliary equipment, wherein the chute main body is of a semi-closed chute structure and comprises a release section, an acceleration section, an erosion section and a deposition section, the four sections are sequentially connected to form a whole, the release section is arranged at the upstream position of the chute main body, the acceleration section is connected to the downstream of the release section to form smooth transition, the erosion section is flush with the tail end of the acceleration section, and the deposition section is fixed on the downstream water surface of the chute main body. The metrology system comprises observation means and sensing devices for recording and analyzing the movement behaviour and physical mechanism of the avalanche flow within the chute body. The device provided by the invention comprehensively simulates the whole process from avalanche release to deposition, accurately measures the key parameters of avalanche flow, and provides powerful experimental support for the research of avalanche disasters.

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock parameter inversion method and system under multi-disaster coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for inverting tunnel surrounding rock parameters under multi-disaster coupling, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering; the method comprises the steps of obtaining field soft rock, preparing soft rock test pieces, grouping the soft rock test pieces, performing an indoor test, obtaining basic static mechanical parameters of the field soft rock and a test stress strain curve under dynamic action according to an indoor test result, determining parameters to be inverted, obtaining upper and lower limits of values of the parameters according to experience, obtaining an objective function based on the test stress strain curve and a simulated stress strain curve, and inverting through a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain inversion parameters of surrounding rocks of a tunnel. The invention obviously reduces the test cost of RHT constitutive parameter calibration, and the constitutive parameter of the reverse performance is matched with the actual height of the engineering. Based on simulation results of the inversion parameters, a powerful reference basis can be provided for blasting construction design.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 24TH BUREAU GROUP SOUTHWEST CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH;CHINA RAILWAY 24TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Correction method suitable for sea-air coupling mode typhoon generation season prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides a correction method suitable for typhoon generation season prediction in a sea-air coupling mode, which comprises the steps of determining basic parameters, establishing a key meteorological element error prediction basic model, generating an error prediction model of each key meteorological element of each grid point through training, combining to form a model cluster for typhoon error prediction in a prediction correction area, correcting sea-air coupling mode predicted values by adopting the model cluster, and carrying out statistical analysis on the predicted correction value of each key meteorological element of each grid point in the prediction correction area to obtain a correction result of typhoon generation season prediction. The correction method suitable for typhoon generation season prediction in the sea-air coupling mode can improve the accuracy of typhoon generation season prediction in the sea-air coupling mode, is not only beneficial to machine learning application in typhoon numerical prediction, but also can provide scientific support for typhoon disaster prevention.

title_en: Storm high-risk division method and system based on hydrological space linear moment frequency analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a storm high-risk zoning method and a system based on hydrological space linear moment frequency analysis, which relate to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction, and the invention enables a rainfall simulation model to fully reflect the hydrological characteristics of an area by carrying out fine gradient division and representative acquisition point setting on the area to be monitored, thereby improving the accuracy of surface runoff prediction; in addition, the comprehensive analysis of the root growth characteristic data in the method enhances the understanding of soil moisture change, and is further beneficial to formulating a more effective disaster prevention and reduction strategy in practical application.
assignees: XIAN YELLOW RIVER PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD;ORDOS SOLID WASTE AND SOIL ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CENTER

title_en: Debris flow model parameter sensitivity analysis and parameter determination method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of model parameter optimization of a debris flow model, and particularly relates to a debris flow model parameter sensitivity analysis and parameter determination method, which comprises the following steps of performing hydrologic analysis by using GDAL, numPy and SciPy libraries in Python according to collected digital elevation data of a research area, preprocessing DEM data of the collected research area by using GDAL libraries in the Python, and determining that parameters needing sensitivity analysis in the debris flow model are clear water peak flow Coarse rate coefficient of ditch bed Longitudinal slope of ditch bed Coefficient of friction Coefficient of turbulence The method identifies key parameters in Massflow models through Morris analysis, and calibrates parameter values by combining a GLUE method, so that model simulation precision is remarkably improved, the method is applied to Massflow, mud-rock flow process simulation is performed, and scientific support is provided for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Long and large tunnel intelligent drilling and blasting monitoring method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long and large tunnel intelligent drilling and blasting monitoring method based on multi-sensor fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly arranging wireless sensor network nodes, secondly inputting drilling simulation parameters of a plurality of wireless sensor network nodes into a tunnel intelligent drilling and blasting monitoring neural network to obtain a group of optimal drilling parameters under a tunnel construction safety state, thirdly, drilling and blasting the tunnel by utilizing the optimal drilling parameters of the wireless sensor network nodes, fourthly, comparing post-blasting parameters with post-blasting virtual parameters, judging tunnel states under the post-blasting parameters, executing the fifth step when the tunnel states are tunnel construction safety critical states, triggering an early warning system when the tunnel states are tunnel construction dangerous states, automatically starting an emergency response mechanism after the early warning system is triggered, and dynamically adjusting the positions and the number of the wireless sensor network nodes and the drilling parameters. The invention can realize the active quantitative control of drilling and blasting parameters and improve the construction efficiency and the quality control level.

title_en: Method and system for preventing and controlling caving disaster of roof of coal face
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for preventing and controlling caving disasters of a roof of a coal face, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological information of each rock stratum corresponding to cutting holes of the stope face by punching peeping holes; based on geological information, a plurality of pressure relief drilling holes are drilled on the side of a coal pillar corresponding to a cut hole, the hard rock stratum of a top plate is presplitted through pressure relief treatment, so that the top plate at the cut hole is converted into a cantilever structure from a beam-shaped structure, monitoring equipment is arranged, a plurality of groups of cushion layers are arranged on a bottom plate of a goaf, and whether the cushion layers are adjusted or not is judged by combining impact data acquired by the monitoring equipment when the top plate collapses, the initial collapse step distance of the top plate under the cantilever structure and relevant parameters of the cut hole. The method can reduce the primary caving step of the top plate, relieve the huge dynamic pressure generated when the top plate is caving, comprehensively prevent and treat the top plate caving disasters from multiple angles, and improve the prevention and treatment effect of the top plate caving disasters.

title_en: Efficient indoor personnel evacuation simulation and optimization method based on social force model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-efficiency indoor personnel evacuation simulation and optimization method based on a social force model, and belongs to the technical field of evacuation modeling and simulation. The method dynamically simulates the motion trail and behavior change of personnel in an evacuation scene by constructing a social force model comprising internal driving force, psychological repulsive force, extrusion force and attractive force and combining with Newton's second law. The simulation platform adopts MATLAB and other tools to support multi-scene modeling and multi-objective optimization, including shortest evacuation time, minimum congestion risk and the like. Based on the model, dynamic simulation and layout optimization of a complex geometric site, such as newly added outlet position design, aisle width adjustment and the like, can be realized, so that evacuation efficiency is remarkably improved. The method is suitable for high-density places such as schools, office buildings, subway stations, gymnasiums and the like, can provide an optimization scheme under disaster scenes such as fire disasters, earthquakes and the like, and provides theoretical support and technical tools for smart city construction and public safety design.

title_en: Construction method of digital twin planning display platform for chemical fine materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction method of a digital twin planning display platform for a chemical fine material, which can construct a millimeter-level precision three-dimensional model based on laser radar, unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography and BIM data, realize dynamic model updating through AI image comparison, deploy a plurality of types of sensors, perform space-time data fusion by adopting a distributed message queue, complete noise filtration and anomaly detection by combining edge computing nodes, identify abnormal video monitoring behaviors by utilizing YOLOv algorithm, and generate a risk thermodynamic diagram prediction equipment fault through an LSTM model. And dynamically simulating a gas leakage diffusion path based on the CFD algorithm and the meteorological data to generate a real-time evacuation route and rescue resource scheduling scheme. The method can be suitable for dangerous chemical storage, equipment inspection and pollution diffusion prevention and control scenes.
assignees: SANTI WISDOM NETWORK TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Urban typhoon disaster rapid prediction method based on intelligent downscaling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent downscaling-based rapid urban typhoon disaster prediction method. According to the invention, based on wind field forecasting results output by a coarse-resolution typhoon numerical forecasting mode, an intelligent downscaling model is constructed by combining underlying surface information, the intelligent downscaling model comprises two layers of downscaling models, a high-resolution local extremely-large wind field simulation result under the influence of regional environmental characteristics is generated, and on the basis of building a building vulnerability assessment model to evaluate the influence of typhoons on a building, the damage risk of a target region is comprehensively analyzed, so that risk disaster prediction is completed. The invention designs the building disaster evaluation model by combining high-resolution meteorological data, can efficiently evaluate the influence of typhoon extreme wind speed on the building, and provides better support for urban disaster prevention decision.

title_en: Test device for simulating stratum collapse
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a test device for simulating stratum collapse, which comprises a transparent model box with an opening at the upper end, wherein a simulation system is connected to signals of the model box, two sides of the model box are respectively communicated with a water inlet pipe and a water outlet pipe, the model box is used for simulating binary water circulation between society and nature, soil layer units, simulation units, seepage units and monitoring units are arranged in the model box, the soil layer units are used for simulating soil layers with different address conditions, the simulation units are used for simulating external influence factors of rainfall, groundwater supply, earthquake and discharged water on the soil layer units, the seepage units are used for simulating the flow of water in the soil layer, and the monitoring units are used for monitoring the soil layer and the water flow state in real time. The simulation of the influence of binary water circulation between society and nature on stratum collapse is realized through a plurality of simulation units and seepage units.

title_en: Landslide dynamic evolution prediction method and system based on biological neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prediction, in particular to a landslide dynamic evolution prediction method and system based on a biological neural network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining comprehensive monitoring data of a landslide area, establishing a biological neural network architecture for simulating and learning a dynamic evolution rule of the landslide, obtaining a dynamic prediction result of a chaotic edge state of a landslide system, generating a space-time evolution path of the landslide by combining a topological manifold generation algorithm, and realizing visual prediction of dynamic evolution of the landslide through the space-time evolution path of the landslide. The method realizes multi-source data depth fusion and high-precision dynamic prediction of the landslide evolution process by establishing a biological neural network architecture and a critical state neural dynamics model, converts a dynamic prediction result into a four-dimensional space-time voxel density field by utilizing a quantum dot nerve fluorescence labeling system and a topological manifold generation algorithm, generates a high-resolution landslide space-time evolution path, and realizes multi-dimensional visual expression of the landslide evolution process.
assignees: KUNMING PROSPECTING DESIGN INST OF CHINA NONFERROUS METALS INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent body simulation decision-making method and device based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides an agent simulation decision method and device based on a large language model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: basic attribute information of the intelligent agent and environmental information of a real-time disaster rescue scene are acquired, and the information is processed in sequence and transmitted to a decision module. The decision module converts the serialized data into natural language description by using a large language model, generates a decision result containing an action scheme and decision interpretation by combining a historical decision record and a behavior library, and then transmits the decision result to the execution module for execution and records the decision result to the message history record database. The method enhances the flexibility and adaptability of the decision of the agent, so that the agent can flexibly cope with changeable disaster rescue situations, and ensures accurate and efficient decision in complex or unknown environments. Meanwhile, information limitation is avoided by efficiently integrating multidimensional data, and decision accuracy is improved. The decision process is transparent and can be interpreted to enhance credibility and understanding. The development efficiency is improved by using a large language model, and higher timeliness is brought to the actual system development.
assignees: GUANGDONG NORMAL UNIV WEIZHI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Soil sample collection device and method for geological disaster management engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soil sample collection device and a soil sample collection method for geological disaster management engineering, and relates to the technical field of soil sample collection. According to the soil sample collection device for geological disaster management engineering and the method thereof, when a soil sample is collected, the transmission mechanism is started to drive the drill rod to rotate and move downwards, meanwhile, the drill rod can drive the transmission rod to rotate when rotating, the stone breaking mechanism at the bottom moves, hard matters contacted with the bottom of the drill rod are broken, so that the drill rod is smoother when drilling, when the drill rod drills into a set depth, the sampling mechanism can work through the switching mechanism, the servo motor a can be started to rotate reversely after the sampling is completed, the drill rod is driven to move upwards, the switching mechanism is started again to drive the knocking mechanism to move, soil adhered to the surface of the drill rod is loosened and separated, and the stability of the soil sample collection device during sampling can be maintained through starting the supporting mechanism.
assignees: HEBEI KUNSHANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall landslide early warning method, equipment and medium based on process stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall landslide early warning method, rainfall landslide early warning equipment and rainfall landslide early warning medium based on process stability, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. According to the early warning method, the pore water pressure distribution characteristics of the slope body are simulated and analyzed based on geological data and historical rainfall data, the stability coefficient of the slope body is calculated according to the pore water pressure distribution characteristics, the stability state and the early warning grade of the slope body are divided according to the stability coefficient, and then a relation model between rainfall intensity and rainfall duration and the stability of the slope body is built, so that the difficulty in building the early warning model is reduced, and compared with the method that the reliability is higher by directly using rainfall and slope body deformation as early warning criteria.

title_en: Three-dimensional dynamic modeling and simulation analysis method for underground coal mine environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground coal mine operation, in particular to a three-dimensional dynamic modeling and simulation analysis method for underground coal mine environment; technical problems: in the prior art, the coal mine underground environment is not intuitively displayed, so that accurate space positioning and analysis are difficult to perform, and a static model cannot simulate dynamic change of the underground environment, so that dynamic analysis is insufficient; the technical scheme is as follows: the method comprises the steps of modeling static entities in the coal mine, constructing a three-dimensional model of the dynamic entities in the coal mine, performing spatial analysis by using the three-dimensional model, and early warning geological disasters in the coal mine; according to the invention, the three-dimensional dynamic model of the underground environment of the coal mine is constructed, and the simulation analysis method is combined, so that the static structure and the dynamic change of the underground environment are comprehensively and intuitively displayed, and powerful support is provided for safe production and efficient management of the coal mine, so that the safety and the efficiency of coal mine production are improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood storage area regulation and control, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood storage area risk-benefit dynamic game regulation and control method. The method comprises the steps of dynamically simulating a real-time flood event based on a digital twin model to obtain probability distribution data, carrying out multi-objective iterative optimization solving on a historical flood diversion regulation strategy based on the probability distribution data to generate a multi-objective optimal balance set, generating a real-time controllable gate regulation instruction set based on the digital twin model and the optimal balance set, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the risk and benefit regulated and controlled in a flood storage area in the process of regulating and controlling a gate in real time through the gate regulation instruction set. The invention realizes high precision, dynamic and intelligent regulation and control of the flood storage area, realizes accurate quantitative assessment of risk and benefit of the flood storage area, provides scientific basis for flood control decision, and effectively reduces flood disaster loss and ecological influence.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Short-term precipitation prediction method and system for generating countermeasure network based on self-attention ConvLSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for forecasting short-term precipitation based on self-attention ConvLSTM to generate an countermeasure network, and belongs to the technical field of weather forecast. The method combines a self-attention mechanism and ConvLSTM networks, improves the precision and timeliness of precipitation prediction through multi-scale feature fusion, adopts a self-attention memory module on a model structure, captures long-range dependence in a space-time sequence through enhancing the relevance among input features, introduces a generated countermeasure network frame, further optimizes the generation effect of the model through a countermeasure training mode, adopts a WGAN-GP algorithm, and utilizes a gradient penalty term constraint discriminator to keep a stable training process in order to solve the problem of mode collapse in training. The method can be effectively applied to the fields of weather forecast and the like, and provides more accurate and real-time forecast support for weather disaster early warning.

title_en: Disaster prevention life circle space form optimization method based on refuge accessibility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster prevention life circle space form optimization method based on evacuation accessibility, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a disaster prevention life circle, S2, calculating form parameters of the disaster prevention life circle evacuation accessibility according to a crowd evacuation process from an evacuation starting point to an evacuation road and finally to an evacuation space, and carrying out quantization processing, S3, dividing the disaster prevention life circle into multiple types, selecting the disaster prevention life circle meeting preset requirements as an evacuation simulation sample, S4, setting crowd parameters, constructing a disaster prevention life circle evacuation simulation model according to the evacuation simulation sample, carrying out crowd evacuation simulation, S5, calculating an evacuation accessibility assessment index based on crowd evacuation simulation results, S6, calculating the association degree between the form parameters and the evacuation accessibility assessment index, extracting the form parameters which are positively correlated and negatively correlated with the evacuation accessibility as key form elements, and S7, optimizing the space form of the disaster prevention life circle based on the association characteristics of the key form elements and the evacuation accessibility.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster prediction and discloses a coal and gas outburst disaster prediction method and device based on multi-physical field coupling. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data enhancement and normalization processing on a training sample set to obtain a model training data set, carrying out pattern recognition and parameter optimization on the model training data set to obtain an outstanding disaster prediction model, carrying out probability distribution calculation on output data of the outstanding disaster prediction model to obtain a confidence interval, carrying out multi-dimensional cross validation on the confidence interval to obtain a prediction reliability assessment result, carrying out threshold grading and risk grading on the prediction reliability assessment result to obtain an early warning grade judgment result, and carrying out space-time correlation analysis on the early warning grade judgment result to obtain target early warning decision information. According to the application, the coupling relation among the multiple physical field parameters is analyzed, and the multiple physical field coupling prediction model is established, so that the accurate prediction of the coal and gas outburst disasters is realized, and the reliability and accuracy of the prediction are improved.

title_en: Simulated driving system and method based on live-action map
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile driving training and provides a simulated driving system and method based on a live-action map, wherein the simulated driving system and method comprises a live-action map data acquisition module, a virtual reality rendering module and a virtual reality display module, wherein the live-action map data acquisition module is used for acquiring and updating live-action map data of roads, traffic signs and surrounding environments and transmitting the data to the virtual reality rendering module; and the virtual reality rendering module is used for rendering a three-dimensional driving environment by utilizing the collected live-action map data and providing selections of different vehicle types. By adopting the simulated driving system based on the live-action map, the reality of driving training is remarkably improved, and the high-precision live-action map data is utilized, so that a driver can experience a driving situation close to reality in a safe and risk-free environment, the safety consciousness and the emergency response capability of the driver are improved, and traffic accidents caused by improper operation or insufficient pre-judgment in real driving are reduced.
assignees: BEIJING HUANKE LIANDONG SCIENCE AND EDUCATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command method and system for low-altitude flight
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency command method and system for low-altitude flight, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time flight monitoring data of a target area, determining an emergency event type in the target area according to an abnormal data subset in the real-time flight monitoring data, calling a flight emergency prediction model corresponding to the emergency event type, training the flight emergency prediction model based on screened flight characteristics and airspace characteristics in historical emergency event data, enabling input parameters and output parameters of each flight emergency prediction model to be consistent in a training stage and an application stage, outputting a flight path adjustment strategy and an emergency resource allocation strategy according to the flight emergency prediction model, generating an emergency command, executing the emergency command, and updating parameters of the flight emergency prediction model according to real-time feedback data after execution. The invention can overcome the problem of cooperative promotion of flight safety and emergency response efficiency in a complex airspace environment.

title_en: Two lining concrete conflagration degradation analogue means
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire disaster degradation simulation device for a secondary lining concrete, which belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and comprises a calcination chamber, a temperature controller and a water cooling pool, wherein the calcination chamber comprises a supporting layer, an insulating layer and an inner lining layer which are sequentially arranged from outside to inside, a heating cavity is arranged between the inner lining layer and the insulating layer, a heating carbon rod is arranged in the heating cavity, a temperature probe is arranged in the calcination chamber, the temperature probe and the heating carbon rod are respectively and electrically connected with the temperature controller, and the water cooling pool is used for water cooling a concrete test block tested by the calcination chamber. The utility model designs a calcining chamber simulating tunnel fire, the temperature in the calcining chamber is regulated and controlled by a temperature controller, a water cooling pool is used for simulating on-site water gun fire extinguishing operation and simulating reduction tunnel fire, and a reliable experimental foundation is provided for detecting elastic waves and cube compressive strength of a concrete sample.
assignees: GANSU PROVINCIAL TRANSP RESEARCH INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD;GANSU ROAD ENG QUALITY TEST DETECTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Bombing back-fire simulation cabin for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bombing back-fire simulation cabin for fire-fighting training, which relates to the field of fire-fighting training and adopts the following scheme: including the cabin body, be provided with the observation window on the cabin body, still include image information acquisition unit and control unit, image information acquisition unit includes camera and display, the camera with the display all with the control unit electricity is connected, the camera sets up the cabin body and with the observation window sets up relatively, the display sets up the cabin body is outside. According to the utility model, each firefighter can clearly observe the internal condition of the simulated cabin, and the capability of accurately judging the occurrence sign of flashback and bombing is improved.

title_en: Coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, in particular to a coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning device. The utility model provides the coal rock dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning device which can be convenient to install, improves the installation efficiency, improves the environmental adaptability of equipment and can be rapidly deployed and efficiently monitored. The utility model provides a coal petrography dynamic disaster monitoring early warning device, includes erection column, base and clamping frame etc. and the erection column downside is connected with the base, and the erection column lower part is connected with two upper and lower clamping frames. According to the utility model, the mounting column is fixed on the coal face by the base, then the drilling is carried out at the monitoring position, then the charge probe is taken down and placed in the drilling, and the charge probe is fixed by the elastic sheet, so that the effects of being convenient to mount, improving the mounting efficiency, improving the environmental adaptability of equipment and being capable of being rapidly deployed and efficiently monitored are achieved.
assignees: YUWU COAL IND CO LTD OF SHANXI LUAN GROUP

title_en: Pressure measuring device for detecting internal pressure of smoke cavity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a pressure measuring device for detecting the internal pressure of a smoke cavity, which comprises a base and a supporting frame, wherein the top end of the base is fixedly connected with the supporting frame, one end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a controller, the top end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with a top plate, the sealing of two ends of an exhaust pipe can be realized through a blocking plate and a sealing gasket, meanwhile, the pressure of the inner side of the exhaust pipe is increased through ventilating air to the smoke cavity of the inner side of the exhaust pipe through a ventilating pipe until the pressure of the inner side of the exhaust pipe reaches a measured pressure value, and meanwhile, the air entering the smoke cavity of the inner side of the exhaust pipe can be heated through an electric heating wire, so that the high-temperature smoke during fire disaster is simulated, the pressure measuring effect is improved, the quality of the exhaust pipe is according with the requirement if the pressure value of the inner side of a pressure meter is changed within a reasonable range, and the quality of the exhaust pipe is not according with the requirement if the pressure value of the inner side of the pressure meter is not changed within the reasonable range and the exhaust pipe is damaged.
assignees: HUNAN LIANFAN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network source network load storage collaborative scheduling method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network source and network load storage collaborative scheduling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information of extreme disasters, historical photovoltaic and power grid parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating probability distribution of a fault scene and initial probability distribution of output of a typical photovoltaic unit, constructing a distribution network source and load storage collaborative distribution robust optimization model considering fault states and uncertainty of photovoltaic output based on a distribution robust optimization algorithm by taking the minimum total running cost of the distribution network as an objective function and combining constraint conditions, generating a CCG algorithm by adopting columns and constraint, decomposing an original problem into main problems and sub problems, and carrying out iterative solution on the main problems and the sub problems by utilizing a commercial solver to obtain a distribution network source and load storage collaborative scheduling scheme to finish optimal scheduling of the distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power distribution network fault evolution method and system based on typhoon refined mobile modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault evolution method and system based on typhoon refined mobile modeling, and relates to the technical field of power systems. The method comprises the steps of establishing a typhoon refined moving model, calculating disaster-induced fault probability of system elements based on the typhoon refined moving model, generating a power distribution network fault scene and carrying out power flow calculation, and updating a system fault state based on a power flow calculation result to obtain a power distribution network fault evolution chain. The method is used for dynamically adjusting the resolution ratio based on the position relation between the wind speed and the wind ring and the system load center by establishing the typhoon refined moving model, so that the model is suitable for a small-scale power distribution network and can also give consideration to calculation efficiency, by defining the span between the load center and the power grid and combining the step resolution ratio in typhoon path simulation, the fault evolution of the power grid in typhoon scenes is close to the real situation, and by improving the calculation method of the fault caused by the physical impact of disasters, the damage probability calculation of the elements is more accurate.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent control method and system for new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transmission and distribution collaborative consumption intelligent control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of new energy, and comprise the steps of collecting real-time monitoring data of each node in an electric power system and preprocessing; and constructing a complex network model of the power grid according to the adjacency matrix, calculating the power weight of each power transmission line, and storing all data into a relational database and managing. According to the method, the nodes and the edges of the power system are accurately modeled, the adjacency matrix is constructed, the topological structure of the power grid and the power flow of the power transmission line are comprehensively reflected, the load and the running state of the power grid are accurately estimated, errors in the traditional method are avoided, the propagation process of faults in the power grid is simulated in real time by calculating the degrees, the clustering coefficients and the expansion series of the nodes and combining the propagation dynamics model, the speed and the range of the fault propagation are predicted, multi-stage early warning is further realized, the accuracy of evaluating the vulnerability of the power grid is improved, and the stability and the emergency response capability of the power grid are enhanced.

title_en: Water network reconstruction method based on forest water function compounding
abstract_en: The invention provides a water network reconstruction method based on a water-forest function composite, which comprises the following steps of water system characteristic identification and topology structure construction, multidimensional forest stand attribute fusion and evaluation, water network model optimization based on circuit theory, multi-path simulation of a water network regulation and storage function and water forest habitat construction. According to the invention, a water system network topological structure is established by adopting a spectrogram convolution network, multidimensional forest stand attributes are fused, a forest water interaction model is established by adopting a circuit theory, a hydrologic process is simulated, the form of a riverbed is adjusted, the water flow dynamics can be simulated under various situations, the regulation and storage effects of water networks under different paths are evaluated, the water system layout and the hydrologic analysis result are combined, the terrain transformation is implemented, the problems of water green space cutting, ecological function weakness, single greening landscape and the like are solved, the effective regulation and storage space of the riverbed which is green in normal times and water in disaster is increased, the ecological landscape of the forest on water is created, and important tools and strategies are provided for realizing forest water compounding and improving city toughness.
assignees: SHANGHAI ACADEMY OF LANDSCAPE ARCH SCIENCE AND PLANNING

title_en: Refuge site identification method, device and medium based on isolated forest model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a refuge site identification method, device and medium based on an isolated forest model, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting Wi-Fi handshake data in a non-disaster period and carrying out data preprocessing to obtain a training data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing an isolated forest model of an informal refuge site according to a training data set, inputting Wi-Fi handshake data of the informal refuge site in a disaster period into the isolated forest model of the informal refuge site to obtain an abnormal score of each data point, identifying potential refuge sites according to the abnormal scores, and allocating rescue resources for the refuge sites.
