The system and the method can automatically identify the crowd gathering condition of the informal refuge place during the disaster, greatly improve the monitoring capability of the refuge crowd gathering area, monitor the equipment connection and crowd activities during the disaster in real time by using Wi-Fi handshake data, do not depend on extra physical infrastructure, save equipment laying cost and have wide application prospect.

title_en: Urban waterlogging forecasting method, system and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging forecasting method, a system and a related device, belonging to the technical field of disaster forecasting, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical city waterlogging data comprising rainfall characteristics and storm intensity; the method comprises the steps of taking historical urban waterlogging data as a training set, carrying out parameter optimization selection on a KNN algorithm by adopting a grid search algorithm to form a new training set, initializing an attribute list in the new training set by adopting a two-position relation to construct a matrix structure group structure, adopting a fusion RF-ER fusion random forest algorithm to construct waterlogging forecast information root nodes, carrying out secondary optimization training, dividing a dataset of a current node according to the characteristic value of the selected optimal characteristic to obtain a plurality of subsets, carrying out decision tree and single node tree selection on the sample set by adopting a decision tree construction algorithm to obtain a dominant population, and re-obtaining the nearest output result of corresponding rainfall according to the selected dominant population. The invention improves the accuracy of forecasting.

title_en: CNN-BiLSTM-based gas concentration time sequence prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster prediction, in particular to a gas concentration time sequence prediction method based on CNN-BiLSTM. Firstly, a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for carrying out feature extraction on input time sequence data, input features are optimized, the time sequence information of the data is captured by combining a bidirectional long-short-time memory network (BiLSTM) so as to enhance the sensitivity of a model to gas concentration change, then a sparrow search algorithm (SCSSA) is improved by fusing sine and cosine and Cauchy variation, the search performance, global convergence and complex nonlinear optimization capacity are improved, further model super-parameters are optimized, then the initial gas concentration data is decomposed and reconstructed through a fully adaptive noise set empirical mode decomposition (CEEMDAN) so as to extract multi-scale features of the data, finally, a CNN-BiLSTM prediction model is established by a training model, and the performance of the CNN-BiLSTM prediction model is verified through a comparison model and evaluation indexes. The gas concentration time sequence prediction method combines the capabilities of signal decomposition and reconstruction of multi-scale extraction data characteristics, improves the optimizing capability of a search algorithm and the time sequence characteristic extraction and learning capability of deep learning, improves the gas concentration prediction capability, and has great significance for preventing and controlling gas disasters in the coal mining process.

title_en: River basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a drainage basin digital twin construction method and system based on multi-source data fusion. The method is applied to the technical field of drainage basin digital twin construction, and comprises the steps of obtaining water level monitoring data, surface flood evolution path data, weather forecast rainfall data and terrain gradient change data, generating a runoff distribution relation by fusing the rainfall and the terrain gradient data, and identifying a high risk area by combining the water level abrupt change amplitude. And establishing a digital twin primary frame, and generating relevant characteristic parameters by utilizing reverse feedback of the flood path and the water level data. Inputting meteorological data, constructing a twin model based on boundary conditions of a water collecting area, and simulating abnormal flood direction and inundation early warning signals. And generating emergency schemes such as flood diversion gate scheduling, flood storage area starting and the like according to the pre-warning space-time distribution and the terrain elevation data, and realizing risk grading management and control. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the flood inundation prediction precision and emergency response efficiency, and provides accurate decision support for flood control in the river basin.

title_en: Multifunctional transportation cabin of geological disaster investigation equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional transportation cabin of geological disaster investigation equipment, which comprises a machine body, wherein universal wheels are fixedly connected to four corners of the bottom of the machine body, a pushing handle is welded to the left side of the machine body, the pushing handle and the universal wheels are matched for transportation, and a storage mechanism is arranged on the front side of the top of the machine body and used for storing a plurality of groups of drill bits. The invention can store and transport equipment such as drill bits, and the like, and is realized by matching the storage mechanism, the drilling mechanism and the fixing mechanism, so that all drill bits are automatically installed, detached and replaced in the storage mechanism, manual operation by workers is not needed, the invention is convenient and quick, and meanwhile, the invention also provides a blanking mechanism, the soil inside the drill bits after drilling can be flushed out, the investigation on geological disasters is realized, the requirements of the workers are met, the practicability of the device is improved, and the device has substantial improvement and is favorable for popularization and use.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Electrical load fluctuation-based electrical fire monitoring and identifying method and platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric fire monitoring and identifying method and platform based on electric load fluctuation, and relates to the technical field of risk management, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing jump monitoring on electric load and arc data, positioning abnormal nodes and generating a heat map acquisition instruction; the method comprises the steps of collecting equipment distribution area data through an infrared heat map, determining an electric heat map, combining transient and gradual fire types, fusing electric arc and heat map data for training, constructing a risk identification module, inputting jump electric data and the electric heat map into the risk identification module, completing load scene judgment, data preprocessing and disaster analysis, generating electric disaster data, and carrying out electric fire management on the equipment area based on the disaster data. The technical problem of electrical fire risk identification capability is insufficient in the prior art is solved, and the technical effects of improving the accuracy and timeliness of electrical fire risk identification are achieved.

title_en: Debris flow disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow disaster warning method and system, the method comprises the steps of preprocessing an image of a welding part of an automobile, carrying out brightness self-adaptive correction on the processed image, carrying out color enhancement on the brightness corrected image in an RGB space, carrying out pixel point search and center point extraction on the color enhanced image, carrying out parallax matching on the color enhanced images of two different visual angles, carrying out fusion processing on the matched image and a welding seam characteristic image, inputting a training image into a preset recognition model for training, inputting a target welding seam image into the trained preset recognition model for recognition, and outputting a welding seam area recognition result.
assignees: JIANGXI VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV;SHANGRAO GUANGXIN HIGHWAY BUSINESS DEV CENTER

title_en: Deep learning three-dimensional climate simulation method for adding climate to real scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a deep learning three-dimensional climate simulation method for adding climate to a real scene, which belongs to the field of image processing and comprises the steps of inputting a real scene image into a jittor frame, emitting a ray from each pixel of the real scene image, sampling each ray to obtain sampling points and directions, coding, sending the sampling points into a nerve radiation field to predict the color value and the density value of each sampling point, substituting the parameters predicted by the nerve radiation field into a rendering equation, inputting the parameters into volume rendering, so as to keep the color, the depth and the opacity of the sampling points, dividing the weather disaster elements of an input weather disaster picture, reconstructing the weather scene corresponding to the weather disaster, and fusing the final scenes obtained in the previous two steps of the scene to realize effect simulation. According to the invention, through a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, the influence of meteorological disasters on the environment can be intuitively displayed, so that a user can visually feel the situation of the disasters, and the data visualization effect and the propagation efficiency are greatly enhanced.

title_en: Forest fire sample library generation method based on remote sensing inversion
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster monitoring, and provides a forest fire sample library generation method based on remote sensing inversion. According to the invention, the earth surface change in the remote sensing image is subjected to inversion extraction, so that a full-flow intelligent and automatic solution from fire information acquisition to sample data set production is automatically generated. The method not only can automatically produce a large-scale fire sample data set and greatly reduce the time and cost of manual marking, but also provides high-efficiency and accurate data support for training and optimizing fire monitoring and disaster assessment models. The data set generated by the technology can obviously improve the accuracy, response speed and adaptability of the fire monitoring model.

title_en: Intelligent meteorological service method and system triggered by meteorological risk pre-evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent weather service method and system triggered by weather risk pre-evaluation, which relates to the technical field of weather disaster early warning, the method constructs a description vector library of various historical weather disasters, the method provides abundant and high-quality data support for training of the general large model, and the disaster risk pre-evaluation large model is obtained through fine adjustment and retraining of the general large model, so that various meteorological disaster risks can be accurately identified and evaluated. After the user inputs the multi-mode prompt data, the multi-mode prompt data comprises at least one of position data, scene image data and scene video data, and the model can quickly obtain a weather disaster risk assessment result, so that the method gets rid of the technical problem that a weather risk prediction area is limited. Under the condition that the assessment result is that the weather disaster risk exists, the method can trigger intelligent weather service based on the assessment result, and the intelligent weather service can effectively improve the pertinence of weather disaster early warning.

title_en: AI artificial intelligence machine learning system and intelligent gateway
abstract_en: The invention provides an AI artificial intelligent machine learning system and an intelligent gateway, which relate to the technical field of AI artificial intelligent control and comprise a communication module, an edge calculation module and a simulation memory area, wherein the communication module establishes bidirectional connection with an air conditioning unit, a security sensor array and an intelligent lighting network in a building through various Internet of things protocols, acquires equipment operation data streams in real time, and comprises an air conditioning compressor current waveform, a security alarm code and lighting equipment light intensity time sequence data, and the edge calculation module is used for extracting air conditioning energy consumption characteristic values, security alarm signals and environment temperature and humidity data sets according to the equipment operation data streams and storing the processed structured data sets into the simulation memory area through a simulation classification algorithm. The invention realizes the real-time acquisition and processing of the data of the multi-source equipment through the cooperation of the multiple modules, analyzes the information of personnel and environment, intelligently generates control instructions, and adapts to various equipment through protocol conversion, thereby improving the environmental comfort, the safety and the energy utilization efficiency of the building and enhancing the compatibility and the emergency response capability of the system.
assignees: ZOKINRE XIAMEN ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for speech-enabled adaptive training for human pilot verbal data capture and reporting for flight operations quality assurance
abstract_en: A system and method for implementing one or more real-time flight operations quality assurance (RTS-FOQA) systems and protocols is disclosed. RTS-FOQA systems assist pilots and other personnel in managing hazards and risks to protect the safety of passengers, pilots, flight attendants, crew, as well as people on the ground. The system is configured to capture voice data from the cockpit, recognize words spoken by the pilots, air traffic controllers (ATC), and other personnel; convert the recognized words into text; compare the text derived from the words spoken by the pilots, ATC, and other personnel to a standard operational procedure (SOP) sequence, wherein the sequence comprises a plurality of SOP operational steps; identify at least one of a plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots; compare the plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots with the required SOP operational procedures; identify at least one of the plurality of SOP operational steps not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilots; and alert the pilots if and when the pilots fails to execute or incorrectly execute any of the plurality of SOP operational steps. In addition to alerting the pilots of the deviation(s) from the SOP sequence(s), the system may automatically generate a SOP exceedance report for recording the SOP operational step(s) not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilot(s), as well as automatically execute an emergency response, automatically execute an evasive maneuver, and/or automatically implement an autopilot—E.G., initiate execution of remotely-piloted, semi-autonomous, or autonomous, arrival approach, and landing procedures.

title_en: Flat-open air door suitable for mine tunnel wind reversing condition
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mine roadway ventilation, in particular to a side-hung air door suitable for a mine roadway in a windward condition. The utility model has the beneficial effects that the air door can be opened and closed to the two sides for sealing, so that the normal opening and closing requirements under the general condition can be met, and the reverse opening and closing requirements of the wind reversing test, exercise and wind reversing disaster reduction can be met by rapidly replacing the positions of the baffle and the tension spring. Simple structure, convenient reversing and reliable use.
assignees: ZHONGTIAN HECHUANG ENERGY CO LTD;JINAN JIAHONG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery drilling and performance evaluation method and system for multi-cluster distributed training
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of cloud computing and artificial intelligence, in particular to a disaster recovery drilling and performance evaluation system and method for multi-cluster distributed training. Aiming at the disaster recovery and performance evaluation problems in multi-cluster distributed training, the method comprises the steps of environmental analysis and modeling, fault injection and drilling control, cross-cluster scheduling and resource monitoring, performance data acquisition and index aggregation, training result evaluation and tuning closed loop and the like. By identifying multi-cluster environment elements, constructing a mapping relation between faults and indexes, injecting faults by using a fault injection tool, realizing task scheduling and resource monitoring by using a multi-cluster management and monitoring tool, collecting and analyzing performance data, further forming a tuning strategy, and realizing closed-loop management. The invention can dynamically simulate faults, monitor training performance, evaluate disaster recovery and recovery efficiency in a multi-cluster environment, improve system training efficiency and robustness, and meet the requirements of high availability and high performance in the fields of finance, automatic driving and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and equipment for simulating wind field and monitoring and distributing points along railway
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway disaster protection, and discloses a method, a system and equipment for simulating a wind field along a railway and monitoring and distributing points. The method comprises the steps of constructing a circular 3D surface model along a railway line according to longitude and latitude data of the railway line based on a geographic information technology, carrying out smoothing treatment on a transition region of the circular 3D surface model by adopting a square cosine function to obtain a terrain model, carrying out grid division on the terrain model based on all wind directions and carrying out calculation by adopting computational fluid mechanics to obtain a calculation result, judging a potential high wind region in the wind field according to the calculation result based on a full wind direction maximum wind speed region rule or a high wind maximum probability region rule, and determining wind monitoring arrangement positions. According to the invention, a digital 3D terrain model along the railway is constructed by using a geographic information technology, wind field simulation evaluation is performed by combining a computational fluid dynamics CFD technology and railway engineering characteristics, and a potential strong wind area is screened out to realize wind monitoring arrangement position selection, so that the wind field simulation evaluation method is used for wind field evaluation of newly built railways and existing railways.

title_en: Remote sensing image-based structure emergency monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of target detection and relates to a structure emergency monitoring method and system based on remote sensing images, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting high-resolution remote sensing images to construct a structure data set, and dividing the structure data set into a training set and a testing set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a structure scene classifier based on target distribution priori and training by using a training set to obtain the structure scene classifier, constructing a structure rotating target detector based on scene context perception and training by using the training set to obtain a structure rotating target detector, inputting a test set into the structure scene classifier to locate an image of a structure scene, inputting the image of the structure scene into the structure rotating target detector to extract a structure target, generating a structure drawing result, and fusing the structure drawing result with a disaster drawing result generated by a structure emergency monitoring module to obtain a structure disaster-affected drawing result. The invention can rapidly and accurately realize the emergency monitoring of the structure.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reaction equipment control system that can networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system of a reaction device of a networkable unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a central control module, a communication transmission module, a reaction simulation module and a networking analysis module, wherein the communication transmission module is controlled and connected with the central control module, the data transmission of the whole system is formed into a decentralised regional chain structure by the communication transmission modules, so that the safety of the data transmission is ensured, the data is stored by the storage nodes established on different regional distributions, the disaster tolerance of the system is ensured, and the safety and the non-tamper property of the data transmission can be effectively improved; different countering strategies can be appointed to carry out synchronous simulation through the set countering simulation module, then targeted interception countering can be carried out according to simulation results, the countering power of the system is improved, the countering strategy appointed parameters of the whole system are optimized through the large data information of the optimized butt joint networking of the whole system, the operation difficulty of the later-stage manual optimization upgrading is reduced, and the practicability of the system is guaranteed.
assignees: SHANGHAI KONGZHI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rock engineering slope stability classification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rock engineering slope stability classification method. The technical scheme includes that spatial distribution characteristics of a side slope structural surface are obtained through combined detection of three-dimensional laser scanning and geological radar, a quantitative index system comprising structural surface occurrence, density and communication rate is established, a micro-seismic monitoring system is adopted to collect a side slope internal fracture signal in real time, a micro-seismic event energy release rate, a main frequency offset and a seismic source mechanism parameter are extracted through time-frequency analysis, a geological structure evolution inversion model is constructed, a geological structure evolution process is reconstructed based on a regional geological database and field drilling data, and a structure residual stress field distribution characteristic is calculated. The invention realizes comprehensive, accurate and real-time monitoring and classification evaluation of the stability of the rock engineering side slope, can effectively predict potential risks, provides scientific and accurate decision basis for side slope support and treatment, and greatly ensures the safety and stability of the rock engineering side slope.

title_en: Method and system for deciding emergency treatment of natural disaster damage of reservoir dam system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency treatment, and discloses a method and a system for determining natural disaster damage emergency treatment of a dam system, wherein the method comprises the steps of classifying preprocessed multi-source data by using a clustering algorithm and constructing a disaster information database based on a classification result; the method comprises the steps of constructing a risk assessment model to assess damage risk of natural disasters to a dam system, generating a plurality of emergency treatment strategies by combining a multi-objective optimization algorithm, screening out an optimal emergency treatment strategy by using a scene simulation technology, distributing resources by using a dynamic resource distribution algorithm, simulating the dam system in real time by using a digital twin technology to predict the damage risk, executing corresponding emergency treatment measures and recording emergency treatment effect data, assessing the emergency treatment effect data by using a data envelopment analysis algorithm, and optimizing the risk assessment model based on an assessment result. The invention enhances the data integration and processing capacity and improves the accuracy and stability of the prediction result.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;BEIJING IWHR KHL CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster simulation system
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire disaster simulation system. The fire disaster simulation system comprises a display screen, a signal receiving matrix, a simulation fire extinguisher and a simulation controller, wherein the display screen is provided with a plurality of display screens, a fire disaster simulation space is formed by surrounding the plurality of display screens, the signal receiving matrix is provided with a plurality of signal receivers, the signal receiving matrix is arranged on the surface of the display screen, a nozzle of the simulation fire extinguisher is provided with a signal transmitter, the simulation controller is connected with each display screen, and the simulation controller is used for simulating fire points on the display screen by taking the signal receivers as fire points to form a flame image. The technical scheme of the application can effectively improve the training effect and the simulation training efficiency.

title_en: Quantitative regulation and control method for oil-based drilling fluid after being polluted by fracturing fluid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of oil and gas drilling, and particularly provides a quantitative regulation and control method for oil-based drilling fluid after being polluted by fracturing fluid. The method comprises the steps of acquiring key performance parameters including apparent viscosity, plastic viscosity, dynamic shear force, density, oil-water ratio and internal phase water activity of the polluted oil-based drilling fluid in real time through a monitoring system, and judging whether fracturing fluid invades or not according to the key performance parameters. And determining the calcium chloride solid supplementing amount according to the internal phase water activity and the empirical formula. According to the regional drilling fluid formula, the fracturing fluid is adopted as internal matched slurry, and additives such as an emulsifying agent, a filtrate reducer, a plugging agent and the like are combined to form the drilling fluid formula with performance similar to that of the original system, and the density is further regulated to stabilize the stratum. The invention realizes quantitative monitoring and regulation of drilling fluid performance, improves on-site emergency response efficiency, effectively controls cost, ensures underground operation safety, and has stronger practical value and popularization prospect.

title_en: MSADBO-CNN-GRU-Attention-based gas concentration time sequence prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine gas disaster prediction, in particular to a MSADBO-CNN-GRU-Attention-based gas concentration time sequence prediction method. Firstly, dynamic Pearson correlation analysis is used, each index is weighted based on a time window of 1 hour, and key factors of leading gas concentration in different time periods are revealed, so that interference of irrelevant factors is weakened, and meanwhile signal intensity of the key factors is enhanced. And then, carrying out local feature extraction on the data by using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), capturing multi-scale information, learning a long-term dependency relationship of time sequence data by combining a gate control circulating unit (GRU), transmitting state information among time steps, and adding an Attention mechanism to weight the hidden state output by the GRU so as to highlight the importance of key time nodes and improve the accuracy of multi-step prediction. Then, MSADBO is obtained by integrating an improved sine algorithm, a self-adaptive Gaussian-Cauchy mixed variation disturbance and a Bernoulli chaotic mapping improved dung beetle search algorithm, and then the super-parameters of the global self-adaptive optimization model are obtained. Finally, training a model, establishing a MSADBO-CNN-GRU-Attention-based prediction model, and verifying the performance of the model through a comparison model. The gas concentration multi-index multi-step time sequence prediction method combines parameter self-adaptability, feature mining and depth time sequence modeling, improves the gas concentration prediction performance, and provides a solution for high-precision multi-step time sequence prediction of the gas concentration under complex working conditions.

title_en: Fire emergency prevention and control digital intelligent system
abstract_en: The patent discloses a fire emergency prevention and control digital intelligent system, which comprises a fire centralized control module, an emergency rescue module and a logistic support module. According to the invention, a digital development engine, a communication network technology and an AI digital system are utilized, a fire control centralized control module builds a regional live-action 3D model, centralized control is formed on related regional monitoring, rescue workers, vehicle materials, fire control equipment, early warning information and the like, 3D visualization of site and information is realized, risks are analyzed by combining an AI algorithm, potential fire hazards are early warned, a logistic support module realizes centralized management and overall deployment of fire control material equipment, emergency exercise and emergency teams, and the emergency rescue module solves key problems of emergency escape, temporary rescue teams building and allocation, data support of fire control and rescue materials and the like, and provides technical support for efficient rescue in an accident state. The system can effectively change the current situation of the fire-fighting early-warning system, improve the stability and accuracy of the fire-fighting emergency early-warning system, is an effective means for realizing the digital management of the fire-fighting emergency of enterprises, has important significance in improving the emergency response speed and the rescue efficiency, optimizing the resource allocation and the operation and maintenance management and scientific decision, and realizes the 'passive' to 'active' transition of fire prevention and control.

title_en: Distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon time-space evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon space-time evolution, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, establishing a typhoon disaster space-time evolution model, and S2, calculating a power distribution network line time-varying fault rate and a fan time-varying fault rate based on the typhoon disaster space-time evolution model. S3, training a graph attention network based on time-varying failure rate of the nodes to obtain a power distribution network failure rate prediction model based on graph attention, obtaining an actual failure rate prediction value based on the power distribution network failure rate prediction model, S4, obtaining a wind power historical output data set, constructing an uncertainty fuzzy set based on Wasserstein distance, S5, constructing a distributed resource uncertainty trading strategy model considering typhoon time-space evolution, and solving the model to obtain a trading strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the prediction result of the faults of the power distribution network under typhoon conditions, further optimizing the distribution and transaction of power resources and the like.

title_en: Tunnel disaster early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel disaster early warning method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining lithology conditions and geological structures along a tunnel, determining a plurality of types of bad geologic bodies and resistivity ranges thereof, establishing a tunnel finite element simulation model according to lithology conditions, respectively setting the bad geologic bodies at different distances in front of tunnel face of the tunnel finite element simulation model, simulating to obtain a plurality of samples, constructing a data set, wherein the samples comprise the distances, the sample resistivity and the geologic body types, the sample resistivity is the resistivity of the bad geologic bodies measured by the tunnel face, constructing a plurality of machine learning models, training a plurality of machine learning models by utilizing the data set, evaluating model performances, taking the optimal machine learning model as a tunnel disaster early warning model, obtaining the resistivity of the geologic body in front of the tunnel face, and predicting the disaster types appearing in front of the tunnel face according to the resistivity of the geologic body in front of the tunnel face and the tunnel disaster early warning model.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD;SHIYAN CITY WATER SOURCE CO LTD

title_en: Regional flood risk assessment method considering pipeline siltation quantification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional flood risk assessment method considering pipeline siltation quantification, which comprises the steps of collecting a real-time monitoring data set of water level, constructing a two-dimensional flood numerical simulation model by taking the obtained data as input, constructing an influence analysis model of equivalent siltation degree of a pipeline on flood, obtaining data, inputting the data into the two-dimensional flood numerical simulation model, outputting the submerged depth of each flood risk assessment interval, constructing a flood consequence assessment model of each flood risk assessment interval, outputting the flood consequence grade of each flood risk assessment interval, dividing flood probability grades, obtaining flood probability assessment models of each flood risk assessment interval, outputting the flood probability grades, and constructing a probability-consequence coupling assessment model by utilizing an improved risk matrix to obtain a flood risk assessment result. The method can effectively and accurately predict and evaluate the flood risk distribution of the test field under the condition of considering the pipeline diseases, and has important significance for urban flood management and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method oriented to forestry vertical field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method facing the forestry vertical field, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time spectrum data set of forestry resources, wherein the data set comprises spectrograms, geographic information, climate data and real fire probability maps of different time steps in a monitoring area, constructing an ST-SegNet network, comprising a SegNet encoder, a SegNet decoder, a ConvLSTM model, a feature fusion layer and a merging layer, constructing the total loss of the ST-SegNet network, and training the ST-SegNet network to obtain the forestry resource space-time spectrum large model. The invention improves the space-time consistency and classification precision of remote sensing image data, ensures higher-quality data processing, enhances the adaptability to complex scenes through space-time spectrum data fusion, improves the detail processing capability, provides a new technical path for environment monitoring and disaster response, and remarkably improves the efficiency of an emergency early warning system.

title_en: Crude oil storage tank combustion boiling overflow simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of crude oil storage tank safety test, in particular to a crude oil storage tank combustion boiling overflow simulation test device which comprises an experiment table, an oil pan, a sampling assembly and a measuring assembly, wherein the oil pan is connected to the experiment table, the measuring assembly comprises a plurality of heat flow meters, thermocouples, a photographic instrument and an infrared photographic instrument, the plurality of heat flow meters are respectively arranged at the bottom, the middle and the outside of the oil pan and are used for measuring and acquiring heat conduction intensity data inside and outside the oil pan when crude oil is combusted, the thermocouples are connected in the oil pan through a mounting frame and are used for measuring and acquiring temperature at the central line of the oil pan, forming position of a hot zone and temperature data in the hot zone, the photographic instrument is used for acquiring flame height, splashing area outline and combustion area outline image data which change along with time, the infrared photographic instrument is used for acquiring heat radiation area outline image data, and the sampling assembly is connected to one side of the oil pan and is used for non-azeotropic oil sampling detection in the hot zone. The device can provide more comprehensive data support for disaster relief.
assignees: PETROCHINA CO LTD;RES INST SAFETY & ENV TECH CO LTD CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Method and device for constructing tunnel disaster early warning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for constructing a tunnel disaster early warning model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining lithologic conditions and geological structures along a tunnel, determining a plurality of types of bad geologic bodies and resistivity ranges thereof according to the lithologic conditions and the geological structures, building a tunnel finite element simulation model according to the lithologic conditions, respectively setting the bad geologic bodies at different distances in front of tunnel face of the tunnel finite element simulation model, simulating, recording the type of each bad geologic body and the distance between each bad geologic body and the tunnel face to obtain a plurality of samples, constructing a data set, wherein the samples comprise the distance, the sample resistivity and the geologic body type, the sample resistivity is the resistivity of the bad geologic body measured by the tunnel face, constructing a plurality of machine learning models, training the plurality of machine learning models by utilizing the data set, evaluating the model performance, and taking the optimal machine learning model as a tunnel disaster early warning model.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG

title_en: Hidden geological disaster multi-mode remote sensing intelligent identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hidden geological disaster multi-mode remote sensing intelligent identification method which comprises the steps of carrying out normalization processing on multi-mode remote sensing data, constructing a pixel-level cross-mode visual converter, constructing a pixel-level cross-mode attention module which comprises a pixel self-attention sub-module, a pixel mutual attention sub-module and a layer adaptation mixing module, introducing a layer adaptation noise mechanism, adaptively adjusting weight proportions of intra-mode self-attention and inter-mode mutual attention in different layers, constructing a relation discriminator, and carrying out evaluation on inter-mode variability of space corresponding points to modulate an attention calculation process, wherein a training model adopts a multi-task loss function to comprise semantic segmentation loss and boundary perception loss joint optimization, so as to generate a hidden geological disaster segmentation result. According to the method, complementary information of the RGB optical image, the InSAR deformation rate image and the DEM elevation data is fully utilized, and accurate identification of hidden geological disasters is achieved through an efficient pixel-level cross-modal fusion mechanism.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY DESIGN CORP;AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHINA RAILWAY GUANGZHOU BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY CONSULTANTS

title_en: Winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method for fusing reduced-scale sunlight-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF) data. A winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method integrating reduced scale SIF data comprises the steps of S1, selecting SIF data reconstruction machine learning model input data, including MODIS reflectivity, fPAR, LAI, ERA5 analysis data temperature, saturated water vapor pressure difference, photosynthetic effective radiation and soil humidity data, S2, training and constructing a machine learning model, S3, constructing a long time sequence high resolution reduced scale SIF product data set and checking effects, and S4, constructing a novel drought fluorescence monitoring index. The winter wheat drought remote sensing monitoring method provided by the invention has the advantages of solving the problem of how to combine SIF information to mechanically improve the timeliness and accuracy of agricultural drought monitoring and effectively improve the disaster prevention and reduction capability of agricultural weather.

title_en: Life detection device used in collapses and under debris
abstract_en: The present disclosure is a life detection device comprising an outer and inner ring (2, 3) containing sensor units (9), speaker (14), wireless communication module (15) and similar data sensors and transmitters in order to detect life much faster after a disaster or accident, to perform more accurate search/rescue operations by detecting the locations of living beings trapped under collapse/debris, and to prioritise rescue operations after life status determinations are made upon the search. It is a life detection device that does not require any training or expertise, is single-use, has an outer cage (1 ) that protects the important parts inside and the circuit board (5) and allows it to roll, has a round shape, a flexible structure that can be rolled, and can easily move in collapsed areas and under debris.
assignees: SUELEYMAN DEMIREL UENIVERSITESI IDARI VE MALI ISLER DAIRE BASKANLIGI GENEL SEKRETERLIK

title_en: Test device for simulating cascade collapse of adjacent underground structure caused by foundation pit collapse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for simulating cascade collapse of adjacent underground structures caused by foundation pit collapse, which relates to the field of foundation pit indoor model test, and comprises a model box, wherein sand is filled in the model box, a foundation pit model and an underground structure model are arranged in the model box, a data monitoring system is arranged in the model box, the foundation pit and the underground structure are respectively simulated by arranging the foundation pit model and the underground structure model, the foundation pit model collapse and the adjacent underground structure model collapse are caused by excavating sand, the transient process of foundation pit collapse and even adjacent underground structure cascade collapse is simulated relatively truly, the technical innovation from deformation research of a traditional model test to transient stability problem research in cascade collapse accidents is realized, hidden danger in actual engineering can be analyzed and researched through data information obtained by a data monitoring system, and effective data support is provided for disaster prevention.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION INFRASTRUCTURE CO LTD;UNIV TIANJIN

title_en: Material throwing type bionic ornithopter
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a material throwing type bionic flapping wing unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a material throwing mechanism and a flapping wing mechanism, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle main body comprises a first front support, a second front support, a rear support and a main shaft, the material throwing mechanism is arranged on the main shaft and used for storing and throwing materials, and the flapping wing mechanism is arranged on two sides of the first front support and the second front support and used for simulating wing flapping to realize flying. The unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled by the arduino single chip microcomputer to take off and land, the material throwing and steering are controlled by the multipath steering engine, meanwhile, the 4G communication is used for information transmission, the bionic flapping wing unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled in a long distance, the urgent nature of the medical protection material demand of a major disaster area is solved, the problem of limited medical protection material distribution of the disaster area is better solved, and therefore the emergency material demand and emergency medical drug transportation are solved, and meanwhile, emergency drugs and substances can be timely thrown in the emergency situation occurring on the road aiming at the congested urban traffic.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method of operating same for measuring density of moving population and providing disaster notification service in camera surveillance system
title_ko: 카메라 감시 시스템에서 유동 인구의 밀집도를 측정하고 재난 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 전자 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operating method of an electronic device (100) for measuring the density of a floating population in a camera monitoring system and providing a disaster notification service. The operating method comprises: a pre-training operation (420); and an inference operation (430) based on the pre-training operation (420). The pre-training operation (420) includes: an operation (510) of determining maximum movable number information (640) indicating the maximum number of objects that can be accommodated; and an operation (520) of generating and storing a plurality of density models having different classification levels and alarm reference values according to the area of a movable area and the maximum movable number. An electronic device for measuring the density of a floating population and providing a disaster notification service in a camera monitoring system and an operating method thereof according to the present invention can realize accurate inference performance by determining an area in which an object can move from an image photographed through a camera and identifying the population density of the area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 카메라 감시 시스템에서 유동 인구에 대한 밀집도를 측정하고 재난 알림 서비스를 제공하기 위한 전자 장치(100)의 동작 방법은, 미리 정의된 세그먼테이션 네트워크(segmentation network) 모델(620)에 기초하여 상기 전자 장치(100)의 카메라(120)를 통해 촬영된 제1 영상(610)에 포함되는 특정 지역 내에서 객체가 이동 가능한 유동 가능 지역의 면적(630) 및 상기 면적에 따라 상기 유동 가능 지역에서 최대로 수용이 가능한 객체의 수를 지시하는 최대 유동 가능 인원 정보(640)를 결정하는 동작(510); 상기 최대 유동 가능 인원 정보에 기초하여 상기 유동 가능 지역 내에 위치하는 객체의 밀집 정도를 지시하는 제1 분류 수준(650)을 결정하고, 상기 제1 분류 수준(650)에 기초하여 유동 가능 지역의 면적 및 최대 유동 가능 인원에 따라 상이한 분류 수준 및 알람 기준 값을 갖는 복수의 밀집도 모델들을 생성 및 저장하는 동작(520); 상기 카메라(120)를 통해 상기 특정 지역 및 상기 특정 지역에 위치하는 객체를 촬영하여 제2 영상을 생성하는 동작(530); 상기 제2 영상에 기초하여 상기 복수의 밀집도 모델들 중 상기 제2 영상에 대응하는 제2 분류 수준을 갖는 밀집도 모델을 결정하는 동작(540); 미리 정의된 객체 검출(object detection) 모델에 기초하여 제2 영상의 밀집도를 결정하는 동작(550); 상기 제2 영상의 밀집도가 상기 제2 분류 수준의 알람 기준 값을 초과하는지 여부를 결정하는 동작(560); 및 상기 밀집도가 상기 알람 기준 값을 초과하는 경우, 상기 제2 지역에 대한 재난 위험을 알리기 위한 재난 위험 정보를 서버(200)에게 전송하는 동작(570);를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: DOOWON ELECTRONICS & TELECOM CO LTD;LEE SANG SUK

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow process simulation method based on rheological evolution characteristics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of mountain torrent and debris flow disasters, and provides a mountain torrent and debris flow process simulation method based on rheological evolution characteristics, which comprises the following steps: and establishing a target channel generalized numerical model, simulating a sediment particle transferring process in the generalized numerical model under the action of water flow or mud-rock flow slurry by adopting a CFD-DEM coupling model, and realizing real-time adjustment of rheological parameters in the simulated mountain torrent mud-rock flow transferring process by adopting a bidirectional coupling mechanism of the CFD-DEM coupling model on the basis of the semi-empirical relation between the resistance coefficient of the mountain torrent mud-rock flow carried sediment particles obtained by deduction in motion and the Reynolds number in the simulation process. The method can simulate the space distribution of the sediment particles in the process of transporting and transferring the torrent mud-rock flow more truly, increases the accuracy of the simulation of the torrent mud-rock flow process, and solves the problem that the rheological evolution phenomenon of the torrent mud-rock flow is caused by the fact that the prior art is difficult to simulate the change of the volume sand content of the torrent mud-rock flow.

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk prediction method, medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of urban disaster prevention and relates to a method, a medium and a terminal for urban waterlogging risk prediction, which comprise the steps of S10, constructing a flooding numerical simulation model, namely an SWMM model, S20, collecting historical actual measurement scene rainfall data, importing the SWMM model and outputting waterlogging node risk to obtain a node risk sample, constructing a rainfall input mode by considering rainfall characteristic values and disaster-causing continuity of the rainfall characteristic values to obtain a rainfall sample, constructing a training sample set of rainfall and the node risk, S30, taking scene rainfall as input, taking the waterlogging node risk as output, constructing a node risk prediction model based on a BP neural network, and S40, quantifying the regional waterlogging risk by an entropy weight method to obtain a regional waterlogging risk value so as to realize urban waterlogging risk prediction. The method has the advantages of simple flow and convenient operation, and effectively improves the accuracy and timeliness of urban waterlogging risk prediction.

title_en: Method for treating coal natural ignition disasters in high-rise areas of underground coal roadways of coal mines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating natural ignition disasters of coal in a coal mine underground coal roadway high-rise area. The method comprises the steps of firstly determining a natural ignition area of a high-rise area of a coal roadway by adopting a detection technology, fixing a fireproof carbon-fixing material on the top of the roadway through a construction anchor rod, covering the ignition area and a front-rear 5m range of the ignition area along the roadway trend, then uniformly spraying water to the surface of the fireproof carbon-fixing material by utilizing a downhole water pipe until a lower fabric layer and a lower filling layer of the fireproof carbon-fixing material are completely wetted, constructing a drilling hole to the high-rise natural ignition area after the lower fabric layer and the lower filling layer are condensed and formed, finally, pouring liquid CO  2  into the high-rise area through the drilling hole to quickly cool down the high-temperature coal body, continuing pouring inorganic carbon-fixing slurry material to completely fill the high-rise area after the ignition area is extinguished, further pouring coal in the flue gas inerting high-rise area of a power plant on the basis, increasing filling strength and compactness through mineralization reaction of flue gas CO  2  and the inorganic carbon-fixing slurry material, and stopping leakage of the high-rise area and suppressing natural ignition of the coal.

title_en: Agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural disaster treatment, and discloses an agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data. The method comprises the steps of receiving heterogeneous meteorological data flow of a target area, performing space-time alignment and feature fusion through a disaster feature decoupling model, and generating a disaster potential energy field distribution map and a disaster category probability matrix. And constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold model, and generating a multi-mode emergency response instruction set. Simulating a disaster secondary event cascade effect by using a disaster chain propagation model, optimizing collaborative decision parameters, and outputting a disaster response action sequence to an agricultural emergency command platform through iterative optimization of a distributed reinforcement learning framework. According to the method, meteorological big data are comprehensively utilized, the early warning accuracy of agricultural disasters is improved, high-efficiency emergency response is achieved, resources are reasonably allocated, cross-department coordination is promoted, and the agricultural disaster loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: Fire disaster simulation system under effect of variable-angle ambient wind and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire simulation tests, and discloses a fire simulation system and a control method under the action of variable-angle ambient wind, wherein the fire simulation system comprises a first bracket, a first wind tunnel and a second wind tunnel, wherein the first bracket is provided with a wind tunnel; the second bracket is positioned in the direction of the wind tunnel outlet, the second bracket is rotationally connected with a shaft lever, the shaft lever is in transmission connection with a first adjusting mechanism, the shaft lever is controlled to rotate through the first adjusting mechanism, the shaft lever is fixedly connected with a supporting platform, the supporting platform is fixedly connected with a fireproof plate, the supporting platform is rotationally connected with a mounting bracket through a rotating shaft, the mounting bracket is detachably connected with a burner, the rotating shaft is vertically arranged with the shaft lever, the second adjusting mechanism is connected between the mounting rack and the supporting platform in a transmission way, and the supporting platform is controlled to rotate along the rotating shaft by the second adjusting mechanism.

title_en: Geological disaster risk intelligent management and control method and system based on big data and intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster risk intelligent management and control method and system based on big data and an intelligent algorithm. And collecting and preprocessing the multi-source big data of topography, geology and weather, ensuring the data to be rich and accurate, and laying a foundation for subsequent evaluation. And constructing a database by using the GIS, playing the space analysis function, and supporting landslide vulnerability calculation. And a neural network artificial intelligent model is adopted, and historical data training is combined, so that risk assessment accuracy is improved. And the mean shift clustering algorithm is used for dividing the vulnerability interval, so that the method is scientific and objective. And a visual vulnerability graph is generated, so that risk information can be mastered conveniently and quickly. According to the graph, differential control measures are adopted for different level areas, so that the method is accurate and efficient. The scheme can early warn and prevent disasters in advance, reduce casualties and property loss, can reasonably plan construction, reduce negative effects of disasters on social economy, and promote sustainable development of areas.

title_en: Real-time simulation method and system for power system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data simulation, in particular to a real-time simulation method and system for an electric power system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power frequency data, carrying out data preprocessing on the power frequency data to generate power frequency preprocessed data, carrying out power characteristic extraction on the power frequency preprocessed data to generate a power frequency characteristic data set, carrying out power system simulation model construction on the basis of the power frequency characteristic data set to generate a power system simulation data model, and carrying out simulation effect quality assessment on the power system simulation data model to complete real-time simulation operation of the power system. Therefore, the invention solves the problems of high computational complexity and low prediction accuracy of the traditional power system simulation model by optimizing the data processing flow and improving the precision and stability of the simulation model, and improves the intelligent level and emergency response capability of the power system operation.
assignees: SHENZHEN RUNDONGLAI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prediction method and system for driving fault influence range of high-speed railway
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-speed railways, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the driving fault influence range of a high-speed railway. The method for predicting the running fault influence range of the high-speed railway comprises the steps of taking historical running fault data of the high-speed railway as training data, constructing a big data model for predicting fault influence time, after running faults occur, taking current running fault data of the high-speed railway as input data, obtaining the fault influence time based on the big data model, pushing the predicted departure time of a train after the running faults at a subsequent station under the condition that the running sequence and the running path of the train are not changed according to the fault influence time, and comparing the planned running time of the train to obtain the number of the trains affected by the faults and the later conditions of the specific trains at each station. The invention can provide reference for train dispatcher in railway fault emergency, and improve the efficiency and accuracy of railway fault emergency response.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Airport terminal passenger emergency evacuation path optimization method based on improved A-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a station building fire evacuation path optimization method based on an improved A-algorithm, which comprises the following steps: (1) Analyzing the flow of the personnel of the terminal building, and finishing the real flight data to perform pretreatment; (2) Simulating the flow of the personnel of the terminal building by using a simulation model, and arranging personnel distribution data; (3) Analyzing the fire disaster reason of the terminal building, and simulating the fire disaster of the terminal building by using fire simulation aiming at the high-ignition fire disaster reason to obtain the fire disaster product data of the terminal building; (4) The method comprises the steps of improving a path planning algorithm, coupling personnel distribution and fire spread data, and re-planning a congestion path; the invention provides a new solution for emergency evacuation of fire disaster in the terminal building and scientific practice guidance for emergency evacuation in complex environments such as the terminal building.

title_en: Falling stone movement track analysis method
abstract_en: The invention provides a falling rock movement track analysis method, which belongs to the field of engineering geology and geological disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of obtaining falling rock characteristic parameters and slope characteristic parameters of dangerous rock mass in a research area, and constructing a dangerous rock mass three-dimensional model in the research area according to the falling rock characteristic parameters and the slope characteristic parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating a falling stone movement process when a dangerous rock body three-dimensional model in a research area collapses, constructing a falling stone movement balance equation by considering air resistance and a vertical downward Magnus force generated when falling stones self-rotate in the air, applying an initial speed to the falling stones in the vertical direction, calculating acceleration of the falling stones falling on a slope by using the falling stone movement balance equation, analyzing movement characteristic parameters of the falling stones according to the acceleration, and analyzing movement tracks of the falling stones according to the movement characteristic parameters. The invention can obtain more reliable motion characteristic parameters, and accurately analyze the motion trail of the falling rocks through the motion characteristic parameters.

title_en: Ship safety protection system and method for hydrogen fuel cell
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrogen fuel cell ship safety protection system and a method, which relate to the technical field of ship safety, and comprise the steps of starting multi-mode sensors in all areas, embedding an edge processing unit, and executing self-checking and calibration; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing sensor data by an edge processing unit to obtain original data, constructing a three-dimensional virtual model of a ship and each area based on the original data, simulating hydrogen diffusion and fire evolution process by combining real-time CFD simulation to obtain risk prediction parameters and preset safety thresholds, triggering an emergency response plan according to an active dispatching control command in a grading manner according to a risk grade, comparing field feedback information with an execution state to verify the emergency response plan and form a safety protection report, and dynamically adjusting the emergency response plan through a risk index.

title_en: Landslide hazard assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard assessment method and system, which relate to the field of geological disaster assessment and comprise the steps of predicting landslide hazard occurrence probability of sample points through a positive sample and uniform sample training landslide hazard probability model, and optimizing by using an artificial bee colony algorithm; in the training process, comparing the predicted density for measuring the range of landslide disasters occurring in a research area with a set threshold value, acquiring corresponding fitness according to a comparison result, using the fitness as negative constraint of a model, using an artificial bee colony algorithm to iteratively search new constant items and pregnant factor weight items to obtain a trained landslide hazard probability model, acquiring geological disaster occurrence probability according to the trained landslide hazard probability model, and evaluating landslide hazard through the geological disaster occurrence probability. The invention can only use the positive sample to train the landslide hazard risk probability model and simultaneously consider the spatial distribution of the landslide hazard risk probability.

title_en: Distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for building group
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed fire situation sensing and collaborative early warning method for a building group, which relates to the technical field of building groups and comprises the steps of collecting fire data through smoke sensing, temperature sensing and infrared imaging nodes, generating a fire feature vector by adopting a distributed preprocessing algorithm, and constructing a multidimensional fire correlation matrix; and training based on the graph structure neural network to generate a dynamic evolution model of the building group fire disaster, and calculating a fire disaster spread prediction result by combining with a digital twin platform of the building group to generate a differential early warning instruction. The intelligent sensing, dynamic prediction and collaborative early warning of the fire conditions of the building group are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning are improved.
assignees: ARIC DALIAN SAFETY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a water storage cavity is formed in the water tank, a spraying component is arranged in the water tank and is matched with a water gun nozzle for use, and a camera main body is arranged on a fixed disc in a sliding manner. According to the invention, through the arranged spraying assembly and the camera body, the range of water sprayed by the spraying assembly can be adjusted through the picture transmitted by the camera body, the spraying range of the spraying assembly is adjusted to the maximum state when the camera body shows that the sprayed flame is reduced in size, the spraying range of the spraying assembly is gradually reduced until the flame is intensively sprayed and sprayed to the fire root of fire, and the fire point is extinguished, so that the fire extinguishing effect is achieved, the range of water sprayed by the water gun spray head is adjusted according to the fire condition, the fire extinguishing operation of firefighters is simulated, and the fire extinguishing effect can be effectively and rapidly realized.

title_en: Tunnel advanced geological forecast risk early warning method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel early warning, and particularly relates to a tunnel advanced geological forecast risk early warning method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out non-contact scanning on geological conditions in front of tunneling to obtain geological data; preprocessing the acquired geological data, carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the preprocessed geological data to construct a three-dimensional model of a geological structure in front of the tunnel, identifying potential bad geological bodies based on the constructed three-dimensional geological model, and acquiring the geological data through non-contact scanning, so that the interference of the traditional exploration method under complex geological conditions is avoided, and the data quality and the forecasting precision are effectively improved. Compared with the traditional geological exploration and drilling sampling method, the risk assessment method has the advantages that risk assessment is carried out through the geological disaster risk assessment model which is built in advance, risk classification is carried out according to the risk assessment result, different early warning thresholds are set, a large amount of manpower and material resource investment is not needed, and construction cost is reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHENGCHEN POLYTRON TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide surface-like deformation monitoring method based on coupling deep learning and InSAR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surface shape deformation monitoring method of coupling deep learning and InSAR technology, which relates to the field of landslide disaster prediction and forecast, and mainly comprises the steps of processing SAR influence data by utilizing a short baseline set technology to obtain landslide displacement time sequence data, carrying out relevance analysis by combining the influence factor data to obtain a landslide deformation associated factor layer, and constructing a training set and a testing set; training the multichannel convolutional neural network by using a training set to obtain a trained multichannel convolutional neural network, predicting a testing set to obtain a landslide surface-shaped displacement grid map of each time point, and integrating the landslide surface-shaped displacement grid map to obtain the prediction results of all time sequences of the whole landslide region. By implementing the coupling deep learning and InSAR technology landslide surface shape deformation monitoring method provided by the invention, the accuracy of monitoring the landslide surface shape deformation can be improved.

title_en: Goaf spontaneous combustion dangerous area judging method and system in working face retraction stage
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine disaster prediction, and discloses a method and a system for judging spontaneous combustion dangerous areas of goafs in a working face withdrawal stage. The method comprises the steps of determining goaf air gap development to form an influence of an air leakage channel on a spontaneous combustion dangerous area, verifying the influence of coal loss distribution on the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the goaf, determining the influence of void ratio and distribution on the spontaneous combustion dangerous area of the goaf after coal discharge amount of a working face is reduced, shrinking air on the working face during withdrawal, switching full negative pressure ventilation of the working face to positive pressure ventilation of a local ventilator after a later-stage end hydraulic support is withdrawn, and introducing a void ratio and coal loss distribution change formula into FLUENT numerical simulation software by using CFD-DEM simulation results. The invention provides technical basis for judging the spontaneous combustion high-risk area of the goaf from the end of mining to the withdrawal of the working face, and the technical standardization and standardization development of the power-assisted industry, and avoids the generation of gases such as CO and CO  2  caused by spontaneous combustion of the goaf.

title_en: Response system of informationized network platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a response system of an informationized network platform, which comprises a multi-mode data intelligent identification module, a layered scheduling and path optimizing module, a remote expert cooperation and auxiliary decision-making module and a self-learning closed loop and continuous optimizing module. The method comprises the steps of realizing quick recognition and priority distribution of emergency calls by fusing voice recognition, wearable equipment vital sign acquisition, video image analysis and deep learning algorithm, carrying out intelligent matching and dynamic path planning of an ambulance by adopting reinforcement learning technology and hierarchical optimization strategy, constructing a remote expert cooperation environment by means of 5G communication and AR glasses, and providing real-time medical guidance and auxiliary decision. The system also performs complete data recording and periodic model training for each emergency procedure to continuously improve the efficiency and accuracy of event identification, resource scheduling and remote collaboration. The invention is suitable for the scenes of medical emergency centers, hospital emergency response and the like before the urban hospital.
assignees: HUNAN PROVINCIAL PEOPLES HOSPITAL THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF HUNAN NORMAL UNIV

title_en: Disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of computer application, and comprises Markov process modeling based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, a deep neural network comprising a codec based on an attention mechanism and corresponding training and application methods; the method comprises the steps of establishing a problem formalized expression of disaster relief material distribution through Markov process modeling, and providing a deep neural network for learning a vehicle team strategy, wherein an encoder takes a distribution task target place as input, outputs an embedded vector of the target place, and combines an environment state and the embedded vector to output a next task point of a vehicle, training of the neural network depends on a simulation environment and a classical multi-agent reinforcement learning training algorithm, the trained network can be deployed in a real scene, and the algorithm is provided for solving the problems of high time requirement, unknown material requirement, complex vehicle cooperation and the like in an emergency disaster relief scene and can be used for various emergency material delivery scenes.

title_en: Mining with strip pressure relief
abstract_en: Strip relief mining is a further study of existing class 2 zone outburst prevention measures. Can control the gas to a state without gas emission basically, thoroughly eliminate the gas disasters and thoroughly improve the unit yield. 2, the mining of the strip pressure relief is effective in solving the problem of the outburst of the gas of the chamotte coal mine, and can thoroughly solve the problem of the restriction of the gas production, so that the unit yield is improved to the greatest extent. And 3, selecting the coiled 307 coal mining work for trial run for the coiled coal mine. The method is as follows. ① Parallel cutting holes are drilled on parallel layers from the air lane to the machine lane, and two lanes of fans are drilled. The pitch of the holes was 10m. ② And (3) digging a narrow roadway from the roadway to the air roadway along parallel drilling holes, and digging two roadways of the ventilator. ③ The tunneling ventilation mode adopts drilling wind guiding to ventilate. ④ The narrow lane width is not more than 2.0m. ⑤ The strip pressure relief mining advances the fully mechanized face mining for at least 30 days. ⑥ The strip pressure relief mining is performed in the main mining coal seam without increasing the overall cost. ⑦ The strip pressure relief mining is applicable to any gas mine.
assignees: PINGDINGSHAN KANGFA COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical monitoring data set of an emergency event in a target area, preprocessing the historical monitoring data set, and generating a standardized event feature set; training a time sequence prediction model according to dynamic environment parameters to obtain an event evolution prediction model, constructing a geographic region matching model based on static geographic parameters, and generating a visual layer template associated with a target region. And collecting the current environmental data flow of the target area in real time, classifying by an event evolution prediction model to obtain an event classification result, and calling a corresponding visual layer template from a geographic area matching model according to the event classification result. And fusing a diffusion path, an intensity level and a called visual layer template in the event classification result, generating a dynamic visual instruction set, and rendering and outputting an emergency event evolution situation map through an interactive interface. The invention can improve the timeliness and the decision reliability of emergency response.

title_en: Application of environment factor optimization TSES method for selecting negative sample in landslide susceptibility evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses application of an environmental factor optimization TSES method in landslide vulnerability evaluation, and particularly relates to the landslide disaster prevention field, which comprises the steps of (1) interpreting landslide and selecting environmental factors to construct a landslide database, (2) establishing a negative sample set, calculating factor contribution values and screening factors by using a Relief algorithm, establishing a negative sample by using a TSES method, establishing another 2 negative sample sets according to a coupling information quantity method and a TSES method, (3) modeling, integrating the positive sample and the negative sample of the landslide to establish a training set, modeling by using a random forest model, (4) evaluating model precision, and evaluating and comparing 3 models by using a confusion matrix and an ROC curve.
