The TSES method for optimizing the environmental factors can improve the precision of the model, solve the problem of factor selection in sampling by taking multiple factors as constraint conditions, and provide a new thought for evaluating and collecting negative samples of landslide susceptibility.

title_en: Screening method of foam extinguishing agent components for photovoltaic power station based on molecular simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of foam extinguishing agents, in particular to a molecular simulation-based screening method of foam extinguishing agent components for a photovoltaic power station, the invention adopts a molecular simulation method to screen the material of the fire extinguishing agent selected for the photovoltaic fire disaster, and the method is mainly aimed at the inflammable photovoltaic components in the photovoltaic power station to screen the high-efficiency fire extinguishing agent matched with the inflammable photovoltaic components. The molecular simulation method can reveal the interaction relation between the surface of the flammable photovoltaic module and the foam extinguishing agent from the microscopic molecular angle, simulate various matching conditions in a short time, and can screen out a compound scheme with the best effect from various surfactants and foam stabilizers. So as to provide theoretical support for foam extinguishing agents used for the fire disaster of the photovoltaic power station. The method is convenient and practical, and has wide application prospect and guidance value for the field of foam extinguishing agent development.

title_en: Training evaluation method and system based on big data cabin escape mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training evaluation method and a training evaluation system based on a big data cabin escape mode, and relates to the technical field of big data intelligent information processing. According to the training evaluation method based on the big data cabin escape mode, training parameters and roles are intelligently configured, and the pertinence and effectiveness of training are improved. Meanwhile, a training scene conforming to the actual situation is constructed by utilizing multidimensional analysis, so that the immersion sense and actual combat of training are improved, and the emergency response capability of students is enhanced. And deep mining is carried out on the collected data by utilizing the big data analysis platform and the constructed mathematical evaluation model, so that a specific numeric training evaluation result is generated, and the training performance of a learner is comprehensively reflected.

title_en: Method for tunneling ultra-deep shaft step blasting energy release support of metal ore
abstract_en: The application provides a method for tunneling a step blasting energy release support of an ultra-deep vertical shaft of a metal mine, which belongs to the technical field of energy release support of the ultra-deep vertical shaft of the metal mine, and comprises the steps of obtaining engineering geological information, dividing the quality grades of horizontal surrounding rock mass of different depths of a shaft according to the engineering geological information, and evaluating the rock blasting tendency grades of the surrounding rock of different depths of the shaft; dividing a shaft circulating excavation section according to engineering geological information, determining a shaft rock drilling blasting parameter, determining a stepped excavation construction mode, a support mode and a support parameter according to engineering geological information and rock explosion tendency grade, loading rock and deslagging, obtaining concrete lining permanent support time, and performing anchor network temporary support and concrete lining permanent support on an ultra-deep shaft. Through the combination form of step blasting and temporary support, in the unstable stratum region of deep high stress, release surrounding rock pressure, absorption rock mass power impact reduce rock burst disaster risk, improve pit shaft construction security.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;SANSHANDAO GOLD MINE SHANDONG GOLD MINING LAIZHOU CO LTD;CHINA COAL NO 5 CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing barrier lake burst risk simulation model by considering manual intervention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a barrier lake burst risk simulation model by considering manual intervention, which comprises the steps of establishing a quantitative model of the influence of manual intervention on a barrier lake burst flood peak and a risk population, establishing a disaster-bearing body loss function under the condition of manual intervention, quantitatively evaluating the influence of the manual intervention on a barrier lake burst disaster chain and predicting the risk by the quantitative model and the loss function, supporting the comparison and selection of multiple-scene rescue emergency schemes under different manual intervention intensities, providing more scientific technical support for barrier lake rescue, and obviously improving the prediction precision of risk loss under the condition of manual intervention.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Scene-oriented forest fire dynamic risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk assessment, in particular to a scene-oriented forest fire dynamic risk assessment method, which solves the problems that the existing model depends on existing data, has poor adaptability to sudden fires or multi-scene conditions and is difficult to meet real-time and accurate assessment requirements. According to the method, the risk assessment framework capable of being dynamically updated is constructed through the technologies of fire behavior simulation, semantic modeling, comprehensive risk assessment model construction and the like, and by means of the method, real-time monitoring and prediction of fire risks can be achieved, and disaster prevention and reduction capacity is improved.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Geological risk analysis method for landslide model threshold simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide model threshold simulation geological risk analysis method which comprises the following steps of constructing a foundation of a landslide model, utilizing a three-dimensional laser scanner to scan the surface of a target slope, obtaining three-dimensional point cloud data of the target slope, conducting optimization processing on the three-dimensional point cloud data to obtain a complete landslide model, establishing the landslide threshold model, constructing a mapping between water content and cohesive force in soil, calculating the current water content of the soil according to the current rainfall intensity of the target slope, inputting the mapping into the landslide threshold model, and evaluating geological risk of the target slope. The invention builds a simple landslide model for researching the characteristics of shallow soil landslide, provides a method for researching the influence of rainfall on slope stability and preventing and controlling landslide geological disasters, provides a new thought for landslide early warning, provides scientific basis for early warning and preventing and controlling landslide disasters, and has important practical application value.

title_en: Forest fire scale burning test system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire disaster reduced scale combustion, and discloses a forest fire disaster reduced scale combustion test system. The forest fire reduced scale combustion test system comprises a main testing device, a cover body, a cover cavity, an environment regulating device, a data collecting and displaying device and a data information recording device, wherein the main testing device supports forest combustible samples, the ignition device is used for igniting the forest combustible samples, the cover body is arranged on the outer side of the main testing device in a covering mode, smoke exhaust ports are formed in the periphery of the cover body, a cover cavity in the cover body is a negative pressure cavity, smoke generated by combustion of the forest combustible samples on the main testing device is discharged out of the cover cavity through the smoke exhaust ports, the environment regulating device is used for regulating and controlling wind speed conditions in the cover cavity, and the data collecting and displaying device is used for collecting and recording temperature and humidity change conditions in the cover cavity and displaying flame synchronous simulation images and/or smoke data information discharged through the smoke exhaust ports. According to the invention, the wind speed in the cover cavity is regulated and controlled by the environment regulating and controlling device, the combustion of combustible matters in the forest and the spreading rule of fire under different wind conditions in the forest are simulated, and data support is provided for fire prevention and control.

title_en: FastSAM-P-based real-time segmentation method for fire loss of building component
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire damage detection methods, in particular to a FastSAM-P-based building member fire damage real-time segmentation method which comprises the following steps of 1, defining types and characteristics of concrete bursting on the surface of an RC structural member and exposed ribs of a reinforcing steel bar after a fire disaster, constructing a corresponding data set for network training and verification, 2, formulating a training strategy and an evaluation index, and 3, constructing a FastSAM-P-based building member fire damage real-time segmentation network architecture. Compared with the traditional segmentation network, the invention realizes the collaborative optimization of segmentation precision and reasoning speed in the task of identifying the building fire loss, and has obvious technical advancement and industrial application value.

title_en: Rock burst prevention and control device for insensitive hard rock based on combination of water power and microwaves
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel construction and deep engineering disaster prevention and control, and provides a rock burst prevention and control device for insensitive hard rock based on hydraulic and microwave combination, which comprises a vehicle-mounted system, a hydraulic fracturing system and a microwave transmitting system; the invention discloses a hydraulic fracturing system, which is used for injecting water into insensitive hard rock drilling holes, forming hydraulic fracturing cracks on the circumferential wall surfaces of the insensitive hard rock drilling holes, then injecting sensitive mineral propping agents to fill the hydraulic fracturing cracks, and moving the sensitive mineral propping agents into the insensitive hard rock drilling holes for microwave irradiation after the sensitive mineral propping agents are injected.

title_en: Automatic intelligent evacuation path generation system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent evacuation, and discloses an intelligent evacuation path automatic generation system and method based on artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of collecting building modeling data, wherein the building modeling data comprise building key parameters and equipment resource parameters, carrying out modeling according to the building modeling data to obtain a building simulation model, defining personnel characteristic parameters and disaster characteristic parameters on the building simulation model to obtain an intelligent evacuation simulation model, and adaptively generating an evacuation path according to the intelligent evacuation simulation model.
assignees: BEIJING HUANZHONG RUICHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Microwave fracturing equipment for deep insensitive hard rock drilling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel construction and disaster prevention and control of deep engineering, and provides microwave fracturing equipment for deep insensitive hard rock drilling, wherein a slurry spraying system and a microwave transmitting system are respectively arranged on a vehicle-mounted system through a mobile platform; the slurry spraying system is used for conveying slurry into the insensitive hard rock drilling hole and forming a sensitive mineral coating on the inner wall surface of the insensitive hard rock drilling hole; the microwave radiation system is used for carrying out microwave irradiation in insensitive hard rock drilling holes for forming sensitive mineral coatings, the temperature of the insensitive hard rock surface is raised through the sensitive mineral coatings, the temperature gradient between a high-temperature area of the hard rock and surrounding hard rock is increased, and the microwave fracturing performance is improved.

title_en: Emergency water purifying device
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency water purifying device, which belongs to the technical field of drinking water treatment and comprises an ultrafiltration membrane component, an end socket, a connector and a manual operation device, wherein the connection relationship between the ultrafiltration membrane component, the end socket, the connector and the manual operation device is three types of purified water, normal flushing and back flushing. The invention is suitable for emergency situations such as flood and earthquake, or field travel and training, and can purify the water source which can be utilized by the pond, the ditch and the like by manual simple operation, so as to meet the safety drinking water requirement of people and effectively prevent secondary disasters caused by water source pollution, and the like, in consideration of the situations of polluted water source, no power supply and the like. The invention also has the advantages of simple operation, convenient assembly and disassembly, convenient carrying, low investment cost and the like.

title_en: Wind-solar-energy storage real-time control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wind-solar energy storage real-time control method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the wind-solar energy storage real-time control method comprises the following steps of S1, building a wind-solar energy storage management control model; and S3, constructing a training method based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm based on the Markov rewarding process, and training the wind and light energy storage management control model to obtain a final model so as to realize wind and light storage real-time control. The method is based on the deep reinforcement learning algorithm, avoids the problems of dimension disasters, low solving efficiency and the like caused by excessive decision variables, and can realize offline training and online application by utilizing the real-time decision capability of the deep neural network.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM ENG & CONSTR CORP;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Method and device for obtaining energy management optimization model of wind-solar electric heating system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obtaining method of an energy management optimization model of a wind-solar electric heating system, which comprises the steps of establishing a Markov chain of the real-time optimization scheduling model of the wind-solar electric heating system containing solid heat storage and energy storage under a reinforcement learning framework, and training the real-time optimization scheduling model of the wind-solar electric heating system containing solid heat storage and energy storage by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm based on the Markov chain to obtain the energy management optimization model of the wind-solar electric heating system. The method avoids the problems of dimension disasters, low solving efficiency and the like caused by excessive decision variables, and can realize offline training and online application by utilizing the real-time decision making capability of the deep neural network. The invention can be widely applied to wind-light electric heating system energy management and scheduling systems in different areas and different scenes, and can rapidly obtain an integrated scheduling plan of the wind-light electric heating system based on the SOC of wind-light electric heating load output and energy storage, thereby reducing wind and light abandoning and ensuring economy, safety and feasibility of the scheduling plan.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM ENG & CONSTR CORP;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Tunnel construction water inflow calculation method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based tunnel construction water inflow calculation method, and belongs to the field of high-precision prediction of tunnel water inflow disasters. The accurate prediction of the water inflow of tunnels is one of the focus problems of attention of underground engineering, and is directly related to engineering construction progress, stability of a tunnel and safety of constructors. Therefore, a method for calculating the water inflow of the tunnel by building a prediction model through integrating a plurality of machine learning algorithms is provided. The method comprises the steps of establishing a geological condition database according to drilling data, field investigation data and long-term observation data in the early stage aiming at a tunnel section needing to calculate water inflow, screening and analyzing data in the database, selecting and preprocessing influence factors, and carrying out iterative updating of a prediction model according to the selected influence factors, so that a high-precision tunnel water inflow prediction result can be obtained through calculation of the field investigation data of an input tunnel construction area.

title_en: Method and device for generating disaster recovery drilling process, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, a medium and electronic equipment for generating a disaster recovery drilling process. The method comprises the steps of obtaining drilling demand data, wherein the drilling demand data comprise drilling demand data for disaster recovery drilling after the current moment, extracting drilling steps in a target asset library based on the drilling demand data to obtain extraction results, wherein the target asset library comprises at least one of N drilling steps, labels of drilling scenes associated with each drilling step comprise drilling scenes which are obtained by dividing the processing environment of a financial service, and disaster recovery drilling processes are generated based on the extraction results and the drilling demand data, wherein the disaster recovery drilling processes comprise processes to be executed required for disaster recovery drilling. The application solves the problems of low efficiency in the related art that a manual carding mode is adopted to generate the disaster recovery emergency exercise implementation flow.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Device for searching and rescuing buried personnel
abstract_en: The device for searching and rescuing buried personnel comprises a portable drilling machine, wherein the portable drilling machine is provided with a plurality of hollow drill pipe sleeves, a gas transmission channel for transmitting gas to the ground is arranged in each drill pipe, a gas outlet of each gas transmission channel is connected with a sampling gas inlet of a gas component analysis device through a gas transmission pipe, a gas purifying and filtering device and a gas sucking pump for sucking gas are connected in series on the gas transmission pipe, a plurality of gas inlets communicated with the gas transmission channel are arranged on the side wall of each drill pipe sleeve in a surrounding manner, jet nozzles are respectively arranged at each gas inlet in each drill pipe sleeve, each jet nozzle is arranged at an outlet of each jet pipe, an electromagnetic valve is respectively connected in series on each jet pipe, and an inlet of each jet pipe is respectively connected with each jet pipe. The device aims to provide a device for searching and rescuing trapped and buried personnel, which can remarkably improve the searching and rescuing efficiency and effect under complex geological disaster scenes, and further realize rapid searching and rescuing of trapped and buried personnel in earthquake, landslide and debris flow disasters, and searching and rescuing of victim remains.
assignees: ZHONGAN GUOTAI BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Model simulation-based damage efficiency simulation and evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention provides a damage effectiveness simulation and evaluation system based on model simulation, which relates to the technical field of explosive effect simulation analysis, and the invention obtains three-dimensional scanning data of a target simulated explosive structure, and a physical field simulation model of the target object is reconstructed based on the finite element grid, so that the stress behavior and stress distribution state of the structure in the actual blasting environment can be accurately restored. And the first correction module and the second correction module are used for correcting the explosive pressure field and the equivalent stress, so that the limitation that the traditional simulation model ignores the environmental complexity is broken through, and evaluation distortion or misjudgment is avoided. In the simulation process, a fragile region with concentrated stress in the structure is automatically identified, and a damage level distribution map is dynamically calibrated by combining the corrected pressure field and stress evaluation, so that a hierarchical early warning instruction is generated, and a scientific basis is provided for engineering protection design, emergency response and risk control.

title_en: Mine underground stress and microseism cooperative intelligent monitoring device and installation method
abstract_en: The device comprises a data monitoring unit, an auxiliary installation unit and an intelligent early warning prediction unit, wherein the data monitoring unit is arranged at the bottom of a drilling hole, the data monitoring unit is in plug-in fit with the auxiliary installation unit, the intelligent early warning prediction unit is arranged on the surface of surrounding rock outside the drilling hole, and the intelligent early warning prediction unit is in communication connection with the data monitoring unit through a cable. The invention realizes the integration of stress and the microseismic sensing element, the synchronous acquisition and processing of monitoring data, reduces the data transmission delay, improves the monitoring efficiency, realizes the dynamic real-time early warning and prediction of geological disasters, can synchronously trigger the stress sensing element to enter a high-frequency sampling mode when the microseismic sensing element monitors an abnormal vibration event, improves the space-time resolution of the monitoring data, and can meet the construction of a geological disaster long-term early warning prediction system by combining historical data with real-time monitoring data.

title_en: Teaching training system integrating digital technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a teaching and practical training system integrating a digital technology, which belongs to the technical field of digital practical training teaching and comprises simulation teaching equipment, a switch, a 4G gateway, a server, a teacher machine and a student machine, wherein the simulation teaching module is in interactive connection with the server, the teacher machine and the student machine through the switch, and the 4G gateway is in interactive connection with the switch. The water pump of the water supply and drainage system can dynamically adjust the pump speed when the water level reaches the set point through the fuzzy PID control algorithm, is quick in response, reduces errors, ensures high efficiency and stability of the water pump, improves the actual operation capability of a user by introducing a fault simulation and intelligent alarm mechanism and dynamically generating various fault scenes, and also combines an artificial intelligent algorithm to automatically select an optimal alarm mode according to the fault type and severity, so that timely and effective response is ensured, and the reliability of the system and the emergency response capability of the user are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN CHENPUSEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam stability evaluation method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a dam stability evaluation method, system, equipment and storage medium, which belong to the technical field of dam stability evaluation and comprise the steps of establishing a dam data disaster database, analyzing stability influence factors according to data in the dam data disaster database to obtain a plurality of dam stability characteristics, screening data sets according to the characteristics, carrying out class balance synthesis on the screened dam disaster database by utilizing a synthetic minority oversampling technology, training a random forest model by utilizing data in the balanced dam data sets, constructing a nonlinear relation between the dam stability characteristics and stability to obtain a dam classification model, obtaining parameters of a dam to be detected, and inputting the dam classification model to obtain a dam stability classification result to be detected. The accuracy of the model in evaluating the stability of the dam is improved by comprehensively considering influence factors.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring and optimizing system and method for energy-saving combustion of a supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, comprising a data acquisition and transmission module, a digital twin modeling module, a fault diagnosis and early warning module and an energy efficiency optimizing module, wherein the data acquisition and transmission module is used for acquiring real-time data in the operation process of the supercritical carbon dioxide coal-fired boiler, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model according to the real-time data to realize the simulation of the combustion process of the coal-fired boiler, the fault diagnosis and early warning module is used for simulating the operation state of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data to diagnose and early warn faults of the coal-fired boiler, and the energy efficiency optimizing module is used for monitoring the energy efficiency of the coal-fired boiler according to the real-time data and simultaneously optimizing in real time according to monitoring results. The invention can acquire monitoring data in real time aiming at the large-capacity coal-fired power plant boiler from the aspects of intellectualization, economy, safety and operability, intelligently judges and sends out early warning, is beneficial to improving the safety and emergency response capability of the operation of the boiler, and effectively prevents possible safety accidents in the operation process.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Natural disaster analysis system for multiple detection ends based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural disaster analysis system of multiple detection ends based on a large model, which comprises a data acquisition module, a scene judgment module, a scene environment simulation module, a scene noise module, a denoising module, a standard disaster module and a scene influence analysis module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires disaster data, the scene environment simulation module establishes a scene simulation environment, the scene judgment module is used for judging an application scene to which current input data belongs, the scene noise module is used for determining the influence of basic environment noise on the data, the denoising module is used for denoising a disaster data result, the standard disaster module establishes a disaster model without scene factors, and the scene influence analysis module is used for establishing a characteristic influence database of different scenes on disaster detection data. The method fully considers the mutual influence between two dimensions of the environment and the disaster type, and has stronger pertinence and more accurate data compared with the prior art. Disaster classification facilitating mutual synthesis and similar impact of multiple disasters provides a data basis.

title_en: Method and system for detecting composite high-temperature drought disaster loss of target crops
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster loss detection, in particular to a method and a system for detecting the composite high-temperature drought disaster loss of target crops, which are based on target crop unit production data, geographic coordinate data of a plurality of grids of a research area and target crop growth factor data training machines of a plurality of dates of the grids to learn and obtain a crop unit production prediction model, an ideal weather scene and the target crop growth factor data corresponding to the composite high-temperature drought scene are constructed so as to respectively drive the crop unit production prediction model, obtaining target crop unit yield prediction data corresponding to ideal weather scenes and composite high-temperature drought scenes, performing difference processing on the obtained target crop unit yield prediction data corresponding to the ideal weather scenes and the composite high-temperature drought scenes to obtain a target crop composite high-temperature drought disaster loss value, reflecting the target crop unit yield loss under composite high-temperature drought stress, and providing scientific basis for guaranteeing national grain safety.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF GEOGRAPHY GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Power distribution network scheduling method, device, terminal and medium based on electric automobile cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network scheduling method, device, terminal and medium based on electric automobile cooperation, and relates to the technical field of power distribution networks. According to the scheme provided by the application, firstly, disaster damage simulation results of the power distribution network are obtained through obtaining extreme scene quantized data and disaster resistance toughness information of the power distribution network through a preset disaster simulation model, the toughness entropy of the power distribution network in the extreme scene is calculated as parameters of indexes such as comprehensive quantized disaster occurrence probability, recovery time and user demand satisfaction according to historical extreme scene data of the power distribution network and by combining with a preset toughness entropy calculation method, then the toughness entropy and the disaster resistance damage simulation results are input into a preset resource scheduling optimization model, so that the resource scheduling scheme of the power distribution network is optimized through the resource scheduling optimization model and by combining with a preset optimizing algorithm, and resource scheduling of the power distribution network in the extreme scene is executed through an optimal solution scheme obtained through optimizing, so that the disaster resistance toughness of the power distribution network in the extreme scene is improved.

title_en: Sky-ground integrated intelligent multi-disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sky-ground integrated intelligent multi-disaster monitoring system which comprises a data sensing layer, a data integration layer and a decision layer, wherein the data sensing layer comprises a satellite synthetic aperture radar interferometry technology, an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc backbone network and a sky-ground integrated data acquisition system constructed by a ground sensor, the data integration layer constructs an emergency data lake based on an emergency data management method of a blockchain and transmits the emergency data lake through a wireless communication link constructed by a 5G network to realize multi-source multi-modal disaster data access, the received data are fused, the decision layer receives the preprocessed data and carries out disaster recognition, evaluation and prediction on a small model in the field of pre-training multi-disaster recognition prediction based on a large model, and early warning and related decision mechanism are implemented on the condition that the disaster risk is higher than the preset possibility.
assignees: GUANGXI ACAD SCIENCES;ZHONGKE QUANWEI TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale rock concrete material mixed fracture simulation method based on variable phase-splitting field fracture theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale rock concrete material mixed fracture simulation method based on a variable phase-splitting field fracture theory, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting physical mechanical parameters of rock concrete material based on a physical test and a literature, S2, establishing a physical model of multi-scale rock concrete according to the collected physical mechanical parameters and engineering conditions, and dividing the model into grids, S3, applying a mixed fracture phase field, a displacement field and a historical strain energy field to the physical model by using numerical calculation software, and S4, updating phase field injury according to the maximum historical strain energy, and realizing the cracking process of the multi-scale rock material by using the mixed fracture phase field injury model. By establishing an innovative phase field control equation, the complex coupling of I type and II type fracture can be considered, the coupling effect of III type fracture can be innovatively added, and the mechanical behavior of the rock concrete material in various fracture modes can be comprehensively represented. The method is suitable for the research of complex fracture behaviors of rock concrete materials, and can be widely applied to the engineering field such as geotechnical engineering, geological disaster assessment and fracture damage analysis in energy exploitation.

title_en: Geological disaster susceptibility drawing model generation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a drawing model for easily reflecting geological disasters, which are used for solving the technical problem that the model cannot accurately reflect the easily reflecting geological disasters in practical application due to the existing training scheme of the model for reflecting the easily reflecting geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a geological disaster space-time training data set of a research area, generating training data subsets corresponding to a plurality of grids in the research area according to the geological disaster space-time training data set by adopting a preset data processing method, calculating safety coefficients according to the training data subsets by adopting an infinite slope equation, determining training safety coefficients corresponding to the grids, carrying out model training on an initial geological disaster susceptibility drawing model according to the training safety coefficients corresponding to the grids and the training data subsets by adopting a preset loss function, and determining a trained target geological disaster susceptibility drawing model.

title_en: Integrated device for predicting rock burst and coal and gas outburst composite disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated device for predicting rock burst and coal and gas outburst composite disasters, which comprises a drilling device, a dust suction device and a coal particle weighing device, wherein a plastic barrel cover is arranged at the front end of the drilling device and is in sealing contact with a rock wall to be drilled, a drill bit reserved pipeline is arranged on the plastic barrel cover, the dust suction device comprises an air inlet pipeline and a centrifugal fan, one end of the air inlet pipeline is communicated with an inner barrel of the plastic barrel cover, the other end of the air inlet pipeline is communicated with the centrifugal fan, a metal net is arranged at the middle section of the air inlet pipeline, a filtering device and a gas infrared sensor are sequentially arranged at the outer end of the metal net and positioned in the air inlet pipeline, and the coal particle weighing device is arranged at the lower part of the metal net. The device can be when colliery underground operation, draws the sample through the drilling, detects the content of buggy and gas in real time to help aassessment rock burst and coal and the outstanding risk of gas.

title_en: Movable landslide identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active landslide identification method, which relates to the field of disaster identification and comprises the steps of obtaining image data of an area to be identified, constructing an active landslide data set, constructing a context-aware adaptive fusion model, wherein the context-aware adaptive fusion model comprises an encoder and a decoder, the encoder comprises a plurality of characteristic processing layers and a convolution layer which are sequentially connected, the characteristic processing layers comprise a convolution layer and a wavelet transform downsampling WDB module which are sequentially connected, the decoder comprises a plurality of multi-branch scale adaptive aggregation MSA modules, a plurality of characteristic extraction refinement layers and a convolution layer which are sequentially connected, the characteristic extraction refinement layers comprise a convolution upsampling CUB module which are sequentially connected, training the context-aware adaptive fusion model based on the active landslide data set, obtaining an active landslide identification model, and inputting the active landslide data set to be detected into the active landslide identification model to obtain an active landslide identification result.

title_en: Building fire smoke simulation model
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire escape training equipment, in particular to a building fire smoke simulation model which comprises a plurality of building bodies which are sequentially overlapped from bottom to top, wherein each building body comprises a floor slab, side walls and an outer wall, the side walls are arranged at two ends of each floor slab and are hinged with each floor slab, the outer walls are arranged at two sides of each floor slab, a partition plate and a partition wall are vertically arranged at the top of each floor slab, evacuation stairs are arranged at the outer sides of the partition plates, fireproof doors are hinged on the partition plates, a room partition wall is arranged between each partition wall and each outer wall, evacuation doors are hinged on the partition walls, an L-shaped partition plate is further vertically arranged at the top of each floor slab, and a space surrounded by the L-shaped partition plates, the partition plates and the partition walls forms a smoke discharging channel. The utility model is convenient to disassemble and assemble, thereby being convenient to carry, and enables audience to intuitively know the spreading of fire smoke and the characteristics of chimney effect in the building through simulating smoke, and to know the functions of the fireproof door and the mechanical smoke discharging facility in the fire.

title_en: Sample sampling equipment for geological disaster treatment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses sample sampling equipment for geological disaster treatment, which comprises a bearing bottom plate, wherein the upper surface of the bearing bottom plate is fixedly connected with a square box and a supporting frame respectively, the inner bottom wall of the square box is fixedly connected with a speed reduction motor, the output end of the speed reduction motor is fixedly provided with a screw rod through a coupler, the outer surface of the screw rod is in threaded connection with a threaded square block, and the outer surface of the threaded square block is fixedly connected with two transmission blocks. The device can utilize the running of the gear motor to rotate with the screw rod, so that the device can move up and down with the screw square, the transmission block and the square connecting rod, and accordingly can move up and down with the moving seat, the sampling tube and the drill bit, the inserted depth of the drill bit can be conveniently adjusted, samples with different depths can be collected, a user can know the sampling depth conveniently through the set indicating rod and the scale plate, the sampling depth can be accurately controlled conveniently, the sampling consistency and accuracy are guaranteed, and the sample error is effectively reduced.
assignees: DAZHOU ZEBRA IND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Broken and torn and fire-extinguishing training facility
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a breaking and fire extinguishing training facility, which relates to the technical field of fire extinguishing training and comprises a first simulation frame and a second simulation frame, wherein the first simulation frame is provided with a first side face, a second side face, a third side face, a fourth side face and a first top face, the first side face is provided with an anti-theft door, the second side face is provided with a rolling door, the third side face is provided with a plurality of plate fixing frames, each plate fixing frame is used for fixing different first plates, the first top face is provided with a second plate, the anti-theft door, the rolling door, the first plate and the second plate are all used for being broken and torn, the fourth side face is provided with at least one water injection target, each water injection target is used for water injection fire extinguishing training, the first end of the second simulation frame can be lapped on the first top face, the second simulation frame is provided with a sloping face, the sloping face is provided with a bearing plate, and the bearing plate is used for bearing a firefighter and/or is used for being broken and torn.

title_en: Interactive fire-fighting lance system based on virtual reality platform development
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive fire-fighting lance system developed based on a virtual reality platform, which comprises a hardware device, a sensor assembly, a data communication module and a virtual training system. Through the cooperation setting of interactive fire gun, data communication module and virtual training system, need not spend all kinds of resources and truly reappear the scene of fire and can avoid real high environmental protection of training cost and have dangerous problem, through the high-fidelity physical simulation of interactive fire gun, rethread intelligence examination system generates the training report based on operation data, can effectively point out the not enough of fire fighter and give effective opinion in order to improve actual combat ability and emergency response speed, cooperation through interactive fire gun and virtual training system makes the scene of fire of simulation can change because of the operation change of fire fighter, and then can simulate out the change of complicated fire scene environment and make it more press close to real fire change.
assignees: BEIJING TIANEN ZHONGTAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building damage detection method and device coupling SAR image and optical image multi-feature
abstract_en: The invention provides a building damage detection method and device for coupling SAR images and optical images, which comprises the steps of acquiring SAR images, optical images and unmanned aerial vehicle images corresponding to a research area in a pre-disaster scene and a post-disaster scene respectively, constructing a research area change detection image set based on the SAR images and the optical images and constructing a vector data set corresponding to the research area based on the optical images and the unmanned aerial vehicle images, extracting multi-scale features corresponding to building vector units from the change detection image set according to the vector data set to construct a multi-scale feature library, training a damage building classification network by utilizing the multi-scale feature library, and using the trained damage building classification network for damage detection of the research area. The method can effectively solve the problems of single data source, strong feature extraction limitation, weak model generalization capability, poor instantaneity and robustness and the like in the prior art.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting linkage control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting coordinated control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting coordinated control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fire dynamic simulator in a simulation manner; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring parameters, obtaining the distribution of the covering combustible, carrying out harmful gas diffusion prediction in a preset future time zone to generate harmful gas prediction distribution, carrying out smoke discharging linkage control scheme optimization in combination with the layout of a smoke discharging device, outputting an optimal smoke discharging linkage control scheme, and carrying out smoke discharging control of a target building in the preset future time zone. The technical problems that fire protection alarms in the prior art are difficult to adjust aiming at different building structures and fire scenes, and the diffusion paths of fire and harmful gases cannot be predicted in real time, so that an emergency linkage control scheme is lack of pertinence, and fire protection emergency response is not timely and accurate are solved, and the technical effects of improving the timeliness and the accuracy of the fire protection emergency response, reducing the harmful gas risk of an evacuation channel and the overall fire protection safety risk are achieved.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIANTAI ZHICHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction method for deep-buried high-ground-stress metal mine soft rock roadway support structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method for a deep-buried high-ground-stress metal mine soft rock roadway support structure, belongs to the technical field of soft rock roadway support, and solves the problem that the traditional low-stress passive support is difficult to bear the stress of metal mine deep-buried engineering soft rock, so that large deformation disasters frequently occur; and (3) measuring and lofting the positions of the long anchor rod and the short anchor rod, paving a W-shaped steel belt after positioning lofting, clearing holes after drilling, anchoring the anchoring ends of the long anchor rod and the short anchor rod by using an anchoring agent, pushing the anchoring agent to the bottom of the holes along the wall of the drilled holes, respectively pushing the long anchor rod and the short anchor rod after the anchoring agent is pushed into the positions, and respectively applying prestress to the long anchor rod and the short anchor rod. When the surrounding rock of the roadway is deformed, the high-stress energy-absorbing structural layer can provide high-strength support, compensate and improve the self bearing capacity of the surrounding rock of the roadway, and simultaneously can improve the extrusion resistance and the impact resistance of the supporting structure so as to ensure the safety of the roadway.
assignees: JINCHUAN COBALT RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD;JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source video monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source video monitoring system and a method, which relate to the technical field of video monitoring and comprise a multi-camera monitoring unit, a multi-source moving object monitoring unit, a multi-source video monitoring controller based on a computer and an alarm unit. According to the invention, the plurality of visual cameras are combined with the plurality of sensors, the monitoring state is reflected in real time through the electronic simulation diagram and the monitoring coverage diagram, the uncovered area can be found in time, if the rotation condition of the cameras caused by the monitoring center control or the moving object tracking control occurs, if the monitoring coverage diagram at a certain moment is judged to have the uncovered area, and the mapping position of the moving object is located in the uncovered area, the risk of illegal invasion is judged at the moment, the multi-source video monitoring controller controls the alarm unit to start the alarm, and simultaneously controls the adjacent cameras at the physical positions of the uncovered area to deflect a set angle towards the central point of the current uncovered area, so that effective early warning and emergency response are realized.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN SPACE OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Landslide three-dimensional deformation field monitoring method and system based on physical information neural network model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide three-dimensional deformation field monitoring method and system based on a physical information neural network model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-stage point cloud data of a landslide body by utilizing three-dimensional laser scanning, obtaining internal and external time sequence deformation data of the landslide body by combining limited inclinometry and GNSS monitoring data, solving the point cloud data by adopting an improved ICP algorithm to obtain a surface deformation field of the landslide body, constructing a physical information neural network model, training according to the monitoring data, predicting displacement along a slope direction and a vertical slope direction by optimizing model parameters, and deducing the three-dimensional integral time sequence deformation field of the landslide according to the trained model to realize real-time monitoring. The landslide deformation monitoring system has the advantages of being capable of providing high-precision landslide deformation monitoring, having real-time performance and accuracy and being capable of effectively early warning landslide disasters.

title_en: Multi-stage strategy optimization method for balancing health and economic newly-developed infectious diseases
abstract_en: The application relates to a multistage strategy optimization method for balancing new infectious diseases of health and economy, which comprises the steps of characterizing population flow on different land utilization by introducing noctilucence of land utilization, simulating and evaluating single or combined management measures of different land areas based on health dimension by using a land utilization perceived infectious disease model, simulating and evaluating single or combined management measures of different land areas based on economic dimension by using an input-output economic disaster influence model, and optimizing two dimensions of health and economy based on targets of different stages of new infectious diseases to obtain optimal countermeasure of multiple stages. Therefore, the problems that the existing direct population flow data is lost, so that simulation is difficult, health and economic losses are difficult to balance in different stages of infectious disease pandemic are solved.

title_en: Gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster monitoring, in particular to a gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the gas coal mine goaf coupling disaster monitoring method comprises the following steps of acquiring comprehensive data of a goaf through a sensor network and preprocessing the data to obtain standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model through a 3D modeling and geographic information system technology, carrying out data synchronization and model correction processing on the digital twin model, optimizing parameters and states of the digital twin model, constructing a fluid-solid-heat multi-field coupling model through a computational fluid mechanics and finite element analysis method, constructing a risk assessment model through a analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, training a disaster early warning model through a machine learning algorithm based on standardized data and the risk assessment model, integrating the digital twin model, the standardized data, the risk assessment model and the disaster early warning model, and constructing a visual interaction platform. The monitoring method can be used for coupling multiple disaster factors and dynamically evolving, so that the disaster prediction accuracy and timeliness are greatly improved.

title_en: Real projective image generating method, storage medium and device based on three-dimensional Gaussian model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real projection image generation method, a storage medium and a device based on a three-dimensional Gaussian model, and aims to solve the problems of low image quality, low generation speed, detail loss and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining image data through unmanned aerial vehicle or aerial photography, extracting camera gestures and sparse point clouds by utilizing a motion restoration structure (SfM) technology, constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian model based on the sparse point clouds, and carrying out iterative training through top-view orthographic projection combined gradient descent algorithm. In the training process, a densification strategy, a point deleting strategy, a blocking strategy and an image pyramid strategy are innovatively introduced, so that the image detail expressive force and the overall quality are remarkably improved. Specifically, the densification strategy realizes fine detail reconstruction by dynamically increasing the density of the Gaussian balls, and the point deleting strategy improves the rendering efficiency and optimizes the computing resource allocation by eliminating the redundant Gaussian balls; the image pyramid strategy generates a multi-level visual effect through multi-scale training, and the blocking strategy improves reconstruction accuracy through local optimization. Finally, based on the three-dimensional Gaussian model which is completed through training, real-time generation of high-quality real shot images in a large-scale scene can be realized. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of efficiency, precision and practicability, provides important technical support for the fields of geographic information systems, urban planning, disaster monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Urban waterlogging simulation method based on SWMM and SIMWE coupling model
abstract_en: A city waterlogging simulation method based on SWMM and SIMWE coupling models comprises the steps of collecting and processing basic data and historical heavy rainfall data of a research area, designing storm events of different reproduction periods, constructing SWMM-SIMWE coupling models and verifying, and simulating city waterlogging conditions in a certain period based on the design of the storm. The method combines SWMM and SIMWE models, is used for simulating an underground drainage system and surface runoff, and can reflect water flow movement and water accumulation distribution under complex urban terrains more accurately and efficiently. The method solves the problem that the urban drainage system and the surface runoff dynamics are difficult to accurately and efficiently simulate in the prior art through a reasonable coupling mechanism, and remarkably improves the water exchange efficiency and the water exchange precision between the underground drainage system and the surface water flow. The simulation result provides scientific basis for urban waterlogging risk assessment and flood control and drainage system optimization, and is beneficial to improving disaster defense capacity of cities.

title_en: Method for generating forest fire emergency special automobile model with assistance of artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a fire emergency special automobile model by assistance of artificial intelligence, and belongs to the crossing field of artificial intelligence and automobile design. The method aims to solve the defects of the traditional forest fire control vehicle design and improve the forest fire rescue efficiency and the firefighter safety. The method is characterized in that data such as a 2D drawing, a forest fire case, fire control demand feedback and the like of the fire engine are widely collected through multiple channels, cleaning, labeling and structuring are carried out on the data, and effective data are divided into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a specific proportion. A deep learning model (such as GAN or VAE) is selected and optimized according to the design characteristics of the forest fire-fighting vehicle, and the model is stabilized through a large number of iterative training. Inputting design keywords to generate a 2D sketch, analyzing, screening and evaluating by using big data, optimizing for multiple times, generating a 3D model frame by using a 3D generation AI model, finely optimizing after multi-dimensional evaluation, and finally generating a 3D model with vivid color and meeting actual combat requirements. The invention utilizes artificial intelligence technology, greatly improves design efficiency, enhances adaptability of the automobile to forest environment, ensures safety of firefighters, promotes technical progress of industry, and has remarkable economic and social benefits.

title_en: Rural refuge personnel evacuation simulation method based on simulation model
abstract_en: The invention provides a rural refuge personnel evacuation simulation method based on a simulation model, which belongs to the technical field of evacuation methods and comprises the steps of S1, collecting design indexes and influence factors of rural refuge space, S2, constructing a rural refuge space planning and designing database, S3, constructing four kinds of intelligent bodies including residents, refuge sites, refuge roads and dynamic environment changes, S4, constructing an environment model according to the actual situation of a target rural area, embedding the four kinds of intelligent bodies into the environment model to form a complete rural refuge emergency intelligent body simulation model, S5, designing an interaction mechanism among the four kinds of intelligent bodies, S6, setting a simulation scene according to the actual situation of the target rural area, S7, starting the rural refuge emergency intelligent body simulation model, simulating the evacuation process of rural refuge personnel in an emergency situation, and S8, evaluating the simulation result. The invention can optimize the emergency evacuation strategy in rural areas and improve the efficiency and safety of dealing with emergency situations such as natural disasters and the like.

title_en: monitering system for growth ststus of farm crops and weather information
title_ko: 복잡지형 기상정보 및 작물 생육현황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system for weather information and crop growth status in complex terrain to analyze crop growth status through crop images collected in real-time from an image collection device. The monitoring system for weather information and crop growth status in complex terrain according to an embodiment of the present specification comprises: a data receiving unit for receiving, in real-time, environmental information data including temperature, humidity, precipitation, solar radiation, and wind direction around cultivated land observed by an environmental information collection module, and image data for photographing the growth status of a target crop body by a crop growth information collection module including a camera; a data processing unit for analyzing weather disasters and the growth status of the recognized crop body by integrating and training the data received by the data receiving unit through deep learning; and a display unit for displaying the environmental information and the crop growth information modeled by the data processing unit on a user's PC or smartphone.

title_en: AI-based predictive simulation system using digital-based city-unit functional materials for climate change response
title_ko: 기후변화 대응을 위한 디지털 기반 도시단위 기능성소재를 적용한 ai 기반의 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: An AI-based predictive simulation system is disclosed. A gathering unit collects and stores weather information by city, water treatment sensing information, and legacy information. A learning model part predicts urban disasters by learning the information and designates a target area. In addition, the learning model part generates disaster prediction information that simulates the degree of improvement during disaster response by reflecting the characteristic information of functional materials. The present invention visualizes the effect of applying functional materials for each city through AI simulation and guides optimal materials, thereby reducing analysis costs and supporting technological leadership.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기후변화 대응을 위해 개발된 다양한 기능성소재를 기후변화 정도가 상이한 각 도시마다 디지털화 AI 예측 시뮬레이션 결과를 통해 기능성소재 적용 전 및 적용 후로 각각 피해 저감을 시각적으로 확인하고, 기후변화 대응에 효율적인 기능성소재 선정을 위한 정보 표출 환경을 안내하는 기후변화 대응을 위한 디지털 기반 도시단위 기능성소재를 적용한 AI 기반의 예측 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것으로, 행정구역별로 구분되는 각 도시마다 구분하여 기상정보를 기설정 주기마다 수집한 도시별 기상정보를 도시별 수집기상정보 DB(111a)에 누적 저장관리하고, 행정구역별로 구분되는 각 도시마다 구비되는 수처리설비에 설치된 수처리 감지센서로부터 센싱된 수처리 센싱정보를 기설정 주기마다 수집한 도시별 수처리 센싱정보를 도시별 수집 수처리 센싱정보 DB(111c)에 누적 저장관리하며, 행정구역별로 구분되는 각 도시마다 관리되는 구조물의 레거시 공통정보를 기설정 주기마다 수집한 도시별 레거시 공통정보를 도시별 수집 레거시 공통정보 DB(111d)에 누적 저장관리하는 수집부(120)를 포함하는 예측 시뮬레이션 서버(100)로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire extinguishing training device using CMG
title_ko: Cmg를 이용한 소화훈련장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing training device using CMG and, more specifically, to a fire-extinguishing training device using cmg, wherein a control moment gyro (CMG) is included in a fire hydrant, so that sufficient repulsive force can be applied to a coffin window without water coming out, so that in fire-extinguishing training for a virtual experience device, training is performed with the feeling that water is actually sprayed, but water is not actually fired, so that the training environment can be pleasant. According to the fire-extinguishing training apparatus using cmg formed according to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, although the fire-extinguishing training apparatus is an irrigation window in which water is not sprayed, the fire-extinguishing training apparatus can sufficiently experience a repulsive force in which water is fired, and actually uses a fire hose and an irrigation window, but water is not sprayed, the fire-extinguishing training apparatus can experience the repulsive force, and the fire-extinguishing training apparatus can completely experience the fire-extinguishing training apparatus through a virtual experience program while sufficiently feeling the force applied to the irrigation window.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 CMG를 이용한 소화훈련장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 소화전에 제어모멘트자이로(CMG)가 포함되어 물이 나오지 않으면서도 관창에 충분한 반발력을 가할 수 있어서 가상체험장치를 위한 소화훈련에 있어서 실제로 물이 분사되는 느낌으로 훈련을 하면서도 실제로 물은 발사되지 않아서 훈련환경을 쾌적하게 할 수 있도록 한 CMG를 이용한 소화훈련장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 실시예로 형성되는 CMG를 이용한 소화훈련장치에 의하면 물이 분사되지 않은 관창이지만, 물이 발사되는 반발력을 충분히 체험할 수 있고, 실제 소방호스와 관창을 사용하지만, 물은 분사되지 않고, 그 반발력은 체험할 수 있으며, 관창에 주어지는 힘을 충분히 느끼면서 가상체험프로그램을 통해서 완벽하게 체험할 수 있는 등의 효과가 발생한다.

title_en: Distributed evacuation performance evaluation method and device considering the dispersion rate by floor
title_ko: 층별 분산율을 고려한 분산 대피 성능평가 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for evaluating dispersion evacuation performance considering a dispersion rate per floor comprising: a step of storing by pre-constructing dispersion rate set per floor, three-dimensional building space shape information, three-dimensional evacuee generation area information, and three-dimensional exit space information wherein ratio information of evacuation personnel assigned to an exit is stored per each floor within a building; a step of collecting the stored dispersion rate dataset per floor to generate a dispersion rate file; a step of calculating the personnel number of evacuees, an exit per floor, an exit, and evacuation routing information according to the dispersion rate of the dispersion rate file, and generating simulation files comprising the calculated information and setting information determined by a predetermined input parameter; a step of executing an evacuation simulation for the generated simulation files; and a step of generating a performance evaluation report file by parsing and analyzing an evacuation result file among execution result files. According to the present invention such as thereof, the optimal evacuation simulation is determined through the dispersion evacuation performance evaluation so that personnel can be evacuated as quickly and safely as possible during the occurrence of a disaster, thereby having the effect of minimizing casualties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 층별 분산율을 고려한 분산 대피 성능평가 방법에 관한 것으로서, 건물 내의 각 층마다 탈출구에 배정된 대피 인원의 비율정보가 저장된 층별 분산율 셋, 3차원 건물 공간 형상 정보, 3차원 대피자 생성 영역 정보 및 3차원 출구 공간 정보를 사전 구축하여 저장하는 단계, 상기 저장된 층별 분산율 데이터 셋을 수집하여 분산율 파일을 생성하는 단계, 상기 분산율 파일의 분산율에 따라 대피자의 인원수, 층별 출구, 탈출구 및 대피 라우팅 정보를 산출하고, 산출된 정보와 미리 결정된 입력 파라미터에 의해 결정되는 설정 정보를 포함하는 시뮬레이션 파일들을 생성하는 단계, 생성된 시뮬레이션 파일들에 대하여 대피 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 단계 및 실행 결과 파일 중 대피 결과 파일을 파싱하고 분석하여 성능평가 보고서 파일을 생성하는 단계를 포함하는 것이 특징이다. 상기와 같은 본 발명에 의하면, 분산 대피 성능 평가를 통해 최적의 대피 시뮬레이션을 결정함으로써 재난 발생 시 인원들을 최대한 빠르고 안전하게 대피시켜 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for establishing debris flow data management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a debris flow data management system, and belongs to the field of debris flow control. The system comprises a channel basic parameter module, a channel satellite picture module, a debris flow motion characteristic module and a debris flow prevention and treatment suggestion module. The system can be used for conveniently knowing the debris flow channel by combining the basic parameter text description of the channel with the debris flow satellite picture. And summarizing the calculation results of the empirical formulas and the numerical simulation calculation results of the debris flow motion characteristics of the research area, and providing suggested correction parameters and calculation formulas, so that a user can select and calculate according to the actual conditions of the channels. And finally, corresponding disaster prevention and reduction suggestions are given according to different debris flow channels, and disaster prevention and reduction effects are evaluated through numerical simulation results before and after prevention, so that a universal principle with low cost and high efficiency is realized, and reliable reference can be provided for debris flow disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: FDEM and SPH combined water-rich filling karst cave flood disaster refined simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of karst cave sudden flood disaster simulation, in particular to a method for finely simulating the karst cave sudden flood disaster by combining FDEM and SPH. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises multi-source data acquisition and integration, high-precision model construction, self-adaptive grid division and material attribute assignment, SPH particle conversion and initialization of water-rich filler, ground stress balance iteration solution, tunnel excavation dynamic simulation, result refined analysis and catastrophe evaluation, tunnel support optimization design and feedback adjustment. The method accurately predicts the catastrophe risk of water burst of the water-rich filling karst cave, locks the instability and water burst hidden danger area of surrounding rock in advance by means of fine model and multi-parameter analysis, builds a firm safety defense line for construction, powerfully optimizes engineering design, accurately determines supporting parameters according to simulation, avoids resource waste, reduces cost and construction period, improves investigation design efficiency, assists scientific decision, promotes technical progress of industry, expands various underground engineering and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Civil air defense engineering fire evacuation path optimization method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a civil air defense engineering fire evacuation path optimization method based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and belongs to the field of path planning algorithms. The method comprises the steps of carrying out scene modeling on a target civil air defense project, combining fire simulation software to obtain a fire simulation model, setting parameters of the fire simulation model, simulating the change condition of fire along with time, extracting fire development data, constructing a grid map of the target civil air defense project by using a grid method, planning nodes in the grid map, determining initial nodes and exit nodes, importing the fire development data into the grid map, adding dangerous grids in the grid map for planning a safe evacuation path in the fire development period, initializing an improved ant colony algorithm, and starting the improved ant colony algorithm on the grid map to obtain an optimal evacuation path.

title_en: Energy storage pre-disaster configuration method and device based on toughness value curve
abstract_en: The application provides an energy storage pre-disaster configuration method based on a toughness value curve, which comprises the steps of considering the influence of ice and snow storms on a power system, simulating damage and failure probability of the power system under the condition, constructing a power system failure probability model for judging power system load loss under extreme disasters, constructing a power system model when the load is lost, wherein an objective function of the model is to minimize power system operation cost and power interruption loss, integrating different capacity storage units into a power grid when the load is lost, reducing the power system operation cost and the power interruption loss as the power grid toughness value, constructing a power grid toughness value model, analyzing the power grid toughness through a multi-stage linear programming algorithm, eliminating redundancy constraint through an umbrella constraint model during analysis, accelerating the division of a parameter space through a warm starting method, determining the influence of energy storage on the power grid toughness, and realizing the energy storage pre-disaster configuration. The application adopting the scheme realizes the pre-disaster configuration of the energy storage of the power system.

title_en: Fire extinguishing simulation precision verification method for energy storage box, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a fire extinguishing simulation precision verification method of an energy storage box, electronic equipment and a storage medium, comprising the steps of constructing a simulation model of the energy storage box; the method comprises the steps of determining the sum of the volume of a box body corresponding to the energy storage box and the volume of an internal component of the energy storage box, calculating a first volume fraction corresponding to fire extinguishing materials of the energy storage box according to the sum of the volume of the box body and the volume of the internal component of the energy storage box, simulating a second volume fraction corresponding to fire extinguishing materials used for extinguishing fire of the energy storage box on the basis of a simulation model, and verifying the fire extinguishing simulation precision of the energy storage box on the basis of the first volume fraction and the second volume fraction. According to the scheme, the consumption of the fire extinguishing material can be adjusted according to the accuracy check result, and the problem that the consumption of the fire extinguishing material is too large or too small when a fire disaster occurs is avoided.
assignees: WUHAN YIWEI ENERGY STORAGE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;JIANGSU JICUI MOBILE COMMUNICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: System and method for monitoring health of deep-open-sea small island
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of deep-sea small island health monitoring and discloses a deep-sea small island health monitoring system and method. The method comprises the steps of adopting a non-invasive data acquisition system consisting of a sensor network, a shore-based camera device and a vibration sensor to realize real-time monitoring of all factors of the vibration states of an open sea environment parameter, reef flat images and a protective building, combining measured data with numerical simulation through joint operation of a wave field distribution model and a structural damage prediction model, improving the space-time resolution of reef flat wave parameters and the evaluation precision of the health states of the protective building, dynamically adjusting an early warning threshold value through deviation analysis of real-time correlation historical disaster data and a current monitoring value, improving the timeliness and accuracy of early warning of extreme events, and finally providing all-weather and high-reliability safety monitoring guarantee for the deep island through an automatic triggering mechanism of multi-stage early warning signals, simultaneously reducing the manual maintenance cost and having obvious technical synergistic effect.

title_en: Ancient site flood disaster risk assessment method based on coupling quantitative simulation and qualitative analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ancient ruined flood disaster risk assessment method based on coupling quantitative simulation and qualitative analysis, which comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of an ancient ruined flood disaster, preprocessing the relevant data, and carrying out risk analysis and vulnerability analysis on the relevant data, wherein the risk analysis is to set a rainfall scene according to fusion environment data and rainfall data by adopting a hydrodynamic model and carry out numerical simulation to obtain rainfall data, and assess the disaster to obtain a quantitative risk level, wherein the vulnerability analysis is to carry out vulnerability level division according to stability, value loss and repairability of the disaster scene, obtain a qualitative vulnerability level, and carry out organic coupling on the quantitative risk level and the qualitative vulnerability level, so as to obtain an ancient ruined flood disaster risk level diagram. The method not only improves the precision of the risk assessment of the flood disasters of the ancient ruins, but also has better interpretability, and can be directly used in a risk assessment system of the flood disasters of the ancient ruins.

title_en: Machine learning-based urban rainfall flood toughness deep learning evaluation method
