abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning-based urban rainfall flood toughness deep learning assessment method which comprises the following steps of 1, clearly analyzing space-time distinguishing characteristics of urban rainfall floods, 2, analyzing and calculating urban rainfall flood toughness indexes, 3, assessing urban rainfall flood toughness, 4, constructing an urban rainfall flood disaster simulation model, and 5, assessing, predicting and learning methods based on machine learning. The method has the advantages that the urban rainfall flood toughness can be accurately estimated by utilizing a machine learning technology, deep feasibility analysis can be carried out by means of a deep learning neural network model, the technology can learn and extract multi-scale characteristics in a space-time dimension, effectively capture nonlinear relations in urban rainfall flood toughness space-time data, improve the accuracy and stability of urban rainfall flood toughness prediction, regulate and control urban rainfall flood toughness, timely determine corresponding urban emergency schemes, and strengthen the integral toughness of a city.

title_en: Regional traffic network dynamic risk assessment method under sudden earthquake influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional traffic network dynamic risk assessment method under the influence of sudden earthquake, which belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster assessment and comprises the steps of collecting data and preprocessing, constructing a traffic network model, constructing an earthquake vulnerability model and constructing a risk dynamic assessment system, comprehensively considering earthquake parameters, socioeconomic performance, regional traffic network and real-time detection data after the occurrence of the earthquake, more comprehensively assessing regional traffic network risks under the earthquake, simulating the damage scene of the earthquake to the traffic network by combining with the earthquake vulnerability model, assessing the damage probability and the function loss of traffic facilities, calculating the connectivity of the traffic network model, dynamically calculating the performance change of the traffic network after the earthquake based on the connectivity index and the weight of the traffic network, and then assessing the toughness of the traffic network according to a network performance recovery curve under a recovery strategy, so that the performance change of the traffic network in the earthquake can be dynamically reflected in real time.

title_en: Earthquake disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic disaster early warning method and a system, which comprise the steps of obtaining sample data of a historical seismic source, wherein the sample data comprises sample input data and a true value, inputting the sample data into a pre-trained XGBoost seismic disaster early warning model for training to obtain a XGBoost seismic disaster early warning model after training, obtaining parameter data of the seismic source to be tested in real time through a ground seismic observation station, inputting the parameter data of the seismic source to be tested into a XGBoost seismic disaster early warning model after training to obtain amplitude of seismic acceleration of the seismic source to be tested along with periodic changes of a building, and determining the dangerous degree of the seismic disaster according to the amplitude of the seismic acceleration of the seismic source to be tested along with the periodic changes of the building. The method and the system can give consideration to the rapid and accurate processing of the high-dimensional seismic characteristic information while paying attention to the lives and properties of people.
assignees: WUJI TECH DEVELOPMENT HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Steep slope stability prediction method and system based on manifold convolution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a steep slope stability prediction method and system based on a manifold convolution network, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prediction. The method comprises the following steps of data acquisition and preprocessing, constructing a graph structure integrating multiple features, constructing a manifold graph convolution neural network model, model training, steep slope ground surface displacement prediction, and performing steep slope stability assessment according to a predicted ground surface displacement result. The method and the system integrate multi-source data such as geology, topography and the like to reflect the real-time state of the slope, capture key factors through multi-dimensional data fusion, and promote the comprehensiveness and accuracy of prediction. And constructing a graph structure fusing the multiple features, and utilizing a manifold graph convolution network and a neural ordinary differential equation to deeply excavate the spatial correlation and the time dynamic change so as to realize the depth fusion of the space-time features. The model has good adaptability to slight deformation and complex geological conditions and high robustness, and can be suitable for slope monitoring of different types.

title_en: Submarine oil and gas pipeline leakage risk assessment and early warning method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of submarine oil and gas pipeline leakage risk assessment, in particular to a submarine oil and gas pipeline leakage risk assessment and early warning method, an electronic device and a storage medium. The submarine oil gas pipeline leakage risk assessment and early warning method comprises the steps of obtaining first monitoring data through a sensor network deployed on a submarine oil gas pipeline, determining a leakage section through the first monitoring data, obtaining second monitoring data through a buoy sensor network deployed on the sea surface, constructing a feature vector and a deep neural network model, inputting the first monitoring data into the deep neural network model, outputting first simulation leakage data, constructing a pipeline physical model through design parameters and environmental conditions of the submarine oil gas pipeline, obtaining second simulation leakage data through computational fluid dynamics CFD simulation based on the first simulation leakage data and the pipeline physical model, correcting the deep neural network model until the difference between the second monitoring data and the second simulation leakage data is within a set difference value, constructing an offshore gas formation analysis model by taking a simulation oil gas leakage area as a boundary, obtaining combustible gas cloud space distribution data, calculating a comprehensive disaster risk index according to the combustible gas cloud space distribution data, and carrying out early warning according to a comprehensive disaster risk index classification level. The method can accurately identify the leakage points, and intelligent risk early warning and assessment are realized.

title_en: Recyclable sensor mounting device with independent adjustment of single arms and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The installation device and the installation method of the recyclable sensor with independent adjustment of each single arm aim to solve the technical problems of insufficient contact tightness and easy loosening and sliding caused by the problems of inclined drilling pore canal, accumulated bottom slag, special-shaped holes and the like in the installation process of the sensor in the construction of a deep rock mass tunnel, the device comprises a driving outer rod, a driving inner rod, an upper adjusting toothed ring, an adjusting piece, a pushing tooth, a pushing seat, an upper supporting arm and a lower supporting arm; the invention improves the stability and reliability of the sensor installation, is suitable for microseismic monitoring under complex environments such as high ground stress, high and low temperature, high karst water pressure, mining disturbance and the like, and has important significance for preventing, controlling, predicting and analyzing deep engineering underground disasters.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for flood risk under climate change
abstract_en: The invention mainly relates to the technical field of hydrologic disaster assessment, and provides an intelligent prediction method for flood risks under climate change, which is characterized in that the hydrologic process of a river basin in future period is simulated and researched based on a global climate mode and a hydrologic-deep learning coupling model, characteristic parameters of a Budyko formula are taken as covariates, a time-varying Copula function is adopted to consider the non-consistency of the hydrologic series under the influence of the climate change and human activities, a joint probability distribution function of flood duration and flood is constructed, the most probable combination of the two is solved, future flood risk changes are estimated according to the joint reproduction period difference of the most probable combination of the flood duration and the flood in future period, the socioeconomic exposure caused by future flood risk increase is predicted, the method has stronger physical meaning and statistical basis, the change characteristics of future flood under the driving of hydrologic cycle variation can be effectively represented, and the accuracy of flood risk prediction is improved.

title_en: Ship fire evacuation simulation method based on UE5
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ship fire evacuation simulation method based on UE5, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a mobile virtual agent in a virtual ship cabin scene, S2, setting an evacuation area matrix and an evacuation area connection condition matrix of the virtual ship cabin, S3, constructing a mobile virtual agent fire evacuation model based on the evacuation area matrix and the evacuation area connection condition matrix, S4, solving the evacuation model to obtain an evacuation path, and controlling the mobile virtual agent to perform evacuation simulation according to the evacuation path. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of optimizing fire evacuation routes and the like.

title_en: LTOT-based critical flight identification and guarantee plan reverse arrangement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a critical flight identification and guarantee plan reverse method based on LTOT, which comprises the steps of data integration and preprocessing, critical flight identification, multi-objective optimization, guarantee plan generation, real-time monitoring and feedback, emergency response and the like, and by combining a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm, and large model layer technologies such as deep neural network, reinforcement learning, integrated learning, natural language processing and the like, the intelligent monitoring and optimizing scheduling of the flight state and airport resources are realized, the system has real-time data acquisition, risk prediction, dynamic threshold adjustment and cross-department cooperative platform, can quickly respond to emergencies, optimize resource allocation, improve flight punctuation rate and operation efficiency, ensure data safety and privacy, and remarkably improve the intelligent level and emergency response capability of aviation scheduling.
assignees: YUNNAN HANGXIN AIRPORT NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disasters, and discloses a geological disaster early warning method, a geological disaster early warning system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of carrying out data preprocessing on acquired multi-source data to obtain preprocessed multi-source data, constructing a multi-source data set, fusing multi-dimensional data characteristics extracted from the multi-source data set through an attention mechanism to obtain a multi-source training data set, constructing an initial geological disaster early warning model through a multi-layer perceptron, a residual error network and a visual model, training the initial geological disaster early warning model through the multi-source training data set to obtain a trained geological disaster early warning model, acquiring new multi-source data in real time, carrying out real-time analysis and prediction on the new multi-source data through the geological disaster early warning model to obtain geological disaster early warning result data, and issuing grading early warning information through a preset channel when the geological disaster early warning result data reaches preset early warning conditions. The method improves the accuracy and timeliness of geological disaster early warning.

title_en: Multistage flexible net structure for large-scale debris flow prevention and control
abstract_en: The application provides a multistage flexible net structure for large-scale debris flow prevention and control, which is applied to a mountain disaster large-scale dynamics simulation experiment platform, wherein the experiment platform comprises an experiment water tank main body and a guard at the bottom of the experiment water tank main body; comprises a plurality of flexible nets positioned in an experiment water tank main body and at least two flexible nets positioned on a guard, wherein each flexible net on the guard is arranged along the direction vertical to the outlet of the experiment water tank main body. According to the application, through the arrangement of the flexible nets in the experiment water tank main body, when the debris flow is silted up and overflows in the previous flexible net, and the structure is invalid, the back flexible nets can play a role in preventing and controlling, and the arrangement of at least two flexible nets on the guard can study the diffusion of the debris flow flowing out of the natural channel opening, and the flexible nets can play a role in preventing and controlling the debris flow. The whole multi-stage flexible net works cooperatively, and multiple prevention and treatment of the flexible net on the debris flow starting process, the acceleration process, the deceleration process and the diffusion process can be studied.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk assessment method considering spatially non-uniform rainfall
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban waterlogging risk assessment method considering space uneven rainfall, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a space uneven rainfall model, S2, constructing a InfoWorks ICM storm waterlogging simulation model, S3, simulating two-dimensional surface water accumulation conditions under different uneven rainfall situations by using a InfoWorks ICM model, counting index values under different uneven rainfall situations, and S4, calculating index weights under different uneven rainfall situations according to a hierarchical analysis method, and quantifying different uneven rainfall waterlogging risks. The urban waterlogging risk assessment method considering the spatially non-uniform rainfall is adopted, so that urban waterlogging risk is assessed more accurately, and a scientific basis is provided for urban drainage planning and flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Emergency generator scheduling method for post-disaster memory and ground-air traffic coordination of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method of an emergency generator with post-disaster memory and ground-air traffic coordination of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an emergency generator scheduling optimization objective function with post-disaster memory and ground-air traffic coordination of the power distribution network by taking the minimization of total power failure loss as an objective, S2, comprehensively considering the transportation path, time coordination and resource allocation of the generator, constructing constraint conditions for scheduling optimization of a truck transporting the emergency generator after disaster of the power distribution network, S3, constructing constraint conditions for scheduling optimization of a helicopter transporting the emergency generator after disaster of the power distribution network, and S4, solving the objective function according to a preset simulated post-disaster fault scene to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme including the transportation path and the unloading capacity of the emergency generator.

title_en: Memory circulation sensing short-time strong rainfall prediction method for flood disaster early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a memory cycle perception short-time strong rainfall prediction method for flood disaster early warning, and belongs to the technical fields of meteorological disaster prevention and control and weather radar echo extrapolation. The method acquires continuous radar echo image data, constructs an MRP-LSTM circulation unit by fusing a memory circulation sensing module and a context feature storage module to obtain global features of the radar echo image, constructs a high-efficiency MRP-Net model by stacking the MRP-LSTM circulation unit, can accurately capture the time sequence features and the context relation in meteorological data after training, greatly improves the short-time strong rainfall prediction efficiency, and provides solid guarantee for timeliness and reliability of flood disaster early warning.

title_en: Method for evaluating probability of river blockage of post-earthquake rainfall induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake rainfall-induced landslide-debris flow geological disaster chain river blockage probability assessment method which comprises the following steps of 1) determining a study area for constructing a landslide occurrence probability assessment model, meshing the study area into a plurality of non-overlapping grid units, constructing the landslide occurrence probability assessment model, acquiring a landslide susceptibility distribution map, 2) acquiring a joint probability distribution model of occurrence times and volume of the landslide in a region to be measured, 3) acquiring migration characteristics of the debris flow in the region to be measured, and 4) obtaining river blockage probability of a river section in the grid unit where the river is located in the region to be measured through multiple Monte Carlo simulation based on rainfall intensity and distribution data. The invention provides a complete evaluation flow, which scientifically quantifies the river-block probability of a river reach by comprehensively calculating landslide occurrence probability and debris flow migration characteristics and combining a Monte Carlo simulation technology, thereby providing important support for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Heterogeneous extreme event prediction method for data tail distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data tail distribution heterogeneous extreme event prediction method, which belongs to the field of disaster prediction and comprises the steps of collecting historical data of scene dependent event occurrence as a scene dependent event data set, generating a non-scene dependent event data set according to experimental simulation, constructing a distribution function set fitting a data distribution rule, splitting tail data to form a plurality of split data sets, fitting an optimal distribution function model of each split data set by using the distribution function model to serve as a priori data equation, splitting the non-scene dependent event data set into a plurality of continuous data sub-data sets, using the optimal distribution function model as a distribution equation of the sub-data sets, and predicting data about to happen of the scene dependent event by using a data reconstruction equation. The invention not only provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and control, but also provides data support for related decisions, and is beneficial to reducing the damage of extreme disasters to society.

title_en: Forest fire target detection method, system, equipment and medium based on improved YOLO
abstract_en: A forest fire target detection method, system, equipment and medium based on improved YOLO comprises the steps of constructing a forest fire target detection data set FF-Dataset containing three targets of flame, smoke and firefighter, dividing the forest fire target detection data set FF-Dataset into a training set, a verification set and a test set, adopting the YOLO as a reference model, integrating a lightweight characteristic enhancement module CFIM and a cross-level characteristic fusion module DPEF-Neck, adding a new small target detection head, constructing a forest fire detection model, inputting the training set into the forest fire detection model, optimizing model network parameters, training to obtain a trained forest fire detection model, inputting the verification set into the trained forest fire detection model, verifying to obtain an optimized generalized forest fire detection model, inputting the test set into the optimized generalized forest fire detection model, testing to confirm the optimal forest fire detection model, and using the system, the equipment and the medium to realize the method.

title_en: Fixed-point lightning early warning method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed-point lightning early warning method based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing data, carrying out sample carding on a multi-source data set to obtain a sample set, carrying out sample factor correlation analysis on the sample set to obtain a sample matrix, carrying out Z-Score standardization on the sample matrix to obtain a standardized matrix, carrying out linear transformation on the standardized matrix by adopting a principal component analysis method, extracting principal components, establishing a lightning early warning model by utilizing a binary logistic regression method based on the extracted principal components, inputting a training data set to train the lightning early warning model, and carrying out fixed-point lightning early warning by utilizing the trained lightning early warning model. The lightning early warning method has the remarkable effects that an operable and practical lightning early warning method is provided for lightning disaster sensitive places such as oil houses, schools, scenic spots, industrial parks, mines and the like, and a scientific basis is provided for managers to take lightning precautionary measures in advance.

title_en: Prediction device
abstract_en: This prediction device (100) comprises: a prediction data generation unit (110) that generates prediction topography data that indicates the topography of the area around each of a plurality of structures located in a target area on the basis of location information for each of the plurality of structures and elevation information that indicates the elevation of the target area; and a prediction unit (140) that performs disaster prediction for each of the plurality of structures located in the target area by inputting the generated prediction topography data into a prediction model built by learning of training data that, for each of a plurality of structures located in a disaster area, associates training topography data that indicates the topography of the area around the structure and whether the structure has been damaged by a disaster.

title_en: Regional traffic network dynamic risk assessment method under influence of burst flood
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional traffic network dynamic risk assessment method under the influence of sudden flood, which belongs to the technical field of flood disaster assessment and comprises the steps of data acquisition and preprocessing, dynamic simulation of flood inundation process, construction of traffic network dynamic model, construction of risk assessment index system and assessment of dynamic risk, wherein the influence of dynamic factors such as flood inundation range, water depth change, water flow speed and the like on a traffic network is fully considered, and the risk of sudden flood on the traffic network can be more accurately assessed. Compared with the traditional static evaluation method, the method can better reflect the actual running condition of the traffic network under the flood disaster, and the reliability and accuracy of the evaluation result are improved. The influence of various factors can be considered more comprehensively, and the accuracy of the evaluation result is further improved. The invention is also provided with risk early warning and emergency decision support, and under the condition of sudden flood, an emergency decision maker can know the risk condition of the traffic network in time.

title_en: Landslide disaster effect analysis method considering three-dimensional stability and finite difference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide disaster effect analysis method considering three-dimensional stability and finite difference, which is characterized in that the change of groundwater level under the event rainfall is calculated in real time through FSLAM, the interaction with a stability analysis module is realized, the closed loop feedback of rainfall infiltration-stability coefficient-motion simulation is realized, the stability coefficient is used as an intensity reduction factor input by Massflow to dynamically adjust material parameters, and the full chain analysis from instability judgment to motion simulation is realized. By using high resolution DEM data, the sliding surface search range can be dynamically defined as a three-dimensional sliding surface, thereby supporting modeling of non-circular surfaces and enabling accurate capture of irregular geometries. The method overcomes the limitation of simplifying the geometric and soil mechanical characteristics of the landslide in the traditional two-dimensional analysis, more accurately captures the complex mechanical behavior in the landslide instability process, and improves the reliability of stability calculation.

title_en: Highway slope landslide monitoring and forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway slope landslide monitoring and forecasting method, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises image acquisition, image processing, model training and data prediction. According to the method, the requirement on storage equipment is reduced by shooting images at fixed time to acquire image data, the displacement of the landslide body is positioned by the monitoring target, the characteristics of the monitoring target are extracted by adopting an image processing algorithm, and the displacement data of the landslide body is acquired by calculating the coordinates of the monitoring target. And predicting the displacement of the landslide body by adopting a prediction method based on the ARIMA model and the combination of various deep learning network items. According to the method, the training network is updated through updating data, continuous prediction and landslide prediction are achieved, and the time of a landslide body reaching a highway pavement is determined according to predicted information. In addition, a brand new monitoring target is designed in the method, and all-weather automatic monitoring can be realized through a solar power supply and night lighting device.

title_en: Method and system for predicting sea wave parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to an improved sea wave prediction method comprising the steps of obtaining training data from a sea wave dataset, wherein the training data comprises a plurality of sea wave variables in the spatial domain, processing the training data by a normalization process, training a machine learning model for sea wave parameter prediction using the processed data, and generating a plurality of sea wave parameter predictions in the spatial domain using the trained machine learning model. The invention aims to provide more accurate and real-time wave prediction data so as to support the demands of the fields of ocean navigation, offshore operation, coastal construction, disaster prevention and the like.

title_en: Experimental platform and experimental method for simulating mine water-bursting and sand-bursting disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental platform and an experimental method for simulating a mine water-and-sand-bursting disaster, wherein the experimental platform comprises a water-and-sand-bursting experimental box body and a control mechanism, an experimental image acquisition system is arranged at the top of the experimental box body, an experimental hydraulic support simulation system and a water-and-sand-bursting weighing and metering system are arranged at the bottom of the experimental box body, a water-and-sand-bursting water source supply device is arranged at the outer side of the water-and-sand-bursting experimental box body, the water-and-sand-bursting experimental box body comprises a simulation box with an open top, and the control mechanism is used for controlling a hydraulic support to simulate an underground coal mine mining mode, so that the capacity of the water-and-sand-bursting simulation experiment is greatly expanded, the water-and-sand-bursting phenomenon under different coal mining conditions can be simulated, more accurate and comprehensive data support and theoretical basis are provided for the water-and sand-bursting control research in the underground coal mine mining process, and the technical problem that the conventional water-and sand-bursting physical similar simulation experimental platform can not simulate the water-and sand-bursting measurement under multiple mining conditions is solved.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Method for constructing mountain torrent hydrokinetic model and parameter calibration in data-lack region based on SWOT remote sensing data
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for constructing and calibrating a mountain torrent hydrodynamic model in a data-missing area based on SWOT remote sensing data, which relates to the technical field of hydrodynamic simulation and mountain torrent disaster early warning and comprises the steps of calculating the observed water depth of each observation point in a target area according to SWOT satellite remote sensing data and soil static environment data; the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial mountain torrent hydrodynamic model based on cellular automata, constructing a micro-parameter learning frame based on the initial mountain torrent hydrodynamic model and a preset machine learning model, training the micro-parameter learning frame to optimize model parameters of the preset machine learning model and determine corresponding optimal hydrodynamic parameters, and determining a final mountain torrent hydrodynamic model according to the optimal hydrodynamic parameters and the initial mountain torrent hydrodynamic model. The application can realize efficient, accurate and automatic parameter calibration, thereby improving the accuracy, timeliness and reliability of flood modeling.

title_en: Simulation and data combined driving coal mine fire dynamic disaster avoidance route planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation and data combined driving coal mine fire dynamic disaster avoidance route planning method, and belongs to the technical field of coal disaster prevention. The technical problems that the traditional timing update brings hysteresis and a plurality of disaster avoidance paths cannot be planned for personnel in different areas at the same time, so that the risk that a single path cannot pass is caused are solved. The method comprises the following steps of S1, positioning a fire source, S2, distinguishing a safe area, an affected area and a high-risk area, S3, monitoring a tunnel damage condition, updating a topological graph, S4, establishing a model for predicting fire and spreading toxic and harmful substances, S5, predicting change trend dynamics of factors affecting escape, S6, outputting optimal paths of different areas, and S7, sending the optimal paths. The method has the advantages that a plurality of disaster avoidance paths can be planned for people in different areas, meanwhile, the passing speed and the weight of each roadway are updated in real time when the disaster occurs, the disaster avoidance paths are dynamically adjusted, and the escape success rate of miners is improved.

title_en: Method and system for constructing Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a Tibetan zone ground disaster early warning model based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the main technical scheme of obtaining first geological data and second geological data, stage weather index data and stage disaster index data, constructing a first geological entity model and a second geological entity model corresponding to a target road section, integrating the stage weather index data into the first geological entity model to obtain a simulated geological entity model of the target road section, constructing a geological disaster early warning model based on the stage disaster index data and the simulated geological entity model, and optimizing parameters of the geological disaster early warning model based on differences between the second geological entity model and the simulated geological entity model. The model can simulate and forecast the influence of the extreme temperature difference on the property of the rock-soil body, and more accurately evaluate the geological disaster risk. The model can be continuously adapted to new environmental changes and geological disaster characteristics, and the prediction precision and long-term applicability of the early warning model are improved.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;SINOHYDRO ENGINEERING BUREAU 4 CO LTD

title_en: Mountain tobacco field yield prediction method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain tobacco plot yield prediction method based on image recognition, which comprises the following steps of collecting image information through a camera, collecting weather smell and soil information through various sensors, uploading collected data to a data cloud through a remote communication module at regular time, directly splicing or aligning the collected original data and inputting the data into a data analysis model, constructing the data analysis model from three aspects of yield prediction, quality grading and disaster risk early warning, adopting mountain environment simulation and samples to generate two data enhancement strategies, generating diversified training data conforming to mountain agronomic laws, creatively increasing the image and the soil information, monitoring various information in the tobacco growth process in an all-round manner in real time, and developing the data analysis model and the data display platform in a matched manner, thereby providing possibility for digitalized transformation of tobacco growth links.

title_en: Reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method firstly identifies risk source factors of historical extreme flood events, and utilizes Vine Copula functions to describe the uncertainty of spatial distribution of the risk source factors, and Latin hypercube sampling is used for generating a risk source factor sample; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a sampling analysis on a sample, then carrying out sample reduction based on a Neural Gas algorithm, constructing a risk source factor scene tree, combining historical flood data and adopting a homonymy scaling method to generate an extreme flood process line scene, then constructing a combined flood control optimization scheduling model, evaluating flood control risks of reservoirs and lakes, and analyzing evaluation effects. The invention has simple structure, accurate and stable risk assessment, is not only beneficial to the fine risk assessment of the high-incidence area of the flood disasters, but also provides theoretical support for extreme flood risk assessment in the data-deficient area.

title_en: Ship fire disaster multidimensional identification and classification method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of ship fire analysis, and particularly relates to a ship fire multidimensional identification and classification method. The fire image classification method comprises the following steps of continuously sampling fire images, preprocessing image data in a sampling sequence, determining a spatial scale unified standard, improving generalized indexes of an identification analysis network by carrying out necessary data enhancement processing on the sampling sequence, establishing a fire image identification network based on element feature expression capability, acquiring dynamic and static fusion features obtained after network learning, and carrying out training classification on fire image samples by a full-connection classification module E by taking the dynamic and static fusion features of the samples into consideration to obtain a final fire image classification result. The fire disaster identification neural network disclosed by the application can pay attention to the expression capability of element features in the same-level similar fire disaster images, realizes key channel control in the corresponding feature map of the fire disaster images by utilizing a global convolution attention mechanism, and creates dynamic and static fusion features to realize classification identification of the fire disaster images.

title_en: Co-vibration landslide susceptibility assessment method and system based on heterogeneous ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating the susceptibility of a same-earthquake landslide based on heterogeneous ensemble learning, which relate to the field of the susceptibility evaluation of the same-earthquake landslide and solve the problem that a single machine learning and deep learning model is difficult to capture the internal relationship between landslide occurrence and disaster factors under the condition of complex difficult mountain areas in the prior art; the method integrates landslide boundary vector data and disaster-causing factor grid data, eliminates invalid disaster-causing factors according to correlation analysis and importance analysis to obtain a training data set, constructs a CNN-RXStack landslide susceptibility evaluation model to predict the same earthquake landslide susceptibility of an earthquake area, converts the landslide occurrence probability obtained by prediction into a landslide susceptibility grade, obtains a landslide susceptibility map, and verifies and analyzes landslide susceptibility results.

title_en: Easy-to-install early warning device for ground disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an early warning device for preventing and controlling ground disasters, which is convenient to install and relates to the technical field of ground disasters, and the early warning device comprises a fixed bottom plate and an installation assembly, wherein a supporting bottom rod is installed on the upper surface of the fixed bottom plate, the installation assembly is arranged on the surface of the fixed bottom plate and comprises a fixed drill rod, a reinforcing screw rod, a fastening bolt, a supporting inner rod, a fixing hole, a fixing rod and a fixing bolt, the fixed drill rod is connected to the surface of the fixed bottom plate in a sliding mode, the surface of the fixed bottom plate is connected with the reinforcing screw rod in a threaded mode, the upper end of the reinforcing screw rod is connected with the fastening bolt in a threaded mode, and the inner side of the supporting bottom rod is connected with the supporting inner rod in a sliding mode. This early warning device for disaster prevention and cure of easy to assemble makes the device realize the quick installation of device through the installation component, and can nimble holistic height of adjusting as required, makes the device can adjust solar panel's angle automatically through adjusting component, guarantees the maximize to solar panel utilization.
assignees: HUBEI HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INST CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive breaking and dismantling training device for fire rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting training and discloses a comprehensive fire-fighting rescue breaking and dismantling training device, which comprises an inclined plane mechanism, a main body component, a first accessory and a second accessory, wherein a rolling door is arranged on the front surface of the main body component, a square frame is fixedly connected to the left side of the rolling door, square wood is arranged on the inner side of the square frame, an anti-theft door is arranged on the left side of the inner side of the main body component, a fixed circular pipe is fixedly connected to the right side of the main body component, reinforcing steel bars are arranged on the inner side of the fixed circular pipe, the inclined plane mechanism, the main body component, the first accessory and the second accessory are placed in a random combination mode according to simulated different field environments, front-back exchange and random combination mode are achieved, different space structures are combined, a complex breaking and dismantling field is simulated, the common problem that various training facilities are fixed and solidified in the past is changed, the cost of training facilities is effectively reduced, and the comprehensive breaking and dismantling skills of firefighters are effectively improved.

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for disaster of expressway high slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method or a device for identifying a mode, in particular to an automatic monitoring system for disaster of a highway high slope, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data collection and feature extraction module, a deep learning training module, a risk assessment model construction module, an early warning notification module and an automatic early warning and processing suggestion module. According to the risk assessment method, a complete risk assessment framework is formed through the risk data collection and basic credibility grading module, the Bayesian network algorithm calculation and weight weighting module and the risk level calculation module, the risk assessment framework has high systematicness, the basic credibility of each risk factor after adjustment is calculated through the Bayesian network algorithm, and the weight weighting is carried out, so that the risk assessment result is more accurate, and different risk levels of high, medium and low can be effectively distinguished.
assignees: HENAN JIAOYUAN ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD;HENAN COLLEGE OF TRANSP

title_en: Risk factor identification method for disaster condition inspection image data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a risk factor identification method for disaster patrol image data, which comprises the steps of obtaining image data of different risk factors, preprocessing the data to obtain original influence data, marking the risk factors in each image in the original image data to obtain sample image data, constructing a network model by taking YOLOv as a basic frame of a risk factor identification task, designing a loss function of the network model, training the network model by adopting the sample image data to obtain a trained risk factor identification model, and carrying out risk factor identification on real-time image data based on the trained risk factor identification model.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Expressway disaster damage event occurrence time deducing method considering traffic time lag effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway disaster damage event occurrence time deducing method considering traffic time lag effect, which comprises the steps of collecting key information of an event scene to form an emergency data sequence, matching the emergency data sequence with a database by a data center to obtain longitude and latitude of a disaster damage event occurrence place and determine numbers of an upstream ETC portal frame and a downstream ETC portal frame, screening out a vehicle list delayed by the disaster damage event by comparing a vehicle passing record of the downstream ETC portal frame with historical vehicle passing data, constructing a vehicle feature vector set of a disaster damage event section, inputting feature vectors of vehicle features and section features of a historical transaction track of the vehicle in the vehicle feature vector set to estimate a highway disaster damage event occurrence time model, training and deducing to obtain time of the vehicle reaching the disaster damage event occurrence place, and weighting and averaging to obtain estimated disaster damage event occurrence time as estimated disaster damage event occurrence time. The invention improves the information inquiry and processing efficiency and ensures the timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Forest fire wind tunnel simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire simulation experiments, and provides a forest fire wind tunnel simulation experiment device and a forest fire wind tunnel simulation experiment method, wherein a combustion experiment is carried out on a self-designed combustion platform fitted with features of terrains and covering vegetation so as to obtain a comprehensive data set of the duration, the spreading trend, the damage degree and the like of the fire of the forest fire; according to the invention, wind tunnel simulation is utilized, the influence factors of various forest fires are comprehensively considered for simulation experiments, a series of methods are adopted to enable the simulation experiments to be more close to actual forest fires, the exploration of fire characteristics, flame spread rules, fire influence ranges and damage conditions to forest ecological vegetation after the disaster when the forest fires are influenced by various factors is realized, and a powerful basis is provided for forest fire control.

title_en: Method for rapidly evaluating structural safety after bridge fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge post-fire structure safety rapid assessment method which comprises the steps of obtaining air temperature, smoke speed distribution, air pressure distribution and flame smoke images through simulating a fire scene, obtaining fire smoke images which completely describe the dynamic change process of a thermal plume and smoke speed distribution images and air pressure distribution images above a fire source when the fire is simulated to enter a fire quasi-steady state stage, forming a training sample, constructing a long-short-time memory network model, training the model, shooting the flame smoke images of the fire scene, inputting the flame smoke images into the trained long-short-time memory network model, outputting the smoke speed distribution images, calculating the final fire source heat release rate according to the flame smoke images and the smoke speed distribution images, calculating the average temperature of components in cables at different moments, and judging whether structural components fail according to the average temperature of the components in the cables at different moments. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;ANHUI LIUWU EXPRESSWAY CO LTD

title_en: Anchoring device for anti-landslide of geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anchoring device for a geological disaster landslide prevention, which relates to the technical field of landslide prevention anchoring, and comprises a bottom plate, wherein the outer surface of the bottom plate is movably abutted with a positioning nut, and the inner side surface of the bottom plate is provided with a protection mechanism; the inner side face of the anchor rod is provided with a positioning mechanism. This an anchor for geological disaster landslide prevention is at first in the landslide body that needs the anchor, and the drilling needs to go deep into in the steady ground body behind it, insert the stock in the slotted hole that drills into, utilize the pulling force of stock to resist the gliding power in the soil, firmly fix the anchor end in the rock body with cement mortar, thereby produce the anchor pulling force, pass through the stock with the pulling force and transmit outside, fix the stock through the bottom plate, firmly fix the bottom plate in the outside of landslide body, thereby constitute complete anchor effect, the pulling force that produces through the anchor end of stock transmission, fix the landslide body in situ, prevent that the landslide body from taking place the gliding harm, keep the stability of soil.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing disaster image damage building retrieval evaluation method
abstract_en: According to the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing disaster image damaged building retrieval and evaluation method, firstly, damaged building characteristics extraction based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing is provided, characteristics of a damaged building are extracted through improvement of an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing identification model network, through the whole processing process and data flow of data in a network model, by adopting two training modes of GoogLeNet and AlexNet, wherein the two training modes include weight initialization and model fine adjustment. Secondly, the generation of the damaged area based on the area prediction is provided, namely the damaged area is obtained by using a data-driven focus frame generation method to replace the traditional damaged area generation method, so that the retrieval efficiency is effectively improved, and the damaged area to be detected is regressed by using an improved non-maximum suppression method. Thirdly, through the detection experimental process and result of the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing damaged building, the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing network is subjected to feature learning by adopting a training frame capable of being processed in parallel, and the optimal method of the retrieval accuracy and efficiency of the damaged building is obtained.

title_en: Tunnel fire accident classification method, system, equipment and medium based on graphic neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of image classification, and relates to a tunnel fire accident classification method, system, equipment and medium based on a graph neural network. The method comprises the steps of collecting scene images of tunnel fire accidents, preprocessing the scene images to obtain preprocessed images, inputting the preprocessed images into a constructed tunnel fire accident classification model, and outputting a tunnel fire accident classification result. When the tunnel fire accident classification model is constructed, the image data sets are randomly divided into three subsets, the first image data set is used for constructing a preliminary model to lay a foundation for subsequent training, the second image data set is used for supervised learning to enable the model to be optimized towards the correct classification direction, and the third image data set is used for performance evaluation to ensure that the model meets the actual application requirements. The automatic fire accident classification model based on the graph neural network method can effectively reduce the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate of the traditional monitoring system, improve the fire identification rate and reduce the emergency response time.

title_en: Underwater manifold leakage emergency response decision support system based on heterogeneous information
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing and intelligent operation and maintenance of underwater production systems, and discloses an underwater manifold leakage emergency response decision support system based on heterogeneous information. Firstly, the data acquisition and integration module acquires multi-source heterogeneous data in real time, wherein the multi-source heterogeneous data comprises underwater sensor data, environment data and historical leakage accident data, and the data are cleaned, formatted and stored. And secondly, a leakage result evaluation module predicts a leakage diffusion range, evaluates accident influence degree and quantifies accident grades based on computational fluid dynamics leakage diffusion simulation and combining an SVM model. And finally, the emergency response scheme generating module calculates index weight by adopting an entropy weight method based on the leakage evaluation result and the historical emergency plan data, and performs priority ranking on the emergency schemes by combining CoCoSo, so as to select an optimal emergency response scheme and support real-time adjustment and optimization.

title_en: Construction site emergency management method, device, equipment and medium based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses a construction site emergency management method based on a micro-service architecture, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical event data and constructing a dynamic digital plan library; the method comprises the steps of applying a dynamic digital plan library to corresponding modules based on a modularized system framework, constructing a structural event matching rule, determining required emergency equipment and computing resources according to the structural event matching rule when an emergency exists, generating an elastic resource management instruction, acquiring data cockpit resources, integrating by using the modularized system framework based on the data cockpit resources, generating a full-dimensional state visual view of a construction site, acquiring double-blind drilling data and an emergency response record, searching problems in an AI model and plan logic, and performing emergency management. The invention also provides a construction site emergency management device, equipment and storage medium based on the micro-service architecture. The invention can improve the risk response speed.

title_en: Dangerous rock multi-parameter association early warning method and system based on space-sky-earth comprehensive perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a dangerous rock multi-parameter association early warning method and system based on space-earth-inner comprehensive perception, belonging to the technical field of dangerous rock monitoring, integrating multiple and multi-scale dangerous rock monitoring data, constructing a multi-parameter early warning system with data complementation, data fusion and data association by utilizing precursor information of dangerous rock instability, solving the problem that data is on one side when single factor or single scale information is predicted, the method has the advantages that the data complementation and comprehensive early warning are realized, meanwhile, a training database for monitoring dangerous rock is generated based on a plurality of dangerous rock destabilization cases and correction data streams, and an early warning function model containing multi-parameter information is constructed, so that the development trend of the data streams of the monitored dangerous rock and the steady state of the dangerous rock are evaluated and prejudged, early warning indication is made according to the early warning level of the monitored dangerous rock, and the early warning accuracy and timeliness of dangerous rock collapse disasters are improved.

title_en: Resource allocation method and system considering two-stage process of disaster prevention and recovery of distribution network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and particularly discloses a resource allocation method and a system considering two-stage process of resisting and recovering a distribution network disaster; the method comprises the steps of constructing mathematical models of a defense response stage and a power supply recovery stage in a post-disaster recovery process of a power distribution network based on mathematical models of a distributed power supply, a telemechanical switch and a flexible soft switch, mathematically characterizing operation and topology characteristics of the power distribution network in the defense response stage and the power supply recovery stage in the recovery process, constructing an optimization framework for elastic lifting in the post-disaster recovery process of the power distribution network, randomly generating a fault simulation post-disaster recovery scene of the power distribution network, and generating a joint configuration scheme of multiple types of flexible resources through the obtained optimization framework to obtain configuration positions and configuration quantity of the distributed power supply, the telemechanical switch and the flexible soft switch. The method can enhance the elasticity of the power grid and improve the resistance and response effect of the power distribution network to disasters.

title_en: Self-supervision remote sensing image registration method based on global information robust feature description
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-supervision remote sensing image registration method based on global information robust feature description, which mainly solves the problems that the existing method is weak in recognition capability and needs a large amount of manual annotation data in the face of complex deformation and extreme appearance change. The realization scheme comprises the steps of generating a synthetic homography data set, utilizing a training key point extraction network of the synthetic homography data set, carrying out random transformation on a large-scale training data set to generate multiple versions of the same picture, utilizing the trained key point extraction network to obtain key point information of the large-scale training data set after random transformation, merging key points of different versions of the same picture, constructing a neural network, utilizing the merged key points to train the merged key points to derive a matching point set, and utilizing the matching point set to calculate homography matrix to carry out image registration. According to the invention, manual labeling is avoided, more robust matching key points and descriptors can be obtained, the accuracy of matching the remote sensing images in the visible light wave band under extreme visual angle change is improved, and the method can be used for preprocessing image data of remote sensing tasks such as environment monitoring, disaster assessment, land classification, urban expansion analysis and the like.

title_en: Expansive soil landslide monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an expansive soil landslide monitoring method, system, equipment and storage medium, which belong to the field of geological disaster monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining measurement parameters and earth surface displacement data of an expansive soil landslide monitoring area, calculating a spearman grade correlation coefficient between the earth surface displacement data and the measurement parameters, screening data in the measurement parameters, taking the screened measurement parameters as characteristic factors, inputting the earth surface displacement data and the characteristic factors into an LSTM (long short term memory) model for training, optimizing super-parameters of the LSTM model through a Bayesian algorithm to obtain an expansive soil monitoring model, continuously obtaining real-time measurement parameters of the expansive soil landslide monitoring area, inputting the real-time measurement parameters into the expansive soil monitoring model to obtain a predicted value of the earth surface displacement data, and realizing the expansive soil landslide monitoring according to the predicted value. The accuracy and the reliability of landslide monitoring are obviously improved, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is improved.

title_en: Fire pump station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment and discloses a fire-fighting pump station, which comprises a prying seat, wherein a water tank is welded on the upper surface of the prying seat, a diesel engine and a water pump are respectively and movably arranged on two sides of the upper surface of the prying seat, the diesel engine and the water pump are in transmission connection through a high-elasticity coupling, a foam tank is arranged on the upper surface of the water tank, one end of the water pump is connected with a pump port soft joint, the other end of the pump port soft joint is internally connected with a pipeline, the end part of the pipeline is connected with the water tank, and a water inlet main valve and a vacuum meter are respectively arranged at the position where the water tank is connected with the pipeline. This kind of fire pump station can effectually mix water and foam liquid to be used for daily drilling and emergency to put out a fire, daily drilling improves the reaction efficiency when the disaster appears, avoids the further expansion of conflagration, reduces the loss, and the device is used for the measure to emergent fire extinguishing simultaneously, can carry out long-range water supply.
assignees: LIAONING LIDA RUNFENG EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Anchor rod and anchor cable drilling machine for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of anchoring drilling machine parts, and discloses an anchor rod and anchor cable drilling machine for geological disaster investigation, which comprises an anchor rod and a pressure head component, wherein a right-angle trapezoid groove is formed in the outer surface of the other end of the anchor rod, the pressure head component comprises an inner ejector rod, a straight groove is formed in the outer surface of the inner ejector rod along the direction of the central axis of the inner ejector rod, an annular groove is formed in the middle of the outer surface of the inner ejector rod, and an outer clamping sleeve comprises a movable sleeve movably sleeved on the outer surface of the inner ejector rod. According to the anchor rod and anchor cable drilling machine for geological disaster investigation, provided by the application, for the arrangement of the pressure head component and the upper structure of the pressure head component, when the pushing mechanism on the anchor drilling machine moves down the newly added anchor rod, the claw can be clamped into the right-angle trapezoid groove, and when the claw rotates in the corresponding direction, the idle time of the pushing mechanism on the claw is effectively shortened, the invalid acting of the anchor drilling machine is avoided, and the drilling efficiency of the anchor drilling machine is improved while the energy consumption is reduced.
assignees: ANHUI CHUANGGONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Double-reel wire deicing device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a double-reel wire deicing device, and relates to the technical field of wire deicing. The drill rod comprises a drill rod, a chuck is arranged below the drill rod, a connecting rod is arranged below the chuck, a reduction gearbox is arranged below the connecting rod, a motor is arranged below the reduction gearbox, a bearing plate is arranged above the reduction gearbox, and a fixing frame is arranged above the bearing plate. The drill rod can well fix the path trend of the line before deicing, when the ice layer enters the deicing range, the spiral blades on the circumferential surface of the drill rod can effectively fix the position of the line to enable the line to accurately enter the lower part of the driving wheel, the effect of extruding the ice layer can be achieved, the effect of breaking ice can be achieved, the cliff type differential design can avoid improper cleaning of a deicing system, larger vibration can be added to the electric wire to remove the ice layer which is easy to fall off on the electric wire, the purpose of rapidly removing the ice layer is achieved, and the influence of natural disasters is further reduced.

title_en: Device for preventing and controlling coal spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for preventing and controlling coal spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disasters, which is characterized in that a pneumatic booster pump is matched with a proportional regulating valve to accurately control slurry flow by high-pressure nitrogen, the required dosage of grouting materials is determined according to the porosity of a goaf, so that the slurry flow nitrogen is pushed to be injected into the goaf, the accuracy of the slurry dosage and the safety in the grouting process are improved, in addition, a sleeve is combined with a grouting pipe, the monitoring result is fed back through an environment monitoring device and a gas analyzer, the grouting range can be adjusted more flexibly according to the conditions of cracks with different depths of a drill hole because the sleeve can move, and the environment monitoring device and the gas analyzer can realize real-time monitoring of the temperature, different gas concentrations and pressures in the whole path before and after grouting and in the grouting process, timely feed back the abnormal data conditions of the required positions, and greatly improve the safety in the underground operation process and the accuracy and the effectiveness in the grouting process.
assignees: UNIV HUNAN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;LUWA COAL MINE SHANDONG LUTAI HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV TIANJIN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semantic modeling, and focuses on a forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving. Aiming at the complexity of fire spread in a forest and town boundary area (WUI), the method creatively introduces a space-time semantic driving mechanism on the basis of a traditional fire spread model, combines the characteristics of the WUI area, and solves the defects of the traditional simulation method in the aspects of accuracy, timeliness and adaptability to complex environments. The method comprises the steps of constructing a WUI fire spreading model based on cellular automaton, constructing a WUI fire scene simulation knowledge meta model and a knowledge map, and constructing a fire space-time semantic query and simulation framework. According to the invention, by fusing semantic information of time and space dimensions, the spreading path and speed of the fire disaster under different terrains, building distribution and meteorological conditions can be more accurately simulated, a more reliable decision basis is provided for fire disaster prevention, emergency response and resource allocation, and the fire disaster prevention and control capability of the border area of forests and towns is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel quality detection and discloses a tunnel operation quality rapid detection method based on energy efficiency evaluation, which comprises the following steps of S1, multi-source data fusion acquisition and modeling, namely deploying an Internet of things sensor network and constructing a three-dimensional tunnel model; S2, dynamic energy efficiency evaluation and self-adaptive scoring, namely calculating a multidimensional energy efficiency ratio based on real-time data, training a lightweight LightGBM model, updating the model every 24 hours in an increment mode, S3, automatically switching to an emergency energy efficiency mode when traffic congestion exceeds a threshold value and a fire disaster occurs in an extreme scene mode, S4, digital twin simulation and real-time optimization, S5, block chain knowledge precipitation and closed-loop management. By monitoring the congestion index and the pollutant concentration in real time, injecting extreme scene data in a virtual environment, locally training LightGBM models of all tunnels, encrypting and uploading parameters to a center for aggregation, and running the equipment according to a decision to realize the dynamic and traceability of energy efficiency evaluation under congestion or fire.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIAO GUOTONG INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale subway group escape system based on panic emotion infection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale subway group escape system based on panic emotion infection, which relates to the technical field of escape systems, and comprises the following steps of 1, constructing crowd evacuation scenes according to subway related information, 2, initializing crowd Crowd, enabling each individual in crowd Crowd to comprise personality traits phi, an initial emotion value e  0  and an initial movement speed v  0 , 3, carrying out an emotion infection simulation algorithm, 4, dividing the range between a pedestrian carrying luggage and the luggage into less than or equal to 0.5m, secondly, carrying out related weighting and improvement on the evacuation speed and the behaviors of the pedestrian according to the volume and the weight of the luggage, and when the volume and the weight of the luggage exceed the personal bearing capacity, generating a discarding behavior, 5, calculating the crowd density rho of a walking area at time t+1 according to the crowd movement information, updating the crowd evacuation behaviors, and 6, and realizing the crowd evacuation visualization in a graphical mode.

title_en: Flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoirs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control dispatching simulation method and system suitable for a multistage serial-parallel cascade reservoir, comprising the steps of collecting and arranging basic data; the method comprises the steps of extracting river network water systems, dividing sub-watershed, generating topological structures based on cascade reservoir serial-parallel connection relations, performing standardization treatment, constructing a model based on three layers of nested circulation on the basis of the cascade reservoir topological structure relations, realizing simulation of warehousing flood and flood control calculation processes of the cascade reservoirs step by step from upstream to downstream, simulating cascade reservoir flood control scheduling processes under different schemes through setting schemes, and performing scheme comparison analysis and effect evaluation. According to the invention, the data base plate and the water rain condition monitoring information are fully utilized, the cascade reservoirs with complex series-parallel connection relations such as series connection, parallel connection or series-parallel connection can be adapted, the simulation of the cascade reservoir flood forecasting and flood control scheduling process is realized, reliable guarantee is provided for scientifically and reasonably formulating a cascade reservoir scheduling scheme, and technical support is provided for improving flood control and disaster reduction capability.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for rock-soil body rupture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rock-soil body monitoring, in particular to an intelligent monitoring method and system for rock-soil body rupture. The intelligent monitoring system for the rock-soil body rupture comprises a data acquisition module, a contact score calculation module and a monitoring adjustment module. The system can comprehensively capture various fine changes of the rock-soil body before fracture through multi-dimensional data monitoring, further accurately judge the stability state of the rock-soil body and discover potential fracture risks in time, and meanwhile, through a historical sample training and index weighting scoring mechanism, the system can quantify the nonlinear association of the cooperative changes among parameters such as surface stress gradient, micro-seismic wave arrival time difference, pore water pressure and the like and fracture precursors, so that powerful data support is provided for effective prevention measures, and occurrence of rock-soil body fracture disasters is effectively avoided.
assignees: FUJIAN RONGQI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Modeling simulation method and data query system for icing stress of distribution line
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a modeling simulation method and a data query system for icing stress of a distribution line, and relates to the technical field of monitoring and management of power systems. The method is based on COMSOL Multiphysics software, models are built according to the section, the span and the material of the distribution line, dead weight load, wind load, ice coating load and the like are applied to the distribution line, then grid division is carried out, calculation is carried out, research types are determined, and a diagram, a deformation map and the like are obtained. And then an App developer is built in the software, a form editor is utilized to manufacture a distribution line icing stress data query system, and the stress and deformation diagram of the distribution line can be calculated and queried by inputting relevant parameters and corresponding meteorological data of the distribution line. The method can comprehensively analyze the real-time stress condition of the wire, can be applied to finite element modeling and stress analysis of the distribution wire, and meanwhile, the manufactured data query system can help staff judge whether the distribution wire has potential risks, ensure the safe operation of the wire and reduce the occurrence of disasters.

title_en: Three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on complex network theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-network collaborative power grid recovery method and system based on a complex network theory, which belong to the technical field of power systems, and effectively solve the problems that the traditional scheme only focuses on fault propagation in a single network, the simulation result and the actual physical condition of the traditional scheme are greatly different, and the traditional power grid recovery strategy mainly only considers a single traditional power generation power station due to the single structure of a current urban power station, so that the disaster recovery capability is poor, the disaster resistance capability is weak and the recovery strategy is not flexible enough.

title_en: Multidimensional situation deduction method for flood disaster prevention of closed or semi-closed space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional situation deduction method for flood prevention disasters in a closed or semi-closed space, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and acquiring geographical and building data, hydrology and meteorological data related to a specified underground space, S2, creating a 3D digital model of the specified underground space according to the geographical and building data, S3, performing scene simulation in the specified 3D digital model according to the hydrology and the meteorological data, establishing a fluid dynamic model, analyzing the interaction relation between the specified underground space and flood factors according to the fluid dynamic model, calculating the correlation characteristics of the specified underground space in time sequence for flood disaster occurrence according to the interaction relation, and implementing different prevention and treatment schemes according to the correlation characteristics. According to the invention, multidimensional simulation and analysis are carried out according to different rainfall situations, so that flood risks under different conditions can be estimated, high-risk areas can be accurately identified, and a specific control scheme is provided according to different situations.
assignees: JIANGXI TELECOM INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode remote sensing image progressive registration method and system
