abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode remote sensing image progressive registering method and system, which comprise the steps of 1, obtaining multi-mode remote sensing image pairs before and after disaster in a disaster area, constructing a disaster scene multi-mode disaster remote sensing image registering data set, dividing a training set and a testing set, 2, constructing a multi-scale depth feature extraction network, carrying out depth coding on the multi-mode remote sensing image pairs, respectively extracting local details and global structural features, generating a multi-scale feature pyramid, 3, constructing a progressive cross-mode transformation network based on the multi-scale feature pyramid, excavating mode invariant features through a cross-mode attention mechanism, returning to a multi-scale symmetrical dense deformation field pixel by pixel, 4, training a depth learning model through a consistency loss function based on the multi-scale symmetrical dense deformation field, executing geometric transformation on the testing set data by using the trained depth learning model, and outputting registering results. The invention realizes the automatic geometric correction of the multi-mode remote sensing image.

title_en: Working pipe assembly for staged fracturing of coal seam roof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a working pipe assembly for staged fracturing of a coal seam roof. The coal mining depth is increased, so that roof disasters frequently happen, the defects of the traditional treatment method are multiple, and the problems that the long drilling segmented hydraulic fracturing technology is complex in operation, the packer is easy to damage and the like are solved. The working tube assembly comprises a fracturing working tube, wherein a seat valve bank and a fracturing working valve bank are sequentially arranged in the fracturing working tube, and the seat valve bank and the fracturing working valve bank share the same valve core. Under different pressures, the valve core can move in the two groups of valves, so that the seat sealing and fracturing functions are realized. The seat seal valve group and the fracturing working valve group are respectively provided with a valve body and a switch, and the working state is controlled through the matching of the valve core and the switch. The hydraulic fracturing device is controlled by the preset pressure threshold, has a simple structure, can accurately plug and conduct the fracturing section, reduces the dependence on a drilling machine, is stable and reliable, can meet the requirements of various working conditions of the hydraulic fracturing of the coal mine section, and can strongly support the disaster management of the coal mine roof.

title_en: Multi-information fusion type tunnel advanced geological forecast water disaster hidden danger judging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-information-fused tunnel advanced geological forecast water disaster hidden danger judging method, relates to the technical field of advanced geological forecast, and can acquire information of various tunnel advanced geological forecast methods when advanced geological forecast work is implemented. The method is based on a dynamic weighted average method to realize an information fusion scheme formula, quantize various information weight scores, the weighted average method is to assign a weight to each parameter or index, and then to carry out weighted average on the values of each parameter or index to obtain a comprehensive value, so that the problems of scattered discrimination reference information, more artificial interference, inaccurate judgment and the like of flood hidden danger in advanced geological prediction work of a tunnel by means of geophysical prospecting, drilling and the like are solved, spatial position characteristics of hidden danger in water-rich areas such as karst cave and fracture in front of a tunnel face are facilitated to be more accurately discriminated, the development probability of the flood hidden danger in front of the tunnel is quantized, and references are provided for tunnel excavation construction so as to reduce the potential safety hazards of tunnel excavation construction.
assignees: WUHAN CCCC ENG SURVEYING CO LTD

title_en: Long-distance pipeline landslide disaster simulation method integrating multiple physical models
abstract_en: The invention provides a long-distance pipeline landslide hazard simulation method integrating multiple physical models, which comprises the steps of collecting data, determining disaster-causing factors based on geographic space distribution according to a pipeline basic database, determining disaster-causing factors based on time distribution according to the pipeline basic database, acquiring a landslide hazard susceptibility regional map according to the disaster-causing factors based on geographic space distribution, acquiring a landslide hazard spatial sensitivity regional map according to the disaster-causing factors based on time distribution, performing space-time coupling on the landslide hazard susceptibility regional map and the landslide hazard spatial sensitivity regional map to acquire a landslide hazard dynamic regional map, and inputting the landslide hazard dynamic regional map into a space-time deep learning model to acquire a predicted long-distance pipeline landslide hazard. The invention has the technical effect that the dynamic mechanism of the landslide disaster of the long-distance pipeline can be comprehensively revealed, thereby providing more scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM PIPELINE ENGINEERING CORP;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM PIPELINE ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Test platform and test method for simulating glacier disasters based on centrifugal machine
abstract_en: The application discloses a test platform and a test method for simulating glacier disasters based on a centrifugal machine, wherein the test platform comprises a circulating cooling system, a chute system and a refrigerating system, wherein the chute system and the refrigerating system are arranged on the centrifugal machine; the chute system comprises a material box, a model box and a slope module, wherein the material box is used for storing and releasing materials, the material box is communicated with the model box, and the slope module is arranged in the model box and is used for providing space for movement of the materials. When the glacier disaster simulation test is performed based on the centrifugal machine, the centrifugal machine applies increasing centrifugal acceleration load to the chute system, so that an equivalent high gravity environment is realized. In the test process, the mixture of the ice and the soil is released from the material box into the model box and then slides along the inclined plane of the slope module, so that the actual glacier disaster movement is simulated, and the development process of the glacier disaster is studied.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line coupling disaster simulation evaluation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: A power transmission and distribution line coupling disaster simulation evaluation method, system, equipment and medium comprise the steps of generating a three-dimensional topographic map according to a geographical area to be simulated, conducting grid division on the geographical area, generating corresponding geological disaster risk evaluation indexes for each grid after division, obtaining meteorological data, conducting carousel chart display on the geographical area to be simulated, obtaining power transmission and distribution line data, conducting visual display on the three-dimensional topographic map, generating a line digital model, calculating disaster risk coefficients corresponding to the line digital models based on the meteorological data and the geological disaster risk evaluation indexes, dividing risk grades corresponding to the line digital models, constructing a finite element model, conducting multi-physical field coupling simulation for multiple working conditions, evaluating disaster risk of the power transmission and distribution line according to the result of the multi-physical field coupling simulation, and generating an evaluation result. The method can improve the accuracy of prediction of physical damage of the power transmission and distribution line system under the condition of the composite disaster chain.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Software supply chain safety protection method, device, equipment and medium based on SBOM
abstract_en: The utility model provides a software supply chain safety protection method, device, equipment and medium based on SBOM, relating to the technical field of software supply chain safety; the method comprises the steps of extracting at least one format of SBOM file from a software supply chain, analyzing the SBOM file into predefined structural data, carrying out component identification, dependency relation identification and component traceability analysis, carrying out security risk detection on each identified component and carrying out quantitative evaluation on component risks, automatically generating an attack scene according to loopholes and dependency relations based on the security risk detection result, carrying out attack simulation and testing, generating a security test report, and configuring a defense and emergency response mechanism aiming at the identified attack risks or after the actual occurrence of attack events. The invention comprehensively integrates the capability of multiple SBOM formats, the enhanced dynamic protection capability and a platform supporting attack and defense exercise, and the characteristics can effectively improve the safety protection capability of a software supply chain and provide more reliable safety guarantee for enterprises.
assignees: CHINA IND CONTROL SYSTEMS CYBER EMERGENCY RESPONSE TEAM

title_en: Quick visualization method and system for earthquake emergency information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data visualization, in particular to a method and a system for quickly visualizing earthquake emergency information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining earthquake monitoring real-time data, dividing population density distribution of a seismic area and key facility positions based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data in a grid mode, generating a seismic area sensitivity matrix, dynamically simulating a seismic wave propagation process based on the earthquake monitoring real-time data and the seismic area sensitivity matrix, generating fluctuation propagation time sequence data, identifying earthquake medium topography and topography vector data of the earthquake monitoring real-time data, and respectively evaluating topography fluctuation and geological stability to obtain earthquake topography fluctuation index data and earthquake geological stability scoring data. According to the invention, through a data visualization technology, quick and accurate evaluation and visualization of earthquake hazard distribution are realized, so that the earthquake emergency response efficiency and the scientificity of disaster rescue decisions are improved.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Distribution network equipment fault discrimination model training method, discrimination method and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distribution network equipment, and discloses a distribution network equipment fault discrimination model training method, a discrimination method and related equipment. The fusion characteristic integrates visual information of the ultrasonic spectrogram and operation data of the electrical equipment, and makes up for the defect of single data source information. And (3) performing iterative training on a pre-constructed fault discrimination model based on the fully-connected neural network by adopting an improved self-adaptive Chernobelin disaster optimization algorithm. By adopting the mode, the model parameters can be optimized, and the learning and distinguishing capability of the model on the fusion characteristics is improved. Therefore, the trained fault discrimination model can more comprehensively and accurately reflect the actual running condition of the equipment, the map features and the running data are effectively fused, and the accurate discrimination capability of potential faults of the equipment is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Operation and maintenance method, system, equipment and medium of drainage pipe network
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation and maintenance method, a system, equipment and a medium of a drainage pipe network, wherein the method is to obtain historical monitoring data of the drainage pipe network in a target area; the method comprises the steps of inputting historical monitoring data into a preset pipe network risk identification model for training to obtain a pipe network risk identification model after training, obtaining real-time monitoring data of a drainage pipe network in a target area, inputting the real-time monitoring data into the pipe network risk identification model after training to obtain a pipe network risk identification result of the target area, generating a health index of the drainage pipe network in the target area according to the real-time monitoring data, and generating an operation and maintenance scheme of the drainage pipe network according to the health index and the pipe network risk identification result. According to the application, the risk state in the pipe network is automatically identified, and the multiple factors such as the topological relation of the pipe network and the flow load are combined to generate the multidimensional operation and maintenance scheme, so that the occurrence of secondary disasters such as urban waterlogging can be effectively avoided, and scientific basis is provided for pipe network planning and investment decision-making.
assignees: XIAMEN MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;XIAMEN MUNICIPAL DRAINAGE MAN CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst dangerous area anchoring parameter design and control effect evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for designing anchoring parameters and evaluating control effects of a rock burst dangerous area, which relates to the technical field of surrounding rock dynamic disaster prevention and control and comprises the steps of developing a dynamic test for supporting an anchor rod and acquiring the dynamic energy absorbing capacity of the anchor rod; the method comprises the steps of establishing an integral stratum model, carrying out simulated excavation to obtain releasable elastic strain energy of surrounding rocks of a roadway in unit volume, determining the number of the required anchor rods in each row distance length of the roadway according to the power energy absorbing capacity of the anchor rods and the releasable elastic strain energy of the surrounding rocks of the unit volume, and carrying out field test to evaluate the anchoring effect. The invention can improve the accuracy of the anchoring parameter design of the rock burst dangerous area.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning optimization method and device based on AI large model technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning optimization method and device based on an AI large model technology, and belongs to the technical field of geological data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining scene characteristics of a target area, wherein the scene characteristics comprise landform topography, geological structures and engineering parameters, determining typical scenes matched with the target area based on the scene characteristics, wherein each typical scene corresponds to a pre-trained AI large model, and performing optimization training on the AI large model corresponding to the typical scene based on scene characteristic differences of the target area and the typical scene so as to perform geological disaster early warning on the target area based on the optimized AI large model. According to the invention, under the condition of limited sample size, the existing knowledge resources are fully utilized, the specific characteristics of the target area are combined, a high-precision geological disaster early warning model is constructed, and the geological disaster early warning effect is optimized.
assignees: CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Inventory resource scheduling method based on decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems that the prior inventory scheduling method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning has dimension disasters and can not efficiently perform inter-warehouse cooperation, the invention provides a graph-based reward aggregation multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm, which simplifies a global value function into a local value function through an inherent coupling relation among nodes, eliminates redundant information, reduces the input dimension of the value function, reduces the fitting difficulty of the value function, and transmits preference information of different nodes by using a reward aggregation mechanism so as to realize efficient cooperation; the strategy of each node is trained through a local value function, and after the training is finished, each node can obtain an allocation scheme of the owned resources only by acquiring the observation value of the node.

title_en: Method, system, medium and equipment for rapidly predicting earthquake damage of steel beam barrel floor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of building safety monitoring and disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a method, a system, a medium and equipment for rapidly predicting earthquake damages of a steel beam barrel floor, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a steel beam barrel finite element model for carrying out steel beam barrel elastoplastic analysis according to floor parameters in actual engineering cases; inputting pre-selected seismic waves into a steel beam barrel finite element model for experimental simulation, collecting and marking damage data of steel beam barrel floors, carrying out feature selection on the marked damage data, forming a damage data set of the steel beam barrel floors by the selected damage data to evaluate and predict the floor damage state, training a selected machine learning model based on the damage data set, carrying out super-parameter optimization, taking the optimized machine learning model as a prediction model of the steel beam barrel floor seismic damage, and carrying out feature importance analysis on the prediction model by adopting SHAP (short-cut point) to explain the dominant mechanism conversion rules in different damage stages.

title_en: Video AI technology-based wharf unbinding operation safety monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring methods, and discloses a wharf cable-releasing operation safety monitoring method based on a video AI technology, which comprises the following steps of relying on an existing video monitoring platform, releasing cable-releasing operation historical video data through a wharf and manually simulating on site; and by combining the latest artificial intelligent deep learning technology, comparing and analyzing various hidden danger features in the image video and disaster databases, detecting the potential safety hazards generated in the video monitoring area in time, and realizing intelligent identification of the cable releasing operation in the petrochemical wharf area. The video AI technology-based wharf unbuckling operation safety monitoring method realizes the station detection function of wharf unbuckling operation personnel, early detection of safety risks, early warning of potential safety hazards, early prevention of on-site violations, early treatment of problem processes, timely elimination of the phenomenon that safety precautions are not implemented in place, and rapid solution of the problem of insufficient execution of the safety precautions, thereby enhancing the safety management capability of companies.
assignees: TIANJIN PORT PETROCHEMICALS TERMINAL CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster chain analysis method combining numerical simulation and complex network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic disaster prevention and risk assessment, in particular to a debris flow disaster chain analysis method combining numerical simulation and a complex network. The method comprises the steps of collecting and analyzing storm, flood and debris flow historical data in a research area, extracting disaster chain association information, establishing a debris flow numerical model, constructing a debris flow disaster chain network, evaluating the vulnerability and efficiency of the network, formulating a broken chain strategy by deleting key nodes or edges, calculating network density change to verify disaster reduction effects, and quantitatively analyzing and discussing the broken chain strategy and the disaster reduction effects. The invention can identify high risk areas and fragile nodes, can quantify the vulnerability and network efficiency of disaster chains, and further formulate targeted disaster reduction measures aiming at different rainfall intensities, thereby providing scientific basis for disaster prevention, disaster reduction and emergency management.

title_en: Hidden structure detection system for intelligent monitoring, early warning and control of mine water damage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster prevention and control, and particularly discloses a hidden structure detection system for mine water disaster intelligent monitoring and early warning prevention and control, which is used for solving the problems of low detection precision of a mine hidden structure, mine water disaster early warning delay and large simulation error of a seismic wave propagation path, and comprises a multi-source data comprehensive detection module, a real-time imaging module, a microseismic multi-scale intelligent analysis module, a seismic wave signal identification module, a region difference analysis module and an intelligent data processing module; according to the invention, through fusion of multisource data, real-time imaging, microseismic analysis, seismic wave identification and intelligent data processing technologies, accurate detection of a hidden structure of a mine, high-precision prediction of mine earthquake and water damage and real-time early warning of risk are realized, and timeliness and accuracy of mine water damage prevention are improved.

title_en: Sampling device for engineering rock soil detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of sampling devices for detection, in particular to a sampling device for engineering rock and soil detection, which comprises a rectangular connecting top plate, an adjusting sampling assembly and a stable supporting assembly, wherein the lower end part of the rectangular connecting top plate is fixedly connected with the adjusting sampling assembly for sampling engineering rock and soil, the adjusting sampling assembly comprises a supporting rod, a limiting clamping ring, a working groove plate, an extending fixed plate, a damping rotating groove block, an electric lifting rod, a rectangular mounting plate, a connecting column, a fixed placing plate, a rotating motor, a drilling cone, a sampling cylinder and spiral teeth, the lower end part of the rectangular connecting top plate is fixedly welded with a supporting rod, samples conforming to geological conditions can be effectively obtained from the site, reliable basis is provided for laboratory analysis, key parameters such as foundation bearing capacity, soil stability and the like can be more accurately estimated through high-quality sampling, the change trend of the geological environment can be monitored through periodic sampling analysis, and potential geological disasters can be prevented.
assignees: SHOUGUANG RUIKE ARCH DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Device for environmental facilities simulation disaster safe education and method thereof
title_ko: 환경시설 가상 재난 안전 교육 장치 및 환경시설 가상 재난 안전 교육 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an environmental facility virtual disaster safety education device comprises at least one processor. The at least one processor determines an environmental facility in which virtual disaster safety education is to be performed based on a user input, determines any one disaster in which the virtual property safety education is to be performed among disasters that may occur in the determined environmental facility based on the user input, determines a method for providing the virtual disaster safety education for the determined any one disaster based on the user input, and performs the virtual property safety education using a display device corresponding to the determined method for providing the additional disaster safety education.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일실시예에 따르면, 환경시설 가상 재난 안전 교육 장치에 있어서, 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 사용자의 입력을 기초로 가상 재난 안전 교육이 수행될 환경시설을 결정하고, 상기 사용자의 입력을 기초로 상기 결정한 환경시설에서 발생 가능한 재난들 중 상기 가상 재산 안전 교육이 수행될 어느 하나의 재난을 결정하고, 상기 사용자의 입력을 기초로 상기 결정한 어느 하나의 재난에 대한 상기 가상 재난 안전 교육 제공 방법을 결정하고, 상기 결정한 상기 가산 재난 안전 교육 제공 방법과 대응되는 디스플레이 장치를 이용하여 상기 가상 재산 안전 교육을 수행한다.

title_en: A wearable controller for providing a phantom pain
title_ko: 환상통을 제공하는 웨어러블 제어 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable control device for providing a phantom pain, which individually adjusts the temperature of each of a plurality of peltier elements to provide a virtual phantom pain experience according to warmth and coolness stimulation to a user body in contact with the peltier elements, thereby increasing a training effect through real phantom pain stimulation in military training or firefighting training without actual physical injury or injury.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다수 개의 펠티어 소자 각각의 온도를 개별 조절함으로써 펠티어 소자에 접촉한 사용자 신체에 온감 및 냉감 자극에 따른 가상의 환상통(Phantom pain) 경험을 제공함으로써, 실제 신체적 상처나 상해 없이도 군사 훈련이나 소방 훈련 등에서 실제와 같은 환상통 자극을 통해 훈련 효과를 높일 수 있는 환상통을 제공하는 웨어러블 제어 장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Power distribution network line reinforcement decision-making method and system considering typhoon disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line reinforcement decision-making method of a power distribution network under consideration of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of generating fault probability of each line after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to a power distribution network pole fault probability generation method, acquiring fault states of each line in the power distribution network after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters, non-electric vehicle user load data and electric vehicle initial states, then establishing a post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, simulating a restoration process after the occurrence of the typhoon disasters according to the post-disaster flexible resource collaborative quick recovery model, obtaining restoration moments of each line, sorting according to the restoration moments of each line by using a Copride sorting method, so as to obtain line importance sorting, and making line anti-station reinforcement decisions of the power distribution network according to the line importance sorting. The method can be used for making the line reinforcement strategy of the power distribution network under typhoon extreme natural disasters.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Geological disaster risk prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk prediction method which comprises the steps of obtaining existing geological disaster data information, selecting a plurality of geological factors as geological disaster risk candidate indexes, performing correlation analysis to obtain final geological disaster risk indexes, constructing a training data set, constructing a geological disaster risk prediction initial model based on SPM chaotic mapping, sparrow algorithm and limit gradient lifting algorithm, training to obtain a geological disaster risk prediction model, and performing actual geological disaster risk prediction of a target area by adopting the geological disaster risk prediction model. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the geological disaster risk prediction method. According to the invention, the risk index is selected based on the correlation analysis scheme, and the geological disaster risk prediction model is constructed and trained based on SPM chaotic mapping, sparrow algorithm and limit gradient lifting algorithm, so that the geological disaster risk prediction method can realize the risk prediction of geological disasters, and is higher in reliability and better in accuracy.

title_en: Multi-disaster Internet of things time sequence self-adaptive anomaly detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster Internet of things time sequence self-adaptive anomaly detection method and a system, which relate to the field of Internet of things, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an anomaly detection model; S2, acquiring a training data set, S3, training an anomaly detection model, S4, acquiring data to be detected, S5, analyzing a reconstruction structure of the data to be detected, S6, analyzing anomaly scores, and an emergency disaster early warning system comprising an acquisition unit, a storage unit, a calculation unit and an early warning unit, wherein the characteristics of a multi-scale time convolution network and a self-adaptive frequency spectrum characteristic module on a time domain and a frequency domain are fused, the characteristics of time sequence data on the time domain and the frequency domain are deeply mined, a gating memory mechanism is introduced to accurately capture and strengthen normal time-frequency characteristics in the data, the identification capability is improved, and a radial basis function layer is added to remarkably improve the detection capability of the model on fine anomalies, so that the model can more accurately detect fine anomaly changes.

title_en: Large model check point disaster recovery system based on network computing and asynchronous check point
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large model check point disaster recovery system based on network computing and asynchronous check points, which adopts a layered storage design and comprises a plurality of groups, wherein each group comprises at least two computing nodes, the computing nodes in the group mutually store check points of each other, each computing node at least comprises a CPU, a memory, a NIC and a plurality of GPUs, the last check point of each GPU is stored in the CPU memory of the current computing node, the last check point is stored in the CPU memory of the adjacent computing node in the same group through a network, and the check points are stored in storage nodes by utilizing the characteristic of data parallelism and network computing. The large model disaster recovery system under the distributed system can provide rapid fault recovery for large model training, realize high-frequency check points, reduce time cost during training and fault recovery, and avoid extra training throughput cost. Meanwhile, the system is suitable for the existing distributed parallel training method and training framework.

title_en: Rapid debris flow blocking dam design method based on movement energy analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid debris flow blocking dam design method based on movement energy analysis, which comprises the following steps of S1, firstly selecting n blocking dam arrangement positions according to a geological survey condition, corresponding to n working conditions, and then analyzing according to each working condition, S2, simulating a movement process of debris flow by using an SPH method, applying a flexible disaster reduction measure function, and simulating a blocking function of the blocking dam on the debris flow by using virtual wall particles, S3, calculating debris flow impact characteristic parameters including tap impact action time delta t, impact average speed, tap length L, tap volume Vol  head  and impact Load size Load  impact , and S4, calculating blocking dam design characteristic parameters including dam height H, dam top length L  T , dam top width W  T , dam bottom length L  B  and dam bottom width W  B , and obtaining blocking dam section design characteristic parameters under different downstream slopes. The method can realize the rapid design of the feature size of the barrage.

title_en: Digital twin river basin flood disaster early warning plan generation system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer science and artificial intelligence, and discloses a digital twin drainage basin flood warning plan generation system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module acquires and processes multi-source data such as drainage basin weather, hydrology, topography, remote sensing and the like in real time to provide real-time data input; the system comprises a digital twin modeling module, a deep learning prediction module, an emergency response generation module and a system feedback module, wherein the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a digital twin model of a watershed hydrologic dynamic process according to real-time data and outputting a simulation result, the deep learning prediction module is used for receiving the simulation result, training the prediction model and outputting space and time distribution prediction of a flood disaster, the emergency response generation module is used for generating an emergency plan of the flood disaster according to the prediction result, and the system feedback module is used for evaluating the emergency plan and the prediction effect and providing adjustment basis for future disaster early warning. The method and the system can realize accurate flood disaster prediction based on real-time data, improve the accuracy and response efficiency of the emergency plan and reduce disaster loss.

title_en: Enteromorpha green tide disaster early warning area determining method based on traceability numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an enteromorpha green tide disaster early warning area based on traceability numerical simulation, and belongs to the field of enteromorpha green tide disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of a, determining disaster sensitive targets, b, collecting enteromorpha green tide distribution, hydrology and meteorological factors in a sea area near the disaster sensitive targets, c, constructing an enteromorpha green tide drift value traceability model, d, carrying out enteromorpha green tide drift value traceability simulation in the sea area near the disaster sensitive targets, backtracking the drift positions of enteromorpha green tide particles at different moments, e, determining an early warning area, counting the enteromorpha green tide particle distribution positions at different moments, determining an outer envelope line according to the enteromorpha green tide particle distribution positions, and further determining the range of the early warning area. According to the method, a traceability numerical simulation method is adopted, a drifting numerical traceability model is combined with a multidirectional scheme design, the enteromorpha green tide disaster early-warning area range is determined, and the determined early-warning area range is high in precision, so that emergency response efficiency can be improved, and timely coping with disasters is ensured.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Experimental simulation device and method for three-dimensional dip angle controllable flow fire disaster in limited space
abstract_en: The invention discloses an experimental simulation device and method for a three-dimensional dip angle controllable flow fire disaster in a limited space. The device comprises a limited space model, a flowing system, a moving system and a lifting system. The moving system comprises a first platform, a moving driving mechanism and a distance meter, and the lifting system comprises a second platform, a lifting driving mechanism and an angle measuring mechanism. The experimental simulation device controls the movable driving mechanism to drive the first platform to move transversely and/or longitudinally in the limited space model until the displacement reaches a preset distance, and controls the lifting driving mechanism to drive the second platform to lift transversely and/or longitudinally until the inclination angle reaches a preset angle, so that the flowing groove structure is positioned at an experimental position in the limited space model. The invention has high experimental accuracy, can obtain important information about the spreading and burning rule of the flowing fire of the tunnel, improves the experimental efficiency, and ensures the reliability and repeatability of the experimental result so that the invention is more easily and widely adopted.

title_en: Intelligent recognition and quantitative characterization method and system for forward-looking borehole video image cracks
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of geotechnical engineering analysis, resource exploitation design, disaster early warning and the like, and discloses a method and a system for intelligently identifying and quantitatively characterizing a crack of a forward-looking drilling video image, wherein the method comprises the following steps of detecting the crack in the forward-looking drilling video by using an improved YOLOv model to generate a crack area boundary frame; the method comprises the steps of dividing the area in a fracture area boundary frame by using an optimized Mask R-CNN model, introducing a binary cross entropy loss function with boundary weighting, designing a weight matrix W, giving weight to the fracture boundary area to obtain a fracture Mask, extracting fracture morphological characteristics in the fracture Mask, and calculating fracture length and attitude change by adopting a feature matching SURF and an optical flow method Lucas-Kanade based on fracture area and fracture morphological characteristic parameters.

title_en: Typhoon-storm-flood disaster under-chain distribution network pre-disaster outage risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating power outage risk before a power distribution network under a typhoon-storm-flood disaster chain, which comprises the steps of predicting a typhoon rainfall time sequence of a target area from a data driving angle based on a mixed depth learning model, constructing a 1D-2D coupling storm flood model of the target area, taking the typhoon rainfall time sequence as input, simulating urban waterlogging under typhoon attack from a physical driving angle to obtain the waterlogging water accumulation depth after typhoon login, evaluating power outage risk of distribution and transformation equipment from environmental and social angles by using a geographic detector, determining driving force of each environmental factor and each social factor on a power outage event, and calculating the power outage risk of the distribution and transformation equipment under the typhoon-rain-flood disaster chain by using the driving force of each factor as weight, wherein the environmental factors comprise the waterlogging water accumulation depth. The method can effectively predict the typhoon rainfall and the flood depth, comprehensively evaluate the power failure risk of the power distribution network and is beneficial to the formulation of the flood control strategy of the power distribution network.

title_en: Water environment monitoring system and method based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water environment monitoring system and method based on big data analysis, comprising a data acquisition and processing module, a water flow and pollutant diffusion modeling module and a data analysis module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module is responsible for collecting and processing original data related to the water environment; and the water flow and pollutant diffusion modeling module is responsible for constructing a hydrodynamic model by utilizing a CFD simulation method based on the processed data, and predicting the pollutant diffusion trend by using a convection-diffusion equation. In the invention, the data analysis and prediction module deeply digs potential information in the acquired data and the simulation result through the K-means clustering algorithm and the LSTM algorithm, and realizes accurate prediction of the pollutant diffusion and water quality change time sequence. Based on the prediction results and the real-time monitoring data, the early warning and emergency response module can discover potential water pollution events in advance and send early warning timely, so that the quick response capability of coping with the water pollution events is enhanced.

title_en: Power system state estimation method considering unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling
abstract_en: The invention aims to solve the problem of insufficient robustness of a traditional power grid state estimation method in a post-disaster recovery and emergency communication scene, and provides an electric power system emergency state estimation method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative graph neural network. The method integrates unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic communication scheduling and a space-time diagram neural network, and solves the problems of data loss, topology time variation, communication interruption and the like. By constructing a simulation data set, designing a space-time diagram convolution network, generating a node voltage estimation and confidence coefficient thermodynamic diagram by combining a diagram characteristic reconstruction module, and formulating a recovery priority strategy. Meanwhile, an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication optimization model is built, and efficient communication resource allocation is achieved. The invention has the beneficial effects of providing a method for collaborative optimization of an information-physical system, providing a quick and reliable communication alternative scheme and solving the problems of measurement deficiency and topology time variation. And a closed loop feedback model is established, so that the communication resource allocation scheduling is dynamically optimized, and the real-time dynamic mode of the power system is adapted.

title_en: Method, system and electronic equipment for calculating stratum segmentation stratum
abstract_en: The invention provides a calculation method, a system and electronic equipment for a fracture surface to divide rock stratum, and relates to the technical field of geological modeling; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fault plane model, carrying out interactive analysis on the rock stratum model and the fault plane model, calculating intersection points or intersecting lines of the rock stratum and the fault plane, determining the rock stratum model after the fault plane is segmented based on the intersection points or intersecting lines of the rock stratum and the fault plane, calculating offset of the rock stratum model after the fault plane is segmented according to the geometric characteristics of the fault plane, and outputting the rock stratum model after the fault plane is segmented and the offset thereof for mining pressure analysis, oil gas simulation and disaster early warning. The invention can adapt to more complex curved surface fault plane and irregular rock stratum structure, and ensure the high precision of the segmentation result. Under a complex geological scene, the efficient processing of the relation between the complex fault plane and the rock stratum is realized, and the efficient and accurate geological modeling requirement is met.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;QINGYANG XINZHUANG COAL MINE OF QINGYANG XINZHUANG COAL IND CO LTD;BEIJING LONGRUAN TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Power failure mechanism-data collaborative space-time prediction method for distribution equipment under typhoon disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power failure mechanism-data collaborative space-time prediction method of distribution equipment under a typhoon disaster chain, which comprises the steps of obtaining weather information, geographic information and distribution equipment sample data after typhoons pass through a border; the method comprises the steps of carrying out pipe-free network flood depth simulation on an area where a typhoon disaster chain is located to obtain the ponding depth of distribution equipment, fitting the relation between the power failure probability and the ponding depth of the distribution equipment by using an exponential function, constructing a power failure mechanism model of the distribution equipment, obtaining the predicted power failure probability of the distribution equipment, constructing a neural network model, correcting a loss function based on the power failure mechanism model of the water failure to obtain a power failure mechanism-data collaborative space-time prediction model of the distribution equipment, and predicting to obtain the final power failure probability of the distribution equipment at a target moment by taking weather information, geographic information, power failure sample data and the predicted power failure probability as inputs of the power failure mechanism-data collaborative space-time prediction model of the distribution equipment. The invention promotes the power distribution and predicting the power failure of the equipment.

title_en: Fire-fighting integrated system and method based on cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting integrated system and a fire-fighting integrated method based on a cloud platform, wherein the fire-fighting integrated system comprises the steps of acquiring video images of a target area, acquiring user data and acquiring sensor data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional simulation map for a target area according to a video image, analyzing fire hazard coefficients of the target area by combining sensor data and marking the fire hazard coefficients in the three-dimensional simulation map, constructing a fire severity thermodynamic diagram for the three-dimensional simulation map according to the fire hazard coefficients, dividing different areas of the target area according to severity thermodynamic values in the fire severity thermodynamic diagram, dividing users into a first user and a second user according to self-descending risk values, determining the number and proportion of the first user and the second user in the different areas, and carrying out evacuation guidance on the different users by combining the three-dimensional simulation map. The invention has the characteristics of improving rescue efficiency and optimizing system intelligence.
assignees: SHANGHAI LINBO CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Weather forecasting method and system based on complex micro-topography condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather forecast element forecast, in particular to a weather forecast method and a weather forecast system based on complex micro-topography conditions, which are used for acquiring high-resolution NCEP/GFS forecast field data and MODIS satellite earth surface static data; setting a multi-layer nested grid and a parameterization scheme to generate WRFOUT a numerical weather forecast file, interpolating forecast data to a weather station position by bilinear interpolation, performing feature engineering by using a variation modal decomposition and principal component analysis method, matching the forecast data and the observation data as a training set of a machine learning model, using Bayesian optimization to find out optimal parameters, and predicting precipitation of the weather station. The invention also comprises the steps of spatial interpolation, topography correction, icing early warning, risk assessment and the like. The method remarkably improves the accuracy and the practicability of weather forecast under the condition of complex micro-terrain, and provides powerful support for weather forecast and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Landslide hazard early warning method, equipment, medium and product based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard early warning method, equipment, medium and product based on deep learning, and relates to the field of geological hazard monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a remote sensing landslide data set, preprocessing the remote sensing landslide data set to construct a multi-mode data set, constructing a deep learning model, dividing the multi-mode data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, respectively using the training set, the verification set and the test set for training, verifying and testing the deep learning model, using the trained deep learning model as a landslide extraction model, using the landslide extraction model to identify a landslide region in the remote sensing image, and performing landslide disaster early warning according to the change of the landslide region, so that the efficiency and the precision of landslide region identification and landslide disaster early warning can be remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF LAND AND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION AND GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Power distribution system toughness assessment method based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system toughness assessment method based on a dynamic Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of disaster assessment and power system toughness analysis. The method comprises the steps of simulating a storm disaster by using a Chicago unimodal rainfall model, simulating urban waterlogging by combining a digital elevation model and a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, establishing a power distribution equipment failure model based on ponding depth data to obtain node failure probability, simulating a power distribution system state by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network to calculate power accessibility, establishing a power distribution network trend model by considering load withdrawal and line topology change, calculating load loss and voltage offset, and evaluating system risks. According to the method, the influence of the storm disaster on the power distribution network is comprehensively considered through multi-model coupling and probability analysis, the toughness of the power distribution network under the storm disaster is accurately estimated, scientific basis is provided for planning, designing and emergency management of a power system, and the disaster resistance and reliability of the power distribution network are improved.

title_en: Quasi-static load loading device with condensed explosive as explosion source
abstract_en: The invention provides a quasi-static load loading device taking a condensed explosive as an explosion source, which converts shock wave load generated by the condensed explosive explosion into quasi-static load by adopting the condensed explosive as the explosion source and combining with the structural design of a porous plate, effectively simulates the load characteristic of combustible gas explosion, can utilize a solid explosive to simulate the load action form of the gas explosion, obviously reduces the experiment difficulty of the gas explosion, provides an experiment detection platform for the structural failure effect under the action of the gas explosion load, obviously improves the explosion overpressure on the basis of ensuring the quasi-static loading, and solves the problems of excessively small explosion overpressure and incapacity of the structure in the original gas explosion experiment. Meanwhile, the homogeneous fine sand layer can be used for absorbing shock wave load transmitted by holes in the porous plate, so that the quasi-static load loading effect of the lower part of the porous plate is guaranteed, the pressure sensor can be protected, and an efficient and reliable experimental means is provided for explosion disaster protection research.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation and path planning. The method is suitable for scenes requiring multi-agent area coverage path planning problems (MACPP) such as post-disaster search and rescue, agricultural irrigation and the like. The invention decomposes MACPP into two sub-problems of inter-area access sequence planning (MTSP) and sub-area Coverage (CPP), and designs a lightweight cross-layer connection multi-agent reinforcement learning framework. The framework adopts a complete collaborative learning strategy to optimize MTSP, designs and uses an exploration mechanism dynamically adjusted along with the interaction frequency to optimize the entrance and exit combination strategy in the training process, and combines a round-trip path algorithm to efficiently solve the CPP problem. By the method, the multi-area search task can be efficiently completed in the shortest time by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, so that the requirements of actual application scenes are met.

title_en: Disaster recovery scheme management method and device capable of automatically maintaining availability of switching flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery scheme management method and device for automatically maintaining the usability of a switching process, which can be used in the technical field of information safety, and the method comprises the steps of determining a disaster recovery scheme corresponding to the starting switching state of a current system; generating a base line scheme by a disaster recovery switching scheme, wherein the base line scheme is represented by a base line group set, performing exercise on a current system in an exercise environment based on the base line scheme, analyzing the effectiveness of the base line scheme according to an exercise result, checking the base line scheme through a green light verification script in a daily state if the base line scheme is effective, forming a base line group to be verified according to a checking result if the base line scheme is required to be updated according to the checking result, determining a minimum switching flow according to the base line group to be verified, performing exercise in the exercise environment by executing the minimum switching flow, and updating the base line scheme according to the exercise result. The invention can improve the timeliness of updating the baseline scheme.

title_en: Device and method for simulating shielding condition of noise reduction device and spraying transformer oil gas to fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating a shielding condition of a noise reduction device for spraying transformer oil and gas to fire, wherein the device comprises an oil drum, a cracking gas device, an oil-gas mixing device and an atomization deflagration device, wherein the transformer oil in the oil drum, the transformer oil cracking gas stored by the cracking gas device is used for being conveyed into the oil-gas mixing device, the oil-gas mixing device is used for simulating oil-gas mixing after actual transformer oil cracking, and the atomization deflagration device is used for atomizing and igniting the oil-gas mixture and simulating the deflagration process of the oil-gas mixture after actual transformer oil cracking. The invention also provides a calculation method of the mixing ratio of the transformer oil and the high-temperature cracking gas thereof in the deflagration process of the transformer and the heating oil temperature of the transformer. The invention has the advantages of realizing the research on the fire evolution process of transformer oil injection and the action mechanism of the transformer oil injection and the noise reduction device under the conditions of different fault positions and fault forms, and providing support for knowing the fire evolution mechanism of the transformer under the shielding condition of the noise reduction device and researching and developing the shedding noise reduction device.
assignees: UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide monitoring device and method based on acoustic emission characteristics of particulate materials
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide monitoring device and method based on acoustic emission characteristics of granular materials, and relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, wherein a geological drilling hole is divided into at least two hole sections from bottom to top, the granular materials are filled in each hole section, and the diameters and/or materials of the granular materials in different hole sections are different; the acoustic emission monitoring unit can monitor acoustic emission information of the particle materials in each hole section, the acoustic emission information comprises a plurality of acoustic emission characteristic parameters, the acoustic emission information of the particle materials in different hole sections is different under the same sliding speed, the analysis unit is in signal connection with the acoustic emission monitoring unit, and the analysis unit can judge whether landslide deformation is generated according to the acoustic emission information and acquire the type of the particle materials in the hole section generating the landslide deformation and/or the depth of a sliding surface. The invention can realize low-cost and continuous monitoring for deep displacement and judge the depth of the sliding surface when landslide occurs.

title_en: Hydrogen-sensitive lithium battery thermal runaway multistage early warning method based on BiLSTM mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BiLSTM mechanism-based hydrogen sensitive lithium battery thermal runaway multistage early warning method which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring parameters of a hydrogen sensor and a temperature sensor, secondly acquiring hydrogen concentration and lithium battery surface temperature data in a set time period, thirdly inputting the hydrogen concentration and the surface temperature in the set time period into an LSTM network and a CNN+ BiLSTM network respectively to acquire early warning information, and fourthly enabling a thermal management system to automatically control temperature from early warning conditions, eliminating early warning states and completing lithium battery thermal runaway multistage early warning. The method has the beneficial effects of improving the prediction accuracy. Simulation experiment results show that the method can effectively early warn thermal runaway of the lithium battery in the charging process, and can send out secondary early warning information for a period of time before the lithium battery fires, so that fire disasters are avoided.

title_en: Hydropower station emergency safety drilling system based on UWB positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station emergency safety exercise system based on UWB positioning technology, which comprises a positioning module, a data acquisition module and an emergency management module, wherein the positioning module comprises a UWB positioning base station and UWB positioning labels, each person is provided with a corresponding UWB positioning label, the positioning module is used for monitoring personnel position information by adopting the UWB positioning technology, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring key element data in real time, the key element data comprises personnel position information, personnel skill data, equipment data and set task priority data of a preset exercise scene, the emergency management module comprises a trained emergency scheduling model, the input of the emergency scheduling model is the key element data, the emergency scheduling model is output as an optimal task allocation scheme, the optimal task allocation scheme comprises an evacuation route and a task list, and the emergency management module is used for obtaining a required optimal task allocation scheme by utilizing the trained emergency scheduling model based on the key element data acquired in real time when an exercise instruction is acquired.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG KANGDING HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Smart city emergency management system and method based on multidimensional heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of smart city emergency management, in particular to a smart city emergency management system based on multidimensional heterogeneous data, which comprises a digital twin city model, a historical emergency event model, an emergency event prediction model, a multidimensional data access model, a data fusion model and an emergency event policy model, wherein the emergency event policy model is used for arranging the fused data according to a decision model, and when the emergency event prediction model is excited, the processing policy of an emergency event is given according to the decision model calculation. The smart city emergency management is realized based on the system. The intelligent city emergency management system and method integrate multidimensional data, construct an area comprehensive situation panoramic view, realize omnibearing monitoring and early warning, real-time simulation, decision planning and evacuation path planning of the urban waterlogging, traffic accidents, production safety and other high risk fields, and improve the response speed of emergency management.
assignees: NANJING NANYOU INST OF INFORMATION TEACHNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Water supply pipeline working condition random simulation method based on pavement elevation and surface rainfall
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline network working condition simulation, in particular to a random simulation method for the working condition of a water supply pipeline based on road surface elevation and surface rainfall, which comprises the steps of constructing an urban pipeline network model, assigning a random value to each water supply pipeline section in the pipeline network model by the random simulation method, and then calculating a road surface elevation correction coefficient and a surface rainfall correction coefficient of each water supply pipe section based on the road surface elevation and the surface rainfall, correcting the random value by using the road surface elevation Cheng Xiuzheng coefficient and the surface rainfall correction coefficient, calculating the accumulation probability according to the correction result, and judging the working condition of the water supply pipe through the accumulation probability. The method can better simulate the working condition changes under the conditions of extreme weather, natural disasters and the like, can also adjust the layout of the water supply network according to the simulation result, increases redundant pipe sections or optimizes pipe connection, and improves the emergency water supply capacity of the network.
assignees: HENAN SHUIGU INNOVATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Ground disaster hidden trouble investigation method and system assisted by multisource time sequence remote sensing soil water content prediction technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for checking ground disaster hidden trouble assisted by a multi-source time sequence remote sensing soil water content prediction technology, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired multi-source time sequence remote sensing data related to soil water content to obtain model basic data, constructing a model sample database, optimizing and training a pre-constructed soil water content prediction deep learning model by adopting the sample database to obtain a model parameter initialization model with optimal weight, predicting the soil water content of the next time step of the multi-source time sequence remote sensing data by utilizing the model parameter initialization model with optimal weight to obtain a prediction result of the soil water content, and then assisting the ground disaster hidden trouble checking by utilizing the prediction result. The method and the device can overcome the defects of high measurement cost and low efficiency of the traditional soil moisture content monitoring scheme, can also be combined with other related information for comprehensive analysis, and improve the accuracy of ground disaster hidden trouble investigation relative to single remote sensing data.
assignees: HUNAN SHUJIE TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV POWER TRANS COMPANY

title_en: Fire control water jet examination device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting water-jet assessment device, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting training devices and comprises a shell with a containing cavity formed therein and a timer fixed on the shell, wherein a water-jet inlet communicated with the containing cavity and the outside of the containing cavity is formed on the front side of the shell, a pressure sensor connected with a controller is fixed on the rear end wall of the containing cavity, a pressure plate aligned with the water-jet inlet is fixed on the detection end of the pressure sensor, a drain pipe and a water collecting pipe extending to the outside of the shell are communicated with the bottom of the containing cavity, a first electromagnetic valve positioned on one side of the water outlet end of the drain pipe is arranged in the drain pipe, and a flowmeter and a second electromagnetic valve are sequentially arranged in the water collecting pipe along the water outlet direction of the water collecting pipe. The utility model has the advantages that the pressure of the water jet can be ensured in the checking process, so that the effectiveness of the water jet can be improved, the checking accuracy can be improved, and firefighters can effectively train.

title_en: Supporting device for underground coal mine drilling gas extraction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a supporting device for coal mine underground drilling gas extraction, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control. The device comprises a telescopic supporting ring, wherein the telescopic supporting ring is sleeved outside a drill rod, the outer side face of the telescopic supporting ring is hinged with a telescopic rod, a lock catch and a control device are arranged on the telescopic supporting ring, an automatic locking device, a rotating assembly, a transmission assembly and the like are arranged on the telescopic rod, and the lock catch, the rotating assembly, the transmission assembly and the like are all connected with the control device. The supporting device can automatically adjust according to the softness of the coal seam, effective support of drilling holes is guaranteed, automatic operation of the supporting device is achieved through equipment such as a control device and a transmission assembly, construction time of the supporting device is shortened greatly, and the supporting device is scientific and reasonable in structural design, easy to operate and beneficial to improving working efficiency of gas extraction.

title_en: Universal bracket for fire hose walking
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and particularly relates to a fire-fighting water belt walking universal bracket which comprises two main wheels, a plurality of transverse auxiliary small wheels, two connecting shafts, a water belt bracket, a waterproof belt abrasion fixing pipe and a shaft sleeve bearing. The position of the fire hose is changed by walking the universal bracket on the fire training or disaster relief site. The auxiliary water band walking bracket reduces friction with the ground under the condition of water storage in the fire hose. Not only improves the effect and quality of fire training, but also shortens the time of fire extinguishment in the fire scene. The service life of the fire hose is prolonged.
assignees: CHONGQING SHUANGLONG FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intermittent type water-bursting and mud-bursting filling structure anti-bursting body reconstruction simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intermittent water and mud bursting filling structure bursting body reconstruction simulation test device, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel disaster research test devices and comprises a water supply unit, a filling medium storage tank, a tunnel simulation unit, a water collecting unit and a measuring unit, wherein the water supply unit is used for storing water required by multiple tests and is used for flowing out water with set pressure, the filling medium storage tank is communicated with the water supply unit and is used for filling test media to simulate silt in a tunnel mud bursting process, the filling medium storage tank is communicated with the tunnel simulation unit, the water collecting unit is provided with a water collecting tank and a weight display device arranged at the bottom of the water collecting tank, the water collecting tank is used for collecting water flowing out through a channel, the weight display device is used for weighing the weight of water in the water collecting tank, the measuring unit comprises a soil pressure test box and a osmometer, and the technical problems that the conventional test device cannot simulate the tunnel intermittent water bursting mud bursting disaster state and is inconvenient to study the bursting body reconstruction process are solved.

title_en: Urban infrastructure risk assessment method oriented to storm disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster chain-oriented urban infrastructure risk assessment method which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, uniformly coding urban infrastructure elements, S2, constructing a correlation network among urban infrastructure nodes, S3, constructing an urban storm disaster chain network, S4, simulating a secondary disaster risk caused by a storm disaster, S5, simulating an infrastructure risk caused by a storm disaster chain, S6, assessing cascade fault conduction of the infrastructure node risk, S7, and realizing real-time risk display based on uniform identification codes. According to the urban infrastructure risk assessment method for the storm disaster chain, support is provided for dynamic emergency decision making of multi-disaster linkage by considering the infrastructure node risk caused by the storm and the secondary disasters, so that the precise infrastructure node risk pre-judgment of timing and fixed points is realized, and the establishment of specific emergency decision making and the targeted resident disaster risk prevention are facilitated.

title_en: Disaster event generation method and system based on gas extraction drilling machine simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation training, in particular to a disaster event generation method and system based on a gas extraction drilling machine simulation system; the technical problem that in the prior art, a simulation training system is difficult to generate disaster events in a training scene in real time according to operation errors of a user in a simulation training process, so that the user is difficult to intuitively understand a chain accident chain possibly caused by the operation errors of the user is solved; firstly, acquiring abnormal parameters generated in user operation, marking an accident chain node corresponding to the abnormal parameters as a disaster event, then, extracting historical training data and current operation records of a user by a system, constructing two types of selection probability models to respectively calculate a first selection probability and a second selection probability, and finally, calculating a final probability by comprehensively considering the first selection probability and the second selection probability to select a plurality of events to be loaded into training scenes of the user for scene generation so as to realize training of the user.
assignees: HUAIBEI MINING MEDIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster hidden danger identification system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based geological disaster hidden danger identification system, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster analysis and comprises a multi-source data integration module, a regional characteristic learning module, a hidden danger identification module, a disaster coupling simulation module and an emergency strategy generation module. The hidden danger identification and disaster coupling simulation method combined with regional feature learning driving is adopted, modeling capability of multi-disaster linkage mechanisms in complex geological environment is enhanced while hidden danger identification precision is improved, regional feature learning is carried out by adopting a lightweight multi-layer sensing method combined with geological unit division enhancement, expression capability of feature learning and discrimination between geological units are improved, hidden danger identification is carried out by adopting a graph rolling network combined with density peak value clustering improvement, disaster coupling simulation is carried out by adopting a graph rolling neural network combined with improved geological response coupling index, and modeling reliability of a geological disaster mechanism and modeling precision of regional risk conduction paths are improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR DADI ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;NUCLEAR IND 243 GROUP

title_en: Parallel pilot tunnel-based open TBM water-rich fault zone advanced treatment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an open TBM water-rich fault zone advanced treatment method based on parallel pilot holes, which comprises the following steps of S1, setting of the parallel pilot holes, S101, setting of pilot hole positions, S102, hole design, S103, bottom slope adjustment, S2, lateral drilling, drainage and pressure relief, S201, lateral drilling, drainage hole arrangement, S202, drainage hole structure determination, S203, drainage treatment, S3, lateral grouting reinforcement, S301, grouting hole arrangement, S302, grouting hole segmentation, S303, grouting implementation and S304, and experimental inspection. The advanced treatment method for the open TBM overwater fault zone based on the parallel pilot tunnel can improve the standardization and feasibility of water prevention of the water-rich fault bailer, improve the treatment efficiency, enhance the water plugging and consolidation effects of advanced grouting, effectively reduce the occurrence risk of surge disasters and have considerable economic benefits.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Urban distribution network fault defense method under flood disaster based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cellular automaton-based urban distribution network fault defense method under a flood disaster, which relates to the field of power systems and is used for accurately predicting the failure probability of distribution network equipment by simulating a ponding dynamic evolution process under the flood disaster and realizing the accurate defense of the distribution network fault condition under the flood disaster by combining emergency resource configuration and deployment of the defense before the disaster. According to the invention, by utilizing the spatial evolution characteristic of CA, complex physical calculation and high-precision data requirements are avoided, so that the calculation efficiency is improved, the adaptability to large-scale urban areas is enhanced, the toughness of the power distribution network under extreme disasters can be remarkably improved, the resource allocation can be optimized, the economic loss caused by the disasters is reduced, and a powerful guarantee is provided for the safe and reliable operation of an urban power system.
