assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;ZHENGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Community management method based on digital twinning and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community management method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of carrying out layered household modeling on a building in a community, establishing a spatial layout model of road, greening and Internet of things equipment to construct a three-dimensional digital twinning base of the community, acquiring real-time data of population whereabouts, vehicle traffic, elevator running states, dog behaviors and high-altitude parabolic events through the Internet of things equipment, synchronizing the real-time data to the dynamic data of the community in real time, associating the real-time data with the digital twinning base to generate an interactive three-dimensional visual interface, dynamically displaying personnel flowing, vehicle tracks, elevator states and event alarm information, analyzing the acquired data based on a machine learning algorithm, and generating a resource configuration optimization strategy, a risk early warning instruction and an emergency response scheme. The method can solve the problems that the current community public safety treatment means mainly comprises webpage end treatment and lacks visual presentation and later exercise prevention capability.
assignees: WUHAN HONGXIN TECH SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task generation system based on natural language and satellite image
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle task generating system based on natural language and satellite images, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent aviation navigation and man-machine interaction. The system combines the visual language model and the large language model, and realizes the automatic generation of the unmanned aerial vehicle flight path and action instructions by inputting natural language instructions and satellite images. The system comprises a task analysis module, a target recognition module and a path and action generation module, wherein the task analysis module is used for converting a natural language instruction into a task target, the target recognition module is used for positioning a target position in a satellite image, and the path and action generation module is used for generating a complete flight task plan according to the target position and geographic metadata. The method has the advantages of no need of training data, direct deployment, high generation speed, strong generalization capability and the like, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous task planning in a complex environment. Compared with manual path planning, the method has the advantages of remarkably improving task efficiency and operation convenience, and is suitable for various scenes such as military reconnaissance, agricultural monitoring and disaster response.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and geological disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system, which comprise the following steps of S1, S2, performing quality control and interpolation processing on geological data acquired in S1 to obtain standardized space-time continuous data, S3, calculating the stress state of a geological body of a target area based on the standardized space-time continuous data, S4, calculating potential instability points in the area and occurrence probability thereof, S5, training a disaster evolution prediction model, outputting occurrence probability of disasters and area distribution thereof, and S6, generating grading early warning information. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and random forest algorithm application, the occurrence probability and evolution trend of geological disasters are accurately predicted, and the accuracy and timeliness of the early warning system are remarkably improved.
assignees: SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCESNO 801 HYDROGEOLOGICAL ENG GEOLOGICAL BRIGA

title_en: Building earthquake damage scene construction method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image
abstract_en: The application provides a building earthquake damage scene construction method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing images, which relate to the technical field of urban earthquake and disaster prevention and comprise the steps of constructing a three-dimensional space model of a building by utilizing an urban earthquake damage simulation system, and determining nonlinear model parameters of the building; the method comprises the steps of constructing earthquake damage scenes by taking a single building as granularity by adopting an elastoplastic time-course analysis method, determining building damage indexes, determining earthquake damage risk levels of all the buildings according to a mapping relation between preset building damage indexes and building earthquake damage risk levels, detecting earthquake resistance of the building with the specified earthquake damage risk level according to a building list, and generating earthquake-resistant measures corresponding to the building with the specified earthquake damage risk level. According to the geometrical attribute information of the building, the three-dimensional space model is built by combining the urban earthquake damage simulation system, the earthquake damage risk level of a single building is accurately divided, and the fine level of urban earthquake and disaster prevention is improved by combining earthquake-resistant measures.
assignees: SHANDONG LUZHEN TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD;SHANDONG ZHENZAI RISK CONTROL CENTER SHANDONG ENGINEERING EARTHQUAKE RES CENTER

title_en: Fault arc causation fire disaster early warning method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fault arc causation fire disaster early warning method based on multi-sensor fusion, and belongs to the field of fault arc fire disasters. The method comprises the steps of building an arc electric fire cause fault simulation test platform, selecting a typical single load and a combined load to perform tests before normal operation of a circuit and the occurrence of an arc cause fire, building a fault arc waveform database and an arc fire database, and providing a power-on detection method of a fault arc detection device for fault classification by combining SVM through sparse matrix representation current characteristics based on dictionary learning. Analyzing the fluctuation range of a plurality of characteristic quantities of a circuit in a normal state and when a fault arc occurs, determining a threshold value by the periodic increment ratio of the characteristic quantities of different states, complementarily forming a final combined load detection threshold value by using a plurality of threshold values, realizing fault arc detection, training a double-layer LSTM model under Bayesian optimization based on an arc fire database, and identifying a plurality of sensor signals in a time window to realize fire early warning.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;Fuzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Combined test device for pressurizing, penetrating and shearing ionic rare earth ore body
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ionic rare earth ore body pressurization penetration shearing combined test device. The system comprises a shearing box, a loading system, a dynamic permeation structure, a graded filter analysis structure, a data assembly and a processing terminal, wherein the loading system is used for applying horizontal load and vertical load to the shearing box, the dynamic permeation structure is used for loading leaching liquid and enabling the leaching liquid to flow into the shearing box, the graded filter analysis structure is used for collecting leaching liquid after reacting with a rare earth ore body sample and acquiring data of graded filter analysis, the data assembly is used for summarizing monitoring data in permeation and shearing processes and is controlled by the processing terminal, and the shearing box comprises an upper box, a lower box, an upper permeation plate, a lower permeation plate, an upper filter screen plate, a lower filter screen plate, a cover plate, a microporous metal plate and filter paper. The invention realizes the fine simulation and penetration and shearing test integration of the in-situ leaching injection and extraction process, and can provide test basis for in-situ leaching injection and extraction parameter design, rare earth ore body stability analysis and disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Historical neighborhood flood disaster refuge equipment for high-density old urban area
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of underwater rescue, and discloses a high-density old urban historical block flood disaster refuge device which comprises a left fixing piece and a right fixing piece, wherein the left fixing piece and the right fixing piece are movably clamped, a fixing mechanism is formed by the left fixing piece and the right fixing piece, one end of a floating air bag is connected with the end part of the left fixing piece, the other end of the floating air bag is connected with the end part of the right fixing piece, connecting pieces penetrate through the two ends of the floating air bag, and the connecting pieces are movably connected with the left fixing piece or the right fixing piece. When the device is worn, the clamping state of one group of left fixing pieces and right fixing pieces is firstly released, then the strip-shaped device is wound on a human body, and finally the clamping state of the group of left fixing pieces and right fixing pieces is recovered, so that the operation of the wearing process is simple, the device does not need to be drilled into the ring-shaped device during wearing, and the rescue efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Open-air large-scale mud-rock flow experimental model device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of debris flow simulation tests, and discloses a field large debris flow experimental model device which comprises a material bin, a bin gate opening and closing mechanism, a slideway and a channel. Wherein a first bracket is arranged below the material bin, a discharge hole facing the ground is arranged on one side of the material bin, and a bin door is hinged at the discharge hole. The bin gate opening and closing mechanism comprises a first cylinder and an air source connected with the first cylinder, one end of the first cylinder is movably connected with the outer wall of the material bin, and the output end of the first cylinder is movably connected with the outer wall of the bin gate. The slide comprises a slope arranged obliquely and a second support for supporting the slope, and the top end of the slope is connected to the bottom end of the discharge hole. The invention can provide reliable test support for the research of the mechanism of the debris flow disaster and the development of the prevention and control technology.
assignees: NO 149 TEAM GANSU COALFIELD GEOLOGY BUREAU;UNIV JILIN;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Reservoir emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir emergency management system, which belongs to the technical field of reservoir emergency management and comprises an emergency plan management module for managing an emergency plan of reservoir operation, a plan exercise management module for managing an exercise process of the emergency plan of reservoir operation, an emergency material management module for managing emergency materials of reservoir operation, a standby power supply management module for managing standby power supplies of reservoir operation, an on-duty management module for managing on-duty plans, attendance conditions and on-duty records of on-duty personnel of reservoir operation, and an emergency response module for acquiring the on-duty plans to inquire on-duty personnel when the reservoir operation meets the triggering condition of the emergency plan, inquiring and locking the standby power supplies and the emergency materials required to be used according to the content of the emergency plan and notifying the on-duty personnel. The invention not only improves the efficiency and effect of reservoir emergency management, but also enhances the executability of an emergency plan, provides powerful protection for the safe operation of the reservoir, and improves the emergency management level.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: High-speed rail network system toughness assessment method and device based on high-speed rail operation data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a high-speed railway network system toughness assessment method and device based on high-speed railway operation data. The method comprises the steps of constructing a high-speed railway network model through a Space-P method and high-speed railway operation data, constructing a multi-dimensional toughness assessment framework aiming at the high-speed railway network model according to the high-speed railway network model and a network performance curve from the perspective of network topology and function service, determining topological structure indexes and function service indexes under the multi-dimensional toughness assessment framework, constructing a comprehensive toughness assessment model according to the topological structure indexes and the function service indexes, and simulating toughness assessment under a multi-disaster scene according to the comprehensive toughness assessment model. According to the method, the topological structure, the functional service characteristics, the full life cycle of disasters, the disaster types and other dimensional factors of the high-speed rail network are comprehensively considered, and the comprehensive toughness scores of the high-speed rail networks with different conditions are determined by combining the evaluation methods of the complex network and the rank sum ratio.

title_en: Power communication emergency plan generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication emergency plan generation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The emergency response scheme simulation test method is characterized by comprising the steps of obtaining an operation data set of the power communication system, carrying out abnormal causal reasoning on the operation data set through a preset power communication large model to determine a causal relationship chain result, collecting a real-time data set of the power communication system, carrying out scene prediction scheme analysis according to the causal relationship chain result and the real-time data set through the power communication large model to determine a plurality of emergency Jing Hou options, carrying out emergency response scheme simulation test on each emergency scene, determining an optimal emergency response scheme corresponding to the emergency scene, and constructing an emergency response scheme candidate set corresponding to the plurality of emergency Jing Hou options according to the optimal emergency response scheme corresponding to each emergency scene, so that the essential cause of an emergency event and an influence chain can be effectively identified, the emergency event can be accurately processed, and the applicability and the accuracy of the emergency prediction scheme are improved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: High-permeability power distribution network risk identification model and system based on dynamic power flow analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vulnerability assessment and pre-disaster risk management of power systems, in particular to a high-permeability power distribution network risk identification method based on dynamic power flow analysis. The existing vulnerability assessment method focuses on static analysis, ignores uncertainty of dynamic tide and distributed generation output, and cannot accurately identify weak links in a power distribution network. The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method based on dynamic power flow analysis. According to the method, a Latin hypercube sampling method is adopted to generate a plurality of distributed power generation output scenes, power grid tide under different weather and load conditions is simulated, and key components in a power distribution network are identified by combining tide calculation and vulnerability analysis, so that scientific basis is provided for risk assessment and emergency response before disaster. Compared with the traditional method, the method can more comprehensively consider the uncertainty of the distributed power generation output and the dynamic characteristics of the power distribution network, and improves the vulnerability identification accuracy of the power distribution network under the condition that the high-permeability renewable energy is accessed to the power distribution network. In addition, the vulnerability of the nodes and the branches in the power system is uniformly evaluated, more comprehensive and reliable technical support is provided for pre-disaster prevention and emergency response of the power grid, and important theoretical value and practical application prospect are achieved.

title_en: Model box and method suitable for test of simulating deep stope mining disaster variable vibration table
abstract_en: The model box and the method suitable for the deep stope mining disaster variable vibration table simulation test comprise a model box outer frame with a front opening, a model box inner frame with a front opening, a hydraulic push plate, a hydraulic push rod, a vibration table, a first operation table and a second operation table, wherein the model box inner frame with the front opening is arranged inside the model box frame, the hydraulic push plate is connected and assembled on the upper part of the inner frame, one end of the hydraulic push rod is circumferentially distributed along the inner frame and is in contact connection with the inner frame, the other end of the hydraulic push rod is connected with the outer frame, and the outer frame is positioned on the outermost layer of the model box frame and is connected with the bottom of the hydraulic push rod. The invention can simulate the three-dimensional stress state of a deep stope, and effectively cooperate with a multifunctional shaking table system to assist in developing a shaking table test of a deep stope under the three-dimensional stress state.

title_en: Sampling device and sampling method for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sampling device and a sampling method for geological disaster investigation, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster investigation and comprise a mounting frame and rotating components, wherein a storage battery is mounted in the mounting frame, a control switch group is mounted on the upper side of a fixed frame, a moving component is mounted on the front side of the mounting frame, a connecting plate is connected to the front side of the moving component, a stirring component and two corresponding fixed components are mounted on the upper side of the connecting plate, a sliding component is mounted on the edge of the connecting plate, the sliding component is connected with the two fixed components, sample storage components are mounted on the left side and the right side of the moving component, the rotating components comprise a rotary plate, a first bevel gear, a spline shaft and a second bevel gear, a row of four rotating holes are formed in the upper side of the connecting plate, the rotary plate is rotatably connected to the inner side of the rotating holes, the rotary plate can rapidly adjust sampling depth according to requirements, and a plurality of geological samples on the same layer can be obtained by drilling once.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Cloud platform-based data rescuing and archiving system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data rescuing and archiving system based on a cloud platform, which relates to the technical field of data management and comprises a plurality of functional modules, a digital twin simulation module, a reinforcement learning optimization module and a data reinforcement learning optimization module, wherein the data perception and acquisition module is used for acquiring operation data in real time through deployment of edge computing nodes, the operation data comprises sensor data, service logs and historical fault data, the transmission links are encrypted by a hybrid encryption technology and are transmitted to a cloud end through a unified data interface standardization, the digital twin simulation module is used for generating a multidimensional data state vector model based on a lightweight modeling engine, dynamically updating twin body states through an integrated space-time data fusion algorithm, introducing prepositive disaster conditions of virtual-real interaction tests, simulating the execution effects of data recovery plans under different disaster conditions through a Monte Carlo method, and performing disaster spreading simulation.

title_en: Geological disaster hidden trouble point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster hidden danger point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining geological environment data and preprocessing, S2, constructing and training a heterogeneous model integrated by a graph convolutional neural network and a multi-layer perceptron, S3, combining residual connection and a attention mechanism to enhance the characteristic recognition capability of the model, optimizing model parameters through a cross entropy loss function, S4, evaluating the heterogeneous model through cross verification, calculating precision, mean square error and confidence level, dynamically distributing integration weight, S5, weighting and fusing the model output according to the integration weight, introducing Bayesian uncertainty estimation to generate a risk distribution probability map, S6, quantifying hidden danger point risk level, mapping into a two-dimensional space distribution map, and visualizing, S7, screening hidden danger points with the risk level higher than a threshold value, and outputting a prediction result. The invention provides a high-precision and reliable geological disaster hidden danger prediction method through an integrated neural network and a depth fusion technology.

title_en: Urban fire emergency evacuation path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth reinforcement learning-based urban fire emergency evacuation path planning method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a dynamic environment map, S2, constructing an evacuation agent strategy network, S3, introducing an improved type of cheetah optimization algorithm into the evacuation agent strategy network, avoiding local optimization through a path jump mechanism, S4, configuring a reconnaissance module for each cheetah body by the improved type of cheetah optimization algorithm, predicting path risks and generating future risk scores, S5, fusing a current path evaluation result and the future risk scores, dynamically correcting path selection, S6, optimizing the evacuation agent strategy network through a centralized training and distribution execution mechanism, generating an optimal evacuation path instruction, S7, receiving dynamic environment map data in real time through an edge computing terminal, outputting the optimal evacuation path instruction, and supporting path rollback and reprofiling. The invention integrates deep reinforcement learning and intelligent optimization algorithm to realize intelligent planning of urban fire evacuation paths.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating earthquake safety toughness of layered rock mass cavern group
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating the earthquake safety toughness of a layered rock mass cavern group, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a geological parameter set and a seismic parameter set based on geological exploration data and numerical simulation data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional geological structure model according to geological parameters, generating a seismic vibration input time-course curve, inputting the seismic vibration input time-course curve into the model, obtaining a seismic dynamic response data set through a dynamic response calculation algorithm, calculating safety state indexes of each cavity by combining a safety threshold judgment rule, and generating an overall seismic safety toughness evaluation result through a seismic toughness quantification model based on the safety state indexes. The method can accurately evaluate the earthquake safety toughness of the layered rock mass cavern group, provide scientific basis for earthquake-resistant design and safety evaluation of the cavern group, and effectively reduce earthquake disaster risk.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Gray correlation-based icing thickness prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological prediction and artificial intelligence, in particular to a gray correlation-based icing thickness prediction method, a gray correlation-based icing thickness prediction system, gray correlation-based icing thickness prediction equipment and gray correlation-based icing thickness prediction medium, which comprise the steps of collecting icing multidimensional data and dynamically screening key meteorological features through gray correlation; the method comprises the steps of constructing and dividing a data set subjected to cleaning and normalization processing, fusing a bidirectional gating circulation unit and a multi-head self-attention mechanism to design a mixed model, carrying out parameter optimization and test verification based on a training set, eliminating redundant interference through dynamic feature screening, bidirectionally analyzing long-short-term icing evolution rules, enhancing extreme weather event feature focusing by an attention mechanism, realizing migration deployment across a weather area by combining a parameter self-adaptive compensation module, remarkably improving prediction precision and ice and snow mutation working condition early warning capability, and providing intelligent decision support for power grid disaster prevention.

title_en: Automatic basin identification method and system in DEM data based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of digital terrain analysis and artificial intelligence intersection, and particularly discloses an automatic basin identification method and system in DEM data based on a neural network. The method comprises the steps of adaptively determining a terrain fluctuation analysis window based on a mean value variable point method, extracting an initial plain area by combining elevation, gradient and terrain fluctuation, removing noise through morphological optimization (hole filling and edge smoothing), constructing a buffer area, screening key terrain factors such as elevation, gradient variable rate and the like to generate multi-channel characteristic data, dividing landform types by using ISODATA dynamic clustering, outputting binary basin data, and performing end-to-end training by adopting an improved ResUNet ++ network (integrated multi-encoder, a cavity space pyramid and a channel attention mechanism) to realize the fine segmentation of complex boundaries. The method supports cross-regional generalization testing, can realize high-precision basin identification under drought and wet landform scenes, and can be widely applied to the fields of resource exploration, ecological protection and disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Geological disaster automatic identification system and method based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster automatic identification system and method based on multi-source remote sensing data, and relates to the field of geological disaster identification.A target area geological disaster optical remote sensing image, SAR radar image and LIDAR point cloud data before and after occurrence are collected firstly, and standard image, standard SAR and standard point cloud are obtained through preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of comparing and analyzing standard images before and after a disaster to determine a disaster area, respectively analyzing the standard images, standard SAR and standard point cloud of the disaster area to obtain a vegetation comprehensive index, an SAR index and a point cloud index, training a convolutional neural network model by utilizing historical disaster data to obtain a disaster identification model, and finally inputting a target area related index into the disaster identification model to determine a disaster type.
assignees: ANHUI TRANSP HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster emergency rescue drilling three-dimensional scene construction method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency rescue, in particular to a three-dimensional scene construction method and device for geological disaster emergency rescue exercise. According to the invention, high-precision live-action three-dimensional data are established through the unmanned aerial vehicle, a landslide body model is established by adopting a BIM technology, a geological disaster exercise scene is established by adopting a mechanical filling site, the engineering quantity of engineering exercise is accurately calculated, the arrangement and rescue positions of rescue equipment are reasonably planned and designed, the engineering exercise is ensured to be carried out smoothly, and the rescue technology reserve and talent culture are promoted. Compared with the traditional rescue drilling scene building, the method has the advantages of high three-dimensional terrain precision, vivid rescue drilling scene design, accurate earth and stone deployment, strong rescue drilling guidance and the like, and achieves the purposes of digitizing the rescue scene design, modularization of rescue equipment, informatization of command control and environment protection of collapse body construction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 2 GROUP;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHINA RAILWAY ERJU 1ST ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system network attack consequence evaluation method considering switch modularization, which relates to the technical field related to power system safety protection and emergency response and comprises the following steps of carrying out modularization modeling on key switch equipment in a power system to determine functional logic and fault propagation paths of the key switch equipment; and solving the optimal attack path and generating a defending configuration scheme by simulating strategy games of an attacker and a defender. The method can more accurately simulate the influence of the network attack on the power system, is beneficial to analyzing the fragile links and key nodes of the network attack, and identifies potential network attack paths and risks, thereby providing scientific basis for the safety protection and emergency response of the power system.

title_en: Multi-index self-adaptive fusion grading early warning method for coal-rock gas dynamic disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-index self-adaptive fusion grading early warning method for coal-rock gas dynamic disasters. The method comprises the steps of (1) multi-source data collaborative preprocessing, namely collecting multi-source data, identifying and marking abnormal values by utilizing a semi-supervision collaborative training model based on xLSTM, denoising acoustic emission and electromagnetic radiation signals by utilizing a PSO-wavelet threshold-OPTICS model, and then interpolating missing values in real time by utilizing a BayOTIDE model, (2) multi-disaster feature fusion and risk prediction, namely inputting the preprocessed data into a MTAFM model, respectively processing different data by a core and an auxiliary expert module, and dynamically fusing features to generate risk probability, and (3) dynamic grading early warning and composite disaster judgment, namely determining an early warning threshold value based on Bayesian dynamic optimization, grading by combining a quantile method, and judging that the coal and gas dynamic disasters are composite disasters during the same early warning. The invention has the advantages of strong adaptive data preprocessing capability, accurate multi-index fusion early warning, reliable dynamic grading early warning and reduced dependence on professionals.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE SAFETY EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Building pedestrian simulation statistics and analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building pedestrian simulation statistics and analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of simulation. The invention provides a comprehensive pedestrian behavior evaluation and optimization scheme through normal pedestrian circulation simulation and emergency evacuation simulation and combining statistical analysis, data visualization and optimization algorithm. The system manages pedestrian density through KD tree, and utilizes ScottPlot to make real-time data visualization to generate one-dimensional, two-dimensional and three-dimensional charts, and visually display pedestrian distribution and flow conditions in the building. In emergency evacuation scenarios, the system passes The algorithm dynamically plans the path, and identifies and relieves potential bottleneck areas by combining heuristic functions of congestion metrics. The simulation system can collect abundant statistical data, including evacuation time, people flow distribution, congestion point analysis and the like, and provides scientific basis for safety design improvement and emergency plan formulation of the building.

title_en: Fire disaster identification method and system based on smoke analysis algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster identification method and a fire disaster identification system based on a smoke analysis algorithm, belongs to the technical field of forest fire disaster identification, and is used for solving the technical problems that the conventional forest fire disaster identification algorithm is easily interfered in multiple aspects under a complex forest environment, so that the misjudgment rate is increased, and potential fire points and fire disaster spreading trends cannot be rapidly locked when a fire disaster occurs. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional monitoring data of a monitored forest zone, dividing the monitored forest zone into cells based on the multidimensional monitoring data and generating a dynamic smoke threshold value of each cell, constructing a cell dynamic association library according to the multidimensional monitoring data of each cell, carrying out smoke recognition on the multidimensional monitoring data and determining a target cell with fire disaster based on the dynamic smoke threshold value, carrying out spreading dynamic simulation on the multidimensional monitoring data of the target cell to obtain spreading simulation data, obtaining an associated cell of the target cell in the cell dynamic association library, determining the associated cell as a potential fire disaster zone, and generating a potential fire disaster zone thermodynamic diagram.

title_en: Advanced identification method while drilling for rock burst and rock burst dynamic disaster dangerous area
abstract_en: A drilling advance identification method for rock burst and rock burst dynamic disaster dangerous areas is characterized by constructing drilling holes in an area to be mined, recording drilling time, displacement, torque, thrust, drilling speed, rotating speed and vibration speed curves in real time, carrying out high-definition shooting on the inside of the holes by adopting a panoramic drilling peeping instrument to obtain crack development degree and size, carrying out triaxial loading drilling orthogonal tests, predicting dynamic disaster dangerous grades at different positions of the drilling holes by establishing corresponding relations between drilling multi-parameter information, ground stress and strength parameters and dynamic disaster discrimination criteria, drawing a dynamic disaster dangerous area prediction graph, and verifying and optimizing a prediction method according to microseism, drilling chip taking and on-site dynamic disaster condition observation in the actual tunneling process. The invention realizes the advanced identification while drilling of the rock burst and the dynamic disaster dangerous area of the rock burst.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;ZHONGKUANG DINGBEI TECH XUZHOU CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Mine self-rescuer simulation training effect monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine self-rescuers, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring simulation training effect of a mine self-rescuer, comprising the following steps of collecting data of physiological monitoring equipment worn by a trainer, and collecting heart rate value and blood oxygen saturation, recording response time and error rate of operation behaviors of a trainer, extracting equipment operation sequence and environment change information, and establishing a physiological behavior integration data set. According to the invention, physiological data and operation behavior data of the trainee are collected in real time, and a multidimensional physiological behavior integration data set is created by combining environment change information, so that not only are heart rate and blood oxygen changes of the trainee in simulation training reflected, but also response time and error rate are synthesized, a basis is provided for evaluating emergency response capability of the trainee, and the training difficulty adaptability index can dynamically reflect physiological and behavior states of the trainee, so that training content can be adjusted in a targeted manner in real time according to the conditions of the trainee, and training difficulty is optimized.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG COAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;WEISHINUO INTELLIGENT TECH QINGDAO CO LTD

title_en: Crude oil supply chain management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of supply chain management and optimization, in particular to a crude oil supply chain management method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a supply chain dynamic model through multi-mode data fusion and causal analysis; the method comprises the steps of generating real-time data and forecast data based on a digital twin technology, simulating a cross-node associated scene and extreme climate conditions, dynamically optimizing a transportation path, an inventory allocation strategy and a delivery sequence through a multi-objective optimization algorithm and a flexible emergency adjustment module, automatically executing an optimization scheme by using an intelligent contract system, generating feedback adjustment data and improvement scheme data based on real-time feedback, and realizing closed-loop optimization. The invention effectively improves the dynamic adaptability of the crude oil supply chain in a complex environment, optimizes the cost, the inventory turnover rate and the delivery efficiency, and simultaneously enhances the robustness and the emergency response capability of the system.

title_en: Tunnel wall detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel wall detection method and device, and relates to the field of tunnel wall detection, comprising the following steps of acquiring and preprocessing multi-mode data in a tunnel, wherein the multi-mode data comprises historical tunnel wall picture data, real-time tunnel wall target images and environment monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a tunnel wall defect detection model, setting an optimization strategy, training the tunnel wall defect detection model by using historical tunnel wall picture data to obtain an optimal tunnel wall defect detection model, and inputting an acquired real-time tunnel wall target image into the optimal tunnel wall defect detection model to obtain a tunnel wall detection result. The tunnel wall detection method and the tunnel wall detection device can effectively solve the key problems of crack growth, water seepage, fire disaster and the like in tunnel wall detection, and provide technical guarantee for tunnel safety operation.
assignees: HEBEI JIAOTOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Snow mountain login safety early warning method and system based on intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow mountain login safety early warning method and system based on an intelligent helmet, and relates to the technical field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting risk multidimensional data in a plurality of mountain climbing routes, quantifying basic risk state indexes of nodes of each mountain climbing route, and constructing a virtual simulation snow mountain digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining running state data and environment state data of a route where a real-time snow mountain login user is located, evaluating fatigue state indexes of the corresponding nodes of the route where the user is located in the real-time snow mountain login, substituting the environment state data of the route where the real-time snow mountain login user is located into a virtual simulation snow mountain digital twin model, quantifying dynamic risk indexes of the corresponding nodes of the route where the real-time snow mountain login user is located, and judging whether the fatigue state indexes of the corresponding nodes of the route where the user is located in the real-time snow mountain login meet the dynamic risk indexes of the corresponding nodes. The method has the advantages of reducing the risk of human misjudgment and improving the emergency response speed in an extreme environment.

title_en: Rock burst identification and control system and method for TBM shield tunneling machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst identification and control system and method for TBM shield tunneling machine, which are used for drilling holes in surrounding rocks around a tunnel and installing monitoring equipment so as to monitor the characteristics of the surrounding rocks in real time, and a rock burst early warning module is used for analyzing monitoring data and early warning rock burst risks according to analysis results. If the rock burst risk is judged to exist, starting the rock burst control unit, enabling the mechanical cutterhead to extend out of the TBM shield machine and start cutting, and enabling the mechanical cutterhead to advance synchronously along with tunneling of the shield machine to form pressure relief cracks. Continuously monitoring in the lancing process, and lancing for a plurality of times according to the monitoring result until the rock burst risk is eliminated. The device is suitable for high-ground-stress underground rock engineering, can intelligently identify and prevent rock burst, and effectively improves the construction efficiency of underground tunnel engineering. Compared with other kerf pressure relief methods, the mechanical kerf has better stability, lower cost and higher safety, and is not easy to cause secondary disasters.
assignees: JIANGXI COPPER TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow numerical simulation method coupled with hydrodynamic model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prediction and discloses a mountain torrent mud-rock flow numerical simulation method coupled with a hydrodynamic model. According to the method, DEM data, rainfall data and land utilization data are used as input parameters, a HiPIMS model is used for simulating the mountain torrent condition in a river basin, then a HiPIMS-FLO-2D coupling model is built based on the HiPIMS model result as the flow process line input of FLO-2D, so that simulation of the debris flow condition in the region is realized, and finally the integral accuracy of the model is evaluated through mountain torrent accuracy index F and debris flow accuracy index omega. The HiPIMS-FLO-2D coupling model provided by the invention can effectively simulate the high-transient mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster process, obviously improves the simulation precision, and provides powerful tools and references for scientific research and prediction of related disasters.

title_en: Self-adaptive classification method for dynamic change of microseismic signal characteristics
abstract_en: A self-adaptive classification method for dynamic change of microseismic signal characteristics relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and information. The method comprises the steps of constructing an Ada-VIT model integrating a feature extractor, a multi-label classifier and a domain discriminator, optimizing features by utilizing an adaptive mechanism to improve identification accuracy of microseismic signals in a complex change environment, training the model by using clean microseismic signals and pure noise signals as source domain samples, identifying and classifying the microseismic signals which are more complex after feature change and contain noise as target domain samples, and verifying self-adaptive capacity of the model in the complex change environment. The method has the beneficial effects that the identification precision of the microseismic signals and the self-adaptive capacity of the model are improved, the multi-label classification performance is optimized, the calculation efficiency and the resource utilization rate are improved, and the comprehensive evaluation index is adopted for performance verification, so that the method has important application value and popularization prospect in the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Active protection system for geological disaster prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active protection system for geological disaster prevention and control, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control and comprises a data acquisition module, a case extraction module, a case matching module, a combined arrangement module and an effect analysis module, wherein the active protection system has the advantages that: the case matching module can accurately find out the previous case similar to the current circling geological features, the accuracy of predicting potential geological disasters is improved, the combined arrangement module can be used for protecting disasters with higher occurrence probability preferentially, the utilization efficiency of protection resources is improved, the buffering capacity of the disasters with higher occurrence probability is improved, the effect of a protection method is improved, the arrangement situation of geological structures and protection schemes can be displayed more intuitively through the effect analysis module, and the feasibility and the effectiveness of the protection schemes can be evaluated in advance through the effect analysis of simulating different disasters.
assignees: The Fifth Geological Brigade of Jiangxi Geological Bureau

title_en: Gymnasium evacuation scheme intelligent pushing method based on group motion simulation technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent pushing method for a gymnasium evacuation scheme based on a group motion simulation technology, and relates to the technical field of building safety simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly adopting a multi-target tracking algorithm and a multi-view scene target continuous tracking technology across cameras to determine the current position and the current speed of personnel in each stadium in real time according to field video data, then fusing three-dimensional virtual scene data of the target stadium and an emergency evacuation scheme to obtain a three-dimensional virtual emergency evacuation scene, then initializing a crowd dynamics simulation model for realizing a crowd motion simulation technology based on the evacuation scene and the current position and the current speed of each personnel, starting the model to simulate the current crowd motion simulation time length of evacuating all personnel in the stadium out of the target stadium, and finally determining the current availability of the emergency evacuation scheme according to the comparison result of the simulation time length and a preset time length threshold value, thereby realizing the purpose of dynamically adapting to the actual real-time situation in the stadium.
assignees: LEPAO SPORTS INTERNET WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: Reverse prediction method for reservoir water level based on osmoticum data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir water level reverse prediction method based on osmoticum data fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing osmoticum data and water level data, and carrying out data alignment and missing value filling; and finally, training a gradient lifting regression model pair by using the fused data to predict the reservoir water level, and measuring the performance of the prediction model by taking a mean square error as an evaluation index. The invention provides accurate reservoir water level prediction, has stronger adaptability and reliability, is particularly suitable for safety management of reservoirs and disaster prevention and reduction, and provides scientific basis for reservoir management.
assignees: ANHUI SHUIKE SHUZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;ANHUI & HUAIHE RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT QUALITY INSPECTION C

title_en: Virtual reality training system and method for firefighter stress disorder auxiliary treatment
abstract_en: The scheme provides a virtual reality training system and a method for firefighter stress disorder auxiliary treatment, the development of a virtual reality technology and a heart rate variability monitoring technology is utilized in the scheme, the firefighter training system and the method based on virtual reality are provided, simultaneously, the selection and adjustment of a virtual reality environment are carried out by combining multiple dimensions, on one hand, the firefighter stress disorder auxiliary treatment system can be used for training firefighter fire task processing capacity, on the other hand, the firefighter stress disorder auxiliary treatment system can be used for assisting in treating firefighter post-traumatic stress disorder, helping firefighter overcome fear psychology of wounds and high pressure faced in a fire fighting task, preventing and assisting in treating post-traumatic stress disorder, effectively improving the stress disorder cure rate of the firefighter group and reducing the stress disorder prevalence rate. In addition, the scheme ensures that the auxiliary treatment training scheme better meets the unique requirements of each firefighter according to individual characteristics, individual differences, psychological states and physiological states through multi-level personalized adjustment, and effectively improves the training effect.
assignees: HANGZHOU MED VISION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote operation and maintenance method for power equipment under virtual mapping
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power operation and maintenance management, in particular to a power equipment remote operation and maintenance method under virtual mapping, which comprises the steps of monitoring power equipment, collecting parameters in real time and uploading the parameters to a cloud; the method comprises the steps of establishing an analog simulation space, dynamically simulating the power grid state, introducing a fault decision mechanism, outputting a protection and operation and maintenance strategy according to the equipment state, and remotely sending the strategy to a control terminal, so that the technical problems that the mutual influence among equipment in the power grid is complex, the abnormal state of the power equipment cannot be timely identified and processed to cause a chain reaction, and the overall stability of the power grid is influenced are solved, the abnormal state of the equipment is remotely detected and identified, the protection strategy of the power equipment and the operation and maintenance strategy of the power equipment are automatically generated, measures are rapidly taken when faults occur, the impact of the equipment faults on the whole power grid is reduced, the stability of the power equipment is effectively improved, the faults are prevented from being diffused in the power grid, and the overall reliability and the technical effect of emergency response capability of the power grid are enhanced.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Mine dust concentration prediction and control method based on self-supervision learning of GNN and transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine dust concentration prediction and control method based on self-supervision learning of GNN and a transducer, and belongs to the field of coal mine disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode mine environment parameters and historical dust concentration data, carrying out standardization and feature engineering treatment on the data, carrying out partial masking on the treated data by adopting an MAE strategy, and reconstructing the internal structure of the masked partial learning data, generating synthetic data similar to the actual mine environment by utilizing GAN (gas-oxygen) to expand a training set, fusing the spatial features extracted by a GNN module with the time sequence features extracted by a transducer module to generate comprehensive feature representation, predicting dust concentration values of all positions of a mine based on the comprehensive features, generating ventilation control parameter suggestions, and dynamically adjusting a mine ventilation system according to a prediction result to realize dust concentration control.

title_en: Geological disaster surveys equipment for mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mine exploration, in particular to geological disaster investigation equipment for mines, which comprises a mounting frame, an earth drilling unit arranged on the top wall of the mounting frame and a collecting unit arranged on the bottom wall of the mounting frame, wherein the device creatively adopts a multi-stage layered collecting barrel to work together with a precise blanking assembly, so that the precise layered collection of collected samples is realized, the design skillfully solves the problem of mixed collection of samples in the prior art, ensures the independence and the integrity of samples in different layers, and simultaneously, the device efficiently completes the whole flow operation of drilling, recycling and collecting by only utilizing the positive and negative rotation of a single motor through the smart linkage mechanism of the earth drilling assembly, and the design improves the automation level of the device and overcomes the defects of low automation degree and complex operation in the prior art.
assignees: SHAANXI YANCHANG PETROLEUM GROUP HENGSHAN WEIQIANG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Phone Number-Based Digital Platform Integrated Management System and Method
title_ko: 전화번호 기반 사용자 인증 및 디지털 플랫폼 통합 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The digital platform integrated management system automatically detects changes in a user's phone number by linking in real-time with a telecommunications carrier's HLR (Home Location Register) or HSS (Home Subscriber Server) system, automatically synchronizes change information with multiple affiliate platforms through API and SDK-based interfaces, and includes a dual identifier structure that updates only the internal identifier (Num-ID) while maintaining the external user ID. According to the present invention, this is a technology that automatically links with various affiliate platforms upon detection of a phone number change or abnormal status to realize user information protection, ensure authentication reliability, and prevent misdelivery.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자 전화번호를 기반으로 다양한 디지털 플랫폼을 통합적으로 관리하고, 사용자 상태에 따른 인증 처리 및 이상 상황 대응이 가능한 시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히, 전화번호 변경 시 이를 자동으로 감지하고, 제휴 플랫폼에 정보 변경을 실시간 동기화함으로써 사용자 정보의 최신성을 유지하고 오도착이나 인증 오류를 방지할 수 있도록 설계되었다. 
또한, 사용자의 앱 이용 로그, 메시지 응답률, 로그인 빈도 등의 데이터를 기반으로 인공지능(AI)이 행동을 예측하고, 번호 변경 또는 서비스 해지 가능성을 점수화하여 선제적으로 사용자에게 안내함으로써 불필요한 서비스 유지 비용을 줄인다. 
비정상 상태가 감지될 경우, 보호자 또는 최근 이용 제휴 플랫폼에 사전 알림을 전송하고, 다회 응답 실패 시에는 공공기관(경찰, 소방 등)에 사용자 정보, 최종 위치, 로그인 기록 등을 자동 전송하는 기능도 포함한다. 이 때 사용자의 사전 설정 및 개인정보 보호법을 기반으로 전송 정보는 필터링 처리된다. 
또한, 사용자가 사망하거나 인지 능력 저하 등으로 직접 시스템을 제어할 수 없는 경우, 사전 등록된 대리인에게 열람, 수정, 해지 등의 권한이 자동으로 이관된다. 모든 정보 변경 이력 및 인증 활동은 위변조 방지 기능이 적용된 인증서 형태로 발급된다. 
본 시스템은 제휴 플랫폼에 SDK 또는 API 형태로 제공되며, 인증 마크를 UI에 표시하거나 메시지 전송 시 오도착 방지 필터를 적용할 수 있도록 구성된다. 전체 구조는 다양한 응용 시나리오에 대응 가능하도록 설계되어 있으며, 고령화 사회의 긴급 대응, 계정 정리, 정보 갱신 등 다양한 사회적 니즈를 충족시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure disaster and aging management technology
title_ko: 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is for simulating and displaying prediction of a damage occurrence situation due to a disaster occurrence and aging of a port building/facility/road/bridge. A big data-based digital twin control system for port infrastructure disaster and aging management technology includes: a port data collection part configured to integratedly manage information on a building, a road, and a bridge constituting a port; and a digital twin platform configured to implement a digital twin by an object modeling part through information data transmitted from the port data collection part, and to output as virtual modeling data of the digital twin based on structural analysis data for the port building/facility/road/bridge transmitted from a structural analysis server and aging information transmitted from the port data collection part. According to the present invention, it is possible to immediately check a degree of aging of the port infrastructure visually through a display part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 관한 것으로서, 종래 항만의 유지보수를 위해 디지털 트윈 플랫폼이 적용된 바 없었다.  
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만을 구성하는 건물과 도로 및 교량에 대한 정보를 통합 관리하는 항만 데이터 취합부와; 상기 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 객체 모델링부에 의해 디지털 트윈(Digital Twin)을 구현하고, 구조해석 서버에서 전달되는 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터와 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 노후도 정보를 기반으로 디지털 트윈의 가상 모델링 데이터로 출력하는 디지털 트윈 플랫폼을 포함하여 구성되는 디지털 트윈 관제시스템에 있어서, 구조해석 서버에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터와, 항만/도로/교량에 대한 구조 해석 데이터를 통해 각각의 잔여 수명을 연산하며, 객체 모델링부에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터에 의해 3D 또는 2D의 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하고, 시뮬레이터부에서는 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달된 정보 데이터를 통해 항만건물/시설/도로/교량에 대한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측하며, 상태감지부에서는 상기 항만 데이터 취합부의 정보 데이터에 회득하기 위한 센서의 상태 및 고장여부를 실시간을 감시하고, 해역별 항만시설물 노후화 평가기준을 통해, 항만시설물의 재해위험도 평가 지표를 결정하여, 각 항만시설물의 환경 위험도 평가기준을 수립하여, 재해위험도 예측 프로그램을 적용하는 것을 항만 인프라 재해 및 노후화 관리기술을 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템을 제안한다.  
본 발명에 의한 항만 인프라 유지관리를 위한 빅데이터 기반 디지털 트윈 관제시스템은 항만 데이터 취합부에서 전달되는 정보 데이터가 디지털 트윈 플랫폼에 전달되고, 객체 모델링부를 통해 각 구성요소에 대한 가상화 모델링 작업을 진행하며, 항만건물/시설/도로/교량의 노후도를 예측 및 시뮬레이션하여 디스플레이할 수 있으므로, 디스플레이부를 통해 시각적으로 항만 인프라의 노후도를 즉각 확인이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 시뮬레이션을 통한 재해발생 및 노후화에 의한 피해발생상황 예측 및 즉각적인 정책적 의사결정 시스템을 구축하고, 빅데이터(기본정보, 2내역/3내역 데이터 및 노후도/재해위험도 평가 데이터 등) 분석 및 가시화를 통한 항만 인프라 모니터링이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: CFD-DEM-based underwater shield tunnel catastrophe simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CFD-DEM-based underwater shield tunnel disaster simulation method, which relates to the technical field of tunnels and underground engineering and comprises the steps of constructing a fluid CFD model, a BPM contact model concrete lining model and a soil mass DEM model based on soil mass particles of an underwater shield tunnel, performing particle fine calibration, constructing an integral DEM model considering interaction between soil mass and a structure, setting time step of the fluid CFD model and the integral DEM model and coupling frequency between the fluid CFD model and the integral DEM model, and performing coupling calculation to obtain a disaster simulation result of the underwater shield tunnel. According to the invention, the time step and the coupling gap are set, so that the simulation result can clearly observe the whole catastrophe process of the underwater shield tunnel, break and non-break distinction can be carried out on Bond bonds in a final BPM model of the concrete lining, and the damage occurrence area of the lining is observed.

title_en: Adaptive strategy optimization method based on urban flood toughness
abstract_en: The application provides an adaptive strategy optimization method based on urban flood toughness, which is applied to the technical field of disaster emergency treatment and comprises the steps of determining an urban flood risk area by analyzing geographic space data; the method comprises the steps of determining adaptive measure distribution of adaptive measures in a flood risk area through preset constraint conditions of the adaptive measures, determining distribution of various adaptive measures corresponding to the type of the adaptive strategy to be evaluated in the adaptive measure distribution according to the type of the adaptive strategy to be evaluated and a target mapping relation, obtaining target adaptive measure distribution, inputting measure parameter information and rainfall data information of the target adaptive measure distribution in a target rainfall scene into an urban flood toughness simulation model to simulate, determining a flood toughness simulation result, determining the type of the target adaptive strategy based on the flood toughness simulation result, and determining the corresponding target adaptive measure distribution as an optimal adaptive strategy. The adaptive strategy that performs best in urban rainfall scenarios is aimed at evaluation.

title_en: Ocean and atmosphere multi-physical-field prediction method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium for predicting ocean and atmosphere multiple physical fields based on a multi-scale graph neural network, which mainly solve the problems of one-sided performance and lack of interaction mechanisms of ocean and atmosphere physical fields in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ocean and atmosphere historical observation data and preprocessing, constructing a multi-scale graph neural network model comprising an encoder, multiple grids, a processor and a decoder, wherein the multiple grids are connected with a local high-resolution grid and a global low-resolution grid through shared nodes and cross-scale edges to realize bidirectional information flow, utilizing a training set to iteratively optimize parameters of the multi-scale graph neural network model, evaluating and optimizing model performance through a testing set, and finally generating a high-precision prediction result. The method can synchronously predict the parameters of multiple physical fields such as mixed wave height, wave period, temperature, wind speed and the like, remarkably improves the calculation efficiency and the prediction accuracy, and can be widely applied to global climate analysis, marine disaster early warning and sea-air interaction research.

title_en: Electric fire disaster identification method based on DB-YOLOv and BTFF networks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision, and discloses an electric fire disaster identification method based on DB-YOLOv and BTFF networks. The method comprises the following implementation steps of 1, obtaining an electric fire picture, preprocessing the electric fire picture to obtain a preprocessed image, 2, redesigning the electric fire picture into a double-branch main network based on YOLOv main network, 3, respectively leading out three feature layers from each branch in the step 2 to perform FPN feature fusion, finally inputting the obtained six feature layers into a binary tree feature fusion network, and 4, training the improved YOLOv network model by using the training data set to obtain an electric fire identification model. The detection efficiency of high-resolution images and the detection precision of electric fires can be improved, and the overall safety of electric equipment is improved.

title_en: Regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on limited samples
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control engineering, and particularly relates to a regional bedding side slope pre-reinforcement range determining method based on a limited sample. The method comprises the steps of firstly, counting disaster factors of regional bedding slopes, secondly, obtaining key disaster factors and distribution conditions of the key disaster factors by adopting a gray correlation method, amplifying limited samples by Monte Carlo simulation, screening out high-risk samples by taking a stability coefficient <1.0 as a standard, obtaining a pre-reinforcing range of the bedding slopes under complex geological conditions by adopting finite element simulation, and finally, establishing a correlation between the key disaster factors of the bedding slopes and the pre-reinforcing range by adopting a data preprocessing and XGBoost machine learning method to realize a regional bedding slope pre-reinforcing range determining method based on the limited samples. The method comprises the steps of amplifying a limited sample, establishing a correlation relation between a key disaster causing factor and a pre-reinforcement range, and finally obtaining the determination of the pre-reinforcement range of other bedding slopes in the area.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;SICHUAN ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Pipeline leakage simulation device and method considering variability of sand foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering model tests, and discloses a simulation device for pipeline leakage considering the variability of a sand foundation, the system comprises a soil body parameter field modeling module, a 3D printing modeling system, a model box, a pipeline, a water pressure loading system, a CCD continuous camera, a data acquisition system and a computer. And constructing a three-dimensional sand parameter field model through CPT field data, generating a sand foundation with space variability by combining with random field theory, and accurately reproducing the space distribution of soil mechanical parameters by utilizing a multi-material 3D printing technology. The pipeline leakage process is simulated through controllable water pressure loading, and soil settlement and pipeline deformation are monitored in real time by combining a CCD imaging and data acquisition system. The invention breaks through the problems of the lack of soil heterogeneity simulation and variability simulation technology and unclear characterization of seepage-deformation coupling mechanisms in the traditional test, and provides a reliable test platform for the mechanism analysis and prevention and control technology development of urban underground pipeline seepage disasters.
assignees: QINGHAI TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Regional intrusion recognition method and system based on large model reasoning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large model reasoning-based area intrusion recognition method and system, the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-mode fusion pretreatment on collected different sensor data based on a self-attention mechanism, analyzing continuous video frames based on a multi-head attention mechanism in a depth vision converter, constructing a dynamic updated environment state representation, simulating and analyzing interaction and behavior patterns among individuals in a scene based on the dynamic updated environment state representation, accurately tracking and predicting behaviors of the individuals and the groups through constructing a behavior graph and dynamically updating node characteristics, determining abnormal events, combining severity of the abnormal events and cost benefits of various emergency response measures, and selecting optimal emergency response measures through an automatic decision support system. The safety monitoring system has the advantages that the technical problems of insufficient data integration, poor adaptability and response delay of the traditional safety monitoring system are solved, and therefore more accurate and efficient safety monitoring and emergency response are realized.

title_en: Quantum calculation embedded power grid elasticity assessment method considering all potential risks
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of analysis and evaluation of power systems, and relates to a quantum computing embedded power grid elasticity evaluation method considering all potential risks, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining typhoon weather disaster information possibly occurring in a future period of time; the method comprises the steps of 2, generating probability distribution based on vulnerability analysis by using typhoon early warning data information, 3, rapidly evaluating system fault risk loss under short-time rolling risk early warning, 4, performing overall process simulation evaluation on the fault risk loss, 5, judging whether a disaster-stricken line is repaired at the moment of t  k , 6, judging whether Monte Carlo simulation meets convergence conditions, and accelerating estimation of line fault probability by introducing a quantum amplitude estimation algorithm, wherein the rapid multi-scene parallel evaluation capability supported by quantum calculation is utilized, and the evaluation efficiency can be remarkably improved under the condition of ensuring consistent precision by combining dynamic repair and quantum embedding elastic evaluation processes.

title_en: Walking booster
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of walking boosters, in particular to a walking booster which comprises a backrest control assembly, wherein a connecting frame assembly is arranged on one side of the lower end of the backrest control assembly, thigh connecting assemblies are arranged on two sides of the connecting frame assembly, a shank connecting assembly is arranged at the lower end of the thigh connecting assembly, a telescopic assembly is arranged at the lower end of the shank connecting assembly, and a swinging assembly is arranged at the lower end of the telescopic assembly. The application can be applied to various scenes such as medical rehabilitation, old life, disaster relief, exercise enhancement and the like, can realize intelligent control, can be connected and fixed with legs and feet, can realize automatic auxiliary walking, can massage the legs of a user, and is beneficial to promoting blood circulation and leg muscle recovery.

title_en: Intelligent water conservancy digital twin simulation system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent water conservancy digital twin simulation system based on multi-source data, which belongs to the technical field of digital monitoring, and aims to realize minute-level data acquisition and transmission by constructing an air-space three-dimensional sensing network and combining edge intelligent preprocessing, acquire data by utilizing sensors such as millimeter wave radar, laser radar and the like, reduce noise and identify anomalies, perform dynamic data fusion and intelligent calibration, realize data second-level alignment and trusted verification by means of a space-time calibration algorithm, kalman filtering and a block chain verification technology, establish a hybrid simulation and intelligent decision model, and realize flood evolution minute-level prediction and emergency response by adopting a physical model, a machine learning architecture and a dynamic threshold decision tree.

title_en: Comprehensive pipe rack toughness assessment method and system for multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion comprehensive pipe rack toughness assessment method and system, which relate to the technical field of toughness assessment and comprise the steps of driving a GIS platform to acquire geographic information according to pipe rack layout positions of pipe racks to be assessed, so as to obtain the geographic information of the pipe racks; the method comprises the steps of obtaining pipe gallery building information through building information retrieval, constructing a pipe gallery multi-body dynamics model by combining the pipe gallery building information and pipe gallery geographic information, carrying out associated pipe gallery positioning to obtain M associated pipe galleries, interacting with an internet of things (IoT) sensor to obtain M operation state time sequence data, carrying out disaster scene superposition matching to output multi-element disaster intensity grading, collecting a multi-element structure response data set in a disaster simulation process by driving the pipe gallery multi-body dynamics model, carrying out pipe gallery toughness quantitative evaluation, and mapping and outputting a pipe gallery structure toughness cloud picture. The method solves the technical problem that the toughness of the comprehensive pipe rack cannot be comprehensively estimated in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of dynamic quantitative estimation of the toughness of the comprehensive pipe rack.
assignees: CCDI SUZHOU EXPLOR & DESIGN CONSULTANT CO LTD

title_en: Power grid line emergency repair scheduling and distributing method for complex multi-constraint disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid line emergency repair dispatching distribution method for a complex multi-constraint disaster scene, and belongs to the technical field of power grid emergency management. The method comprises the steps of decomposing a complex rush-repair task into a plurality of quantifiable subtasks, establishing a matrix description of task requirements and technical capability requirements, establishing a multi-dimensional technical capability assessment index system, dynamically quantifying the technical capability level of emergency personnel through assessment and scoring, establishing an assessment model based on the technical capability satisfaction rate, estimating the rush-repair man-hour by combining a Monte Carlo simulation method based on Latin hypercube sampling, carrying out team internal task allocation by using a Hungary algorithm, and optimizing the multi-team task allocation by utilizing an ant colony algorithm of multiple traveling companies by combining the rush-repair man-hour estimation. The method can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of emergency task allocation, improve the utilization rate of limited resources and provide technical support for rush repair work in disaster scenes.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster overall process simulation method integrating water-soil coupling and solid-liquid conversion
abstract_en: The invention provides a debris flow disaster recovery whole-process simulation method integrating water-soil coupling and solid-liquid conversion, which comprises the steps of calculating solid, liquid and gas three-phase mass at a background grid node according to a geological report (k=1) or a simulation result of a k-1 time step (k > 1), calculating solid, liquid and gas three-phase momentum at the background grid node, calculating internal force, external force and drag force coefficients on the background grid node, solving acceleration of the solid, liquid and gas nodes based on a mixture control equation and Darcy law, and updating solid, liquid and gas three-phase speeds of a substance point. The invention introduces a three-phase coupling control equation of 'soil body framework-pore fluid-pore gas', a soil-water characteristic curve, a relation between permeability coefficient and saturation, a density smoothing algorithm and a density-based solid-liquid conversion criterion, realizes the whole process effective simulation of debris flow soil-water coupling and solid-liquid conversion, and has important significance for revealing the debris flow disaster process and guiding the prediction, evaluation and prevention of debris flow disasters.

title_en: Park fire-fighting early warning management system and method for property management
