abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control and discloses a park fire control early warning management system and method for property management, wherein the park fire control early warning management system comprises the steps of constructing a conduction reachability matrix to quantify the physical association strength of a sensor in a building heat conduction network, activating a conduction path association device to perform data cross verification when the sensor alarms, and outputting a three-level credibility label; the deconstructing fixed plan is a detecting element, a control element and a suppressing element basic unit, a plan execution chain containing an execution sequence is generated based on real-time fire simulation dynamic assembly, and intelligent migration of the response rule of the new park is realized through building a topology vector matching historical case library. The invention breaks through the limitation that the traditional system depends on single sensor threshold judgment, endows the sensor network with self-interpretation capability through a physical conduction model, eliminates the kidnapping effect of false alarm on system decision, reconstructs an alarm-confirmation-response linear flow into a multipath parallel decision mechanism, and avoids the secondary disaster risk caused by false start of a smoke discharging system in the traditional scheme.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN CUIHENG PROPERTY SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting landslide vulnerability by using machine learning model and SBAS-InSAR deformation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting landslide easily by utilizing a machine learning model and SBAS-InSAR deformation, which comprises the steps of obtaining an environmental static factor and a landslide catalog in a sample area, obtaining a dynamic factor based on an SBAS-InSAR technology, establishing a landslide prediction model based on a random forest algorithm, inputting the static factor, the dynamic factor and the landslide catalog into the landslide prediction model for training, inputting the environmental static factor and the dynamic factor of the area to be tested into the landslide prediction model after training, and obtaining a landslide easily-occurring map. According to the landslide susceptibility mapping method, the earth surface deformation rate is used as a dynamic factor to be integrated into landslide susceptibility evaluation, a scientific basis is provided for landslide prevention and disaster reduction, the earth surface deformation rate and the earth surface rail lifting deformation rate are obtained, the earth surface deformation rate is integrated into a static factor data set, and after unified data preprocessing is completed, the static factor and the dynamic factor data are input into a landslide prediction model to be jointly trained and evaluated, so that the landslide susceptibility mapping method has the advantage of high precision.

title_en: Digital twin intelligent campus management method and system based on geographic information
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent campus management and discloses a digital twin intelligent campus management method and system based on geographic information, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring operation data of each teaching space in a campus based on a geographic information technology, and extracting operation characteristic data; the method comprises the steps of analyzing operation characteristic data by using an efficiency analysis algorithm, identifying key factors influencing the operation efficiency of teaching spaces, establishing a risk prediction model based on the key factors, predicting the operation efficiency trend of each teaching space at the future moment by using the risk prediction model, and inputting the operation efficiency trend and real-time operation data into a digital twin model for operation state simulation and management strategy simulation. According to the invention, by introducing a risk prediction model and a digital twin simulation mechanism, the running efficiency change trend can be dynamically predicted, and an optimization strategy is formulated in advance, so that the intellectualization of campus management is effectively enhanced, and the campus service efficiency and emergency response capability are improved.
assignees: XIAN XINGXUN INTELLIGENT COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency resource dynamic scheduling method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource dynamic scheduling method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are characterized in that a dynamic road network topology is constructed through fusion processing of multi-source disaster area state data, dynamic evolution modeling of road network states is realized based on a space-time attention diagram network model, a path passing weight coefficient and a disaster diffusion simulation result are generated, a multi-objective optimization model taking material transportation timeliness, a path risk coefficient and disaster area demand urgency as optimization targets is established, space-time constraint conditions and a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism are introduced, material distribution scheme solving with space-time attenuation factors is realized, and finally an emergency resource scheduling strategy is generated by combining path priority planning and a space-time matching algorithm. The invention can improve the timeliness of emergency resource scheduling in a complex environment.

title_en: Advanced prediction method and system for underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining and preprocessing underground engineering historical monitoring data to obtain a time sequence parameter data set, constructing n underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction single model libraries and using the single model libraries as n decision trees of an improved GBDT model to form an underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction model, inputting and training the time sequence parameter data set into the underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction model to obtain a trained underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction model, obtaining and preprocessing real-time monitoring data to obtain real-time sequence parameter data, and inputting the real-time sequence parameter data into the trained underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information advanced prediction model to predict to obtain advanced monitoring information. The invention can predict the underground engineering dynamic disaster monitoring information in advance.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based bad weather power grid risk identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying risks of a severe weather power grid based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting multisource weather forecast data and power grid topological structure data in a target area, carrying out data cleaning and space-time calibration, fusing the weather data and power grid state data by utilizing a knowledge graph technology, generating a physical risk correlation sub-graph and a linkage risk correlation sub-graph, analyzing the physical damage risk and the fault cascade diffusion risk of power grid facilities by adopting a probability simulation method and a graph theory cascade failure analysis method respectively, determining the comprehensive risk level of a power grid, and generating a power grid risk thermodynamic diagram according to the comprehensive risk level of the power grid. The visual expression of the risk level of the power grid region is realized, and a decision basis is provided for power grid dispatching operation and pre-disaster early warning.

title_en: Two-dimensional numerical method and device for simulating seepage softening of discontinuous surface of rock mass
abstract_en: The application provides a two-dimensional numerical method and a device for simulating seepage softening of a discontinuous surface of a rock body, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining hydraulic joint units in a two-dimensional model area according to type identifiers of joint units in the two-dimensional model area corresponding to a target rock type in a current time step, performing softening process calculation on the hydraulic joint units to determine contact forces acting on two walls of the hydraulic joint units, performing seepage calculation on the hydraulic joint units to determine first fluid pressures acting on all nodes of the hydraulic joint units, and determining total equivalent node forces acting on each node according to the contact forces and the first fluid pressures, wherein the total equivalent node forces are used for updating the type identifiers of the joint units associated with the hydraulic joint units. According to the method, not only is seepage calculation carried out on the hydraulic joint unit carried out, but also softening process calculation is carried out, and the prediction accuracy of rock mass disasters is improved, so that an effective prevention and control strategy can be adopted, and the method is suitable for discontinuous surface fluid-solid coupling calculation of various rocks.

title_en: Method for identifying internal solitary waves in mode data and inverting amplitude based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a machine learning-based method for identifying internal solitary waves in mode data and inverting amplitude, and belongs to the technical field of ocean observation. The method comprises the steps of combining Mask-RCNN and a variation self-encoder, firstly preprocessing and imaging sea surface height data, extracting texture features through a local binary pattern algorithm, constructing a labeling data set, performing model training, identifying internal solitary wave fringes and positions thereof, extracting and processing temperature field data, inverting a temperature field deep in water by the variation self-encoder, and extracting the amplitude of the internal solitary waves in the temperature field based on an internal wave identification result. The invention can efficiently and accurately process large-scale and fine ocean mode data, and remarkably improves the efficiency and accuracy of data processing. The invention has wide application prospect, and particularly in marine disaster early warning, marine science research and internal wave dynamics research, the automatic identification and amplitude extraction capability of internal waves can be greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic emergency response system of energy-saving intelligent street lamp and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic emergency response system of an energy-saving intelligent street lamp and a control method thereof, relates to the technical field of industrial Internet of things control, and solves the problems of poor dynamic scene adaptability, single emergency response strategy and insufficient communication stability of the traditional intelligent street lamp system; the intelligent dimming system generates a dynamic priority scheduling matrix through multi-source data fusion and a self-adaptive weighted decision tree, combines an improved fuzzy reinforcement learning training intelligent dimming strategy, utilizes a multi-level fuzzy control and fuzzy reasoning system to realize emergency parameter generation driven by accident level, dynamically selects an optimal communication link transmission instruction based on a multiple access protocol and multi-scale channel perception, adopts an IEEE 1588PTP protocol and Bayesian clock drift correction to ensure time sequence consistency, optimizes energy consumption and safety balance through multi-objective reinforcement learning, remarkably improves dynamic adaptability, emergency response accuracy and communication reliability of complex scenes, and realizes collaborative optimization of energy saving efficiency and road safety.
assignees: NANYANG GREAT OPTOELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent self-organizing interaction-based computational network ecological digital simulator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power network service, and provides a multi-agent self-organizing interaction-based power network ecological digital simulator, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the system comprises a multi-agent self-organizing interaction module, a resource modeling and dynamic allocation module, a business scheduling and collaborative optimization module, a risk management and emergency response module and a strategy evaluation and optimization regulation and control module. The digital simulator of the invention constructs a refined and virtualized calculation network model through multi-agent self-organizing interaction, can dynamically reappear resource interaction behavior under complex environment, evaluate the effectiveness of a scheduling strategy, and optimize the adaptability of the system in a high dynamic environment, thereby providing scientific basis for intelligent decision of calculation network ecological operation.

title_en: Intelligent identification system and method for earthquake ground surface fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring, in particular to an intelligent identification system and an intelligent identification method for an earthquake ground surface fracture zone, wherein the intelligent identification system comprises modules of heterogeneous data registration, feature extraction and fusion, fracture zone segmentation, active learning, form optimization and the like, and realizes accurate processing of remote sensing data and intelligent identification of the fracture zone; the system adopts multi-scale feature point matching and self-adaptive weight registration, improves the data registration precision by more than 30%, overcomes the dependence of the traditional method on artificial experience, combines multi-scale space pyramid pooling and deformation sensitive segmentation through multi-mode feature decoupling and attention-directed feature fusion, effectively identifies fracture zones and evaluates prediction uncertainty, optimizes training data through Bayesian estimation and mixed sampling strategies by an active learning module, and finally outputs accurate fracture zone distribution and attribute information by a morphological optimization module through geological constraint and fault topological reasoning, thereby improving the intelligent level and efficiency of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring.

title_en: Small river flood intelligent forecasting and early warning method based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood forecasting and early warning, and discloses a small and medium river flood intelligent forecasting and early warning method based on big data analysis. The invention deeply fuses big data, artificial intelligence and distributed simulation front technology, forms a set of flood intelligent forecasting and early warning technology system aiming at small and medium rivers, and can rapidly and accurately forecast flood dynamics by analyzing massive data, intelligent operation by means of artificial intelligence and high-efficiency processing of distributed simulation, thereby remarkably improving the accuracy of flood forecasting and the timeliness of risk early warning, not only being beneficial to relevant departments to plan flood prevention measures in advance, but also providing firm and reliable technical support for flood and drought disaster defense, effectively reducing disaster loss and guaranteeing the life and property safety and stable development of social economy of people in a flow area.
assignees: GANJIANG XIAYOU HYDROLOGY WATER RESOURCE MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Intelligent extraction method for coal mining subsidence area ground surface cracks based on improved transducer model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent extraction method for earth surface cracks in a coal mining subsidence area based on an improved transducer model, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The unmanned aerial vehicle with the high-resolution optical camera is used for collecting images, the image overlapping rate of 70% -80% is guaranteed, and a training data set is constructed through professional labeling, cutting screening and data enhancement. The encoder of the innovative model has the characteristics that the self-adaptive multi-scale patch mapping layer can dynamically adjust the patch size according to the local complexity degree of the image, the characteristics are extracted efficiently, double-attention fusion is combined with optimized position encoding, long-distance dependency capture is enhanced, and the calculation amount and the overfitting of the dynamic sparse connection full-connection layer are reduced. And the residual attention enhancing pyramid pooling and space-channel attention bottleneck mechanism highlights key characteristics and suppresses noise, and the break point detection and connection rule determining module is utilized to realize complete restoration of the ground cracks. The data set is used for deployment after a model is trained, and the ground crack information can be accurately obtained through pretreatment, encoding and decoding and post-treatment, so that the data base is firmly built for mining area safety management and geological disaster prevention.

title_en: Intelligent early warning method and system for elevator fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning method and system for elevator fire, the method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic fire risk index according to smoke concentration, temperature gradient, gas composition and infrared image data collected by a multi-mode sensor in an elevator hoistway, constructing a multi-dimensional risk feature vector based on the dynamic fire risk index, generating escape route instructions comprising stop floor sequences and speed curves according to the multi-dimensional risk feature vector, generating a network simulator panic grade and a behavior mode by antagonizing based on infrared thermal imaging data and voice recognition data in an elevator car, and generating an elevator gating strategy, a ventilation system regulation instruction and a voice guidance instruction by combining the escape route instructions, so as to realize intelligent early warning control for elevator fire. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the fire risk can be evaluated in real time, the escape path can be optimized, the elevator emergency system can be accurately regulated and controlled, and the safety evacuation efficiency in a fire scene can be improved.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery method for power distribution network by integrating attention mechanism and hierarchical decision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and particularly discloses a post-disaster recovery method of a power distribution network integrating an attention mechanism and a layering decision, which comprises the steps of constructing a global layer and a local layer layering decision framework of the power distribution network; the global layer comprises abstracting a power distribution network into a directed graph G= (V, E), calculating feature vectors of nodes, calculating to obtain a node feature matrix based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism, then calculating to generate a maintenance priority thermodynamic diagram based on the node feature matrix, dynamically adjusting the maintenance priority of the nodes according to feedback information of the local layer, constructing a state space, an action space and a reward function based on the maintenance priority thermodynamic diagram by the local layer, performing reinforcement learning training by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, generating a maintenance action strategy, and constructing a global and local cooperative strategy. The invention has the advantages that the hierarchical decision framework combines the attention mechanism and reinforcement learning, so that the global layer can quickly determine key maintenance nodes, and the local layer accurately executes maintenance actions.

title_en: Stair machine for firefighter training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stair machine, and discloses a stair machine for training a firefighter, which comprises a stair machine body, wherein a sliding rod is arranged at the top of the stair machine body, a safety rope is fixedly wound at the bottom of the sliding rod, one end of the safety rope is fixedly provided with a safety belt, the back surface of the safety belt is fixedly provided with an air respirator, the middle parts of two sides of the stair machine body are respectively provided with a mounting frame, and the adjacent sides of the two mounting frames are respectively provided with a negative weight.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Emergency and simulation system device based on marine pulping production fault
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of pulping and papermaking, and discloses a marine pulping production fault emergency and simulation system device which comprises an operation table, wherein a display is arranged on the front side of the operation table, operation buttons are arranged on two sides of the display, the operation buttons are arranged on the front side of the operation table, a starting button is arranged on the left side of the operation buttons on the left side of the operation table, the starting button is arranged on the front side of the operation table, a scram button is arranged on the right side of the operation buttons on the right side of the operation table, the scram button is arranged on the front side of the operation table, and warning lamps are fixedly connected to the top of the operation table. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the plurality of groups of sensors and the operation console, the running state and data of the pulping equipment can be monitored in real time, the occurrence of faults is reduced, and through the arrangement of the simulation box, operators are allowed to practice responding to the occurrence of various fault conditions in a virtual scene, so that the emergency response capability and the operation skill are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU XINSIHUI MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional indoor simulation test system for deformation and damage process of reverse-inclined rock slope
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional indoor simulation test system for a deformation and damage process of a reverse-tilting rock slope. The model box consists of a counter-force loading frame, a sealing transparent plastic plate and a reverse-tilting rock slope model, wherein the stacking simulation unit comprises a jack, a loading base plate, a pressure gauge and a dial indicator, the water storage simulation unit comprises a water tank, a water supply pipe, a drain valve and the like, the rainfall simulation unit comprises a spraying system, a water tank, a water supply pipe and the like, and the monitoring unit comprises an acoustic emission monitoring system, a miniature soil pressure box, a pore water pressure sensor, a strain gauge, an infrared thermal imager, a camera and the like. The utility model can simulate the deformation and damage process of the reverse-inclined rock slope under various working conditions such as pile loading of the slope top, slope excavation, rainfall simulation, reservoir water storage and the like, explores the deformation and damage mechanism of the reverse-inclined rock slope, and provides support for disaster prevention and reduction of the reverse-inclined rock slope.

title_en: Testing device for simulating effect of fire-fighting water jet on concrete in fire disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a testing device for simulating the effect of fire-fighting water on concrete in a fire disaster in the civil engineering field, which comprises a high-temperature furnace, wherein a first bracket is arranged in the high-temperature furnace and used for supporting the fire-fighting simulation device, the fire-fighting simulation device comprises a testing box and six water injection devices, the testing box comprises a box cover and a box body with an opening at the top, a second bracket is arranged in the box body and used for placing a concrete test block, the bottom of the box body is communicated with a drainage steam pipe, the six water injection devices are respectively used for injecting water in six directions of front, rear, left, right, upper, lower and lower of the concrete test block, the water injection devices comprise a water tank and a pressure gauge, the water outlet end of the water tank is communicated with the water inlet end of a water pump, the water outlet end of the water pump is communicated with the testing box through a guide pipe, the water pump is provided with a valve, the pressure gauge is used for detecting the water pressure of the water outlet end of the water pump, and the outer side of the guide pipe is provided with a phase change cooling device for cooling flowing water. The utility model realizes that the concrete is sprayed with water in a calcined state, and can truly reflect the action condition of fire fighting water on the concrete in fire.

title_en: High-steep road embankment slope soil engineering simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope simulation tests, in particular to a high-steep road embankment slope soil engineering simulation test device and a high-steep road embankment slope soil engineering simulation test method, wherein the high-steep road embankment slope soil engineering simulation test device comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom vibration table, a slope assembly, an airflow assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the slope assembly is arranged on the multi-degree-of-freedom vibration table, the airflow assembly is positioned above the slope assembly, and the driving assembly is connected with the multi-degree-of-freedom vibration table, the slope assembly and the airflow assembly; the stirring piece is connected with the frame unit and used for driving the inclination of the frame unit to change, the data acquisition system is used for monitoring the movement characteristics and collapse deformation of the slope model in the simulation process in real time and collecting data information generated in the test process, and the problems that the traditional slope test device cannot dynamically simulate gradient gradual change caused by earthquake collapse and is difficult to reproduce the multi-disaster coupling effect of falling stone impact and hydrological air flow disturbance are solved.
assignees: JIANGXI HIGHWAY DEV CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA JIAOTONG;JIANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: CNN-LSTM-based large-scale crowd evacuation time rapid prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CNN-LSTM-based large-scale crowd evacuation time rapid prediction method, which comprises the steps of building a crowd evacuation simulation model according to evacuation places, simulating evacuation processes and storing evacuation video and evacuation time data, carrying out standardization processing on the data, building a time window, extracting pedestrian distribution diagram sequence fragments from continuous time steps through a sliding window to form a data set, building a large-scale crowd evacuation time rapid prediction model formed by a convolutional neural network, a circulating neural network and a regression output layer, extracting space characteristics by the convolutional neural network, excavating time sequence characteristics by the circulating neural network, building a mapping relation between crowd distribution diagrams and evacuation time by the regression output layer, predicting the evacuation time, and carrying out rapid prediction on the large-scale crowd evacuation time by using the trained and optimized large-scale crowd evacuation time rapid prediction model.

title_en: Method and system for identifying shockproof disaster reduction entity integrating attention and MarkBERT
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a vibration-proof disaster-reduction entity identification method and system integrating attention and MarkBERT, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting original text data in the earthquake field within a specific period, preprocessing the collected original text data, marking the preprocessed text data according to a preset marking target and a preset rule, extracting features of the marked data, constructing a deep learning model comprising a MarkBERT coding layer, a time sequence analysis layer, a dynamic context adjustment module and a CRF decoding layer, training the model by using the marking data, and evaluating entity identification performance of the model after training by using a test dataset. The invention can effectively solve the problems of insufficient characteristic information and low recognition efficiency in the shockproof disaster reduction named entity recognition task, and improves the precision and effect of named entity recognition.

title_en: Mine time-lag type rock burst dynamic short-term intelligent forecasting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine time-lag type rock burst dynamic short-coming intelligent forecasting system, and belongs to the field of rock burst disaster short-coming forecasting. The system comprises a deep well three-dimensional microseismic field universe sensing module, a microseismic characteristic parameter extraction module, a rock burst catastrophe evolution data set construction module, a data preprocessing module, a deep learning prediction module, an interpretability analysis module and a dynamic short-term intelligent prediction module. And constructing a dynamic tracking type microseismic sensing network through a three-level annular nested layout strategy, acquiring microseismic event data in real time, extracting space-time characteristic parameters, constructing a rock burst time sequence data set by combining a sliding time window method, and predicting the occurrence probability and intensity level of rock burst. The system optimizes model parameters by adopting a wolf-simulated annealing mixed algorithm, and improves the credibility of the prediction result through SHAP value analysis. The system can realize dynamic short-term early warning of rock burst disasters and provide scientific decision support for mine safety management.
assignees: EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE COAL INFORMATION INSTITUTE

title_en: Overlying strata type rock burst risk assessment method based on multi-source logging while drilling data fusion
abstract_en: According to the method, drilling is carried out at intervals of 5-50 m in a roadway, drilling parameters such as torque, thrust, drilling speed, rotating speed and the like, natural gamma, resistivity and sound wave speed curves are obtained while drilling, impact danger levels near different drilling positions are judged by combining monitoring data such as microseismic, stress and support resistance, corresponding relation between multi-source logging characteristic parameters and impact danger levels is established by continuously accumulating drilling multi-source logging information and data of impact danger levels near corresponding positions, and the impact danger levels near the next construction drilling positions are predicted, so that real-time identification while drilling of the rock-covering rock burst risks is realized, hysteresis and inefficiency of risk assessment are avoided, and disaster prevention and control timeliness are remarkably improved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;ZHONGKUANG DINGBEI TECH XUZHOU CO LTD;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Remote sensing landslide and surrounding building detection method and system based on ViTAEv-S model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing landslide and surrounding building detection method and system based on a ViTAEv2-S model, belonging to the field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a detection model, namely adopting a light-weight segmentation framework comprising an encoder and a decoder, wherein the encoder adopts a ViTAEv-S backbone network, and combines multi-scale cavity convolution and a self-attention mechanism to extract multi-scale features; the decoder simplifies the U-Net structure, removes the pyramid pooling module, adds the space attention module to focus landslide and building areas, adds the channel attention module to strengthen the corresponding characteristic channels of the landslide and the building, trains the detection model, and synchronously segments the landslide and the building by using the trained detection model. The invention provides a lightweight improvement scheme aiming at the segmentation frame, improves the semantic segmentation precision, obviously reduces the consumption of computing resources, improves the training capacity of small samples, realizes synchronous detection of landslide and buildings through multi-task learning, and is suitable for disaster real-time monitoring scenes.

title_en: Portable operation's fire-fighting lance
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable operation fire-fighting lance, which comprises a water strip coil, a plug frame assembly, a lance assembly and two plug frame assemblies. The arm fixing assembly is arranged on the water gun assembly and is clamped with the arm, the two inserting frame assemblies are arranged on two sides of the water gun assembly, and the arm fixing assembly is connected with the inserting frame assemblies in a linkage mode. The water hose reel is connected with the inserting frame assembly in a linkage way, and comprises a sleeve seat and a water delivery belt. According to the portable operation fire-fighting lance, the water belt coil, the inserting frame assembly, the water lance assembly and the two inserting frame assemblies are mutually matched, so that the special water belt throwing method can be simulated by utilizing the mechanical structure, and common personnel do not need to orderly match each finger, palm and arm of the common personnel like a fire fighter. The operation of the firefighter can be simulated only by swinging arms and buckling the mechanism, so that the firefighter can be used by people conveniently.
assignees: JINGNING SHE AUTONOMOUS COUNTY TRANSP DEVELOPMENT CENTER

title_en: Simulation method for urban flood emergency rescue path planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method for urban flood emergency rescue path planning, which is used for carrying out urban road network modeling based on urban topographic maps, rainfall data, existing water distribution and key position information, establishing a hydrodynamic model by using MIKE simulation software to simulate the rainfall and flood spreading process of a city to obtain flood dynamic information at each position point in a flood disaster scene model, including flood depth and flow rate, respectively constructing objective functions with the shortest maximum time of arrival of disaster relief points, the lowest running risk of rescue vehicles and the shortest total weighted rescue time, setting constraint conditions to ensure that all the disaster relief points are covered and vehicles are prevented from being excessively distributed, carrying out solution of a pareto solution set by adopting NSGA-II non-dominant ranking genetic algorithm based on the flood dynamic information, the objective functions and the constraint conditions, carrying out weighted analysis on the result of the pareto solution set to obtain optimal solutions, and outputting the urban flood emergency rescue path planning.

title_en: Karst region dangerous rock disaster large-scale physical model simulation experiment device and method
abstract_en: A large-scale physical model simulation experiment device and method for a dangerous rock disaster in a karst area belong to the technical field of rock mechanics, the device comprises a rigid foundation, a horizontal dynamic load applying assembly, a vertical static load applying assembly and a similar physical model bearing table assembly, wherein the horizontal dynamic load applying assembly and the similar physical model bearing table assembly are arranged at the top of the rigid foundation in parallel, and the vertical static load applying assembly comprises a horizontal longitudinal position adjusting mechanism, a vertical height position adjusting mechanism, a horizontal transverse position adjusting mechanism and a static load pressure head. The large physical model simulation experiment device and method for the dangerous rock disaster in the karst area can realize loading at any position in space, can meet the experiment loading requirement under the condition of the variability of the dangerous rock body, can adapt to the experiment loading requirement of physical models with different sizes which vary in a large range, can realize the coupling loading of horizontal dynamic load and vertical static load, and can develop experimental research under the complex stress environment.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION SECOND ENG BUREAU CIVIL ENG GROUP CO LTD;UNIV GUANGXI

title_en: Reinforcing optimization method, device and equipment for side slope and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a reinforcing and optimizing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for a side slope, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, the method comprises the steps of analyzing various parameters of the side slope, simulating the placing links of prestressed anchor cables in dynamic simulation software, and iterating the placing density of the prestressed anchor cables through global optimization, the method has the advantages that as many slopes as possible are reinforced by the minimum prestress anchor cables, whether the iteration result of global optimization meets the requirement is reflected by verifying the safety coefficient of the slopes, the slope reinforcement effect is ensured to reach the standard, the reinforcement materials are accurate, and the problem that the reinforcement effect is not ideal due to redundancy or deficiency of the reinforcement materials caused by manual design is avoided.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Avalanche disaster risk method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides an avalanche disaster risk method, an avalanche disaster risk system, avalanche disaster risk equipment and avalanche disaster risk media, and relates to the technical field of avalanche disaster coping and prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining avalanche occurrence data and disaster pregnancy background data of a target area, determining avalanche pregnancy factors according to the disaster pregnancy background data, taking avalanche points as positive samples based on the avalanche occurrence data of the target area, collecting non-avalanche points as negative samples, constructing training data, constructing a random forest model, training the random forest model by using the training data to obtain an avalanche dynamic assessment model, and assessing the avalanche disaster risk of the target area based on the avalanche dynamic assessment model. The application solves the problem of how to focus the change of meteorological factors in the high occurrence period of snow avalanche to obtain a dynamic avalanche risk assessment model, and provides factors which are important to monitor for avalanche early warning of different months of snow seasons.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Mine safety training detection method and system based on mixed reality
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of mine safety mixed reality interactive training, and particularly provides a mine safety training detection method and system based on mixed reality, wherein the method mainly comprises the steps of acquiring a mine basic data set and generating reinforced safety constraint boundary data according to the mine basic data set; generating environment risk features according to the reinforced safety constraint boundary data, generating safety behavior features according to the reinforced safety constraint boundary data and the environment risk features, generating risk evolution features according to the environment risk features and the safety behavior features, generating emergency response features according to the safety behavior features and the risk evolution features, and generating dynamic risk visualization pictures according to the risk evolution features and the emergency response features. The application realizes the visualization of training scene dynamics, operation behavior compliance detection automation and risk evolution process, and improves the safety training effectiveness and emergency processing capability.

title_en: Servo continuous variable stiffness loading experiment system for dynamic disasters of deep coal rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disaster servo continuous variable stiffness loading experimental system for deep coal and rock mass, and relates to the technical field of deep engineering dynamic disaster simulation; the invention provides the technical scheme that the servo continuous variable stiffness loading experiment system comprises an electrohydraulic servo rock mechanical experiment system, an electromagnetic variable stiffness loader, a monitoring system and an electronic control system, wherein the rock mechanical experiment system applies external load in a servo control loading mode, the electromagnetic variable stiffness loader comprises a loading rod and a bearing table, the monitoring system is used for monitoring the whole inoculation process of the dynamic disaster of the coal rock mass in real time, the electronic control system can realize continuous and automatic change of the stiffness of the coal rock mass loading system, and the servo continuous variable stiffness loading experiment system can quantitatively calculate the energy input by the loading system to the coal rock mass and adapt to the automatic and continuous variable stiffness loading of the deep engineering coal rock mass stress environment.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Pipeline flow flash characteristic research device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a device and a method for researching flow flash characteristics of a pipeline, and relates to the technical field of hydrodynamics, wherein the device comprises an air supply device, a flash evaporation device and a flash evaporation device, wherein the air supply device is connected with an experimental pipeline system and is used for filling high-pressure liquefied gas into the experimental pipeline; the pressure relief device comprises an experiment pipeline system, a data acquisition device and a pressure relief device, wherein the experiment pipeline system is used for heating an experiment pipeline and performing pressure relief when the current pressure is equal to the pressure required by an experiment, the data acquisition device is connected with the experiment pipeline system and used for observing the temperature of the experiment pipeline to reach the experiment temperature and observing whether the current pressure reaches the pressure required by the experiment, after the pressure relief is performed, the pressure data are observed, and after the pressure data are not reduced any more, the data are stopped from being recorded, so that the pressure relief experiment is completed. The application simulates the flow flash phenomenon caused by pressure release of the high-pressure liquefied pipeline, is beneficial to understanding the disaster-causing process of leakage of the high-pressure liquefied pipeline, and improves the safe operation level of the pipeline.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;GUANGHUI ENERGY COMPREHENSIVE LOGISTICS DEV CO LTD;ORIENTAL TECH INC

title_en: Expansive soil landslide displacement prediction method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting landslide displacement of expansive soil, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prediction, and the method comprises the following steps of acquiring real-time sequence data of a plurality of landslide influence factors of a region to be predicted; the method comprises the steps of taking a neural network model fransformer as a basic model, using a time sequence convolution network TCN to replace an embedded layer of the fransformer to obtain a mixed prediction model TCN-fransformer, designing a physical loss function based on an expansion constitutive equation, training the TCN-fransformer, inputting real-time sequence data into the trained TCN-fransformer, splicing the characteristics at corresponding moments by using the TCN, mixing the characteristics through a full connection layer, and linearly projecting the mixed characteristics to obtain landslide displacement. The method and the device can improve landslide displacement prediction precision.

title_en: Vehicle driving auxiliary system and method based on AR (augmented reality) glasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle driving auxiliary system and a vehicle driving auxiliary method based on AR glasses, wherein the vehicle driving auxiliary system comprises an environment sensing module, a driver state monitoring module, a danger early warning and avoiding module, an automatic driving and auxiliary driving module, a driving simulation and training module, an abnormal behavior identification module, a road information and navigation module and a health and emergency response module, wherein the environment sensing module is used for solving the problem of poor sight under extreme weather and road sensing under complex environments.
assignees: ZHUHAI HENGQIN YUANZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bridge collapse major disaster timely alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a timely warning system for occurrence of a major disaster in bridge collapse, which mainly comprises a plurality of displacement pressure control switches arranged at two ends of a bridge box, an information wireless transmission module connected with the displacement pressure control switches, a wireless information collection control module, a reminding warning lamp and a voice warning horn arranged at two ends of the bridge, and a management center. The management center develops management system software, can judge accident occurrence position nodes according to program software and received signal data, and simulate and generate damage profile graphs and tables. The management center can also jointly communicate with mobile phones located in the accident occurrence area through mobile communication and satellite communication, the vehicle navigation system client pushes emergency stop information, meanwhile, an unmanned aerial vehicle workstation arranged nearby the scene can be operated through the management center, image data of the scene can be collected at the first time, so that disaster loss can be judged quickly, and follow-up management and control measures and schemes can be formulated.

title_en: Cotton waterlogging risk evaluation method based on machine learning model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a machine learning model-based cotton waterlogging risk evaluation method which comprises the steps of 1) collecting data and preprocessing, 2) taking cotton yield in cotton flooding stress test data as output data, optimizing a BP neural network model through a genetic algorithm to simulate cotton yield under flooding stress, 3) optimizing the BP neural network model through a rated genetic algorithm to simulate cotton yield in a research area, 4) calculating standardized rainfall and transpiration index SPEI, soil moisture abnormality index SMAI, rainfall suitability, air temperature suitability and sunlight hours suitability through the collected data, 5) calculating hazard degree, vulnerability, exposure degree and disaster prevention and reduction capability of waterlogging, and 6) calculating comprehensive risk of waterlogging in the experimental area by integrating the hazard degree, vulnerability of a disaster bearing body, exposure degree and disaster prevention and reduction capability of a research area and evaluating. The invention solves the problems of difficult model space scale popularization, large analog data quantity and insufficient analog precision.

title_en: Joint rock body heat-power response excitation test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal-dynamic response excitation test device and a test method for an jointed rock, which belong to the field of underground engineering surrounding rock disaster prevention and control, wherein the device comprises a rectangular frame, the top of the rectangular frame is connected with a vibration exciter fixing frame, the bottom of the vibration exciter fixing frame is connected with a vibration exciter, the vibration exciter fixing frame is connected with a shaft pressure loading structure, and a vibration exciting head of the vibration exciter penetrates through the shaft pressure loading structure and is connected with an upper joint block. The left side of the rectangular frame is connected with a sliding force loading structure, and the sliding force loading structure is connected with a sample joint block through a steel wire rope. The bottom of rectangular frame is provided with the lift, and lower joint block is placed at the top of lift. The invention can realize the loading of periodic vibration waves, effectively simulate the compression waves and the tension waves of actual blasting and earthquake, effectively simulate the influence of dynamic action on the jointed rock mass in a high-temperature environment, and solve the defects that the traditional device can not realize the tension impact and can not perform the thermal-dynamic response test of the jointed block.

title_en: Training simulation system and method for mine belt fire disaster treatment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine belt fire disaster disposal practical training simulation system which comprises a simulation roadway, belt operation simulation, fire disaster initiation and control, environment simulation, monitoring and data acquisition unit. The invention also provides a training simulation method for mine belt fire disaster disposal, which can comprehensively and truly simulate the occurrence and development processes of mine belt fire disasters, including various causes for causing the mine belt fire disasters, the spreading condition of the mine belt fire disasters under different environmental conditions, fire extinguishing operation and the like. The invention can provide accurate data support for the research of mine belt fire, is helpful for in-depth research of mine belt fire mechanism, and provides basis for formulating more scientific fire prevention and control strategies. The invention can improve the understanding and coping ability of rescue workers to mine belt fire, so that the rescue workers can more skillfully and effectively perform fire extinguishing and rescue operations in actual rescue work.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Fire engineering facility-based detection device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment detection, in particular to a fire-fighting equipment detection device and a fire-fighting equipment detection method, wherein the fire-fighting equipment detection device comprises a support rod, the top of the support rod is fixedly connected with a smoke cover, and a smoke generator is arranged in the support rod; the second gear is driven by the motor to roll along the arc toothed bar to drive the smoke spraying head to move in the arc groove, the first guide groove and the second guide groove, so that multi-angle arc track smoke spraying is realized, the real scene that smoke diffuses from different directions in a fire disaster is simulated, meanwhile, pressure can be applied to the bottom or the top of the toothed plate by the limiting rod in the moving process of the second gear, the fan blade rotates to generate simulated wind force through the transmission of the toothed plate and the first gear, the interference of air flow in a fire scene on the smoke is reduced, and in addition, the linkage structure formed by the extrusion block and the stop lever can automatically adjust the smoke spraying amount according to the size of the wind force, and the dynamic process that the smoke concentration changes along with the air flow in the fire disaster is repeated.

title_en: Emergency command system and method based on BIM digital base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency command and discloses an emergency command system and method based on a BIM digital base, wherein a unified data model is established through an expansion IFC standard, BIM building information, GIS geographic space data, monitoring data and an emergency plan document are subjected to semantic mapping and entity alignment, an emergency knowledge graph taking the BIM building information as a node is generated, physical simulation and LSTM prediction algorithm are coupled, the monitoring data are injected into the BIM model to deduce a disaster process, a risk thermodynamic diagram and an evacuation forbidden zone are output, space-time accessibility of emergency resources is calculated through a reinforcement learning model according to the deduction result, an optimization scheme comprising unmanned plane paths, personnel evacuation routes and equipment scheduling instructions is generated, the instructions are synchronized to an augmented reality individual soldier terminal and a mobile command shelter through edge calculation nodes, resource deployment states are marked in the BIM model in real time, multi-terminal operation is synchronized, timeliness and accuracy of disaster situation perception are remarkably improved, and disaster loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: Feature selection and data balance-based graphical network intrusion detection method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of industrial network security, and particularly discloses a graphical network intrusion detection method based on feature selection and data balance, which comprises the steps of firstly acquiring an intrusion detection data set containing non-numerical data and numerical data, performing independent heat coding on the non-numerical data, performing maximum and minimum normalization on the numerical data, and dividing a training set and a testing set; then adopting a mixed feature selection strategy of ReliefF filtering method and Borata packaging method to select features of the training set, utilizing an SMOTE-ENN mixed sampling method to resample the training set, converting the resampled training set and the original testing set into gray images, training by using a EFFICIENTNET image classifier to obtain a trained model, and finally carrying out classified prediction on the gray images of the testing set by using the model. The application effectively solves the problems of data redundancy, dimension disaster and class unbalance in IIoT environment, and remarkably improves the accuracy and stability of the intrusion detection system.

title_en: Post-earthquake activity landslide intelligent identification method based on earth surface disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent identification method for a post-earthquake movable landslide based on earth surface disturbance, and relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control engineering. The method comprises the steps of obtaining regional remote sensing image data before and after an earthquake and preprocessing the regional remote sensing image data, calculating regional current ground object spectrum indexes and earth surface disturbance indexes based on the preprocessed regional remote sensing image data, obtaining regional current terrain indexes by utilizing terrain elevation data, constructing a post-earthquake movable landslide intelligent recognition model based on a convolutional neural network, training and testing the post-earthquake movable landslide intelligent recognition model, and obtaining post-earthquake movable landslide intelligent recognition results according to the regional current ground object spectrum indexes, the earth surface disturbance indexes, the terrain indexes and the tested post-earthquake movable landslide intelligent recognition model. The intelligent identification method for the post-earthquake movable landslide has the characteristics of high accuracy, strong space-time expansibility, low time consumption, low cost and high operability, and provides an effective method for establishing a long-term landslide movable database in an earthquake region.

title_en: Coal mining subsidence InSAR phase filtering method and model based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based coal mining subsidence InSAR phase filtering method and model, and belongs to the field of phase filtering. The method comprises the steps of constructing an MCR-PFNet model, carrying out phase filtering aiming at the noise problem in coal mining subsidence InSAR data, introducing a multi-head self-attention module and a CBAM attention module into a coding and decoding path through the MCR-PFNet model, enhancing the capturing capacity of space and deformation characteristics, optimizing the convolution structure of a network through a residual block, and ensuring the high precision and robustness of a filtering result. Through verification of multiple groups of simulation and actual data, the method is superior to the traditional method in phase filtering precision and noise elimination effect, and can effectively recover the earth surface deformation information. The method has simple steps and high efficiency, is suitable for processing InSAR data in the coal mining subsidence area, and meets the requirements of the fields of earth surface deformation monitoring, disaster prevention, resource management and the like.

title_en: Earthquake geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic geological disaster monitoring and early warning device which comprises an intelligent sensing system, an analysis system and an execution and feedback system, wherein the intelligent sensing system is used for collecting geological parameters, facility states and environmental factors in real time through a multi-mode sensor array, the distributed optical fiber sensing and capturing pipeline strain, an MEMS accelerometer is used for monitoring vibration, an InSAR satellite is used for providing deformation data, the analysis system is used for constructing a complex network modeling engine, a directed weighting network model is used for fusing a historical transition probability matrix and real-time deformation rate parameters, the two-channel causal reasoning engine is combined, the two-channel causal reasoning engine comprises a physical causal channel and a data causal channel, the physical causal channel is embedded into a coulomb rupture criterion to calculate fault stress accumulation rate and Darcy law to simulate pore pressure propagation, the data channel is used for generating a counterfactual causal link through CausalGAN and combining a time causal convolution network to trigger hierarchical early warning based on analysis results of the analysis system.

title_en: Flood forecasting method, equipment and medium based on multi-model collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood forecasting method, equipment and medium based on multi-model cooperation, belongs to the technical field of flood forecasting and flood disaster simulation, and is used for solving the technical problems that in a traditional flood forecasting method, a flood forecasting model is insufficient in coupling, weak in visualization capability, lack of real-time interaction and non-visual information transfer. The method comprises the steps of collecting water conservancy information data of a target river basin, carrying out collaborative architecture interaction under relevant multiple models on water conservancy factors in the target river basin according to the river basin characteristics of the water conservancy information data, constructing a water-yielding professional collaborative model, carrying out three-dimensional modeling simulation calculation on the result data output by the water-yielding process and the flood-inundation range through a preset UE5 engine to obtain a three-dimensional simulation scene, carrying out multidimensional information broadcasting on real-time water conservancy data based on the three-dimensional simulation scene, determining multidimensional simulation forecast data, and carrying out verification analysis on key indexes of the multidimensional simulation forecast data to obtain flood control decision information.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Monte Carlo simulation method-based substation flood season safe operation risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for evaluating the safe operation risk of a transformer substation in the flood period based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, which belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids and comprises the steps of classifying and dividing the flood period influence factors of the transformer substation; the method comprises the steps of constructing a judgment matrix and weights according to expert scoring of key influence factors, carrying out consistency check on the judgment matrix, adjusting element values of the judgment matrix if the consistency check of the matrix does not meet preset conditions, reassigning the weights until the preset conditions are met, constructing a dynamic risk calculation model based on Monte Carlo simulation, obtaining simulation results, analyzing, judging stability of fitting degree, obtaining main risk factors and taking precautionary measures corresponding to emergency management. The method has the advantages that various factors around the transformer substation are considered into influence factors through accident tree analysis, system integration of multi-dimensional environmental factors is achieved, objectivity and comprehensiveness of transformer substation risk assessment are remarkably improved, and analysis capability of complex environmental coupling effect is enhanced.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Machine learning-based river basin flood disaster early prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of flood disaster prediction, and particularly discloses a machine learning-based river basin flood disaster early prediction method. According to the scheme, a dynamic smoothing coefficient self-adaptive adjustment mechanism is introduced into a Holt-windows three-parameter model, a smoothing coefficient is automatically adjusted according to real-time change of data, a precipitation prediction model is built by combining a two-way long-short-term memory network, change characteristics of recent data are timely captured, the accuracy of precipitation prediction is further improved, a multi-objective optimized drosophila optimization algorithm is introduced into a decision tree model, a composite objective function is designed, the accuracy of the decision tree, the complexity of the model and the training time are comprehensively considered, pareto optimization is introduced, the optimization result is prevented from being trapped into a local optimal solution, and the adaptability and the generalization capability of the model are further improved.
assignees: GEOVIS YISHUI SICHUAN TECH CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION INST OF WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE

title_en: Immersive rail transit simulation training system and method based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses an immersive rail transit simulation training system and a training method based on virtual reality, which relate to the technical field of rail transit simulation training and comprise the following steps: in the rail transit simulation training environment, continuously monitoring a virtual driving visual angle of a student in which the student is currently positioned, and acquiring visual parameter information of a scene in front of the student in real time. The invention solves the hysteresis problem of LOD adjustment in a high-speed dynamic scene, and improves the emergency response capability and training sense of reality of students. Through real-time monitoring of the view angle of a student, data preprocessing and index management, a high-efficiency data set is constructed, and key indexes are extracted to quantify scene changes in front. By combining machine learning prediction, high-speed approaching obstacles are intelligently identified, progressive LOD adjustment is adopted, low-precision LOD+motion blur is combined in an initial stage to reduce calculation load, LOD is gradually improved, visual continuity and calculation performance optimization are ensured, and reality, stability and training effectiveness of a simulation system are improved.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHIXIN RAIL TRANSIT OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge disaster assessment method and device for estuary area
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a storm surge disaster assessment method and device for a river mouth region, wherein the assessment method comprises the steps of obtaining basic geographic data, meteorological data, tide and wave data and disaster bearing body data of a preset region of the river mouth region, constructing discrete grids according to the basic geographic data, constructing a numerical simulation model of storm surge and wave in the discrete grids according to the tide and wave data, simulating different typhoon scenes in the numerical simulation model of the storm surge and wave according to the meteorological data to obtain simulation results, assessing and obtaining dangerous grades of each region according to the simulation results, assessing and obtaining fragile grades of each region according to the disaster bearing body data, and determining comprehensive risk grades of each region according to the dangerous grades and the fragile grades. The embodiment of the invention can simulate the evolution process of storm surge disasters more accurately, and further determine the comprehensive risk level of each region in the estuary area.

title_en: Nuclear power station operation optimization method, system, equipment medium and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment media and a product for optimizing the operation of a nuclear power plant, and relates to the field of nuclear power, wherein the optimizing method comprises the steps of acquiring actual safety analysis data of the nuclear power plant and simulation safety analysis data of a nuclear power simulation model under the same operation data, wherein the nuclear power simulation model is obtained by carrying out full-working-condition simulation on the nuclear power plant; and generating a corresponding optimization strategy by combining the actual safety analysis data, the simulated safety analysis data and the state data, wherein the optimization strategy is used for optimizing the operation process of the nuclear power station. The optimization strategy of the operation of the nuclear power station can be generated through the actual safety analysis data and the simulation analysis data, the accurate working condition simulation and optimization decision can be carried out in the whole life cycle of the nuclear power station, and the emergency response capability of staff is improved.
assignees: STATE NUCLEAR POWER AUTOMATION SYSTEM ENG COMPANY LTD

title_en: Vegetation environment coupling prediction method and system based on multisource remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vegetation environment coupling prediction method and system based on multisource remote sensing data fusion, and relates to the field of vegetation environment monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining vegetation canopy structure data, vegetation environment temperature detection data and vegetation component characteristic data through calculation of a data fusion algorithm, constructing a vegetation transpiration intensity outlier detection model by introducing the vegetation canopy structure parameters, identifying a local drought or water accumulation area based on the vegetation transpiration intensity outlier detection model, detecting trunk pest eating vibration signals and trunk pest scanning data based on the local drought or water accumulation area, and simulating a pest spreading path according to the trunk pest eating vibration signals and the trunk pest scanning data. The invention realizes the analysis of the vegetation specific ecological structure and the deep research and application of the instant response mechanism aiming at disasters.
assignees: YIWEI JIKONG BEIJING GARDEN TECH CO LTD;BEIJING INST OF LANDSCAPE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title_en: Rectangular tunnel fire experiment simulation device with variable section height and width
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rectangular tunnel fire experiment simulation device with a variable section height and width, which comprises a tunnel model main body, a longitudinal ventilation system and a measurement system, wherein the tunnel model main body is formed by connecting a plurality of tunnel units in a detachable mode, and the tunnel units comprise an outer frame and a tunnel model arranged in the outer frame, so that the dynamic change of the section of the tunnel model can be realized, and the fire experiment simulation device is suitable for fire experiment requirements under different tunnel scenes. Meanwhile, the variable-frequency axial flow fan and the rectifying gauze are combined, so that uniform distribution of wind speed in the tunnel model is ensured, and powerful support is provided for simulating ventilation conditions in a real fire environment. In addition, the device integrates various monitoring means such as temperature, wind speed and image acquisition, can comprehensively and accurately record various key parameters in the fire disaster process, and provides a high-simulation test platform and high-fidelity data support for tunnel fire disaster dynamics research.

title_en: Method for constructing development working face to liberate shallow portion safety coal pillar resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for freeing shallow security coal pillar resources by constructing a development working face, which comprises the following steps of 1, analyzing exploitation conditions, determining a roof water control thought, determining a grouting reconstruction water control thought, 2, determining a grouting reconstruction object and a grouting reconstruction range, wherein the grouting reconstruction object is a loose layer bottom water-containing sand layer, an air oxidation zone and a key fault top, 3, determining drilling and grouting construction parameters, 4, engineering construction, dynamically optimizing a scheme, drawing a grouting P-Q-T dynamic curve, adjusting scheme design, and 5, checking and evaluating engineering effects. According to the invention, by carrying out comprehensive grouting reconstruction on the loose bed bottom containing, wind oxidation zone and fault structure, a roof water-bearing layer in the mining influence range is transformed into a relative water-resisting layer, meanwhile, a fault water-bursting sand channel is plugged, the stability of roof surrounding rock is improved, three formation conditions of a water sand source, water pressure and a bursting sand channel are destroyed, and double disaster prevention and control of the source and the channel are realized.

title_en: Disaster text classification method based on improved black wing iris algorithm and xgboost
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing, and particularly relates to a disaster push classification method based on an improved iris nigricans algorithm and xgboost. The method comprises the following steps of firstly carrying out systematic pretreatment on the obtained text data, including steps of cleaning, word segmentation, feature extraction and the like, then optimizing feature selection through an improved iris nigromaculata algorithm, training and testing a xgboost model by using an optimized feature subset while reducing the dimension, and finally comprehensively evaluating the performance of the model through accuracy, classification report, ROC curve and AUC value. The method adopts the black wing iris algorithm combining the chaotic initialization and the Levy flight strategy, reduces the data dimension, enhances the global searching capability of the algorithm, accelerates the convergence speed and optimizes the characteristic selection process.

title_en: Disaster recovery and cloud loading method and device for local message middleware
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of IT and software development and discloses a method and a device for cloud loading of a local message middleware disaster recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining local metadata sent by a disaster recovery agent; the method comprises the steps of obtaining local metadata through a disaster recovery agent from a local message middleware, carrying out format conversion on the local metadata, packaging the local metadata after format conversion into recovery snapshot data, storing the recovery snapshot data into a backup warehouse, carrying out disaster recovery exercise by utilizing the recovery snapshot data in the backup warehouse, retaining a disaster recovery instance on the cloud based on a disaster recovery exercise result, and switching the local metadata in the local message middleware to the disaster recovery instance on the cloud when the local message middleware has faults. The cloud migration and cloud loading method reduces the manual operation complexity of migration and cloud loading, and provides a unified disaster recovery and cloud loading scheme.

title_en: Visual system and method for simulating earthquake disasters of urban building group
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of urban earthquake disaster simulation, and provides a visual system and a visual method for urban building group earthquake disaster simulation, wherein the system comprises an offline data preprocessing and blocking organizing module and a blocking dynamic data management and scheduling module; the system comprises a GPU acceleration rendering module, a GPU parallel displacement animation module, a high-efficiency interaction module and a high-efficiency interaction module, wherein the GPU acceleration rendering module is used for endowing unique identifiers for vertexes through global floor index mapping, finally submitting a merging model to the GPU, realizing real-time rendering of building forms in cooperation with displacement textures and a custom shader, the GPU parallel displacement animation module is deeply coupled to a GPU rendering pipeline and used for resolving vertex displacement and color values in real time and injecting the vertex displacement and color values into the rendering pipeline, and the high-efficiency interaction module is used for dynamically updating label content and coordinates to realize three-dimensional interaction. According to the application, massive time sequence displacement data are encoded into textures, and parallel computation is performed by using the GPU vertex shader, so that real-time and smooth animation simulation of all building earthquake responses is realized, and the performance bottleneck of the traditional CPU computing mode is solved.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI;SHANGHAI RES INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCES CO LTD

title_en: Landslide hazard risk assessment method, landslide hazard risk assessment equipment, landslide hazard risk assessment medium and landslide hazard risk assessment product
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide hazard risk assessment method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of geological hazard risk assessment.
