The method comprises the steps of constructing a disaster pregnancy factor system participating in landslide disaster risk assessment, uniformly sampling a research area according to preset sampling intervals to obtain a uniform point set, respectively collecting information amounts of disaster points and uniform points in the research area to form a positive sample set and a negative sample set, constructing a landslide disaster risk assessment model based on an artificial neural network, training the model by adopting the positive sample set and the negative sample set, outputting landslide disaster occurrence probability of each sample, further calculating prediction precision and prediction density of the model, calculating a weighted cross entropy loss function based on the prediction density, and carrying out error counter-propagation until the training is completed, and carrying out landslide disaster risk assessment on an area to be assessed by utilizing the trained landslide disaster risk assessment model, so that objectivity, rationality and accuracy of the landslide disaster risk assessment can be remarkably improved.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF LAND AND SPACE ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION AND GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION;UNIV CHENGDU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Characteristic distillation tree line fault identification method based on RT-DETR algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characteristic distillation tree line fault identification method based on an RT-DETR algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of electric disaster prevention and comprises the steps of constructing a tree line fault image data set, dividing the tree line fault image data set into countermeasure image data and labeling image data, training the countermeasure image data to obtain super-resolution image data, mixing the super-resolution image data and the labeling image data, dividing the super-resolution image data into a training set, a verification set and a test set, respectively training, verifying and testing a teacher model and a student model to obtain optimal performance weights, obtaining a student model after characteristic distillation by utilizing the optimal performance weights, obtaining a student model after pruning by utilizing the student model after distillation, carrying out distillation fine tuning to obtain a tree line fault identification model, and deploying the tree line fault identification model to an edge end system. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can reduce the manual detection cost, improve the real-time performance of fault detection, reduce the dependence on a cloud server, and are more suitable for tree line fault identification scenes.

title_en: Coastal karst structure disaster-causing and treatment stability simulation test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of karst geological disaster prevention and control, and provides a coastal karst structure disaster-causing and treatment stability simulation test device and a test method, wherein the device comprises a tidal water tank, a rock-soil simulation box body, a karst structure module and a grouting module, wherein the rock-soil simulation box body is arranged at one side of the tidal water tank, and a seepage hole is arranged between the rock-soil simulation box body and the tidal water tank; the system comprises a tidal water tank, a rock-soil simulation box body, a rock-soil construction module, a grouting module and a control module, wherein one end of the karst construction module is used for being connected with the tidal water tank, the other end of the karst construction module is used for being connected with the rock-soil simulation box body or the grouting module, the tidal water tank is used for injecting seawater and can adjust water level, water pressure and water temperature, the rock-soil simulation box body is used for laying a rock-soil body, the karst construction module comprises different types of construction combinations, the combination of a multi-aperture pipeline and multi-aperture cracks and the simulation of cracks with different dip angles can be realized, and the grouting module is used for pumping different grouting materials to the rock-soil simulation box body or the karst construction module. Has the advantages of multiple functions, simple operation and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;CHINA RESOURCES CEMENT HEPU CO LTD;SHANDONG BAINIAN HUITONG ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Waterlogging prediction method, equipment and medium based on two-dimensional hydraulic model
abstract_en: The application discloses a waterlogging prediction method, equipment and medium based on a two-dimensional hydraulic model, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of data sources, integrating the plurality of data sources, and preprocessing the integrated data sources to obtain a geographic information base; determining a preset two-dimensional hydraulics model, inputting a geographic information base into the two-dimensional hydraulics model to be deduced through the two-dimensional hydraulics model, so as to obtain a waterlogging simulation result, simulating according to the waterlogging simulation result to obtain a waterlogging simulation result, and determining a waterlogging risk map according to the waterlogging simulation result. The method improves waterlogging decision making capability and is beneficial to identifying potential risk areas in advance. The dynamic and fine simulation of the waterlogging process is realized, and real-time and visual information support is provided for flood control decisions. Based on the risk assessment result, a waterlogging prevention and disaster reduction strategy with high pertinence and high operability is provided, and disaster response efficiency and resource optimal configuration are improved.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: National defense mobilization user device connected with emergency mechanism
abstract_en: The application discloses a national defense mobilization user device connected with an emergency mechanism, which relates to the field of emergency rescue management and comprises a laser module, a positioning module, a vibration module, a shooting module, an image processing module, a storage module, a display module and a microprocessor, wherein the laser module is used for measuring distance, emitting visible laser and being used as a shooting prop, the positioning module is used for positioning the current position of a user, the vibration module is used for detecting vibration signals emitted by trapped personnel in a rescue scene and emitting high-frequency vibration signals, the shooting module is used for shooting a real scene and identifying a bar code or a two-dimensional code, the image processing module is used for generating a simulated training scene in national defense mobilization and a mixed virtual reality scene according to the real scene, the communication module is used for communicating with a rescue command center or a user family, the storage module is used for storing rescue operation flow, map data, trapped personnel and material information, the input instruction and viewing related information are input by the display module, and the microprocessor is used for coordinating the work of the modules. When suffering from emergencies and disasters, related personnel can timely take self-rescue and mutual-rescue measures to reduce losses by using the system and the method.

title_en: Intelligent slope disaster early warning method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of side slope disaster early warning, in particular to a side slope disaster intelligent early warning method based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring historical side slope data of a database, constructing a long-short-period memory artificial neural network LSTM, and training a model; S2, based on the sampling frequency alpha, multi-source data related to slope stability are collected at fixed time, the collected multi-source data are preprocessed, and the preprocessed data are constructed into a characteristic vector format required by a model. According to the intelligent slope disaster early warning method based on machine learning, the long-term memory neural network is adopted to carry out modeling training on the historical slope monitoring data, so that time sequence characteristics and long-term dependence in the slope deformation evolution process can be effectively captured, the prediction accuracy of disaster occurrence probability of landslide, collapse, debris flow and the like is improved, and the purposes of automatic and intelligent disaster early warning are achieved.
assignees: GEZHOUBA ECOLOGICAL CONSTRUCTION HUBEI CO LTD

title_en: Airport core risk overall process management method based on double preventive working mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an airport core risk overall process management method based on a dual preventive working mechanism, which comprises the main steps of collecting multi-source data related to airport operation in real time through various sensors and systems, replacing a multi-head attention mechanism in a traditional Transformer model by utilizing a plurality of expert big models, generating countermeasure data, generating diversified virtual risk scenes and countermeasure samples by utilizing a plurality of expert big models, constructing a high-fidelity virtual simulation environment based on big model automation, evaluating and deciding risks, carrying out accurate risk evaluation and decision support by utilizing a self-adaptive risk scoring system and an intelligent decision support mechanism, realizing comprehensive, accurate and intelligent management of airport core risks, and remarkably improving the safety and emergency response capability of airport operation.

title_en: Coal mine disaster early warning method and system based on geological model and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine geological safety monitoring and disaster early warning, in particular to a coal mine disaster early warning method, a system and a storage medium based on a geological model. And then, dispersing a mechanical field and a fluid field by utilizing a fractal partial differential equation operator, and globally solving a large-scale nonlinear equation by a quantum annealing or quantum and classical combined annealing mode to form a quantum fractal coupling simulation result. And finally integrating the grid units and the monitoring data in the fuzzy hypergraph structure, performing fuzzy membership analysis on the multi-disaster element coupling signs, and outputting early warning information once judging that the risk reaches a threshold value. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring the geological disasters of the coal mine.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method and system for water disaster of top plate of steeply inclined working face
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent monitoring method and system for a water disaster of a top plate of a steeply inclined working face, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting underground real-time monitoring data based on preset sampling frequency, wherein the real-time monitoring data comprise microseismic sensing data, water level data, water pressure data and humidity data, inputting the real-time monitoring data into an early warning model to obtain a prediction result, the prediction result comprises a disaster type, an occurrence area and time, the early warning model is obtained by training and adjusting a long-period memory network model through historical monitoring data, and when the prediction result exceeds a preset early warning threshold, early warning is triggered. The invention aims to realize the whole process management from real-time monitoring to data analysis and early warning, and provides technical support for safe, efficient and green exploitation of the water-rich and steeply inclined working face of the top plate.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;TAIPING COAL MINE OF SICHUAN CHUANMEI HUARONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Plug-in type pre-pumping drilling gas extraction pipe
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of gas disaster prevention and control and discloses a plug-in type pre-pumping drilling gas extraction pipe, which comprises a pipe body, wherein a socket is arranged at one end of the pipe body, a plurality of locking holes are annularly arranged on the outer wall of the socket, a socket which is plugged with the socket is arranged at the other end of the pipe body, a plurality of extending arms are annularly arranged at the end part of the pipe body, a convex block matched with the locking holes is arranged on each extending arm, an annular groove is further formed in the outer wall, close to one end of the socket, of the pipe body, and a sealing ring for sealing the socket and the socket is arranged in the annular groove. The socket joint adopts a socket joint mode, the lugs on the plurality of extending arms are used for locking with the plurality of locking holes on the socket, and the sealing ring is used for sealing the socket and the socket, so that the reliable socket joint of two pipelines is realized, and compared with threaded joint, the socket joint is simple to operate and saves time and labor.
assignees: HUNAN GAS TREAT AND UTILIZATION ENGINEERING RESEARCH CENTER CO LTD;HUNAN COAL IND NIUMASI MINING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent prediction method and system for multi-source data internet-of-things monitoring flood disasters
abstract_en: The intelligent prediction method for the multi-source data internet-of-things monitoring flood disasters comprises the steps of obtaining flood disaster indexes of a region through satellite remote sensing, obtaining a flood disaster remote sensing dynamic evaluation grade Y of the region by combining flood disaster weights of the remote sensing flood disaster indexes, carrying out well position monitoring point deployment of ground pulse laser sensors in the region where important flood is easy to occur based on the Y of the region to obtain a ground multi-point well position pulse laser water level monitoring result B, carrying out real-time visual internet-of-things on the multi-source data on the Y and the B through a GIS technology, a cloud computing technology and an internet-of-things technology, normalizing the Y and the B, and inputting a multi-source index flood disaster prediction multi-mode large language model to carry out training and analysis to obtain a prediction result. The method comprehensively utilizes the laser pulse monitoring technology, the GIS technology, the cloud computing technology, the Internet of things technology and the multi-source index flood disaster prediction multi-mode large language model, has high precision and high interpretability, and is more efficient and accurate in flood early warning.
assignees: JIANGHUAI FRONTIER TECH COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION CENTER

title_en: Farmland monitoring method based on environment prediction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of informationized agriculture, in particular to a farmland monitoring method based on an environment prediction model, which comprises the following steps of collecting farmland environment data and crop planting data; the method comprises the steps of environment prediction, monitoring and early warning, disaster prevention and early warning, wherein the environment prediction comprises the steps of obtaining historical data of environment data and crop planting data, constructing an environment prediction model, predicting a change trend in a future set time of farmland environment, the monitoring and early warning step comprises the steps of generating an early warning prompt when the early warning condition is met according to the change trend, and the disaster prevention and early warning step comprises the steps of accurately demarcating and simulating images and texts of a farmland disaster influence area according to early warning prompt content, the environmental data acquired in real time and the crop planting number when the early warning prompt is received, so as to generate a visual disaster prevention early warning diagram. According to the invention, by monitoring the farmland in real time, the condition of the farmland is analyzed and mastered more accurately, timely and visually, so that corresponding management measures are taken timely, and the production efficiency and yield of the farmland are improved.
assignees: CHONGQING COMMUNICATION IND SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network mountain fire disaster monitoring method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of mountain fire disaster monitoring, and provides a machine learning-based power distribution network mountain fire disaster monitoring method which comprises the steps of acquiring satellite remote sensing data, meteorological monitoring data, power distribution network operation parameters, geographic information data and human activity data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a mountain fire disaster index system comprising a geographic environment index, a climate dynamic index, a grid vulnerability index and an artificial risk index based on preprocessed data, carrying out quantitative processing on index parameters in the index system to obtain feature vectors, inputting a constructed sample training set into a grid transducer-CNN hybrid model for training, outputting a mountain fire disaster monitoring model, inputting data acquired in real time into the mountain fire disaster monitoring model to generate a monitoring result comprising disaster types, longitude and latitude coordinate positioning and disaster intensity classification, dynamically correcting the disaster intensity classification according to a fire spreading rate and a fire passing area, and improving the accuracy of mountain fire disaster monitoring.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level centralized drainage roadway arrangement system for underground mine stope
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-level centralized drainage roadway arrangement system of an underground mine stope, which comprises drainage holes, drainage wells, a ditch, drainage horizontal roadways and a water sump, wherein the drainage holes are communicated between a rock drilling horizontal roadway and a mineral discharging horizontal roadway and between the mineral discharging horizontal roadway and a transportation horizontal roadway, the upper end of the drainage well is communicated with the transportation horizontal roadway, the lower end of the drainage well is communicated with the drainage horizontal roadway, the ditch is arranged in the rock drilling horizontal roadway, the mineral discharging horizontal roadway and the transportation horizontal roadway so as to lead water to the drainage holes or the drainage wells, the drainage horizontal roadways are distributed in an inclined mode so that the water gushes of the drainage horizontal roadway automatically flow to the lowest level, and a pump station for draining the water gushes to the ground surface is arranged in the water sump arranged at the lowest level of the drainage horizontal roadway. The application simplifies the arrangement of the drainage roadway, simply and reliably conducts multi-level water burst to the existing roadway to be intensively drained to the drainage roadway, reduces the construction period and the cost, improves the production environment of the working face of a stope, and improves the disaster resistance capability of a mine.
assignees: SHOUGANG LUANNAN MACHENG MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Method for dynamically reconstructing power distribution network disaster based on look-ahead-pre-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on a look-ahead-pre-algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of power distribution network reconstruction. The dynamic reconstruction method in power distribution network disaster based on the look-ahead-pre-algorithm comprises inputting initial running state of the power distribution network, and acquiring system state at current moment Generating all feasible action sets at the current moment For each action Executing an evaluation flow, constructing a future disaster scene by using a Monte Carlo method, simulating a system evolution process by combining a basic strategy, and evaluating actions Selecting the action with the minimum expected cost as the optimal action at the current moment to execute and update the system state Updating the time step if the current time step Returning to S2 to continue decision, otherwise, stopping algorithm execution. The reconstruction method optimizes the current decision, considers the influence of the current decision on the future, realizes the efficient and rapid dynamic reconstruction decision in the disaster, and improves the reliability and the toughness of the power distribution network.

title_en: Two-dimensional flood simulation method, equipment and medium for continuous dam break of cascade reservoir
abstract_en: The application discloses a two-dimensional flood simulation method, equipment and medium for continuous dam break of a cascade reservoir, and relates to the technical field of hydrodynamic modeling and flood disaster simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out integral two-dimensional modeling on the cascade reservoir based on data related to the cascade reservoir under the condition that the regulation and accumulation effects of the interval reservoir and the influence of the continuous dam break are not considered, so as to obtain an integral two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and obtain a maximum submerged range; the method comprises the steps of carrying out step-by-step segmentation on the cascade reservoirs according to the number of the reservoirs, carrying out two-dimensional modeling on the reservoirs in each segment to obtain a segmented two-dimensional model, carrying out simulation by adopting an integral two-dimensional hydrodynamic model or a segmented two-dimensional model based on dam break rules of the reservoirs in each step in the step-by-step simulation process to obtain a submerged result of each stage of segmented two-dimensional model, and finally generating a cascade reservoir dam break flood risk map by superposing the maximum submerged range and the submerged result. The application can improve the calculation efficiency and accuracy of continuous dam break simulation analysis of the cascade reservoir.

title_en: Annealing algorithm-based improved genetic algorithm resource scheduling scoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue resource scheduling, in particular to a resource scheduling scoring method of a genetic algorithm based on an annealing algorithm improvement, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a resource information database in advance; S2, obtaining a final resource set meeting the emergency requirement of the current user, S3, constructing an objective function, simultaneously generating a plurality of initial populations of the resource scheduling scheme, carrying out global optimization calculation on the initial populations by combining a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm, and S4, obtaining the optimal resource scheduling scheme based on a global optimization calculation result. According to the invention, through modularized design and genetic algorithm optimization, the high efficiency and applicability of resource scheduling are ensured, and the response speed of emergency rescue and the resource utilization efficiency are obviously improved. The genetic algorithm is combined with the simulated annealing algorithm to quickly generate a resource scheduling scheme, shortens the emergency response time and improves the scheduling efficiency.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst prediction method based on improved WOA optimization FTWSVM
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster prediction, in particular to a rock burst prediction method based on improved WOA optimization FTWSVM. Firstly, selecting rock burst intensity level prediction index data, and reconstructing a disaster sensitive index set by adopting a Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA). Then adding nucleation expansion, introducing a fuzzy weight improvement double twin support vector machine to obtain FTWSVM model, and applying M-Map chaotic mapping and opposite learning improvement whale search algorithm to obtain IWOA optimization model key super-parameters. Finally, training a model, establishing a IWOA-FTWSVM-based prediction model, and verifying the performance of the model through a test set. The rock burst intensity level prediction method combines the parameter self-adaption and the small sample modeling method, improves the rock burst intensity level prediction capability, and provides a solution for effectively and timely preventing rock burst disasters in mine exploitation.

title_en: Shield adaptability adjustment method based on stratum structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a shield adaptability adjustment method based on a stratum structure, which comprises the steps of obtaining geological parameters of a shield machine construction area through drilling and geophysical prospecting, arranging sensors at the positions of shield machine keys to collect construction parameters of the shield machine in real time, adopting a convolutional neural network CNN to analyze the geological parameters to identify stratum characteristics, constructing a geological model based on the identified stratum characteristics, constructing a disaster risk index system, adopting a logic regression and random forest algorithm to predict disaster risks based on the geological model and the construction parameters, dynamically adjusting cutter head configuration of the shield machine, optimizing tunneling parameters or adopting an improved residue soil scheme according to the predicted disaster risks, and adopting a multi-stage early warning mechanism to trigger emergency response measures through monitoring the geological parameters, the construction parameters and environmental changes in real time so as to ensure construction safety. The invention can improve the safety and efficiency of shield construction, reduce the risk of geological disasters and provide reliable technical support for underground space development.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD;CHANGJIANG INSTITUTE OF SURVEY TECH THE MINISTRY OF WATER RESOURCES;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Single landslide risk quantitative evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a single landslide risk quantitative evaluation method and system, which are used for acquiring landslide topography files and physical parameters of a landslide rock-soil body, simulating a motion intensity field in a landslide evolution process through MassFlow software to obtain maximum motion intensity, establishing a multi-level multi-dimensional vulnerability evaluation system, extracting disaster-bearing body index data in a landslide risk area according to the vulnerability evaluation system, quantitatively evaluating vulnerability of the disaster-bearing body according to the disaster-bearing body index data based on an AHP-entropy weight method coupling model to obtain vulnerability values of different disaster-bearing bodies in a landslide motion range, quantitatively calculating the landslide risk according to the maximum motion intensity and the vulnerability values of the disaster-bearing bodies based on spatial relations of the vulnerability and the vulnerability, and obtaining risk partition conditions of the different disaster-bearing bodies under the threat of starting and damage of the landslide. The method effectively improves popularization applicability and calculation efficiency of the risk quantitative evaluation method under the single landslide scale.

title_en: Cross-modal feature alignment driven large model migration optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large model migration optimization system driven by cross-modal characteristic alignment, which particularly relates to the field of simulated countermeasure, and is used for solving the problems of high-dimensional data storage and calculation efficiency of multi-source information processing in a countermeasure environment, wherein after multi-source observation is subjected to entropy gating sparsification, a closed loop is formed by multi-scale time condensation, contextual entropy pruning and combined fluctuation trend dynamic control, so that cross-modal high-dimensional information is balanced between compression storage and time sequence integrity, the weight of a mapping stage is adjusted in a self-adaptive manner according to situations, and residual errors are corrected at any time; the incremental exercise and drift monitoring continuously consolidates long-term memory to avoid forgetting disasters, the reasoning and scheduling of real-time write-back performance indexes drives the structure to self-evolve, so that the aims of inhibiting double loads of video memory and delay caused by dimensional explosion, keeping migration alignment precision, ensuring that strategy sequences keep high consistency and high confidence output in complex situations, reducing calculation force demands linearly and remarkably improving resource utilization rate are achieved.
assignees: NO 15 INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Bidirectional fully-opened semicircular tent and opening method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bidirectional fully-opened semicircular tent and an opening method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of outdoor tents. The tent solves the defects that the traditional tent in the prior art is complex in installation and disassembly, poor in stability and not suitable for application places such as field training, field disaster relief and international rescue. The main structure of the awning comprises awning cloth, a reinforcing rope and two groups of opening and closing mechanisms, wherein two or more structural beams are arranged between the two groups of opening and closing mechanisms, the awning cloth is arranged on the structural beams through strapping, and the reinforcing rope is connected with the structural beams through shackles on the structural beams. The invention is mainly used in scenes requiring quick construction and disassembly, such as outdoor activities, emergency rescue, military use and the like.

title_en: Rescue training safety device after simulated earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue training safety device after an earthquake disaster simulation, which comprises a plug seat and a cable connected to the top of the plug seat, wherein a detachable plug assembly is arranged at the bottom of the plug seat and comprises plug grooves, plug blocks, inner cavities, movable blocks, plug blocks, slots, pressing blocks and springs, the plug blocks are plugged into the plug grooves formed in the bottom surface of the plug seat, and through the designed plug seat, the detachable plug assembly, a rotary connecting seat and other assemblies, personnel can freely select braiding ropes with matched lengths and respectively connect the braiding ropes on the plug seat by utilizing the detachable plug assembly.
assignees: QINGDAO HAILI EMERGENCY SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data-based smart safety integrated control platform system
title_ko: 데이터 기반 스마트 안전 통합 관제 플랫폼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data-based smart safety integrated control platform system. The system comprises: a data collection means for receiving at least one construction information among a digital map, an equipment-mounted image, a construction environment image, and sensing data for any one construction site; a scenario establishment means for establishing a safety-related risk factor analysis scenario and a risk scenario by data mining the collected construction information; a safety management information generation means for monitoring whether a disaster occurs or a safety accident occurs at the construction site according to any one generated scenario, and generating at least one safety management information among a disaster occurrence notification, a safety accident notification, and a response guideline according to a monitoring result; and an integrated control server for controlling an operation of each facility in the construction site based on the generated safety management information. According to the present invention, a big data-based data standardization system construction technology for various unstructured data produced at the construction site can be improved, and safety data of the construction site can be constructed and predicted through systematic classification of various safety accidents at the construction site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 데이터 기반 스마트 안전 통합 관제 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 시스템은 어느 하나의 건설 현장에 대한 디지털 지도, 장비 탑재 영상, 시공 환경 영상 및 센싱 데이터 중 적어도 하나의 건설 정보를 수신하는 데이터 수집 수단, 수집된 건설 정보를 데이터 마이닝하여 안전 관련 위험 요인 분석 시나리오 및 위험 시나리오를 수립하는 시나리로 수립 수단, 생성된 어느 하나의 시나리오에 따라 상기 건설 현장의 재해 발생 여부 또는 안전 사고 발생 여부를 모니터링하고, 모니터링 결과에 따라 재해 발생 알림, 안전 사고 알림 및 대응 지침 중 적어도 하나의 안전 관리 정보를 생성하는 안전 관리 정보 생성수단, 및 생성된 안전 관리 정보를 기초로 상기 건설 현장 내 각 설비의 동작을 제어하는 통합 관제 서버를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 건설현장에서 생산되는 다양한 비정형 데이터에 대해 빅데이터 기반의 데이터 정형화 시스템 구축 기술 향상시키고, 건설현장의 다양한 안전사고에 대한 체계적인 분류를 통해 건설현장의 안전 데이터를 구축하고, 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire valve condensate automatic drain device
title_ko: 소방용 밸브 응축수 자동 배수장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for automatically draining condensate water of a fire-fighting valve, wherein a through hole is drilled in a valve body to be lower than a bottom surface of a clapper opening and closing a valve, and a condensate water pipe in which a drain ball having buoyancy is embedded is coupled to the through hole. When the condensate water is collected in a pipe or the valve body, the condensate water pipe is guided to the condensate water pipe and is discharged when the drain ball is lifted by buoyancy. Therefore, the apparatus for automatically draining condensate water of a fire-fighting valve does not corrode components of the valve body and does not interfere with operation of the clapper. To this end, the present invention comprises: a through-hole punched on a side surface of a dry valve body or a preparatory operation type valve body to be lower than a bottom surface of a clapper; a condensate pipe guiding a built-in drain ball to be lifted by buoyancy when condensate water is introduced; and an elbow connecting the condensate pipe and the through-hole. The condensate pipe comprises an outlet of which an upper portion is coupled to a screw unit formed in the elbow through a connection nut and a lower portion is blocked when the drain ball is placed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 밸브를 여닫는 클래퍼 밑면보다 낮게 밸브몸체에 관통구를 천공하고 부력을 갖는 배수볼이 내장된 응축수관을 관통구에 체결함으로써, 배관 또는 밸브몸체에 응축수가 고이면 응축수관으로 유도되어 부력으로 배수볼이 상승될 때 배출되기 때문에 밸브몸체 부품을 부식시키지 않고 클래퍼 작동에 지장을 주지 않는 소방용 밸브 응축수 자동 배수장치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 클래퍼 밑면보다 낮게 건식 밸브몸체 또는 준비작동식 밸브몸체 측면에 천공된 관통구, 응축수가 유입되면 내장된 배수볼이 부력으로 상승되게 안내하는 응축수관 및 상기 응축수관과 상기 관통구를 연결하는 엘보를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 응축수관은 상기 엘보에 형성된 나사부에 연결너트를 통하여 상부가 체결되고, 하부는 상기 배수볼이 놓이면 막히는 배출구를 포함하여 구성된다.
assignees: LEADERS FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV GACHON IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Safety design device, safety design method, and ammonia-fueled ship
abstract_en: A safety design method according to an embodiment comprises: executing an ammonia dispersion simulation on the basis of ventilation control information for an engine room in an ammonia-fueled ship; updating the ventilation control information so that a first area where the ammonia concentration is greater than or equal to a threshold is reduced on the basis of a hazard map generated through the dispersion simulation; repeating the execution of the dispersion simulation and the update of the ventilation control information until the first area satisfies a first condition; executing a disaster impact simulation for crew on the basis of the hazard map that satisfies the first condition, work information of the crew, and equipment arrangement information; updating the equipment arrangement information so that a second area where the risk of disaster impact on the crew is greater than or equal to a threshold is reduced on the basis of a disaster impact risk map generated through the disaster impact simulation; repeating the execution of the disaster impact simulation and the update of the equipment arrangement information until the second area satisfies a second condition; and outputting the ventilation control information and the equipment arrangement information that satisfy the second condition.

title_en: Snow melting simulation and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a snow melting simulation and risk early warning method and system, and belongs to the technical field of flood early warning. The method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multisource weather, geographic information and snow characteristic data of a target area, constructing a snow melting simulation model considering various factors, predicting snow melting amount, runoff and soil water content by utilizing CEEMDAN algorithm and LSTM network, introducing a multi-head attention mechanism, dividing space-time grids to perform time-by-time simulation calculation to obtain a space-time distribution result, setting a risk assessment index system, calculating snow melting risk index, judging whether the risk index exceeds a threshold value, outputting an early warning result, matching risk grades when the risk index exceeds the threshold value, drawing a risk partition map, and marking a low risk or safety state when the risk index does not exceed the threshold value. By adopting the snow melting simulation and risk early warning method and system, accurate prediction and timely early warning of snow melting flood risks are realized, disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved, and potential loss and damage caused by snow melting flood are reduced.

title_en: Landslide hazard physical model test system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide hazard physical model test system and a landslide hazard physical model test method, and relates to the technical field of landslide hazard simulation tests. The landslide disaster physical model test system and method divide the landslide body into a plurality of sections, each section of the landslide body can flexibly adjust the height and angle of the landslide body through the slope body adjusting mechanism according to test requirements, a three-dimensional image of bedrock is formed through scanning, a three-dimensional printing forming bedrock template is adopted, soil bodies are paved on the upper surface of the bedrock, the surface topography of the landslide body is simulated with high precision, the data information of the actual topography is highly consistent with each data information of the actual topography, water is sprayed on the soil bodies through a rainfall unit according to a set rainfall mode, the rainfall condition and the loading condition of the soil bodies are simulated with high precision through a loading unit, and the rainfall and the loading can be simultaneously realized, so that the test process is more accurate and simple, materials and manpower are saved, and the limitations of the traditional landslide physical model test system that the precision is low, the applicability is poor, time and labor are broken through.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Novel electric power system-oriented intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device and method for a novel power system, wherein the intelligent collaborative network safety emergency response device comprises an edge probe acquisition module, an intelligent analysis module and a digital twin sandbox deduction module, the edge probe acquisition module is used for capturing power communication data streams in real time, the intelligent analysis module is based on a time sequence anomaly detection algorithm and a vulnerability database, the digital twin sandbox deduction module comprises a network attack simulator, a power business influence evaluator, a strategy generator, a strategy execution module, a strategy optimization module and a man-machine collaborative module, the technical scheme can realize quick adaptation of a model through an improved dynamic weight fusion mechanism and element learning online optimization, and the requirement on annotation data is remarkably reduced.

title_en: Multi-scale earthquake geological disaster assessment method considering deformation field and earthquake vibration characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scale earthquake geological disaster assessment method considering deformation field and earthquake vibration characteristics, which comprises the following steps of carrying out regional scale risk assessment based on deformation field and earthquake vibration parameters; and carrying out disaster process simulation based on the dynamic risk score of the gallery scale, carrying out disaster prediction of the site scale, and generating a final earthquake disaster visualization map and report. According to the invention, through multi-scale dynamic coupling and multi-physical field simulation, deformation field, ground vibration parameters and numerical simulation technology are combined, and through a grading evaluation method of different scales (areas, galleries and fields), geological disaster risks under the action of earthquakes can be more comprehensively identified, the method is suitable for different application scenes, and the evaluation accuracy and engineering applicability are improved.

title_en: Emergency rescue path planning method, system, equipment and medium based on building earthquake damage simulation
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency rescue path planning method, system, equipment and medium based on building earthquake disaster simulation, relating to the field of rescue path planning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional structure of a building based on a two-dimensional plan of the building in which the earthquake disaster occurs; the method comprises the steps of processing a three-dimensional structure of a building by a physical engine to obtain building damage and road surface accumulation results under an earthquake, extracting an indoor and outdoor integrated road network from the building damage and the road surface accumulation results under the earthquake by a navigation grid method to obtain a road network extraction result, planning a path by adopting an optimized A-type algorithm based on the road network extraction result to obtain an emergency rescue path planning result. The application can meet the requirements of evacuation safety, trafficability, traffic capacity constraint and strain, and provides indoor and outdoor integrated path planning service for search and rescue personnel so as to respond to the emergency optimal rescue path requirement.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle domain adaptation detection method for image pixel-level hybrid enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle domain adaptation detection method with image pixel-level hybrid enhancement, and belongs to the field of infrared target detection application. The method is applied to infrared unmanned aerial vehicle data, an infrared camera is utilized to collect an infrared unmanned aerial vehicle image, and domain self-adaptive target detection of the infrared unmanned aerial vehicle image is realized through the steps of data preparation, pseudo tag generation, region division and confidence calculation, confidence-based hybrid image generation, bidirectional dynamic region pseudo tag filtration, hybrid tag generation, loss calculation, model training optimization and the like. The method can be used for target detection tasks of the infrared unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as night monitoring, disaster relief, military reconnaissance and the like, can effectively solve the problem of performance degradation in infrared image cross-domain application (such as different equipment and environmental conditions), and improves the accuracy and the robustness of target detection.

title_en: Mine disaster monitoring data analysis and early warning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a mine disaster monitoring data analysis and early warning method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source sensing data and a three-dimensional geological model of a mine, carrying out time sequence prediction and feature extraction on the multi-source sensing data and the three-dimensional geological model based on a PSO-CNN-LSTM hybrid algorithm to obtain disaster classification level and fusion feature data, carrying out feature masking on the fusion feature data to obtain local model data when the disaster classification level meets preset requirements, and carrying out global fusion on the local model data according to a safety aggregation protocol based on a federal learning method to obtain shared early warning data. The method can realize mine sensing data sharing for training the comprehensive early warning model, and improves disaster prediction accuracy.
assignees: SHAANXI COLORED YULIN COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional slope scouring and erosion simulation test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional simulation side slope erosion and corrosion test method, which is characterized in that waves with different energy, frequency and amplitude are simulated through a wave making module to test the requirements of different waves on the erosion action of a simulation side slope, the influence of the erosion of the waves on the side slope composed of different components is simulated through arranging a replaceable panel for simulating the side slope with different hardness or the side slope with different soil, the rebound energy of the colliding bank waves is reduced through arranging a wave eliminating module to avoid the energy dissipation of the simulation waves, the wave eliminating module comprises an inverted triangle water baffle table with a soft water absorbing piece and a buffer table with an extremely small gradient, and the invention can realize various experiments such as erosion experiments of different angles, erosion experiments of different energy waves, erosion experiments of the side slope with different rock mineral component structure types, and the like on one device, simplify the device, save energy, and have a certain degree of scientific research and engineering practical significance in the aspects of environmental protection, geological disaster protection and the like.

title_en: Mining pressure simulation calibration method based on generation type artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an ore pressure simulation calibration method based on a generated artificial intelligence, and relates to the field of coal mine safety. The method comprises the steps of modeling according to mine geological data and carrying out mine pressure simulation, dynamically obtaining mine pressure observation data and simulation unit parameters in real time, constructing and training a mine pressure simulation real-time calibration model based on the mine pressure observation data and the simulation unit parameters, and carrying out real-time calibration reasoning on the mine pressure simulation by utilizing the mine pressure simulation real-time calibration model. The invention solves the problems that the mine pressure simulation result and the actual mine pressure show a significant time lag, and the real-time monitoring requirement of the mine safety production cannot be met. The deviation between the simulation result and the actual ore pressure distribution is smaller, and the precision is higher. Autonomous learning and intelligent adjustment under mine environment change are realized, and complex and changeable mining conditions are easily handled. Real-time accurate simulation and intelligent calibration of the dynamic process of the mine pressure are realized, so that more reliable technical support is provided for disaster early warning and prevention of the coal mine roof.
assignees: QINGYANG XINZHUANG COAL MINE OF QINGYANG XINZHUANG COAL IND CO LTD;HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;BEIJING LONGRUAN TECHNOLOGIES INC

title_en: Railway dangerous rock stability intelligent prediction method based on RF-GA-SVM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent railway dangerous rock stability prediction method based on an RF-GA-SVM model, which comprises the following steps of determining railway side slope dangerous rock stability evaluation characteristics, establishing a railway side slope dangerous rock stability evaluation system, collecting related data such as railway side slope dangerous rock, geology, weather and the like, establishing an initial data set, performing data preprocessing, eliminating redundancy evaluation characteristics by utilizing variable importance scores of a random forest algorithm, performing global optimization on SVM model super parameters by adopting a genetic algorithm, constructing a railway side slope dangerous rock stability prediction model RF-GA-SVM based on the SVM model after super parameter optimization, and training, testing and evaluating the RF-GA-SVM model to obtain a final railway side slope dangerous rock stability prediction model. The method integrates three algorithms of RF, GA and SVM, not only improves the accuracy and efficiency of railway slope dangerous rock stability prediction, but also obviously improves the robustness and applicability of a prediction model, and provides powerful technical support for railway safety management and geological disaster prevention and control.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;CCCC FIRST HARBOR ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Roadway water burst spreading process simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadway water inrush spreading process simulation method and system, belonging to the field of mine hydrogeology and computer graphics, comprising the following steps: the bidirectional water inrush spreading simulation model of the dynamic topology network is constructed, and the water flow spreading process in the mine can be reflected in real time. The spreading simulation model is combined with a message queue mechanism and a three-dimensional visualization engine, can provide accurate water flow path prediction and dynamic display, and effectively improves the monitoring and emergency response capabilities of mine sudden floods.
assignees: XUZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE SAFETY EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Flushing fluid dynamic pushing and rotating directional deflecting continuous rope coring drilling tool and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flushing fluid dynamic pushing-against rotary directional deflecting continuous rope coring drilling tool and a method, comprising a rotary directional deflecting drilling tool and a continuous coring drilling tool therein; the rotary directional deflecting drilling tool comprises a coring drill bit, a dynamic pushing deflecting device, a positioning pup joint and a coring drill rod which are connected in sequence, and the continuous coring drilling tool comprises a coring pipe, a measurement and control guide pup joint, a positioning salvaging mechanism and a rope salvaging device which are connected in sequence. The invention combines dynamic pushing, rotating and directional deflecting with continuous rope coring, utilizes high-pressure flushing fluid provided by a slurry pump as a driving power source, realizes deflecting direction control by dynamically controlling a flushing fluid flow channel mode, realizes efficient core extraction by rope salvage, can continuously take rock samples while accurately controlling drilling tracks, improves the rock core taking rate and the taking precision of geological drilling exploration, and provides technical equipment guarantee for mineral resource assessment, underground engineering investigation, geological disaster prevention and control and the like.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Pre-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle pre-allocation method and system for electric power emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle pre-allocation method and a pre-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle pre-allocation system for electric power emergency communication, belonging to the technical field of power system optimization control, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating the fault probability of a communication component based on a vulnerability model; according to historical meteorological data, communication network topology and risk factors of communication equipment components, generating a plurality of possible damage scenes through simulation and simulation iteration, obtaining variables in different damage scenes, obtaining damage conditions of the communication components in the damage scenes by comparing the relationships of the variables and fault probabilities in different damage scenes, predicting power emergency communication requirements when disasters occur according to regional power service and power service importance degrees under the disasters, constructing a pre-disaster unmanned aerial vehicle pre-allocation model based on the power emergency communication requirements and the damage conditions of the communication components in the damage scenes, defining constraints of recovery targets and pre-allocation positions of the unmanned aerial vehicles, solving the pre-allocation model of the unmanned aerial vehicles based on the damage scenes, and obtaining pre-allocation positions of the unmanned aerial vehicles and communication resource reservation strategies under the condition of meeting minimum load loss. The method improves the quick recovery capability of the electric power emergency communication.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Composite dynamic disaster simulation device and method for deep mining of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a composite dynamic disaster simulation device for deep mining of a coal mine, which belongs to the technical field of simulation equipment for mining of the coal mine and comprises a fixed base, a guide rod frame and a sliding sleeve, wherein a frame body is fixedly arranged at the center of the upper end of the fixed base, a carrying cylinder is horizontally assembled on one side of the frame body in a sliding and detachable manner, coal and rock blocks are stored in the carrying cylinder, stress loading units are uniformly assembled on the inner wall of the carrying cylinder at equal intervals, an air supply mechanism is assembled at one end, far away from the fixed base, of the carrying cylinder, and the composite dynamic disaster simulation method for deep mining of the coal mine.

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device which allows training target persons to receive disaster prevention training at appropriate places.SOLUTION: An information processing device is provided, comprising: a generation unit configured to reference damage level information indicative of the duration of time spent by training target persons in a region and an extent of damage in the region to generate disaster risk level information in the region for each of a plurality of regions; a comparison unit for comparing the disaster risk level information of each of the plurality of regions with those of others; and a provision unit for providing the training target persons with information according to a result of the comparison.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Device for demonstrating soil liquefaction geological disasters and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demonstration device for soil liquefaction geological disasters and a use method thereof, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster demonstration, and comprise a base, wherein a demonstration box is arranged on the upper part of the base in a sliding way, a movement assembly is arranged on the base and the demonstration box together, the movement assembly comprises a first driving unit and a second driving unit which are arranged on the base, a rotating disc which is rotationally connected with the side surface of the base, a movable rod which is movably connected with the side surface of the rotating disc, a return plate which is arranged on the side surface of the demonstration box, the invention changes the movement amplitude of the demonstration box in real time when demonstrating the soil liquefaction geological disaster through arranging the movement assembly, and the irregular movement amplitude can simulate the broadband characteristic of earthquake waves, so that the experimental result is more similar to the actual earthquake liquefaction phenomenon.

title_en: Landslide hazard identification method and system based on multi-mode remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard identification method and system based on multi-mode remote sensing data fusion, and relates to the technical field of landslide hazard identification, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-mode historical landslide remote sensing data of different time scales; and carrying out noise reduction, smoothing and fusion on the landslide risk characterization indexes of each mode in different time scales by utilizing an extended Kalman filter, improving the accuracy and the robustness of the data, training a landslide disaster identification model by adopting a multi-mode landslide data set, identifying the landslide disaster by adopting the trained landslide disaster identification model on the multi-mode remote sensing data at the current moment, and realizing intelligent identification of the landslide disaster and improving the landslide identification precision.

title_en: Fire extinguishing force deployment evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium for fire control strength deployment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining fire accident related data, constructing a fire accident scene model based on the fire accident related data, executing at least one fire power deployment scheme on the fire accident scene model to obtain multiple groups of fire feedback data, wherein the fire accident scene model is a three-dimensional model for dynamically simulating fire accident spatial layout, fire environment and disaster trends, inputting the fire feedback data into a pre-trained fire control evaluation model aiming at each group of fire feedback data, determining an evaluation index corresponding to the fire power deployment scheme based on a model output result, and evaluating the fire power deployment scheme based on the evaluation index and a preset index threshold. The accuracy and the reliability of fire-fighting power deployment scheme evaluation are improved.

title_en: Coastal city storm surge disaster toughness assessment method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the toughness of a storm surge disaster in an coastal city based on a graphic neural network, which is used for collecting multi-source heterogeneous data related to the storm surge disaster in the coastal city, and comprises geographic information data, infrastructure data and historical storm surge data, constructing coastal city infrastructure network structure data according to the geographic information data and the infrastructure data, then constructing a graphic neural network model, merging characteristic parameters of the historical storm surge data with the coastal city infrastructure network structure data, inputting the trained graphic neural network model, simulating the progressive influence of the storm surge disaster on coastal city infrastructure nodes, evaluating the state evolution of each node in the coastal city infrastructure network under the influence of the storm surge based on the propagation result of the graphic neural network, and respectively carrying out summarizing analysis on different functional areas based on the obtained toughness evaluation index data of each node to form an integral coastal city toughness evaluation result.

title_en: Landslide hazard assessment method and system based on extreme rainfall model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard assessment method and system based on an extreme rainfall model, belongs to the technical field of geological disasters, and aims to solve the technical problem of poor landslide hazard assessment effect. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geological sample data and rainfall sample data, screening evaluation factors by adopting Pearson correlation coefficients, importing screening results and obtained historical landslide point sample data into geographic information software ArcGIS to obtain a data set containing non-landslide points, constructing and training a MaxEnt model, obtaining position data to be tested, inputting the MaxEnt model, outputting a landslide susceptibility evaluation prediction index map, importing the landslide susceptibility evaluation prediction index map into the geographic information software ArcGIS to obtain susceptibility evaluation results, inputting the maximum rainfall amount of each month into the ArcGIS to construct rainfall intensity values of different recurrence periods by using Pearson III type distribution, and obtaining landslide risk evaluation results according to the susceptibility evaluation results and the rainfall intensity values of different recurrence periods.
assignees: SICHUAN INSTITUTE OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image colorization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image colorization system which comprises a data acquisition module, a model training module and a colorization image generation module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring a multi-mode data set, the model training module is used for training a noise prediction model by utilizing the multi-mode data set, the noise prediction module is obtained through cross attention mechanism network construction, and the colorization image generation module is used for inputting an image to be predicted into the noise prediction model to acquire a color optical image. The method is suitable for scenes needing high-precision SAR image analysis such as disaster monitoring, topography investigation and the like.

title_en: Chemical exposure dynamic simulation evaluation method and system for wastewater treatment process
abstract_en: The invention provides a chemical exposure dynamic simulation evaluation method and a system for a wastewater treatment process, which are characterized in that a chemical addition data set and a real-time monitoring data set of the target wastewater treatment process are firstly obtained, dynamic exposure parameters are extracted to generate a dynamic exposure parameter set containing chemical diffusion rate, exposure contact time and environment interaction influence parameters, then a multi-stage iterative simulation is carried out on the dynamic exposure parameter set based on a preset dynamic simulation strategy network to obtain a chemical exposure dynamic simulation result containing exposure concentration distribution and exposure probability of each treatment node, exposure risk evaluation is carried out according to the chemical exposure dynamic simulation result, a chemical exposure optimization strategy set containing addition concentration adjustment, addition time sequence optimization and emergency response triggering strategies is generated, and is fed back to a wastewater treatment control system to dynamically adjust the chemical addition process, so that more accurate and safe wastewater treatment chemical management is realized.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Three-dimensional segmentation method for burst damage of RC structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete structure damage detection, in particular to a three-dimensional segmentation method for RC structure burst damage after fire, which comprises the steps of firstly, determining types and three-dimensional characteristics of the RC structure member surface concrete burst damage after fire, and constructing a corresponding three-dimensional point cloud data set for network training and verification. And then based on a KP-FCNN network structure, the detection and segmentation accuracy is improved, the model size is reduced, the reasoning time is obviously improved by improving and optimizing KPConv layers of the model, the optimal segmentation accuracy of 82.3% is achieved under the working conditions of different damage degrees, the automatic damage segmentation of the burst damage of the concrete structure after a fire disaster is realized, and the technical support is provided for three-dimensional quantification and deployment of the follow-up damage to an unmanned plane system.

title_en: Toughness improvement method for power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness improvement method for a power transmission network based on improved Bayesian optimization, which aims to solve the problem that the existing toughness improvement method is low in efficiency in large-scale optimization of variables. The toughness improving method comprises the steps of firstly, including a plurality of power transmission lines in a power transmission network, reinforcing the power transmission tower as a measure for improving the toughness, obtaining vulnerability curves of the power transmission towers before and after reinforcement, secondly, simulating damage scenes of the power transmission towers through Monte Carlo under each typhoon scene, wherein the power transmission lines are damaged only when one power transmission tower is damaged, thirdly, determining the reinforcing sequence of the power transmission towers, fourthly, determining the relation between the number of the power transmission tower reinforcements on each power transmission line and the annual damage exceeding probability of the power transmission lines, and fifthly, improving the toughness of the power transmission network based on Bayesian optimization. The invention integrates an improved Bayesian optimization method, realizes reinforcement optimization of a large-scale network for various complex uncertainties, and can accurately evaluate the toughness improvement strategy of the electric power system under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Bottom drainage roadway one-roadway four-purpose coal and gas co-mining method
abstract_en: The invention provides a bottom drainage roadway and one roadway four-purpose coal and gas co-mining method, which belongs to the technical field of coal mines, and comprises the steps of firstly tunneling a bottom drainage roadway at a position of 10-12 meters of a coal seam bottom plate, determining an optimal drilling position by adopting a gray wolf hunting optimization algorithm, setting a high-position directional drilling group every 10-15 meters, installing an intelligent gas drainage system, starting a gas pre-drainage function 60-90 days before the working face is propelled, constructing a double return air system by using the bottom drainage roadway during the back mining, synchronously paving a drainage water supply pipeline to realize water recycling, setting a transportation device, a disaster avoidance chamber and a communication system, establishing an overall process monitoring system, installing various sensors to realize real-time monitoring, making a special emergency plan, ensuring safe and efficient operation of the system, and solving the technical problem of increasing gas concentration and accumulating risk in the multifunctional utilization process of the bottom drainage roadway.
assignees: KUNMING COAL DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: High constant resistance energy-absorbing grouting anchor rod
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of grouting anchors, and discloses a high constant resistance energy-absorbing grouting anchor, which comprises a grouting anchor assembly and Gao Hengzu energy-absorbing assemblies, wherein the grouting anchor assembly comprises a drill bit, a ribbed hollow anchor, a grouting stop plug, a backing plate, a butterfly-shaped tray and a pre-tightening nut, the ribbed hollow anchor is sequentially provided with the grouting stop plug, one backing plate, the Gao Hengzu energy-absorbing assembly, the other backing plate and the butterfly-shaped tray from top to bottom, the Gao Hengzu energy-absorbing assembly comprises a bearing bead frame and a column casing, the bearing bead frame comprises a retainer and a plurality of balls, the inner surface of the upper part of the column casing is an inverted triangle inclined plane, and the balls are initially positioned between the outer wall of the ribbed hollow anchor and the inner wall of the inclined plane of the column casing. The Gao Hengzu energy-absorbing grouting anchor rod can continuously provide high constant resistance, absorb energy and let pressure, block cracks and effectively reduce disasters such as slope instability.
assignees: UNIV XUZHOU TECHNOLOGY;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system applied to the disaster early warning field, which comprises a monitoring module for collecting rainfall conditions, vegetation development conditions, soil moisture content, ground seam development conditions and human activity data, an analysis and judgment module comprising a preliminary analysis and dynamic correction unit, an early warning module for sending an alarm and an escape path and a simulation module for predicting a disaster path, wherein the vegetation monitoring not only considers the soil fixation effect but also introduces root damage effect, the human activity monitoring distinguishes over-ground engineering and underground engineering, and the dynamic correction unit solves the influence of historical early warning residual risks on the current evaluation through superposition of time attenuation and main control factors.

title_en: Model test device and method for simulating upward floating of subway tunnel segment in operation period
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground engineering visualization, and provides a model test device and a method for simulating the floating up of subway tunnel segment in the operation period, wherein the device comprises a groundwater seepage system, a test box and a drainage recovery system which are sequentially connected along the water flow direction; the top of the test box is open, the inside of the test box is filled with a simulated stratum, a simulated pipe piece structure is embedded in the simulated stratum, a displacement and pressure monitoring device is connected to the simulated pipe piece structure, a rainfall water distribution mechanism is covered on the top open area of the test box, the underground water seepage system comprises a water inlet tank, the water inlet tank is connected into the test box through a water inlet pipeline, and the drainage recovery system comprises a water storage tank which is communicated with the test box through a water outlet pipeline. The tunnel segment floating scene under various hydrogeological conditions can be simulated by the scheme, and experimental support is provided for subway disaster prevention design and safe operation and maintenance.

title_en: Urban waterlogging risk comparison method and device based on spatial sensitivity
abstract_en: The application relates to a city waterlogging risk comparison method and device based on space sensitivity, wherein the method comprises the steps of comprehensively collecting weather, geographic information, population, traffic and historical disaster data; integrating multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a three-dimensional coupled waterlogging risk assessment model of 'danger-sensitivity-vulnerability', dynamically adjusting a weight coefficient by combining a machine learning algorithm, introducing physical constraint to optimize the surface runoff simulation precision to generate a grid risk unit, fusing a multi-dimensional risk index and geographic space data to generate a grid risk distribution map, constructing waterlogging risk deduction models under rainfall scenes in different reproduction periods, realizing multi-layer comparison analysis by a GIS space superposition technology, and performing visual output. According to the application, through a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation system, dynamic weight adjustment and high-resolution space mapping, accuracy and dynamic adaptability of waterlogging risk evaluation are remarkably improved, and scientific and efficient decision support is provided for urban waterlogging management.
assignees: CLP CLOUD COMPUTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ice lake feedback monitoring and early warning method based on artificial intelligence and multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice lake feedback monitoring and early warning method based on artificial intelligence and multisource data fusion, which belongs to the technical field of natural disaster monitoring and specifically comprises the steps of extracting a ice lake state feature vector of multi-space-time data through cross-mode self-supervision learning and constructing a three-dimensional virtual ice lake model, constructing a glacier three-dimensional stress field model based on the feature vector, constructing a seepage channel map model through a graph neural network based on a finite element method, fusing the features of the glacier three-dimensional stress field model and the seepage channel map model to form a mechanical-seepage coupling state vector, constructing a pulse neural network to simulate glacier crack expansion and seepage mutation pulse event, constructing a federation structure of an isomerism map and combining a dynamic weighting aggregation strategy to output a federation weight matrix, fusing federation learning weight and a three-dimensional model output result, and calculating a burst posterior probability through the Bayesian neural network to generate a four-level early warning signal.

title_en: Tropical region offshore marine meteorological fusion analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tropical region offshore marine meteorological fusion analysis method which comprises the following steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing data, secondly controlling data quality, namely checking the data and analyzing error characteristics of marine meteorological observation data, thirdly, performing intelligent fusion on the quality-controlled multi-source data fusion analysis system in the tropical region, constructing a marine meteorological fusion analysis data set, fourthly, constructing a coupling analysis model, performing coupling analysis on marine meteorological elements by combining a physical model and a numerical simulation technology, finding early warning rules and influence factors of the marine meteorological system by simulating and predicting interaction process between marine meteorological elements and the atmosphere, and thirdly, dynamically applying and evaluating the data in real time, and finding and analyzing potential marine meteorological disaster risk.

title_en: Remote sensing image segmentation method based on foreground perception network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image segmentation and discloses a remote sensing image segmentation method based on a foreground sensing network, which comprises the steps of constructing the foreground sensing network based on a coder and decoder structure and constructing a combined loss function; the method comprises the steps of training a foreground sensing network, utilizing the trained foreground sensing network to divide to obtain a class probability map of each pixel, carrying out multi-scale classification on the class probability map based on dynamic multi-resolution attention and combining environmental characteristics, dynamically adapting a post-processing strategy, and carrying out post-processing according to the adapted post-processing strategy so as to optimize a division result. According to the invention, through multi-scale feature fusion, environment self-adaptive post-processing and geographic semantic constraint, an end-to-end intelligent segmentation framework is constructed, segmentation precision, robustness and practicability in a complex remote sensing scene are remarkably improved, and an efficient solution is provided for the fields of natural resource management, disaster emergency response and the like.

title_en: Evacuation path optimization method based on coupling numerical simulation and layered reinforcement learning
