abstract_en: The application provides an evacuation path optimization method based on coupling numerical simulation and layered reinforcement learning, which relates to the field of storm surge, and comprises the steps of constructing a coupling numerical simulation frame of high-precision storm surge; the method comprises the steps of carrying out storm tide numerical simulation through a coupling numerical simulation frame to generate a submerged depth data set, carrying out high-resolution submerged depth interpolation through the submerged depth data set and combining an inverse distance weighted interpolation algorithm to generate a high-resolution submerged depth interpolation data set, carrying out risk classification on the high-resolution submerged depth interpolation data set to generate a risk area map, generating an evacuation road network through a path planning neural network model based on a graph neural network and the risk area map, optimizing an evacuation strategy of the evacuation road network through a hierarchical depth reinforcement learning frame, generating a combined optimal dynamic evacuation strategy, and remarkably improving the generalization performance and the calculation efficiency of evacuation path planning.

title_en: Coal seam small-structure imaging and stress inversion method based on drilling acoustic wave remote detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal seam small-structure imaging and stress inversion method based on drilling sound wave remote detection, which comprises the steps of respectively arranging sequential drilling holes on a top plate and a bottom plate of a coal seam, continuously transmitting sound waves to the coal seam in the sequential drilling holes and receiving reflected waves to obtain reflected wave full-wave signal data of an upper interface and a lower interface of the coal seam, processing the data to obtain two-dimensional imaging slices of a coal seam area at the current position, sequentially detecting along the trend of the coal seam, establishing a three-dimensional geological structure model of the coal seam after combining different two-dimensional imaging slices, and then realizing division of a high-dynamic disaster risk area by adopting a specific processing mode based on the three-dimensional geological structure model.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;UNIV CHINA PETROLEUM EAST CHINA;CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION NO 22 RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: High-freedom-degree slope test system and method for multi-type geological disaster process simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-degree-of-freedom slope test system and a high-degree-of-freedom slope test method for simulating a multi-type geological disaster process, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering test and comprise a geological disaster simulation generating mechanism and a terrain regulation and control mechanism, wherein the geological disaster simulation generating mechanism comprises a lifting carrier capable of ascending and descending; the device comprises a lifting platform, a movable pushing plate, a plurality of slope panels, a test slope, a slope panel, a terrain inserting block and a slot, wherein the lifting platform can move forwards and backwards, the movable pushing plate is used for exciting a geological disaster body forwards after the lifting platform rises to a set height, the slope panels can move forwards and backwards, lift upwards and downwards and vertically rotate, the test slope with single inclination angle or multiple inclination angles and required slope length is formed by splicing the slope panels in the front-back direction, the slope panel at the rearmost end of the test slope is always connected to the lifting platform when the height is set, the terrain inserting blocks are designed according to requirements and have different sizes and shapes, and the top surface of the slope panel is provided with the slot for detachably inserting the terrain inserting block. According to the test system provided by the invention, the length, gradient and slope surface of the test slope can be flexibly adjusted, and a more accurate simulation test can be realized.

title_en: Building damage identification and marking method based on unmanned aerial vehicle image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building damage identification and marking method based on unmanned aerial vehicle images, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a data set D containing a damaged building; the method comprises the steps of constructing an improved target detection network, selecting a loss function as WIoU, training the improved target detection network to be converged by using a data set D to minimize WIoU to obtain an improved target recognition model, shooting an aerial image to be recognized by a cradle head camera carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle, inputting the improved target recognition model to obtain a recognition image, and positioning the recognition image to a map. The method can accurately identify the damaged building from the aerial photograph, can directly mark the world coordinates of the damaged place by utilizing the POS information and the cradle head camera information of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and directly returns a map with marks, thereby facilitating the manager to evaluate the damaged condition of the disaster area in real time, and can rapidly obtain the result in the communication limited area.

title_en: Tailing pond disaster hidden danger intelligent identification early warning system based on three-dimensional reconstruction
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent identifying and early warning system for disaster hidden danger of a tailing pond based on three-dimensional reconstruction, which relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning, and comprises a digital modeling module, a target tailing pond and a target tailing pond, wherein the digital modeling module is used for establishing a three-dimensional digital model of the target tailing pond; the system comprises a disaster simulation module, a risk assessment module and an early warning module, wherein the disaster simulation module is used for collecting environment geographic information, loading the environment geographic information into a three-dimensional digital model, carrying out numerical simulation of preset disaster events and generating preset disaster simulation results, the risk assessment module is used for carrying out risk assessment based on the preset disaster simulation results and generating risk indexes, and the early warning module is used for carrying out disaster hidden danger identification early warning based on the risk indexes. The method and the device can solve the technical problems of insufficient real-time performance of data acquisition and limited disaster simulation precision in the prior art, and further influence on disaster hidden danger early warning accuracy, realize accurate evaluation and real-time early warning of disaster risk of the tailing pond, and achieve the technical effects of improving disaster risk identification and early warning accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: MCC INSPECTION AND CERTIFICATION CO LTD;HEBEI EMERGENCY MAN PUBLICITY AND EDUCATION CENTER;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system, installation method and monitoring and early warning method suitable for flushing of offshore wind turbine foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system, an installation method and a monitoring and early warning method suitable for flushing an offshore wind turbine foundation, wherein the monitoring and early warning method comprises data acquisition, rationality and effectiveness analysis, data statistics and matching, data preprocessing and feature extraction, intelligent monitoring and early warning model training, flushing evolution analysis and achievement output, and can realize real-time monitoring and intelligent early warning of the flushing condition of the offshore wind turbine foundation, effectively improve the early warning capability and the response efficiency of the flushing disaster of the offshore wind turbine foundation and ensure the safe operation of offshore wind power facilities.

title_en: Mining area multisource disaster simulation experiment device and application method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mining area disaster simulation experiments, in particular to a mining area multi-source disaster simulation experiment device and a using method thereof, the mining area multi-source disaster simulation experiment device comprises a chassis, an earthquake simulation mechanism, a mining disturbance simulation mechanism and a water bursting simulation mechanism are arranged on the upper side of the chassis, the earthquake simulation mechanism comprises a separated bottom plate and a side pressurizing mechanism, the split type bottom plate comprises two movable bottom plates capable of horizontally moving on the bottom frame, a splicing plate is fixedly connected between the two movable bottom plates, a plurality of dividing lines are arranged on the splicing plate, the splicing plate can be divided into two split plates along any dividing line, a side pressurizing mechanism is used for applying side pressure, a mining disturbance simulation mechanism is used for applying vibration force, and a water bursting simulation mechanism is used for adding water flow. The invention can simulate earthquake, mining disturbance and water bursting simulation on the mining area model, and simulate the conditions of the mining area under disasters such as earthquake, mining disturbance, water bursting and the like.
assignees: NINGXIA HONGDUNZI COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor fusion quantitative region prediction method for coal seam outburst risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method of a coal seam outburst risk multifactor fusion quantitative region, which belongs to the field of prediction of coal and gas outburst regions, and comprises the steps of obtaining gas occurrence, geological structure, coal seam burial depth, soft layering and mining conditions of a target coal seam to obtain basic information of the target coal seam; according to basic information of a target coal seam, combining Rhino and FLAC  3D  software, and simulating to obtain spatial distribution of vertical stress and horizontal stress of the target coal seam; obtaining the spatial distribution of the coal seam parameter values of the target coal seam based on a spatial combination interpolation method of the kriging and the random forest; based on the vertical stress, horizontal stress, gas pressure, gas content, firmness coefficient of coal and gas diffusion initial speed of coal of the target coal seam, the extension object model is combined to obtain the outstanding danger level of each region of the target coal seam, and the method has important significance for realizing the regional danger fine management and precise control of the outstanding disasters.

title_en: Explosion accident source item simulation analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation analysis method and a device for an explosion accident source item, which relate to the technical field of analysis of explosion accident source items, the method establishes a set of complete analysis model for the explosion accident source item, and by carrying out complete and complete analysis simulation on the explosion, the distribution conditions of light radiation (light impulse), shock waves and stable clouds after explosion accidents can be simulated, and basis is provided for evaluating and simulating propagation, influence and prevention after explosion accidents. Therefore, a decision maker can set corresponding protection measures according to the obtained source parameters, and scientific basis is provided for emergency response, pollution control and public protection after explosion accidents occur. Compared with the traditional single source item simulation, the method can obtain rich and various source item data by one model, and reduces the setting cost of the model and the time cost required by calculation.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION INST OF AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation simulation method and system based on panic emotion transmission and danger source influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crowd evacuation simulation method and a system based on panic emotion transmission and danger source influence, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a simulation scene, and modifying the infection rate of infectious disease dynamics into a state transfer function influenced by an emotion threshold value; after the simulation starts, calculating a state transfer function for each individual in the crowd, establishing a panic emotion transmission model, setting a dangerous repulsive force special for a dangerous source, establishing a social force model based on the panic emotion transmission model and the dangerous repulsive force, and simulating crowd evacuation based on the social force model. According to the invention, the infection rate of infectious disease dynamics is changed from a static parameter to a dynamic parameter influenced by an emotion threshold, the dynamic parameter is used as a state transfer function of an individual, the function is used as a bridge, a social force model and panic emotion transmission are fused together, and individual differences in crowd evacuation are deeply reflected, so that the simulation of crowd evacuation is realized.

title_en: Urban fire disaster management and control method and device based on fire scene simulation
abstract_en: Responding to receiving an instruction signal for fire control of a target area where a fire disaster occurs in a city, and acquiring scene data of the target area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; the method comprises the steps of constructing a fire scene twin simulation model of a target area at least comprising a temperature field and a smoke diffusion vector field based on scene data, inputting the fire scene twin simulation model into a fire scene prediction model, carrying out fire scene deduction on the target area based on the temperature field and the smoke diffusion vector field to obtain dangerous area information and evacuation channel information, generating a rescue path of the target area in the fire scene twin simulation model based on the dangerous area information and the evacuation channel information, determining a fire disaster management and control strategy of the target area, and carrying out fire disaster management and control on the target area according to the fire disaster management and control strategy. By the method, the real-time performance, accuracy, comprehensiveness and stability of controlling the urban fire are improved.
assignees: DALIAN JINDI KONGYU FENGYUN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous rock falling rock movement characteristic analysis method based on discrete element simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous rock falling rock movement characteristic analysis method based on discrete element simulation, which belongs to the technical field of engineering geology and comprises the steps of collecting dangerous rock data through multiple means and preprocessing, constructing a three-dimensional visual dangerous rock initial model, constructing a discrete element model based on the three-dimensional visual dangerous rock initial model, defining contact types and parameters among joint units by adopting a Hertz-Mindelin contact theory, determining normal contact force, simulating dangerous rock falling rock movement by taking multiple physical field factors into consideration by adopting a discrete element simulation technology based on the discrete element model and the normal contact force, obtaining a discrete element model simulation result, performing joint damage judgment by adopting a dynamic updating method, and verifying the discrete element model by adopting an indoor physical model test and field monitoring data. And (3) designing and implementing control engineering according to the simulation result, so that dangerous rock falling and falling disasters are effectively controlled, and engineering safety is ensured.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HYDROCHINA GUIYANG EXPLORATION DESIGN RES INSTITUTE ROCK SOIL ENGINEERING CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel toughness supporting structure and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel toughness supporting structure and a construction method thereof, which are used for excavating a tunnel by a drilling and blasting method and comprise one layer or two layers of attached primary supports, wherein each layer of primary support comprises a multi-ring primary support body, the multi-ring primary support bodies are sequentially connected in the longitudinal direction of the tunnel, each ring of primary support body comprises a plurality of assembled corrugated steel plate units, each assembled corrugated steel plate unit is arc-shaped, the assembled corrugated steel plate units are sequentially connected into a ring, grouting holes are formed in each assembled corrugated steel plate unit, a waterproof sprayed concrete layer is sprayed on the inner side wall of the primary support on the inner side, the outer side of the surrounding rock of the tunnel is stuck, the inner side of the surrounding rock of the tunnel is stuck, and basalt fiber ultra-high performance concrete layer is sprayed on the waterproof sprayed concrete layer. The supporting structure can be used for considering rigidity and toughness and improving disaster resistance and sustainability of tunnel engineering.
assignees: China railway tunnel group co ltd;CHINA RAILWAY TUNNEL SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a physical similarity simulation experiment crack identification platform, which realizes the full-flow intellectualization from data acquisition to analysis and display by integrating a multi-mode data synchronous acquisition module, a self-adaptive preprocessing assembly line, a mixed deep learning module and an interactive three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein the multi-mode acquisition system solves the problem of asynchronous traditional data, the preprocessing assembly line automatically processes high-throughput data and filters noise, the mixed model combines images and stress field characteristics to improve crack identification precision, the three-dimensional visualization engine supports crack evolution dynamic playback, parameter automatic calculation and immersive interaction, the bottlenecks of high manual dependence, dynamic analysis fault, three-dimensional characterization missing and the like in the traditional method are broken through, the efficiency and the precision of rock crack research are obviously improved, and a full-period digital solution is provided for mineral engineering, geological disaster prevention and the like.

title_en: Device and method for simulating engineering vibroflotation to induce karst roof damage and ground collapse
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for simulating karst roof damage and ground collapse induced by engineering vibroflotation, and belongs to the technical field of physical simulation of geotechnical engineering and geological disasters. The device comprises a karst stratum simulation system, a covering stratum rock-soil simulation system, a groundwater seepage simulation system, a pile foundation/drilling construction vibroflotation load simulation system and a monitoring and measuring system. By constructing a karst overburden-karst rock stratum-karst cavity stratum structure and combining the double-water-level rich water environment and three-dimensional ground stress loading, the damage process of the vibroflotation load to the karst cave roof and the catastrophe evolution of ground collapse in pile foundation or drilling construction are truly simulated. The method comprises the steps of karst stratum preparation, load application, data monitoring and the like, key parameters can be flexibly adjusted, and multi-element monitoring data can be obtained. The karst cave roof damage simulation system solves the problem that the karst cave roof damage process is difficult to simulate in the prior art, has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in operation, high experimental accuracy and the like, and is suitable for karst cave collapse mechanism research and disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Railway line rainfall early warning method based on VMD-PSO-LSTM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway line rainfall early warning method based on VMD-PSO-LSTM, which relates to the technical field of railway heavy rainfall disaster risk early warning, and comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring and preprocessing month rainfall data measured at weather stations along the railway line, S2, determining the decomposition number k of VMD and decomposing the month rainfall data to obtain k IMF sequences, S3, optimizing parameters of an LSTM model by using PSO algorithm for each IMF sequence, S4, training and predicting the IMF sequences by using PSO-LSTM optimization model, S5, overlapping sequences obtained by k predicted values to obtain predicted results of original rainfall sequences, and decomposing the original rainfall sequences into a plurality of subcomponents with different frequencies and characteristics by VMD, so that the time sequence characteristics are clearer, the precision is improved, meanwhile, LSTM can fully excavate dynamic characteristics of signals when being combined with the decomposed subsequences, the predicting effect is enhanced, and particle swarm optimization automatically optimizes LSTM super parameters through global search, and the predicting performance is improved.

title_en: Test system and method for simulating soft soil jacket pile foundation circulation performance evolution
abstract_en: The application discloses a test system and a method for simulating the evolution of the pile foundation circulation performance of a soft soil jacket, which belong to the technical field of geotechnical engineering indoor model experiments, the application discloses the lateral ultimate bearing capacity, displacement distribution rule and pile-soil interaction mechanism of a pile group system in soft soil through static load test by constructing a reduced scale model test system considering the anisotropic characteristics of soil structure and constitution, provides a theoretical basis for evaluating foundation stability, the cyclic load test simulates alternating loads such as long-term waves and earthquakes in the marine environment, clarifies the evolution characteristics of soil rigidity degradation, pile foundation accumulated damage and interface slip, overcomes the defects of the traditional design on power coupling effect and fatigue life prediction, can optimize design parameters of a jacket foundation in a soft soil foundation according to test results, improves the safety and durability of engineering such as offshore wind power, oil gas platforms and the like under extreme loads, and provides test support for pile foundation performance degradation models under multi-disaster coupling.
assignees: GD POWER DEV CO LTD;GUODIAN XIANGSHAN OFFSHORE WIND POWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation product, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to analyze and evaluate different limit state resistance capacities of buildings with different structural forms by using nonlinearity Pushover, construct a building resistance capacity prediction dataset through multi-parameter combination simulation and train a machine learning prediction model. And analyzing the impact force of the building under the action of different landslide impact strengths by using a smooth particle flow and finite element coupling dynamic model, and constructing a mathematical calculation model of the landslide impact force based on impact force data. And (3) establishing a filling wall damage judging condition, comparing landslide impact force with building structure resistance capacity and filling wall resistance capacity, and determining the damage state of the building. And calculating probability vulnerability of the building by considering the landslide impact strength and the uncertainty of building material parameters, constructing vulnerability contour maps of the buildings with different structural forms, and providing theoretical and technical support for landslide quantitative risk evaluation disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Air bearing type membrane structure fire overall process response simulation method based on heat-pressure-structure coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heat-pressure-structure coupling-based air-supported membrane structure fire overall process response simulation method, belongs to the technical field of structure disaster prevention and fire safety evaluation, and solves the problems that a membrane surface temperature field non-uniformity and material degradation time-varying relation analysis is lacking, an internal air pressure dynamic evolution mechanism is ignored, a fire overall process system simulation method is lacking, and an engineering safety evaluation system is not formed at present. According to the invention, FDS is taken as a fire scene modeling basis, and an ABAQUS finite element platform is combined, so that multi-field data linkage is realized through a user-defined Python interface and a subroutine, and the whole dynamic evolution process from firing to collapse of the air film structure in a fire is accurately described. Based on thermal-pressure-structure coupling, the invention constructs a collaborative simulation framework, realizes multi-field data linkage and material partition analysis, simulates air pressure evolution and film surface damage, covers the whole fire disaster process, and provides a reliable technology for safety evaluation and fire resistance design.

title_en: Elevator safety management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building and elevator dispatching control, and particularly discloses an elevator safety management method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting elevator structure, electrical configuration, environmental parameters, using record and maintenance historical data, constructing an elevator twin map in a unified format, executing fault evolution modeling and simulation based on the map to generate a trigger factor set, constructing a multi-elevator dispatching task map, completing path optimization and task cooperation, generating an intelligent rescue path table, identifying abnormality, generating a fault response trigger chain, issuing an edge control instruction, constructing an emergency response rule base and a strategy template set, and performing virtual exercise based on the strategy template and outputting feedback data. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent scheduling method and the intelligent scheduling system based on the multi-source data and the path scoring mechanism under the condition that the elevator is trapped, and response timeliness and system coordination capability are improved.
assignees: ZHONGYUAN CARBON INVESTMENT ANHUI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radionuclide data assimilation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radionuclide data assimilation method, a device, equipment and a medium, relates to the technical field of diffusion simulation, and aims to solve the problem that a traditional numerical model is difficult to dynamically correct a prediction result due to the fact that radionuclide has obvious uncertainty in atmospheric diffusion simulation. According to the method, real-time observation data and model prediction are fused through data synchronization technologies such as Kalman filtering, the accuracy and the instantaneity of diffusion simulation are optimized, and real-time decision support is provided for emergency scenes such as nuclear leakage. Meanwhile, the method supports minute-level data update and meets the aging requirement of emergency response. In addition, the method has strong fault tolerance capability on observation noise and data loss.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION INST OF AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Building space evacuation performance evaluation method based on weight network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building space evacuation performance evaluation method based on a weight network, and belongs to the technical field of building safety and emergency management. According to the method, building space is abstracted into a weight network, and the balance and stability of an evacuation path are comprehensively evaluated by combining evacuation simulation and network analysis technologies. The method comprises the steps of constructing a topological network model of a building space, defining weight coefficients of nodes, dividing an export service subgraph, calculating an export load index, a balance index and a node sensitivity index, and analyzing the stability of a network through node attack. The method solves the problems that the prior art relies on multiple evacuation simulation, the process is complicated and the space structure performance cannot be intuitively reflected, can quickly identify key nodes and optimize evacuation path design, and remarkably improves evaluation efficiency and accuracy. The method is suitable for evacuation design and performance evaluation of multiple types of personnel-intensive places such as teaching, exposition, business, transportation hub and the like.

title_en: Disaster monitoring and safety production multi-source data fusion analysis method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster monitoring and safety production multi-source data fusion analysis method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-dimensional meteorological data and position data of a predicted target, wherein the meteorological data comprises rainfall, wind speed, cloud storage and temperature, and each frame of data of the meteorological data carries a position tag; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing meteorological data, aligning and generating dimension-reduced data on a time window, extracting a time feature vector and a space feature vector from the dimension-reduced data, inputting the time feature vector and the space feature vector as input features into a preset disaster prediction model, and outputting disaster probability of a position tag, wherein the disaster prediction model is generated by training a neural network by using historical meteorological data. The method solves the problem that in the prior art, the evaluation result obtained by carrying out static evaluation on the safety production basic condition level based on the preset rule cannot reflect the influence of actual meteorological data on safety production.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue scheme generation method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-model-based emergency rescue scheme generation method, and relates to the field of emergency rescue and the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of processing historical case information and disaster related data by using a large model according to preset constraint prompt information to obtain an initial rescue scheme, executing the initial rescue scheme by using a simulation system to obtain an initial simulation execution result, evaluating the initial simulation execution result to obtain an initial evaluation result, and carrying out semantic understanding on the initial evaluation result by using the large model according to the constraint prompt information to obtain a target rescue scheme meeting scheme constraint conditions.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning model construction method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method, a system and a storage medium of a geological disaster early warning model, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out gradient analysis on a digital elevation model of a research area to obtain gradient values of all digital grids; the method comprises the steps of carrying out space reclassifying and segmentation on a plurality of digital grids according to gradient values, administrative division data of a research area and susceptibility unit data, calculating disaster factor coefficients of each slope unit according to disaster point information, respectively calculating historical rainfall factor coefficients and forecast rainfall factor coefficients of each slope unit according to meteorological data through a rainfall reduction algorithm, carrying out iterative training on an initial early warning model based on the gradient factor coefficients, the susceptibility factor coefficients, the disaster factor coefficients, the historical rainfall factor coefficients and the forecast rainfall factor coefficients, and taking the trained early warning model as a geological disaster early warning model. According to the invention, through the constructed geological disaster early warning model, the geological disaster grade and range in the prediction area are automatically analyzed in real time.

title_en: Cold air strong wind identification method and system based on multi-source data and deep learning
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a cold air high wind identification method and system based on multi-source data and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of creating a historical weather data set, constructing a weather disaster positive sample and a weather disaster negative sample, training a cold air gale identification model based on Res-Unet according to the weather disaster positive sample and the weather disaster negative sample, acquiring real-time weather element data and real-time three-dimensional radar detection data, and inputting the real-time weather element data and the real-time three-dimensional radar detection data into the trained cold air gale identification model based on Res-Unet to obtain a gale weather prediction result. The method and the device can remarkably improve the recognition accuracy of the model in complex weather phenomena, and can acquire the prediction result of the windy weather in real time. This means that the system can identify and give out early warning in advance before the occurrence of a cold air high wind event, and take precautionary measures in advance to reduce the loss caused by disasters.

title_en: Irrigation system for regulating soil moisture content by means of meteorological data information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irrigation system for regulating soil moisture content by means of meteorological data information, which relates to the technical field of agricultural irrigation and comprises a historical meteorological data processing module, a crop water demand model optimizing module, a soil water balance model optimizing module, an irrigation decision model optimizing module, a multi-mode fusion model optimizing module, an execution control module and irrigation equipment, wherein the system calculates an ET0 value through a Penman-Montetith formula, optimizes a soil moisture content model by combining rainfall intensity duration correction factors, dynamically associates crop coefficients and meteorological elements, constructs an irrigation water capacity function based on meteorological forecast and real-time monitoring data, introduces a disaster early warning mechanism to regulate irrigation time sequence, adopts a historical meteorological feature fusion neural network, reduces prediction errors through cross verification, realizes accurate matching of the soil moisture content and crop water demand, and improves maintenance efficiency of the irrigation equipment by integrating multi-source meteorological parameters, optimizing water circulation simulation precision, and replacing the irrigation equipment without stopping.

title_en: Directional fire-extinguishing mechanical arm device for tunnel fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional fire-extinguishing mechanical arm device for tunnel fires, and belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment. The tunnel fire directional fire extinguishing mechanical arm device comprises a base unit fixed at the top of a tunnel and comprising a frame, a damping component and an environment monitoring module, a four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm module comprising a horizontal rotary joint, a vertical pitching joint, a telescopic arm, a tail end nozzle gesture adjusting joint and a tail end nozzle, a multi-mode fire source positioning unit comprising an infrared thermal imager, a multi-spectrum flame detector and a laser radar, an intelligent injection control unit comprising a path planning algorithm module, a motion controller and a fire extinguishing agent flow adjusting system, and an extreme environment resisting protection structure comprising a composite ceramic coating, an aerogel heat insulation sleeve and a nitrogen positive pressure cavity. The device realizes 18 seconds of fire source hit and 20 seconds of extinguishing of 10m2 oil fires in simulation test, reduces the consumption of extinguishing agent by 62%, and remarkably improves the rapid inhibition capability and safety of tunnel fires.

title_en: Physical model experiment system and method for deep complex karst ground subsidence
abstract_en: The invention provides a physical model experiment system and method for deep complex karst ground subsidence, comprising a overburden rock-soil simulation module, a karst fracture pipeline simulation module, a karst cave stratum simulation module, a hydrodynamic condition simulation module, an underground engineering excavation and load disturbance simulation module and a monitoring and measuring module, wherein the overburden rock-soil simulation module simulates geological environments such as deep karst fractures and pipelines, the karst cave stratum simulation module simulates karst cave and cave stratum environments, the hydrodynamic condition simulation module is used for simulating influences of underground water and rainfall on a karst system, the underground engineering excavation and load disturbance simulation module is used for simulating underground engineering excavation, vibration loading and ground load influences, and the monitoring and measuring module is used for monitoring changes of various key physical quantities in the experiment process. The invention can truly reproduce the deep complex karst collapse formation process under the stress of various factors and provides an experimental research platform for preventing and controlling karst geological disasters.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;HEFEI RAILWAY HINGE ENG CONSTRUCTION HEADQUARTER OF CHINA RAILWAY SHANGHAI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: River basin mountain torrent mud-rock flow physical process simulation method for risk early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a river basin mountain torrent mud-rock flow physical process simulation method for risk early warning, which comprises specific research and development content and corresponding problems and achieves the following aims of constructing a river basin unit database, clarifying the characteristics of a river basin and a channel, providing data support based on physical process refined simulation, and developing river basin hydrologic process simulation research based on a SWAT distributed model with improved glacier water melting simulation. The full-link simulation from precipitation to disaster modeling is realized by constructing a mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster overall process coupling model and utilizing a dynamic data link to connect a river basin hydrology and channel water sand dynamic process, a disaster mechanism is accurately revealed, a channel disaster dynamic evolution assessment and risk division function is provided by integrating a visual system through the model, a forecasting system designed in an object-oriented development mode is adopted, a provincial early warning platform can be seamlessly accessed, and a systematic solution is provided for river basin or regional disaster early warning.

title_en: Water source protected area pollution analysis method and system based on software model simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a water source protected area pollution analysis method and system based on software model simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a pollution source data set and a geographic characteristic data set of a target water source protected area, then calling a software model to perform dynamic pollution diffusion simulation treatment on the pollution source data set, and obtaining a pollution diffusion feature set, and then carrying out space influence analysis on the pollution diffusion feature set based on the geographic feature data set to generate a pollution influence analysis result comprising a pollution migration path, an influence region boundary and a time distribution interval. And determining a pollution protection priority set according to the result, generating a differential protection strategy set by combining a preset emergency response rule, and finally feeding back the differential protection strategy set to a water source protection management system to trigger pollution protection operation, so that accurate and efficient pollution protection of the water source protection area can be realized.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY TIANJIN ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Loess plateau chain-generated disaster multi-scene dynamic prediction method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of loess disaster simulation and stability prediction, and relates to a loess plateau chain-generated disaster multi-scene dynamic prediction method, system and equipment; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time data and historical data of a region to be tested, preprocessing the historical data to obtain a database, respectively constructing a numerical model and a visual terrain model according to the real-time data, determining parameter thresholds of disaster occurrence according to the historical data and the numerical model, judging whether the disaster dynamic evolution is carried out or not by taking the parameter thresholds as judgment bases of the disaster dynamic evolution, predicting real-time landslide stability coefficients, sliding surfaces, debris flow movement ranges and accumulation heights of the region to be tested according to the real-time data when the disaster dynamic evolution is carried out, displaying on the visual terrain model, realizing simulation and prediction of geological disasters, dynamically demonstrating the development and threat range of the disasters, facilitating quick understanding of disaster risks, timely formulating effective disaster prevention and reduction measures and reducing disaster losses.

title_en: Typhoon disaster chain risk assessment method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster chain risk assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the field of risk assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first typhoon related data at the current moment, and carrying out characteristic engineering on the first typhoon related data to obtain multidimensional characteristics; inputting the multi-dimensional features into a preset evaluation model, determining key risk factors in the multi-dimensional features based on feature importance weights, carrying out weighted prediction on the key risk factors through each decision tree to obtain comprehensive predicted values of a plurality of decision trees, and determining risk evaluation grades based on the comprehensive predicted values, wherein the feature importance weights are determined in the process of training the evaluation model, each decision tree is obtained through residual fitting in the process of training the evaluation model by using historical typhoon data, and the evaluation model is determined according to model parameters optimized by the predicted values of each decision tree. By implementing the risk assessment method and the risk assessment device, accuracy and timeliness of risk assessment can be improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Rubbish soil temperature data processing and analyzing system and method based on water circulation pipe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for processing and analyzing garbage soil temperature data based on a water circulation pipe, and relates to the field of garbage soil temperature data processing; firstly, the water wall equivalent model breaks through the calculation limitation of the traditional discrete pipeline, the simplified calculation of continuous media is realized through parameterization deduction, secondly, the model is arranged at unequal intervals and combined with a sectional processing method, the modeling problem of space-time variability of a multi-layer circulating system is effectively solved, and finally, the double-process simulation of cooling and temperature return is integrated, so that the dynamic rule of the thermal response of garbage soil is completely revealed. The systematic modeling method not only reduces the computational complexity, but also provides an important temperature control path for disaster prevention and control and heat resource utilization of the landfill site through accurate quantification of heat source items, and has remarkable engineering application value.

title_en: Drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly provides an drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of collecting data of a drought early warning river basin; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model considering hydrologic process to simulate daily runoff, reconstructing long-series daily runoff data, constructing a month-scale vegetation-meteorological hydrologic drought regression model, calculating comprehensive meteorological hydrologic drought indexes, extracting drought events, constructing K artificial intelligent models, inputting meteorological hydrologic observation data into the K artificial intelligent models to simulate, adopting a Bayesian mode averaging method to calculate the weight of each artificial intelligent model, constructing a combined distribution function of drought index observation and forecast values based on Copula functions, and adopting an artificial intelligent-Bayesian coupling model to develop drought forecast. The method solves the problems of data scarcity, model uncertainty and the like in drought early warning, and provides high-precision and quantifiable decision support for water resource management, disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Simplified method for achieving microcosmic result acquisition by utilizing macroscopic evacuation simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a simplified method for obtaining microscopic results by utilizing macroscopic evacuation simulation. According to the method, factors such as obstacle avoidance, collision, waiting and the like are considered in combination with a plan semantic segmentation result, a new result is adjusted and calculated on the basis of a macroscopic simulation result, and a visual effect of an evacuation simulation result is achieved in combination with a plan. The method provided by the invention not only inherits the calculation efficiency of macroscopic simulation, but also combines the advantages of microscopic simulation, thereby breaking through the limitation of macroscopic simulation, being capable of rapidly realizing microscopic evacuation simulation under different layout conditions of a single building and providing a multi-dimensional evaluation basis for building safety design.

title_en: Offshore seawater quality prediction and early warning method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine environment monitoring, in particular to a machine learning-based offshore seawater quality prediction and early warning method, which obtains water quality data of an automatic monitoring station in real time, and constructing a machine learning model input structure taking a time sliding matrix as a core, predicting future water quality parameters by adopting a supervised learning algorithm, and creatively providing a water quality risk quantification evaluation system. The method solves the defects of the traditional method in the aspects of business operation, real-time early warning and ecological risk prejudgment, realizes the full-flow automation from data acquisition, model training, predictive analysis to hierarchical early warning, and provides intelligent decision support for offshore ecological protection and disaster prevention and control.
assignees: MARINE ENV MONITORING CENTRAL STATION GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Coal-rock dynamic disaster while-drilling multi-element signal sensing and early warning method
abstract_en: A multi-element signal sensing and early warning method for coal and rock dynamic disasters while drilling is characterized in that a multi-parameter sensing system integrated by a drilling machine is utilized in the early coal seam stoping period, while drilling signals generated during drilling of each drill rod are collected in real time, while drilling data are obtained based on the while drilling signals, a mechanical parameter inversion model is built, compressive strength of the coal and rock is calculated, a gas parameter inversion model is built, gas pressure and coal and rock permeability are obtained through decoupling, the compressive strength of the coal and rock, the gas pressure and the coal and rock permeability are used as core indexes, continuous representation of disaster risk distribution in the whole area is achieved by adopting a spatial interpolation method, a comprehensive risk index is built according to the continuous representation, and risk level of the coal and rock dynamic disasters is further quantified based on the comprehensive risk index according to a value range of the comprehensive risk index. The method can realize real-time sensing, accurate inversion and active prevention and control of coal and rock dynamic disasters, and can effectively solve the problems of low detection precision, poor real-time performance, insufficient global property and the like in the traditional technology.

title_en: Clean workshop production environment quality control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for controlling the quality of a production environment of a clean workshop, and relates to the technical field of environmental control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer sensing network, deploying temperature and humidity, particle concentration, pressure difference and VOC gas sensors, and preprocessing data by each node through edge calculation; the method comprises the steps of integrating data based on a dynamic weight distribution algorithm, adjusting weight according to confidence score to generate an environment quality comprehensive index, establishing an LSTM pollution diffusion prediction model, combining airflow field simulation to calculate a diffusion path during sudden pollution to generate an emergency response partition strategy, utilizing reinforcement learning to optimize fresh air system control parameters, establishing a dynamic ventilation frequency adjustment model based on real-time environment quality index and historical energy consumption data, minimizing energy consumption on the premise of guaranteeing cleanliness through a Q-learning algorithm, setting a double-threshold early warning mechanism, starting local pressurization purification by the comprehensive index exceeding a first-level threshold, and forming a dynamic isolation barrier by the aid of the super-second-level threshold in linkage with adjacent areas, and simulating an intervention scheme effect through a digital twin system.

title_en: Geological disaster deformation data acquisition method for Beidou inspection unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster deformation data acquisition, in particular to a geological disaster deformation data acquisition method for a Beidou inspection unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the steps of making a monitoring route in a monitoring area and interweaving the monitoring route, carrying out trend integration according to the trend of the land subsidence of adjacent unit areas, and obtaining the trend of the land subsidence of different positions of the monitoring area. According to the invention, the sedimentation trend of the corresponding monitoring area is simulated by the unit areas after mutual integration, the sedimentation trend of the corresponding monitoring area is independently simulated by the unintegrated unit areas, so that the unit area sedimentation area simulation is realized, the current geological disaster data acquisition work can be subdivided, the sedimentation trends of different positions of the whole monitoring area are divided by the simulation results and integration work of each unit area, the sedimentation trend of the whole monitoring area is fed back in a refined mode, and the accuracy of geological disaster deformation data is improved.
assignees: HUNAN ZHONGKAN BEIDOU RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and detection, in particular to a landslide early warning and monitoring method and system based on NBIOT. The method comprises the steps of collecting data including rainfall data, soil humidity data and displacement data, conducting data processing and analysis, conducting integration and time synchronization processing on the collected data, comparing the integrated data with a preset alarm threshold, triggering a local alarm mechanism when the data exceeds the preset alarm threshold, otherwise, uploading the data to a cloud, conducting cloud data processing, conducting data preprocessing and building and training a BP neural network model, conducting random initialization on weights and threshold values of the neural network, extracting historical data to serve as training sample input, conducting training on the BP neural network through a back propagation algorithm, adjusting the weights and the threshold values, adjusting network structures or parameters to meet performance requirements, and conducting landslide probability prediction through the model. According to the technical scheme, the monitoring precision and timeliness can be improved, and the early warning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Virtual reality fire-fighting exercise and training method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality fire-fighting exercise and training method and system, the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional fire scene based on a BIM model and fluid dynamics, resolving fire spreading rate and smoke concentration in real time, generating a dynamic disaster evolution model by combining explosive parameters, collecting heart rate variability and action tracks of a user through wearing equipment, calculating physiological stress indexes and equipment operation deviation degree, triggering smoke suppression, explosion delay and fire correction instructions based on correlation of fire and physiological data, generating a cooperative avoidance strategy by combining path coincidence degree and fire-fighting roles and feeding the cooperative avoidance strategy back to a fire correction module, aligning space-time data to evaluate contribution degree and cooperative influence weight of fire-fighting operation to fire suppression, outputting a multidimensional evaluation matrix, generating a three-dimensional defect thermodynamic diagram by utilizing a space-time convolution network, marking a high risk area and feeding the three-dimensional defect thermodynamic diagram back to a disaster model, and realizing self-adaptive difficulty iteration.

title_en: Security management system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a safety management system, which relates to the technical field of safety management, wherein the system comprises a safety standardization module and a safety situation module, the safety standardization module comprises a target responsibility sub-module, a institutional management sub-module, an education training sub-module, a field management sub-module, a double prevention machine sub-module, an emergency management sub-module, an accident management sub-module and a continuous improvement sub-module, and the safety situation module comprises a statistics analysis sub-module and a safety portrait sub-module. The invention comprehensively improves the safety management level of the water business industry, enhances the risk prevention and control capability, promotes the implementation of responsibility system, improves the emergency response speed, promotes continuous improvement and optimization, improves the safety consciousness and skill of staff, and solves the problems of unclear responsibility, unsmooth information, incomplete hidden trouble investigation, lack of accident tracking and correction mechanism and low digital intelligent level in the prior art by means of digitalization and intellectualization.

title_en: Construction method of composite agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring index system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring, in particular to a construction method of a composite agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring index system. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining regional agricultural component data, carrying out spatial distribution analysis to identify agricultural distribution boundaries, further defining an agricultural overlapping region, collecting historical weather disaster data, generating a weather disaster space-time sequence, identifying a correlation mode of weather and agricultural disasters, predicting composite agricultural juncture development data according to the agricultural overlapping region, identifying available resources, carrying out heterogeneous component interactive simulation, constructing an agricultural interactive effect field, deducing weather disaster absorbing capacity, finally carrying out composite agricultural disaster prediction based on the historical correlation mode and absorbing capacity, constructing a monitoring index system, and realizing system monitoring and management of the agricultural weather disasters. The invention realizes the system monitoring and evaluation of agricultural meteorological disasters and promotes the intellectualization and scientization of agricultural management.

title_en: Semantic segmentation-based rapid automatic modeling method for macroscopic evacuation network model
abstract_en: The invention provides a macroscopic evacuation network model rapid automatic modeling method based on semantic segmentation. The method can utilize the plane grating image to quickly and automatically generate a macroscopic evacuation network model and establish a corresponding topological evacuation network diagram. By comparing the results of the automatic modeling method of the macroscopic evacuation network model provided by the invention on the 3-layer building example with the analysis of the manual modeling results, the automatic modeling method provided by the invention can greatly reduce the modeling time required by the macroscopic evacuation network model to 1/150, has obvious speed advantage, can solve the problems of repeated and time-consuming manual calculation work, and can be suitable for rapid evacuation simulation of a large number of buildings and different layouts of single buildings by combining the macroscopic simulation method.

title_en: Emergency disposal measure chain coupling analysis system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency disposal measure chain coupling analysis system, which comprises a disaster model service chain construction and management module, a knowledge base construction and accident evolution diagram generation module, an accident evolution diagram real-time monitoring and dynamic deduction module, a decision suggestion module and a decision suggestion module, wherein the disaster model service chain construction and management module is used for collecting various disaster models, and is stored in a plurality of storage nodes of a model storage cluster in a scattered manner after being packaged, the knowledge base construction and accident evolution diagram generation module is used for generating an accident evolution diagram based on a pre-constructed knowledge base, the accident evolution diagram is used for representing various accident evolution processes with association relations and combined actions, the real-time monitoring and dynamic deduction module is used for collecting various data of an emergency scene of an electric power industry in real time, and is combined with the accident evolution diagram and outputs provided by various disaster models corresponding to the accidents, and the decision suggestion module is used for simulating the dynamic deduction model by utilizing a domino effect and determining optimal emergency decision suggestion information of an actual scene according to simulation results. According to the invention, multiple associated disasters can be comprehensively processed through multi-module cooperation, and complex disasters and emergency situations can be dealt with.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion ice lake intelligent identification method and system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data fusion ice lake intelligent identification method, a system and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of terrain monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining Sentinel-2 data, gradient data extracted by ALOS-DEM and NDWI data, preprocessing the gradient data and the NDWI data, dividing the gradient data and the NDWI data into a training set and a testing set, introducing a CBAM module based on ResNet-50 as a backbone network, constructing a Mask R-CNN model for target detection and segmentation of a ice lake region, performing model training by adopting a multi-task joint loss function, preprocessing the data to be detected, inputting the optimal Mask R-CNN model, and finally obtaining the recognition result of the ice lake. By combining gradient data and NDWI generated by high-resolution ALOS-DEM elevation data, the influence and misjudgment of water turbidity and mountain shadows on ice lake identification are effectively reduced, the accuracy of ice lake identification is remarkably improved, the ice lake area of a complex plateau terrain area is automatically and efficiently identified, the ice lake identification efficiency is greatly improved, and the method has great significance in predicting and preventing disasters such as glacier collapse and ice lake burst.

title_en: Heterogeneous distillation SAR target recognition method and system based on class center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a class center-based heterogeneous distillation SAR target recognition method and system, which are used for processing data comprising SAR images and heterogeneous data, constructing a heterogeneous image recognition network based on resnet-18 networks, performing supervision training on the heterogeneous image recognition network by using the heterogeneous images, wherein a supervision loss function is cross entropy loss, constructing the SAR image recognition network by using multi-scale feature fusion and a channel attention mechanism based on the heterogeneous image recognition network, performing class center distillation on the SAR image recognition network by using the SAR images, wherein the distillation loss is an MSE loss function, and inputting a test sample image into the SAR image recognition network to obtain a final recognition result. The multi-modal learning, knowledge distillation and attention mechanisms are integrated, the accuracy and the robustness of SAR target recognition are obviously improved, and the method is suitable for high-value scenes such as military reconnaissance and disaster monitoring.

title_en: Multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for island working face in complex stress area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster integrated prevention and control method for a island working face of a complex stress area, which comprises the steps of inducing crack expansion in a stress concentration area through hydraulic fracturing and deep hole blasting, weakening a top plate and reducing the area of a suspended ceiling; drilling holes for outburst prevention measures in the coal seam construction completion area, drilling holes for hole making, pressure relief and permeability increasing of construction machinery, drilling holes for penetrating layers in transportation drainage roadway construction, pumping pressure relief gas in adjacent layers of coal seams, continuously performing pressure relief extraction on the coal seam which is not mined by the bottom plate, performing pressure relief gas extraction on the adjacent layers, dividing working surfaces according to the area verification condition during extraction according to high-risk areas, buffer areas and safety areas, and performing regional prevention and control on different areas. The method solves the bottleneck technology of island working disaster prevention and control in the high-stress concentration area under the disturbance of multiple legacy coal pillars, solves the problem of gas prevention and control of the island working face in the complex stress area, effectively relieves the main contradiction of the current coal mine safety production, and solves the problem that the actually measured drilling cuttings desorption index K1 exceeds the standard during the stoping period.

title_en: Outdoor Evacuation Simulation System for Disasters and Emergencies
title_ko: 재난 및 비상 상황에서의 실외 대피 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: In a simulation system estimating an evacuation route and an evacuation time by precisely simulating movement of a vehicle and a pedestrian in a disaster and emergency situation, provided is an outdoor evacuation simulation system in a disaster and emergency situation comprising: a road network data processing module; a movement model; a movement route calculation module; an occupant attribute management and evacuation time estimation module; a pedestrian movement module; a visualization and animation output module; a disaster scenario configuration module; and a road network data processing and management module. An outdoor evacuation simulation system in a disaster and emergency situation and an evacuation time estimation method according to the present invention relate to a technical field estimating the evacuation time and visually presenting the evacuation route by utilizing a Cellular Automata theory and a Micro Simulation model to simulate movement of a vehicle and walking evacuation of a person. Precisely simulating a movement route, a speed, and a vehicle type of an individual vehicle in a unit of 1 second is possible. Analyzing a bottleneck phenomenon and a congested section specifically is possible. Enabling precise individual vehicle movement simulation while maintaining calculation efficiency even in a large-scale network is possible through Cell unit modeling based on Cellular Automata.

title_en: Landslide sliding space-time dynamic simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide sliding space-time dynamic simulation method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining a landslide influence key factor by adopting a deterministic coefficient method based on a space-time database of a preset landslide area, obtaining a landslide risk coefficient by utilizing a support vector machine model based on the landslide influence key factor, constructing a landslide sliding space-time dynamic simulation model by combining the support vector machine model, the landslide risk coefficient and a cellular automaton model of the preset landslide area, and carrying out space-time dynamic sliding simulation on a target landslide area based on the landslide sliding space-time dynamic simulation model to obtain a sliding path and a sliding range of the landslide. The landslide control system can be applied to landslide sliding simulation, can simulate disaster division and sliding characteristics of landslide under the conditions of high efficiency and accuracy, provides a new thought for landslide disaster management, plays a supporting role in landslide monitoring and early warning, and has a very wide application prospect.

title_en: GCN-MHA-GRU-based landslide displacement prediction method for black square platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide displacement data prediction, in particular to a black square table landslide displacement prediction method based on GCN-MHA-GRU. The method comprises the steps of obtaining synthetic aperture radar monitoring data of a black square platform area, extracting landslide surface deformation data of the black square platform area from the synthetic aperture radar monitoring data, carrying out decomposition processing on the landslide surface deformation data according to a satellite orbit by adopting a three-dimensional deformation decomposition method, establishing a landslide prediction model based on a graph neural network, a multi-head attention mechanism and a gating circulation unit, inputting the decomposed landslide surface deformation data into the landslide prediction model for training, and carrying out landslide displacement prediction on the black square platform area according to the trained landslide prediction model. The landslide displacement prediction model is constructed efficiently, accurately and robustly, and powerful technical support can be provided for scientific prevention and control of geological disasters.

title_en: Industrial park waterlogging monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and equipment for monitoring and early warning of waterlogging in an industrial park, which relate to the field of monitoring, forecasting and early warning of waterlogging, the equipment comprises a table body, a terminal, a cloud server and an edge end, the upper surface of the table body is provided with a non-cover organic glass frame, the rain simulator can simulate a rainfall device or receive natural rainwater above the uncovered organic glass frame, one end of the upper surface of the table body, which is close to the uncovered organic glass frame, is fixedly connected with a covered water tank, and a pipeline assembly is arranged in the uncovered organic glass frame. According to the invention, the rainfall data of each waterlogging point is extracted according to the video image data, the accuracy of the rainfall process is improved, the accuracy of waterlogging disaster forecast is improved, the monitored complete early warning process can be finished at the edge end, the influence of network disconnection and power failure under extreme weather is avoided, the influence of extreme weather and human factors is eliminated, and the forecast early warning time is effectively shortened.

title_en: Intelligent real-time generation method for building crowd evacuation emergency line diagram
abstract_en: According to the intelligent real-time generation method of the building crowd evacuation emergency line graph, firstly, building space personnel self-adaptive evacuation space-time track modeling is conducted through a building emergency evacuation model space-time track modeling method, then, calculation and analysis are conducted on evacuation tracks through a clustering method based on space-time similarity and structural similarity, the evacuation tracks are clustered according to a method of combining the two, after fine adjustment is conducted on the clustered tracks, emergency line graph design and organization are conducted, an evacuation simulation line graph is constructed, and the real track of the personnel in the system is calculated. The evacuation simulation flow diagrams of the designs reflect the real track of the personnel in the simulation system. Therefore, the management and control of the evacuation personnel flow are guided, the evacuation personnel flow is effectively controlled and induced, the crowding of the personnel flow during the emergency is avoided and relieved, the maximization of the evacuation efficiency is realized, and the economic loss and the casualties are effectively reduced.

title_en: Deepseek-based weather forecast generation method and deepseek-based weather forecast generation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather, in particular to a weather forecast generation method and system based on deepseek. The method comprises the following steps of S1, determining a weather forecast area range, obtaining historical weather forecast data and historical weather forecast query data in the weather forecast area range, classifying the historical weather forecast data according to weather disaster grades to obtain weather disaster classification results, S2, obtaining weather correction data and weather similarity data based on the historical weather forecast query data, and performing data splicing on the weather correction data and the weather disaster classification results to obtain first spliced data. The invention provides a method based on double-channel LSTM and multi-mode feature fusion, which is used for decoupling time sequence and mode features, improving the representation and generalization capability of complex data by utilizing dynamic splicing and a cross-mode attention mechanism, and enhancing training stability and prediction robustness by combining dynamic loss weights.
assignees: Henan Meteorological Observatory;FUJIAN HUAWANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal-rock mass multi-physical-field transparent analysis and disaster risk evaluation method
abstract_en: A coal-rock mass multi-physical-field transparent analysis and disaster risk evaluation method comprises the steps of collecting multiple parameters, analyzing the multiple physical fields, carrying out dynamic disaster early warning, collecting the multiple parameters, providing a data basis for inversion model construction, carrying out occurrence feature identification through an occurrence inversion model, carrying out stress field transparent analysis and seepage field transparent analysis, constructing a stress-gas coupling early warning model based on the multi-physical-field transparent analysis result, carrying out numerical simulation work such as coal seam mining, roadway tunneling and the like in combination with a mine mining production succession sequence, obtaining stress field and seepage field spatial distribution features and dynamic evolution rules aiming at a roadway and a geological area in front of the mining work surface based on a while-drilling inversion technology, obtaining a protruded starting mechanical criterion C  m , and carrying out advanced early warning of coal-rock mass dynamic disaster by using the protruded starting mechanical criterion C  m . The method can realize transparent analysis of multiple physical fields and dynamic and accurate identification of dynamic disasters of the coal and rock, and realize advanced prevention and control of dynamic disasters of the coal and rock.

title_en: Mountain disaster three-dimensional numerical simulation system and method based on WebGL
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and control, in particular to a mountain disaster three-dimensional numerical simulation system and method based on WebGL, wherein the system comprises a preprocessing module, a processing module and a processing module, wherein the preprocessing module is used for importing target area topographic data and fluid material source data, and mapping the target area topographic data into three-dimensional topography based on WebGL for visual display; and the motion module is used for simulating fluid source data in three-dimensional terrain by utilizing a pre-established landslide and detritus single-phase medium model and a landslide and detritus multiphase flow model. According to the application, the landslide detritus flow single-phase medium model and the multiphase flow model are established based on the continuous medium depth integral theory, multiple factors can be comprehensively considered, excessive stress difference generated by simplifying and neglecting key factors is avoided, so that the simulation result is closer to the actual situation, the accuracy of mountain disaster numerical simulation is greatly improved, and the method is crucial for accurately predicting the occurrence and development processes of mountain disasters and provides more reliable data support for disaster control.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU
