title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle management system, which comprises a model construction module, a high-order potential energy encoder module, a tensor coupling dynamic propagation module, a potential energy trend predictor module, a risk assessment module, a feedback adjustment module, a decision support module and a model training and optimizing module, wherein the model construction module is used for constructing a tensor potential energy evolution network model, the high-order potential energy encoder module is used for generating potential energy representation of a current life cycle stage, the tensor coupling dynamic propagation module is used for capturing time sequence and space dependency relationship and generating a hidden state tensor, the potential energy trend predictor module is used for generating a potential energy predicted value at the next moment, the risk assessment module is used for triggering risk early warning and generating a risk grade, the feedback adjustment module is used for dynamically adjusting a risk threshold and tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters, the decision support module is used for providing an emergency response and resource optimizing scheme, and the model training and optimizing module is used for optimizing tensor potential energy evolution network model parameters. According to the invention, dynamic monitoring, risk prediction and early warning of hydraulic engineering are realized through the tensor potential energy evolution network model, and the management safety and accuracy are improved.
assignees: ZHICHENG SHUCHUANG XIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Submarine tunnel cross-fault water inrush disaster early warning decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel correlation, aims to solve the problems of inaccurate water inrush identification, lack of interpretability and the like of a high-risk scene of a conventional submarine tunnel crossing fault zone, provides a method and a system for pre-warning water inrush disaster of the submarine tunnel crossing fault zone, constructs a attention mechanism and Bayesian inference combined modeling path, realizes full-flow response control of input features from weighting, prediction and interpretation, adopts an interpretable model to analyze driving force, thereby providing a transparent and credible risk assessment result, combines key driving force in multi-source heterogeneous data, and comprehensively realizes real-time identification and pre-warning of the water inrush disaster risk of the tunnel by numerical simulation, effectively improves the identification accuracy of the water inrush risk and the perfection of the pre-warning mechanism in the tunnel construction process, and has important engineering application value.

title_en: Disaster simulation system and method for tunnel and ballast bed interface stripping under complex environment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of underground engineering, and relates to a disaster simulation system and a disaster simulation method for tunnel and ballast interface stripping under a complex environment, wherein the disaster simulation system comprises a simulation box, an excitation loading system, a hydraulic loading system, an optical monitoring system, a digital image system, a test acquisition system and a data processing system; transparent parts are arranged on two side walls of the simulation box, a tunnel model is arranged in the simulation box, a ballast bed is paved on the tunnel model, water filling ports are formed in the other two side walls of the simulation box, a water outlet is formed in the bottom of the simulation box, an excitation loading system is arranged at the ballast bed, a water pressure loading system is connected with the ballast bed through a pipeline, an optical monitoring system and a digital image system are arranged outside the simulation box, a test acquisition system is in communication connection with the ballast bed, and a data processing system is in communication connection with the test acquisition system. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, and effectively improves the efficiency and accuracy of the simulation monitoring of the tunnel and the ballast bed load.

title_en: Multi-disaster risk early warning method and equipment for overhead transmission line based on analysis of disaster-pregnancy mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for early warning multiple disasters of an overhead power transmission line based on disaster pregnancy mechanism analysis, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning of power transmission lines. According to the method, dynamic and accurate multi-disaster early warning of the overhead transmission line is realized by constructing a disaster-tolerant mechanism model, quantifying disaster coupling effect, monte Carlo simulation and comprehensive risk assessment.

title_en: Mud-rock flow multi-field coupling simulation device and method based on real-time regulation and control of solid-phase concentration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mud-rock flow multi-field coupling simulation device and method based on real-time regulation and control of solid-phase concentration, comprising a model box system, a power-driven hydraulic lifting platform and a mud-rock flow channel, wherein the model box system comprises a source region, a circulation region and a stacking region from top to bottom, and the circulation region is provided with a stress sensing layer; the multi-field coupling triggering system comprises a steel frame, a variable particle size rainfall module, a pulse dam break device and a material replenishing unit, a multi-dimensional monitoring system, an intelligent control system and a data fusion and visualization module, wherein the multi-dimensional monitoring system comprises a variable parameter sensor array and a three-dimensional structure scanning unit, and the intelligent control system comprises an upper computer, a multi-field cooperative control module, a solid phase concentration self-adaption module and a data fusion and visualization module. The invention solves the technical problems of insufficient rheological control capability and low multi-field coupling precision of the traditional device, and provides a high-precision experimental platform for the research of the debris flow disaster mechanism, the recurrence of disaster process and the verification of prevention and control technology.

title_en: Flood simulation method and device based on urban infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood simulation method and a flood simulation device based on urban infrastructure, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting street view images of cities, wherein the street view images comprise street view data obtained by collecting the infrastructure of different cities in different angles and different times; the method comprises the steps of classifying street view data according to types of infrastructures, extracting to obtain urban infrastructure data, fusing the infrastructure data with urban topography data to obtain urban fused topography data, dividing water collecting areas of cities based on the fused topography data, extracting water system data, building a flood simulation model based on urban infrastructure according to the water system data, fully considering influences of the infrastructures such as urban street networks, wall systems and buildings on urban flood processes, improving simulation precision of urban storm flood models, and reducing urban flood disasters.
assignees: URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN INST CO LTD OF SHENZHEN

title_en: Bridge usability and travelling comfort evaluation method after explosion load
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge service performance and travelling comfort assessment method after explosion load action, which comprises the steps of establishing a finite element model of a bridge under the explosion action, extracting the residual area of a bridge section after explosion and the elevation of a bridge deck after explosion, calculating the damage degree of the bridge section and the distribution of the level of bridge deck irregularity, assessing the passing capacity of the bridge according to the distribution, establishing an axle coupling model after explosion by importing a result file of a bridge component after explosion for the bridge which can still be used, forming the irregularity after explosion, extracting and calculating the vertical acceleration of a vehicle after analysis, and assessing the travelling comfort of the bridge after calculation of the root mean square value of the acceleration. According to the invention, through the coupling evaluation of the damage degree and the bridge deck irregularity grade, the composite influence of explosion on the bridge safety and the driving comfort is comprehensively quantized, the misjudgment risk caused by one-sided evaluation is avoided, meanwhile, the economic cost is greatly reduced through a simulation analysis calculation mode, and the safety risk of post-disaster site survey is avoided.

title_en: High-gas strong-mine-pressure composite dynamic disaster experimental device
abstract_en: The application relates to a high-gas strong-mine-pressure composite dynamic disaster experimental device, which relates to the technical field of indoor experimental equipment and comprises an experimental box and an experimental assembly, wherein a sample is arranged in the experimental box, the experimental assembly comprises a gas control part and an experimental part, the gas control part is arranged on the experimental box and is used for simulating gas pressure in the experimental box, and the experimental part is arranged on the experimental box and is used for performing pressure detection experiments on the sample. The application has the effect of improving the accuracy of the experimental result.
assignees: UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL;CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD;LIAONING GEOLOGY ENG VOCATIONAL COLLEGE

title_en: Embedded part for pipeline anti-seismic bracket
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an embedded part for a pipeline anti-seismic bracket, which comprises a reinforcing mechanism, wherein the reinforcing mechanism comprises an embedded body, two L-shaped plates arranged on one side of the embedded body, two hollow threaded drill rods vertically penetrating through the L-shaped plates, a plurality of glue outlet holes formed in the hollow threaded drill rods and a frame body connected with the L-shaped plates. According to the utility model, two L-shaped plates are inserted into a wall body, then the hollow threaded drill rod is rotated through an opening, so that the hollow threaded drill rod is nailed into the wall body, then an external foaming agent is injected into the hollow threaded drill rod, when the hollow threaded drill rod is filled with foaming glue, the foaming glue is discharged from a glue outlet hole, then the hollow threaded drill rod is filled between the L-shaped plates and the wall body, and then the frame body is filled with the foaming glue, so that the L-shaped plates and the wall body are filled, the L-shaped plates are not easy to loosen, the wall-mounting firmness of the embedded body is improved, and the hollow threaded drill rod is better applied to natural disasters such as earthquakes.
assignees: JIANGSU HUIPENG COMPLETE EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous crowd evacuation model integrating multidimensional panic emotion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous crowd evacuation model integrating multidimensional panic emotion characteristics in the technical field of crowd evacuation dynamics, which comprises a multidimensional panic emotion analysis unit and an improved social force model unit, wherein the multidimensional panic emotion analysis unit is used for quantifying panic emotion influences of three dimensions of environmental stress, individual characteristics and group effects, generating dynamic multidimensional emotion pressure factors, the improved social force model unit is used for adjusting expected speeds of heterogeneous individuals based on the multidimensional emotion pressure factors, realizing dynamic simulation of crowd evacuation behaviors, and dynamically optimizing evacuation paths and group cooperation strategies based on the real-time panic pressure factors by a dynamic adjustment mechanism.
assignees: UNIV CHANGCHUN SCIENCE & TECH;INSTITUTE OF SCIENT AND TECHNICAL INFORMATION OF JILIN PROVINCE

title_en: Geological disaster prediction method based on reinforcement learning and GRU
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological engineering, in particular to a geological disaster prediction method based on reinforcement learning and GRU. The method can effectively optimize the weight parameters and the bias parameters in the model by applying the Adam optimizer, thereby achieving the aim of minimizing the loss, and simultaneously, an effective model can be obtained by training the model, and the capability of the model is evaluated by using the models so as to be compared with other models.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method, system, equipment and medium with multiple spatial scales
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent reinforcement learning method, system, equipment and medium with multiple spatial scales, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting each micro-grid in a distributed new energy power system as an agent, setting the new energy power system as a distributed power grid agent at the same time, constructing a decentralised part observable Markov decision process, designing a strategy network and a value network based on the decentralised part observable Markov decision process, and training to obtain an optimal strategy of each agent by adopting the multi-agent reinforcement learning method and an experience playback technology based on the decentralised part observable Markov decision process and the design of the strategy network and the value network. Therefore, the exponential reduction of the control space dimension is realized, the dimension disaster is avoided, the multi-agent reinforcement learning convergence speed is accelerated, and the algorithm performance is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Typhoon and landslide disaster coupled high-voltage tower facility risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of application of computational fluid dynamics, in particular to a high-voltage tower facility risk assessment method for typhoons and landslide disaster coupling. The method has the beneficial effects that disaster dangers of a plurality of specific facilities in the area can be rapidly analyzed, and the simulation calculation result is closer to the real data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Gas fire safety inspection and optimization system based on simulated annealing algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas fire safety inspection and optimization system based on a simulated annealing algorithm, which comprises a risk assessment module, a hidden danger detection module, an optimization scheduling module and a visual management module. The system is coupled with an isolated forest algorithm and a random forest optimization simulated annealing algorithm to optimize a gas fire control inspection path and a hidden danger investigation strategy, so that inspection efficiency and coverage rate are improved. The operation data of the gas equipment are acquired in real time through the sensor of the Internet of things, potential hidden dangers are accurately positioned by combining an image recognition technology, and the hidden danger level is quantitatively analyzed by utilizing the risk assessment model. The optimal scheduling module dynamically adjusts the allocation of the checking tasks based on the simulated annealing algorithm, and ensures that the resource utilization is maximized and the emergency response time is minimized. The visual management module displays the detection result and the optimization strategy and provides decision support for management personnel. The system can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of gas fire safety inspection, reduce the possibility of hidden danger occurrence and ensure public safety.
assignees: Huarun nanjing municipal design co ltd

title_en: Landslide movement simulation method and system considering influence of particle crushing on excess pore water pressure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide movement simulation method and system considering the influence of particle crushing on excess pore water pressure, comprising the following steps of 1) calculating SPH particle dimensionless crushing potential energy index, 2) calculating SPH particle crushing index, 3) calculating SPH particle crushing potential energy, and 4) calculating the excess pore water pressure of the SPH particles. According to the landslide movement simulation method considering the influence of particle crushing on the excess pore water pressure, the effective calculation of the excess pore water pressure generated due to the influence of particle crushing in the movement process of landslide and debris flow is realized, a powerful support is provided for analysis of a landslide and debris flow solid-liquid coupling mechanism, the deviation of the pre-estimated excess pore water pressure in the landslide and debris flow caused by the influence of non-considered particle crushing can be solved, and the simulation effect on the disaster mobility is improved.

title_en: Escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape guiding scheme design, in particular to an escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment. Aiming at the defects of path planning, survivor positioning and cutting, dynamic risk response lag and the like in the traditional rescue, vital signs are detected through multi-source sensor fusion, and an optimal rescue path is generated in millisecond-level time by combining real-time coupling simulation of a stress field, a toxic gas diffusion field and a fire disaster thermal flow field of a building structure. The system automatically classifies priorities after detecting the vital body signals, supports the through-wall mode to quickly approach to high-risk survivors, and synchronously optimizes the multi-objective traversal sequence. The guiding path is dynamically projected to a visual field interface of the rescue personnel through the AR equipment, and the heartbeat frequency domain visualization and the risk chromaticity warning are fused. The scheme breaks through the bottleneck of artificial experience decision making, realizes closed loop intelligent response from physical sign perception to path execution, and greatly improves rescue timeliness, target hit rate and action safety in complex disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO JUNHAI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Quantification method and system for planning toughness improvement contribution before disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantification method and a quantification system for planning toughness improvement contribution before power distribution network disaster, which belong to the technical field of analysis of toughness improvement effectiveness of power distribution network, and the method comprises the steps of generating various disaster scenes through Latin hypercube sampling, and generating a pre-disaster reinforcement scheme of reinforcement grade based on topological structures of the power distribution network and a traffic network; the method comprises the steps of calculating fault probabilities of electric lines and traffic roads under different scenes according to disaster scene parameters to generate a fault state set, optimizing a repair team path and a repair time sequence through a post-disaster repair scheduling model, calculating post-disaster accumulated disaster damage cost, inputting data into XGBoost for training, and analyzing toughness contribution of each reinforcement action by using a SHAP method according to reinforcement planning conditions and full link cost. The method can accurately identify the reinforcement priority of the key lines in the power distribution network and the traffic network, improves the fineness and the interpretability of the pre-disaster resource allocation, can guide the accurate release of limited pre-disaster resources, and has practicability and popularization significance.

title_en: Fluid-evacuation multi-mode simulation method and system for preventing and controlling harmful gas in high and large personnel-intensive space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fluid-evacuation multi-mode simulation method and system for preventing and controlling harmful gases in a high and large personnel space, which relate to the technical field of fluid dynamics and comprise the steps of constructing a fluid simulation model based on a fluid simulation tool, quantifying the diffusion speed and range of the harmful gases to obtain a three-dimensional space-time evolution rule, constructing an evacuation simulation model by utilizing a AnyLogic tool, dynamically generating personnel evacuation paths and time, realizing real-time data interaction of Star-CCM+ and AnyLogic by Java scripts, and dynamically adjusting evacuation strategies. The method realizes millisecond-level dynamic coupling of harmful gas diffusion and personnel evacuation, forms closed-loop feedback through real-time data interaction, adopts a high-precision modeling technology, accurately simulates building bypass effect and personnel behavior response, supports parameterized fast switching, provides quantitative decision support, and improves simulation precision and response speed.

title_en: Icing thickness growth simulation method, equipment and medium based on typical icing form of high-altitude area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power transmission lines and provides a method, equipment and medium for simulating ice coating thickness increase based on a typical ice coating form of a high-altitude area. The ice coating thickness growth simulation method fully considers the ice coating shape change in the ice coating growth process of the high altitude area, and is more consistent with the actual ice coating growth, and the simulation precision is higher.
assignees: SOUTHWEST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling system for power grid safety guarantee of multi-source data analysis, which comprises an air-ground sensing layer, a multi-source data fusion engine, an extreme weather decision closed loop module, a power grid immune engine and an intelligent execution terminal, wherein the air-ground sensing layer is used for collecting meteorological data, equipment state data and power grid operation data, the multi-source data fusion engine is used for carrying out space-time alignment and feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a power grid panoramic state matrix, the extreme weather decision closed loop module is used for deducing a disaster propagation path through federal learning based on the power grid panoramic state matrix and outputting a scheduling control instruction, the power grid immune engine is used for receiving the power grid panoramic state matrix, simulating a hidden fault chain through a digital twin body and dynamically generating a protection device correction strategy, and the intelligent execution terminal is used for executing the scheduling control instruction and the protection device correction strategy and feeding back a physical power grid state to the digital twin body. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and an intelligent algorithm, panoramic sensing, disaster pre-judgment, dynamic protection and strategy optimization of the power grid are realized, and the safety guarantee capability is improved.
assignees: GUONENG CHANGZHOU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system risk assessment method aiming at extreme weather disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system risk assessment method aiming at extreme weather disasters, which comprises the following steps of A, estimating short-time rainfall intensity according to space-time distribution of occurrence frequency of the extreme storm weather disasters, B, respectively constructing fault probability models of power distribution equipment in storms, floods and debris flows in extreme weather and obtaining comprehensive fault probability models, C, simulating node states of the power distribution network at different moments by using a state sampling method, constructing a power distribution system risk assessment index, and providing power distribution system operation risk indexes from two aspects of elements and systems by establishing the comprehensive time-varying fault probability model of the power distribution system, so that the risk prevention capability of the power distribution system facing the extreme weather disasters is improved, and the capability of accurately identifying fragile rings and emergency response capability of the power distribution system are improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic simulation system for dam break flood evolution process of reservoir based on topography factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic simulation system for a dam break flood evolution process of a reservoir based on a topography factor, which comprises the following components: dam break flood foundation database, important index amount calculator, flood transit water level calculation model, disaster area inversion model and time sequence visualization tool. The method fully utilizes the topographic information of the digital elevation model, calculates and obtains important index quantity and other result data based on dam body, annual water level and other conventional parameters, establishes a flood transit water level calculation model, obtains regional submerged water level, divides the topographic data through submerged water level elevation to obtain a flood submerged area, carries out rapid statistics based on house and other ground object data, creates a time axis, carries out simulation presentation on the flood water level, submerged range, submerged path and other information according to the time axis, realizes dynamic simulation of dam-break flood, and forms a flood submerged area dynamic evolution simulation display tool.

title_en: Coal body pressure relief drilling arrangement method based on ground stress direction of working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal body pressure relief drilling arrangement method based on a working face ground stress direction, which comprises the steps of arranging a microseismic monitoring system on a working face, collecting microseismic event data of the working face in real time, triggering short-term stress field inversion when the energy of a microseismic event exceeds a preset energy threshold value, inverting the stress field near the working face, determining the directions of maximum horizontal compressive stress and minimum vertical tensile stress, determining the arrangement direction of drilling holes according to the direction of the maximum horizontal compressive stress, constructing a plurality of drilling holes according to the arrangement direction of the drilling holes, releasing pressure on the coal body, monitoring the stress change of the working face in real time through the microseismic monitoring system, and dynamically adjusting the arrangement scheme of the drilling holes according to the monitoring result. The method can obviously reduce the risk of earthquake activities, improve the pressure relief effect and the capability of preventing coal and rock dynamic disasters, improve the precision and efficiency of stress field inversion, enhance the safety and efficiency of coal mining, and reduce the resource waste and the environmental impact.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING;YANMEI HEZE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent prediction method for transient temperature field of high-ground-temperature tunnel based on heat transfer-hard boundary coupling neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent prediction method of a transient temperature field of a high-ground-temperature tunnel based on a heat transfer-hard boundary coupling neural network, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of the high-ground-temperature tunnel, the invention constructs a physical heat transfer equation by constructing a high-ground-temperature heat transfer model of the tunnel and setting basic conditions, sets boundary conditions and performs ventilation simulation at the same time, acquires a data set with a tag and a data set without the tag, inputs the data set into the neural network model for training, meanwhile, hard boundary constraint is set, and the neural network model is optimized through a multitask loss function based on a physical heat transfer equation, a labeled data set and initial conditions to obtain the model.

title_en: Water conservancy reservoir group joint scheduling optimizing system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based water conservancy reservoir group joint scheduling optimization system which comprises a real-time data acquisition and preprocessing module, a reservoir group digital twin modeling module, a future state prediction module, a joint scheduling optimization module, an adaptive memory mechanism management module, an execution and dynamic adjustment module, an emergency response module and a feedback and adaptive optimization module, wherein the real-time data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for acquiring and processing meteorological data, the reservoir group digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a dynamic digital twin reservoir group simulation model, the future state prediction module is used for predicting the future state change trend of a reservoir group, the joint scheduling optimization module is used for optimizing a multi-target joint scheduling scheme, the adaptive memory mechanism management module is used for maintaining an excellent scheduling strategy memory and performing intelligent disturbance adjustment, the execution and dynamic adjustment module is used for executing a scheduling scheme and dynamically correcting the scheduling scheme, and the emergency response module is used for generating an emergency scheduling scheme and the feedback and adaptive optimization module is used for feeding back a real-time execution result to dynamically correct the twin model. The invention realizes real-time optimization and intelligent emergency response of the reservoir group dispatching system, and remarkably improves dispatching efficiency and system stability.
assignees: HUBEI TONGDA SHUKE TECH CO LTD;HUBEI WATER RESOURCES RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Building structure intelligent management method and system based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building structure intelligent management method based on BIM, which comprises the following steps of dynamic monitoring factor mining and multi-modal sensing, namely collecting weather hydrology, geological conditions, micro environments and natural disaster historical data, step two, namely performing virtual-real fusion dynamic analysis driven by a nerve operator, namely converting and mapping the collected data format into a BIM model, integrating a virtual-real synchronous engine, pre-training a Fourier nerve operator through real-time displacement and strain data reverse calibration model boundary conditions in a construction stage, establishing a direct mapping relation between external load and structure response, step three, namely performing multi-modal data cooperation and hierarchical authority interaction, namely forming a multi-dimensional feature matrix through time stamp and space coordinate association, step four, namely performing multi-modal graph convolutional network damage identification, namely extracting damage sensitive features through dynamic association among nodes of a self-adaptive graph convolutional layer, and step five, performing dynamic life early warning of digital twin driving, namely predicting residual service life of a structure.
assignees: UNIV SHAOYANG;HUNAN NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY INST

title_en: Modular and multifunctional karst collapse physical simulation experiment platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a modular and multifunctional karst collapse physical simulation experiment platform which comprises a rigid frame, a bearing device, a moving device, a loading device, a lifting device, a pile foundation construction dynamic load simulation device, a ground driving dynamic load simulation device, a rainfall simulation device, a computer vision monitoring device, a groundwater pumping and drainage simulation device and a groundwater space excavation disturbance simulation device. The mobile device is arranged on the bearing device, the lifting device, the loading device and the pile foundation construction dynamic load simulation device are arranged on the mobile device, the driving dynamic load simulation device is connected with the traction device of the mobile trolley, and the camera shooting monitoring device and the rainfall simulation device are arranged on the rigid frame through the support. The invention fully considers the key disaster-causing conditions in urban environment, has wide coverage of working condition scenes and strong applicability, adopts modularized design as a whole, can flexibly load each module according to the requirements, can simulate the real environment more truly, and can reproduce the disaster evolution process of ground subsidence.

title_en: Intelligent campus simulation system based on multi-agent dynamic interaction and reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent campus simulation system based on multi-agent dynamic interaction and reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of cooperation and interaction of distributed agents. The disaster scene generation system comprises a multi-agent basic simulation platform, an agent behavior module, a group influence algorithm module and a disaster scene generation module. The multi-agent basic simulation platform simulates a campus environment and provides real-time environment data for the agent behavior module through the data interface, so that agents such as students, teachers and the like are driven to operate according to preset behavior logic. And simultaneously transmitting the positions of the intelligent agents and authority role authority levels to a group influence algorithm module, calculating the behavior offset in real time by the group influence algorithm module, feeding back an offset instruction to the behavior module and correcting the target. Building structure parameters and various data are provided for the disaster generation module to dynamically generate a disaster model, meanwhile, a PPO algorithm is called to combine various statistical data to optimize a reward function, and finally, an evacuation path is optimized.

title_en: Cooperative control method for distributed nodes and power grid through full-dimensional perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative control method of a distributed node and a power grid of full-dimensional perception, and relates to the technical field of power grid control. The method is based on innovative means such as a full-dimensional sensing system, a layered hybrid management and control architecture, combination of an improved genetic algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, digital twin simulation verification, TSN technology, disaster recovery mechanism and the like, and the power grid state is monitored in real time by deploying multi-dimensional sensing equipment, the layered hybrid management and control architecture is constructed to achieve global strategy formulation and local rapid regulation, the improved genetic algorithm and the deep reinforcement learning are used for multi-objective optimization, the digital twin simulation verification regulation scheme is introduced, the TSN technology is adopted to ensure hard and real-time transmission of key data, the disaster recovery mechanism and standardized interfaces are designed to improve the reliability and compatibility of the system, and the problems that in the prior art, the data confidence assessment is insufficient, the communication mechanism is imperfect, the cloud server is excessively dependent, the multi-objective optimization effect is poor and the like are effectively solved.

title_en: Disaster-causing structure earthquake advanced detection device and method for stopping drilling along with hole
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-causing structure earthquake advanced detection device and method for stopping drilling along with a hole, wherein a hollow rod body is formed into a double-layer structure by an inner pipe and an outer pipe, and an annular channel between the inner pipe and the outer pipe is used as a first water injection channel; the shock absorber is arranged in the inner pipe and far away from the drill bit and used for placing the node type seismograph, a second water injection channel is arranged on the shock absorber, the hydraulic pressurizing system is used for injecting high-pressure water into the inner pipe, when water is injected through the second water injection channel, the piston can be pushed to move so that the powerful spring deforms to increase elasticity, and then the metal impact block is driven to rapidly move so as to impact the drill bit to generate seismic waves, and when water is injected through the first water injection channel, the powerful spring, the metal impact block and the piston can be reset. The mode of carrying out seismic detection while drilling realizes the detection capability of the front disaster-causing structure while drilling under the condition of adapting to the drilling seismic construction environment, and has the advantages of long distance, large range and high precision.

title_en: Multi-mode simulation-based harmful gas prevention and control partition optimization method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for optimizing harmful gas prevention and control subareas based on multi-mode simulation, which relate to the technical field of emergency prevention and control and building environment safety and comprise the steps of constructing a harmful gas diffusion model based on Star-CCM+ and outputting harmful gas concentration distribution data in real time; and AnyLogic, establishing a personnel evacuation model to obtain personnel evacuation paths and time when the harmful gas is diffused, and generating a partition rule according to the double-model coupling result. Compared with the traditional static partition design, the dynamic partition can adjust the partition boundary in real time according to the concentration gradient of the harmful gas, the moving path of the personnel and the topological structure of the building space, has high suitability, constructs a parameterized configuration module, supports the switching of physical parameters of the harmful gas and the topological structure of the building as required, and can quickly generate an emergency plan matched with a specific scene.

title_en: Seismic disaster scenario construction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of seismic disaster scenario construction, and discloses a seismic disaster scenario construction method based on big data, which comprises the following specific steps: the first step is multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and preprocessing ground structure data acquisition, namely acquiring spatial distribution characteristics of urban building groups by utilizing a multi-platform remote sensing technology. The three-dimensional coupling model of the underground pipe network and the ground building is built by integrating multi-source data, the defect of isolated analysis of the ground and underground systems in the traditional method is overcome, synchronous simulation of dynamic association process of pipe network rupture and building damage is realized, the additional influence of pipe network failure on the stability of a building foundation and the linkage effect of soil erosion caused by leakage fluid are accurately analyzed, meanwhile, the space-time association rule of pipe network rupture events and multiple types of secondary disasters such as building fire and fire fighting failure is built, the risk of functional paralysis of building groups and the disaster diffusion range under different damage degrees are dynamically predicted, and the disaster evolution path is displayed in real time through a visual platform.

title_en: Emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on complex network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency response, and particularly discloses an emergency response organization toughness evaluation method and system based on a complex network. The method comprises the steps of constructing an organization relation matrix according to actual response data and emergency plan data to establish relations and interaction mechanisms among all main bodies in an emergency response process, constructing four stages of organizing networks of a pre-disaster plan, an emergency rescue, a recovery reconstruction and a post-disaster plan according to the organization relation matrix, evaluating node importance, evaluating toughness of network organization representing emergency response by simulating network operation conditions under a single attack strategy, coupling multiple network attack strategies by utilizing an entropy weight method, simulating different high-risk scenes, obtaining weights of the attack strategies by calculating information entropy, evaluating network efficiency under multiple attack scenes, and obtaining overall toughness level of the emergency response organization in all stages. The invention can clearly reflect the emergency response capability and the recovery capability of the organization in different stages.

title_en: Beidou deformation prediction method, device, equipment and medium applicable to small sample data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Beidou high-precision deformation monitoring, in particular to a Beidou deformation prediction method, a Beidou high-precision deformation prediction device, beidou deformation prediction equipment and a Beidou medium suitable for small sample data, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a target small sample data set to obtain a preprocessed training set and a preprocessed testing set, wherein the target small sample data set comprises original Beidou deformation data at the first m moments and original Beidou deformation data at the current moment; training a pre-constructed transformation-BiLSTM fusion deformation prediction model by using the pre-processed training set to obtain a final deformation prediction model, and inputting the pre-processed test set into the final deformation prediction model to generate predicted Beidou deformation data. Therefore, the problems that when the sample size is small, the existing deformation prediction model is difficult to fully capture the complex deformation rule in the monitoring data, the prediction accuracy is low, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning are affected are solved.

title_en: Geological survey data wisdom cloud management analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological survey data intelligent cloud management analysis system which comprises a data access module, a data management and integration module, a data processing module and an intelligent analysis module, wherein the data access module is responsible for supporting automatic or manual introduction of geological survey data from various sources, the data management and integration module is used for receiving data transmitted from a data acquisition and uploading module and carrying out version control to integrate the data, the data processing module is responsible for data cleaning, format conversion and normalization processing and introducing an antagonism training technology to generate an antagonism sample, the intelligent analysis module is used for constructing a prediction model, modeling time series geological data by utilizing LSTM, capturing long-term dependency in the data, identifying geological change trend, inputting the output of LSTM as a characteristic into an SVM classifier, classifying or carrying out regression prediction on geological structures, and generating synthesized data similar to real data but with more amounts by simulating geological processes and disaster generation mechanisms, and is used for training the prediction model.
assignees: SHAANXI MINERAL GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER SHAANXI ANCIENT BIOLOGICAL STONE PROTECTION RES CENTER

title_en: Goods expiration early warning method and system based on supply chain management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of a commodity in a temporary period based on a supply chain management system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional dynamic feature vector by acquiring key features of the commodity in the supply chain system, carrying out standardized processing on the multidimensional dynamic feature vector, and then encoding the multidimensional dynamic feature vector into qubits; the method comprises the steps of constructing an energy function by utilizing a quantum-element model, solving and screening a candidate solution set through a quantum annealing algorithm to generate an early warning threshold value of the temporary period of goods, applying the threshold value to a lightweight neural network model, realizing model switching through loss function comparison, reducing calculation cost, avoiding dimension disasters through feature dimension reduction and selection, reducing model training complexity, improving real-time response capability, and meanwhile, dynamically optimizing model parameters to enhance generalization performance, adapting to market environment changes, thereby reducing the temporary period risk of goods, reducing inventory loss and improving economic benefit and market competitiveness of enterprises.
assignees: NANJING MUSHU HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on chaotic annealing ant colony
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent decision method for blocking-resistant aging emergency material transportation toughness based on a chaotic annealing ant colony, and relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency scheduling and optimization. The method comprises the steps of firstly extracting scene data and converting the scene data into model parameters, secondly constructing a mathematical model with optimized survivability, thirdly initializing algorithm parameters and generating an initial path, fourthly dynamically adjusting the temperature and the volatilization rate of the pheromone, fifthly generating an anti-blocking perception path and implementing bypass restoration, sixthly updating the pheromone distribution based on an annealing criterion, and seventhly locking a key path and outputting an optimal transportation scheme. The method can ensure the timely delivery of materials in the complex road network blocking and sudden demand scene, improves the timeliness and toughness of the emergency transportation system through a chaotic annealing mechanism and an anti-blocking simulation technology, can be widely applied to the fields of natural disaster rescue, public health event response and the like, and provides scientific basis for emergency decision.

title_en: Construction area traffic flow guiding and speed cooperative control system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of intelligent transportation, and particularly relates to a traffic flow guiding and speed cooperative control system in a construction area, which realizes accurate control of traffic flow through cooperative operation of a region sensing module, a distributed guiding module, a communication module and an emergency response module, wherein the region sensing module is based on a three-dimensional modeling and digital twin technology, and is used for fusing real-time traffic flow, vehicle state and environment data to construct a three-dimensional simulation space of a target region, the distributed guiding module is used for establishing a drainage control model by using a distributed reinforcement learning algorithm, combining a three-level communication node of a vehicle-road-cloud, dynamically optimizing a sub-area congestion regulation strategy and real-time adjusting vehicle acceleration and speed, and the emergency response module is used for quickly generating an emergency instruction and feeding back to the guiding model by using an anomaly analysis algorithm and a strategy library to solve an emergency anomaly event.

title_en: Dam break flood emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on improved NSGA-III
abstract_en: According to the dam-break flood emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on the improved NSGA-III, dam-break flood simulation, evacuation point and refuge point selection, multi-objective optimization and heuristic strategies are fused, efficient evacuation path optimization for people with different priorities can be achieved under the extreme dam-break scene, the overall evacuation efficiency and the priority are improved, and an evacuation optimization model adapting to the spatial distribution characteristics of flood risks is constructed by carrying out two-dimensional unsteady flow dam-break simulation in HEC-RAS and combining with scientific selection and priority division of the evacuation point and the refuge point by an ArcGIS Pro platform.

title_en: Relay protection setting method, system, equipment and medium for power grid regulation and control integrated training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a relay protection setting method, a relay protection setting system, relay protection setting equipment and relay protection setting media for a power grid regulation and control integrated training system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid running state parameters and new energy output, and fusing the power grid running state parameters and the new energy output to obtain first data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a neural network model by taking first data as input data, introducing a loss function, training the neural network model to obtain a first neural network model, deploying and simulating the first neural network model in real time, calculating a setting value according to an output relay protection setting constraint condition to obtain a first setting value, deploying the first setting value in a relay protection device, helping a regulator to master a setting method under a complex working condition, and improving emergency response capability.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and full-flow simulation optimizing system for central control system of offshore oil platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of central control platforms, and particularly relates to an intelligent monitoring and full-flow simulation optimizing system of an offshore oil platform central control system, which comprises an offshore oil platform central control system, wherein an intelligent monitoring platform and a full-flow simulation optimizing platform are arranged in the offshore oil platform central control system, and an abnormal history and analysis module, a fault pre-judging and optimizing module and an unmanned inspection integrated module are arranged in the intelligent monitoring platform; the intelligent instrument desk account system is characterized in that a full-flow simulation optimizing module and an intelligent instrument desk account module are arranged in the full-flow simulation optimizing platform, the intelligent instrument desk account system further comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a cabin which are arranged in a high-risk area corresponding to the offshore oil platform, and the unmanned aerial vehicle and the cabin are designed by adopting an anti-corrosion machine body. The system has a multi-level emergency response mechanism and extreme working condition coping capability, adopts full-flow simulation optimization, intelligent inspection and predictive maintenance, and has a multi-mode data fusion architecture and an open platform expansion.

title_en: Forest town juncture building external fire test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest town border area building external fire test device and a test method, wherein the device comprises a combustion system, a blowing system, an ignition system water collecting system, a measuring system and a data acquisition system, wherein the blowing system, the ignition system water collecting system, the measuring system and the data acquisition system are arranged on one side of the combustion system, the combustion system is of an overall building structure, the blowing system is used for simulating wind power to blow the combustion system, the ignition system is used for guaranteeing ignition and ignition conditions, the water collecting system is positioned below the combustion system and is used for collecting water, the measuring system is used for measuring temperature, heat radiation and size, the combustion system is further provided with a fire extinguishing system, the fire extinguishing system is used for testing fire extinguishing efficiency, and the data acquisition system is respectively connected to the blowing system, the fire extinguishing system and the measuring system in a signal mode. The device and the method for testing the fire disaster outside the building in the forest and town boundary area can spray and cool the outside of the building facilities, ensure that combustible materials related to the building outside facilities can not be ignited within a certain time, and realize the purpose of cooling and protecting the fire disaster.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Landslide monitoring and early warning method and system based on aerospace earthquake integration
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide monitoring and early warning method based on aerospace and earthquake integration, and belongs to the technical field of landslide disaster monitoring. The air-day-ground-earthquake monitoring data are integrated to cover the multidimensional parameters such as ground surface deformation, terrain change, internal strain, crack expansion, rainfall intensity, microseismic activity and the like, so that the limitation of a single monitoring means is solved, and a space-time complementary three-dimensional monitoring system is formed. And setting an early warning response rule according to the data analysis processing result, constructing an early warning model by combining an optimal weighted random forest method and a comprehensive scoring model through a multi-source data fusion technology, realizing real-time evaluation and early warning grade judgment of landslide risk, and realizing visual display of monitoring data. Iterative training is carried out on the model by introducing reward and punishment factors, and weight distribution of different data sources is dynamically adjusted, so that the early warning model has self-adaptive capacity, early warning requirements of long-term slow deformation and short-term accelerated deformation are considered, and the early warning accuracy of the model is improved.
assignees: DATANG HYDROPOWER SCIENCE & TECH RES INST CO LTD;CHINA DATANG CORP SCI & TECH RES INST CO LTD;CHINA DATANG GROUP SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD HYDROPOWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Geological disaster risk evaluation method, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk evaluation method, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of dividing an evaluated area into a source domain and a target domain according to the density degree of geological environment data, determining cross-regional sharing characteristics, performing dimension reduction and noise removal optimization to obtain an optimized characteristic set, constructing a domain countermeasure neural network containing a gradient inversion layer, pre-training based on the source domain optimized characteristic set to obtain a source domain pre-training model, reversing gradient directions through the gradient inversion layer in the countermeasure training, reducing characteristic distribution differences of the source domain and the target domain to obtain a cross-regional adaptation model, performing data expansion processing on the target domain optimized characteristic set by using the model to obtain target domain expansion data, and finally performing geological disaster risk evaluation according to the target domain expansion data to obtain a geological disaster risk evaluation result of the target domain. The method and the device can solve the problem of insufficient evaluation precision caused by insufficient data quantity in the data scarcity area.

title_en: Method and system for identifying and tracking radar echoes with different intensities based on computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recognition and track tracking system of radar echoes with different intensities based on computer vision, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological data analysis and processing. The method comprises the steps of firstly acquiring weather image data through a weather radar to obtain weather radar echo pictures of echoes with different intensities, then preprocessing the weather radar echo pictures, constructing a radar echo picture training data set, and then constructing and training to obtain a storm detection model. And then, recognizing each frame of weather map in the weather map data by utilizing a storm detection model, outputting a corresponding storm region boundary frame, calculating a dynamic moving path of the storm region boundary frame, and realizing real-time tracking of the storm region. The invention can automatically identify the storm region and track the dynamic change thereof, and provides important support for meteorological monitoring and disaster early warning.

title_en: Industrial fire emergency method based on visual edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides an industrial fire emergency method based on visual edge calculation, which comprises the steps of synchronously collecting visual data, thermal data and gas data ‌ at the edge end of a factory, respectively processing and extracting the collected data to obtain visual features, thermal features and gas features, fusing the visual features, the thermal features and the gas features to obtain multi-mode fusion features, predicting whether fire occurs or not, generating a fire prediction picture if the fire occurs, presetting a time sequence analysis model, generating fire emergency task flows according to the output result of the time sequence analysis model, dividing the priorities of the fire emergency task flows, submitting the fire emergency task flows to a workflow engine to distribute the fire emergency task flows to corresponding execution units, and collecting the multi-mode data of different factory areas and pre-training the corresponding fire emergency models based on the steps S11 to S14. According to the invention, the factory multi-mode data is synchronously collected and fused to generate the corresponding factory industrial fire emergency scheme, so that the fire emergency response time is obviously shortened.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster time sequence prediction system and method based on multi-mode data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural meteorological prediction, in particular to an agricultural meteorological disaster time sequence prediction system and method based on multi-mode data fusion, which are characterized in that related data of agricultural meteorological disasters are collected and preprocessed to construct a dynamic semantic association diagram, multi-layer feature abstraction processing is carried out to generate semantic enhancement feature vectors; the multi-target optimization module performs model training based on comprehensive feature representation to optimize a plurality of targets, the multi-time scale prediction output module generates short-term accurate prediction, mid-term trend prediction and long-term risk assessment results and provides prediction confidence, error range and risk level information, and a dynamic semantic association graph and multi-layer feature mapping mechanism are constructed to realize deep fusion of multi-mode data in a semantic layer.

title_en: Transformer substation toughness assessment method based on zero and game and vulnerability analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transformer substation risk assessment, in particular to a transformer substation toughness assessment method based on zero and game and vulnerability analysis. The method comprises the steps of modeling a transformer substation through network topology analysis, calculating a system function by utilizing an accessibility matrix, establishing a vulnerability model of an element, carrying out model Carlo simulation by utilizing a vulnerability function of the element to calculate the risk of the transformer substation under earthquake disasters, modeling the operation risk and loss of a artificial attack time-varying power station, constructing zero and game models of defenders and attackers, providing an effective protection strategy according to specific budget limits and known attack scenes, comprehensively considering the influences of the two disasters, establishing a transformer substation toughness assessment method considering natural disasters and artificial attacks, effectively reducing the safety risk of the transformer substation under extreme events, and improving the safe operation capacity of the transformer substation.

title_en: Multifunctional real-time monitoring device for safety of tailing dam body under rainfall condition
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mine safety facilities, and discloses a multifunctional real-time monitoring device for the safety of a tailing dam body under rainfall conditions, wherein a mountain model and a tailing dam accumulation model arranged in the mountain model are arranged in an experiment box, a drainage system is arranged in the tailing dam accumulation model, an inclinometer, a crack meter and a hygrothermograph are arranged in the tailing dam accumulation model, a water level meter for the water level in a reservoir of the tailing dam accumulation model is also arranged on the experiment box, and the inclinometer, the crack meter, the soil hygrothermograph and the water level meter are all connected with a receiver assembly; and the experimental box is also connected with a rainfall simulation system for simulating rainfall on the tailing dam accumulation model. By using the method, the dam-filling model test of the indoor tailing pond can be carried out under the condition of simulating rainfall, so that the method has good reference value for deeply knowing the dam-filling mechanism and the breaking mode of the tailing dam, and disaster early warning of the tailing dam is expected to be achieved.

title_en: Control board and program
abstract_en: Provided is a control board comprising: a training data storage unit for storing communication status training data, including disaster log data for recording a disaster that occurred in the past, disaster-stricken area log data for recording a disaster-stricken area, and communication status log data for recording the communication status in the disaster-stricken area; and an execution unit having a model generation function for generating, through machine learning, a communication status estimation model that estimates the communication status in the disaster-stricken area from disaster identification data identifying the disaster and disaster-stricken area identification data identifying the disaster-stricken area by using a plurality of pieces of the communication status training data stored in the training data storage unit as teacher data, and a RAN control function for controlling an RAN function covering the disaster-stricken area by executing an AI process (RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC)) or the like on the basis of a communication status estimation result obtained by estimating the communication status in the disaster-stricken area from the disaster identification data and the disaster-stricken area identification data using the communication status estimation model.

title_en: Flood disk-restoring method based on distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood restoration method based on a distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling mode, which comprises the steps of compiling a data set of a historical mountain flood disaster, determining a topological structure relation of a river basin, and drawing up a key node corresponding to the river basin, and based on the key node, constructing a hydrologic model above the key node, constructing N computing units based on the data set and according to the topological relation of the river basin, adjusting the parameters to obtain an optimal flood simulation result and a parameter result, constructing a hydrodynamic model below the key node in the river basin, carrying out simulation analysis on regional application and flood evolution of the flood based on the optimal flood simulation result and the parameter result, constructing the hydrodynamic model, more accurately reflecting the generation, confluence and evolution processes of flood in the river basin, improving the application effects of the flood in aspects of flood simulation, early warning and response, helping to restore the actual situation of the flood disaster more accurately in the flood restoration process, and providing reliable basis for post-disaster assessment, reconstruction and planning.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;HYDROLOGY BUREAU OF HAIHE RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION MINI OF

title_en: Non-steady crowd evacuation path planning method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a non-steady crowd evacuation path planning method and device based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the step of simplifying the unsteady evacuation environment into a two-dimensional area by a discrete grid method. Modeling the dynamic diffusion of the dangerous source, updating the position and the range of the fire source in real time, and simulating the dynamic development of the fire. The personnel are considered as agents and move according to potential energy field guided decision rules. And (3) taking the maximum evacuation number and the minimum evacuation time as objective functions, determining constraint conditions by combining with market reality and intelligent body movement rules, and constructing an unsteady crowd evacuation path planning model. And converting the path planning into a Markov decision process by adopting an APF-MADDPG algorithm, designing state characteristics, constructing a deep reinforcement learning framework by combining a potential energy field, and training a model to realize the non-steady crowd evacuation path planning. By adopting the method, the practicability and the instantaneity of crowd evacuation path planning can be improved.

title_en: Hydrologic-landslide coupling forecasting and parameter optimizing method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a hydrologic-landslide coupling forecasting and parameter optimizing method, which comprises the steps of constructing a coupling model, wherein the coupling model comprises a hydrologic model and a landslide model, the hydrologic model is used for simulating space-time changes of water quantity and energy flux in a flow field, the landslide model is used for representing slope stability, an intelligent forecasting model of the coupling model is built through a machine learning algorithm, the intelligent forecasting model is subjected to parameter optimization by utilizing an intelligent substitution model based on Gaussian process regression, an optimized parameter sample and an objective function value thereof are output, and the objective of simultaneous forecasting of flood and landslide disasters in a research area can be achieved, and the accuracy and efficiency of model calculation are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Mud-rock flow impact force test measurement method for calibrating fluid-solid coupling simulation parameters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow impact force test measurement method for calibrating fluid-solid coupling simulation parameters. The method comprises the steps of collecting fine sand in a debris flow ditch area to manufacture debris flow test materials, simulating debris flow impact tests with different gradients through a test measuring device, repeating the test for at least 5 times for each gradient, recording flow forms, debris flow impact force peaks and impact force time course curves of the debris flow test materials in the impact process in each test process, and calculating to obtain the debris flow impact force peaks and impact force time course curves of each gradient, wherein the data can be used as basic data for calibrating flow-solid coupling simulation parameters. According to the invention, the impact force of the debris flow under different inclination angles can be collected, the flow form in the debris flow impact process is observed, and parameters of debris flow numerical simulation can be calibrated through the movement form of the debris flow in the test process and the test data, so that debris flow simulation work is developed, and references are provided for debris flow disaster prevention and control.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: SAM-based remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image pit water surface extraction method and device based on SAM, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a proper SAM model version, configuring an operation environment, then carrying out pit target detection on a remote sensing image pit based on a YOLOv model after training, generating a target detection frame, and inputting the generated target detection frame as a boundary frame prompt (box prompt) and a remote sensing image into the SAM model together to obtain a remote sensing image pit segmentation result. The method can not only improve the precision and efficiency of pit extraction, but also adapt to the pit extraction requirements of different scales and complexity, provides powerful support for the fields of water resource management, environment monitoring, disaster early warning and the like, has higher accuracy in pit detection, has good robustness and high running speed, is light in weight and easy to deploy, and provides an innovative application for the field of pit water surface extraction.
assignees: ZHONGKE XINGTU ZHIYUAN TECH ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Rock rough interface friction and slip test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of earth science and engineering geology, in particular to a rock rough interface friction and sliding test device and a test method, wherein a plurality of first test pieces are attached to the outer side wall of each test piece, the strain force of the test piece can be subjected to multi-point detection, the defects of the traditional single or low-density sensing layout are overcome, and the integrity and accuracy of experimental data are improved. The upper shell and the lower shell apply confining pressure to the test piece, and the first force application part and the second force application part are matched to apply normal force and shearing force, so that a three-dimensional stress field can be effectively simulated, and the temperature changing mechanism in the upper shell and the lower shell, the second test piece and the third test piece respectively detect dynamic distribution of sliding friction heat generation and micro-fracture evolution, so that multiple physical field coupling monitoring such as sound, heat, strain and the like is realized, the friction instability process of multi-factor interweaving under real geological conditions is effectively simulated, and a powerful support is provided for deep exploration of geological disasters and engineering activity mechanisms.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY

title_en: Fire fighter capability level assessment method and system based on fire scene environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire fighter's ability level assessment method and system based on fire scene environment, the invention relates to the technical field of ability level assessment method, determines the sub-ability level of each fire fighter's node according to the node position of each fire fighter's node, fire behavior event and fire fighter's past fire fighter's records, the ability level of the firefighter is estimated based on the node positions and sub-ability levels of the firefighting exercise nodes and the body data sets corresponding to the firefighting exercise nodes, so that the accuracy of the estimation of the ability level of the firefighter is improved. In each fire-fighting exercise node, a plurality of abnormal fire-fighting action features are determined according to the identification of the abnormal fire-fighting actions, and abnormal fire-fighting factors are determined based on the abnormal fire-fighting action features and the corresponding body data sets, so that the identification accuracy of the abnormal fire-fighting factors is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Personalized document generation method and related device for power industry
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a personalized document generation method and a related device in the power industry, wherein a user behavior map is firstly obtained and established according to user behavior information, and a user behavior map and a user document generation instruction are combined to obtain personalized document requirements of a user, so that a solid foundation is provided for personalized services; and then obtaining document generation response requirements of the user according to the operation scene information of the user, performing reinforcement learning training on a preset power large language model according to the document generation response requirements of the user, obtaining a document dynamic generation adjustment strategy of the user, enhancing emergency response capability and ensuring optimal response. And then, according to the document generation instruction, the personalized document requirement and the document dynamic generation adjustment strategy of the user, calling the power large language model to generate the personalized document of the user. The personalized document generation of the high-quality and professional power industry is realized. The speed, quality and safety of the generation of the documents in the power industry are improved.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban power grid post-disaster two-stage recovery method and system based on star-ground fusion communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster two-stage recovery method and a post-disaster recovery system for an urban power grid based on satellite-ground fusion communication, which relate to the field of post-disaster recovery of power grids, wherein in the first stage, an available post-disaster recovery time sequence of satellite communication is output through a real-time simulation result of a channel state of a post-disaster recovery period of low-orbit satellite communication; in the second stage, the coupling relation between information interaction and time sequence recovery of the power network and the information network under the star-ground fusion communication is considered, an optimization model is established to solve the post-disaster optimal recovery strategy under the satellite usable boundary, and the post-disaster efficient recovery of the urban power network under the star-ground fusion communication driving is realized. The invention considers the time-varying simulation condition of the low-orbit satellite communication during the post-disaster recovery, and also considers the complex coupling relation between the urban power grid information and the physical system and the restoration logic, thereby being beneficial to guiding the reasonable and efficient recovery of the urban power grid based on the satellite-ground fusion communication after encountering an extreme natural disaster and improving the toughness of the urban power system.
