assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Biological comprehensive control device with simulated goaf disaster gas environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a biological comprehensive control device for simulating a disaster gas environment in a goaf. The biological comprehensive control device with the goaf disaster gas environment simulation function comprises a temperature control box, an air generator and a gas chromatograph, wherein a reaction furnace, heating equipment and refrigerating equipment are arranged on the temperature control box, an air flow channel is arranged in the reaction furnace, and a circulating fan and a plurality of heat-sensitive sensors are arranged in the air flow channel. The biological comprehensive control device with the disaster gas environment simulating the goaf provided by the utility model can conveniently simulate complex gas and temperature environment of the goaf in the reaction furnace by arranging the temperature control box, the reaction furnace, the air generator, the gas chromatograph, the heating equipment and the refrigerating equipment, is convenient for carrying out design experiments on the relation between the biological flora and the disaster gas, and is beneficial to finding out dominant flora capable of rapidly metabolizing the disaster gas.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;SICHUAN POLICE COLLEGE;SICHUAN HENGSHENG COAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Building disaster damage prediction method based on deep learning and multi-scale images
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building damage detection, in particular to a building disaster damage prediction method based on deep learning and multi-scale images. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a double-time-phase remote sensing image, an unmanned aerial vehicle image and a local image of a building group and an image of the building group to be detected, respectively building a macroscopic damage evaluation model, a mesoscopic damage evaluation model and a microscopic damage evaluation model according to the double-time-phase remote sensing image, the unmanned aerial vehicle image and the local image, carrying out damage judgment on a seismic area which has occurred to obtain a damage state and related parameters of the building, building a building damage prediction model, training the building damage prediction model according to the damage state and related parameters of the building, obtaining related parameters of an unknown area, and carrying out damage prediction on the building by utilizing the trained building damage prediction model. The invention improves the complex disaster environment characterization capability and the multi-source data collaborative analysis capability, and ensures the accuracy of the building disaster damage assessment result.

title_en: Wind and rain coupling damage mechanism experiment test system and method for transmission tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind-rain coupling disaster mechanism experiment test system and method for a transmission tower, wherein the experiment test system comprises a wind tunnel test device and a rainfall simulation device which are respectively and independently controlled, a transmission tower shrinkage model which is fixed on a turntable mechanism, the angle of the transmission tower shrinkage model is adjusted through the turntable mechanism to change the wind direction, a data acquisition device which comprises a plurality of laser displacement sensors arranged on a sensor fixing bracket, a plurality of displacement measuring points on the transmission tower shrinkage model and stress strain gauges adhered on the transmission tower shrinkage model, and a data acquisition device which is used for analyzing the power reaction mechanism of the transmission tower shrinkage model under the corresponding wind-rain coupling condition according to the experimental data result. The invention can simulate the real wind and rain coupling effect, realize the fine experimental test of disaster damage mechanism research on the transmission tower and ensure the accuracy of experimental results.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Power system training management method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power system research and discloses an electric power system training management method, an electric power system training management system, an electric power system training management device and a storage medium, wherein the electric power system training management method comprises the steps of obtaining first operation data and first operation data; the method comprises the steps of generating a dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment according to first operation data, linking the first operation data with the dynamic three-dimensional simulation training environment, constructing a first learning evaluation model, and generating a personalized learning path based on the cooperative action of an analysis mechanism and the first learning evaluation model. The dynamic fault propagation modeling and real-time operation feedback mechanism can truly simulate the running state of a power grid, is matched with a personalized learning recommendation function, can greatly improve the operation skills and emergency response capability of students, and has outstanding practical value and popularization prospect.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD TALENT DEV CENTER

title_en: Deep learning model-based correction method for typhoon in North Pacific ocean
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of precipitation scales, in particular to a method for correcting precipitation of a North-ocean typhoon based on a deep learning model, which comprises the steps of obtaining ERA5 data, GPM data and a tropical cyclone optimal path data set of the North-ocean, obtaining an active period and an influence range of the historical typhoon, extracting precipitation data corresponding to each typhoon from the ERA5 data and the GPM data, preprocessing the precipitation data to obtain a data set of a training model, constructing the North-ocean typhoon precipitation correction model, training the model by using the data set, obtaining ERA5 of a target typhoon, analyzing the precipitation data, and inputting the ERA5 of the target typhoon into the trained North-ocean typhoon precipitation correction model to obtain a precipitation correction result of the target typhoon. According to the method, through the nonlinear feature extraction capability of the deep learning model, the prediction accuracy of analysis data on typhoon precipitation is improved, the model can keep a fine space structure of a precipitation field, the evolution rule of typhoon precipitation is captured, and a scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention decision.

title_en: Agent index-based quick evaluation method and system for earthquake-resistant toughness of water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for earthquake-resistant toughness of a water supply pipe network based on an agent index, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of civil engineering and comprise the following steps of S1, pipe network topology modeling and information determination, S2, earthquake-resistant toughness time dimension division and index definition, S3, preparation index and agent index calculation, S4, robustness index and agent index calculation, S5, recovery index and agent index calculation, S6, adaptability index and agent index calculation, S7, monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty analysis, and S8, establishing a functional relation. The rapid evaluation method and the rapid evaluation system for the earthquake-resistant toughness of the water supply pipe network based on the agent index solve the problem of rapid evaluation of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the urban water supply pipe network and provide an effective approach for analysis and design of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the pipe network.

title_en: Abaqus slope stability calculation and UE4 three-dimensional engine fusion-based method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating fusion with a three-dimensional engine of UE4 based on Abaqus slope stability, which comprises the following steps of constructing a geological slope model in Abaqus, generating a corresponding job script job.py, calling the job script job.py through batch processing service and submitting the job script job.py to the Abaqus for calculation, analyzing a calculation result odb file, generating corresponding data, namely a node array node, a mesh grid array meshs, stress arrays s1, s2 and s3 and deformation data ux, uy and uz, calling the UE4 engine to read the values of the nodes and the meshs, defining different color ranges according to the values of ux, uy, uz, s, s2 and s3, and carrying out dynamic rendering and displaying. The invention skillfully combines the excellent finite element computing capability of Abaqus and the excellent high-performance dynamic rendering technology of UE4, realizes the depth integration and advantage complementation of the Abaqus and the UE4 in functions, breaks the barrier between the computing precision and the visual effect of the traditional geological disaster simulation, and provides a brand-new technical path for the simulation of the geological disaster.

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster early warning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire early warning and discloses a tunnel fire early warning method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the tunnel fire early warning method based on deep learning comprises the steps of deploying a sensor and constructing a wireless transmission network to acquire multi-mode data; preprocessing, feature extraction and feature fusion are carried out on the multi-mode data, a tunnel fire early warning model adapting to the construction environment is built, a dynamic threshold mechanism is designed, a multi-stage early warning response mechanism is designed, and early warning is carried out. The invention solves the problem of easy dust interference by arranging the dustproof smoke sensor, automatically adjusts the sampling frequency and the communication frequency according to the monitoring requirement during data transmission, ensures the monitoring effect and prolongs the service life of a battery, builds a TCNN-based tunnel fire early-warning model and builds a large-scale fire data set through FDS digital simulation to train the model, designs a dynamic threshold value which can be automatically adjusted according to the environment, and solves the problem that a fixed threshold value system is not suitable for changing the environment.

title_en: Similar typhoon intelligent retrieval method and device for disaster insurance
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster insurance-oriented intelligent search method and device for similar typhoons, which are used for acquiring characteristics of forecast typhoons and characteristics of a plurality of simulated typhoons generated through a disaster model, carrying out similarity analysis on full-path morphological data of the forecast typhoons and full-path morphological data of each simulated typhoons respectively, carrying out similarity analysis on full-path near-center maximum wind speed sequences of the forecast typhoons and full-path near-center maximum wind speed sequences of each simulated typhoons respectively, carrying out similarity analysis on full-path center air pressure sequences of the forecast typhoons and full-path center air pressure sequences of each simulated typhoons respectively, carrying out similarity analysis on landing points of the forecast typhoons and landing points of each simulated typhoons respectively, carrying out comprehensive similarity analysis on a plurality of key points of the forecast typhoons and the full-path morphological data of each simulated typhoons respectively, carrying out feature fusion to obtain comprehensive similarity scores of the simulated typhoons, and determining the similar typhoons and insurance loss based on the comprehensive similarity scores of the simulated typhoons.
assignees: CHINA REINSURANCE GROUP CATASTRIAL RISK MAN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency simulation drilling method and system for sudden event of reservoir dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir dam emergency simulation drilling method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, receiving an emergency type selected by a user through a user interface, S2, loading corresponding scene data and processing logic rules, S3, driving drilling according to a preset emergency flow, providing a plurality of preset options for the user to select in each stage of the preset emergency flow, dynamically jumping to the next stage according to the user selection, S4, calculating each role score and overall drilling score in real time through a multilevel weight algorithm based on the user selection in each stage, and S5, outputting a scoring result and drilling evaluation report. According to the invention, dangerous condition monitoring, reporting, decision making, treatment, post-treatment and full link are simulated through a standardized flow, and the emergency response efficiency and decision scientificity are improved by combining a dynamic scoring algorithm and multi-role cooperative operation, so that the method is suitable for emergency capability training and exercise of reservoir management units, government departments and related technicians.
assignees: ANHUI SURVEY & DESIGN INST OF WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Oxidation-seepage experimental method for simulating infiltration filling process of oxidized surface water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pyrite-containing filler experiments, in particular to an oxidation-seepage experiment device and method for simulating the process of filling surface water seepage into filler, wherein the experiment device comprises a reaction kettle for containing a sample, a water adding device for providing seepage solution for the sample and a pressurizing device for constructing a controllable oxidation reaction environment for the reaction kettle, can acquire mineral phase change sequences and particle migration distribution characteristics of the filler under different oxidation-seepage coupling conditions, quantitatively analyze dynamic association rules of oxidation reaction rate, seepage speed and filler component evolution, further reveal association mechanisms of oxidation-seepage effect and filler component variation, provide technical support for analysis of disaster causing mechanisms of upward arch deformation of a pyrite-containing roadbed, and further ensure the stability of roads and buildings.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty, and belongs to the field of disaster simulation and early warning of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out cascading failure simulation on a power grid in the typhoon scene, determining disconnection conditions of lines at each time point based on wind-induced failure rates of the lines at each time point in the typhoon scene and forming a wind-induced failure set, traversing the wind-induced failure set, calculating cascading failure caused by wind-induced failure at each time point based on the disconnection conditions of the lines and corresponding wind-electricity output, wherein the cascading failure comprises wind-induced failure and line disconnection failure caused by one or more thermal overloads, and determining key lines in the power grid based on the cascading failure in multiple simulation. The method provided by the invention accurately evaluates the influence of the cascading failure caused by typhoons on the power grid through the simulation of the cascading failure under typhoons by double time scales (typhoons and cascading failure time scales).
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Sustained-release emergency nutrition preparation based on multilayer coating and preparation method thereof
abstract_en: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of nutritional preparations and provides a sustained-release emergency nutritional preparation based on multi-layer coating and its preparation method. The sustained-release emergency nutritional preparation based on multi-layer coating includes a sustained-release matrix, protein components, fat components, and micronutrients, and has a three-layer functional coating structure. The three-layer coating is composed of a gastric soluble layer, a sustained-release layer, and an enteric soluble layer from the outside to the inside. The sustained-release emergency nutritional preparation based on multi-layer coating prepared by the present invention has a reasonable proportion of raw materials, a scientifically feasible preparation process, and all performance indicators of the product meet the requirements. It has good nutritional balance, satiety, nutritional preservation, and energy sustained-release effect, and can meet the needs of emergency situations such as disaster rescue. The need for a 7-day food free period and the ability to meet space feeding needs The needs in scenarios such as military training and weight loss during battles.

title_en: Roadway-side filling body and roof grouting cooperative roadway protection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for cooperatively protecting a roadway by grouting a roadway-side filling body and a roof, which is characterized in that a roof drilling hole is drilled on broken surrounding rock at one side of a goaf along the roadway direction, a roadway-side filling wall structure is arranged below the roof drilling hole, grouting is respectively carried out on the roof drilling hole and the interior of the roadway-side filling wall structure after gangue is filled in the roof drilling hole and the roadway-side filling wall structure, the roadway-side filling body is formed after slurry in the roadway-side filling wall structure is solidified, and finally the roadway-side filling wall structure is removed, so that the supporting advantages of roof grouting and roadway-side filling are combined, the roof hazard caused by surrounding rock and water-rich rock stratum is effectively controlled, the overall stability of the roadway is obviously improved, and the method is beneficial to preventing disasters such as roof bursting, roof falling and the like of the roadway roof, and is suitable for high-risk roadway supporting in weak surrounding rock and water-rich areas.
assignees: CHN ENERGY XINJIANG ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD;GUONENG XINJIANG KUANGOU MINING IND CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Digital twinning-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-based power grid real-time optimal scheduling system and method, and relates to the technical field of power grid scheduling. The environmental parameters of the key nodes are collected in real time through deployment of sensors, a dynamic environmental condition coefficient is constructed, the power grid state is analyzed by combining the frequency stability and the relative strength index, a multi-model fusion prediction mechanism is built, and space-time double-dimension accurate prediction of load and power generation is realized. And a multi-objective optimization model is adopted, new energy consumption maximization and scheduling cost minimization are taken as core targets, a genetic algorithm is introduced to solve an optimal scheduling scheme, and a digital twin model is combined to forward simulation screening of a feasible solution. And the scheduling strategy is dynamically adjusted through abnormal early warning triggering, environment association degree analysis and model iterative optimization, so that the power supply efficiency and emergency response capability under an extreme scene are improved. The method effectively fuses multi-source heterogeneous data, and achieves real-time sensing of the running state of the power grid, collaborative optimization of multi-energy resources and self-adaptive iteration of a scheduling model.

title_en: The Multi-Map Support Method for Training in Responding to Multiple Casualty Incident Disasters
title_ko: 다중 사상자 발생 재난 상황의 대응 훈련을 위한 멀티맵 지원 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a metaverse system provides a method and education for coping and responding to a disaster situation and a general accident situation in which multiple casualties may occur through a method of providing a multi-map for training to respond to a disaster situation in which multiple casualties occur. Accordingly, the present invention relates to a multi-map support method for training to reduce casualties through judgment on users' response to a disaster and embodied experience.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시예에 따른 메타버스 시스템은 다중 사상자 발생 재난 상황의 대응 훈련을 위한 멀티맵을 제공하는 방법을 통해 다중 사상자가 발생할 수 있는 재난 상황 및 일반적인 사고 상황에서 대처 및 대응 하는 방법 및 교육을 제공하는 것이며, 이를 통해 사용자들의 재난 시 대응에 관한 판단력 및 체화된 경험을 통해 사상자를 감소시키기 위한 훈련용 멀티맵 지원 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: System for providing disaster safety education service based on metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스 기반 재난안전교육 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a metaverse-based disaster safety education service providing system for effectively preparing for various disaster situations and a method thereof. The present invention includes: a disaster situation modeling unit in which a plurality of disaster type scenarios, corresponding damage scenarios and response scenarios are stored; a setting unit that converts an action in a virtual reality space into an action when a user inputs an action in a disaster situation and transmits it to a simulation unit; and a simulation unit that supports real-time data transmission between the modeling unit and the setting unit so that the scenario proceeds according to the action input by the user by supporting real-time data transmission between the modeling unit and the setting unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 재난상황에 효과적으로 대비하기 위한 메타버스 기반 재난안전교육 서비스 제공 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 복수 개의 재난유형 시나리오와 이에 대응하는 피해 시나리오 및 대응 시나리오가 저장되어 있는 재난상황 모델링부; 사용자가 재난상황에서의 행동을 입력하면 가상현실 공간 상에서의 행동으로 변환하여 시뮬레이션부로 전달하는 설정부; 및 상기 모델링부와 상기 설정부 간의 실시간 데이터 전송을 지원함으로써 사용자가 입력한 행동에 따라 시나리오가 진행되도록 하는 시뮬레이션부;를 포함한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Vehicle for fire inspection
title_ko: 소방 순찰차
abstract_en: Disclosed is a fire patrol vehicle. The fire patrol vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a vehicle body; a moving part moving the vehicle body; a detecting part detecting a type of surrounding object and whether a fire occurs; a fire extinguishing liquid spraying part spraying a fire extinguishing liquid toward the object when the fire is detected; and a drill lift provided on one side of the vehicle body, wherein the drill lift comprises a joint part configured with a plurality of links and a drill mounted on a front end part of the joint part, a drill is inserted into an electric vehicle, when the object in which the fire occurs is the electric vehicle, to perform perforation toward a battery of the electric vehicle, and the fire extinguishing liquid can be sprayed through a hole perforated by the fire extinguishing liquid spraying part.
abstract_ko: 소방 순찰차가 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 소방 순찰차는, 차체와, 차체를 이동시키는 이동부와, 주위 대상물의 종류 및 화재 발생 여부를 감지하는 감지부와, 화재 감지 시, 대상물을 향해 소화액을 분사시키는 소화액분사부와, 차체의 일측에 마련된 드릴 리프트를  포함하되, 드릴 리프트는 복수의 링크로 구성된 관절부와, 관절부 선단부에 장착된 드릴을 포함하고, 화재가 발생한 대상물이 전기차인 경우, 전기차 내측으로 드릴을 진입시켜 전기차의 배터리 쪽으로 천공을 수행하고, 소화액분사부에 의해 천공된 홀을 통해 소화액을 분사시킬 수 있다.

title_en: System for estimating amount of cloud water and amount of water vapor using dual-frequency radar
abstract_en: To provide a system for estimating an amount of cloud water and an amount of water vapor using a dual-frequency radar, capable of timely and appropriately observing the amount of water vapor contained in a cloud or a cumulus cloud before the occurrence of a rainfall, the distribution of a place where the amount of cloud water is large, or the like, and quickly coping with a disaster.SOLUTION: A system for estimating an amount of cloud water and an amount of water vapor includes: weather simulation means for calculating three-dimensional distribution weather data based on a cloud resolution numerical weather model; machine learning data creation means for creating machine learning data including one-dimensional distribution data of a temperature, an atmospheric pressure, the amount of cloud water, the amount of water vapor, a dual-frequency radar reflection factor, and a dual-frequency ratio with respect to a distance from a radar; machine learning means for creating an estimation model for estimating the one-dimensional distribution data of the amount of cloud water and the amount of water vapor with respect to the distance from the radar by performing machine learning using the machine learning data as teacher data; and cloud water amount and water vapor amount estimation means for estimating the one-dimensional distribution data of the amount of cloud water and the amount of water vapor with respect to the distance from the radar.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: NATIONAL RES INSTITUTE FOR EARTH SCIENCE AND DISASTER RESILIENCE

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image-based structure disaster damage evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a structure disaster damage evaluation method and system based on a high-resolution remote sensing image, comprising the steps of 1, obtaining a high-resolution remote sensing image structure extraction data set, selecting a fixed number of samples as a training set, constructing a structure sample library under a dense scene, selecting a fixed number of samples as a test set, 2, constructing a boundary buffer zone analysis network to extract the dense structure and obtain a final structure grid result, 3, constructing a regularized vector fusion model, performing iterative training by using the training set to obtain a structure vector generation model, and 4, predicting the test set by using the boundary buffer zone analysis network and the regularized vector generation technology to obtain a test set structure vector diagram, combining the disaster vector diagram extracted by multi-source disaster data, and outputting the structure disaster damage evaluation result through fusion of the structure vector diagram and the disaster vector diagram. The method is used for accurately extracting the task of dense structure vectorization under the disaster scene.

title_en: Network public opinion intelligent classification and emergency decision system based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent classification and emergency decision system of network public opinion based on multi-mode fusion and dynamic evolution, belonging to the field of network public opinion monitoring, big data analysis and artificial intelligence. The system comprises a multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module, a multi-dimensional classification engine module, a logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module, a stakeholder dynamic risk assessment module, an intelligent decision and emergency response module, a benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module, a benefit decision and emergency response module and a classification response module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for crawling multi-mode data, constructing a propagation path atlas after preprocessing, identifying key propagation nodes, the multi-dimensional classification engine module is used for carrying out conflict intensity quantification on public opinion events, dynamically updating a rule thesaurus and keeping the adaptability of a conflict intensity quantification model, the logic atlas construction and anomaly detection module is used for constructing a public opinion propagation path and public opinion event commonality logic chain mode, monitoring the public opinion propagation speed and giving an alarm, the benefit correlator dynamic risk assessment module is used for carrying out fine classification on a network public opinion participation main body, providing basis for differentiation propagation intervention, simulating public opinion evolution and carrying out risk simulation, and the intelligent decision and emergency response module is used for executing emergency measures of different levels based on risk indexes according to a classification response strategy.

title_en: Elastic scheduling method and system based on hybrid deep learning under weather-sensitive safety constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elastic scheduling method and system based on hybrid deep learning under weather-sensitive safety constraint. The method comprises the steps of inputting power distribution system information and all weather information, extracting key ice disaster weather elements by using a key element extraction model based on an attention mechanism based on the input all weather information, obtaining a safety limit value by using a dynamic safety limit value determination model based on mixed deep learning based on the key ice disaster weather elements, constructing a Markov decision process considering weather sensitivity safety limit value by taking the safety limit value as a weather sensitivity parameter and combining the initially input power distribution system information, and obtaining a final elasticity improvement strategy by using a training method based on a depth certainty strategy gradient. The method can accurately determine the weather-sensitive safety limit value and rapidly and effectively determine the elastic lifting strategy for the safety limit value to be reduced, so that the safety of the power grid under ice disaster is ensured to a greater extent.

title_en: Quick air leakage and structure protection cooperative device based on mining plugging air wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid air leakage and structure protection cooperative device based on a mining blocking air wall, and belongs to the technical field of mine gas disaster prevention and control. This kind of quick air leakage and structure protection cooperative device based on mining shutoff gas wall includes the gas wall body, including inner bag and outer bag, the outer bag outside is equipped with a pair of horizontal slide rail channel and a pair of vertical slide rail channel, be equipped with on the gas wall body and aerify hole and air leakage hole, still include the gas wall protection component, including horizontal protection component and vertical protection component, still include the air leakage component, including pipeline and clamp, pipeline one end air leakage hole threaded connection, the drilling department that the gas was taken out to the other end inserted the gas pipeline is fixed through the clamp, protect the gas wall body through horizontal protection component and the vertical protection component that sets up, avoid touching sharp object when removing the gas wall body and lead to the gas wall body to damage, utilize the negative pressure environment of gas extraction pipeline to carry out quick air leakage to the gas wall body.

title_en: Foam fire extinguishing test system and test method for simulating fire disaster of energy storage battery
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire tests, in particular to a foam fire extinguishing test system and a test method for simulating an energy storage battery fire, wherein the test system comprises a test box, a foam fire extinguishing device, an overcharging trigger device and a data acquisition device, at least one unit for simulating fire is arranged in the test box and is far away from the foam fire extinguishing device, the unit is connected with the overcharging trigger device and is used for triggering thermal runaway of the unit, the foam fire extinguishing device is arranged outside the test box and is used for injecting compressed air foam into the unit in the thermal runaway state to extinguish the fire, and the data acquisition device is used for acquiring data of the unit and extinguishing the fire. The invention effectively improves the performance evaluation capability of the compressed air foam in the fire scene of the energy storage battery, and can comprehensively evaluate the performance of the fire extinguishing medium, thereby providing data support for the fire extinguishing efficiency, explosion suppression capability and environmental adaptability of the compressed air foam.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA SHANGDU POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST

title_en: Dangerous gas leakage tracing positioning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas leakage tracing positioning, in particular to a dangerous gas leakage tracing positioning method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the tracing positioning method comprises the steps of collecting environmental parameters and gas concentration data from fixed and mobile sensors, wherein the fixed sensors are deployed at key nodes to monitor gas diffusion; the method comprises the steps of carrying a mobile sensor on a patrol robot or an unmanned aerial vehicle to dynamically fill a dead zone of the fixed sensor, preprocessing data, denoising, normalizing and enhancing features of the data, extracting and selecting features, extracting key features by using a machine learning algorithm, training a model, predicting the position of a leakage source by training a deep neural network model, monitoring and triggering, monitoring data and triggering tracing and positioning when abnormal, accurately positioning, positioning the leakage source by using the model and real-time data, and intelligently deciding to provide an emergency response suggestion and an optimization scheme.

title_en: Multi-disaster collaborative prevention and control method and system for advanced exploratory area fracturing of coal seam of tunneling working face under complex geological conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for cooperatively preventing and controlling multiple disasters in advanced exploratory areas of a coal seam of a tunneling working face under complex geological conditions, and belongs to the field of mine disaster prevention and control. The method adopts a drilling-detecting-pressing-pumping integrated process, geological exploration is completed through advanced exploratory hole construction bedding drilling, pressure relief and permeability improvement of a coal body are achieved based on a segmented backward hydraulic fracturing process and a recyclable packer device, a gas extraction system is connected through a two-blocking one-injection and pressure hole sealing process after fracturing, and roadway stability is enhanced through an anchor net cable-beam supporting system. The matched fracturing system comprises a water tank, a water injection pump, an ultrahigh pressure hydraulic hose, a fracturing sealing tubular column and an integrated monitoring device. According to the invention, repeated construction of drilling and resource waste are reduced through multi-disaster collaborative design, and the anchor net cable beam support system enhances the roadway stability under complex geological conditions. The scheme has high adaptability and popularization value and provides reliable technical support for coal mine safety exploitation.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Underground high-pressure-bearing weak water-rich aquifer grouting method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the crossing field of the mine water damage prevention and control field and the mining engineering field, and particularly discloses a method for grouting a downhole high-pressure weak water-rich aquifer, which comprises the following steps of implementing associated drilling; the method comprises the steps of implementing a main grouting hole, implementing a split water hole, arranging a water pressure monitoring device and ball valves capable of adjusting water discharge at the positions of the split water hole and a main grouting hole opening, installing a high-pressure blowout preventer and a closed drainage system at the position of the split water hole opening, connecting the high-pressure grouting system with the main grouting hole opening, implementing a main grouting hole to a high-pressure-bearing weak water-rich aquifer, opening the split water hole ball valve to drain water, continuously monitoring water pressure, grouting and sealing related drilling holes, opening the main grouting hole opening ball valve, and opening the high-pressure grouting system. The underground high-pressure-bearing weak water-rich aquifer grouting method is more scientific, accurate, practical and easy to implement, and can meet urgent requirements of mine safety production and geological disaster prevention.
assignees: WENG FU GROUP CO LTD;UNIV GUIZHOU

title_en: 3D printing model for road tunnel damage structure after fire disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a 3D printing model of a road tunnel damage structure after fire, which is of a cylindrical structure, wherein the cross section of the cylindrical structure comprises an outer wall and an inner wall, the outer wall comprises an upper half part of a semicircular structure, two outer side edges and an outer bottom edge, two semicircular ends are connected to the upper ends of the two outer side edges, two ends of the outer bottom edge are connected to the lower ends of the two outer side edges, the inner wall comprises a broken-simulating edge positioned on the upper half part, two inner side edges and an inner bottom edge, two ends of the broken-simulating edge are connected to the upper ends of the two inner side edges, and two ends of the inner bottom edge are connected to the lower ends of the two inner side edges. The model truly reproduces the damage condition of the post-disaster tunnel through a series of operations and 3D printing technology, and provides reliable support for subsequent structural analysis and repair schemes.

title_en: Pre-control and monitoring method and system for whole process of actual grouting engineering based on digital geological model
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-control and monitoring method for a whole process of actual grouting engineering based on digital geological model, comprising: extracting discontinuous fracture surfaces in a geologic body structure, to build a underground geologic body structure model; build a multi-source geologic body attribute model, optimizing and solving grouting simulations of a disaster high-risk region by using multiphase flow calculation method, and controlling grouting equipment by using optimized grouting parameters to carry out an actual grouting engineering; obtaining a multi-factor diffusion range of variable coefficients by adjusting physical values of the parameters in the grouting simulation and attribute data structure model by using a control variable method, learning and capturing complex mapping relationship between different parameters by using a neural network, optimizing the grouting parameters in the actual engineering in real-time, so as to realize the pre-controlling, monitoring and optimization of the whole process of the actual grouting engineering.

title_en: Method and device for determining recovery speed of impact dangerous coal seam exploitation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining mining speed of an impact dangerous coal seam, which comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional geometric model for reflecting the geological structure and the coal seam morphology of a coal mine according to geological data and engineering parameter data of the coal seam, dividing grids to generate a discretization model for numerical calculation, setting boundary conditions and loading modes of the discretization model according to set solving parameters and combining the mechanical properties of the coal and the coal seam environment in the geological data to simulate the mechanical response data of the coal and rock, calculating the maximum elastic energy accumulated in a coal and rock unit body when the rock burst of the coal seam occurs according to the mechanical response data, and calculating the safe recovery speed of coal seam mining according to the maximum elastic energy. Therefore, the safe recovery speed is calculated by preventing and controlling the occurrence of rock burst disasters, the elastic strain energy accumulated in the coal-rock unit body can be reduced, the occurrence probability of rock burst is reduced, and the safe production of coal mines is ensured.

title_en: WAGA-BP network-based slope safety coefficient prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope safety coefficient prediction method and a system based on a WAGA-BP network, which relate to the technical field of slope geological disaster prediction and comprise the steps of establishing a digital model of a target slope based on geographic information of the target slope; the method comprises the steps of carrying out simulation experiments based on a digital model to obtain the safety coefficient of a target slope under different environmental parameters, constructing a slope stability evaluation sample library based on the safety coefficient of the target slope under different environmental parameters, training a WAGA-BP neural network based on the slope stability evaluation sample library to obtain a prediction model after training, and predicting the safety coefficient of the target slope based on the prediction model after training. The invention relieves the technical problem of low accuracy in the prior art.

title_en: Full-scale full life cycle monitoring method for surrounding rock stress of stope roadway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-scale full life cycle monitoring method for surrounding rock stress of a stoping roadway, which relates to the technical field of coal mine roadway safety monitoring, wherein monitoring stations are arranged in five areas of a tunneling head-on roadway top plate, a roadway bottom plate, two sides of a solid coal roadway and the front of the tunneling head-on roadway to form a three-dimensional monitoring network; the range of the advanced disturbance area is determined based on the dynamic change from the stable state to the continuous rising of the stress value by arranging the preset drilling holes in the safety area of the external expansion of the theoretical disturbance area, so that the monitoring data is ensured not to be interfered by tunneling disturbance. The method comprises the steps of monitoring and covering a roadway tunneling front, a tunneling period, a stabilization period and a stoping period, synchronously collecting space-time coordinates and stress field parameters, forming a complete full life cycle monitoring data chain, comprehensively capturing stress dynamics of surrounding rocks of the roadway, finding a high stress area before tunneling in advance, releasing pressure of deep holes in the tunneling period, reducing stress peaks in the stoping period, and avoiding chain disasters of tunneling hidden danger-stoping burst.

title_en: Fire simulator and evaporation rate regulating and controlling method
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a fire simulator and a method for regulating and controlling evaporation rate. The fire disaster simulator comprises an evaporation pond, a hydraulic component, a porous medium module, a radiation type heater, a first temperature sensor, a quality sensor and a processing module, wherein the evaporation pond comprises a steam outlet, the hydraulic component is arranged at the bottom of the evaporation pond and comprises a top plate and a hydraulic column connected with the top plate, the porous medium module is arranged in the evaporation pond, a liquid fuel layer is formed between a punching supporting plate and the top plate, the porous wetting layer is arranged on one side of the punching supporting plate, which is far away from the top plate, the radiation type heater is arranged above the porous wetting layer, the first temperature sensor is arranged in the porous medium module, the quality sensor is arranged at the bottom of the outer side of the evaporation pond, the shooting module is arranged at the outer side of the evaporation pond and detects the liquid level parameter of the porous wetting layer, the liquid level parameter is the height of an interval between an evaporation interface in the porous wetting layer and the top plate, and the processing module controls jacking pressure of the hydraulic column and incident radiation flux of the radiation type heater according to the temperature parameter, the liquid level parameter, the quality parameter and the target evaporation rate.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;BEIJING URBAN CONSTR DESIGN & DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Water conservancy channel editing method based on digital three-dimensional scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water conservancy channel editing method based on a digital three-dimensional scene, which does not need third-party modeling software. When editing, dotting is firstly performed according to a required channel model, point positions are added to be connected into a smooth curve to finish mesh drawing at the bottom of the channel, the shape of the bottom is accurately drawn, and a foundation is laid for subsequent modeling. And then, rendering textures through the scene capturing channel bottom model material data to RENDERTARGET, updating to a topographic map layer, and ensuring the real representation of the materials. And then, the topography is processed by using a topography layer BOOL operation and a topography noise l erp algorithm. And calculating model vertex data, carrying out surface subdivision and UV data calculation, and finally drawing a model according to the vertices. The method can dynamically create and edit the water conservancy channel in the three-dimensional scene, facilitates the development of irrigation simulation, disaster drilling and rescue measure simulation of the water conservancy project, and realizes the editing of the water conservancy channel with high degree of freedom and diversity.
assignees: SICHUAN YIFANG WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake collapse building dielectric constant inversion method based on improved neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inversion method of dielectric constants of a seismic collapse building based on an improved neural network, and aims to improve inversion accuracy of Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) data and identification capacity of an internal structure. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a radar data set of a simulated collapse building structure, and preprocessing the radar data set, wherein the method comprises the steps of removing background interference, median filtering and time gain enhancement so as to improve the signal to noise ratio. On the basis, a UKAN neural network which introduces a concentration mechanism and a depth separable convolution is constructed, and the KAN module is combined to strengthen the nonlinear modeling capability. And inversion is carried out on the GPR image through the model, dielectric constant distribution in the collapse structure is rebuilt, and automatic identification of critical areas such as a survival gap is realized. The invention can provide high-efficiency and accurate structural analysis and rescue decision support in complex post-disaster environments, and has practical application value.

title_en: Assessment method for dynamic response of large-span suspension bridge under wind-vibration combined effect
abstract_en: The invention provides an evaluation method of dynamic response of a large-span suspension bridge under the combined action of wind and vibration, and particularly relates to the technical fields of bridge engineering structure safety and disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a bridge finite element model by utilizing ANSYS software, S2, carrying out modal analysis on the finite element model to determine self-vibration frequency, S3, determining the selection and reading of earthquake waves, S4, calculating a rotation matrix, S5, simulating a pulsation wind speed spectrum by utilizing Simiu power spectrum and determining the fitting degree of the pulsation wind speed spectrum and a target spectrum, S6, applying load to the finite element model established in S1, S7, calculating a dynamic response value under the combined action of earthquake and wind load, and S8, carrying out drawing analysis on internal force and displacement response value by utilizing ORIGIN software. According to the invention, the load dynamic response analysis is carried out by using ANSYS software, so that the effect of the combined action of earthquake and wind load on the bridge is comprehensively and systematically examined, the accurate evaluation of the risk disasters in the two stages of construction and bridge formation under the action of multiple disasters is realized, and the safety and reliability of the bridge structure are ensured.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;SHANDONG GOLD MINING LAIZHOU CO LTD JIAOJIA GOLD MINE

title_en: Mineral product detection method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mineral exploration method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional ore body model by fusing geological exploration data, real-time market price and mineral separation technical parameters; the method comprises the steps of generating a mining boundary data under different price conditions by iteratively solving a grade-cost optimal solution based on a dynamic optimization algorithm and price fluctuation simulation, classifying the ore body blocks by utilizing a machine learning model to generate a space distribution data set containing mining resources and associated resource labels, and rapidly evaluating emergency resource potential and outputting a mining area map and a productivity planning scheme by combining real-time market parameters and label data. The method breaks through the limitation of traditional static threshold evaluation, realizes dynamic optimization of resource availability and intelligent promotion of emergency response capability, remarkably improves the utilization rate of low-grade ore and associated resources, shortens the decision period of resource guarantee, and provides scientific basis for mineral development in complex market environment.

title_en: Unsteady slurry diffusion process simulation method and system considering slurry-rock coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsteady state slurry diffusion process simulation method and system considering a slurry-rock coupling effect, which belong to the technical field of rock mass engineering grouting and comprise the steps of 1 defining basic assumptions of slurry and cracks, 2 establishing a slurry flow control equation and a crack deformation control equation based on the basic assumptions of the slurry and the cracks, 3 establishing an unsteady state slurry-rock coupling pressure control equation based on the slurry flow control equation and the crack deformation control equation, 4 establishing initial conditions, boundary conditions and grouting body conditions based on the basic assumptions of the slurry and the cracks, establishing an unsteady state slurry diffusion model considering the slurry-rock coupling effect by combining the unsteady state slurry-rock coupling pressure control equation, and 5 performing numerical solution on the unsteady state slurry diffusion model by adopting a finite volume method. The invention is suitable for grouting design and optimization in the fields of tunnel engineering, mine engineering, geological disaster prevention and control and the like, and can provide theoretical support and technical guidance for engineering practice.

title_en: Route guidance system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route guidance system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model management module, a route planning module, a route indication module and a driver, wherein the route indication module is used for controlling a dynamic indicator to rotate and indicate directions according to evacuation routes planned by the route planning module, the dynamic indicator comprises an outer ring body and an indicator arrow shell, the driver is used for receiving control instructions of the route indication module and controlling a rotating shaft to rotate, a first green lamp panel is arranged on one opposite side of the indicator arrow shell, a red lamp panel is arranged on the end face of the arrow side of the indicator arrow shell, a second green lamp panel is arranged on the end face of the other side of the indicator arrow shell, a red annular lamp body is arranged on the outer ring surface of the arrow side of the indicator arrow shell, and a green annular lamp body is arranged on the other side surface of the outer ring body. Compared with the prior art, the invention solves the problem that the emergency evacuation scheme of the public building simulation system lacks a reliable guidance system combined with the emergency evacuation scheme.
assignees: ZHONGKE HUANSEN WISDOM TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood simulation method based on deep learning reconstruction image model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood simulation method based on a deep learning reconstruction image model, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring basic data of a research area, 2, constructing a one-dimensional-two-dimensional hydrodynamic coupling model, 3, preprocessing data, 4, constructing a U-Net deep learning reconstruction image model, 5, setting and training the U-Net deep learning reconstruction image model, and 6, simulating urban flood. The method improves the response speed of urban flood simulation on spatial resolution, combines simulation precision and calculation efficiency, rapidly and accurately obtains the high-resolution flood ponding simulation result under the condition of only using limited training data, and provides scientific support for urban flood disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating lightning trip-out rate of 10kV overhead line in plain area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power distribution networks, and particularly relates to a method and a system for evaluating a lightning trip rate of a10 kV overhead line in a plain area, which are used for solving the problems of high calculation complexity and long time consumption in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining lightning ground flash density and soil resistivity of an area where an overhead line is located, and rapidly calculating lightning trip-out rate of an insulator of the line and average height of a wire. The invention combines the geographic parameters and the empirical formula, replaces the traditional multi-physical-field simulation, shortens the calculation time from a few hours to a second level, can realize high-efficiency evaluation without professional lightning simulation knowledge, is suitable for rapidly making a lightning protection strategy for a basic-level power operation and maintenance unit, and is particularly suitable for plain areas with the altitude less than or equal to 1000m, the soil resistivity of 50-1000 Ω -m and the average height of 10-22m of the lead.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Colliery fire monitoring and fire extinguishing control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine fire monitoring and extinguishing control system, which relates to the technical field of coal mine fire monitoring, including ground equipment, mine flame sensor, temperature and humidity sensor, smoke sensor, dust concentration sensor, thermal imaging camera, electric ball valve, junction box, network switch and intrinsically safe power supply device installed in multiple areas underground. The invention can build a dynamic dust drift simulation model by setting a wind speed sensor, a spatial shape recognition device and a microseismic monitoring unit, and introduce geological disturbance data to predict and modify the dust accumulation area, so as to achieve intelligent ventilation control in high-risk areas. The invention has strong practicability and can drive the electric ball valve to accurately spray in time according to the monitoring results when a fire occurs Fire fighting, The characteristics of improving emergency response efficiency and control accuracy.

title_en: Soft rock TBM machine-blocking risk intelligent prediction method based on numerical mechanism guidance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft rock TBM card machine risk intelligent prediction method based on numerical mechanism guidance, which comprises the following steps of establishing an extrusion soft rock stratum TBM dynamic tunneling whole process refined numerical simulation model, wherein the model comprises a TBM cutter head, a front middle tail step shield, soft rock, a segment lining and a back wall backfill material, simulating an evolution process, systematically calculating and analyzing surrounding rock geological parameters, TBM tunneling parameters, TBM construction parameters and TBM construction parameters to construct a card machine index numerical value sample library, predicting soft rock large deformation and shield extrusion load, fusing TBM rock-machine interaction multisource data in actual engineering to establish a soft rock TBM card machine risk intelligent prediction model, and evaluating TBM card machine risk and verifying the effectiveness of prevention and control measures, wherein the TBM cutter head, the front middle tail step shield, the segment lining and the back wall backfill material are sequentially arranged in a mode of S01. The technical scheme of the invention can comprehensively consider the whole process of dynamic interaction of the TBM and the soft rock, explain the disaster occurrence mechanism of the TBM card machine and improve the generalization capability of the machine learning method in practical application.

title_en: Early warning method and system for electrical fire disaster of high-rise building based on simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method and system for electrical fire of a high-rise building based on simulation. The method comprises the steps of establishing an electrical fire simulation model of a high-rise building according to different fire types and environmental conditions, setting basic parameters and simulation parameters of the simulation model, running the simulation model to generate multiple groups of simulation result data, establishing a fire risk feature library according to the multiple groups of simulation result data generated according to different fire types and environmental conditions, training a fire risk early warning model according to the established fire risk feature library, processing real-time monitored temperature and gas concentration data according to the trained fire risk prediction model, predicting feature quantity change trend in a future period, processing the predicted feature quantity change trend in the future period according to the trained fire risk early warning model, and determining an electrical fire risk classification early warning result. Therefore, the fire risk can be recognized in advance, and the practicability is high.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ANQING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Remote sensing image change detection method of disaster-affected area and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The application provides a remote sensing image change detection method of a disaster area and a storage medium thereof, which are characterized in that a pre-disaster image and a post-disaster image of the disaster area are obtained, an image detection training model generated based on a visual language architecture is obtained, then parameter fine adjustment is carried out on the image detection training model based on LoRA technology and AdaLN technology to obtain an image detection target model, finally, image change detection is carried out on the pre-disaster image and the post-disaster image through the image detection target model to obtain a change mask image of the disaster area, and further, the high-efficiency fine adjustment of model parameters can be realized in a mode of training a low-rank matrix by introducing a LoRA module into the model.

title_en: Disaster chain dynamic risk assessment method and system based on logistic regression
abstract_en: Defining a novel extreme disaster, constructing a four-dimensional disaster systematic scoring frame, scoring indexes based on the four-dimensional disaster systematic scoring frame, calculating the weight of each index and the comprehensive score of the disaster based on the information entropy theory, and screening the trigger factors of the disaster chain; based on disaster chain triggering, designing a disaster chain topological structure, training a logistic regression model to dynamically update failure probability, calculating disaster chain risk degree, and evaluating disaster chain risk based on the disaster chain risk degree. The invention constructs a four-dimensional disaster systematic scoring framework, reduces the sensitivity to single index scores, and overcomes the inapplicability of the traditional risk matrix to non-traditional risks and low-frequency high-loss risks exceeding the original design standard. In addition, the invention provides the disaster chain topological structure and trains the logistic regression model, thereby obviously improving the accuracy and reliability of disaster chain risk prediction.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER DESIGN CO LTD SHENZHEN

title_en: Remote sensing extraction method and system for extremely-heavy rain flood disaster damaged house
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing extraction method and a remote sensing extraction system for a damaged house in an extreme storm flood disaster, and relates to the field of intelligent processing of remote sensing images. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-mode remote sensing feature set of a house key target fusing spectrum and texture features, adopting a principal component method and a dynamic weight distribution method to achieve multi-feature dimension reduction and fusion, aiming at different house types, providing a high-resolution remote sensing house sample marking method considering geometric structures, adopting a Gaussian mixture model to achieve house sample probability measurement to form a house element sample library, adopting an improved deep learning model to train the features, constructing a house remote sensing intelligent extraction model, combining the training model and multi-mode remote sensing data to achieve automatic extraction of the house key target before and after a disaster, and adopting a change analysis detection method to determine a damaged house target.

title_en: Dynamic planning method for danger avoiding path of high-risk barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic planning method for a danger avoiding path of a high-risk barrier lake, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a barrier lake downstream danger area range calculation model coupling a dam bursting flood outer envelope with a secondary disaster range, S2, establishing a subsection danger avoiding window time calculation model, S3, establishing a crowd-dividing path planning model based on dynamic toughness weight and multi-objective collaborative optimization, and S4, dynamically rolling and updating based on a flood evolution process. The method can accurately define the downstream risk avoiding range of the barrier lake, improves the accuracy of the downstream risk avoiding range of the barrier lake by overlapping the multi-method flood-bursting simulation outer envelope with the secondary disaster range, establishes a crowd-dividing path planning method based on dynamic toughness weight and multi-objective collaborative optimization, breaks through the limitation that the traditional path planning only considers the shortest path, and combines crowd characteristics, real-time road conditions and secondary disaster risks to realize the dynamic generation of the differential risk avoiding path.

title_en: Energy-saving and environment-friendly rock sample sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses energy-saving and environment-friendly rock sample sampling equipment for geological disaster investigation, which relates to the technical field of rock sampling and comprises a base, wherein a rotating hemp rod is rotatably connected to the side of the upper surface of the base, a top plate is arranged at the upper end of the rotating hemp rod, a grip is arranged on the outer side of the upper end of the rotating hemp rod in a penetrating manner, a sampling cylinder for sampling a rock sample of the base is arranged at the center of the base, and a spraying mechanism is arranged between the outer side of a spray pipe and the outer side of the lower end of the rotating hemp rod. This energy-concerving and environment-protective type geological disaster reconnaissance is with rock sample sampling device, spray header can realize reciprocal swing under the drive of the dual effort of half gear and torsion spring to spray the processing to sampling tube department, when spraying the deashing to the sampling tube, still can spray the cooling to sampling tube department and handle, thereby avoid the sampling tube when carrying out the drilling operation, the barrel gathers more heat because of the frictional action and makes the overheated phenomenon of sampling tube take place.

title_en: Universal wind speed prediction method and device for real-time typhoon rapid early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a universal wind speed prediction method and device for rapid early warning of a typhoon in real time, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of carrying out typhoon data analysis according to coastal city information and typhoon history information based on a simulated circle method to obtain typhoon basic information, carrying out model construction according to the typhoon basic information based on a mathematical statistics inference method to obtain a parameter probability distribution model, carrying out random sample generation according to the parameter probability distribution model by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain a first training data set, carrying out optimization training on a universal wind speed prediction model to be trained by using the first training data set and typhoon real-time information based on a dynamic elite retention strategy to obtain the universal wind speed prediction model to be optimized. The invention relates to a high-efficiency and accurate general wind speed prediction method based on a GA-BP neural network and a dynamic elite retention strategy.

title_en: Building emergency evacuation behavior prediction system based on emotion infection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of public safety, in particular to a building emergency evacuation behavior selection research method based on emotion infection. The method acquires emotion infection intensity data through a questionnaire, constructs a mixed selection model (HCM) taking emotion infection into consideration, and introduces a P-SIR model combining an OCEAN model and an SIR infectious disease model to simulate an emotion infection process. And carrying out simulation experiments on path selection of evacuees by Anylogic simulation software, and exploring the influence of psychological latent variables such as emotion infection and the like on the emergency evacuation path selection. The invention solves the problems that the emotion infection model is not careful enough to consider and the psychological factors in the mixed selection model are not comprehensive in the existing research, improves the accuracy and the practicability of the emergency evacuation model, and provides theoretical support and basis for the emergency management department to formulate an effective library emergency evacuation management strategy and building design specification.

title_en: Sealing test device and method for sealing fireproof organic filler
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of testing devices, and particularly discloses a sealing testing device and a sealing testing method for sealing fireproof organic fillers, wherein the sealing testing device comprises a testing table, a testing box is slidably arranged at the upper end of the testing table, and a testing sample is slidably arranged in the testing box; the testing device can comprehensively simulate various working conditions such as temperature, pressure, vibration and the like in an actual use scene, so that the testing result is closer to the performance of the sealing fireproof organic filler in a real environment, the testing accuracy and reliability are improved, moreover, the sealing performance test and the fireproof performance test are organically combined, the fireproof effect of the sealing fireproof organic filler in a sealing state and the dynamic change of the sealing performance in a fire disaster process can be intuitively reflected, and more comprehensive data support is provided for evaluating the comprehensive performance of the sealing fireproof organic filler.
assignees: GUANGDONG HONGTAI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency refuge site live-action drilling and monitoring maintenance system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency refuge site live-action drilling and monitoring maintenance system which comprises an information display module, a live-action drilling module, a site monitoring module, a facility monitoring module, a data acquisition system, a data transmission and encoding module, a data storage and organization module and a monitoring data module, wherein the information display module is used for providing visual site overview, the live-action drilling module is used for simulating drilling for arrangement and evacuation of an emergency host, the site monitoring module is used for performing multi-mode monitoring on a water supply pipeline and a power supply pipeline in the refuge site, the facility monitoring module is used for acquiring monitoring data of the water supply pipeline and the power supply pipeline through monitoring equipment, the data acquisition system is used for acquiring a hardware system consisting of a sensor and a transmission box, the sensor and the transmission box are arranged on the water supply pipeline and the power supply pipeline, the data transmission and encoding module is used for constructing a real-time communication framework, the data storage and organization is used for constructing a structured data storage scheme based on a database, and the monitoring data module is used for establishing an online electronic archive system and intensively storing and managing related data of the emergency refuge site. The invention can map refuge places and hidden facilities in real time so as to ensure that the refuge places can be normally started in disaster.

title_en: Navigation ship safety system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine vessel safety, in particular to a marine vessel safety system, which comprises a vessel safety monitoring module, a data acquisition module, a marine environment adaptability module, an emergency response and early warning system, a remote monitoring and scheduling module, an automatic collision avoidance and navigation system and a crew behavior monitoring and safety training module. According to the invention, through comprehensive real-time monitoring, data acquisition and intelligent analysis, the safety and efficiency of ship navigation are improved, and the marine environment adaptability module, the automatic collision avoidance and navigation system and the crew behavior monitoring and safety training module are introduced, so that not only can the navigation parameters of the ship be automatically adjusted to deal with external environment changes, but also remote scheduling and emergency response can be provided, human errors are reduced, and the stable operation of the ship under complex navigation conditions is ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU MARITIME INST;CHANGJIANG NANJING WATERWAY BUREAU

title_en: Multi-source data fusion determination method for small-river-basin geological disaster monitoring distribution target area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion determination method for a small-river-basin geological disaster monitoring distribution target area, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring; the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical geological disaster data and geospatial data in a small-river-area research area and establishing a database, constructing a refined evaluation unit for the research area, performing risk evaluation on the research area by adopting a machine learning algorithm, modeling the research area by adopting numerical simulation and analyzing the risk, obtaining multi-time-phase SAR images of the research area by utilizing satellites, setting a deformation rate threshold value, screening high-risk areas, analyzing the geological disaster risk of the small-river-area by combining a plurality of similar evaluation methods, and determining the high-risk areas as the preferred monitoring distribution target areas. The method provided by the invention effectively improves the accuracy, rationality and scientificity of the demarcation of the small-river-area geological disaster monitoring distribution target area.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING HUADI ZIHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Composite geological disaster prevention and control structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a composite geological disaster prevention and control structure which comprises a supporting seat, wherein a conical seat is fixed at the bottom of the supporting seat, fixing holes are formed in the conical seat and the supporting seat, a movable column is movably arranged in the fixing holes, a drill bit is fixed at one end of the movable column, a threaded seat is fixed in the fixing holes, a threaded column is rotatably arranged in the threaded seat, one end of the threaded column is fixed on the movable column, a fixing plate is welded on the side of the supporting seat, a movable frame is movably arranged on the side of the fixing plate, and cuttage is welded at the bottom of the fixing plate. According to the invention, when an object falls to the buffer belt during use, the buffer belt is contracted inwards, the buffer belt drives the motor base and the rotating cylinder to move inwards, primary buffering is completed through movement of the buffer belt, and secondary buffering is completed through movement of the motor base and the rotating cylinder and matching of the supporting mechanism and the damper, so that damage to equipment caused by overlarge impact force is avoided.

title_en: Lightweight intelligent landslide displacement prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a lightweight intelligent landslide displacement prediction method, which belongs to the field of geological disaster monitoring and prediction, and comprises the steps of obtaining historical monitoring displacement time sequence data of landslide body monitoring points, carrying out dynamic normalization processing on the displacement time sequence data, constructing a lightweight prediction model comprising a gating enhanced ordinary differential equation network and a dynamic residual correction module, synchronously optimizing a basic prediction and residual correction network through a combined training module, adopting a composite loss function comprising dynamic threshold Huber loss and L2 regularization, automatically updating a sliding window and calculating a prediction result based on a rolling prediction mechanism when new monitoring data arrives. According to the invention, through the cooperative optimization of the gate control enhanced ordinary differential equation network and dynamic residual correction, the model is ensured to be light, and the prediction precision is improved, so that real-time and reliable technical support is provided for early warning of landslide disasters and disaster prevention and reduction decision.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN SCI & ENG;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visualization system based on three-dimensional tide transport model and pollutant transport model
