abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualization system based on a three-dimensional tide transport model and a pollutant transport model, and relates to the technical field of marine environment numerical simulation and visualization; the method comprises the steps of establishing a high-resolution three-dimensional tide and pollutant transport model, integrating strait inflow, runoff and open sea exchange data, embedding a pollutant tracing algorithm, quantifying the contribution rate of multi-source input to a target sea area, adopting a B/S architecture to develop an interactive platform, supporting a user to remotely set parameters, automatically calling model calculation, dynamically rendering a tide flow field, pollutant diffusion and oil spilling track through an image superposition technology, evaluating the environment capacity of a bay by combining the water exchange rate, designing an oil spilling early warning subsystem to realize accident rapid simulation and damage visualization, integrating a data updating mechanism and an API interface, guaranteeing model timeliness and expanding a real-time data assimilation function, breaking through local modeling limitation, improving marine environment management efficiency and improving marine pollution emergency response capability.

title_en: Karst collapse prediction system and method controlled by folds and interlayers
abstract_en: The invention provides a karst collapse prediction system and method controlled by folds and interlayers, and relates to the technical field of karst collapse prediction. The system and the method for predicting the karst collapse under the control of the folds and the interlayers concretely comprise the following steps of S1, early-stage data acquisition, S2, field investigation, S3, karst collapse disaster rule and mechanism research, S4, karst collapse susceptibility prediction, S5, karst collapse prevention and control subareas and countermeasures. Survey and investigation work is carried out through comprehensive means such as data collection, geological measurement, drilling, geophysical prospecting, hydrogeological experiments, indoor model analysis and the like, the ground collapse development characteristics and distribution rules of karst troughs around a scientific city tunnel are ascertained, the cause mechanism of karst collapse is summarized, a prediction structure model is established, and the regional large-scale ground collapse susceptibility zoning and prevention and control zoning analysis is realized, so that feasible prevention and control measures are provided, and the method has higher guiding significance for guiding the ground collapse work in similar areas.
assignees: CHONGQING NANJIANG SURVEY & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Underground portable drilling and slotting depth exploration device for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster management, in particular to a portable drilling and slotting depth exploration device for underground coal mines, which comprises a hollow supporting rod; the device also comprises a hollow guide rod, a solid transmission rod, a high-toughness probe and a round guide wheel, wherein the hollow support rod is provided with two upper and lower connecting rods, and the upper end of the upper hollow support rod is provided with the hollow guide rod; according to the utility model, the hollow supporting rods, the solid transmission rods, the hollow guide rods and the high-toughness probes are connected and penetrated, after the hollow guide rods penetrate into the drill holes and reach the slotting position, the high-toughness probes are pushed to extend out of the hollow guide rods and enter the slotting through the solid transmission rods, the difference value of scale marks before and after the solid transmission rods are the actual slotting depth for exploration, the device is convenient to disassemble and assemble, convenient to carry, accurate and reliable in exploration data, and in line with the actual situation, the follow-up guidance design on mine drill holes is more reasonable, and hidden trouble problems brought to mine safety production are reduced.
assignees: CHINA COAL NORTHWEST ENERGY CHEMICAL GROUP CO LTD;CHINA COAL ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;ORDOS YIHUA MINING RESOURCES CO LTD

title_en: Container fire experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire experiments and discloses a container fire experiment device which comprises a container body, a fire occurrence unit, a temperature detection unit and a temperature detection unit, wherein the fire occurrence unit is arranged in the container body and is suitable for placing a fire source, the temperature detection unit is movably arranged in the container body and is suitable for detecting temperatures of different positions in the container body. The utility model is based on the container body, creates a scene close to reality for experiments, and the internally arranged fire disaster generating unit is positioned in the container body, so that the fire disaster generating source in the container can be accurately simulated by placing the fire source and controlling parameters such as the type, the intensity and the like of the fire disaster generating unit, and the utility model provides possibility for researching the fire disaster development under different conditions. The movably arranged temperature detection units can be flexibly arranged at different positions inside the container body, and the temperature change of each position can be effectively detected.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake-resistant disaster-reduction simulation system capable of liquefying foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer modeling, in particular to an earthquake-resistant disaster-reduction simulation system for a liquefiable foundation. The system comprises a cyclic stress ratio field analysis unit, a superhole pressure ratio evolution analysis unit and a stress coupling correction unit, wherein the cyclic stress ratio field analysis unit is used for generating a cyclic stress ratio field by utilizing a depth reduction relation, the superhole pressure ratio evolution analysis unit is used for deducing a superhole pressure ratio and establishing an evolution relation of the superhole pressure ratio with time and depth, and the stress coupling correction unit is used for updating an effective vertical stress value based on the superhole pressure ratio, synchronously correcting a shear modulus according to a coupling relation of a shear wave speed and the superhole pressure ratio and feeding the corrected shear modulus back to the superhole pressure ratio evolution analysis unit. The invention effectively improves the scientificity and engineering applicability of the liquefiable foundation for earthquake and disaster reduction.

title_en: Multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode traffic network robustness calculation method under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing an inter-city public traffic network comprising a plurality of traffic modes, generating an air pressure attenuation model and a typhoon continuous influence model by combining space-time dynamic characteristics of the typhoon disasters, calculating failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters based on a system vulnerability curve and a Monte Carlo simulation method, establishing a traffic network cascade failure model according to the failure probability distribution and state of the inter-city public traffic network under the typhoon disasters, simulating the structure and function loss process of traffic network sites and lines under the disaster conditions, designing a traffic network robustness index calculation system, and quantifying the performance change of the inter-city public traffic network from two aspects of topological structures and service functions. The invention can accurately quantify the influence of typhoon disasters on a traffic system.

title_en: Internal solitary wave identification method based on synthetic aperture radar altitude data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine remote sensing and discloses an internal solitary wave identification method based on synthetic aperture radar altimeter data, which comprises the following steps of collecting multidimensional characteristic components observed by a Sentinel-3 satellite synthetic aperture radar altimeter, and preprocessing the multidimensional characteristic components; the method comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out frequency domain band-pass filtering and self-adaptive sliding standard deviation operation on the preprocessed multidimensional characteristic components, constructing an input tensor composed of four characteristic components after normalization processing, constructing a deep learning model ISW-DETSRALNET, training the model, inputting the input tensor into a model which is qualified in training, and automatically identifying internal solitary wave information by the model. The method disclosed by the invention can effectively inhibit the interference of ocean background noise, remarkably improve the accuracy and robustness of internal solitary wave detection, and provide technical support for ocean power environment monitoring, internal solitary wave disaster early warning and ocean engineering safety.

title_en: Fire disaster simulation method, device, equipment and medium for new energy vehicle roll-on and roll-off places
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire simulation method, a device, equipment and a medium for a rolling place of a new energy vehicle, which are characterized in that an accurate fire risk simulation evaluation model is established, a fire scene model of mixed transportation and subarea transportation of the rolling place is set, and based on key data such as temperature distribution, heat radiation intensity and the like, the method comprises the steps of simulating the spreading condition of the fire disaster of the electric vehicle under different transportation strategies, further evaluating the effectiveness of the transportation strategies, formulating the transportation strategies of the roll-on-roll ship according to the vehicle power mode, and providing scientific basis for formulating reasonable transportation strategies and emergency response measures of the roll-on-roll site, so that the safety of the roll-on-roll site of the new energy vehicle is improved.
assignees: COSCO SHIPPING SPECIALIZED CARRIERS CO LTD

title_en: About Jian Gaosi kernel self-adaptive filtering method and system based on nearest center estimation
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for self-adaptive filtering of about Jian Gaosi cores based on nearest center estimation, which relate to the field of data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining initial parameters and training sets, constructing a self-adaptive filtering system based on the initial parameters, carrying out cluster division on input signals, obtaining feature vectors of the input signals through calculating about Jian Gaosi cores, selecting corresponding sub-filters according to the clusters to predict, obtaining predicted output, constructing a target optimization problem according to a maximum correlation entropy criterion based on the errors of the predicted output and expected output, converting the target optimization problem into a convex optimization problem, solving the convex optimization problem through hybridization of three conjugate gradients, updating weights of the sub-filters, and repeating the steps to enable errors of the self-adaptive filtering system to converge, thereby completing the self-adaptive filtering process. The application solves the problem of dimension disaster existing in the traditional feature mapping method through about Jian Gaosi cores, remarkably reduces the computational complexity, and simultaneously greatly reduces unnecessary computational overhead through nearest center estimation.

title_en: Real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time earthquake disaster early warning of earthquake engineering, in particular to a real-time earthquake motion numerical prediction method fusing fracture directivity effect, which carries out filtering and baseline correction on a real-time observation strong vibration waveform of an earthquake table network, corrects the ground earthquake motion waveform to a bedrock site by using an empirical site effect correction model, then converts the corrected acceleration record into energy parameters, and generating a meshed bedrock seismic energy field through Kerling space interpolation, simulating a seismic energy space-time propagation process based on an RTT model by utilizing a Monte Carlo method, and obtaining a predicted seismic energy field with a plurality of time steps.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Prediction method for flue gas layer thickness of V-shaped slope tunnel of water adding spray system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a prediction method for the thickness of a smoke layer in a V-shaped slope tunnel of a water adding spray system. The smoke layer thickness prediction method comprises the steps of determining a fire scene according to a tunnel structure and a gradient, establishing a tunnel model in fire dynamics simulation software FDS, setting basic parameters of the tunnel model, dividing grids, determining influence factors and basic physical quantities of smoke layer thickness, obtaining dimensionless items of the influence factors according to pi theorem, deducing a dimensionless calculation formula of the smoke layer thickness, changing the tunnel gradient, fire source power and water spray flow, performing numerical simulation to obtain smoke layer thickness values in the tunnel under different working conditions, drawing simulation results into a scatter diagram, performing nonlinear fitting to obtain values of unknown coefficients in the dimensionless relation, and further constructing a smoke layer thickness prediction model in the dimensionless V-shaped slope tunnel. The method is suitable for predicting the thickness of the smoke layer of the tunnel when the fire disaster of the symmetrical V-shaped slope tunnel occurs with different fire source powers, different water spray flows and different gradients.

title_en: Transformer fire risk detection method and device and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems, and relates to a method and a device for detecting the fire risk of a transformer and a readable storage medium, wherein the method and the device are used for acquiring the operation parameters of all parts in the transformer, and acquiring the characteristic parameters of all parts in the transformer, the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of combustible substances in the transformer and the load data of all parts of the transformer under the combustion thermodynamic characteristic parameters of the combustible substances based on the type and the voltage level of the transformer; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional model of the transformer based on operation parameters and characteristic parameters of all components in the transformer, gridding the three-dimensional model of the transformer to obtain a three-dimensional grid model of the transformer, dynamically simulating the three-dimensional grid model of the transformer based on load data of all components of the transformer under the combustion mechanical characteristic parameters of combustible substances to output fire risk indexes of all components in the transformer, and calculating the fire risk indexes of the transformer to be detected based on the fire risk indexes of all components and fire risk propagation coefficients among all components.
assignees: STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV COMPANY;STATE GRID NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Real-time aviation geomagnetic anomaly measurement and analysis method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the aeromagnetic detection technical field, and discloses a real-time aerogeomagnetic anomaly measurement analysis method and system of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which are used for analyzing the volume and power consumption boundary of an atomic air chamber under the requirement of project precision indexes according to the environmental adaptability problem of a core component of the precision of a magnetometer influenced by the atomic air chamber and a laser light source, realizing the optimization of the volume power consumption by combining experimental correction, stabilizing the frequency and the power of a laser by developing a high-precision temperature control circuit, the atomic spectral line signals are utilized to further stabilize the laser frequency, the technology for identifying and extracting the magnetic anomalies of the human magnetic source is constructed through the identification of the weak magnetic signals of the human magnetic source and the extraction of the anomaly information, the numerical simulation and physical simulation methods are applied to research the general distribution rule of the magnetic field of the magnetic source under the spatial distribution of different background magnetic fields, and the technology for detecting and identifying the hidden meaningful magnetic bodies under the complex disaster environment is broken through.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Based on VR gas safety emergency training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of training simulation, and discloses a gas safety emergency training system based on VR (virtual reality). The system comprises a three-dimensional scene construction module, an interactive data acquisition module, an interactive data processing module, an assessment data analysis module and an assessment evaluation module; the training method replaces physical exercise, training can be repeated for an infinite number of times in the same scene, training cost is obviously reduced, a VR technology provides multi-sense stimulation, visual cognition of students on danger is enhanced, safety consciousness and emergency response capability are effectively improved, dangerousness is avoided, key coefficients such as timeliness ‌, ‌ path planning rationality ‌ and the like are automatically calculated by a system through collecting student operation data, the operation precision ‌, ‌ flow compliance ‌ and ‌ of ‌ equipment are processed, scientific quantification and accurate scoring of training effects are achieved, automatic grading evaluation is carried out according to scoring results, a custom review module is triggered on students with insufficient capability, a 'training-assessment-intervention' closed loop is formed, and overall training efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANYANG CHINA RESOURCES GAS CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic disaster dynamic monitoring accurate early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring and accurate early warning method for water conservancy disasters, which relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy and emergency management and comprises the following steps of carrying out multisource data fusion modeling in advance, acquiring high-precision DEM (digital elevation model) and point cloud data through a high-molecular satellite and an unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR, and constructing a multidimensional database containing topography, hydrology and personnel distribution according to hydrologic monitoring and communication signaling data; and carrying out small-river-area disaster evolution simulation. The method realizes multi-source data fusion, improves monitoring comprehensiveness and instantaneity, solves the problems of limited monitoring range and insufficient precision of the traditional single data source, simultaneously realizes high-precision positioning and track prediction, realizes dynamic tracking of personnel coordinate centimeter-level to 200 meters precision, and combines a state space model to smoothly predict the track in a signal shielding scene, thereby avoiding positioning interruption and providing real-time and continuous personnel distribution data support for disaster influence evaluation.

title_en: Two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of power distribution system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage fault recovery method for improving elasticity of a power distribution system, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon space-time evolution model to generate a predicted fault scene, simulating a power distribution line in the predicted fault scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method to generate a plurality of fault scenes, constructing an uncertain set based on an information entropy value of the fault scenes and a fault weight, further constructing a robust optimization model, solving the robust optimization model, determining a pre-layout scheme of a mobile energy storage system and a static reactive compensator in the worst fault scene before disaster, constructing a multi-source collaborative post-disaster multi-period multi-objective fault recovery model, and realizing recovery of a power loss load and the fault line of the power distribution system by reconstructing and optimally scheduling the mobile energy storage system, the static reactive compensator, a maintenance team and electric vehicles through a network. The invention remarkably improves the overall elasticity of the power distribution system, not only enhances the disaster resistance capability, but also improves the capability of quickly recovering power supply.

title_en: Dynamic course reminding self-adaption method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-mode environment state observation model by the algorithm, collecting multiple types of data such as user behaviors, course attributes and the like through a mobile terminal GPS and a course management system interface, and forming a 12-dimensional state vector to serve as environment state input of a deep reinforcement learning framework. And then designing a deep reinforcement learning framework and a reward function, adopting an Actor-Critic network architecture, generating a reminding strategy by a strategy network, evaluating the strategy value by a value network, and training the network by a specific objective function and gradient updating mode. Meanwhile, a disaster recovery mechanism and multi-scene adaptation are established, course change events are monitored in real time, and emergency reminding is triggered. And finally integrating the trained model into practical application, generating a course reminding strategy based on student learning behavior data in real time, realizing self-adaptive reminding of a dynamic course, and effectively improving accuracy and user experience of course reminding.

title_en: Lightweight human body target detection method and system based on improvement YOLOv11
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lightweight human body target detection method and system based on an improvement YOLOv (compact disc) 11, and belongs to the technical field of target detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a background image and a human body target image, constructing a data set, dividing the data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing a light human body target detection model LIGHTSEEK-YOLO, training the constructed light human body target detection model LIGHTSEEK-YOLO by using the training set, evaluating a target detection result by using an evaluation index, and testing the trained light human body target detection model LIGHTSEEK-YOLO by using the test set. The invention can more accurately and rapidly detect personnel targets in a complex disaster scene, and provides powerful technical support for disaster rescue.

title_en: Nuclear power station bearing device collision safety analysis method
abstract_en: The application relates to a collision safety analysis method for a nuclear power station bearing device. The method comprises the steps of simulating a preset collision on a nuclear power station bearing device, performing anti-collision capacity simulation calculation on a bearing device structure of the nuclear power station bearing device to obtain an anti-collision capacity calculation result and a collision impact load generated by the preset collision, analyzing a first impact result of the preset collision on equipment in the nuclear power station bearing device based on the anti-collision capacity calculation result, evaluating a second impact result of the collision impact load on a key structure of the nuclear power station bearing device, determining a failure non-impact object item from the nuclear power station bearing device based on the collision impact load, evaluating a third impact result of a secondary disaster of the failure non-impact object item on a safety level object item, and obtaining a safety analysis result of the nuclear power station bearing device based on the first impact result, the second impact result and the third impact result. By adopting the method, the accuracy of safety evaluation can be improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER INST CO LTD;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel water and mud bursting catastrophe evolution stage division method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dividing a disaster evolution stage of water burst and mud burst of a tunnel, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel engineering and comprises the following steps of S1, investigating geology and hydrogeology of an excavated section of the tunnel, S2, carrying out geophysical prospecting and advanced drilling test on the unexplored section of the tunnel, S3, obtaining geological conditions and hydrogeological conditions of the excavated section of the tunnel according to tunnel body information, S4, obtaining water burst characteristics of the excavated section, S5, analyzing water chemical characteristics and water rock action characteristics of water burst of the tunnel, S6, obtaining supply elevation, supply sources and supply proportion of each supply source of the water burst of the tunnel, S7, obtaining rock mass density characteristics of the unexplored section, S8, obtaining geological conditions and water outlet conditions of the unexplored section, and S9, comprehensively judging and dividing the disaster evolution stage of the water burst and mud burst of the tunnel. According to the method, the tunnel water-flooding catastrophe evolution stage can be judged by combining various information indexes, the catastrophe evolution stage is scientifically divided, and the accuracy of a judging result is improved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;SICHUAN TIBET RAILWAY CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Multi-mode knowledge graph-based park multistage intelligent reasoning early warning system
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of data island, high false alarm rate, response lag and the like of the traditional park early warning system, the invention provides an intelligent early warning system integrating the perceived data of the Internet of things and the domain knowledge graph, which is suitable for park safety prevention and control in the industries of chemical industry, logistics, manufacturing and the like. The knowledge graph is an ideal tool for modeling the connection between objective objects in the real world, and the problem of data island can be effectively solved by constructing the knowledge graph and the fusion intelligent reasoning algorithm for the intelligent park safety management field, and the accuracy and timeliness of park risk early warning are obviously improved. Specifically, the invention designs a whole set of early warning system from bottom to top in three aspects of multi-mode knowledge graph modeling, three-level early warning reasoning engine and self-adaptive optimization mechanism, and establishes the park early warning requirement which meets the current intelligentization and saves the labor cost. The multi-modal knowledge graph relates to six types of ontology concepts, and comprises different data types, including equipment topological relation, environment parameter association, emergency plan, risk analysis, attack behavior simulation and asset attribute model. The three-level early warning reasoning comprises rule reasoning, sub-graph matching reasoning and link prediction reasoning. The self-adaptive optimization technology aims at constructing a feedback learning mechanism, taking the treatment result of each early warning into a knowledge graph, and continuously optimizing the object relation weight. In early warning simulation experiments, the scheme of the invention realizes the effect that the false alarm rate is reduced by 42% and the emergency response speed is improved by 60%, thereby proving the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme.
assignees: INNOVATION DRIVE SHAANXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic model real-time correction method based on reinforcement learning A2C algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrological model real-time correction method based on a reinforcement learning A2C algorithm, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining basic data of a research area and preprocessing, 2, constructing a real-time correction model based on the reinforcement learning A2C algorithm, 3, training and verifying the real-time correction model, and 4, correcting rainfall in real time by using the real-time correction model. According to the method, the problems that the traditional method is slow in convergence and easy to sink into local optimum are solved by coupling reinforcement learning A2C algorithm and hydrologic model, and high-precision and self-adaptive real-time correction of flood forecast is realized. The method of the invention obviously improves the accuracy and dynamic response capability of flood forecast, and provides reliable technical support for flood control and disaster reduction and water resource management.

title_en: Prestressed pipe pile for slope reinforcement and slope reinforcement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prestressed pipe pile for slope reinforcement, which comprises a base, a pile body, a small tray, a large tray and a plurality of vertical steel bars, wherein the lower end of the pile body is connected with the middle part of the base, a flange plate extending to the periphery is arranged at the top of the pile body, a plurality of radial holes are distributed on the side wall of the pile body, one end of each radial hole is communicated with the vertical hole in the middle part of the pile body, the other end of each radial hole is communicated with the outside of the pile body, the large tray and the small tray are sleeved outside the pile body in a sliding manner through a central hole, the large tray is positioned below the small tray, the plurality of vertical steel bars are distributed around the pile body, the lower ends of the large tray and the small tray are connected with the base, and the upper ends of the large tray are screwed into nuts after penetrating through the steel bar mounting holes in the large tray. The invention also provides a side slope reinforcement method. According to the invention, the mechanical property of the rock mass is enhanced by grouting and applying prestress, the bending strength of the pile body is enhanced and the aperture of a drilled hole is reduced by combining a plurality of prestress pipe piles, and the disturbance of construction on a side slope is weakened, so that the side slope is effectively reinforced, and landslide disasters are prevented.
assignees: HEBEI IRON & STEEL GROUP SIJIAYING YANSHAN IRON MINE CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Fire-fighting limited space training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of training equipment, in particular to fire-fighting limited space training equipment, which comprises a tank body, wherein a plurality of manholes penetrating through the tank body are formed in the tank body, the manholes are used for a firefighter to enter and exit the tank body, a flange is arranged on the manholes, and the flange is arranged outside the manholes. The utility model discloses a fire control limited space training equipment simulation chemical industry device tower ware structure is provided with climbing facility, manhole in the outside of training equipment, and inside sets up intermediate layer and circular passageway, and firefighter can carry out rescue special training through limited space equipment for various rescue conditions of better processing. In addition, the training environment of the chemical device can be created, different limited space environments and training difficulties can be designed according to training requirements, emergency response capability of firefighters in a dark environment and a closed environment is trained, and emergency rescue capability of firefighters is improved.
assignees: HENGLI PETROCHEMICAL DALIAN REFINERY CO LTD

title_en: Surface runoff estimation and flood simulation method based on impermeable surface of town
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban flood disaster prevention and control, in particular to a surface runoff estimation and flood simulation method based on impermeable surfaces of towns. The method comprises the steps of dividing a target town area into a plurality of sub-areas, collecting spectral information of remote sensing satellite images in each sub-area, calculating spectral characteristic indexes of each sub-area based on the spectral information, determining a water-impermeable surface area in the target town area based on the spectral characteristic indexes of each sub-area through a clustering algorithm, calculating surface runoff of the water-impermeable surface area based on precipitation, collecting soil information of areas adjacent to the water-impermeable surface area, calculating permeability coefficients of the areas adjacent to the water-impermeable surface area based on the soil information, judging whether flood risks exist in the water-impermeable surface area based on the permeability coefficients and the surface runoff, and improving accuracy of surface runoff estimation and reliability of flood simulation.

title_en: Method and device for determining catalyst and machine-readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for determining a catalyst and a machine-readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial weather modification. The method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining index values of test indexes of a plurality of different types of catalyst samples, wherein the index values are index values of the catalyst samples tested in a preset strong freezing rain simulation environment, and the key conditions of freezing rain are reproduced through a simulation platform so as to overcome the deviation between a traditional laboratory and a real scene. The method comprises the steps of determining the weight of each test index based on all index values and weight distribution algorithms, determining the evaluation score of the catalyst sample based on a multi-criterion decision algorithm and the index values and weights of each test index for each kind of catalyst sample, and determining the catalyst sample with the highest evaluation score as a target catalyst. The performance of different types of catalysts is scientifically and comprehensively evaluated, so that scientific basis is provided for the selection and application of the catalysts, and the cost for preventing and controlling the freezing rain disasters is reduced.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Training subjects rapid construction method and system based on flow layout
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training subject rapid construction method and system based on process arrangement, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing nodes required by the training subject, including tool nodes, system nodes and disaster nodes, wherein the tool nodes comprise start nodes, end nodes and parallel nodes, the system nodes comprise environment setting nodes, scene setting nodes, self-checking nodes and evaluation nodes, the disaster nodes comprise fire nodes, smoke nodes and wounded nodes, arranging the training subject process based on the nodes, verifying the process standardization, storing the verified process as a training subject model, and calling the training subject model to execute the training subject. According to the invention, the needed flow nodes are constructed according to the training subjects, the training subject flows are organized based on the nodes, stored as models and trained, the complex scene information can be converted into the node information which can be configured, the nodes can be organized according to the actual requirements, the purpose construction requirements of diversified training subjects are met, and the flexible combination and personalized definition are realized.

title_en: Intelligent medical visual voice call control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent medical visual voice call control method and system, which are used for monitoring and acquiring first data representing vital body characteristics of a monitored main body, second data representing the environment of the monitored main body and the expression intention of the monitored main body in real time, and calling a control center intelligently according to the first data, the change of the second data and the expression intention of the monitored main body. The multi-mode call request control method is adopted, so that the emergency response speed and the judgment accuracy are remarkably improved, meanwhile, the dependence of a patient on the operation of medical equipment is reduced, the self-service efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the wide deployment adaptation scenes of family scenes, community medical treatment and intelligent terminals are supported without limitation. Secondly, through intelligent model pre-training, disagreement map information is matched with patient's illness state, efficient and orderly unfolding of response requests is guaranteed, medical resources are divided into reasonable and public levels, and guarantee is provided for fair and reasonable medical seeking of patients.
assignees: The Sixth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Electric bicycle fire simulation demonstration method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation demonstration method and a device for fire disaster of an electric bicycle, which relate to the technical field of fire safety simulation, and are used for acquiring a demonstration main body of the simulation demonstration device for fire disaster of the electric bicycle, wherein a simulation assembly is assembled in the demonstration main body and comprises an electric bicycle model, a fire simulation assembly, a smoke release assembly and a smoke exhaust fan, a transparent observation window and a temperature sensor are externally arranged, and the simulation assembly is connected with a main controller through a relay IO module; and the main controller sends out a control instruction which is used for driving the relay IO module to coordinate the action of the simulation component, and the fire simulation flow is executed to realize the fire phenomenon of open fire simulation.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;SICHUAN TIANZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide identification method and system based on staged feature self-adaptive transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing technical field of artificial intelligence and geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a landslide identification method and system based on staged characteristic self-adaptive transfer learning, comprising the steps of constructing an initial landslide identification model F  1  with an encoder-decoder; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a domain-adaptive landslide recognition optimization model F  2  by migrating general vision pre-training weights and utilizing encoder parameters of a source domain remote sensing image dataset D  S  fine-tuning model F  1 , inputting a source domain remote sensing image dataset D  S  and a target domain unmanned aerial vehicle image dataset D  T  into a model F  2 , obtaining a domain-adaptive model F  3  based on covariance alignment mechanism processing, inputting a small amount of target domain small sample data D'  T  with labels into the model F  3 , fine-tuning specified parameters in the model F  3  through a supervision learning mechanism to obtain a target domain adaptation model F  4 , and executing a landslide recognition task on an input unmanned aerial vehicle image to be detected based on the target domain adaptation model F  4 .

title_en: Single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-hole coal rock stress state acquisition method for drill-in sensing-drill-out correction, and belongs to the technical field of mine dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining wave speed and acoustic emission dynamic characteristics of coal and rock, determining a perception index threshold value, secondly selecting drilling engineering, installing a wave field acquisition tool, thirdly setting acquisition parameters, acquiring and transmitting wave field signals in real time, fourthly performing data noise reduction processing to obtain characteristic parameter values, fifthly selecting the index threshold value, dynamically perceiving an initial stress state of the coal and rock, sixthly, performing drilling-returning peeping scanning, correcting the stress state of the coal and rock in real time, and seventhly, performing inversion imaging to obtain a hole circumferential stress field. According to the invention, dynamic perception of the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state in the drilling process is realized, the hole circumference stress correction degree is provided, and the Kong Zhoumei rock initial stress state is objectively corrected in the drilling withdrawal process, so that a real basis is provided for comprehensively acquiring the underground coal rock stratum stress state.

title_en: Complex terrain karst tunnel disaster identification method and system based on advanced drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a complex terrain karst tunnel disaster identification method and system based on advanced drilling, which are used for determining the risk level of a target karst tunnel by combining geological conditions, hydrologic conditions and structural mechanics response, further determining an advanced prediction detection scheme of the target karst tunnel, reasonably selecting the advanced prediction detection scheme according to the risk condition of the target karst tunnel, and determining the dynamic weights of different advanced prediction detection methods based on the matching degree, the historical accuracy of the different advanced prediction detection methods on the type of the target karst tunnel and the quality of the related data of the target karst tunnel currently acquired by the advanced prediction detection method, so that the more accurate advanced prediction detection method can be effectively utilized, and the accuracy of subsequent identification is improved.
assignees: GUANGXI COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;GUANGXI GUIXIANG HIGHWAY CO LTD;GUANGXI INSTITUTE OF TRANSP TECHNICIAN;GUANGXI ROAD & BRIDGE ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Single-ditch debris flow disaster-induced intensity prediction method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-ditch debris flow disaster-causing intensity prediction method considering climate change, which is characterized in that a time window is moved to adapt to the change trend of historical climate, the time window is gradually changed from small to large, and the rainfall sequence characteristics of different historical periods are subjected to stability test, so that the rainfall time periods with different statistical characteristics are determined. The span length of the rainfall time period determines the analysis of rainfall sequences and the analysis of the disaster-causing intensity of the debris flow, which can be performed on the time of the multiple teenagers in the future. Then, the rainfall extremum of different time periods is calculated and fitted, and the rainfall extremum of future time periods can be extrapolated. According to the concrete geological conditions of the gully where the debris flow is located, the disaster-causing strength prediction of the debris flow is realized by utilizing FLO-2D simulation in combination with the influence of the debris flow on the surface runoff. The invention can realize the dynamic coupling of hydrodynamic force change and slope response mechanism under the climate change situation, and reveal the influence rule of climate change on the triggering and movement of the debris flow disaster.

title_en: Drilling investigation device for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation, in particular to a drilling investigation device for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises a supporting circular plate, a plurality of locking universal wheels arranged at the bottom of the supporting circular plate, and a drilling mechanism, wherein the drilling mechanism is used for preventing and controlling the drilling investigation of geological disaster areas and is positioned on the supporting circular plate; when the device performs drilling rotation exploration to generate dust, the invention can spray the mixture of water and dust suppressant, effectively inhibit dust diffusion, improve working environment, ensure the health of staff, fully stir the mixture of water and dust suppressant entering the water inlet hose by utilizing the rotation action of the rotating screen plate, promote the dust suppression effect of spraying the mixture of water and dust suppressant, and simultaneously drive the impeller to drive the rotating rod to rotate by water flow impact on the basis of revolution of the rotating tube, so that the rotating tube rotates, the mixture of water and dust suppressant is uniformly sprayed, the dust suppression range is enlarged, and the dust suppression effect is improved.
assignees: XINDIAN COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Grading method and grading system for surrounding rocks of tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering, in particular to a grading method and a grading system of tunnel surrounding rock, wherein the grading method comprises intelligent perception and data acquisition, multi-source data fusion and modeling, dynamic grading of a mixed model, real-time decision and support optimization, online learning and dynamic feedback, and risk early warning and emergency response; compared with the geological data acquisition mode of combining manual drilling coring with low-resolution geophysical prospecting in the prior art, the method has the defects of low efficiency, large subjective error and difficulty in covering complex geological structures, achieves real-time dynamic acquisition of full-section geological information through unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR scanning, intelligent rock core image analysis and high-density internet of things (IoT) sensor network collaborative operation, eliminates manual intervention errors by combining a multi-source data fusion algorithm, remarkably improves automation level and three-dimensional space characterization precision of data acquisition, and provides a high-resolution holographic data base for surrounding rock classification.
assignees: CHONGQING YICHENG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: System, method, medium and equipment for drilling of oil gas production system by virtual-real fusion attack and defense
abstract_en: The application provides a virtual-real fusion attack and defense exercise system, a virtual-real fusion attack and defense exercise method, a medium and equipment of an oil gas production system, which comprise a virtual-real simulation module, a local attack module and a safety protection module, wherein the virtual-real simulation module is used for simulating the field operation environment of the oil gas production system, maintaining the communication control relation between a regulation and control center and station equipment, receiving an attack instruction, simulating the physical influence of the station equipment of the oil gas production system under the attack condition, monitoring a network risk area of the oil gas production system, calling the attack strategy instruction to initiate the attack instruction to a communication link or a control node in the network risk area, and the safety protection module is used for detecting the system abnormality of the station equipment in the simulation module, calling a protection strategy matched with the system abnormality to carry out linkage protection and generating an attack and defense exercise report. The application can provide a high-fidelity experimental environment for attack penetration, active defense and emergency response faced by the oil gas production system in a real scene, and effectively ensure the safety protection capability of the oil gas production system.

title_en: Implementation method of immersion type dangerous working condition emergency exercise platform based on Web and VR equipment and exercise platform
abstract_en: An implementation method of an immersive dangerous condition emergency exercise platform based on Web and VR equipment and the exercise platform belong to the field of Web visualization and emergency management. Solves the common problems of high cost, high risk, poor immersion and insufficient flexibility of the traditional means. The method comprises the steps of constructing a Web front-end system, integrating a Babylon JS engine to realize 3D scene rendering, loading and analyzing an industrial equipment model in GLTF/OBJ format, butting VR head display equipment by utilizing WebXR API of Babylon JS, defining a drilling flow by a configurable JSON/JS script, recording user operation paths, reaction time and operation sequence data to generate a quantized evaluation report, realizing multi-person collaborative drilling based on WebSocket, and supporting an administrator to monitor participant behaviors and remotely intervene through a background interface. The method is used in the field of emergency response exercise.
assignees: DAQING ANRUIDA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Urban rainstorm and waterlogging simulation forecasting method applicable to pipe-lacking network data area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation forecasting method suitable for urban rainstorm and waterlogging in a pipe-network-lacking data area, which is characterized in that for a pipe-network-free data area, rainwater inspection well information is acquired by calling a hundred-degree map, drainage flow of a pipeline is generalized based on a rainwater well equivalent drainage method, for a pipe-network-containing data area, a drainage pipe network model based on a one-dimensional Saint Vinan equation is built by adopting a finite difference method, then a hydrodynamic model is built, the rainwater well equivalent drainage method and the drainage pipe network model are coupled with a FVCOM model, an earth surface ponding evolution process is simulated, a rainstorm and waterlogging data set is obtained, a water depth forecasting model is built based on the obtained data training, and then the water depth of each forecasting point after a specific time is predicted in an actual rainfall event, and when the waterlogging early warning range is reached, the pre-warning can be performed in advance. The method can realize the advanced prediction of the submerged depth of the spot easy to flood, can realize the prediction of the flood in the city of the network-lacking data, and greatly reduces the loss of storm disasters.

title_en: Drainage basin hydrologic prediction method based on digital twin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a watershed hydrologic prediction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, processing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a multi-source data set, constructing a multi-dimensional space feature set according to the multi-source data set, simulating a hydrologic cycle process by adopting a finite volume method based on the multi-dimensional space feature set, obtaining a hydrologic cycle simulation result, obtaining an error value of the hydrologic cycle simulation result and actual observation data, carrying out nonlinear relation mining on the multi-dimensional space feature set by a neural network algorithm based on the error value to obtain a data driving prediction result, fusing the hydrologic cycle simulation result and the data driving prediction result by adopting a weighted fusion algorithm to obtain a fusion prediction result, constructing a digital twinning model based on the digital twinning model according to the fusion prediction result, and predicting the hydrologic state in real time. The invention can provide more effective decision support for water resource management and flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Mud-rock fluid section impact force experiment and field measurement method
abstract_en: In the section impact force experimental measurement, an experimental system and data are utilized to construct a section empirical green function through convolution inversion, and then a vertical earthquake signal is obtained through measurement at any section, so that the measurement of the solid phase vertical impact force at the section is realized. Further introducing flow depth parameters and realizing the measurement of the vertical impact force of the liquid phase on the section. In the field measurement of the section impact force, the experimental measurement is used as the basis, the problem of simulation and identification of the field mud-rock fluid is solved, and the measurement of the vertical impact force of the solid phase and the liquid phase on the section of the channel is realized. The optimization scheme solves the problems of signal compensation and calculation of particle characteristic particle size by using the PSD inversion of the power spectrum density of the signal. The method solves the problems of directly inverting and measuring the debris flow impact force by using the earthquake vibration signal and respectively measuring the solid-liquid phase vertical impact force, so that the data of the earthquake monitoring station network can be more effectively utilized in the mountain disaster field.

title_en: Construction management method and construction management system utilizing 4D model system
abstract_en: To provide a construction management method configured to determine and provide a degree of influence on construction through environmental impact simulation that combines environmental information with a construction management 4D model, and obtain an evacuation plan corresponding to the degree of influence to be provided to a construction site, thereby improving safety and productivity.SOLUTION: A construction management method that utilizes a 4D model system includes the steps of: preparing a plan 4D model which is a time-based plan three-dimensional structural diagram in a construction site; preparing, based on the plan 4D model, an actual/corrected 4D model which is a three-dimensional structural diagram obtained by reflecting actual results with the progress of the construction; obtaining environmental information including environmental change forecast; performing environmental impact simulation while reflecting the environmental information acquired by the actual/corrected 4D model; and providing a result of the environmental impact simulation to a terminal of a person concerned, obtaining an evacuation plan formulated by the person concerned, and providing the evacuation plan in combination with the environmental impact simulation result to the construction site.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Disaster Safe Experience System For Education
title_ko: 다중 밀집 체험 시뮬레이터 및 이를 이용한 다중 밀집 체험 시스템
abstract_en: A multi-density experience simulator is provided, comprising: a booth (100) of a set shape with an internal space provided to allow entry of an experiencer; a compression unit (200) installed on each of the four sides of the booth to repeatedly press the experiencer entering from all sides to create a multi-density situation; and a video unit (300) placed on both sides of the booth to provide video and sound indicating a multi-density situation, wherein the booth (100) comprises: a floor portion (110) of a set area equipped with casters; a wall portion (120) vertically installed from the edge of the floor portion; an entrance portion (130) placed at one of the wall portions to selectively shield the experience space; a ceiling portion (140) shielding the upper part of the booth; and an extension portion (150) extending outward from both sides of the wall portion. According to the present invention, since one can experience a stampede accident caused by a crowded situation that is difficult to experience in normal times in a safe place, it is effective because it not only raises awareness of the risks of stampedes but also enables effective response in the event of a stampede accident through the experience of stampede accidents caused by crowding and education on how to respond to such accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군중이 일시적으로 몰려 인명사고가 발생하는 상황을 임의 구현 내지 직·간접적으로 체험할 수 있게 제공함으로써 사고 발생 시 효과적인 대처와 함께 이에 대한 위험성을 인지하여 원초적으로 안전사고가 발생하지 않게 적극 유도하고, 나아가 다양한 상황을 고려한 맞춤형 조건을 구현하기 위하여 체험부스의 공간 확장과 축소 기능은 물론 다중 밀집에 대한 영상과 음향 효과가 구현 가능할 뿐 아니라 군중에 의한 불가항력의 움직임과 밀착에 의한 가압 정도를 세밀하게 제어하여 다중 밀집의 다양한 형태를 제공하는 등 기존과 차별화된 구조로부터 비롯되는 취급과 사용, 유지 및 관리 보수의 용이함 등으로 인해 사용의 편의성 내지 효율성이 극대화 유도되는 다중 밀집 체험 시뮬레이터 및 이를 이용한 다중 밀집 체험 시스템에 관한 것으로, 체험자의 입실을 허용토록 내부공간이 마련된 설정 형상의 부스(100);와, 부스의 사방면에 각 설치되어 입실 중인 체험자를 사방에서 반복적으로 압박하여 다중 밀집 상황을 조성되게 하는 압박유닛(200);과, 부스의 양면에 배치되어 다중 밀집 상황을 나타내는 영상 및 음향을 제공하는 영상유닛(300);으로 구성되고, 적어도 1인 이상의 체험자의 입장을 허용하는 부스부(10);와, 부스부 내에 설치되며 다중 밀집과 관련된 상황을 시각, 청각, 촉각에 대해 영상물을 제공하는 영상부(20);와, 부스부 내에 설치되며 체험자를 다방면에서 가압하여 인위적인 다중 밀집 상황을 연출하는 푸시부(30);와, 부스부 입구에 설치되어 부스부의 입장 인원을 파악하고, 푸시부에 부착되어 체험자의 가압압력을 파악하는 센서부(40);와, 영상부와 푸시부의 구동 조건을 설정 및 제어하는 제어부(50);로 구성된다.
assignees: CHANGJOIN CO LTD;LEE KYUNG SUK;LEE YOO KYUNG

title_en: Method and system for constructing three-party evolution game model related to power grid company, VPP operator and user
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a three-party evolution game model related to a power grid company, a Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operator and a user, which adopts an evolution game method to study the interaction behavior among the power grid, the Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operator and the user, and mainly improves the disaster resistance of an urban energy system. The effect of long-term power system development on simulation results was studied. Key parameters in the gaming model are determined by numerical modeling. The evolution stabilization strategy of the individual participants and the system as a whole is analyzed. According to the simulation results, as the unit load recovery benefit increases from 40 to 1000, three parties will give more and more priority to recovery capability in the decision. Furthermore, within certain parameters, the goal of increasing renewable energy consumption may conflict with the goal of improving the recovery capacity of the power system. The research can provide strategy suggestions for improving the long-term recovery capacity of the power system and valuable insights for formulating a feasible plan.

title_en: BIM-based pumping and storing station building foundation dangerous point management and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM-based system for managing and controlling basic dangerous points of a pumping and storing power station building, which comprises a data layer, an application layer, a model layer, a data layer and a disaster development path simulation layer, wherein the data layer organizes linear engineering monitoring data into a high-order tensor of 'pile number x time x sensor type x space position' by utilizing four-dimensional tensor modeling, dynamically identifies a strain rate mutation point in a compression process by combining sliding window anomaly detection and directly stores original data by utilizing a Tucker decomposition, and then implements a layered storage strategy on non-mutated data by utilizing a data value evaluation model driven by deep reinforcement learning, the model layer is used for fusing a physical information neural network, embedding a geotechnical constitutive equation into an LSTM network to construct a mixed loss function, combining project data to carry out small sample fine adjustment after pre-training a universal geological model by migration learning, and dynamically generating a dangerous source list and triggering instant early warning by utilizing a BIM model based on the output of the data layer, and simulating a disaster development path by combining a digital twin technology.

title_en: YOLO-Unet-based fire detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and discloses a fire detection method and a fire detection device based on YOLO-Unet, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a sample image set; the method comprises the steps of enhancing a sample image set to obtain an enhanced image set, training an initial fire detection model based on the enhanced image set to obtain a target fire detection model, wherein the initial fire detection model comprises a YOLOv model and a U-net model, acquiring an image to be detected, which is acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, and detecting the image to be detected by adopting the target fire detection model to obtain a fire detection result. The invention is beneficial to understanding fire characteristics by acquiring the sample image set, and the fire detection model consists of the YOLOv model and the U-net model, so that detection and segmentation integration is realized, a fire region can be rapidly positioned, an accurate shape can be provided, the fire detection accuracy is improved, and an important basis is provided for subsequent fire situation analysis, emergency response and prevention and control decision.

title_en: Emergency command and disaster recovery service system for civil aviation system flight
abstract_en: The invention relates to civil aviation emergency command disaster recovery, and discloses an emergency command and disaster recovery service system for civil aviation flight, which comprises an intelligent prediction and early warning module, an emergency command module and a virtual simulation and training module, wherein the intelligent prediction and early warning module is used for analyzing historical data and weather forecast information, predicting potential flight danger and challenges and providing real-time early warning and advice, the emergency command module is connected with the intelligent prediction and early warning module and used for processing emergency situations in flight and coordinating actions of an emergency response team and providing real-time communication and monitoring, and the virtual simulation and training module is connected with the emergency command module and used for creating a highly real flight simulation environment. The risk is identified in advance through intelligent early warning, the emergency command module rapidly responds and provides real-time communication monitoring, virtual simulation training enhances personnel handling capacity, meanwhile, stable operation and data safety of the system are guaranteed, data integrity is guaranteed through a block chain technology, and disaster backup service is provided to guarantee continuous operation of the system.

title_en: Digital twin airport oil depot based emergency drilling evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin technology and emergency management systems, and particularly relates to an emergency drilling evaluation system and method based on a digital twin airport oil depot. According to the multi-dimensional evaluation index system constructed by the comprehensive analysis and evaluation module based on the digital twin airport oil depot emergency exercise evaluation system and the method, the exercise effect is quantitatively evaluated from multiple aspects such as emergency response speed, resource utilization efficiency, loss control degree and the like by combining an analytic hierarchy process and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, various problems in the exercise process can be deeply analyzed, the generated evaluation report not only contains detailed problem analysis, but also provides a targeted improvement suggestion, and meanwhile, historical data and industry standards can be compared, so that evaluation is more scientific and accurate, and powerful support is provided for emergency management decisions.

title_en: Method and system for pre-warning trip of induction lightning of 10kV overhead line in plain town area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power distribution networks, and particularly discloses a method and a system for pre-warning tripping of a 10kV overhead line induction mine in a plain town area. Aiming at the problems that the existing method relies on full-wave electromagnetic simulation, is complex in calculation and low in efficiency, the invention provides a simplified model based on parameter dimension reduction. The method comprises the steps of determining key parameters such as lightning ground flash density, soil resistivity, insulator dry arc distance, wire average height and the like, constructing a tripping rate conversion model by establishing a nonlinear mapping relation between an inductive lightning tripping rate and the parameters, and avoiding traditional three-dimensional electromagnetic field simulation by combining characteristics of flat terrain and soil homogenization in a plain town area and coupling line parameters and lightning electromagnetic effects through functions. During calculation, the tripping rate is rapidly output according to the parameter range, and the risk dynamic assessment is realized by matching with the early warning level. The method solves the problems of high calculation force dependence and complex modeling, and provides an efficient tool for lightning protection reconstruction and digital management of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Ship monitoring method, medium and equipment based on Beidou vision fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship monitoring method, medium and equipment based on Beidou vision fusion, the multi-stage verification ship monitoring method is constructed by means of deep fusion of the Beidou positioning terminal and the vision AI monitoring equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining preliminary position information by obtaining alarm data uploaded by a Beidou terminal, scheduling an intelligent camera in a preset range, calculating accurate coordinates of a target based on reference positions and ranging data of the intelligent camera, driving the camera to zoom and turn to focus on a target area to collect visual data, carrying out event identification on the visual data by utilizing a pre-training model, carrying out consistency comparison verification on positioning alarm and visual identification results, and finally generating verification alarm comprising event types, accurate positions and image analysis. According to the technical scheme, the positioning accuracy and the alarm accuracy are effectively improved, the positioning accuracy and the event identification accuracy are remarkably improved, the false alarm condition is greatly reduced, and the emergency response time is effectively shortened.

title_en: Geological disaster risk point monitoring and emergency response system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and particularly discloses a geological disaster risk point monitoring and emergency response system and method, comprising the following steps of firstly, extracting statistical characteristics of historical monitoring data of each monitoring node for principal component analysis and extracting principal component data; the method comprises the steps of performing K-means clustering analysis on principal component data of each monitoring node to generate K-class data points to classify each monitoring node, and labeling time sequence data of K-class monitoring nodes, inputting the time sequence data into an initial LSTM model for training to output fault probability coefficients of the K-class monitoring nodes, inputting real-time sequence data of the K-class monitoring nodes into the trained LSTM model to output the predicted fault probability coefficients of the K-class monitoring nodes, judging the fault risk of the current monitoring node according to the magnitude of the predicted fault probability coefficients of the K-class monitoring nodes, and judging the current monitoring node as a risk node if the current fault probability exceeds a preset fault probability coefficient range.
assignees: SICHUAN INST OF METAL GEOLOGICAL SURVEY

title_en: Fire disaster test platform and test method for fire fighting equipment of transformer substation in Sha Ge barren region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control experiment platforms and discloses a fire control equipment fire test platform for transformer substations in Sha Ge barren areas, which comprises an experiment truss, wherein a main body oil tank is arranged in the experiment truss and is positioned in the geometric center area of the experiment truss, a smoke-sensing temperature-sensing fire detector is fixedly arranged at the inner top of the experiment truss and is positioned right above the main body oil tank, a fire detection camera is arranged at the upper part of the inner side wall of the experiment truss, and the installation position of the fire detection camera is higher than the top of the main body oil tank. According to the fire disaster test platform and the experimental method for the substation fire fighting equipment in the sand gorge region, the problems of scene simulation distortion, interfered data acquisition, stiff equipment layout and the like of the traditional platform are solved through multidimensional anti-interference monitoring of an environment sensing layer, dynamic decision of an intelligent control layer, extreme environment adaptation design of a hardware execution layer and closed loop optimization of a verification feedback layer.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA EHV POWER SUPPLY BRANCH INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Building fire point identification detection method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrier
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire point identification and detection method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle carrier, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to solve the technical problem that monitoring capability of a building is insufficient after a fire disaster occurs. The unmanned aerial vehicle detection method comprises the steps of integrating an edge service detector with an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain unmanned aerial vehicle detection equipment, configuring unmanned aerial vehicle flight track planning, a view angle and a deflection angle based on a building environment, determining frame rate and definition of video shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle according to video push flow conditions, collecting historical images shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a training data set based on processed images, marking images in the training data set to obtain marking information, constructing a new YOLOv-n-MobileNetV algorithm model to serve as a fire point recognition model, deploying the finally trained fire point recognition model to the edge service detector in a light mode, and recognizing fire points and smoke through the finally trained fire point recognition model.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test device and method for simulating breakage of ore earthquake focus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for simulating the fracture of a mineral earthquake focus, wherein a rock sample is placed in the test device and is mounted to a triaxial test machine, a loading method is determined according to the type of the fracture of the mineral earthquake focus to be simulated, the triaxial test machine is used for applying load, if the rock sample is required to be applied with pressure or pulling force, the upper clamping component and the lower clamping component are driven to apply required stress to the rock sample by applying pulling force or pressure to an inner frame, if the rock sample is required to be applied with shearing force, the two shearing stress loading components are simultaneously applied with pressure, and then the lower clamping component is driven to move along a horizontal sliding groove relative to the upper clamping component, the required shearing force is applied to the rock sample, so that compression-shearing composite fracture or tension-shearing composite fracture test is realized, and the fracture process of different mineral earthquake focuses is effectively simulated, so that acoustic emission data corresponding to the fracture process of different mineral earthquake focuses is acquired, and data support is provided for revealing the fracture evolution mechanism and disaster early warning.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;INNER MONGOLIA YITAI COAL CO LTD;UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst development area geological disaster identification method and system based on artificial intelligence, relates to the field of geological disaster early warning and risk assessment, and solves the technical problems that geology and related data are difficult to integrate, model prediction disaster types are difficult to construct based on historical disaster cases and real-time monitoring data, and a prediction result is lack of correlation with a geographic space so as to generate a risk distribution map and dynamically update a high risk area; the method comprises the following steps: introducing multi-source heterogeneous data and combining historical geological disaster cases; preprocessing data; extracting the characteristics of the change rate of the underground water level, the soil humidity and the vibration frequency; combining a plurality of features into a feature matrix, and projecting the feature matrix into a principal component space; after training a model by using a random forest algorithm, optimizing and constructing the model by combining cross verification and a Bayesian algorithm; converting the model prediction result into a risk grade value through a mapping rule; and generating a risk level distribution map based on the GIS data.
assignees: GUIZHOU BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT 114 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE

title_en: Thermal disaster risk assessment method based on twisted conductor structure parameterization modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal disaster risk assessment method based on parameterized modeling of a stranded conductor structure, which comprises the following steps of digital modeling, anisotropic heat conduction calculation, multi-physical field coupling simulation, dynamic failure criterion, risk quantification output, safety time threshold setting and final output of the risk grade and safety margin index of a current conductor. According to the thermal disaster risk assessment method based on the twisted conductor structure parametric modeling, the parametric modeling and the anisotropic heat conductivity coefficient calculation are carried out on the twisted conductor, so that the reliability of thermal disaster assessment is improved, an accurate and reversible quantitative mapping relation between key twisted structure parameters such as the wire core diameter, the twisting density and the twisting pitch and the axial and radial anisotropic heat conductivity coefficients of the conductor is established, so that model simulation can be directly carried out in the design stage of the twisted conductor, the parameters of the twisted conductor are optimized, and the safety coefficient of the finally produced twisted conductor is improved.

title_en: Apparatus for interpreting accident of chemical substance based on three-dimensional
title_ko: 화학물질 누출사고 피해영향 범위 예측 및 사고원인 분석을 위한 3차원 기반의 화학물질 사고해석 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional-based chemical accident analysis device for predicting a damage effect range of a chemical leak accident and analyzing an accident cause.
