The three-dimensional-based accident analysis device reflects weather changes such as wind speed and wind direction according to changes in topography, and performs a three-dimensional-based accident analysis computer simulation for a phenomenon such as heat/flow due to chemical leakage, chemical leakage/diffusion, chemical reaction/diffusion, fire due to chemical, explosion due to chemical, etc. when an accident occurs in a chemical, by reflecting weather changes such as wind speed and wind direction according to changes in topography, it is possible to accurately predict a range of a damage effect for an accident of a chemical by distance over time. In addition, it is possible to effectively prevent the spread of damage due to an accident of a chemical by quickly providing a disaster prevention work and a resident evacuation prediction range.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화학물질 누출사고 피해영향 범위 예측 및 사고원인 분석을 위한 3차원 기반의 화학물질 사고해석 장치에 관한 것으로, 지형의 변화에 따른 풍속과 풍향 등의 기상 변화를 반영하여 화학물질의 사고 발생 시 화학물질의 누출에 의한 열/유동, 화학물질 누출/확산, 화학물질 반응/확산, 화학물질에 의한 화재, 화학물질에 의한 폭발 등의 현상에 대한 3차원 기반의 사고해석 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션을 수행함으로써, 시간에 따른 거리별 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해영향의 범위를 정확하게 예측할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 방재작업 및 주민대피 예상범위를 신속하게 제공하여 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해 확산을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for Evacuation Simulation for Radiological Emergency in Nuclear Power Plants and Method thereof
title_ko: 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for simulating introduction of radiation in emergency of a nuclear power plant. The apparatus is a radiation emergency introduction simulation device of a nuclear power plant, and comprises an environment setting unit which sets information on evacuees on the road using a plurality of alternative actors based on an alternative model and an actor-based model, and acquires past traffic volume information and past weather information according to conditions under which introduction simulation is performed. The introduction simulation apparatus may further include an introduction simulation unit configured to calculate an exposure route, which is a route of a radioactive material, when a wide area evacuation occurs due to a radiation emergency in a nuclear power plant, perform a route search to a position outside the exposure route for the plurality of alternative actors according to a moving speed for each of the plurality of alternative actors determined based on past traffic information, past weather information, and the exposure route, and perform an introduction simulation for the plurality of alternative actors.
abstract_ko: 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다.  이 장치는 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치로서, 대체 모델과 행위자 기반 모델에 기반한 복수의 대체 행위자를 이용하여 도로 상의 대피자에 대한 정보를 설정하고, 소개 시뮬레이션이 수행되는 조건에 따른 과거의 교통량 정보와 과거의 기상 정보를 획득하는 환경 설정부를 포함한다.  상기 소개 시뮬레이션 장치는 원자력발전소에서 방사선 비상으로 인해 광역 대피가 발생하였을 때 방사성 물질의 경로인 피폭 경로를 계산하고, 과거의 교통량 정보, 과거의 기상 정보 및 피폭 경로에 기반하여 결정되는 복수의 대체 행위자별 이동 속도에 따라 복수의 대체 행위자에 대한 피폭 경로를 벗어난 위치까지의 경로 탐색을 수행하여 복수의 대체 행위자에 대한 소개 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 소개 시뮬레이션부를 더 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Reinforcement learning simulator device for calculating weapon combinations, including oc-gaws(optimal configuration of ground attack weapon system), for each optimal attack strategy of a weapon system and its control method
title_ko: 무기체계의 최적 공격 방책별 무기 조합 산출을 위한 강화학습용 시뮬레이터 장치 및 이의 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulator device for reinforcement learning for calculating a weapon combination for each optimal attack measure of a weapon system and a control method thereof. More specifically, a control method of a simulator device for reinforcement learning for calculating a weapon combination for each optimal attack measure of a weapon system according to the present invention may comprise the steps of: generating a battlefield situation scenario based on a scenario DB; specifying battlefield situation information of an enemy according to the battlefield situation scenario; inputting the battlefield situation scenario and the battlefield situation information into a command decision support system artificial intelligence model; generating an attack weapon combination of allies to correspond to the battlefield situation scenario using a retained weapon database (DataBase) of the allies and the artificial intelligence model; simulating an attack on the enemy according to the battlefield situation information in the battlefield situation scenario with the attack weapon combination; performing an evaluation on the attack weapon combination based on the simulation result; and performing a compensation process for the artificial intelligence model based on the evaluation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무기체계의 최적 공격 방책별 무기 조합 산출을 위한 강화학습용 시뮬레이터 장치 및 이의 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 보다 구체적으로, 본 발명에 따른 무기체계의 최적 공격 방책별 무기 조합 산출을 위한 강화학습용 시뮬레이터 장치의 제어방법은, 시나리오 DB에 기반하여, 전장 상황 시나리오를 생성하는 단계, 상기 전장 상황 시나리오에 따른 적군의 전장 상황 정보를 특정하는 단계, 상기 전장 상황 시나리오 및 상기 전장 상황 정보를 지휘결심 지원체계 인공지능 모델에 입력하는 단계, 아군의 보유 무기 DB(DataBase) 및 상기 인공 지능 모델을 이용하여, 상기 전장 상황 시나리오에 대응할 아군의 공격 무기 조합을 생성하는 단계, 상기 공격 무기 조합으로, 상기 전장 상황 시나리오에서 상기 전장 상황 정보에 따른 적군에 대한 공격을 시뮬레이션 하는 단계, 상기 시뮬레이션 결과에 기반하여, 상기 공격 무기 조합에 대한 평가를 수행하는 단계 및 상기 평가 결과에 기반하여, 상기 인공지능 모델에 대한 보상 프로세스를 수행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a basic numerical model, 2) generating a sample combination, 3) solving a control equation and saving a sample calculation result, 4) extracting and reconstructing channel data to form a data set, 5) training the model to an suspension condition, and 6) outputting the model to predict the landslide movement path and the final accumulation state according to given information. The method has the advantages that the method can solve the problems that landslide disasters in engineering have multiple uncertain factors, movement paths and damage ranges cannot be accurately predicted, and has a more efficient prediction analysis process for potential landslide disasters with uncertainty under the condition of ensuring accuracy.

title_en: Power transmission line mountain fire occurrence probability prediction method based on interpretive ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power transmission line mountain fire occurrence probability prediction method based on interpretive integrated learning, and belongs to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power transmission lines. The method comprises the steps of constructing a power transmission line mountain fire data set, dividing a training set and a testing set of the mountain fire data set according to the proportion of 7:3 to serve as training samples, building a mountain fire occurrence probability prediction model based on different balance sample sets by adopting a self-adaptive lifting algorithm, a gradient lifting decision tree, an extreme gradient lifting tree and a lightweight gradient elevator, comparing the prediction performance of each model under different power transmission line mountain fire data sets, carrying out super-parameter optimization by taking the balance data set and the model with optimal comprehensive performance to obtain an optimized mountain fire occurrence risk early warning model, solving the numerical value corresponding to each input characteristic quantity in the optimized mountain fire occurrence risk early warning model by a saproli additive method, quantifying the importance of each characteristic to the model, providing multi-aspect explanation for the model, and facilitating understanding of mountain fire occurrence risk prediction results made by the model.

title_en: Disaster risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous data, and relates to the technical field of data fusion and processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-source heterogeneous disaster risk data stream; the method comprises the steps of constructing a normalized disaster feature matrix, generating a multi-source feature associated matrix, generating a disaster risk index set according to a disaster risk prediction model, generating a regional disaster risk distribution thermodynamic diagram, constructing a disaster risk time sequence model, generating a disaster research report, and carrying out visual early warning on the disaster research report through a three-dimensional simulation technology. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional disaster risk assessment and early warning depends on a single or a small number of data sources, the data is one-sided and lacks of real-time performance, and the assessment and early warning are inaccurate, achieves the technical effects of comprehensively analyzing in real time based on multi-source heterogeneous data, improving the accuracy of disaster risk assessment and the timeliness of early warning, and providing reliable basis for disaster emergency decision.

title_en: Rock burst early warning method based on multi-disaster information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst early warning method based on multi-disaster information fusion, which belongs to the field of underground engineering rock burst prediction and comprises the steps of placing a standard rock sample in a true triaxial test system, simulating a rock burst inoculation process through radial quick unloading and tangential continuous loading, synchronously collecting test basic data, carrying out normalization processing on the test basic data to obtain a unified normalized data set, establishing a fusion function model based on the normalized data set, determining a key stage division result of the rock burst inoculation process by analyzing time sequence distribution characteristics of extreme points and inflection points of the fusion function model, and constructing a rock burst early warning chain from the internal state, external representation, time sequence and spatial distribution of rock based on the key stage division result of the rock burst inoculation process, so as to realize the early warning of rock burst disasters.
assignees: UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC;UNIV NORTHEASTERN;UNIV SOUTH CHINA

title_en: Device and method for testing multi-disaster physical model of landslide and debris flow in avalanche ice lake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing a multi-disaster physical model of a landslide and a debris flow of an avalanche ice lake, comprising an avalanche simulation assembly, an ice lake simulation assembly, a landslide simulation assembly, a debris flow simulation assembly, a freeze thawing control system, wherein the avalanche simulation assembly is used for simulating avalanche and assisting in avalanche starting through a power device, the ice lake simulation assembly is used for simulating ice lake breaking and performing temperature monitoring through a temperature monitor, the landslide simulation assembly is used for simulating landslide and performing model shape deformation monitoring through a deformation monitor, the debris flow simulation assembly is used for simulating debris flow and performing flow monitoring through a flow monitor, the freeze thawing control system is used for starting avalanche and ice lake breaking, the temperature control is performed through a temperature control box and an operation panel, a collection system is used for collecting experimental materials after use, solid-liquid separation is performed through a filter, real-time monitoring is performed on each simulation assembly through a monitoring system, and each experimental data is accurately recorded.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method, medium and equipment for geological disasters of waste slag field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method, medium and equipment for geological disasters of a waste slag field, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster evaluation; the method comprises the steps of optimizing simulation geotechnical parameters by adopting an engineering analogy method and field actual measurement data, defining a waste slag sliding mode and initial boundary conditions based on a three-dimensional geological model, inputting topographic features into Massflow software for three-dimensional elastoplastic hydrodynamic simulation, calculating a waste slag motion track according to the optimized simulation geotechnical parameters, simulating displacement, accumulation range and motion time of waste slag at different moments to generate a space-time evolution diagram of slag thickness, speed and influence range, carrying out dynamic risk assessment based on the space-time evolution diagram, and visually outputting disaster risk areas through a GIS platform. The invention obviously improves the analysis efficiency and the early warning timeliness under complex terrains.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;CHINA RAILWAY SEVENTH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster identification model construction method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a fire disaster recognition model construction method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source fire disaster monitoring data from different data platforms, taking all environment monitoring variables as input of a recognition model group aiming at each recognition model group, taking fire disaster characteristic variables corresponding to the recognition model group as output of the recognition model group, training each fire disaster recognition sub-model in the recognition model group, comparing recognition results output by each fire disaster recognition sub-model with real fire disaster records, determining initial weight of each fire disaster recognition sub-model according to comparison results, weighting and integrating a plurality of fire disaster recognition sub-models under the recognition model group based on the initial weight, and constructing a fire disaster recognition model corresponding to the recognition model group so as to construct a comprehensive fire disaster recognition model based on the fire disaster recognition models under different types. By adopting the method and the device for constructing the fire disaster identification model, the accuracy and the stability of fire disaster identification are improved.
assignees: DALIAN JINDI KONGYU FENGYUN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster investigation sampling equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation and provides geological disaster investigation sampling equipment which comprises a storage barrel, a fixing ring fixedly connected to the top side of the storage barrel, a bottom ring fixedly connected to the bottom end of the storage barrel, a supporting component arranged on the top side of the bottom ring, a lifting ring arranged on the inner wall of the storage barrel, supporting legs arranged on the bottom side of the bottom ring, a fixing plate fixedly connected to the inner wall of the lifting ring, a drilling component arranged on the bottom side of the fixing plate and used for sampling geology, and a sliding rail fixedly connected to the outer wall of the storage barrel, wherein a soft baffle is connected to the inner wall of the sliding rail through a winding component, and the bottom end of the soft baffle is arranged on the bottom side of the lifting ring. Through the cooperation of soft separation blade and the spacing spout of slide rail, haulage rope linkage baffle, the haulage rope is tightened when lifting ring rises to certain height, and dual construction prevents that the sample from spilling, and pushes down and pull up lifting ring and realize automation mechanized operation, promotes convenience and degree of automation.

title_en: Device and method for simulating adjacent landslide and mud-rock flow river blocking dam-forming level breaking experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam-level breaking experimental device and method for simulating adjacent landslide and mud-rock flow river blocking, wherein the device comprises a water storage tank, a main tank connected with an outlet of the water storage tank, a first branch tank and a second branch tank which are laterally intersected with the main tank, a stacking platform communicated with the lower end of the main tank, and a supporting frame, wherein the water storage tank is positioned above the main tank and is connected with the main tank through a hinge, so that gradient adjustment of the main tank is facilitated, and the bottom surface of the water storage tank is inclined towards the upper part of a dry water flow tank. In the experimental device for simulating the dam-link-level breaking of the adjacent landslide and the mud-rock flow block Jiang Cheng, the gradient of the main groove and the branch groove is adjustable, the flow rate of the main groove, the substance type of the branch groove and the substance source quantity are controllable, and the experimental device can be used for simulating the single or two landslide mud-rock flows of the adjacent river reach or the multi-scene blocking dry flow process of the landslide mud-rock flows and the dam-link-level breaking process of the dam-link dam, is beneficial to comprehensively acquiring the formation evolution mechanism of the dam-link-level breaking disaster chain of the landslide mud-rock flow block Jiang Yan and improves the chain mechanism research scientificity and comprehensiveness of the river-block disaster chain of the landslide mud-rock flow.

title_en: Urban public safety intelligent emergency command method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban public safety intelligent emergency command method, which relates to the technical field of urban public safety and comprises the following steps of constructing a multi-source perception network in advance to collect fire data in real time, wherein the fire data at least comprises smoke concentration, temperature change and flame images, calculating a fire risk value in real time and triggering early warning based on a multi-source data fusion and early warning analysis model, predicting the occurrence probability of a fire by using a Bayesian network model, simulating the fire spreading trend and speed, scheduling emergency resources based on a multi-target optimization model, and performing post-disaster assessment. According to the invention, the analytic hierarchy process is adopted to fuse multi-source data and calculate weights, the Bayesian network model is used for predicting fire probability, the improved CellularAutomata model is constructed to simulate the spreading trend, the multi-target optimization model is combined to schedule emergency resources, the risk quantitative evaluation and the accurate resource configuration are realized, and decision bias and resource waste caused by experience judgment are avoided.

title_en: Construction method of rainfall field space feature intelligent recognition model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an intelligent rainfall field spatial feature recognition model, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting rainfall data of a research area, 2, constructing a similar real rainfall field, 3, determining and quantifying influence factors, 4, constructing the intelligent rainfall field spatial feature recognition model, and 5, training and verifying the model. The method fully considers various factors with obvious influence on the rainfall spatial distribution, is beneficial to improving the adaptability and migration capacity of the model, enhancing the generalization performance of the model, and is also beneficial to revealing the change rule and response mechanism of the model for identifying the rainfall spatial characteristics under different conditions. By the method, the spatial information of the multi-source rainfall data can be effectively fused, and a rainfall field spatial feature recognition model with strong robustness and interpretability is constructed by combining the spatial scale, the rainfall magnitude and the terrain change influence factor, so that reliable technical support is provided for applications such as refined weather monitoring and disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization
abstract_en: The invention is used in the technical field of industrial process control, and discloses a coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring historical time sequence data of the coal mine power load, and carrying out data preprocessing on the original data with the resolution of 15 minutes to obtain a daily load power data set. According to the coal mine load clustering method based on dynamic reconstruction and cohesive separation loss optimization, by means of a layer-by-layer unsupervised pre-training and global fine tuning mechanism of a stacked self-encoder (SAE), deep time sequence characteristics of high-dimensional load data can be automatically learned, nonlinear time-space correlation characteristics in the data can be effectively captured, compared with the traditional methods such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and discrete wavelet transformation, the limitations of insufficient nonlinear characteristic extraction, limited non-stationary data processing effect and the like are avoided, effective mapping from high-dimensional data to a low-dimensional embedded space is achieved, and the influence of 'dimension disasters' is reduced.

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery exercise method, device, equipment and medium, which are applied to the technical field of storage and comprise the steps of responding to a disaster recovery exercise triggering operation, carrying out preset operation on an object in a target barrel in a slave station, prohibiting data synchronization between the slave station and a master station in an object storage multi-station architecture, wherein the preset operation comprises writing operation and deleting operation, recording an operation log corresponding to the object in the target barrel, wherein the operation log comprises an operation type, responding to the disaster recovery exercise triggering operation, entering a read-only state, traversing the operation log, determining the operation type corresponding to the operation log, and carrying out dirty data cleaning and data synchronization between the dirty data cleaning and the master station based on the operation type. Therefore, the disaster recovery backup exercise function is realized in the object storage multi-site architecture, and the accuracy of data recovery is ensured.
assignees: JINAN INSPUR DATA TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rock mass fracture risk early warning method, system, device and storage medium based on acousto-optic data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a rock mass fracture risk early warning method, system, device and storage medium based on acousto-optic data fusion, which are characterized in that acoustic emission energy, acoustic emission count, DIC data and other acousto-optic monitoring data of a rock mass test piece are collected, multi-dimensional precursor indexes such as acoustic emission b value, acoustic emission energy variance, strain field differential data and the like are obtained through calculation, a CUSUM-Pettitt is utilized to cooperatively test and identify a mutation point, a confidence coefficient and a physical mutation amplitude are combined to divide multi-stage early warning grades, and a LightGBM algorithm is used for training a classification model to realize accurate early warning of rock mass fracture risk. The application integrates multisource physical field information, overcomes the limitation of single data monitoring, improves early warning reliability and timeliness, and is suitable for disaster prevention and control in the fields of mine safety, rock mass engineering and the like.

title_en: High-degree-of-freedom gas-dust explosion fidelity simulation device and experimental method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-freedom gas-dust explosion fidelity simulation device and an experimental method, the system comprises an experimental pipeline system, a ventilation system, a gas configuration system, a remote control ignition device, a roadway equipment model and a data analysis system. The pipeline system is formed by connecting pipeline sections with different structures, explosion venting pipelines and flange plates. The ventilation system and the gas configuration system consist of a small fan, a reduced-size automatic air door, an electromagnetic valve, an air compressor, a dust injector, an intelligent pressure transmitter gas cylinder A and the like. The air distribution system comprises a vacuum pump, an intelligent pressure transmitter, an air compressor, an air storage tank and an air bottle. The remote control ignition device is formed by refitting an original small-sized remote control car, the car body shell is an explosion-proof shell, the ignition electrode is additionally arranged on the car roof, and a direct current stabilized voltage power supply for supplying power to the ignition electrode is internally installed. The roadway equipment model is a 1:35 reduced-size conveyor belt model, a reduced-size coal cutter model, a reduced-size heading machine model and a reduced-size hydraulic support model which are prepared by 3D printing. The data analysis system comprises a high-speed camera, a multi-parameter gas sensor, an overpressure sensor, a schlieren and the like. The invention supports the experimental study of the whole process of gas and dust diffusion-explosion based on a roadway ventilation network, effectively restores the real scene of the mine explosion accident, and aims to realize disaster source identification and early warning and targeted prevention of the explosive gas and radically prevent the explosion accident.

title_en: Earthquake landslide risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake engineering, geotechnical engineering and geological disaster evaluation, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the danger of earthquake landslide, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining regional terrain data and constructing a terrain geometric model based on the regional terrain data; the method comprises the steps of identifying a specific seismic unit with possible energy convergence in a region based on a terrain geometric model, simulating a propagation path of seismic waves in the terrain geometric model aiming at the specific seismic unit, determining the energy influence degree of the specific seismic unit on the seismic waves according to the change of the propagation path, and effectively considering the local energy influence of complex terrains on the seismic waves by constructing the terrain geometric model, identifying the energy convergence seismic unit, simulating the propagation of the seismic waves and correcting seismic vibration parameters.

title_en: Earthquake-excavation-acid rain coupling induced dangerous rock collapse experimental device and method
abstract_en: An earthquake-excavation-acid rain coupling-induced dangerous rock collapse experimental device and method belong to the technical field of geotechnical engineering simulation experiments, the device comprises a counter-force supporting component, an earthquake power disturbance simulation application component, an engineering excavation disturbance simulation application component and an acid rain corrosion and rainfall simulation component, the earthquake power disturbance simulation application component, the engineering excavation disturbance simulation application component and the acid rain corrosion and rainfall simulation component are all arranged on the counter-force supporting component, and a Bian Powei rock model is located in the counter-force supporting component. According to the invention, the influence factors such as earthquake, engineering excavation, acid rain corrosion, rainfall, river scouring and the like can be simulated, the influence factors can be combined arbitrarily to simulate the inoculation and induction processes of the dangerous rock collapse disaster under the coupling condition of the influence factors, and the experimental conclusion obtained on the basis can reflect the inoculation and induction mechanism of the dangerous rock collapse disaster more truly, so that technical support is provided for prediction and forecast of the dangerous rock collapse disaster.
assignees: UNIV GUANGXI;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY DETECTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster prevention and control construction grouting anchor rod
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of anchor structures, in particular to a grouting anchor rod for geological disaster prevention and control construction, which comprises anchor bars and a hollow tubular structure, wherein the surface of the anchor bar is divided into an anchor section and an anchor installation section; the drill bit comprises a body, a sleeve, a moving tube and a sliding block, wherein the mounting part and the tail end of the anchor are arranged at intervals, the working part is far away from the anchor, one end wall of the sleeve is connected with the end face of the mounting part, the inner wall of the sleeve is sleeved on the circumferential outer wall of the anchor, the other end of the sleeve is provided with a supporting part, a boss is arranged on the inner wall of the supporting part, the moving tube is arranged between the sleeve and the anchor, the inner wall of the sleeve is provided with the sliding block, the outer wall of the moving tube is provided with a chute, the sliding block is arranged in the chute, and one end of the moving tube far away from the body is abutted against the inner wall of the boss.
assignees: XI AN HANGXING IOT INFORMATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evaluation device, disaster evaluation method, and program
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster evaluation device, etc. that make it possible to comprehensively evaluate the status of restoration associated with the occurrence of a disaster. A disaster evaluation device according to the present invention is configured to: perform simulations, in response to the occurrence of a disaster, of the status of damage individually in relation to a plurality of types of events due to the disaster; convert data indicating the status of damage as the results of the simulations into data indicating a common social value; evaluate changes in the social value due to the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data; and recommend one or more countermeasures to the plurality of types of events on the basis of the degrees of decrease in the social value due to the evaluated disaster. The disaster evaluation device should perform simulations of the status of restoration from the disaster in relation to the plurality of types of events on the basis of received restoration plan information, should convert the data indicating the status of restoration into data indicating the common social value, and should evaluate changes in the social value due to restoration from the disaster on the basis of the plurality of items of converted data.
assignees: NEC CORP;UNIV TOHOKU;NEC SOLUTION INNOVATORS LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire accident rescue teaching demonstration device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a tunnel fire accident rescue teaching demonstration device which comprises a base, wherein a mountain model and a tunnel model are arranged at the top of the base, the tunnel model is positioned in the mountain model, and the tunnel model comprises a tunnel pipeline, a risk avoiding system, an illumination system and a smoke exhausting system. The intelligent vehicle fire disaster evacuation device has the beneficial effects that smoke and high temperature generated by a vehicle in a fire disaster are simulated through the smoke system and the heating system, the controller starts the risk avoidance system, the lighting system, the smoke evacuation system and the water-based fire extinguisher, rescue after the fire disaster is carried out, the effectiveness of rescue is judged according to the numerical values acquired by the smoke detector and the temperature detector, the optimal evacuation route is obtained, the working states of the smoke evacuation system and the water-based fire extinguisher are changed through multiple demonstrations of the device, and a student is enabled to be skilled in holding the working states of the smoke evacuation system and the water-based fire extinguisher for effectively cooling and evacuating the smoke and the optimal evacuation route.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geotechnical engineering stability early warning system method combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, which relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering safety monitoring and disaster early warning, and comprises the steps of combining slope deformation monitoring and numerical simulation, wherein multisource real-time monitoring data of slope deformation and numerical simulation are fused, and a dynamically updated slope deformation evolution analysis system is constructed; and setting an automatic triggering grading early warning signal of a geotechnical engineering early warning index to finish slope risk dynamic assessment and early warning output of the geotechnical. The invention realizes automatic triggering of the grading early warning signals, obviously improves the response speed, judgment accuracy and risk assessment scientificity of the geotechnical engineering early warning system, and provides intelligent, dynamic and systematic technical support for slope safety prevention and control.

title_en: Mine disaster emergency escape training system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine disaster emergency escape practical training system, and relates to the technical field of mine practical training. The system comprises a roadway simulation module, a preparation area module, a self-rescuer blind Dai Shi training module, a self-rescuer AI visual identification and assessment system, an assessment confirmation module and a self-rescuer training management system, wherein the roadway simulation module is used for manufacturing a simulated roadway environment according to an actual roadway structure and simulating a roadway disaster environment, the preparation area module is positioned in the simulated roadway and used for identifying and registering information of reference personnel, the self-rescuer blind Dai Shi training module is positioned in the simulated roadway and used for carrying out wearing practical training of the self-rescuer by the reference personnel, the assessment confirmation module is positioned in the simulated roadway and used for assessing the result of the self-rescuer worn by the reference personnel, returning the result and time to the self-rescuer training management system, confirming the assessment time and scoring according to the completion time. The system can realize the self-rescuer wearing training examination in the disaster simulation environment.

title_en: Event prediction model construction method and device for multi-infrastructure system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for constructing an event prediction model of a multi-infrastructure system, which are implemented by collecting basic data of each infrastructure in the multi-infrastructure system; respectively carrying out analog simulation on basic data of each infrastructure to obtain operation data of each infrastructure, coupling a space-time diagram network constructed by each infrastructure to establish a space-time diagram network model, and carrying out migration training on the space-time diagram network model according to the operation data and real-time data obtained by monitoring to obtain an event prediction model. The event prediction model constructed by the scheme of the application can scientifically and accurately evaluate and predict the response and evolution of the multi-infrastructure system in the event and help to deal with urban disaster events.

title_en: Air-ground cooperative intelligent emergency material scheduling and power configuration optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a space-ground cooperative intelligent emergency material dispatching and power configuration optimizing method and a space-ground cooperative intelligent emergency material dispatching and power configuration optimizing system, which construct a space-ground cooperative emergency resource joint dispatching framework, wherein the framework integrates heterogeneous resources such as future emergency trucks, unmanned aerial vehicles, unmanned and manned new energy automobiles and the like, and aims to jointly optimize post-disaster emergency material dispatching and power recovery processes so as to improve overall emergency response efficiency and cooperative capacity. Secondly, a two-stage optimization model is designed aiming at the complexity of cooperative scheduling of the space and the ground under the framework, and the aim is to maximize emergency power supply capacity of a key area in a first stage and minimize unmanned aerial vehicle material distribution time taking off from a large-scale power supply vehicle based on the emergency power supply capacity in a second stage. Finally, for efficient solution of the model, GRASP algorithm and ALNS algorithm were developed respectively. The feasibility and the potential of the whole method for realizing the rapid response of emergency materials and electric power under the background of real disasters are verified through simulation analysis based on actual scene data.

title_en: Intelligent building fire disaster recognition and simulation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building fire disaster identification and simulation early warning method and system, which belong to the technical field of building informatization and disaster prevention and control, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to realize early fire disaster identification, intelligent fire disaster prediction and dynamic evacuation path planning, and improve fire disaster identification accuracy and response speed; the multi-mode data acquisition comprises the steps of adopting a vision, environment and space multi-mode sensor to acquire data, carrying out feature fusion on the acquired data by using a multi-channel deep convolution network to generate unified space-time fire characterization, constructing a video-sensing-geometric data collaborative perception network on the basis of the space-time fire characterization, improving recognition robustness in a complex environment, carrying out intelligent recognition and decision, carrying out early warning control linkage, and carrying out post-disaster evaluation feedback.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor fusion-based power transmission line mountain fire spreading range prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems, in particular to a method and a system for predicting a mountain fire spreading range of an electric transmission line based on multi-factor fusion, which are used for constructing a fusion database through real-time acquisition of multi-source data and space-time alignment processing; the method comprises the steps of extracting fire scene characteristics by adopting an image processing technology, calculating fire wire distance and vegetation combustion parameters by combining laser radar data, constructing a prediction model, dynamically correcting fire spreading parameters, simulating a spreading path based on a three-dimensional model and terrain data, evaluating the influence degree of fire on a power transmission line and generating an early warning strategy. The problems of smoke shielding monitoring failure, insufficient night prediction precision and the like caused by single data source dependence are effectively solved, the mountain fire early warning capability under a complex environment is remarkably improved, and high-precision and real-time technical support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction of an electric power system.
assignees: CHONGQING DODEM COMMUNICATIONS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire evacuation guiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety, in particular to a fire evacuation guiding method and a fire evacuation guiding system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining building layout information, conducting evacuation path network modeling according to the building layout information to obtain evacuation channel data, conducting path congestion assessment according to the evacuation channel data to obtain path congestion data, obtaining fire-fighting sensing data, sensing fire positions in real time based on the fire-fighting sensing data to obtain fire position data, conducting fire spreading direction prediction based on the fire position data to obtain fire spreading direction data, identifying fire dangerous areas according to the fire spreading directions, conducting building structure heat conduction simulation according to the fire dangerous areas to obtain building structure heat conduction data, and identifying unstable structures based on the building structure heat conduction data to obtain unstable structure data. The invention improves the safety and evacuation efficiency of fire evacuation based on the fire safety technology.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUAAN ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine catastrophe scene deduction method
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal mine disaster scene deduction method, which belongs to mine disaster emergency rescue and comprises the steps of collecting environment data of a coal mine stope, carrying out data screening according to key elements according to the environment data, extracting time sequence characteristics, deducing the time sequence characteristics by utilizing an energy-based dynamic time sequence model to obtain probability energy distribution of disaster development, constructing a time sequence-limited Boltzmann machine model according to the probability energy distribution for predicting the disaster development trend of a mine, wherein a display layer unit corresponds to a sensor observation value of a current time point, a hidden layer unit captures potential time sequence characteristics and modes, the time sequence connection establishes association between hidden layers at the current time and hidden layers at the first N times, and adopts a time-dependent condition contrast divergence algorithm for model training.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging fire disaster early warning method and system based on electric arc detection
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle charging fire early warning method and system based on arc detection, comprising the steps of carrying out time-frequency domain analysis on an arc signal by adopting a wavelet analysis method according to randomness and transient property of the arc signal, extracting time domain and frequency domain characteristics of the arc signal, carrying out classification and identification on the arc signal by combining a support vector machine algorithm to judge whether arc discharge occurs, carrying out modeling analysis on distribution of wires and connectors in an electric vehicle charging system to obtain propagation paths and attenuation characteristics of the arc signal at different positions, and establishing an accurate arc signal propagation model by combining a finite element simulation method to guide sensor deployment and positioning algorithm design, comprehensively considering factors such as arc positioning precision, system cost and convenience when the sensor is deployed, optimizing the number and positions of sensor nodes by adopting a genetic algorithm, and minimizing the sensor deployment cost while meeting the requirements of arc positioning performance.

title_en: Three-dimensional mechanical analysis experiment system for submarine landslide-seabed-pipeline
abstract_en: A three-dimensional mechanical analysis experiment system for a submarine landslide-seabed-pipeline comprises a high-speed landslide driving system, a high-pressure photoelastic observation system, a three-dimensional stress acquisition system and a central controller. The high-speed landslide driving system drives the photoelastic landslide body to realize high-speed linear motion under the gradient condition through the crawler-type driving mechanism, and simulates the gradient high-speed motion characteristic of a real submarine landslide. The high-pressure photoelastic observation system comprises a photoelastic seabed, a photoelastic pipeline assembly, a high-pressure sealing cabin and a top hydraulic loading mechanism, and pore pressure distribution and a three-dimensional stress field in the impact process are dynamically developed through a photoelastic effect by utilizing the refractive index difference of fluid in pores and photoelastic materials and combining pore pressure data. The three-dimensional stress acquisition system captures multi-angle photoelastic stripes in real time and solves the global three-dimensional stress tensor. The central controller cooperatively regulates and controls all the systems to realize the control of high-speed movement, high-pressure environment and material variables. The system well meets the quantitative research requirements of the disaster-causing mechanism and the protection design of the submarine landslide.

title_en: Landslide remote sensing rapid identification method, system, equipment and medium based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide remote sensing rapid identification method, a system, equipment and a medium based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a landslide remote sensing image, manufacturing a landslide remote sensing image data set, S2, based on a target detection algorithm YOLOX, using BiFPN to replace an original PAN model module, establishing a deep learning rapid identification model, S3, training, verifying and testing the deep learning rapid identification model by using the landslide remote sensing image data set to obtain the landslide remote sensing rapid identification module, S4, constructing a data preprocessing module, S5, constructing an alarm feedback module, and when the landslide remote sensing rapid identification module outputs an image block containing landslide, extracting longitude and latitude information and giving an alarm. Compared with the traditional manual searching and unmanned aerial vehicle detection, the method has the characteristics of rapidness, high efficiency, strong robustness, wide application range and the like, and meanwhile, the method can automatically return the position information of the target, thereby being beneficial to improving the landslide disaster reduction and relief efficiency.

title_en: Method and system for discriminating mining shock and rock burst composite dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for discriminating a mining earthquake and rock burst composite dynamic disaster, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out numerical simulation on the movement evolution of a cover rock and the evolution of a stress field according to geological data to obtain a simulation result, establishing a mechanical model of a island coal pillar and a target rock stratum simultaneously subjected to uniform load and horizontal concentrated stress according to the simulation result, deducing a dynamic and static stress expression caused by the breaking instability of the target rock stratum according to the mechanical model, and constructing a discrimination formula of the mining earthquake and rock burst composite dynamic disaster according to the dynamic and static stress expression and combining a dynamic and static load superposition theory to reveal the occurrence mechanism of the mining earthquake and rock burst composite dynamic disaster of a huge hard rock downhill coal pillar so as to predict the occurrence of the mining earthquake and rock burst composite dynamic disaster according to the discrimination formula.

title_en: Power distribution network fault probability analysis method based on waterlogging scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault probability analysis method based on a waterlogging scene, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical rainfall data of a target geographical position, carrying out data processing, respectively calculating the maximum value of daily rainfall and the occurrence date of the maximum daily rainfall year by year, establishing a annual maximum daily rainfall sequence, analyzing the distribution of daily rainfall intensity of the past year based on the annual maximum daily rainfall sequence, converting the daily rainfall intensity into a rainfall overrun probability index, obtaining a power distribution network line cumulative fault probability model based on the rainfall overrun probability index, carrying out sampling simulation on the fault scene of the power distribution network when the waterlogging disaster passes through the power distribution network line cumulative fault probability model, reflecting the power distribution network fault condition through a simulation result, fitting the fault scene based on the historical data such as the annual maximum daily rainfall, sampling and simulating the random faults of extreme weather, and realizing the analysis and the prediction of the power distribution network fault probability.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multisource rainfall product complementarity analysis method based on SHAP model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource rainfall product complementation resolution method based on a SHAP model, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting multisource rainfall product data; step 2, multi-source rainfall product data fusion, step 3, quantitatively evaluating contribution degree of the multi-source rainfall products, and step 4, analyzing complementarity degree among different rainfall products. According to the method, the influence of the multi-source rainfall products on the precision of the final product after different combinations are fused is analyzed, and the cooperative contribution degree is quantized, so that the quantized evaluation of complementarity among the multi-source rainfall products is realized. The method can identify the advantage complementary relation among the rainfall products after fusion, improves the accuracy and the interpretability of rainfall estimation, and provides scientific basis for weather forecast, hydrologic simulation and disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method for detecting degradation channel of reservoir bank soil hydro-fluctuation belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a degradation channel of a reservoir bank soil hydro-fluctuation belt, which can accurately construct a three-dimensional resistivity distribution model of an underground soil body through potential response feedback and resistivity tomography technology, provides underground structure information with higher resolution than that of the traditional method, and particularly breaks through the depth limit of the traditional method in deep detection of the reservoir bank hydro-fluctuation belt. By combining the relation between the resistivity distribution and the permeability coefficient and other hydraulic parameters, the invention not only can accurately identify the distribution of the underground aquifer, but also can effectively locate the latent and pre-development degradation channels and analyze the evolution trend of the channels, thereby providing scientific basis for the analysis of the stability of the reservoir bank and the disaster early warning. In addition, the potential exploratory well is drilled in the detection area, and current is applied to collect potential response data, so that complex drilling and excavation operations in traditional exploration are avoided, and high-precision detection can be completed under the condition that the underground environment is not disturbed on a large scale.

title_en: Mountain torrent mud-rock flow monitoring and early warning method based on intelligent image sample generation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountain torrent mud-rock flow monitoring and early warning method based on intelligent image sample generation, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning and comprises the following steps of video acquisition and transmission, preprocessing and amplifying data, namely preprocessing the acquired video data, intelligently generating preprocessed original photos by utilizing AIGC technology, amplifying a sample data set, training and testing an early warning model, training and testing the sample by utilizing a deep learning model based on the amplified sample data set, establishing an early warning model, realizing monitoring and early warning of mountain torrent mud-rock flow, evaluating the model obtained by training, and adjusting model parameters according to evaluation results to optimize performance, and the method has the beneficial effects of generating diversified mountain torrent mud-rock flow scene samples based on AIGC and deep learning, and effectively solving the problem of insufficient sample data set.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: System for providing emotional safety training to supervisor at construction sites and method thereof
title_ko: 건설 현장 관리자에게 감성 안전 교육을 제공하는 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing emotional safety education to a construction site manager and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for providing emotional safety education to a construction site manager comprises: a database storing data related to an emotional safety culture; a user device downloading the data related to the emotional safety culture from the database, receiving response information from a user for the downloaded data, and transmitting the received response information of the user to a consultant device; and the consultant device receiving the response information of the user from the user device and evaluating the degree of emotion of the user based on the received response information of the user. As described above, according to the present invention, it is possible to improve the change in the perception of the construction site manager and the emotional safety culture through the emotional safety education according to the degree of emotion of the construction site manager. In addition, it is possible to clearly motivate disaster prevention by identifying and delivering interests between construction site managers and workers.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건설 현장 관리자에게 감성 안전 교육을 제공하는 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면 건설 현장 관리자에게 감성 안전 교육을 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, 감성 안전 문화에 관련된 자료가 저장된 데이터베이스; 상기 데이터베이스로부터 감성 안전 문화에 관련된 자료를 다운받고, 다운된 자료에 대해 사용자로부터 응답 정보를 입력받으며, 입력된 상기 사용자의 응답 정보를 컨설턴트 디바이스에 전송하는 사용자 디바이스; 및 상기 사용자 디바이스로부터 상기 사용자의 응답 정보를 입력받고, 입력된 상기 사용자의 응답 정보를 기초로 사용자의 감성 정도를 평가하는 컨설턴트 디바이스를 포함할 수 있다. 
이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 건설 현장 관리자의 감성 정도에 따른 감성 안전 교육을 통해 건설 현장 관리자의 인식의 변화 및 감성 안전 문화를 향상시킬 수 있다. 
또한, 건설 현장 관리자와 근로자 사이의 이해관계를 파악하고 전달하여 재해 예방에 대한 동기를 명확하게 부여할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method of psychological first aid simulation for disaster shock recovery
title_ko: 재난 충격 회복을 위한 심리적 응급 처치 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a psychological emergency treatment simulation system for disaster shock recovery. Provided is a psychological first aid simulation system for disaster shock recovery, comprising: a user terminal playing a PFA game according to a user input; and a PFA game simulation server simulating the PFA game.
abstract_ko: 구급 요원의 신체에 장착되며, 재난 충격 환자를 촬영하여 PFA 영상을 생성하는 구급 요원 카메라 장치; 상기 구급 요원 카메라 장치에서 생성된 PFA 영상을 저장하는 구급 요원 단말; 간호사의 신체에 장착되어 재난 충격 환자를 촬영하여 PFA 영상을 생성하는 간호사 카메라 장치; 상기 간호사 카메라 장치에서 생성된 PFA 영상을 저장하는 간호사 단말; PFA 전문가 의견을 입력받는 PFA 전문가 단말; 상기 구급 요원 단말에 저장된 PFA 영상 및 상기 간호사 단말에 저장된 PFA 영상을 수집하여 저장하고, 저장된 PFA 영상에 대한 상기 PFA 전문가 단말에서 입력받은 PFA 전문가 의견에 따라 PFA 빅데이터를 생성하여 저장하는 PFA 빅데이터 생성 서버; 상기 PFA 빅데이터 생성 서버에 저장된 PFA 빅데이터에 기반하여 재난 충격 환자를 표준화하여 표준화 환자를 생성하여 저장하는 표준화 서버; 사용자 입력에 따라 사용자 아바타를 이용하여 PFA 게임을 플레이하는 사용자 단말; 상기 PFA 게임의 결과를 기반으로 디브리핑을 하기 위한 PFA 교육자 의견을 입력받는 PFA 교육자 단말; 상기 표준화 서버에 저장된 표준화 환자를 이용하여 상기 PFA 게임을 시뮬레이션하고, 상기 사용자 단말의 사용자 입력 및 상기 PFA 교육자 단말의 PFA 교육자 의견에 따라 상기 PFA 게임의 시뮬레이션 결과에 대한 디브리핑을 수행하는 PFA 게임 시뮬레이션 서버를 구성한다.
assignees: UNIV CHUNG ANG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Event extraction and semantic information enhancement method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides an event extraction and semantic information enhancement method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of deeply understanding the context of a disaster event based on the input text of the disaster event through a pre-built pre-training model ERNIE and outputting the input text of the disaster event carrying context information, extracting the disaster event of the disaster event input text carrying the context information through a gate control circulation unit GRU network layer, accurately labeling the extracted disaster event through a conditional random field CRF sequence labeling layer, obtaining the transition probability among labeled labels through modeling calculation, improving and enhancing the extracted disaster event through additional semantic knowledge through a disaster event semantic information enhancement mechanism, and finally outputting disaster event information.

title_en: Urban system simulation model coupling method, equipment and product based on disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city system simulation model coupling method, equipment and a product based on a disaster chain, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting city related data and flood related data; the method comprises the steps of classifying urban related data according to different urban system types to obtain first modeling data of different types of urban systems, classifying flood related data to obtain second modeling data related to flood related to operation of different types of urban systems, constructing different types of urban system models according to the first modeling data and/or the second modeling data of the different types of urban systems, analyzing disaster chains of the flood related data to determine disaster chains of various types of water disasters, coupling the urban system models and the disaster chains of various types of water disasters to generate an urban system disaster simulation model fusing the disaster chains of the composite water disasters, and carrying out urban system simulation model coupling by considering the disaster chains of the composite flood, so that accuracy of urban composite water disaster prediction can be improved.

title_en: Fire situation prediction method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire situation prediction method based on multi-source data, and relates to the technical field of fire prediction. Firstly, acquiring fire image data and fire time sequence image data, and preprocessing. And constructing and training an improved GhostNetV feature extraction network, inputting fire image data into the trained improved GhostNetV feature extraction network, and extracting a fire image data time sequence feature matrix. And then preprocessing the extracted time sequence feature matrix and the fire time sequence image data to obtain a time sequence sample. And finally, constructing and training a TSF fire disaster prediction network, wherein the TSF fire disaster prediction network comprises a plurality of decision trees, inputting the pre-time sequence samples into the trained TSF fire disaster prediction network, and predicting the fire disaster situation based on the output result of the decision trees. The fire situation prediction method provided by the invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of the fire situation prediction method.

title_en: Method for evaluating vulnerability of shield tunnel under water and sand gushing disaster driven by physical-data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical-data fusion-driven shield tunnel vulnerability evaluation method under water and sand gushing disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of (1) determining information such as selected tunnel types, soil layer sections, water gushing disasters and the like, (2) establishing a substance point method-finite element method coupling model taking soil body-structure interaction into consideration under the action of the water gushing sand gushing disasters for dynamic response analysis, (3) training and optimizing a multi-layer perceptron machine learning model, establishing a multi-input-multi-output real-time prediction model, and the like. The method for evaluating the vulnerability of the shield tunnel under the water and sand gushing disaster, which is based on stratum-tunnel interaction and a soil mass catastrophe deformation mechanism, is established by combining a dynamic numerical analysis method and a machine learning prediction model, simultaneously systematically considers the rigidity of the tunnel joint, the soil mass characteristics, the uncertainty of monitoring data and the like, and can comprehensively evaluate the capability of the tunnel for resisting damage under the water and sand gushing effect.

title_en: Storm surge intelligent early warning method, system and medium based on multi-model coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge intelligent early warning method, a storm surge intelligent early warning system and a storm surge intelligent early warning medium based on multi-model coupling, and relates to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of establishing a basic data set, obtaining real-time meteorological data and ocean data, performing fuzzy path fitting, establishing a fitting result, performing regional grid segmentation by utilizing the basic data set and the fitting result, establishing a grid segmentation result, inputting the real-time data and the basic data into a simulation unit, executing simulation operation, establishing node simulation data, obtaining node preset safety response measures, performing combined early warning identification according to the response measures and the simulation data, and reporting early warning signals, so that the technical problems of insufficient simulation precision, insufficient early warning timeliness and insufficient refinement degree caused by strong subjectivity of experience forecast and inherent error of a single model in the conventional storm surge early warning method are solved, and the technical effects of improving accuracy, timeliness and refinement degree of storm surge early warning through performing fuzzy path fitting and multi-model coupling simulation operation are achieved.
assignees: GUANGDONG LANKUN MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-scale people stream evacuation simulation method considering congestion state real-time decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-scale people stream evacuation simulation method considering congestion state real-time decision, which belongs to the technical field of crowd emergency evacuation and comprises the steps of S1, obtaining crowd to be evacuated, a protection place and road network data in an area, S2, constructing a road traffic time calculation model, S3, constructing a protection place full-man early warning model, S4, constructing a shortest time stream model considering congestion state real-time decision, S5, obtaining a crowd evacuation moving process by using crowd simulation and carrying out visual presentation.

title_en: Nuclear power station internal flooding experiment verification method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of analysis of nuclear power internal disasters and discloses a verification method, a device, equipment and a medium for a nuclear power internal flooding experiment, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing modeling analysis on a target factory building prototype, and determining a plurality of model parameter values of an experimental scaling model; the method comprises the steps of constructing an experimental scaling model according to a plurality of model parameter values, determining experimental parameters of an internal flooding experiment, carrying out the internal flooding experiment on the experimental scaling model by utilizing the experimental parameters to obtain an internal flooding experiment result of the experimental scaling model, obtaining an internal flooding simulation result of a numerical model, comparing the internal flooding simulation result with the internal flooding experiment result, and verifying the accuracy of the internal flooding simulation result according to the comparison result. According to the invention, by constructing an experimental scaling model of a nuclear power plant prototype, the flooding delay conditions under different working conditions are simulated, and compared with the flooding simulation results, the accuracy of the flooding simulation calculation is verified, and more accurate guidance is provided for the internal flooding analysis of the subsequent nuclear power engineering.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Pore-perimeter acoustic wave information driven hydraulic fracturing self-adaptive optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hydraulic fracturing self-adaptive optimization method driven by hole circumferential acoustic wave information, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent prevention and control of mine dynamic disasters. The method comprises the steps of selecting a hydraulic fracturing implementation site, establishing a corresponding relation between fracturing parameters and coal rock mass intensity, designing drilling parameters of hydraulic fracturing holes based on the overlying rock characteristics of the implementation site, installing an intelligent measuring drill bit, setting sound wave acquisition parameters, implementing drilling operation, acquiring and transmitting hole circumference sound wave signals, extracting data characteristic values to obtain the fracturing parameters, starting fracturing operation, adaptively adjusting the fracturing parameters, and starting implementation of next hydraulic fracturing holes based on fracturing intervals after fracturing is completed. The invention realizes accurate and effective fracturing of the overlying strata and reduces the production cost on the basis of ensuring the safe production of mines.

title_en: Goaf coal-missing spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disaster simulation experiment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf coal-missing spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disaster simulation experiment system and method, and belongs to the field of coal mine coal-missing spontaneous combustion and gas symbiotic disaster generation. The invention explores the evolution rules of quality, temperature, pressure, gas composition and content in the spontaneous combustion and gas explosion processes of the residual coal. The coal-missing combustion chamber in the simulation experiment system provided by the invention can be used independently, is provided with a plurality of interfaces for connecting monitoring equipment, can independently study the coal-missing combustion process, can comprehensively study the evolution of spontaneous combustion of coal-missing in the goaf and gas symbiotic disasters, reduces the experiment cost and provides a necessary foundation for prevention and control of spontaneous combustion of coal-missing in the goaf and gas symbiotic disasters in the mine.

title_en: Mechanism and data hybrid-driven large-scale stacking layer landslide evolution state identification and conversion prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mechanism and data hybrid-driven large-scale stack landslide evolution state judging and converting prediction method and system, relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and can improve prediction accuracy and reliability. Firstly, a mechanism driving model is established by using a numerical method, and is optimized by using a Bayesian parametric inversion and a non-invasive finite element method. And training the historical monitoring data by using a random forest and support vector machine model, and establishing a data-driven prediction model. And finally, a model coupling method is used, a hybrid driving model is established by comprehensively utilizing the prediction results of the mechanism driving model and the data driving model to predict the landslide evolution state of the stacking layer, so that the prediction precision and reliability of the model are improved.

title_en: High-speed remote landslide dynamic process prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and discloses a high-speed remote landslide dynamic process prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a landslide area to be studied, obtaining physical and mechanical parameters of solid particles, ice, water, gas, solid frameworks and a landslide body of the landslide area, S2, constructing a high-speed remote landslide thermal-water-force-steam coupling dynamic model for describing the whole ice-water-steam phase change process of a cold region by establishing a mechanical balance, material conservation and energy conservation equation according to the physical and mechanical parameters, and S3, carrying out simulation prediction on the high-speed remote landslide dynamic process by the high-speed remote landslide thermal-water-force-steam coupling dynamic model to obtain a prediction result. The invention adopts a thermal-water-force-steam coupling modeling frame combining solid ice melting and pore water vaporization processes, is suitable for simulating a multi-stage phase change process caused by rapid temperature rise in a landslide shear band, and can continuously describe transition behaviors among freezing, melting and vaporization stages.

title_en: Power grid fault handling method and system based on large model and multiple agents
abstract_en: A power grid fault handling method and system based on a large model and multiple agents. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and collecting multi-source data of a power grid to form power grid fault information, carrying out semantic analysis on the power grid fault information, generating a fault treatment strategy through a power domain large model of fine adjustment training, decomposing the fault treatment strategy into an executable subtask sequence, defining input and output and execution sequences of each subtask, constructing a plurality of intelligent agents, cooperatively controlling a plurality of subtasks for executing the fault treatment strategy, setting a multi-dimensional evaluation index after the fault treatment strategy is executed, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on a fault treatment effect. According to the technical scheme for handling the power grid faults by combining the large model with the multiple intelligent agents, the intelligent level and emergency response efficiency of the power grid fault handling are improved.
assignees: XILIN GOL POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic flood risk evaluation method based on flood inundation simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic flood risk evaluation method based on flood inundation simulation, and relates to the technical field of natural disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological hydrologic data of a target area, constructing a flood risk model according to the meteorological hydrologic data, carrying out parameter calibration on the flood risk model by utilizing measured rainfall data and flow-water level data, carrying out D8 diffusion algorithm and water balance equivalent analysis based on a GIS space analysis technology, converting the water quantity of a river dike higher than the target area into submerged depth sum by utilizing the constructed flood risk model, obtaining a submerged depth map of the target area, generating a flood deduction result, determining flood disaster risk grade division of the target area according to the flood deduction result, and evaluating flood disaster risk. According to the invention, the flood risk model and the GIS space analysis flood previewing model are constructed, and the flood risk model can better reflect the flood previewing result.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION INST OF WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER SCIENCE

title_en: Disaster risk assessment method and device for power distribution system under typhoon disaster and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power systems, and provides a disaster risk assessment method, device and electronic equipment for a power distribution system under typhoon disasters. The method comprises the steps of inputting geographic information data and typhoon track parameters of a power distribution system, initializing operation states of all feeder lines of the power distribution system, calculating disaster resistance capacity corresponding to all feeder lines, constructing a dynamic typhoon field model based on the geographic information data and the typhoon track parameters, solving surface wind speed of a position where the feeder lines are located, comparing the surface wind speed with the disaster resistance capacity, updating feeder line fault states based on comparison results, calculating power failure evaluation indexes of the power distribution system based on updated feeder line fault states, and returning to execute the operation states of all feeder lines of the power distribution system until preset simulation ending conditions are reached, and outputting the power failure evaluation indexes. Through the iterative mechanism of dynamic wind field modeling and disaster resistance comparison, disaster simulation resolution self-adaption is realized, accuracy is high, more scientific decision support is provided, and therefore elasticity of the power distribution system is enhanced.

title_en: Q-learning electric automobile group charging scheduling method based on clustering state space dimension reduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Q-learning electric automobile group charging scheduling method based on clustering state space dimension reduction, which relates to the technical field of electric automobile cluster scheduling, wherein a scheduling range is determined based on user charging will and electric automobile cluster charging power, a Markov decision model is constructed, then a state space dimension reduction module of K-means clustering is embedded in a reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain a clustering reinforcement learning algorithm, and finally, the optimal scheduling strategy is output by a solution model; the invention can compress the high-dimensional state space to constant complexity through clustering, solves the problem of dimension disaster in large-scale electric vehicle group collaborative scheduling in the traditional reinforcement learning, adopts a non-neural network reasoning architecture, has remarkable advantages in calculation efficiency and data utilization, reduces hardware resource consumption and deployment cost, can quickly converge under the condition of a small sample, and reduces the dependence on the scale of training data.

title_en: AR-based forest fire control terrain simulation training method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control simulation training, and particularly discloses a forest fire control terrain simulation training method and system based on AR. The method comprises the steps of determining a target forest area, constructing a three-dimensional terrain model, carrying out dynamic fire simulation to generate a fire-fighting training scene, creating initial guiding information to carry out initial guiding of AR fire-fighting training, evaluating a plurality of training monitoring data, sequentially selecting representative training data, generating representative guiding information, and carrying out sequential guiding and monitoring of AR fire-fighting training. Initial guiding information can be created, initial guiding, monitoring and evaluation are carried out on a plurality of firefighters in a firefighting training scene, representative training data are selected successively to generate representative guiding information, the plurality of firefighters are guided successively and monitored, guiding information which is more fit with actual training can be automatically created, and therefore firefighting capacity of firefighters is effectively and gradually improved in successive firefighting simulation training.
assignees: NANCHANG LINGXING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydraulic engineering data intelligent monitoring method and system based on digital twin
