abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method and system for hydraulic engineering data based on digital twinning, which comprehensively considers the actual physical structure, operation parameters and surrounding environment information of hydraulic engineering when a hydraulic engineering digital twinning model is constructed, breaks the limitation that the traditional monitoring means only pay attention to a single parameter or a few parameters, utilizes model associated data and visual display, enables management staff to visually check the state and parameter change of each part, improves the monitoring efficiency and the comprehensiveness, solves the limitation that the traditional monitoring means lacks effective analysis and excavation, adopts a risk assessment formula to convert the data into risk indexes, enables the management staff to intuitively know the safety condition, combines the model to simulate and analyze the risk development trend and the result when the risk assessment value exceeds the threshold value, finds out problems and risks in advance, triggers early warning, enables related staff to formulate corresponding measures according to the simulation result, such as adjusting flood discharge flow, reinforcing structures and the like, reduces disaster loss, and improves the safety and reliability of the hydraulic engineering.
assignees: ZHONGTOU DECHUANG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Combustion device for simulating true fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of teaching and practicing, and discloses a combustion device for simulating real fire, which comprises a shell and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein the auxiliary mechanism comprises a first motor arranged in the shell, the first motor is used for simulating plane combustion in an initial state, the safety mechanism comprises a second motor arranged at one side of the shell far away from the first motor, the output end of the second motor is fixedly connected with a second carrier, the second carrier is correspondingly adjusted by matching with the auxiliary mechanism to simulate the real fire of different implementation means, and a coordination assembly is arranged in the second carrier and is used for carrying out real-time treatment on the real fire based on the execution state of the second carrier. According to the invention, through the arrangement of the shell, the auxiliary mechanism and the safety mechanism, when the carrier I and the carrier II rotate to form a similar hemisphere, the flip is opened to be in contact with the shell, the underground equipment isopiestic model is placed on the surface of the steel wire mesh for ignition combustion, a dynamic reconfigurable disaster simulation scene is constructed, meanwhile, fuel oil or water is added into the spherical cavity to simulate the underground environment, and the drilling safety is improved.

title_en: Urban fire hazard early warning analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for urban fire hazard early warning analysis based on big data, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprise the steps of initializing Gaussian kernel functions and bandwidth parameters of KDE based on characteristic dimensions, constructing quenching functions and coupling parameters as constraints by combining GIS information, and calculating the simulated defect density, calculating the actual critical index and the standardized deviation by combining the time sequence, constructing a thermal diffusion equation, solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, generating a space-time risk field, and calculating a risk propagation speed field. According to the method, through a multi-index clustering method combining entropy weight and kernel density, risk identification precision of high-dimensional heterogeneous data is improved, an odd-symmetry abnormal point identification mechanism is constructed, accuracy and stability of abnormal point identification are improved, a thermal diffusion equation is constructed, a space-time risk field is generated through solving by a two-stage constant-proximity method, dynamic evolution display of urban fire risks is achieved, and early warning response efficiency is improved.

title_en: Accident scenario construction method and system for accident scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accident scenario construction method and a system for accident scenario construction, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out accident data acquisition and data preprocessing on disaster-bearing objects, respectively extracting common features and individual features, generating a space-time aligned feature vector matrix, loading the feature vector matrix in real time to generate a space-time synchronous digital twin body, carrying out accident process mechanism analysis on the disaster-bearing objects, determining disaster-causing factors possibly causing accidents, adopting reinforcement learning algorithm to simulate accident evolution paths, generating scenario construction element model libraries required by accident scenarios of the disaster-bearing objects, collecting risk data and emergency preparation data of the disaster-bearing objects, and carrying out accident scenario construction by matching with the element model libraries. By effectively integrating the multi-source data, the authenticity of the constructed accident scene is effectively ensured, and meanwhile, the constructed accident scene is more targeted and applicable by adopting a dynamic deduction mode.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Ground disaster early warning protection system for tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground disaster early warning protection system for tunnel construction, which relates to the technical field of tunnel safety construction and comprises a geological monitoring system, a drilling system, a gas impact system, a terminal processing system, a dynamic combustible gas detection system and a closed flame-proof system, wherein the ground disaster early warning protection system for tunnel construction is concrete pouring equipment arranged in front of a tunnel face, and the concrete pouring equipment performs concrete pouring on a hole when the dynamic combustible gas detection system detects that combustible gas escapes from a drill hole. According to the invention, the dynamic combustible gas detection system is arranged to detect whether the combustible gas exists in the geological structure behind the tunnel face, so that the combustible gas can be prevented in advance, and the damage caused by the combustible gas is reduced.

title_en: Angle detection device for installing stress meter
abstract_en: The utility model provides an angle detection device for installing a stress meter, which comprises a first connecting part, an angle detection device and a second connecting part, wherein the first connecting part is used for being connected with a drilling stress meter, one end of the angle detection device is connected with the first connecting part and used for detecting the rotation angle of the drilling stress meter when the drilling stress meter is installed, and the second connecting part is connected with the other end of the angle detection device and used for being connected with a rotation system, wherein the rotation system is used for providing rotation force for the drilling stress meter. The device can monitor and adjust the angle in real time in the installation process, so that the angle error in the traditional installation method is avoided, the accuracy of engineering safety assessment is further improved, and the risk of geological disasters is reduced.
assignees: UROICA SHANDONG MINING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: System for Analyzing Dynamic Event Tree Applying Effect of Multiple External Events and Method thereof
title_ko: 다중 외부사건의 효과를 적용하는 동적사건수목 분석 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for analyzing a dynamic event tree applying an effect of multiple external events. The system comprises: a physical module for collecting a monitoring variable and a control variable while performing a simulation of a physical model; a diagnosis module for determining a branch rule for determining a branch of the simulation using the monitoring variable; and a scheduler for generating at least one branch point based on the branch rule. The system may further include an external event module configured to store an external event occurrence rate and a disaster degree for a plurality of external events, and transmit information of the external event generated after the external event occurs based on the external event occurrence rate during simulation of the physical model and the disaster degree corresponding thereto to the scheduler. The system may further include a reliability module configured to calculate a branch probability related to whether a plurality of devices fail and an operator operation performance time point based on at least one branch point, change a control variable, and calculate the branch probability by determining whether the device is healthy based on a device failure rate value newly calculated by reflecting a disaster degree when it is determined that an external event has occurred based on information on the external event transmitted from the scheduler and the disaster degree.
abstract_ko: 다중 외부사건의 효과를 적용하는 동적사건수목 분석 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다.  이 시스템은 물리모델의 시뮬레이션을 수행하면서 감시변수 및 제어변수를 수집하는 물리모듈, 감시변수를 이용하여 시뮬레이션의 분기를 결정하기 위한 분기규칙을 결정하는 진단모듈 및 분기규칙에 기반하여 적어도 하나의 분기지점을 생성하는 스케줄러를 포함한다.  이 시스템은, 복수의 외부사건에 대한 외부사건 발생률과 재해도를 저장하며, 물리모델의 시뮬레이션 중에 외부사건 발생률에 기초하여 외부사건을 발생시킨 후 발생된 외부사건의 정보와 이에 해당되는 재해도를 스케줄러로 전달하는 외부사건모듈을 더 포함한다.  이 시스템은, 적어도 하나의 분기지점에 기반하여 복수의 기기들의 고장 여부 및 운전원 동작 수행 시점과 관련된 분기확률을 계산하고, 제어변수를 변경하되, 스케줄러로부터 전달되는 외부사건의 정보와 재해도에 기초하여 외부사건이 발생된 것으로 판단되는 경우 재해도가 반영되어 새롭게 산출되는 기기 고장률 값에 기초하여 기기의 건전성 여부를 판단하여 분기확률을 계산하는 신뢰도모듈을 더 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Business continuation support system, business continuation support method, and program
abstract_en: To provide a business continuation support system capable of enhancing the execution property of a business continuation plan.SOLUTION: A business continuation support system according to an embodiment includes a detection device for detecting states of lifelines to be supplied to a business continuation support object area and a state of a heat resource generated in the business continuation support object area, and a simulator device for simulating supply states of lifelines after a disaster, a supply state of the heat resource, and an operation state of heat source equipment for consuming the lifelines and generating the heat resource on the basis of the detection results of the detection device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Design method of building water supply and drainage system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a design method of a building water supply and drainage system, which relates to the technical field of drainage systems and comprises the steps of drawing distribution of pipelines and drainage equipment of the building drainage system by using a BIM forward design method, measuring and calculating drainage data by using a numerical simulation method, layering the drainage data by using a hierarchical analysis method, constructing a judgment matrix, calculating a weight index, combining a Kriging agent model with a bat model, and calculating the optimal arrangement modes of the drainage pipelines and the drainage equipment with different functions and the optimal quantity of fire hydrant. The design method of the building water supply and drainage system can optimally arrange drainage equipment, realize the most reasonable and most efficient utilization of the drainage equipment to drain water in the building, simultaneously take the maximization of water circulation and material utilization into account, simultaneously consider the influence of fire emergency on the drainage system, and combine with the actual design of the most favorable arrangement of fire fighting equipment required by corresponding disaster countermeasures.

title_en: System and method for intelligent evacuation guidance based on spatial sound
title_ko: 공간 음향 기반 지능형 대피 유도 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a spatial sound-based intelligent evacuation guidance system and method. The spatial sound-based intelligent evacuation guidance system includes a digital twin system and an evacuation guidance device. The digital twin system determines the on-site deployment of a sound reproducer and a reverberation eliminator included in the spatial sound-based evacuation guidance device based on simulation results in which a virtual human is evacuated to a destination according to evacuation guidance sound.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공간 음향 기반 지능형 대피 유도 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 공간 음향 기반 지능형 대피 유도 시스템은, 디지털 트윈 시스템과 공간 음향 기반 대피 유도 장치를 포함하고, 상기 디지털 트윈 시스템은 시뮬레이션 결과를 바탕으로 상기 대피 유도 장치에 포함된 음향 재생기와 잔향 제거기의 현장 배치를 결정한다. 
상기 디지털 트윈 시스템은, 대상 공간의 구조, 목적지의 위치, 음향 재생기와 잔향 제거기의 개수 및 대상 공간을 모델링한 가상 공간에 배치될 가상 인간의 수를 포함한 시뮬레이션 데이터를 입력받고, 상기 가상 공간에 배치된 상기 음향 재생기를 통해 상기 목적지를 지향하도록 출력되는 대피 유도 음향을 설정하며, 시뮬레이션 데이터를 기초로 가상 인간이 대피 유도 음향에 따라 상기 목적지로 대피하는 시뮬레이션을 수행한 결과를 바탕으로 음향 재생기와 잔향 제거기의 위치를 결정한다.

title_en: Virtual reality reconstruction and interactive investigation system and method for fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality reconstruction and interactive investigation system and a method for a fire scene, and relates to the technical field of disaster emergency. The method comprises the steps of synchronously obtaining thermal imaging data, millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data, gas component data and building surface deformation data through a multi-mode sensing array, calculating a structural collapse rate index based on the building surface deformation data, extracting flame dynamic diffusion characteristic vectors from the thermal imaging data, triggering a dynamic data compensation mechanism when the collapse rate exceeds a preset safety threshold, switching a three-dimensional reconstruction data source to millimeter wave radar point cloud data, fusing the compensated multi-source data to generate a virtual scene, otherwise adopting a standard registration mode to generate the scene, and dynamically optimizing data fusion weight parameters according to space-time continuity indexes of the virtual scene. The invention effectively solves the problem of reconstruction distortion of the traditional method through a multisource data dynamic compensation mechanism and space-time continuity verification, and improves the reliability and real-time interactivity of virtual reconstruction of a fire scene.

title_en: Method and system for deciding investment of distribution network in two stages of pre-disaster and post-disaster accounting
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining investment of a distribution network in two stages of pre-disaster and post-disaster, which are based on typhoon historical data analysis, generate a plurality of post-disaster fault simulation scenes and occurrence probabilities of the post-disaster fault simulation scenes for worst typhoon events, calculate the line fault probability of the distribution network under the worst typhoon event scenes, construct an upper-layer optimization model by taking the minimum investment cost of a pre-disaster element reinforcing and energy storage system configuration and the optimal preset toughness level as targets for the fault conditions, construct a lower-layer optimization model by taking the minimum load loss cost under different post-disaster fault scenes as targets based on the optimal element reinforcing and energy storage system configuration planning scheme obtained by the upper-layer optimization model, and solve the double-layer optimization model to obtain a plurality of pre-disaster investment decision schemes. The scheme of the invention fully considers the influence of post-disaster maintenance decision-making problem on pre-disaster investment planning, balances the pre-disaster investment cost and the post-disaster load loss cost based on a multi-objective optimization theory, thereby obtaining various pre-disaster investment decision-making schemes and improving the overall toughness level of the power distribution network.
assignees: DEZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting method and device considering typhoon space-time characteristics, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal for elastically lifting a power distribution network by considering typhoon space-time characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks; the three-layer problem model is obtained by converting an elastic lifting model of the power distribution network, the elastic lifting model of the power distribution network is constructed according to an investment layer model and an attack uncertainty set, the attack uncertainty set is constructed according to space-time characteristics of typhoons and historical fault operation data of the power distribution network, and nodes and branches in the power distribution network are controlled according to solutions to complete elastic lifting of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the influence of the space-time characteristics of typhoons on the branch fault uncertainty of the power distribution network is simulated by utilizing the space-time characteristics of typhoons, and the system elasticity of the power distribution network to typhoons disasters is increased by combining an investment strategy and an operation strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting fire disaster ultra-early false alarm solution method and system based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of design of fire-fighting fire super-early false alarm solution, in particular to a fire-fighting fire super-early false alarm solution method and a fire-fighting fire super-early false alarm solution system based on multi-mode fusion. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting multidimensional data such as a temperature field, a smoke spectrum, gas types, gas concentrations, environmental sound waves and the like through a multi-mode sensor array, extracting characteristics, inputting the characteristics into a false alarm solution judgment model obtained through opposite training range learning for analysis, deeply identifying the essential difference between fire and high-simulation interference signals through the model, and finally generating an early warning signal according to the confidence level output by the model and combining a dynamically adjusted decision threshold value. The system correspondingly comprises a sensing, processing, distinguishing and decision-making module. The invention fundamentally solves the problem of false alarm through the countermeasure training and the multi-mode deep fusion, realizes the ultra-early, highly reliable and self-adaptive intelligent fire early warning, and remarkably improves the guarantee capability of fire safety.
assignees: QINGDAO JUNHAI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: CFD optimization-based air volume matching and linkage control method and system for smoke prevention and exhaust system of underground plant
abstract_en: The invention provides an air volume matching and linkage control method and system for an underground plant smoke prevention and exhaust system based on CFD optimization, and belongs to the technical field of underground smoke exhaust systems. According to the method, the system comprises the steps of carrying out physical modeling according to an actual underground factory building, carrying out grid division, selecting a solver, setting boundary conditions, simulating air flow field changes to obtain an initial air flow field, adopting CFD to simulate temperature changes, smoke concentration changes and air flow changes in different fire scenes, analyzing air flow and smoke flow in the underground factory building, evaluating the defects of the existing system, optimizing smoke exhaust pipeline arrangement and fan configuration according to the defects, and dynamically calculating the air flow changes in the fire environment by combining a real-time monitoring system and the CFD to adjust the air quantity of a pressurizing air supply system, a smoke exhaust system and a ventilation system. The efficient linkage of the system is realized, the smoke discharging efficiency and emergency response capability are improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the dual aims of energy conservation and efficiency improvement are achieved while the safety of personnel evacuation is ensured.

title_en: Iron tower disaster early warning method and system based on multidimensional association mining
abstract_en: The application provides an iron tower disaster early warning method and system based on multidimensional association mining, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning, and are used for carrying out statistical analysis by calling multidimensional iron tower data, mining the hierarchical relationship between environment and iron tower state and risk characteristics, supervising and training an iron tower supervision model based on the hierarchical relationship, acquiring real-time monitoring data based on preset sampling frequency according to a sensing monitoring equipment group, returning the real-time monitoring data to the iron tower supervision model, executing feature extraction fusion under spatial distribution and health prediction under a time sequence to determine iron tower risk data, and carrying out disaster early warning and operation maintenance management based on the iron tower risk data. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy of iron tower risk prediction and untimely disaster early warning caused by incomplete utilization of iron tower data due to single data source in the prior art, and achieves the technical effect of remarkably improving the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Fire extinguishing action mechanical arm simulation reproduction method based on motion capture and gesture reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire extinguishing action mechanical arm reproduction method based on motion capture and gesture reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of respectively setting marking points at a plurality of preset positions of upper limbs of a firefighter, setting at least one reference point at a central shaft of a trunk, collecting motion data of the marking points and the reference points when a professional fire extinguishing hand performs fire extinguishing action by using a motion capture system, preprocessing the motion data, building a space model based on the preprocessed motion data of the marking points, further calculating a gesture quaternion of the tail end of the mechanical arm, mapping a world coordinate system to a coordinate system of a base of the mechanical arm based on the reference points, and generating a control instruction according to the gesture quaternion of the tail end to drive each joint of the mechanical arm to reproduce the fire extinguishing action. The invention realizes high-precision and standardized reproduction of the fire extinguishing actions of the professional fire extinguishing hand, and ensures the stability and fluency of the simulation actions of the mechanical arm, thereby providing objective, repeatable and strong-consistency technical support for evaluating the fire extinguishing performance of the fire extinguisher.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Method for predicting void ratio of goaf of underground coal face of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a goaf void ratio prediction method of a coal mine underground coal mining working face, which mainly comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a section width mathematical model of the goaf behind a working face according to the stress state of each partition of the goaf behind the working face, secondly constructing a void ratio mathematical model of the goaf according to the stress state of each partition of the goaf behind the working face, and finally obtaining a void ratio distribution rule of the goaf behind the working face by combining laboratory simulation test results and field actual conditions. The method solves the problem of poor reliability of estimating the void ratio of the goaf behind the working face in the prior art, can greatly improve the prediction precision of goaf air leakage rate, spontaneous combustion ignition 'three zones', goaf filling and the like, and scientifically guides the accurate management and disaster prevention of mines.

title_en: Power grid disaster prevention and reduction method and device for dynamic intelligent decision tree and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a power grid disaster prevention and reduction method and device of a dynamic intelligent decision tree and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid operation state data, weather condition data and equipment health state data of a target power grid, inputting the power grid operation state data, the weather condition data and the equipment health state data into a dynamic emergency decision model to obtain disaster occurrence probability and disaster occurrence range, simulating the disaster occurrence probability and the disaster occurrence range by using a disaster simulation twin model to obtain power grid disaster prevention strategy data, analyzing the power grid disaster prevention strategy data to obtain power grid resource allocation information and power grid abnormal maintenance information under the condition that the power grid disaster prevention strategy data is abnormal, and optimizing the power grid resource allocation information and the power grid abnormal maintenance information by using preset disaster scene simulation data to obtain disaster processing data. By adopting the method, the power grid can be always in an active state in the disaster prevention and reduction process.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban storm waterlogging process simulation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method of urban rainstorm waterlogging process based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of flood disasters. The method comprises the steps of constructing a rainfall-water depth data set of urban inland inundation, training a ConvLSTM deep learning model by using the rainfall-water depth data set, constructing a flood forecasting system based on the deep learning model, constructing a training set and a verification set based on simulation results under different rainfall situations, comprehensively evaluating the performance of the ConvLSTM model, and verifying in an actual scene. The coupling model of the invention not only improves the accuracy and speed of urban flood forecast, but also enhances the adaptability to extreme weather events, and future research will focus on further optimizing the model structure.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly relates to a small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning. The intelligent diagnosis and decision-making system comprises a vital sign acquisition module, an edge calculation platform module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the vital sign acquisition module is used for acquiring physiological parameters of a sensor, the man-machine interaction module is used for acquiring injury image data and human body posture data, the edge calculation platform module comprises an injury image data processing model, an injury characteristic fusion model and a decision-making model, and intelligent injury diagnosis and decision-making are carried out through an expert system based on a knowledge graph and a multi-sensor fused neural network model by combining the biological characteristic data and the image characteristics, so that scientific and reliable support is provided for injury identification and emergency decision-making under a complex environment. The invention solves the technical problems of difficult acquisition of medical data, difficult fusion of heterogeneous data, complex emergency decision and the like, can be applied to various scenes such as disaster site emergency training and the like, and has important application value.

title_en: Underground stratum water-bearing nuclear magnetic resonance 3D imaging method while drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a nuclear magnetic resonance 3D imaging method while drilling for the water content of an underground stratum, which comprises the following steps of arranging a plurality of long lead grounding sources with the length of 500-1000 meters and the interval of 10-20 meters on the ground, supplying alternating current pulses with the frequency of Ramo frequency to enable hydrogen nuclei in the underground water to form macroscopic magnetic moment, and picking up nuclear magnetic resonance NMR signals generated by excitation of different excitation pulse moments by using the same coil after cutting off excitation current pulses; A receiving coil is arranged behind the drill bit, and the free induction attenuated FID signal is dynamically received along with the running of the drill bit. The excitation magnetic field is formed by arranging a long-wire grounding source on the ground, and the nuclear magnetic resonance signal is dynamically received while drilling by installing a receiving coil behind the drill bit, so that the high-precision detection of the water content of the underground rock stratum from two dimensions of the ground surface and the underground is realized. The change of the aquifer and potential water inrush hidden danger can be monitored in real time, and the detection precision and resolution are effectively improved.

title_en: Virtual reality inspection emergency method and system for safety operation of pressure vessel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality inspection emergency method and a virtual reality inspection emergency system for safe operation of a pressure container, which particularly relate to the technical field of the pressure container, and are characterized in that fatigue data in a plurality of time periods are collected and integrated into a VR system, fatigue data of equipment materials are loaded by creating a fault test environment, failure response of the equipment in a fatigue state is simulated, abnormal fluctuation of the equipment data and emergency response of operators are recorded in real time, accuracy of VR simulation is evaluated and divided into high-accuracy and low-accuracy simulation grades, for low-accuracy simulation, abnormal degree is further analyzed, failure time and failure condition of the equipment are dynamically adjusted, so that the simulation precision and the emergency response capability of operators are improved, the problem that the existing VR simulation system cannot fully consider the extreme failure mode of the equipment is effectively solved, and the operators can make more accurate and timely decisions when facing actual sudden events.

title_en: Equivalent quantitative evaluation method by replacing roadway with holes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hole-substituted roadway equivalent quantitative evaluation method, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of S1, evaluating the influence range and degree of a coal seam after overburden mining under the conditions of a fracturing drilling hole and a low-level roadway, obtaining the corresponding control range size and degree, performing dimensionless normalization processing of the influence range, S2, performing quantitative evaluation of overburden gas migration capacity of the staged fracturing drilling hole and the low-level roadway, performing dimensionless normalization processing, S3, performing quantitative analysis on the influence range and diversion capacity of a plurality of fracturing drilling holes and the low-level roadway of the overburden, performing quantitative analysis on construction cost and time of the plurality of fracturing drilling holes and the low-level roadway, performing dimensionless normalization processing of the construction cost and time, and S5, performing serial equivalent analysis on dimensionless parameters in the steps S1-S4, and completing equivalent evaluation of the plurality of fracturing drilling holes on the low-level roadway.
assignees: LUOTUOSHAN COAL MINE NAT ENERGY GROUP WUHAI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication frequency spectrum scheduling method and system based on dynamic entropy optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication spectrum scheduling method and system based on dynamic entropy optimization, comprising the steps of 1, constructing an emergency communication system and calculating received signal gain, 2, constructing a spectrum sensing and user access model, 3, evaluating channel quality in the emergency communication system, 4, establishing a state, action and rewards of deep reinforcement learning according to the spectrum sensing and user access model and the evaluation of the channel quality, 5, constructing a deep reinforcement learning model and training to obtain a trained deep reinforcement learning model, and 6, acquiring an optimal strategy of unmanned aerial vehicle emergency communication spectrum scheduling in a spectrum environment by using the trained deep reinforcement learning model to realize multi-user aggregation spectrum access. The invention solves the problems of limited spectrum resources and energy sources, multi-user dynamic competition and the like in disaster rescue scenes through intelligent distributed spectrum management, and remarkably improves the spectrum utilization efficiency and the communication reliability.

title_en: Mountain state real-time monitoring and identifying method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain state real-time monitoring and identifying method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-angle dynamic images through a PTZ camera, training a double-target detection network based on YOLOv frames, constructing a falling stone-crack detection model, synchronously outputting boundary frame coordinates of a falling stone target and position information of a crack region, constructing a falling stone track prediction model through a DeepSORT multi-target tracking algorithm, obtaining falling stone movement track data, carrying out pixel-level semantic segmentation on the crack region, generating a crack mask map, extracting a main crack direction vector, carrying out registration and differential calculation on the images, obtaining crack width variation and extension length, identifying a newly-increased crack region and marking spatial distribution of the newly-increased crack region, and constructing a multi-level alarm mechanism comprising a field acousto-optic alarm device and a multi-level alarm signal of a cloud platform. The invention has the advantages that the mountain disaster is efficiently monitored and early-warned in real time through falling rock detection and tracking and crack analysis and prediction.
assignees: CHONGQING YIER PUBLIC SECURITY EMERGENCY IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for flood disaster scenario construction
abstract_en: The invention provides an infrastructure cascade failure prediction method and system for constructing flood disaster situations, which comprise the steps of constructing extreme storm flood disaster situations by using a numerical simulation method, constructing independent network topologies of traffic infrastructures, power infrastructures and communication infrastructures, analyzing cascade relations and disaster propagation mechanisms of the power-communication-traffic infrastructures under extreme storm impact, constructing a third-order network model of urban key infrastructure cascade failure, wherein the third-order network model comprises the third-order network topology model, the extreme storm flood model, the disaster propagation model and the cascade failure model, setting infrastructure failure conditions according to the submerged water depth of the urban infrastructure affected by the extreme storm, and performing infrastructure node failure prediction, independent infrastructure network failure prediction and urban key infrastructure cascade failure prediction. The invention can predict the cascade failure of the infrastructure.

title_en: High-precision multi-module coal and gas outburst dynamic simulation test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety, in particular to a high-precision multi-module coal and gas outburst dynamic simulation test device, which mainly solves the technical problem that a test device capable of accurately simulating a coal and gas outburst process is lacking in the prior art. The device comprises a cavity component, a crust simulation component, a gas simulation component, a protruding monitoring component and a data analysis processor, wherein the cavity component comprises a left side cavity, a middle cavity and a right side cavity, the crust simulation component comprises a power source, an electromagnetic valve, a piston, a pressure waveform generator, a pressure controller, an acceleration sensor and a piezoelectric crystal sensor, the gas simulation component comprises a gas container, a gas controller and a gas sensor, and the protruding monitoring component comprises a strain sensor, a microseismic sensor, a three-dimensional laser scanner and a high-speed camera. The device can acquire multidimensional data such as mechanics, chemistry, morphology and the like in the process of protrusion in real time, thereby ensuring simulation precision and further providing comprehensive data support for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Foundation grouting device for geological disaster construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foundation grouting device for geological disaster construction, which relates to the technical field of foundation engineering grouting and comprises a bottom plate, wherein universal wheels are arranged on the lower side of the bottom plate, a concrete barrel is fixedly connected to the upper side of the bottom plate, a pushing handle is fixedly connected to the left side of the bottom plate, a pouring unit for pouring a foundation is arranged on the upper side of the bottom plate, a concrete pump is fixedly connected to the outer side of the concrete barrel, and the pouring unit comprises a protective cover. This ground slip casting device for geological disaster construction, through being provided with protection casing, lifting disk, hydraulic stem, commentaries on classics pipe, transport cavity and drill bit, the convenience control drill bit punches on the ground to pour concrete, and through vibration section of thick bamboo, movable disk, vibration stick, intake pipe one, communicating pipe one and air pump, the convenience control vibration stick descends to the drill bit downside, when convenient control pours concrete, the control vibration stick stirs the concrete, makes concrete distribution even.

title_en: Rainfall threshold determining method and system under slope instability condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining a rainfall threshold under a slope instability condition, which belong to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and are characterized in that geometrical parameters, slope types, mechanical parameters and rainfall conditions under different rainfall conditions of a slope to be analyzed are obtained, working condition data sets under different rainfall situations and slope parameter combination conditions are generated, safety coefficients, deformation fields, plastic area distribution and potential sliding surfaces of the slope under each working condition are obtained through finite element model simulation according to the working condition data sets, the safety coefficients and the instability probabilities of the slope under different rainfall conditions are output by inputting the safety coefficients, the instability probabilities of the slope into a pre-trained neural network model, and a relation curve of the safety coefficients and the instability probabilities along with the change of rainfall is fitted, so that critical rainfall thresholds of the slope under different rainfall conditions are determined. The method combines the finite element multi-physical field simulation with the neural network model, and can realize comprehensive analysis of the stability of the side slope.

title_en: Internal support fixed type core sleeve and orifice three-proofing device for hydraulic punching
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and discloses an internal support fixed type core sleeve and an orifice three-proofing device for hydraulic punching, wherein the core sleeve comprises a sleeve body, a rubber ring arranged on the sleeve body, a sleeve, a rubber expansion pipe, a key block, a communicating pipe and a valve; the two ends of the sleeve are provided with inward flanging which is welded with the sleeve body; the rubber expansion pipe is arranged between the sleeve body and the sleeve, two ends of the rubber expansion pipe are fixedly connected with the sleeve body or the inner flanging, and a sealing space is formed between the rubber expansion pipe and the sleeve body; the communicating pipe is arranged at one end of the sleeve, which is exposed out of the drilling hole, and is communicated with the rubber expansion pipe through the sleeve, the valve is arranged on the communicating pipe, the plurality of key blocks are fixed on the rubber expansion pipe, and the sleeve is provided with a avoidance through groove corresponding to each key block. The core sleeve designed by the utility model has the advantages of convenience in disassembly and assembly, simplicity and rapidness in operation and reliability in fixation.
assignees: HUNAN GAS TREAT AND UTILIZATION ENGINEERING RESEARCH CENTER CO LTD;HUNAN COAL IND NIUMASI MINING CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation Simulation System
abstract_en: To provide an evacuation simulation system capable of obtaining an evacuation simulation result in which characteristics of evacuees are more accurately reflected.SOLUTION: The evacuation simulation system includes: a vulnerable evacuee index acquisition unit for acquiring a vulnerable evacuee index indicating the difficulty of evacuation of an evacuee on the basis of objective information of the evacuee and additional information obtained by observing the evacuee; and a simulation processing unit simulating the time required for evacuation of the evacuee on the basis of the vulnerable evacuee index.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent algorithm-based high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system safety, and discloses a high-voltage transmission line safety assessment method based on an intelligent algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a database through multi-source data acquisition and fusion processing, analyzing the relevance of meteorological conditions and an icing formation mechanism by using a deep learning model, excavating an evolution rule of the correlation, carrying out multi-scene simulation and sensitivity analysis by combining physical characteristics and topographic information of a power transmission line, and establishing a line icing risk partition assessment system. According to the method, the mechanical strength and the ice coating thickness critical value of a circuit are calculated based on a mechanical model, a grading early warning threshold standard is formulated, a time sequence prediction algorithm and a risk propagation model are constructed to realize intelligent early warning, and an anti-icing resource optimal allocation and self-adaptive generation of a deicing scheme are adopted to form an anti-icing strategy. The invention effectively improves the capacity of the high-voltage transmission line for resisting ice coating disasters and enhances the safe and stable operation level of the power grid.

title_en: Reservoir intelligent prediction system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion
abstract_en: The reservoir intelligent prediction system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion integrate satellite remote sensing (NDVI, LST), radar monitoring (PI) and traditional climate parameters, build a multi-mode space-time feature fusion system of 15-dimensional feature vectors, introduce a space-time attention mechanism, dynamically weight features based on mutual information and Euclidean distance, strengthen key element association capture, design an event-driven extreme climate online learning framework, shorten model updating period through SGD algorithm, build a cross-basin element learning migration framework, and realize efficient adaptation of a new basin by using meta training and single-step fine tuning. The system comprises a training stage (feature fusion, network training, online learning and meta learning transfer) and an operation stage (data real-time access, dual-mode prediction and decision support), wherein the water storage quantity prediction error can be controlled within 5%, and the intelligent level of the scenes such as dynamic regulation and control of water resources, flood control and disaster reduction is remarkably improved.
assignees: HYDROELECTRIC POWER GENERATION PLANT TIANSHENGQIAO FIRST LEVEL HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway intelligent construction site safety penetration type management messenger platform which comprises a multi-mode data fusion processing module, an edge computing node cluster, a three-dimensional visual penetration type management interface, an intelligent early warning and emergency response module, a self-adaptive network transmission module and the like, wherein the multi-mode data fusion processing module integrates various data, a dynamic data calibration algorithm is utilized to realize real-time cleaning, alignment and association analysis, and break a data island, the edge computing node cluster performs localized preprocessing and the like on the data in a key area to reduce the load of a central server, the three-dimensional visual interface supports drilling type viewing based on a digital twin construction model to realize three-dimensional monitoring, the intelligent early warning system adopts a reinforced learning model to automatically trigger multi-channel early warning, and the self-adaptive network transmission module dynamically switches communication modes to ensure low-delay transmission of the key data. The platform realizes the real-time collection and integration of the construction site data, and reduces the manual intervention.
assignees: HUATIE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY TEN BUREAU GROUP EIGHTH ENG COMPANY;CR10G ELECTRIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster dynamic prediction method based on satellite remote sensing multisource data fusion and space-time converter
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain torrent disaster dynamic prediction method based on satellite remote sensing multi-source data fusion and space-time transform, which comprises multi-source data acquisition and fusion, feature extraction and dimension reduction, model construction and training and mountain torrent risk assessment and prediction. The invention deeply fuses an advanced data fusion algorithm and a space-time converter network architecture to efficiently process multi-source heterogeneous data such as rainfall distribution, topography, vegetation coverage and the like acquired by satellite remote sensing. The space-time Transformer network can accurately capture the coupling relation and dynamic evolution rule of each influence factor in the space-time dimension in the occurrence and development processes of the mountain torrent disasters by virtue of a strong attention mechanism, compared with the existing similar technology based on satellite remote sensing and deep learning, the prediction precision of the mountain torrent disasters is improved in a breakthrough way, and more reliable data support is provided for disaster early warning and emergency decision.

title_en: Advanced dynamic evaluation method for dolomite sand formation characteristics
abstract_en: A method for advanced dynamic evaluation of dolomite sand features includes determining microscopic and macroscopic thresholds of dolomite sand degree classification based on an indoor test as rock test static parameters, extracting dynamic parameters and electrical parameters of dolomite rock mass based on geophysical advanced detection combined with bullet-electricity as advanced detection dynamic parameters, carrying out principal component analysis and correlation analysis on the rock test static parameters and the advanced detection dynamic parameters, constructing a dolomite sand dynamic-static parameter quantitative conversion model by utilizing RBFNN, taking the rock test static parameters as input and sand degree classification as output, training an intelligent classification evaluation model, mapping the advanced detection dynamic parameters into the rock test static parameters through the quantitative conversion model, inputting the mapped rock test static parameters into the intelligent classification evaluation model for verification and iterative optimization, and outputting sand degree classification results. The invention can realize the prevention and control of the sand-making advance of dolomite in front of the tunnel face of tunnel construction and avoid the occurrence of sand-making sand-surging and collapse ground disaster.

title_en: Rock burst intensity forecasting method for improving RNN-DNN hybrid neural network based on model independent element learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst intensity forecasting method based on a model-independent element learning improved RNN-DNN hybrid neural network, belongs to the technical field of rock soil rock burst, and aims to solve the problems of low forecasting accuracy and insufficient adaptability across engineering scenes in the traditional forecasting method. The method comprises the steps of widely collecting multi-source rock burst influence factor data, determining rock burst grade division standards, constructing a rock burst database, performing deficiency value complementation through Bayesian interpolation to obtain primary data, performing outlier rejection by using an ECOD anomaly detection algorithm to obtain secondary data, dividing the secondary data into a training set and a verification set, optimizing initial parameters of an RNN-DNN hybrid neural network by using a model independent element learning frame, loading the initial parameters into the hybrid neural network, and performing model training by combining the training set and the verification set to obtain a rock burst intensity prediction model. The method can improve accuracy of rock burst intensity prediction and scene-crossing universality, and provides technical support for deep underground engineering disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Flexible resource optimization method and system considering elasticity and carbon reduction comprehensive value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible resource optimization method and a system for considering elasticity and carbon reduction comprehensive value, which are used for acquiring parameters of an electric power system, constructing a multi-objective flexible resource allocation framework for two-stage optimization, wherein the first stage makes decisions on the types, the numbers and the positions of resources within a given budget range, the second stage simulates and evaluates the elasticity and the carbon reduction effect of the decisions through extreme faults and the system operation under the conventional operation scene, constructs a multi-objective optimization model, adopts an NCC method to solve the multi-objective optimization model, generates two anchor points, maps the targets to a normalized space, defines Utopia vectors and generates uniformly distributed points, finally obtains a set of all Pareto optimal solutions, and completes flexible resource optimization planning. According to the invention, a resource construction-operation simulation two-stage optimization framework is constructed, fault recovery after extreme disasters and electric power-carbon-green evidence market coupling operation under conventional conditions are fused in an operation simulation link, and thermal power generating units and energy storage resources collaborative optimization planning taking elasticity and carbon reduction targets into account is realized.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Post-disaster intelligent recovery method and device for power distribution network based on RainbowDQN algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster intelligent recovery method and device for a power distribution network based on RainbowDQN algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a power distribution network model and a preset N-3 fault combination, constructing a Markov decision environment model of a power distribution network load recovery task of the N-3 fault of a line, setting an objective function and constraint conditions of the Markov decision environment model, training an agent in the Markov decision environment model by adopting a RainbowDQN algorithm added with a self-adaptive action mask to obtain a trained agent, transmitting parameter information of the power distribution network with the N-3 line fault to the trained agent, and outputting a load recovery strategy of the power distribution network with the N-3 line fault by the agent. The method of the invention utilizes the flexible soft switching technology to rapidly isolate the affected area when the natural disasters cause faults, reduces the risk of fault diffusion, ensures that the power supply grid can rapidly carry out necessary topology adjustment after the disasters, and realizes the efficient distribution of the post-disaster power support.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Karst area tunnel excavation induced ground subsidence catastrophe mechanism analogue test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation test device for a disaster mechanism of ground collapse induced by karst area tunnel excavation, which comprises a covering layer simulation box, a karst pipeline system, a karst water cavity simulation box, a tunnel simulation assembly, a water level control box, a water supply system, a multi-parameter monitoring system and a bearing steel frame. The underground water leakage rate is quantitatively controlled by the aid of the electric regulating valve and the electromagnetic flowmeter, and the multi-parameter monitoring system comprises a displacement sensor, a pore water pressure sensor and the like and is used for synchronously collecting multidimensional data such as water displacement, surface displacement and the like. The invention can accurately simulate the groundwater leakage process caused by tunnel excavation, reveal the association rule of groundwater leakage rate and ground subsidence development mode, and provide theoretical basis for karst area tunnel engineering disaster early warning and protection design.
assignees: NANJIANG HYDROLOGY GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING GEOLOGICAL TEAM CHONGQING BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERALS E

title_en: Prediction method for collapse range of weak area of high-valley heap type dumping site
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of a collapse range of a weak area of a high-valley heap type dumping site, which comprises the steps of obtaining high-precision topographic data of the dumping site and an original earth surface through a three-dimensional modeling technology, constructing a triangular net model, carrying out grid reconstruction processing on the triangular net model to generate a hybrid hexahedral closed grid model suitable for numerical calculation, calculating and delineating a maximum strain increment position based on three-dimensional strength folding and subtracting method and combining field physical test and laboratory mechanical test data, determining the weak area of the high-valley heap type dumping site, establishing a landslide particle flow model of the weak area of the Gao Gudui type dumping site, and predicting three-dimensional spatial distribution of the collapse influence range through fluid dynamics simulation. The method breaks through the limitation of traditional plane strain analysis, realizes three-dimensional visual prediction of landslide influence range under complex terrain, remarkably improves disaster early warning precision of the dump, provides scientific decision basis for mine safety protection, and effectively reduces landslide accident risk and protection cost.
assignees: SINOSTEEL MAANSHAN GENERAL INSTITUTE OF MINING RES CO LTD

title_en: Mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine safety training method and system based on digital twin and virtual reality, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring laser scanning point cloud and geological exploration data of an underground roadway of a mine, and constructing a high-precision virtual underground environment model based on the data; based on the virtual underground environment model, combining explosion condition judgment, triggering disaster simulation, generating a virtual training environment by using a real-time rendering and dynamic labeling technology, acquiring operation behavior data of training personnel in the virtual training environment, evaluating the operation behavior data to obtain a behavior evaluation result, constructing and training an evaluation model by using machine learning based on the behavior evaluation result and environment parameter change data, and generating customized training contents by combining geological conditions and mining process characteristics of different mining areas. The method can construct a high-restoration-degree virtual scene, solves the problem of single traditional training scene, realizes quantitative evaluation of training effect, and improves training pertinence and effectiveness.
assignees: HSIKWANG SHAN TWINKLING STAR CO LTD;HUNAN INST TRAFFIC ENG

title_en: Self-adaptive risk assessment method and system for disaster prevention and reduction emergency exercise
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive risk assessment method and a self-adaptive risk assessment system for disaster prevention and reduction emergency exercise, which belong to the technical field of intersection of information technology and emergency management and comprise the following steps of S1, constructing a plan knowledge graph and generating an actual behavior graph, wherein the construction of the plan knowledge graph comprises the steps of analyzing the emergency exercise plan, extracting a response unit and a task node defined in the plan as a plan entity node, extracting a command chain and task dependency relationship between the entities as a plan relationship edge, generating the plan knowledge graph as a static assessment benchmark, and the generation of the actual behavior graph comprises the steps of carrying out real-time fusion and analysis on multi-source heterogeneous data in the exercise process to form a structured state flow with unified space-time benchmark and constructing an actual behavior graph dynamically evolving along with time according to the structured state flow.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YONGJI ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydrological model parameter calibration method for hydrological data lack watershed
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of parameter calibration of hydrological models of drainage basins, in particular to a parameter calibration method of hydrological models of a drainage basin, which is used for determining a drainage basin B controlled by a drainage basin A and a hydrological station (reference station) adjacent to the drainage basin A with data, collecting hydrological weather and underlying surface characteristic data of the two drainage basins, calculating A, B design floods of the two drainage basins by using a storm runoff check algorithm, comparing the design floods of storm runoff check of the adjacent drainage basin B with the design floods calculated by actual measurement flow data, determining a flood correction coefficient kappa for correcting the design floods calculated by the storm runoff check algorithm of the drainage basin A, inputting model parameters and design surface stormwater of the drainage basin A into a hydrological model, simulating outlet section floods, comparing simulation results and corrected storm runoff check results, analyzing parameter sensitivity and adjusting and optimizing model parameters. The invention is suitable for parameter calibration of the mountain torrent forecast model in the small river basin with the lack of data, and provides a new means for flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;YUNNAN INSTITUTE OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Water damage prevention and control technology for mining of middle-deep metal mine
abstract_en: The invention provides a water disaster prevention and control technology for mining of a deep and medium-grade metal mine, which comprises the following steps of 1, carrying out transient electromagnetic and two-dimensional seismic geophysical prospecting on an auxiliary roadway bottom plate in the middle section of a mining area to obtain a transient electromagnetic result and a two-dimensional seismic geophysical prospecting result, 2, carrying out space superposition analysis on the transient electromagnetic and two-dimensional seismic geophysical prospecting result to determine a comprehensive water-making abnormal area, 3, utilizing a downhole directional multi-branch drilling technology to carry out grouting blocking on the drainage and vertical crack structures of the comprehensive water-making abnormal area, 4, determining the maximum disturbance range M of mining of the middle section of the mine on surrounding rocks in the middle section of the mining area, and 5, carrying out curtain grouting outside the maximum disturbance range M. The invention forms a closed-loop precise control system and obviously improves the safety and efficiency of mine exploitation.
assignees: ANHUI TAIPING MINING CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Disaster recovery exercise method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery exercise method, a disaster recovery exercise system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of disaster recovery exercise. The disaster recovery configuration information of the service system is automatically read, a drilling plan is generated, disaster recovery switching operation is executed, and key indexes are monitored in real time; after the exercise is finished, a report is generated and all process records are saved for audit analysis. By automatically reading and generating the disaster recovery backup exercise program, the time and error of manual configuration are reduced, and the exercise program is ensured to be accurate and error-free. Each key index is monitored in real time and displayed to a user, so that possible errors can be found and corrected in time, and the drilling precision is improved. The automatic execution and real-time feedback mechanism of the drilling process effectively reduces human misoperation and ensures smooth implementation of disaster recovery schemes. Through a plurality of preset templates and flexible custom adjustment options, the full coverage of various disaster recovery scenes is ensured. The resource allocation in the drilling process is intelligently optimized by the system, so that the waste of resources is reduced and the utilization efficiency of the resources is improved.

title_en: Distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on CNN-LSTM and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed optical fiber temperature-sensing fire detection algorithm based on a CNN-LSTM and an attention mechanism, and aims to solve the problems of high false alarm rate, response lag and poor scene adaptability in the traditional detection technology. The system collects temperature data at a space resolution of 0.5 m at intervals of 2 seconds through a distributed optical fiber sensing unit, inputs CNN-LSTM hybrid model to extract space-time characteristics after Z-Score standardization, db4 wavelet noise reduction and 12-dimensional characteristic enhancement pretreatment, and outputs fire risk indexes of 0-100 in combination with focusing key areas and moments of an attention mechanism. The model training adopts transfer learning and Focal Loss function to realize cross-scene rapid adaptation and sample imbalance treatment, and parameters are updated through incremental learning every 30 days. Practice shows that the false alarm rate of the method is reduced by more than 80 percent compared with that of the traditional threshold method, and the smoldering fire disaster early warning is advanced by 25 seconds, so that the method can be widely applied to fire safety monitoring of complex scenes such as tunnels, substations, comprehensive pipe galleries and the like.

title_en: High side slope chain risk assessment method based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high side slope chain life risk assessment method based on numerical simulation, which belongs to the technical field of landslide numerical simulation and comprises the following steps of S1, collection of landslide susceptibility results and landslide cataloging data, S2, screening of a landslide starting area, S3, numerical simulation of the landslide, S4, space analysis and risk assessment. According to the high side slope chain risk assessment method based on numerical simulation, the landslide starting area is accurately screened through numerical simulation, and scientific basis is provided for landslide disaster prevention and disaster reduction.

title_en: Full-process mechanized construction line of 'one tunnel twelve lines' of tunnel by drilling and blasting method and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering construction, in particular to a drilling and blasting method tunnel 'one tunnel twelve line' full-process mechanized construction line and a use method thereof. The working procedures are sequentially carried out according to twelve working lines from a face, namely an advanced forecasting line, an advanced supporting line, a digging and loading line, an anchor rod construction line, an arch centering installation line, a shotcrete line, an inverted arch construction line, a waterproof board, a secondary lining steel bar working line, a secondary lining pouring line, a lining maintenance line, a ditch cable groove line and a solid detection line. The invention fully releases human resources, especially for geological disaster areas such as rock burst, soft rock large deformation and the like, and greatly improves the construction safety.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 12TH BUREAU GR;THE 3TH ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 12TH BUREAU GROUP

title_en: Comprehensive management and evaluation method for rural road traffic safety risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural road traffic safety risk comprehensive management and evaluation method which comprises the following steps of selecting rural road layout front-end equipment to monitor illegal behaviors, processing the illegal behaviors, dividing the risk grades of illegal personnel, arranging the illegal personnel according to the risk grades to conduct training and learning, dissuading the unlearned illegal personnel to complete training and learning, monitoring, early warning and emergency response in a high-risk environment, and evaluating comprehensive management effects. According to the invention, by monitoring the rural road traffic illegal behaviors in real time and managing risk personnel in a grading manner, the investment of staff and the cost for checking the illegal behaviors are effectively reduced, meanwhile, the rural road environment monitoring and safety early warning emergency response capability is improved, the intelligent level and safety of traffic management are obviously improved, the traffic accident rate is reduced, and the public travel safety is ensured.

title_en: Integrated landslide susceptibility assessment method combined with chimeric model
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated landslide susceptibility assessment method combined with a mosaic model, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired multi-class data to obtain grid point data, randomly generating non-landslide points according to a preset distance, and deriving an evaluation factor original value to obtain an original data set; calculating the contribution factor value of each evaluation factor, multiplying the contribution factor value by the original value of the evaluation factor to obtain a weighted data set, constructing a mosaic model by using a Extratrees model and an XGB model, dividing the weighted data set into a training set and a verification set, training the mosaic model by using the training set, verifying by using the verification set, performing landslide hazard susceptibility analysis by using the verified mosaic model, and outputting a landslide hazard susceptibility prediction graph. The method solves the problems of obvious short plates and insufficient accuracy of the evaluation result in the aspects of data integration and quantitative analysis in the traditional landslide susceptibility evaluation method.

title_en: Prediction system and method for high-temperature heat wave drought composite disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prediction, and particularly discloses a prediction system and a method for a high-temperature high-wave drought composite disaster, wherein the system comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a multi-dimensional input feature set, a multi-dimensional data analysis module and a multi-dimensional prediction module, wherein the multi-source data acquisition module is used for acquiring meteorological data, topographic data, vegetation and soil data and human activity data; the system comprises a data processing module, a deep learning model training module and a prediction output module, wherein the data processing module is used for carrying out space-time alignment, normalization processing and outlier rejection on collected meteorological data, topographic data, vegetation and soil data and human activity data, then extracting key features through dimension reduction by a principal component analysis method, the deep learning model training module adopts a CNN-RNN fusion architecture, and the prediction output module is used for generating a composite disaster prediction result through the trained deep learning model training module. By adopting the technical scheme, multidimensional data can be considered, a multi-element coupling model is constructed, and prediction of space-time distribution, evolution rate and coupling strength of high-temperature heat wave drought composite disasters in complex geographic units and ecologically vulnerable areas can be realized.

title_en: Small sample target detection method and system based on cross-modal knowledge fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small sample target detection method and system based on cross-modal knowledge fusion, which mainly solve the problems of sparse visual characteristics and poor detection effect in small sample target detection in the prior art. The implementation scheme of the method comprises the steps of constructing a small sample target detection data set by utilizing a remote sensing image data set, dividing a training sample and a test sample, respectively establishing a higher-efficiency baseline unit, a semantic feature extraction unit and a cross-modal semantic fusion unit, connecting the higher-efficiency baseline unit and the semantic feature extraction unit in parallel and then connecting the higher-efficiency baseline unit and the semantic feature extraction unit in series with the fusion unit to form a remote sensing image small sample target detection model based on cross-modal knowledge fusion, training the remote sensing image small sample target detection model by utilizing the training sample, and inputting the test sample into the trained small sample target detection model to obtain target positioning and classification. By introducing semantic features, the problem of lack of visual features in a small sample scene is effectively solved, the small sample target detection effect is improved, and the method can be used for environment monitoring, city planning and disaster early warning.

title_en: Flood control and debris flow prevention geological disaster control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control and debris flow prevention, and particularly discloses a geological disaster prevention method and system for flood control and debris flow prevention, comprising the following steps of firstly, carrying out real-time monitoring and data acquisition on disaster conditions of flood and debris flow, deploying a multi-parameter sensor network in a target area, and acquiring rainfall, soil moisture content, earth surface displacement, underground water level, debris flow velocity and flow data in real time; the intelligent disaster prevention system based on the intelligent drainage system and the self-adaptive flood control gate realizes comprehensive sensing of disaster characteristics through collaborative monitoring of the sensor network and the unmanned aerial vehicle, dynamically generates risk levels based on a machine learning model, improves early warning accuracy, realizes active intervention of disasters through facilities such as the intelligent drainage system and the self-adaptive flood control gate, ensures disaster condition data to be credible based on a block chain and machine learning technology, provides scientific basis for post-disaster reconstruction, and improves public disaster prevention awareness and emergency capability through VR simulation and a user terminal.
assignees: XINDIAN COMPREHENSIVE SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Rock burst grade prediction method and system based on HPO-SVM model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst grade prediction method and a rock burst grade prediction system based on an HPO-SVM model, which belong to the field of underground engineering rock burst disaster prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing and analyzing a sample data set of rock burst cases, dividing the sample data set into a training set and a testing set, and determining rock burst main control factors and rock burst grades; the method comprises the steps of establishing a rock burst prediction model based on a hunter prey optimization algorithm and a support vector machine algorithm, training the rock burst prediction model based on a training set to obtain a trained rock burst prediction model, selecting a plurality of evaluation indexes of the rock burst prediction model, inputting a test set into the trained rock burst prediction model to obtain a predicted value, comparing and analyzing an actual value and the predicted value based on the evaluation indexes, selecting a rock burst engineering instance as a verification set, and predicting the rock burst intensity level of the rock burst engineering instance by adopting the rock burst prediction model. The invention can accurately predict the rock burst grade of the underground engineering and is beneficial to improving the safety and the construction efficiency of the underground engineering.

title_en: Geological disaster risk prediction method and system for long-distance diversion and adjustment water line
