abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and particularly discloses a method and a system for predicting geological disaster risk of a long-distance diversion and water line, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a research area where an originally planned diversion and water line is located into grids, and constructing a grid data set according to historical data corresponding to sensitivity evaluation factors of each unit in the grids; the method comprises the steps of determining a super-parameter space of a gradient lifting decision tree, carrying out grid search on the super-parameter space to obtain super-parameter combinations meeting preset conditions, constructing the gradient lifting decision tree based on the super-parameter combinations, training the gradient lifting decision tree by utilizing a grid data set, inputting current data corresponding to sensitivity evaluation factors of units where an originally planned drainage line is located into the gradient lifting decision tree, predicting geological disaster occurrence probability of the originally planned drainage line in each unit, and determining risk grades and geological disaster sensitivity partitions according to the geological disaster occurrence probability. The invention can effectively avoid high risk areas of geological disasters.

title_en: Personnel evacuation simulation method considering panic emotion and competitive behaviors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel evacuation simulation method considering panic emotion and competitive behaviors, which comprises the steps of building a digital model of a building, meshing the building space, initializing evacuation personnel, calculating a panic value of the personnel, judging the personnel state, randomly moving the personnel in the panic state to surrounding blank neighborhoods, constructing a normal personnel behavior rule based on a field intensity model, calculating a personnel competitiveness value, when a plurality of evacuees compete for the same grid, obtaining the priority passing right of the position by the evacuee with the highest competitiveness value, keeping the evacuee motionless, and updating the personnel position until evacuation is completed. The model fully considers the panic emotion and competitive behavior of people in the evacuation process, more truly restores the evacuation process of the people, and provides support for the optimization of evacuation management.

title_en: Tidal flat evolution prediction method and system based on hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention provides a tidal flat evolution prediction method and system based on a hybrid model, which relate to the technical field of intersection of dynamic geomorphology and artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of constructing a tidal flat erosion and deposition evolution database under different situations of a target coastal zone; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topography prediction model through an artificial intelligent algorithm based on a database, taking hydrodynamic feature data as input and seabed scouring and silting change amount as output, performing hybrid simulation based on a physical mechanism model and the topography prediction model, updating topography boundary conditions through cyclic iteration to realize long-duration evolution prediction, configuring a service application module, receiving user input parameters through an interactive interface and outputting a visual result. According to the invention, the traditional hydrodynamic force-sediment-landform coupling calculation is decoupled into a chain-type flow with a physical mechanism and AI cooperated, so that the calculation complexity is obviously reduced, the off-line rapid calculation business of tidal flat evolution is realized, and a real-time technical support is provided for coastal zone planning and disaster prevention decision.

title_en: Three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system based on autonomous control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring, in particular to an autonomous controllable three-dimensional tunnel water burst analysis method and system; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous geological, hydrologic and construction data, fusing and obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological-construction coupling digital twin model after alignment coding, conducting water gushing evolution rolling prediction through multi-scale physical-AI mixed modeling and correcting real-time data, outputting prediction data, constructing a three-dimensional visual platform, starting multi-level linkage early warning based on a risk threshold, and enabling the system to comprise a data fusion module, a water gushing evolution rolling prediction module and a multi-level linkage early warning module, and meet the requirements of rapid early warning and timely decision making of water gushing disasters in the tunnel construction process by combining three-dimensional visual rendering and deep learning fluid simulation technology through fusion of geological data, hydrologic monitoring data and construction parameters.

title_en: Slope deformation monitoring and dynamic early warning method and system based on multi-sensor data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope deformation monitoring and dynamic early warning method and system based on multi-sensor data, which relate to the technical field of slope monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source sensor data by using pre-deployed multi-type sensors, constructing graph structure data according to sensor distribution and the pre-processed multi-source sensor data, modeling by using a graph convolution network, and constructing a slope deformation monitoring model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out combined training on slope deformation monitoring models of a plurality of stations by introducing a clustered federal learning strategy, carrying out risk classification by using the trained slope deformation monitoring models, extracting key influence factors of landslide disasters, introducing an improved firefly algorithm to dynamically optimize an early warning threshold, and judging by using the optimized early warning threshold and the current risk level to generate early warning information. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis, the reliability of monitoring and the timeliness of early warning are improved, and the spanning from single-point static to networked intelligent of the slope deformation monitoring is realized.
assignees: SHANXI METALLURGICAL ROCK SOIL ENGINEERING INVESTIG CO LTD

title_en: Method, system and medium for deploying disaster damage emergency resources of power distribution network based on VQNN model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster damage emergency resource deployment method, a system and a medium for a power distribution network based on VQNN models, relates to the technical field of emergency resource scheduling, and aims to determine the fault probability of each tower of the power distribution network under natural disasters based on basic operation data and disaster environment data, simulate the power failure diffusion path of the tower after disconnection faults to obtain the overall fault probability of the power distribution network under the natural disasters, construct a power distribution network vulnerable curve based on the overall fault probability to evaluate the disaster damage load loss of the power distribution network, and provide a reliable data base for subsequent resource scheduling based on the disaster damage load loss and a load gap by taking the disaster damage load loss, the power balance of emergency power supply resources and the emergency power supply resources as constraint conditions and the minimum scheduling cost as targets.

title_en: Method and system for simulating dam break whole process of tailing pond
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for simulating the whole dam break process of a tailing pond, which comprise the steps of constructing a three-dimensional geological grid model according to earth surface point cloud data of a target area and matching drilling data, solving an initial ground stress field by a virtual mass method and setting stress unbalance rate conditions, simulating the mountain break process based on the initial ground stress field and landslide impact force in a landslide simulation stage to obtain the boundary of a broken area and pore water pressure distribution, starting a dam break simulation stage of a deformation broken area when dam displacement in disaster response suddenly changes or the stress exceeds a threshold value, simulating a mud-sand flow motion path based on the boundary of the broken area and topographic data in the dam break simulation stage, and finally generating a disaster forming path diagram, a stacking thickness cloud diagram and an influence range thermodynamic cloud diagram based on the mud-sand flow motion path.
assignees: SHENZHEN ACAD OF DISASTER PREVENTION AND REDUCTION

title_en: Test system and test method for simulating karst tunnel water and mud bursting disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation, and particularly discloses a test system and a test method for simulating karst tunnel water and mud bursting disasters. The seepage simulation box comprises a box body, a first cover plate and universal wheels, wherein a tunnel hole is formed in the front plate surface of the box body and used for installing a tunnel test unit, and the interior of the box body is filled with different materials in a layered mode to simulate soluble rock and non-soluble rock geologic bodies respectively, and rock stratum permeability parameters are regulated and controlled to reproduce evolution of a corrosion channel and water-proof characteristics of non-soluble rock stratum. The test system disclosed by the invention combines accurate water supply, extreme rainfall simulation, karst boundary difference modeling and double-hole coupling monitoring means, reveals critical conditions and propagation mechanisms of water and mud bursting disasters caused when a tunnel passes through a soluble and non-soluble rock interface, and provides reliable test basis for disaster chain prevention and control in karst area tunnel construction and operation.
assignees: SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN SHUDAO EXPRESSWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Subway carriage fire temperature prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway carriage fire temperature prediction method which comprises the steps of obtaining fire experiment data through fire condition simulation of a subway carriage, preprocessing the fire experiment data to obtain a preprocessed data set, constructing an initial temperature prediction model based on a multilayer feedforward network and a genetic algorithm, training the initial temperature prediction model based on the preprocessed data set to obtain a temperature prediction model, and predicting the carriage top temperature of the subway carriage through the temperature prediction model. The invention constructs a temperature database based on the subway carriage fire numerical model and determines a proper hyper-parameter value. The GA-BPNN algorithm model consisting of the input layer, the hidden layer and the output layer is used for predicting the ceiling temperature distribution of the fire disaster of the subway train carriage, and the operation management of a tunnel subway system is expected to be further improved.

title_en: Urban haze disaster risk assessment method based on information entropy improved PCA-ISSA-CatBoost model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of haze disaster risk assessment, in particular to an urban haze disaster risk assessment method based on an information entropy improved PCA-ISSA-CatBoost model, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring a sample data set based on an index feature system, S2, dividing the sample data set into a plurality of initial pellets through pellet calculation, further refining pellet layers of the initial pellets step by step according to granularity to form a plurality of layered pellet sets, weighting each pellet in each layered pellet, carrying out principal component analysis to obtain a corresponding principal component, S3, fusing the principal components of each pellet to obtain a global principal component, screening out a preset number of features to form an initial feature set Fs, S4, constructing a CatBoost model, S5, enabling a sparrow search algorithm to search an optimal feature subset F  opt  of the initial feature set Fs and an optimal super-parameter theta  opt  of the CatBoost model, S6, training the CatBoost model, and carrying out haze disaster risk assessment by using the trained CatBoost model. The method can accurately, reliably and low-dependency risk prediction for the haze disasters.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for predicting icing thickness of power transmission line in stages
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power systems, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting ice coating thickness of a power transmission line in stages. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial icing thickness data and future microclimate data, preprocessing the future microclimate data to obtain an icing growth rate data set, screening the icing growth rate data set based on a gradient aggregation optimization tree algorithm to obtain a training set and a testing set, carrying out parameter optimization based on an expected improved convergence frame and a self-adaptive nuclear fusion machine to determine optimal parameters of a model, carrying out training verification according to the optimal parameters of the model and the training set and the testing set to establish a target icing growth rate prediction model, and calculating the icing thickness at a future moment in stages based on the target icing growth rate prediction model and the initial icing thickness. According to the invention, the staged differentiation prediction of the icing growth, stabilization and melting stages is realized by constructing a cooperative mechanism, so that the engineering practicability of the icing thickness prediction of the power transmission line is improved.
assignees: GUIYANG BUREAU EHV POWER TRANS CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Coastal flood control self-adaptive strategy optimization system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coastal flood control self-adaptive strategy optimization system based on reinforcement learning, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-dimensional data acquisition module, a deep learning data processing module, a reinforcement learning strategy generation module, an unmanned aerial vehicle execution and feedback module, a dynamic optimization closed loop unit and an emergency mode subunit, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-dimensional data acquisition module is used for carrying out cooperative work through a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle group to acquire data, the deep learning data processing module is used for processing the data acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-dimensional data acquisition module and updating a three-dimensional terrain model, flood evolution prediction, a flooding simulation graph and abnormal signal real-time detection in real time, the reinforcement learning strategy generation module is used for designing a state space, expanding an action space and optimizing a reward function, the unmanned aerial vehicle execution and feedback module is used for strategy execution tracking, post-disaster evaluation and model iteration, and the dynamic optimization closed loop unit comprises a daily mode subunit and an emergency mode subunit. According to the invention, the real-time sensing and accurate decision of the flood control strategy can realize the dynamic optimization of the coastal flood control self-adaptive strategy.

title_en: Improved LSTM model-based transmission line geological disaster time sequence InSAR prediction method
abstract_en: An improved long-short-term memory network LSTM model is constructed based on an improved LSTM model power transmission line geological disaster time sequence InSAR prediction method, a basic data set is built for LSTM model training by utilizing acquired power transmission line monitoring area time sequence InSAR deformation result data, regularization technology, attention mechanism and self-adaptive learning rate adjustment strategy are introduced in the model training process, overfitting risk is reduced, generalization capability of the model is improved, and a high-precision deformation prediction model for monitoring power transmission line time sequence InSAR is obtained. The method has important significance for early warning and deformation trend analysis of geological disasters around the power transmission line, and can provide scientific basis and decision support for safe operation of power transmission facilities, so that potential hazard of the geological disasters to a power system is effectively reduced.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Marine platform early warning method and device based on ocean numerical model parameter adjustment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore platform early warning method and device based on ocean numerical model parameter adjustment, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a large-area ocean numerical model to simulate ocean parameters which possibly influence the safety of an offshore platform in a future period of time; the method comprises the steps of extracting parameter information near an offshore platform in a large-area ocean numerical model, processing model forecasting results, automatically judging whether the offshore platform has potential safety hazards according to the model forecasting results, sending early warning information to staff, monitoring ocean data in real time, continuously verifying simulation accuracy of the numerical model, and automatically adjusting parameter values of the model based on AI big data. The invention provides a high-efficiency and accurate offshore platform safety pre-warning method, which is beneficial to discovering potential safety hazards of an offshore platform in advance, reduces working risks of offshore platform staff, has the disaster prevention and reduction effects, and is particularly suitable for being applied to sea areas with changeable sea conditions.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method integrating double engines
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide vulnerability evaluation method integrating double engines, which relates to the technical field of landslide hazard prediction, and comprises the steps of preprocessing evaluation factor data of a landslide hazard research area, and obtaining an initial evaluation factor original data set based on information magnitude of the evaluation factor data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a fusion double-engine model, carrying out weighting treatment on an initial evaluation factor original data set, reserving geological features closely related to a landslide generation mechanism, obtaining feature vectors, carrying out gradient lifting treatment and optimization to obtain a landslide vulnerability probability value, training the fusion double-engine model by utilizing the initial evaluation factor original data set to obtain a trained fusion double-engine model, analyzing evaluation factor data, dividing the evaluation factor data into five grades by using a natural breakpoint method, obtaining a landslide disaster vulnerability prediction graph, and completing the evaluation of landslide vulnerability. The method solves the problem of low landslide risk assessment precision.

title_en: Disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for underground coal mine trackless rubber-tyred vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for a coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, which is characterized in that a digital twin platform is used for acquiring data acquired by a data acquisition module to construct a virtual environment of an operation roadway of the coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, an expert recommendation module is used for manually processing an emergency scheme before the emergency is acquired by an information recording module, recommending the disaster emergency scheme after analysis, inputting the scheme into the digital twin platform for simulation verification, a voice recognition module is used for converting manual voice recognition into a control command which can be recognized by a dynamic command module, and the dynamic command module is used for dynamically controlling the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle according to the control command and the disaster emergency scheme. Through the mutual cooperation of the modules, the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle can be rapidly and effectively processed when an emergency occurs in the operation process of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle, the operation safety of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle is ensured, and the working efficiency of the underground trolley rubber-tyred vehicle of a coal mine is finally improved.

title_en: Colliery is fire prevention and extinguishing system in pit based on distributing type thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground fire prevention and extinguishing system based on a distributed Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring and intelligent control and comprises a perception sub-node module, a communication cooperation module, an edge decision control module, a linkage response module and a cloud management platform. Environmental data such as temperature, gas concentration, smog and the like are acquired through a multi-mode sensor, and an edge AI chip is utilized to analyze in real time and generate early warning scores. And a multiscale scoring fusion and neighborhood reference mechanism is adopted, so that the accuracy and the robustness of early fire disaster identification are improved. And a multi-node cooperative confirmation mechanism is introduced to realize distributed intelligent judgment, so that false alarm and missing report are effectively avoided. The system has the communication self-healing capability, and can realize second-level response and local control by linking devices such as spraying, plugging, power-off and the like on the basis of multi-node response. And by combining the cloud three-dimensional mine map and the fire simulation platform, an underground collaborative fire prevention and extinguishing system is constructed, and the early warning response capability and the emergency treatment efficiency of coal mine fires are obviously improved.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD;UNIV ANHUI JIANZHU

title_en: Integrated landslide susceptibility assessment method based on XGB (XGB) reinforcement model
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated landslide susceptibility assessment method based on an XGB reinforcement model, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction, and comprises the steps of preprocessing collected evaluation factor data of a landslide disaster research area to obtain grid points, extracting an original data table of all evaluation factors corresponding to the landslide points by generating non-landslide points, constructing an evaluation data set by calculating information values of the evaluation factors, dividing the evaluation data set into a training set and a verification set, constructing a CatBoost-XGB integrated model, training by using the training set, verifying by using the verification set to obtain an optimal integrated model, importing all grid point data in the area into the integrated model for landslide disaster susceptibility analysis, and outputting a landslide disaster susceptibility prediction graph.

title_en: Three-dimensional visual emergency management system for mining area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mining area emergency management, and discloses a three-dimensional visual emergency management system for a mining area, which comprises a data acquisition module and a three-dimensional sand table generation module. The three-dimensional sand table generation module processes the data through a three-dimensional visualization engine, wherein a data preprocessing unit completes space coordinate system unification, missing data complementation and outlier correction, and a scene rendering unit generates a three-dimensional dynamic sand table through texture mapping, space feature fusion, space coupling modeling and three-dimensional scene synthesis. The system has the functional modules of offline data loading, disaster diffusion simulation, escape route planning and the like, and supports cross-platform rendering and user interaction operation. According to the invention, three-dimensional dynamic display and emergency analysis of multi-source data of a mining area are realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision are improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ANBANG SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: The coal seam directional long drilling and along-production segmented hole sealing device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a device and a method for sectionally sealing a directional long drilling hole of a coal seam along with mining, wherein the device comprises a main extraction pipe, an air charging pipeline, a hole sealing air bag, a hard screen, a polyurethane sealing block and an air charging bottle, wherein the main extraction pipe comprises a plurality of gas extraction pipes which are connected with each other, the main extraction pipe is arranged in the directional long drilling hole, the hole sealing air bag is vertically arranged in the main extraction pipe, the hole sealing air bag is communicated with an air charging port of the air charging pipeline through a spiral air tap, an air inlet of the air charging pipeline is connected with the air charging bottle, the polyurethane sealing block is arranged between the outer side of the pipe wall of the main extraction pipe and the inner wall of the hole of the directional long drilling hole, the polyurethane sealing block is arranged at a certain distance (usually 8 m) from the main extraction pipe port, a connecting channel is arranged on the polyurethane sealing block, the air charging pipeline is arranged in the connecting channel, the hard screen is arranged at the front side of the hole sealing air bag, and the hole sealing air bag is bonded with the hard screen. The application eliminates the gas extraction blank area of the coal seam, reduces the possibility of gas disasters and improves the gas extraction rate.
assignees: Huainan mining industry group co ltd;UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Drilling water level measurement system and method for hydrogeological survey
abstract_en: The invention relates to a drilling water level measurement system and a drilling water level measurement method for hydrogeological investigation, which relate to the technical field of hydrogeological investigation. By establishing a dynamic environment compensation model, namely a salinity-density dynamic model, combining with real-time correction of the inclination angle of an ultrasonic propagation path and high-frequency monitoring and dynamic compensation of environmental parameters such as atmospheric pressure, temperature, humidity and the like, the water level measurement precision of +/-0.01 m under the whole environment is realized. Through multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis, three measurement data of a pressure method, an ultrasonic method and a rope measuring method are fused, weights are dynamically distributed according to standard deviations of the measurement methods, and fusion water level is calculated, so that + -0.01 m-level measurement accuracy is realized, and the accuracy of measurement results is greatly improved. Meanwhile, the dynamic response speed is increased, and in a karst area water inrush early warning scene, the alarm can be triggered by calculating the second derivative of water level data, so that the early warning capability of geological disasters is effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA COALFIELD HUASHENG HYDROGEOLOGICAL INVESTIG CO LTD

title_en: Simplified modeling and optimizing design method for modularized building transverse connection node
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of modularized buildings, and particularly relates to a simplified modeling and optimal design method for modularized building transverse connection nodes. The method comprises the steps of 1, obtaining parameters of a test piece, modeling by using a layered shell unit, obtaining key calculation data, and constructing constitutive relation of a double-node unit, 2, building an elastoplastic finite element model of a high-level modularized shear wall structure, 3, carrying out elastoplastic analysis on the model, recording structural response and calculating damage parameters, and 4, judging whether to adjust design parameters of a component according to limit values of the damage parameters. According to the invention, a double-node unit structure of bending/shearing behaviors is constructed through layered shell simulation data, a damage evaluation model under a multi-level earthquake is established, the reinforcement ratio and the post-cast section width are optimized based on the damage overrun degree, a closed loop of building a structure, analyzing the structure, evaluating the damage and optimizing parameters is formed, and a design platform with adjustable disaster resistance is provided for a high-rise modularized building.
assignees: UNIV QINGDAO TECHNOLOGY;LINGZHEN QINGDAO VIBRATION CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Finite element analysis-based equivalent loading method and system for galloping load of icing wire
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equivalent loading method and system for galloping load of an icing wire based on finite element analysis, which are characterized in that a wire model is built based on actual line parameters, and a wire is built and initial tension is applied based on engineering simulation software; and obtaining three-component pneumatic parameters through a full wind attack angle wind tunnel test, constructing a pneumatic load mathematical model, calculating the load on the lead, and loading the calculated load on the nodes in the lead with concentrated load. According to the invention, dynamic aerodynamic force is equivalent to node concentrated force loading through a quasi-static load conversion strategy, and high-efficiency and accurate galloping simulation is realized by combining nonlinear shape finding of the lead and wind tunnel test data. The method solves the problems of low dynamic fluid-solid coupling iteration efficiency and high model complexity, and provides an efficient and reliable technical means for anti-galloping design and disaster prevention evaluation of the power transmission line.

title_en: Biological safety event emergency coping virtual simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public health safety and discloses a virtual simulation training system for emergency response of a biosafety event, which comprises a virtual environment construction module, an actual operation training management module, an intelligent evaluation feedback module, a case teaching engine module, a self-adaptive optimization module and an evaluation report generation module, wherein a light source self-calibration module is arranged for configuring differential material optical response models for different protective equipment to ensure the authenticity standard of visual presentation of various protective equipment, and meanwhile, the accuracy of aerosol leakage risk evaluation is ensured by comparing the wavelength of a virtual light source with a preset spectrum reference value in real time, the misjudgment risk of emergency training is further reduced, and whether an observation view angle deviates from a biosafety observation standard axis is judged in real time by calculating the spatial position deviation of a virtual view point and a pollution core area of a user, so that the system can effectively avoid the condition of missing critical pollution path identification.

title_en: Building evacuation simulation method considering influence of path multi-space parameters on evacuation behavior
abstract_en: A building evacuation simulation method considering influence of path multi-space parameters on evacuation behaviors belongs to the technical field of personnel evacuation simulation. The method comprises the steps of determining a typical plane, analyzing typical plane traffic space composition, analyzing typical plane traffic space parameters, constructing a building model, establishing a moving mode and an interactive system of a virtual reality platform, selecting experimental design of evacuation paths, constructing an evacuation path selection model, developing an evacuation simulation flow and improving the evacuation model flow. The method integrates the influence of the evacuation path multi-space parameters on the evacuation path selection into a building evacuation model, and builds an improved evacuation model, so that the evacuation simulation result is more in line with the actual situation. Based on the evacuation simulation result evaluation of the method, a framework is provided for the design of the safe evacuation of the knowledge-intensive building, and the evacuation time can be shortened by 31.71% at most by optimizing the building traffic space plane based on the method.

title_en: Intelligent design method and system for water supply, drainage and fire control in rail transit section
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail traffic engineering and discloses a method and a system for intelligently designing water supply and drainage and fire protection in a rail traffic zone, wherein S1, candidate points are preset, namely, a plurality of candidate mounting points of fire protection and drainage equipment are preset in the rail traffic zone according to zone geometric parameters, evacuation flow lines and specification requirements, and candidate point set data are formed; the method comprises the steps of S2, fire working condition simulation, S3, hydraulic calculation and environment checking, S4, optimization iteration, S5, multi-objective optimization and S6, digital twin verification, wherein a plurality of fire working conditions are generated based on a random algorithm, and fire scene simulation is conducted aiming at the working conditions. A digital twin model is established based on BIM and GIS, pareto solution set is mapped into a three-dimensional scene, dynamic simulation and reasoning check are carried out by combining CFD and hydraulic data, and real-time monitoring data of a sensor can be fused, so that the equipment arrangement scheme can meet the standard constraint, and feasibility and safety of the equipment arrangement scheme can be continuously checked in the running process.

title_en: Mining drilling machine matched while-drilling monitoring system and abnormal power phenomenon judging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining drilling machine matched while-drilling monitoring system and an abnormal power phenomenon judging method in the technical field of underground coal mine safety monitoring and early warning, wherein the while-drilling monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a rapid adaptation module, a data transmission module and a data analysis and display module, the data acquisition module and the rapid adaptation module are integrated on while-drilling monitoring equipment, the rapid adaptation module is used for butt-jointing the power output end of the drilling machine and the drill rod through the shaft coupling, the data acquisition module comprises a three-in-one sensor, a displacement sensor and a coal powder amount electronic scale, and the data acquisition module transmits acquired monitoring data to the data analysis and display module through the data transmission module. According to the invention, through monitoring and analysis of multiple data, various abnormal dynamic phenomena in the drilling process are reflected in time at multiple angles, data support is provided for timely analyzing drilling response, accurately early warning rock burst and other dynamic disasters, and the coal mine safety monitoring level is improved.

title_en: Underground power distribution room flooding simulation and rush repair training method and system based on Internet of things data acquisition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water immersion simulation of a power distribution room, and discloses a water immersion simulation and rush repair training method and system of an underground power distribution room based on data acquisition of the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of simulating a water level evolution matrix of the underground power distribution room in a water immersion scene by adopting a shallow water diffusion wave model; the virtual reality training platform integrates the power distribution room environment, the water level evolution matrix and the fault probability of the power distribution equipment, and an underground power distribution room rush repair training scene is generated. According to the invention, a shallow water diffusion wave model integrating the terrain gradient, the drainage capacity and the rainfall trend is constructed, the propagation evolution of the water level in the space-time dimension is simulated, the probability of each power distribution equipment failure is further estimated, the failure probability, the water level evolution result, the power distribution room environment and the virtual reality environment are integrated, the immersive training of the rush-repair task is realized, and the emergency response capacity and the maintenance efficiency of the rush-repair personnel to the flood situation are remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUHAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY

title_en: TBM cutter torque prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TBM cutter torque prediction method and a TBM cutter torque prediction device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a first tunneling parameter related to TBM cutter torque, measuring the linear and nonlinear correlation degree between the first tunneling parameter and the cutter torque, screening a second tunneling parameter, preprocessing the second tunneling parameter, sequentially constructing a data set comprising a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a time sequence, constructing a fusion network model based on a space-time attention mechanism, a time convolution network and a bidirectional long-short-time memory network, training the fusion network model by using the training set, adjusting model super-parameters based on the verification set, checking the generalization performance of the model on the test set, obtaining a trained fusion model, and predicting the TBM cutter torque by using the fusion model. The method of the invention screens out tunneling parameters by combining experience knowledge and correlation analysis, designs a novel network which integrates multi-scale time convolution and bidirectional long-short-time memory network under space-time attention for torque accurate prediction, can provide early warning for TBM card machine disasters and guidance for tunneling parameter optimization, and has important engineering application value.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on a remote sensing technology, comprising the following steps: the multi-source remote sensing data is acquired and processed to generate a multi-dimensional data set, and then the multi-dimensional data set is generated through weighted average fusion. And then, the earth surface temperature data is extracted and compared with the historical value, a temperature deviation value is calculated to generate temperature abnormal distribution data, and the disaster intensity index is calculated by combining the change trend of the soil humidity and the vegetation index data to generate disaster intensity distribution data. These data weather are imported into a drive simulation system to simulate the evolution of the disaster and predict the impact range and duration of the disaster. If the predicted data exceeds the early warning threshold value, generating early warning data comprising disaster category, influence area and predicted time, and generating disaster risk distribution data by using a spatial interpolation method for dynamic monitoring. The disaster monitoring and early warning method improves accuracy and timeliness of disaster monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Power grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid topology toughness enhancement method based on pre-disaster prediction of a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a grid graph structure taking grid equipment as nodes, predicting node damage probability through the graph attention network, defining a high-risk node set, constructing a mixed integer programming model according to the high-risk nodes and propagation paths thereof, solving to generate an optimal grid structure adjustment strategy before disaster, generating a resource scheduling scheme by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning algorithm in combination with the strategy, calculating a grid toughness core index after simulation operation, optimizing the structure adjustment strategy if the index is lower than a preset threshold value, and uploading the optimized strategy and scheduling scheme to a scheduling platform to finish pre-disaster active defense deployment. The invention realizes the cooperative linkage of pre-disaster risk prediction and topology reconstruction and resource deployment, automatically generates a differential pre-disaster defense scheme, converts post-emergency repair into pre-disaster prevention and distribution, and remarkably improves the pre-disaster prevention and control response efficiency.

title_en: Complex domain SAR image super-resolution reconstruction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex domain SAR image super-resolution reconstruction method and a system. The method comprises the following steps of S1 preprocessing complex domain data, S2 constructing a data set and amplifying the data, S3 constructing a deep learning model, dividing a training area and a verification area, training the model, S4 evaluating precision by using high-resolution original image data, and S5 obtaining a high-resolution SAR product according to the deep learning model of an optimal training scale. According to the scheme, under the condition that the processing capacity of hardware is improved, the result which is superior to the result reconstructed only by means of the amplitude graph superminute is obtained, more ground object details can be recovered, and the application value of the existing image data in the natural disaster field and the identification capacity of military targets are improved.
assignees: ZHONGKE SATELLITE ANHUI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Roof bolter for mining
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mining machinery equipment, and discloses an anchor rod drilling machine for mining, which comprises a chassis, wherein a platform is fixedly arranged at the top of the chassis, a control console is fixedly arranged at the top of the platform, a heat dissipation groove is formed in the side face of the control console, a rectangular shell is fixedly arranged on the side face of the control console, a rectangular groove is formed in the side face of the rectangular shell, and a threaded rod is movably arranged in the rectangular groove. The utility model can ensure that heat can be smoothly emitted by cleaning dust and dirt on the surface of the heat radiating groove, thereby improving the heat radiating efficiency, avoiding heat transfer from being blocked, leading to the increase of the internal temperature of the drilling machine, simultaneously effectively preventing the overheat problem, protecting the safe operation of the drilling machine, avoiding damaging the internal electronic elements and even causing fire disaster due to overhigh temperature, prolonging the service life of equipment and reducing the maintenance and replacement cost.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program for automating disaster and failure preparedness simulation for system
title_ko: 시스템에 대한 재해 및 장애 대비 모의 훈련을 자동화하는 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시스템에 대한 재해 및 장애 대비 모의 훈련을 자동화하는 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 시스템 장애 대비 모의 훈련 방법은, 수집된 정보를 분석하여 적어도 하나의 후보 시나리오를 생성하는 단계; 사용자 단말의 요구 사항을 기초로 상기 후보 시나리오를 평가하는 단계; 상기 평가 결과 선정된 최종 시나리오를 상기 사용자 단말에 전달하는 단계; 상기 최종 시나리오 수행을 위한 스크립트를 조회하는 단계; 및 상기 스크립트로 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 단계;를 포함하는 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: Portable electric water hose winding machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable electric water hose winding machine which comprises a bottom plate, a winding mechanism, a water hose limiting mechanism and a control mechanism. The winding mechanism comprises a chassis, a winding motor and a winding component, the chassis is arranged on a bottom plate, the winding motor is arranged in the chassis, the winding component comprises winding disks and winding rods, the winding disks are connected with output shafts of the winding motor, the winding rods are arranged on two sides of the winding disks and are vertically arranged on the sides of the winding disks, the water band limiting mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate and located on the front side of the winding mechanism, the water band limiting mechanism comprises an upper limiting rod, the upper limiting rod is used for limiting a water band to pass through between the bottom plate and the upper limiting rod, and the control mechanism comprises an intelligent digital circuit board processor, a voice recognition module and an infrared sensor. Therefore, the intelligent degree is high, the automatic winding can be performed by starting and stopping through voice, the automatic winding can be stopped after the winding is completed, the problem that the manual winding is time-consuming and labor-consuming after the training and rescue of firefighters is solved, and the working efficiency of firefighters is greatly improved.

title_en: Tunnel heat damage type identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in tunnel engineering, and provides a tunnel heat damage type identification method, which is characterized in that in order to improve the accuracy of heat damage identification, surface water heat abnormality is regulated and drawn and drilling water chemical characteristics are newly added in a survey design stage, heat convergence characteristics and potential heat damage sections are identified based on newly added data and traditional data, and for the potential heat damage sections, drilling rock temperature monitoring, drilling water chemical characteristic monitoring and drilling gas composition and concentration monitoring are newly added in addition to traditional comprehensive advanced geological forecast so as to identify heat convergence characteristics, a crack rock heat conduction theory is applied to identify potential disaster causing structures and positions thereof based on data acquired in a survey design stage and a construction stage, and heat damage types are determined according to the heat convergence characteristics corresponding to the positions of the disaster causing structures. The heat damage identification accuracy is improved through multi-means collaborative detection and multi-source data fusion.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Landslide hazard detection method based on improved remote sensing landslide image segmentation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide hazard detection method based on an improved remote sensing landslide image segmentation model, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a multi-feature input data set based on gradient tensor data, S2, preprocessing the multi-feature input data set and generating an enhanced feature data set through a feature enhancement technology, S3, constructing a landslide detection model, S4, combining a training data set, cross entropy loss and an Adam optimizer to optimize the landslide detection model to generate an optimized landslide detection model, S5, correcting the optimized landslide detection model based on a segmentation evaluation result to generate a final landslide detection model, and S6, generating a current landslide disaster detection result based on the final landslide detection model and acquired landslide image real-time data. The invention can fully excavate the implicit characteristic information of the remote sensing image data, effectively improve the semantic segmentation precision of the traditional model and improve the landslide extraction precision and accuracy.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;CHINA ANNENG GROUP THIRD ENG BUREAU CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management intelligent detection alarm system and method based on multi-mode information
abstract_en: The system acquires and fuses multi-source information such as earthquake waves, building structures, urban pipe networks and the like through a multi-mode earthquake information acquisition and fusion module, calculates dynamic response through a dynamic analysis module based on an improved Newmark-beta algorithm, and then combines a finite element simulation model construction module with urban parameters to construct a high-precision model. And finally, triggering corresponding alarm and multi-channel information sending by the intelligent detection alarm module according to the grading result. The method comprises the steps of information acquisition, dynamics analysis, model construction, disaster prediction, risk assessment grading, alarming and the like, and the intelligent detection and accurate alarming of the urban earthquake disaster are realized, so that the emergency management efficiency and reliability are improved.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster hydraulic fracturing optimization method based on global model segmentation
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster hydraulic fracturing optimization method based on global model segmentation, which comprises the steps of global model and stress result generation, sub-model cutting and stress inheritance, drilling parameterization information modification, fracture randomness simulation, loading injection pressure and fracturing fluid material parameters, high-precision structural grid division, stress cloud image and data extraction generated by an operation model, digital twin body construction, AI proxy model training and optimization decision, optimized drilling parameter generation, parameter feedback and iterative optimization. According to the hydraulic fracturing control method, the crack expansion process is simulated, the injection pressure and the fracturing fluid parameters are intelligently optimized, the hydraulic fracturing process is accurately controlled, the hydraulic fracturing rock burst prevention and control capacity is improved through intelligent and dynamic optimization, the rock burst risk is effectively reduced, and the prevention and control effect and the resource exploitation safety are improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, in particular to an intelligent fire monitoring and early warning method. The diffusion effect of the heat source is simulated by introducing the Gaussian distribution model, the suitability of smoke flow to the air flow in the building is enhanced, the limitation of the traditional smoke diffusion model is optimized according to the local turbulence correction driven by differential pressure, and particularly the non-uniform air flow effect in the narrow corridor, the courtyard and other areas is realized, so that the accurate monitoring and early warning of the fire disaster are realized. The expected speed and the comfortable distance of people are dynamically adjusted by combining optical flow sensing with environment sensing (such as smoke concentration and temperature), so that the problem of optimizing the flow and evacuation paths of people in a high-density scene can be effectively solved. Particularly in a narrow space, the interaction between people and obstacles can be fed back in real time, and secondary accidents caused by crowded or high-temperature smoke influence are prevented.
assignees: ANHUI NEWT FIRE EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Loess slope top power transmission tower instability prediction method based on landform effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a loess slope top power transmission tower instability prediction method based on a landform effect, which belongs to the technical field of power transmission tower stability prediction and comprises the following steps of obtaining the landform and landform parameter data of loess slopes around a power transmission tower foundation and carrying out correction pretreatment on the parameter data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a geometric model of a loess slope by discrete element software, including a three-dimensional structure model of the earth surface, a loess layer and a tower foundation, introducing a fluid-solid coupling algorithm, carrying out finite element numerical analysis on the geometric model, simulating the deformation and damage process of the loess slope and the interaction relation of stress of a power transmission tower foundation by dynamic simulation and time coupling, calculating stress field distribution of the power transmission tower foundation by finite element numerical analysis, and carrying out verification optimization on the model by combining field monitoring data. The method overcomes the limitation of the prior art in the aspect of instability prediction of the loess slope power transmission tower, realizes the accuracy, the instantaneity and the comprehensiveness of prediction, and reduces the disaster loss.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Ruin training device with underground buried pipeline and various collapse scenes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruin training device with underground buried pipelines and various collapse scenes, and relates to the field of ruin training devices. The ruin training device is constructed into a double-layer building structure and comprises a first layer, a second layer and a roof layer, wherein the two sides of the ruin training device are respectively provided with a buried collapse structure, the trunk structure of the second layer is a teaching corridor, and one side of the teaching corridor is provided with a T-shaped collapse structure and an inclined collapse structure. According to the invention, through the T-shaped collapse structure, the inclined collapse structure, the A-shaped collapse structure, the V-shaped collapse structure, the laminated collapse structure and the buried collapse structure, complex scenes such as floor fracture, wall inclination, laminated collapse and the like which are common in an earthquake are covered, the diversity of real disaster scenes is simulated, the details of cutting windows, inclined dark rooms and the like are combined, the practical combat training conditions such as visual obstruction, narrow space passing and the like are provided, and the adaptability of rescue workers to diversified ruin environments is remarkably improved.

title_en: Tunnel gas disaster prediction method based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel gas disaster prediction method based on numerical simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly) collecting geological rock samples and coal samples at a tunnel construction section, determining mechanical parameters and seepage parameters of the rock samples and the coal samples, secondly) establishing a coal penetrating tunnel model by utilizing COMSOL software, embedding a damage-seepage coupling model into the coal tunnel model, thirdly) setting pressure boundary conditions and flow boundary conditions of gas flow in rock strata and coal beds, performing numerical simulation on a coal penetrating tunnel excavation process, outputting gas emission quantity at a tunnel face by the damage-seepage coupling model, and fourthly) comparing the gas emission quantity at the tunnel face output in the third) with a set gas early warning threshold value to judge the dangerous grade of the gas emission quantity. According to the invention, the coal-penetrating tunnel model and the damage-seepage coupling model are combined, and the gas emission quantity of the face can be accurately pre-judged by simulating the tunnel excavation process, so that the early warning of gas disasters can be realized according to the gas emission quantity.
assignees: SICHUAN YANJIANG YIJIN EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;SICHUAN ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING CHENGTOU JIANGCHANG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Disaster scene point cloud data-oriented segmentation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and point cloud segmentation, and provides a method and a system for segmenting disaster scene point cloud data, wherein in the continuous learning of a student network, the data resampling is carried out on new objects in a secondary subset, so that the network can be effectively promoted to improve the distinguishing capability of the new objects; the method comprises the steps of generating a pseudo tag by combining a teacher network prediction result with a new type original real tag, obtaining training loss based on the difference between the generated pseudo tag and a student network prediction result, synchronously layering and pooling point cloud features of a teacher network and a student network, obtaining distillation loss based on the difference between the pooled features of the teacher network and the student network, further realizing that the network does not need to construct total loss based on an old type, solving the problem that the old type is stored continuously and greatly increasing the memory of a computer, and simultaneously guiding the student network learning by utilizing the trained teacher network on a main subset, so that post-disaster objects in the new type can be rapidly identified.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE INST METROLOGY & MEASUREMENT TECH

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster drilling and blasting optimization method based on sub-model stress inheritance
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster drilling and blasting optimization method based on sub-model stress inheritance, which comprises the steps of global model and stress result generation, sub-model cutting and stress inheritance, drilling parameterization information modification, TNT explosive parameter modeling, JWL state equation loading, high-precision structural grid division, operation model generation stress cloud image and data extraction, digital twin body construction, AI proxy model training and optimization decision, optimized drilling parameter generation, parameter feedback and iterative optimization. According to the invention, by constructing a digital twin body coupled with a global-local model, extracting the blasting stress response, establishing an AI proxy model by combining a deep neural network, carrying out dynamic decision and closed-loop optimization on key factors such as blasting drilling arrangement, explosive parameters and the like, a dynamic and accurate blasting pressure relief prevention and control scheme is provided, the blasting pressure relief effect and rock burst prevention and control capability are effectively improved, and a safe, efficient and intelligent technical support is provided for rock burst disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Quality control method and device for disaster recovery switching, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality control method and a device for disaster recovery switching, electronic equipment and a storage medium thereof, and relates to the disaster recovery management field or other related technical fields, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a disaster recovery switching task and determining a disaster recovery switching scene based on the disaster recovery switching task; and executing disaster recovery switching tasks based on the scene templates and the application switching flows, wherein in the process of executing the disaster recovery switching tasks, the disaster recovery switching tasks are subjected to abnormality detection based on a disaster recovery switching quality control mechanism, and an abnormality response strategy is output, and the abnormality response strategy is used for processing the abnormal situation of the disaster recovery switching tasks. The method solves the technical problem that in the related art, the disaster recovery backup switching is tested in advance by executing disaster recovery backup exercise, but the prediction mode is difficult to ensure the disaster recovery backup switching quality in an actual disaster recovery backup switching scene.

title_en: Greenhouse environment optimization control method and device integrating deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a greenhouse environment optimization control method and device integrating deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of training and obtaining a crop growth state track, a control input track and a greenhouse environment state track through reinforcement learning algorithm on a slow time scale, inverting to obtain a coordination state track, adding the crop growth state track and the coordination state track to a control target of fast time scale control, obtaining an initial guess of the fast time scale control through reinforcement learning algorithm, optimizing the initial guess through optimization control algorithm, and determining a short time domain control decision sequence for finally controlling a greenhouse to be controlled. The rapid decision capability of the reinforcement learning agent is utilized, the bottleneck of optimizing and controlling dimension disaster is broken through, the control instantaneity is improved, the decision of the agent is optimized and the mechanism is interpreted through the optimizing control, and the precise and rapid control of the greenhouse environment is realized so as to ensure the maximization of economic benefit.

title_en: Mobile energy storage pre-deployment and scheduling method based on dynamic constraint
abstract_en: A mobile energy storage pre-deployment and scheduling method based on dynamic constraint comprises the steps of 1) obtaining road condition data of an easy-disaster area to be deployed, 2) conducting mobile energy storage system simulation pre-deployment on each node of the easy-disaster area, 3) establishing a mobile energy storage system routing and scheduling model, 4) establishing power system operation constraint and power system dynamic constraint, 5) introducing conditional risk value measurement, establishing a two-stage random planning model considering risks, 6) solving the two-stage random planning model based on a Benders decomposition algorithm to obtain an optimal pre-deployment position and a post-disaster scheduling strategy of the mobile energy storage system, 7) deploying the mobile energy storage system based on the optimal pre-deployment position, and when disaster occurs, adjusting the mobile energy storage system by utilizing the post-disaster scheduling strategy. The invention ensures the safety and stability of the system operation, and ensures that the optimization result is more close to the actual application requirement. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional gradual optimization method and realizes the comprehensive optimization of the whole disaster influence process.

title_en: Live Fire Training System and Method Including a Modular Live Fire Burn Room for Training Firefighters
abstract_en: A modular fire training system. The modular fire training system may include an outer structure; an inner structure, the inner structure may be configured to be positionable within the outer structure; one or more openings formed in either or both of the outer structure and/or the inner structure; a burn crib configured to be positionable within the inner structure; and an insulation layer disposed about an exterior of the inner structure.

title_en: FAO system vehicle simulation fault test method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a FAO system vehicle simulation fault test method and system, and relates to the technical field of rail transit. According to the invention, a vehicle simulation model is used for simulating a fire disaster, physical data, passenger behavior data and sound data are fused, validity detection is performed through a gradient lifting tree, decision is ensured to be based on trusted data, YOLOv models are improved, corresponding reasoning speed is improved, the requirement of quickly extracting tracks is met, and the track continuity is improved under shielding and similar appearance scenes by combining Kalman filtering and cosine distance.

title_en: Discrete element simulation-based ion type rare earth mining area landslide early warning method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses an ion type rare earth mining area landslide early warning method, device, equipment, medium and product based on discrete element simulation, and relates to the landslide early warning field; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mining area three-dimensional geological model and a particle discrete element model, correcting the particle discrete element model and simulating a displacement field evolution graph, a stress distribution evolution graph and a sliding surface evolution trend of a mine after disaster, obtaining multi-dimensional features, constructing a machine learning model, inputting the multi-dimensional features into a random forest model to obtain key trigger factors, training a long-period memory network and predicting future mine displacement and landslide probability, combining the future mine displacement, the landslide probability and the key trigger factors to obtain combined features, judging whether the combined features exceed an early warning value, and if so, restarting the particle discrete element model. The application can improve the prediction precision and the prediction efficiency.
assignees: GANZHOU NONFERROUS METALLURGICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV JIANGXI SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Earthquake disaster area prediction method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for predicting the area of an earthquake disaster area, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical earthquake data in a preset time interval and obtaining target earthquake data based on the historical earthquake data, determining earthquake influence range factors, obtaining influence factor data in the target earthquake data based on the earthquake influence range factors, preprocessing the influence factor data and the earthquake intensity data, generating sample data based on the preprocessed influence factor data and the earthquake intensity data, constructing an initial model based on a deep learning algorithm-FCN (fuzzy C-means network) multi-layer fully connected neural network, training the initial model based on the sample data to obtain an earthquake disaster area prediction model, inputting the earthquake data to be predicted into the earthquake disaster area prediction model to obtain the area of each intensity area, and predicting the area of the earthquake intensity area by combining a plurality of influence factors, so that the prediction precision is improved, meanwhile, more influence factors can be expanded on the prediction model, and the iterative evolution of the prediction model is rapidly realized.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk loss quantitative evaluation method and device considering cascading effect
abstract_en: The application discloses a quantitative assessment method and a quantitative assessment device for the risk loss of a mountain torrent disaster in consideration of a cascading effect, and relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, wherein the method simulates flood evolution by constructing a hydrodynamic model comprising a reference and various coupling working conditions, outputs simulation results, calculates risk indexes under the working conditions, and accurately quantifies cascading risk amplification coefficients by comparing the index values of the reference and the coupling working conditions; and finally, by embedding the amplification coefficient into a loss evaluation model, the loss of the key risk interval is accurately calculated, so that the accurate quantification and scientific evaluation of the whole cascade effect from a physical mechanism to economic loss are realized.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Port wave spectrum parameterized modeling algorithm based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a harbour wave spectrum parameterized modeling algorithm based on machine learning, which relates to the technical field of ocean engineering and realizes high-precision modeling through three steps, wherein a federal learning framework is constructed in the first step, training sub-models of all data parties only share parameters, homomorphic encryption fusion characteristics are combined, weights are dynamically adjusted, privacy protection type data fusion is realized, a generated countermeasure network is deployed in each local node, multiscale wave characteristics are extracted through a frequency domain hierarchical attention branch network, sea wave energy conservation constraint is implanted, a generator is optimized, extreme samples conforming to physical laws are generated, a mixed training data set is formed, and a CNN-LSTM basic model is trained in the third step, and dynamic model optimization is realized through sliding windows, forgetting factors, bayesian optimization and performance monitoring reconstruction. The method effectively improves the prediction precision and long-term stability of the wave spectrum, reduces the maintenance cost, and can be used for the scenes of berthing, disaster prevention and early warning of port ships and the like.

title_en: Extraction roadway stability enhancing method based on complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing stability of a stope roadway based on a complex environment, which belongs to the technical field of coal mining and comprises the following steps of S1, testing physical and mechanical properties of rock and coal samples, S2, testing ground stress, accurately measuring the ground stress value of the coal mine, providing design basis for post roadway support forms and other disaster management, S3, analyzing the bearing structure and stability of surrounding rocks of a roadway along the sky, revealing the bearing structure and deformation mechanism of the surrounding rocks of the roadway, S4, reasonably setting dimensional value simulation of coal pillars, S5, regulating and controlling stress environment, S6, dynamically regulating and monitoring, S7, and testing site industrialization.
assignees: XICHUAN COAL MINE BRANCH HUANENG TONGCHUAN ZHAOJIN COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD

title_en: Stay wire space safety early warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data
abstract_en: The invention provides a stay wire space safety pre-warning method based on three-dimensional topographic data, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line construction safety. The method comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud, combining a BIM model to complete three-dimensional coordinate fusion, constructing a multi-body dynamics and finite element model, calculating tension and safety coefficients, extracting minimum distance between a stay wire and an obstacle by adopting a hierarchical bounding box method, collecting tension and gesture by using a key position layout sensor, fusing simulation and actual measurement data, estimating a structural state by Kalman filtering, evaluating a safety level, giving early warning and adjustment advice, displaying a stress vector and a risk thermodynamic diagram on a three-dimensional platform, establishing a real-time monitoring mechanism, an abnormal automatic pushing scheme, and constructing a fault tree and a Bayesian network to identify disaster factors and fault paths. The invention realizes the integrated assessment of the wire pulling space and the stress safety, improves the detection precision and the intelligent early warning capability, and is suitable for multiple scenes of iron tower construction and operation and maintenance.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;YANCHENG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Global landslide remote sensing rapid identification model modeling method based on improved DeepLab-V < 3+ > and application
abstract_en: The invention relates to a global landslide remote sensing rapid identification model modeling method based on improvement DeepLab-V < 3+ > and application thereof, which are used for conducting general investigation on global landslide disaster points, compiling landslide catalogues, investigating the spatial distribution characteristics of landslide and providing basic information for global disaster area reconstruction and recovery, landslide risk assessment and landslide early warning and forecasting. The method comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a target area data acquisition point to acquire data characteristics, S2, making a landslide remote sensing image dataset, S3, based on DeepLab-V3+, improving ASPP and fusion CBAM, establishing an applicable landslide identification algorithm, S4, training, verifying and testing by using the dataset pair to obtain a global landslide rapid detection model, S5, inputting global influence, and making a detected landslide result into a global landslide distribution map. A total of 10016 landslide areas were detected, and 2304 landslide areas were detected in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau. The result shows that the invention can initially detect landslide in the global range, and has popularization and application prospects and possibility.

title_en: Marine disaster-bearing body data refined monitoring method, system, medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, a medium and a program product for finely monitoring marine disaster-bearing body data, which relate to the technical field of disaster-bearing body data monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring remote sensing images and point cloud data, carrying out data registration and correction by combining geographic positioning information and monitoring supplementary data, and generating a unified reference geographic map; the method comprises the steps of constructing a marine wind power facility part level model and a marine pasture field primitive model, dynamically updating disaster bearing body attributes and space positions in the marine wind power facility part level model and the marine pasture field primitive model by combining a time sequence database based on real-time monitoring data, calculating storm surge and sea wave parameters of a target monitoring area, dividing disaster risk grades by combining historical disaster data to obtain a marine disaster assessment result, and carrying out disaster dynamic visual display and extreme weather scene simulation deduction by combining a visual platform.
assignees: GUANGDONG INST OF LAND AND RESOURCES SURVEYING AND MAPPING;GUANGDONG PROVINCE SURVEYING AND MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge intensity influence area automatic identification method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a storm surge intensity influence area automatic identification method, a storm surge intensity influence area automatic identification system and a storm surge intensity influence area automatic identification medium, which relate to the technical field of disaster emergency response and comprise the steps of collecting storm surge associated influence data, carrying out intensity influence analysis and constructing a storm surge intensity influence factor set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out classification training fusion on historical storm tide event samples to generate a storm tide intensity influence grade discriminator, carrying out twin fusion to obtain a storm tide intensity prediction intelligent body, carrying out water level prediction simulation to generate a multidimensional storm tide intensity field, carrying out cluster analysis and geographic matching recognition, outputting an intensity influence region spatial distribution diagram, and carrying out storm tide early warning and forecasting.
