The method solves the technical problems that the identification of storm surge intensity influence areas in the prior art often depends on a simple numerical simulation model, or only uses a single storm surge influence factor, cannot flexibly adapt to complex ocean environment changes, and the reliability and accuracy of the identification result are insufficient.
assignees: GUANGDONG LANKUN MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network toughness assessment method based on dynamic disturbance assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network toughness assessment method based on dynamic disturbance assessment, which relates to the technical field of power systems and automation and comprises the following steps: and constructing a disturbance model to simulate a response process of the power distribution network when encountering extreme disasters or faults, wherein the disturbance model comprises various disturbance scenes such as natural disasters, power equipment faults and network attacks. According to the method, the accuracy of the toughness evaluation of the power distribution network is improved by introducing the distributed power supply evaluation method based on the dynamic response model, the response characteristics of the photovoltaic power generation and energy storage equipment in an extreme environment can be simulated in real time, and the evaluation result is ensured to be more accurate. By the aid of a flexible resource scheduling and recovery strategy optimization technology, a post-disaster recovery process is optimized based on a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm, key loads are scheduled preferentially, recovery time is shortened, recovery efficiency of a power grid is improved, and emergency response capability and recovery capability of the power distribution network in the face of extreme disasters are enhanced.

title_en: Calculation method of water intake entrainment risk time-space spectrum of coastal nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a calculation method of a water intake entrainment risk space-time spectrum of a coastal nuclear power plant, which comprises the steps of establishing a large-scale sea area two-dimensional hydrodynamic force mathematical model, verifying the hydrodynamic force model, carrying out two-dimensional hydrodynamic force flow reverse processing, identifying entrainment influence areas, arranging source points for continuously throwing particles in the influence areas, simulating particle transport tracks along with moisture in a forward flow field, determining release time periods and release points of all particles entering a water intake facility, calculating the water intake entrainment risk probability space-time spectrum, and rapidly determining entrainment process curves according to open sea monitoring data. The method takes the maximum envelope line of the particle track in the prediction period as the maximum influence area of entrainment, lays particle sources in the area, simulates the particle track of each source point, constructs entrainment risk time-space spectrums corresponding to the putting point, the putting period and the entrainment period one by one according to time intervals, and can predict the influence process of any foreign sea potentially disaster-causing substance on water taking in real time by searching the spectrums, thereby providing basis for water taking safety protection and operation and maintenance of a coastal nuclear power plant.

title_en: Land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of land degradation restoration, and discloses a land degradation area vegetation restoration planning method based on AI image recognition, which integrates multi-source data such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle, weather station, soil sensor and the like, generates a composite environment grid with unified space-time reference through a space-time diagram convolution network, extracts drought and heavy rain precursor characteristics, and predicts disaster probability by utilizing a space-time converter model; dividing a degraded area and a non-degraded area by UNet, embedding a 3-PG vegetation growth model in UNet, constructing a vegetation type library by combining meteorological areas, outputting planting parameters, carrying out regression optimization and verification through a Gaussian process, constructing a vegetation knowledge map by integrating multi-source data and logistics data, generating a restoration scheme through a graphic neural network, constructing a digital twin body based on a Unity engine, simulating the feasibility of the vegetation growth verification scheme, and updating model parameters by combining unmanned plane data through a set Kalman filter. The method realizes the precision and dynamic optimization of repair planning through the AI technology.
assignees: YANTAI LAND RESERVE AND UTILIZATION CENTER YANTAI MINERAL RESOURCES RESERVE CENTER YANTAI GEOLOGICAL

title_en: Time-lag type rock burst risk area analysis method and system for tunnel by drilling and blasting method
abstract_en: The invention provides a time-lag type rock burst risk area analysis method and system for a tunnel by a drilling and blasting method, which relate to the technical field of tunnel risk analysis and comprise the steps of obtaining first information, wherein the first information comprises geological survey information and microseismic data information in the tunnel excavation process; the method comprises the steps of carrying out actual disaster grade analysis and microseismic activity mapping grade analysis according to geological survey information to obtain actual disaster grade and microseismic activity mapping grade, carrying out energy release rate calculation processing based on all the actual disaster grade and microseismic activity mapping grade, identifying and obtaining a potential aging disaster risk area according to the calculated energy release rate, and evaluating the risk degree of the potential aging disaster risk area based on a preset aging disaster risk degree evaluation table to obtain an aging disaster risk analysis result of the area. The method not only improves the objectivity and accuracy of judging the risk of the aging disaster, but also can pertinently guide the arrangement of the sensors and the selection of the monitoring range.

title_en: Method and device for constructing power grid icing scene library
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid icing disaster prediction, in particular to a power grid icing situation library construction method and device, comprising the steps of obtaining predetermined icing influence factor corresponding historical data and icing intensity historical data; the method comprises the steps of taking a group of preset ice coating influence factor corresponding historical data and ice coating intensity historical data as an ice coating scene, clustering all ice coating scenes, constructing a clustering cluster into an ice coating scene Jing Ku, taking the clustering center of the clustering cluster as scene description of the ice coating scene Jing Ku, generating different ice coating scenes by adopting a Monte Carlo simulation algorithm, classifying all the ice coating scenes, and adding the classified ice coating scenes to corresponding ice coating scenes Jing Ku. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the power grid icing condition Jing Ku based on the artificial intelligence algorithm is established, the double breakthrough of the terrain quantization precision and the system dynamic property is realized, and the comprehensiveness, the accuracy and the practicability of the icing condition Jing Ku are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood network flood bank flooding simulation and disaster damage assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out hydrodynamic analysis based on hydrologic geographic data to determine a potential overtop area, simulating the evolution of a bursting mouth based on accumulated scouring energy criteria aiming at the potential overtop area to generate a bursting mouth flow process, simulating flood evolution according to the bursting mouth flow process to generate a spatial disaster intensity field, and evaluating direct and indirect economic losses by combining the disaster intensity field and social economic data to generate a comprehensive disaster loss result. The invention introduces physical criteria based on accumulated scouring energy, adopts comprehensive strength indexes, three-dimensional vulnerability curved surfaces and applies graph neural networks to simulate cascade failure, and solves the problems of missing of a breach triggering mechanism, single disaster intensity measurement and static disaster damage assessment.
assignees: TAIHU BASIN MANAGEMENT BUREAU WATER RESOURCES DEVELOPMENT RES CENTER

title_en: Flood disaster dynamic prediction method based on multi-source remote sensing data and knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster dynamic prediction method based on multi-source remote sensing data and a knowledge graph, which relates to the field of data prediction and comprises the specific steps of firstly, establishing a space-time disaster dynamic model through a physical driving text generation module, describing the evolution process of the flood disaster, and generating personalized flood disaster description by combining static characteristics and dynamic remote sensing data; the multi-mode fusion module utilizes self-adaptive mode mapping, a cross attention mechanism and a weighted fusion strategy to strengthen mutual dependence and information sharing among different modes, and finally, training is carried out through a regression model, and feature weights are dynamically adjusted through a self-adaptive feature weighting mechanism and an incremental learning mechanism, and finally, flood disaster predicted values are obtained through a prediction set.

title_en: Underground engineering depth burial division method and system based on tunnel excavation effect
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for dividing underground engineering deep and shallow burial based on tunnel excavation effect, and belongs to the technical field of computer aided design. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial ground stress field of a tunnel area, sampling the tunnel area, carrying out a conventional triaxial test to obtain a full stress-strain curve of surrounding rock, obtaining ground stress information of a given engineering section according to the initial ground stress field of the tunnel area to establish a three-dimensional numerical model of a tunnel, carrying out numerical simulation by adopting a constitutive model considering strain softening to obtain a stress field after tunnel excavation, and carrying out deep and shallow burial division based on the full stress-strain curve and the stress field after tunnel excavation. According to the scheme, the fact that tunnel disasters are obviously influenced by true three-dimensional stress under strong structural stress is fully considered, tunnel excavation effect is considered, deep and shallow burial division is carried out based on a true three-dimensional stress field, clear suggestions are provided for the selection of surrounding rock constitutive models in the design process, and clear guidance is provided for support design.

title_en: Flood inundation early warning method and system for electric equipment in flood storage area
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation early warning method and a flood inundation early warning system for electrical equipment in a flood storage area, which relate to the technical field of flood prevention and disaster reduction of the electrical equipment, and comprise the steps of acquiring historical meteorological data and historical gate water level data of the flood storage area, and performing data cleaning and feature screening to obtain a training data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a water level prediction network model, acquiring live meteorological data, forecast meteorological data and live gate water level data of a flood storage area in real time, inputting the water level prediction network model to generate a future gate water level prediction value, inputting the future gate water level prediction value and forecast rainfall data into a hydraulic model to generate a standardized grid file containing grid inundation water depth information, analyzing inundation water depth spatial distribution based on the standardized grid file, and generating a flood inundation early warning signal by combining electrical equipment position information. The method has high prediction precision and high running speed, and the water level prediction network model can be widely applied to other time sequence data prediction scenes.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for seasonal frozen soil side slope seepage-freeze thawing coupling simulation
abstract_en: A device and a method for simulating seasonal frozen soil side slope seepage-freeze thawing coupling belong to the technical field of side slope seepage tests or geotechnical engineering. The method has the advantages that the method fully considers the freeze-thawing characteristics of the slopes in the frozen soil area and the seasonal frozen soil area for many years and the seepage environment, is reasonable in structural design and more in line with the actual situation, can carry out deep theoretical research on the instability and damage problem of the slopes in the frozen-thawing state under the seepage condition, and provides good reference for the analysis of the reasons and prevention and treatment measures of landslide disasters in the cold area.

title_en: Dynamic landslide easy-occurrence area identification method based on hydrologic-landslide coupling model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dynamic landslide easy area identification method based on a hydrologic-landslide coupling model, which comprises the steps of constructing a hydrologic model and carrying out hydrologic process simulation based on the hydrologic model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a slope stability model based on the hydrologic process, popularizing the slope stability model to an area scale, coupling the slope stability model with the hydrologic model to obtain a hydrologic-landslide coupling model, dynamically identifying landslide easily-occurring areas based on the hydrologic-landslide coupling model and combining landslide influence factors to obtain identification results, wherein the landslide influence factors comprise but are not limited to rainfall intensity, gradient, earth surface coverage and soil type, and the accuracy of the calculation results of the model in the area can be improved to achieve the aim of simultaneously forecasting flood and landslide disasters.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Urban land block real-time population distribution simulation method for earthquake emergency treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time population distribution simulation method of urban plots facing earthquake emergency treatment, which comprises the steps of classifying urban plots in detail according to land utilization types, simulating coverage areas of all base stations, overlapping the base stations with the urban plots to generate sub plots, calculating sub plots areas, calculating simulated population numbers of all sub plots based on initial conditions that average population density weights of all types of urban plots are equal, carrying out normalization processing, calculating new average population density weights of all types of urban plots in a research range, replacing old average population density weights with the new average population density weights of all types of urban plots, repeating iterative calculation until calculation results are converged, calculating the real-time population numbers of all types of urban plots when the calculation results are converged, generating a real-time plot population distribution map of earthquake emergency treatment based on the real-time population numbers, and using the real-time plot population distribution map in earthquake emergency response.

title_en: Disaster dynamic mapping and risk early warning system and method based on deep learning and remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster dynamic mapping and risk early warning system and method based on deep learning and remote sensing technology, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition processing module is used for acquiring remote sensing monitoring data of various natural disasters, and preprocessing the remote sensing monitoring data based on a preset standardized rule to obtain a basic data set; the system comprises a feature extraction module, a spatial distribution processing module, a time sequence analysis module and a dynamic mapping early warning module, wherein the feature extraction module is used for extracting disaster intensity features and disaster range features by adopting a deep learning model based on a basic data set to obtain disaster feature sets, the spatial distribution processing module is used for obtaining spatial distribution map layers affected by disasters by adopting a spatial interpolation technology based on the disaster feature sets, the time sequence analysis module is used for obtaining a plurality of groups of spatial distribution map layers in a continuous time period to construct a time sequence analysis model to obtain a change trend of the disasters in a time dimension, and the dynamic mapping early warning module is used for simulating and early warning future short-term disaster evolution by adopting a Prophet model short-term prediction algorithm based on the change trend.

title_en: Anti-interference method for multi-band radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference method of a multi-band radar, which comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining an enhanced model in an offline state through offline dynamic countermeasure training, secondly obtaining an original echo signal in an online state to carry out self-adaptive filtering, carrying out space-time spectrum feature extraction by using the enhanced model, thirdly carrying out feature fusion and target separation according to the extracted space-time spectrum feature, fourthly carrying out optimization according to the separation result and judging whether a termination condition is achieved, if so, ending and outputting a multi-dimensional data packet, otherwise, returning to the step two. The method disclosed by the invention achieves the industry leading level on the anti-interference performance and vital sign monitoring precision through triple technical breakthroughs of hardware reconstruction, dynamic countermeasure training method and closed loop feedback, and is particularly suitable for extreme scenes such as firefighting rescue, battlefield search and rescue and the like. And the next step can focus on optimizing the light weight of the model, and further improve the deployment efficiency of the mobile platform.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Virtual training method and system for firefighter search and rescue escape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual training, in particular to a method and a system for virtual training of firefighter search and rescue escape, wherein the system comprises a virtual scene dynamic construction module, a door and a channel are abstracted into sides giving geometric distance weight according to a building plan, a room intersection and a corridor intersection are abstracted into nodes, the fire spreading or structure collapse event is responded in the virtual training, the weight of the corresponding sides is adjusted to infinity, a shortest path is obtained, and a reference rescue path set is established. According to the invention, through dynamic analysis of structural information of the building plan, intersections of rooms and hallways are abstracted into nodes, doors and channels are abstracted into sides with geometric weights, accessibility of the sides is adjusted in real time after fire spread or structural collapse occurs, non-passable conditions are introduced in calculating paths, and real-time adaptability and rescue simulation precision of the path generation process are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Geological disaster vulnerability prediction method and prediction equipment
abstract_en: A geological disaster vulnerability prediction method and prediction equipment relate to the technical field of mineral geological exploration service. In the method, the prediction equipment firstly utilizes a geographic detector model to screen out core layering factors with highest interpretation degree on the distribution of historical geological disaster points, and the factors can explain the spatial distribution rule of geological disasters to the greatest extent. Based on the core layering factors, the research area is divided into different geological environment units, and the influence degree of the dynamic geological environment factors on geological disasters is reflected through the environment complexity weight. On the basis, the negative sample sampling quota is calculated by adopting the area occupation ratio and the environment complexity weight, so that the representativeness and rationality of the negative sample on the space distribution are improved, the geological disaster susceptibility prediction model obtained by final training can consider the comprehensive influence of static and dynamic geological environment factors, and the accuracy and reliability of geological disaster prediction are improved.
assignees: DADI XINYA BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thick and hard top plate impact disaster treatment method based on blasting technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thick and hard roof impact disaster management method based on a blasting technology, which relates to the technical field of blasting pressure relief and comprises the steps of determining the position of the bottom surface of a key layer, constructing a blast hole from a low-level roadway towards the key layer if the bottom surface of the key layer is within a range of 20m above a coal seam, constructing the blast hole from a drainage roadway towards the key layer if the span of the working surface is more than 150m and within a range of 20m to 40m above the coal seam, constructing a high-level roadway along the trend of the working surface in the key layer if the span of the working surface is more than 150m and constructing the blast hole from the high-level roadway towards the key layer if the bottom surface of the key layer is more than 100m above the coal seam, and drilling the blast hole from the ground towards the key layer if the bottom surface of the working surface is more than 150 m. According to the invention, the span of the working surface and the appearance position of the thick and hard top plate are taken as starting points, different conditions of covering the thick and hard top plate on the working surface are divided, and a corresponding blasting pressure relief technology is provided, so that the blasting pressure relief effect is improved.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating formation of debris flow by using flood erosion ditch bed of widened river reach
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and engineering geology, in particular to a device and a method for testing mud-rock flow formed by a flood erosion ditch bed of a river reach with variable width. The device comprises a water storage tank, a water tank connected with an outlet of the water storage tank, a limiting module, a material box, a conveyor belt and a stacking platform connected with the lower end of the water tank, wherein the water storage tank is arranged above the water tank and connected with the water tank through a hinge, the limiting module is fixed in the water tank through a movable buckle, the material box and the conveyor belt are arranged above the water tank, and the position of the material box and the conveyor belt is adjusted through a movable bracket, so that loose solid substances can be conveniently supplied to different positions of the water tank. The method can be used for simulating the process of forming the debris flow by the flood erosion ditch bed of the river reach with the width change and the motion evolution process of the debris flow in the river reach with different widths, is beneficial to comprehensively obtaining the formation and evolution mechanism of the debris flow in the river reach with the width change, and improves the scientificity and comprehensiveness of the disaster research of the debris flow.
assignees: CT HYDROGEOLOGY & ENV GEOLOGY CGS;UNIV YANGTZE

title_en: Landslide identification method, landslide identification system, computer equipment and landslide identification medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide identification method, a landslide identification system, computer equipment and a landslide identification medium, and belongs to the technical field of disaster identification. According to the method, a two-dimensional RGB image of a known landslide and a non-landslide side slope and a corresponding three-dimensional laser scanning real-point cloud image are obtained, and a training data set and a verification data set are constructed by combining an NYU Depth V2 data set. Reconstructing a point cloud image of a verification data set by using an improved encoder-decoder convolutional neural network model, verifying the reconstruction effect, extracting three-dimensional information such as the number of cracks in a slope, the length of the cracks in the slope, the relative height difference of a slope body, the length of the longest crack, the width of the largest crack and the like, screening landslide identification indexes by using an improved nonlinear NT hyperplane algorithm, constructing a landslide identification model, and selecting an optimal model by the verification data set to realize landslide identification based on a two-dimensional RGB image. The invention reduces the complexity of landslide identification modeling and avoids falling into dimension disaster.

title_en: Method for evaluating efficiency of artificial ice core catalysis in freezing rain environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power grid disaster prevention, and discloses a method for evaluating the catalysis efficiency of an artificial ice core in a freezing rain environment, wherein the freezing rain environment is simulated by a cloud chamber, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining the first ice crystal concentration and the first artificial ice core effective concentration of the artificial ice core added in the cloud chamber for contact freezing nucleation, the second ice crystal concentration and the second artificial ice core effective concentration of the artificial ice core added in the cloud chamber for desublimation nucleation, and the third ice crystal concentration of the artificial ice core not added in the cloud chamber; the method comprises the steps of obtaining first ice crystal generation efficiency based on first ice crystal concentration, third ice crystal concentration and first artificial ice core effective concentration, obtaining second ice crystal generation efficiency based on second ice crystal concentration, third ice crystal concentration and second artificial ice core effective concentration, and respectively evaluating the efficiency of contact freezing nucleation and the efficiency of desublimation nucleation based on the first ice crystal generation efficiency and the second ice crystal generation efficiency and the preset threshold value respectively to realize the efficiency evaluation of artificial ice core catalysis in a freezing rain environment.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;HUNAN DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Simulation deduction method for high-risk ground collapse disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of ground subsidence modeling, in particular to a high-risk ground subsidence disaster simulation deduction method which comprises the steps of collecting echo signals of each detection point in each leakage area of a pipeline, obtaining hole parameters of the hole area in each leakage area, carrying out filtering treatment on the echo signals of the detection points at the edge positions of each leakage area to obtain standard echo sequences of each leakage area, further obtaining peak-to-peak deviation values of each detection point in each leakage area and soil non-uniformity evaluation values of each detection point in each leakage area, and carrying out threshold treatment on the soil non-uniformity evaluation values of each detection point in each leakage area to obtain hole adjustment parameters of the hole area in each leakage area so as to correct the hole parameters of the hole area in each leakage area and further carrying out finite element analysis on ground subsidence. The application can improve the modeling precision of ground subsidence.
assignees: HENGSHUI YETONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Power dispatching misoperation prevention method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power dispatching misoperation prevention method and a power dispatching misoperation prevention system, and relates to the technical field of power dispatching. The power dispatching misoperation prevention method and system comprise the following steps of S1, early preparation and planning, S2, system development and implementation, S3, flow specification and operation control, S4, system integration and test, S5, training and deployment, S6, continuous monitoring and optimization, wherein an intelligent misoperation prevention locking system combines a multi-mode verification and state monitoring technology, so that manual misoperation is effectively prevented, and a self-detection and fault early warning function can timely discover and deal with potential risks. The automatic flow of the standardized operation ticket system reduces human errors and improves the working efficiency. Double review and speech recitation mechanisms enhance the safety of operation. The system integration and the test ensure the efficient coordination among the devices, and the intelligent linkage strategy further improves the emergency response capability. The simulation training system combines the historical cases, so that the skill level of the dispatcher is improved.
assignees: SHANGQIU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID HANAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rock burst and coal spontaneous combustion collaborative early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock burst and coal spontaneous combustion collaborative early warning method and system based on coal pillar state monitoring, wherein the early warning method comprises the following steps of S1, setting a plurality of drilling holes in coal pillar construction, S2, respectively setting a first-stage monitoring unit in each drilling hole, wherein the first-stage monitoring unit comprises a stress-microseism composite sensor and a distributed optical fiber sensor, S3, identifying a crack position according to abnormal strain parameters monitored by the distributed optical fiber sensor, setting a second-stage monitoring unit in the crack position, wherein the second-stage monitoring unit comprises an air volume detection device, a gas monitoring device and a temperature detection device, S4, receiving multi-source data monitored by the first-stage monitoring unit and the second-stage monitoring unit by utilizing an edge computing gateway, executing data fusion, triggering corresponding early warning grades according to early warning decision standards, and executing response measures corresponding to the early warning grades. The early warning method provided by the invention realizes the cooperative monitoring of rock burst and coal spontaneous combustion disasters, and solves the problem of delay of disaster chain response.

title_en: Enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise climate risk prevention and control, and provides an enterprise climate risk prevention and control system applying big data and artificial intelligence, which comprises a multi-source climate data acquisition module, a satellite, a ground station and enterprise Internet of things data are integrated through federal learning; the system comprises an enterprise asset digital twin module, an AI risk prediction engine, a dynamic risk assessment module, a self-adaptive response decision module, a hierarchical early warning and linkage insurance platform, wherein the enterprise asset digital twin module integrates BIM/GIS to construct a dynamic asset model, the AI risk prediction engine adopts a space-time convolutional neural network to analyze weather-asset relevance, combines physical simulation with generation of an countermeasure network quantification physical/transformation risk, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a risk thermodynamic diagram and calculates a supply chain interruption probability, and the self-adaptive response decision module outputs a hierarchical early warning and links the insurance platform to trigger automatic claim settlement. The system verifies the credibility of the data through the blockchain, utilizes the edge computing nodes to realize local disaster recovery decision when the network is interrupted, forms a closed loop control mechanism of 'monitoring-predicting-evaluating-responding-optimizing', and solves the problems of data island, responding delay and unknown risk prediction in the traditional scheme.

title_en: Tailing dam multi-field coupling discrete element catastrophe early warning method based on energy evolution criterion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tailing dam safety monitoring and early warning, in particular to a tailing dam multi-field coupling discrete element catastrophe early warning method based on an energy evolution criterion. The method comprises five modules, namely a discrete element model construction module, a multi-field coupling calculation module, an energy evolution analysis module, a high-efficiency algorithm optimization module, a dynamic early warning decision module and a classification early warning signal output module, wherein the discrete element model construction module is used for establishing a discontinuous medium model of a tailing particle accumulation body and representing inter-particle mechanical behaviors, the multi-field coupling calculation module is used for realizing dynamic coupling simulation of a seepage field, a stress field, a chemical field and a temperature field, the energy evolution analysis module is used for tracking the energy accumulation, conversion and release processes of a system in real time and extracting critical characteristics before disaster, the high-efficiency algorithm optimization module is used for improving the calculation efficiency through a parallel calculation and order reduction model, and the dynamic early warning decision module is used for fusing the energy criterion and monitoring data and outputting classification early warning signals. The method breaks through the limitation of single parameter early warning of traditional displacement, pore water pressure and the like, realizes accurate capture of the disaster precursor of the tailing dam from the energy driving view angle, and improves early warning timeliness and reliability.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY;JIANGXI PROVINCIAL ACADEMY OF EMERGENCY MAN SCIENCES

title_en: Arrangement and construction method for secondary mining working face of coal resource left over in mining of thick coal seam strip
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layout and construction method of a secondary mining working face for mining left-over coal resources by a thick coal seam strip, and belongs to the technical field of secondary mining of coal. The method solves the problems of rock burst induction, gas accumulation and natural ignition multi-source disaster cooperative prevention and control in the island coal pillar repeated mining process. The method comprises the steps of firstly researching geological data of a mine, clearly leaving a coal re-mining range, repairing an original roadway and tunneling a exploration roadway to the front of a stoping line, drilling, sampling, extracting gas and exploring a goaf state, then establishing a three-dimensional numerical model, combining the model with a similar material simulation method and the like, analyzing the goaf overlying rock movement state and compaction condition, determining a roadway arrangement mode according to the result, mining a stoping roadway, drilling holes in the top of the roadway while mining the roadway, injecting foaming materials, and finally drilling holes into a working face while tunneling to extract gas. The invention can improve the recovery rate of resources in the repeated mining process and reduce disaster risks such as gas accumulation, spontaneous combustion and ignition.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle track correction method, device, equipment and storage medium based on near space environment parameters
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle track correction method, device, equipment and storage medium based on near space environment parameters, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of detection tasks based on natural disaster monitoring tasks; dividing the adjacent space into a plurality of detection areas according to the detection tasks, distributing corresponding detection tasks and detection areas for the unmanned aerial vehicle, planning a flight track in the detection areas based on the detection tasks, simulating according to the environment parameters and the flight track of the detection areas to obtain track correction values under different environment conditions, and carrying out flight track correction and detection task execution in the flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the track correction values under the condition that the flight track needs to be corrected to obtain detection data. According to the application, the flight trajectory is corrected through the trajectory correction value, so that the correction effect of the flight trajectory is effectively improved, the detection task is further executed, the execution efficiency of the detection task and the accuracy of detection data are obviously improved, and the natural disaster early warning is conveniently and accurately carried out.

title_en: Irrigation area ditch drainage-farmland waterlogging simulation evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating and evaluating irrigation area ditch drainage-farmland waterlogging, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining target area meteorological hydrologic data, DEM data, drainage facility vector data and land utilization classification data, S2, generalizing an irrigation area drainage system to generate nodes, drainage channels and sub-catchment areas, S3, converting the shp files into the inp files, constructing a parameterized model, carrying out parameter calibration and verification on the model, S4, simulating waterlogging conditions under different rainfall and channel siltation situations, S5, extracting overflow node data, carrying out flood inundation analysis, and S6, generating a flood risk density map according to the overflow node data. The invention also discloses a system for simulating and evaluating the irrigation area ditch drainage-farmland waterlogging. The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating and evaluating irrigation area ditch drainage and farmland waterlogging, which solve the problem that the prior art cannot simulate ditch drainage and farmland waterlogging risk evaluation under irrigation area waterlogging disasters.

title_en: Non-point source pollution risk assessment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pollution risk assessment, and particularly discloses a non-point source pollution risk assessment method based on machine learning, which is implemented by collecting water quality monitoring data of a target river basin in a historical period under various meteorological conditions and synchronously collecting meteorological monitoring data in a corresponding period; the method comprises the steps of extracting weather extremum events and corresponding water quality response characteristics thereof, constructing a weather-water quality association data set, training a prediction model between weather factors and pollution load peaks by using a machine learning method, evaluating short-term risk levels of non-point source pollution based on prediction results, generating risk early warning signals according to the risk levels obtained by evaluation, providing high-timeliness and high-precision risk decision support for river basin management through multi-source data fusion and machine learning modeling, remarkably enhancing the capability of coping with sudden pollution events, and simultaneously providing key technical support for optimizing management resource allocation and reducing water environment disaster risks.
assignees: ANHUI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE ANHUI ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT PLANNING INSTITUTE ANHUI ECO;UNIV HEFEI TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent security management system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent security management system and method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of intelligent security, firstly, on the basis of multidimensional environment perception, an independent credibility calculation model is introduced, a comprehensive credibility evaluation value which can reflect the current environment condition and the historical performance is endowed for each characteristic index, then, a multi-mode collaborative rule base and a real-time reasoning mechanism based on the multi-mode collaborative rule base can simulate the thinking mode of human expert, the inherent relation among different characteristic indexes is deeply excavated, the preliminary credibility is adjusted accordingly, the accuracy of risk identification under a complex scene is improved, the real security threat and accidental abnormal fluctuation can be effectively distinguished through significance verification based on causal association strength, and finally, a treatment instruction is automatically and rapidly generated through mapping and matching of a verification result and a preset strategy library, so that automatic closed-loop management from risk perception to emergency response is realized.

title_en: Signal enhancement method, device, equipment, medium and product based on high signal-to-noise ratio label cannon and depth network
abstract_en: The application provides a signal enhancement method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product based on a high signal-to-noise ratio label gun and a depth network, which comprise the following steps of optimally designing parameters of an observation system according to a target geological task; selecting a seed gun in a noise area and generating the seed gun as label gun data, carrying out mathematical transformation on the label gun data and the original data, extracting noise characteristics from the label gun data and the transformed multi-domain characteristic data, constructing a depth network model by utilizing the denoised training data, carrying out contrast analysis on the denoised training data and the original data, inputting the seismic data to be denoised into the trained depth network model for denoising, monitoring the performance of the depth network model and the denoising effect of the seismic data in real time, carrying out parameter adjustment optimization, and enhancing effective signals in the seismic data. The application obviously improves the signal-to-noise ratio under complex noise scenes, simultaneously effectively reserves the characteristics and waveform integrity of effective signals, and can be widely applied to the fields of oil-gas exploration, geological disaster early warning, underground structure detection and the like.

title_en: Artificial intelligent simulation method and equipment for atmospheric photochemical reaction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification discloses an artificial intelligence simulation method and equipment for atmospheric photochemical reaction. According to the three-dimensional initial concentration and the environment factors, a target model obtained through pre-training is adopted to predict and obtain the predicted concentration of the chemical substances after a specified step length, and the rest iterates the environment factors according to the predicted concentration of the chemical substances, so that a complete and complex photochemical mechanism is successfully realized in a unified artificial intelligence model and is easily coupled into the non-static atmosphere numerical model, wherein the model has stronger nonlinear representation capability and is not easily influenced by dimension disasters, and meanwhile, quick, accurate and stable simulation is realized.

title_en: Mountain torrent visual simulation chain service construction method and system for knowledge-related integration of data model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a mountain torrent visualization simulation chain service by data model knowledge association integration, belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and disaster reduction informatization, and solves the problems of model input standard confusion and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-scale mountain torrent data, constructing an ontology model based on the multi-scale mountain torrent data for structural expression, realizing integration of mountain torrent scene data-simulation model-domain knowledge based on a large language model, prompting words and external real-time monitoring data as constraint conditions, constructing a mountain torrent data model, classifying and simplifying mountain torrent dynamic visualization process data based on human eye visual perception characteristics and the mountain torrent data model, taking the simplified mountain torrent grid data as original calculation data, and constructing a 'transmission-calculation-drawing' elastic scheduling algorithm to dynamically and visually simulate mountain torrent according to user requests. The invention is used for constructing the mountain torrent visual simulation chain service of the data model knowledge association integration.

title_en: Intelligent loading acceptance checking system and method for fire resistance of building structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent loading acceptance system and method for fire resistance of a building structure, comprising a fire resistance acceptance scheme generating module, a high-temperature simulation and loading module, a sensor monitoring module, a fire resistance evaluation module and a fire resistance acceptance and display module, wherein the fire resistance acceptance scheme generating module is used for acquiring fire resistance grade requirements of building components and making fire resistance acceptance schemes of the building components, the high-temperature simulation and loading module is used for simulating thermal stress and load effects of a building in a fire disaster, the sensor monitoring module is used for monitoring reaction data of the building components of the building structure in a test process in real time and storing the reaction data into a fire simulation experiment database, and the fire resistance evaluation module is used for evaluating the fire resistance of each building component in a key test area and the fire resistance acceptance and display module is used for generating fire resistance acceptance reports of the building components. By the technical method provided by the invention, the acceptance process is optimized, the structural safety of the high-rise building under the fire condition is enhanced, and a more scientific, efficient and reliable fire resistance evaluation scheme is provided for the building industry.
assignees: GUANGDONG CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY SAFETY INSPECTION GENERAL STATION CO LTD

title_en: Building semi-supervised extraction method and system for video disaster data and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised extraction method, a system and electronic equipment for a building of video disaster data, which relate to the technical field of image information extraction, wherein the method comprises the steps of updating parameters of a heterogeneous double-branch feature extraction network based on a plurality of target frame images about disasters; when the updating times reach a preset time threshold, obtaining a pseudo tag set of a building in a preset target frame image output by each branch of the current heterogeneous dual-branch feature extraction network, calculating to obtain countermeasures of the pseudo tag set output by each branch and cross losses among the pseudo tag sets output by all branches, judging whether the sum of all countermeasures and cross losses is smaller than the preset loss threshold, obtaining a first judgment result, and continuously updating parameters of the current heterogeneous dual-branch feature extraction network when the first judgment result is negative, and finishing training. The heterogeneous double-branch feature extraction network which is completed through training can efficiently and accurately identify the building in the image to be segmented.

title_en: Method and device for generating reconstruction plan during disaster recovery period of power distribution network based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for generating a reconstruction plan during disaster recovery of a power distribution network based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of disaster emergency of power systems. The method comprises the steps of establishing a reconstruction model in a disaster recovery period of a power distribution network and converting the reconstruction model into a Markov decision process model, establishing a reinforcement learning agent corresponding to the power distribution network, generating a training sample based on the Markov decision process model for offline training of the reinforcement learning agent, and finally obtaining the trained reinforcement learning agent, and generating a reconstruction plan in the disaster recovery period of the power distribution network on line by using the trained reinforcement learning agent. According to the method and the device, the reconstruction plan can be generated according to the branch fault probability of the power distribution network before the disaster occurs, so that the elasticity of the power distribution network when coping with the disaster is effectively improved, and the load loss condition caused by the disaster is reduced.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Drought-resistant disaster-reduction effect evaluation method, drought-resistant disaster-reduction effect evaluation system and storage medium for cascade reservoir
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drought-resistant and disaster-reducing effect evaluation method, a drought-resistant and disaster-reducing effect evaluation system and a storage medium for a cascade reservoir, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, developing cascade reservoir dispatching simulation; S2, acquiring a drought scene data set, S3, constructing a three-level nine-index system, S4, carrying out index standardization processing, S5, distributing entropy weight, and S6, calculating a TOPSIS evaluation model. The method has the advantages that the reservoir group regulation capacity and disaster reduction effect under drought conditions are quantitatively evaluated by constructing a scientific multi-index evaluation system, so that technical support is provided for reservoir dispatching optimization and drought resistance decision.

title_en: Automatic driving test scene set optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic driving test scene set optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium, which are used for generating OpenSCENARIO-format simulation scene files through preprocessing data, analyzing the simulation scene files through a teacher model, outputting risk description texts, receiving scene feature vectors and risk description texts through a student model, outputting failure probability, determining a comprehensive value index according to the failure probability, dynamically updating a scene library of an automatic driving test scene, collecting failure data in an AUT test, performing incremental fine tuning on the student model to obtain an optimized target test scene set, effectively solving the gradient estimation variance explosion problem caused by sparsity disaster, improving the stability of model training, enhancing the recognition capability of long-tail rare failure scenes, improving the accuracy of failure probability prediction, improving the judgment accuracy of the model on boundary scenes, and improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of scene value quantification.

title_en: Subway evacuation dynamic decision simulation system based on virtual reality and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway evacuation dynamic decision simulation system based on virtual reality and artificial intelligence, which comprises an environment modeling module, an agent generation module, an evacuation behavior decision module, a path planning module and a man-machine interaction module which are in communication coupling, wherein the environment modeling module is used for constructing a three-dimensional subway tunnel evacuation scene and integrating fire scene dynamic data, the agent generation module generates heterogeneous agent groups based on demographic data, the evacuation behavior decision module adopts an improved social force-agent model and a finite state machine to realize agent behavior decision, the path planning module implements a three-level navigation algorithm to realize global path planning and local path dynamic adjustment, and the man-machine interaction module acquires participant behavior data through VR equipment and interacts with a simulation environment in real time. The method has the advantages that the interaction between the real person evacuation behavior and the intelligent body is realized through the highly simulated environment and the intelligent decision model, and the efficiency and the scientificity of subway tunnel emergency evacuation exercise are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI TUNNEL ENGINEERING & RAIL TRANSIT DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE;SHANGHAI SHENTONG METRO GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI SHENTONG METRO CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI INST OF DISASTER PREVENTION AND RELIEF

title_en: Landslide hazard evolution analysis method and system based on coupling model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a landslide disaster evolution analysis method and system based on a coupling model, wherein the method firstly integrates geological structure monitoring data, topography and topography distribution data and hydrologic environment monitoring data of a target earthquake region to generate a comprehensive monitoring data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing an interaction association relation of a target equation set based on a data set, constructing a geological-landform-hydrologic coupling model, dynamically simulating and quantitatively evaluating the instability probability and landslide scale of a potential landslide body according to a preset scene parameter combination, generating an image-text labeling quantitative evaluation report, finally carrying out vulnerability analysis and risk evaluation on the disaster-bearing body based on the report, and generating a comprehensive guidance report comprising a disaster-bearing body vulnerability spatial distribution map, landslide risk prevention and control measure proposal and a regional spatial planning optimization scheme, thereby providing scientific basis for landslide disaster prevention and control and regional planning.

title_en: Fuel supply system for fire-fighting training
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire training fuel supply system which comprises a fuel tank, a fire disaster simulation facility, a booster pump, a return pipeline and a flow regulating device, wherein the fuel tank is used for storing fuel, the fire disaster simulation facility is provided with a plurality of fire disaster simulation facilities and is used for simulating the condition of a fire scene, the booster pump is arranged on a fuel pipeline, a pressure transmitter is arranged on a main pipe at an outlet of the booster pump and used for measuring the actual pressure P1 of the outlet of the booster pump, one end of the return pipeline is connected with the fuel pipeline, the other end of the return pipeline is connected with the fuel tank, and the flow regulating device is arranged on the return pipeline and is used for regulating the flow of the return pipeline according to the outlet pressure P1 of the booster pump. The utility model has simple structure, ensures the stable operation of each fire simulation facility, and avoids the pipeline rupture possibly caused by overlarge pressure fluctuation in a pressure regulating mode.

title_en: High-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring devices, in particular to a high-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops, which comprises a positioning tube, wherein a humidity sensor can be directly buried into soil through a ground drilling tube through the arrangement of an adjusting mechanism, meanwhile, the depth of the humidity sensor in the soil can be adjusted, the sensor is not required to be taken out and buried into the soil again, namely, the device is carried to a monitoring place, a support ring is held to vertically insert a ground drilling cone into the soil, a second motor is started to drive a second bevel gear to rotate, a second screw rod drives a transmission block to drive a humidity sensor part to move out of a through groove and enable the sensor to be in contact with the soil, the humidity of the soil can be monitored, in the detection process, a first motor is started, the first motor drives a first screw rod to rotate, and the screw rod drives a screw rod to descend continuously so as to adjust the depth of the ground drilling tube.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Gamified business learning & ai talent discovery platform for kids
abstract_en: An interactive platform for children aged 6 to 12 that combines gamification and AI to simulate real-life scenarios through educational games. It introduces various professional concepts such as engineering, education, firefighting, policing, finance, and business tailored to each country's specific needs. By employing AI-based behavioral analyses, the platform personalizes each child's learning path, aiding in the identification and development of their individual talents. This approach enables children to acquire essential skills for navigating diverse professional fields and social interactions. Additionally, ItSeemsCool engages parents and educators by providing detailed behavioral insights and talent discovery reports, empowering them to effectively guide children's educational journeys. Motivational features like badges, leaderboards, and AR/VR tools maintain children's engagement, making learning both enjoyable and impactful. Overall, ItSeemsCool offers a comprehensive solution to modern educational challenges by combining professional concept education, gamification, and AI to enhance children's practical and social skills, preparing them for a successful future.
assignees: HAMZEHPOUR ZAHRA;GHASEMI DAREHNAEE ZEYNAB;SAMIE SOROUSH;MOAZED MAHYAR

title_en: Geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning. The geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning comprise a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a deep learning model module and a prediction output module, wherein the data acquisition module acquires soil properties, meteorological data, groundwater level and topography gradient multidimensional data by adopting a remote sensing technology, geological exploration equipment and sensors. According to the geotechnical engineering geological disaster prediction method and system based on deep learning, accuracy and reliability of original data are guaranteed, and quality of model training is improved by adopting multi-source data acquisition, data preprocessing and optimization of a feature extraction module. In particular, the deep learning model module adopts a convolutional neural network structure to capture spatial features in geological data, and can automatically learn a more complex mode, so that the prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Landslide displacement prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide displacement prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction; the method comprises the steps of respectively carrying out modal decomposition operation and denoising operation on each landslide historical data in sequence to obtain a plurality of denoising modal components, determining each relation coefficient between a denoising displacement component and each denoising induction factor component, taking the corresponding denoising induction factor component as a relevant induction factor component when the relation coefficient meets a preset relevant condition, taking induction factor historical data as input, taking the corresponding denoising displacement component as output to construct a data set, training a preset initial model by using the data set to obtain a landslide displacement prediction model, and obtaining each induction factor monitoring data to be input into the landslide displacement prediction model to obtain landslide displacement prediction data. The method and the device can accurately identify key factors causing landslide displacement of the target area, and improve the accuracy and reliability of landslide displacement prediction.

title_en: Flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of digital twinning, in particular to a flood disaster evolution method and system based on digital twinning technology, the method comprises the steps of collecting all point cloud data of river basin topography, constructing a three-dimensional topography model, obtaining reflection intensity and elevation data of each point cloud, clustering all point clouds corresponding to the ground, and recording the area where the ground in each cluster corresponds to all point clouds as each local area; calculating a coplanar characterization value, an erosion evaluation value, a destabilization risk value, a soil fixation evaluation value and a terrain evolution factor of each local area, constructing a digital twin simulation platform of river basin terrain by combining a three-dimensional terrain model, and carrying out simulation on flood disasters. The application can avoid the defect that the static terrain model cannot respond to the terrain evolution caused by the flood disaster, effectively reduce the simulation error generated by the digital twin simulation platform in the flood disaster evolution process, and improve the accuracy of risk assessment on the flood disaster.

title_en: Rock-soil landslide monitoring and early warning system with air-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses an air-ground cooperative rock-soil landslide monitoring and early warning system, which relates to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning and comprises an air remote sensing monitoring module, a ground sensing module, a data communication module, a multi-source information fusion module and an intelligent early warning decision module; the system comprises an aerial remote sensing monitoring module, a ground sensing module, a multisource information fusion module, an intelligent early warning decision module and a full-element analysis and early warning module, wherein the aerial remote sensing monitoring module is used for acquiring aerial image data based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, the ground sensing module is used for acquiring ground sensing data, the multisource information fusion module is used for carrying out fusion alignment on the aerial image data, the ground sensing data and geological model multiscale information, a deep learning algorithm is adopted to extract morphological characteristics of ground surface cracks, a deformation time sequence generated by radar interferometry is analyzed, an abnormal movement mode is identified, and the intelligent early warning decision module is used for analyzing a landslide evolution stage and simulating a geologic body deformation process and carrying out early warning decision.
assignees: WENZHOU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE;WENZHOU SURVEY AND MAPPING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Mine fire disaster fidelity simulation system and safety guarantee method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine fire disaster fidelity simulation system and a safety guarantee method, the intelligent ventilation control system comprises a pilot control subsystem, a simulated roadway subsystem, an intelligent ventilation control subsystem, a data acquisition subsystem and two safety guarantee subsystems. The ignition control subsystem mainly comprises four ignition sources (coal, pits, cables and conveyor belts), a heating plate, an igniter, fireproof glass and an iron frame, and the simulation roadway subsystem consists of an L-shaped air inlet roadway, an air return roadway, four connecting branch roadways connected with the L-shaped air inlet roadway and the air return roadway, a refuge chamber and a rolling shutter door. The intelligent ventilation control subsystem comprises two ventilators, an automatic air door, a remote control center and the like. The data acquisition subsystem comprises a mine tripod head camera, a multi-parameter gas sensor, a thermocouple, a smoke sensor and the like. The invention supports the research of a mine fire early-stage flame image characteristic and index gas parameter identification method, constructs a mine fire multi-physical field coupling mechanism, and forms two safety guarantee subsystems of early-stage fire identification early-warning based on fire source image characteristic and index gas identification and disaster smoke flow emergency regulation based on an intelligent ventilation system based on the mine fire multi-physical field coupling mechanism.

title_en: Disaster recovery method, device and equipment based on large model
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery method, a disaster recovery device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on a large model, which comprise the steps of acquiring system operation data and business knowledge; the method comprises the steps of inputting system operation data and business knowledge into a large model for defect simulation, generating a disaster model and a corresponding disaster recovery model, wherein the disaster recovery model is used for disposing the corresponding disaster model, determining a target disaster model matched with the real-time disaster after monitoring the real-time disaster, and executing the target disaster recovery model corresponding to the target disaster model. The method can overcome the defects that the traditional scheme depends on manual limitation and the general large model lacks customized IT disaster recovery knowledge, thereby generating a disaster model and a disaster recovery model which are attached to an actual IT architecture more accurately, improving the accuracy of the disaster recovery scheme, reducing the delay and deviation of manual decision making, being more suitable for the dynamic change of the cloud primary environment, providing more efficient and reliable disaster recovery support for complex and changeable IT systems, and effectively guaranteeing the continuity and data safety of the business.

title_en: Forest fire satellite remote sensing image reconstruction method and system under thin smoke interference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for reconstructing a forest fire satellite remote sensing image under the interference of thin smoke, comprising the following steps of firstly, constructing a forest fire remote sensing image data set under the interference of thin smoke; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model with thin smoke interference, training to obtain a trained multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model, and inputting a forest fire satellite remote sensing image under the thin smoke interference into the trained multi-branch forest fire remote sensing image reconstruction model to obtain a forest fire remote sensing reconstruction image with the thin smoke interference removed. The invention effectively solves the problem that the existing remote sensing image reconstruction method under the light common atmospheric interference is not suitable for the remote sensing image reconstruction of the forest fire scene under the thin smoke interference, and can provide reliable and applicable satellite remote sensing image support for forest fire situation research and judgment, accurate positioning of a combustion area, resource scheduling, personnel evacuation, traffic control and other emergency command decisions.

title_en: Building shock resistance prediction model training method, prediction method and related products
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building shock resistance prediction model training method, a prediction method and related products, and relates to the technical field of disaster risk prevention and control. According to the training method disclosed by the invention, the grid semantic image of the multi-source anti-seismic influence factor and the fusion image of the remote sensing image are used as training samples, and the geometric features of the remote sensing image and the structural essential features reflected by the grid anti-seismic influence factor are fused by the fusion image, so that the correlation between the structural essential features and the anti-seismic capacity of the building exterior can be more accurately correlated by the model, and the accuracy of a prediction result is improved. The problem that single data source information is limited in the deep learning earthquake-resistant prediction method is solved.

title_en: Intelligent combined control method, system, equipment and storage medium for full-motion simulator environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of environment control and multi-system cooperative linkage of flight simulation training equipment, and provides an intelligent combined control method, system, equipment and storage medium for an environment of a full-motion simulator, which solve the problems of low intelligent level and poor emergency response efficiency of multi-system cooperative control. The method comprises the steps of acquiring running data and basic environment parameters of all subsystems in an environment joint control system in real time through a multi-dimensional environment sensing network, carrying out fusion and state analysis, identifying safety abnormality, smoke simulation triggering or subsystem faults, identifying the abnormal signals, namely generating corresponding joint control instructions by utilizing a logic control algorithm, sending the instructions to external systems such as a power supply, a corridor bridge, a motion and a fire alarm and an IOS instructor station through a cross-system joint control mechanism, receiving external feedback signals in real time by the system, dynamically adjusting a cooperative control strategy, and constructing a closed-loop intelligent joint control system. The intelligent level and emergency response efficiency of the multi-system cooperative control are improved.

title_en: Slope disaster deformation evaluation method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope disaster deformation evaluation method, system, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster remote sensing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting unmanned aerial vehicle orthographic image data and unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared image data of a slope disaster area, identifying boundary and deformation crack distribution parameters of a defined disaster area, and determining surface temperature field data of deformation cracks and surrounding areas; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deformation crack temperature field calculation model according to ground surface temperature field data and air parameters, calculating the penetration probability based on the deformation crack temperature field calculation model by combining deformation crack bottom simulation temperature, deformation crack average temperature and deformation crack peripheral area average temperature, and evaluating the penetration state of the deformation crack in a slope disaster area and an underground goaf according to the penetration probability.

title_en: Emergency evacuation simulation method and system for personnel of composite inclined posture wide passenger plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating emergency evacuation of personnel of a wide passenger plane with a composite inclined posture, and belongs to the technical field of emergency evacuation simulation. The method comprises the steps of S1, building a physical simulation model of the wide passenger plane, setting an intelligent agent in the physical simulation model of the wide passenger plane, and S2, carrying out emergency evacuation simulation on personnel in a composite oblique posture based on an improved social force model, the intelligent agent model and the physical simulation model of the wide passenger plane. The invention comprehensively considers the reality of simulation and constructs a simulation model of the emergency evacuation of personnel in a passenger cabin under the combined tilting posture of the transverse tilting and the pitching tilting of the wide passenger plane (B787). The method is used for supplementing data for related research of emergency evacuation of personnel in the inclined attitude of the aircraft and providing corresponding basic support for the actual situation.

title_en: Method for identifying and predicting damage of PC box girder under fire disaster and monitoring and early warning system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a PC box girder fire damage identification prediction method and a monitoring and early warning system thereof, which belong to the technical field of bridge safety risk assessment and comprise the steps of selecting and constructing characteristics of PC box girder fire pre-stress loss and bending-resistant bearing capacity loss, constructing a PC box girder pre-stress loss database and a bending-resistant bearing capacity loss database under fire, preprocessing various original data in the pre-stress loss database and the bending-resistant bearing capacity loss database, converting each parameter into a format which can be analyzed by a machine learning model, dividing a data set into a training set and a testing set, optimizing super-parameters of models corresponding to the pre-stress loss and the bending-resistant bearing capacity loss based on the training set and the testing set, performing performance assessment, result visualization processing and SHAP interpretability analysis on the optimized models, and applying the models to PC box girder fire damage identification prediction. The invention solves the problem of large prediction error in the prior art.

title_en: Multi-mode real-time emotion analysis method and system for 5G new call
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode real-time emotion analysis method and system for a new 5G call, and relates to the technical field.
