The method comprises the steps of constructing a training set containing multi-modal features such as intonation, expression and vocabulary based on 5G characteristics, dividing data subsets by adopting a hierarchical sampling technology, calculating time period-emotion correlation values and optimizing data distribution through timestamp coding and emotion label mapping, dynamically extracting cross-modal context features during real-time analysis, updating a prediction model by combining semantic emotion correlation rules, establishing a double-sample library mechanism, storing features which are verified to be consistent into a reinforcement learning library, marking inconsistent features as misleading/noise features and automatically removing the misleading/noise features, performing triple label marking on misjudging samples, and positioning high-risk error modes and generating correction rules through misjudging density screening, conflict degree calculation and clustering analysis. According to the embodiment, the 5G low-delay characteristic is utilized, the real-time performance and the accuracy of emotion analysis are improved, and key technical support is provided for scenes such as intelligent customer service, emergency response and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHANGJIUXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway tunnel fire disaster fire spread prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway tunnel fire disaster spread prediction method, which comprises the steps of firstly, digitally modeling a fire source type, secondly, initializing a fire scene, thirdly, loading and triggering dynamic fire sources, fourthly, coupling calculation of multiple physical fields of fire disaster spread, fifth, dynamic response of a ventilation system, sixth, generation of a visual risk thermodynamic diagram, and seventh, real-time early warning of safety margin; the method has the advantages that full-element modeling capability supports multidimensional parameter input from fire source characteristics to tunnel environments, the scene range of typical fires of subways is improved and covered, fire spreading errors are reduced through multi-physical-field simultaneous equation solving, smoke diffusion simulation precision is improved, dynamic ventilation adjustment and safety early warning mechanisms are realized, and more buffering time is provided for emergency response.

title_en: Digital twin of thermal power plant operation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital twin and energy industry intellectualization, and relates to a digital twin system for a three-dimensional running state of a thermal power plant, which solves the technical problems of island, visual deletion and prediction hysteresis of the traditional running data. The system builds a multi-source data fusion-dynamic physical deduction-virtual-real interaction control system, wherein a multi-source data fusion engine breaks through a DCS/SIS barrier to achieve 20 ten thousand+data points/second millisecond synchronization, a GPU drives a VFX Graph particle system and an LOD rendering technology to achieve 90fps@4K smoke flow simulation on RTX 4080, and an AR instruction is directly connected with a PLC to build a virtual-real bidirectional control chain to form a closed loop of monitoring-deduction-intervention. The key indexes are that the fault early warning is more than or equal to 72h, the fault positioning is 0.5 h/time, the data delay is less than or equal to 10ms, and the model precision is +/-2 cm. And adopting an edge-cloud cooperative architecture, and performing lightweight deployment on the Unity model. The actual measurement of the Beijing energy Chifeng power plant is that the emergency response is shortened to 4.3 minutes from 26 minutes, and an innovative paradigm foundation for 'predictive intervention' driving is laid for the digitization of thermal power.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA HUIBO TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method for establishing digital emergency expert training database of container terminal
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of automatic container terminal operation optimization, in particular to a method for establishing a container terminal digital emergency expert training database, which comprises data collection, data arrangement analysis, database construction, expert system construction and system training and optimization. According to the invention, the efficiency and the accuracy of emergency response are remarkably improved by constructing the container terminal digital emergency expert training database and the matched expert system. When an emergency occurs, the system can rely on accumulated mass data and intelligent analysis capability, a targeted disposal method and flow guidance are generated at the first time, unstable factors of artificial decisions in traditional emergency management are effectively avoided, response time is greatly shortened, loss caused by the emergency is reduced to the minimum, meanwhile, the gap of a novel automatic wharf emergency management disposal method is filled, and solid guarantee is provided for safe and efficient operation of the wharf.
assignees: TIANJIN PORT SECOND CONTAINER TERMINAL CO LTD

title_en: Flood depth prediction method, system, medium and processor based on ensemble learning and weak supervision sequencing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood depth prediction method, a system, a medium and a processor based on integrated learning and weak supervision sequencing, and relates to the field of flood disaster monitoring. Aiming at the problem that the prior art cannot fully utilize social media image data to carry out flood analysis, the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting, screening and preprocessing the social media image data to construct a flood disaster data set, then formulating water depth grade standard marking data taking people, vehicles and bicycles as references, then fusing ResNet and Swin transducer models and optimizing loss functions, then constructing models through pre-training, fine-tuning and combined training, and finally carrying out performance evaluation and applying the performance evaluation to prediction. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the social media image data value can be fully mined, the flood depth prediction precision is improved, the data annotation flow is simplified, the method is more timely and accurate in the aspect of assisting flood inundation decision, and the method has great significance in monitoring and coping with flood disasters.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Random finite fault seismic source model building method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a random limited fault source model, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining the geometrical morphology of a fault based on regional geological data and earthquake monitoring data, estimating non-planar fault parameters and average sliding quantity of fault surfaces by combining historical data and an empirical formula, S2, estimating the concave-convex bodies, obstacle distribution and sliding strength of the fault surfaces according to historical earthquake inversion data, obtaining sliding quantity of each sub fault through random disturbance average sliding quantity, S3, determining an initial breaking point and average breaking speed of the discrete fault surfaces as sub fault units, generating random breaking initial time conforming to normal or power law distribution based on a random number method, S4, calculating the earthquake time of each sub fault by adopting a random point source method, superposing contribution and introducing the influence of a shallow speed structure V30, and generating a three-dimensional earthquake dynamic field, S5, comparing actual strong earthquake record adjustment parameters, and outputting a multi-risk-level earthquake parameter evaluation result after iterative optimization. According to the method, the randomness and the experience data are fused, so that the simulation precision of the seismic source model on the uncertainty of the seismic process is improved, the influence of the potential maximum magnitude earthquake of the movable fracture zone in the future can be effectively estimated, the simulation precision and the calculation efficiency of the earthquake are improved, and the method is suitable for earthquake resistant design of engineering structures and earthquake disaster assessment.
assignees: JIANGXI TONGJI CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MAN CO LTD;HU YISHI

title_en: Basic disaster backup drilling and disaster switching method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data disaster recovery, and provides a method and a system for basic disaster recovery exercise and disaster switching, wherein the method comprises the steps of automatically identifying multi-source heterogeneous database assets through a rule engine and a machine learning algorithm and constructing a disaster recovery topological graph; the disaster recovery method comprises the steps of generating and optimizing a disaster recovery strategy by an intelligent algorithm based on a disaster recovery topological graph, dynamically adjusting the disaster recovery strategy by combining real-time business requirements, fusing historical disaster recovery data with real-time monitoring data to reconstruct the disaster recovery strategy, collecting execution data in real time in exercise, optimizing the disaster recovery strategy by a closed loop feedback mechanism, monitoring the whole flow state by a visual interface and displaying key indexes, quantitatively analyzing exercise results based on a multidimensional evaluation model, determining a target disaster recovery strategy, authorizing key operation by a safety verification mechanism, matching a disaster recovery scene scheme according to fault types, and controlling an automatic execution unit to finish disaster switching based on the target disaster recovery strategy. The disaster recovery switching method and the disaster recovery switching device improve disaster recovery switching accuracy in complex scenes.

title_en: Method and system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying generation and influence of sudden natural disaster fault scenes, belonging to the technical field of disaster risk assessment and toughness modeling of an electric power system; the method comprises the steps of calculating damage probability of each node by combining with the geographical coordinates of the nodes, generating an initial fault set by using a Monte Carlo sampling method, defining a node state vector, performing fault cascade propagation simulation until the node state vector reaches a stable state, respectively identifying an electric power failure area, a communication uncontrolled area and a traffic blocking area, and outputting the initial fault set, the stable state and the three areas together as simulated disaster scene samples to finish identification. The invention solves the problems of difficult multi-network cascade fault propagation and system interruption identification under the influence of complex disasters, supports the automatic generation of samples and the accurate identification of disaster influence areas, provides data support for the follow-up, and can be used for the evaluation of multi-network fusion and resource scheduling.

title_en: Dangerous chemical storage and transportation device safety accident simulation system based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety accident simulation system of a dangerous chemical storage and transportation device based on a VR technology, which comprises a scene simulation module, an accident simulation module, a user interaction module, a data analysis and evaluation module, a decision tree model and a knowledge base, wherein the scene simulation module is used for training and generating an countermeasure network, taking a real dangerous chemical database as input and receiving physical and chemical rule constraints of the knowledge base, synthesizing parameters of virtual new dangerous chemicals, constructing a dangerous chemical storage and transportation scene, rendering and scene interaction through a VR engine, the accident simulation module is used for simulating dangerous chemical accidents, defining different disaster evolution rules through a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, enabling an agent to generate a disaster scene through self-play countermeasure, the user interaction module is used for interacting with a virtual environment through VR equipment, the data analysis and evaluation module is used for recording user behavior data, dynamically constructing a decision tree model based on real-time disaster parameters, combining an expert rule base and reinforcement learning rewarding function, and generating a non-programming scheme, and the knowledge base is used for providing safety standards, a case base and training progress management of dangerous chemicals.
assignees: SPECIAL EQUIPMENT SAFETY SUPERVISION INSPECTION INST OF JIANGSU PROVINCE;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Household linkage-based health multi-dimensional management system for old people
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health management, in particular to a multi-dimensional management system and method for the health of the aged based on family linkage; the invention discloses a health multi-dimensional management system for old people based on home linkage, which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a health analysis module, a body medical intervention module, a home interaction module and a community communication module, wherein the multi-mode data acquisition module is used for acquiring physiological data and exercise data of the old people through manual input and access of Internet of things equipment, the physiological data comprises blood sugar, blood pressure, blood oxygen and body fat rate, the exercise data comprises exercise type, duration and strength, the health analysis module is used for analyzing the physiological data based on a preset health evaluation algorithm and a pre-training model, and the problem of home supervision deficiency in the existing application is solved through real-time synchronous data, hierarchical early warning and emergency response of family members, so that the initiative and the safety of health management of the old people are improved.

title_en: A falling stone impact structure simulation test system for shaking table is experimental
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster simulation and discloses a falling stone impact structure simulation test system for a vibration table test, which comprises a frame, a vibration table, a test model, a limiting component and an impact test piece, wherein the vibration table is arranged on the horizontal ground, the frame is fixedly arranged on the table top of the vibration table, the test model is fixedly arranged on the table top of the vibration table, the limiting component comprises a guide groove, the guide groove is obliquely arranged on the frame, the lower end outlet of the guide groove faces the test model, the impact test piece is arranged in the guide groove, and the impact test piece is arranged in the guide groove through the oblique arrangement of the guide groove.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation, which relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching training, and comprises the steps of integrating a power grid topological structure, equipment operation data and historical fault data, constructing a three-level dynamic simulation model of equipment level, station level and regional level, based on acquired real-time operation data, after the data are subjected to dimension reduction and anomaly detection, the parameters and the states of the three-level dynamic simulation model are updated, the updated model is utilized to drive simulation, disaster scenes are generated by combining power flow analysis, load prediction and stability assessment, cognitive process data are collected, quantitative analysis is performed by combining preset assessment indexes, and personalized training feedback is generated. The invention highly restores the running state of the power grid, improves the data accuracy, enriches the training content, enhances the training effect, improves the capability of a dispatcher to cope with complex situations, breaks the regional limitation and improves the training efficiency and the resource utilization rate.
assignees: HUANENG LIANCHENG POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: VOCs gas leakage detection system integrated with intelligent analysis platform through multi-terminal coordination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VOCs gas leakage detection system integrated with a multi-terminal coordination and intelligent analysis platform, which comprises a data acquisition module and an intelligent analysis platform module, wherein the intelligent analysis platform module comprises a multispectral feature fusion model and a leakage diffusion simulation engine, the multispectral feature fusion model is used for combining gas absorption peak characteristics with environmental temperature and humidity data to distinguish real leakage and interference signals, and the leakage diffusion simulation engine predicts a gas diffusion path by using a hydrodynamic model to generate an emergency response plan. The invention discloses a VOCs gas leakage detection system integrated with an intelligent analysis platform through multi-terminal coordination, which is used for solving the problems that in the prior art, detection is inaccurate, a gas diffusion path cannot be predicted, emergency response capability is lacking and the like.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KUNTENG INFRARED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight fire and smoke detection method based on improvement YOLOv n
abstract_en: The invention provides a lightweight fire and smoke detection method based on an improvement YOLOv n, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision target detection. The technical problems of low detection precision, large omission factor and insufficient instantaneity of the existing fire and smoke detection method are solved. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a fire disaster data set, S2, replacing YOLOv n main network with RepGhostNet network, S3, introducing a lightweight cross-scale feature fusion module CCFM, S4, replacing a bounding box regression loss function with Focaler-GioU, and S5, training an improved yolov11n network model by utilizing the fire disaster smoke data set to obtain a trained model. The invention improves the detection capability of small targets by optimizing the network structure, improving the loss function and the like, enhances the adaptability of the model to complex scenes and improves the reasoning efficiency.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides a fire disaster early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of arranging a composite optical fiber and a target sensor in a region to be detected to collect historical multi-mode data so as to construct a multi-mode data sequence, carrying out space-time alignment on all mode data in the multi-mode data sequence to construct a training data set, extracting multi-dimensional feature vectors based on the training data set, determining masks based on preset three-dimensional coordinate models, training a first artificial intelligent model according to the multi-dimensional feature vectors and the masks, obtaining a target signal according to the trained first artificial intelligent model, training a second artificial intelligent model according to the target signal, collecting real-time multi-mode data through the composite optical fiber and the target sensor, triggering the trained second artificial intelligent model and inputting the real-time multi-mode data into the training data set if the real-time temperature mode data in the real-time multi-mode data reaches preset triggering conditions, so as to obtain target fire risk probability, and triggering target early warning operation according to the target fire risk probability.
assignees: TANGSHAN XINYADE BELLOWS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue simulation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency rescue simulation method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computer simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode data of a plurality of users participating in simulation; aiming at each user, based on the corresponding multi-mode data, a cognition-physiological state vector representing the internal state of the user is calculated in real time, cognition-physiological state vectors of all users are gathered, a group cognition cooperative spectrum vector representing the overall cooperative state of a team and containing indexes such as decision-making synchronous rate, information sharing entropy and the like is analyzed and generated, a disaster regulation decision module adaptively decides and generates a disaster regulation action according to the spectrum vector, and an environment updating module updates a virtual environment according to the disaster regulation action. According to the application, objective and quantitative evaluation and self-adaptive targeting training of team collaborative efficiency are realized by constructing closed-loop feedback of team cognitive state and disaster environment evolution.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDE QIRUI SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation method and device for toughness of water supply network system and computer medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method, a device and a computer medium for toughness of a water supply network system, which are characterized in that hydraulic model parameters of the water supply network are firstly obtained, then a low stress scene, a medium stress scene and a high stress scene are constructed, wherein the low stress scene is constructed according to historical water demand data, the medium stress scene is constructed on the basis of the low stress scene by overlapping pipeline failures, the high stress scene is constructed on the basis of the medium stress scene by overlapping fire working conditions, the water supply quantity and the water demand of the water supply network in the low stress scene, the medium stress scene and the high stress scene are respectively calculated according to the hydraulic model parameters of the water supply network, and finally a plurality of strain indexes for quantifying the toughness of the water supply network system are calculated according to the water supply quantity and the water demand of the water supply network in the low stress scene, the medium stress scene and the high stress scene. According to the invention, the toughness of the water supply network system is evaluated with low calculation cost by only traversing single-pipe failure and overlapping scene simulation of single-point fire disaster working conditions on the basis of single-pipe failure.
assignees: GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Goaf impact airflow disaster factor assessment method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a goaf impact air flow disaster-causing factor assessment method and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of selecting disaster-causing factors; calculating the association degree of the disaster causing factors and the air leakage flow velocity of the goaf by adopting a gray association degree calculation method, marking the association degree as a first association degree, calculating the association degree of the disaster causing factors and the concentration of the CO flow field of the return air corner of the working face, marking the association degree as a second association degree, and simulating the goaf impact air flow after respectively adjusting the numerical values corresponding to the first disaster causing factors or the second disaster causing factors on simulation software for simulating the goaf impact air flow. The invention solves the technical problem that the main influencing factors and the secondary influencing factors cannot be distinguished in the prior art, so that the treatment measures cannot be adopted pertinently. The goaf impact air flow disaster-causing factor assessment method provided by the invention can accurately calculate the influence degree of different disaster-causing factors of goaf impact air flow on working face recovery, and takes targeted prevention and control measures according to main disaster-causing factors.
assignees: CHN ENERGY XINJIANG ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: Ground subsidence simulator
abstract_en: A ground subsidence simulator relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and analysis. According to the invention, the ground subsidence data center module and the ground subsidence simulator module are constructed, so that comprehensive management and efficient analysis of ground subsidence related monitoring data are realized. The data center module manages attribute data, space vector data, remote sensing image data and project data, and realizes semantic recombination and directory configuration of multi-source heterogeneous data based on a dynamic resource tree. The simulator module provides the running environment and management functions of the analysis algorithm and the model, takes the project as a core unit and binds the data, the algorithm script and the intermediate result in a strong association way. The invention ensures the integrity, traceability and reproducibility of the simulation analysis process and provides powerful support for urban planning, infrastructure construction and geological disaster prevention. Meanwhile, the visual analysis function is also provided, case management is supported, and users can share and view data and calculation processes of typical cases conveniently.

title_en: Training plan demonstration system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a training plan demonstration system, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprises a data acquisition and integration subsystem: deploying an Internet of things sensor, an unmanned aerial vehicle, satellite remote sensing equipment and a docking history database to acquire a plurality of items of data related to emergency rescue training and planning, and performing cleaning conversion and associated integration pretreatment on the plurality of items of data to generate high-quality initial data; according to the invention, the data acquisition integration subsystem is used for deploying the Internet of things sensor, the unmanned aerial vehicle, the satellite remote sensing equipment and the docking history database, so that comprehensive and accurate emergency rescue training and planning related multiple items of data are obtained, the GIS and BIM in the disaster scene simulation subsystem are utilized to construct virtual scenes of different types of disasters or events, the rescue scheme generation subsystem is combined to automatically generate diversified rescue schemes by reinforcement learning, the reality of the simulation scene is improved, and the rationality of the rescue scheme generation is enhanced.
assignees: XIAN HAIXUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Disaster Damage and Earthquake Impact Prediction-Based Evacuation Range Estimation and Management System
title_ko: 풍수해 및 지진 피해 예측 기반 대피 범위 추정 및 관리 시스템

title_en: Apparatus for three-dimensional realtime interpreting accident of chemical substance based on artificial intelligent
title_ko: 인공지능 기반의 화학물질 누출사고 피해영향 범위 예측 및 사고원인 분석을 위한 3차원 실시간 화학물질 사고해석 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반의 화학물질 누출사고 피해영향 범위 예측 및 사고원인 분석을 위한 3차원 실시간 화학물질 사고해석 장치에 관한 것으로, 지형의 변화에 따른 풍속과 풍향 등의 기상 변화를 이용하여 특정 지역별로 기상조건 변화에 따른 대기 운동을 반복 학습하여 실시간 공기 유동 예측을 위한 인공지능 학습모델을 구축하고, 구축된 인공지능 학습모델을 이용하여 화학물질의 사고 발생 시 화학물질의 누출에 의한 열/유동, 화학물질 누출/확산, 화학물질 반응/확산, 화학물질에 의한 화재, 화학물질에 의한 폭발 등의 현상에 대한 3차원 실시간 사고해석 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션을 수행함으로써, 시간에 따른 거리별 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해영향의 범위를 신속 정확하게 실시간 예측할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 방재작업 및 주민대피 예상범위를 신속하게 제공하여 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해 확산을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent path planning method and system based on dynamic road condition prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent path planning method and system based on dynamic road condition prediction. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining multisource dynamic data of a target area, then constructing a weather effect prediction model to predict weather effect parameters in a future period, secondly constructing a weather-traffic coupling model, respectively establishing association models corresponding to precipitation, traffic flow density and average speed according to road types through historical data analysis to estimate the traffic efficiency of each road section under the dynamic weather condition, finally generating a plurality of candidate paths according to the traffic efficiency, screening candidate path sets meeting the multi-objective optimization condition from the candidate path sets, carrying out simulation evaluation on the candidate path sets, and determining an optimal path according to simulation results. Compared with the traditional static path planning method, the method and the system remarkably improve the response capability of the traffic system to weather disasters and provide predictive navigation service for intelligent network vehicles.

title_en: Geological disaster vulnerability evaluation method and system based on sample enhancement
abstract_en: Collecting original disaster sample data, and performing space expansion on a positive sample by analyzing the space characteristics of a disaster influence range to generate a new enhanced sample set; the method comprises the steps of introducing contribution degree of an influence factor as a weight coefficient, respectively calculating weighted cosine similarity between an extended sample and an original positive sample, constructing a credibility evaluation index based on a weighted cosine similarity result, screening samples according to a preset credibility threshold, training XGBoost a model by using the screened samples, and applying the trained model to a target research area. The system comprises a sample enhancement module, a model training module and a model application module. By using the method, the accuracy and the reliability of geological disaster susceptibility evaluation are effectively improved. The method can be widely applied to the disaster prediction field.

title_en: Ocean disaster bearing detection method based on candidate region rescreening mechanism under small sample
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of remote sensing, in particular to a marine disaster-bearing detection method based on a candidate region rescreening mechanism under a small sample, which comprises the steps of constructing a small sample target detection network based on an improved Meta R-CNN, adding a false mark self-adaptive relieving module, a double-stage sampling module and a weighted nonlinear aggregation module between a region proposal network and a detection head of the small sample, wherein model training comprises two stages, namely calculating the similarity distance between an ROI query feature and a support type prototype feature through the false mark self-adaptive relieving module, screening false mark samples and configuring weights to determine a positive sample, regulating an aggregation strategy by the double-stage sampling module according to training progress, and calculating an attention weighting matrix and weighting the support type prototype feature by the weighted nonlinear aggregation module to obtain an aggregation feature input detection head identification detection frame. And repeating training to a preset condition to obtain a model for detecting the target of the small sample. The method solves the problem of small sample scenes, and greatly improves the accuracy and reliability of ocean disaster bearing body detection.

title_en: Dangerous chemical transportation three-dimensional space positioning tracking and emergency response method and system based on photogrammetry and Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical transportation three-dimensional space positioning tracking and emergency response method and system based on photogrammetry and Beidou positioning, which belong to the technical field of dangerous chemical transportation safety monitoring and control and comprise the steps of constructing a three-dimensional grid model based on collected photogrammetry data, beidou positioning data and environment data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out anomaly detection on dangerous chemical transportation images in photogrammetric data by adopting an improved YOLOv model to obtain an anomaly detection result, carrying out dynamic risk assessment by adopting a fuzzy logic algorithm based on the anomaly detection result and combining a three-dimensional grid model and a CFD fluid diffusion simulation method, triggering emergency response for a high risk event after the dynamic risk assessment, and updating an improved YOLOv model by adopting incremental learning for a medium and low risk event after the dynamic risk assessment. The invention realizes high-precision positioning and dynamic modeling, improves the accuracy of small target detection, and solves the problem of insufficient real-time performance and synergy of emergency response.

title_en: Mining earthquake risk main control factor analysis method based on rock stratum macro-micro numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method of mine earthquake risk main control factors based on rock stratum macro-micro numerical simulation, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting rock samples and testing to obtain micro rock mechanical parameters, then constructing a standard sample model based on discrete element numerical analysis software, carrying out non-homogeneity parametrization on the standard sample model by utilizing Weibull functions and fractal dimension and the micro rock mechanical parameters to realize accurate matching of rock mass micro-macro mechanical characteristics, converting the micro rock mechanical parameters into macro rock mechanical parameters for discrete element analysis through rock quality index and rock mass strength conversion relation to realize high-fidelity reconstruction of the discrete element macro model, and carrying out orthogonal test and extremely poor analysis to quantify the macro non-homogeneity main control factors to realize priority sequencing of the macro non-homogeneity main control factors serving as key disaster causing factors. The method can simulate the rock stratum under the heterogeneous condition, so that the result is attached to the actual rock stratum condition, and data support is provided for subsequent rock stratum mining risk prevention and control treatment.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;INNER MONGOLIA YITAI COAL CO LTD;UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Automatic measurement method, system, equipment and storage medium for classifying degree of rotary drum experimental rock based on visual identification
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for automatically measuring the sorting degree of ice rock in a drum experiment based on visual identification, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation and test. According to the application, the ice particle area ratio is used as the sorting degree index for the first time, and a standardized calculation model with continuous change between 0 and 1 is established, so that the method has clear physical meaning and stable mathematical characteristics. Compared with the traditional mode of relying on indirect indexes such as centroid position change, the bottleneck that the experiment can not accurately measure and extract particle information is effectively solved, the index not only has clearer physical meaning and statistical stability, but also can accurately calculate the sorting degree index in real time, and the experiment adaptability is remarkably improved.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV TSINGHUA;UNIV CHONGQING JIAOTONG

title_en: Software development stability testing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of software development testing, in particular to a software development stability testing method; S1, verifying state migration stability and boundary condition reliability of a core security function of an internet security service system under normal load, abnormal input and configuration dynamic change scenes. According to the invention, an attack and service load superposition scene is simulated through an ATT & CK framework, the influence of security protection on service SLA is quantized, the stability of the system in an attack and defense environment is ensured, three-level fault injection and disaster recovery verification across an available area are realized based on a Kubernetes cloud native architecture, and the automatic detection, switching reliability and data consistency of the system in a multi-level fault are ensured, so that the toughness and service continuity of the system in a security threat and sudden fault scene are improved.
assignees: HEFEI SHENGDONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traceable lightweight design method for fire-extinguishing protective clothing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire protection, and discloses a traceable lightweight design method of fire protection clothing, which comprises the following steps of: the method comprises the steps of carrying out muscle group partition analysis on human physiological data of a firefighter to obtain a human muscle group load distribution map, constructing a human body load holographic model based on the human muscle group load distribution map, constructing a combat activity load network based on combat environment data and the human body load holographic model, carrying out high-temperature fire scene environment simulation on the human body load holographic model, generating protective performance demand data based on simulation results, carrying out protective material adaptation analysis and combination optimization on the combat activity load network by utilizing the protective performance demand data to obtain a material layered configuration scheme, carrying out comprehensive evaluation and light weight index verification on the material layered configuration scheme to generate a final fire-extinguishing protective clothing design scheme and traceable data file.

title_en: Urban flood area identification and depth calculation method based on Mask R-CNN model and AAMED algorithm
abstract_en: The application provides a city flood area identification and depth calculation method based on a Mask R-CNN model and AAMED algorithm, which comprises the steps of data material acquisition, construction and training of an improved Mask R-CNN model, flood area and wheel detection based on the improved Mask R-CNN model, wheel ellipse fitting and parameter extraction based on AAMED algorithm, and ponding depth calculation and result output. The result shows that MaskR-CNN has 90.69 percent of recognition accuracy on the ponding region. In confusion matrix analysis, the recognition accuracy of the model on the water accumulation area and the non-water accumulation area is 93.53 percent. The depth calculation model provided by the application has the positioning accuracy of 96.12% on the wheels and the segmentation accuracy of 96.58%. The field proportion of the absolute error between the calculated depth of the model and the observed water level is smaller than 2cm and exceeds 80 percent. The improved ponding area recognition model has good recognition performance. The method is helpful for identifying the flood area and measuring the water level in time, thereby providing reference for urban flood early warning and disaster prevention control.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Emergency rescue decision-making system for simulating mine water disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue decision-making system for simulating mine water disaster, which relates to the technical field of simulation, and comprises a data acquisition module, a model building module, a monitoring module, an analysis module, a decision-making module, a database and an early warning terminal, wherein a roadway model and a mine water penetration and spreading model are constructed according to all information in a mine, all hydrogeological data of all key areas in the mine are acquired in real time, judging the possibility of water damage in the mine, if the possibility is high, analyzing each water damage occurrence point and the escape route of workers, simulating the water damage by using a mine water permeable spreading model, and making a rescue route according to the simulation result and the escape route of the workers, so that the rescue time is increased, the instantaneity of each data and the effectiveness of the rescue route are ensured, and the success rate of rescue is improved.
assignees: XIAN LINGRUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground coal mine area detection system and method based on simultaneous detection of multiple measuring points
abstract_en: The application discloses a coal mine underground area detection system and method based on simultaneous detection of multiple measuring points, wherein the system comprises multiple groups of sensors and a data collection and analysis device, each group of sensors comprises a transmitting sensor and a receiving sensor, each sensor is correspondingly arranged in a drilling hole of an area to be detected and is connected with the data collection and analysis device through a connecting wire, and the data collection and analysis device is used for carrying out CT inversion on signal waves received by each receiving sensor for the first time, preliminarily judging whether disaster areas exist in all directions around the area to be detected, carrying out collaborative analysis operation according to the signal waves received by each receiving sensor again after the positions are adjusted, and determining disaster types and spatial position coordinates of the disaster areas. According to the system, through joint monitoring and verification among a plurality of measuring points through each group of sensors, the disaster type and the disaster position coordinates can be accurately determined, and the safety of underground operation is improved.
assignees: HUATING COAL GROUP CO LTD;CCTEG COAL MINING RES INST CO LTD;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for simulating sediment migration of salt cavern storage under multi-factor coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for simulating sediment migration of a salt cavern reservoir under the action of multi-factor coupling, wherein the device comprises a salt cavern simulation system, a multi-mode gas injection system and a particle image velocimetry system, wherein the salt cavern simulation system comprises a simulated gas injection cavity and a simulated halogen discharge cavity, the bottoms of the simulated gas injection cavity and the simulated halogen discharge cavity are connected through a communication channel, the multi-mode gas injection system is connected with the simulated gas injection cavity and comprises at least two gas sources which can be controlled independently and can be used for injecting gas sequentially or in a mixed mode, the brine circulation system is connected with the simulated halogen discharge cavity, a stratum dip angle simulation mechanism is used for fixing the salt cavern simulation system and adjusting a dip angle, a programmable earthquake vibration can be applied to an earthquake simulation vibration table, the pressure balance compensation system is connected with gas phase spaces at the tops of the two cavities, and the gas is automatically compensated when the pressure difference exceeds a threshold value. The invention integrates a plurality of key factors influencing sediment migration, can simulate injection and production operation, introduces dimensions such as gas components, geological forms, safe operation, disaster load and the like, and improves the fidelity of simulation experiments.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Dynamic resource scheduling method and system for post-disaster emergency repair of highway
abstract_en: The invention relates to a resource dynamic scheduling method and a system for post-highway disaster emergency repair, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency repair information, inputting the emergency repair information into a double-layer optimization model to obtain an optimal global scheduling strategy, wherein the double-layer optimization model comprises an upper-layer global strategy optimization sub-model and a lower-layer loading and unloading plan dynamic optimization sub-model, the upper-layer global strategy optimization sub-model is used for generating a candidate global scheduling strategy according to the emergency repair information and iteratively evolving a population according to the adaptability of the candidate global scheduling strategy to obtain the optimal global scheduling strategy, and the lower-layer loading and unloading plan dynamic optimization sub-model is used for executing specific driving path planning according to the candidate global scheduling strategy and carrying out simulation optimization and evaluation on loading and unloading plans to obtain the total driving time and the global scheduling performance penalty of a vehicle of the candidate global scheduling strategy and returning the vehicle total driving time and the global scheduling performance penalty as a fitness value to the upper-layer global strategy optimization sub-model. Compared with the prior art, the scheduling method and the scheduling device have the advantages that scheduling efficiency and adaptability are remarkably improved.

title_en: Enteromorpha green tide refined drift prediction method considering barrier blocking effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enteromorpha green tide refined drift prediction method considering barrier blocking effect, and belongs to the field of enteromorpha green tide drift prediction methods. The method comprises the steps of a, selecting a forecasting area, obtaining obstacle distribution conditions and environment elements in the forecasting area, b, obtaining historical satellite remote sensing images of the forecasting area, obtaining the distribution position, the shape and the coverage area of green tide of the enteromorpha based on the satellite remote sensing images, c, constructing an enteromorpha green tide refined drift forecasting model considering the obstacle blocking effect, d, training the constructed enteromorpha green tide refined drift forecasting model considering the obstacle blocking effect, e, determining the distribution position of the enteromorpha green tide as an initial drift position through the satellite remote sensing images, adopting the trained refined drift forecasting model, carrying out drift forecasting, and obtaining the green tide particle positions of the enteromorpha at different moments. The method can provide accurate drift early warning results for raft culture areas and disaster important protection areas.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Disaster rainfall monitoring method based on Internet of things signal transmission effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disastrous rainfall monitoring method based on an Internet of things signal transmission effect, which comprises the steps of constructing a signal characteristic matrix by utilizing signal parameters of an Internet of things terminal acquired by a communication base station, dividing rainfall grade matrixes for reference rainfall data acquired by auxiliary rainfall monitoring equipment, constructing a training set and a testing set based on the signal characteristic matrix and the rainfall grade matrixes, training a machine learning model by utilizing the training set to acquire a rainfall intensity grade estimation model, inputting signal characteristics in the testing set into the rainfall intensity grade estimation model to acquire a rainfall grade estimation result, and performing spatial interpolation processing on the rainfall grade estimation result to acquire regional rainfall intensity grade distribution data. The method and the device fully utilize the attenuation effect of rainfall on the communication link signals of the cellular Internet of things, can realize rainfall monitoring with large range and high space-time resolution, and can be applied to disaster early warning scenes such as urban waterlogging, mountain area debris flows and the like.

title_en: Pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster preventive island division method and system for a constrained spectrum clustering power transmission system, which are used for acquiring power grid data comprising grid frame data, unit parameters, load data and typhoon path parameters, and calculating the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons by adopting a Holland wind field model based on the acquired power grid data And Holland B parameters Then calculating the wind speed of each node of the power grid, and obtaining the maximum wind speed radius of typhoons The method comprises the steps of calculating the fault probability of a power transmission line and a tower by wind speed of each node of a power grid, simulating cascading faults caused by single line faults to generate a high-probability fault scene set, calculating a risk index RI, carrying out fuzzy classification, outputting a risk grade, and executing preventive island division when the risk grade exceeds a set threshold value. Three cascade control of data-driven evaluation, dynamic risk decision-constrained spectral clustering isolation is adopted, so that the technical pain points of pre-disaster defense deficiency and island division rough in extreme weather are overcome, and core support is provided for the elastic power grid.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for distributing building water retaining measures under typhoon flood in long-period regional scale
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distributing building water retaining measures under typhoon flood with long period area scale, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon rainfall model of a research area to obtain a typhoon rainfall event library with a perpetual scale, constructing a training data set required by a typhoon rainfall-waterlogging maximum inundation proxy model, constructing the typhoon rainfall-waterlogging maximum inundation proxy model fusing a convolutional neural network and a gate control circulation unit, determining urban building water retaining measure types and cost benefit parameters, extracting all events with reproduction periods smaller than a decision threshold, establishing an optimization model of an area scale measure planning decision problem, expanding multi-objective optimization of minimum loss and minimum cost, solving the optimization model of the area scale measure planning decision problem to obtain a combined optimization solution of area disaster reduction measures, and making disaster reduction planning according to actual conditions. The invention realizes the cost-benefit optimization of different disaster reduction measure combinations in the regional scale, and provides scientific basis and decision support for the configuration of pre-disaster waterlogging prevention measures.

title_en: High-resolution low-air-image risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution low-meteorological risk early warning method, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and comprises the following components of S1, a data acquisition and preprocessing step, S2, a multi-disaster correlation model building and training step, S3, a high-resolution grid risk calculation step, S4, a risk assessment and grading step, and S5, a linkage early warning release and dynamic updating step; according to the invention, by combining historical disaster data and real-time data, a correlation model of low weather risk and geological disasters and flood disasters and multiple disasters is constructed, linkage early warning of multiple disasters is realized, meanwhile, the correlation model of multiple disasters is dynamically updated and optimized by continuously collecting data in real time, the risk value and the early warning level of a grid unit are timely adjusted according to a new calculation result, and latest early warning information is issued.
assignees: CHONGQING YUNJI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation analysis method for wind-induced response of tree
abstract_en: The application provides an evaluation analysis method of tree wind-induced response, which relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction engineering, and comprises the steps of constructing a geometric model aiming at a target tree; performing CFD simulation based on a geometric model to obtain wind pressure time course data and crown load data of branch CFD grid points under different wind field conditions, performing finite element mesh division on the geometric model to construct a finite element model, wherein the mesh unit type comprises hexahedron units, tetrahedron units and wedge units, mapping the branch wind pressure time course data and crown load data to the surface of the finite element model, performing structural finite element analysis to obtain cloud image data of the change of stress and displacement of a target tree with time under different wind field conditions, and performing wind response analysis and wind resistance performance evaluation of the target tree based on the cloud image data and tree wind-induced damage judgment criteria. The technical scheme of the application can provide scientific basis for solving the response behavior of the target tree under the strong wind condition.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING FORESTRY;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Indoor escape route optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning, in particular to an indoor escape route optimization method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a layered road network model, receiving monitoring data of the Internet of things to conduct danger diffusion simulation and predict danger areas when danger occurs, acquiring crowd distribution information by combining a camera and a Wi-Fi probe to obtain a predicted personnel distribution map in a preset time zone, conducting escape route optimization in the preset time zone according to the predicted danger areas and the predicted personnel distribution map by utilizing the layered road network model, outputting an optimal escape scheme, respectively sending a plurality of optimal escape routes to a plurality of associated escape personnel through equipment terminals, and executing route dynamic update according to danger sensing data until personnel evacuation is completed. The optimal escape scheme suitable for different dangerous scenes and personnel distribution conditions can be rapidly and accurately planned.
assignees: HEBEI BRANCH OF CHINA TOWER CORPORATION LTD

title_en: SSA-SVM algorithm-based coal-rock power damage multi-parameter early warning method
abstract_en: A coal rock power damage multi-parameter early warning method based on an SSA-SVM algorithm comprises the following steps of (1) selecting a coal rock sample needing early warning, collecting acoustic emission signals in the process of coal rock sample power damage, (2) extracting time-frequency domain characteristic information of the acoustic emission signals to obtain 10 acoustic emission indexes and evolution rules, (3) carrying out normalization treatment, (4) repeating the steps (1) - (3), carrying out coal rock tests with not less than 50 pieces to carry out tests, selecting acoustic emission indexes with success rates greater than a preset percentage threshold, (5) constructing a feature matrix, dividing training subsets and verifying subsets, (6) constructing an SVM regression model framework, (7) optimizing a punishment factor c and a parameter g of a radial basis kernel function by using a sparrow search algorithm, determining an optimal super-parameter combination by cross verification, and (8) predicting future time energy changes by using a prediction model, so that coal rock power disaster early warning can be realized. The invention improves the early warning accuracy.

title_en: Rail transit junction emergency regulation and control method and system based on real-time simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail transit junction emergency control method and system based on real-time simulation, which relate to the technical field of intelligent transportation and rail transit emergency management and comprise the steps of performing time synchronization processing on real-time passenger flow data and train running state data to generate a junction state data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-level simulation model, simulating a passenger flow distribution evolution process by presetting passenger flow evacuation behaviors and train operation constraint conditions, positioning capacity limiting nodes in each evacuation path based on an output result of the multi-level simulation model by adopting a bottleneck recognition algorithm, calculating passenger flow bearing capacity, generating optimal path regulation parameters aiming at shortest evacuation time, converting the optimal path regulation parameters into a train automatic control system instruction and a passenger flow guiding display instruction, and transmitting the train automatic control system instruction and the passenger flow guiding display instruction to each line control unit by a hub centralized dispatching system to regulate train operation frequency and passenger flow evacuation direction. The invention realizes the intellectualization and the coordination of the emergency control of the rail transit junction.
assignees: JIANGSU TIANKUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar echo extrapolation method and system based on frequency domain enhancement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar echo extrapolation method and system based on frequency domain enhancement, the method mainly comprises the following steps of obtaining a historical radar echo gray level image sequence and preprocessing, generating sequence samples by adopting a sliding window, dividing the sequence samples into a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing a frequency domain enhancement U-Net network comprising an encoder-decoder structure, introducing a multi-scale depth convolution structure into the encoder and the decoder, enhancing frequency domain characteristics by using a frequency domain dynamic attention mechanism in jump connection, adopting a composite loss function comprising intensity weighting loss, frequency domain consistency loss and structural similarity loss, training a training set input model, inputting the test set into the trained model, and outputting radar echo prediction results at future time. The method can be effectively applied to the fields of short-term weather forecast, strong convection monitoring and the like, and provides more accurate and reliable radar echo prediction support for weather disaster early warning.

title_en: Modularized three-section type rock debris flow test device and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized three-section type rock debris flow test device and a test method thereof, belonging to the field of geological disaster simulation test devices, wherein the test device comprises a modularized chute system, a closed-loop temperature control chamber system, a circulating water supply and tailing treatment system, a multi-dimensional monitoring system and a machine vision recording system, the method has the advantages that repeated start-stop and staged stacking behaviors of the rock debris flow are reproduced in an indoor test, stacking space distribution characteristics of the rock debris flow in a real trough and internal structure characteristics of a stacking body are reproduced, the movement, stacking, energy dissipation and phase change processes of the rock debris flow in a real terrain can be simulated with high precision, and technical defects of a traditional one-stage or two-stage model in terms of terrain simplification, friction simulation, stacking morphology and climate coupling are overcome.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Evaluation method and system for influence of volcanic ash on urban air quality
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating influence of volcanic ash on urban air quality, which relate to the technical field of environmental atmospheric pollutant evaluation and volcanic disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking sulfate concentration in particulate matters as a key index, the influence period is automatically judged by acquiring air quality monitoring data before, during and after volcanic eruption and combining with a dynamic threshold value, and the influence range is predicted by simulating the volcanic ash diffusion path and concentration distribution by using an atmospheric diffusion model. Generating a visual geographic information map through Kerling spatial interpolation, and calculating characteristic indexes (sulfate/ Concentration ratio) to perform site influence grading, and calculating region comprehensive influence indexes by combining population density and other weights to realize high, medium and low influence grading. The invention can accurately quantify the contribution degree of volcanic eruption to urban air quality, and provides scientific basis for air quality early warning and prevention and control.

title_en: Early warning method and terminal for geological disaster risk along railway
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-warning method and a terminal for geological disaster risks along a railway, which are used for acquiring historical geological disaster data occurring along the railway and collecting rainfall data in a corresponding time period, constructing a sample set based on the historical geological disaster data and the rainfall data, determining optimal rainfall effective days and attenuation coefficients based on the sample set by taking F1 scores as evaluation indexes, calculating and obtaining effective rainfall according to the optimal rainfall effective days and the attenuation coefficients, at least taking the effective rainfall and the rainfall data as input, taking the occurrence probability of the geological disaster as output, training a logistic regression model, acquiring real-time rainfall data, calculating the effective rainfall corresponding to the real-time rainfall data, and generating the occurrence probability of the geological disaster of each section along the railway based on the trained logistic regression model. The invention considers the accumulation effect of early rainfall and combines the change characteristic of real-time rainfall, thereby improving the scientificity and reliability of the early warning result.
assignees: FUJIAN METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER FUJIAN METEOROLOGICAL FILM AND TELEVISION CENTER

title_en: Disaster protection method and system based on mining side slope
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster protection method and system based on a mining side slope, wherein the disaster protection method comprises the steps of determining a geomechanical model of the target mining side slope, determining a goaf geometrical parameter and a goaf overburden collapse characteristic parameter, analyzing a side slope damage mode under the goaf mining influence by the geomechanical model to obtain a stability coefficient of the target mining side slope, and determining a filling range parameter and a filling slurry design parameter of the goaf according to the stability coefficient. The slope damage mode of the slope under different mining conditions is simulated through the geomechanical model of the target mining slope, and compared with a single parameter evaluation mode, the obtained stability coefficient is more accurate. The filling range of the goaf and the design parameters of the filling slurry are determined according to the stability coefficient, so that the filling range of the goaf and the performance of the filling slurry can be matched with the actual stability requirement of the side slope, and the problem of geological disasters of the mining side slope can be effectively solved.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT TECH CO LTD;CCTEG XINRONG TECH INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;CCTEG CYCLE INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method based on AI and digital twin
abstract_en: The application provides an AI and digital twin-based multi-source data disaster prediction and simulation method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency management and comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data through an edge computing node to output a standardized data set; the method comprises the steps of generating a disaster prediction result through an AI disaster prediction model based on a standardized data set, combining the disaster prediction result with a digital twin model to form a disaster simulation, generating a rescue scheme report based on the disaster prediction result and the disaster simulation, and analyzing the rescue scheme report to form an optimal scheme.

title_en: Intelligent access control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of access control, in particular to an intelligent access control system which comprises a multi-mode sensor group, a data processing module, a model judging module and an execution output module, wherein the multi-mode sensor group is used for collecting multi-dimensional data when a user passes through, the data processing module is used for carrying out feature extraction and preprocessing on the multi-dimensional data to generate structural features, the model judging module is internally provided with a pre-training identity verification model and a pre-training stress state detection model and is respectively used for analyzing the structural features to output an identity matching score and a stress risk score, and the execution output module is used for executing access control operation according to the identity matching score and the stress risk score. The problem that the traditional intelligent access control system relies on single biological characteristics to cause low authentication accuracy in a shielding scene is solved, and security holes which cannot be identified in a concealed mode and trigger emergency response when being stressed are overcome.
assignees: FUJIAN LAIFU ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood toughness assessment method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood toughness assessment method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining hydrological data of an area to be assessed and geographic information data of urban space form factor layers, setting boundary conditions of a plurality of flood scenes according to the hydrological data, constructing a multi-scene urban flood disaster simulation model by combining the geographic information data, respectively generating flood depth data of the urban space form factor layers of the flood scenes, and calculating a first toughness index, a second toughness index and a third toughness index of each flood scene so as to calculate a flood toughness comprehensive assessment result of each flood scene of the area to be assessed. According to the invention, an evaluation system of various composite flood disaster situations is established, different disaster factors and interaction thereof are comprehensively considered, and the effect of key space parameters in urban flood toughness is fully considered, so that the capability of the urban to cope with the flood disasters can be evaluated more comprehensively and accurately.

title_en: Half-resolution MPM-DEM coupling numerical simulation method for interaction of debris flow and structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a half-resolution MPM-DEM coupling numerical simulation method for interaction of debris flow and a structure, which relates to the field of geotechnical engineering disaster simulation. The synchronous solution of fluid-solid multiphase coupling is realized through the grid-particle information exchange and the bidirectional transmission of the particle-grid coupling force. And the flow-solid contact force adopts a semi-analytic mode, and the DEM particles-wall contact are accurately calculated based on a Hertz-Mindlin model. The method truly reproduces the cooperative collision, blockage and impact mechanism of the block stone and the drift wood in the debris flow, and simulates the three-dimensional large-scale situation of millions of fluid particles and tens of thousands of particles. The simulation result can output key indexes such as stress time course, impact peak value, blocking rate and the like of the structure, and provides a reliable numerical basis for debris flow protection.

title_en: River sediment flushing simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river sediment flushing and dredging simulation method, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and hydrologic simulation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water-sand coupling mathematical model based on actual measurement topographic data and channel map data of a target river reach and adopting a non-uniform sand unbalance sand conveying theory, calibrating a verification model through a hydrodynamic module and a wave module which interact with each other in real time through an MCT coupler, obtaining actual measurement flood and water-sand series data, acquiring future water-sand process data predicted by a plurality of climate modes, inputting the future water-sand process data into the verification model, dividing the river reach according to characteristics such as gradient of a river bed and curvature of the river, and calculating impulse of each sub-river reach within 50 years in the future. The method can simulate the movement of water flow and sediment in river channels, reservoirs and lakes, can be applied to the fields of river channel remediation planning, flood control and disaster reduction decision, reasonable development and utilization of water resources and the like, and provides important data support and scientific basis for hydraulic engineering construction and management.

title_en: Future time phase forest fire smoke simulation method and system based on satellite remote sensing image space-time fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite remote sensing image space-time fusion-based future time-phase forest fire smoke simulation method and system, which are used for fusing Himawari-8/9 images and GF-4 images to generate fused images with high time resolution and high spatial resolution, and constructing a future time-phase forest fire smoke simulation model (A-Conv-LSTM) which introduces a space-time attention mechanism to realize dynamic simulation of the future time-phase forest fire smoke. The invention dynamically simulates the characteristics of spatial distribution, concentration, drifting direction and the like of the forest fire smoke in the future time phase by utilizing the fused image sequence of Himawari-8/9 images and GF-4 images, and provides important basis for the research and judgment of the forest fire development situation, the early dispatching of the suppressing force, the avoidance of risks by firefighters and the like.

title_en: Coal mine water damage early warning system based on four pre-frameworks
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine water disaster early warning system based on a four-pre-framework, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine water disaster monitoring and early warning, and comprises a water disaster forecasting module, a water disaster early warning module, a water disaster forecasting module and a water disaster forecasting plan module, wherein the water disaster forecasting module is used for collecting water disaster monitoring data, forecasting water level data of water inflow and long-term holes and giving out water disaster assessment forecasting results, the water disaster early warning module carries out single-factor early warning on all collected indexes and decomposes multi-factor coupling problems to realize multi-factor early warning, the water disaster forecasting module carries out simulation on water disaster avoiding route planning and groundwater migration simulation based on the early warning results, and the water disaster forecasting module carries out drainage linkage and emergency rescue implementation on the forecasting results, evaluates and evaluates the forecasting plan and optimizes key areas and early warning thresholds of monitoring and forecasting.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Mining area watering cart running control method based on animal avoidance real-time re-planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area watering cart running control method based on real-time re-planning of animal avoidance, which realizes intelligent obstacle avoidance through multi-mode sensor fusion detection, target recognition of deep learning driving, three-dimensional dynamic path planning, a multi-stage acousto-optic early warning system and self-adaptive speed adjustment, and shortens detection response time and reduces false alarm rate by adopting a radar, a camera, a bionic compound eye vision module and the like. Constraint conditions such as terrain gradient and soil humidity are integrated through an RRT algorithm, continuous processing of path curvature is achieved, the sprinkler can complete path reconstruction without stopping completely under an animal sudden-prevention scene, a hierarchical early warning mechanism triggers three-level acousto-optic warning according to animal approaching degree, a dynamic speed regulation model is matched, and continuity of spraying operation is guaranteed while safety margin is guaranteed. According to the mining area complex environment operation safety and operation efficiency are remarkably improved through the environment interference compensation, the geological disaster early warning interface and the driver behavior simulation unit.
assignees: BEIJING LUKAI ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large language model earthquake-proof report examination method and device based on field knowledge enhancement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large language models, in particular to a large language model earthquake-proof report examination method and device based on field knowledge enhancement, and provides a large language model earthquake-proof report examination method based on field knowledge enhancement, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a large language model in the building earthquake-proof professional field, then training the large language model in the building earthquake-proof professional field, then preprocessing data of an earthquake-proof examination report, finally examining based on the trained large language model in the building earthquake-proof professional field, thus, the accumulated earthquake-proof special examination experience is fused with the large language model, the professional LLM in the vertical field is built, strict examination can be carried out by contrasting the standard and the file, the interference of human errors and subjective factors is effectively avoided, the accuracy and the reliability of examination results are improved, the examination efficiency is improved, more scientific and accurate basis is provided for expert examination and internal pre-examination, the earthquake-proof and disaster-proof capability of construction engineering is further improved, and the earthquake disaster risk is reduced.

title_en: Large-section tunnel blasting vibration monitoring system
