abstract_en: The invention provides a large-section tunnel blasting vibration monitoring system, which relates to the technical field of tunnel blasting monitoring and comprises the steps of identifying a large-section structure of a regional target tunnel through a remote sensing technology, constructing a first data set, acquiring parameters of target tunnel supporting equipment, constructing a second data set, constructing a prediction model through a convolutional neural network, and predicting a tunnel inner wall damage coefficient D  i  and a supporting equipment damage coefficient generated by blasting vibration of an ith region Further acquiring soil parameters of a jth region covered on the target tunnel outside the target tunnel, which corresponds to the ith region of the target tunnel, and constructing a soil damage coefficient of the jth region covered on the outside of the target tunnel And constructing a soil damage coefficient calculation model, so as to simulate and evaluate the stability risk of the 5m covered soil layer outside the tunnel, and be beneficial to early warning disasters such as landslide, collapse and the like caused by blasting.
assignees: NO THREE ENG CO LTD OF CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENG CO LTD;CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD;RAIL TRANSIT BRANCH OF CHINA COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium for main-distribution network
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster prevention strategy determination method, device, equipment and medium of a main-distribution network, relating to the technical field of power system elasticity evaluation and comprising the steps of determining a target topology model of a system based on a preset island balance strategy and topology information of the main network and the distribution network in a power system with the cooperation of the main-distribution network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out random fault scene generation based on a preset improved Monte Carlo algorithm, carrying out trend analysis and cascading fault simulation analysis of a fault scene based on a fault generation result and a target topology model, analyzing fault coupling conditions of a main-distribution network based on a fault scene analysis result, a system collapse threshold and a seepage theory, determining a critical threshold curve in a two-dimensional failure space, and determining a criticality index corresponding to each component in the main-distribution network and a comprehensive toughness evaluation index of the system based on the critical threshold curve to determine a target disaster prevention strategy. The application can identify critical conditions of the cooperative failure of the main-distribution network and identify weak links of the system, thereby enhancing the resistance of the system.
assignees: STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO;INST ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCES STATE GRID CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rock dynamic shear failure simulation method and equipment considering friction contact
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock dynamic shear failure simulation method and equipment considering friction contact, which comprises the steps of calculating a stress tensor and a fourth-order elastic modulus matrix according to a rock material elastic constitutive relation, establishing a crack surface local coordinate system based on a maximum shear stress criterion, determining normal and tangential unit vectors, introducing a crack density function and a corresponding degradation function of a cohesive force phase field model to eliminate the influence of a phase field characteristic length, deducing a dynamic shear phase field model energy functional, judging a contact state according to the crack surface normal strain, deducing strong forms of a displacement field control equation and a phase field control equation, carrying out variation treatment on the strong forms of the displacement field control equation and the phase field control equation to obtain corresponding weak forms, and realizing rock dynamic shear failure simulation considering friction contact based on the weak forms to support rock stability assessment in geological disaster prevention and control. The model of the invention is insensitive to the characteristic length of the phase field, and the simulation result is more reliable.

title_en: Environment-adaptive corn emasculation period disease and pest green prevention and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and green plant protection, and discloses a system and a method for controlling plant diseases and insect pests in a corn emasculation period based on environmental adaptation, wherein the control system comprises an environmental simulation unit, a plant diseases and insect pests simulation database, a predictive analysis module, an early warning decision module and an acquisition unit, according to the invention, by constructing a nonlinear mapping model of five-dimensional environment vectors (temperature, humidity, illumination intensity, rainfall and wind speed) and pest activities and adopting multiple regression analysis and Monte Carlo simulation, pest occurrence probability distribution under different climatic situations is generated, the limitation of a single threshold model is effectively overcome, and the prediction reliability under a complex environment is obviously enhanced; the method can early warn the outbreak risk of the plant diseases and insect pests by 72 hours in advance, reduce disaster loss by at least 30%, reduce the dosage of chemical pesticides by more than 40% through a grading green prevention and control strategy, and protect the biological diversity of farmlands and the ecological health of soil.
assignees: CANGZHOU ACAD OF AGRICULTURE AND FORESTRY SCIENCES

title_en: Cable bridge rapid fire extinguishing method based on superfine dry powder extinguishing agent
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable bridge rapid fire extinguishing method based on an ultrafine dry powder extinguishing agent, which comprises the steps of judging fire disaster by monitoring temperature and smoke data, adjusting the particle composition of the extinguishing agent by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and optimizing injection parameters and a structural integration scheme. And by combining special environmental factors, the behavior of dry powder particles is simulated, a distributed system architecture is constructed, and fire positioning and resource coordination are realized. And simulating a dry powder deposition rule, improving a cleaning process, integrating linkage control logic into an intelligent system, monitoring a storage environment, predicting performance attenuation, circularly optimizing a fire extinguishing process, and realizing quick fire extinguishing and long-term standby. The invention obviously improves the fire prevention and control efficiency and recovery speed of the cable bridge.
assignees: PROPERTY BRANCH OF HUAIBEI MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events, in particular relates to the triage training field, and aims to solve the problem that the existing triage training is lack of pertinence. The method comprises the steps of searching a history record of an emergency public event through a tree construction module, constructing a triage strategy time sequence tree, marking response bias factors through a bias recognition module, constructing a bias path library, converting the bias factors into interference options in a simulation training process through an interference generation module, setting interference induction weight and time compression parameters of the interference options through an interference setting module, collecting training object response data through a dead zone recognition module, constructing a bias trend intensity curve, recognizing triage bias dead zones, and finally using the recognized bias dead zones as key targets of a current training period through a bias training module to carry out training. The system can realize intelligent identification and targeted training of diagnosis-dividing cognition weak links, and improves accuracy and timeliness of diagnosis-dividing emergency response.

title_en: Urban subway network toughness pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-disaster-post-disaster double-stage optimization method for toughness of an urban subway network under a flood disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining urban subway network information, road network information and flood disaster information, constructing an urban subway topological network and a road topological network, simulating flood depth space-time changes in the subway and the road network during the duration of the flood disaster, judging a subway network failure station set based on water accumulation depth, calculating flood control resource demand based on the number of stations, the types of the stations and the flood depth of each station in the failure station set, establishing and solving a pre-disaster-post double-stage optimization model for toughness of the urban subway network to obtain an optimal pre-disaster closing station decision, a flood control resource warehouse site selection decision and a post-disaster restoration decision, wherein the double-stage optimization model is a double-layer planning model, and an upper-layer model and a lower-layer model are mutually coupled and optimized through a pre-disaster closing station set and a post-disaster restoration process.

title_en: Intelligent feedback type tunnel catastrophe monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of tunnel catastrophe, in particular to an intelligent feedback type tunnel catastrophe monitoring method, which comprises the steps of firstly, deploying a tunnel monitoring system; the tunnel is internally provided with a temperature sensor, a smoke sensor, an air flow rate sensor and a gas concentration sensor, and the temperature sensor is used for monitoring the temperature change in the tunnel. According to the intelligent feedback type tunnel disaster monitoring method, the safety and the emergency response capability of the tunnel are effectively improved through a real-time data monitoring, analyzing and automatic control mechanism. First, with temperature, smoke, gas concentration and air flow rate sensors, the system is able to detect and identify potential catastrophic risks within the tunnel in time, such as fire, smoke diffusion and harmful gas leakage. Once abnormality occurs, the system predicts catastrophe through an algorithm model, and combines simulation analysis results to accurately evaluate the propagation path of fire and the diffusion of smoke, thereby providing reliable data support for quick response.
assignees: China railway tunnel group co ltd;GUANGZHOU NANSHA NEW DISTR MINGZHUWAN DEVELOPMENT CONSTRUCTION ADMINISTRATION;SANCHU CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY TUNNEL GROUP

title_en: Gas-liquid collaborative fire extinguishing simulation device and method for transformer oil tank of converter station
abstract_en: The application discloses a gas-liquid collaborative fire extinguishing simulation device for a transformer tank of a converter station, which comprises a tank body, wherein a plurality of windings are arranged in the tank body, the bottoms of the windings are arranged on a lifting base table, a heating member is arranged in the tank body, an adjustable split is arranged at the top of the tank body, a multi-mode fire extinguishing assembly is arranged outside the tank body, and a gas-liquid fire extinguishing agent is led into the tank body from the split by the multi-mode fire extinguishing assembly. According to the application, the temperature rising member is arranged in the box body, the gap with adjustable size is arranged at the top of the box body, the lifting base table is arranged in the box body to adjust the position of the winding, and the multi-mode fire extinguishing assembly is arranged outside the box body, so that the condition that the transformer oil tank is subjected to fire disaster under different oil temperatures, (oil) leakage degrees, gap sizes and winding intervals can be realized, and fire extinguishing of corresponding modes can be carried out according to requirements.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Device and test method for researching seepage and sedimentation of water-rich tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device and a test method for researching seepage and settlement of a water-rich tunnel, belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering tests, and aims to disclose a disaster-causing mechanism of the water-rich tunnel and differences between the disaster-causing mechanism and a settlement disaster-causing process of a typical engineering area. The system comprises a model box, a tunnel model, a water injection-seepage system and a settlement-deformation monitoring system, wherein a soil layer is filled in the model box, the tunnel model is buried at the designed depth of the soil layer, the water injection-seepage system is buried in the soil layer and is used for injecting water into the soil layer to simulate seepage process, the water injection system comprises seepage pipes and water injection pipes, the settlement-deformation monitoring system comprises settlement measuring rods used for monitoring stratum settlement, the settlement measuring rods comprise various specifications, a dial gauge used for monitoring surface settlement and dial gauge hangers, a soil pressure gauge used for monitoring soil pressure, a pore water pressure gauge used for monitoring pore water pressure, a moisture gauge used for monitoring moisture migration, and a reflection monitoring target point used for monitoring tunnel convergence.

title_en: Emergency shelter intelligent management and control system and method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency refuge intelligent management and control system and method based on multi-source information fusion, and relates to the technical field of geographic data processing. According to the invention, data fusion is carried out on real-time scene data, a dynamic scene monitoring model is established according to data fusion results, a historical disaster evolution model is established according to historical case data, the historical disaster evolution model is compared with the dynamic scene monitoring model, a comparison case is selected according to comparison results, the trend of disasters is simulated in the dynamic scene monitoring model according to the comparison case, the trend result of disasters is covered on the dynamic scene monitoring model, crowd evacuation simulation is carried out on the dynamic scene monitoring model by taking an emergency evacuation place as a simulation end point, a personnel evacuation route is generated according to crowd evacuation simulation results, and dynamic adjustment is carried out according to the real-time scene data in the execution process of the personnel evacuation route.

title_en: Mountain disaster chain breakage simulation method and system based on numerical model
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain disaster chain broken chain simulation method and system based on a numerical model, which belong to the field of disaster simulation, and are used for preprocessing data based on a basic geographic data set and a disaster data set, and the method comprises the steps of extracting space vector data and surface layer raster data for cleaning, carrying out distributed storage and dimension conversion in combination with disaster thematic data, carrying out parameterization on the converted data, and sending the parameterized data to a numerical calculation model; the numerical calculation model comprises a built thematic disaster simulation model module, a risk early warning model module, a risk source identification model module and a coupled disaster chain model module, wherein the risk source identification model module respectively acquires parameters of the thematic disaster simulation model module and then carries out risk source identification, the coupled disaster chain model module carries out dynamic joint simulation of a disaster scene through the parameters of the coupled multi-thematic disaster simulation model module, and the risk early warning model module carries out risk early warning through early warning threshold configuration.

title_en: Device and method for intelligent early recognition, prevention and control simulation of fire smoke in confined space
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early intelligent recognition and prevention and control simulation device and method for smoke dust of a limited space fire disaster, comprising a load sliding base, a limited space simulation system, a data analysis processing system and a data analysis processing system, wherein the limited space simulation system comprises a semi-closed box body, a fire source simulation unit, a temperature and humidity monitoring unit, an air pressure monitoring unit and a dust output unit, an air conveying unit and a temperature and humidity control unit are arranged in the semi-closed box body, the load sliding base is provided with the dust output unit, the air conveying unit and the temperature and humidity control unit, the dynamic dust fall regulation system is arranged at the top of the semi-closed box body, the dust source dynamic tracking system is arranged at the top of the load sliding base, and the data analysis processing system is connected with the dust source dynamic tracking system. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional single sensor. The multi-source data fusion remarkably improves the precision and the instantaneity of dust diffusion path tracking, fire source dynamic identification and gas component monitoring.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUHAI COLLEGE CHINA UNIV OF MINING & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-channel multi-mode space-time 3D convolution and transducer fused satellite-borne GNSS-R wave height inversion model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a satellite-borne GNSS-R wave height inversion model fused by multichannel multi-mode space-time 3D convolution and a transducer, and aims to solve the problems that the traditional empirical model is poor in adaptability to complex ocean and the existing deep learning cannot fully mine space-time correlation. The method innovates and fuses three modules to cooperatively process, namely firstly extracting local space-time characteristics of multichannel GNSS-R data by using 3D CNN-ConvLSTM and capturing dynamic time sequences, secondly deeply coding sea surface environment parameters by using a multi-head attention mechanism of a transducer, establishing global dependence among the characteristics, and finally realizing cross-mode fusion by adopting a weighted summation and characteristic splicing strategy. Training by an Adam optimizer and early-stopping strategy control, and optimizing by taking a mean square error as a loss function. Experiments show that compared with the traditional model and the machine learning model, the method reduces the effective wave height estimation error by 40-53%, the correlation coefficient reaches 0.84-0.91, the precision and generalization capability under complex sea conditions are obviously improved, and reliable support is provided for marine remote sensing monitoring and disaster early warning.

title_en: Drilling device for dangerous rock single blasting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling device for dangerous rock single blasting, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention engineering devices and comprises a single cantilever mechanism, a vertical connecting mechanism, a transverse moving mechanism, a drilling position adjusting mechanism and a drilling mechanism. The two ends of the top beam of the single cantilever beam mechanism are supported between the dangerous rock monomer and the stable mountain to construct an aerial working platform, the cross beam of the transverse moving mechanism is suspended below the top beam through a vertical connecting mechanism, the drilling position adjusting mechanism realizes transverse and vertical two-dimensional accurate positioning through the transverse moving vehicle, the vertical rail seat and the vertical moving vehicle, and the drilling track of the drilling mechanism can rotate around a horizontal shaft to drive the drill bit to adjust the pitching angle. The invention gets rid of the dependence on dangerous ground, realizes suspended, multi-angle and high-precision drilling operation under complex terrain, effectively solves the problems of difficult platform construction, low positioning precision, poor safety and the like of the traditional method, and remarkably improves the efficiency, safety and adaptability of dangerous rock blasting construction.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA KANGNING MINING CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for modeling fault personalized information portrayal of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power systems and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for modeling personalized information portraits of power distribution network faults, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first multidimensional operation data of a power distribution network in a target area and carrying out first preprocessing; and clustering based on the division result to establish the personalized information portrait of the power distribution network faults. The method and the system can comprehensively consider multidimensional operation data of the power distribution network, accurately simulate normal operation data before and after faults, and improve fault analysis accuracy. In addition, through regional meshing and clustering operations, data internal connection is deeply mined, and finer and personalized fault information portraits are constructed. The method is favorable for quickly positioning the fault point, provides support for fault repair and prevention, and improves the operation efficiency and safety of the power distribution network.

title_en: Universal AI Based Autonomous Pet Management Platform
abstract_en: The present invention introduces a universal AI-powered pet management platform that establishes an entirely new category of technology, transcending conventional pet training systems. This comprehensive system integrates a modular wearable pet device with interchangeable sensors, sophisticated AI processing capabilities, and diverse output modules to create a unified ecosystem for holistic pet care. Unlike traditional training devices focused solely on behavior modification, this platform simultaneously manages multiple domains including real-time health monitoring, environmental safety assessment, emotional well-being analysis, autonomous training, emergency response, and seamless integration with external systems. The platform's universal architecture enables dynamic adaptation across diverse applications from companion animals to service animals, wildlife monitoring, and specialized deployments. By leveraging advanced artificial intelligence models, multimodal communication pathways, and a universal API for third-party integration, the system creates an interconnected technological framework that fundamentally transforms the relationship between pets, technology, and human interaction, rendering isolated pet devices obsolete.

title_en: Apparatus, system and method for three-dimensional realtime interpreting accident using artificial intelligent in case of a chemical substance leak accident
title_ko: 화학물질 누출사고 발생 시 인공지능을 이용하여 실시간으로 3차원 사고해석을 수행하기 위한 장치, 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화학물질 누출사고 발생 시 인공지능을 이용하여 실시간으로 3차원 사고해석을 수행하기 위한 장치, 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 지형의 변화에 따른 풍속과 풍향 등의 기상 변화를 이용하여 특정 지역별로 기상조건 변화에 따른 대기 운동을 반복 학습하여 실시간 공기 유동 예측을 위한 인공지능 학습모델을 구축하고, 구축된 인공지능 학습모델을 이용하여 화학물질의 사고 발생 시 화학물질의 누출에 의한 열/유동, 화학물질 누출/확산, 화학물질 반응/확산, 화학물질에 의한 화재, 화학물질에 의한 폭발 등의 현상에 대한 3차원 실시간 사고해석 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션을 수행함으로써, 시간에 따른 거리별 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해영향의 범위를 신속 정확하게 실시간 예측할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 방재작업 및 주민대피 예상범위를 신속하게 제공하여 화학물질의 사고에 대한 피해 확산을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Strong convection strong wind-oriented power transmission line failure risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: A power transmission line failure risk assessment method and system for strong convection strong wind comprises the steps of establishing a strong convection strong wind field theoretical model based on actual measurement data and a wind field change rule, selecting an actual engineering to establish a power transmission line model, carrying out simulation analysis on the basis of the established strong convection strong wind field theoretical model and the power transmission line model under different wind speed working conditions to obtain structural response of the power transmission line model, applying horizontal thrust to the power transmission line model to carry out nonlinear pushing and covering analysis to obtain structural capacity of the power transmission line model, fitting a vulnerability curve according to the structural response and the structural capacity, and carrying out risk assessment according to the vulnerability curve. According to the invention, through establishing a wind field model and a power transmission line model, disaster simulation, risk assessment and fault precaution measures are carried out, so that key technical support is provided for wind resistance design, a disaster mechanism and probabilistic risk of the power transmission line induced by strong convection and strong wind are revealed, and precaution measures for coping with the power transmission line faults induced by strong convection and strong wind are provided.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE THE HONG KONG POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Earthquake landslide simulation test device for coupling fault dislocation and pulse vibration
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of physical simulation of geological disasters, and particularly relates to a seismic landslide simulation test device for coupling fault dislocation and pulse vibration. The driving system comprises a high-thrust vertical actuator and a high-thrust horizontal actuator, the high-thrust vertical actuator is in transmission connection with the vertical dislocation model box, and the high-thrust horizontal actuator is in transmission connection with the horizontal dislocation model box. The fault real dislocation load and the speed pulse load can be synchronously loaded, and the dislocation and vibration double-field coupling earthquake effect of the real vibration fault can be simulated through the dislocation of the fault disc and the pulse vibration linkage. The fault breaking and pulse effect of complex vibration faults such as left-hand walking and sliding, thrust, left-hand walking and sliding, positive breaking, right-hand walking and sliding, thrust, right-hand walking and sliding, positive breaking and the like on the landslide can be synchronously coupled.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Suspended support construction system for dangerous rock single blasting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a suspended support construction system for dangerous rock single blasting, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention engineering devices and comprises a single suspension beam mechanism, a vertical connecting mechanism, a transverse moving mechanism, a counterweight mechanism, a drilling position adjusting mechanism and a drilling mechanism. The two ends of the top beam of the single cantilever beam mechanism are supported at the tops of the dangerous rock monomers and the main mountain body to provide main support. The vertical connecting mechanism suspends the cross beam below the top beam. The transverse moving vehicle of the drilling position adjusting mechanism drives the drilling mechanism to move along the lower rail to adjust the drilling position. According to the invention, suspended installation is performed by utilizing dangerous rock terrains, a bottom operation platform is not needed, overturning is effectively resisted through a counterweight system, regional drilling operation is safely, stably and efficiently implemented on the side surface of the bottom of a dangerous rock monomer, and the problem of mechanical drilling at the special position is solved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA KANGNING MINING CO LTD

title_en: Flood disaster identification method based on feature and relationship combined knowledge distillation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of knowledge distillation, in particular to a flood disaster identification method based on feature and relationship combined knowledge distillation, which comprises the following steps of S1, inputting a teacher network and a corresponding student network to be trained, wherein the teacher network is a deep neural network model to be compressed; the method comprises the steps of S2, obtaining a training set and a knowledge distillation module, defining total loss training loss of combined distillation in the knowledge distillation module, S3, inputting a teacher network into the knowledge distillation module, performing combined training on a student network through characteristic knowledge distillation and relationship knowledge distillation, and S4, outputting the trained student network as a compressed deep neural network model for flood disaster identification. Through the scheme, effective distillation training of different network structures is realized, the model distillation effect is improved, the model calculation cost is further reduced, and model training is accelerated.

title_en: Collapse column exploration and treatment method based on ground directional drilling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine geological security and hydrogeological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a collapse column exploration and treatment method based on ground directional drilling, which comprises the following steps that a directional horizontal hole group Z1 adopts a lower, upper and middle treatment mode, and firstly, 2 middle treatment branch holes drill at the edges of four-ash-edge crack development zones to determine the boundary of the collapse column; the method comprises the steps of drilling five lower treatment branch holes along five ash holes on a section plane, carrying out grouting treatment on the lower part of a cut-off position of a collapse column, drilling the upper 2 treatment branch holes along one ash hole on the section plane, carrying out grouting treatment on the upper part of the cut-off position of the collapse column, carrying out grouting treatment on the rest part by using 3 treatment branch holes in the middle, carrying out supplementary reinforcement on the collapse column by additionally arranging 3 movable holes, drilling each treatment branch hole in the directional cluster type hole group J1 downwards from the top of the collapse column, carrying out supplementary grouting reinforcement on the collapse column, and achieving the treatment purpose by adding the directional cluster type hole group J1 into the directional horizontal hole group Z1.
assignees: HYDROLOGY PROSPECTING TEAM OF ANHUI PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Multi-scale synthetic aperture radar flood detection method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of radar remote sensing image processing, in particular to a multi-scale synthetic aperture radar flood detection method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of flood disaster SAR images of a flood area, preprocessing the flood disaster SAR images to obtain standard flood disaster SAR images, dividing the standard flood disaster SAR images, constructing a training, verifying and testing data set, constructing a multi-scale SAR flood detection network model based on a multi-scale feature extraction network and a multi-head self-attention mechanism, training the multi-scale SAR flood detection network model by utilizing the training data set and the verifying data set, inputting the testing data set into the trained multi-scale SAR flood detection network model to output a flood detection result corresponding to the target flood area, thereby effectively inhibiting the influence of speckle noise, improving the distinguishing capability of flood and confusable ground objects under complex scenes, and improving the accuracy and the robustness of SAR image flood detection.
assignees: UNIV WUHAN;HUBEI AERIAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING INST

title_en: Multi-mode semantic alignment method for emergency scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a multimode semantic alignment method for emergency scenes, which comprises the steps of obtaining multimode data and mapping dialect vocabulary in the multimode data to a standard language system; the method comprises the steps of generating initial semantic vectors in texts/voices by using a multi-language pre-training model, identifying characteristic elements in images/videos based on a target detection model, generating structured visual semantic labels and embedding the vectors, eliminating language features in the initial semantic vectors in the texts/voices based on cross-language countermeasure training, generating language-independent semantic vectors, calculating similarity between the language-independent semantic vectors and the visual vectors based on cross-modal contrast learning, optimizing inter-modal distances through triple loss functions, updating parameters of the cross-language countermeasure training and the cross-modal contrast learning, and minimizing total loss functions. The method solves the problem of multi-mode information processing in the multi-dialect environment in the prior art, and improves the efficiency and accuracy of emergency response.

title_en: Multi-scenario geotechnical engineering physical model test device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a physical model test device for multi-scenario geotechnical engineering, which comprises a rainfall and recharging water supply module, a vibration control module and a stress application and spraying module, wherein the rainfall and recharging water supply module comprises a water inlet pipe, first heating equipment and a first constant water pressure control device, the first heating equipment and the first constant water pressure control device are communicated with the water inlet pipe, a plurality of single equipment can be integrated on one equipment to complete an experiment through a designed mechanism, the problems of single function and limited application range of the traditional equipment are effectively solved, and meanwhile, the limitations of a monitoring and control system due to the fact that design targets are dispersed and the function integration level of the traditional equipment are insufficient are also solved, and the problems of system simulation and accurate research on a complex geological disaster process are further severely restricted.

title_en: Geological disaster multi-mechanism privacy data collaborative investigation method based on federal learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a federal learning-based geological disaster multi-mechanism privacy data collaborative investigation method which comprises the following steps of firstly constructing an initial geological disaster prediction model by a central server to generate global model parameters, registering identity information by each mechanism to the central server to obtain a safety communication key, secondly locally collecting geological disaster related original data by each mechanism, preprocessing the original data and extracting characteristics, thirdly, federal cyclic training, repeatedly executing until convergence, fourthly, forming a new version global model by the central server according to the data quantity or preset credibility weight of each mechanism, verifying credibility, and thirdly, distributing the updated global model to all participating mechanisms by the central server. The invention realizes the cooperative optimization of privacy and efficiency by fusing the federal learning framework with the space-time feature protection mechanism, and provides a technical paradigm for the multi-mechanism privacy security cooperation by the space-time feature cooperative modeling.
assignees: The First Geological Brigade of Jiangsu Geological Bureau

title_en: Method, system and equipment for planning safety control line of peripheral land of chemical industry park
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system and equipment for planning a safety control line of a chemical industry park, which are used for constructing a high-precision three-dimensional CFD model comprising a construction structure of the chemical industry park, a protection facility of the chemical industry park and a terrain around the chemical industry park, simulating the evolution process of various disaster scenes under different meteorological conditions and different protection measures by utilizing an accident scene dynamic driving engine in the high-precision three-dimensional CFD model to obtain safety distance thresholds corresponding to the disaster scenes, integrating the safety distance thresholds of the multi-disaster scenes, establishing a space superposition model under a unified coordinate system, updating the space superposition model according to the dynamic update condition of the safety distance thresholds, determining the range of the safety control line of the planning of the chemical industry park according to the updated space superposition model, and improving the safety and the rationality of the safety control line planning.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ACADEMY OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ZHEJIANG SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH DETECTION EXAMINAT

title_en: Accident result simulation calculation method based on mathematical physical model coupling solution
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident result simulation calculation method based on mathematical physical model coupling solution, which comprises the steps of constructing an accident chain knowledge map and a physical trigger map, establishing causal relation and physical constraint among equipment, states, events and results, converging and mapping historical records, expert rules and online observation data into map entities and relations to form a baseline accident scene and calculate a baseline index, generating candidate paths by utilizing map reasoning and coupling multi-physical field simulation, realizing closed loops of map reasoning and object understanding through consistency check, scoring and disturbance simulation analysis on the candidate paths, screening robust target paths, carrying out high-fidelity simulation on the target paths, combining sensitivity analysis and minimum cut-off set to identify key nodes, and generating treatment suggestions and action priorities. The invention realizes the high-reliability prediction of accident evolution and the closed-loop linkage of emergency response, and has high precision, high robustness and engineering feasibility.
assignees: SHANGHAI GELUE SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Discrete element modeling and numerical simulation method for side slope damaged by vibration
abstract_en: A discrete element modeling and numerical simulation method for the vibration damage of a side slope comprises the steps of 1) establishing a model box model of the vibration damage of the side slope, constructing a two-dimensional numerical simulation box according to input length and height, 2) giving specified particle radius and dispersion coefficient parameters of the particle model, applying a gravity action and naturally stacking the model, 3) importing side slope elevation data, cutting and layering an initial geometric model by using a cutting tool to form the side slope model, 4) storing soil material parameters in a document, importing the soil material parameters, 5) giving the particle radius, dispersion coefficient and other parameters of the particle model, applying the gravity action and naturally stacking the model, 6) carrying out standard balance to balance stress, energy, heat and the like of the whole model, and 7) setting different peak acceleration and vibration frequency to study the disaster process of the vibration damage of the side slope. And (5) completing discrete element numerical simulation of slope vibration damage.
assignees: SUZHOU NANLI SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flame smoke detection method and system based on improvement YOLOv s
abstract_en: The application discloses a flame smoke detection method and a system based on improved YOLOv s, and relates to the technical field of fire disaster identification, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an up-sampling update layer based on common convolution, dynamic convolution and cavity convolution corresponding to different receptive fields; the method comprises the steps of constructing an aspect ratio consistency penalty according to an aspect ratio difference term based on nonlinear transformation, replacing an upsampling initial layer in YOLOv s network architecture by an upsampling updating layer, reconstructing a YOLOv s basic model according to the aspect ratio consistency penalty and a loss function in YOLOv s network architecture by linear interval mapping, training YOLOv s basic model based on historical fire image data, obtaining a flame smoke detection model, obtaining real-time image data, and obtaining a flame smoke detection result according to the real-time image data and the flame smoke detection model. The application has the beneficial effects of improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of identifying extreme forms such as flame, smoke and the like.
assignees: HANGZHOU INTELLIGENT LINGTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel construction safety early warning method and system based on multidimensional data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel construction safety pre-warning method and system based on multidimensional data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical disaster condition data set consisting of various disaster type data, and training a disaster type recognition model according to the historical disaster condition data set; setting a plurality of sensors for acquiring information in a tunnel in real time, constructing a tunnel BIM model, mapping the information in the tunnel into the tunnel BIM model, inputting the information in the tunnel acquired in real time into the training disaster type identification model, identifying the possible disaster type in the tunnel, mapping the disaster type into the tunnel BIM model, calculating the real-time risk value of each position in the tunnel according to the information in the tunnel, marking and connecting the positions corresponding to the real-time risk values meeting preset conditions to form an escape path, mapping the escape path into the tunnel BIM model, and displaying the tunnel BIM model on virtual reality equipment in real time.
assignees: CCCC THIRD HIGHWAY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station emergency exercise system and method based on virtual reality and intelligent analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station emergency exercise system and method based on virtual reality and intelligent analysis, wherein the hydropower station emergency exercise system comprises a virtual reality equipment module, a control terminal and user interface module, a data acquisition, storage and encryption module, a data analysis and emergency command module, an intelligent analysis and evaluation module and an intelligent analysis and evaluation module, wherein the virtual reality equipment module is provided with VR glasses supporting real-time transmission of on-site images and voice interaction of exercise, the control terminal and user interface module is provided with a visual user interface, the data acquisition, storage and encryption module is used for conducting encryption processing on data, controlling data access through a permission management mechanism and regularly backing up the data, the data analysis and emergency command module is used for generating an emergency treatment proposal and commanding workers to conduct fault treatment when accidents occur, and the intelligent analysis and evaluation module is used for automatically generating a comprehensive evaluation report after the exercise is finished. A hydropower station emergency exercise system and method integrating virtual reality technology, intelligent analysis, big data management and real-time communication functions are constructed, the defects of a traditional exercise mode are overcome, interactivity, instantaneity and scientificity of emergency exercise are enhanced, and emergency response capability of the hydropower station for emergency events is improved.

title_en: Method for tracing disaster-causing path of coastal disaster-bearing body based on digital-analog experiment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for tracing a disaster-causing path of an offshore disaster-bearing body based on a digital-analog experiment, which relates to the technical field of marine dynamic disaster simulation, and is used for determining marine dynamic disaster characteristics of an offshore research area, integrating multi-source historical disaster data, real-time monitoring data and disaster-bearing body background data to construct a space-time correlation database, and establishing an offshore storm surge-sea wave coupling numerical mode based on a three-dimensional ocean and third-generation sea wave mode and verifying the model. According to the method, storm tide-sea wave coupling numerical mode is constructed, multi-disaster nonlinear interaction is comprehensively considered, an energy conservation equation is introduced to quantify the generation, transmission and dissipation processes of disaster energy, the limitation of a traditional single-disaster linear model is solved, real-time feedback of a disaster-bearing body three-dimensional dynamic model is combined, a closed energy-damage association mechanism is formed, the tracing accuracy of a disaster chain propagation path is remarkably improved, and the identification of key nodes and a dominant path is ensured to be more in line with physical reality.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Flood disaster forecasting method based on space-time feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster forecasting method based on space-time feature fusion, which relates to the technical field of flood forecasting and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting data and preprocessing the data; S2, extracting rainfall space-time parameters and runoff space-time parameters to generate a flood influence parameter set, S3, presetting river bearing rules, building a river bearing model based on the river bearing rules and river structure parameters, S4, training and optimizing the river bearing model, and generating a flood forecasting scheme, and S5, verifying and optimizing the flood forecasting scheme to be output as a flood disaster forecasting method. The invention improves the accuracy of the flood forecasting scheme by combining the space-time characteristic fusion and the data driving algorithm, and can comprehensively and accurately reflect various factors influencing the occurrence of the flood by extracting the space-time parameters of the river structure, the precipitation and the runoff in multiple dimensions.
assignees: HEBEI CANGZHOU HYDROLOGY SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster multisource situation intelligent perception management and control method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting hydrological weather and topographic data, generating a standardized data set through space-time alignment and abnormal cleaning, constructing a directed topological graph containing node and edge attributes based on the extracted river network topological relation, further designing a graph neural network model, obtaining a flood dynamic route prediction model through physical constraint loss function training of an embedded water balance principle, inputting real-time hydrological data into the model to conduct graph convolution operation, predicting the water level, flow and split ratio change of each node in a future period, and finally combining a digital elevation model to conduct submerged simulation analysis to generate a flood control scheduling scheme and risk early warning information. The method realizes the deep fusion of a physical mechanism and data driving, effectively captures the flood propagation rule under the topological constraint of the river network by using the graph neural network, obviously improves the calculation efficiency while guaranteeing the prediction precision, and provides real-time and reliable decision support for flood disaster prevention and control in complex river network areas.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Flood control four-pre-system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control forecasting, in particular to a digital twinning-based flood control four-pre-system, which comprises a database construction module, a data analysis module, a prediction simulation module and a data judgment module, wherein the database construction module is used for constructing a river basin database and an extreme weather database, the data analysis module is used for constructing a hydrologic twinning model of a target area and determining comprehensive impact indexes corresponding to a plurality of key early warning areas and associated extreme weather data, the prediction simulation module is used for carrying out flood prediction simulation based on the regulated hydrologic twinning model and the extreme weather database so as to obtain flood propulsion parameters of a flood flooding area and each key early warning area, and the data judgment module is used for determining flood control early warning parameters of the target area based on flood control early warning parameters and area characteristics of each key early warning area. The invention can improve the accuracy of flood control early warning and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIHE HUAIHE XIAOQING BASIN WATER RESOURCES MAN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Photovoltaic power station disaster damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating disaster damage of a photovoltaic power station, which comprise the steps of generating a simulated wind speed working condition set matched with a current photovoltaic power station based on strong wind speed and photovoltaic power station data, traversing the simulated wind speed working condition set, calculating loss probability contribution of each simulated wind speed working condition when acting on the current photovoltaic power station, counting loss probability contribution corresponding to all simulated wind speed working conditions to obtain loss ratio probability of the photovoltaic power station, carrying out Bayesian updating iteration on photovoltaic vulnerability priori distribution by using the loss ratio probability of the photovoltaic power station to obtain photovoltaic vulnerability posterior distribution as post-disaster loss probability distribution, and providing reference for typhoon disaster evaluation and typhoon prevention measures of the photovoltaic power station.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Quantitative traceability determination method for mixed gas source of working face
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative traceability measurement method for mixed gas sources of a working face, which belongs to the technical field of underground gas disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of selecting at least three drilling sites by a s1. working face gateway, respectively drilling at least two holes upwards adjacent to a coal bed, drilling at least two holes downwards adjacent to the coal bed, taking at least one coal sample from each hole, and S2, measuring methane carbon isotope values ( 13  C), ethane carbon isotope values ( 13  C), carbon dioxide carbon isotope values ( 13  C), methane hydrogen isotope values ( 2  H) and ethane hydrogen isotope values ( 2  H) for each coal sample, and carrying out s4. quantitative traceability analysis on the mixed source gas sample isotope values of s3.. The invention adopts the hydrocarbon same-number measurement technology, effectively utilizes the marking hydrocarbon isotope value of each coal bed, calculates the proportion of the mixed source gas sample from each coal bed by establishing a mathematical model, realizes the quantitative tracing of the mixed source gas sample source, and has strong distinguishing degree and high accuracy.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST

title_en: Train operation control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device for train operation, which relate to the field of train control and comprise the steps of acquiring real train data of a train, inputting the real train data into a pre-trained train model to obtain operation data output by the train model, determining a current operation mode of the train, wherein the operation mode comprises at least one of an energy consumption minimum mode, a train schedule mode, an emergency response mode, an energy-saving-efficiency balance mode and a multi-target optimization mode, optimizing and calculating a train operation control strategy by utilizing an optimization algorithm based on the current operation mode and the operation data, generating operation control instructions in the current operation mode, and respectively transmitting the operation control instructions to a traction system, a braking system and a network system of the train. Real train data of various trains are obtained, simulation is carried out, operation data are obtained, and processing of data of various sources is achieved. And generating train operation control instructions based on various control strategies of the train so as to realize various different control modes of the train.

title_en: Four-field fusion monitoring and early warning method for rock burst and roof water inrush composite disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-field fusion monitoring and early warning method for rock burst and roof water inrush composite disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly determining each monitoring index and early warning value, collecting each monitoring index value during stoping, screening out monitoring abnormal data, removing the removed data, supplementing the removed data to form a data set required by subsequent model training and verification, establishing a stress-vibration-energy-seepage four-field multi-source initial early warning model for analyzing the monitoring index values and carrying out preliminary early warning, simultaneously combining the preliminary early warning result with expert discrimination, carrying out optimization adjustment on the early warning model, and finally judging whether the rock burst and roof water inrush composite disasters risk exists during the stoping of the current working face according to the optimized early warning model, and determining the rock burst and roof water inrush composite disasters types along with the change rule of the monitoring data. The method can accurately judge the rock burst of the working face and the type of the roof water bursting composite disaster, and provides data support for accurately preventing and controlling the rock burst and the roof water bursting composite disaster.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;SHANDONG ENERGY GROUP NORTHWEST MINING CO LTD;CHINA COAL ENERGY RES INST CO LTD;ZHONGTIAN HECHUANG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Visual tunnel water burst simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a visual tunnel water burst simulation test device, wherein the inner cavity of a box body is divided into a simulation cavity and a water collecting cavity through a filter plate, fluid-solid coupling similar materials are arranged in the simulation cavity, a water supply module is arranged at one end of the box body corresponding to the simulation cavity so as to supply water to the fluid-solid coupling similar materials to simulate tunnel water burst, an osmotic pressure module comprises a plurality of osmotic pressure meters distributed in an array mode on the same plane, a plurality of osmotic pressure modules are uniformly distributed in the simulation cavity, and a display module is correspondingly connected with the osmotic pressure modules through a controller. The fluid-solid coupling similar materials are arranged in the box body, water burst simulation is realized through water supply, a plurality of groups of osmotic pressure modules are arranged in the fluid-solid coupling similar materials, and the osmotic pressure flow meters in the osmotic pressure modules are distributed in an annular array, so that the internal osmotic flow state of the fluid-solid coupling similar materials can be monitored, the display is used for displaying the osmotic flow state of the corresponding area of each osmotic pressure module, the water burst disaster process is visually reproduced, and the authenticity of the acquired disaster evolution rule is improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 14 BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Test device for multi-physical field coupling simulation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a test device for multi-physical field coupling simulation, which relates to the technical field of physical field tests and comprises a test bed, wherein a water tank is fixedly arranged at the left part of the top end of the test bed, a vibration structure is fixedly arranged at the right part of the top end of the test bed, a box body is fixedly arranged at the top of the vibration structure, a landslide model is fixedly arranged at the left part of the inside of the box body, a water pump is fixedly arranged at the top end of the water tank, the input end of the water pump extends to the bottom of the inside of the water tank, and a water spraying frame is fixedly connected with the output end of the water pump. According to the test device for the multi-physical-field coupling simulation, through the action of the vibration structure, when the multi-physical-field coupling simulation test device is used for simulating the disaster scene of the landslide model, the landslide model can vibrate up and down while vibrating horizontally, so that the test scene is more fit and reality, and the accuracy of experimental data is improved.

title_en: Server management-based kiosk and fire extinguishing device linkage system
title_ko: 서버 관리 기반 키오스크와 소화 장치의 연동 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 서버 관리 기반 키오스크와 소화 장치의 연동 시스템에 관한 것으로, 소방 방재 훈련을 위하여 교육용 연기를 분사하는 분사 동작을 실행하는 교육용 소화 장치; 상기 교육용 소화 장치와 연동하여 상기 소방 방재 훈련 동안 가상의 훈련 상황을 구현하는 훈련 영상을 재생하고 상기 분사 동작에 동기화된 분사 효과를 반영하여 상기 훈련 영상을 갱신하는 키오스크 단말; 및 상기 소방 방재 훈련이 개시되면 상기 분사 효과에 관한 시계열 데이터를 수집하고 상기 소방 방재 훈련이 종료되면 상기 시계열 데이터를 평가하여 훈련 결과를 생성하는 연동 서버;를 포함한다.

title_en: System for retrieving past scenarios for responding to social disasters and method for operating the Same
title_ko: 사회재난 대응을 위한 과거 시나리오 검색 시스템 및 그 운용 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난관리 및 재난대응 기술 분야에 관한 것으로서,  
재난 대응을 위한 시나리오 기반의 의사결정 지원 시스템에 있어서, 
과거 재난 사례, 가상훈련 시나리오 및 사용자 정의 시나리오 데이터를 포함하는 재난 관련 정보를 저장하는 데이터 저장부와; 상기 저장된 데이터를 분류, 검색 및 시각화 가능하도록 처리하는 데이터 처리부와; 입력된 재난 유형, 발생 지역, 재난 경보 단계 등을 기반으로 상기 저장된 데이터 중에서 대응 시나리오를 검색하여 추출하는 시나리오 추천부와; 상기 추천된 시나리오를 인과관계형, 타임라인형 또는 서술형 중 적어도 하나의 형태로 시각화하여 출력하는 시나리오 시각화부와; 시각화된 시나리오를 다수의 사용자에게 실시간으로 공유할 수 있도록 재난안전상황실 내 전광판 또는 협업형 사용자 단말로 출력하는 협업 공유부와; 신규로 수집되거나 사용자에 의해 작성된 시나리오를 학습하여 유사한 재난 유형 또는 새로운 조합의 시나리오를 자동 생성하는 인공지능 기반 시나리오 생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Smart Farm Convection Control System with AI-based Prediction, Correction, and Disaster Response
title_ko: Ai 기반 예측·보정 및 재난 대응형 스마트팜 대류 제어 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 스마트팜 환경 제어 기술에 관한 것으로, 온실 내부의 공기 흐름을 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 예측·보정하여 균일한 환경을 유지하고, 폭염·한파·폭설과 같은 재난 상황에서도 안정적인 운전이 가능한 스마트팜 대류 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 시스템은 센서 네트워크(10)와 기상 데이터 수집부(15)를 통해 환경 및 외부 기상 데이터를 수집하고, 이를 AI 기반 대류 제어부(20)에서 디지털 트윈 시뮬레이션, 예측, 보정 및 최적화 과정을 거쳐 송풍기(30)와 환기창 개폐기(40)를 제어한다. 또한 재난 대응 모듈(60)을 포함하여 이상 기상 상황 발생 시 AI 제어를 보정하거나 직접 제어를 수행함으로써 최소한의 대류를 보장한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 온실 내부 환경의 균일성 확보, 에너지 효율 향상, 재난 대응력 강화에 효과적이며, 결과적으로 농작물의 생산성과 품질을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Garden planning scheme intelligent adjustment system and method based on virtual information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual information-based intelligent adjustment system and method for a garden planning scheme, and relates to the technical field of intelligent gardens, wherein the intelligent adjustment system comprises the steps of generating a wind pressure distribution thermodynamic diagram by combining vegetation distribution data in the garden planning scheme with wind resistance coefficients in a nursery stock knowledge graph in a layering manner; the wind pressure distribution thermodynamic diagram is accessed into a disaster knowledge graph, the occurrence probability of a disaster chain is calculated, a disaster chain probability matrix is generated, a comprehensive vulnerability index is calculated, space model adjustment is carried out, typhoon passing dynamic parameters are injected into three-dimensional virtual simulation based on the adjusted space model, a disaster deduction report is generated through real-time disaster deduction, and wind resistance optimization construction diagram and a final space model are generated through dynamic scheme optimization according to the disaster deduction report. According to the invention, through disaster knowledge graph access and disaster chain probability calculation, multi-disaster type coupling analysis is realized, and the blind area of single disaster evaluation is eliminated.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Geological disaster deduction method and system based on digital twin simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster deduction method and a system based on a digital twin simulation platform, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster deduction; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body model based on multi-source data inversion and a three-dimensional geological modeling technology, updating geological parameters in real time to reflect the state change of the geological body, introducing a multi-level stepped early warning model, strengthening timeliness and foresight of early warning by fusing the physical model with deep learning prediction, combining the dynamic selection precision of the stepped disaster deduction model and generating a risk thermodynamic diagram, and improving the spatial fineness and decision support capability of geological disaster risk identification. The multi-dimensional organic coordination is realized, the overall accuracy and response speed of the system are enhanced, and the requirements of efficient and accurate disaster risk management under complex geological environment are met.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING THREE GORGES;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: RFECV multi-model-based mud-rock flow type discriminating method in alpine mountain area
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of debris flow disaster monitoring, and discloses a debris flow type discrimination model training method, device, computer equipment, computer readable storage medium and computer program product based on RFECV models, wherein the method comprises S101, data acquisition and pretreatment; S102, feature processing, S103, data division, S104, sample unbalance processing, S105, model preliminary training, S106, feature subset optimization, S107, super parameter range convergence, S108, super parameter assignment, S109, candidate type discrimination model training, S110, cycle optimization judgment, S111 and discrimination result output. The automatic feature optimization method based on RFECV effectively eliminates redundant features, improves the interpretability and stability of the model, introduces a super-parameter self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, realizes dynamic optimization of the model, enhances training efficiency and generalization capability, solves the problems of subjective experience dependence, difficult feature selection, unstable model and the like of the traditional classification, and realizes efficient and accurate division of the debris flow type in alpine mountainous areas.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Mountain landslide grading early warning method based on multi-mode data change characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide grading early warning method based on multi-modal data change characteristics, which comprises the steps of establishing a mountain digital twin body, deploying a multi-node sensor network in a target area, configuring an edge calculation unit, collecting geological data in real time, screening the geological data based on the mountain digital twin body to form effective local data, constructing a lightweight multi-modal neural network model at each node, dynamically searching super parameters by utilizing an ant colony optimization algorithm to generate an encryption model weight update quantity package, dynamically calculating node weights by a central server according to disaster feature vectors output by the digital twin body, weighting and polymerizing to generate a global model and directionally distributing and updating, fusing real-time monitoring data and model prediction results, executing millimeter-level disaster evolution simulation through a variable-step physical engine, triggering advanced early warning signals when a deduction prediction risk exceeds a threshold value, and remarkably improving edge model adaptability, federal aggregation precision and early warning advance.

title_en: Urban operation event consultation scheduling method and system based on two-dimensional and three-dimensional integration
abstract_en: The application discloses a two-dimensional and three-dimensional integrated urban operation event consultation scheduling method and system, which relate to the technical field of Internet, and comprise the following steps: based on the event position, the surrounding two three-dimensional dynamic and static data are automatically positioned and fused in the digital twin base map, an integrated visual scene is quickly constructed, the time-consuming pain points of information dispersion and integration are solved, and situation perception efficiency is greatly improved. Then, simulation deduction is carried out on the plan in a visual scene, and the abstract text is converted into an intuitive dynamic process, so that a decision maker can rapidly evaluate the feasibility and the pre-judgment risk of the plan, and the efficiency of the scheme research and judgment and decision making is improved. And finally, issuing and tracking the optimized decision-making structured instruction to form a closed loop from analysis, decision-making to execution, so that the communication level and information distortion are reduced, the emergency response time is shortened as a whole, and the consultation efficiency is obviously improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN PLANNING AND NATURAL RESOURCES DATA MAN CENTER SHENZHEN SPACE GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION CENTER;SHENZHEN ETOP INFORMATION CO LTD

title_en: Roof strata global deformation and motion monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for monitoring global deformation and movement of a roof strata, which are characterized in that flexible monitoring cables integrated with nine-axis inertial sensors are arranged inside drilling holes of the roof strata, a gravitational field and a geomagnetic field are used as absolute space references, and accurate sensing of three-dimensional postures of strata can be realized without relying on underground unstable external references. Based on the dynamic calibration algorithm, the sensor installation deviation is automatically compensated, discrete measuring points are fused into a continuous three-dimensional track through a Bezier curve, the global kinematic behavior of the high-level rock stratum from initial micro deformation, gradual revolution until collapse and breakage is intuitively reconstructed, data acquisition and transmission are realized, three-dimensional reconstruction is realized, a pre-warning closed-loop mechanism is finally driven, deterministic precursor characteristics are captured before structural instability through correlation of rock stratum attitude change rate and vibration energy evolution law, passive response type post-disaster treatment is converted into advanced response active prevention and control, and the accuracy and timeliness of mine roof disaster pre-warning are improved.

title_en: Rock becomes angle shearing mechanism and infiltration test device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock angle-changing shearing device and an infiltration test device, which relate to the technical field of rock mechanics experiments and comprise a base and a bevel board assembly, wherein the shearing angle can be adjusted, the infiltration test device is matched, a mechanical experiment, seepage and crack observation system is included, dynamic visualization of shearing band evolution and seepage and association analysis with mechanical response are realized through a high-speed camera, the flexible adjustment and accurate fixation of the shearing angle are realized through the design of a rotating shaft and a sliding part, the infiltration test device is combined, a seepage-mechanical coupling research platform is provided, meanwhile, a multi-field coupling system is constructed by integrating mechanical loading, seepage experiment and crack observation, complex environment response is simulated synchronously, multidimensional data is captured by utilizing fluorescence development and high-speed photography, and a water-force coupling destabilization mechanism is disclosed, so that technical support is provided for disaster prevention and control.
assignees: HENAN QIANPING RESERVOIR IRRIGATION DISTRICT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. The geological disaster monitoring system based on intelligent hidden danger discrimination comprises a multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition module, a data fusion module, a dynamic threshold self-adaption module, a digital twin and real-time early warning linkage module and an edge-cloud cooperative computing architecture module. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion, dynamic threshold self-adaption, digital twin linkage and edge-cloud cooperative architecture, accurate identification and real-time early warning of geological disasters are realized. In a landslide monitoring scene, the early warning accuracy rate of the system reaches 89%, the response time is shortened to 10 minutes, the geological disaster prevention and control capability is obviously improved, and the stable operation of the system in a complex geological environment is ensured through hardware standardized deployment, model refined training and process automation linkage, so that the requirements of real-time monitoring and emergency response are met.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY NANCHANG CAMPUS

title_en: Rural building group flood disaster loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building group flood influence analysis, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the flood disaster loss of a rural building group, aiming at the problem that the accuracy of an evaluation result is low due to the fact that uncertainty factors in the loss evaluation process are not fully considered in the existing building flood loss function; comparing the submerged depth map with SAR image water body extraction data and social media data to obtain a flood simulation result, combining building classification information and the maximum submerged depth map to obtain submerged depth of each building, calculating component information of the building, analyzing building flood vulnerability according to the component information and the submerged depth to determine total loss of all buildings, and evaluating the effect of the current disaster prevention measures according to the total loss under different disaster prevention measures. The invention can provide scientific basis for building flood loss assessment and disaster prevention decision.
assignees: NO 4 ENG CORP LTD OF CR20G;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Flood evolution process generation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information and discloses a flood evolution process generation method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first data parameters of all stations in a target river basin, and establishing a flood evolution information definition table according to the first data parameters; the method comprises the steps of obtaining water levels and flow data of all stations in a target time period according to a flood information definition table, establishing a first traversal strategy, analyzing a plurality of flood evolution paths in the target flow period through the water levels and the flow data of all stations by the first traversal strategy, and summarizing the flood evolution paths obtained through the first traversal strategy to obtain a final flood evolution process. The flood evolution process can be comprehensively, accurately and efficiently simulated, scientific and reliable decision support is provided for flood control and disaster reduction work, and accordingly the flood control and disaster reduction efficiency and accuracy are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NANJING NARI WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Biological outbreak risk assessment method for water intake of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological outbreak risk assessment method for a water intake of a nuclear power plant, which belongs to the field of operation safety and risk management of the nuclear power plant, and comprises the steps of acquiring temperature, dissolved oxygen, chlorophyll, salinity and biological abundance monitoring data through sensors arranged at the water intake of the nuclear power plant, carrying out standardized treatment, balancing the number of samples with different biological abundance levels through a few types of oversampling, constructing a random forest classification model, carrying out random search and cross-validation optimization super-parameter data preprocessing, training out a random forest model with the best generalization performance, carrying out nuclear power heat trap risk assessment, outputting a biological disaster risk level in the current time period, and sending an alarm when the level is higher.

title_en: Emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue path planning method and system for self-adaptive risk avoidance, which comprise the steps of establishing an emergency rescue path network structure, carrying out risk entropy driven self-adaptive Monte Carlo simulation analysis before an actual natural disaster comes, carrying out path information statistical analysis on Monte Carlo simulation results, establishing a pre-planned path library, temporarily setting up priori risk distribution of each planned path in the pre-planned path library when the actual natural disaster comes, carrying out dynamic correction on the priori risk distribution of each planned path in the emergency rescue process by adopting sequential Bayesian inference, carrying out dynamic planning on the emergency rescue path based on path posterior risk average values of each planned path after the sequential Bayesian inference, selecting an optimal rescue path and executing an emergency rescue task until the emergency rescue activity is ended. According to the invention, by means of the path dynamic adjustment strategy, the scattered transportation strategy, the path pre-planning strategy and the network-free communication strategy, the rescue resources can be ensured to efficiently and safely reach the target site in natural disaster scenes such as flood, typhoons and the like.

title_en: Train electrical control simulation system
