abstract_en: The application discloses a train electric control simulation system which comprises a sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit, a safety loop simulation unit, an air conditioner control simulation unit, an illumination control simulation unit and a power supply simulation unit, wherein the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit is used for simulating train opening and closing logic and interlocking functions, the safety loop simulation unit is used for simulating train interlocking functions related to train safety operation and comprises the step of interlocking with the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit to realize door opening and closing safety interlocking, the air conditioner control simulation unit is used for simulating temperature regulation and air conditioner faults in a train, the illumination control simulation unit is used for simulating train illumination mode switching and emergency response functions, and the power supply simulation unit is used for simulating train power supply selection logic and protection functions and is used for supplying power to the sliding plug door centralized control simulation unit, the safety loop simulation unit, the air conditioner control simulation unit and the illumination control simulation unit. The application can replace the actual vehicle for training the students, can reduce the training dependence of the students on the actual vehicle, reduce the cost and the safety risk, and enhance the fault simulation and diagnosis capability of the students.
assignees: CRRC NANJING PUZHEN RAIL TRANSP CO LTD

title_en: Landslide risk assessment method, device, equipment and medium based on rainfall
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide risk assessment method, device, equipment and medium based on rainfall, wherein for a target area, a fitting formula is constructed by acquiring historical rainfall and landslide data of the target area so as to establish quantitative association between a landslide risk value on the same day and the rainfall data on multiple days, and then the weighting result of the dedicated rainfall on the same day on the landslide is obtained by training, verifying, testing and parameter optimizing a neural network model and independently calculating the historical data of each target area. The calculation result can be directly applied to disaster prevention and relief work of each city, rescue materials can be accurately reserved in advance according to the current-day landslide risk value output by the model, the allocation plan of rescue workers is scientifically arranged, the capability of the city for coping with landslide disasters is improved, and the disaster loss is reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: A device for practicing fire extinguisher of fire fight training
title_ko: 소방훈련용 소화기 실습 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방훈련용 소화기 실습 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 소방 훈련자에게 챔버 내부에 수용되는 컨베이어의 무한궤도 상에서 이송되는 형태로 소화기를 제공하여 훈련자로 하여금 실제 소화약제 분말이 분사되는 소화기의 실습이 가능하도록 하면서 분사되는 분말에 훈련자의 신체가 노출되는 것을 방지하여 보다 향상된 사용상의 안전성을 제공할 수 있는 소방훈련용 소화기 실습 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방훈련용 소화기 실습 장치는 훈련자에게 소화기를 제공하여 소화기 분사 실습을 수행하기 위한 장치에 있어서, 소화분말 약제가 내장된 복수개의 소화기; 복수개로 구성되는 반달 형상의 이송판을 구비하여 소정 크기의 타원을 그리며 무한궤도를 이루도록 구동되며, 궤도 상에 상기 복수개의 소화기가 결합되는 컨베이어; 컨베이어와 상기 컨베이어에 결합된 소화기가 내부에 수용되도록 소정의 수용 공간을 형성하며, 사용자 및 훈련자에 의해 내부가 보이도록 투명한 재질로 구성되는 챔버; 및 상기 챔버 내부에 설치되어 소화기로부터 분사된 소화약제 분말을 포집하도록 구비되는 집진기;를 포함하고, 상기 챔버는, 챔버의 외부로부터 내부를 향해 훈련자의 양손과 손목이 삽입되도록 소정 영역이 관통되는 한쌍의 홀 형태로 형성되며 상기 챔버의 측면을 둘러 복수개 구비되는 삽입구;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Evaluation method, equipment and medium based on emergency treatment of emergency
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency processing evaluation method, equipment and medium based on emergency, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining model parameters, determining preset emergency types, determining corresponding emergency models according to the model parameters and the emergency types, determining disaster dynamic data through the emergency models, determining emergency processing effects according to the disaster dynamic data, determining evaluation grades according to the emergency processing effects, obtaining an actual operation processing scheme of an administrator in real time, simulating the actual operation processing scheme through the emergency models to obtain simulation effects, and judging the simulation effects according to the emergency processing effects to determine scores corresponding to the actual operation processing scheme. The method and the system accurately construct the model according to various parameters, scientifically evaluate the emergency effect and grade, acquire the scheme in real time and simulate and judge, provide data support for emergency treatment, and improve decision scientificity and practical operation capability of an administrator.
assignees: CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY SHANDONG COMMITTEE PARTY SCHOOL SHANDONG ADMINISTRATIVE SCHOOL

title_en: Logistics warehouse electrical fire monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric fire monitoring, and discloses a logistics warehouse electric fire monitoring method and system based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining sensing data of different types through a first Internet of things network and a second Internet of things network, matching network association relations, calculating the sensing association relations, further obtaining matching degree values of the first and second monitoring target values, identifying the first and second monitoring target values from the two types of sensing data, combining the matching degree values to adjust weights, then weighting and calculating a field target value, driving simulated spark to generate when the field target value exceeds a preset reference value, and carrying out fire disaster early warning by judging the corresponding relation between the simulated target value and the field target value. The system is matched to realize the method. According to the application, by utilizing the cooperative monitoring of the double Internet of things and combining the association analysis, the dynamic weight adjustment and the simulation verification, the timeliness and the accuracy of the detection of the electric fire disaster of the logistics warehouse are effectively improved, the manual dependence is reduced, and the reliable guarantee is provided for the warehouse safety.
assignees: LOGISTICS BRANCH CHONGQING COMPANY OF CHINA NAT TOBACCO CORPORATION

title_en: Lightning proximity forecasting method based on radar data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightning proximity forecasting method based on radar data, and belongs to the technical field of lightning proximity forecasting. The method comprises four steps of collection and pretreatment of radar data and synchronous lightning data, construction and training of a U-Net model, construction and training of PredRNN radar extrapolation prediction models and prediction of lightning occurrence probability. According to the invention, predRNN is combined with a U-Net model, the advantages of the two models are fully exerted, the PredRNN model is focused on the prediction of time sequences, the U-Net is good at spatial feature extraction and the identification of lightning occurrence areas, and the loss function is optimized by using mean square error loss and decoupling loss. By means of the integration of PredRNN and the U-Net model and the improvement of the loss function, the method is more suitable for complex and changeable weather conditions than the existing model, improves the reliability and stability of lightning approach forecast, and provides more powerful support for weather disaster early warning.
assignees: ZHEJIANG METEOROLOGICAL SAFETY TECH CENTER ZHEJIANG LIGHTNING PROTECTION CENTER

title_en: Simulation system and method for influence of landslide blockage form on river channel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation system and a simulation method for influence of landslide blocking morphology on a river channel, and aims to overcome the defect that the influence of different landslide blocking morphologies cannot be systematically researched under the condition of reflecting complex natural conditions in the prior art. The system comprises a simulated river channel, wherein an upstream water collecting tank with a water supply system is arranged at the upstream of the simulated river channel, a landslide simulation operation platform and an information collecting system are arranged at the midstream of the simulated river channel, and a downstream water collecting tank with a water circulation system is arranged at the downstream of the simulated river channel, so that a water flow environment close to nature can be created. According to the method, through filling different landslide materials and stabilizing water flow, the separation door is opened, and the information collection system is combined to record data, so that various landslide forms can be repeatedly simulated, blockage and water flow changes can be synchronously tracked, system research on influences of different forms is realized, and support is provided for disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Gradient reservoir outflow analysis and simulation method based on GraphDB knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GraphDB knowledge graph-based cascade reservoir outflow analysis and simulation method, which is characterized in that a GraphDB graph database constructed based on a large amount of data is used for carrying out relationship identification and knowledge reasoning on reservoir outflow related entities, and the influence of each entity on outflow flow is mined and clarified, so that outflow is accurately simulated based on the knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps of demand analysis and data collection, data modeling, data integration and loading, knowledge graph construction, knowledge reasoning, query and analysis, and result display and application. The cascade reservoir outflow analysis and simulation method based on GraphDB knowledge patterns provided by the invention can visualize complex relations between the cascade reservoir in-out and in-storage, upstream and downstream water levels and the like, provide convenience for knowledge sharing cooperation of different departments and institutions, rapidly deduce historical decision or optimization strategies under different situations based on a large amount of historical data, and provide data-driven decision support for reservoir flood control and disaster reduction, water supply in prospecting and the like.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Multi-AGV deep reinforcement learning dynamic path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-AGV deep reinforcement learning dynamic path planning method, which comprises the steps of creating a virtual storage simulation training environment, extracting virtual storage simulation training environment information from the virtual storage simulation training environment, building a simulation environment according to a ros operation system, and building an AGV model. The invention obtains the optimal action from the original image obtained from the AGV camera. The method has the advantages that the step of manually extracting the characteristics is omitted, in addition, a dynamic grouping mechanism is introduced, a plurality of AGVs are dynamically grouped through an evaluation network and an attention network, communication among the AGVs is carried out through a communication network, network parameters are trained by combining deep reinforcement learning, and the problem of dimension disasters occurring in the process of multi-AGV joint decision in the process of planning a plurality of AGVs collision-free paths is solved.

title_en: Experimental platform for simulating transformer fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides an experimental platform for simulating a transformer fire disaster. The experimental platform comprises a transformer simulation device, an oil collecting pit simulation device and a first explosion venting surface, wherein the transformer simulation device comprises a simulation assembly, a drainage structure and an explosion venting assembly, the simulation assembly is provided with a first explosion venting surface, the drainage structure is arranged on the simulation assembly and comprises a drainage space and a drainage port, the first explosion venting surface is positioned in the drainage space, the explosion venting assembly is used for detonating oil in the simulation assembly, the oil collecting pit simulation device is provided with an oil collecting concave part, the transformer simulation device is arranged in the oil collecting concave part, an oil passing space is formed between the simulation assembly and the oil collecting concave part, an opening of the oil collecting concave part faces upwards and is positioned below the drainage structure, the first explosion venting surface is arranged on the top surface of the simulation assembly, and the detonated oil in the simulation assembly breaks through the first explosion venting surface and enters the drainage space so as to enter the oil collecting concave part through the drainage port and the opening of the oil collecting concave part under the guidance of the drainage space. The invention solves the problem of single simulation scene of the oil collecting pit fire simulation device in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster intelligent monitoring and early warning system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster early warning, in particular to an intelligent mountain torrent disaster monitoring and early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a perception layer, a network layer, a platform layer and an application layer, wherein the platform layer specifically comprises the following components: the system comprises a data processing module, a torrent risk prediction module, an early warning decision module, a dynamic risk factor calculation module and a disaster simulation and optimization module; compared with the prior art that the risk prediction model depends on static historical data, the dynamic risk caused by human activities and fluid characteristic changes is difficult to respond, the dynamic risk factor calculation module is innovatively introduced, human engineering activities and water and sand content are quantized into the fusible correction parameters in real time, the prediction model has the ability of sensing and adapting to the dynamic change of the risk, and the timeliness and accuracy of early warning are remarkably improved.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, storage medium and product for simulating deduction
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of simulation deduction, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for simulation deduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data sources of different modes in the target field, wherein the target field comprises urban traffic, education training, emergency response, automatic driving or medical disease analysis, and the data sources comprise at least two of image data, text data and voice data; and carrying out simulation deduction on the fusion characteristics through a preset reasoning method and a decision model to obtain a simulation deduction decision result, wherein the simulation deduction decision result comprises a reasoning result and a decision scheme. The method can achieve the effect of simulating the human cognitive process to carry out accurate and real simulation deduction.

title_en: Industrialized planting, ornamental and leisure tomato picking stadium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a factory planting, ornamental and leisure tomato picking place. The greenhouse type cherry tomato harvesting machine comprises a venue main body adopting a greenhouse structure, wherein three independent spaces are arranged in the venue main body, the three independent spaces are respectively an ornamental harvesting area, a training area and a production service area, the ornamental harvesting area is communicated with the training area and the production service area through disinfection channels, the venue main body is provided with a venue inlet and a venue outlet, the venue inlet and the venue outlet are respectively used for guests to enter and exit from a venue, the ornamental harvesting area is provided with a tomato planting area for guests to enjoy a cherry tomato modern planting scene and experience cherry tomato harvesting, and the ornamental harvesting of cherry tomatoes is realized in the tomato planting area by controlling the field planting time difference of plants. The method can eliminate damage to the growing environment of cherry tomatoes caused by frequent entrance and exit of a large number of tourists, ensure healthy growth of cherry tomatoes, and effectively reduce the probability of crop disease and insect disasters caused by bringing viruses, germs and ova into a greenhouse by controlling the field planting time difference of plants.
assignees: TANGSHAN DUOMA PARK TOURISM CULTURE CO LTD

title_en: Orthogonal double-pendulum weight parameter optimization method for anti-icing disaster of power transmission line in high-altitude area
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide an orthogonal double pendulum weight parameter optimization method for anti-icing disaster of a power transmission line in a high-altitude area, which carries out finite element modeling through self parameters and actual environment parameters of an actual power transmission line, obtains the maximum electric field intensity of the surface of the orthogonal double pendulum weight and the maximum electric field intensity of the power transmission line through simulation, constructs a corresponding fitness function, and adopts a genetic algorithm to determine the optimal parameters of the orthogonal double pendulum weight, so that the obtained orthogonal double pendulum weight can be suitable for the operation environment of the actual high-altitude area, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the power transmission line.
assignees: STATE GRID TIBET ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Backup disaster recovery optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a backup disaster recovery optimization method, which relates to the technical field of IT operation and maintenance and disaster recovery, and comprises the steps of analyzing statistical dependency relationship among basic performance indexes by utilizing a causal discovery algorithm based on standardized monitoring data flow to construct a directional weighted graph, triggering a reverse tracing positioning root cause component when the basic performance indexes in the directional weighted graph deviate from a normal performance base line, analyzing and identifying a service influence path through a forward path to generate a backup strengthening instruction, generating various potential disaster recovery switching schemes according to a historical exercise record and a strategy library in a digital twin environment, carrying out parallel deduction, quantitatively evaluating the performance influence of each potential disaster recovery switching scheme on a virtual service link in the deduction process, and selecting an optimal disaster recovery switching scheme through comparing evaluation results. The invention realizes prospective optimization and service influence minimization of disaster recovery decision, and enhances the automation, intellectualization and service adaptation capability of the backup disaster recovery system.
assignees: BEIJING BEIKONG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent interactive biological safety simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biosafety and intelligent training, in particular to an intelligent interactive biosafety simulation training system which comprises a simulation cabin, an operation environment simulation module, an environment adjusting device and a data processing unit, wherein a virtual experiment scene is generated through a holographic projection assembly, a user action is captured by an optical tracking module, a sense of immersion is enhanced by a touch feedback device, and environmental parameter consistency is ensured by combining environment adjustment and state acquisition. The invention can provide a highly-simulated biosafety training scene, improve the operation skills and emergency response capability of users, reduce the deployment complexity and the operation cost, and meet the requirements of small and medium-sized laboratories.

title_en: Manual induced landslide method for breaking rock slope
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster management of easily sliding slopes, and particularly relates to a manually induced landslide method for breaking rock slopes. The method comprises the steps of determining a preset sliding surface, arranging a plurality of directional drilling holes at the intersection of the lower edge of the preset sliding surface and the outer surface of the side slope, arranging a plurality of slope reinforcing anchor rods on the outer surface of the side slope in an array mode, spraying rock hydrolysis catalysts into the directional drilling holes, arranging a resonance wave generating device in a safety area below the preset sliding body, exciting resonance effects of micro-cracks of the side slope bedrock by the resonance wave generating device, arranging a loading body at the intersection of the upper edge of the preset sliding surface and the outer surface of the side slope, and waiting for the preset sliding body to generate sliding damage under the load action of the loading body. The invention can conveniently and accurately realize the active treatment of the broken rock slope which is easy to generate landslide hazard.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;YALONG RIVER HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on federal learning and UNet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk analysis, in particular to a landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on federal learning and UNet, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting landslide influence factor data, S2, establishing a federal learning framework, S3, designing an UNet deep learning model, namely, extracting and dividing features, S4, integrating federal learning model training and parameters, namely, updating a global UNet-based deep learning model, S5, federal learning iteration and model optimization, namely, optimizing parameters of the UNet-based deep learning model, S6, generating a landslide susceptibility feature map and probability regression, namely, outputting a landslide susceptibility evaluation result, S7, and verifying and disaster prevention and reduction suggestions, namely, providing landslide risk early warning and disaster prevention and disaster reduction suggestions, and realizing more efficient and accurate landslide susceptibility evaluation, and timely updating the model to cope with new data changes.

title_en: Disaster reduction rescue path planning method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster reduction rescue path planning method and system based on the Internet of things, the method comprises the steps of environment interaction, network updating, rewarding function design, inner-layer network training, outer-layer optimized searching and disaster relief path planning. The invention belongs to the field of path planning, in particular to a disaster relief and rescue path planning method and system based on the Internet of things, wherein the scheme reduces instruction conflict and overshoot and oscillation by sectionally executing and delaying issuing control instructions; the method comprises the steps of introducing dynamic temporary priority, designing sectional rewards by combining distance progress, heading punishment and energy perception, improving safety and reliability of disaster reduction rescue path planning, dynamically adjusting by self-adaptive probability adjustment of unique intersection and mutation operation and combining performance index fluctuation, adapting to complex disaster variation on site, avoiding parameter sinking to local optimum, introducing a gene resetting mechanism of an enhancement stage, continuously exploring potential optimal solutions, and improving path efficiency and rescue effect.

title_en: In-situ test device and method for water inrush site of deep underground engineering
abstract_en: The application provides an in-situ test device and method for water inrush sites of deep underground engineering, and belongs to the technical field of underground engineering. The test device comprises a drilling system, a pressurizing system and a data acquisition system, wherein the drilling system is used for arranging a water injection hole in front of a palm face of a test tunnel by utilizing an adjacent tunnel, the test tunnel is an in-building tunnel, the adjacent tunnel is a parallel pilot tunnel of the in-building tunnel, the pressurizing system is used for controllably and directionally pressurizing and injecting water to a rock mass in the water injection hole so as to simulate the processes of initiation, expansion, penetration and water bursting of a rock mass crack, and realize in-situ reproduction of a deep underground engineering water bursting disaster occurrence mechanism, and the data acquisition system is used for synchronously acquiring test signals in the pressurizing water injection process in real time by using various sensors so as to obtain in-situ test data. According to the scheme, the parallel pilot tunnel for tunnel construction is fully utilized, the front of the tunnel face is provided with the water injection hole for monitoring, and the in-situ water inrush test result is obtained.
assignees: UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC;CHANGAN UNIV;UNIV CHINA MINING;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Typhoon path simulation method for coupling machine learning with multi-source marine environment factors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon path simulation method of machine learning coupling multi-source marine environmental factors, belongs to the field of typhoon disaster simulation, and constructs a typhoon full-path machine learning prediction model integrating marine environmental factors. Firstly, key sea parameters such as sea surface temperature, vertical wind shear of the atmosphere, relative humidity, absolute vorticity, vertical speed, induced airflow and the like, typhoon path and strength time sequence data are integrated, a significant factor influencing typhoon path and strength is selected by combining a P value threshold method, and then, based on a logistic regression model, a counter propagation neural network, a circulating neural network and a support vector machine learning model, a super parameter optimization scheme is combined, so that a full path four-stage optimal prediction model of typhoon in a generation stage, a movement stage, a strength evolution stage and an attenuation stage is respectively constructed. Compared with the traditional statistical model, the machine learning model provided by the invention can better capture the complex interaction mechanism between typhoons and environmental fields.

title_en: Flood-prone area prediction method based on machine learning fusion multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood easy-occurrence area prediction method based on multi-source remote sensing data, which is characterized in that radar remote sensing, optical remote sensing, soil moisture, rainfall, river and topography data are fused, and constructing a flood susceptibility factor, and evaluating and predicting the flood susceptibility based on a machine learning model. The method comprises the following steps of S1 obtaining multi-source remote sensing data of a research area and preprocessing, S2 calculating flood probability of each pixel after a flood event based on radar remote sensing images, S3 calculating terrains, hydrology, vegetation, soil moisture and rainfall related factors, constructing a flood probability factor set, S4 training a flood probability model by adopting XGBoost and optimizing an input variable set, S5 inputting latest remote sensing data when the flood event happens, calculating a flood probability value and evaluating flood risk. The invention improves the accuracy of flood susceptibility prediction by utilizing multisource remote sensing data and machine learning technology, and can be widely applied to the field of flood disaster monitoring and early warning.

title_en: Probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises the following steps of firstly, considering the uncertainty of earthquake intensity, dispersing a target earthquake magnitude range into a plurality of equidistant intervals and calculating the occurrence probability of earthquakes of different earthquake magnitudes; the method comprises the steps of modeling disaster causes of earthquakes of different earthquake levels by adopting a vulnerability curve, calculating expected values of damaged elements of a power distribution system and a natural gas system, then randomly generating a fault scene under each classified earthquake level by using a Monte Carlo method, carrying out simulation on cascading faults of an electric comprehensive energy system under the random fault scene, recording the total loss load of the system, and finally calculating average loss load under each classified earthquake level, selecting a typical fault scene and forming a classified fault scene set. The method quantifies the tail risk of the low-probability extreme event and provides a scene basis for the toughness promotion strategy formulation of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: Disaster emergency hyperspectral target detection method based on residual enhancement depth KAN network
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a disaster emergency hyperspectral target detection method based on a residual enhancement depth KAN network, which comprises the steps of obtaining a public hyperspectral data set, taking the public hyperspectral data set as training data, constructing a pre-trained hyperspectral target detection network, inputting the training data into the pre-trained hyperspectral target detection network, extracting spectral features of hyperspectral images based on the residual enhancement depth KAN network, calculating a loss function based on the spectral features, repeatedly training the hyperspectral target detection network based on the loss function until an optimal network weight is obtained, inputting a to-be-detected pixel spectrum and an priori target spectrum into the trained hyperspectral target detection network, extracting feature vectors, calculating cosine similarity of the to-be-detected pixel spectrum feature vectors and the priori target spectrum feature vectors, and selecting pixels with highest cosine similarity scores as target pixels. The method can stably and efficiently perform target detection work in various complex ground environments such as disaster emergency and the like.

title_en: Method and device for generating tunnel surrounding rock energy evolution proxy model
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for generating a tunnel surrounding rock energy evolution proxy model, which are used for constructing an energy evolution prediction model with good generalization capability and real-time prediction capability by fusing a deep learning technology and a numerical simulation result, realizing efficient and accurate prediction of tunnel surrounding rock energy evolution and providing reliable support for early warning and disaster prevention and control of deep tunnel rock burst.

title_en: Geological modeling construction optimization method suitable for surface mine geological disaster investigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geologic modeling, in particular to a geologic modeling construction optimization method applicable to surface mine geologic hazard investigation. The method comprises the steps of determining reasonable drilling positions by fully collecting and integrating geological data and geophysical data and using a scientific geological inversion analysis method, constructing a mineral body model by combining drilling sampling data, constructing a geological profile by using a GIS system to obtain accurate profile parameters, and constructing an original geological three-dimensional model. Meanwhile, a Bayesian method is introduced to calculate probability distribution of a ground level, and an original model is marked and compiled to obtain a final high-precision three-dimensional geological model, so that the defects of the traditional method can be effectively overcome, the accuracy, reliability and scientificity of geological modeling are improved, and more accurate and comprehensive geological information support is provided for predicting, evaluating and preventing and controlling geological disasters of an open mine.

title_en: Fire spread integrated prediction method and system for coupling smoke and meteorological feedback effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for integrally predicting fire spread by coupling smoke and meteorological feedback, which firstly estimate forest fire emission parameters in real time based on satellite remote sensing data, and converting the space-time dynamic emission flux into a recognizable space-time dynamic emission flux of a numerical weather chemistry forecast model WRF-Chem, and realizing the matching with the WRF-Chem weather chemistry grid through grid interpolation. And secondly, simulating a bidirectional coupling process of the smoke aerosol and the gas image field based on WRF-Chem to generate a dynamic gas image field containing smoke radiation feedback. And finally, inputting a dynamic weather field into a weather-wildfire coupling simulation and weather research forecasting mode WRF-Fire to realize the feedback effect simulation of smoke on Fire spread. The invention discloses an aerosol-dominant positive feedback chain for the first time, namely, fire discharge provides scientific support for disaster prevention decision through the synergistic effect of thermodynamic heating and radiation forcing, so that the emergency response efficiency is improved.

title_en: Wind-driven rain erosion risk assessment method for natural river basin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and soil conservation, in particular to a wind-driven rain erosion risk assessment method for a natural river basin, which accurately identifies wind-driven rain events meeting specific wind speed, rain intensity and wind direction stability conditions by fusing DEM, meteorological and underlying surface data, and breaks through the limitation of traditional vertical rainfall assumption. By adopting a pixel-by-pixel calculation mode, the wind kinetic energy enhancement, the raindrop impact angle and the surface roughness effect are comprehensively considered, the wind-driven rain action intensity and the surface sensitivity index are constructed, the wind-driven rain erosion risk index with definite physical meaning is obtained, and the risk grade division is realized through a fractional number method. According to the method, complex numerical simulation is not needed, rapid, quantitative and space refined assessment of the river basin scale wind-driven rain erosion risk can be realized by means of conventional meteorological data, the problems that the prior art ignores space heterogeneity, relies on complex models and is high in cost are effectively solved, and reliable basis is provided for river basin water and soil conservation and disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Construction method of intelligent highway control plan of double emergency lanes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an intelligent control plan of an expressway with double emergency lanes, which is characterized in that the data of a road are acquired in real time through determining a traffic control comprehensive condition index calculation formula of the road to be controlled, traffic control comprehensive condition characteristics are constructed, a control plan cluster is produced, then a target plan and a plan execution effect and an execution condition thereof are obtained through calculation and simulation verification and recorded into a plan library, so that the expressway with double emergency lanes can be quickly searched for directly providing a solution when dealing with accidents of high-flow traffic or inner lanes, the emergency response speed is higher, and a series of plans in the control plan cluster are respectively and transversely compared through two angles of index calculation and simulation, thereby avoiding errors caused by unreasonable values of influence factor parameters, simultaneously obtaining the emergency target plan with high traffic efficiency and low secondary accident risk, and greatly improving the traffic efficiency of vehicles.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment platform and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk assessment platform and a geological disaster risk assessment method based on big data, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment of mining construction areas, wherein the platform divides the mining construction area into a plurality of subareas, acquires geological data, induced disturbance data and disaster bearing data in real time, and uploads the geological data, the induced disturbance data and the disaster bearing data to a central platform after multi-source data preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a convolutional neural network model, training by utilizing data, realizing identification of regional geological sensitivity, evoked factor response and human activity bearing characteristics and joint dynamic risk assessment, calculating geological sensitivity coefficients, assessing geological environment stability, calculating evoked intensity coefficients, judging disaster induction intensity, calculating disaster-bearing fragile coefficients, assessing human activity load and evacuation capacity, and aiming at each assessment result, the platform can timely formulate corresponding risk control strategies, improve the safety management level of mining construction regions and enhance geological disaster early warning and prevention capacity.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for virtual simulation emergency exercise under dynamic catastrophe condition of mine fire disaster based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for virtual simulation emergency exercise under a dynamic disaster condition of mine fire disaster based on deep reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of mine safety management. The method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive mine database, collecting mine environment, equipment, fire sources and ventilation system data, generating a mine structure model by using a three-dimensional modeling technology, and simulating a mine fire spreading process in real time by using a fire dynamics simulation, deep reinforcement learning optimization and virtual reality technology. The system feeds back the operation of the drilling personnel in real time according to the operation of the drilling personnel, and optimizes a fire spread simulation model. The parameters such as wind speed, wind quantity and the like of the ventilation system are calculated in a coupling way with fire spread, so that the accuracy and dynamic response of fire simulation are ensured. The system realizes the intellectualization, individuation and high efficiency of mine fire emergency exercise through the cooperative work of a plurality of modules, and effectively improves the emergency response capability of the exercise personnel.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Method, equipment and storage medium for disaster early warning of large model in integrated delivery network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and storage medium for disaster early warning of a large model in an integrated delivery network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of training disaster backup data by using the large model to obtain the association relation between a computing node and a service in the delivery network; the method comprises the steps of matching and expanding association relations between computing force nodes and services further, supplementing a training result data set of a large model, adopting a resampling strategy in the training result set of the large model, carrying out weight marking on core services and taking the core services as dynamic parameters of model training, carrying out model operation to obtain a data set range in which disaster early warning is possible, marking path nodes in the data set range in which disaster early warning is possible, carrying out multipath exploration on path nodes through which data exceeding an alarm threshold value passes, forming an early warning perception link, and adopting labels to carry out interval between the early warning perception link and other perception links. The invention improves the speed and accuracy of disaster early warning.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive emergency treatment method for internal phase of earth surface of tunnel water-gushing mud
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive emergency treatment method for the internal phase of a ground surface hole of a tunnel water-gushing mud-gushing, which comprises the steps of preliminarily predicting a cavity collapse area and a water-gushing mud-gushing port; the method comprises the steps of determining the treatment range of the surface grouting, performing comprehensive evaluation on the surface grouting, and detecting and dredging in a hole. The method comprises the steps of preliminary prediction of a cavity collapse area and a water and mud gushing opening based on an magnetotelluric method, determination of the cavity collapse area by combining surface grouting drilling, filling grouting in situ, carrying out hole periphery compaction consolidation grouting subsequently, comprehensive evaluation of surface grouting effect by combining a pressurized water test result and the magnetotelluric method, and determination of whether a dredging condition exists in a hole or not by combining an advanced exploratory hole and a pressurized water test result. The method is implemented step by step and layer by combining with the judging standard, avoids the risk of secondary surging to the greatest extent, is suitable for treating the tunnel surging disaster under the conditions of deep burial, high risk and complex geology, and has the advantages of high reliability, high safety, high success rate and small comprehensive risk.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Satellite network controller disaster recovery scheduling method based on GCN
abstract_en: A satellite network controller disaster recovery scheduling method based on GCN relates to the technical field of satellite network management and graphic neural network, and solves the problems that in the prior art, the matching relationship between a switch and a controller needs to be planned again in each time slot due to relative motion between satellites, so that the calculation force consumption is overlarge, and an allocated standby controller cannot provide optimal performance guarantee when a main controller fails. The method comprises the steps of selecting a main controller based on a multi-objective optimization model, then simulating faults of each controller in sequence, continuously using the multi-objective optimization model to select a standby controller under the condition, and completing deployment of the main controller and the standby controller through multiple iterations. Compared with the existing deployment method of the main and standby controllers, the method simulates the failure of the main controller when the standby controller is selected, so that the standby controller is the optimal choice when the main controller fails, and the role positioning of the standby controller is more accordant.

title_en: Surface deformation displacement prediction method and system based on VMD-SSA-LSSVM
abstract_en: The invention provides a surface deformation displacement prediction method and a surface deformation displacement prediction system based on a VMD-SSA-LSSVM, which comprise the steps of initializing VMD parameters based on statistical characteristics, carrying out self-adaptive VMD decomposition on a standardized surface deformation sequence to obtain IMF components, removing invalid IMF components to obtain effective IMF components, independently configuring SSA search space to obtain optimization parameters, training LSSVM submodels of the effective IMF components based on the optimization parameters, carrying out rolling prediction on the LSSVM submodels to obtain a prediction result, and carrying out weighted fusion on the prediction result according to an energy occupation ratio to obtain the surface deformation displacement prediction result. The technical scheme of the invention can process non-stable and multi-scale earth surface deformation signals, can capture sudden displacement and long-term slow deformation at the same time, and provides a more reliable technical means for geological disaster early warning and major engineering safety monitoring.
assignees: SHENZHEN INTEGRATED GEOTECHNICAL EXOLORATION & DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: In-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence, which comprises the steps of obtaining state data, a target extreme climate data set and historical disaster data of an in-service bridge, determining vulnerable key structural components of the in-service bridge under corresponding extreme climate according to the historical disaster data, determining a dominant failure mode, constructing an in-service bridge model containing parameter uncertainty according to the state data of the bridge, the vulnerable key structural components under the corresponding extreme climate and the dominant failure mode by adopting finite elements, inputting the target extreme climate data set into the in-service bridge model, and calculating probability distribution of bridge damage states of the key structural components at the second moment under different intensities through Monte Carlo simulation of a plurality of groups of random parameter samples to generate an extreme climate intensity-failure probability vulnerability curve. By implementing the method, the efficiency and the precision are effectively balanced, and the safety risk of the bridge under extreme weather is reduced.

title_en: Disaster early warning method and system for wide-grading gravel soil
abstract_en: The invention provides a wide-grading gravel soil catastrophe early warning method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source state data of a soil body, carrying out data dimension reduction and analysis on the multi-source state data, screening out a key catastrophe factor set representing a wide-grading gravel soil catastrophe process, simulating a soil body catastrophe evolution process on a microscopic numerical model by adopting a coupling simulation technology based on the key catastrophe factor set, extracting quantitative early warning indexes corresponding to the key catastrophe factor set from the evolution process, carrying out data-level fusion on real-time monitoring values of all factors in the key catastrophe factor set obtained by a plurality of monitoring points by adopting a self-adaptive weighted average algorithm, generating a fusion data sequence, carrying out fusion calculation on the basis of the quantitative early warning indexes and the fusion data sequence through fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, obtaining a comprehensive risk evaluation result, determining a risk grade according to the comprehensive risk evaluation result, and effectively avoiding loss caused by hysteresis.
assignees: JIANGXI VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV;SHANGRAO GUANGXIN HIGHWAY BUSINESS DEV CENTER

title_en: Coal mine underground reservoir dam body impact resistance stability simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The application provides a device and a method for simulating the impact stability of a dam body of a coal mine underground reservoir, wherein the device comprises a main body frame, a dam body model, a dam body loading system, an impact disturbance system, an impact energy monitoring system and a response measurement monitoring system, wherein the dam body loading system is arranged at the upper part and two sides of the main body frame and is used for providing vertical static load force and transverse static load force for the dam body model; the impact disturbance system is arranged at the upper part of the main body frame and used for applying dynamic load force to a target position of the dam model, the impact energy monitoring system is used for monitoring impact speed and impact energy of the impact disturbance system, and the response measurement monitoring system is used for monitoring response states of the dam model when the dam loading system and the impact disturbance system act. The application can obtain the mechanical response characteristics and deformation damage rules of the underground reservoir dam under the impact load effect, and reveal the disaster-causing mechanism of the coal mine underground reservoir dam caused by impact dynamic disaster inoculation.
assignees: NAT INST CLEAN & LOW CARBON ENERGY;GUONENG SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD;CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power supply guarantee emergency dispatching method, system, device and medium based on mobile power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power supply guarantee emergency dispatching method, a system, a device and a medium based on a mobile power system, belonging to the technical field of power system emergency guarantee and intelligent dispatching, comprising the steps of constructing a three-dimensional coupling model for simulating the comprehensive influence of extreme meteorological conditions on road traffic capacity, power system running state and power supply requirement; the power supply guarantee emergency dispatching method, system, device and medium based on the mobile power system are suitable for emergency power guarantee tasks under a large-scale natural disaster, have high intellectualization and expandability, realize intelligent dispatching of emergency power supply resources, path optimization and rapid load recovery, integrate multisource information, have intelligent perception and high-efficiency decision-making capability, and can comprehensively consider road traffic, power supply and demand and load priority, realize dynamic optimized dispatching of mobile power units in the mobile power system, thereby improving disaster coping capability and power grid toughness.
assignees: JIANGSU NANBO SMART ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI;UNIV SOUTHEAST;NANJING DONGBO SMART ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Dam deformation and temperature optical fiber monitoring equipment and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses dam deformation and temperature optical fiber monitoring equipment and a monitoring method thereof, which relate to the technical field of dam deformation monitoring and comprise a cushion block and a left sand box, wherein the left sand box is fixed on the cushion block through bolts, and wing plates are fixedly arranged on two sides of the opening of the left sand box, a tray is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the opening of the left sand box, and a plurality of threading holes are vertically arranged at the closed end of the left sand box. According to the dam deformation and temperature optical fiber monitoring equipment and the monitoring method thereof, in the test process, through the double sand box linkage system, the left sand box is fixed, the right sand box can move tangentially/vertically under the action of the composite moving assembly, the layered shearing effect in actual engineering is simulated, the monitoring capability of the distributed optical fiber sensor on the shearing displacement of the soil body is verified, the cable-soil interaction when the dam is deformed is simulated, and the dam deformation and temperature optical fiber monitoring equipment is suitable for researching the mechanical behavior of the soil body under different stress conditions, and has important application values in the aspects of geological disaster early warning and geotechnical structure safety evaluation.

title_en: Long tunnel remote automatic monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-and-large tunnel remote automatic monitoring method which comprises the following steps of S1, arranging sensors in and around a tunnel, S2, transmitting data acquired by the sensors, a camera and sound acquisition equipment to a remote monitoring center in real time through a remote data transmission system, S3, carrying out preprocessing on the data after the data are received by the remote monitoring center, constructing an intelligent data processing and analyzing model based on a neural network according to the preprocessed data, training and optimizing the network by utilizing a continuous counter-propagation algorithm and a random reinitialization technology, and evaluating the stability and safety of the tunnel by utilizing the intelligent data processing and analyzing model, S4, carrying out early warning and alarming, wherein when the monitored data exceed a preset threshold value, an automatic monitoring platform automatically triggers an early warning mechanism, and S5, carrying out emergency response and processing, and immediately starting an emergency pre-plan once the hidden danger or problem exists in the tunnel.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHIRUN SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Disaster avoidance place starting and path planning decision-making method considering urban water affair system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster avoidance place starting and path planning decision method considering an urban water system, which comprises the steps of obtaining rainfall update forecast data under rainfall events in a target area, constructing a decision scene, namely establishing an urban waterlogging simulation model through the urban water system data, inputting the rainfall update forecast data into the urban waterlogging simulation model to generate a inundation scene, obtaining space-time distribution of disaster-stricken personnel evacuation demands in each building, obtaining the function change condition of a road network, constructing a multi-stage evacuation decision frame, namely considering disaster avoidance place cost and disaster-stricken personnel transfer risk, constructing a double-objective optimization mathematical model, updating a double-objective optimization mathematical model solving result, and carrying out path planning for disaster-stricken personnel needing to be transferred to obtain an optimal transfer path. The invention balances the cost of disaster avoidance places and the transfer risk of disaster-stricken personnel, solves the inherent error in forecasting rainfall, and dynamically optimizes decision in the process that rainfall information is gradually clear along with the time.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENGINEERING GROUP ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for constructing simulation model of urban water supply system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for constructing a simulation model of an urban water supply system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a water supply system structure model comprising a water supply node model and a topological relation model, establishing an operation rule model and constructing a hydraulic balance model, quantitatively evaluating the water production capacity, the water storage capacity and the water production dynamic balance capacity of the water supply system based on multi-model collaborative simulation, constructing a double-layer failure simulation system of the water supply system association failure and cascade failure to conduct overall process simulation prediction of the water supply system from single-point failure to regional failure based on the capacity model, and constructing a three-stage closed-loop recovery simulation system of a water supply system recovery strategy, recovery degree and recovery time to conduct overall process optimization decision of the water supply system from emergency response to complete recovery based on failure simulation results output by the double-layer failure simulation system. The emergency response capability of the water supply system is improved through full-flow simulation.

title_en: Multi-agent optimization training method and system based on perception analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a multi-agent optimization training method and system based on perception analysis, comprising the steps of obtaining an initial perception description vector of each type of each command; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a final perception description vector of each type of each command, comparing similarity of a target command and all commands in a historical analysis task to obtain process reference degree of each reference command for the target command, analyzing difference of perception data to obtain perception environment consistency of the target command and each reference command, comparing and updating difference obtained result contribution degree of the perception description vector and the final perception description vector to obtain adaptation weight of each strategy to the target command, and obtaining optimal strategy combination of a target agent to the task to be analyzed according to the adaptation weight. The invention aims to solve the problem of dimension disaster caused by multiple strategies of multiple intelligent agents and improve training efficiency by reducing action space.
assignees: LANKING INFORMATION TECH NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on rock-soil body microseism sensing network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring and early warning system based on a rock-soil body microseism sensing network, in particular relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and is used for solving the problems of insufficient positioning accuracy and poor early warning reliability caused by neglecting formation heterogeneity in the existing seismic source positioning method; the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological exploration data of a monitoring area, constructing a three-dimensional heterogeneous stratum model containing cracks and faults, simulating a distortion propagation path of micro-seismic waves in an anisotropic medium, generating a waveform feature library, extracting time-frequency domain energy distribution of actual signals, matching the time-frequency domain energy distribution with the feature library, dynamically correcting equivalent wave velocity field parameters, combining sensor coordinates and a corrected wave velocity field to calculate a propagation time difference matrix, constructing a nonlinear equation set taking wave velocity deviation as constraint, solving seismic source space coordinates, finally generating dynamic early warning signals based on the distribution relation of the seismic sources and the stratum model, and remarkably improving seismic source positioning precision and early warning accuracy in a complex rock environment.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;XINJIANG GEZHOUBA DASHIXIA WATER CONSERVANCY PROJECT DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG XINHUA YEERQIANG RIVER BASIN WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;XINJIANG UYGUR AUTONOMOUS REGION TARIM RIVER BASIN CHEERCHEN RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY MAN CENTER

title_en: Side slope dangerous rock mass identification prediction method and device based on large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying and predicting a side slope dangerous rock mass based on a large model, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster coping and prevention and control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data, constructing a first database and a second database, preprocessing the data of the first database and the second database, training a prediction model, obtaining real-time monitoring data, preprocessing the real-time monitoring data, analyzing the preprocessed real-time monitoring data by using the prediction model, dynamically adjusting a risk threshold value, analyzing a risk result, determining a countermeasure according to the risk result, and carrying out visual display.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP THIRD ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHENGDU XINGJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test system and method for air-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperation oriented virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test system and an air-ground cooperation oriented virtual-real fusion traffic twin simulation test method, belongs to the field of intelligent traffic design optimization, verification or simulation, and aims to provide a highly flexible multi-scene experiment platform for teaching and scientific research through the concept of 'entity twin-dynamic mapping'. Based on a dynamic display technology, the system twines real traffic scenes such as urban roads, emergency evacuation, three-dimensional parking and the like into a small-scale experimental space, supports rapid scene and space layout switching, and realizes seamless mapping of virtual and real environments. The central control system synchronizes the motion trail and virtual traffic flow of physical devices such as unmanned aerial vehicles, intelligent vehicles and the like in real time through a virtual-real fusion technology, and forms a bidirectional interactive closed loop of 'small space entity-central control virtual'. The multi-scene self-adaptive integration idea is taken as a core, and the space-ground coordination capability is combined, so that the dynamic reconstruction and nonlinear migration of tasks such as logistics distribution, emergency response and the like are supported, and the cross-scene experiment can be completed without hardware transformation.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING QIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: AF/rGO fiber haptic system and method with multi-model sensing capability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic electronic skin and flexible sensing materials, and particularly provides an AF/rGO fiber touch system and an AF/rGO fiber touch method, wherein aramid 1414 fibers are adopted as a base material, are repeatedly immersed in graphene oxide solution after being ultrasonically cleaned, are subjected to surface loading with graphene oxide coating, are reduced into graphene oxide coating by utilizing steam, and are subjected to hot pressing and synergetic to prepare an AF/rGO fiber sensor; the piezoresistance and thermosensitive effect of the fiber are used as core materials of the sensor, the fiber is connected with two electrodes to form the sensor, mechanical and temperature stimulation is converted into resistance signal change, the pressure and temperature sensing capability of skin is simulated through multi-mode fusion and signal processing, the fabric recognition and gesture recognition are realized based on the contact resistance dynamic response of a micro-scale structure and by combining a neural network algorithm, and meanwhile, fire disaster early warning is triggered through temperature resistance signal change by utilizing the flame retardant property of an aramid fiber substrate.

title_en: Radar echo extrapolation method based on space-time attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar echo extrapolation method based on a space-time attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining radar echo data of a target area, preprocessing the obtained radar echo data, carrying out sliding grouping on the preprocessed radar echo data, carrying out data augmentation to obtain a radar echo sequence data set, then dividing the radar echo sequence data set into a training set and a testing set, constructing a radar echo prediction network model based on SimVP architecture, carrying out training and testing, supervising the model training by adopting a multi-target loss function, and carrying out real-time prediction to obtain future radar echo images. The method can more accurately capture the dynamic evolution of complex weather phenomena such as storm and the like, can remarkably improve the accuracy and the interpretability of short-time adjacent weather forecast, provides more reliable technical support for timely and accurate early warning of meteorological disasters, and has important practical application value.

title_en: Chemical industry park multisource risk coupling evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical industry park wind control, and discloses a chemical industry park multisource risk coupling evaluation system and method. The system comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing unit, a multisource risk coupling evaluation model, a dynamic risk situation evaluation unit, a risk intention deducing unit, an emergency strategy generation unit, a visual interaction unit and an emergency strategy comprehensive display unit, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing unit acquires and processes dangerous source state, environment and emergency resource information in real time, the multisource risk coupling evaluation model simulates risk evolution based on a coupling mechanism and outputs quantitative indexes, the dynamic risk situation evaluation unit calculates risk space-time propagation by combining real-time meteorological information to generate a dynamic map, the risk intention deducing unit deduces risk evolution trend by combining a historical accident situation library to identify short-term and long-term risks, the emergency strategy generation unit combines emergency resource layout to generate a multi-level emergency response strategy, and the visual interaction unit comprehensively displays the dynamic map and the emergency strategy. The system realizes accurate evaluation and dynamic management and control of multisource risks, and improves the park risk management and control and emergency response capability.
assignees: JIANGSU GUOHENG SAFETY EVALUATION CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Distributed flood forecasting method based on multilayer soil humidity assimilation
abstract_en: A distributed flood forecasting method based on multilayer soil humidity assimilation belongs to the field of flood forecasting. Firstly, constructing a distributed hydrologic model, dividing a soil profile into three layers with different characteristics, namely a surface layer, a lower layer and a deep layer, secondly, collecting and processing remote sensing observation data, comprising four parts of uniform spatial scale, uniform unit, uniform time scale and deviation correction, and finally, constructing a multi-layer soil humidity number assimilation module based on the distributed hydrologic model, and correcting simulation errors of the surface layer and the lower layer soil humidity of the distributed hydrologic model by adopting a set Kalman filtering algorithm and a Kalman gain pushing method, thereby improving flood forecasting precision. According to the invention, the Kalman gain of the surface layer is shifted to the lower layer, so that the humidity states of the surface layer and the lower layer soil before the field flood of the distributed hydrologic model occurs are corrected, the accuracy and the reliability of flood forecast are improved, the model soil humidity simulation error can be effectively reduced, and technical support is provided for flood control and disaster reduction of large and medium-sized watersheds.

title_en: Snow eave growth monitoring system based on terrain coupling and dynamic evolution model
abstract_en: The application provides a snow eave growth monitoring system based on a terrain coupling and dynamic evolution model, which relates to the technical field of mountain snow disaster monitoring, and comprises a sensitive area identification module, a dynamic evolution module and a dynamic evolution module, wherein the sensitive area identification module is used for acquiring environmental data of mountain terrains and wind fields, constructing a wind and terrain microscale coupling tensor field according to the environmental data, identifying a snow eave potential formation sensitive area according to the wind and terrain microscale coupling tensor field, establishing a dynamic evolution model integrating a pneumatic jump accumulation and micro sintering mechanism according to the identified snow eave potential formation sensitive area, simulating a snow eave generation and growth process according to the dynamic evolution model, and obtaining a structure expansion result generated by the snow eave according to simulation. According to the application, a sensitive area identification module for fusing a wind field and a topography microscale coupling tensor field is constructed, and a snow eave structure evolution model, a multidimensional sensing data fusion mechanism and a zoning risk output module are combined to dynamically describe the growth process of the snow eave under specific topography and meteorological conditions.

title_en: Earthquake signal analysis and collapse disaster early warning method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application provides a machine learning-based earthquake signal analysis and collapse disaster early warning method, and relates to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The method comprises the steps of performing first processing operation on a multi-source data set to obtain a first data set containing seismic signal characteristics, performing second processing operation on the multi-source data set to obtain a second data set containing geological condition characteristics, performing third processing operation on the multi-source data set to obtain a third data set containing space-time dynamic characteristics, constructing a target characteristic data set based on the first data set, the second data set and the third data set, training an initial disaster early warning model based on the target characteristic data set to obtain a target disaster early warning model under the condition that training is completed, receiving seismic collapse monitoring data, taking the seismic collapse monitoring data as input of the target disaster early warning model, and outputting a seismic collapse prediction result based on the target disaster early warning model. The method can improve the accuracy of the prediction of the collapse disaster.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD

title_en: Substation area flood early warning method and system based on critical surface rainfall
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid flood disaster early warning, and particularly relates to a substation area flood early warning method and system based on critical surface rainfall; the method comprises the steps of obtaining environment information, real-time rainfall information and real-time soil humidity information of a transformer substation, determining critical surface rainfall on the basis of the environment information of the transformer substation, setting early warning grades on the basis of the critical surface rainfall, inputting the real-time rainfall information and the real-time soil humidity information into a pre-established distributed hydrologic physical model, carrying out river basin hydrologic simulation by using the distributed hydrologic physical model to obtain a water level change predicted value of a transformer substation area, carrying out flood early warning according to the water level change predicted value of the transformer substation area, and outputting corresponding early warning grades. According to the invention, the topography and topography, hydrologic characteristics and rainfall data of the transformer substation area are comprehensively analyzed, the critical surface rainfall is determined, and a flood early warning model is established accordingly, so that the accurate early warning of the flood disasters of the transformer substation area is realized.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Hydropower station electric power safety VR scene construction and operation verification method
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydropower station electric power safety VR scene construction and operation verification method, a hydropower station electric power safety VR scene construction and operation verification device, electronic equipment and a computer-readable storage medium. The hydropower station electric power safety VR scene construction and operation verification method provided by the embodiment of the invention can accurately simulate the complex running environment and equipment linkage logic of the hydropower station, obviously improve the accuracy of misoperation accident simulation and the authenticity of emergency response training, and effectively improve the electric power safety training effect and operation normalization.
assignees: SICHUAN HUANENG BAOXINGHE WATER POWER CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method combined with negative-sample optimization and deep learning model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability assessment method combining negative sample optimization and a deep learning model, which is implemented according to the following steps of step 1, obtaining original various landslide disaster influence factors in a research area, carrying out quantization treatment to obtain the landslide disaster influence factors, step 2, sampling non-landslide negative samples according to a proportional sampling strategy to form a sample set, step 3, constructing a CNN-SA-BiGRU coupling deep learning model, training, and step 4, predicting landslide probability and manufacturing a landslide vulnerability partition map. The method solves the problems that the existing method subjectively selects a non-landslide sample, and the model is built to be fitted and has poor stability, so that the prediction result is inaccurate.

title_en: Surface mine backup pre-splitting perforation hole distribution and step slope angle control method
