abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of surface mine pre-cracking perforation, and particularly relates to a surface mine backup pre-cracking perforation hole distribution and step slope angle control method, which comprises the following steps of (1) preparing work before pre-cracking perforation, wherein the flatness of a pre-cracking perforation area is controlled according to +/-0.1 meter; the method comprises the steps of (1) pre-splitting Kong Bukong, firstly adopting inflection points to distribute holes preferentially, then combining a hole spacing method for sequentially distributing holes to two sides to perform pre-splitting Kong Bukong, and (3) pre-splitting perforation, wherein before the surface mine is backed up to pre-split perforation, measurement is performed on a drill rod through an angle measuring instrument, and the transverse horizontal projection is controlled to vertically design a pre-splitting perforation line and the longitudinal direction accords with the designed step slope angle respectively. The method effectively controls the flatness of the perforated area, prevents abrupt uneven pre-cracking surfaces, reduces the phenomenon of deep crossing and forking of pre-cracking perforations of the side slope backup of an open stope, improves the pre-cracking half-porosity of the backup, avoids the instability of the side slope, reduces the occurrence probability of geological disasters of the mine side slope, and realizes safe production.
assignees: TAIYUAN IRON & STEEL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent maintenance method and system based on dam safety state drive
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent maintenance method and system based on dam safety state drive, wherein the method is characterized in that real-time and historical data of four core indexes of dam structural stability, seepage control capability, equipment reliability and environmental adaptability are collected, weight distribution is carried out by adopting an Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and comprehensive safety percentage is calculated, and intelligent inspection scheduling is realized by dynamically adjusting inspection period, technical means and resource allocation according to safety level. The system further integrates a multi-source data fusion module, a dynamic adjustment module and a machine learning module, eliminates noise by using a Kalman filtering algorithm, and optimizes risk prediction and weight distribution by combining an LSTM neural network model. When the safety level is below a preset threshold, the system automatically starts an emergency response mechanism, including an automated monitoring, emergency equipment scheduling and BIM simulation system, to guide emergency treatment. The invention can improve the safety and the operation and maintenance efficiency of the dam operation.
assignees: HUANENG SICHUAN ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;SICHUAN HUANENG TAIPINGYI HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Electric power spot market load prediction method and system based on causal discovery
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of causal discovery, provides a causal discovery-based power spot market load prediction method and a causal discovery-based power spot market load prediction system, and solves the problems of low accuracy and poor timeliness of power transaction trend prediction in extreme weather. The method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of electric power transaction, sound waves and vibration signals of a new energy power station, analyzing to obtain microclimate data and abnormal state data of a photovoltaic panel, generating disaster monitoring data, combining simulation data of the power station and market price data, analyzing causal relations between weather and output and market variables by using a causal discovery algorithm to construct a dynamic causal graph, fusing the causal graph and weather raster data to enhance the generation of semantic data, distributing weights by using a space-time attention mechanism, and finally predicting the influence of new energy output loss on electric power market load. The method and the system improve the accuracy and timeliness of the power transaction trend prediction in extreme weather.

title_en: Loess sliding impact masonry building vulnerability evaluation method based on physical mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quantitative evaluation of geological disaster risks, in particular to a loess sliding impact masonry building vulnerability evaluation method based on a physical mechanism. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geological background parameters and building structure parameters of a loess sliding region, constructing a three-dimensional geological model of loess sliding based on the geological background parameters and the building structure parameters, analyzing a three-dimensional movement process of loess sliding to obtain a loess sliding kinematic simulation result, and carrying out space matching on the speed, the height and the impact direction of the sliding body moving to a target building position based on the loess sliding kinematic simulation result and the building structure parameters to obtain the impact speed, the impact height and the impact included angle of the sliding body. The method and the device for evaluating the vulnerability of the building improve the evaluation efficiency and the evaluation precision by quantitatively analyzing the vulnerability of the building, and have wide engineering application values.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Coal mine area ground collapse damage degree evaluation and prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mine geological disasters, and particularly relates to a method for evaluating and predicting ground collapse damage degree of a coal mine area. The method comprises the steps of establishing a classification standard for evaluating the collapse land damage degree of the coal mining ground through field geological investigation and data collection, evaluating the current situation of the collapse land damage degree of the ground of the mined working surface, counting drilling data in the ground collapse influence range of the mined working surface, taking the collapse land damage degree of the ground of the mined working surface as a discrimination result, establishing a Fisher discrimination model, finally counting all drilling data of a mining area, applying the drilling data to the established Fisher discrimination model, predicting the collapse land damage degree of the coal mining ground of the mining area, establishing a factor thematic map according to a GIS space analysis method, and obtaining a ground collapse land damage degree map according to the discrimination prediction result so as to realize accurate and reliable quantitative prediction on the collapse land damage degree of the coal mining ground of a region to be mined in the coal mining area.
assignees: SHENMU NINGTIAOTA MINING CO LTD SHAANXI COAL AND CHEMICAL IND GROUP;UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Forest fire risk assessment method based on interpretable deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire risk assessment method based on interpretable deep learning, which relates to the technical field of forest disaster prevention and comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to generate a multi-dimensional data cube, extracting a logic relation for forming forest fire risk based on the multi-dimensional data cube, constructing a forest fire risk field knowledge graph based on the logic relation of the forest fire risk, constructing and training a concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model based on the multi-dimensional data cube as a training sample, and mapping the multi-dimensional data cube input into the concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model to a semantic concept layer defined by the forest fire risk field knowledge graph. The invention generates a multidimensional data cube by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data, constructs a knowledge graph in the forest fire risk field, trains a concept bottleneck interpretable deep learning model, maps input data to a semantic concept layer, and outputs fire risk level and concept activation results.

title_en: Multi-dimensional dynamic coupling hydraulic engineering toughness assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional dynamic coupling hydraulic engineering toughness assessment method which comprises the steps of S1, S2, carrying out dynamic simulation on a disaster chain, training a GAN model by utilizing data collected in the step S1, constructing a 'structural mechanics-hydrodynamic-ecological model' coupling frame by the trained GAN model for generating virtual scenes of different disaster combinations, simulating dynamic evolution after disaster occurrence, generating a plurality of groups of disaster chain evolution processes, S3, calculating a comprehensive toughness index, and assessing the engineering toughness of each group of disaster chain evolution processes generated in the step S2.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Super-standard flood dynamic simulation method and device considering disaster of flood control engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for dynamically simulating super-standard flood by considering catastrophe of a flood control project, which are characterized in that data are collected in a traditional model construction mode, a river course flood evolution model is constructed according to the collected data, the position and the type of a water injection project are marked in the model, catastrophe information of the water conservancy project is obtained in real time in the running process of the model, model parameters of the catastrophe position are dynamically adjusted according to the position and the catastrophe information of the water conservancy project, the model parameters of the catastrophe position are calculated according to the type of the water conservancy project and the model parameters of the catastrophe position to obtain a breach flow, the model parameters of the river course flood evolution are dynamically modified according to the model parameters of the catastrophe position and the breach flow, and the catastrophe is calculated to obtain a super-standard flood dynamic simulation scene. Compared with the prior art, which mainly adopts a scene type and static simulation method, the invention can realize dynamic simulation in the model operation process, and couples the catastrophe process to the flood process simulation, so that the simulation of the super-standard flood process is more real.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Wisdom bridge geological disaster prevention and control system based on 5G
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G-based intelligent bridge geological disaster prevention and control system which comprises an image acquisition module, a sensor monitoring module, an edge calculation module, a 5G communication module, a cloud intelligent analysis platform and an early warning and emergency treatment module. The image acquisition module acquires images of the bridge and surrounding geological environment in real time by utilizing a high-resolution camera powered by solar energy and an infrared thermal imaging device, and the sensor monitoring module acquires bridge plate displacement, pier inclination angle, structural strain and environmental parameters. And the edge calculation module is used for carrying out local quick identification and risk initial judgment on the monitoring data, and the 5G communication module is used for realizing low-delay and multi-link data transmission. The cloud intelligent analysis platform fuses the multi-source data to perform secondary analysis, risk prediction and evolution simulation, and triggers multi-level early warning and traffic linkage measures through the early warning and emergency treatment module. The invention can realize real-time, accurate and whole-process prevention and control of bridge geological disasters and remarkably improve the safety operation level of the bridge.

title_en: Landslide identification method based on multi-level heterogeneous knowledge distillation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification method based on multi-level heterogeneous knowledge distillation, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and image identification, and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a basic segmentation network; S2, extracting multi-level features, S3, calculating mixed supervision loss, adjusting self-adaptive distillation parameters, S5, optimizing student models, S6, and identifying landslide. The landslide identification method based on multi-level heterogeneous knowledge distillation improves the reasoning speed, gives consideration to high precision and high efficiency, has complete segmentation result outline and clear boundary, reduces omission and false detection, effectively solves the problem of unbalanced category, improves the robustness to changes such as illumination, and is stable in performance in different geological background data sets, optimizes the training process and improves the learning stability.

title_en: Urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data-based urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain simulation method, which comprises the steps of simulating and verifying an urban flood model based on big data, constructing an urban lifeline facility flood disaster chain based on big data, dynamically simulating a lifeline facility flood disaster chain by coupling a numerical simulation and cascade failure method, and evaluating the influence of extreme storm flood on the evolution of the lifeline facility disaster chain. The method of the invention is based on big data, adopts the technical scheme of numerical simulation, big data and cascade failure, the dynamic simulation of the life line facility disaster chain is creatively realized, the technical method in the field is innovated, and the method has obvious technical progress.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring method and system based on random forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster monitoring method and system based on random forests, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data in each training sample, constructing a main control feature factor set through a recursive feature elimination method based on a support vector machine according to the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous data, constructing a random forest model according to the main control feature factor set, monitoring geological disasters through the random forest model by utilizing the main control feature factor set of each training sample, training the random forest model according to geological disaster monitoring results of each training sample, obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data to be monitored, which are related to the geological disasters, inputting the multi-source heterogeneous data to be monitored into the trained random forest model, outputting the geological disaster type and risk level, judging whether the risk level reaches a risk threshold, if so, triggering an early warning signal, otherwise, continuing monitoring.

title_en: Knowledge and vision combined driving flame image recognition analysis method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flame image recognition analysis method and device driven by combination of knowledge and vision, and relates to the technical field of image recognition. Firstly, acquiring flame knowledge graph data. Based on the data, a convolutional neural network is established, a corresponding flame image is taken as input, and the entity embedded vector is taken as a label for training, so that an entity embedded vector prediction model is formed. And (3) segmenting the flame image, extracting flame visual characteristic parameters, embedding and spatially expanding to generate a characteristic data training tensor. The feature data is trained to extract the composite features by means of ViT network models. And acquiring a flame image to be identified, calculating a dangerous emergency coefficient through a model, comparing the dangerous emergency coefficient with a threshold value to generate a corresponding processing scheme, and simultaneously textually outputting a result. The visual characteristics and the knowledge graph are effectively combined, and the accuracy and the intellectualization of flame image identification and emergency response are improved.

title_en: Method for preventing and controlling heading face head-on rock burst disasters and water injection bag system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing and controlling a heading face rock burst disaster and a water injection bag system, which comprises the steps of S1, determining the number and positions of directional pressure relief drilling holes, working face tunneling parameters and water injection bag distribution parameters, arranging bags according to the parameters, injecting water into the bags, S2, discharging water from the outermost water injection bags for pressure relief, pushing the discharged water pressure relief bags to the adjacent water injection bags for tunneling, S3, stopping tunneling, recovering the discharged water pressure relief bags, discharging water from the next water injection bags for pressure relief, pushing the discharged water pressure relief bags to the adjacent water injection bags, and starting the next tunneling until the tunneling reaches a designed position. The water injection bag system comprises a plurality of bags, a water injection pipe, one-way valves, a water outlet pipe and ball valves, wherein water is injected into each bag in one way along the water injection pipe through each one-way valve during water injection, the ball valves of the water outlet pipe are opened during water discharge, and water in the water injection bags flows out along the water outlet pipe for pressure relief.

title_en: HIL algorithm-based power system transient stability time domain numerical value recurrence calculation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of quantum computation and power systems, in particular to a power system transient stability time domain numerical value recurrence computation method based on an HIL algorithm. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a mathematical model of an electric power system element, discretizing a state equation by adopting an implicit trapezoidal integration method, simplifying a differential variable by a primordial elimination method, reducing network nodes of a network topology, then combining the differential equation and an algebraic equation, and introducing a quantum Newton-Lafson algorithm based on an HHT algorithm to carry out efficient solution. According to the invention, the quantum algorithm is introduced into the transient stability time domain simulation combining the implicit trapezoidal integration method and the Newton-Laporthelson method, the exponential acceleration characteristic of the HHT algorithm in solving the linear equation set is utilized, and the complexity of model solving is effectively reduced, so that the solving efficiency of the residual equation set and the whole simulation is greatly improved, and the problem of dimension disaster faced in the transient stability analysis of a large-scale power system is effectively alleviated.

title_en: Wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind and rain, earthquake and wave disaster coupling experiment system, relates to the field of ocean engineering experiment equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the degree of restoration of natural disaster experiments is not high. The system comprises a wind and rain simulation unit, a wave simulation unit, an earthquake simulation unit and a cooperative control unit, wherein the wind and rain simulation unit comprises a wind tunnel main body, a fan arranged in the wind tunnel main body and a rainfall simulation mechanism arranged in the wind tunnel main body, the wave simulation unit comprises a wave making pool arranged in the wind tunnel main body, a wave making mechanism and a flow making mechanism arranged in the wave making pool, the earthquake simulation unit comprises a vibrating table arranged in the wave making pool and used for bearing a building model, and the wind and rain simulation unit, the wave simulation unit and the earthquake simulation unit are all electrically connected with the cooperative control unit, and the cooperative control unit is used for controlling the working state of each simulation unit. The method is used for realizing the restoration simulation of multiple disasters of the traffic infrastructure in the coastal extreme environment.
assignees: UNIV SHIJIAZHUANG TIEDAO;HEBEI TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ocean disaster forecasting method and system for coupling wind field and wave field
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of marine disaster forecast, and discloses a marine disaster forecast method and a marine disaster forecast system for coupling a wind field and a wave field, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining wind field and wave field observation data at the initial moment of a target sea area; the method comprises the steps of taking wind field observation data as an initial field to execute first-round wind field numerical forecasting, taking wave field observation data as the initial field and taking a first forecasting wind field as a driving wind field to execute first-round wave field numerical forecasting, calculating sea surface roughness based on the first forecasting wave field, executing second-round wind field and wave field numerical forecasting by taking the sea surface roughness as parameters, carrying out iterative coupling inspection based on two-round forecasting results until the final wind field and the wave field are converged, and generating ocean disaster forecasting results according to the final wind field and the wave field. According to the method, through bidirectional coupling and iterative optimization of the wind field and the wave field, the sea-air interaction simulation precision is improved, and the reliability and accuracy of ocean disaster forecast are improved.

title_en: Rolling stone identification and tracking method based on improvement yolo-deepsort
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling stone identification and tracking method based on improvement yolo-deepsort, which belongs to the technical field of disaster monitoring and comprises the steps of obtaining a rolling stone picture data set and preprocessing to obtain a rolling stone picture training set and a rolling stone picture verification set, improving a yolov network model based on a MobileNetV module and a WTConv module to construct a rolling stone target identification model, constructing a deepsort rolling stone tracking model based on a rolling stone target identification network, training and verifying the constructed rolling stone identification and tracking network to obtain a rolling stone identification and tracking model, obtaining rolling stone pictures and videos to be detected, and predicting the rolling stone pictures and videos to be detected by utilizing the obtained network model to obtain the identification and tracking results of the falling stone pictures and videos to be detected. The method solves the problems of low identification and tracking efficiency and insufficient accuracy of the rolling stone disasters.

title_en: Slope displacement prediction method and system based on physical information neural network and gating cycle unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, in particular to a slope displacement prediction method and system based on a physical information neural network and a door control circulation unit. The method combines the physical information neural network with the gating circulation unit to realize the organic fusion of data driving and physical constraint, embeds a slope mechanical control equation and boundary conditions into the neural network training process through the physical information neural network, maintains the physical rationality of a prediction result when the monitored data is insufficient or noise exists, and simultaneously, effectively captures the nonlinear time sequence characteristics of the slope displacement under the complex working conditions of rainfall, water level, construction and the like, and improves the modeling capability of the dynamic evolution process. The method not only improves the accuracy and stability of slope displacement prediction, but also enhances the generalization capability and engineering interpretability of the model under different working conditions, realizes real-time early warning of the risk of slope instability, and provides more reliable technical support for geological disaster prevention.
assignees: SICHUAN TONGCHUAN ENGINEERING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A administering device that is used for liquefying gentle slope area landslide mud flow disaster chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a treatment device for a landslide and mud flow disaster chain in a liquefiable gentle slope zone, which relates to the technical field of slope protection and comprises a permeable decompression anti-slip blocking structure, wherein the permeable decompression anti-slip blocking structure comprises a cantilever section, a prefabricated baffle is arranged on the cantilever section, a porous permeable section is arranged at the bottom of the cantilever section, a composite infiltration supporting structure is arranged on the outer side of the porous permeable section, and an earthquake opening and closing valve is arranged at the upper end inside a cavity anchoring section. This a treatment device for but liquefaction gentle slope zone landslide mud flow disaster chain sets up in the outside of porous section of permeating water through the rubble filling material layer, and the annular space between the section of permeating water of rubble filling material layer mainly used porous section and the drilling large aperture section is filled, selects for use single particle diameter or graded rubble to guarantee its good permeability, can quick drainage and transmission pore water pressure, so that under the circumstances of assisting to fix porous section of permeating water, promote the drainage efficiency between the section of permeating water of porous section and the first infiltration hole simultaneously.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Numerical simulation method, system, medium and equipment for wire icing process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method, a system, a medium and equipment for a wire icing process, and relates to the field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the mass flux of liquid water conveyed to the surface of a wire in air; the method comprises the steps of determining a corresponding icing mass increment through numerical integration based on a wire icing theoretical model by combining liquid water mass flux, freezing rate, collision rate and wire icing diameter of each time step, obtaining a simulation result of icing mass variation in the wire icing process by combining icing mass loss based on the icing mass increment, determining icing density according to the impact speed of liquid drops, the median volume diameter of the liquid drops and the icing surface temperature, and obtaining a simulation result of icing thickness variation in the wire icing process by combining the simulation result of icing mass variation based on the icing density so as to complete numerical simulation of evolution of the wire icing process under natural conditions.
assignees: GUIZHOU INST OF MOUNTAIN METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of distribution network after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of a distribution network after disaster, belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and solves the problems that the traditional sequencing relies on manual/single indexes, is difficult to cope with fault uncertainty and lacks a standardized model. The method comprises the steps of calculating load recovery weights based on population density and unit load economic loss by using an improved analytic hierarchy process, simulating and generating a multi-fault scene by using Monte Carlo, building an optimization model by taking minimum economic and social losses as targets and combining a complex electricity means and scheduling constraint, solving the model to obtain switch operation time, and determining transfer priority by using Copride sequencing. The invention provides a scientific scheme for emergency decision of complex fault scenes, meets the requirement of rapidly making an optimal transfer strategy after disaster, and reduces economic and social losses.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent identification and digital reconstruction method for rock mass fracture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rock mass engineering, in particular to an intelligent identification and digital reconstruction method for rock mass cracks, which comprises the steps of collecting rock mass crack images; manually marking color blocks, introducing marked medical image cell membrane samples and road crack samples based on transfer learning, performing joint training on a crack recognition model, inputting a rock mass crack image into the crack recognition model to split cracks, constructing a snake-shaped convolution network to extract multi-scale features of the image, digitally reconstructing a binary image to obtain block set and fold line set data, and restoring the digital data from a pixel scale to an engineering scale. The invention realizes the intelligent identification of the rock mass fracture image and the full-flow automation of the digital reconstruction, and can be widely applied to the fields of geotechnical engineering design, slope disaster identification, underground space stability analysis and the like.

title_en: Debris flow risk prediction method and system based on POA optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow hazard prediction method and system based on a POA optimization algorithm, and relates to the technical field of debris flow disaster prediction. According to the invention, through a shear simulation experiment, the soil moisture content sensor, the soil pressure sensor data and the soil shear parameters are collected and processed, the soil detection parameters related to the debris flow are extracted, the self-attention mechanism is fused to the LSTM neural network model, the super parameters of the LSTM neural network model are optimized by utilizing the POA algorithm, the long-term dependence in the soil data of the debris flow is accurately captured, the extraction capacity of the model on key features is enhanced, the prediction of the susceptibility of the debris flow is realized, the limitation of the traditional method is overcome, and a powerful technical guarantee is provided for the early warning and prevention and control of the debris flow disaster.
assignees: ANNENG TIBET CONSTRUCTION DEV CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN DURUI SENSING CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for fire resistance of steel truss bridge
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method for fire resistance of a steel truss bridge, which comprises the following specific steps of (1) defining performance targets, (2) constructing a fire disaster-structure coupling effect model, (3) optimizing an upper layer model, namely solving extreme fire scenes, (4) and coefficient The test measurement of (5) the lower layer optimization model comprises the optimization of a protection scheme, and (6) the simulation analysis of the nonuniform extreme temperature field by finite element software and the collaborative verification of the coefficient measured by the test of the step (4) . According to the invention, through the verification of double-order collaborative optimization and a reduced-scale test, the balance of the fire resistance performance and the protection cost of the structure under the extreme fire scene is realized, and the problems of single fire resistance design scene and insufficient optimized coupling in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Multidirectional water jet three-dimensional cutting anti-reflection method based on roadway loosening ring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidirectional water jet three-dimensional cutting anti-reflection method based on a roadway loose coil, and relates to the technical fields of coal bed gas exploitation, oil and gas well yield increase and mine disaster prevention and control. The multi-directional water jet three-dimensional cutting anti-reflection device is prepared by a water tank, a high-pressure water pump, a drilling machine, a drill bit, a drill rod and a rotatable jet nozzle, then the multi-directional water jet three-dimensional cutting anti-reflection device is used for implementing graded accurate anti-reflection on different stress areas, a plastic crushing section, a stress concentration section, an elastic deformation section and a raw rock stress section are sequentially divided from outside to inside along the axial direction of a drilling hole, the raw rock stress section is subjected to hole making in a large size, the elastic deformation section is subjected to annular slotting, and planetary ray slotting is performed on the stress concentration section. Compared with a single slotting mode, the slotting mode which is suitable for different stresses and is formed by the invention can improve the permeability by 10-25 times, realize cooperative pressure relief, and is suitable for high-efficiency permeability improvement of various strata such as coal beds, shale, sandstone and the like.
assignees: SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ship emergency drilling virtual simulation interaction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship emergency exercise virtual simulation interaction method, device, equipment and medium, which solve the technical problems of insufficient environment authenticity, low cooperation efficiency, insufficient immersion sense, single evaluation and poor system expansibility in the traditional exercise by three-dimensional virtual environment construction, multi-person cooperative interaction and dynamic scene generation and intelligent team evaluation technologies. The method is suitable for crew team training, maritime rescue cooperative exercise and ship setting safety verification, and can remarkably improve team emergency response capability and training efficiency.

title_en: Landslide test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a landslide test device which comprises a base, a supporting mechanism, a vibrating mechanism and an intercepting mechanism, wherein the supporting mechanism is arranged on the base, the vibrating mechanism is arranged on the supporting mechanism, a simulated side slope is arranged on the vibrating mechanism, a rolling stone is adhered and paved on the simulated side slope, the vibrating mechanism can apply vibration to the simulated side slope, and the intercepting mechanism is arranged on the base and corresponds to the simulated side slope and is used for intercepting the rolling stone from a roller on the simulated side slope. The method has the advantages that the severity of landslide can be predicted by simulating the influence effect of natural disasters on different slopes, and meanwhile, the protection intensity of the landslide can be predicted to better protect the disasters caused by the landslide. The landslide test device has the advantages of simple structure and easiness in implementation, is suitable for being installed and used in the existing landslide test, is low in use cost, and can improve benefits.
assignees: XINJIANG COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;XINJIANG TRAFFIC INSPECTION CERTIFICATION CO LTD

title_en: Child Disaster Safety Education management System and Method based on CCTV VIDEO
title_ko: Cctv 동영상에 기반한 어린이 재난안전 관리 지원 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 CCTV 동영상에 기반한 어린이 재난안전 관리 지원 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 패턴화할 수 있는 일정하게 정해진 대피동선과 행동 특징(양상)들을 포함하는 영유아 재난 대피 훈련 교육 영상들을 재난 대피 행위 탐지를 위한 기계 학습 데이터로 활용하여 영유아 보육 또는 교육 기관 재난 상황 탐지 모델을 쉽고 간편하게 기계 학습하고, 이를 활용해 영유아 보육 또는 교육 기관 재난 상황을 정확하게 탐지할 수 있도록 한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KYONGGI IND & ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Education and training method using education and training system based on extended reality
title_ko: 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템을 이용한 교육 훈련 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 목적은 실제와 유사한 환경으로 구현된 사격 지휘 통제 체계를 포함하는 교육 훈련 시스템을 통해, 확장 현실 기반 사격 절차 훈련 능력과, 다중 접속을 통한 발사 반/훈련생별 교육 훈련 능력과, 훈련 통제 시스템을 통한 교관의 훈련 총괄 능력과, 미숙련자 숙달 교육을 위한 학습 훈련 능력을 보유할 수 있도록 하는 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템을 이용한 교육 훈련 방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해, 본 발명에 따른 교육생 장비에 의해, 훈련 장비의 조작이 수행되는 단계; 훈련용 서버로 상기 교육생 장비에 의해 조작된 데이터가 전송되는 단계; 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 상기 조작 데이터가 수신 처리되는 단계; 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 훈련 장비 ID와 데이터를 확인하여 상기 훈련용 서버의 상태 값이 변경되는 단계; 및 상기 훈련용 서버에 의해, 현재 훈련 상태 값이 상기 교육생 장비로 전송되는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Knowledge-data double-drive karst tunnel construction period gushing water risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knowledge-data double-drive karst tunnel construction period gushing water risk assessment method which comprises the steps of obtaining influence factors of a target karst tunnel gushing water disaster, constructing a risk evaluation index comprehensive layering system, obtaining comprehensive weights according to the risk evaluation index comprehensive layering system, constructing a knowledge-driven gushing water risk assessment model according to the comprehensive weights and a VIKOR model, constructing a training sample library according to the knowledge-driven gushing water risk assessment model, constructing a DE-GWO-ELM model, training the DE-GWO-ELM model according to the training sample library, obtaining a DE-GWO-ELM model of the knowledge-data double-drive, inputting monitoring data to be assessed into the DE-GWO-ELM model, and outputting gushing water risk values. The invention can effectively and accurately realize the gushing water risk assessment and has stronger instantaneity and interpretability.

title_en: Determination method for spontaneous combustion evolution process of open-pit mine end slope coal
abstract_en: The application provides a determination method of spontaneous combustion evolution progress of side coal at an open pit, which belongs to the field of geotechnical engineering geological disaster prevention and control and the field of mine safety and environmental protection, and comprises the steps of updating the porosity, the permeability and the range of a pre-established three-dimensional geological model by adopting three-dimensional distribution of bending subsidence zone porosity, fracture zone permeability and collapse zone porosity in a combustion zone after an initial real-time temperature field range of a exposed coal bed is obtained, carrying out coal fire evolution simulation again according to the updated pre-established three-dimensional geological model to obtain a coal fire development range, an updated real-time temperature field range and a gas concentration field, and outputting a final coal fire development range and an updated real-time temperature field range if combustion cannot be continued. The method effectively improves the efficiency and the accuracy of the coal fire control of the open pit end slope.

title_en: Comprehensive advanced geological prediction method for ultra-deep vertical shaft of metal ore
abstract_en: The application provides a comprehensive advanced geological prediction method for an ultra-deep vertical shaft of a metal mine, which belongs to the technical field of construction prevention and control water of the ultra-deep vertical shaft of the metal mine, and comprises the steps of combining a plurality of detection methods, taking the advantages and the advantages of being capable of effectively detecting conditions of deep strata of the ultra-deep vertical shaft under different environmental conditions, accurately identifying conditions which possibly exist in the deep strata and have construction hidden danger, high confined aquifers and the like and are easy to cause gushing water disasters, improving advanced detection precision of the deep strata of the shaft, forming a feedback prediction flow of geological analysis-geological modeling-physical detection circle target-drilling verification, constructing a multi-level verification system, clearly detecting specific geological conditions of abnormal areas, obviously improving advanced positioning and judgment accuracy of geological abnormal bodies in the deep strata, and comprehensively analyzing and judging geological abnormal body information by integrating and fusing multi-source geological information so as to meet requirements of deep rock mechanical characteristic analysis and gushing water disaster prevention and control.
assignees: SANSHANDAO GOLD MINE SHANDONG GOLD MINING LAIZHOU CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN;CHINA COAL NO 5 CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying and controlling thick coal seam mining gas channel under close-range goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying and controlling a thick coal seam mining gas channel under a near goaf, which relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and comprises the steps of obtaining an initial space form of a composite channel of a coal pillar-inverted trapezoid fracture zone through a similar material simulation test, inverting three-zone porosity and permeability by discrete element software UDEC, determining that a 5-20m rear part of a working surface is a gas key inflow zone through Fluent software simulation, implementing a three-dimensional extraction structure on site, configuring a wind row of >1500m < 3 >/min to form a front-mounted target control system, setting a gas on-line monitoring module to monitor gas concentration data in real time, feeding back to a negative pressure regulating valve of the three-dimensional extraction structure in real time, and forming gas concentration closed-loop regulation control.
assignees: YANGCHANGWAN COAL MINE CHN ENERGY NINGXIA COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Cold region side slope multi-field coupling effect simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cold region side slope multi-field coupling effect simulation test device and a method, which consists of a freezing and thawing environment test box, a side slope model, an anchor rod axial loading system, a crevice water injection assembly and a multi-element data monitoring system, can simulate the multi-physical field coupling effect of freeze thawing cycle, crack water penetration and long-term creep. By dynamically adjusting temperature gradient and graded loading parameters, stress field, temperature field and displacement field data can be acquired in real time, the influence of different freeze thawing conditions and creep drawing loads on a slope damage mechanism can be analyzed, a key test means is provided for revealing strain rate effects, aging deformation characteristics and instability criteria of the slope in a cold region, and the method has important guiding values for stability assessment and disaster prevention and control of the slope engineering in the cold region.
assignees: LANZHOU ENGINEERING & RES INSTITUTE OF NONFERROUS METALLURGY CO LTD

title_en: Real triaxial CT real-time scanning experimental device for dynamic disturbance hard rock of deep engineering
abstract_en: A real-time CT scanning experiment device for a hard rock true triaxial under dynamic disturbance of deep engineering belongs to the technical field of rock mechanics experiments, and comprises a base, a true triaxial loading mechanism and a CT real-time scanning mechanism. The method can realize CT real-time scanning of the whole process of the dynamic disturbance true triaxial experiment, can acquire information of the crack development process in the rock at different loading moments, overcomes the problems that the rock crack cannot be directly observed and other monitoring means have large errors and inaccurate results in the traditional true triaxial experiment, can develop the stress release and dynamic disturbance coupling effect true triaxial experiment, simulate the working condition of a deep engineering hydraulic fracturing technology for preventing dynamic disasters, acquire the crack development process in the rock at different moments through CT real-time scanning, and enable the crack development process in the rock to realize accurate three-dimensional reconstruction, and can develop three-direction dynamic disturbance true triaxial experiment, long-term fatigue true triaxial experiment and hydraulic fracturing dynamic disturbance coupling true triaxial experiment, and realize CT real-time scanning and three-dimensional reconstruction in the experimental process.

title_en: Method for researching fire resistance limit of steel tube restrained concrete after impact
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire resistance detection after concrete wall impact, in particular to a method for researching fire resistance limit after steel tube constraint concrete impact. The method comprises the steps of establishing a finite element impact simulation model and a static analysis model, obtaining a maximum impact energy critical value which can be born by a component, calculating the distribution condition of a component temperature field through heat transfer analysis, obtaining an initial fire resistance limit of the component from an initial fire resistance limit model, obtaining a damaged state after impact, calculating the fire resistance limit of the component under the combined action of impact and fire, and establishing a machine learning model. According to the invention, the universal machine learning prediction model is built through the parameters of the multi-type components, so that the dependence of the traditional test method on the specific component form is avoided, the evaluation cost is obviously reduced, meanwhile, the impact damage and fire resistance correlation modeling is adopted, the fire resistance limit damage condition after impact can be simulated under the condition of lacking test data, and a new method is provided for composite disaster research.

title_en: Post-disaster structure prediction method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster structure prediction method, a post-disaster structure prediction device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, which comprise the steps of collecting three-dimensional data of a nuclear power plant structure, obtaining a structure model, constructing a structure finite element model according to the structure model, determining a simulation working condition, carrying out calculation and analysis according to the structure finite element model and the simulation working condition to obtain damage types and calculation time consumption, determining an evaluation model according to the damage types and the calculation time consumption, setting a displacement sensor and a strain sensor on the nuclear power plant structure according to the evaluation model and a sensor arrangement rule, collecting displacement data generated by the displacement sensor, and constructing a state initialization analysis model according to the displacement data.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: All-weather remote sensing image cloud removing method and system based on lightweight AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to an all-weather remote sensing image cloud removing method and system based on a lightweight AI. Aiming at the problem of optical remote sensing failure caused by cloud and smoke in a disaster site, a satellite-borne multi-mode data dynamic fusion engine is constructed to cooperatively process optical images, microwave SAR, infrared thermodynamic diagrams and meteorological data, a physically-guided lightweight hybrid neural network (CNN-converter double-branch architecture) is innovatively adopted, an countermeasure training mechanism constrained by an atmospheric scattering model is embedded, an edge-cloud cooperative computing architecture is deployed, and disaster site real-time processing is realized through 5 G+space-based relay. The cloud thickness self-adaptive dynamic fusion weight distribution algorithm is firstly provided, the SAR penetration characteristic is utilized to reconstruct a cloud layer shielding region, and the infrared heat source is combined to enhance the surface characteristics. The system realizes real-time cloud removal processing of <2 seconds at the edge equipment, SSIM is improved by more than 40%, and the system supports all-weather situation awareness under extreme environments such as heavy rain/dense smoke and the like, and is remarkably superior to the traditional single-source cloud removal method.

title_en: Dynamic optimization method and system for electric power material multi-layer inventory based on graph reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic optimizing method and system for electric power material multi-layer stock based on graph reinforcement learning, firstly modeling an electric power material supply chain network based on a graph neural network, a multi-level inventory structure is formed of upstream suppliers, downstream engineering points, turnaround libraries, terminal libraries, etc., and each inventory node is modeled as an agent. Then, an adhesion dynamic calculation model is designed, the dynamic interaction intensity among nodes in the multi-layer inventory network is quantified through an attention mechanism, and the supply timeliness constraint is reflected through introducing a supply time attenuation effect. Finally, when the intelligent agent is trained in a staged iterative mode, an intelligent agent strategy is designed, the iterative training sequence of the intelligent agent is optimized through dynamic interaction intensity, the problem of dimensional disaster and instability of the multi-intelligent-agent reinforcement learning method in multi-level inventory optimization is solved, the method can adapt to the scene of dynamic change and collaborative optimization of a supply chain network structure, and finally the long-term cost of an electric power material supply chain is effectively reduced.
assignees: MAT COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Flood risk early warning grading standard method based on urban flood simulation prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk early warning grading standard method based on urban flood simulation forecasting, which is implemented according to the following steps of firstly, constructing a gridding urban model, secondly, evaluating disaster-bearing object capacity of the gridding urban model in the first step, thirdly, evaluating flood prevention capacity of each grid unit in the gridding urban model in the first step, thirdly, constructing a flood risk evaluation model, thirdly, constructing a flood risk grading early warning model, quantifying flood risk values and continuous trend, setting triggering conditions of risk early warning, and thirdly, constructing a grading early warning model. The method solves the problems that the existing grading method cannot accurately simulate the dynamic process of urban flood occurrence and has low matching degree with actual risk early warning, can accurately predict and evaluate the urban flood risk level, and improves the early warning accuracy and timeliness.

title_en: Large passenger car passenger evacuation model and method based on field cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of passenger car safety, in particular to a large-scale passenger car passenger evacuation model and method based on a field cellular automaton. The model comprises a static field module, a strategic behavior module, a tactical behavior module and an execution behavior module, wherein the static field module is used for obtaining a two-dimensional continuous space discrete field formed by meta cells by taking a compartment floor of a certain electric motor coach as a projection plane and calculating evacuation static navigation information, the strategic behavior module is used for modeling evacuation pre-movement time of passengers by adopting a passenger evacuation pre-movement time prediction model based on the static navigation information, the tactical behavior module is used for determining and dynamically adjusting outlet selection according to the subjective perception distance and crowdedness information of the passengers by utilizing a passenger outlet selection behavior prediction algorithm, and the execution behavior module is used for simulating the passengers to move towards a target outlet according to movement decisions and adjusting body gestures and movement positions to update related behaviors in the process of moving towards the outlet.

title_en: SEO optimization management system based on AI multi-domain name cluster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based multi-domain name cluster SEO optimization management system, belongs to the technical field of domain name optimization management, and aims to solve the problem that cluster content homogenization risks and management cooperativity are poor. The system performs multidimensional similarity assessment by fusing semantic comparison of a pre-training language model and original structured fingerprint analysis through a differential control module. When the similarity exceeds the limit, the system generates a differential matrix to guide the content regeneration by the constraint instruction, so that the uniqueness of the output content is ensured. And combining a cluster scheduling module, and realizing collaborative release of content, asymmetric optimized allocation of resources and active risk emergency response based on dynamic priority and risk monitoring by the system. The invention can automatically produce high-quality differentiated content, and remarkably improve the overall SEO benefit and operation safety of the cluster.

title_en: Natural disaster risk identification method, device, equipment and storage medium based on federal learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a natural disaster risk identification method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on federal learning, which relate to the technical field of risk prevention and comprise the steps of acquiring and desensitizing natural disaster data to obtain initial multi-modal data; the method comprises the steps of extracting initial multi-modal data, aligning semantic features obtained by extracting the initial multi-modal data with the initial multi-modal data, processing missing values of the initial multi-modal data, fusing space-time features based on the target multi-modal data to obtain a fusion result, defining nodes and edges based on the modal space-time features in the fusion result, connecting the nodes and the edges, aggregating neighborhood information of the connection result to determine a graph to be processed based on the neighborhood information and the connection result, utilizing a federal learning framework and training a model based on the graph to be processed, transmitting model parameters to an edge server to aggregate model parameters, and transmitting the aggregation result to a central server to generate a target hazard recognition model based on the aggregation results, so that the efficiency of recognizing natural disaster hazards is improved.
assignees: INSPUR ENTERPRISE CLOUD TECH SHANDONG CO LTD;INSPUR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Avalanche impact protection structure numerical simulation method based on bidirectional coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method of an avalanche impact protection structure based on two-way coupling, which relates to the technical field of mountain disaster protection and comprises the steps of modeling and initializing an avalanche material source, adopting a discrete element theory to simulate an avalanche process, realizing the whole process dynamics simulation and reproduction of the avalanche disaster from starting to moving to the impact protection structure, modeling the avalanche protection structure based on a general finite element simulation platform, setting discrete element-finite element contact coupling, solving unit stress and strain data, carrying out numerical simulation control and solving, carrying out impact response extraction and result analysis, carrying out systematic analysis on structural response and impact characteristics to evaluate the dynamic performance and safety margin of the structure under the effect of avalanche impact, and providing theoretical basis and technical support for the design and performance evaluation of the protection structure.

title_en: Multi-dynamic disaster simulation test device for underwater cross-fault tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of test simulation devices, and particularly discloses an underwater cross-fault tunnel multi-dynamic disaster simulation test device, which comprises the following components: the multi-field coupling box body is arranged above the base and is formed by splicing a left box body and a right box body, and the left box body is connected to the rotary locking mechanism. Sliding coupling connecting rods are distributed on the front side wall and the rear side wall of the multi-field coupling box body, the sliding coupling connecting rods sequentially penetrate through holes in the outer side walls of the left box body and the right box body to enable splicing surfaces of the left box body and the right box body to be tightly extruded, and gaps are reserved between the sliding coupling connecting rods and the through holes. The side wall of the multi-field coupling box body is also provided with a load applicator. The lower part of the right box body is perpendicular to the bottom surface of the right box body, a walking sliding dislocation driver is arranged on the lower part of the right box body, and an inclining sliding dislocation driver is arranged on the front wall surface or the rear wall surface of the right box body. The simulation test device can realize the stepless adjustment of the fracture surface inclination angle, and can simulate the fracture surface sliding composite environment under the actual working condition more truly.

title_en: Icing thickness prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on Bayesian optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for predicting icing thickness based on Bayesian optimization. The design of the second important feature extraction logic can accurately extract the features highly related to the ice coating thickness, so that information redundancy is avoided, and the prediction accuracy of the model is improved. And (3) establishing a model training set based on feature extraction, so that the model can learn the internal rule in the data, and further accurate prediction of the icing thickness is realized. Through the optimization and evaluation operation of the icing thickness prediction model, the prediction performance and stability of the model can be further improved, and the reliability and accuracy of a prediction result are ensured. The method has remarkable advantages in the aspect of ice coating thickness prediction, and can provide powerful technical support for the related field.

title_en: Protection method, device, equipment and medium for power grid facilities under natural disasters
abstract_en: The application provides a protection method, a device, equipment and a medium for power grid facilities under natural disasters. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an initial data set, wherein the initial data set comprises a precipitation data set, a normalized vegetation index, land utilization data, road network data, soil type data, river network density data, elevation data, gradient data, rock data and earth surface deformation rate. Then based on the initial data set, simulating the position points of landslide and dam blocking in the river after landslide is generated by rainfall, and the geometric parameters of the landslide and dam blocking. And then simulating a first evolution rule of the burst flood generated by the landslide damming dam after burst based on the position points and the geometric parameters. And finally, determining emergency protection measures of power grid facilities downstream of the landslide and dam based on a first evolution rule of the breaking flood. The application improves the protection accuracy of the power grid facilities under natural disasters in the prior art.
assignees: HEYUAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for identifying key ore pillars in goaf under open pit
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for identifying key ore pillars in a goaf under an open pit, and provides a concept and a calculation method for an index PFCI of disaster causing of ore pillar instability, wherein the index comprehensively considers the volume change of the goaf and the range of the ore pillar instability, can quantitatively characterize the disaster severity degree of the ore pillar instability, establishes an ore pillar instability simulation and linkage effect analysis algorithm based on a mechanical transfer relation, completely tracks the whole process of the ore pillar linkage instability in a cyclic iteration mode, simultaneously constructs a key ore pillar identification system based on a risk value, realizes the accurate identification and risk grade division of key control ore pillars through the coupling calculation of the instability probability and the disaster causing index, breaks through the limitation of evaluating the ore pillar instability results only based on the bearing area loss, and can accurately reflect the disaster nature of transition of the ore pillar instability from a discrete small space to a continuous large space through quantifying the coupling effect of the goaf range, thereby providing a brand-new theoretical basis for quantitative evaluation of the ore pillar instability results.

title_en: Urban storm four-weather intelligent prevention method based on AI technology energization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban storm four-pre-intelligent prevention method based on AI technology energy, which is characterized in that a foundation support is constructed through multi-dimensional data acquisition and integration, namely, a real-time virtual reality mapping of a scene physical entity and virtual simulation is realized through combination of history data calibration parameters, high-precision prediction of indexes such as storm rainfall, ponding, water level and the like is realized, a scene exclusive threshold value triggers timely early warning, disaster evolution pre-modeling under different scenes is dynamically generated, a adaptive emergency scheme is dynamically generated, and an iterative optimization closed loop is formed through an actual storm data calibration model.
assignees: SHANGHAI ZHONGJING HANDING DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system integrating multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sea filling engineering and digitalization, and discloses a sea filling engineering three-dimensional geological data processing method and system for fusing multi-source data, wherein the method determines first subsidence data by generating four-dimensional geological bodies, and (3) fusing the three-dimensional drilling data, the geophysical prospecting data, the oblique photography model and the real-time sedimentation data, constructing a dynamically updated three-dimensional geological model to determine second sedimentation data, and reflecting the geological deformation accumulation process of the sea-filled area in real time according to the first sedimentation data and the second sedimentation data. The crossing of the geological model from 'static snapshot' to 'dynamic deformation' is realized, the space-time deformation effect is improved, the risk prevention and control efficiency of the sea-filling engineering is improved, the engineering geological disaster early warning aging is advanced, and technical support is provided for engineering safety early warning.
assignees: CCCC THIRD HARBOR ENG CO LTD

title_en: Lithium battery thermal runaway situation prediction method based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery thermal runaway situation prediction method based on multi-physical field coupling, which comprises the steps of firstly measuring various gas generation rate changes and temperature change data of a thermal runaway process in a standard environment through a sample lithium battery heating test, then determining a gas generation rate equation of various gases in the standard environment through polynomial fitting test data based on Arrhenius equation and temperature-gas generation coupling mechanism, then utilizing an Ansys Fluent platform integrated component transfer model and a related gas combustion reaction model, constructing a three-dimensional fluid dynamic simulation model of an actual environment where the sample lithium battery is located, dynamically correcting the gas generation rate through real-time temperature field data based on the gas generation rate equation obtained through fitting test data, and simulating the actual generation rate of various gases of the lithium battery in the thermal runaway process in the application environment, and finally combining the gas combustion reaction model to realize prediction and simulation of the lithium battery thermal runaway fire disaster development situation in the application environment.

title_en: Passive prevention and control structure for avalanche and air wave disasters and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive prevention and control structure for avalanche and air wave disasters and a construction method thereof, comprising the following steps of S1, calculating movement parameters of the avalanche based on simulation analysis software, wherein the movement parameters comprise impact force, movement speed and accumulation thickness of the avalanche and air wave, S2, establishing a model in CFD software according to the movement parameters, simulating flow fields around the prevention and control structure under different protection distances and different protection heights, acquiring a wind speed cloud image and pressure distribution, determining arrangement positions and structure heights of the prevention and control structure according to the wind speed cloud image and the pressure distribution, S3, establishing a stress model of each rod piece in simulation software according to the movement parameters in S1, checking the stability of each rod piece based on the stress model, and selecting steel models of each rod piece according to checking results for construction.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Underground space digital twin system of coal mine based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety monitoring, and discloses a coal mine underground space digital twin system based on numerical simulation, which comprises the following modules: the multisource sensor assembly is arranged in roadway surrounding rock and used for collecting stress, displacement, anchor rod axial force and vibration data in real time. The underground space digital twin system of the coal mine based on the numerical simulation realizes the dimension crossing from single index trend analysis to full-field stress and displacement continuous evolution process prediction, and provides more comprehensive stability cognition. The model parameters are continuously updated through a dynamic self-calibration mechanism, the traditional method of relying on fixed experience values is replaced, and the long-term fidelity and the prediction accuracy of the model under complex geological conditions are remarkably improved. The system provides a visual risk map based on simulation deduction and a multi-scene simulation function, reduces the dependence on manual experience, and provides visual and scientific basis for support scheme optimization and disaster emergency decision.

title_en: Mountain travel route planning method based on weather and natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain travel route planning method based on weather and natural disasters, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a Markov game model based on POMDP, combining Mamba multi-mode feature compression and RAG semantic enhancement, designing a dynamic risk matrix integrating geological disaster probability, weather trend and ecological sensitivity, providing partial observable environment state perception, secondly establishing a Nash balanced constraint optimization model, introducing NSGA-II-Actor-Critic architecture to optimize unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and path adjustment through federal learning and extreme weather strategy, triggering dynamic communication by rainfall super-threshold, thirdly integrating safety and experience benefit design reward functions, processing continuous action planning by an improved model DDPG, combining NSGA-II to accelerate multi-target Pareto front convergence, fourthly constructing a user weather sensitivity image, dynamically adjusting weight balance benefit and AR simulation preview preference, fifthly, carrying out intelligent body and environment feature complementation based on a GIS closed-loop decision engine, recording emergency logs and meta learning disaster case library.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method, a geological disaster early warning system, geological disaster early warning equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting characteristic data of a target area, collecting data through a ground deformation monitoring network and underground water dynamic monitoring equipment to obtain and extract characteristic parameters based on a plateau environment basic data set, a mining characteristic data set, a plateau environment correction coefficient, a ground deformation monitoring data set and an underground water dynamic data set to obtain a fusion characteristic vector; the method comprises the steps of constructing and training a settlement prediction model by adopting a machine learning algorithm, a constructed plateau rock-soil body constitutive model and a fusion feature vector to obtain a settlement prediction model, reasoning the fusion feature vector based on the settlement prediction model to obtain ground settlement prediction values and spatial distribution thereof, generating early warning information based on the ground settlement prediction values and the spatial distribution thereof, and transmitting the early warning information. And the early warning accuracy of geological disasters is improved.
assignees: QINGHAI CHINACOAL GEOLOGY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision method and device for realizing flood simulation and prevention by combining Cesium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster prevention and management, and particularly provides a method and a device for realizing intelligent decision making of flood simulation prevention by combining Cesium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, geographic data access; the method comprises the steps of S2, realizing real-time monitoring and analysis of hydrologic conditions, S3, constructing a flood simulation model, including hydrodynamic model construction, model parameter setting and optimization and a real-time updating mechanism, S4, unrealEngine, wherein a Chaos physical engine processes physical interaction of water flow, physical data of the Chaos are associated through modularized logic, S5, an integrated LSTM time sequence prediction model is combined with hydrologic real-time rainfall to realize flood evolution trend, S6, heatMap shows important disaster areas and disaster water level conditions, S7, identifying nearby refuge points, and scientifically and reasonably arranging emergency paths. Compared with the prior art, the invention can provide intelligent decision management for disaster pre-simulated pre-disaster prevention and post-disaster rescue recovery.

title_en: Typhoon and storm induced composite flow slip disaster simulation system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a simulation system and a simulation method for typhoon and storm-induced composite flow slip disasters, wherein the simulation system comprises a slope simulation box, a wind load control system, a rainfall control system and a spatial three-dimensional visual data acquisition system, wherein the slope simulation box is used for simulating a slope covered by vegetation, the wind load control system is used for simulating a wind load applied to the slope simulation box and controlling a wind load time course according to a set typhoon grade, the rainfall control system comprises a variable-frequency water pump and is used for determining rainfall intensity according to the set typhoon grade and determining target power of the variable-frequency water pump according to the rainfall intensity, simulating rainfall and controlling the rainfall time course, and the spatial three-dimensional visual data acquisition system is used for acquiring multi-section visual three-dimensional data of a three-mechanism coupling disaster simulation process of a slope model under the actions of the wind load, the rainfall and a plant model. According to the application, the three-mechanism coupling catastrophe process of the side slope model under the actions of wind load, rainfall and plant model is accurately simulated, and the three-mechanism coupling catastrophe mechanism in the soil body is revealed, so that the dynamic three-dimensional analysis of engineering is realized.

title_en: Drilling disaster prevention and control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses drilling disaster prevention and control equipment, which belongs to the technical field of drilling engineering and comprises a drill rod main body, wherein an installation groove is formed in the outer side wall of the drill rod main body, a fixing rod is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the drill rod main body, an arc-shaped plate is rotatably connected to the outer side wall of the fixing rod, a telescopic rod is rotatably connected to the outer side wall of the arc-shaped plate, and one end, far away from the arc-shaped plate, of the telescopic rod is rotatably connected with the outer side wall of the drill rod main body. This creep into calamity prevention and control equipment uses through dead lever, arc, telescopic link, reset spring, push away ring, draw-in groove, waterproof motor, tooth, bracing piece, gyro wheel's cooperation, is convenient for adjust the angle between arc and the drilling rod main part to be convenient for compact to the inside wall of well drilling, evenly scribble the mud simultaneously, avoid the mud can't carry out effective protection to the wall of a well, thereby avoid rock in the stratum to lose the support and collapse, lead to appearing the rock mass piling up in the well, influence the normal activity from top to bottom of drilling tool and go on smoothly of drilling operation.

title_en: Emergency Preparedness System and Method
abstract_en: An emergency preparedness system and method includes a communication unit to communicate personalized instructions to a user, based on type of emergency, location of the user relative to the emergency, user role and user language; an application executing on at least one user device associated with the user to receive the personalized instructions; an interactive broadcast platform to provide up-to-date information pertaining to the emergency; an off-network communication module to enable communication even in the event of a failure of cellular, internet, or other network infrastructure; and a simulation engine for training users in emergency response preparedness. The modular emergency preparedness system and method is designed to equip communities with the necessary means to effectively deal with and respond to a vast range of emergencies, from natural disasters like hurricanes, earthquakes, and floods, to human-made crises like terrorist acts, fires, chemical spills, or even unforeseen socio-economic disruptions.

title_en: Teaching building structure convenient to student's activity between class
