abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of school building design, in particular to a teaching building structure convenient for students to move between classes, which comprises a teaching area, a dining room area, an evacuation walkway, a logistic lane and a fire-fighting channel, wherein the teaching area comprises a plurality of teaching buildings, each teaching building comprises a plurality of classrooms and first corridors, a plurality of connecting corridors are arranged between two adjacent teaching buildings and are arranged in an upper layer and a lower layer, the connecting corridors are respectively communicated with the first corridors with corresponding layer heights, an indoor activity area is arranged on each connecting corridor, and an outdoor activity area is formed between two adjacent teaching buildings and each connecting corridor. According to the application, the outdoor activity area and the indoor activity area are directly communicated with the first corridor, so that students can conveniently go and go between classrooms and the activity area, a physical exercise place which is not affected by weather is provided for the students, and the inter-class movement of the students is facilitated.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHANGDA ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV SHANGHAI

title_en: Boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method embedded into deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a boundary hierarchical grid physical constraint variation assimilation method for embedding a deep neural network, which comprises the steps of establishing a momentum equation containing boundary hierarchical grid turbulence friction items, simulating the boundary layer turbulence friction items through the deep neural network, constructing weak constraint items of a variation assimilation frame cost function by using the momentum equation, training the deep neural network by using a data set constructed by a historical numerical weather forecast mode simulation result, linearizing the trained deep neural network to obtain corresponding tangential operators and accompanying operators, embedding the tangential operators and accompanying operators into the variation assimilation frame cost function, acquiring multi-source remote sensing observation data and a numerical weather forecast mode background field, and solving an analysis field by taking the cost function as a target to complete data assimilation. The invention can improve the assimilation and numerical forecast level of disaster weather data such as typhoons, and the like, in particular to the observation assimilation level related to boundary layers.
assignees: NANJING METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Phase-change blasting shock earthquake wave reflection method, medium, equipment and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a phase-change blasting shock wave reflection method, medium, equipment and a product, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of arranging a detection hole and a plurality of blastholes on a tunnel face, placing a blasting tube in the blastholes, placing a detector in the detection hole, and generating a seismic wave through phase-change blasting; the method comprises the steps of separating longitudinal waves and transverse waves of seismic wave signals detected by a detector, processing the longitudinal waves and the transverse waves respectively by a two-dimensional F-K digital filtering method, filtering interference waves, separating effective waves and direct waves, dividing a data set of the effective waves into a training set and a testing set, constructing a model for predicting bad geological disasters in front of a tunnel face based on a support vector machine, obtaining optimal parameters of the model by using a particle swarm algorithm, training and testing the model by using the training set and the testing set, and using the tested model for tunnel geological forecasting. The method improves the accuracy of advanced geological forecast of the gas tunnel and reduces the gas explosion risk.

title_en: Test research method for filling coal rock impact dynamic disasters of prevention and control working face
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of mining engineering safety, in particular to a test research method for filling, preventing and controlling coal rock impact dynamic disasters of a working face, which aims at solving the problem that the sudden breaking process of an overlying strata is difficult to reproduce in the traditional coal mine impact dynamic disaster research, constructing a two-dimensional similar simulation experiment platform for instantaneous fracture of a hard roof of a coal seam, converting gravitational potential energy into impact kinetic energy through impact of falling of a drop hammer to induce stress mutation of coal and rock, simulating instantaneous collapse working conditions of the roof in a structural instability state of an overlying strata, and capturing the whole process of dynamic interaction of a filling body and a coal and rock system under the impact dynamic disaster of the coal and rock by combining a sensor and a monitoring system; meanwhile, a filling material is introduced to support the goaf, experimental data comparison of coal rock supporting pressures before and after goaf filling is carried out, and the protection effect of the filling material on coal rock under the condition that an upper covering plate is instantaneously collapsed is studied.

title_en: Flood forecasting method and system for non-flow data area by combining Xinanjiang model and intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood forecasting, in particular to a method and a system for forecasting flood in a no-flow data area by combining a Xinanjiang model and an intelligent algorithm. The method comprises the following steps of reading configuration files and rainfall flood process data, and step S2, training a Xinanjiang model based on the data of step S1 to obtain a point set between forecast flow and water level And establishing a Z-Q coordinate system, and constructing a Z-Q function model and a curve by an AR (P) model, thereby avoiding the investment and operation risk of installing and maintaining high-cost flow monitoring equipment in complex terrains, improving the feasibility and accuracy of flood forecasting in areas without flow data, providing reliable basis for flood control engineering dispatching and safety early warning, promoting the improvement of the integral flood control and disaster reduction capability of China, and guaranteeing the social stability and economic sustainable development.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BRANCH OF GUANGDONG HYDROLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Hinge passenger evacuation and flow distribution method and device under abnormal event and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of passenger transportation junction pedestrian guidance and comprehensive transportation, in particular to a junction passenger evacuation flow distribution method, a junction passenger evacuation flow distribution device and electronic equipment under an abnormal event, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out discrete simulation on junction evacuation efficiency under different flow distribution schemes based on a discrete event simulation model of junction operation constructed in advance so as to obtain simulation data; and solving an optimal flow distribution strategy of the hub under an abnormal event by using a heuristic algorithm by using the calculation model. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the queuing theory model cannot accurately describe the operation condition of the junction under the condition of large passenger flow aggregation, so that the junction evacuation time cannot be obtained through mathematical operation, the discrete time simulation calculation evacuation time needs to be calculated on a large scale, the time is long, the efficiency of optimization calculation is low, the requirement of sudden large passenger flow evacuation cannot be met and the like are solved.

title_en: Bird situation recognition method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a bird condition recognition method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of bird condition recognition. The method combines the image category recognition model and the bird group scene recognition network model to realize high-efficiency classification and bird group dynamic monitoring of the air flying object. The unmanned aerial vehicle image, the aircraft image and the bird image are distinguished by preprocessing the aerial image and classifying the data set training image class recognition model. And identifying bird images through a bird group scene identification network model, and finishing the statistics of the number of bird groups and the positioning of the bird groups. Through time sequence analysis of a plurality of aerial images, the flight track of the bird group is constructed, the flight direction is determined, continuous tracking of the dynamic behavior of the bird group is realized, and key data support is provided for bird driving decisions. The deep learning model is combined with the real-time image processing flow, so that the recognition accuracy is ensured, the calculation efficiency is considered, the real-time bird situation monitoring requirement under complex environments such as airports is met, and the intelligent level and emergency response capability of airport airspace safety management are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHIDUOYUAN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Debris flow ditch mountain torrent early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow trench and mountain torrent early warning method, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical data and monitoring data, carrying out outlier rejection, missing value filling, mi-max normalization processing, data labeling and data segmentation on the historical data to obtain a training set, a verification set and a test set, respectively carrying out outlier rejection, missing value filling, Z-score normalization processing and space-time matching on the monitoring data in sequence to obtain a time window matrix, training an LSTM neural network based on the training set to obtain a dynamic risk prediction model, inputting the time window matrix into the dynamic risk prediction model to obtain disaster probability and stage early warning, integrating millimeter wave displacement monitoring, soil capacitance sensing and meteorological data fusion cross fields, dynamically adjusting threshold values by machine learning, and forming a special solution for geological disasters.
assignees: HUANENG TIBET YARLUNG ZANGBO RIVER HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT AND INVEST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scale numerical simulation method for slope instability mechanism of shear band with toughness
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geotechnical engineering geological disaster prevention and control, and provides a multiscale numerical simulation method for a toughness-containing shear band slope destabilization mechanism, which is used for acquiring physical mechanical parameters of a geotechnical body material, establishing a numerical model based on a particle flow discrete element method, calculating contact force among particles by adopting a Johnson-Kendell-Robert contact model as a contact model among the particles, defining pressure interference parameters to control a normal contact stiffness limit value, carrying out dynamic modeling of a discrete element particle system based on a particle generator, carrying out static modeling of the discrete element particle system based on a Lagrangian continuous element part, converting acting force of the discrete element particles into equivalent grid node force by an equivalent node force conversion method, and defining surface properties of all element sets possibly related to contact in a solver.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;HYDROCHINA GUIYANG EXPLORATION DESIGN RES INSTITUTE ROCK SOIL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Multimode slope state monitoring method based on infrasound and Beidou signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and particularly discloses a multi-mode slope state monitoring method based on infrasound and Beidou signals, which comprises the steps of determining potential slip planes based on a slope three-dimensional geological model and numerical simulation, and cooperatively arranging an infrasound sensor array and a Beidou monitoring station; the method comprises the steps of realizing reliable data transmission through a hybrid ad hoc network and Beidou short messages, extracting infrasound features through wavelet packet transformation and spectrum analysis, processing Beidou signals through a state threshold least square algorithm, constructing a space-time convolution network based on an attention mechanism, dynamically fusing multi-mode features, triggering hierarchical early warning based on a dynamic threshold model, and adaptively adjusting system operation parameters. The invention solves the problems of unscientific layout, low fusion degree, poor environmental adaptability and the like in the existing monitoring method, realizes early and accurate early warning and self-adaptive intelligent monitoring of the slope state, and can be widely applied to slope stability monitoring in the fields of mines, highways, railways and the like.
assignees: BEIJING ANXIN YIWEI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for treating coal mine sky water hazard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine overhead water disaster treatment method which comprises the steps of S1-S5, S1, obtaining water accumulation amount and geological condition data of an overhead water accumulation area above a working surface to be mined, S2, determining drilling construction parameters and filling construction parameters based on the water accumulation amount and geological condition data of the overhead water accumulation area, S3, drilling operation is carried out on a roadway according to the determined drilling construction parameters, accumulated water in the overhead water accumulation area is discharged through drilling to form a goaf, S4, when the accumulated water level of the goaf is lowered to a preset position, mining tunneling operation is started, when the roadway is constructed to the position of the next overhead water accumulation area, the steps of S1-S3 are repeated, S5, selecting a solid water medium and filling the solid water medium in the goaf according to the filling construction parameters so that the solid water medium is solidified in the goaf to reduce accumulated water in the goaf. The method for treating the coal mine overhead water damage has the advantages of reasonable arrangement, small potential safety hazard, low prevention and control cost and the like.

title_en: Regional long-period flood risk calculation method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a regional long-period flood risk calculation method and system, and relates to the technical field of flood disaster risk assessment. The method comprises the steps of dividing rainfall events based on rainfall data of a rainfall station in a research area, carrying out flood result simulation on the research area by applying a hydrological hydraulic simulation model and the rainfall events to obtain flood result parameters of the research area, sequencing the rainfall events according to the severity of the flood result parameters from large to small, compiling rainfall event sample sequence numbers based on sequencing results, calculating experience frequencies corresponding to the rainfall events according to an experience frequency formula, and calculating the flood risk of the rainfall events in a long period of the research area. The comprehensive flood risk in a long period of the area, which is obtained by the method, is not the flood risk of a single rainfall event, provides support for decision-making activities with larger time span or longer continuous effect, and is suitable for long-term decision-making scenes such as infrastructure construction, community planning, flood insurance rate setting and the like.

title_en: Fire disaster disposal verification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster disposal verification method and system, the method comprises the steps of generating a prevention and control plan, selecting historical fire disaster case data closest to a prevention and control target from a fire disaster database, simulating fire disaster in simulation software, simulating process data of the monitored fire disaster based on the monitoring configuration of the fire disaster, simulating disaster situation disposal based on the fire disaster prevention configuration, adjusting the monitoring configuration and the fire prevention configuration with optimal results according to simulation results, simulating the fire disaster in a full-scale experiment platform, verifying performance of the monitoring configuration and the fire prevention configuration according to the optimal monitoring configuration and the fire prevention configuration, and correcting the prevention and control plan according to verification results. According to the invention, by means of a double verification mechanism of fusion construction software simulation and full-scale experiments, the cost and technical difficulty of the verification process of the prevention and control plan are effectively reduced, and the scientificity and reliability of the performance verification result of the prevention and control plan are obviously improved through the cross verification of the two-dimensional experimental data.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Disaster situation video description generation method oriented to emergency disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster situation video description generation method for an emergency disaster scene, which comprises the steps of carrying out frame-level sampling processing and multi-class target detection on a disaster video stream, calculating the spatial proximity degree of a target to construct an apparent visual map, constructing a latent layer visual map, fusing the apparent spatial characteristics and the latent layer spatial characteristics to obtain fusion characteristics, splicing and mapping the alignment characteristics and the fusion characteristics to obtain cross-modal splicing characteristics, generating the cross-modal splicing characteristics into word sequences, and carrying out optimization training on the word sequences. The invention improves the modeling capability of the multi-target structural relation in the disaster video and the semantic accuracy of description generation based on the visual association modeling mechanism of the apparent space and the latent layer space in a double-layer level. According to the method, a visual association diagram is constructed from two dimensions of explicit structural association and implicit semantic association between targets, and a diagram convolution network is introduced to extract high-level semantic features of the diagram structure, so that the problem of descriptive information deletion caused by scene confusion and association complexity is effectively solved.

title_en: Meta-learning risk rapid assessment method for distributed resource toughness planning
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of power distribution network planning, and discloses a meta-learning risk rapid assessment method for distributed resource toughness planning, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a typical scene set containing conventional and extreme working conditions according to history and disaster data, and establishing an equipment fault model under the scene; S2, constructing an economic and toughness evaluation index system, determining weights through an entropy weight method to calculate scheme comprehensive scores, S3, performing meta training, obtaining meta initialization network parameters through a model-independent meta learning algorithm, S4, performing migration learning fine adjustment based on the meta initialization parameters and a small amount of new data, and obtaining a special network to rapidly evaluate the comprehensive scores. By means of the technical means of constructing a typical operation scene set of the power distribution network containing extreme weather, the comprehensive risk simulation technical effect of the planning scheme under various working conditions is achieved, and the problem that risk assessment is incomplete due to the fact that extreme disaster scenes are ignored only by considering conventional operation working conditions when the planning scheme is assessed is solved.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Construction method of disaster chain coupling transfer model of new energy facility of distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a disaster chain coupling transfer model of a new energy facility of a distribution network, which relates to the technical field of disaster modeling, simulation analysis and risk assessment of a novel power system, and comprises the steps of obtaining disaster types, intensities and influence ranges faced by the new energy facility of the distribution network under typhoon and storm coupling scene, and identifying key disaster chain scene elements; the method comprises the steps of determining key nodes in a disaster chain according to identified elements, constructing topological relations of a disaster chain network based on the key nodes to form a disaster chain network structure, constructing a conditional probability table for the constructed topological relations, simulating a disaster transfer process according to a constructed model, introducing case backtracking verification to evaluate model accuracy, and optimizing model parameters. The invention effectively simulates the coupling fault transfer process of the new energy facilities of the distribution network under the typhoon and storm coupling scene, and can provide accurate risk assessment and decision support for the formulation of disaster prevention and reduction measures and the optimization of emergency response strategies.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV JILIANG CHINA

title_en: Data-driven campus security management level assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric digital data processing, in particular to a data-driven campus security management level assessment method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining crowd variation degree of a target area and determining a high-density aggregation area by using crowd density data of the target area at all moments; determining the evacuation confusion degree in the high-density gathering area by utilizing the movement direction of target students in the high-density gathering area, determining evacuation danger factors in the high-density gathering area by utilizing the crowd change degree and the evacuation confusion degree, determining the congestion correction coefficient of the high-density gathering area by utilizing the evacuation danger factors in the multi-exercise process, and determining the campus safety management level assessment result by utilizing the congestion correction coefficients of a plurality of high-density gathering areas. By the technical scheme, the reasonability of the current evacuation scheme can be evaluated more accurately, and the campus safety management capability level under the real emergency condition can be evaluated more accurately.
assignees: BEIJING LIZHI QIYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for generating source network load operation scene under ice disaster disturbance based on migration learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a source network load operation scene generation method, a system, equipment and a storage medium under ice disaster disturbance based on transfer learning, which relate to the technical field of power system operation and analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a simulation sample library based on a power grid structure, fault types and icing conditions, then integrating and standardizing source domain samples, dividing risk grades, and constructing and pre-training a least square loss function condition to generate an countermeasure network model. The method can accurately generate the ice disaster disturbance operation scene, help the power department to grasp risks in advance, can make equipment maintenance, resource allocation and emergency preparation according to the risk, reduce the influence of ice disasters on a power system, ensure stable power supply, guide planning and transformation of a power grid, and improve the overall disaster resistance and market risk management capability.

title_en: Side slope infiltration and stability analysis method, medium and equipment under double rainfall algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water and soil simulation analysis, in particular to a method, medium and equipment for analyzing side slope infiltration and stability under a double rainfall algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps of describing a water retention parameter A by using saturated water content, initial water content and underground water burial depth; the method comprises the steps of introducing a water retention parameter A, deducing an empirical formula of soil water content to obtain a slope water content distribution model after rainfall, dividing the rainfall process into two stages of complete infiltration and incomplete infiltration to obtain a segmented expression of the rainfall infiltration rate, deducing a change relation of a wetting front depth along with rainfall time according to a rainfall conservation law, and calculating to obtain a safety coefficient of the slope under a certain rainfall moment according to the change relation of the wetting front depth along with the rainfall time. According to the invention, by introducing a water retention parameter fitting soil body water content formula, rainfall subsection infiltration analysis and double rainfall calculation method, high-precision simulation of a strong rainfall induced slope instability process is realized, so that slope disaster early warning is carried out.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;GUANGDONG JIAOKE TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent sensing and dynamic grouting reinforcement method and system for tunnel collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent sensing and dynamic grouting reinforcement method and system for tunnel collapse, which comprises the following steps of S1, inputting processed collapse image data, acquired engineering parameters and crack indexes into a reinforcement decision prediction model, S2, carrying out multi-task training on grouting reinforcement parameters by the reinforcement decision prediction model, S3, carrying out dynamic adjustment on a multi-task training process, optimizing and adjusting the reinforcement decision prediction model to obtain a trained reinforcement decision prediction model, and S4, inputting target engineering parameters into the trained reinforcement decision prediction model to output a target engineering grouting reinforcement scheme. According to the invention, the three-dimensional reconstruction and the fracture index dynamic calculation are combined, so that the slump volume measurement error is reduced, the fracture identification accuracy is improved, and the disaster assessment precision is remarkably improved. The multi-task learning network is combined with the physical constraint model, so that prediction errors of reinforcement parameters are greatly reduced, the classification accuracy of support types is improved, and the efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Training method of mountain torrent dangerous position prediction model and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a training method of a mountain torrent dangerous position prediction model and application thereof, wherein the training method comprises the steps of acquiring digital elevation data, geological data, hydrologic observation data, historical mountain torrent data and target rainfall intensity of a plurality of sub-watersheds; for any sub-basin, simulating a submerged area and a submerged depth of a flood disaster of the sub-basin under the target rainfall intensity by utilizing a hydrologic hydrodynamic model according to the acquired data, classifying the dangers of the submerged area according to the submerged depth and setting classification labels, forming a plurality of flood submerged samples according to the submerged areas and the classification labels of the plurality of sub-basins, wherein each flood submerged sample comprises three-band input data, a submerged area and a classification label of one sub-basin, the three-band input data comprises digital elevation data, flow accumulation and gradient of the sub-basin, and training an initial flood dangerous position prediction model adopting a UNet network structure by taking the plurality of flood submerged samples as training data.

title_en: Method and system for sensing disaster of soluble rock stratum tunnel based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soluble rock stratum tunnel disaster sensing method and system based on multi-source information, which belong to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring and comprise the steps of establishing a monitoring index data set, converging the monitoring index data set to a cloud end for space-time registration to generate a multi-dimensional time sequence data field, calculating data uncertainty of each monitoring area by adopting an information entropy theory, calculating space-time evolution characteristics, carrying out classifier identification by combining spatial gradients of a deformation field to obtain a key monitoring area, adaptively adjusting sensor acquisition frequency, starting a supplementary monitoring device for encryption observation, carrying out space-time response calculation by adopting a machine learning algorithm to generate a tunnel disaster evolution prediction result, and carrying out grading threshold comparison and numerical simulation verification on the prediction result to realize effective identification and sensing of disaster evolution states. The method adopts the technical means of combining multisource data fusion, information entropy theory, machine learning and self-adaptive monitoring, and can realize dynamic, accurate and predictive sensing of the tunnel disaster evolution process.

title_en: Railway train autonomous operation control method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a railway train autonomous operation control method and system, which belong to the technical field of train operation control and are used for acquiring physical side state data, wherein the physical side state data comprises ground center, railway trains, infrastructure and operation environment state data, recognizing each monitored physical side state data, simultaneously recognizing a train operation scene, carrying out scene division, carrying out disaster deduction prediction and fault diagnosis situation prediction by combining the operation scene recognition and the monitoring state data to form a recognition scheme under the current operation scene, adopting a decision based on knowledge and rules for a simple operation scene based on the recognition scheme, carrying out on-line simulation deduction decision for complex and unknown operation scenes, carrying out simulation optimization of strategies to obtain an optimal operation strategy, and controlling train operation according to the optimal operation strategy to realize autonomous train operation. The invention realizes the autonomous control operation of the railway train in various complex and unknown scenes.

title_en: Fire-fighting fire dynamic simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire control simulation, and discloses a fire control fire disaster dynamic simulation method based on multi-physical field coupling. The method comprises the steps of collecting temperature field distribution data, smoke concentration gradient data, airflow speed field data and heat conduction parameters of a building structure on a fire scene, establishing a bidirectional coupling model of the temperature field and a smoke diffusion field, dynamically correcting smoke convection effect by the temperature gradient through real-time data exchange, constructing an association model of the airflow speed field and the heat conduction parameters of the building structure, adjusting speed field vortex coefficients according to heat flow intensity, integrating the bidirectional coupling model and the association model to form a multi-physical field joint calculation frame, propelling a simulation process in a discrete time slicing mode, and outputting a three-dimensional dynamic simulation map comprising a temperature field evolution track, a smoke diffusion path and an airflow disturbance range. The method can accurately restore the multi-physical-field synergistic process of the fire scene, and provides effective support for fire rescue decisions and building fireproof design.

title_en: Training method and device for corn yield prediction model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a training method and device of a corn yield prediction model, which comprises the steps of preprocessing grid basic meteorological data and a plurality of grid corn main disaster index data corresponding to the grid basic meteorological data to obtain grid input data, dividing the grid input data into a plurality of sub-grid input data according to a corn growing stage, wherein each sub-grid input data in the plurality of sub-grid input data corresponds to one stage in the corn growing stage, and inputting the plurality of sub-grid input data into the corn yield prediction model to perform model training to obtain the trained corn yield prediction model, so that the prediction precision of corn yield is improved.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster multidimensional disaster-bearing body dangerous trend probability assessment method based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the risk trend probability of a mountain torrent disaster body based on a game theory, which comprises the steps of constructing a joint distribution function of total rainfall and peak rainfall intensity based on a Copula function, designing different probability rainfall scenes by combining rainfall time distribution characteristics, respectively establishing a hydrologic model and a hydrodynamic model on the different probability rainfall scenes, simulating to obtain a flood dynamic disaster factor index, obtaining a disaster-pregnant environment index, combining the flood dynamic disaster factor index to construct a risk index system, comprehensively weighting each index in the risk index system based on the game theory to obtain a mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation graph, and carrying out weighted superposition on the mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation graph and a disaster receiving hierarchical graph of the mountain torrent disaster body to obtain a mountain torrent disaster risk trend probability evaluation result of the multidimensional disaster receiving body. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional mountain torrent disaster risk assessment method, and remarkably improves the accuracy and effectiveness of mountain torrent disaster defense.

title_en: AI technology-based data disaster recovery verification method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based multi-node rapid disaster recovery switching method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting disaster recovery configuration information and backup data characteristics, establishing a data dependency relationship and an influence range association map, constructing a directed acyclic graph of fault combinations, optimizing verification timing arrangement by adopting a q-learning algorithm, scoring risks according to verification results, generating a verification report, training a local disaster recovery efficiency assessment model based on the verification results of a plurality of data centers, performing weighted aggregation of model parameters by using FedAvg algorithm through a federal learning mechanism, generating a global assessment model, and feeding the assessment results back to a disaster recovery system for continuous optimization. According to the invention, through collaborative modeling of each data center, scattered professional knowledge is integrated on the premise of protecting data privacy, so that the improvement of verification coverage rate, the minimization of business influence and the enhancement of verification accuracy are realized, and the technical problems of low efficiency, incomplete coverage, incapability of sharing experience and the like of the traditional disaster recovery verification method are effectively solved.

title_en: Dynamic planning method for fire evacuation path of deep subway station based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic planning method for a fire evacuation path of a deep subway station based on cellular automata, which comprises the steps of building subway space topology by using the cellular automata, simulating a fire environment by adopting an FDS tool to obtain environment data, building a multi-field model based on the subway space topology and the environment data, calculating pedestrian transition probability based on the multi-field model, correcting pedestrian transition probability by combining deep subway facility characteristics and pedestrian behaviors, finally outputting corrected pedestrian transition probability, optimizing a cost function of an A star algorithm based on the corrected pedestrian transition probability to obtain a dynamic cost function, further obtaining an improved A star algorithm, planning an initial path based on the improved A star algorithm, formulating a path updating rule and implementing a smooth transition strategy, and realizing dynamic path planning. The invention is beneficial to improving the evacuation safety and the dispatching efficiency under the situation of fire.

title_en: LSTM-random forest double-track residual error correction-based gas content while-drilling dynamic inversion method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic inversion method of gas content while drilling based on LSTM-random forest double-track residual error correction, which belongs to the technical field of gas disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of S1, measuring and collecting multi-element parameters of gas emission while drilling, S2, carrying out characteristic engineering treatment on the collected multi-element parameters, S3, respectively inputting data subjected to the characteristic engineering treatment into a random forest model and an LSTM model to predict the gas content, S4, carrying out residual error correction on prediction results of the random forest model and the LSTM model, and S5, carrying out super-parameter tuning and grid search on the random forest model and the LSTM model to obtain an optimal random forest-LSTM double-track residual error correction model and super-parameter, and carrying out final prediction of gas content inversion while drilling.
assignees: CHINA COAL HUAJIN GROUP JINCHENG ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Optimization method for earthquake motion intensity index of underground diaphragm wall-subway station system
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses a method for optimizing earthquake intensity indexes of a ground connection wall-subway station system, and relates to the technical field of earthquake resistance evaluation of underground structures. The method comprises the steps of constructing a two-dimensional nonlinear finite element model of a diaphragm wall-subway station, obtaining engineering demand parameters EDP through nonlinear time-course analysis, calculating candidate earthquake intensity index sets IMs, forming an original database of the IMs and the EDP, dividing a training set and a testing set, generating optimal candidate IM combinations on the training set through a filtering method, an embedding method and a wrapping method, constructing a multi-model verification platform, evaluating generalization performance of each combination based on model independent evaluation standards, comprehensively analyzing and determining optimal scalar IM and optimal vector IM combinations, and verifying the whole optimal method through vulnerability analysis. The method breaks through the limitations of the traditional method, improves the accuracy of earthquake resistance evaluation, determines the suitability of the method, and provides reliable technical support for earthquake disaster prediction and vulnerability analysis.

title_en: Layout method of high-speed service area supporting facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent remote sensing, in particular to a layout method of high-speed service area supporting facilities. The method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing data of a matched facility layout, identifying a suitable construction area, carrying out landslide risk assessment according to the suitable construction area to obtain landslide risk data, designing an emergency evacuation path according to the landslide risk data, calibrating a service area arrangement area according to the emergency evacuation path, carrying out space bearing capacity analysis based on the service area arrangement area to obtain space bearing capacity data, constructing a bearing partition diagram according to the space bearing capacity data, carrying out wind direction simulation analysis based on the service area arrangement area to obtain wind direction data of the service area arrangement area, and setting a wind direction buffer green belt according to the wind direction data of the service area arrangement area to obtain wind direction buffer green belt data. The invention realizes scientific layout of the facilities matched with the placement area based on the intelligent remote sensing technology, and improves the safety and the environment adaptability of the facilities.

title_en: Isotope fingerprint-based coal spontaneous combustion index gas tracing and analyzing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal spontaneous combustion index gas tracing and analyzing method based on isotope fingerprints, which comprises the steps of preparing desorption gas by drilling holes in each coal bed of a coal mine, measuring the gas isotope abundance ratio, forming isotope fingerprint feature maps, drawing stable hydrocarbon oxygen isotope fingerprint feature maps of oxidation processes of coal samples of each coal bed at different temperatures through a temperature programming-gas chromatography-stable isotope mass spectrometer combined system, collecting gas in a downhole non-spontaneous combustion area, measuring normal background isotope values, establishing a background database and various gas stable isotope fingerprint features to jointly construct a coal mine hydrocarbon oxygen isotope fingerprint database, applying a physical constraint optimization and source separation quantization mathematical model, and combining a Bayesian depth inversion method to realize rapid matching and high-precision tracing of stable isotope actual measurement data and the fingerprint database. The invention can realize the traceable analysis of the gas abnormality of the spontaneous combustion index of the coal in the shallow-buried close-range multi-coal seam mining process, locate the spontaneous combustion disaster site of the coal and ensure the safe production of the coal mine.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU ZHONGKUANG ZEYUAN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU ZHONGKUANG CHENYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster trace segmentation method for building based on clear boundary detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster trace segmentation method for a building based on clear boundary detection, which comprises the following steps of post-disaster building image acquisition and preprocessing, encoder feature extraction, second-order derivative multi-scale context enhancement, namely constructing a multi-scale context enhancement module SDMCM based on the second-order derivative as a jump connection component, positioning edge pixels by the multi-scale context enhancement module SDMCM according to the features extracted by the encoder, boundary refinement decoding output, and mixed focus loss training and segmentation output, wherein the preprocessed images are subjected to multi-level feature extraction through a modified EFFICIENTNETV lightweight encoder to obtain rich feature representation from details to semantics.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Landslide displacement monitoring and predicting method based on small baseline set technology and GRU
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide displacement monitoring and predicting method based on a small baseline set technology and GRU, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and predicting. The method comprises the steps of obtaining SAR image data, constructing an interference pattern and a coherence pattern, preprocessing the interference pattern, carrying out pixel-level time sequence displacement processing on the preprocessed interference pattern through a two-step inversion process, carrying out geocoding on a processing result, projecting the processing result into a drawing coordinate system to obtain landslide displacement monitoring data, constructing and training a landslide prediction model by adopting landslide displacement mechanism characteristics and rainfall time sequence data, predicting landslide displacement in a time node of a landslide future through the trained landslide prediction model based on real-time landslide displacement monitoring data and combining future rainfall prediction data as input data, and not only effectively improving prediction precision and generalization capability of the model under a complex scene, but also obviously improving landslide displacement prediction precision and stability and providing reliable technical support for timely early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: Device and method for simulating gas and underground water under fault disturbance of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine simulation tests, in particular to a device and a method for simulating gas and underground water under coal mine fault disturbance, wherein the device for simulating the gas and the underground water under the coal mine fault disturbance comprises a vibration box and an installation box arranged on one side of the vibration box, a servo driving assembly is arranged in the installation box and is connected with a vibration arm capable of periodically knocking the vibration box, a fault simulation unit is provided with a fault closing state and a fault expansion state, when the driving piece drives the fault simulation unit to be converted into the fault expansion state from the fault closing state through a pushing plate, liquid of a water tank is sprayed outwards through a spraying shaft to simulate underground water seepage, and meanwhile, the air flow generation plate is sprayed outwards to simulate gas seepage, so that the technical problem that the conventional test device cannot synchronously simulate dynamic disturbance and dynamic coupling induced sliding and disaster processes of multiple physical fields in deep mining of a coal mine is solved.
assignees: CHONGQING DAOYIAN TECH CO LTD;CHONGQING VOCATIONAL INST ENG

title_en: Typhoon disaster annual risk dynamic assessment technology based on time sequence vector autoregressive model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of typhoon risk assessment, and discloses a typhoon disaster annual risk dynamic assessment technology based on a time sequence vector autoregressive model, which comprises the steps of determining main disaster factors influencing typhoon disaster loss by using an EOF/MVEOF method; the method comprises the steps of integrating the position, wind speed intensity and precipitation of a historical typhoon path into four-dimensional time sequence vectors by using a VAR method, simulating and generating a new typhoon time sequence by estimating parameters of a time sequence model, building a support vector machine model by using the relation between global sea temperature data and typhoon login frequency, carrying out annual prediction on typhoon frequency, evaluating the intensity of main disaster causing factors by using a typhoon simulation data set, and carrying out annual prediction on typhoon damage by using the constructed quantitative relation between the main disaster causing factors and loss. The method can provide technical support for management, emergency, disaster reduction and the like of global typhoons, and has important significance for reducing global disaster loss and global sustainable development.

title_en: Urban water supply system earthquake-resistant analysis method based on multi-fine digital twin model
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake-resistant analysis method of an urban water supply system based on a multi-fine digital twin model, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent disaster prevention and digital twin of urban infrastructure systems, and comprises the steps of geometrically modeling according to a rule of progressive from a bottom level to an upper level, and constructing a topological network model and a hydraulic model of an urban pipe network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-fineness parameterized numerical model library, designing a dynamic scheduling engine based on event response, constructing a bidirectional data conversion interface and a unified semantic framework, constructing a multi-fineness twin model, simulating by utilizing the multi-fineness twin model to obtain a real-time simulation result, visualizing the comprehensive state of the urban water supply system based on the real-time simulation result, making an emergency decision, and completing earthquake-resistant analysis of the urban water supply system.

title_en: Disaster rescue device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of disaster medical rescue and discloses a disaster rescue device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein rollers are uniformly arranged on the bottom surface of the bottom plate, a vertical plate is longitudinally arranged on the left end surface of the bottom plate, a handle is fixedly arranged on the left side surface of the vertical plate, guide rods are symmetrically arranged on the left side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, a sliding plate is sleeved on the guide rods, a first spiral spring sleeved on the guide rods is arranged between the sliding plate and the bottom plate, a second frame is fixedly arranged on the right side of the upper surface of the sliding plate, a second motor is fixedly arranged at the end part of the second frame, a rotating wheel is fixedly sleeved on a motor shaft of the second motor, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the right end surface of the sliding plate, a rotating frame is arranged on the right side surface of the sliding plate, and a pull rope is connected between the side surface of the rotating frame and the rotating wheel. According to the invention, the waste materials are adhered by skillfully drilling and injecting the sizing material, so that surrounding crushed aggregates are adhered into a whole, and a covering in the rescue process is cleaned rapidly, thereby providing assistance for medical rescue.

title_en: Method for controlling actions of overlying strata in stope by weakening broken and expanded rock stratum seam network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the movement of overlying strata in a stope by weakening and expanding a stratum seam network, and relates to the technical field of mining. Firstly, acquiring mining conditions, geological features and mechanical parameters, defining three-zone range of the rock stratum, deducing the thickness and quantity of the rock stratum to be improved through a filling balance formula, then arranging directional drilling holes and implementing fracture network weakening, enabling the high-position thick and hard rock stratum to be assisted with ground pulse fracturing, and finally, monitoring, evaluating and dynamically optimizing parameters in multiple dimensions. According to the invention, the continuous seam net is constructed to improve the formation swelling property, the lower fracture zone is converted into the caving zone, the caving formation is fully crushed and swelled and then fully fills the goaf, so that the severe movement of the formation is restrained, the method is suitable for the scenes of mine earthquake and rock burst prevention and control, coal and gas outburst prevention and control, coal-series co-associated mineral production coordinated mining, water retention mining and the like, and a new technical path is provided for mine disaster prevention and control and multi-resource collaborative mining.

title_en: Rock-soil body deformation real-time monitoring method and system with high-density pixel tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a rock-soil body deformation real-time monitoring method and system with high-density pixel tracking. The technical scheme includes that monitoring videos are collected and uploaded or cached, format conversion, time alignment and buffer management are completed, points are automatically distributed, high-density pixel-level continuous tracking is conducted to generate a coordinate matrix, a training and optimizing model is conducted, three-dimensional coordinates are obtained through depth estimation, cluster analysis, threshold judgment and alarm triggering are conducted, and visual display and report generation are conducted. The intelligent monitoring system has the advantages of strong equipment compatibility, high automation degree, high monitoring density, strong real-time performance, no physical target, flexible deployment and the like, can be widely applied to complex geological scenes such as slopes, tunnels, landslide bodies and the like, remarkably improves the timeliness and accuracy of geological disaster early warning, reduces the operation and maintenance cost, and has good engineering popularization value.

title_en: Intelligent emergency response method based on multi-agent simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency response method based on multi-agent simulation. The method is used for simulating a human emergency command system aiming at sudden emergency events, constructing a three-layer organization structure comprising a command center, a decision layer and an execution layer, distributing roles and responsibilities for each level of agents, simultaneously configuring a shared database for storing and sharing information and knowledge among the agents, updating situation description of the emergency events in an iterative manner by a plurality of agents to optimize the generated emergency response strategy, carrying out disfigurement on the emergency response process of each level of agents after the final updated emergency response strategy is formed, and carrying out structural processing on disfigurement results and new knowledge and updating the disfigurement results into the shared database to complete intelligent emergency response based on multi-agent simulation.

title_en: Rescue skill training method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue skill training method and system, the method comprises the steps of collecting data from a multi-source accident report, constructing a scene library comprising disaster sites and rescue processes based on the collected data, automatically dividing each scene in the scene library into a classification system comprising a plurality of layers, obtaining information of rescue operation performed by training personnel, carrying out multi-mode knowledge skill feedback according to the rescue operation, evaluating the rescue operation in real time, comparing the rescue operation with a plurality of preset evaluation indexes to generate evaluation scores, and pushing subsequent training scenes to the training personnel based on the evaluation scores. By utilizing the scheme of the application, a cut-off training mode is eliminated, and the user operation is evaluated in real time and quantitatively, and personalized subsequent training content is automatically pushed. The method ensures the high authenticity and actual combat value of training content, further realizes the radical transition from passive training to intelligent guiding, and greatly enhances the pertinence, efficiency and final effect of training.

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.

title_en: Intelligent exploration early warning safety helmet capable of modeling and simulating in real time
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety construction, and provides an intelligent exploration and early warning safety helmet capable of realizing real-time modeling simulation, which comprises a safety helmet main body, a camera shooting assembly, HMD equipment, a GPS positioning device, a communication module and an intelligent assembly, wherein the intelligent assembly is provided with a diffusion model-based 2D-3D algorithm and a GPU accelerator particle method, the camera shooting assembly converts an acquired multi-view omni-directional image from 2D to 3D through a diffusion model in the intelligent assembly to generate a three-dimensional point cloud model, and the three-dimensional point cloud model is imported into the GPU accelerator particle method through a self-coding python interface to realize simulation of the current working condition to obtain a simulation result and return a safety report. The method can collect multi-view omni-directional images, can build an accurate surrounding geologic body point cloud model, can quickly obtain a high-precision simulation result, and can realize quick acquisition of a mine operation environment and accurate early warning of disaster risk.

title_en: Disaster emergency rescue nursing skill training system based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency rescue nursing skill training system based on virtual reality, and relates to the technical field of virtual reality. According to the invention, a high-simulation virtual disaster scene is constructed based on real data, a diversified injury virtual object matched with the high-simulation virtual disaster scene is generated, the secondary disaster risk diffusion effect and emergency prompt information are superimposed in real time, physiological state changes of blood pressure, respiration and the like of an injured person caused by nursing operation difference in the rescue process are dynamically simulated, the problem of fixed injury condition in a traditional training field Jing Shanyi is solved, instant and multi-mode feedback of the operation of a learner is realized through accurate comparison and layered identification of multi-dimensional operation characteristics, the defects of guiding lag and universalization are overcome, a personalized and self-adaptive training scheme is generated according to comprehensive evaluation results, the progress is dynamically adjusted, and scene simulation, operation practice, accurate feedback and personalized promotion are integrated.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Method for arranging distributed optical fiber sensors in low-permeability stratum and grouting and hole sealing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for arranging a distributed optical fiber sensor in a low-permeability stratum and grouting and hole sealing, which comprises the following steps of arranging a plurality of directional drilling sites in a disc zone roadway of a target stratum, horizontally constructing a plurality of directional drilling holes in the target stratum in each directional drilling site, fixing the distributed multi-parameter composite optical fiber sensor on a grouting pipe, arranging the grouting pipe and the distributed multi-parameter composite optical fiber sensor in each directional drilling hole, and carrying out sectional grouting in each directional drilling hole and solidifying the slurry. The invention can realize high-precision multi-parameter measurement of a plurality of monitoring points within a long distance and a wide range, can provide more continuous and accurate stress distribution information, realize continuous and accurate monitoring of safe and efficient exploitation of complex phosphorite bodies, provide real-time data support for mine safety production, timely early warn potential geological disaster risks, and ensure the life safety of miners and the mine production safety.
assignees: HUBEI SHENNONG PHOSPHORUS INDUSTRY TECH CO LTD;WUHAN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Search and rescue resource allocation method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue resource distribution method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of 1, building a training environment, building a state update model, 2, building an emergency disposal decision punishment function, building a base agent punishment function, 3, training the multi-agent search and rescue resource distribution model based on the training environment and the punishment function, modeling a disaster disposal-oriented search and rescue resource distribution problem as a Markov process decision problem, building a corresponding state space and an action space, modeling a plurality of resource bases as a plurality of base agents based on the multi-agent reinforcement learning frame, adopting a centralized training distributed execution paradigm, training the search and rescue resource distribution model, and 4, generating a multi-area search and rescue resource scheme based on the multi-agent search and rescue resource distribution model, and combining the search and rescue resource quantity limitation of each base according to different disaster areas.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Physical simulation experiment system for structure with controllable time sequence superposition seismic load
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster analysis, and particularly discloses a physical simulation experiment system for a structure with controllable time sequence superposition seismic load. The earthquake wave simulation vibration table can simulate earthquakes with different coordinates, different earthquake source depths and different earthquake load intensities through the earthquake source hammering system, can realize multi-type earthquake wave simulation, can truly present the sequence activities of the earthquakes through the cooperation of the earthquake wave simulation vibration table and the earthquake source hammering system, has time sequence superposition of dynamic effects, can realize the dynamic coupling of a construction stress field and time sequence earthquake motions through the arrangement of the construction physical simulation equipment, the earthquake wave simulation vibration table and the earthquake source hammering system, and is beneficial to researching the deformation and displacement processes of each geologic body model under the condition of critical conditions of the construction stress field and facing the earthquake vibration disturbance.
assignees: UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;SICHUAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY RES CENTER

title_en: Multifunctional circulating water tank test device and method for simulating river bank slope damage under scouring and seepage effects
abstract_en: A multifunctional circulating water tank test device and method for simulating river bank slope damage under the scouring and seepage effects belong to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, a water supply system comprises a pipeline, a water supply tank, a water pump, a flat water tower and a water drain tank and is used for providing water flow and water supply and drainage devices, a water tank system comprises a water diversion tank, an energy dissipater, a circulating water tank, a limiting module and a tail gate and is used for providing water flow channels and river bank slope plasticity, a filtering system comprises a filtering tank, a filtering plate and a water baffle and is used for filtering and precipitating particles in water and providing circulating water flow, and a bracket system comprises an adjustable bracket and is used for supporting the whole circulating water tank and providing gradient. The river channel simulation method can solve the defects of fixed river channel form and single function in the river channel simulation collapse test of the existing water channel device, can simulate the straight channel scouring damage process of the river bank, study the bank slope scouring damage process of the concave-convex bank under the variable-curve condition, provide theoretical and technical support for ecological bank protection engineering design and river bank disaster prevention and reduction, and can meet the multifunctional requirements of scientific research and engineering practice.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning coal-rock gas dynamic disasters of deep tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The application provides a coal and rock gas dynamic disaster monitoring and early warning method and system for a deep tunneling roadway, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining microseismic monitoring data, ground sound monitoring data, gas concentration data and wind speed data collected by a microseismic monitoring system, a ground sound monitoring system and a safety monitoring system, respectively disposing a plurality of microseismic sensors of the microseismic monitoring system on a coal roadway to be drilled and a bottom-pumped roadway to be drilled, disposing a plurality of ground sound sensors of the ground sound monitoring system on the coal roadway to be drilled, disposing a methane concentration sensor and a wind speed sensor of the safety monitoring system in front of a head on of the coal roadway to be drilled, obtaining a plurality of characteristic data of a roof coal and rock fracture microseismic positioning event, a plurality of characteristic data of a near-field coal and rock fracture event and a plurality of characteristic data of gas gushes, and determining an early warning risk level based on the characteristic data so as to realize coal and rock gas dynamic monitoring and early warning for the deep tunneling roadway.

title_en: Fine detection method for three-dimensional structure damage of post-disaster building by air-ground combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster building three-dimensional structure damage fine detection method by air-ground combination, which belongs to the technical field of post-disaster emergency building damage assessment and comprises the steps of collecting post-disaster building air-map images and preprocessing, registering and fusing point clouds of a fast point characteristic histogram FPFH characteristic and iterative closest point ICP, carrying out data enhancement by using CT-3DGAN, and carrying out fine segmentation on the building three-dimensional damage based on CD-PointNet ++. The invention provides an improved iterative closest point ICP algorithm based on ground and aviation data to ensure high-precision registration, particularly under the scene of large point cloud noise and low overlapping rate, a CT-3DGAN model integrates three-dimensional convolution and three-dimensional transform in a generation contrast network GAN frame, a three-dimensional building damage data set is expanded, representativeness is enhanced, training of a deep learning model is promoted, a CD-PointNet ++ model effectively identifies complex three-dimensional damage characteristics, and accurate segmentation of post-disaster building facade and roof damage is realized.

title_en: Detection sampling device for mapping geological disaster landform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection sampling device for mapping geological disasters and features, which relates to the technical field of mapping and sampling and comprises a movable frame, a sampling tube is slidably arranged in an outer sleeve, an elastic connecting component is arranged between the outer sleeve and the sampling tube, the lower end of the sampling tube is fixed with a hollow drill bit communicated with the inside, the movable frame is provided with an inclined component for driving the outer sleeve to rotate, the sampling tube is internally provided with a pushing column in a sliding manner, the transmission case is provided with a pushing component for driving the pushing column to axially slide relative to the sampling tube, and the movable frame is provided with a collecting basket. According to the invention, the outer sleeve is firstly abutted against the ground to play a good stabilizing role, the sampling tube and the hollow drill bit are vertically moved downwards to sample the rock and soil layer under the action of the elastic connecting component, the stability of the rock and soil sampling process is greatly improved, the inclination of the hollow drill bit during sampling can be effectively avoided, and the sampling effect is greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent rainfall simulation system and method for slope stability experiment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering disasters, and particularly relates to an intelligent rainfall simulation system and method for slope stability experiments. The system comprises an intelligent rainfall simulation unit, a comprehensive monitoring unit, a real-time data fusion and self-adaptive control unit and a data analysis and visualization unit, wherein the units are organically unified and mutually matched. The intelligent control system can realize intelligent control of the rainfall process, has the advantages of high rainfall intensity, accurate and adjustable raindrop size and rainfall uniformity, high system integration level and high automation degree, can realize real-time multidimensional monitoring, and realizes high-precision real-time analysis and automatic risk early warning of experimental data. Advanced monitoring means such as DIC full-field strain, optical fibers and acoustic emission are adopted, experimental precision is remarkably improved, accurate basis is provided for slope stability analysis and disaster prevention, the method can be applied to the fields of engineering slope safety assessment, education and public safety, and safety and disaster prevention awareness are improved in aspects such as geological engineering, geotechnical engineering, universities and colleges, scientific research teaching, emergency exercise and science popularization.

title_en: Underground cavern monitoring and early warning method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground engineering monitoring, in particular to an underground cavern monitoring and early warning method and system based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining stratum rock mass parameters and geological structure labels of a target cavity, generating a virtual geological disaster scene data set by utilizing a generation countermeasure network, extracting combined characteristic tensors of InSAR point cloud phase fluctuation, an anchor rod stress meter reading and a composite electrode potential gradient through a time sequence convolution layer, optimizing fusion weights, outputting a pre-training strategy network, adopting a model independent element learning adapter, fine-tuning the pre-training network by utilizing actual cavity monitoring data to obtain a disaster response model, and finally generating a displacement and stress cooperative control instruction by the model by monitoring the composite electrode potential gradient in real time, and issuing a rock burst risk level instruction and a target reinforcement area coordinate. The method effectively improves physical rationality of the virtual data, geological adaptation capability of the model and interpretability.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADONG SURVEYING AND MAPPING AND ENGINEERING SAFETY TECH CO LTD;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: Goaf collapse risk assessment data fusion system based on big data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf collapse risk assessment data fusion system based on big data processing, which particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster assessment, and comprises three major core modules, namely a multi-source data self-adaptive weighting fusion module, a physical-temporal neural network dynamic prediction module, a risk field three-dimensional splitting and emergency response module, a three-dimensional clustering and automatic calculation risk parameters of three-dimensional voxels of a high risk area, an emergency scheme generation by combining DEM data and an A-algorithm, a digital twin deduction assessment, and improvement of assessment accuracy and emergency scheme operability, wherein the non-raster data is converted into a continuous field by using a Kriging interpolation, the weight is dynamically allocated by combining information entropy and related coefficients, the enhanced feature field is generated by self-supervision pre-training, the physical-temporal neural network dynamic prediction module is integrated with elastoplastic constraint loss and multi-task learning, and the future multi-time step risk probability field and deformation prediction field are output by using a space-time convolution-memory network.

title_en: Channel disaster dynamic data set generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel disaster dynamic data set generation method, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-view video sequence of a channel, constructing a three-dimensional channel digital model of the channel to be tested according to the multi-view video sequence, carrying out geometric and material joint optimization on a crack image, applying arbitrary rigid transformation to obtain crack image data, constructing a Voronoi polyhedron, combining with a Delaunay tetrahedral grid, dividing a plurality of lobe areas, controlling the size and the direction of the lobe areas through the number and the distribution mode of Voronoi seed points to obtain a concrete fracture image, modeling water body fluctuation in the channel to be tested, determining the horizontal and vertical displacement of each modeling lattice point to obtain a channel water surface image, and constructing a synthetic dataset training YOLOv model to obtain a channel disaster detection model. The invention can solve the problem of scarcity of the prior channel disaster data set and realize high-precision identification of channel disasters.

title_en: Goaf three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction system based on multi-source remote sensing image fusion
