abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of remote sensing image processing and geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a goaf three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction system fused by multi-source remote sensing images, which comprises a heterogeneous data preprocessing module, a data fusion module based on differential geometry, a three-dimensional subsidence basin reconstruction module, a subsidence dynamic monitoring module and a virtual reality interaction module, wherein the system creatively introduces differential geometry theory to solve the heterogeneous fusion problem of high-resolution optical satellite images, SAR satellite images and airborne remote sensing Lidar point cloud data, mapping multi-source data to a unified feature space through manifold learning, calculating self-adaptive fusion weights through curvature analysis, constructing a multi-scale feature correlation matrix based on geodesic distances, generating a high-precision fusion image, carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction by combining subsidence basin geological parameters and a physical constraint method, ensuring that a reconstruction result accords with an actual subsidence physical rule, realizing dynamic monitoring and virtual reality interaction of a subsidence process, and supporting parameter adjustment and model optimization.
assignees: THE FIFTH GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF JIANGSU GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Collaborative control method for multi-mode VR tunnel fire simulation experiment equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a collaborative control method of multi-mode VR tunnel fire simulation experiment equipment, which belongs to the technical field of virtual reality fire simulation, and comprises the steps of generating NPC behavior parameters according to an NPC evacuation model and model input parameters, wherein the model input parameters comprise current environment parameters of an environment where NPC is located, controlling the behavior of the NPC in a VR tunnel fire scene displayed by a VR device according to the NPC behavior parameters, wherein the NPC evacuation model is constructed according to the relationship between the behavior of the NPC and the applied force of the environment to which the NPC is subjected, the applied force of the environment is determined according to the environment parameters, and comprises evacuation self-driving force, repulsive force with walls, ventilation acting force and social force, wherein the social force comprises repulsive force with other NPCs, follow-up force and autonomous decision force. The invention fully considers the physical environment and the force exerted by the social environment of the NPC, so that the NPC has stronger sense of reality.

title_en: Quaternary wind heavy rainfall early warning system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather disaster prediction, in particular to a deep learning-based strong rainfall warning system for a monsoon, which comprises an information acquisition module, a model training module and a model training module, wherein the information acquisition module is used for collecting historical multi-source weather data in a region to be predicted, analyzing the historical multi-source weather data to obtain structural data containing weather elements, screening the structural data, selecting the monsoon strong rainfall examples, marking the monsoon strong rainfall examples, preprocessing the structural data to obtain historical structural data, the model training module is used for constructing a deep learning model based on ConvLSTM architecture, training the deep learning model by using the historical structural data to obtain a trained strong rainfall prediction model, and the model training module is used for analyzing the contribution of key weather elements to the strong rainfall generation by using the structural weather data and screening key potential indexes and threshold values thereof, so that the effective prediction of the monsoon strong rainfall is realized, and the prediction accuracy and reliability are improved.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating susceptibility to rainfall induced landslide based on geometric features of side slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating the susceptibility of rainfall induced landslide based on geometrical characteristics of a side slope, and belongs to the technical field of landslide geological disaster prevention and control; the slope roughness coefficient of each simulated three-dimensional slope model is calculated, the safety coefficient of each simulated three-dimensional slope model in different rainfall phases is obtained based on slope geometric feature calculation and a standard three-dimensional slope model, and the linear relation between the slope roughness coefficient and the safety coefficient of each simulated three-dimensional slope model in the same rainfall phase is fitted to obtain the corresponding relation between the slope roughness coefficient and the safety coefficient in different rainfall phases. The method can accurately and efficiently evaluate the susceptibility of the side slope to rainfall-induced landslide.

title_en: Geological disaster identification method based on improved Stacking algorithm and DAS system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distributed optical fiber sensing, and discloses a geological disaster identification method based on an improved Stacking algorithm and a DAS system, which comprises the steps of collecting vibration signal data and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase demodulation to extract time domain and frequency domain features to form an original feature set, selecting a plurality of base classifiers, inputting samples to obtain feature vectors of prediction probabilities corresponding to the samples under the base classifiers, splicing to form a prediction probability matrix, calculating a weighted fusion prediction probability matrix, splicing to obtain a fusion feature matrix, respectively inputting the fusion feature matrix corresponding to a training set sample and a test set sample into a deep neural learning network for training and testing to obtain a geological disaster recognition model, obtaining data to be recognized, calculating the fusion feature matrix, inputting the trained geological disaster recognition model for recognition, and obtaining the geological disaster type. The invention improves the recognition capability and the environmental adaptability of the DAS system in a complex environment.

title_en: Robotic tele control arrangement
abstract_en: Building on and adopting tele driving technologies, here a tele robotic arrangement (20) drives a vehicle via robot (21 ), replacing the dependence on tele controlled technologies and mechanisms installed on a minimum level 2 autonomous vehicle. The regular remote-control cockpit (22), simulating a vehicle cockpit (21) is driven by a remote driver to operate remotely the driving mechanisms and devices inside the actual vehicle via a humanoid robot (21), which consists of multiple cameras (eyes) (28), hands (29), adjustable angle feet (30), microphones (31), speakers (32), control units (33), signal receiver and transmitter units (58), in addition to the vehicle computer vision equipment (34), all are set to transmit remotely a semi-driver and vehicle vision to a remote driver receiver (58) inside a cockpit (22) and receive driving instructions from it. The humanoid remotely controlled robot could be modified to do other technical, medical, security, guiding, educational, irrigation, firefighting... tasks.

title_en: Environment-controllable ruin rescue simulation device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of simulated emergency rescue, in particular to an environment-controllable ruin rescue simulator which comprises a building frame, wherein the bottom of the building frame is fixedly connected with an underground structure body, and the top of the building frame is fixedly connected with a building roof; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the building body frame and the obstacle, when the device is used, the building body frame is used as a main body supporting structure and combined with an underground structure, so that the underground and ground environments of ruins are simulated, the building body roof not only enhances the stability of the structure, but also provides a top closed space, rescue scenes under different environment conditions are conveniently simulated, the positions are flexibly adjusted according to training requirements, different rescue paths are formed, and therefore, a highly simulated ruin rescue environment is provided for training the search and rescue dogs, and meanwhile, as people can enter the device, the device can also be used as an auxiliary training tool for people, and the cooperative capacity and emergency response capacity of the search and rescue dogs and people in ruin rescue are improved.

title_en: Emergency plan treatment scheme generation method and device based on large model
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for generating an emergency plan treatment scheme based on a large model. The method comprises the steps of constructing an emergency plan label system, labeling a plurality of types and regions of collected emergency plans based on the emergency plan label system to form a labeled emergency plan data set, constructing a basic large language model, inputting the emergency plan data set into the basic large language model to perform supervised learning training, adjusting model parameters to enable the model to have the capability of extracting emergency plan key information and understanding plan logic semantics according to labels, collecting event information after an emergency occurs, carrying out label matching on the event information and the emergency plans analyzed by the model, and calling key contents corresponding to an organization command system, emergency disposal measures and emergency guarantee labels in the plans to generate a disposal scheme of the current stage of the emergency. The scheme of the invention can improve the efficiency and scientificity of emergency response.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for residual gas content of pre-drainage coal seam
abstract_en: A dynamic prediction method for residual gas content of a pre-extracted coal seam includes the steps of taking on-site working conditions into consideration, collecting parameters such as gas content change, related geological factors, extraction factors and the like, constructing a dynamic monitoring data set, screening main control factors based on gray correlation degrees, determining main control factors affecting residual gas content after extraction, taking the main control factors of residual gas content as independent variables, combining pre-extraction dynamic correction factors, establishing a dynamic prediction model, periodically adopting measured data to verify and optimize parameters of the dynamic prediction model, dividing a pre-extraction working face into uniform grid units, calculating residual gas content of each grid based on the dynamic prediction model, judging extraction dead zones according to quantitative standards, visually displaying, and formulating a differential drilling optimization scheme according to dead zone distribution. According to the invention, the prediction model of the residual gas content dynamically responding to the change of the mining conditions is constructed, so that the prediction of the mining blind area and the optimization of drilling are realized, the gas mining efficiency of the coal seam can be improved, and the occurrence of gas disasters is reduced.
assignees: HUANGLING JIANZHUANG MINING CO LTD OF SHAANXI COAL IND GROUP

title_en: Main control room disaster simulation and human body analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a main control room disaster simulation and human body analysis system and method, comprising a data acquisition module, a disaster simulation subsystem, a failure prevention simulation subsystem, a human-computer interaction failure simulation subsystem and a human body physiological analysis subsystem, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring comprehensive data of a nuclear power plant, the comprehensive data comprise plant data, environment data, earthquake data, fire data, human body physiological data and historical data, the disaster simulation subsystem is used for simulating different disaster working conditions, the failure prevention simulation subsystem is used for simulating the path state between a main control room and an auxiliary control room, the human-computer interaction failure simulation subsystem is used for simulating the failure state of main control room equipment, and the human body physiological analysis subsystem is used for acquiring and analyzing human body physiological information under the disaster working conditions.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Transmission tower vulnerability analysis method and system based on earthquake simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower vulnerability analysis method and system based on seismic simulation, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention of electric facilities and comprise the steps of correcting foundation rock vibration parameters based on equivalent shear wave velocity to generate a high-precision earth surface PGA distribution map, automatically positioning key node layers through eigenvalue decomposition, reducing a three-dimensional transmission tower model into a two-dimensional serial multi-degree-of-freedom model, outputting layer quality vectors, polycondensation rigidity matrixes and rod bending rigidity, performing time-course analysis by using the corrected PGA driving reduced model to generate seismic damage probability, fusing multi-source remote sensing data and PGA, outputting landslide space probability through a deep learning model, calculating impact strength and landslide kinetic energy to judge landslide damage probability, and calculating comprehensive damage probability based on a double-threshold condition triggering probability union to generate a three-dimensional vulnerability curved surface. The method solves the problems of high report missing rate and low calculation efficiency in single disaster evaluation, and achieves minute-level accurate early warning of composite disaster risk of the transmission tower.
assignees: CSG EHV TRANS COMPANY BOSE BUREAU

title_en: Landslide risk multi-criterion depth prediction method integrating geographic information and physical information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide risk multi-criterion depth prediction method integrating geographic and physical information, which belongs to the field of geological disaster early warning and is realized by a landslide risk depth learning prediction system and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting high-resolution satellite image data, S2, performing scaling and normalization processing on the image data, S3, constructing a geographic and physical information depth neural network, respectively completing independent training by using historical data, S4, training a multi-criterion filter by using the historical data again, and S5, processing the image data by using the trained geographic and physical information depth neural network to obtain a landslide sensitivity map. The method provides the geographic and physical information depth neural network capable of crossing the verification mechanism, ensures the accuracy of landslide risk prediction, can accurately classify various land coverage, remarkably improves the spatial precision and robustness of terrain analysis, integrates the terrain factor enhancement prediction capability, and can effectively support landslide easy-occurrence area identification of a landform complex area.

title_en: Electric pole disaster resistance research system and optimization structure based on multi-disaster analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-disaster analysis-based electric pole disaster resistance research system and an optimization structure, wherein the system comprises five modules of integrated data collection, processing, multi-source analysis, decision generation and simulation calculation, and the fusion modeling, coupling analysis, risk grading, optimization scheme generation and simulation verification of geological disasters, meteorological disaster data and electric pole structure parameters are realized, and real-time linkage early warning and parameter optimization are realized through a bidirectional verification mechanism. The invention can improve the stability and reliability of the electric pole in a multi-disaster environment, reduce disaster risk loss and optimize maintenance cost.
assignees: GUANGXI LVNENG ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Centrifugal test device for water-sand mixed fluid migration research
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centrifugal test device for water-sand mixed fluid migration research, which comprises a material source box module, a sand-crushing channel module, a collecting box module, a data acquisition module and a sand accumulation behavior and interface flow characteristics, wherein the material source box module is used for simulating water source and sand source supply, dynamically monitoring the material source state through a water pressure sensor, a soil pressure sensor and a displacement sensor, the sand-crushing channel module is combined with an aluminum back plate by adopting a transparent acrylic front plate, a water pressure sensor and a temperature sensor are embedded in the collecting box module for simulating water-sand migration processes in cracks with different geometric forms, the collecting box module is used for receiving an effluent water-sand mixture, the water pressure sensor is arranged in the collecting box module for monitoring residual pressure at an effluent end, a weighing sensor is arranged outside the collecting box module for calculating the water-sand mixture fluid quality change in real time under a high g environment, and the data acquisition module is used for acquiring water pressure, stress, vibration, acceleration and temperature signals and analyzing sand accumulation behavior and interface flow characteristics through image comparison. The device has the advantages of adjustable channel structure, controllable hydraulic condition, multiple monitoring means and high test precision, and is suitable for researching various water burst and sand burst disaster mechanisms.

title_en: Building fire safety control method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a building fire safety control method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the steps of constructing a sensor-middle station-model bidirectional mapping, reconstructing a dynamic scene by adopting a nerve radiation field technology, constructing a building full-element dynamic digital mirror image based on federal migration learning fusion cross-domain desensitization data, positioning a fire source in real time and predicting a flame spreading track through a spectrum analysis algorithm, operating fire simulation by linking the full-element dynamic digital mirror image, optimizing a fire resource scheduling path through a multi-target particle swarm optimization algorithm, generating a multi-target rescue scheme, utilizing an asynchronous blockchain to store a fire prevention decision instruction, plotting rescue key areas and planning an optimal evacuation route, converging federal node data quantization data contribution degree, reproducing historical fire conditions and deducing a new scene for iterative optimization. The application solves the problems of data perception fragmentation, difficult cross-domain fusion, fire prediction lag, underscience in resource scheduling, slow iteration of a drilling scheme and the like in the traditional management and control.

title_en: Method for generating concrete structure damage image after fire disaster based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: A method for generating a concrete structure damage image after fire disaster based on a generated countermeasure network relates to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and comprises the following steps of step 1, data set manufacturing; and 2, generating a damage image of the concrete structure after the fire disaster by adopting an improved cyclic generation countermeasure network architecture, improving the generator and the discriminator by adopting the improved cyclic generation countermeasure network architecture, and performing network training and performance evaluation. The invention can generate multiple types of vivid damage images with controllable attributes under the condition of limited real samples, thereby expanding a damage image data set, solving the problem of insufficient data and providing reliable data support for subsequent damage detection and quantitative evaluation.

title_en: Coal mine underground reservoir environment risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer simulation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating the environmental risk of an underground coal mine reservoir, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin body of the underground coal mine reservoir; establishing a risk assessment index system, collecting monitoring data corresponding to the index system in real time, calculating risk coupling factors among indexes of different dimensions, dynamically adjusting the weights of the index system according to the risk coupling factors and real-time numerical values of the indexes to generate a dynamic weight set, calculating the current comprehensive risk level, extracting physical field parameter values in the real-time monitoring data, inputting the physical field parameter values into a multi-physical field coupling simulation engine for simulation, and outputting a prediction report. The method can realize dynamic evaluation and advanced early warning of the environmental risk of the underground reservoir of the coal mine, improves the risk identification precision and emergency response capability, and is suitable for safety control of the whole life cycle of the underground reservoir under complex geological conditions.
assignees: GUONENG SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ENERGY SHENDONG COAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Low-temperature rain, snow and freezing composite disaster event identification and risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-temperature rain, snow and freezing composite disaster event identification and risk early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological observation data and simulation prediction data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cumulative probability distribution function mapping relation by utilizing historical meteorological observation data and simulation prediction data, correcting systematic deviation of the simulation prediction data based on the cumulative probability distribution function mapping relation to obtain corrected prediction data, constructing a composite disaster event identification model and a risk diagnosis model, inputting the corrected prediction data into the composite disaster event identification model to obtain occurrence information of a future composite disaster, inputting the occurrence information of the future composite disaster into the risk diagnosis model, and carrying out early warning on the risk level of the future composite disaster event. According to the invention, by introducing a multi-site and multi-factor fusion identification method, the identification range has more space continuity, and the space-time characteristics of a large-range and procedural low-temperature rain, snow and freezing disasters can be reflected more accurately.

title_en: Multi-sensor-based firefighter power-assisted vehicle attitude control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control and fire safety, in particular to a method and a system for controlling the posture of a firefighter power-assisted vehicle based on multiple sensors. The firefighter power-assisted vehicle attitude control method based on the multiple sensors trains an attitude control model based on sample attitude data, generates target attitude data and power distribution parameters, adjusts load distribution by combining load simulation analysis, and finally meets performance requirements. The firefighter power-assisted vehicle attitude control system based on the multiple sensors comprises a control scheme generation module for realizing the method. The invention can improve the dynamic balance and man-machine cooperation capability under complex terrain and enhance the stability and adaptability of the firefighter power-assisted vehicle.

title_en: Rainfall-induced landslide geological disaster scene simulation analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall-induced landslide geological disaster scene simulation analysis method, which belongs to the field of image synthesis, and more particularly relates to the field of 3D (three-dimensional) geographic model modeling for computer graphics, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring various custom model data for setting the current moment of a mountain based on a 3D graphic model for setting the current moment of the mountain; and intelligently predicting whether landslide geological disasters occur on the side surfaces of each mountain in the next time interval with the current moment as the starting moment according to the custom model data by adopting a landslide intelligent prediction model. The invention also relates to a rainfall-induced landslide geological disaster scene simulation analysis system. According to the invention, aiming at the technical problem that future landslide data of a physical entity which is easy to slide, such as a mountain, is difficult to predict in the prior art, the intelligent prediction of whether landslide can occur on each side of the mountain is set according to the 3D graphic model for setting the current moment of the mountain, so that the technical problem is solved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY GUANGZHOU ENGINEERING GROUP MUNICIPAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster high-risk area quantitative identification method based on ensemble learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative identification method of a high-risk area of a mountain torrent disaster based on ensemble learning, which belongs to the field of mountain torrent disaster prevention and control, and comprises the steps of constructing a mountain torrent disaster risk influence factor database of a disaster causing factor-pregnant disaster environment-disaster bearing body based on a disaster system theory, constructing an HEC-RAS two-dimensional hydrodynamic model to simulate flood elements under different conditions and rain, combining a multi-scale evaluation unit and GIS space analysis, establishing a dynamic evaluation method based on the submerged elements and a risk level threshold, realizing mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation of the multidimensional disaster bearing body, analyzing the influence of rainfall characteristics on the disaster risk degree, constructing a training data set by taking the integrated scene rainfall characteristics and the pregnant disaster environment factors as input variables through index screening and discretization, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation model guided by the disaster bearing body based on a stack algorithm frame. By the technical scheme, the timeliness of dynamic risk assessment of the mountain torrent disasters is remarkably improved.

title_en: Underwater disaster relief detection method based on small sample learning
abstract_en: The underwater disaster relief detection method based on small sample learning comprises the steps of acquiring hull attitude parameters and sonar echo signals of an unmanned survey boat through a multi-beam sonar and an attitude sensor so as to establish an original data set with acoustic impedance labels. And performing characteristic enhancement processing on the original data set, and adding a shadow region and an abnormal mask mark of multipath interference to the overexposed patch to obtain an enhanced mark data set. And constructing a small sample learning model based on the enhanced marker data set, and training and outputting detection model parameters through the small sample learning model. And (3) invoking a trained small sample learning model to detect and compensate and infer the multi-beam sonar image of the hard substrate region so as to output a corrected disaster relief detection result. The invention solves the problem of missed detection caused by imaging blind areas due to strong reflection of a hard substrate by automatically identifying and shielding the specular reflection and the energy saturation area and then carrying out compensatory inference in the shadow area and the multipath interference area.
assignees: UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL;NANJING INST TECH;YANGTZE RIVER ESTUARY HYDROLOGY AND WATER RESOURCES SURVEY BUREAU OF CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMM

title_en: Method for dividing gas dangerous areas of coal face perceived while drilling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prediction, in particular to a method for dividing a gas dangerous area of a coal face while drilling perception, which comprises the following steps of S1, in the drilling process of a detection drilling hole of the coal face, synchronously acquiring three parameters, namely a direct gas parameter, a drilling dynamics parameter and a hole wall geophysical parameter through a measurement while drilling system, wherein the measurement while drilling system comprises a sensor array arranged on a drilling tool and a data transmission module communicated with a ground data processing system, S2, carrying out space-time alignment and fusion analysis on the multisource parameters acquired in the step S1, adopting a pattern recognition method based on mutation point detection and multisource association, realizing accurate recognition and grading early warning of the gas dangerous area through multisource information fusion and dynamic coupling modeling, improving detection precision and early warning timeliness, and forming a closed-loop prevention and control system integrating perception, evaluation and management and control.

title_en: Enteromorpha green tide medium-long term probabilistic set forecasting method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting a medium-long-term probabilistic set of green tide of enteromorpha, and belongs to the field of green tide forecasting of enteromorpha. The method comprises the steps of a, acquiring longitude, latitude and initial appearance time of an initial appearance position of an enteromorpha green tide based on historical monitoring data, setting a potential throwing area and an initial window period, constructing a space-time probability density function of the throwing area, generating an initial field set scheme for long-term drift prediction in the enteromorpha green tide, b, acquiring a plurality of groups of medium-term and long-term ocean environment prediction driving field data, constructing a multi-driving field set scheme, c, substituting the initial field set scheme and the multi-driving field set scheme into a Lagrange drift prediction model, performing cyclic simulation, obtaining drift tracks of each enteromorpha green tide particle under all set schemes, and generating a long-term set prediction result in the enteromorpha green tide. The method can be used for carrying out medium-and-long-term forecasting of the green tide of the enteromorpha, remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of forecasting, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Underground material arrangement evaluation method, equipment and storage medium based on coupling of water passing probability and centrality entropy weight
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground material arrangement evaluation method based on coupling of water passing probability and center entropy weight, which comprises the steps of firstly calculating the water passing probability of each node in a roadway space, obtaining water passing risk scores by simulating a water flow diffusion process and combining elevation factors, distance factors and adjacent factors, normalizing, secondly calculating center indexes such as degree center, medium center and approaching center of each node in a roadway network, constructing an evaluation matrix comprising the water passing probability and the center indexes, calculating each index weight by adopting an entropy weight method after normalization processing, further obtaining a comprehensive evaluation value of each node, and finally giving optimization suggestions of underground material arrangement based on a visual result of the comprehensive evaluation value. According to the invention, the water inrush risk and the roadway network topology importance are comprehensively considered, the multi-index coupling is realized through objective weighting, the rationality of underground material arrangement can be scientifically evaluated, the emergency response efficiency of the mine water inrush disaster is improved, and the method has important engineering application value.

title_en: Earthquake and secondary disaster vulnerability assessment method combining multiple agents and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake and secondary disaster vulnerability assessment method combining multi-agent and deep learning, which comprises the following steps of (1) collecting data related to an earthquake and secondary disasters thereof and preprocessing the data to obtain multi-source static data, extracting key features from the multi-source static data, (2) constructing a hierarchical structure index system for vulnerability assessment by using expert knowledge, constructing a judgment matrix by using a analytic hierarchy process, calculating the weight of each index to obtain an AHP weight vector, (3) constructing and dynamically simulating disaster propagation by the multi-agent system, and (4) designing a GCN+transform deep learning model, combining the multi-source static data and dynamic evolution data to construct a space-time feature tensor as input of the GCN+transform deep learning model, and outputting a vulnerability assessment result. The invention can solve the problems of the existing earthquake and the secondary disaster vulnerability assessment precision and timeliness.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Fire disaster prediction method and device based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster prediction method and a fire disaster prediction device based on multi-source data fusion, which belong to the technical field of data processing, wherein the fire disaster prediction method based on multi-source data fusion comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source historical data of a target area, wherein the multi-source historical data comprise historical sensor data, historical satellite remote sensing data, historical meteorological data, historical building data and historical fire disaster data; and taking the input data set as the input of a fire prediction model, and carrying out fire prediction on the target area based on the output result of the fire prediction model, wherein the fire prediction model is obtained by training an LSTM network using GRU to replace an input gate and a forget gate based on the multi-source historical data. The invention can effectively improve the accuracy of fire prediction.
assignees: HUBEI FENGHUO PINGAN INTELLIGENT FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge disaster numerical simulation optimization method for ocean pasture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of numerical simulation optimization, in particular to a storm surge disaster numerical simulation optimization method for an ocean pasture. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a boundary of an ocean pasture and an initial still water level, discretizing a geographical space of the ocean pasture into a rectangular grid layout, obtaining data of weather grid points of the ocean pasture, calculating a total water level increment through a wind pressure wind field physical driving water level increment calculation algorithm, obtaining an updated water level, introducing a storm path projection similarity weight mechanism based on the updated water level, carrying out local enhancement correction on the water level field in storm tide simulation, obtaining the water level after weight correction, and outputting a water level space distribution diagram. The method solves the problems that the traditional storm surge disaster numerical simulation optimization method mostly ignores the dynamic regulation effect of wind speed change on sea surface roughness and wind resistance, ignores the 'inverted barometer' effect, cannot respond to the air pressure change dynamically and cannot reflect the regulation effect of geospatial factors on the simulated water level field accurately.

title_en: Numerical simulation system for thermal-force coupling behavior of reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforced concrete structure thermal-force coupling behavior numerical simulation system, which particularly relates to the field of constructional engineering, and comprises a thermal conduction analysis module, a mechanical behavior analysis module, a bonding slip behavior analysis module and a simulation calibration module, wherein the thermal conduction analysis module is used for simulating the temperature field change of concrete in the fire process by defining temperature related parameters of the concrete, the mechanical behavior analysis module is used for simulating the nonlinear mechanical behavior of the concrete, and is combined with a temperature-dependent material model to analyze the strength degradation, crack expansion and plastic deformation of the concrete at high temperature, and the bonding slip behavior analysis module is used for setting nonlinear contact behavior between reinforced steel bars and the concrete. The invention realizes the comprehensive simulation of the reinforced concrete under the high temperature conditions such as fire disaster and the like, and can accurately predict the strength degradation, crack expansion and bonding sliding behavior of the reinforced concrete and the concrete by combining a temperature field and a mechanical field.

title_en: Method and system for inducing water-control anti-impact energy-release ring of coal mine composite disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mining, and discloses a method and a system for inducing a water control and anti-impact energy release ring of a coal mine composite disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring geological exploration data and monitoring data of a target area, analyzing by using a constructed disaster coupling risk evaluation model, and judging the risk level of the target area facing rock burst and water bursting composite disasters; when the risk level exceeds the threshold value for constructing the energy release ring, a key target horizon is selected in the rock stratum above the target area through overlying strata structural mechanics analysis and mining stress transmission path simulation, a hydraulic fracturing scheme and a drilling explosion scheme are designed according to geomechanical characteristics and disaster risk characteristics of the key target horizon, energy release ring induction is implemented in the target area based on the hydraulic fracturing scheme and the drilling explosion scheme, seismic activity energy and frequency change of the target area are evaluated through microseism monitoring after implementation of the scheme, and the stress release effect is analyzed.

title_en: Combined reaming and comprehensive repairing method for underground coal mine gas drainage drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined reaming and comprehensive repairing method for underground coal mine gas drainage boreholes, which comprises the following steps of S1, selecting a monitored low-concentration gas drainage borehole, disconnecting a gas drainage pipeline, S2, mechanically reaming an original borehole section, S3, carrying out jet rotary cutting reaming operation on the drainage borehole, dredging and repairing a borehole blocking section, S4, carrying out grouting secondary hole sealing on the reamed drainage borehole by adopting a large-diameter hole sealing pipe and a large-diameter bag, S5, connecting the large-diameter hole sealing pipe into the gas drainage pipeline for gas drainage, periodically monitoring the gas drainage concentration, S6, disconnecting the gas drainage pipeline, and carrying out repeated dredging and repairing by adopting a high-pressure continuous winding type steel pipe/hose connection hydraulic spin self-feeding repairing device to the drainage borehole through the large-diameter hole sealing pipe after the gas concentration is monitored. The invention has low engineering cost and relatively simple process, fully improves the drainage efficiency, shortens the drainage time and eliminates the gas disasters to the maximum extent.
assignees: SHANXI JINCHENG ANTHRACITE MINING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND MARKETING GROUP YANGQUAN CO LTD;SHANXI COAL TRANSP AND MARKETING GROUP SECURITY COAL INDUSTRY CO LTD;JIAOZUO CHENGBO MINE SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Knowledge generation and search question-answering system for dangerous chemical accident disposal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency response and artificial intelligence, and discloses a knowledge generation and search question-answering system for dangerous chemical accident handling. The system comprises a data access module, a text segmentation module, a vectorization coding module, a vector library, a knowledge graph module, a retrieval and recall module, a reordering module, a multi-agent collaboration module, a history session persistence module and a user interface module. Through local text coding and local reordering, the mixed retrieval of BM25, semantic vector and knowledge graph is combined, and rules, text and graph evidence are fused by a multi-agent mechanism to generate a traceable answer with references. The system supports the incremental importing of knowledge maps from the cache directory, wherein the fusion prompt can be submitted to DEEPSEEK API to generate an answer, or can be switched to a local model to meet the offline and privacy requirements. The system is suitable for scenes such as government and enterprise safety production, emergency command and training.

title_en: Method for forecasting flood in river basin influenced by strong human activities based on hybrid model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for forecasting flood of a river basin affected by strong human activities based on a mixed model, which comprises the steps of constructing and calibrating a distributed hydrological model combining sub-river basin division and Ma Sijing methods; and then constructing an error correction model by using a Bayesian optimized LSTM (least squares) by taking a hydrological model simulation error and multi-step long-basin average precipitation based on river channel propagation time as characteristics, and finally coupling the two models to realize real-time prediction. By Lanxi river basin verification, compared with the traditional model, the Nash efficiency coefficient of the hybrid model is obviously improved, the relative error of flood peaks is less than or equal to 8%, the peak time difference is less than or equal to 2 hours, the accuracy is stable within a prediction period of 12 hours, long-series continuous uninterrupted historical data are not needed to be used as a support, only data during field flood are needed, the method is suitable for the hour scale flood forecast of a strong human activity river basin without data, efficient and reliable technical means are provided for flood control and disaster reduction, and the method has wide engineering application prospect.

title_en: Landslide-debris flow disaster chain assessment method based on graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of landslide-debris flow disaster chains based on a graph neural network, which comprises the steps of generating a composite ground object unit through composite curvature field watershed segmentation and hydrologic analysis, abstracting the composite ground object unit into geographical nodes, screening and optimizing multisource environmental factors through mutual information, constructing a directed weighted graph by combining spatial similarity, adopting an improved GRAPHSAGE model which introduces neighbor weight, self-loop and residual information and cancels random sampling, and constructing a sample set adapting to a minority data area through a unit splitting-feature matching-terrain fitting mechanism, thereby completing model training and risk prediction. The method solves the problems of single disaster assessment, strong sample dependence and high miss judgment rate of the traditional technology, has excellent performance indexes, effectively reduces miss judgment risk of high risk areas, and provides accurate and efficient technical support for disaster chain risk assessment of small watershed in few mountain areas.

title_en: Electric power facility fire disaster early warning method based on temperature and smoke cooperative induction
abstract_en: The invention provides a power facility fire disaster early warning method based on temperature and smoke cooperative induction, which is suitable for the technical field of power facilities. The method comprises the steps of electric power facility statistics, sensing equipment arrangement, data processing, result display and early warning notification, wherein the optimal arrangement positions of the smoke sensor, the temperature sensor and the camera are determined through electric power facility fire source point statistics and fire dynamics simulation, the correlation between the change trend of the temperature and the change trend of the smoke data on the same type of facilities is analyzed, the comprehensive risk scoring is carried out by adopting a dynamic base line based on historical data, the judgment accuracy is greatly improved, the fire analysis is carried out on an instant image by combining a multi-mode large model, the problem that the threshold value is set too low to report by mistake or too high to report by mistake is solved, the accurate early warning is realized, and meanwhile, the construction and management cost of early warning and monitoring of all electric power facilities in an area is reduced through regional unified planning and numbering management.
assignees: JIEYANG HUILAI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;DAHUANG GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheme release method based on emergency state dynamic change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plan release method based on dynamic change of emergency states, which relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and comprises the steps of activating a pre-built knowledge graph frame according to an emergency type identifier acquired in real time to form an initialized dynamic knowledge graph, capturing a feedback data stream in real time, importing the feedback data stream into a state update layer of a state evolution knowledge graph to generate an updated state evolution knowledge graph, generating an evacuation instruction based on the updated state evolution knowledge graph, switching to Mesh network broadcast path change information through a damaged base station to generate an execution effect, and re-triggering and activating the pre-built knowledge graph frame as a new emergency type identifier. According to the intelligent countermeasures, artificial disturbance simulation nodes are implanted in the state evolution knowledge graph, and the diffusion path is deduced, so that the intelligent countermeasures are dynamically generated.

title_en: Method for calibrating magnitude based on seismic source dynamics mechanism
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering, and relates to a seismic level calibration method based on a seismic source dynamics mechanism, which comprises the steps of determining seismic source parameters in a target area, establishing a dynamic seismic source model according to the information of a seismic emission fault in the target area, acquiring a Digital Elevation Model (DEM) of the target area, processing DEM data, establishing a three-dimensional field model of the target area and acquiring geological parameters, determining a friction constitutive relation, carrying out high-precision seismic simulation by adopting a spectral element method on the premise of not changing geometric factors of the model, acquiring seismic characteristics, and determining a proportion coefficient corresponding to a current fault And (5) value, and then performing magnitude calibration. Compared with the prior art, the method has the beneficial effects that the calculation efficiency is high, the modeling method is simple, the effectiveness of calculation results can be perfected, the accuracy of the vibration level calibration is improved, and therefore a more reliable scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction design of regional infrastructures.

title_en: Remote sensing image landslide identification method based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement
abstract_en: A remote sensing image landslide recognition method based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement comprises the steps of constructing a coding sub-network based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement remote sensing image landslide recognition, constructing a decoding sub-network based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement remote sensing image landslide recognition, constructing a recognition sub-network based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement remote sensing image landslide recognition, constructing a remote sensing image landslide recognition network based on visual state space and frequency domain enhancement, generating a training set, a verification set and a test set, training a remote sensing image landslide geological disaster recognition network, and recognizing a remote sensing image landslide geological disaster range.

title_en: Physical model device capable of simulating multi-working-condition disaster response of roadbed and side slope
abstract_en: The invention relates to a physical model device capable of simulating multi-station disaster response of a roadbed and a side slope, which is characterized by comprising a model box body, a loading assembly, a rainfall assembly and a coordination control assembly, wherein the model box body comprises a rigid frame and a transparent panel, a detachable baffle is arranged in the model box body and is used for separating a side slope simulation area and a roadbed simulation area in the same box body, the loading assembly comprises a vertical loading module and a horizontal loading module, the seepage assembly comprises seepage water tanks arranged on the left side, the right side and the rear side of the model box body and is used for realizing control of seepage water boundaries and seepage flow on the single side, the double side or the three sides, the rainfall assembly comprises a rainfall nozzle and is used for simulating rainfall working conditions with different intensities and durations, and the coordination control assembly is electrically connected with the loading assembly, the seepage assembly and the rainfall assembly and performs data interaction with an external computer. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high spatial reconstruction and functional integration level, fine control and synchronous coupling of multi-disaster working conditions, high reliability of test results and the like.

title_en: Hydropower engineering construction progress analysis method based on LSTM and MC simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydroelectric engineering, in particular to a hydroelectric engineering construction progress analysis method based on LSTM and MC simulation, which comprises a data input layer, an LSTM layer, a Monte Carlo simulation layer, a bidirectional interaction analysis layer, a construction period prediction layer, a scheme optimization layer and an evaluation decision layer; dividing the construction period of a key line into time sequence segments, importing multi-source heterogeneous data, combining GAT to construct a construction node association map, receiving LSTM time sequence characteristics by an MC simulation layer to dynamically adjust sampling parameters, optimizing parameters in real time by a bidirectional interaction layer and triggering LSTM retraining, generating a risk interval and dynamically adjusting resource allocation, and outputting a structured decision report containing disposal requirements. The method realizes progress dynamic risk quantification and resource intelligent optimization, improves prediction precision and emergency response speed, provides high-adaptability decision support for hydropower engineering progress control, and solves the defects that the prior art depends on manually preset parameters, static solidification and time sequence dependence capture is insufficient.

title_en: Grenade Training Accident Prevention System
title_ko: 수류탄 훈련사고 예방 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군사 훈련 중 수류탄 투척 훈련에서 발생할 수 있는 사고를 예방하기 위한 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은 훈련병과 교관의 안전을 보장하기 위해 와이어가 연결된 조끼(10)와 모터 구동부(70)를 이용하여 긴급 상황에서 자동으로 대피할 수 있도록 설계되었다. 본 발명의 시스템의 주요 구성 요소로는 훈련병과 교관이 착용하는 와이어가 연결된 조끼(10), 수류탄 훈련 벙커실(150) 최상 고개부에 설치된 제1 회전축(30), 긴급 대피실(140) 최하 저면부에 설치된 제2 회전축(40), 긴급 모터 구동부(70), 낙하 안전 쿠션(170), 긴급 대피실 상부의 구난 덮개(130) 등이 있다. 비상 상황이 발생하면 교관이나 관제사가 비상 버튼(110)을 눌러 모터 구동부(70)를 작동시킨다. 모터 구동부(70)가 회전하면서 조끼(10)와 연결된 와이어(20)가 제1 회전축(30)과 제2 회전축(40)을 통해 감기게 되어, 훈련병과 교관은 긴급 대피실(140)로 자동 이동한다. 이동 동선에는 쿠션(170)이 설치되어 있어 강제 이동 중 발생할 수 있는 부상을 방지한다. 시스템 작동 시 긴급 대피실 상부의 구난 덮개(130)가 연동되어 훈련병과 교관을 추가적으로 보호한다. 이러한 자동화된 대피 절차를 통해 훈련 중 발생할 수 있는 사고를 신속하고 안전하게 예방할 수 있다. 훈련병과 교관은 긴급 대피실(140) 최저면 제2 회전축(40) 앞 바닥으로 자동 이동하여 대피하게 되는데, 이동 동선에는 강제 이동 중 다치지 않도록 쿠션(170) 등이 안전하게 보호한다. 시스템 작동 시 연동되는 긴급 대피실 상부의 구난 덮개(130)가 훈련병과 교관을 더욱 안전하게 보호한다. 본 발명은 높은 신뢰성과 신속성을 통해 훈련 병력의 안전을 극대화할 수 있다.

title_en: Landslide and bridge collapse disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning method and a system for landslide and bridge collapse disasters, which relate to the technical field of traffic safety monitoring and comprise the steps of constructing a heterogeneous graph structure of a multi-source node, inputting the heterogeneous graph structure into a heterogeneous graph annotation force coding model for feature fusion, outputting a first alarm score of each node, weighting the first alarm score based on image confidence of adjacent camera nodes to obtain a recalibration alarm score of each node, constructing time sequence input, carrying out graph convolution and time convolution processing on the time sequence input based on a dynamic space-time graph convolution network, triggering early warning blocking action when the node recalibration alarm score exceeds a threshold value, returning a treatment result as a training sample, and carrying out incremental updating on the model. The method of the invention realizes the disaster monitoring of a large scale and full links and reduces the false alarm rate. And simultaneously capturing risk characteristics on time sequence dimension and space topology, so as to realize early warning of disaster trend.
assignees: GUIZHOU JIN JIU BIOTECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting equipment maintenance detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire-fighting equipment maintenance detection device, which comprises a handle, wherein the top end of the handle is provided with a first electric push rod, the piston end of the first electric push rod is connected with a supporting plate, the top surface of the supporting plate is provided with a rotary driving mechanism, the rotary driving mechanism is connected with a turntable, the top surface of the turntable is provided with an angle switching mechanism, one side of the angle switching mechanism is provided with a bracket, the top surface of the bracket is provided with a smoke manufacturer, and the turntable is provided with a position adjusting mechanism, so that the smoke rising from the lower part during fire disaster can be simulated, the smoke can be restored, and after being shielded by a building structure, the smoke can detoured from the side to the real diffusion path of an alarm, and the reliability of fire early warning prediction can be effectively improved. In addition, the device can clean dust and tiny sundries on the surface of the smoke alarm without climbing by personnel, so that the maintenance work efficiency is remarkably improved, and the risk of high-altitude work is avoided.
assignees: HENAN KANGXIAN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Bow net state monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bow net state monitoring system and method, which belong to the technical field of bow net monitoring and comprise the following steps of training a monitoring model to identify a safety event, acquiring bow net state monitoring information, determining a first temperature sequence of a target monitoring area in a first time period, studying and judging the current running condition of a train based on a train state monitoring model, determining a first abnormality judgment parameter, predicting a second temperature sequence of the target monitoring area in a second time period, determining a second abnormality judgment parameter, determining a comprehensive abnormality judgment value, determining abnormality early warning information of at least one time point, adjusting the monitoring model parameter based on the current running condition of the train, determining the occurrence probability of the safety event through the monitoring model, and determining safety warning information of at least one time point. The invention improves the processing speed and efficiency of responding to the safety event, enhances the safety performance and disaster prevention capability, and realizes the technical effect of improving the bow net state monitoring precision.

title_en: Meteorological disaster flash message generation method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application provides a method for generating weather disaster flash information based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining sand dust source space distribution and real-time wind direction and wind speed information of a target area, preprocessing and integrating the sand dust source space distribution and wind direction and wind speed data to generate a standard data set, inputting the standard data set into a pre-constructed weather diffusion model, simulating a sand storm influence range and a diffusion trend to obtain a sand storm diffusion trend analysis result, generating an influence area distribution map, defining flash information and a pushing strategy as action spaces after a dynamic state space is built, inputting the generated influence area distribution map, real-time traffic condition data and user image data into a trained sand storm early warning flash information generation model, outputting target flash information according to a current state, pushing the flash information to a target user, and adjusting the super parameters of the sand storm early warning flash information generation model in real time according to the sand storm development dynamic change and user feedback.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION METEOROLOGICAL SERVICE CENTER NINGXIA PROFESSIONAL METEOROLOGICAL OBSE

title_en: Scene matching method for urban flood disaster emergency decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene matching method for emergency decision of urban flood disasters, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent water affair and emergency management. The method aims to solve the problems that the traditional emergency decision is slow in response, large in calculation amount and difficult to adapt to real-time working conditions. The core is realized through an off-line construction-on-line application two-stage mode. In the off-line construction stage, the system collects historical rainfall data, recognizes typical scene rainfall through space-time clustering analysis, derives and expands to construct a huge urban scene rainfall scene library, and calculates and stores an optimal combination optimization scheduling mode in advance by utilizing a simulation model and an optimization algorithm to form an emergency decision scene library. In the online application stage, when the actual forecast rainfall is received, the system searches the most similar scenes in the library through a quick matching algorithm to acquire an initial emergency decision scheme. The invention preposes a large amount of calculation work, obviously shortens the emergency response decision time, and improves the scientificity, the precision and the real-time adaptability of the decision.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENG DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Fuel operation accident radioactivity result analysis method based on staged release mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a fuel operation accident radioactivity result analysis method based on a staged release mechanism, which comprises the following steps of S  1 , setting an initial source item composition of damaged fuel release including iodine and inert gas in an initial form, S  2 , dividing radioactivity release into two stages, constructing a release model of the two stages, wherein the first stage is bubble instantaneous release, the second stage is element iodine re-precipitation release, S  3 , calculating dynamic decontamination factors of element iodine in a water layer according to the first stage and the second stage, S  4 , establishing a release path and a dose calculation model of radioactive substances, and S  5 , setting acceptance criteria and result judgment. The invention realizes the fine simulation of the accident release behavior and the accurate prediction of the critical position dosage. The system can support the optimal design, reduce the construction cost, improve the application passing rate of the license, and provide scientific basis for accident alleviation and emergency response.
assignees: SHANGHAI NUCLEAR ENG RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for identifying weak links of power distribution system in extreme disaster scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a device for identifying weak links of a power distribution system in an extreme disaster scene, relates to the technical field of power grid operation, and can truly restore the complex damage process of an actual disaster to the system and improve the identification accuracy of the weak links of the power distribution system in the extreme disaster scene. The method comprises the steps of respectively constructing an equipment fault probability model and a distributed power supply power generation power model of an extreme disaster scene according to scene models of different extreme disasters, applying the equipment fault probability model and the distributed power supply power generation power model to different fault scenes in a power distribution system to carry out simulation to obtain fault statistics probability of equipment elements, constructing an objective function according to products of the fault statistics probability of the equipment elements and set deviation, and solving the objective function by using a binary particle swarm algorithm on the basis of presetting at least one constraint condition to obtain weak links of the power distribution system in the extreme disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide easy-occurrence area prediction method integrating small sample table learning and probability feedforward modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide easily-occurring area prediction method integrating small sample table learning and probability feedforward modeling, which belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and comprises the following steps of S1, disaster-causing factor extraction and sample data set construction; S2, disaster factor information quantity calculation and normalization processing, S3, sample balance and boundary optimization, S4, landslide susceptibility prediction model training and evaluation based on TabPFN, and S5, classification of landslide susceptibility and visual drawing. The landslide easily-occurring region prediction method based on the fusion of the small sample table learning and the probability feedforward modeling can improve the quality of a training set, enhance the adaptability and generalization of small samples and high-dimension data, reduce the parameter dependence, inhibit the influence of abnormal values, ensure the stable output in a high-noise environment and enhance the fault tolerance of the model.

title_en: Shield tunnel fire high temperature-explosion impact coupling effect simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-explosion impact coupling effect simulation device for a shield tunnel fire disaster, which comprises a tunnel test piece, a pulley, a metal rope, an ice chamber, an explosive and a plurality of working sensors, wherein the pulley is arranged on the inner wall of the tunnel test piece, the metal rope is arranged on one side of the pulley and guided by the pulley, both ends of the metal rope extend out of the tunnel test piece, one end of the ice chamber and one end of the metal rope are fixed, the explosive is arranged in a closed cavity of the ice chamber, the other end of the metal rope is pulled to send the ice chamber into an internal combustion environment of the tunnel test piece, and the working sensors are used for collecting corresponding experimental data. The method comprises the steps of fully forming and stabilizing a high-temperature environment in a tunnel, delaying and insulating by an ice shell to ensure that the explosive cannot spontaneously ignite before a preset moment, and enabling experimenters to select an optimal explosion point from the moment according to a temperature curve to realize a real coupling time sequence of fire disaster and explosion.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle safety test method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a safety test method and related equipment of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a false data injection attacker is built based on MAVProxy to perform multi-level attack tests on an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a control system and a ground control station, and the sensor and the control system of the unmanned aerial vehicle body are interfered by means of sensor false data injection, data tampering, control command tampering and the like, so that the safety test method and related equipment can simulate various safety threats, comprehensively evaluate the anti-attack capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle system in the face of the safety attacks such as false data injection, control system hijacking, communication interference and the like, provide technical support for improving the safety, reliability and emergency response capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in complex and changeable environments, and provide open sources for protocols and the like used for carrying out the attack tests and targets and the like of the attack tests, thereby having good reproducibility and universality. The invention is widely applied to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles.

title_en: Non-contact visual settlement displacement monitoring and operation state evaluation method for operation state of high-steep slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact visual settlement displacement monitoring and operation state assessment method for an operation state of a high-steep side slope, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent construction of the high-steep side slope and comprises the steps of obtaining an image of the high-steep side slope, extracting characteristic points of the image of the high-steep side slope, constructing a settlement displacement database of the high-steep side slope, constructing a characteristic matching network model based on a graph roll-up neural network, training the characteristic matching network model by adopting the settlement displacement database of the high-steep side slope, inputting the newly obtained image of the high-steep side slope into the characteristic matching network model for characteristic matching, extracting key point pairs of two images of the high-steep side slope, calculating settlement displacement data of multiple measuring points of the high-steep side slope based on the key point pairs, and carrying out risk assessment and early warning on the settlement displacement data of the operation state of the high-steep side slope according to the settlement displacement data of multiple measuring points of the high-steep side slope, thereby having great significance for safe operation and disaster prevention and reduction of the high-steep side slope and adjacent traffic facilities.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION GROUP CHENGDU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTR GROUP CO

title_en: Comprehensive forest and grassland fire monitoring and emergency command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest grassland fire emergency command and discloses a forest grassland fire comprehensive monitoring and emergency command method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource monitoring data of satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles and ground sensors, constructing a fire scene multidimensional feature vector through collaborative training and feature fusion, inputting the feature vector into a physical simulation model to generate fire scene spreading speed and temperature gradient data, analyzing terrain obstacle coefficients based on the spreading speed data and generating helicopter no-fly zone coordinates and passing attenuation factors, solving and outputting rescue unit deployment instructions through a scheduling matrix, and utilizing an augmented reality terminal to project holographic images to realize dynamic closed-loop feedback. The invention solves the problem of cracking of traditional fire prediction and resource scheduling through deep fusion of physical mechanism and reinforcement learning, realizes intelligent decision of accurate prediction of fire and emergency response, and remarkably improves the accuracy and timeliness of fire prevention and control.
assignees: BEIJING JINLIN WEIYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground surface subsidence prediction method based on variational modal decomposition and BP neural network
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and prediction, in particular to a ground surface subsidence prediction method based on variation modal decomposition and BP neural network. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining multi-time-phase SAR images of a research area and corresponding DEM, atmospheric correction and precise orbit data, extracting sedimentation time sequences through an SBAS-InSAR process, then carrying out VMD decomposition on the sedimentation time sequences, constructing and training a BP neural network for each IMF component, carrying out future time sequence prediction by taking a history sequence of the BP neural network as input, finally superposing all component prediction results to form integral earth surface sedimentation prediction, comparing the prediction results with actual observation through indexes such as calculation RMSE, MAE, MAPE and the like, adjusting VMD or BP model parameters according to requirements to optimize performance, realizing accurate noise stripping, extracting key trends, and greatly improving accuracy and robustness through component prediction superposition and feedback optimization.
assignees: SHANXI JINCHENG ANTHRACITE MINING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL;SHANXI JINCHENG SONGYU COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Slope settlement positioning method and system based on radar combined video
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope settlement positioning method and a system based on radar combined video, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and processing point cloud data and images based on a slope radar and a camera, generating a simulated SAR image based on the point cloud data, and generating an enhanced video image by applying a Retinex algorithm; the method comprises the steps of extracting time sequence features of point cloud data, obtaining radar features through VAE coding based on the time sequence features, extracting multi-scale features in an enhanced video image, generating a spatial feature map by combining with the creation of three-dimensional view cone features, generating video features based on the spatial feature map, and generating fusion features by combining the spatial feature map and the radar features, generating a two-dimensional Gaussian thermodynamic diagram based on the point cloud data, generating a prediction thermodynamic diagram by using the fusion features, and generating an ROI feature map by combining the two-dimensional Gaussian thermodynamic diagram. According to the slope settlement monitoring method, the accuracy, the robustness and the real-time early warning capability of slope settlement monitoring are effectively improved through multi-mode feature fusion and self-adaptive optimization.
assignees: ZHONGAN GUOTAI BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident emergency three-layer coupling network model and construction method
abstract_en: A nuclear accident emergency three-layer coupling network model and a construction method relate to the crossing field of nuclear accident emergency management and complex system risk simulation. The nuclear accident emergency three-layer coupling network model comprises an RMN layer, an IN layer, an EN layer, a three-layer network coupling mechanism and a three-layer network coupling mechanism, wherein the RMN layer is used for simulating the dynamic diffusion process of radionuclide leaked from nuclear accidents IN the atmosphere, the IN layer is used for constructing a spatial distribution and dependency relationship network of an infrastructure, the EN layer is used for topologically defining the command or cooperation relationship of emergency organization When the RDR of the grid in the grid is larger than or equal to RDR  max‑1 , The IN layer nodes IN the same position grid are marked as damaged state, and the bi-directional dependency density of the IN layer and the EN layer is quantified through the coupling strength epsilon. The method is used for predicting the direct risk of radioactive pollution and the secondary risk caused by emergency evacuation in nuclear accidents, revealing the risk evolution rule, quantifying the risk diffusion scale, determining key influence factors and providing theoretical basis for formulating an emergency strategy.

title_en: High and cold side slope disaster body segmentation method integrating optics and SAR images
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alpine side slope disaster body segmentation method integrating optical and SAR images, which comprises the following steps of 1, performing snow coverage normalization processing on visible light green light wave bands and short wave infrared wave bands based on optical images, generating an ice and snow mask by using a maximum expected algorithm and a Gaussian mixture model, 2, preprocessing the optical images and the SAR images, 3, constructing an alpine side slope disaster body segmentation model based on a transform network, 4, training the segmentation model by combining Dice loss and cross entropy loss, freezing parameters of an image encoder in the training process, and 5, inputting the alpine side slope remote sensing images into the trained segmentation model, and outputting segmentation results of the side slope disaster body by the segmentation model. The method solves the problems of large ice and snow interference and poor multi-source data cooperativity in the division of the high and cold side slope disaster, and improves the division precision and engineering applicability.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;CCCC THIRD HIGHWAY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Pipe network safety accident emergency rescue evaluation method and system
