abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipe network safety accident emergency rescue evaluation method and system, and relates to the technical field of accident emergency rescue evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a correlation database; the method comprises the steps of performing independent and interactive evaluation analysis on multidimensional data to obtain an emergency rescue capability evaluation result, performing scene expansion to obtain an expanded basic emergency exercise scene set, performing emergency response exercise to obtain an emergency response exercise data set, performing hardware capability evaluation and software capability evaluation, and summarizing the emergency rescue capability evaluation result and the emergency rescue response evaluation result to obtain a security accident emergency rescue evaluation result of a target evaluation enterprise. The invention solves the technical problems of single evaluation dimension and insufficient accuracy caused by the lack of systematicness in the evaluation of the emergency rescue capability of the pipe network safety accidents in the prior art, achieves the systematic evaluation of the emergency rescue capability of the pipe network safety accidents of the target evaluation enterprise, and improves the technical effects of comprehensiveness and accuracy of the evaluation.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster prediction model training method based on hybrid optimization neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster prediction model training, and discloses a mountain torrent disaster prediction model training method based on a hybrid optimization neural network, which is used for collecting key data related to mountain torrent disasters, such as rainfall intensity, water level height, soil humidity and water flow speed, in real time through a multi-source sensor network, and carrying out data annotation based on historical disaster events, carrying out normalization processing on the acquired data by adopting a sliding window and cluster analysis, and constructing a deep neural network architecture, wherein the deep neural network architecture comprises a multi-scale feature extraction and time sequence attention enhancement module and a mixed optimization training strategy. According to the method, the model prediction precision and the real-time performance are effectively improved through innovative weight initialization and double-stage optimization training, and the model can be continuously optimized under changing environmental conditions through online incremental model updating, so that disaster early warning signals are generated in real time, and powerful support is provided for mountain torrent disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Microseismic monitoring three-component sensor device and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic monitoring three-component sensor device which comprises a hole bottom contact device, a three-component sensor main body and a rotary rod. The invention also provides a using method of the microseismic monitoring three-component sensor device. Compared with the prior art, the microearthquake monitoring three-component sensor device can be stably and accurately installed in a drilling hole in any direction required by design, meanwhile, in the process of placing the microearthquake monitoring three-component sensor device into the drilling hole and grouting, the three-component sensor main body cannot rotate, accurate measurement of the directions of three components of the microearthquake monitoring three-component sensor device X, Y, Z can be realized, and a foundation is provided for accurate analysis of follow-up microearthquake data and quantitative early warning of disasters.

title_en: Disaster risk assessment system with InSAR and geological model linked
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological monitoring, and particularly discloses an InSAR and geological model linkage disaster risk assessment system which comprises a data input and management module, an integrated InSAR data processing module, a model coupling and inversion analysis core module, a risk assessment and prediction module, a result visualization and output module and a risk assessment result visualization and standardization output module, wherein the data input and management module is used for automatically acquiring and standardizing multisource geological data and providing basic data for I nSAR processing, the integrated InSAR data processing module is used for automating and batching SAR data and providing observation basis for geological model calibration, the model coupling and inversion analysis core module is used for carrying out depth linkage on InSAR observation deformation and a geological model, generating a high-confidence geological model through inversion optimization model parameters and providing core support for risk assessment, and the risk assessment and prediction module is used for achieving disaster stability assessment, short-term or long-term prediction and extreme scene simulation and outputting risk level and early warning information.
assignees: SHAANXI HAIXIN MINING ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Landslide risk early warning method, device and equipment based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a landslide risk early warning method, device and equipment based on multi-source data fusion, relates to the technical field of natural disaster monitoring, and aims to solve the problem of low precision and timeliness of landslide risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of collecting multisource monitoring data of a target area in real time and constructing a multisource parameter set, wherein the multisource parameter set comprises rainfall characteristic data, soil hydrogeological parameters and slope morphological parameters, conducting space-time discretization water migration simulation based on the multisource parameter set to generate space-time distribution data reflecting dynamic changes of a slope water field, calculating a slope stability index sequence according to the space-time distribution data to construct a prediction model reflecting risk evolution trend, setting a dynamic grading early warning threshold value based on an output result of the prediction model, and triggering multi-grade early warning information when a risk grade reaches a preset condition.
assignees: SHANXI ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCT GROUP TESTING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Equipment placement rationality assessment method and system based on rasterization algorithm and Holt-windows algorithm
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a device placement rationality assessment method and a device placement rationality assessment system based on a rasterization algorithm and a Holt-windows algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises a data acquisition module, a rasterization processing module, a region classification module and a mixed prediction model training module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring region data, stream data, equipment data and weather data, the rasterization processing module is used for dividing a target region into a plurality of grids and generating grid codes for each grid, the grid codes comprise region codes, reserved codes and code serial numbers, the region classification module is used for classifying the grids according to stream data, and the mixed prediction model training module is used for combining a Holt-windows algorithm and a support vector machine algorithm, training to obtain a prediction model and obtaining an equipment quantity predicted value. The application can improve equipment deployment scientificity, operation and maintenance efficiency and emergency response capability, and improve equipment configuration efficiency.

title_en: Gas-containing coal seam punching-slitting integrated test device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control and extraction utilization, and discloses a gas-containing coal seam punching-lancing integrated test device and a method, wherein the device comprises a simulated loading system, a real triaxial loading pressure cabin, a coal rock test piece is placed in the simulated loading system, the real triaxial loading pressure cabin is used for applying stress to the coal rock test piece, and a gas injection and extraction pipeline is connected to the real triaxial loading pressure cabin; the integrated execution system comprises a sliding base and a drilling part, wherein the drilling part is arranged on the sliding base through a limiting frame and used for punching, punching and lancing a coal rock test piece, and the intelligent measurement and control system is used for controlling the drilling part to drill. The invention integrates the functions of mechanical punching, high-pressure water jet punching, directional lancing and the like, realizes the simulation and verification of enhanced extraction through integrated design, and is a key technical platform for developing a novel gas extraction process and verifying the performance of related high-end equipment.

title_en: Urban drainage waterlogging prevention simulation regulation and control and water city adaptation method based on traditional wisdom
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional intelligent integrated urban drainage simulation and water city adaptation method, which belongs to the technical field of urban drainage waterlogging prevention, and the invention improves the coping capacity of cities to storm and flood disasters through digital technology such as three-dimensional dynamic simulation and digital twin, and realizes the harmonious adaptation of urban hydrologic environment and urban construction; the method comprises the key steps of sample database construction, ancient city drainage water conservancy calculation mode development, digital simulation, three-dimensional deduction system platform construction, system verification, optimization and the like; the technology also relates to the technology for evaluating the value of the heritage of the water-controlling and water-draining type, the stagnancy-accumulation-drainage text path construction of complex underlying surface and composite functional infrastructure, and the development of a digital base-based water-city history backtracking, city storm water-logging simulation and joint regulation and control decision support platform; the invention improves the coping capability of the city to storm and flood disasters through a digital technology, and realizes the harmonious adaptation of the urban hydrologic environment and urban construction.
assignees: JIANGSU YANGTZE RIVER DELTA SMART WATER RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;XINJIANG WESTERN UNITED DIGITAL IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;ZHEJIANG EAST UNITED WATER ENV CO LTD;ZHEJIANG WEIPU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;NANJING WEIPU WATER ENG CO LTD;NANJING WEIGAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prediction method for prestress loss of steel cable in whole fire disaster process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method of prestress loss of steel ropes in the whole fire process, which belongs to the technical field of bridge engineering, and establishes a finite element heat transfer analysis model of the steel ropes and a finite element thermal coupling analysis model of the corresponding steel ropes based on ABAQUS finite element software, and loading a heat transfer analysis result of the steel cable into a thermodynamic coupling analysis model as a prestress field, and simulating to obtain the prestress loss evolution condition of the steel cable in the whole fire process. Compared with the traditional fire test method, the method not only greatly reduces the research cost, but also remarkably improves the analysis efficiency, and the prediction method provided by the invention can be directly applied to engineering practice, provides scientific basis for stress state evaluation of a steel cable structure after a fire disaster, has important reference value for guiding formulation of a post-disaster repair scheme, and is beneficial to improving fire safety performance of the engineering structure.

title_en: Water pollution inspection regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a water pollution inspection regulation and control method and a system, which relate to the technical field of water pollution inspection regulation and control, and the method and the system realize the global three-dimensional accurate perception by integrating multi-source data such as hyperspectrum, unmanned ship, internet of things and the like to construct a uniform water quality distribution diagram with high space-time resolution; the method combines real-time water flow data, dynamically simulates a pollutant diffusion path and generates pollution source probability distribution, so that pollution tracing is improved from static presumption to dynamic tracing, positioning accuracy and efficiency are remarkably improved, meanwhile, the prediction and early warning capability of future change trend of key water quality parameters is enhanced, time is strived for early intervention, a scientific and self-adaptive change optimizing and regulating strategy is generated based on a water pollution knowledge graph and a multi-objective optimizing algorithm, a closed-loop efficient automatic execution system is finally formed, and the overall efficiency of water pollution emergency response and normal regulation is greatly improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL CHRISTIAN TECH SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Full-period full-space-time early warning and control method for heterogeneous overburden type strong mine earthquake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period full-space-time early warning and preventing method for a heterogeneous overlying strata type strong mineral earthquake, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a working face mining numerical model before mining, analyzing main control factors of mining earthquake risks under macro-micro heterogeneous conditions to determine main control disaster causing strata of the mineral earthquake risks, then adopting an automatic inversion method of fracture parameters of the mineral earthquake sources to process the mining earthquake risks to form micro-earthquake induced fracture imaging, realizing position prediction of a strong mineral earthquake disaster source in the main control disaster causing strata of the mineral earthquake risks after the fracture imaging processing, simultaneously generating training data according to acquired data, obtaining a probability prediction model of rock burst risk after training the model, and using the probability prediction model for predicting the rock burst risk of the main control disaster causing strata of the mineral earthquake, combining the two predictions to realize full-time air prediction of the rock burst risk of the main control disaster causing strata of the mineral earthquake risks, and finally carrying out protection and management on the main control disaster causing of the mineral earthquake risks based on prediction results to effectively improve the coping capacity of the mineral earthquake disaster and the rock burst disaster of the mineral strata.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;UNIV NORTH CHINA SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;NORTH CHINA INST SCIENCE & TECH;UNIV XINJIANG

title_en: Landslide real-time prediction method and early warning method based on multi-mode information fusion
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of computer application technology and geological disaster prediction and early warning, and particularly discloses a landslide real-time prediction method and an early warning method based on multi-mode information fusion, wherein the prediction method comprises the steps of constructing a landslide event text data set; the method comprises the steps of training a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF model after space-time element labeling, constructing a structured historical landslide knowledge map, utilizing a landslide boundary training data set to train a U-Net++ image segmentation model to identify a landslide space boundary, taking time and space information as space-time anchor points, combining a recognition result of the U-Net++ image segmentation model, identifying landslide occurrence range and time on a remote sensing cloud platform, combining the landslide occurrence range and time to extract multidimensional dynamic environment factors, constructing a time sequence feature sample set, training a landslide susceptibility prediction model, and realizing dynamic prediction of landslide risk. The method has the advantages of considering timeliness and space accuracy, and effectively improving the prediction accuracy and response capability of landslide disasters.
assignees: JIANGSU GEOLOGICAL INFORMATION MUSEUM;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Design method and system of water rescue training base
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a design method and a system of a water rescue training base. The method comprises the steps of determining disaster scenes of a water rescue training base for simulating flood disasters, determining the number of ponds and first parameter information of each pond according to first information of the breach, second information of the barrier lake and third information of the overflow, determining second parameter information of a water supply and drainage system according to the first parameter information and the number of the ponds, determining third parameter information of intelligent control equipment according to the second parameter information, and finally designing the water rescue training base according to the first information, the second information, the third information, the number of ponds, the first parameter information, the second parameter information and the third parameter information, so that a pond system comprising various disaster scenes is established, the composite flood disaster environment can be effectively simulated, and the reality and the systemicity of rescue training are improved.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Real-time flood control scheduling method for water engineering group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time flood control scheduling method for a water engineering group, which comprises the steps of constructing a component system of engineering entities, disaster bearing targets and legal knowledge, acquiring a real-time water rain project, fusing five-dimensional indexes and combining with an aging correction factor, calculating a composite risk index, dynamically identifying an effective water engineering group based on the real-time water rain project and the component system and combining with a marginal benefit ratio, implementing a low, medium and high-level layered activation strategy for the effective water engineering group according to a threshold value of the composite risk index, executing multi-scene simulation optimization for the activated project by adopting a dual-mode workflow combining an agent model and a high-precision physical model, and outputting a final flood control scheduling scheme. The invention realizes accurate perception of risk, dynamic optimization of engineering and fine configuration of scheduling strategies.

title_en: Emergency vehicle priority and queuing optimization cooperative control method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent traffic, and discloses a cooperative control method for priority and queuing optimization of emergency vehicles, which solves the difficult problem of cooperative emergency priority at a peak saturation intersection and social vehicle dredging. The method comprises the steps of constructing a road network model containing a center and four peripheral intersections, collecting multi-source traffic data, preprocessing a post-construction data set, training an LSTM-converter double-branch model to predict queuing and emergency tracks, constructing an intelligent body based on PPO, combining segment rewarding training, and deploying output signal decision. The invention ensures low delay of emergency, optimizes the queuing of social vehicles, improves the efficiency of a peak intersection, is suitable for a high saturation scene, effectively relieves the congestion of the social vehicles while ensuring the preferential passage of rescue vehicles, and remarkably improves the overall operation efficiency and emergency response capability of the intersection under a complex traffic environment.

title_en: Tunnel deformation early warning method and system based on digital twin and data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a tunnel deformation early warning method and system based on digital twinning and data monitoring, which belong to the technical field of computer data simulation, and comprise the steps of firstly acquiring physical stratum dynamic monitoring data, real-time construction disturbance data and initial digital twinning model configuration parameters of a tunnel construction area, then carrying out virtual-real dynamic coupling and feedback iterative processing on the physical stratum dynamic monitoring data, generating a preliminary virtual-real coupling digital twinning model, and then carrying out iterative optimization on the preliminary virtual-real coupling digital twinning model based on the real-time construction disturbance data to obtain a final virtual-real coupling digital twinning model, carrying out stratum deformation linkage effect deduction according to the preliminary virtual-real coupling digital twinning model, generating a stratum deformation linkage path set, carrying out risk linkage mode identification on the stratum deformation linkage path set, determining a tunnel stratum large deformation risk linkage mode, finally generating construction early warning information comprising a risk linkage diffusion area, a risk linkage evolution period and an emergency response priority according to the construction early warning information, and transmitting the construction early warning information to a tunnel construction management system, and effectively guaranteeing tunnel construction safety.

title_en: Mountain land vibration response simulation device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain earthquake response simulation device, which relates to the technical field of geological dynamics of rock mass engineering, and comprises an earthquake power loading unit, a vibration table and a vibration table, wherein the earthquake power loading unit is provided with two six-degree-of-freedom vibrating tables, and each model box is provided with a mountain model; the freeze thawing circulation loading unit realizes program temperature control in the box through a compressor-condenser-capillary tube-heat conducting tube system, an acceleration sensor, a temperature sensor and a fiber bragg grating are embedded in the model, the fault movement loading unit is sequentially and flexibly connected with the first to fourth fault moving plates to simulate fault displacement, the structural stress loading unit pushes the sub-plates to laterally press a mountain model in the model box through a loading rod, and the monitoring unit fuses sensor data and high-speed camera images and analyzes the catastrophe process in real time through a computer. The invention integrates structural stress, fault movement, freeze thawing cycle and earthquake power quadruple composite loading for the first time, accurately uncovers the catastrophe dynamics mechanism of the mountain, and is suitable for the prevention and control research of geological disasters of major engineering.

title_en: Deformation early warning method and system for slope support structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of slope support, and discloses a deformation early warning method and a deformation early warning system for a slope support structure, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring support structure data such as slope surface displacement, deep displacement, rock mass stress, rainfall, support structure stress and the like in real time by using a multi-source sensing system; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional geological model, inputting support structure data into the three-dimensional geological model for simulation, constructing a slope support deformation prediction early warning model according to the simulation result of the three-dimensional geological model, inputting support structure data acquired in real time into the slope deformation prediction early warning model for prediction, carrying out deformation early warning classification according to the prediction result by the slope deformation prediction early warning model, obtaining a slope support structure strategy according to the deformation early warning classification result, and carrying out visual processing on the slope support structure strategy. The invention improves the accuracy and comprehensiveness of slope monitoring, enhances the timeliness and accuracy of disaster early warning, and provides powerful support for safety management and intelligent decision of slope engineering.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Risk evaluation method based on deep learning after occurrence of high-energy microseism event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-energy microseism event risk evaluation method based on deep learning, and constructing a multidimensional feature data set by fusing the signal space-time attribute and the geological feature, and providing comprehensive information for model training. The Bi-LSTM is adopted to capture the time sequence characteristics of the microseismic signals, and the accurate assessment of the risk of the microseismic events is realized by combining geological structure information. The training set and the testing set are reasonably divided, and the RMSE performance index is adopted for evaluation, so that the model is ensured to have good generalization capability and prediction precision. The method optimizes the model structure and parameter setting, improves the training efficiency and stability, and is suitable for complex coal mine production environments. Finally, the method can effectively early warn rock burst disasters, reduce casualties and equipment damage risks, optimize mine exploitation plans and safety management, and has important practical value and application prospect.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;BEIJING ANKE XINGYE TECH CO LTD;YUNDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall landslide hazard evaluation sampling optimization method based on distribution area expansion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall landslide risk evaluation sampling optimization method based on distribution area expansion, which belongs to the field of risk evaluation of geological disasters, and comprises the steps of S1, expanding a sampling area to a rainfall gradient area when a regression coefficient of a rainfall factor in a logistic regression model is smaller than 0, S2, collecting samples in the expanded sampling area, dividing the samples into landslide samples and non-landslide samples according to whether landslide occurs, S3, respectively extracting influence factors related to the occurrence of the landslide from the landslide samples and the non-landslide samples according to a rainfall landslide formation mechanism, including a topography factor, a geological factor, a landform factor and a rainfall factor, S4, inputting the extracted influence factors into a logistic regression model for training, calculating the regression coefficient of each influence factor, calibrating the relation between rainfall and the landslide, and entering S5 when the regression coefficient of the rainfall factor is positive, returning to S1, otherwise, inputting new samples into the logistic regression model after training, and outputting a prediction result.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Test assembly for high-efficiency heat-insulating wall body for assembly building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of wall testing, and discloses a testing assembly of a high-efficiency heat-insulation wall for an assembly building, which comprises a tester, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly connected inside the tester, a first motor is fixedly connected to the right side of the fixing plate, rotating rods are respectively and rotatably connected to the inner wall of one side of the tester and the left side of the fixing plate, the right end of one rotating rod is fixedly connected to the driving end of the first motor, the ends of the two rotating rods close to each other are respectively and fixedly connected with a disc, the ends of the two discs close to each other are fixedly connected with a linkage rod, two rotating rings are rotatably connected to the outer part of the linkage rod, and a displacement rod is fixedly connected to the outer part of each rotating ring. According to the utility model, the shaking test can simulate earthquake emergency, the earthquake resistance of the wall body is accurately checked, the safety of the building when encountering disasters is ensured, the upper limit of the bearing of the wall body can be defined by the pressure test, and the stable structure of the building under the long-term bearing is ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUANAN DINGSHENG CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster blasting cleaning and charging structure for tunnel mouth
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of tunnel mouth blasting cleaning construction, in particular to a post-disaster blasting cleaning charging structure for tunnel mouths. The detonating cord of the shaped charge structure is arranged in the middle of the energy collecting tube, explosive is filled in the energy collecting tube, the energy collecting tube comprises energy collecting petals and buckles, a plurality of energy collecting petals surround to form a tubular structure, the end parts of the adjacent energy collecting petals are connected through the buckles, and energy collecting grooves are formed in the energy collecting petals. The energy-gathering pipe is formed by the energy-gathering valve and the buckle, so that the rapid explosive loading and the explosive-guiding pipe installation are facilitated, the length can be cut on site according to the depth of the blast hole, the energy-gathering pipe can adapt to adverse environmental conditions of field disaster relief, the operation is simple, the energy-gathering pipe can be processed on a construction site, the requirements on the processing environment are low, the explosive loading of the blast hole can be realized while the explosive loading of the blast hole is realized, and the applicability is strong. Different numbers of energy gathering petals can be selected to surround energy gathering pipes with different sizes in the construction process, and the method can be well suitable for corresponding drilling holes of current construction equipment.

title_en: Urban power distribution network toughness assessment method and system for flood disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster scene-oriented urban power distribution network toughness assessment method and a flood disaster scene-oriented urban power distribution network toughness assessment system, which belong to the technical field of power distribution network toughness assessment and comprise the steps of acquiring rainfall data, land utilization data, elevation data and the like and inputting the rainfall data, land utilization data, elevation data and the like into a flood simulation module; the system comprises a waterlogging simulation module, a disaster-receiving judgment module, a load reduction optimization module, a power distribution system load reduction optimization module and a system toughness evaluation module, wherein the waterlogging simulation module simulates rainfall runoff and confluence to generate ponding distribution, the disaster-receiving judgment module combines power distribution equipment and a line disaster-receiving fault model to acquire fault probability of the power distribution equipment and the line to generate a system disaster-receiving scene under a flood disaster, the load reduction optimization module constructs a power distribution system load reduction optimization model to aim at minimizing total load reduction amount of the power distribution system, and the system toughness evaluation module measures overall toughness of the power distribution system under the flood disaster scene. The method carries out quantitative evaluation on the overall toughness level based on the system load reduction, and identifies the weak links of the system by combining the node load importance and the ponding condition, thereby providing reference for the differential reinforcement and operation and maintenance strategy and guiding the subsequent waterlogging prevention planning and operation and maintenance management.

title_en: Dynamic simulation method for buried gas pipe network disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster simulation of buried gas pipe networks, in particular to a dynamic simulation method of a buried gas pipe network disaster. The method comprises the steps of constructing a spatial topology database of the urban buried gas pipe network and a three-dimensional visual model thereof, determining earthquake motion time course data suffered by each pipeline in the buried gas pipe network, integrating the earthquake motion time course data into the spatial topology database of the urban buried gas pipe network, acquiring section combined stress evolution data of each pipeline in the whole earthquake process, judging and giving out earthquake damage levels of the pipelines at all times in the whole earthquake process, and constructing a three-dimensional dynamic visual model of earthquake disasters of the urban buried gas pipe network under inconsistent excitation to give out the damage evolution process of each pipeline in the earthquake. The earthquake disaster simulation method can realize earthquake disaster simulation of the urban underground gas pipe network under inconsistent excitation, the earthquake disaster simulation result is more in line with the actual situation, and the destructive evolution process of each pipeline in the earthquake can be given.
assignees: INST ENG MECH CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital twin-based geological disaster monitoring and early warning system and method, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model building module, an early warning module and a warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data, a dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm is utilized for preprocessing the data, the model building module is used for building a deep learning model by using a deep learning algorithm and using a counter propagation algorithm for model training, the model weight and the deviation are continuously adjusted through iterative optimization, the quality of an output result is continuously improved, the output of a convolutional layer of a convolutional neural network is transmitted into the deep learning model for feature extraction again to finish testing, the digital twin-based model is obtained, the early warning module is used for inputting real-time monitoring data into the digital twin-based model to obtain a prediction result, and when the prediction result reaches an early warning grade, early warning information is generated, an early warning signal is triggered and is sent to relevant personnel for confirmation and release. According to the invention, the dynamic-static self-adaptive fusion algorithm and the deep learning classification algorithm are fused, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of analysis and processing of various geological disaster data can be further improved.

title_en: House safety protection analysis method and system based on big data evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of AI intelligence, in particular to a house safety protection analysis method and system based on big data evaluation, which realizes accurate prevention and control of high-altitude falling object risks through multidimensional data integration and dynamic analysis, combines deep learning to quantify building aging degree, couples wind power disaster dynamic correction risks, avoids subjective errors, the falling track and the kinetic energy are predicted through CFD and mechanical simulation, the falling point hazard is pre-warned in a grading manner, the protection resources are intelligently distributed based on the personnel density and the risk level, the high-risk targets are preferentially processed, a closed loop is formed from data acquisition to automatic protection, timeliness is improved, labor cost is reduced, and the scheme is used for remarkably improving the prevention and control precision and efficiency through scientific quantification, dynamic coupling and automatic decision.

title_en: Multi-agent exploration and coverage control method based on state-based potential playing and near-end policy optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent exploration and coverage control method based on state-based potential game and near-end policy optimization, and belongs to the technical field of automatic control. Aiming at the problems that the task coordination efficiency of multiple intelligent agents is low and the strategy is difficult to converge in an unknown or dynamic environment, the method models the exploration and coverage task as a generalized state base potential game, defines a global potential function and an individual utility function, and constructs a state space, an observation space, an action space, a state transfer function and a rewarding function. Under the framework of centralized training and distributed execution, a near-end strategy optimization algorithm based on potential game increment constraint is designed, and a reward shaping mechanism and an epsilon-annealing posterior constraint mechanism are introduced to guide efficient updating and stable convergence of strategies. Through two-dimensional discrete grid simulation scene training, the system can achieve remarkable improvement of exploration efficiency and coverage effect under limited communication and local perception conditions. The method can be widely applied to emergency disaster relief, environment monitoring and unmanned cluster tasks.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative multi-time scale simulation urban blackout emergency recovery system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban power system emergency management, in particular to a multi-energy collaborative multi-time scale simulation urban blackout emergency recovery system, which comprises a multi-energy flow modeling module, a multi-time scale simulation module, a comprehensive evaluation module and an emergency scheduling decision module. The multi-energy flow modeling module accurately models units of an electricity, heat, gas and the like multi-energy system and a distributed power supply, load, energy storage and the like, the multi-time scale simulation module divides the scale according to the minute scale, the hour scale and the day scale to simulate fault evolution and recovery processes, the comprehensive evaluation module constructs an index system containing dimensions of safety, reliability, energy conservation, high efficiency and the like, and the emergency scheduling decision module generates a recovery strategy of the collaborative municipal facilities based on simulation and evaluation results. The method can effectively shorten the power failure recovery time, reduce economic loss, and is suitable for preventing and emergency disposal of urban blackout disasters.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Real-time fluid simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time fluid simulation method and a real-time fluid simulation system, which belong to the technical field of computer graphics and disaster science. The technology provides a systematic solution for real-time monitoring, dynamic deduction and intelligent decision-making of disasters such as flood, landslide and the like, and can be expanded to the fields of climate change simulation, urban toughness evaluation and the like in the future.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Karst geological disaster multisource fusion prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a karst geological disaster multisource fusion prediction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is used for preprocessing resistivity, wave velocity amplitude reduction and linear dissolution rate by acquiring the resistivity, the wave velocity amplitude reduction and the linear dissolution rate of a historical karst geological sample to obtain training characteristic data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a transducer model based on training characteristic data, training to obtain a target model, preprocessing real-time geophysical prospecting data of a target area, inputting the real-time geophysical prospecting data into the target model, outputting karst development risk level, realizing karst risk accurate prediction, improving karst disaster detection accuracy, reducing the missing report rate of high-risk karst, remarkably solving the problem of high-risk missing report caused by data singleness, space relevance deficiency and sample imbalance in the prior art, improving the accuracy of karst disaster prediction, avoiding construction risk, improving the recognition capability of hidden karst, and improving the speed and efficiency of karst geological disaster multisource fusion prediction.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY MAJOR BRIDGE RECONNAISSANCE & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent test device and method for lining structure under coupling of long-term load and extreme load
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of structural mechanical property tests, in particular to an intelligent test device and method for a lining structure under coupling of long-term load and extreme load, wherein the test device comprises an arched lining structure test piece; the device comprises a lining, a soil-stone groove, a lining back cavity water seepage corrosion system, a surrounding rock load system, an impact test system, an earthquake test system and an intelligent regulation and control system, wherein the lining back cavity water seepage corrosion system is used for simulating corrosion caused by a cavity between the lining outer surface and soil and stones due to water seepage, a jack applies load to an elastic cushion layer through a loading plate, so that uniform surrounding rock load is applied to soil Dan Jiezhi in the soil-stone groove, the impact test system is used for simulating the damage effect of out-of-control impact of a vehicle on a lining structure, the earthquake test system is used for simulating earthquake disturbance, and the intelligent regulation and control system can intelligently regulate and control a corrosive liquid supply device and the jack according to data obtained through monitoring of a concentration sensor and a pressure sensor. The invention can simulate the destructive influence of high surrounding rock stress, water-rich surrounding rock environment corrosion, earthquake disasters and external impact damage superposition conditions on the lining structure.

title_en: Geological disaster detection method and system for multi-data fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster detection, and discloses a geological disaster detection method and a geological disaster detection system for unmanned aerial vehicle multi-data fusion, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle initial image is acquired through an unmanned aerial vehicle, a three-dimensional image marking element is obtained, and an environment training set large model is established; the method comprises the steps of inputting three-dimensional image marking elements into an environment training set large model to obtain a first detection result of a geological disaster, predicting the geological disaster according to the environment training set large model to obtain an unmanned aerial vehicle geological disaster prediction image, converting the unmanned aerial vehicle geological disaster prediction image into an unmanned aerial vehicle index feature image, analyzing big data to obtain a second detection result of the geological disaster, and comparing and verifying the first detection result and the second detection result to obtain the unmanned aerial vehicle image geological disaster detection result.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway dangerous situation early warning telephone notification system, which relates to the technical field of highway dangerous situation early warning and comprises a dangerous situation information acquisition module, a feature extraction unit, an early warning information generation module, a telephone notification distribution module, an intelligent voice interaction module and a feedback verification module. The system collects multi-source data through the mobile terminal of the patrol personnel, identifies the dangerous situation type and severity degree through a deep learning algorithm, predicts the influence range by combining a traffic flow simulation model, plans an optimal notification path based on an improved Dijkstra algorithm, and initiates intelligent voice early warning to the affected vehicle through an operator network. The system supports multilingual interaction, multimodal feedback verification and blockchain storage, realizes quick discovery, accurate evaluation and efficient notification of highway dangerous situations, and remarkably improves the safety and emergency response capability of highway traffic.
assignees: GUANGXI TRANSP SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for realizing unmanned tunneling working face
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for realizing an unmanned tunneling working face, which comprise the steps of dividing equipment groups working on the tunneling working face into N rigid body groups which independently operate, installing an inertial navigation and a laser target on main rigid body equipment of each rigid body group, designing and installing a measuring and positioning robot, wherein the measuring and positioning robot comprises an inertial navigation and N automatic target-seeking total stations, establishing a digital twin platform of the unmanned tunneling working face, realizing pose calculation, fault diagnosis, disaster early warning, cooperative control, scene update, equipment start-stop and maintenance decision-making, and providing remote intervention and man-machine interaction interfaces to realize unmanned operation of the tunneling working face. The invention can realize the accurate measurement, positioning and attitude control of all equipment such as digging, drilling, anchoring, supporting, transporting, passing and the like in the tunneling working face, realize the unmanned operation of zero accident and zero fault of the tunneling working face, and provide technical support for avoiding personal injury and death and greatly improving the tunneling efficiency.

title_en: Method and device for judging and identifying mud-carrying sand water burst of mine with multi-source geological exploitation data fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for judging and identifying the water burst of mud-carrying sand in a mine by fusion of multi-source geological exploitation data, belongs to the technical field of mine exploitation early warning, and solves the problems that the formation of the water burst disaster of the mud-carrying sand is closely related to the pore structure of weakly cemented sandstone, dynamic development of mining cracks and water pressure mutation of an aquifer, but the accurate judgment and identification are difficult to realize in the traditional technology. According to the method for judging and identifying the water burst of the mine carried silt and sand, disclosed by the application, the physical mechanism of multi-source data is combined, the prediction model can be used for more comprehensively capturing the precursor characteristics of the water burst of the mine carried silt and sand through data training, early warning is carried out in real time, a risk source is positioned, accurate basis is provided for taking measures such as drainage, reinforcement and support in advance, and the occurrence probability of the water burst accident of the mine carried silt and sand is effectively reduced.

title_en: Reinforced concrete slab damage evaluation method based on M-V curve
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster protection engineering, and discloses a reinforced concrete slab damage evaluation method based on an M-V curve, which comprises the steps of determining relevant design parameters of the reinforced concrete slab; defining limit values of four damage degrees of mild damage, moderate damage, severe damage and complete failure, calculating limit values M  0  and V  0  of four damage degrees in an M-V curve, drawing the M-V curve, scanning slope characteristics, simulating a slope falling stone movement track, obtaining a plurality of groups of falling stone quality and impact speed combinations, defining damage grades of reinforced concrete plates according to actual falling stone quality and impact speed, counting the number of falling stones in different damage areas, and calculating damage probability. The damage evaluation method provided by the invention can be used for rapidly quantifying and predicting the impact damage degree of the composite cushion layer concrete slab, can be used for evaluating the impact resistance of the reinforced concrete slab with any cross section covered by any composite cushion layer with any thickness, and provides a reference for the prevention and control of the reinforced concrete slab against falling rocks.

title_en: Physical simulation experiment device and experiment method for pipeline geological disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a physical simulation experiment device and an experiment method for pipeline geological disasters, relates to the technical field of pipeline geological disaster physical simulation experiments, and aims to simulate damage to pipelines when the pipeline geological disasters occur. The physical simulation experiment device for the pipeline geological disaster comprises a box body, a pipeline and a first driving device, wherein the box body encloses a synthetic soil filling space, the pipeline is fixedly connected to the box body, at least part of the pipeline is positioned in the soil filling space, and the first driving device acts on soil in the soil filling space so that the soil acts on the pipeline to simulate a scene of the geological disaster.
assignees: NAT PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;STATE PETROLEUM PIPELINE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE BRANCH

title_en: Geological disaster demonstration simulation sand cabinet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster demonstration simulation sand cabinet which comprises a cabinet body with a cavity, wherein the top surface and the front side surface of the cabinet body are open, a bottom plastic plate is arranged on a bottom plate of the cabinet body, the inner side end of the bottom plastic plate of the cabinet body is lifted in a linkage way by a lifting device fixedly connected with the cabinet body, the front side surface of the cabinet body is provided with a front plastic plate, the top surface of the cabinet body is provided with a top plastic plate, the cabinet body is used for internally containing space sand, and the bottom plastic plate, the front plastic plate and the top plastic plate are molded in the cabinet body to form a mountain slope and then simulate geological change. The characteristics of good space sand plasticity, poor self-stability and strong viscosity are utilized, the demonstration of the slope deformation movement process is very ideal, and the observation time is sufficient from the process stages of deformation, crack occurrence, sliding occurrence and the like. The multifunctional intelligent geological disaster sensor has the advantages of simple and portable manufacture, low cost and easy arrangement, can mobilize the occurrence process and phenomenon of geological disasters experienced by eyes, hands and the like, intuitively senses the geological disasters for people, particularly teenagers, and has strong practicability and wide applicability.
assignees: NANJING GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY EAST CHINA GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH I

title_en: Automatic drop hammer testing machine safety device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of component disaster simulation, and particularly relates to a safety protection device of an automatic drop hammer testing machine. The safety protection device aims to improve the safety of the dynamic drop hammer testing machine. Comprises a drop hammer enclosing structure and a supporting structure. The drop hammer enclosure structure comprises a first enclosure steel ring, a second enclosure steel ring, a third enclosure steel ring and a fixed steel ring. The first enclosure steel ring is connected with the second enclosure steel ring through a vertical square steel pipe, and the third enclosure steel ring is connected with the fixed steel ring through an inclined square steel pipe. The supporting structure comprises inclined struts, an anchoring screw, a vertical round steel pipe, a fixed cushion block and a gasket. The fixed cushion block and the gasket are provided with through holes, the anchor screw rod sequentially penetrates through the gasket and the through holes of the fixed cushion block to be anchored to an anchor hole reserved on the ground, the gasket is fixed at a preset position through threads of the anchor screw rod, the vertical round steel pipe is sleeved on the anchor screw rod, and the bottom of the vertical round steel pipe abuts against the gasket. The diagonal bracing is respectively connected with the first and second enclosure steel rings and the vertical round steel pipe.
assignees: SHANXI LIHUO EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Model for simulating subway station fire spreading
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-extinguishing rescue models. The utility model provides a model that simulation subway station conflagration spread, includes the station room, the both sides in station room are provided with respectively and import and export two, the station room is provided with tunnel, stair, elevator, security check gate, two-way platform. The fire disaster simulation device starts one of the simulation nodes to spread around the fire disaster in the process of generating the fire disaster, the nearby simulation nodes receive the smoke signals and can start the fire disaster, so that the fire disaster can be quickly formed to spread after the simulation nodes in the spreading area can receive the signals according to the trend of the smoke, the fire disaster can be restored more truly, the fire fighter can be helped to learn and exercise, better rescue routes can be simulated when one of the positions is in fire disaster according to internal scenes, and fire disaster parameters can be regulated under the condition of simulating the fire disaster, so that the learning effect is achieved.
assignees: CHANGSHA WEICHUANG TECH SIMULATION MODEL CO LTD

title_en: KGAT-based flood disaster observation resource recommendation method, system, medium and processor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a KGAT-based flood disaster observation resource recommendation method, a KGAT-based flood disaster observation resource recommendation system, a KGAT-based flood disaster observation medium and a KGAT-based flood disaster observation processor. The method comprises the steps of collecting data, constructing a knowledge graph, checking the graph, constructing and training KGAT algorithm models, obtaining recommended observation tasks and allocating observation resources. The method comprises the steps of firstly determining a data source to collect data, constructing a map, checking by using OntoQA index system, splitting a map data training model, selecting basic tasks from the map, generating recommended tasks by combining new disaster characteristic factors through the model, and finally allocating resources. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the knowledge graph is built by fusing the multi-source data to mine potential links, by means of KGAT algorithm accurate recommendation, the efficiency of flood disaster observation resource allocation is effectively improved, powerful support is provided for disaster monitoring and handling, and the method is suitable for the field of flood disaster monitoring.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Earth-rock dam break flow prediction method based on physical consistency and attention mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning, and discloses a method for predicting the breaking flow of an earth-rock dam based on physical consistency and attention mechanism, which comprises the steps of collecting the breaking peak flow data of the earth-rock dam and preprocessing the data; the method comprises the steps of generating a countermeasure network model through physical information attention to obtain an enhancement data set, constructing a support vector machine model according to the enhancement data set, dividing the enhancement data set into a training data set and a test data set, optimizing the support vector machine model through an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm of a multi-strategy regulation mechanism to obtain an optimized MPSO-SVM model, inputting the test data set into the optimized MPSO-SVM model, and predicting peak flow of a dam break event. The scheme of the invention improves the precision, stability and practicability of the earth-rock dam break flow prediction model, and provides technical support for earth-rock dam safety precaution and disaster management.

title_en: Geological disaster change detection method and system based on improved twin U-Net and center surrounding double-flow network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a geological disaster change detection method and system based on an improved twin U-Net and center surrounding double-flow network. The method comprises the steps of constructing an improved twin U-Net network as a feature extraction backbone, integrating a deformable convolution module in an encoder to adaptively adjust a receptive field, embedding a central surrounding double-flow network in a decoding path, extracting detail features through the central flow path, acquiring global context around the flow path, designing a feature fusion module to realize double-path feature depth fusion, calibrating feature response by adopting a gating attention unit, introducing a contrast feature learning mechanism to strengthen feature space clustering characteristics, implementing multi-mode degradation enhancement training to improve model robustness, and minimizing an objective function comprising difference perception loss and feature contrast loss through end-to-end joint optimization. The invention can accurately identify the geologic hazard change areas such as landslide, debris flow, ground subsidence and the like, and has the advantages of high detection precision and strong anti-interference capability.

title_en: SEM-FEM-SPH simulation method and system for three-dimensional seismic source-landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses an SEM-FEM-SPH simulation method and system for a three-dimensional seismic source-landslide. The method combines a spectral element method, a finite element method and a smooth particle fluid dynamics method, and realizes the whole process simulation of starting, sliding and stacking of the landslide triggered by the vibration from the rupture of a seismic source to the space earthquake. The method comprises the steps of simulating a regional seismic wave field by a spectral element method to generate a local side slope space non-uniform seismic dynamic field, providing a local side slope FEM-SPH three-dimensional bridge domain coupling model considering complex terrain effects, and realizing seamless connection of a regional scale SEM model and the local FEM-SPH coupling model based on an internal input method. The method overcomes the limitation of uniform input assumption and preset slip planes in the traditional earthquake landslide simulation, can realize direct numerical simulation from the rupture of a seismic source to the whole process of earthquake-triggered landslide inoculation, migration and accumulation under the condition of a complex site of a mountain canyon, and provides key technical support for earthquake landslide disaster risk assessment.

title_en: Intelligent building-oriented emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of building emergency evacuation path planning, and particularly provides an emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method for an intelligent building and related equipment thereof, which mainly comprise the steps of acquiring building real-time monitoring data, preprocessing the real-time monitoring data, and obtaining building security situation data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out threat diffusion simulation and region division on building security situation data to obtain security region division data, carrying out personnel cluster analysis and social force model prediction on the basis of the building security situation data to obtain personnel evacuation behavior prediction data and evacuation bottleneck early warning data. The application realizes the accurate adaptation of evacuation paths, on-site threat spreading trend and real-time change of personnel flow, avoids personnel from sinking into an unwarranted threat area, reduces local congestion, and effectively shortens the whole evacuation time.

title_en: Typhoon disaster refuge population estimation method for service refuge site planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster refuge population estimation method for service refuge site planning, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data related to a typhoon disaster caused emergency transfer setting population, processing the multi-source data to obtain a plurality of prediction factors, assigning the prediction factors to grid units, arranging emergency transfer setting population records to uniform administrative division space scales, constructing an emergency transfer setting population simulation model, training and testing, simulating grid-level transfer population estimation results corresponding to artificial typhoon event, aggregating the grid-level transfer population estimation results to planning units to obtain transfer population simulation data of each planning unit under typhoon scene with a preset year range, calculating the relationship between the reproduction period and the transfer population of each planning unit to obtain a reproduction period transfer population curve of each planning unit, and setting refuge requirements of the planning units according to actual conditions. The present invention may generate emergency transfer placement population estimates covering different probability levels.

title_en: Subway station emergency evacuation route planning method based on brain-like pulse neural network
abstract_en: A subway station emergency evacuation route planning method based on a brain-like pulse neural network belongs to the crossing field of traffic transportation and intelligent computation. The invention discloses a multi-objective path planning method for a large passenger flow scene of a subway station, which is based on a Brain-like pulse neural network (Brain-INSPIRED SPIKING NeuralNetwork, BSNN) to construct an evacuation environment map structure and combines crowd heterogeneity modeling and personalized path objective functions. The method integrates neural network modeling based on a topological graph, objective function design of multi-type passenger demands, a pulse-driven rapid optimizing mechanism and a congestion prediction algorithm based on membrane potential change, and realizes self-adaptive path adjustment and congestion avoidance flow guidance among different demand personnel. The system dynamically generates personalized paths through a time sequence control and path state iterative updating mechanism, and remarkably improves evacuation efficiency and road utilization rate in a high-density people stream environment. Simulation experiments show that the method can shorten the whole evacuation time by about 48% in the subway peak period scene, improves the path utilization rate by 27%, has good response speed and self-adjusting capability, and is suitable for an intelligent decision support system of multi-scene emergency evacuation tasks.

title_en: Mining roadway surrounding rock mechanical parameter real-time acquisition method based on fracture fractal evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine geotechnical engineering and intelligent monitoring, and discloses a real-time acquisition method for surrounding rock mechanical parameters of a mining roadway based on fracture fractal evolution, which comprises the steps of acquiring initial mechanical parameters of a rock sample; the method comprises the steps of establishing a quantitative relation model, determining a relevant fitting coefficient, establishing a theoretical model of dynamic change of surrounding rock mechanical parameters along with crack evolution based on rock sample initial mechanical parameters and the relevant fitting coefficient, acquiring a drilling monitoring image, and outputting the surrounding rock mechanical parameters based on the theoretical model of dynamic change of the surrounding rock mechanical parameters along with crack evolution. The problems that the traditional method for acquiring the mechanical parameters has long period and high cost, can not dynamically reflect the mining effect and the like are solved, and real-time and reliable mechanical parameter support is provided for roadway stability analysis, support design and disaster early warning.
assignees: GUIZHOU COAL MINE DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;GUIZHOU MINE SAFETY SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster intelligent internet of things multivariable time sequence anomaly detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster intelligent internet of things multivariable time sequence anomaly detection method and device, and relates to the technical field of internet of things anomaly detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an initial anomaly detection model; S2, acquiring a training data set, S3, performing optimization training on an initial anomaly detection model by using the training data set to obtain an optimized anomaly detection model, S4, acquiring real-time monitoring data, S5, analyzing the real-time monitoring data by using the optimized anomaly detection model to obtain a detection result, wherein the dynamic gating expansion convolution network DGDC solves the problems of rigid structure and parameter explosion of the traditional TCN, namely, a receptive field is expanded exponentially along with the number of layers by dynamic expansion rate scheduling, the characteristics of second-level burst and cycle can be captured simultaneously, the parameter is reduced by 60% -70% by depth separable convolution, and the efficiency and the precision of local feature extraction are superior to those of the traditional convolution type module by combining the suppression effect of a gating linear unit GLU on noise features.

title_en: Highway structure monitoring method, device, equipment, medium and product based on general artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway structure monitoring method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product based on general artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of highway structure monitoring and comprise the following steps: firstly, a first model is obtained by pre-training on a source domain corresponding to a sudden disaster scene based on disaster data in the scene, then, a second model is obtained by fine tuning the first model on a target domain corresponding to a highway structure based on historical monitoring data, and finally, the second model is deployed into a project monitoring system of the highway structure, and the structural state of the highway structure is monitored in real time. By the method, the first model of the sudden disaster scene is obtained through pre-training and the second model is obtained through fine adjustment of the first model based on transfer learning, so that the sudden disaster scene of the highway structures such as the bridge-tunnel slope can be effectively identified through the second model under the condition of few samples in the sudden disaster scene early warning of the highway structures such as the bridge-tunnel slope, and accurate and reliable early warning support is provided.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGJIAO HUALIAN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Urban lifeline system toughness evolution simulation method and device based on performance state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for simulating the toughness evolution of an urban lifeline system based on a performance state, and relates to the technical field of toughness cities, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving system related data, inputting the system related data into a pre-established system performance state conversion dynamics model, dividing the initial performance of the system into a system surviving performance, a system failure performance and a system recovery performance based on a disaster disturbance impact rate, a system resisting rate and a system performance recovery rate, and outputting to obtain a performance change curve based on the division rules of the system surviving performance, the system failure performance and the system recovery performance; the performance change curve is input into a preset toughness quantification formula, the toughness value under a single disaster scene is output, and the change trend of the toughness value under each disaster scene along with time is determined through iteration of multiple disaster scenes, so that the simulation of the toughness evolution trend is realized.

title_en: Avalanche susceptibility assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an avalanche susceptibility evaluation method, an avalanche susceptibility evaluation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method and the device are applied to the electronic equipment, and particularly a plurality of evaluation factors which are relevant to avalanche in a target area are selected; and carrying out model training according to the multiple evaluation factors and the avalanche point data information to obtain an optimal avalanche model, carrying out identification processing on a target area according to the optimal avalanche model, and manufacturing an avalanche susceptibility distribution diagram according to an identification result. According to the technical scheme, the avalanche susceptibility distribution map can be manufactured for the target area, a scientific data base is provided for the avalanche susceptibility evaluation of the specific area, avalanche risk management is facilitated, and an important basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: XINJIANG TRAFFIC SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Marine investigation system with shipborne mud closed circulation and emergency leakage prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shipborne mud closed circulation and emergency leakage-proof marine investigation system, and belongs to the technical field of marine engineering geological investigation. In the prior art, mud is easy to leak in a stormy wave environment, and quick emergency response is lacking, so that the operation safety and the environmental protection are affected. The system adopts a closed mud circulation system, comprises a mud tank with a sealing cover at the top, a mud pump, a high-pressure conduit and a double-layer filtering device, realizes physical isolation and cyclic utilization of mud, integrates an emergency leakage-proof system, monitors the mud state in real time through a liquid level sensor and a pressure sensor, automatically closes the mud pump and an emergency cut-off valve to block mud circulation when abnormal liquid level drop or sudden pressure drop is detected, simultaneously starts an emergency recovery pump to convey the mud to a standby storage cabin, and is also provided with a stormy wave grade identification module and false triggering prevention logic to distinguish real leakage from environmental interference and avoid false alarm. The method is used for ocean drilling operation, and improves operation continuity, safety and environmental protection.

title_en: Fire disaster simulation equipment for power cable short circuit
abstract_en: The invention provides fire simulation equipment for short circuit of a power cable. The cable simulation system comprises an experiment cable and a pipe gallery simulation piece, wherein the pipe gallery simulation piece is used for simulating a limited long and narrow environment where a real short-circuit cable is located, the supporting system is arranged in the pipe gallery simulation piece, the experiment cable is horizontally placed on the supporting system, the heating system is electrically connected with the experiment cable and used for introducing overload current into the experiment cable, the ignition system can generate metal molten drops, the ignition system is provided with a liquid outlet used for discharging the metal molten drops, and the liquid outlet of the ignition system is located above the experiment cable and enables the metal molten drops to fall on the experiment cable so as to achieve short-circuit current thermal effect of the experiment cable and ignition simulation reproduction of the metal molten drops. The technical scheme of the invention solves the problem of poor accuracy of the simulation effect of the fire simulation equipment for the short circuit of the power cable in the prior art.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Highway high slope avalanche artificial treatment effect evaluation method and device based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a highway high slope avalanche artificial treatment effect evaluation method and device based on multi-source data, which comprises the steps of determining a slope area to be interfered from a highway slope area, simulating an avalanche motion path of the slope area to be interfered to obtain an avalanche flow center line and an avalanche accumulation arrival line, selecting candidate intervention points along the avalanche flow center line under the condition that the avalanche accumulation arrival line has a spatial intersection with a highway facility buffer area, screening points in a preset range of the candidate intervention points according to the topography curvature of the slope area to be interfered in a slope descending direction to obtain optimal intervention points, filtering the optimal intervention points to obtain target intervention points, implementing snow accumulation artificial intervention prognosis on the slope area to be interfered based on the target intervention points, and evaluating snow accumulation artificial intervention on the slope area to be interfered according to the difference between first snow accumulation data and second snow accumulation data of the slope area to be interfered. In the embodiment of the application, the scientificity and reliability of avalanche disaster prevention and control are improved.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based method, equipment and medium for predicting flood and drought disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, equipment and medium for predicting a flood and drought disaster based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical multi-source monitoring data, utilizing a data fusion technology to integrate the data of the historical multi-source monitoring data to construct a corresponding space-time data model, utilizing a self-encoder algorithm to conduct feature learning on the data in the space-time data model to extract potential key features, screening the potential key features based on preset flood disaster prediction types to obtain feature sets to be applied, wherein the flood disaster prediction types comprise flood prediction and drought prediction, determining a neural network frame to be trained based on the flood disaster prediction types, training the neural network frame based on the feature sets to be applied to obtain a corresponding disaster prediction model, receiving real-time multi-source monitoring data, and utilizing the disaster prediction model to conduct prediction of the corresponding flood disaster based on the real-time multi-source monitoring data.
