Aiming at the technical problems that the traditional fire hose in a construction temporary building area is low in deployment efficiency, poor in reliability, incapable of being dynamically adjusted in real time and slow in fault response, the invention plans an optimal laying path according to environment information, an intelligent coupler is connected with a water hose of a built-in sensing unit to form an annular closed loop, the loop is self-organized after power-on, a system state estimated value is generated through multi-mode sensing data fusion, an MPC controller is adopted to solve a hydraulic optimization problem in a rolling manner, the pressure of the pipe network is dynamically balanced, fault diagnosis and evaluation are carried out based on digital twin-body parallel simulation, and when a fault is completely invalid, a failure section is automatically isolated, degraded into a dendritic network, communication is maintained and is guided to a nearest water intake. The invention can remarkably improve the reliability, the self-adaptability and the emergency response capability of the fire-fighting water supply in the temporary building area.

title_en: Flood drought risk assessment and deduction system and method based on slope multi-level regulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood drought disaster risk assessment and deduction system and method based on slope multi-level regulation, and belongs to the technical field of flood drought disaster risk prevention and control and watershed hydrologic regulation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of a target river basin, carrying out water source refined analysis through water quantity transfer coefficient (K1 and K2) coupling based on the hierarchical synergy of slope surface 'upper interception, middle stagnation and lower dissipation', calculating controllable, effective and renewable water source quantity, carrying out flood and drought disaster chain risk collaborative assessment by combining energy adjustment capability differences of all the hierarchical layers, outputting hierarchical risk and 0-10 level aggregate risk indexes, driving a scene deduction model with a physical mechanism and data driving coupling, completing historical extreme event compound dish and future climate scene prediction, and outputting a regulation measure layout optimization scheme through hierarchical slope regulation threshold comparison after rendering by a visual engine. The system adopts a micro-service architecture, and comprises data management, multi-level regulation collaborative analysis, water source analysis, risk evaluation, scene deduction, decision support and threshold comparison modules. The invention realizes high resolution accurate positioning, low error simulation and efficiency improvement of flood drought disaster risks, forms a decision closed loop from risk identification to optimization regulation, and can provide direct and quantitative technical support for flood drought prevention and control engineering practice in the river basin.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;WENG BAISHA

title_en: Intelligent detection device and method for sulfate corrosion concrete in various environments
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent detection device for sulfate corrosion concrete in various environments, which comprises an environment simulation cabin, a layered object carrying platform, an anti-blocking circulation system, a nondestructive detection matrix and an emergency response system, wherein the environment simulation cabin comprises a 400L stainless steel sealed pressure-bearing cabin body, a V-shaped bilge inclination angle 45+/-1 DEG, an air pressure control unit and a temperature and humidity control unit, the layered object carrying platform comprises a lifting objective table, the anti-blocking circulation system comprises a V-shaped connecting pipe, a circulation pipeline and a four-channel peristaltic pump, the nondestructive detection matrix comprises an annular ultrasonic array, an electromagnetic vortex sensor and a near infrared hyperspectral system, and the emergency response system comprises a four-channel peristaltic pump and a high-pressure pump for pressure relief. The invention provides an intelligent detection device and method for sulfate corrosion concrete in various environments, which are integrated with maintenance, multi-environment coupling sulfate corrosion nondestructive detection and durability evaluation of a concrete structure.
assignees: NANTONG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Supercritical CO2Digital twin regulation and control method and system for environmental safety of power generation sealed factory building
abstract_en: The invention provides a supercritical CO  2  power generation sealed factory building environment safety digital twin regulation and control method and system, belongs to the technical field of supercritical carbon dioxide circulating power generation, and can at least partially solve the problems that the existing traditional technology is difficult to capture dynamic evolution rules of complex working media, temperatures and flow fields, and the simulation precision is insufficient and the emergency response is lagged.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD;XIAN THERMAL POWER RES INST CO

title_en: Cascading failure risk assessment method considering aging of power transmission line in typhoon weather
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety protection of power systems, and discloses a cascading failure risk assessment method considering power transmission line aging in typhoon weather, wherein a typhoon wind speed simulation model is established according to weather bureau forecast information, and a tower wind load is calculated by combining power grid geographic information; and (3) establishing a transmission tower fault probability calculation model considering ageing and a cascading fault probability calculation model of line ageing, and obtaining a risk value of power grid regulation by combining the cascading fault probability in consideration of comprehensive cost. And calculating the comprehensive risk of causing the cascading failure under the typhoon disaster by combining the risk value regulated by the power grid based on the risk value of the collapse of the tower, forecasting typhoons at each moment as a stage, and accumulating the risk values of all stages until the typhoons are finished to obtain the risk value of the final state of the system. According to the method, the tower aging and the transmission line aging influence are considered, and the tower collapse risk and the power grid regulation risk are considered, so that the risk assessment of typhoons on the power grid is more practical.

title_en: Mountain river flood diversion tunnel line based on hydrodynamic model and scale optimization design method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain-region river flood diversion tunnel line and a scale optimization design method based on a hydrodynamic model, which are characterized in that MIKE software is adopted to construct a one-dimensional hydrodynamic mathematical model of a study area, and design flood water surface lines of different frequencies of urban areas are calculated according to the one-dimensional hydrodynamic mathematical model of the river area, boundary conditions and rated comprehensive rough rate. According to the actual conditions of cities, aiming at the main problems of urban flood causes and the current flood control system, engineering measures such as flood control reservoir construction, getting off beach river returning, river channel improvement, embankment elevation, flood diversion channel construction and the like are drawn up, and flood diversion tunnel route and planning optimization research are developed based on a hydrodynamic model. The numerical simulation of flood disasters is completed by utilizing the modern information technology, and a complete disaster prevention and control system is established for realizing the scientific, efficient and automatic targets of disaster prevention and relief decisions, so that the urban flood prevention capability is comprehensively improved, and the life and property safety of people is ensured.

title_en: Construction method of mountain torrent risk prediction large model fused with physical constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a mountain torrent risk prediction large model with fusion of physical constraints, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an AI large model framework based on a transducer-Unet, 2, constructing a hydrologic hydrodynamic model, 3, coupling the AI large model with the hydrologic hydrodynamic model, and 4, constructing training sample large data and carrying out mountain torrent risk prediction large model training. The invention fully plays the advantages of strong learning and adaptation capability and strong interpretability of the physical model by fusing physical constraint in the AI large model, remarkably improves the generalization capability of the model, and is suitable for risk prediction of different types of mountain torrents. Compared with the traditional rainfall prediction driving hydrologic model and the mountain torrent disaster early warning index, the mountain torrent risk prediction large model constructed by the invention integrates physical constraint, greatly improves the calculation efficiency of the risk prediction, improves the accuracy and the analysis speed of mountain torrent risk prediction, and provides reliable technical support for mountain torrent disaster prevention and control.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Mountain transportation rail laying method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rail traffic engineering and mountain transportation equipment installation, and relates to a construction method of a mountain transportation rail laying method. The method solves the technical problems that the traditional mountain track laying has large disturbance to mountain bodies, the supporting structure is uncoordinated with geological environment and geological disasters are easy to induce. The method comprises the steps of constructing a four-dimensional high-fidelity geological information model along a track through multi-source sensor fusion, adopting finite element analysis and topology optimization design to unevenly distribute self-adaptive anchor point arrays based on the model, utilizing an automatic drilling and grouting integrated platform to conduct minimally invasive drilling and two-stage pressure grouting to form a distributed miniature pile anchoring unit, assembling gridding connecting tie bars and an adjustable track supporting base to form an integral bearing structure, and integrating a long-term health monitoring system.
assignees: GUIZHOU COLLEGE OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Large-scale landslide susceptibility evaluation method and system based on physical constraint U-Net model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale landslide susceptibility evaluation method and system based on a physical constraint U-Net model, which relate to the technical field of landslide disasters and comprise the steps of obtaining evaluation factors of a target area and constructing a historical data set about the evaluation factors and the landslide area; the method comprises the steps of constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation model by combining a U-Net model and physical constraints, training the landslide susceptibility evaluation model through the historical data set, inputting real-time evaluation factors of a target area into the trained landslide susceptibility evaluation model for prediction, and obtaining a large-scale landslide susceptibility evaluation result of the target area. The method solves the problems that the evaluation result obtained by the existing landslide susceptibility evaluation method has lower spatial resolution than the original input data, and the evaluation result effect is poor when the evaluation area is larger.

title_en: Regional debris flow residual slope surface object source identification model determination method, identification method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a determination method, an identification method and a related device for a regional debris flow residual slope surface material source identification model, and relates to the field of geological disaster identification and risk assessment; dividing a debris flow ditch in a target area based on a high-precision digital elevation model to obtain a plurality of slope units, calculating the terrain factors, average vegetation coverage and effective migration space of each slope unit, determining a target area through a residual slope area slope surface object source target area discrimination model and the parameters, selecting a typical debris flow ditch in the target area, screening residual slope area and non-residual slope area slope surface object sources by combining the acquired data, constructing a sample library based on comprehensive remote sensing data and screening results, and training a machine learning model to obtain a regional identification model. The application can realize the automatic identification of the residual slope surface material source.

title_en: Ground subsidence simulation device and method for pipeline leakage and rainfall coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster simulation and engineering protection, and discloses a ground subsidence simulation device and method with pipeline leakage and rainfall coupling effect, wherein the ground subsidence simulation device comprises a model box, a water circulation system, an underground water level control device and a rainfall simulation device; the model box is respectively connected with a water circulation system, an underground water level control device and a rainfall simulation device, a leakage pipeline and a porous filter plate are arranged in the model box, the water circulation system comprises a water source tank, a water pump, a water supply pipeline, a sewage collecting tank and a water return pipeline, the water source tank is connected with the model box through the water pump and the water supply pipeline, the model box is connected with the water source tank through the sewage collecting tank and the water return pipeline, and an overflow pipe is arranged on the underground water level control device and extends into the model box. The influence of the multi-field coupling effects such as pipeline leakage, ground water level, rainfall and the like on ground collapse in the actual geological disaster occurrence process can be more accurately simulated.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV;ZHEJIANG ACADEMY OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ZHEJIANG SAFETY PRODUCTION TECH DETECTION EXAMINAT

title_en: Coal and rock dynamic disaster prediction method based on multi-element image information
abstract_en: A coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction method based on multi-element image information belongs to the field of coal-mine coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction, and combines sound information and visual information to extract surrounding rock characteristics in a coal mine well and predict occurrence of dynamic disasters by combining a machine learning model. The method mainly comprises the steps of collecting sound signals from a site key observation area, manufacturing an artificial speckle field, extracting spectrogram information, extracting digital speckle information, establishing a data set, a coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction model based on multi-element image information, training the model, extracting spectrogram and speckle image of the site key observation area, calculating entropy, mean value, variance sum, angular second moment and deformation field non-uniform statistical index S  W  values of the spectrogram, and sending the obtained values to the established coal-rock dynamic disaster prediction model based on multi-element image information for prediction.

title_en: Fire early warning method and system for electrical equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster early warning method and system for electrical equipment, and belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical parameter data related to fire disaster early warning of the electrical equipment, carrying out data processing on the historical parameter data, constructing SageFormer a model, training the SageFormer model according to the historical parameter data after data processing, collecting real-time parameter data related to the fire disaster early warning of the electrical equipment, inputting the real-time parameter data into the SageFormer model after training, predicting the probability of fire disaster occurrence of the electrical equipment in the next time period, judging whether the probability of fire disaster occurrence of the electrical equipment in the next time period is larger than the preset probability, and if yes, outputting fire disaster warning information of the electrical equipment. According to the invention, through SageFormer model, potential risks can be captured before the fire occurs, so that early warning of the fire is realized.
assignees: BEIJING URBAN CONSTRUCTION INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shallow landslide hazard prediction model construction method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a shallow landslide disaster prediction model construction method, device, equipment and medium, wherein sample data of a shallow landslide disaster are obtained; and training the isolated tree constructed by the isolated forest algorithm by adopting the training sample to obtain a disaster vulnerability prediction model. The method and the device can solve the problem of sample number dependence and improve the prediction precision of shallow landslide hazard prediction model construction under the condition of small sample number.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery network fault processing method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery network fault processing method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of fault processing, and accurately diagnoses network faults through a safety strategy rule base and a mapping result of an artificial neural network. The artificial neural network can provide mapping of disaster-tolerant network faults and recovery strategies, train simulation fault samples, optimize network fault diagnosis recovery strategies, and even if a network fails, the scheme can determine and execute the network fault recovery strategies passing verification according to network fault diagnosis results, so that the artificial neural network has good fault classification, identification, diagnosis and recovery capabilities, can timely cope with large-scale disaster-tolerant network faults, can improve reliability and safety of a network system, and provides real-time monitoring, prediction and fault recovery capabilities, thereby rapidly positioning fault links and fault nodes when faults occur in the aspect of network disaster tolerance, automatically completing fault diagnosis and fault recovery, and rapidly performing network fault recovery.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster relation extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural meteorological disaster relation extraction method, which belongs to the technical field of agricultural meteorological disaster relation extraction, and comprises the steps of firstly cleaning multi-source heterogeneous agricultural meteorological text data, marking entities and relations, completing structural pretreatment, then extracting deep semantic features of texts by using a BERT pre-training model through a parallel processing framework, constructing a syntactic structure diagram by combining dependency syntactic analysis, further carrying out dynamic pruning and feature learning on the syntactic structure by adopting a self-attention force diagram convolution network, introducing a residual error contraction network to carry out intelligent noise reduction treatment on the features, and finally carrying out high-precision relation classification by fusing semantics and syntactic features, thereby realizing automatic extraction of critical information such as disaster time, place, loss degree and the like. The method can efficiently and accurately identify the relationship among the entities in the text in the field of agricultural meteorological disasters, and remarkably improves the accuracy, robustness and automation level of the extraction of the agricultural meteorological disasters.

title_en: Power transmission line icing disaster early warning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of icing disaster early warning, and discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for early warning icing disasters of a power transmission line, wherein a weather prediction model is built based on a convolutional neural network, the weather prediction model after current weather data input training is obtained to output weather prediction data, extreme weather characteristics are extracted according to historical weather data, extreme weather comprehensive influence factors are extracted and built, the icing thickness of the power transmission line is calculated through a physical model, meanwhile, the ice coating form is identified to obtain the ice coating type and the local ice coating density, the result is input into a preset ice coating prediction model, ice coating prediction data are output, an ice coating prediction accuracy density function under each subinterval of the extreme weather integrated influence factor is established, accordingly, the corresponding ice coating prediction accuracy under the subinterval of the extreme weather integrated influence factor is obtained, and the ice coating prediction correction value under the subinterval of the corresponding integrated influence factor is obtained, so that the ice coating prediction data are corrected, and disaster assessment is carried out.

title_en: Slope potential slip plane identification method based on airborne LiDAR point cloud multi-scale fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope potential slip plane identification method based on airborne LiDAR point cloud multi-scale fusion, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting original point cloud data, preprocessing to obtain pure earth surface point cloud, constructing a multi-scale digital elevation model sequence, and extracting topographic features from the multi-scale digital elevation model sequence to obtain a multi-scale topographic feature map; and performing unsaturated seepage simulation on the geometric boundary of the microscale digital elevation model in the multiscale digital elevation model sequence in combination with a rainfall condition set based on a historical rainfall record to obtain a pore water pressure distribution cloud chart, merging the multiscale topographic feature chart to obtain a geometric slip sensitivity index, and coupling the pore water pressure distribution cloud chart and the geometric slip sensitivity index to generate a critical slip plane index chart. And a slope stability analysis report is visually output, so that high-precision and quantifiable risk assessment on potential sliding surfaces of the slope is realized.
assignees: NO 6 GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF JIANGSU GEOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Toughness index evaluation method and system for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness index evaluation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of firstly, taking account of disaster uncertainty caused by extreme disasters to establish a typical fault scene set of the electric comprehensive energy system, secondly, taking account of dynamic and static characteristics and coupling constraints of an electric and gas heterogeneous energy flow system to establish a numerical simulation model of the electric comprehensive energy system under fault conditions, simulating cascade faults and energy supply recovery processes of the system under the typical fault scene set, and finally, drawing a multi-stage toughness curve of the system based on simulation results to establish a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation index system of electric-gas dependency under a toughness view. The invention also discloses a toughness index evaluation system of the electric comprehensive energy system, which can realize full-dimensional quantitative analysis of the multi-energy dependence relationship under the fault working condition and effectively screen out weak links caused by multi-energy flow strong coupling.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: SAR-to-optical image generation method and device for fire monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire monitoring-oriented SAR-to-optical image generation method and device, and aims to solve the problems that SAR images are difficult to interpret and optical telefeeling is blocked in fire monitoring, and the existing generation method is unstable in training, high in calculation cost, discontinuous in structure and the like. The method comprises the steps of obtaining SAR images, preprocessing the SAR images to construct pseudo RGB images, extracting near infrared and short wave infrared bands of multispectral images, calculating NBR indexes to generate fire masks, constructing spectrum guiding loss functions, generating trunks by DDPM, embedding cross-domain translators, combining hierarchical structure guiding mechanisms, weighting and fusing global and local reconstruction results, and outputting optical style images. The invention can generate optical images with clear details, consistent spectrum and consistent structure under the shielding of smoke and cloud layers, balance the generation quality and efficiency, improve the accuracy of fire monitoring and post-disaster evaluation, and is suitable for multi-scene fire monitoring.

title_en: Methods for Validating Compliance in Disaster Recovery Exercises
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses are described for validating compliance in disaster recovery exercises (DREs). In conducting a DRE, a method may collect network data and may enrich the collected network data with application data. The method may simulate the unavailability of a cloud network node, collect network data in the new configuration, compare the two collected network data sets, and determine applications that rely on the simulated unavailable cloud network node. The method may indicate which application was resilient to the simulated unavailable network cloud node based on its determination. By enriching, the method may create a mapping to trace each traffic packet back to a specific application and verify whether the specific application's performance complies with the DRE. Unlike the current methods that lead to time-consuming manual analyses that are prone to false positives, the method may validate compliance in an automated way in a near-real-time fashion.

title_en: Geological ecological restoration evaluation method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological restoration evaluation, and provides a geological ecological restoration evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for preventing and treating geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of researching data acquisition, setting of geological disaster types, initial evaluation, data preprocessing, model construction and training, risk determination before restoration, information acquisition after restoration, geological disaster risk prediction and geological ecological restoration evaluation; according to the method, the model is trained by utilizing the remote sensing image, the sound wave data and the initial evaluation data, prediction of an evaluation result by the remote sensing image and the sound wave data is achieved, difficulty and time of risk evaluation are reduced, in addition, surface features and structural features are simultaneously extracted by combining the remote sensing with the sound wave, a prediction effect of the model is optimized, the sensing capability of surrounding environment is improved by a multi-mode adjacent sensing model, prediction precision of a single block is improved, and a repair effect evaluation mechanism is optimized by a repair effect evaluation rule.

title_en: Mining quick rock breaking emergency rescue drilling tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining rapid rock breaking emergency rescue drilling tool, which belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment and comprises a double-power unit, a transmission shaft, a drill rod, a composite drill bit and a rotary cutting part. The front end of the inner cavity of the composite drill bit is in a trapezoid array, the hard alloy impact hammer is embedded in the forefront end of the inner cavity of the composite drill bit, the impact hammer is driven to impact a rock stratum by the aid of the matching of the sliding block and the piston limiting groove, the reset structure achieves high-frequency circulation, and the drill rod is meshed with the composite drill bit through the outer tooth ring to drive the cutting teeth of the rotary cutting part to synchronously cut. The diamond layer is laser cladding on the surface of the impact hammer, and the cutting pick adopts a forward tilting PDC tooth tip and advances the end face of the drill bit by 5-8mm, so that impact-cutting cooperative rock breaking is realized. The transmission shaft is internally provided with an overload pressure relief channel, and the rotary cutting part is in a modularized clamping structure of the connecting block and the limiting groove, so that the cutting pick group can be quickly replaced for 3 minutes. The drilling speed of the drilling tool in granite reaches 1.2m/min, the maintenance efficiency is improved by 70%, the stuck drilling failure rate is reduced by 90%, and the gold aging requirement of 30 minutes of mine disaster rescue is met.

title_en: Green street runoff intelligent stagnating accumulation and peak staggering emission method based on real-time weather radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green street runoff intelligent stagnation and peak-staggering emission method based on real-time weather radar data, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent water affairs. The method aims to solve the problems of lag response and low regulation efficiency of the traditional green street facilities. The method comprises the steps of inputting predicted rainfall into a digital twin model matched with physical facilities to conduct runoff process simulation preview, integrating simulation results, local sensor data and downstream pipe network states by a multi-mode intelligent algorithm deployed on edge computing equipment, dynamically deciding to generate an optimal valve control instruction by adopting control strategies such as prospective pre-evacuation, maximum stagnation or self-adaptive peak-shifting emission, and finally continuously correcting the digital twin model through a closed loop feedback mechanism. The invention changes passive response into active pre-control, can obviously improve the regulation and storage efficiency of the existing green street facilities and the flood peak reduction capability of a downstream pipe network, and enhances the climate adaptability and toughness of the urban drainage system.

title_en: Geological disaster investigation sampling equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster investigation, in particular to geological disaster investigation sampling equipment, which comprises a lifting bracket, wherein a first installation table and a second installation table are respectively and slidably installed in the lifting bracket, the first installation table and the second installation table are fixedly connected, a jacking cylinder is fixedly installed on the first installation table, a turntable is rotatably installed at the bottom of the second installation table, a plurality of integrated storing and taking mechanisms are installed at the bottom of the turntable, a first motor for driving the turntable to rotate is fixedly installed at the top of the second installation table, and when the integrated storing and taking mechanism is jacked by the jacking cylinder, part of soil samples are obtained and automatically stored by the integrated storing and taking mechanisms penetrating into a target soil layer. According to the invention, a vertical penetration type sampling mode is adopted, the sampling pipe is directly penetrated into the target soil layer to obtain the sample, the purity of the obtained sample is improved by changing the sampling mode, and the problem that the purity of the obtained sample is reduced due to mixing of upper soil and lower soil caused by stirring of a spiral drill in the prior art is avoided.

title_en: Full-flash active area diagnosis method for lightning detection data missing area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-flash active area diagnosis method for a lightning detection data missing area, which comprises the steps of collecting lightning active data, carrying out space-time consistency matching, carrying out convection cloud area and lightning identification, constructing a lightning tag set in the convection cloud area according to a lightning identification result, carrying out feature calculation to obtain multidimensional infrared bright temperature features, carrying out feature screening to obtain multidimensional infrared bright temperature representative features, carrying out multi-model integrated training and optimization according to the lightning tag set and the corresponding multidimensional infrared bright temperature representative features, carrying out model evaluation to select a comprehensive optimal lightning diagnosis model, and inputting the multidimensional infrared channel bright temperature data to be diagnosed into the comprehensive optimal lightning diagnosis model to obtain a lightning diagnosis result. The lightning activity area kilometer level identification can be realized, the technical bottleneck of efficient monitoring of the lightning activity in the remote area is solved, and a realization means is provided for lightning monitoring and early warning in the remote area, so that lightning protection and disaster reduction work in the corresponding area is effectively supported.

title_en: VR panoramic flood disaster analysis method and system combining knowledge graph and visual large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VR panorama flood disaster analysis method and system combining a knowledge map and a visual large model, belongs to the technical field of intelligent disaster information analysis, and particularly relates to technologies such as virtual reality panorama images, knowledge maps and visual large models, and the like, which are suitable for automatic extraction, structural analysis and visual expression of disaster information in flood scenes, and solve the problems that the prior art lacks unified disaster information identification rules, influences accurate extraction and space mapping of disaster parameters and scene objects, and cannot realize automatic identification and dynamic labeling of VR panorama image flood disaster elements. The method comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge-graph-constrained vertical vision large model of a flood disaster scene, training, automatically identifying disaster information and labeling risks in a preprocessed VR panoramic image based on the trained vertical vision large model, and carrying out multidimensional visualization after labeling. The method is used for VR panorama flood disaster analysis.

title_en: Self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of task diversion disaster recovery previewing scheme design, in particular to a self-organizing task diversion disaster recovery previewing method and system. The method comprises the steps of setting a replay area, disaster recovery levels and corresponding temporary storage areas in a robot control system, responding to area alarms, automatically identifying related tasks, automatically determining task processing strategies based on preset rules according to task types and disaster recovery levels, including path diversion or reassignment to the temporary storage areas, executing diversion in a simulation environment, dynamically changing the number of tasks and AGVs to test system limits, and finally generating replay data for evaluating system performance. The corresponding system comprises functional modules for realizing the steps. The invention solves the problem that the prior art lacks automatic disaster recovery replay capability, can expose the system bottleneck in advance, and provides data support for optimizing the scheduling strategy and improving the system toughness.
assignees: REALSEE SUZHOU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire simulation test method for ship compartment entity of hydropower station ship lift
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station ship lift carriage entity fire simulation test method which comprises the steps of constructing a test platform with fireproof protection at a preset position of a ship lift carriage chamber, arranging a plurality of types of measuring devices, conducting a cold smoke pre-test through a controlled smoke source, verifying the effectiveness of the measuring devices, setting a plurality of groups of working conditions including different ship lift carriage elevations and ventilation states, arranging a fire source device, injecting environment-friendly fuel, igniting the fuel after regulating the ship lift carriage to the preset state, collecting data such as temperature, wind speed, smoke and toxic gas concentration in real time, comparing the test data with a numerical simulation result, determining fire spreading rules and influences on personnel evacuation, optimizing a prevention and control scheme, accurately reproducing a ship fire scene under the special working condition of a ship lift, quantifying fire characteristic parameters, providing scientific basis for the optimization of the prevention and control scheme, guaranteeing the safety of the ship lift and a large dam, and being standard in test flow and strong in universality and being popularized and applied to different large-scale vertical ship lifts.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire control design simulation evaluation system based on intelligent building engineering
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of computer aided design, and particularly discloses an intelligent fire control design simulation evaluation system based on intelligent building engineering. The system comprises a building information model analysis module, a fire risk quantification evaluation module, a multi-objective optimization decision module, a dynamic disaster evolution simulation module and an evacuation path real-time planning module, wherein the accuracy, the balance and the reliability of fire control design are realized by quantitatively analyzing building fire risks, multi-objective optimization equipment configuration, dynamic simulation disaster evolution and real-time planning of evacuation paths, and the overall efficiency and the compliance of the intelligent building fire control system are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI YITAI TECH INFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy previewing system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and intelligent scheduling of an electric power system, and provides a system, a method, equipment and a medium for previewing an extreme weather elastic scheduling strategy, wherein the system comprises a meteorological-GAN modeling module, a reinforcement learning training module and a digital twin test platform which are connected in sequence; the method comprises the steps of generating an extreme weather power grid fault sequence with space-time correlation characteristics by a meteorological-GAN modeling module, training a power failure recovery decision model by a reinforcement learning training module based on the generated fault sequence, performing pressure test and robustness verification of a disaster evolution path on the decision model by a digital twin test platform, forming a closed-loop optimization framework by three modules through a bidirectional data channel, and breaking through the difficult problems of data dependence bottleneck and robustness verification of a power grid scheduling strategy under extreme weather by a collaborative mechanism of high-fidelity disaster scene generation, self-adaptive decision training and extreme pressure test.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional lithium battery mine visualization system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical sensing layer, a data interaction layer and a data interaction layer, wherein the physical sensing layer is deployed on a lithium battery mine site and comprises a plurality of sensor networks for collecting geologic bodies, production equipment, environmental parameters, personnel positions and vehicle states, and the data interaction layer comprises a data integration platform and edge computing nodes and is used for cleaning, fusing, protocol conversion and edge side preliminary analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data uploaded by the physical sensing layer and uploading the multi-source heterogeneous data to a cloud. According to the invention, by integrating the slope monitoring sensor and the professional analysis model, real-time evaluation and advanced early warning of the slope stability and the safety of the tailing pond are realized, important accidents such as collapse, dam break and the like are effectively prevented, meanwhile, the migration paths of fluoride dust, radioactive substances and potential leakage pollutants in the atmosphere and water are dynamically simulated by utilizing the harmful element diffusion model, so that accurate decision support is provided for environmental risk emergency response, and the influence on the surrounding ecology is reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: JIANGXI LITHIUM BATTERY IND DIGITAL TRANSFER PROMOTION CENTER

title_en: Optimal dispatching method, system, equipment and medium for cascading failures in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cascading failure optimization scheduling method, system, equipment and medium under extreme weather, which belong to the technical field of disaster simulation and comprise the steps of calculating all line failure rates according to extreme weather data and power distribution network frame data, screening all lines to obtain a key line set, establishing an upper optimization model according to a first constraint condition, inputting the key line set into the upper optimization model to obtain an initial scheduling scheme, screening out a key line with the largest cut load in the initial scheduling scheme as a second constraint condition of the upper optimization model, inputting the second constraint condition into the upper optimization model to obtain a middle scheduling scheme, and adjusting the middle scheduling scheme to obtain a final scheduling scheme. The invention solves the problem that the prior art only aims at a single fault or static running state design strategy, realizes the design of a multi-angle and dynamic scheduling scheme, and meets the requirements of loss reduction and pre-prevention and control.

title_en: Distributed mountain torrent forecasting system based on short-term forecasting and hydrodynamic mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed type mountain torrent forecasting system based on a short-time forecasting and hydrodynamic mechanism, which relates to the technical field of mountain torrent forecasting and comprises a short-time forecasting access module, a distributed hydrodynamic force calculation module, a forecasting-mechanism coupler and a dynamic scheduling and early warning module, wherein each module realizes asynchronous data transmission and state synchronization through a distributed message middleware APACHE KAFKA, multi-source short-time rainfall forecasting data is received and processed through the short-time forecasting access module, a solid data basis is provided for subsequent mountain torrent forecasting, the distributed hydrodynamic force calculation module can simulate a flood evolution process more accurately, forecasting accuracy is improved, the forecasting-mechanism coupler provides more comprehensive risk information for a decision maker, and the dynamic scheduling and early warning module can dynamically schedule calculation tasks according to the situation of a risk field and trigger multi-stage early warning when necessary, so that the coping capacity and early warning efficiency of mountain torrent disasters are effectively improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Multi-physical-field coupling vibration table test system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-physical-field coupling vibration table test system and an operation method, and relates to the technical field of multi-physical-field earthquake simulation tests, wherein the system comprises a vibration table earthquake simulation system; the test system considers the multi-physical-field coupling working conditions of a temperature field, a water division field and a stress field, can simulate disaster working conditions such as earthquake, rainfall, train load, freeze thawing circulation and the like, can flexibly adjust the disaster development sequence according to test requirements, can realize sequential or simultaneous action of the disaster in the multi-physical-field, is reasonable in system arrangement, small in occupied area, has detachability, easy to carry, strong in practicability, can greatly reduce test difficulty and improve test efficiency, and has waterproof and heat-insulating equipment for ensuring long-term stable operation of various devices of the system.

title_en: Debris flow velocity calculation method based on large-particle starting critical condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of debris flow disaster prevention and control, in particular to a debris flow velocity calculation method based on a large particle starting critical condition, which comprises the steps of constructing a water tank experimental device, and placing large particle materials in the water tank experimental device; the method comprises the steps of applying a medium flowing function on a water tank experimental device to form a stable medium flow field in the water tank experimental device, detecting large-particle materials to obtain motion parameters and structure parameters of the large-particle materials, determining acting force characteristic parameters in the motion process of the large-particle materials according to the motion parameters of the large-particle materials, and determining the starting acting flow velocity of the large-particle materials according to large-particle starting critical conditions, the acting force characteristic parameters and the structure parameters. According to the invention, a water tank experimental device is set up to simulate the physical process of debris flow and the starting condition of large particles at the channel shrinkage position is judged by utilizing the debris flow motion empirical formula, so that the accuracy and reliability of suddenly amplifying and identifying the debris flow caused by the blockage of the large particles at the channel shrinkage position are improved.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Multi-objective dynamic optimization-based cascade junction ecological dispatching system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cascade junction ecological dispatching system based on multi-objective dynamic optimization, which comprises a data acquisition and transmission system, a dispatching decision support system, an analog simulation system, a cascade junction joint dispatching control system, an ecological monitoring and evaluation system and an emergency response system, wherein the data acquisition and transmission system is used for acquiring hydrologic, meteorological and ecological monitoring data in real time, the dispatching decision support system is used for generating a dispatching decision scheme, the analog simulation system is used for simulating a hydrologic process and evaluating ecological effects, the cascade junction joint dispatching control system is used for coordinating water flow connection and distributing flow, and the ecological monitoring and evaluation system is used for evaluating ecological dispatching effects. The invention also relates to a method for utilizing the cascade junction ecological dispatching system based on the multi-objective dynamic optimization. The invention realizes the cooperative optimization among multiple targets, effectively improves the overall operation benefit of the step junction, improves the ecological environment and increases the economic benefit and the ecological benefit.
assignees: HUBEI PROVINCIAL WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation method based on coupling of emotion infection and social force model
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of crowd simulation and emergency evacuation, and provides a crowd evacuation method based on coupling of emotion infection and social force models, which comprises the following steps of constructing an emotion infection model based on SEIRS frames, dividing individual emotion states into an easy state, an exposed state, an infected state and a recovered state, dynamically adjusting the infection rate and the recovery rate through a feedback function, establishing a social force model, embedding emotion values into target driving force and inter-individual repulsive force calculation, realizing real-time adjustment of emotion on exercise behaviors, and fusing Global path planning and an ant colony pheromone mechanism, and introducing a density perception cost function and an pheromone guiding force to realize dynamic blocking avoidance; and designing a bidirectional feedback mechanism, and triggering local path reconstruction when congestion is detected. The invention realizes the bidirectional coupling of emotion transmission and behavior decision, improves the authenticity and adaptability of evacuation simulation, and can provide scientific basis for emergency management and evacuation strategy optimization in public places.

title_en: Deep geothermal resource distributed enhanced mining test platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep geothermal resource distributed enhanced mining test platform and a method, and relates to the technical fields of mine safety engineering and disaster prevention and control. The test platform comprises an outer shell, an inner shell, a three-way pressurizing device, a reaction frame, a multifunctional injection well and a production well, wherein the three-way pressurizing device is arranged between the outer shell and the inner shell, a dry hot rock test piece is placed on the inner shell, the reaction frame is provided with a groove, the multifunctional injection well, the production well and a sensor hole, the test method is used for constructing an artificial heat storage by loading the test piece, heating in a partition mode and simulating a site environment through stress application, fracturing in a partition mode step by step, circularly collecting heat in a whole mode, a combined mode, a single mode and the like, and changing parameters for comparing and evaluating the exploitation efficiency. The invention can truly reproduce the whole process of deep geothermal exploitation, accurately optimize the fracturing and exploitation scheme and provide scientific test support for safe and efficient exploitation of the enhanced geothermal system.

title_en: Heat insulation box and test platform for simulating glacier disasters
abstract_en: The application discloses a heat insulation box and a test platform for simulating glacier disasters, wherein the test platform comprises a refrigerating system, a circulating cooling system and the heat insulation box, the refrigerating system is arranged on the heat insulation box, and the circulating cooling system is connected with the refrigerating system through a heat insulation conduit. The heat insulation box is internally provided with a slope module, the slope module comprises a heat insulation base, a heat insulation bottom plate and a heat conduction plate, the heat insulation base is arranged on the bottom plate of the heat insulation box to form a slope base, the heat insulation bottom plate is arranged on the heat insulation base to form a slope bottom plate, the heat conduction plate is arranged on the heat insulation bottom plate to form a slope panel, and the heat insulation bottom plate is provided with a plurality of refrigerating element placing holes. When the glacier disaster cantilever type centrifuge simulation test is carried out, the centrifuge applies increasing centrifugal acceleration load to the chute system, and the mixture of ice and soil is released from the material box into the heat insulation box and then slides along the inclined plane of the slope module, so that actual glacier disaster movement is simulated, and the development process of the glacier disaster is studied.

title_en: Intelligent wall collapse simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent wall collapse simulation system, which belongs to the technical field of natural disaster simulation and comprises a supporting device, a driving device and a wall body, wherein the wall body is fixed at the top of the supporting device, the driving device is arranged in the supporting device and can drive the wall body to move, the supporting device comprises a base, one side of the top of the base is provided with the wall body, the driving device comprises a vibrator, a push rod, a connecting rope and a winder, the vibrator is arranged at the bottom of the wall body, the push rod is connected with the wall body, the winder is arranged in the base, one end of the connecting rope is connected with the winder, and the other end of the connecting rope is arranged at the top of the wall body. According to the utility model, the driving device is provided with the connecting rope and the winder, wherein one end of the connecting rope is arranged on the winder, and the other end of the connecting rope is arranged on the wall body. The winder can control the length between connecting rope and the wall body, through the receive and release of control connecting rope, can realize the control of wall body inclination and the correction, can simulate different collapse scenes.
assignees: GUANGDONG NIKOLA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation experiment equipment for intelligent monitoring of disaster of road side slope in cold region
abstract_en: The utility model provides simulation experiment equipment for intelligent monitoring of the disaster of a highway side slope in a cold region, which is characterized in that a spray header is arranged to spray and simulate the effect of rainwater in a simulation box, a cone block is arranged in the spray header as the through hole of the spray header is larger, water flowing out of a water pipe is dispersed to the through holes around the cone block to disperse running water and simulate the characteristics of precipitation in the mountain region, the spray header is pushed to slide on a bracket by a pushing component to form local spraying, the position of the local spraying can be adjusted, different water yield areas are compared, a water outlet is arranged at the bottom of the simulation box and used for discharging accumulated water in the simulation box, and a refrigerator and a refrigerating pipeline are arranged to refrigerate the inside the simulation box so as to simulate temperature difference change. By adopting the technical scheme, the influence of precipitation and temperature difference change in the cold region on the rock stratum is effectively simulated, and the accuracy of simulation experiment data is effectively improved.

title_en: Judgment method based on three-dimensional particle flow modeling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of landslide, in particular to a method for predicting landslide movement. The method for predicting the movement of the landslide body by using the three-dimensional particle flow method comprises the following steps of 1) calibrating macro-micro parameters calculated by particle flow, 2) establishing a three-dimensional geological sliding bed model and realizing a space model interaction and display technology, and 3) simulating the particle flow of the landslide body, and carrying out inversion analysis on the disaster causing range of the landslide body and realizing achievement display. The novel interdisciplinary method is adopted, the real scene space technology is applied to landslide body disaster-causing range display, field information is acquired through unmanned aerial vehicle images, a landslide field real scene space model is generated by using an oblique photography technology, and a disaster field is restored more intuitively in a three-dimensional form. Meanwhile, through online editing of the real model and coupling and interaction of a numerical calculation result and the real space model, the landslide disaster-causing range prediction result is displayed digitally and three-dimensionally, and technical support for landslide disaster monitoring and prevention is provided accurately and intuitively.

title_en: Urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban underground space emergency drainage control method under flood disasters, which comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional real-time data through a multisource heterogeneous digital twin drainage intelligent management and control platform, inputting a 1D-2D dynamic bidirectional coupling model to simulate the dynamic coupling relation between pipe network water flow and regional ponding to obtain water flow pressure distribution and ponding diffusion trend data, starting a space-time characteristic driving drainage scheduling algorithm to extract space-time correlation characteristics and construct a decision variable set, combining emergency drainage control parameters to screen variables, inputting the screened variables into the model for feedback verification, adjusting algorithm parameters if the screened variables do not meet the requirements, and sending control instructions to execution equipment through the platform if the screened variables meet the requirements. The method can improve the prediction precision of the ponding and water flow state, improve the adaptability and the reliability of a scheduling scheme, accelerate the response speed of emergency drainage, comprehensively improve the coping capacity of underground space flooding, and ensure the operation safety of the underground space.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Measurement marking equipment for geological disaster investigation operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ground disaster measurement, in particular to measurement marking equipment for geological disaster investigation operation, which comprises an outer box, wherein a drilling mechanism is arranged on the right side of the outer box and comprises a drill rod, a base plate and a first hydraulic cylinder, a storage rack is further arranged in a movable cavity and can reciprocate back and forth, a plurality of detection holes distributed from top to bottom are further formed in an inclinometer pipe, different types of sensors can be movably connected in the detection holes to complete monitoring operation of different environmental parameters, a liquid storage cavity is further arranged in the outer box and positioned on the left side of a second hydraulic cylinder, a liquid pump is arranged in the liquid storage cavity, the bottom end of the liquid storage cavity is further connected with a grouting pipe through a liquid conveying pipe, one end of the liquid conveying pipe is connected with the liquid pump, and an electromagnetic flow control valve is further arranged on the grouting pipe. The invention improves the accuracy and the installation stability of the measurement marking operation of the inclinometer pipe, and simultaneously realizes the upgrading conversion from the traditional physical measurement marking to the intelligent-integrated-multisource fusion measurement environment information acquisition station of the geological disaster investigation operation.
assignees: GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION CENTER OF HENAN PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY

title_en: ERLTC high-resolution numerical simulation prediction method, medium and program product based on IDII and DMSI fusion driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster risk assessment and computer numerical simulation, and discloses a ERLTC high-resolution numerical simulation prediction method, medium and program product based on IDII and DMSI fusion driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data, constructing a typhoon center following dynamic reference system, defining a quaternary gust and dry invasion diagnostic domain under the reference system, and respectively calculating a dynamic quaternary gust index DMSI and a whole layer dry invasion index IDII; and introducing a constraint field into numerical mode integration, carrying out directional correction on the model precipitation field, and outputting high-resolution space-time distribution of extreme precipitation of the landing typhoon. The invention can strengthen the expression and the application of the dry invasion-monsoon gushing-landing typhoon maintenance coupling mechanism in numerical calculation, and improves the simulation prediction capability of ERLTC space-time occurrence and intensity.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic emergency decision method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic emergency decision method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for urban flood disasters, and relates to the technical field of emergency management and response scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential game model for flood disaster emergency decision, solving a game saddle point strategy through a forward-backward scanning algorithm to obtain an optimal emergency prevention and control strategy, carrying out multi-dimensional simulation verification by taking a typical flood disaster event as a sample, and finally adjusting the strategy according to a simulation result to form a target emergency prevention and control strategy and using the target emergency prevention and control strategy for actual emergency decision. The application can give consideration to space-time dynamic characteristics and random uncertainty in emergency decisions of urban flood disasters, and realize dynamic adaptation and continuous efficient decisions of disaster systems and emergency response systems.

title_en: Seabed reference station determining method based on multidimensional engineering parameter grading
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining a submarine reference station based on multidimensional engineering parameter scoring, which relates to the technical field of submarine engineering construction, and comprises the following steps: through standardized processing of topography, soil layer, hydrology and geological disaster data, multidimensional parameter calculation such as earthquake vibration judgment, seabed flushing analysis, seabed sedimentation simulation, bearing capacity calculation, geological disaster stability analysis and the like are sequentially carried out, static geological information is coupled with a dynamic geological process, and comprehensive stability indexes capable of reflecting seismic, flushing and sedimentation and other variable factors are formed. And each single-factor result is quantized into a total score through weighted scoring and is used for comprehensively determining the optimal site of the submarine reference station. The invention can combine dynamic geological process to improve the accuracy of submarine reference station evaluation.

title_en: Device and method for testing physical model of ice rock disintegrating debris flow silo effect based on ice bucket terrain
abstract_en: The invention provides a physical model test device and method for an ice rock disintegrating chip flow silo effect based on ice bucket terrain, and belongs to the field of chip flow disaster simulation. The device comprises a chute with a preset inclination angle with the ground, wherein two sides of a circulation area at the upper part of the chute are solid side walls, two sides of the lower part of the chute are suspended side rods to form rectangular hollows, rectangular steel frames are symmetrically embedded in the rectangular hollows at the two sides, the rectangular steel frames are lower than the rectangular hollows, a plurality of transverse guide rail walls perpendicular to the side rods and parallel to the short sides are arranged in the rectangular steel frames, cushion blocks with the same height as a gap are arranged at the positions where the transverse guide rail walls intersect with the side rods, guide rail rollers are arranged at the lower sides of the cushion blocks, so that the transverse guide rail walls can translate vertically along the guide rail rollers, and side erosion samples are symmetrically arranged at the upper part of the chute and the top of the rectangular steel frames to form variable-angle funnel-shaped side erosion channels. The invention effectively improves the simulation authenticity and accuracy of the ice rock breaking chip flow under the ice bucket topography.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Device and method for preventing and controlling coal dynamic disasters of coal mine tunneling roadway
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal rock dynamic disaster prevention and control, in particular to a coal rock dynamic disaster prevention and control device and method for a coal mine tunneling roadway, comprising a pressure relief drilling machine mounting frame and a movable sliding table, wherein the upper surface of the movable sliding table is provided with a guide assembly, a guide shell and a power head, a drilling assembly is arranged between the guide assembly and the guide shell in a penetrating way, the drilling component comprises a drilling component, an outer drilling barrel is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the drilling component, a discharging cavity is formed between the outer drilling barrel and the drilling component, a first crushing component is penetrated and arranged at the edge of one end of the drilling component, and a plurality of groups of detection components and second crushing components are penetrated and arranged at intervals on the outer surface of the drilling component. According to the application, through the double-layer design of the outer drilling barrel and the drilling component, the stability of the hole wall is improved, the possibility of hole collapse in the drilling process is reduced, meanwhile, in the chip removal process, the disturbance and damage of coal rock fragments and air circulation to the hole wall are effectively reduced, and the possibility of hole collapse is further reduced.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST;CHONGQING BOJIAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Alarm noise reduction method based on large model and reinforcement learning cooperation and related equipment
abstract_en: An alarm noise reduction method and related equipment based on large model and reinforcement learning cooperation relate to the technical field of alarm noise reduction in video monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting alarm information in a video monitoring system, grading the alarm information according to the risk degree of each alarm information, carrying out data preprocessing on the alarm information after grading to obtain alarm training data, training a preset alarm basic model by adopting the alarm training data to obtain a target alarm model, constructing a target noise reduction model based on semantic understanding output of the target alarm model, inputting the alarm information to be noise reduced into the target alarm model to obtain a semantic understanding result, and carrying out decision optimization on the semantic understanding result based on the target noise reduction model to obtain a target alarm information row. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the overall operation efficiency and emergency response capability of the security system can be improved.

title_en: Landslide identification method and landslide identification device
abstract_en: The application relates to a landslide identification method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images and basic geographic data of an area after landslide disasters, fusing the remote sensing images and the basic geographic data through space registration to obtain a unified space-referenced fusion data set, wherein the basic geographic data at least comprises a topographic map and a geological map, extracting landslide influence factors from the fusion data set, constructing a landslide sample data set based on the landslide influence factors and spectral bands of the remote sensing images, constructing a network model fused with a feature extraction module, a gridding attention mechanism module, a feature fusion module and a prediction module, training and optimizing the network model based on the landslide sample data set to obtain a trained network model, inputting a test image into the trained network model, and outputting the outline of the area where landslide is estimated to occur in the test image. By adopting the method, the landslide mass can be identified with high precision and the boundary can be segmented in the complex terrain environment.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Roadway deformation monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a roadway deformation monitoring method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of roadway deformation monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining first image data of a roadway, filtering the first image data, extracting first deformation disaster characteristic information, processing point cloud data in the first deformation disaster characteristic information to obtain first point cloud data, constructing a first real-scene three-dimensional model according to integration data of the roadway and the first point cloud data, wherein the integration data comprise roadway surrounding rock lithology, physical mechanical properties and drilling data, obtaining second image data of the roadway, filtering the second image data, extracting second deformation disaster characteristic information, processing the point cloud data in the second deformation disaster characteristic information to obtain second point cloud data, constructing a second real-scene three-dimensional model according to the integration data and the second point cloud data, comparing the second real-scene three-dimensional model with the first real-scene three-dimensional model, and monitoring whether deformation of the roadway occurs. The application can improve the monitoring efficiency of roadway deformation.

title_en: Coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and space-time diagram network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine disaster early warning method based on multi-source data fusion and a space-time diagram network. The method comprises (a) collecting multisource heterogeneous monitoring data, (b) constructing an anisotropic space-time diagram of a geologic-physical dual constraint, (c) training the diagram using a geologic-physical anisotropic space-time diagram neural network whose diagram volume lamination is designed to learn simultaneously And And (d) predicting disaster risk by using the trained model and generating early warning. According to the invention, geology and physical priori knowledge are taken as constraints to be incorporated into the topological structure of the GNN model, so that the model can follow a physical rule, and disasters (propagation) under anisotropic geological conditions are predicted, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy and timeliness of early warning.

title_en: Gangue grouting filling method for coal mine underground water resource recycling in caving region
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of green mining and disaster prevention and control of coal mines, and particularly relates to a gangue grouting filling method for a caving region for recycling water resources in coal mines. The coal gangue is used as main filling aggregate and is directly digested underground, so that the problems of land occupation and environmental pollution caused by ground stockpiling are avoided, and harmless and large-scale disposal of the gangue is realized. The two systems of water treatment and gangue treatment are combined into a whole, and the comprehensive operation cost of the mine in the aspects of water damage prevention and control, gangue treatment and outsourcing water source is obviously reduced through a circulating operation mode, so that the cost benefit is high. The method has the advantages that the accurate detection and effect verification of the front and rear ponding areas are carried out through the geophysical prospecting means, and the measures of directional drilling, safety monitoring and the like are combined, so that the controllability and safety of the whole operation process are ensured, and the safety and reliability are high.

title_en: Wetland group dynamic water distribution method, device and equipment based on self-adaptive optimization model
abstract_en: The invention provides a wetland group dynamic water distribution method, device and equipment based on a self-adaptive optimization model, and relates to the technical field of dynamic water distribution, comprising the steps of obtaining a predetermined water distribution scheme; the water distribution scheme is determined based on a prediction model and a multi-target dynamic optimization model, a simulation result is obtained by simulating the water distribution scheme through a digital twin platform, a control instruction is generated based on the simulation result and the execution device is driven to distribute water based on the control instruction, abnormality detection is carried out in the water distribution process to obtain an abnormality detection result, emergency response is carried out based on the abnormality detection result, feedback data in the water distribution process is monitored in real time, and the prediction model and the multi-target dynamic optimization model are dynamically calibrated based on the feedback data so as to realize closed loop optimization. In the mode, dynamic water distribution is realized by dynamically calibrating the model, real-time response of environmental mutation and synchronous triggering of anomaly detection and emergency strategy are realized, and adaptability of dynamic change of the water demand of the wetland is improved.

title_en: Sealing and grouting device and method for poorly-sealed drilling pressure-bearing water layer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine disaster-causing bad drilling unsealing, and discloses a sealing and grouting device and a method for sealing a bad drilling pressure-bearing water layer, wherein the sealing and grouting device comprises an inner cylinder, a back-buckling sleeve is sleeved outside the inner cylinder, an outer cylinder is connected with the outer screw thread of the back-buckling sleeve, and the inner cylinder is slidably inserted in the outer cylinder; the inner cylinder comprises an upper connecting coupling, a six-edge short section, an upper limiting step of the inner cylinder, an upper packing rubber cylinder inner cylinder liquid inlet hole, an inner cylinder grouting hole and a lower packing rubber cylinder inner cylinder liquid inlet hole, the outer cylinder comprises a back-buckling female buckle, an upper packing rubber cylinder and a lower packing rubber cylinder are arranged on the outer wall of the outer cylinder, and an upper packing rubber cylinder liquid inlet one-way valve is arranged on the cylinder wall of the outer cylinder. According to the invention, the grouting blocking is carried out on the target bearing water layer, the outer cylinder is reserved in the hole to form the blocking for the target bearing water layer, and then the grouting pipe string is put into the grouting pipe string to carry out grouting on the whole shaft, so that triple isolation blocking of water layer grouting, outer cylinder blocking and inner grouting of the target bearing water layer is realized, and the effect of water layer blocking is improved.
