assignees: SHAANXI 185 COALFIELD GEOLOGY CO LTD;SHAANXI COAL GEOLOGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method for predicting instability volume of reservoir side slope deformation body
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the instability volume of a reservoir bank slope deformation body, which comprises the steps of respectively obtaining surface displacement and rock mass internal deformation data through a millimeter wave radar and an inclination angle sensor, and identifying a key deformation area and generating a data set after processing through a self-adaptive noise decomposition algorithm. And carrying out space-time alignment on the data by utilizing the engineering coordinate system and the topological relation to generate a fusion matrix. And reconstructing a potential slip surface geometric model by combining the slip surface characteristics of the historical cases, and calculating the instability volume probability distribution by adopting Monte Carlo simulation. And finally, inputting the multidimensional data into a space-time prediction model, and outputting a destabilization volume prediction result with probability distribution. The method can improve the accuracy and reliability of the prediction result, and provide scientific basis and technical support for safety monitoring and disaster early warning of the bank side slope.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic feedback optimization-based method and device for layered catalytic simulation of freezing rain disasters, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of a catalyst to construct a frostbite catalytic simulation model, coupling the frostbite catalytic simulation model to a cloud micro-physical scheme of a meteorological numerical mode, determining a layered collaborative catalysis scheme, carrying out simulation experiments on the layered collaborative catalysis scheme based on the frostbite catalytic simulation model, generating an optimization strategy according to the simulation experiments, constructing a catalytic efficiency quantitative evaluation method, outputting the optimization strategy conforming to preset conditions according to an evaluation result, and generating a dynamic optimized layered broadcasting scheme. Finally, a multi-index evaluation system taking supercooled water-ice phase particle conversion efficiency as a core is established, single-zone catalysis limitation is broken through, hierarchical cooperative intervention is realized by analyzing a supercooled water-reverse temperature layer linkage mechanism, and supercooled water transformation efficiency and freezing rain prevention and control accuracy are remarkably improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;HUNAN DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Forestry pest hazard risk prediction method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forestry disaster prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the risk of a forestry pest disaster based on big data, which comprise the steps of data acquisition, data processing and data output. The method comprises the steps of obtaining forest disease and insect disaster data, sorting and dividing data segments according to time, establishing a double-model framework of a time sequence model and a regression model, predicting disaster occurrence time by the time sequence model, evaluating influence of disasters on forest risks by the regression model, processing time sequence data by utilizing a random forest model, identifying key disaster characteristics, training the regression model according to the key disaster characteristics, inputting test data, outputting risk degree and main disaster characteristics, comprehensively predicting disaster occurrence time and risk degree by the double-model framework, improving prediction comprehensiveness, and intelligently adjusting a prediction method by adopting a self-adaptive time division strategy by a system, enhancing prediction capability on irregular diseases and insect pests and providing scientific and accurate decision support for forest disaster prevention and control.

title_en: LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric air flow field numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation system for an LES ultra-high resolution TC atmospheric flow field, and relates to the fields of atmospheric observation, numerical assimilation and high resolution numerical simulation. According to the method, three-dimensional power-thermal information is obtained by cooperatively implementing airship platform radar observation and downward projecting sounding observation in a tropical cyclone core area, radar radial wind and profile observation operators are preprocessed and constructed, multi-source observation is fused in a multiple nested grid numerical mode by adopting a data assimilation strategy, and a three-dimensional initial/analysis field adapting to large vortex simulation is generated. And then, configuring a large vortex simulation solver on an innermost grid covering a tropical cyclone boundary layer, adopting fine horizontal grids and boundary layer encryption vertical layering, explicitly analyzing boundary layer vortex, small-scale convection and turbulence structures, and outputting an ultrahigh-resolution three-dimensional flow field product for fine evaluation of strong wind and disaster risks.

title_en: Flood and aquatic product flow simulation method based on time-varying flow coefficient
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydrologic models and flood forecast, and discloses a flood flow simulation method based on a time-varying flow coefficient. The method accurately describes the behavior of the in-soil flow, can accurately simulate the inflection point of a flood water withdrawal section, obviously improves the flood forecasting precision of a semiarid semi-humid area, and provides reliable technical support for flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Mountain highway disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain road disaster identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing image restoration and super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source remote sensing images of mountain areas of a plateau, preprocessing, extracting geomorphic metering parameters based on a digital elevation model, constructing a super-resolution reconstruction network integrating deformable convolution and a Transformer, reconstructing low-resolution images by utilizing composite loss function constraint training comprising the geomorphic metering parameters, carrying out feature extraction and self-adaptive weighted fusion on the preprocessed images and the high-resolution images obtained by reconstruction, identifying landslide, debris flow and subgrade subsidence disasters along the road by utilizing a multi-task deep learning model based on the fused images, carrying out morphological optimization and boundary refinement under GIS constraint on identification results, and outputting disaster thematic map. The invention effectively improves the accuracy and reliability of highway disaster identification under complex terrain environments.

title_en: Mining area rock burst and gas efficient treatment method based on hydraulic fracturing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of deep coal seam exploitation, and particularly relates to a mining area rock burst and gas efficient treatment method based on hydraulic fracturing; sequentially designing a plurality of working surfaces along the trend from bottom to top, constructing an air return gallery of the last working surface, constructing a mining area air inlet gallery at the trend lower part of the first working surface, and then constructing an air return gallery and a mining area air inlet gallery of the last working surface which are communicated through bedding drilling to perform hydraulic fracturing pressure relief and gas pre-extraction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a return air gallery and a transport gallery of a first working face from a transport mountain, carrying out gob-side entry retaining on the return air gallery as a transport gallery of a next working face during stoping, ventilating from the transport gallery to a coal mining position of the working face, simultaneously ventilating from a mining area air inlet gallery to a goaf, and discharging ventilation air from the return air gallery of the last working face through a bedding drill hole and hydraulic fracturing cracks of the rest working face to carry gas in a coal bed. The invention can ensure the gas pre-pumping effect of the subsequent working face and solve the problem of gas disasters caused by goafs.

title_en: Method, equipment and storage medium for acquiring toughness improvement strategy of power distribution network
abstract_en: A method, equipment and storage medium for obtaining a toughness promotion strategy of a power distribution network are used for obtaining the toughness promotion strategy of the power distribution network for strong random and high-influence meteorological events and are applied to the technical field of evaluation and construction of a toughness power system, and comprise the following steps of calculating fault probability of a power distribution line from information such as meteorological data and reinforcing a high-probability line; generating a fault scene based on a Monte Carlo simulation method, taking the minimum configuration cost of an emergency vehicle and a distributed power supply and the minimum total cost at the time of disaster as an objective function of a pre-disaster toughness lifting strategy, taking the minimum loss load cost and the minimum total cost of power generation resources as an objective function of disaster resistance and recovery stages, drawing a performance curve of the power distribution network, and analyzing toughness indexes of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the line reinforcement, the distributed energy allocation and the emergency vehicle allocation are used as toughness lifting means, the optimization problem is solved to obtain an optimal scheme, the power supply capacity of the distribution network under extreme disasters is ensured, pre-disaster early warning and disaster emergency scheme making of the distribution network are facilitated, and the anti-vulnerability of the distribution network is improved.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire dynamic simulation method and system for open space steel structure canopy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster dynamic simulation method and a fire disaster dynamic simulation system for an open space steel structure canopy, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a fire disaster scene of the steel structure canopy, extracting state information of the fire disaster scene, constructing a time-space distribution heat input function of each structure node of the steel structure canopy, and calculating the total surface heat input flux of the structure node at each position; and taking the thermal failure probability as an integral core, combining the structural importance weight, calculating the risk index of each structural node, and monitoring the risk of each structural node of the steel structure awning in real time according to the risk index.

title_en: Method for treating composite goaf fire zone of shallow coal seam group by using temperature-sensitive gel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for treating a fire zone of a shallow coal seam group by utilizing temperature-sensitive gel, which comprises the following steps of S1, equipment installation, wherein a plurality of electromagnetic fire detecting lines are uniformly arranged on the ground surface at equal intervals, each electromagnetic fire detecting line is connected with a high-precision anti-interference magnetometer, the anti-interference magnetometer is connected with a central processing system, S2, automatic fire extinguishing is carried out, when a fire disaster occurs, the position and the depth of a hole to be drilled are judged through the central processing system according to the position and the range of the fire zone detected by the electromagnetic fire detecting lines, then a hole is drilled at the corresponding position, quantitative temperature-sensitive gel is injected into the hole, the temperature-sensitive gel flows to the goaf along the hole, liquid-solid phase transformation occurs when the temperature-sensitive gel encounters a high-temperature fire source point in the flowing process of the goaf, the film is formed to cover the high-temperature zone, and the solid temperature-sensitive gel gradually thickens and wraps the fire source along with the injection of the temperature-sensitive gel, so that the fire extinguishing of the goaf is realized.

title_en: Operation and maintenance business cooperation method for multi-system railway passenger station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for coordinating operation and maintenance services of a railway station aiming at multiple systems, and relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation and building automation. The method comprises the steps of analyzing on-site multi-system real-time monitoring data, mapping to obtain a unified operation state view representing the logic state and the physical position of the total station equipment, instantiating a target plan action sequence according to a pre-constructed joint model in response to an emergency event, carrying out state matching and mode constraint comparison based on the unified view, generating action executable judgment results and mode conflict mark information through incremental local simulation, identifying failure actions based on the judgment results, searching functionally equivalent resources and spatially reachable paths by utilizing the joint model, and reconstructing to generate an optimal substitution action sequence. The invention solves the linkage failure problem caused by mode conflict or equipment failure of the traditional plan under the complex working condition, realizes the dynamic consistency check and flexible resource reconstruction of emergency response, and ensures the operation safety of the station.

title_en: Method and device for simulating freeze rain disaster intensity weakening numerical value based on warm cloud catalysis, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional space related condition data, initializing a freezing rain particle swarm model based on the related condition data, selecting a manual intervention warming cloud layer area according to preset conditions, formulating a catalysis scheme in combination with the preset target, carrying out first simulation on the catalysis scheme based on the freezing rain particle swarm model, determining initial conditions in a first simulation result, carrying out second simulation on the initial conditions and the freezing rain particle swarm model, calculating a freezing rain particle size spectrum, a freezing rain disaster intensity index and a freezing rain disaster level, determining a weakening value of the catalysis scheme on the freezing rain disaster intensity, and adjusting the catalysis scheme. The method realizes the whole physical process coupling numerical simulation of warm cloud catalysis, rain drop particle size regulation, freezing rain formation and disaster intensity evaluation, and is helpful for quantitatively and objectively evaluating the actual weakening effect of catalytic measures on freezing rain disasters.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;HUNAN DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Analysis method and analysis model for comprehensive disaster prevention and reduction effects of multiple disaster species of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a model for analyzing disaster prevention and reduction effects of multiple disaster types of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, comprising the steps of constructing a typical disaster event library corresponding to each natural disaster; the method comprises the steps of constructing a typical disaster scene based on disaster occurrence frequency, carrying out simulation deduction on the typical disaster process to obtain an engineering disaster reduction benefit probability distribution curve representing the correlation between each disaster occurrence frequency and engineering disaster reduction benefit, further constructing and obtaining disaster reduction benefit expectations, selecting a target engineering operation period, and analyzing a comprehensive disaster reduction benefit expectancy curve to obtain an engineering accumulated disaster reduction benefit value in the target engineering operation period. The invention breaks through the limitation that the existing method is only suitable for single disasters, and can provide accurate, visual and quantitative technical support for loss analysis, emergency dispatch and emergency plan formulation of various natural disasters in the watershed after the hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering is built.

title_en: Fire disaster area inversion method based on airborne double-spectrum detection and depth estimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire disaster area inversion method based on airborne double-spectrum detection and depth estimation, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-dimensional data sets such as a double-spectrum image, a temperature image and an unmanned aerial vehicle attitude, constructing a multi-mode space collaborative perception segmentation network, combining temperature change characteristics with temperature space distribution characteristics of flames to generate temperature area distribution characteristics, coupling absolute temperature and pixel information to strengthen weak flame edge extraction, designing a temperature guiding space structure Loss function TSS_Loss, combining gradient change consistency constraint and temperature weight constraint on the segmentation Loss function for network training, segmenting pixel areas according to the unmanned aerial vehicle attitude, target depth and fire areas, combining an airspace transmission inversion formula to deduce early fire areas, and calculating actual fire areas. The invention effectively combines multi-source information to carry out physical constraint, and can realize more accurate fire detection segmentation and calculation of fire area.

title_en: Inland region TRP feature recognition and evaluation method, medium and program product based on data driving and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, medium and program product for identifying and evaluating TRP characteristics of an inland region based on data driving and numerical simulation, which relate to the technical field of meteorological disaster monitoring and early warning and numerical simulation. The regional numerical mode and the analysis data are utilized to diagnose the key physical fields such as the whole water vapor flux, the water vapor balance, the dry invasion, the water vapor gushing of the monsoon and the like to form a characteristic index set reflecting the coupling influence of typhoons, the monsoon and the dry and cold air, a data driving learning algorithm is introduced on the basis, a TRP generation and storm intensity grading identification model is obtained through training, and a risk assessment product is generated through calibration and risk grading, so that the identification and assessment capability of remote storm of inland typhoons is improved.

title_en: Remote sensing image generation method driven by multi-mode semantics and physical laws
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing image generation method driven by multi-mode semantics and physical laws, which belongs to the technical field of computer vision and remote sensing image generation, and aims at the problems of insufficient alignment of cross-mode semantics, low reliability of generated results and insufficient fusion of physical mechanisms, and the method comprises the steps of firstly removing low-quality samples from original data and unifying spatial scales; the method comprises the steps of extracting multi-mode semantic vectors by using BLIP and CLIP models, introducing remote sensing physical rules to perform vector optimization, embedding position coding and physical constraint conditions in a latent space, realizing multi-source information joint modeling by using a cross-mode encoder, and finally performing denoising reasoning based on a transducer architecture by taking text description, physical priori knowledge and diffusion time steps as joint conditions, and completing reverse diffusion reconstruction by using a cross-attention mechanism. The method improves physical rationality and semantic consistency, and provides a more reliable technical paradigm for remote sensing image generation in the fields of disaster monitoring, military simulation and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;JIANGSU BITEDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;HENAN LONGYU ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode intelligent high-compaction training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-voltage equipment practical training, in particular to a multi-mode intelligent high-compaction training system which comprises a practical training data sensing module, a practical training simulation module, a practical training evaluation center, a scene interaction unit, a practical training adjustment pushing unit, a practical training report and a personalized lifting scheme, wherein the practical training data sensing module is used for collecting practical training environment, a virtual and real state of high-voltage equipment, student behaviors and physiological feedback data, the practical training simulation module is used for constructing a dynamic practical training scene and simulating complex faults, extreme working conditions and emergency flows, the practical training evaluation center is used for evaluating student operation specifications, fault diagnosis logics and emergency response capability through an improved transducer-ConvNeXt model, generating scores and short-circuit reports and carrying out risk early warning, the scene interaction unit is used for providing multi-mode interaction functions and visually demonstrating the disassembly and internal electric fields and magnetic fields of the high-voltage equipment, and the practical training adjustment pushing unit is used for dynamically adjusting practical training scene difficulty and content side emphasis according to evaluation results, student states and equipment loads. Therefore, the problems of single training scene, inaccurate evaluation and the like in the prior art are solved.

title_en: Dangerous rock image sample pixel-level labeling method based on intelligent segmentation
abstract_en: The invention provides a dangerous rock image sample pixel level labeling method based on intelligent segmentation. The method is based on an X-AL labeling tool and an SAM2 intelligent segmentation algorithm, provides a pixel-level labeling method integrating AI assistance and artificial refinement in the field of dangerous rock and ground disasters, and provides a three-standard-person arbitration mechanism and a sample data set construction scheme. The method has an intelligent segmentation feedback learning mechanism and the capability of continuously strengthening automatic labeling. And a theoretical foundation is laid for supporting the construction of a dangerous rock image sample library and the training of a deep learning model.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING GEOMATICS AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER CHONGQING SURVEYING AND MAPPING PRODUCT QUALITY INSPEC

title_en: Urban waterlogging dynamic simulation method and system for large-scale response to climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban waterlogging risk simulation analysis and discloses a method and a system for dynamically simulating urban waterlogging with large scale response to climate change, wherein the method comprises the following steps that S1, storm information in social media is acquired through a crawler, and an AI model and an ArcGIS are coupled to generate a large scale space inundation map; the method comprises the steps of S2 identifying waterlogging ponding time, obtaining corresponding rainfall, dividing inundation maps with different rainfall intensities, S3 analyzing urban waterlogging vulnerability influence factors and obvious recessive characteristics by using PDP and SHAP interpretable algorithms, S4 constructing an urban waterlogging disaster vulnerability simulation framework based on a long and short neural network, S5 simulating future climate change, and S6 dynamically simulating urban waterlogging vulnerability by coupling future climate data and urban development scenes. The system overcomes the defects of the traditional observation data by integrating social media multi-source data, improves the simulation precision by means of an interpretable algorithm and a comprehensive weighting method, and realizes accurate dynamic pre-judgment of current and future urban waterlogging risks under large scale.

title_en: Near-field dynamics simulation method and system for creep-seepage coupling of deep rock mass
abstract_en: The invention provides a near-field dynamics simulation method and a near-field dynamics simulation system for creep-seepage coupling of a deep rock mass, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and comprise the steps of establishing a near-field dynamics numerical calculation model based on geological investigation data, forming a near-field dynamics creep-seepage coupling basic motion equation based on a Burgers creep constitutive model, carrying out the simulation of a creep process of the rock mass by utilizing the near-field dynamics numerical calculation model and the creep-seepage coupling basic motion equation, carrying out iterative solution on stress, strain, displacement, water pressure and damage of each time step in the simulation process until the condition of iterative stop is met, and finally obtaining the distribution characteristics of a displacement field, a damage field and a seepage field of the rock mass and a creep characteristic curve to realize the near-field dynamics simulation of the creep-seepage coupling process of the rock mass. The invention fills the technical blank of near field dynamics in the field, and realizes the accurate reproduction and prediction of the long-term stability of engineering rock mass and the disaster evolution process.
assignees: POWERCHINA CHENGDU ENGINEERING CORP LTD;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation method, a system and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an infrastructure network according to city key infrastructure information; the method comprises the steps of constructing an interdependence matrix according to an infrastructure network, determining a dependency weight according to the interdependence matrix, determining an initial impact node in the infrastructure network according to urban meteorological observation data, inputting the infrastructure network, the upstream and downstream relation of the node, the dependency weight and the initial impact node into a cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, and obtaining an urban rainfall flood impact cascade propagation simulation result. According to the embodiment of the invention, the infrastructure network, the node upstream-downstream relationship, the dependence weight and the initial impact node are input into the cascade propagation simulation model to perform propagation simulation, so that cascade simulation of the process from local node triggering to range diffusion of urban flood impact can be effectively realized, and the accuracy of urban flood disaster impact propagation simulation is improved.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS;UNIV JIANGXI NORMAL

title_en: Power grid disaster early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster early warning method and device, relates to the technical field of power safety, and aims to improve accuracy of early warning results. The method comprises the main technical scheme of obtaining power grid disasters and meteorological data, screening a single feature set meeting conditions according to preset supporters obtained by a genetic algorithm for each data area, determining multiple occurrence time periods according to occurrence time of the meteorological data, constructing a backward-offset response window with each time period as a reference, wherein the window comprises reference periods and backward-offset preset time periods, correlating the reference period meteorological and disaster data and the reference period meteorological with disaster data in each response window to form multiple initial correlation sets, screening a target item combination feature set in the multiple initial correlation sets, screening combined features required by confidence level load according to preset confidence level obtained by the genetic algorithm as target correlation rules, and inputting the target correlation rules, the power grid disasters and the meteorological data into a pre-training early-warning model to obtain power grid disaster risk early-warning results.
assignees: NORTH CN ELEC POWER RES INST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Intelligent detection method for double-branch remote sensing target fused with privacy calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-branch remote sensing target intelligent detection method integrating privacy calculation, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing data to obtain image weight of each image, S2, establishing a double-branch remote sensing target detection model which comprises a feature extraction module, a feature fusion module and three double-branch output modules, wherein the feature extraction module adds SimAM mechanisms and an SPPF_ReLU module into a YOLOv l CSPDARKNET feature extraction module, the feature fusion module adopts CSPDARKNET architecture, S3, sampling image samples in a data sample set according to the image weight, inputting the image weight into the double-branch remote sensing target detection model for training, and detecting a remote sensing target by using the trained model. The invention can enhance the attention degree of the sample to few category characteristics and obtain excellent detection results for disaster remote sensing image scenes with extremely unbalanced sample category distribution.

title_en: Mixed test device for deep underground structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground structure tests, and provides a deep underground structure mixing test device which comprises a model box, a plurality of loading plates, a plurality of drivers and a hydraulic loading mechanism, wherein the loading plates are arranged in the model box, each loading plate is arranged in parallel with one inner wall of the model box, a containing space is formed between the loading plates and is used for containing a rock-soil body-underground structure model, the drivers are connected with the loading plates and are used for driving the loading plates to move, the hydraulic loading mechanism is arranged on the model box and communicated with the model box, and the hydraulic loading mechanism is used for injecting water into the model box and adjusting the pressure of water in the model box. According to the deep underground structure mixing test device, the plurality of drivers and the hydraulic loading mechanism are arranged, so that the occurrence environment of high soil pressure and high hydraulic pressure of deep underground soil can be simulated, and important scientific support is provided for safe development and disaster prevention and control of deep underground space.

title_en: BIM-based subway safety emergency drilling platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway safety emergency exercise platform based on BIM, and belongs to the field of application intersection of subway safety emergency management and BIM technology. The method aims at solving the problems of high cost, limited scene, weak data acquisition and analysis and incomplete existing BIM emergency application of the traditional subway emergency exercise. The platform comprises a server, a client, a data interface layer and a support engine, wherein a distributed server architecture and a high-performance 3D engine are adopted, the server realizes scene model lightweight management, multi-role configuration, interactive event binding, drilling checkpoint creation, full-flow data management and AI virtual user and anti-cheating functions, the client supports PC, VR, mobile terminal multi-device access and single/multi-person collaborative drilling, and the data interface layer is in butt joint with a subway existing system. The invention can realize high-precision scene restoration, low-cost drilling and data driving optimization and remarkably improve subway emergency response capability.
assignees: SHENZHEN CHIMING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Electric control room for petroleum drilling machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric control room for an oil rig, which comprises an electric control room main body, wherein a cabinet body is fixedly arranged on one side of the outer surface of the electric control room main body, a plurality of carbon dioxide fire extinguishing agent storage tanks are fixedly arranged in the cabinet body, a collecting pipe is fixedly communicated with the carbon dioxide fire extinguishing agent storage tanks together, the collecting pipe penetrates through the cabinet body, and an electric three-way valve is fixedly communicated with an interface at the top of the collecting pipe. According to the utility model, each electrical cabinet is isolated and arranged through the arranged carbon dioxide fire extinguishing agent storage tank, the collecting pipe, the electric three-way valve, the smoke sensor, the temperature sensor, the T-shaped rail, the transverse pipe, the spray head, the connecting pipe, the hose, the sliding block, the walking component, the mounting seat, the servo motor, the rotary table, the spray pipe and the flame-retardant partition plate, when a fire disaster occurs, the number of the ignition points is judged through the arranged sensors, and when only one ignition point exists, the fire can be extinguished at fixed points, and the influence on surrounding electrical cabinets is reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG YUTENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: End-to-end flow field flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end river basin flood risk influence forecasting method based on physical constraint, in particular to the technical field of meteorological hydrologic forecasting and artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of S1, acquiring multisource space-time data of a target river basin, constructing a river basin diagram structure after space-time alignment and meshing, S2, constructing an end-to-end deep learning network comprising a self-adaptive multi-mode feature extraction module and an influence prediction module, and training the network by utilizing a loss function fused with physical constraints to obtain a flood risk influence prediction model, wherein the physical constraints at least comprise water balance constraints. According to the invention, the key problems of error accumulation, poor physical consistency and scarcity of disaster samples in the traditional cascade forecasting mode are solved by deeply embedding the physical mechanism into the data driving model, so that the forecasting precision and reliability are remarkably improved.
assignees: ANHUI INST OF METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCES ANHUI ECOLOGICAL METEOROLOGICAL AND SATELLITE REMOTE SENSING C

title_en: Early warning release method and system for dynamic channel thermal expansion based on decoupling architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning and issuing of dynamic channel thermal expansion based on a decoupling architecture, which relate to the technical field of disaster early warning information and comprise the following steps of establishing a load mapping table based on a logic decoupling architecture of channel resources; the method comprises the steps of calculating instantaneous load gradients of a channel instance before and after expansion triggering based on a load mapping table, generating gradient balance coefficients, constructing a dynamic thermal expansion disturbance response model based on the gradient balance coefficients, simulating a load fluctuation propagation path under thermal expansion, calculating a time delay function of propagation of expansion disturbance to an early warning module, dynamically adjusting an early warning triggering threshold based on the time delay function, aligning signals according to the adjusted early warning triggering threshold, and asynchronously broadcasting early warning. According to the invention, by generating the gradient balance coefficient and dynamically adjusting the early warning trigger threshold value in combination with the disturbance response model, cross-channel time sequence alignment and asynchronous broadcasting are realized, and the problems of early warning response delay and unbalance caused by multi-channel load coupling are effectively solved.
assignees: ANHUI DISASTER WARNING AND AGRICULTURAL METEOROLOGICAL INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Drilling pressure relief effect analysis and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing and evaluating a pressure relief effect of a drilling hole, which relates to the technical field of monitoring and controlling dynamic disasters of coal mines, and comprises the steps of arranging a stay rope type displacement acquisition device at a hydraulic drilling machine for the coal mine, and arranging a vibration signal acquisition device at the roadway wall adjacent to the drilling hole; the method comprises the steps of analyzing displacement change data and vibration change data, calculating pressure relief drilling construction depth, calculating drilling time lengths and vibration amplitudes of different drilling depths to obtain average amplitude of each meter depth, obtaining distribution conditions of roadway lateral support pressure according to the average amplitude of each meter depth, and evaluating drilling pressure relief effect according to the distribution conditions of the roadway lateral support pressure. The invention can realize accurate acquisition of vibration signals at different drilling depths during drilling, solves the technical problems of rough verification and pressure relief effect evaluation and analysis weakness of the current drilling construction quality, and provides reliable technical support for coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and control.
assignees: BEIJING ANKE XINGYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-layer collaborative pressure relief gas control method for directional drilling of bottom drainage roadway of low-permeability coal seam
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-layer collaborative pressure relief gas treatment method for directional drilling of a low-permeability coal seam bottom drainage roadway, relates to the technical field of mineral disaster prevention and treatment, and aims to solve the problem that production safety is affected due to low gas treatment efficiency. The method comprises the steps of determining a priority pressure relief mode from a pressure relief mode library based on basic parameters of a roof, a coal seam and a floor of a target area, wherein the basic parameters comprise coal and rock physical parameters, gas occurrence parameters and stratum characteristic parameters, the pressure relief mode library comprises an independent pressure relief mode of the floor, the coal seam and the roof, a cooperative pressure relief mode of the floor-coal seam, the coal seam-roof and the floor-coal seam-roof, and a cooperative pressure relief mode of the floor-coal seam-roof, a drilling group corresponding to the priority pressure relief mode is arranged in a bottom drainage roadway arranged on a working face floor, pressure relief operation is carried out in the drilling group according to a preset procedure to expand a fracture network, and the fracture network is used for carrying out gas pressure relief extraction on the target area, and the pressure relief operation comprises a slotting operation, a fracturing operation and a hole making operation.
assignees: SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Active power distribution network dynamic reconstruction system oriented to graph neural network induction under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graph neural network-induced active power distribution network dynamic reconstruction system oriented to typhoon disasters, which comprises a graph neural network module, a preprocessing filter module, a post-processing selection module, an optimization solving module and a scene generating module. The system dynamically simulates topology reconstruction through a switch door control message transmission mechanism, adopts a topology independent local predictor to realize the expansion of cross-network configuration, combines pre-filtering non-key switch and post-processing confidence degree selection, and combines GNN prediction with MIP optimization on the premise of ensuring physical feasibility. In the actual measurement of an IEEE 33 node system, 1.64 times of calculation acceleration is realized, only 0.67% average optimality gap is generated, the problem of low calculation efficiency in the traditional method is effectively solved, and the toughness level of the power distribution network for coping with extreme weather is remarkably improved.

title_en: Impact experiment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact experiment system, which relates to the technical field of component disaster simulation and comprises a fixing frame, a test piece, an axial loading device and a lateral impact device, wherein the fixing frame and the test piece are fixedly arranged, the axial loading device is arranged on the top end of the fixing frame, the axial loading device is arranged above the test piece, the axial loading device can be connected or contacted with the top end of the test piece and downwards applies an axial load to the test piece, and the lateral impact device can transversely impact on the outer side wall of the test piece.

title_en: Method and system for fault water disaster sensing and danger relieving operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine disaster prevention and control, in particular to a fault water disaster sensing and danger eliminating operation method and system, comprising the steps of setting a monitoring area, carrying out three-dimensional space grid segmentation, calculating the coupling coefficient of data in each grid, setting a multi-level risk threshold value, and judging the risk level of the coupling coefficient of each grid; based on the determined grid risk level, a knowledge reasoning mode, an acoustic warning mode and a three-dimensional visual mode are established, a normalization result is weighted and fused according to a preset credibility weight to obtain a final risk value, the final risk value is compared with a preset early warning threshold value to trigger corresponding level early warning, the grid of high risk early warning is determined based on the determined grid of the corresponding level early warning, a drilling verification and grouting plugging danger solving process is started, and the technical problem of collaborative perception, early warning and danger solving intelligent collaborative difference of mine disaster multisource data is solved.

title_en: Risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent early warning and discloses a risk early warning method and system for low-temperature rain, snow and freezing weather disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a heterogeneous diagram; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data to obtain training and reasoning samples, constructing a graph neural network on a heterogeneous graph, carrying out joint learning on node time sequence characteristics and side relations to obtain graph representations representing cold air invasion, rain and snow zone movement and risk propagation delay, outputting road table temperature evolution, icing threshold arrival time and wire icing growth rate based on the physical guiding neural network, fusing characteristics obtained by the graph neural network with characteristics obtained by the physical guiding neural network, outputting asset-level risk scores and confidence intervals thereof, obtaining expected arrival time, and establishing early warning according to prediction results and observation results. The application provides finer and more reliable grading risk early warning, and improves the accuracy, the interpretability and the practicability of early warning.
assignees: HENAN METEOROLOGICAL OBSERVATORY YELLOW RIVER BASIN METEOROLOGICAL CENTER HENAN ENV METEOROLOGICAL F

title_en: Public emergency evacuation identification test and evaluation method and system
abstract_en: A public emergency evacuation identification test and evaluation method and system belong to the technical field of virtual reality, and solve the technical problem that the perception and decision behaviors of participants in VR experiments are affected by external factors such as personnel message communication, smoke of fire scenes, flame rendering, crowd crowding and trampling which are not considered in the prior art, so that the reliability of evaluation results is reduced. The simulation experiment platform comprises three-dimensional computer graphic software, a game engine and a virtual reality technology, an emergency event and emergency evacuation identification system is developed, the system comprises a personnel message communication and message transmission module, a particle system and BP_ DATAMANAGER blueprint data linkage module and a crowding effect simulation module, and the participants are tested to obtain test and evaluation results. The invention is used for realizing real and efficient public emergency evacuation identification test and evaluation.

title_en: Machine learning-based flood disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood disaster early warning method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of identifying a built-up area of a national city by using an artificial image identification algorithm based on machine learning based on satellite remote sensing images, obtaining multi-element data corresponding to key hydrologic elements, analyzing and extracting key characteristics in the historical multi-element data, dividing the historical multi-element data into a training set and a verification set according to the key characteristics, training a hydrologic forecasting model constructed by a plurality of neural networks based on the training set, and acquiring rainfall forecasting information based on a mesoscale numerical forecasting mode. By integrating the real-time weather forecast data and the hydrological forecast model, the method can rapidly forecast the flow of the key water body and generate early warning information in a short time, thereby improving the timeliness of early warning. This efficient data processing and predictive capability ensures rapid delivery of early warning information, providing the public and related institutions with sufficient time to take countermeasures.

title_en: Road disaster monitoring, identifying and early warning response system and method based on AI technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a road disaster monitoring and early warning technology, in particular to a road disaster monitoring, identifying and early warning response system and method based on an AI technology. The intelligent central processor module is used for realizing real-time detection and identification of road disasters and quantifying risk levels, the early warning response output module is used for converting the risk levels into early warning levels to respond and issuing information such as disaster types, positioning coordinates and the like to the outside, and the sample database self-adaptive optimization module is used for training data to realize continuous optimization of detection performance. The invention can obviously improve the space-time coverage and detection precision of road disaster monitoring, reduce the cost of error detection and manual inspection, realize multi-stage early warning and greatly improve the early warning response capability of related departments to road disasters.

title_en: Landslide integrated numerical calculation method for statics inversion and dynamics linkage analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide integrated numerical calculation method for statics inversion and dynamics linkage analysis, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-dimensional data of a target landslide area, constructing a statics analysis model by using related model processing data, carrying out statics inversion operation based on a limit balance principle to obtain critical parameters, constructing a dynamics analysis model, inputting related parameters, simulating the whole process of a landslide body by using a fluid-solid coupling algorithm, and extracting key characteristic parameters to form a calculation result. The method realizes deep linkage of statics inversion and dynamics analysis, comprehensively combines mechanical action, can accurately extract key parameters, provides reliable basis for landslide disaster prevention and control, and improves disaster prevention and reduction application value.

title_en: Storm surge disaster frequency prediction method and system based on LSTM
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a storm surge disaster frequency prediction method and system based on LSTM. The method comprises the steps of collecting sea surface air pressure, wind speed and wind direction and sea water temperature through multi-source marine meteorological monitoring equipment to form an observation data set, extracting time sequence characteristics of meteorological elements to obtain a storm surge characteristic vector sequence, converting the storm surge characteristic vector sequence into time sequence training samples through tensor reconstruction algorithm, constructing a bidirectional LSTM neural network for training to obtain a prediction model, carrying out reasoning prediction on the real-time characteristic vector sequence, and comparing the real-time characteristic vector sequence with historical records for verification, so as to finally obtain storm surge disaster frequency prediction data. The method solves the technical problem that the storm surge disaster frequency prediction precision is insufficient because the existing storm surge prediction technology cannot effectively capture the long-term time sequence dependency relationship and the multi-time scale change rule of storm surge.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;HUANENG ZHEJIANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Lateral impact experimental system for bending combined stress component
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lateral impact experimental system of a bending combined stress component, which relates to the technical field of disaster simulation components, and comprises a clamping component, a lateral impact component and a bending loading component, wherein the clamping component is used for clamping and fixing a test piece, the lateral impact component accurately simulates horizontal power load in accidents such as vehicle impact and the like, and reproduces a real dynamic impact process, and the bending loading component can continuously apply axial pressure and bending moment in the whole impact process, so that the test piece is always in a composite stress state in actual working, and can always be in a bending composite stress environment which truly reflects the actual working state in the impact process, and the impact behavior of the component under the complex stress can be highly restored in a laboratory, thereby providing a reliable experimental basis for researching the power response and the damage mechanism of the test piece.

title_en: Simulation method based on complex building crowd evacuation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to a simulation method based on a complex building crowd evacuation model. The method comprises the steps of dividing personnel in a target building into evacuation groups, combining planned evacuation lines of personnel in the evacuation groups with actual residence time of residence nodes on the planned evacuation lines to obtain theoretical evacuation lines, determining evacuation confusion based on the number of the evacuation groups accommodated by the example nodes in sub-periods and the theoretical residence time, determining evacuation danger based on the evacuation confusion of the example nodes in each sub-period and ‌ fluctuation trend ‌ of the evacuation confusion of the example nodes in simulation periods, adjusting the theoretical residence time of the example nodes based on evacuation danger difference between the example nodes and adjacent nodes on the theoretical evacuation lines, determining optimal residence time, and determining optimal evacuation routes of the example groups. According to the invention, people in the building are divided into groups, the stay time of nodes on the evacuation route is adjusted by considering the path crossing and congestion, and the evacuation accuracy of the super high-rise building under a complex environment is improved.

title_en: Underground structure damage evolution assessment method under sudden explosion load effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground structure damage evolution assessment method under the action of burst explosive load, which relates to the technical field of civil engineering and engineering disaster prevention and is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, simulating an underground structure based on the explosive load, a geometric boundary and material parameters, and constructing a unified constitutive model, and S2, introducing a Deruker-Prague criterion pressure-related strength criterion into the unified constitutive model to describe the influence of confining pressure on shear strength. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing an underground structure damage evolution assessment method under the action of sudden explosion load, solving the problem that the existing analysis method is difficult to simultaneously consider key pain points such as pressure correlation, high strain rate effect, random material discreteness, damage softening energy consistency and the like, establishing a set of damage evolution assessment method and an implementation system which can be implemented from a material layer to a structure layer, and supporting quantitative prediction and engineering grading judgment on the whole process of crack initiation and propagation to destabilization damage of an underground structure.

title_en: Tunnel construction geological disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel construction geological disaster early warning and discloses a tunnel construction geological disaster early warning method and system. The method collects multi-source geological monitoring data and environmental dynamic parameters of a tunnel construction area. And then, data contradiction and redundancy are eliminated through data fusion and feature engineering processing, so that a standardized training data set is formed. And then training and verifying the disaster risk prediction model by using the data set through a machine learning algorithm, so as to obtain an optimized model for accurately predicting the disaster risk. And predicting risk values of different geological structure units by using an optimization model, generating a risk distribution map, and determining an optimal geological structure unit through a search algorithm. Based on the analysis, numerical simulation of geological disaster triggering and spreading is executed, a disaster evolution rule is analyzed, and a path simulation data set is output. And finally, carrying out multi-objective optimization on the data set according to the safety early warning target, generating a geological disaster early warning scheme and carrying out iterative calibration.

title_en: Vibration table test method considering time-varying degradation of seismic performance of anchored rock slope
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geotechnical engineering disaster prevention and reduction and earthquake engineering tests, and relates to a vibrating table test method considering time-varying degradation of the earthquake resistance of an anchored rock slope. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a dynamic performance time-varying degradation model based on the interfacial cohesive force of an anchoring system and the attenuation law of yield resistance of free section steel bars, and respectively realizing physical equivalent simulation of interfacial degradation and component yield resistance reduction by regulating and controlling rock mass similar material proportions and utilizing a graded stiffness anchoring system. The method has the core that the anchoring performance attenuation of the supporting structure is actively simulated in advance before the earthquake wave is applied to the vibrating table, so that the limitation that the traditional test only simply simulates the static low bearing capacity is broken through the real evolution path of ' the bearing capacity of the anchoring system is firstly reduced, the side slope stress is redistributed and accumulated to be damaged and then the sudden earthquake load ' is suffered '. The invention effectively realizes the space-time coupling of static time-varying degradation accumulation and transient earthquake dynamic action, solves the problems of interface degradation simulation distortion and the like, and provides a reliable test method for dynamic stability evaluation and reinforcement design of long-term service anchoring slopes.

title_en: Component residual bearing capacity assessment method based on entropy fuzzy analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a component residual bearing capacity assessment method based on an entropy fuzzy analysis method, and belongs to the field of structural engineering. Aiming at the existing evaluation method, such as subjective expert experience method, high cost of load test method, dependence of reliability theory on mass data, the existing fuzzy evaluation method is too subjective in weight. The method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic critical value adjustment formula set through different damage rates of a physical test simulation component, correcting a normalization matrix of a traditional entropy method to obtain a dynamic entropy weight set under different rates, collecting actual measurement damage data to construct a current fuzzy judgment matrix and a pre-judgment fuzzy judgment matrix, combining the current fuzzy judgment matrix and the pre-judgment fuzzy judgment matrix to form a compensation matrix, calculating a target layer fuzzy judgment matrix by combining the compensation matrix and the dynamic weight, correcting to obtain a final reduction coefficient, and further calculating the residual bearing capacity. The method solves the problem of dynamic weight distribution under multi-damage coupling, reduces subjective dependence, adapts to damage rate change, improves evaluation accuracy, and can be used for structural maintenance decision and emergency study and judgment after disasters.

title_en: Deep learning landslide identification method and system integrating optical and SAR remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention provides a deep learning landslide identification method and system integrating optical and SAR remote sensing data, and relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and identification, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an optical image and an SAR image of a target area, registering the optical image and the SAR image to generate an optical-SAR image pair, and generating a corresponding binary label graph for the optical-SAR image pair; constructing a landslide identification model to be trained, constructing a data set by the optical-SAR image pair and a corresponding binary label graph, training the landslide identification model to be trained by utilizing the data set to obtain a landslide identification model to be trained, inputting the optical-SAR image pair of a region to be identified into the landslide identification model to be trained, and outputting a landslide identification result graph of the region to be identified. The invention overcomes the limitation of a single remote sensing data source in landslide identification in the prior art, and improves the landslide identification precision in a complex environment.

title_en: Mixed disaster emergency evacuation path simulation planning method and system based on social distance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a social distance-based simulation planning method and system for a mixed disaster emergency evacuation path, and belongs to the technical field of emergency management. Aiming at the concurrent scene of epidemic situation of great infectious disease and natural disaster, the method provides a K shortest path capacity planning algorithm with social distance, which comprises a K shortest path generation operator with node capacity constraint, a conflict road section identification operator and a capacity allocation operator with social distance, and rapidly generates an evacuation scheme under the condition of parameter determination, so as to realize dynamic balance of evacuation efficiency and infection risk. Further, the operator is integrated into a simulation optimization framework, an alternative scheme library is built through random sampling and budget allocation under the condition of uncertain parameters, and the reliability and the robustness of the scheme are improved. The invention can quickly and flexibly formulate a reliable evacuation strategy under a complex disaster environment, avoid local congestion and scheme failure, and enhance the collaborative coping capability of multiple disasters.

title_en: Power distribution network elasticity evaluation method and device considering power-traffic coupling, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network elasticity evaluation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium considering power-traffic coupling, belonging to the field of power system safety evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a geospatial coupling relation of a power distribution network and a traffic network; the method comprises the steps of carrying out disaster simulation based on a geospatial coupling relation to generate a series of disaster scenes which simultaneously comprise the running state of a power distribution network line and the traffic network road traffic state, constructing a post-disaster cooperative recovery model with the aim of minimizing economic loss in the post-disaster recovery process, solving the post-disaster cooperative recovery model in each disaster scene to generate an optimal post-disaster recovery plan, and calculating indexes such as load recovery time, load loss probability and the like according to all post-disaster recovery plans so as to realize quantitative evaluation of the power distribution network elasticity. Therefore, by implementing the method and the device, the problem that the elasticity evaluation of the power distribution network in the prior art is not accurate enough can be solved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Flood simulation and forecast method based on hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling for alpine mountain areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood simulation and forecast method based on hydrologic hydrodynamic coupling in alpine mountain areas, and belongs to the technical field of disaster forecast. The method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and preprocessing multisource basic data, namely collecting multiscale basic data of multiple types aiming at a target cold mountain area, S2, carrying out deep learning correction and fusion on satellite precipitation data, namely carrying out hour scale correction and fusion by adopting a deep learning algorithm aiming at the problems of local overestimation and underestimation of the satellite precipitation data. The method has the advantages that through collecting satellite remote sensing, re-analysis, ground observation and 4 types of core data of geographic space, all elements of 'precipitation-runoff-topography-underlying surface' required by flood simulation in alpine mountain areas are covered, simulation one-sided performance caused by data type deletion in traditional modeling is avoided, precipitation and runoff outliers are removed by adopting a3 sigma rule, a data format and a space-time scale are unified, a standardized data set is formed, and interference of outliers, format incompatibility and space-time mismatch on input of a subsequent model is avoided.
assignees: Tibet Autonomous Region Meteorological Information Network Center

title_en: Radar reflectivity cascade model inversion method based on sunflower satellite multichannel bright temperature
abstract_en: The invention provides a sunflower satellite multichannel bright temperature-based radar reflectivity cascade model inversion method which comprises the steps of constructing a cascade model based on a UNet structure, selecting sunflower satellite data and radar reflectivity jigsaw data at corresponding moments, training the constructed cascade model, and inverting the radar reflectivity data by utilizing the sunflower satellite data. The radar reflectivity inversion method has the beneficial effects that the radar reflectivity inversion method realizes the high-precision inversion of radar reflectivity under different weather conditions, greatly improves the resolution and stability of weather monitoring, can be widely applied to the fields of short-term prediction, strong convection monitoring, quantitative precipitation estimation and the like, and provides powerful technical support for weather early warning and disaster defense.
assignees: TIANJIN YUNYAO AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD;WUXI YUNYAO YUHANG METEOROLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING YUNYAO AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD;SHANGHAI YUNYAO AEROSPACE METEOROLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gas disaster early warning method for drilling optical fiber sensing monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas disaster prediction, in particular to a gas disaster early warning method for drilling optical fiber sensing monitoring, which comprises the steps of screening and numbering through-layer extraction drilling holes penetrating through a coal roadway area to be excavated as monitoring drilling holes; the method comprises the steps of installing a composite optical fiber sensing cable integrated with temperature and pressure sensing functions in a monitoring drill hole, early warning gas desorption and outburst risks by identifying the mutation modes such as continuous temperature drop and rising and falling, and early warning drill hole collapse by identifying the modes such as pressure fluctuation and sudden falling. In the tunneling process, the composite optical fiber sensing cable which is tunneled in the rear is rolled and moved forward to a new front drill hole, so that continuous monitoring of gas extraction information is realized. The method and the system directly sense the physical process in the coal seam, the early warning is obviously advanced compared with the traditional roadway gas monitoring, the accuracy is improved through pattern recognition, and meanwhile, the dual early warning of gas disasters and stable drilling is realized, so that the cost is low and the reliability is high.

title_en: Side slope deformation trend prediction method based on three-dimensional point cloud and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope deformation trend prediction method based on three-dimensional point cloud and deep learning, which relates to the technical field of geological disasters and comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring multi-time-sequence three-dimensional point cloud data of a target slope, S2, preprocessing to obtain a standardized time-sequence point cloud data set, S3, extracting slope deformation characteristic parameters from the standardized time-sequence point cloud data set, S4, constructing a prediction model, S5, integrating data into a model training sample, training and optimizing the deep learning prediction model, S6, inputting the data into the trained deep learning prediction model, outputting a deformation trend prediction result of the target slope, S7, carrying out reliability assessment on the deformation trend prediction result, and generating a final prediction report. According to the invention, by fusing the deep learning model of the CNN and the attention mechanism LSTM, the spatial correlation and the time dynamic property of the slope deformation can be simultaneously excavated, compared with the traditional statistical model, the prediction precision is improved, and the method is particularly suitable for long-term deformation trend prediction.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;SHENZHEN FUTIAN DISTRICT CONSTRUCTION ENG QUALITY INSPECTION CENTER

title_en: Front track and rear wheel carrying drilling construction equipment and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides front track and rear wheel carrying drilling construction equipment and a construction method thereof, wherein the front track and rear wheel carrying drilling construction equipment comprises a chassis, front suspension mechanisms and steering mechanisms are respectively arranged at two ends of the chassis, the front suspension mechanism is provided with lifting crawler wheels at two sides, the steering mechanism is provided with a rear suspension mechanism at the bottom, the chassis is provided with a portable drilling machine, the portable drilling machine comprises a drilling base, and the drilling base is provided with a rotating guide frame. The whole structure is suitable for complex terrains and severe environmental conditions, and a drilling machine, a drill rod, a control console, an operator, auxiliary tools and the like are rapidly transported to a designated exploration position. Accurate stratum structure and rock-soil body mechanical parameters are obtained, the entering efficiency of people, machines and materials under severe terrain conditions after disaster is improved, and the rapidity and accuracy of stratum information acquisition after disaster are improved. According to the application, the direction of the drill rod on the power head is adjusted by driving the amplitude cylinder and the stabilizing cylinder of the portable drilling machine so as to adapt to vertical, horizontal or inclined drilling of the drill rod.
assignees: CCCC SECOND HARBOUR ENG CO LTD;ZHONGDIZHUANG BEIJING SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;CHINA GEOLOGICAL EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear leakage quick positioning method based on gridding aerosol online monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear safety on-line monitoring, in particular to a nuclear leakage quick positioning method based on a gridding aerosol on-line monitoring device, which comprises the steps of collecting aerosol radioactivity data through gridding deployed monitoring equipment, identifying suspected abnormal points through threshold comparison, carrying out data cross verification by taking the suspected abnormal points as the center and combining wind direction screening key verification equipment, and generating emergency response signals or interference signals by fusing environment parameter discrimination, thus effectively reducing false alarm; and defining a primary screening range, positioning a suspected leakage source by simulating a diffusion process of a potential leakage source and comparing the diffusion process with measured data, verifying and determining a final leakage source by reversely simulating time matching of historical monitoring data, quantitatively evaluating a diffusion risk level, generating a leakage diffusion list, realizing quick and accurate positioning and dynamic risk evaluation of the nuclear leakage source, and obviously improving the efficiency and reliability of nuclear emergency response.

title_en: Balanced adjusting device and method for collapse prevention holes of internal flow field of extraction drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse-preventing hole balancing adjusting device and method for an internal flow field of an extraction drilling hole, which belong to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and are characterized in that sieve holes with different apertures are formed in a multi-section sieve tube, the diameters of the sieve holes are gradually increased from a drilling hole opening to a hole bottom, so that extraction negative pressure is uniformly distributed in the length direction of the extraction drilling hole, gas at the hole bottom of the extraction drilling hole easily flows into an extraction system, the internal flow field of the extraction drilling hole is changed, the problem of uneven extraction effect of an extraction long drilling hole is effectively avoided, a blank zone of the extraction long drilling hole is eliminated, the gas extraction effect of the extraction long drilling hole bottom is improved, meanwhile, an collapse-preventing ventilation mechanism is integrated, a sealing section is formed by grouting at the hole opening, the sieve holes are effectively supported, the lasting permeation is prevented, and the stability and the sealing performance of the whole extraction system are ensured.

title_en: Mariculture area risk assessment method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a risk assessment method and a risk assessment device for a mariculture area, which are used for realizing the joint simulation of various power elements such as deep water topography, an atmospheric forced field, a typhoon moving path, a tide boundary, sea water temperature and salt flow and the like by constructing a multi-dimensional power element coupling simulation model, so that more real and fine marine environment characteristic information can be obtained. By carrying out bidirectional data exchange between the wind wave model and the hydrodynamic model, key parameters such as wave radiation stress, tide speed, tide level and the like can be synchronously updated, so that the simulation precision under extreme sea conditions is remarkably improved.
