On the basis, the method combines the differential characteristics of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities to respectively determine the risk levels of the cultured organisms and the physical disaster-bearing entities, and further generates the comprehensive risk assessment result facing the target area, so that the actual risk condition can be reflected more accurately, and the scientificity and reliability of disaster early warning and management decision of the mariculture area are improved.

title_en: Large linear cultural heritage multi-scenario long time sequence flood submerged evolution simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large linear cultural heritage multi-scenario long time sequence flood submerged evolution simulation method and system, belonging to the field of climate change influence evaluation and cultural heritage disaster simulation, comprising the steps of acquiring multi-scenario climate data and correcting deviation; the method comprises the steps of calculating extreme precipitation indexes based on data after deviation correction, matching the hourly rain distribution of precipitation with extreme precipitation days to obtain hourly sequence and spatial weight of the extreme precipitation, obtaining parameter data of each river basin based on digital elevation model data and land utilization data, inputting the hourly sequence and spatial weight of each river basin and the parameter data into a flood inundation hydrodynamic model, and carrying out large-scale linear cultural heritage flood inundation evolution simulation. The method effectively solves the problems of coarse space-time resolution, large systematic deviation and the like of global climate model data in regional application, and simultaneously overcomes the bottleneck of overhigh calculation load in long-time sequence and multi-scenario simulation of the traditional high-resolution hydrodynamic model.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR-based power transmission tower inclination monitoring method under submerged condition
abstract_en: The invention provides a power transmission tower gradient monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR under submerged conditions, which comprises the steps of obtaining power transmission tower point cloud data, intercepting horizontal rod section point cloud at the position, close to the water surface, of the bottom of a tower body through a bounding box, carrying out statistical outlier filtering, obtaining tower top three-dimensional coordinates at the same time, adopting a multi-time RANSAC combined PCA strategy to intensively and steadily fit a section main plane from section candidate point sets, orthogonally projecting the section point cloud to the fitting plane, adopting a convex hull-rotary caliper-external square shape regularization strategy to extract a robust section center, calculating horizontal offset, inclination angle and inclination rate according to the section center and the tower top position, and constructing a controllable inclination sample through an axial rotation directional grading inclination simulation verification method to carry out accuracy verification. According to the invention, the inclination evaluation can be completed only by a single horizontal section at the bottom and the position of the tower top, so that the dependence of the traditional method on the basic standard and the complete tower body data is eliminated, and an effective technical approach is provided for the on-line inspection and the post-disaster rapid evaluation of the pole tower.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Flood control engineering emergency treatment management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control engineering emergency disposal management method and system, and belongs to the technical field of flood control engineering. The method comprises the steps of collecting weather data and hydrologic data, preprocessing the weather data and the hydrologic data to obtain a complete weather data set and a complete hydrologic data set, extracting characteristics of the complete weather data to obtain weather characteristic data, training a rainfall forecast model for forecasting rainfall based on the weather characteristic data, generating rainfall forecast data through the rainfall forecasted by the trained rainfall forecast model, carrying out forecast calculation based on the complete hydrologic data set and the rainfall forecast data, generating a forecast scheme, carrying out optimal scheme assessment on the forecast scheme, assessing the optimal forecast scheme, and carrying out flood scheduling based on the optimal forecast scheme. The invention greatly improves the flood control emergency response speed and the accuracy.
assignees: CHINA WATER RESOURCES BEIFANG INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Disaster numerical simulation method and device for tunnel mud bursting and water inrush
abstract_en: The application relates to a numerical simulation method and a numerical simulation device for a disaster caused by mud bursting and water bursting of a tunnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a three-dimensional discrete meta-model of a target area according to geological information of the target area, simulating a water bursting bailer disaster process caused by tunnel excavation by using the three-dimensional discrete meta-model based on tunnel information to obtain a numerical simulation result of the mud bursting and water bursting disaster, adjusting angles corresponding to tunnel crossing fault areas in the tunnel information, and obtaining the numerical simulation results of the mud bursting and water bursting disasters under different tunnel information. By adopting the method, the numerical simulation result of the mud-bursting water disaster simulated by the three-dimensional discrete element simulation under the angles corresponding to the different tunnel-crossing fault areas can be obtained, the subsequent full-depicting of the occurrence process of the mud-bursting water of the tunnel is facilitated, and the accuracy of the simulation result is improved.
assignees: SINOHYDRO BUREAU 7 CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Urban comprehensive pipe rack electric power cabin fire disaster numerical simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire numerical simulation method and a fire numerical simulation system for an electric power cabin of an urban comprehensive pipe gallery, and relates to the technical field of urban infrastructure safety evaluation. Setting a fire source position based on a regional section structural grid model, establishing a fire temperature field space-time evolution model and acquiring air temperature field distribution data, mapping the air temperature field data to the structural grid model to acquire a structural temperature field, performing transient heat-structure coupling analysis to acquire strain field and thermal stress field data, acquiring structural damage data of each grid unit based on the strain field and the thermal stress field data to define a total damage variable, presetting a regional section total damage variable dynamic threshold, and completing evaluation through a result matched with a threshold interval.

title_en: Method for determining key rock stratum of large-scale dumping deformation body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining a key rock stratum of a large-scale dumping deformation body. The method comprises the steps of carrying out geological condition system investigation and ascertaining key geological information of a large-scale dumping deformation body, determining the fracture surface characteristics of the large-scale dumping deformation body by means of drilling, determining the large-scale dumping deformation body as an embedded rock beam type key rock stratum if the embedded rock beam which is good in lithology, has a certain thickness and is complete in structure is arranged at the front, middle and rear parts of the large-scale dumping deformation body, and otherwise, calculating residual unbalanced thrust of each unit rock stratum based on a superposition stress type cantilever beam, an independent stress type cantilever beam and fracture mechanics multiple fracture expansion theory, wherein the peak position of the residual unbalanced thrust can be determined as a progressive dumping type key rock stratum. The method realizes the accurate characterization and judgment of the key rock stratum of the large-scale dumping deformation body, and simultaneously provides key guidance for the research and reinforcement design of the destabilization mechanism of the large-scale dumping deformation body and the disaster early warning.

title_en: Extreme precipitation disaster risk early warning method integrating space-time coupling and topographic effect
abstract_en: The invention provides an extreme precipitation disaster risk early warning method integrating space-time coupling and a topographic effect, which comprises the following steps of performing space-time alignment on multi-source data to ensure accurate matching of different data sources in time and space dimensions, wherein the multi-source data comprise radar reflectivity factors, satellite TBB data and ground precipitation observation data, performing precipitation intensity simulation by combining high-resolution topographic data based on the space-time aligned data, correcting precipitation intensity by combining a weighted fusion algorithm on the basis of the space-time alignment and topographic effect simulation, evaluating the extreme precipitation disaster risk, and sending early warning signals according to evaluation results. The invention can comprehensively capture various factors influencing the rainfall and the disaster risk, obviously improves the prediction accuracy of the extreme rainfall event, and can provide more accurate early warning before the rainfall occurs, thereby helping relevant departments and the public to take countermeasures in time and reducing potential disaster loss.

title_en: Geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster prediction and early warning method and system combining monitoring data and numerical simulation, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, the invention forms a standardized data matrix by laying a plurality of sensors in a geological disaster prone area and preprocessing the data, constructs a catastrophe structure map, calculates the side weight of each variable as a map node, generates a sparse weighted adjacent matrix through threshold screening, updates node characteristics by adopting a neural network, the current catastrophe state is identified through the probability distribution of the full-connection layer output catastrophe stage, the coupling strength index is calculated, similarity matching is carried out, the coupling strength and the structural similarity are comprehensively evaluated, the graph migration weight is obtained, the critical variable threshold value and the time are further predicted, the critical parameter and the neural network identification result are fused to construct a unified risk index model, early warning information and corresponding measures are issued according to the risk grade division, and the structural fusion and dynamic intelligent identification of the multi-source data are realized.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING THREE GORGES;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Disaster scene-oriented negative sample mining enhanced unmanned aerial vehicle image-text retrieval method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image-text retrieval, in particular to a disaster scene-oriented negative sample mining enhanced unmanned aerial vehicle image-text retrieval method which comprises the steps of respectively preprocessing acquired paired image sample data and text sample data, constructing a training set, constructing a coarse-granularity cross-modal alignment module, constructing a fine-granularity difficult-to-negative sample mining module, inputting the training set into an unmanned aerial vehicle image-text retrieval model, training and optimizing the training set to convergence by using a mixed momentum loss function to obtain a training completed model, and inputting the image data and the text data of paired unmanned aerial vehicles to be identified into the training completed model to obtain unmanned aerial vehicle image-text retrieval results.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster deduction method and system based on MPM method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide geological disaster deduction method and system based on an MPM method, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting disaster scene multisource data and synchronously constructing a digital twin body model; the method comprises the steps of adopting a qualitative and quantitative two-stage inversion calibration model, combining a qualitative layer with monitored displacement direction and deformation mode, preliminarily inverting key parameters such as adhesive force, internal friction angle and the like of a sliding belt, calculating a practical deformation range, a collapse position and displacement amount by using the quantitative layer comparison model, optimizing parameters to match a practical landslide state, embedding a rock-soil body aging characteristic model in landslide long-term evolution deduction, describing annual scale parameter degradation by using an exponential function, dividing prediction into continuous analysis steps, and completing current-to-future full-period simulation by means of mass particle method MPM calculation to output a deformation range, displacement amount and a collapse risk result. And reliable decision support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;UNIV WUHAN TECH;CHANGAN UNIV

title_en: Air-ground integrated intelligent agricultural inspection and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and remote sensing monitoring, and particularly discloses an air-ground integrated intelligent agricultural inspection and monitoring system. The system comprises a sky-end aircraft, a ground-end mobile platform and a cloud server, which are interconnected through a multi-level communication module. The aircraft is provided with a multi-mode remote sensing acquisition module and has the capabilities of taking off and landing and data feedback of an ad hoc network, a ground platform is provided with a plurality of soil environment sensors and an edge calculation module to acquire and preprocess environment information, and a cloud server has the functions of data analysis, large model training and agricultural decision making. The system trains the agricultural large model through a self-built multi-mode data set, integrates remote sensing and ground information, and realizes crop state monitoring, anomaly detection and accurate decision. The system has the advantages of high precision, high aging, multi-source coordination and the like, can be widely applied to agricultural inspection, disaster early warning and refined management scenes, and remarkably improves the intelligent level of agricultural monitoring.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA QIANHANG FANGYU TECH CO LTD;BEIJING CHINA TRANSINFO INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety agent construction system and method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data processing, in particular to a security intelligent agent construction system and method based on a large model. The method comprises the steps of constructing a low-temperature liquid leakage knowledge base, collecting normal operation condition data, training a leakage perception model in an unsupervised mode, configuring a large model with a tool calling interface as a safety intelligent agent, synchronously collecting multi-mode data in real time, generating a preliminary abnormal alarm through the perception model and retrieving associated information, fusing the multi-mode information by the intelligent agent to conduct leakage prediction analysis and comprehensive research and judgment, automatically calling a professional tool to conduct quantitative result simulation on a confirmed leakage event, and generating a situational treatment scheme. The invention effectively overcomes the dependence on the rare leakage sample, improves the detection reliability, greatly improves the accuracy of research and judgment through knowledge enhancement and multi-mode fusion, realizes the full-flow automation from early perception and intelligent analysis to the result severity division, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and emergency response efficiency of industrial safety monitoring.
assignees: NANJING LIANCHENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Bridge disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge disaster early warning system, and relates to the technical field of bridge monitoring. The bridge health condition monitoring system comprises a bridge real-time monitoring module, a satellite positioning module, a data transmission module, a data management module and a simulation display module, wherein the bridge real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring bridge health condition data in real time through automatic monitoring equipment, the satellite positioning module is arranged at the top end of the automatic monitoring equipment to obtain monitoring data with positioning information, the data transmission module is used for transmitting the monitoring data with the positioning information to the data management module, the data management module is used for analyzing the monitoring data to determine whether a bridge disaster occurs or not and outputting disaster early warning information, and the simulation display module is used for marking the bridge damage position through building a bridge three-dimensional model and visually displaying the bridge health condition and the disaster early warning information. The bridge disaster early warning system and method realize timely visual early warning of bridge disasters, provide reliable basis for daily maintenance of the bridge, and reduce accident occurrence probability.

title_en: Test device for simulating continuous drought disaster of crops under different slopes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for simulating continuous drought disaster of crops under different slopes, which relates to the technical field of agricultural planting and is arranged in one or more groups, and particularly comprises a support frame and a planting frame, wherein one end of the support frame is in running fit with one end of the planting frame through a rotary connecting piece, a lifting part for controlling the rotation of the planting frame relative to the support frame is arranged between the support frame and the planting frame, and comprises a connecting rod, an internal thread slide bar, a threaded rod and a shell.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Method for generating highway engineering feasibility research report based on local large model training
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for generating a highway engineering feasibility research report based on local large model training, which integrates multi-source data based on a locally deployed large model, extracts a standard field through regularization and constructs a highway engineering knowledge graph, and realizes mapping and verification from a fuzzy policy to a structured field. By adopting TensorRT acceleration reasoning, a canonical glossary is injected, the term consistency is optimized by combining contrast learning, and a canonical text is generated through LoRA fine tuning and rewarding functions. After the route parameters are input, geometric features and a recommended bypass scheme of the associated disaster database are calculated, and chapter contents are generated. Outputting a formal report based on the template, and ensuring data consistency through cross verification. And (3) adopting RPA grabbing standard update, combining Kafka and Faiss vector library to realize compliance verification, triggering knowledge graph increment update and conflict correction, and forming a full-flow automatic and intelligent feasibility study report generating system.
assignees: JIANGXI HIGHWAY RES AND DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Integrated incremental learning method and system for icing prediction of power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of anti-icing and disaster reduction of transmission lines, in particular to an integrated incremental learning method and system for icing prediction of a transmission line, comprising the steps of collecting icing data of the transmission line and preprocessing the data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing icing data, constructing an icing data set based on the preprocessed icing data, training the icing data set, constructing an icing prediction model, predicting the icing condition based on the constructed icing prediction model, and incrementally updating the prediction model. The method can predict the icing condition of the power transmission line, accurately and real-timely identify the equivalent icing thickness of the wire, solve the problems of low prediction precision, poor generalization capability and the like of an offline model, and provide technical reference for intelligent operation and maintenance of the icing line.

title_en: Flood and secondary disaster collaborative early warning method and system suitable for karst landform
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of disaster early warning, and provides a flood and secondary disaster cooperative early warning method and system suitable for karst landforms, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster factor data of a target area; the method comprises the steps of inputting disaster factor data into a preset hydrogeological coupling model, outputting surface water depth, underground river key node water level and water pressure change values of different positions of a target area, determining comprehensive risk levels of different positions of the target area according to the surface water depth, the underground river key node water level and the water pressure change values, dividing the comprehensive risk levels into a first level, a second level and a third level from high to low, and automatically generating adaptive cooperative early warning information when the comprehensive risk level of any position exceeds a preset risk threshold of an electric power facility at the current position. The collaborative simulation and the accurate early warning of the underground disaster process of the earth surface of the karst landform area are realized, and the early warning capability of flood and secondary disasters in a complex geological environment is remarkably improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Fire risk assessment method and device for energy storage power station and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire risk assessment, in particular to a fire risk assessment method, a fire risk assessment device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium of an energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining structural information and equipment information of the energy storage power station and constructing a three-dimensional simulation model; based on the disaster situation diffusion trend under various emergency situations, the fire-fighting equipment deployed by the energy storage power station and the corresponding emergency response plan, the emergency response plan is simulated in the multi-physical-field simulation process, and the simulation result is subjected to fire-fighting risk assessment to obtain an assessment result. The physical characteristics and fire dynamics are utilized for modeling, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of fire extinguishing design are improved, the design cost and the time investment are obviously reduced, and a powerful guarantee is provided for the fire safety of the energy storage power station.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RES INST;INNER MONGOLIA SHANGDU POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Disaster situation-oriented rapid drawing simulation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster simulation mapping systems, in particular to a rapid drawing simulation system for disaster situations, wherein a hidden Markov model is used for statistical modeling of a stage demarcation sequence, a stage mean value and a continuous ratio are used as statistical characteristics in a state transition matrix, self-adaptive updating of probability distribution among stages of disaster intensity is realized through weight adjustment and change chain construction of a high-frequency transition stage group, continuity and statistical stability of a disaster evolution process are maintained, a path calculation adopts a Dijiestra algorithm, a path cost matrix is formed by superposing gradient, friction and energy loss parameters among geographic nodes, spatial precision and energy diffusion rationality of disaster propagation direction deduction are improved, clustering and grading are carried out on a fluctuation value and a distance mean value in a mapping grid system, and multi-stage risk spatial distribution is generated, so that the spatial hierarchical difference of high-risk nodes is quantitatively expressed.

title_en: Construction method and device of spreading type geological displacement and vibration monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method and a device of a spreading type geological displacement and vibration monitoring system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and aim at the problems of limitation of the existing system layout, insufficient data fusion, high cost, dependence on pre-training and response hysteresis; the distributed star sensor network is constructed, 100-node time synchronization precision is achieved based on a domestic low-power wide area network, the precision is less than 500ms, a dynamic situation map and a multi-parameter early warning model are combined, four-level risk assessment is achieved by adopting an unsupervised AI large model, and the accuracy rate is more than 90%. And the low-power consumption power supply and multimode communication are optimized, the continuous voyage is realized for more than 1 year under the environment of-40 ℃ to 80 ℃, and the communication failure rate is less than 1%. The system supports one-time throwing deployment, displacement monitoring error is less than 5%, and the problems of complex terrain coverage and accurate early warning are effectively solved.

title_en: Automatic monitoring method for monitoring stratum collapse by using soil pressure gauge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses an automatic monitoring method for monitoring stratum collapse by utilizing a soil pressure gauge, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a stratum collapse hidden trouble point area through detection, drilling and cleaning, placing a sleeve in a monitoring hole, layering a plurality of soil pressure gauges along different depths in the axial direction of the sleeve, and filling and compacting a backfill layer to enable the soil pressure gauge to be at a set pressure value; the method solves the problems that the existing monitoring method only can monitor single-direction deformation and equipment is complex to install, realizes real-time and automatic monitoring of pressure changes of different depths of a stratum, improves timeliness and accuracy of the early warning, has lower cost and is suitable for collapse scenes of various stratums.
assignees: SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor coupled dry-type transformer fire disaster characteristic and fire extinguishing efficiency comprehensive test platform and test method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of transformer safety detection and fireproof research, and particularly relates to a multi-factor coupling dry type transformer fire disaster characteristic and fire extinguishing efficiency comprehensive test platform and a test method. The intelligent fire extinguishing system comprises a full-size transformer for simulating the thermal-electric coupling effect under the real working condition, an insulating material module, an environment control chamber, a fire extinguishing system, a data acquisition system and an intelligent control center, wherein the insulating material module is arranged inside the full-size transformer, the environment control chamber is used for accommodating the full-size transformer, the fire extinguishing system comprises a fire extinguishing agent tank and an injection pipeline laid in the environment control chamber, the data acquisition system comprises a high-speed shooting-infrared thermal imaging system arranged around the environment control chamber, and the intelligent control center is in communication connection with the full-size transformer, the environment control chamber, the fire extinguishing system and the data acquisition system. The invention can truly reproduce the formation, spreading and extinguishing processes of the transformer fire, and the experimental result is closer to the actual running state, and has the advantages of strong authenticity, good repeatability, wide application range and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban system toughness dynamic measurement method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for dynamically measuring toughness of an urban system, which relate to the field of urban disaster management and risk assessment, and comprise the steps of obtaining toughness index data and disaster environment data of a target city; the method comprises the steps of determining initial storm impact indexes according to disaster environment data, constructing a toughness index system according to toughness index data and the initial storm impact indexes, respectively calculating weighted comprehensive indexes of all toughness dimensions according to all toughness index values under all toughness dimensions to obtain a plurality of toughness attribute parameter values, simulating system performance change of a target city after disaster impact according to all the toughness attribute parameter values by adopting a parameterized gamma group recovery function model to generate a dynamic performance recovery curve, and calculating dynamic toughness quantification values and recovery time of the target city based on the dynamic performance recovery curve. The application can dynamically simulate the whole process of impact-response-recovery for the city, and improves the accuracy of urban toughness measurement.

title_en: Power transmission line disaster monitoring data fusion analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission line disaster monitoring data fusion analysis method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical meteorological data in a target area, obtaining satellite remote sensing data of the target area, extracting a plurality of micro-topography factors, obtaining standing accounts and space topology information of the power transmission line in the target area, obtaining anti-galloping vulnerability indexes of each line section, constructing and training a statistical interpolation model and a machine learning fusion model based on the historical meteorological data and the micro-topography factors to generate a meteorological element sequence along the power transmission line of the target area, calculating historical galloping occurrence frequency and strength of the target area based on the meteorological element sequence, the anti-galloping vulnerability indexes and a multi-meteorological element cooperative threshold condition, and combining meteorological prediction data to obtain a galloping disaster dynamic risk early warning result of the power transmission line. According to the invention, the anti-galloping vulnerability index, the multi-meteorological element cooperative threshold value and the meteorological prediction data are combined, so that the accuracy of disaster risk early warning results is improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: New energy field group emergency treatment method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy field group emergency processing method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly integrating power generation equipment monitoring data, meteorological observation data and power grid scheduling information to form a real-time data set in a unified format, identifying equipment fault types by adopting an anomaly detection algorithm based on the data set to generate an anomaly event sequence, searching a reference case from an emergency knowledge base through similarity matching for unrecognized anomalies, expanding anomaly event description, extracting bottleneck stages and dependency relations of an emergency response path by adopting a process analysis technology to construct a critical path structure diagram, combining resource allocation data, determining a time node sequence by applying a priority ordering rule, and finally generating a customized emergency management scheme by simulating and verifying optimized personnel configuration. The invention obviously improves the efficiency and accuracy of the abnormal processing of the power generation equipment group, and ensures the running stability of the power grid and the high efficiency of emergency response.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Impact-gas composite dynamic disaster in-situ simulation test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact-gas composite dynamic disaster in-situ simulation test system and method, and relates to the technical field of deep mines and engineering. The system comprises an outer shell and an inner shell, wherein the inner shell is positioned inside the outer shell, a three-way pressurizing device, a counter-force frame and a collapse device are arranged between the outer shell and the inner shell, a mining robot is arranged behind the inner shell, a heating plate is arranged below the inner shell, and the counter-force frame and the outer shell are respectively provided with an air charging hole. The test method comprises the steps of loading coal rock test pieces, applying three-dimensional stress, simulating ground temperature, filling gas, keeping the pressure balance of the inner cavity and the outer cavity, and then simulating induced disasters through the operation of a mining robot and the collapse of a top plate. The method can comprehensively restore the site coal seam occurrence environment and the disaster evolution process, realize the integrated simulation of single disasters and composite disasters, can be used for analyzing the disaster-causing rules of the composite disaster evolution and the critical condition of the transition of the single disasters to the composite disasters, and provides technical support for disaster prevention and control of deep mines.

title_en: Real-time true and false early warning distinguishing method based on small-sized slope crack meter sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time true and false early warning distinguishing method based on a small-sized slope crack meter sensor, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing time sequence data in a construction data set, inputting a pre-constructed real early warning prediction probability generation model to carry out multi-fold cross training and super-parameter optimization, inputting a real-time acquired crack meter displacement sequence triggering equipment alarm and synchronous rainfall data thereof, preprocessing, inputting a plurality of trained early warning recognition models to obtain a plurality of early warning probability outputs, averaging early warning probabilities output by the plurality of models, judging an integrated result based on a preset probability threshold, finally outputting a recognition conclusion that the current alarm is real early warning or false early warning, and pushing the conclusion and corresponding confidence level to a monitoring platform. The invention realizes real-time early warning and identification of the end-to-end crack meter and effectively reduces the early warning and false alarm rate of equipment.

title_en: Fire exercise and escape simulation method and system based on VR technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire exercise and escape simulation method and system based on a VR technology, wherein the fire exercise and escape simulation method based on the VR technology comprises the following steps of S1, creating a virtual fire scene according to a pre-constructed fire scene model and scene parameter information set by an administrator, S2, acquiring behavior data and selection data of participants in the virtual fire scene in real time, dynamically adjusting exercise tasks according to the behavior data and the selection data, and S3, acquiring behavior sequence data and corresponding environment state evolution data of the participants recorded in the operation period of S2, performing grading analysis based on preset fire control grading rules, and generating and outputting feedback reports. According to the invention, by constructing the virtual disaster environment capable of dynamically responding and the intelligent evaluation closed loop driven by data, the training effect and scientificity of emergency exercise are improved.
assignees: CGN ZHIZAO TECH SUZHOU CO LTD;SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST

title_en: Disaster situation-oriented harbor power grid toughness optimization method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a harbour power grid toughness optimization method, system and medium for disaster situations, which comprises the steps of determining the optimal energy storage equipment layout and capacity configuration by adopting a pre-disaster optimization model in a pre-disaster stage of a harbour power grid, wherein the pre-disaster optimization model is a two-stage optimization model, the first stage is used for optimizing the arrangement and investment of energy storage equipment, the second stage is used for simulating load reduction and power flow optimization adjustment in the most unfavorable scene after disaster, the scheduling scheme of a distributed power supply, the energy storage equipment and an electric automobile is obtained by adopting the in-disaster optimization model in the disaster stage of the harbour power grid so as to optimize power supply, the in-disaster optimization model aims at minimizing load loss and guaranteeing important user power supply priority, and the post-disaster recovery stage of the harbour power grid adopts a post-disaster recovery reconstruction model to optimize the switching state, the node electrification condition and the load recovery strategy of the harbour power grid. Compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively pre-configure the distributed power supply and the mobile energy storage.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Landslide type spatial prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide type space prediction method, which relates to the technical field of landslide disaster space prediction, and mainly comprises the steps of obtaining a mixed data set according to a landslide database and satellite images, preprocessing, dividing the preprocessed mixed data set into a training set and a testing set according to a preset proportion, carrying out binary vulnerability evaluation on various machine learning models by utilizing the data set, adopting a multi-objective parameter optimization method, selecting a machine learning model with optimal performance as a landslide type space prediction model, resampling the training set, training the landslide type space prediction model, and using a prediction mode and key disaster causing factors of a SHAP algorithm and a KL divergence analysis model according to a confusion matrix and a result of the landslide type space prediction. By implementing the landslide type spatial prediction method provided by the invention, the reliability and the interpretability of the landslide type spatial prediction can be improved.

title_en: Fine three-dimensional geological modeling method based on geophysical prospecting three-dimensional positive inversion algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a refined three-dimensional geological modeling method based on a geophysical prospecting three-dimensional inversion algorithm, which belongs to the field of geological exploration, and comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data and constructing an initial model, and obtaining a three-dimensional physical model by combining a constraint three-dimensional inversion algorithm; the lithology classifier is created, a three-dimensional lithology probability body is generated according to the three-dimensional physical model, geological structure boundary enhancement is carried out, geological classification is carried out based on the probability body, an equivalent surface is extracted from the three-dimensional lithology probability body, a preliminary geological interface is generated, construction processing is carried out, and then attribute model coupling is carried out, and a model is output. The method directly builds the space continuous model through three-dimensional joint inversion, avoids interpolation errors between survey lines, forcibly matches drilling data and performs geophysical prospecting data trend control, combines local precision and global rationality, is driven by a full-flow algorithm from inversion to lithology classification, reduces manual intervention, and is suitable for high-precision scenes such as urban underground space, mineral exploration, geological disaster assessment and the like.

title_en: Disaster scheduling method and device for power distribution system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster scheduling method and device for a power distribution system and electronic equipment. The disaster scheduling method comprises the steps of obtaining system parameters of a power distribution system, simulating disaster parameters in a disaster influence range to obtain a plurality of disaster simulation scenes, determining road section scheduling parameters corresponding to the disaster simulation scenes, respectively, calling disaster scheduling functions and constraint conditions corresponding to the disaster scheduling functions, solving a pre-disaster scheduling function under the constraint conditions according to the power distribution network parameters, the traffic network parameters and the road section scheduling parameters to obtain a pre-disaster scheduling strategy, and solving a pre-disaster scheduling function under the constraint conditions according to the real-time power distribution network parameters, the actual damage scene and the pre-disaster scheduling strategy to obtain the pre-disaster scheduling strategy under the constraint conditions under the condition that the disaster occurs, and controlling the pre-disaster scheduling strategy to schedule. The method and the system solve the technical problem that in the related technology, accurate dynamic scheduling of the power distribution network system is difficult to realize in a disaster scene.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Real-time modeling method and system for power transmission line disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time modeling method and a real-time modeling system for a disaster scene unmanned aerial vehicle of a power transmission line, relates to the technical field of power operation and maintenance, and aims at a global positioning system signal loss scene to solve the problems of pose drift and difficult alignment of subgraphs in the case of weak common vision in the traditional method. The global pose optimization model fuses the historical constraint of preprocessing training data, the single machine positioning result of local pose data and the visual characteristics of an operation key frame image set, an internal constraint system without external positioning signals is constructed, pose errors are corrected, strong dependence on an image common view area is broken, efficient fusion of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle pose stability and local data is realized, early data preprocessing, pose resolving and later three-dimensional reconstruction are combined, a real-time dense map generating period is shortened, support is provided for positioning faults after power transmission line disasters, damage assessment and emergency repair scheme formulation, and emergency response efficiency and reliability are improved.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Marine converter station structure optimization method and device for multiple natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for optimizing a structure of an offshore converter station facing multiple natural disasters, and belongs to the field of structural optimization of offshore converter stations; and finally, if the simulation data verification result meets the preset disaster resistance threshold, carrying out structural optimization according to the first structural optimization scheme, otherwise, carrying out secondary optimization on the first structural optimization scheme to obtain a second structural optimization scheme and carrying out structural optimization according to the second structural optimization scheme. Therefore, by implementing the invention, the problem that the disaster resistance improving effect of the structural optimization of the offshore converter station is difficult to improve while the engineering economy is ensured in the prior art can be solved.

title_en: Disaster condition state risk assessment model construction method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster condition assessment and discloses a disaster condition risk assessment model construction method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of judging the disaster threat degree of each disaster type according to disaster risk indexes, generating a disaster assessment chain rule of a target assessment point and disaster scene analysis requirements, and constructing a disaster condition risk assessment model service chain; the disaster state risk assessment model service chain is combined with the service quality index, a combined link is selected from the disaster causing risk assessment model group, the disaster scene simulation analysis function is realized by utilizing the combined link, the semantic extraction function is generated by utilizing a residual network based on the combined link, the disaster state risk assessment model is established by combining the deep reinforcement learning technology, and the disaster state risk assessment of the target assessment point is realized. The invention can improve the stability and controllability of the whole evaluation flow, and obviously improve the scientificity, efficiency and practicability of disaster condition risk evaluation.

title_en: Evacuation exercise method, system, equipment and medium based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent safety drilling and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evacuation drilling based on virtual reality, which comprise the steps of generating a three-dimensional virtual scene comprising a plurality of key evaluation points based on scene data; the method comprises the steps of generating real-time behavior instructions based on real-time behavior data, driving virtual characters to conduct corresponding behaviors, recording real-time life values, generating life value sequences according to time sequences, extracting selection data of the virtual characters at key evaluation points based on the real-time behavior instructions, generating actual exercise routes, comparing the actual exercise routes with preset standard exercise routes to obtain route comparison results, acquiring real-time physiological data and evacuation exercise duration when evacuation exercise is conducted, and generating exercise evaluation reports based on the life value sequences, route comparison results, the real-time physiological data and the evacuation exercise duration. By implementing the technical scheme provided by the application, the reliability of evacuation exercise in virtual reality can be improved.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model discloses geological drilling investigation equipment for preventing and controlling geological disasters, which comprises a drilling investigation trolley, a drilling investigation sampling mechanism and a controller, wherein a ground pile inserting assembly is arranged at the bottom of the drilling investigation trolley at four corner positions, the drilling investigation sampling mechanism comprises a positioning rotary drum, a slotting assembly and a sampling assembly, the slotting assembly comprises a slotting drill bit, a second bearing, a slotting motor, a pushing-down block and a pushing-down motor, the sampling assembly comprises a sampling inserted rod, a plurality of sampling components, a fixed-depth downward-moving motor and a downward-moving screw rod, the sampling components are arranged on the sampling inserted rod at equal intervals, a fine-tuning motor is arranged in the drilling investigation trolley, and the controller is used for controlling the equipment to work. According to the utility model, the sampling inserting rod is accurately inserted into the slot, a plurality of sampling components which are arranged on the sampling inserting rod at equal intervals can be positioned to an accurate depth, each sampling component extends out of the sampling inserting rod and is inserted into soil for sampling, and a plurality of layers of sample images can be taken at a time, so that the sampling effect is good.
assignees: LIAONING NUCLEAR IND GEOLOGY 241 GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Ontology-Based Language Model Training Method for Disaster Safety Response and Disaster Safety Information Providing Method and System Using the Same
title_ko: 재난 안전 대처를 위한 온톨로지 기반의 언어모델 학습 방법 및 이를 이용한 재난 안전 정보 제공방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 재난안전정보 제공방법에 관한 것으로서 재난안전에 관련된 데이터를 구조화함으로써 온톨로지를 생성하고, 생성된 온톨로지를 기반으로 언어모델을 학습시킴으로써 재난 안전과 관련된 사용자의 질의에 대해 재난안전 SOP를 실시간으로 생성하여 사용자에게 제공할 수 있어 누구나 신속하고 정확한 재난안전관련 정보를 쉽게 제공받을 수 있는 재난안전정보 제공방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Disaster scene support method and server performing the same
title_ko: 재난 현장 지원 방법 및 이를 수행하는 인공지능 에이전트 서버
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 현장에서의 자동화된 의사 결정을 지원하는 인공지능 에이전트 서버에서의 재난 현장 지원 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 상황에 대한 타겟 음성 데이터를 텍스트로 변환하는 단계; 상기 텍스트를 사전에 마련되는 재난 특화 언어 모델에 입력하여 상기 재난 상황에 대응되는 재난 메타데이터를 추출하는 단계; 상기 재난 메타데이터를 사전에 마련되는 지리 정보 시스템(GIS, Geographic Information System)에 매핑하여 좌표 정보를 생성하는 단계; 상기 좌표 정보를 기준으로 상기 좌표 정보에 매칭되는 외부 환경 정보를 수집하는 단계; 상기 재난 메타데이터 및 상기 외부 환경 정보를 결합한 정보를 사전에 마련되는 재난 예측 모델에 입력하여 재난 예측 시나리오를 도출하는 단계; 및 상기 재난 예측 시나리오를 시각화하여 출력하는 단계를 포함한다. 이를 통해 재난/재해 상황에서 현장 보고, 상황 분석, 예측 및 대응 방안 도출까지 재난/재해 상황의 대응 과정 전반에 대한 자동화 및 고속화가 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training, relates to the technical field of firefighting training safety, and aims to solve the problems of difficult personnel positioning, communication distortion delay, low efficiency of video monitoring and untimely safety intervention in the existing firefighting training. The system comprises a personnel positioning subsystem based on UWB, a real-time communication subsystem based on WebRTC and a training guide management subsystem, wherein the UWB personnel positioning subsystem realizes accurate positioning and track tracking of different training spaces, the WebRTC real-time communication subsystem realizes multi-mode real-time voice interaction and voice-text conversion, and the training guide management subsystem realizes positioning display, communication scheduling, video linkage and alarm control through front and rear end cooperation. The system can improve the safety monitoring precision and the scheduling efficiency in the training of firefighters, simultaneously supports the backtracking and the rewinding of the training process, and provides technical support for the safety guarantee and the efficiency improvement of the firefighting training.

title_en: Urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on disaster-bearing body function destruction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood disaster chain propagation simulation method based on a disaster bearing body function destruction mechanism, relates to the field of hydraulic engineering and disaster prevention and reduction, and solves the problems of insufficient mechanism description, imperfect relevance analysis and the like of the conventional method. The method comprises the steps of inputting flood inundation scenes, combining a disaster-bearing body direct function destruction mechanism and an indirect function destruction mechanism, determining a core disaster-bearing body destruction threshold and probability distribution, identifying a direct destruction unit, establishing a life line facility function association network, calculating the total function failure probability of the disaster-bearing body, identifying an indirect destruction unit, updating the function states of the disaster-bearing body scene by scene, constructing a space propagation model, forming different scene disaster chain networks, and finally outputting key information. The invention can accurately simulate the disaster chain propagation, improves the scientificity of risk assessment and emergency response, and provides reference for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Polarization SAR image classification method based on polarization rotation domain ViT and complex phase gating activation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polarized SAR image classification method based on polarization rotation domain ViT and complex phase gating activation in the technical field of image processing, which is characterized in that a rotation domain feature sequence is generated through polarization coherent matrix rotation transformation, global space-time features are extracted by an input rotation domain ViT encoder after complex convolution embedding, CPGLU activation function processing and azimuth position coding enhancement, regional consistency is optimized by combining super-pixel constraint loss, classification confidence is output, model training adopts a migration learning and AdamW optimizer, parameters are updated through data enhancement strategies during each round of training, and the method solves the problems of insufficient utilization of complex information, insufficient rotation sensitivity feature mining and interference of speckle noise in the traditional polarized SAR classification technology, and can be widely applied to polarized SAR remote sensing interpretation scenes such as agricultural monitoring, urban drawing, disaster assessment and the like.
assignees: YANGZHOU POLYTECHNIC INST;NANJING YUDADIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water level prediction method and system for disaster prevention of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction in the power industry, and discloses a water level prediction method and a system for power grid disaster prevention, wherein a space-time diagram neural network taking a platform area as a node and a river channel as a side is constructed by acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data of each platform area in a power grid; the method comprises the steps of carrying out physical constraint on a space-time diagram neural network based on a Saint Violet equation, constructing a target space-time diagram neural network model, carrying out countermeasure training on the target space-time diagram neural network model to generate a reinforced prediction model, and carrying out water level prediction on a target platform area by adopting the reinforced prediction model to generate a water level prediction report. According to the method, through the collaborative innovation of deep coupling modeling of the physical laws and the space-time diagram network, robust enhancement of countermeasure training and physical interpretability analysis, comprehensive improvement of water level prediction accuracy, long-term stability and interpretability is achieved, the problem of prediction drift caused by embedding and deleting of the physical laws in the traditional method is effectively solved, and reliable technical support is provided for water immersion disaster early warning of the power grid.
assignees: YUNFU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method for simulating numerical value of erosion based on semi-implicit two-phase object particle method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating numerical values based on a semi-implicit two-phase object particle method, which relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering numerical simulation, and comprises the steps of generalizing unsaturated easily-eroded pile-up soil into a two-phase multi-component medium based on a mixture theory; establishing a solid-liquid dual-phase grid system, establishing a core control equation of seepage and erosion in a soil body, transmitting substance point information of a solid phase and a liquid phase to corresponding background grid nodes in the dual-layer grid system, applying boundary conditions on background grids of the dual-layer grid system, performing semi-implicit solving on the core control equation, mapping the obtained node speed to the substance points, judging whether the relative speed of the solid phase and the liquid phase exceeds a seepage speed threshold value, updating state variable information carried by the two-phase substance points, correcting permeability and saturation, and judging whether calculation reaches a specified time or whether the soil body reaches a yield limit. The invention has important theoretical and engineering practical values for solving the problem of simulating the erosion disaster of the accumulated soil.

title_en: Dimension reduction simulation method and system for near fault multi-point multi-dimensional all-non-stationary earthquake motion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dimension reduction simulation method and system for near-fault multi-point multi-dimension full-non-stationary earthquake motion, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake engineering and disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of screening near fault strong shock records containing horizontal and vertical speed pulses, fitting the extracted pulses by using a Gabor wavelet model, identifying low-frequency key parameters, establishing probability distribution, simulating a high-frequency component by using a 1D-nV non-stationary random vector process, combining a random orthogonal function to reduce the dimension, selecting points through a number theory and carrying out inverse probability transformation to generate a representative point set, substituting the representative point set into the model to generate a high-low frequency speed time course, and superposing the high-low frequency speed time course to obtain a seismic shock sample with complete probability information. The system comprises data screening, parameter identification and other modules. The invention uses few random variables to generate samples meeting the precision, improves the simulation efficiency, and can be used for dynamic response and earthquake-resistant reliability analysis of engineering structures by combining a probability density evolution theory.

title_en: Three-dimensional ocean element field reconstruction method based on multivariate empirical orthogonal function decomposition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment monitoring and numerical simulation, and relates to a three-dimensional marine element field reconstruction method based on multivariate empirical orthogonal function decomposition. The method comprises the steps of S1, multi-source data collaborative preprocessing, S2 and MEOF joint mode extraction, S3, vertical projection operator optimization construction, S4, three-dimensional element field dynamic reconstruction, S5 and multi-source data fusion verification. The method breaks through the limitations of precision, efficiency and adaptability in three-dimensional field reconstruction in the prior art by organically combining multivariate modal decomposition and physical constraint projection, provides a key technical support for real-time monitoring of marine dynamic environment, and can be widely applied to the fields of marine disaster early warning, underwater engineering safety guarantee and the like.

title_en: Extra-large high-pressure tunnel group fault-fracture-resistant analysis system for crossing movable fracture
abstract_en: The application discloses an ultra-large high-pressure tunnel group fault-fracture-resistant analysis system for crossing active fracture, which is characterized by comprising a data monitoring module, a simulation module, an analysis module, a prediction module, an evaluation module and a feedback module, an intelligent analysis system covering data acquisition, model construction, risk identification, early warning response and information visualization is constructed. Compared with the existing technical means relying on static models or single parameter judgment, the system introduces a deep learning model and a multi-parameter coupling mechanism, realizes dynamic identification and accurate prediction of the earthquake induced structural effect, and can dynamically quantify potential influence of fracture zone activities on tunnel group structures through the model, thereby providing scientific basis for stability early warning, operation and maintenance strategy optimization and emergency response of tunnels during and after an earthquake.

title_en: Post-disaster recovery analysis method and system for building group coupled with earthquake and secondary fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster recovery analysis method and system for building groups coupled with earthquakes and secondary fires, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining earthquake motion input data; according to earthquake motion input data, a building group earthquake motion analysis model is used for obtaining a building group earthquake motion result, according to the building group earthquake motion result, a fire spreading simulation considering the influence of building height is conducted to obtain a building group earthquake post-second fire spreading result, according to the building group earthquake motion result and the building group earthquake post-second fire spreading result, a building floor damage state is obtained through a coupling rule, according to the damage state, the functional loss and the repair requirement of a building are evaluated, according to the functional loss and the repair requirement of the building, a post-disaster recovery process of the building group is simulated through a system dynamics model, and repair cost and repair time are output to obtain a building group post-disaster recovery analysis result.

title_en: Method for predicting fire situation of long tunnel in real time based on image recognition and physical information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time prediction method for fire situations of a long tunnel based on image identification and physical information fusion, which comprises the steps of 1, building a large-gradient tunnel fire simulation device with a contracted size under a complex ventilation mode, building a large-gradient tunnel fire data set, 2, building a large-gradient tunnel fire parameter prediction network based on Vision Transformer framework, and 3, building a total loss function of the large-gradient tunnel fire parameter prediction network And training is carried out, so that an optimal fire parameter prediction model is obtained and is used for predicting the fire images and physical information of the long gradient tunnel to obtain the fire parameters of the long gradient tunnel. The invention can realize the dynamic simulation of the fire disaster of the long-gradient tunnel under the complex ventilation mode, and predict the heat release rate of the fire disaster of the long-gradient tunnel with different gradients/pressure intensity/fuel/height/position and different positions under the coupling effect of the complex ventilation mode in Shi Gongyun-dimensional stage according to the flame image and the physical information in real time, and the temperature and the heat flow distribution under the ceiling.

title_en: Physical-driven shallow-buried tunnel excavation deformation evolution prediction method and related device for arbitrary section
abstract_en: The application discloses a physical-driven shallow-buried tunnel excavation deformation evolution prediction method with arbitrary section and a related device, relating to the technical field of tunnel disaster prediction, the method comprises the steps of inputting geological parameters and mechanical performance indexes of a target tunnel into a trained deformation evolution prediction model to obtain a target global displacement prediction result, and accordingly obtaining a visualized graph of tunnel excavation deformation evolution. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a tunnel inner boundary parameterization analysis function corresponding to each sample data by means of a corner-preserving mapping method and a complex function analysis method, obtaining an inner boundary analysis set based on the tunnel inner boundary parameterization analysis function corresponding to all the sample data, and optimizing an initial deformation evolution prediction model based on a training data set and the inner boundary analysis set to obtain a trained deformation evolution prediction model. The method and the device remarkably improve accuracy, calculation efficiency and adaptability of deformation evolution prediction in the tunnel excavation process.

title_en: Automatic monitoring method for monitoring stratum collapse by using layered settlement meter
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses an automatic monitoring method for monitoring stratum collapse by using a layered settlement meter, which comprises the following steps of 1) monitoring holes and installing isolation pipes; step 2), placing an isolation tube with a magnetic ring into a monitoring hole, step 3), filling backfill soil layers into gaps between the outer wall of the isolation tube and the hole wall of the monitoring hole, step 4), adjusting the relative positions of a plurality of magnetic layering sedimentation sensors on a core rod to enable the positions of the magnetic layering sedimentation sensors to be matched with the positions of the magnetic ring, then installing the core rod into the isolation tube, step 5), matching a data acquisition terminal on the core rod, and simultaneously configuring power supply equipment on the data acquisition terminal, and realizing layering monitoring of different depths of stratum by drilling the isolation tube at hidden danger points, arranging the magnetic ring and the magnetic layering sedimentation sensors, breaking the limitation that the traditional monitoring is difficult to accurately position the sedimentation layers, and clearly capturing the sedimentation dynamics of stratum at each depth.
assignees: SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-network cascading failure propagation prediction method based on heterogeneous graph neural network under disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-network chained fault propagation prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network under a disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of the disaster, electric power, communication and traffic networks, constructing a four-layer heterogeneous graph model, defining multi-type interlayer edges, establishing a mapping relation between disaster physical quantity and physical node health states, predicting initial fault states at disaster impact time, defining multi-scale multi-mechanism propagation rules based on the interlayer edges, simulating chained fault processes, constructing a space-time heterogeneous graph neural network model, stacking a heterogeneous graph neural network module and a gating circulation unit module, adopting a double-head prediction layer to predict node continuous running states and discrete functional states in an autoregressive mode, carrying out post-processing on a state time sequence output by the model, and reconstructing a cross-domain chained fault propagation path through a causal attribution algorithm. The invention can accurately simulate the whole evolution process from disaster occurrence to multi-network cascading failure, and realize multi-scale failure prediction and causal analysis.
assignees: JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Storm prediction method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm prediction method and a system based on multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of weather prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of reading a historical rainfall record in a preset time zone, carrying out local boundary segmentation based on scene differentiation aiming at a target area, and determining a regional grid; the method comprises the steps of calling a multi-source observation record based on a multi-source data interface, executing fusion supervision training to generate a storm prediction model, training an influence pre-evaluation model, reading real-time observation data based on the multi-source data interface, executing a prediction result based on the storm prediction model to determine a prediction evaluation result, executing self-adaptive matching and decision on the prediction evaluation result to determine a risk prevention and control instruction, and executing wind control management based on a risk grid area, so that the problem that the disaster prediction work in the prior art cannot effectively fuse the multi-source data due to insufficient rigor and insufficient completeness is solved, and the precise management and control on the storm prediction is realized.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: CFD-DEM coupling analysis method for sandstone cementation degradation
abstract_en: The application provides a CFD-DEM coupling analysis method for sandstone cementation degradation, which aims at solving the problems that only the drag force of water on particles is considered in the existing CFD-DEM coupling simulation, the influence of water on the reduction of the bonding strength of particles and the increase of the porosity between particles caused by the dissolution of cement is ignored, the strength reduction effect of the cement between the immersed and dissolved particles on weak cemented sandstone is considered, and the cementing degradation and porosity change coupling model of the weak cemented sandstone under the immersed erosion is considered in the CFD-DEM fluid-solid coupling method, so that the defects of the existing method for simulating the immersed erosion disaster of sandstone are overcome. The application reproduces the situation that the strength of sandstone is reduced and the porosity is increased due to erosion of the immersed cementing agent, and applies the CFD-DEM fluid-solid coupling analysis method to analysis of sand gushing disasters of weak cementing rock bodies such as sandstone in water-rich areas.

title_en: Non-supervision deep learning rainfall dry-wet period classification and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unsupervised deep learning rainfall dry-wet period classification and monitoring method, which adopts a drying period CML signal training, learns normal signal characteristics through a self-encoder, a variation self-encoder and a fusion model thereof, and realizes rainfall abnormal attenuation detection by taking reconstruction errors and potential distribution deviation as discrimination indexes. The intelligent rainfall monitoring system can automatically identify rainfall events without additional equipment and manual labeling, has the capability of cross-link and cross-regional generalization, has strong robustness to non-rainfall interference such as wet antenna effect and the like, can realize large-scale real-time monitoring in smart city and 6G integrated sensing scenes, and is widely applied to the fields of weather, hydrology and disaster early warning.
assignees: INST ATMOSPHERIC PHYSICS CAS;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Fire test system with real fire and full-scale structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire test system with a real fire and full-scale structure, which comprises a fire burning and spreading control device, a fire cooling simulation device, a structure reverse loading and counterforce frame device, a control test and analysis device, a test safety guarantee device and a ventilation smoke discharging and processing device, wherein the fire burning and spreading control device is used for simulating the burning heating and space spreading process of a real fire, the fire cooling simulation device is used for simulating the cooling process of fire-fighting spraying and extinguishing, the structure reverse loading and counterforce frame device is used for applying a multidimensional mechanical load to a full-scale test piece in the fire test process, the control test and analysis device is used for integrally controlling the operation of the fire burning and spreading control system, the fire cooling simulation system and the structure reverse loading and counterforce frame system, and collecting and processing test data, and the test safety guarantee device is used for monitoring system operation parameters in real time and carrying out safety protection. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of being capable of completely and highly accurately simulating the real fire disaster process, having full-scale structure and complex mechanical boundary test capability, being capable of realizing synchronous implementation of mechanical loading and fire disaster environment, and the like.

title_en: Combined rock burst-gas composite disaster management method for coal mining area well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine area well-ground combined rock burst-gas composite disaster management method which comprises the steps of determining the position of a coal mine underground directional long drilling track, carrying out a coal mine underground directional long drilling and ground through directional well, carrying out a well-ground combined fracturing pipeline connection and bearing test, carrying out sand blasting perforation staged fracturing by adopting a single-seal backward dragging perforation fracturing tool string, carrying out perforation staged fracturing in a directional long drilling Kong Luoyan Quan Kong by adopting a double-seal backward dragging perforation fracturing tool string, carrying out casing encryption perforation in a directional long drilling full hole by adopting a double-seal backward dragging perforation fracturing tool string, or carrying out screen pipe feeding in a directional long drilling Kong Luoyan. The invention effectively manages the risk of rock burst disasters, simultaneously meets the tangential or coincident requirements of the fracturing cracks and the fracture zones formed after coal seam stoping, realizes mining pressure relief gas management, and realizes the cooperative management of rock burst and gas disasters through a drill hole along the coal seam roof.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Dynamic landslide assessment method, system and medium based on ensemble learning and phase gradient analysis
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dynamic landslide assessment method, a system and a medium based on ensemble learning and phase gradient analysis.
