A dynamic landslide assessment method based on integrated learning and phase gradient analysis comprises the steps of obtaining raster data of a whole area of a target area, raster data of disaster factors, landslide and non-landslide vector data, respectively constructing a training data set and a prediction data set through spatial correlation, training a Stacking integrated model by using the training data set, inputting the prediction data set to obtain the risk probability of each raster landslide, further determining the landslide susceptibility level, obtaining SAR image data, calculating and Stacking phase gradients in different preset spatial directions, combining stacked gradient graphs to obtain phase gradient indexes, accordingly determining the final deformation level of each raster, constructing a dynamic assessment list by taking the landslide susceptibility level as a column and the final deformation level as a row, determining each raster assessment level, and accordingly accurately locking a high risk area, reducing the range of the high risk area and providing targeted decision support for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dam safety, and discloses a dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, a disaster source generation module, a digital twinning simulation module and a model correction module, wherein the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module is used for constructing a finite element model of a dam and dynamically coupling a material constitutive relation in the finite element model with the structural entropy, the disaster source generation module is used for generating a disaster source combination pair, the digital twinning simulation module is used for carrying out dynamic response simulation calculation on the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, and the model correction module is used for correcting parameters of the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module. According to the application, the structural entropy is introduced to comprehensively quantify the damage, energy dissipation and information uncertainty of the material, and a dynamic coupling mechanism of the constitutive relation of the material and the structural entropy is established, so that the digital twin model is converted from a traditional static parameter model into a dynamic evolution model capable of reflecting the degradation and damage accumulation process of the material by endogenous property, and the reality and fidelity of simulation are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN HUADIAN JINSHAJIANG MIDSTREAM WATER POWER DEV CO LTD LIYUAN GENERATING BRANCH

title_en: Injection fire and force action coupling test system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a spray fire and force action coupling test system which comprises a spray fire assembly, a high-temperature loading and counterforce frame supporting assembly, a water spray cooling assembly, a control test and analysis assembly, a test safety guarantee assembly and a test safety guarantee assembly, wherein the spray fire assembly is used for generating adjustable spray flames and comprises a fuel supply module, a spray fire combustion module and a large calorimeter module, the high-temperature loading and counterforce frame supporting assembly is used for applying adjustable mechanical load to a test piece in a high-temperature environment and comprises a loading actuator, a mute oil source and a counterforce frame, the water spray cooling assembly is used for simulating a fire protection water spray cooling process and comprises a spray cooling module and a spray water column cooling module, and the control test and analysis assembly comprises a digital control module and a test analysis and monitoring module, and the test safety guarantee assembly comprises an exhaust gas collection and purification treatment module, an equipment safety guarantee module and an environment safety guarantee module. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of high simulation of real disaster scenes, accurate and adjustable parameters, high test repeatability and reliability, good safety, good environmental protection and the like.

title_en: Urban catchment area reconstruction effect simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method of a reconstruction effect of an urban catchment area, which comprises the steps of dividing cell units, calculating a production flow by using a Green-Ampt model, combining a pipe network and a river network by using a Saint Violet process to obtain a residual production flow, simulating cell overflow to realize the reconstruction of the catchment area, and calculating road confluence by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic force equation. The invention provides a method for simulating the reconstruction effect of an urban catchment area, which solves the problem that the prior art cannot capture abrupt change of a catchment path and has poor predictability of waterlogging. Through the merging process of the dynamic simulation district overflow and the catchment area, local sudden waterlogging risk points can be identified in advance, scientific decision basis is provided for urban flood prevention and control, such as drainage facility layout, emergency material deployment, flood control plan making and the like, flood disaster occurrence probability is reduced, and urban flood toughness is improved.
assignees: CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: SOP (system on a chip) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness optimization of power systems, and discloses a SOP (system on demand) site selection and volume determination method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-disaster chain coupling, which comprises the steps of establishing a time-varying dynamic fault model through a meteorological physical coupling mechanism and associating a typhoon path, an icing growth process and a line fault rate; the method comprises the steps of carrying out Monte Carlo disaster chain simulation, simulating a line cascade failure process under extreme weather, recording node voltage deviation and load reduction, carrying out multidimensional sensitive node evaluation based on Monte Carlo simulation results, outputting a sensitive node list, establishing a multi-objective optimization model by taking sensitive nodes as candidate positions, and solving an SOP optimal site and volume-fixing scheme by adopting a second-order cone planning algorithm. The method realizes the full-chain technology closed loop from meteorological data acquisition and sensitive node identification to flexible resource regulation and control, and achieves the purposes of improving the toughness and reliability of the system and optimizing the operation strategy of the power distribution system.

title_en: Dangerous chemical anomaly identification and early warning method based on few-sample learning and multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous chemical anomaly identification and early warning method based on few-sample learning and multi-mode fusion. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring image data of a monitored scene by deploying a visible light and infrared thermal imaging bimodal camera, secondly, adopting an ORB feature extraction and PROSAC mismatching rejection algorithm to realize infrared and visible light image registration, then dynamically optimizing a network structure based on a Poisson distribution PSDropout less sample training mechanism, then realizing high-precision identification and positioning of an abnormal object based on an improved ResNet backbone network and combining an FPN and PAN multi-scale feature fusion structure, and finally triggering a grading early warning mechanism according to the risk level of an identification result to realize intelligent response from primary prompt to advanced emergency linkage. The method effectively solves the problems of inaccurate abnormal detection, unclear identification and untimely early warning in the prior art, and remarkably improves the safety management and emergency response efficiency of dangerous chemical storage.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU NORMAL;UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;ZHEJIANG GUOZI ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster intelligent prediction method and system based on satellite remote sensing space-time characteristics and convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster intelligent prediction method and system based on satellite remote sensing space-time characteristics and a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting satellite remote sensing data and ground monitoring data of a target area and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction on preprocessed remote sensing data and ground monitoring data by using a convolutional neural network, constructing a mountain torrent risk prediction model based on the extracted features, training and optimizing the mountain torrent risk prediction model by using historical mountain torrent data to obtain a target mountain torrent risk prediction model, inputting the preprocessed data into the target mountain torrent risk prediction model to predict a target area to obtain probability or risk score of mountain torrent occurrence, and calculating according to the probability or risk score of mountain torrent occurrence to obtain a mountain torrent risk index. The method has the remarkable effects that not only is the high-precision prediction of the occurrence of the mountain torrents realized, but also the timeliness of emergency treatment is remarkably improved.

title_en: Multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing physical and social factors of power grid information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-carbon balance defense method, system, equipment and storage medium for fusing power grid information physical social factors, which comprises the steps of constructing an information physical social system multidimensional coupling model, combining a finite state machine and historical disaster data, simulating a dynamic evolution track of the system under an extreme natural disaster condition, constructing a risk assessment model based on an event-driven mechanism, quantitatively evaluating the multidimensional coupling factors based on natural disaster events and artificial carbon emission emergency, presetting a stage collaborative defense strategy, constructing a carbon balance defense effect evaluation model, and quantitatively verifying emission reduction and restoration capacities of strategies of each stage by combining quantitative evaluation results. The method can synchronously optimize carbon emission and carbon sink layout under extreme disaster situations, enhance toughness and low-carbon transformation capacity of the power system, realize dynamic regulation and control of disaster-induced carbon unbalance, and ensure scientificity and executable performance of the scheme under complex conditions.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle SAR path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle SAR path planning method based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning and comprises the steps of simulating a mountain environment through a digital elevation model generated by a function, and representing the position of an unmanned aerial vehicle by using discrete coordinates; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle SAR resource allocation system, constructing a task allocation objective function under constraint conditions, converting the task allocation objective function into a multi-objective optimization problem to solve by adopting a differential evolution algorithm, constructing a path planning objective function, ensuring that the unmanned aerial vehicle completes an imaging task while avoiding collision, planning paths of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a Q-table method based on task allocation results, and carrying out point objective imaging simulation by adopting a BP algorithm based on the obtained unmanned aerial vehicle paths. The method can be used for efficiently completing the SAR collaborative path planning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in a complex environment, and the unmanned aerial vehicles can effectively cooperate with rescue teams to execute advanced reconnaissance and information support tasks in post-disaster emergency rescue.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCI & TECH CHINA;YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE QUZHOU OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: VR emulation emergency teaching device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a VR simulation emergency teaching device, which relates to the technical field of teaching equipment and comprises a VR glasses main body and two auxiliary pieces, wherein a protection assembly is fixedly arranged on the front side of the VR glasses main body, the two auxiliary pieces are distributed on the left side and the right side of the VR glasses main body, a first binding belt is arranged on one side, away from the two auxiliary pieces, of each auxiliary piece, and a connecting belt is fixedly arranged between the opposite sides of the first binding belt. According to the utility model, the VR glasses main body is worn on the head of a user through the first binding band and the second binding band, the connecting frame II is moved and taken down from the second inserting block, the rotating pressing plate is rotated from the horizontal state to the vertical state, the connecting frame I is taken down from the first inserting block, the binding band can be quickly replaced when the binding band is worn and aged for a long time, teaching film sources capable of carrying out emergency, disaster and other conditions are led into the VR glasses main body 1, and then VR simulation teaching can be carried out on the emergency, disaster and other conditions, so that coping consciousness and preventive consciousness are enhanced.

title_en: Movable GNSS point fixing device for monitoring side slope
abstract_en: A movable GNSS point fixing device for monitoring a slope belongs to the technical field of geological monitoring of a strip mine slope. The drilling device comprises a ball screw, a drilling power head, a spiral drill rod assembly, a core shaft pipe, a main spiral blade and a rock drill bit, wherein the ball screw is rotationally connected to a shell of a GNSS mobile monitoring point, a ball nut is screwed on the ball screw, the drilling power head is arranged between the two ball screws and is respectively connected with the ball nuts on the two ball screws, the spiral drill rod assembly mainly comprises the core shaft pipe, the main spiral blade and the rock drill bit, and the core shaft pipe and the main spiral blade are connected below the drilling power head. The fixing device not only solves the problems of the traditional fixing method, has the advantages of compact structure, simple and convenient operation, strong adaptability and the like, can be flexibly adjusted according to the specific conditions and monitoring requirements of the slope, but also is beneficial to improving the automation level and the intelligent level of slope monitoring and provides more reliable technical support for preventing geological disasters of the strip mine slope.

title_en: Multisource rainfall fusion method and system based on improved convolution long-term and short-term memory network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological monitoring, in particular to a multisource rainfall fusion method and a multisource rainfall fusion system based on an improved convolution long-short-term memory network, which are used for constructing a regional planar rainfall field based on rainfall observation data of a commercial microwave link and rainfall observation data of a ground rainfall station, constructing a rainfall data fusion training sample, setting rainfall labels of the rainfall data fusion training sample by utilizing the planar rainfall field of the high-precision ground rainfall station, wherein the ground rainfall station is arranged at partial positions in the region in a scattered manner; and constructing a rainfall space-time fusion model based on the convolutional neural network and the long-short-term memory network, and training the rainfall space-time fusion model by utilizing a rainfall data fusion training sample so as to predict a rainfall field of the region to be detected by utilizing the trained model. The invention can improve the precision and space-time resolution of rainfall products and provide reliable data support for the refined early warning and forecasting of flood disasters.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Flood inundation situation intelligent sensing and lightweight analysis model construction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation situation intelligent perception and lightweight analysis model construction method, which relates to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring and flood control and disaster reduction, and comprises the steps of obtaining LiDAR point cloud data of an unmanned plane and satellite multispectral image data, constructing a differential manifold terrain characterization model, regarding the earth surface as a Riemann manifold, accurately describing complex terrain features, constructing a lightweight inundation calculation model based on manifold diffusion theory, adopting Laplace-Bellamide operator and multiscale solving strategy, realizing rapid and accurate prediction of flood inundation range and water depth, providing full-flow intelligent support through a multi-terminal early warning information pushing mechanism, shortening simulation time from 24 hours to 2 hours, controlling root mean square error of water depth prediction to 0.35 m, and reducing flow speed prediction error of a gradient mutation area by 12%.

title_en: Rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization, and relates to the technical field of robot path planning, wherein the method collects rescue environment audio data in a stereo format in real time; the method comprises the steps of analyzing acoustic characteristics of rescue environment audio data by adopting a pre-training sound source positioning model, outputting sound event types and position data contained in the audio, determining a rescue target according to an output result of the pre-training sound source positioning model, fusing data acquired by a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain an environment model of a rescue area, formulating a rescue route of the rescue robot by adopting a secondary optimization path planning algorithm based on the position information of the rescue target and the environment model of the rescue area, and realizing dynamic obstacle avoidance in a moving process of the robot by adopting a dynamic window method. The problem of insufficient planning accuracy of the rescue robot path in the post-disaster environment with limited vision is solved, a method for determining rescue target position information from an auditory sense is expanded, and the planning efficiency of the robot path is improved.

title_en: Plateau area construction monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle and three-dimensional simulation technology
abstract_en: A construction monitoring system for a plateau area based on unmanned aerial vehicle and three-dimensional simulation technology is particularly suitable for the whole-flow digital management of construction under a complex plateau environment. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform carrying multiple sensors, a three-dimensional modeling module, a data processing module and a monitoring terminal. The unmanned aerial vehicle acquires high-precision terrain data, builds a digital twin reference model, a data processing module identifies safety equipment in real time based on an AI visual algorithm, monitors the temperature of a frozen soil roadbed, pre-warns geological disasters through a GIS and Beidou technology, and a monitoring terminal integrates construction progress analysis, quality detection and operation and maintenance path planning functions. The invention solves the core problems of severe highland climate, complex geology and the like through the whole-flow digital management before construction, during construction and after construction, and improves the construction efficiency and the safety.
assignees: HUADIAN NEW ENERGY GROUP CO LTD TIBET BRANCH;THREE GORGES HIGH TECH INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for analyzing stability of reservoir bank dangerous rock based on directional progressive degradation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for analyzing stability of reservoir bank dangerous rock based on directional progressive degradation, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control. The method comprises the steps of determining physical and mechanical properties and boundary conditions of the reservoir bank dangerous rock, constructing a geologic model of the reservoir bank dangerous rock, establishing the reservoir bank dangerous rock model by utilizing FLAC3D software based on the determined physical and mechanical properties, dividing grids, endowing mechanical parameters to rock mass units in the model according to a directional progressive degradation principle, carrying out stability analysis by utilizing FLAC3D based on the established reservoir bank dangerous rock model and the endowed mechanical parameters, obtaining stress distribution, strain distribution and displacement, verifying analysis results and outputting treatment suggestions. According to the invention, through finely acquiring basic geological information and physical mechanical parameters and combining the degradation level division of directional layering, the accurate simulation of the dangerous rock degradation process is realized, and the defect that the degradation directionality and the degradation level cannot be reflected by the homogenization parameter assignment in the existing method is overcome.

title_en: Transmission tower support relative displacement calculation method, system, equipment and medium based on monitoring information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower support relative displacement calculation method, a system, equipment and a medium based on monitoring information, and relates to the technical field of transmission tower geological disaster resistance, comprising the steps of collecting monitoring data of a target transmission tower and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of establishing a structural analysis model of a transmission tower, simulating the stress and boundary conditions of an actual tower structure, identifying the influence relation of support displacement in all directions on a specific measuring point in the middle of a tower leg, calculating a sedimentation value between two supports of a target tower, applying the sedimentation value to the vertical direction of a certain support, recording the displacement response of the measuring point in the middle of the tower leg, keeping the sedimentation value applied in the vertical direction unchanged, and gradually applying horizontal displacement and longitudinal displacement until the horizontal relative displacement and the longitudinal relative displacement of the measuring point in the middle of the tower leg are consistent with monitoring data. According to the invention, a displacement reverse-pushing mechanism of monitoring information is introduced, limited support direction monitoring data are converted into effective input in a model, and the accuracy of identifying the settlement state of the tower foundation is improved.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method, system, equipment and medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster early warning method, a system, equipment and a medium based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multiple data sources of a target area, preprocessing and extracting features based on the data sources to obtain feature parameters, wherein the feature parameters comprise landform factors, geological environment factors and rainfall factors, training a constructed random forest model based on a training sample set, automatically optimizing super parameters of the random forest model to obtain an early warning model, inputting the feature parameters into the early warning model, and outputting disaster probability and corresponding early warning grades of the target area as early warning results. According to the application, the machine learning model based on the random forest can better capture the complex nonlinear relation among the landform factors, the geological environment factors and the rainfall induction factors, and the early warning precision and generalization capability of the early warning model are improved by combining with the automatically optimized model super-parameters, so that the problem of low early warning accuracy of geological disasters is solved.

title_en: Rainfall landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rainfall type landslide early warning method based on multi-source environment threshold and nonlinear fusion, which comprises the following steps of constructing a landslide disaster-causing factor set, introducing soil humidity, vegetation index and evapotranspiration, calculating threshold parameters corresponding to rainfall type landslide events to obtain an environment threshold point set, constructing and training a landslide susceptibility model based on progressive learning according to the landslide disaster-causing factor set, adopting a double-layer nonlinear fusion model based on multi-source data fusion and quality perception gating, combining the landslide susceptibility model to obtain comprehensive risk probability distribution, and carrying out grading early warning based on the comprehensive risk probability distribution to finish rainfall type landslide early warning. The method is based on traditional rainfall parameters, introduces early-stage disaster-pregnant environmental factors to form a multi-source environmental threshold, adopts fuzzy logic reasoning to realize nonlinear fusion of threshold information and landslide susceptibility base map, combines with a annual iteration updated susceptibility map layer to dynamically reflect the regional environmental condition evolution process, and realizes more refined and adaptive space grading early warning.
assignees: HUNAN SHUANGPAI PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Hydrogen light energy storage and charge source optimal configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a hydrogen light energy storage and filling optimizing configuration method and system, which are used for constructing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, solving optimal capacity configuration, generating a distributed power supply and load uncertainty scene of a distribution network based on a generation countermeasure network, combining a Monte Carlo simulation optimizing device output strategy, determining an inter-energy-station master-slave game model, distributing a power interaction strategy between a micro-network and a main network through a Nash equilibrium algorithm, ensuring high-precision acquisition of current signals, adapting to real-time requirements of a dynamic industrial environment, solving problems of scene generation distortion, emergency response lag and the like in the traditional technology, and optimizing energy configuration.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD PINGHU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Full-period analysis and emergency guarantee method and system for large power grid irregular event
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-period analysis and emergency guarantee method and system for a large power grid irregular event, and belongs to the technical field of large power grid safety and simulation analysis. The method comprises the steps of constructing basic data for simulation calculation of a large power grid, generating power grid element fault probability of an irregular event based on the basic data, generating a large power grid serious fault set based on pseudo-random sampling according to the power grid element fault probability, executing whole-process dynamic simulation of the large power grid based on the power grid serious fault set, carrying out safety scanning and instability discrimination on the whole-process dynamic simulation, outputting scanning discrimination results, generating a staged emergency control strategy according to the scanning discrimination results, and executing the emergency control strategy when the large power grid is unstable. The implementation of the emergency control strategy has great engineering guiding significance for improving the disaster prevention and reduction capacity of the large power grid.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Pedestrian node selection behavior simulation method based on illusion engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public transportation stations and crowd behavior simulation, and discloses a pedestrian node selection behavior simulation method based on a illusion engine. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a dynamic three-dimensional scene containing interactable equipment logic and environment elements by using a virtual engine, then defining a pedestrian node alternative scheme and dividing a queue group to construct a nested structure, then determining objective attributes and limited rational factors which influence node selection, constructing a queue group and a utility function of a specific node layer based on the nested structure and the limited rational factors, further calculating pedestrian selection probability by using a mixed nested Logit model, and finally operating simulation in the virtual engine and outputting a result. The method solves the problems that the existing simulation method is difficult to reflect the heterogeneity, limited cognition and poor in applicability of pedestrians, has wide applicability, comprehensive influence factor consideration and high visualization capacity, and can be used for scenes such as station layout optimization, emergency evacuation, intelligent scheduling and the like.

title_en: Fokker-Planck equation solving method based on physical information neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving Fokker-Planck equation based on physical information neural network, belonging to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of structure and machine learning, comprising the steps of 1, establishing a one-dimensional FP equation changing with time according to an actual engineering structure, and constructing physical information; the method comprises the steps of 2, obtaining a training data set according to a motion equation calculation domain, 3, introducing constructed physical information into a neural network, training the neural network by using the data set, 4, effectively approximating an accurate solution of an FP equation by using the trained neural network, and 5, introducing a robustness assessment mechanism to ensure the stability and reliability of the model under different conditions. By introducing physical constraint, the method constructs a generalized calculation framework suitable for various FP equation related problems, and provides a new solution for probability evolution modeling of a random power system. By utilizing the framework, the probability density function of the dynamic response of the engineering structure can be obtained by solving the equation, and then the probability density function is used for analyzing the reliability of the structure and evaluating the failure probability.

title_en: Multi-factor coupled mountain area mountain torrent dynamic partition early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-factor coupled mountain area mountain torrent dynamic partition early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of mountain torrent defense, according to the invention, the dynamic partition early warning of mountain torrent disasters in mountainous areas is realized by integrating multi-source data through a system, quantifying multi-factor synergistic effect and constructing a differential early warning model. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and preprocessing high-resolution topographic data, multisource meteorological hydrologic observation data and soil attribute data, dividing hydrologic subareas, constructing a basic database, secondly adopting a control variable method to screen small-basin units with convergent parameters, simulating and analyzing a coupling driving mechanism of precipitation, topography and soil through a distributed hydrologic model, constructing a dynamic subarea early warning model based on a multifactor action rule, dynamically adjusting early warning threshold values by combining real-time data, and finally outputting mountain torrent risk grades of different hydrologic subareas to provide quantitative support for mountain torrent early warning in mountain areas.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Gas-containing coal rock damage risk prediction method based on acoustic emission and depth residual error attention network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting the damage risk of gas-containing coal and rock based on acoustic emission and depth residual error attention network, which belongs to the field of mine safety and geological disaster prediction, and comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an original acoustic emission signal of a gas-containing coal and rock combination in the whole process of uniaxial compression damage; the method comprises the steps of selecting main control factors from a plurality of initial acoustic emission characteristic indexes by adopting ReliefF characteristic selection algorithm, constructing input characteristic vectors, carrying out data preprocessing and sample division, constructing and training a depth residual error attention noise reduction network model, sequentially extracting time sequence characteristics and suppressing noise through a convolution sparse attention module, fusing time-frequency domain characteristics through a time-frequency characteristic transmission module to capture non-stationary signal characteristics, and finally outputting the damage risk level of a coal-rock combination through a multi-layer perceptron. The method effectively improves the objectivity and accuracy of prediction and the robustness under the noise environment, and realizes the fine quantitative identification of the damage risk level.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY;SHAANXI BINCHANG XIAOZHUANG MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Emotion simulation method for sudden public event
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public security personnel evacuation, discloses a method for simulating emotion infection of an emergency public event, and aims to solve the problems that an existing emotion infection simulation model does not fully consider a group emotion propagation theory mechanism and influence of individual characteristics of an intelligent body, and simulation accuracy and authenticity are insufficient. The method is realized through six core steps based on an improved SIRS (Susceptible-Infected-Recovered-Susceptible) model and an OCEAN large five-personality model, namely 1) a three-dimensional simulation model of a public place is built, 2) personality traits, emotional states and behavior states of the intelligent agents are initialized, 3) emotion transmission processes (including transmission ranges, influence values, distance weights and emotion conflict processing) among the intelligent agents are calculated, 4) intelligent agent behavior logic under different emotion states is realized, 5) emotion attenuation of the intelligent agents is calculated, and 6) evacuation speed is determined and simulation is completed. The invention can accurately restore the emotion infection and evacuation behaviors of people in sudden scenes, improves the simulation authenticity and the light weight level, and provides decision support for emergency evacuation scheme formulation and emergency management.

title_en: Hot-fluid-solid coupling partition loading test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thermal-fluid-solid coupling partition loading test device and a thermal-fluid-solid coupling partition loading test method, and relates to the technical field of deep mines and engineering. The device comprises an outer shell body which is sealed front and back, and an inner shell body which is placed in the outer shell body, wherein a three-way pressurizing device and a counter-force frame are arranged between the outer shell body and the inner shell body, a coal rock test piece is placed in the inner shell body, a plurality of multifunctional measuring tubes are arranged in the inner shell body, the outer shell body is provided with an air charging hole, a groove is formed in the counter-force frame, and a sensor hole is arranged in the groove. The invention can truly restore complex occurrence environment of deep heterogeneous stratum, solves the problem that the prior device can not simulate the temperature and pressure stress characteristics of the partition, and provides a scientific and reliable test platform for the dynamic disaster mechanism research of deep coal mines.

title_en: Simulation test system and method for secondary disaster induced by coal mine gas dynamic disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation test system and a simulation test method for secondary disasters induced by coal mine gas dynamic disasters. The system consists of a disaster inoculation induction module and a secondary disaster propagation evolution module, and can integrally simulate a series of complete chained processes of secondary disasters such as explosion, shock waves, wind current disturbance and the like, wherein the complete chained processes can be used for simulating deep coal beds to induce coal and gas outburst due to mining disturbance under the environments of in-situ stress, temperature and gas pressure, and further igniting gas-dust mixed clouds formed by the outburst. The invention can simulate the ventilation condition of the roadway and can be additionally provided with a water spraying/explosion suppression system for checking and evaluating the efficiency of the active disaster suppression technology. The invention can realize the accurate regulation and control of the outstanding source parameters, roadway environment and ignition conditions, and acquire multi-physical-field evolution data through the high-precision sensing network, thereby providing a key test platform and scientific basis for revealing the inherent mechanism of deep composite dynamic disasters, evaluating disaster risks, and checking and optimizing disaster prevention and reduction technologies.

title_en: Stratum collapse pressure earthquake prediction method and device based on rock mechanics nonlinear change
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum exploration and development, and discloses a stratum collapse pressure earthquake prediction method and device based on rock mechanics nonlinear change, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively carrying out nonlinear fitting on compressive strength and rock cohesion and internal friction angle through triaxial mechanics experiments to obtain a corresponding fitting relation; and finally, predicting three-dimensional collapse pressure body data of the stratum according to the pore pressure body, the maximum and minimum horizontal main stress bodies, the three-dimensional space rock cohesive force distribution and the internal friction angle distribution and a collapse pressure calculation model. The method can more accurately predict the collapse pressure of the stratum, and can reduce geological disasters caused by improper drilling operation, thereby protecting geological environment and reducing potential influence on the ground surface and underground water resources.

title_en: Slope disaster early warning method based on soil particle loss
abstract_en: The application discloses a slope disaster early warning method based on soil particle loss, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a ramming modeling basis through multidimensional data, carrying out seepage-stress coupling numerical simulation by utilizing simulation software, calculating slope stability coefficients and potential instability ranges under different working conditions, constructing and training a neural network model with the capability of rapidly predicting the stable state of a slope according to input parameters, reversely pushing real-time slope shear strength parameters, inputting the reversely pushed real-time slope shear strength parameters and on-site rainfall into the trained neural network model, and outputting the stability coefficients and the potential instability ranges of a current slope by the model. The method has the beneficial effects that the full-flow logic of data acquisition, numerical simulation, intelligent modeling, on-site monitoring and dynamic early warning is used for acquiring the rammed modeling basis through multidimensional data, so that rich and accurate data support is provided for the subsequent links, and the scientificity and reliability of the early warning model are ensured.

title_en: Tunnel vault vertical cavity collapse mud gushing and accumulation body disposal device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tunnel geological disaster treatment, and discloses a device for treating vertical cavity collapse and mud and a pile body of a tunnel vault, which comprises a backfill layer, a concrete layer, a buffer layer, an advance support and an initial support; the backfill layer is arranged on the collapse mud and is convenient for mechanical walking, bagged soil Dan Huitian is used for back pressure extension of the collapse body with the upper half section to the collapse cavity opening, a concrete layer and a buffer layer are sequentially arranged between the backfill layer and the collapse cavity from bottom to top, the advanced support is arranged in the backfill layer positioned in the collapse cavity, and the primary support is arranged at the lower part of the backfill layer in the collapse cavity and is connected with the primary support at the non-collapse position in the tunnel. According to the utility model, the collapse cavity is initially blocked by the backfill layer, and the concrete layer and the buffer layer are arranged between the backfill layer and the collapse cavity, so that the impact force of the rock block falling and smashing to the concrete layer can be reduced by the buffer layer, and the concrete layer is protected. Meanwhile, the stacking body adopts a large pipe shed drilled by the root canal for advanced support, so that the loose stacking body can be effectively treated.
assignees: GUIZHOU ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Deep learning-based rock burst accumulation debris rheological property prediction system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a system and a method for predicting rheological properties of rock burst accumulation scraps based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining terrain data of a rock burst accumulation area, carrying out gradient analysis on the terrain data, marking a high gradient area, carrying out rock burst chip detection on the basis of the high gradient area to obtain rock burst chip data, inputting the rock burst chip data into a pre-trained deep learning model, carrying out chip liquefaction potential analysis to obtain liquefaction potential data, carrying out slurry formation simulation according to the liquefaction potential data to obtain slurry evolution data, carrying out rheological initial parameter calculation on the basis of the slurry evolution data to obtain rheological parameter data, carrying out chip slurry flow simulation according to the rheological parameter data to obtain slurry flow data, and identifying shear thinning characteristics according to the slurry flow data. The invention improves accuracy of identifying the liquefaction potential of the rock burst and the rheological property prediction based on the geological disaster monitoring technology.

title_en: Data processing system, method, apparatus and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing system, a method, a device and a readable storage medium. The system comprises a data source, a redundant storage layer and an air control processing layer, wherein the data source comprises a first data source used for providing service data and a second data source used for providing callback data, the redundant storage layer comprises a first storage unit used for storing the service data and a second storage unit used for storing the callback data in a lasting mode, and the air control processing layer is used for detecting and processing link abnormality based on performance indexes of all components on a data link. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the data is almost lost when each link of data processing fails, the service recovery time is greatly shortened, meanwhile, the method is compatible with multiple cloud service providers in architecture design, the locking of manufacturers is effectively avoided, the technical flexibility is enhanced, in addition, the disaster recovery is ensured, and a solid foundation is provided for data audit, backtracking analysis and model training.

title_en: Typhoon disaster situation position extraction and classification method and system based on social media
abstract_en: The invention discloses a typhoon disaster situation position extraction and classification method and a typhoon disaster situation position extraction and classification system based on social media, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting text data and preprocessing to generate text vectors; extracting multi-hidden-layer semantic representation of text vectors through a BERT model, fusing, receiving output of each hidden layer by using an auxiliary classifier, generating intermediate results of position extraction and disaster classification, accelerating training, identifying place name entities through a BiLSTM-CRF model, outputting BIO label sequences, completing position extraction, calculating weights of the place name entities in texts through a place name enhancement weight mechanism, strengthening semantic features related to positions in disaster classification tasks, performing multi-label classification through a CNN model, outputting disaster classification results, jointly optimizing and training two task models through a multi-task loss function, and inputting texts to extract and classify typhoon disaster positions. The method can extract disaster position information from social media with high precision, realize multi-label disaster classification and provide comprehensive space-time characteristic analysis for typhoon disaster assessment.

title_en: Mine composite disaster prevention and control method and system based on well-land collaborative fracturing and extraction
abstract_en: The application provides a mine composite disaster prevention method and system based on well-land collaborative fracturing and extraction, wherein the method comprises the steps of identifying a high-level overburden key layer and a low-level overburden key layer in an overburden layer based on mine geological conditions; the method comprises the steps of establishing an L-shaped double-step horizontal well according to a key layer, carrying out sectional hydraulic fracturing on well sections of the L-shaped double-step horizontal well in a high-position overlying strata key layer and a low-position overlying strata key layer, enabling a straight well section of the L-shaped double-step horizontal well to extend downwards to be communicated with an underground operation roadway and establish a high-pressure fluid conveying channel leading to the underground roadway, carrying out sectional hydraulic fracturing on drilling holes arranged in the underground roadway through ground fracturing equipment, and connecting the fractured L-shaped double-step horizontal well and the fractured drilling holes in the underground roadway to a coal mine extraction system for grid-connected collaborative extraction. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the large-area pressure relief and permeability increase of the coal seam are realized, the extraction efficiency is improved, and the safe and efficient production of the mine is ensured.

title_en: Coal and gas outburst area prediction method based on structural physics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine and gas outburst disaster prediction, and particularly relates to a coal and gas outburst area prediction method based on structural physics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining mine gas geological data, constructing a coal and gas outburst prediction index system based on mine structure physical environment analysis, quantitatively analyzing prediction indexes and determining critical values, dividing coal and gas outburst dangers based on structure physical, and predicting coal and gas outburst areas. According to the method, the coal and gas outburst prediction index system is established by analyzing the physical environment of the mine construction, the physical factors of the construction are quantized and index critical values are determined by utilizing a modern mathematical method and a numerical simulation method, the reliability of the coal and gas outburst prediction result is improved, and the application and practice of the coal and gas outburst prediction method based on the construction physics are perfected.

title_en: Early-stage disaster identification and grading early-warning method for oil and gas pipeline and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early-stage disaster identification and grading early warning method for an oil and gas pipeline, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas pipeline safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of determining landslide disaster-causing mechanism through indoor test and physical and numerical simulation, establishing displacement, stress, strain and rainfall early warning threshold values, acquiring space-base, air-base and foundation monitoring data according to a general investigation-detailed investigation-checking system, carrying out space-time alignment, structural matching and unstructured feature extraction by adopting sensor preprocessing and multisource heterogeneous data fusion algorithm, constructing a prediction model to realize mapping of the monitoring data and a vulnerability result, and dynamically updating a vulnerability grade map by accessing minute-grade rainfall monitoring data to generate a grading early warning signal. The method can realize dynamic identification and grading early warning of landslide hazard of the oil and gas pipeline.
assignees: SICHUAN KEHONG OIL AND GAS ENG CO LTD;BEIJING ZHONGYOU SPARK BUSINESS SERVICE CO LTD;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Urban gas pipe network toughness weak link identification and dynamic evaluation method under storm disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dynamic evaluation methods, and particularly relates to a method for identifying and dynamically evaluating urban gas pipe network toughness weak links under a storm disaster, which comprises the steps of data acquisition and preprocessing, collecting topological structures of the urban gas pipe network, node operation attributes, maintenance records, storm intensity, ponding distribution, foundation disturbance and historical rush repair response data, integrating the data into a basic data set after unifying space coordinates and time stamp formats, constructing a static graph model, mapping pipe sections, valves and user nodes into graph nodes, mapping pipeline connection and control relations into graph edges, injecting pressure, fault rate, burial depth and material attributes, constructing an initial static pipe network graph, carrying out disturbance and evolution dynamic simulation, defining a storm disturbance function, mapping the storm disturbance function to the nodes and the edge attributes, carrying out iterative computation on node functional states at all moments through threshold rules and rush repair recovery functions, and forming a pre-disaster, mid-disaster and post-disaster dynamic graph sequence.

title_en: Urban traffic cooperative scheduling method and system based on large model and multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large model and multi-agent-based urban traffic collaborative scheduling method and system, comprising the steps of converting natural language task description into a task semantic graph and a structured Prompt; the method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of strategy candidates by using a large language model, performing language scoring and reasoning arbitration, selecting an optimal strategy for execution by a plurality of agents based on a scoring result, collecting behavior execution data, performing evaluation feedback, realizing strategy closed-loop updating by parameter optimization and promt fine tuning, and improving the multitasking adaptability and training efficiency of a system by combining a distributed task embedding mechanism and a lightweight migration module. The collaborative training system constructed by the invention has the capabilities of natural language interaction, strategy interpretation, behavior control and task migration, and is suitable for various complex urban tasks such as traffic jam dredging, emergency response, signal lamp linkage and the like.

title_en: Landslide surge impact pontoon disaster chain estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide surge impact floating vessel disaster chain estimation method and system, and relates to the technical field of disaster chain estimation.A digital elevation model DEM generated by satellite remote sensing images and aerial survey data is subjected to coordinate pairing with geological drilling monitoring data to obtain three-dimensional topographic information and geotechnical property parameters of a research area; the invention adopts multi-layer series value simulation in links such as surge propagation, flood inundation, structural impact and the like to form a whole-process closed loop monitoring and early warning system of landslide, surge, structural impact, dam rupture and downstream flood, and can obtain the downstream submerged range, the maximum impact force and the structural safety state in real time by means of the accurate solution of Boussinesq equation to wave propagation, dynamic matching of dam bearing capacity and the break simulation and Morison rule impact evaluation to a target structure such as a pontoon or a wharf and the like and visually present the system in a risk level diagram layer form.

title_en: Disaster area rescue resource allocation method and system under condition of donation material fluctuation
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area rescue resource allocation method under the condition of donation material fluctuation, which comprises the steps of constructing a basic parameter matrix of area-material, calculating rescue benefits of allocation of various donation materials in each disaster area, carrying out column normalization processing on the rescue benefit matrix of the area-material, calculating standard score Z values of elements, obtaining a scoring matrix Q of the area-material, constructing a fluctuation simulation matrix conforming to normal distribution, multiplying corresponding elements of the scoring matrix Q of the area-material by each fluctuation simulation matrix sample to obtain a dynamic scoring matrix Q ', substituting the dynamic scoring matrix Q' into a GRA model to solve to obtain an optimal resource allocation matrix T corresponding to each group of fluctuation scenes, and carrying out multidimensional evaluation and screening on all the resource allocation matrices T to determine a rescue resource allocation scheme under donation material fluctuation. The invention carries out global optimization on the resource allocation scheme under the fluctuation of the materials, and realizes the optimal allocation of the rescue comprehensive benefit of the disaster area under the fluctuation of the donated materials.

title_en: Building waterproof supervision acceptance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building waterproof supervision acceptance system and a method, and relates to the technical field of buildings, wherein the method comprises the steps of scanning a waterproof material sample through a micro-channel impedance tomography strategy, extracting pore communication paths and defect distribution characteristics, and constructing a three-dimensional infiltration network model comprising pore sizes, communication paths and defect distribution; based on a material family knowledge graph, mapping the water pressure and crack propagation law of a concrete structure in a historical engineering to a penetration network characteristic space of a current material to generate a composite test parameter set comprising a heavy rain impact waveform, a temperature circulation gradient and a structural deformation rate, synchronously applying dynamic load in a climate simulation test cabin according to the composite test parameter set, positioning a leakage high risk area according to a test result through a space-time correlation algorithm, and generating a decision scheme comprising maintenance priority, carbon footprint evaluation and disaster resistance prediction by combining a material durability database and area extreme climate data.
assignees: GUANGDONG CAIMAO CONSTRUCTION ENG CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Chemical industry park dynamic evacuation path planning method based on GPRO reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of evacuation path planning, in particular to a chemical industry park dynamic evacuation path planning method based on GPRO reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of firstly, building an environment state space, digitizing the chemical industry park into a grid map, wherein each grid comprises dynamically updated environment information, 1.2), forming an agent perceived state space S_t, secondly, designing an action space, namely 2.1), defining an agent executable action set A, 2.2), selecting an action a_t from the set A after each interval t by the agent, and executing the action a_t, and thirdly, designing a multi-target reward and punishment function, namely, training an optimal strategy network five by a reinforcement learning algorithm based on GPRO, deploying a model and generating a dynamic path. The application has high dynamic adaptability, real multi-objective optimization, excellent real-time performance, faster convergence, higher sampling efficiency and stronger robustness.
assignees: SHENLAN GANZHI HANGZHOU IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent identification and alarm method and system for unscheduled power failure of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine power, in particular to an intelligent recognition and alarm method for an unscheduled power failure of a coal mine, which comprises data acquisition and pretreatment; the method comprises the steps of planning power outage information comparison, constructing a PLC rule engine to judge power outage characteristics, combining machine learning model verification, starting local audible and visual alarm, pushing remote information through an industrial ring network, transmitting alarm based on risk level, linkage inspection and fault positioning, and recording and optimizing iteration. According to the method and the system for the intelligent recognition and alarm of the coal mine unplanned power failure, automatic linkage control is adopted, a closed-loop emergency response system is constructed through automatic switching-off of non-key equipment, switching of standby power supply of key equipment and path planning of a patrol robot, and a layered decision mechanism is constructed through planned power failure database filtering, rule engine primary screening and recognition classification model rechecking, so that recognition accuracy is effectively improved, dynamic optimization is realized through rule engine threshold self-adjustment and model iterative training, and model accuracy is effectively improved.
assignees: SHAANXI XINNENG COAL DRESSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method, device and medium for inducing hydrate-containing sediment physical degradation based on discrete element hydrate decomposition
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation method, equipment and medium for inducing mechanical degradation of hydrate-containing sediment based on discrete element hydrate decomposition, wherein the simulation method comprises the steps of carrying out a numerical triaxial or biaxial compression test on a hydrate-containing sediment sample, calibrating mesoscopic parameters associated with a relevant contact model by combining a trial-and-error method, and constructing a mechanical degradation model of the hydrate-containing sediment in the process of discrete element hydrate decomposition; and randomly removing part of hydrate particles according to a set hydrate decomposition rate in the mechanical degradation model to simulate hydrate phase volume reduction, and reducing parallel bond radius multipliers to simulate hydrate cementation damage caused by decomposition. The mechanical degradation behavior of the hydrate-containing sediment is accurately characterized by comprehensively considering the hydrate phase volume reduction and the cementation damage effect in the hydrate decomposition process, and the method is suitable for the mechanical characteristic analysis of the hydrate-containing sediment with coexisting multiple occurrence forms and can be used for evaluating geological disasters and engineering risks in the hydrate exploitation process.

title_en: Method for predicting slope deformation based on multi-source data
abstract_en: A method for predicting slope deformation based on multi-source data belongs to the technical field of prediction and analysis of mine slope stability. Including data collection, data normalization, data training, data prediction, and the like. According to the method, by monitoring the distribution mode of the attention weight of the model, before the physical quantity does not reach the dangerous threshold, the dangerous evolution trend similar to the historical instability case can be identified. The early warning based on the behavior pattern similarity advances the warning time from the moment of instability to the moment of presenting the instability symptom, thereby gaining precious time for rescue and relief. The method effectively overcomes the core defects of insensitivity to abrupt change events, early warning delay, poor interpretation and the like in the existing side slope prediction technology, provides an early, accurate, reliable and interpretable intelligent early warning solution, and has extremely high application value in the fields of mine safety, geological disaster prevention and control and the like.

title_en: Building fire safety assessment method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for evaluating fire safety of a building. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data of a target building and generating a building physical model, wherein the data comprise building geometry, material properties, fire-fighting facilities, evacuation networks and historical fire-fighting management records, generating sudden fire scene data by combining historical fire statistics data, inputting a fire spreading simulation model to obtain temperature field, smoke concentration field and speed field data, inputting the building physical model to perform structural response simulation to obtain key component stress, strain and displacement process data, determining available safe evacuation time, simulating personnel evacuation to obtain required safe evacuation time by combining the smoke and speed field data, generating assessment indexes comprising fire-fighting facility defects, evacuation and structural bearing risk levels, and generating fire-fighting management suggestions by combining the fire-fighting management resource data. By adopting the method, the suitability of the building fire safety evaluation on complex scenes and the actual effect of fire control management can be improved.

title_en: Rapid prediction method and system for large-scale casualties based on space-time data mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid prediction method and a rapid prediction system for large-scale casualties based on space-time data mining, which are applied to the technical field of disaster casualties prediction. The method comprises the following steps of collecting multi-source space-time data in real time and preprocessing, inputting the preprocessed multi-source space-time data into a disaster prediction model to predict disaster occurrence probability, disaster occurrence subareas and disaster severity in a monitored area, inputting a prediction result of the disaster prediction model and the preprocessed multi-source space-time data into an casualty number prediction model to predict casualty numbers in the monitored area, updating input data of the casualty number prediction model after actual disaster occurrence, and re-predicting the casualty numbers in the monitored area at each updated time node, and performing incremental training after disaster is over. The invention introduces an iterative correction mechanism, ensures the accuracy of the prediction result of the casualties, and can provide reference for post-disaster rescue work.

title_en: Pre-deployment robust optimization method and system for electric bus before disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-deployment robust optimization method and system before electric bus disaster, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid, bus, load and disaster prediction data, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a fault scene set, establishing a robust optimization model aiming at minimizing system load shedding, considering electric bus operation, dispatching, scheduling constraint and power distribution network system constraint, describing line fault uncertainty by constructing a reinforced confidence set, and adopting a C & CG decomposition algorithm solution model to obtain an optimal pre-deployment scheme. The invention effectively solves the problems of inflexible deployment and high cost of the traditional fixed energy storage in post-disaster recovery, and remarkably improves the post-disaster recovery speed and the elasticity level of the power distribution network and reduces the economic loss of power failure while ensuring normal public transportation service by utilizing the mobile energy storage characteristic of the electric public transportation.

title_en: Colliery rock burst disaster prevention and control detects early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst disaster prevention and control detection early warning device, which comprises an arch frame, wherein a plurality of anchor rod mechanisms are arranged on the outer wall of the arch frame at equal intervals, each anchor rod mechanism comprises a hollow anchor rod, each hollow anchor rod penetrates through the outer wall of the arch frame, a drilling mechanism is arranged at the end part of each hollow anchor rod and is used for drilling the inner wall of a roadway, after the hollow anchor rods are implanted, a controller instructs a multi-way reversing valve to be opened, a hydraulic medium is pumped into a fixed pipe through an infusion pipe to push a movable rod to be unfolded around a hinging point, a movable plate is guided to be tightly attached to the hole wall through an L-shaped groove, so that a microseismic sensor is tightly coupled with a rock mass, and the first tray, the second tray and a fastening bolt are matched, the tight contact between the sensor and the rock mass is ensured while the supporting strength is enhanced, and the poor coupling problem of the traditional sensor is effectively avoided.
assignees: ZHONGTIAN HECHUANG ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Fireproof testing device for production of insulation boards
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fireproof testing device for producing an insulation board, which relates to the technical field of insulation board fireproof testing, wherein the conventional fireproof testing device for producing the insulation board is influenced by a clamping component in the testing process, the two sides of the insulation board are heated unevenly, and the detection data is influenced, the utility model reduces the direct contact area of the clamping component and the insulation board as much as possible, further reduces the influence of the clamping board on the testing, the insulation board clamping assembly can turn over inside the switch assembly with the insulation board, so that different surfaces of the insulation board are subjected to fire baking, the multidirectional heating condition of the insulation board in a real fire disaster can be simulated, the fireproof performance of the insulation board in an actual fire disaster scene can be reflected more accurately, the evaluation of one-sided performance caused by single-sided testing is avoided, scientific basis can be provided for architectural design, fire engineering and the like better, and reasonable application of the insulation board in different places and environments is guided.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA NORTH TIMES DESIGN RES INSTITUTE STOCK CO LTD

title_en: System and method for creating a virtual 3D city model by combining artificial intelligence image analysis technology and parametric modeling
title_ko: 인공지능 영상 분석 기술과 파라메트릭 모델링을 결합한 가상 3차원 도시 모형 생성 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공지능 영상 분석 기술과 파라메트릭 모델링을 결합한 가상 3차원 도시 모형 생성 시스템에 관한 것으로서, GIS 데이터와 BIM 데이터를 수집하는 공공 데이터 수집 모듈, 수집된 GIS 및 BIM 데이터에서 모델링 파라미터를 추출하는 모델링 파라미터 추출 모듈, 수집된 GIS 및 BIM 데이터로부터 수집이 불가능한 세부 정보를 추출하는 것으로서, 인공지능 객체 인식 기술을 이용하여 미분류 지형·지물 정보를 추출하고 인공지능 의미론적 분할 기술을 이용하여 미분류 지형·지물의 색상, 텍스처 및 밀도를 추출하는 인공지능 영상분석 모듈, 상기 모델링 파라미터 추출 모듈로부터 수신된 파라미터를 파라메트릭 모델링의 파라미터로 활용하고, 상기 인공지능 영상분석 모듈로부터 수신된 건물 옥외 시설물, 건물 외벽 색상, 텍스처, 산림 내 나무의 밀도 등의 지형·지물 정보를 이용하여 지형·지물을 3차원 모델로 생성하는 파라메트릭 모델링 모듈 및 생성된 3차원 모델에 텍스처 및 재질 정보를 적용하여 최종적으로 가상 3차원 도시 모형을 생성하는 텍스처 및 재질 적용 모듈을 포함하는 것이 특징이다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 기존의 공공 데이터만으로는 표현하기 어려웠던 건물 외벽 색상, 텍스처, 옥외 시설물, 산림 내 나무의 밀도 등의 세부 정보를 영상 데이터에서 추출하여 적용함으로써 보다 현실적인 가상 3차원 도시 모형을 생성할 수 있다. 또한 스마트 시티 구축, 도시 환경 시뮬레이션, 건축 설계, 재난 관리, 도시 계획 등의 다양한 분야에서 활용될 수 있으며, 현실과 유사한 3차원 모델링을 통해 다양한 산업에서의 활용도를 증대시킬 수 있다.

title_en: System for Optimal Evacuation Route Selection Based on Elevation and Slope Analysis for Slope Walking Evacuation Simulation
title_ko: 경사로 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 위한 고도 및 경사도 분석 기반의 최적 대피 경로 선정 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 발생 시 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 기반으로 대피 경로를 분석하고 최적화하는 기술에 관한 것으로,  
경사로 보행 대피 시뮬레이션을 위한 고도 및 경사도 분석 기반의 최적 대피 경로 선정 시스템에 있어서, 
수치 표고 모형(Digital Elevation Models, DEM) 데이터를 기반으로 지형의 고도를 분석하는 고도 분석 모듈과; 도로 링크 데이터를 활용하여 링크별 지점의 경사도를 산출하는 경사도 분석 모듈과; 산출된 경사도 데이터를 이용하여 대피자들의 이동 특성을 고려한 최적 경로를 생성하는 대피 경로 최적화 모듈과; 생성된 경사도 데이터와 대피 경로 데이터를 데이터베이스(DB)에 저장하고 관리하는 데이터 관리 모듈과; 대피 지역의 세부적인 존(Micro 존) 분할을 통해 통행량을 예측하고 이를 대피 시뮬레이션에 적용하는 존 세분화 모듈과; 대피 지역 및 경로에 대한 시뮬레이션을 실행하여 대피자의 이동 경로와 소요 시간을 시각적으로 제공하는 시뮬레이션 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Integrated Management and Simulation System for Disaster Evacuation Facilities
title_ko: 재난 대피 시설 통합 관리 및 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 대피 시설의 통합 관리 및 시뮬레이션 기술에 관한 것으로,  
재난 대피 시설 관리 시스템에 있어서, 
방사능 재난, 화학사고, 풍수해, 지진해일 등 다양한 재난 유형별로 대피 시설 데이터를 구축하는 데이터베이스 모듈과; 각 재난 유형에 따라 해당 대피 시설 데이터의 수집, 분류 및 시각화 기능을 제공하는 데이터 처리 모듈과; 특정 대피 시설의 수용 인원, 사용 여부 등 시설 정보를 수정하고, 수정된 데이터를 기반으로 신규 재난 시나리오를 생성하는 수정 및 분석 모듈과; 다양한 재난 상황에서 개별 대피 시설 데이터를 중첩하여 표출하고, 재난 피해 범위를 시뮬레이션할 수 있는 중첩 표출 모듈과; 재난 유형별 대피 시설을 조회하고 추가 피해를 대비한 대체 대피 시설 정보를 제공하는 사용자 인터페이스 모듈을 포함하며, 
상기 데이터베이스 모듈은 원전 구호소, 화학사고 대피 장소, 이재민 임시 주거 시설, 지진해일 긴급 대피 장소, 지진옥외 대피 장소의 데이터를 각각 구축하고, 상기 중첩 표출 모듈은 개별 대피 시설 피해 데이터를 타 재난 피해 데이터와 통합하여 재난 상황별로 실시간 분석 결과를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: This system includes a server means including a database for storing past weather data, disaster data and topographical data, a simulation means for executing simulation on the basis of a condition designated by a user, a result generation means for generating a simulation result and transmitting it to the terminal of the user, and a terminal means for receiving the input of the user and transmitting it to the server.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Ultra-high pixel remote sensing image region of interest intelligent detection method based on deep layered distillation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-high pixel remote sensing image region of interest (ROI) intelligent detection method based on a depth layered distillation network, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision and remote sensing image processing. The method achieves efficient and accurate ROI detection by constructing a double-layer distillation architecture of dynamic multi-example network (DMIN) and lightweight pre-screening network (LIPN). The method comprises the steps of carrying out pyramid layering processing on an input ultra-high resolution remote sensing image to generate a high-resolution image pair and a low-resolution image pair, training a double-branch attention model on the high-resolution image by using DMIN, screening a key region by a self-distillation strategy and generating a mask, guiding LIPN to learn redundant region prediction on the low-resolution image based on the mask, and carrying out feature extraction and classification on only an effective region in the high-resolution image by means of LIPN rapid pre-screening in an inference stage. The invention innovatively introduces a Chebyshev polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold (CKA) classifier, and enhances the nonlinear modeling capability. Experiments show that the method can ensure the detection precision and improve the reasoning speed by more than 28.6%, is suitable for remote sensing scenes such as building detection, vegetation classification, disaster assessment and the like, and can be deployed on satellite or unmanned aerial vehicle edge equipment to realize real-time processing.
assignees: SUZHOU SUPEREAL MICROELECTRONICS CO LTD;UNIV JIANGSU;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Slope safety coefficient calculation method considering upward-inclined drain hole
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, and particularly discloses a slope safety coefficient calculation method considering a slope drainage hole, comprising the following steps of establishing a slope seepage numerical simulation model containing the slope drainage hole, and obtaining the space coordinates of nodes inside the slope and pore water pressure data through finite element calculation; generating a potential slip plane based on limit analysis upper limit theory, calculating pore water pressure values at discrete points on the potential slip plane by using a Kriging interpolation method and using node space coordinates and pore water pressure data as samples, establishing a balance equation of soil gravity power, pore water pressure power and internal energy dissipation power when the slope is in a critical damage state according to the potential slip plane, soil strength parameters and pore water pressure values obtained by interpolation, solving the balance equation, and further obtaining the slope safety coefficient considering the inclined drain hole. The application can efficiently and accurately calculate the slope safety coefficient considering the upward-inclined drain hole.

title_en: Big data-based water quality safety monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water quality safety monitoring and early warning method based on big data, and relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning.
