Setting sampling points according to areas, attaching scene labels, arranging sensors to obtain water quality information, building a water quality evaluation model based on a support vector machine improvement model, inputting the water quality information into the water quality evaluation model, outputting to obtain water quality categories, dividing the sampling points into normal sampling points and key sampling points according to the water quality categories, predicting water quality safety by using LSTM (least squares) and carrying out graded early warning based on normal point data, positioning pollution sources by using time-space kriging interpolation based on key point data, simulating a pollution diffusion path by using multivariate collaborative interpolation, and combining the normal point early warning and key point diffusion simulation to obtain a water quality safety monitoring early warning result. According to the invention, the global risk classification report is generated by fusing the normal sampling point early warning result and the key sampling point diffusion path, and the emergency response and the long-term treatment strategy are matched.

title_en: Cable channel fire disaster identification method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product based on numerical simulation
abstract_en: The application relates to a cable channel fire disaster identification method, a device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product based on numerical simulation. The method comprises the steps of performing simulation on a three-dimensional geometric model according to simulation parameters of the three-dimensional geometric model of a sample cable channel to obtain sample smoke trace characteristics and sample fire spreading path information, extracting sample fire source position information, sample fire intensity information and sample cable material information from the simulation parameters, performing iterative training on a fire recognition model to be trained according to the sample smoke trace characteristics, the sample fire spreading path information, the sample fire source position information, the sample fire intensity information and the sample cable material information to obtain a fire recognition model to be trained, and inputting the smoke trace characteristics of the cable channel to be analyzed into the fire recognition model to be trained to obtain a fire recognition result of the cable channel to be analyzed. By adopting the method, the fire analysis accuracy of the cable channel can be improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Automatic support protection system for in-situ disaster-control drilling of coal seam and use method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine disaster management, in particular to an automatic supporting and protecting system for in-situ disaster-control drilling of a coal seam and a using method. The system comprises a drilling device, a supporting device and a control system. The supporting device is sleeved on the outer side of the drill rod in a magnetic adsorption mode and synchronously enters a drill hole while drilling, and comprises an accompanying bracket, an automatic telescopic device, an electromagnet and a supporting pipe network from inside to outside. The support pipe network is a flexible and telescopic metal tubular grid structure. After drilling to the designed depth, the control system instructs the automatic expansion device to extend outwards, radially pushes out the support pipe network, enables the support pipe network to be clung to and anchored on the hole wall, and generates continuous radial supporting force by utilizing elastic deformation of the grid structure to form permanent support. The drill pipe and internal devices may then be safely withdrawn. The invention realizes synchronous and integrated operation of drilling and supporting, can effectively prevent hole collapse and diameter shrinkage, and provides effective support for in-situ disaster control such as dust prevention, fire prevention and the like when materials are injected into a coal bed.
assignees: UNIV ANHUI SCI & TECHNOLOGY;ANHUI PANSHI MINING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault arc hidden trouble identification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fault arc hidden trouble identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, fault arc true equivalent reproduction and multidimensional parameter observation; S2, analyzing early electric sign rules of the fault arc, S3, analyzing volt-ampere characteristics of alternating current and direct current fault arcs based on a low-voltage fault arc real-model simulation observation experiment platform, S4, analyzing disaster critical conditions and rules of the electric fires according to a correlation mechanism of the fault arc and the electric fires, and providing basis for measuring and diagnosing the low-voltage fault arc. The application preliminarily realizes multidimensional observability and interpretability of the whole process from occurrence to disaster by multi-factor modeling, energy mechanism analysis and experimental platform construction of fault arc, provides a solid foundation for subsequent deep exploration of intelligent detection algorithm, arc prediction model, electric safety level evaluation system and the like, and promotes the ground application of fault arc monitoring technology in the fields of industry, electric power operation and maintenance and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN POWER CO LTD POWER SUPPLY SERVICE CENTER METRIC CENTER;State grid hunan electric power co ltd;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Landslide body dynamic simulation monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source sensing fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and discloses a landslide dynamic simulation monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source sensing fusion, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data of a landslide body through a plurality of heterogeneous sensors, and aligning the multi-source data in time and space after preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a multiparameter fusion model fusing a displacement field, a mechanical field and an environmental field based on preprocessing data, enabling the multiparameter fusion model to output deformation rate and stability coefficient, dynamically adjusting the displacement field, the mechanical field and the environmental field weight according to a landslide evolution stage, then predicting future deformation trend of a landslide body by combining a geological structure and historical data, comparing the stability coefficient with a dynamic safety threshold value to judge risk level, generating early warning information, dynamically correcting a reference weight coefficient in the model based on deviation of monitoring data and model output, and enabling the model to be self-adaptively optimized. The application solves the problems of single monitoring dimension and static solidification of the model in the prior art, and realizes accurate and self-adaptive monitoring and early warning of the landslide risk state.
assignees: NO 4 ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY NO 3 ENG GROUP CO LTD;CHANGAN UNIV;CHINA RAILWAY NO 3 ENG GROUP

title_en: Cloud computing-based high slope disaster intelligent early warning method, system, medium and product
abstract_en: A cloud computing-based high slope disaster intelligent early warning method, system, medium and product relate to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of constructing a case evolution map on the cloud based on a historical landslide case database, matching a multidimensional real-time feature vector of a target side slope with nodes in the case evolution map, determining a target node with highest similarity, searching and generating a plurality of first potential evolution paths leading to known instability cases in the case evolution map, evaluating risk levels of each first potential evolution path, generating early warning information according to the risk levels, applying virtual engineering intervention measures in a simulation mode according to the early warning information, evaluating modification effects of the virtual engineering intervention measures on the case evolution map, evaluating release effects of each intervention strategy based on the modification effects, and selecting optimal intervention strategies for deployment according to the release effects. By implementing the technical scheme, the high side slope disaster can be accurately pre-warned.
assignees: SHANDONG HIGHWAY & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of open type heading machine for different geology
abstract_en: The application provides a construction method of an open type tunneling machine for different geology, which comprises the steps of starting a tunneling host machine to perform tunneling operation, controlling an advanced directional drilling and fixing machine to perform geological detection to judge whether the unfavorable geology exists, controlling the advanced directional drilling and fixing machine to perform pretreatment corresponding to the unfavorable geology, enabling the advanced directional drilling and fixing machine to move along the main frame through a displacement compensation mechanism in the operation process of the advanced directional drilling and fixing machine, enabling the relative positions of the advanced directional drilling and fixing machine and a tunnel to be unchanged until the tunneling process is finished. By using the construction method of the open type tunneling machine for different geology, the construction method integrating geological detection, risk early warning, advanced treatment and emergency response can be realized in the tunneling process, so that the safety, efficiency and adaptability of tunnel construction are improved.
assignees: TIANHE MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on data drift detection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of tunnel engineering, and discloses a tunnel disaster monitoring and early warning method and system based on data drift detection, comprising the steps of constructing a classifier pool; the method comprises the steps of collecting tunnel monitoring data in real time, conducting blocking processing, conducting real-time processing on data blocks by adopting an incremental learning classifier, calculating probability values of unlabeled samples in the data blocks based on a conformal prediction framework, generating pseudo-label confidence, comparing probability value distribution of adjacent data blocks, detecting whether data drift occurs, further judging whether the data drift is reproduced or not if the data drift is detected, selectively reusing a historical model or a training new model in a classifier pool based on a judging result, and triggering corresponding early warning according to disaster probability output by the classifier. The method and the system remarkably improve the response speed of the disaster prediction model to sudden geological disasters, reduce the false alarm and missing report risk caused by the dynamic change of the environment, and provide real-time and reliable early warning support for tunnel construction safety.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;SHANDONG UNIV QIHE NEW MATERIAL AND INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Tunnel disaster monitoring method and blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a tunnel disaster monitoring method and a blocking method based on earthquake damage-flood cooperation, and relates to the field of intelligent prevention and control of earthquake engineering and disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining damage characteristics, seepage characteristics and aftershock characteristics based on DOFS data of a section in a decoupling way; the method comprises the steps of obtaining water pressure data through simulation according to multisource sensing data in a section, determining current damage variables, damage-seepage coupling indexes and crack hydraulic opening degrees based on various characteristics and historical data, determining seepage pressure gradients among sections according to water pressure values of various sections, determining seepage velocity vectors among sections according to the crack hydraulic opening degrees and the damage-seepage coupling indexes of the sections, determining system cascade failure risk indexes according to the damage variables of the sections and dynamic risk propagation weights among the sections, and determining disaster chain propagation strength indexes of a current tunnel by utilizing an entropy weight method. The method can realize real-time monitoring and risk assessment of the secondary flood disasters after tunnel earthquake.

title_en: Flood disaster real-time early warning and dynamic decision method based on distributed optical fibers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time flood disaster early warning and dynamic decision method based on distributed optical fibers, which comprises the following steps of distributing distributed optical fiber sensors at key positions of a river channel, collecting data in real time to form a data set, marking disaster grades, dividing the marked data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, calculating fusion weights of measuring points at the key positions, carrying out weighted splicing on the data of the measuring points according to the fusion weights to generate fusion space feature vectors, constructing a flood disaster prediction model, carrying out iterative training on the model to obtain a trained model, carrying out weighted fusion on newly collected data, inputting the newly collected data into the trained model, outputting disaster grade prediction results, judging whether to carry out early warning according to the prediction results, and generating decisions of corresponding disaster grades according to the prediction results. The invention can predict and dynamically decide flood disasters in real time by efficiently utilizing the collected high-frequency, multi-measuring-point and unstructured data.

title_en: Method, system, computer equipment and storage medium for monitoring galloping of transmission conductor
abstract_en: The application discloses a monitoring method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium for galloping of a power transmission wire, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring attitude monitoring data and peripheral meteorological data of the power transmission wire in a district range; the method comprises the steps of acquiring running state data related to power transmission wire service, correlating gesture monitoring data, peripheral meteorological data and running state data of the same power transmission wire acquired at the same monitoring node, generating a data sample, performing iterative training on a semi-supervised clustering model by using the collected data sample, outputting a clustering result, and determining whether a target power transmission wire corresponding to the latest collected data sample is in galloping or not according to the clustering result. According to the application, the semi-supervised clustering model is used for online learning training, so that monitoring of the occurrence of the galloping of the power transmission wire is realized, especially, monitoring of micro-galloping can be realized, early discovery, early treatment and early regulation of the galloping of the power transmission wire are realized, and the capability of the power transmission line for resisting natural disasters is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Power transmission line icing galloping potential early warning method suitable for multiple rainfall phases in complex terrain area
abstract_en: A method for early warning icing galloping potential of a power transmission line suitable for multiple precipitation phases in a complex terrain area relates to the field of power transmission line safety, establishes an early warning standard of icing galloping potential level based on power transmission line icing galloping historical data mining, establishes a small microscale wind field prediction mode WRF-CALMET aiming at key parameter wind in the standard to solve the problem of wind field simulation misalignment in the complex terrain area, and establishes an icing prediction mode WRF-ICINGLIVE aiming at key parameter icing thickness in the standard to realize online calculation and direct output of icing thickness in multiple precipitation phases. By the method, the ice-coating galloping potential early warning result of the power transmission line in a multi-precipitation phase state in a complex terrain area can be timely obtained under the current service timeliness requirement, so that a prospective scientific basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction decisions of the power transmission channel, and the safe and stable operation level of the power grid corresponding to extreme weather is effectively improved.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Emergency scenario evolution simulation method based on multi-source data-driven dynamic Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency scenario evolution simulation method based on a multi-source data-driven dynamic Bayesian network, and belongs to the technical field of offshore emergency. The method comprises the steps of constructing a general accident emergency scene evolution framework based on public safety triangle theory, identifying ship accident emergency scene elements and constructing an emergency scene evolution path, constructing a DBN model based on the path, determining DBN parameters by combining statistical analysis, a Markov transfer model and a Leaky Noisy-OR model, simulating natural environment changes by using an evidence reasoning method, and evaluating the influence of ship-end emergency, shore-based emergency and ship-shore collaborative emergency on scene state evolution. The invention discloses a dynamic evolution rule of different types of accident emergency situations on the North ocean, provides scientific basis for emergency management and decision making, and improves the emergency response capability of the North ocean emergency.

title_en: Urban disaster risk monitoring method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based urban disaster risk monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of data analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical disaster monitoring records of a target area, combining with urban disaster priori knowledge, analyzing and determining an associated monitoring list of the target area, wherein the associated monitoring list comprises a data type list and a data range list, constructing an area disaster digital twin model corresponding to the associated monitoring list in the target area, configuring an acquisition time window for the target area, carrying out real-time data acquisition by combining with the associated monitoring list to obtain time sequence monitoring data, inputting the time sequence monitoring data into the area disaster digital twin model to carry out disaster evolution simulation analysis to obtain a simulation analysis result, and determining the disaster risk level of the target area. The method and the system effectively improve the accuracy and timeliness of urban disaster risk early warning.

title_en: Model training method, fire monitoring method, device and system and household appliance
abstract_en: The application discloses a model training method, a fire monitoring method, a device and a system and household appliances, and belongs to the field of fire monitoring. A fire disaster early warning model of a neural network is built, then three parameters of smoke concentration, CO concentration and temperature are input, the fire disaster situation is predicted in a multi-dimensional mode, and finally whether a pure fire disaster exists or not is output, and whether a fire disaster exists, a fire disaster is ignited or an open fire disaster can be obtained. Not only can accurately predict the occurrence probability of fire, but also can distinguish fire types, thereby being convenient for targeted treatment in early stage of fire. Greatly reduces the severity of fire disaster and simultaneously reduces the economic loss caused by fire disaster.

title_en: Method for predicting offshore wind power generation situation in extreme weather based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy power prediction, in particular to a method for predicting the offshore wind power generation condition of extreme weather based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the steps of obtaining data under the historical extreme weather, dividing the data into a training set and an optimizing set, then removing noise, extracting environmental data characteristic data for fusion, determining freezing proportion according to extreme weather disaster level and freezing partial layer parameters of a pre-trained conventional power generation prediction model, and after training the unfrozen layer, constructing an extreme weather power generation prediction model, periodically acquiring data in an optimization set by constructing a simulation time axis for automatic learning, finally acquiring environmental data in real time for prediction, judging the prediction accuracy according to the similarity between a prediction result and the data in the optimization set, and if the prediction accuracy is inaccurate, analyzing an abnormal reason and correcting related parameters. The method provided by the invention effectively overcomes the difficulty of inaccurate prediction of the offshore wind power generation in extreme weather, and obviously improves the accuracy and reliability of the prediction of the wind power generation in extreme weather.
assignees: ZHONGKE ZHIDAO BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydrologic digital twin model construction method and system based on artificial intelligence technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrologic digital twin model construction method and a system based on an artificial intelligence technology, which relate to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring and intelligent early warning and comprise the steps of constructing a hydrologic element measuring point monitoring model fused with multi-source sensor data, and introducing a complex association of a graph convolution network capture environmental factor and hydrologic elements; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mapping model by utilizing an improved long-short-term memory neural network, designing balance data precision and space consistency of a multi-target dynamic monitoring loss function, fusing a measuring point predicted value and a global simulation value through field self-adaptive countermeasure training, generating a basic hydrologic digital twin model, constructing an interaction model by combining an extreme working condition parameter migration strategy, constructing an inference mechanism based on a hydrologic disaster knowledge graph, and outputting a physical engineering disposal scheme. The method solves the problems of weak generalization capability, insufficient data fusion, poor adaptability to extreme working conditions and the like of the traditional hydrologic model, and realizes high-precision real-time sensing and intelligent decision in the hydrologic process.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Impact-salient composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on energy chain evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses an impact-salient composite dynamic disaster prediction method based on energy chain evolution, and relates to the technical field of coal mine underground dynamic disaster prediction. According to the invention, the roadway impact-salient composite dynamic disaster energy under the conditions of different surrounding rock mechanical parameters, gas parameters and impact load parameters is solved by automatic numerical simulation, and an impact-salient composite dynamic disaster energy data set under various working conditions is automatically constructed. The invention provides a CNN-LSTM-Attention roadway impact-salient composite dynamic disaster energy prediction model with energy and space feature constraint, wherein the CNN model extracts roadway space features, the LSTM model acquires energy time sequence, the Attention automatically distributes space-time dual-area Attention mechanism weight, and the three are cooperatively fused, so that the roadway impact-salient composite dynamic disaster energy prediction accuracy is improved.
assignees: ORDOS RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIAONING UNIV OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Multi-dimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional coupling reversible mapping landslide susceptibility evaluation method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. The method has the advantages of being more efficient in characteristic characterization, realizing low-dimensional sparse characterization by using one-hot coding of extremely random leaf nodes, reducing the calculated amount of a deep network, inhibiting overfitting through sparsity, retaining the combined meaning of geological factors corresponding to the leaf nodes, considering efficiency and interpretability, being more robust in network training, solving the gradient attenuation problem by lossless characteristic propagation of reversible residual blocks, improving the generalization capability of small samples by random subspace heavy parameter strategy, enabling the models to be stably trained in a landslide sample scarcity scene, and enabling overfitting gap to be less than or equal to 0.010.

title_en: River course flood evolution simulation and flood prevention emergency decision support system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water conservancy informatization and flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a river course flood evolution simulation and flood control emergency decision support system and method, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a central decision correction server and a boundary space-time reference node arranged at the edge of a key flood prevention node, wherein the central decision correction server is provided with microsecond time synchronization capability and is used for collecting state data such as sluice opening, personnel transfer and the like and executing control instructions, the boundary space-time reference node is aligned with heterogeneous data through a high-precision timestamp, a digital twin situation under a unified space-time reference is constructed, and hydrodynamic model boundary conditions are dynamically corrected based on instruction execution deviation to trigger re-simulation and emergency decision updating. The invention solves or at least reduces the problem of disconnection between simulation results and reality caused by lack of closed loop feedback and unified time reference of simulation deduction and physical execution in the existing system, and provides a river flood evolution simulation and flood prevention emergency decision support system and method.
assignees: HENAN YONGKUN WATER CONSERVANCY CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: LightGBM model-based power grid weather damage level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid weather damage level prediction method and system based on LightGBM model, and belongs to the field of disaster early warning of power systems. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing meteorological elements, power grid distribution and transformation faults, equipment and regional data, calculating exposure and vulnerability grid-level disaster-bearing body indexes, screening key features through correlation analysis after data aggregation, constructing a two-level classification dataset according to disaster damage labels defined by the number of users with power failure, configuring and training LightGBM two-level and three-level classification models, optimizing the two-level classification threshold values, deploying the models, and sequentially reasoning and outputting disaster damage levels after real-time meteorological data processing. The method solves the problems of low recall, scene separation and poor precision of severe disaster damage prediction in the prior art, improves the recognition and prediction precision, attaches the operation and maintenance of the power grid, supports emergency decision, and improves the disaster early warning and emergency efficiency of the power grid.
assignees: NANCHANG KECHEN ELECTRIC POWER TEST RES CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic demarcation method for mountain torrent disaster dangerous area based on multi-source data coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic demarcation method of a mountain torrent disaster dangerous area based on multi-source data coupling, which comprises the steps of acquiring rainfall forecast data of a weather radar, earth surface deformation monitoring data and high-precision DEM topographic data in real time, preprocessing the data to generate a fused multi-source dataset, constructing a distributed hydrological model, calculating the yield and the flow of a sub-river basin, training a Seq2Seq-LSTM model based on rainfall-water level-rising time sequence data, forecasting the dangerous area in a set time period in the future, adopting an SOM-CLARA clustering algorithm, dynamically dividing the high/medium/low dangerous area by taking rainfall intensity, earth surface deformation rate and gradient as feature vectors, and combining a critical rainfall threshold and a spatial heterogeneity index to determine the early warning level of each dangerous area. According to the invention, the range of the dangerous area is dynamically adjusted through the multi-source data dynamic coupling and self-adaptive demarcation algorithm, so that the accuracy and timeliness of mountain torrent disaster risk prevention and control are remarkably improved.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Four-dimensional monitoring and early warning method based on deformation gradient threshold
abstract_en: The invention provides a four-dimensional monitoring and early warning method based on a deformation gradient threshold, which comprises the steps of obtaining displacement of monitoring points, engineering environment data and time sequence data of a hydropower station, extracting deformation characteristics and process characteristics, matching a deformation prediction model with a preset characteristic library, fusing gate-control weighted deformation and process characteristics by multiple scales, classifying gradient lifting trees to obtain a preliminary early warning strategy, driving the model to simulate deformation, optimizing the deformation through multiple constraints to obtain a target early warning strategy, and adjusting the target early warning strategy in real time by a dynamic correction model and outputting early warning signals when abnormal deformation occurs. The invention can improve the accuracy, the instantaneity and the reliability of engineering instability monitoring and early warning and reduce the disaster risk.
assignees: POWERCHINA KUNMING ENG CORP LTD;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;SINOHYDRO BUREAU 6 CO LTD

title_en: Ruins simulation method for earthquake rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological earthquake simulation ruins, and discloses a ruin simulation method for earthquake rescue, which comprises the steps of firstly respectively constructing a main body structure and a scene simulation engine, and then building environment simulation equipment, transmitting data acquired in the environment simulation equipment to an intelligent perception network, transmitting real-time data of personnel to a scene simulation engine by the intelligent perception network, and finally transmitting all data to a data management platform. According to the ruin simulation method for earthquake rescue, simulation parameters are adjusted in real time through the behaviors of rescue workers, risks and challenges faced by participants in training approach to real disaster sites, psychological adaptability and emergency response capability are improved, the AI system adjusts scene complexity or triggering events according to actions, decisions and speeds of each rescue worker, difficulty can be set for personnel with different skill levels in a personalized mode, and training efficiency and training effect are improved.

title_en: Pump gate station scheduling method based on rainfall scene library and urban waterlogging simulation model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water management, in particular to a pump gate station scheduling method based on a rainfall scene library and an urban waterlogging simulation model, which comprises the steps of acquiring real-time rainfall forecast data and constructing a rainfall forecast process curve according to the real-time rainfall forecast data; the rainfall situation is determined by matching the rainfall forecasting process curve with a preset rainfall situation library, the rainfall situation is matched with a preset pump gate station scheduling strategy library, a pump gate station scheduling strategy is obtained, and a target pump gate station is controlled to drain according to the pump gate station scheduling strategy. According to the application, the traditional lagging and passive scheduling modes are converted into active and prospective intelligent scheduling by establishing a rapid mapping channel for forecasting rainfall to match rainfall situations and then matching a pump gate station scheduling strategy, so that the response speed and decision scientificity of urban flood prevention and drainage are remarkably improved, and the risk of flood disasters is effectively reduced.
assignees: GUANGDONG AIKE ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data disaster backup and recovery exercise method and system
abstract_en: A data disaster backup and recovery exercise method and system comprise the steps of obtaining service flow data of call service nodes, call relations among a plurality of call service nodes and data flow records, constructing a service dependency directed graph, generating a call service node layering table, completing environment initialization in a preset exercise environment, establishing a flow mirror channel in a target service environment, copying read-only service flow in the target service environment to the preset exercise environment in real time through the flow mirror channel, obtaining a first data change snapshot of the target service environment and a second data change snapshot in the preset exercise environment, generating a data consistency check baseline table, analyzing the data consistency check baseline table, determining a data inconsistency event, updating the service dependency directed graph based on the data inconsistency event, and generating a comprehensive exercise report. The application can improve the accuracy of data disaster backup and recovery exercise.

title_en: Method and system for rapidly generating embankment scene based on graph calculation and topology optimization
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster emergency management and simulation calculation, in particular to a method and a system for rapidly generating a embankment scene based on graph calculation and topology optimization. The method comprises the specific steps of S1, marking scene key information based on a GIS map, S2, analyzing marked geometric data, constructing a topological relation based on graph calculation, S3, extracting elements required by model calculation from the analyzed topological relation, defining the attributes of the elements, S4, generating a rescue traffic network based on the defined element attributes and the geometric information, S5, checking the generated geometric data, the topological relation, the model elements and the traffic network, S6, integrating all data to generate complete simulated scene output after the checking is passed. According to the invention, by marking the critical information of the scene of the dike, the breach point and the simulation range and combining with the analysis of the geometric topological relation and the definition of the model elements, the simulation environment suitable for flood spreading and breach scouring calculation is quickly constructed, and the efficient and reliable technical support is provided for the emergency response and the auxiliary decision of the dike breach disaster.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Slope debris flow space-time early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope debris flow space-time early warning method and system, which belong to the technical field of debris flow early warning, and comprise the steps of collecting and preprocessing historical multi-source space-time data of a research area, constructing a sample data set, conducting data optimization processing on the sample data set, constructing a training data set containing disaster causing characteristics, constructing a machine learning model, conducting space-time self-adaptive training and super-parameter optimization on the training data set by utilizing the training data set, integrating an interpretability analysis module at the output end of the machine learning model for completing training and super-parameter optimization to form a debris flow space-time early warning model, inputting multi-source space-time data in grids in the research area into the debris flow space-time early warning model, predicting and outputting the occurrence probability of debris flow and generating a space-time early warning graph. The invention realizes the full-flow, automatic and intelligent space-time early warning process from data to early warning and then to mechanism interpretation by constructing a high-precision and interpretable space-time early warning model of the debris flow.
assignees: UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY;GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION;Natural resources ecological restoration center of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region

title_en: Pedestrian dynamic modeling method, device and storage medium considering panic emotion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian dynamic modeling method, equipment and medium considering panic emotion, which comprises the steps of firstly completing space discretization, static field calculation and obstacle treatment through scene initialization, determining the distance from a grid to an outlet by using Euclidean distance, generating a static field value, defining the space constraint of pedestrian motion, then innovatively constructing a multi-dimensional dynamic coupling panic factor quantification system in a pedestrian motion calculation link, integrating crowd density, environment stimulus intensity, distance between a pedestrian and a stimulus source and the like, realizing the accurate quantification of the panic emotion through a distance attenuation and time attenuation mechanism, and deeply binding the panic emotion with motion parameters. According to the invention, through the deep fusion of the panic emotion and the OSM model, the irrational behavior and the differential motion trail of pedestrians in an emergency scene are effectively reproduced, the simulation precision of a complex evacuation scene is remarkably improved, scientific and quantitative basis can be provided for evacuation scheme optimization and crowd management and control strategy formulation, and the method has important significance in improving public safety management level.

title_en: Nuclear power plant cold source water intake disaster-causing object migration path prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a disaster-causing object migration path of a cold source water intake of a nuclear power plant, which relates to the technical field of marine environment simulation and nuclear safety early warning and comprises the following steps of obtaining the topography, water depth, shoreline, tide level, wind field and hydrologic data of a target nuclear power plant sea area; the method comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional hydrodynamic model of a sea area based on data to simulate and obtain flow field data of space-time variation of the sea area, adopting a Lagrange particle tracking method to simulate and set a motion track of one or more virtual particles at an initial position based on the flow field data, and determining an early warning range of disaster-causing objects which can reach a water intake of a nuclear power plant within a preset time scale according to the motion track of the virtual particles. According to the invention, through integrating multisource marine environment data, a high-precision hydrodynamic model and a Lagrange particle tracking technology, the migration path of algae, spilled oil and other disaster-causing objects near the water intake of the nuclear power plant can be accurately simulated, and the early warning range of multiple time scales can be quantitatively given.
assignees: MCC INSPECTION AND CERTIFICATION CO LTD;CENTRAL RES INST BUILDING & CONSTR CO LTD MCC GROUP

title_en: Coal anisotropy-based method for predicting drainage capacity of through-bed drilling gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for predicting drainage capacity of through-layer drilling gas based on coal body anisotropy, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control and comprises the steps of quantifying permeability main control factor sensitivity weight, determining permeability evolution rules under the actions of different effective stresses and coal body structures, determining a coal body permeability anisotropy multi-factor response mechanism, establishing Kong Zhouyou effect force field space functions taking radial distances, tangential distances and circumferential angles as variables, constructing a through-layer drilling hole circumferential permeability anisotropy space distribution model, establishing a drilling unloading area stress-damage-seepage multi-field coupling mechanism and a permeability anisotropy time-space evolution model, analyzing interference characteristics among through-layer drilling gas migration flow field holes, analyzing through-layer drilling group drainage interference effect and layer management seepage control capacity prediction models, clarifying scale effect and marginal descending rules of group hole topology structures, and constructing a through-layer drilling group drainage capacity prediction three-dimensional model controlled by layer management direction.
assignees: LUOTUOSHAN COAL MINE NAT ENERGY GROUP WUHAI ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Automatic monitoring method for stratum collapse by using water level gauge
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses an automatic monitoring method for stratum collapse by utilizing a water level gauge, which comprises the following steps of arranging at least two water level monitoring points with different depths in a monitoring area, drilling holes and loading a water well pipe; installing water level gauge sensors at different depths below the groundwater surface; the gap is filled with a water filtering stone layer and an upper filling layer under the underground water surface; the water level meter sensor is connected with the data acquisition device and calibrated, the acquisition device is connected with the monitoring and early warning cloud platform, the power supply equipment supplies power, the cloud platform analyzes data in real time and sends out early warning in a super-threshold mode, collapse depth, scale and transfer rate can be judged, layering and automatic real-time monitoring is achieved, data accuracy and early warning timeliness are improved, and the method is suitable for stratum collapse monitoring of various hydrogeological areas.
assignees: SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Mine intelligent disaster avoidance path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine intelligent disaster avoidance path planning method which comprises the steps of collecting mine environment parameters, disaster information, personnel distribution data and danger avoidance facility state data in parallel, triggering disaster early warning when the parameters are detected to exceed a safety threshold value continuously for many times, generating disaster event identification, centering on the event, defining an influence area according to the disaster information, converging data in the area to form a dynamic data pool, executing disaster diffusion simulation and personnel evacuation track simulation based on the dynamic data pool, fusing the disaster diffusion simulation result and the personnel evacuation track simulation result to form a dynamic obstacle map, obtaining a plurality of paths according to the personnel distribution data and the danger avoidance facility state data, adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the dynamic obstacle map, and obtaining a disaster avoidance path according to path length, safety redundancy and group evacuation efficiency. The invention realizes the dynamic planning of the mine disaster avoidance path, and obviously improves the path safety and the evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating firefighting spray plane design drawing based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a fire-fighting spraying plane design drawing based on a generated countermeasure network, wherein the method is characterized in that a plurality of building plane drawings and matched fire-fighting spraying plane design drawings are obtained, filling pretreatment is carried out respectively, and training feature drawing pairs are generated; the method comprises the steps of training a preset countermeasure generation network model by adopting each training feature map to generate a fire control spraying arrangement model, carrying out filling pretreatment on a building plan to be treated to generate a building plan feature map when the building plan to be treated is received, inputting the building plan feature map into the fire control spraying arrangement model, outputting a spraying design feature map, and combining the building plan feature map and the spraying design feature map to generate a target spraying plan design map. Therefore, the spraying plane design drawing is efficiently and accurately generated by training the fire-fighting spraying arrangement model and adopting the model to spray the building plane graph to be processed.

title_en: Knowledge base construction and rescue scheme generation evaluation system based on AI large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knowledge base construction and rescue scheme generation evaluation system based on an AI large model, and belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue. The system comprises a knowledge base construction module, an agent optimization module, a scheme generation module and an automatic evaluation module, wherein the knowledge base construction module is used for building a comprehensive seismic disaster knowledge system by integrating structured and unstructured data so as to build a multi-source heterogeneous seismic knowledge base, the agent optimization module is used for building professional seismic rescue agents based on a large language model by utilizing the multi-source heterogeneous seismic knowledge base and performing agent optimization, the scheme generation module is used for generating an intelligent rescue scheme by utilizing the professional seismic rescue agents based on semantic understanding and reasoning capacity of the multi-source heterogeneous seismic knowledge base, and the automatic evaluation module is used for evaluating and optimizing the intelligent rescue scheme generated by the scheme generation module. The invention realizes the intelligent generation of the earthquake rescue scheme and can provide a multi-element disaster exercise scheme.
assignees: HONGHE POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based fire evacuation path dynamic planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent evacuation simulation, in particular to a dynamic planning method and a dynamic planning system for a fire evacuation path based on digital twinning, wherein the invention can dynamically analyze the spreading trend of fire and the air evolution characteristics such as heat aggregation by constructing a digital twinning environment containing multidimensional real-time sensing data such as temperature, smoke, heat radiation intensity and the like, further accurately quantitatively evaluate the danger level of each section of the evacuation path, the video monitoring and wireless positioning information is integrated to grasp the specific positions and the movement tracks of people in the building in real time, the actual flow bottleneck is identified based on the flow direction consistency, the distribution density and the congestion condition of the people, and finally, the dynamic dangers of the fire environment and the macroscopic flow trend of the people are combined, the passing cost value of each path section is subjected to double dynamic correction, an evacuation path planning result which gives consideration to the fire hazard avoidance and the crowd congestion and the evacuation is generated, and the real-time performance and the safety of evacuation decision are effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU PINGKEJIE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method integrating Bayesian optimization and sparse residual error network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability evaluation method integrating Bayesian optimization and a sparse residual network, and relates to the technical field of mountain disaster space prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing landslide multisource factor sets, completing space standardization, carrying out feature compression by utilizing Bayesian optimization XGBoost, outputting primary probability features, inputting the primary features into a sparse gate-control residual error network, extracting high-order nonlinear coupling features through a sparse attention and residual error contraction dual mechanism, adopting a cross entropy loss and self-adaptive learning rate training network, outputting landslide occurrence probability, and dividing and drawing the probability of occurrence based on a GIS natural breakpoint method. The method is different from the existing landslide model in primary feature extraction and depth network architecture, obviously improves landslide susceptibility prediction precision and interpretability, and provides scientific basis for cold region traffic route selection and disaster prevention planning.

title_en: Storm surge coupling numerical simulation method and system based on climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm surge coupling numerical simulation method and system based on climate change, and relates to the technical field of numerical simulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the size of a regional grid according to pre-acquired regional characteristics, and carrying out data reconstruction processing on acquired heterogeneous space data based on the size of the regional grid to obtain a comprehensive heterogeneous data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a comprehensive heterogeneous model, carrying out model coupling to obtain a comprehensive coupling model, carrying out friction coefficient adjustment to obtain a storm surge coupling numerical simulation model, carrying out storm surge simulation on comprehensive observation data obtained in real time, and carrying out evaluation optimization on the storm surge coupling numerical simulation model to obtain a storm surge simulation model for storm surge coupling numerical simulation under climate change. The invention breaks through the limitation of the traditional single water increasing simulation through the comprehensive coupling model, and obviously improves the simulation capability of the polar water level, the near-shore water increasing and the composite disaster process.

title_en: Railway wind snow blowing danger judging and identifying method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway wind and snow blowing risk judging and identifying method and system, which are characterized by selecting wind and snow blowing disaster vulnerability evaluation indexes, calculating according to the weight of each vulnerability evaluation index and normalized vulnerability evaluation index values to obtain wind and snow blowing disaster vulnerability indexes, selecting wind and snow blowing disaster vulnerability evaluation indexes, calculating according to the weight of each vulnerability evaluation index and normalized vulnerability evaluation index values to obtain wind and snow blowing disaster risk evaluation values in grids based on the wind and snow blowing disaster vulnerability indexes and the vulnerability indexes, carrying out wind and snow blowing disaster risk grade division on railway lines based on the wind and snow blowing disaster risk evaluation values in grids, and quantitatively evaluating the influence degree of wind and snow blowing disasters on the wind and snow blowing disaster high wind risk areas by adopting a numerical simulation method. The method solves the defect that the influence degree of wind and snow blowing on the line is difficult to accurately quantify in the past, and is helpful for preventing the influence of the wind and snow blowing on railway construction and normal operation.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY FIRST SURVEY & DESIGN INST GROUP LTD;CHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION CORP LTD

title_en: Coal mine emergency drilling method and system based on dynamic catastrophe chain simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a coal mine emergency drilling method and system based on dynamic catastrophe chain simulation, and belongs to the field of mine emergency rescue simulation training drilling. Aiming at the technical problems that the static scene simulation in the existing coal and gas outburst accident emergency exercise cannot truly reproduce disaster burstiness and dynamic evolution characteristics, the real-time simulation of the disaster chain type propagation process is lacking, the exercise immersion is poor, the cooperative disposal capacity is insufficient in training, and the like, the high-fidelity dynamic reduction of the coal and gas outburst whole process is realized by constructing a three-dimensional mine scene and inputting the outburst parameters, dynamically simulating the shock wave propagation, breaking the coal body throwing and gas diffusion processes, and simulating the equipment destruction state based on the shock wave pressure. The method and the system effectively improve the consistency of the drilling scene and the real catastrophe, remarkably enhance the fidelity and the effectiveness of emergency training, and provide high-quality informatization technical support for emergency decision and collaborative treatment capability of mine staff under complex catastrophe conditions.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Rock damage acoustic emission precursor signal analysis method based on deep clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock destruction acoustic emission precursor signal analysis method based on deep clustering, which belongs to the technical field of rock mechanics and geotechnical engineering and comprises the steps of collecting and recording acoustic emission waveform signals of the whole rock deformation destruction process, preprocessing the collected signals, decomposing the collected signals by using discrete wavelet transformation to obtain multi-channel wavelet coefficient tensors, constructing a deep convolution self-encoder, performing unsupervised training, extracting features of the multi-channel wavelet coefficient tensors by using the trained encoder to obtain feature vectors, performing clustering analysis on the feature vectors to obtain class labels to which each acoustic emission event belongs, and realizing rock destruction acoustic emission precursor signal analysis based on clustering analysis results. According to the method, the acoustic emission original waveform is processed and analyzed, manual design parameters are not needed, acoustic emission precursor signals of rock damage can be effectively mined, and technical support is provided for disaster early warning of rock mass engineering.

title_en: Simulation method and system for tunnel disaster prevention and rescue monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation method and a system of tunnel disaster prevention and rescue monitoring equipment. The method comprises the steps of modeling equipment, defining equipment states and equipment operation rules, unifying equipment interfaces, storing state information and operation parameters of all the equipment in a unified data structure, distributing data to each physical interface and each communication protocol interface through interface mapping, setting a man-machine interaction mechanism, monitoring the equipment states in real time, controlling equipment working conditions, and recording and outputting operation processes of an equipment model. The invention simulates the hardware behavior through a software algorithm, realizes the running states and control response of a set of equipment such as a simulation fan, a blast gate, emergency lighting, evacuation indication, a protective door and the like, and fundamentally solves the problems of cost, efficiency and coverage in the test of the monitoring system of the tunnel disaster prevention rescue equipment.
assignees: SICHUAN CRUNGOO INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for collecting natural disasters in real time; means for training a generative AI model using the collected natural disasters; means for predicting a probability of occurrence of disasters using the generative AI model; means for reflecting the predicted probability of occurrence of disasters in a map service; and means for providing shelter information and information for preparing for disasters.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system, comprising: means for collecting, by a server, disaster information from the Internet; means for training, by the server, a generated AI model based on the collected disaster information; means for periodically distributing, by the server, the trained generated AI model to terminals; and means for providing, by the terminals, disaster information to users in offline environments by using the locally stored generated AI model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: Means for receiving authentication information of a user and performing authentication by collating the authentication information with a database, means for starting a session in a case where the authentication succeeds and returning an error message in a case where the authentication fails, means for displaying a screen for inputting personalized data and storing the input data in the database, means for converting a voice of the user into a text, analyzing the text on the basis of a natural language processing engine, and generating an appropriate answer, the system includes a means for arranging an emergency response when necessary, and a means for providing an appropriate teaching material or training program in response to the learning or training request of the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system, comprising: means for obtaining earthquake information; means for obtaining terrain information and weather data; means for performing a tsunami simulation based on the earthquake information and the terrain information; means for evaluating a risk of a user based on a simulation result; means for sending a notification to the user based on an evaluation result; and means for generating a personalized evacuation instruction based on location information of the user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to quickly and effectively perform information collection and handling of a business office when a disaster occurs.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a disaster prediction unit, a real-time information collection unit, a disaster-stricken office identification unit, a report creation unit, an action presentation unit, and a knowledge accumulation unit. The disaster-forecasting unit uses the generated AI to integrate the business office information into the geographic information system, and forecasts disasters. The real-time information collection unit collects disaster information in real time when a disaster occurs. The disaster-stricken office specification unit specifies a disaster-stricken office and aggregates peripheral information thereof. The report creation unit creates a report summarizing a situation at the time of occurrence of a disaster. The action presentation unit presents an action to be taken next. The knowledge accumulation unit accumulates past disaster response data and generates training and a response manual.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and system for dynamically generating storm disaster warning based on grid live condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic generation method and a system for a storm disaster warning based on grid live condition. The method comprises the steps of collecting site observation precipitation data, grid live precipitation data, radar data, geographic environment data and storm disaster warning events in a preset time period, carrying out deviation analysis and correction on the grid live precipitation data by utilizing the site observation precipitation data, calculating grid precipitation storm disaster warning thresholds according to the corrected grid live precipitation data and the site observation precipitation storm disaster warning thresholds, constructing a training data set, carrying out training optimization on a storm disaster warning model by utilizing the training data set, and carrying out red and orange storm disaster warning of villages and towns based on the storm disaster warning model after the training optimization. The invention can make up the defects of the layout of the observation station network, realize the effective monitoring of the disaster in the rainstorm in the non-station area, and remarkably improve the accuracy, the spatial resolution and the disaster prevention applicability of the risk early warning of the rainstorm disaster.
assignees: HUBEI METEOROLOGICAL INFORMATION AND TECH SUPPORT CENTER

title_en: Underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twinning-based underground space fire-fighting early warning method, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent fire fighting; the method comprises the steps of judging fire state of a node network to obtain fire state parameters, deducing change conditions of the fire state parameters in real time through fire trend analysis to determine tunnel fire evolution trend data, dynamically rendering through smoke and thermodynamic diagram based on the fire evolution trend data to obtain simulation scenes of tunnel fire evolution, and carrying out personnel evacuation simulation on a tunnel according to the simulation scenes to determine real-time personnel evacuation planning under tunnel fire. The method solves the technical problem that fire prediction is inconvenient in fire-fighting early warning of the tunnel underground space in the prior art.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster damage monitoring method and judging device for electric power facilities
abstract_en: The invention relates to a disaster damage monitoring method and a disaster damage judging and identifying device for an electric power facility, and belongs to the technical field of disaster damage monitoring of the electric power facility. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional feature image of a disaster damage judging and identifying device through collecting multi-source data, dynamically scheduling and matching a pre-layering model for concurrent tasks based on the multidimensional feature image, carrying out decoupling analysis on the multidimensional feature image through the pre-layering model, completing classification and positioning in parallel, generating a new model through training data uploaded by all disaster damage judging and identifying devices, setting multidimensional feature weights based on release targets, calculating comprehensive scores, and screening gray release targets. According to the invention, the dynamic scheduling of model resources is realized through multidimensional feature images, the utilization efficiency and response instantaneity of edge side resources are improved, the decoupling architecture is adopted to process classification and positioning tasks in parallel, the recognition precision is improved, a closed-loop self-evolution system is constructed by means of cloud-edge cooperative intelligent gray level release mechanisms, and the monitoring precision, predictability and continuous optimization capability are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Gravity balance dislocation device capable of realizing vertical reciprocating motion of large-tonnage test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a gravity balance dislocation device capable of realizing vertical reciprocating motion of a large-tonnage test system, and relates to the field of civil engineering physical and mechanical tests. The device mainly comprises a stagger-movable model box body, a spring balancer, a damping spring shock absorber, a stagger-movable simulation oil cylinder, a large-flow dynamic hydraulic system, a sliding constant force clamping mechanism and a triaxial loading oil cylinder. The device innovatively adopts a spring balancer and a damping spring shock absorber, and is used for effectively balancing the self weight of the movable model box body, so that the movable model box body can be driven by the movable simulation oil cylinder to realize the thrust required by vertical reciprocating motion. The method can restore extreme mechanical environments such as fault dislocation, earthquake disturbance and construction excavation disturbance, so as to explore and invert the whole disaster inoculation occurrence process, and can provide theoretical and technical support for safe operation of tunnels and underground engineering, fault dislocation damage, quick repair after earthquake disaster and the like.

title_en: Multi-parameter multi-dimensional perception testing device and method for coal seam mining bottom plate water progressive guide lifting rock-soil model test
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine disaster simulation and monitoring, in particular to a multi-parameter multi-dimensional sensing testing device and method for a coal seam mining bottom plate water progressive rock-soil model test, which comprises a two-dimensional plane model frame, wherein the side wall of the two-dimensional plane model frame is provided with a hydraulic hanging rail which is rotationally connected with the two-dimensional plane model frame through a hinge mechanism, the device has high integration degree, is rich in a two-dimensional plane model test system, a multi-parameter distributed sensing system, a mining simulation and loading system, a data acquisition and processing system and scientific system design, and realizes multi-parameter, multi-dimensional and real-time dynamic monitoring of the progressive water lifting process of the coal seam mining bottom plate. The device has the outstanding advantages of comprehensive detection parameters, continuous space coverage, strong anti-interference capability, visual data fusion and the like, and has wide applicability.

title_en: Geotechnical engineering catastrophe main control factor determination and safety evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining and safely evaluating a disaster main control factor of geotechnical engineering, which relate to the technical field of engineering safety evaluation and comprise the steps of constructing a full convolution network model to learn and combine sparse drilling data to conduct interpolation prediction on stratum images of unknown areas and outputting stratum profile predicted images; the BP neural network based on the simulated annealing algorithm inverts constitutive parameters through soil mechanical test data, integrates stratum section images, soil constitutive parameters and existing upper building information to conduct fine modeling, conducts fine simulation under the influence of multiple factors aiming at each potential factor, analyzes and determines the weight of each factor from simulation results by adopting an entropy weight method, establishes a multi-factor catastrophe evaluation model by utilizing a Topsis method, achieves quantitative safety evaluation and obtains an optimal construction scheme. According to the scheme, the disaster factor identification and construction scheme optimization are realized through the intelligent inversion and fine modeling method, and the accuracy of disaster prediction and the scientificity of safety decision are improved.

title_en: New energy automobile parking space fire self-adaptive fire suppression method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy automobile parking space fire self-adaptive fire suppression method, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobile parking space fire control equipment, and comprises the steps of constructing a system comprising a central control unit, an environment sensing module, a fire type identification module and a directional suppression execution module; the method comprises the steps of collecting visible light images, thermal imaging temperature, smoke concentration and volatile organic compound data of a hydrogen-carbon monoxide electrolyte through an environment sensing module, analyzing and judging fire types through a pre-training model, matching corresponding inhibition strategies based on a preset mapping table, positioning and accurately conveying and releasing fire extinguishing agents through a directional execution module, continuously collecting data to evaluate inhibition effects, and dynamically adjusting the strategies until the fire is extinguished and no re-burning risk exists. The fire disaster identification method improves fire disaster identification accuracy and inhibition efficiency, avoids secondary risk, ensures safety of the parking space and is suitable for fire disaster protection of the parking space of the new energy automobile.
assignees: CNBCC AUTOMOBILE SPARE PART XIAMEN CO LTD

title_en: Public safety agent perception planning control system and method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a public safety intelligent agent perception planning and control system and method, comprising a multimodal perception module, an intelligent planning module, a precision control module, and a model training and optimization module. The multimodal perception module is connected to the intelligent planning module, and the intelligent planning module and the multimodal perception module are respectively connected to the precision control module. The model training and optimization module are respectively connected to the multimodal perception module, the intelligent planning module, and the precision control module. The present invention integrates multidisciplinary technologies such as computer vision, sensor fusion, reinforcement learning, and path planning, aiming to empower various public safety equipment and systems with accurate environmental perception, efficient task planning, and reliable action control capabilities, thereby improving the intelligent management level in the field of public safety, Effectively addressing security challenges in complex scenarios such as crime prevention, disaster emergency response, and control of densely populated areas, providing solid technical support for safeguarding public safety in society.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIZHI JUSHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for testing accumulated water frost heave of tunnel backing cavity under seepage condition and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for testing ponding and frost heaving of a tunnel backing cavity under a seepage condition. The test device comprises a test box mechanism, a seepage system, a refrigerating and heat-preserving system, a lining and cavity system and a data acquisition system, wherein surrounding rock similar materials are filled in the test box mechanism, a lining and back cavity and data acquisition elements are arranged in the middle of the test box mechanism, the seepage system is arranged on two sides of the test box mechanism and connected with the test box mechanism through connecting pipes, the refrigerating system for cooling is arranged in the middle of a tunnel lining, and a heat-preserving plate is wrapped on the outer side of the test box mechanism. The device and the method can simulate the ponding frost heaving process of the cavity of the tunnel backing under the seepage condition, can deeply understand the frost damage mechanism of the tunnel in the cold region, optimize the lining design, and provide more reliable test basis for disaster prevention and reduction of the tunnel in the cold region.

title_en: Digital twinning-based system and method for improving toughness of distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based system for improving toughness of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, which comprises a physical model layer, a data interaction layer, a simulation model layer and an application service layer, wherein the physical model layer is used for acquiring geographical information of the power distribution network, equipment account data of the power distribution network, topological structures of the power distribution network, user load information and historical typhoon scene libraries, the data interaction layer is used for accessing data acquired by the physical model layer, the simulation model layer is used for simulating typhoon fields, equipment failure rate calculation, typhoon scene simulation, load loss calculation, equipment toughness calculation and equipment vulnerability sequencing, and the application service layer is used for providing a reinforcement strategy for the power distribution network to cope with typhoon disasters. The utility model also discloses a method for improving the toughness of the distribution network under typhoon disasters based on digital twinning. According to the invention, real-time synchronization of a physical entity and a digital model is realized, multi-source heterogeneous data are deeply fused, and the reinforcement requirements of power distribution network equipment in two different reinforcement modes facing typhoon disasters are met by embedding two different toughness promotion models.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Urban storm flood multi-scale dynamic simulation method based on digital elevation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of flood disaster simulation, and provides a digital elevation-based urban storm flood multi-scale dynamic simulation method, which comprises the steps of collecting relevant data of urban storm rainfall; the method comprises the steps of constructing a geometric model of a drainage pipe network, connecting the model with a surface water flow dynamic simulation through a coupling method, adopting a microscopic-scale drainage system modeling and a high-resolution water flow simulation method to evaluate flood ponding and flow distribution of different catchments, describing water flow behaviors in a pipeline based on a one-dimensional pipe network model, reflecting water flow changes of urban environments based on a two-dimensional surface water dynamics model, coupling the one-dimensional pipe network model with the surface water dynamics model, simulating dynamic interaction between surface water flow and the drainage pipe network through calculated water volume exchange, and adjusting model parameters based on actual flood data. The invention breaks through the adaptability bottleneck of the traditional model in complex urban environment and extreme weather, and realizes the full-flow and high-precision dynamic simulation of water flow from macroscopic drainage basin to microscopic facilities.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Device for simulating different drought environments to start debris flow and air resistance monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for simulating different drought environments to start debris flow and a method for monitoring air resistance, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster simulation tests.
