According to the invention, three parallel variable slope test boxes are connected in parallel and are converged into the main circulation channel, so that visual and quantitative research on the debris flow starting and migration processes under different drought environments and surface salinity conditions is realized. The device is provided with a controllable strength fan-shaped atomization precipitation simulation system, a temperature simulation system, a capillary water supply and salt migration system, a wireless landfill type pressure sensing array and a multi-channel water collection system, and the special water division field and the air resistance effect of 'lower wetting and upper drying' of drought river valleys are accurately reproduced, so that the critical condition for debris flow starting is revealed. The method realizes high-precision simulation and real-time monitoring of the air resistance effect in the drought valley debris flow starting process, improves test repeatability and prediction precision, and provides effective technical means and quantitative basis for researching the geological disaster mechanism of the western drought valley region, constructing an early warning model and optimizing prevention and control measures.

title_en: Intelligent mountain highway open shed tunnel security risk assessment method based on KG-SW-EWM-FCE coupling principle
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent evaluation method for mountain highway open shed tunnel safety risk based on a KG-SW-EWM-FCE coupling principle, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting the whole amount of data related to the collapse-resistant disasters of the open shed tunnel, S2, preprocessing and standardizing the collected data, S3, constructing an knowledge graph of the collapse-resistant disasters of the open shed tunnel, S4, screening key risk factors based on the knowledge graph, S5, constructing a fusion algorithm model based on the KG-SW-EWM-FCE, S6, training the fusion model and optimizing parameters, and S7, intelligently evaluating the collapse-resistant disasters of the open shed tunnel. The invention solves the core pain point of the traditional technology through the innovative design of knowledge graph-multi-algorithm fusion-closed loop optimization.
assignees: JIANGXI HIGHWAY RES AND DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: L-shaped drilling pressure relief and shock absorption method for thick and hard top plate of island working face
abstract_en: The invention provides an L-shaped drilling pressure relief and shock absorption method for a thick hard top plate of an island working face, which comprises the steps of confirming positions of a main key layer and a plurality of sub-key layers of the thick hard top plate above the island working face, collecting microseismic data of the top plate of the working face during working face mining, identifying positions of the key layers of main induced rock formations above the island working face, constructing a overlying strata structure model corresponding to abnormal mining pressure induced by key layer breaking energy transfer of the island working face, judging an induced rock formation induced impact mechanism, determining a disaster-causing main control layer and a plurality of disaster-causing sub-control layers, and performing L-shaped drilling construction pressure relief operation on the disaster-causing main control layer and the disaster-causing sub-control layers. According to the method, a key layer theory and microseismic data analysis are utilized to identify a key layer where a shock inducing rock stratum in a thick and hard top plate of an island working surface is located, a cover rock structure model above the island working surface is constructed, a disaster inducing sub-control layer and a disaster inducing sub-control layer are distinguished for a plurality of shock inducing rock strata, and therefore ultra-long drilling arrangement and pressure relief operation are carried out.

title_en: Cargo hold container conveying simulation device of fire-fighting rescue real-fire practical training system of aircraft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cargo hold container conveying simulation device of an aircraft fire-fighting rescue real fire training system, which comprises a cargo hold, wherein a cabin door is arranged on one side of the cargo hold, a universal ball platform is arranged above the cargo hold, which is close to the cabin door, a unidirectional ball platform in butt joint with the universal ball platform is arranged above the cargo hold, which is far away from the cabin door, the universal ball platform comprises a platform base, a universal ball assembly is inserted above the platform base, a side edge is arranged on the outer side of the lower part of the platform base, and a sleeve is fixedly arranged on the top wall of the platform base. Through the cooperation setting of universal ball platform and one-way ball platform, make this real standard system cargo hold container of fire rescue of aircraft ware transport analogue means have been equipped with the effect that is convenient for send into the container in the cargo hold and can effectively simulate the transport container in the conflagration to and have had the effect that can simulate the uneven complex situation in ground and make the firefighter remain vigilant throughout.
assignees: BEIJING XINCHEN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a data input means to be used for inputting data of a new user, a generation means for generating a training plan on the basis of past training data and basic information of the user, a proposal means for proposing the generated training plan to the user, a detection means for detecting abnormality, and a response means for performing emergency response when the abnormality is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of providing a quick and accurate evacuation instruction to a user and performing appropriate training even in normal times.SOLUTION: The system includes means for acquiring images and video feeds of a scene in real-time and pre-processing the same, means for analyzing the acquired AI using a generated AI model and evaluating the progress of a hazard, means for acquiring location information of a user and generating a safest evacuation route based on the analysis result, means for transmitting the generated evacuation route information to the user's device and providing audio and visual evacuation instructions, means for generating a virtual-training scenario and implementing an interactive Evacuation drill with the user, and means for continuously updating the generated data model based on the utilization of the system and new hazard patterns.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Dam address comparison and selection method integrating dam break scene simulation
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, provides a dam address comparison method integrating dam break scene simulation, and aims to solve the problems that the traditional dam address comparison depends on static parameters and ignores the influence of extreme dam break risks and multidimensional disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining river basin multisource geospatial data, primarily screening candidate dam addresses, constructing a three-dimensional geomechanical model, coupling a fluid dynamics equation, simulating dam break flood evolution and sediment transportation processes, quantifying population evacuation time threshold values, infrastructure inundation loss and ecological damage indexes, constructing a comprehensive risk and benefit scoring model by combining engineering cost and power generation benefits and adopting an entropy weight method, and sequencing and optimizing the first three dam addresses. The system correspondingly realizes the modularized function. By means of dynamic simulation and multi-objective decision fusion, scientificity, disaster resistance toughness and ecological economy cooperativity of dam address comparison selection are remarkably improved, and quantifiable and reusable technical support is provided for hydraulic engineering toughness planning.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIYANG ENGINEERING CORP LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER UPSTREAM HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Lightning protection test system and lightning protection test method for fan blade
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power disaster prevention, and particularly relates to a lightning protection test system and a lightning protection test method for fan blades, wherein the lightning protection test system for the fan blades comprises a fan scaling model, a wind turbine control system and a wind turbine control system, wherein the fan scaling model is subjected to equal scaling according to the size of a fan and comprises a rack and a plurality of blades arranged on the rack; the lightning protection device comprises a lightning receptor device, a lightning stroke simulation module, a lightning protection test module and a control unit, wherein the lightning receptor device is detachably arranged on a blade and is used for receiving simulated lightning strokes, the lightning stroke simulation module is arranged above a plurality of blades and is used for applying induction Lei Xinhao to the blades to simulate lightning strokes, the lightning protection test module is arranged on the blades and is used for detecting transient voltage and transient current of a blade grounding loop, and the control unit is used for determining the lightning protection performance of the lightning receptor device according to detection results of the lightning stroke test module and the lightning receptor device. The lightning protection test system for the fan blade can simulate the lightning strike environment of the fan so as to debug and verify the lightning arrester device.
assignees: State grid hunan electric power co ltd;HUNAN DISASTER PREVENTION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD DISASTER PREVENTION & MITIGATION CT;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Passenger ship personnel evacuation time prediction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a passenger ship personnel evacuation time prediction method based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field. The method comprises the steps of determining influencing factors of passenger ship personnel evacuation time as input features, training various machine learning models, predicting the passenger ship personnel evacuation time by using the input features, obtaining model performance evaluation indexes based on a preset test set, calculating the comprehensive score of each machine learning model according to the model performance evaluation indexes through an entropy weight method, and deploying the machine learning model with the highest comprehensive score as an optimal model on a passenger ship to realize passenger ship personnel evacuation time prediction. The method establishes a passenger ship scene evacuation simulation model based on the intelligent agent, comprehensively considers the influence of factors such as personnel attributes, group behaviors, passenger ship layout, external environment and the like in the passenger ship scene, effectively establishes the relationship between the influence factors and evacuation time, provides a solid data basis for accurate analysis of a machine learning model, and enables the simulation to be closer to the real evacuation situation.

title_en: Negative sample screening method based on self-training semi-supervised machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a negative sample screening method based on self-training semi-supervised machine learning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment in the field of civil engineering. The method comprises the steps of constructing an initial training set containing historical disaster positive samples and non-disaster candidate negative samples, training an initial classification model by adopting a machine learning algorithm, correcting the negative class confidence of the candidate negative samples by combining characteristic values output by an interpretable machine learning method, screening high-confidence negative samples through a dynamic threshold value to form a trusted negative sample set, recombining the trusted negative sample set with the positive samples until the negative sample set is stable or the performance of the model is improved and slowed down, finally outputting a final model for predicting the vulnerability of the geological disaster and the trusted negative sample set, effectively reducing the label noise of the negative sample, improving the prediction capability of the model in a positive sample scarcity scene, and providing reliable technical support for disaster prevention and reduction of the geological disaster.

title_en: Knowledge question-answering system based on large language model in coal mine fire early warning field and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a knowledge question-answering system in the field of coal mine fire disaster early warning based on a large language model and a construction method thereof, belonging to the technical field of coal mine data query and analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting environment, sensor and equipment state monitoring data, cleaning enhancement data by adopting a fire sensor analog quantity-discrete quantity mixed interpolation method, optimizing and processing abnormal values, converting structured data based on a keyword association labeling improvement method of a coal mine fire term dictionary, constructing a domain knowledge base, matching query questions, constructing question-answer pairs based on the knowledge base and training corpus, finely adjusting a large model to generate a scene knowledge model, constructing a question-answer system, and visually realizing gas abnormality identification, alarm pushing and knowledge question-answer. According to the method, the intention of the user is accurately understood through matching of the large language model and the knowledge base, the vectorization technology is used for realizing knowledge retrieval, optimizing resources, improving query efficiency, response speed and intelligence level, and providing reliable technical support for coal mine fire early warning and safety management.
assignees: GD POWER DEV CO LTD;GUODIAN CONSTR INVEST INNER MONGOLIA ENERGY CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Prefabricated assembled grouting anchoring foundation for post-disaster rush repair of electric power facility
abstract_en: The invention provides a prefabricated assembled grouting anchoring foundation for post-disaster repair of an electric power facility, which relates to the technical field of anchoring foundations and comprises an annular fixing ring, wherein a mechanical drill bit is arranged below the annular fixing ring, an adjusting nut is arranged above the mechanical drill bit, a slurry outlet is arranged below the annular fixing ring, a cement channel is arranged in the slurry outlet, a cavity is formed in the slurry outlet, a ground leveling mechanism is arranged below the annular fixing ring, the electric power facility can be leveled and stably fixed on the ground damaged after the disaster, and the leveling mechanism comprises a level detector, a level adjusting cylinder, an adjusting nut and a threaded rod.

title_en: Typhoon-resistant toughness enhancing method for net cage
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for enhancing typhoon resistance of a net cage, which belongs to the technical field of marine culture equipment and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional fluid-solid coupling model, carrying out fluid-solid coupling load calculation, quantifying the space-time distribution characteristic of coupling load on the net cage, simulating the stress-strain response of a net cage structure, positioning the weak part of the net cage, identifying a failure conduction path, combining the space-time distribution characteristic and the identification result of the failure conduction path, designing three-level enhancement measures to enhance toughness, carrying out simulation test, verifying structural stability, carrying out closed-loop optimization according to the verification result, being applicable to upgrading and reconstruction of the existing net cage, obviously improving the structural integrity maintaining capability of the net cage in typhoon environment, resisting high-grade typhoon impact, reducing economic loss caused by typhoon disasters, providing a new paradigm for design of marine culture equipment in extreme environment resistance, and having obvious industrial value and social benefit.

title_en: Underground structure nondestructive testing method and system for earthquake prevention
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, and discloses a nondestructive testing method and a nondestructive testing system for an underground structure for earthquake prevention, wherein a broadband low-frequency transient air pressure excitation signal is applied to the ground surface; the broadband low-frequency transient air pressure excitation signal is downwards transmitted through a geotechnical medium, a high-sensitivity air pressure microwave dynamic sensor array distributed on the ground surface is adopted to collect secondary air pressure fluctuation signals which are re-radiated to the ground surface from the air-solid coupling resonance response in real time, the collected secondary air pressure fluctuation signals are preprocessed, low-frequency pneumatic resonance characteristics are extracted, a damage area with local void or micro-crack of an underground structure is determined according to the three-dimensional distribution of the pneumatic resonance intensity, and nondestructive detection for preventing earthquake is achieved. According to the invention, through a surface broadband low-frequency transient air pressure excitation and air-solid coupling resonance response reradiation mechanism, the complete nondestructive detection of a deep underground structure is realized, and damage imaging can be completed without drilling or excavation.

title_en: Tunnel fire test device for natural ventilation and smoke discharge of unpowered hood
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ventilation and smoke discharge of tunnels, and relates to a tunnel fire test device for natural ventilation and smoke discharge of an unpowered hood. According to the invention, a tunnel is simulated through the first box body, a vertical shaft is simulated through the second box body, tunnel wind and environmental wind are simulated through the two variable frequency fans, a fire disaster is simulated through the fire source combustion assembly, smoke generated when the fire disaster occurs is simulated through the smoke source combustion assembly, the wind speed and the temperature when the fire disaster occurs are detected through the detection assembly, flame combustion and smoke flow images when the fire disaster occurs are shot in real time through the shooting assembly, then the rotating speeds of the two variable frequency fans are controlled according to the wind speed, so that different pressure differences are formed inside and outside the tunnel, and the influence of unpowered hood ventilation smoke discharge on the temperature and the smoke flow in the tunnel under the driving of different pressure differences is researched by matching the received temperature and the smoke flow images.

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster economic loss quantitative evaluation method based on IBWO-IRCNN-Informer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of waterlogging disaster damage assessment, and particularly discloses a quantitative assessment method for urban waterlogging disaster damage based on IBWO-IRCNN-Informer, which comprises the steps of constructing a model of urban waterlogging disaster simulation by utilizing a InfoWorks ICM model, carrying out coupling simulation on a one-dimensional hydrodynamic process of an urban pipe network and a two-dimensional water accumulation and overflow process of the ground surface, constructing a waterlogging flooding prediction model by combining IRCNN, informer and an improved white whale optimization algorithm, constructing a data set based on a simulation result of the model of waterlogging disaster prediction, training and evaluating the model of waterlogging flooding prediction, identifying and dividing each disaster-bearing body region by utilizing a geographic information system technology, carrying out superposition analysis on a flooding region obtained by the model of waterlogging flooding prediction, determining exposure disaster-bearing body information, combining a waterlogging disaster damage rate function and a maximum economic damage amount of each disaster-bearing body, partitioning the region and considering the occurrence probability of waterlogging, and calculating the possible economic damage amount of the partition based on the economic damage amount, and realizing a risk region based on possible economic damage amount.

title_en: Conductive field source-based combined vibration and electricity mining advanced prediction method in TBM environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a conductive field source-based combined mining advance prediction method in a TBM environment, and belongs to the technical field of mining advance prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing a training set through simulation data generated by transient electromagnetic forward modeling and tunnel seismic advanced prediction forward modeling, training a Wnet network based on the training set, receiving the transient electromagnetic data and tunnel seismic wave data by utilizing the Wnet network after training, and outputting advanced geological prediction results, wherein a loss function of the Wnet network training process comprises model errors of predicted resistivity and actual resistivity, model errors of predicted wave impedance and actual wave impedance, and errors of calculated theoretical response and input response, wherein Wnet network prediction results are substituted into a transient electromagnetic forward equation and a tunnel seismic wave forward equation. The method overcomes the limitation of a single geophysical method through multi-source information complementation, and improves the identification capability of complex geological disaster bodies by using the sensitivity of TEM to water and the sensitivity of tunnel seismic exploration to rock mass structures.
assignees: ANSTEEL GROUP MINING IND CO LTD

title_en: Gas-spontaneous combustion-dynamic disaster control method based on high-level horizontal long drilling
abstract_en: The invention provides a gas-spontaneous combustion-dynamic disaster control method based on high-level long drilling, which is characterized in that the high-level long drilling is arranged on a top plate along the mining direction, so that one hole is multipurpose, the gas-spontaneous combustion-dynamic disaster control method has the functions of gas extraction and filling, the gas extraction is firstly carried out through the high-level long drilling along with the pushing of a working surface, then the grouting filling is carried out by using a novel sulphoaluminate cement-based double-liquid filling material according to the caving step distance of the top plate, a stable filling body is formed after the slurry is condensed, the further development of a layered top fracture field is restrained, the broken coal rock mass is bonded to provide support for the top plate above a coal bed, and the cyclic operation of a gas extraction system and a filling grouting system is ensured in the pushing process. The invention effectively integrates gas control, fire prevention and extinguishment and roof control, greatly reduces drilling engineering quantity, reduces disaster control cost, realizes mine water resource and solid waste utilization, and remarkably improves the safety and environmental protection of mine exploitation.

title_en: Sea surface floater dynamic weight point location method and system based on remote sensing identification
abstract_en: A sea surface floater dynamic weight point placement method and system based on remote sensing identification belong to the technical field of marine environment monitoring and disaster emergency treatment, and aim to solve the problems that in the prior art, remote sensing identification of sea surface floater output is static polygon, the output is difficult to directly use for tracing simulation or salvage operation, and the traditional point placement has a plurality of manual interventions, low sampling precision and incapability of describing floater space-time heterogeneity. The method comprises the steps of identifying the coverage range and density of the sea surface floaters, generating grid points of a fixed resolution matrix, calculating the density weight of 0-1 interval, weighting randomly distributed particles, outputting the positions and the distribution density of the particles, constructing a density field and optimizing a salvage path, wherein the system is correspondingly provided with six modules of remote sensing identification, grid generation, weight calculation, particle distribution, result output and operation planning. The method does not need manual secondary treatment, improves tracing simulation precision and salvaging efficiency, reduces calculation and operation cost, and is suitable for large algae, floating garbage strips, oil spilling and other scenes.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: Data processing method for geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method for geological disasters, which particularly relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and data processing, and comprises the steps of collecting and normalizing multisource monitoring data to construct unified time sequence fusion vectors, identifying weak abnormal signals based on disturbance change rates and sensitivity models, extracting high disturbance feature points through sliding window clustering, constructing a dynamic risk factor matrix by combining remote sensing images, extracting dominant risk factor feature vectors through principal component analysis, inputting the dominant risk factor feature vectors into a disaster evolution simulation model, predicting future high risk areas by combining a historical path library, and finally outputting potential micro-disaster trigger points and risk grades to realize hierarchical early warning processing.

title_en: Slope falling stone detection method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a system for detecting falling rocks of a side slope, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and intelligent visual detection; the training set comprises a plurality of side slope image samples with falling stone labels, a side slope falling stone detection model is built, the side slope falling stone detection model comprises an input layer, a double-branch feature extraction module, a multi-scale feature fusion module, a segmentation decoding module and an output layer which are sequentially connected, the side slope falling stone detection model is trained by the aid of the preprocessed training set, a trained side slope falling stone detection model is obtained, a side slope image to be detected is obtained, the side slope image to be detected is input into the trained side slope falling stone detection model, and a corresponding side slope falling stone detection result is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method can carry out pixel level segmentation on the falling stone target under a complex background, and realizes high-precision, real-time and automatic falling stone detection.
assignees: SOUTH SURVEYING & MAPPING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode data intelligent identification and early warning system for low-altitude safety emergency scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and computers, and particularly relates to a multi-mode data intelligent recognition and early warning system for a low-altitude safety emergency scene. The method aims to solve the problems of difficult detection and delayed emergency response of a small low-altitude target in a complex urban environment. The system integrates radio frequency, optical, acoustic and meteorological multisource sensing nodes, achieves target fusion tracking through space-time reference synchronization and cross-modal association matching, utilizes a deep neural network with an attention mechanism to conduct threat cognition, combines Monte Carlo simulation and a dynamic weighting algorithm to conduct three-dimensional risk assessment, generates a yellow, orange and red three-level early warning instruction, and pushes early warning results to a multi-department collaborative response platform through an encryption interface and guarantees the whole process traceability through blockchain evidence storage. The system remarkably improves the low-altitude security situation sensing precision and the emergency response efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE CHENJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Micro-grid emergency dispatching method and system based on data-driven security domain
abstract_en: The invention provides a micro-grid emergency dispatching method and system based on a data-driven security domain. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the real safety boundary can be efficiently approximated by a small amount of high-value samples by introducing an active learning mechanism guided by the information entropy, so that the modeling cost is obviously reduced and the depiction precision of the safety domain is improved. On the basis, the high-precision dynamic safety boundary is used as a hard constraint to be embedded into a two-stage random optimization framework, and the cooperative optimization of safety and economy is realized by combining fault prediction and island operation capability. And a closed-loop optimization mechanism is formed through simulation verification and performance evaluation feedback, so that the load shedding amount is effectively reduced in a disaster scene, and the running toughness and the power supply reliability of the micro-grid are comprehensively improved.

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for evaluating toughness of a large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster, which are used for constructing a large-scale urban power grid fault scene and a time-varying fault probability model of a power transmission line under earthquake disaster, generating an earthquake-fault combined scene based on Monte Carlo simulation, selecting k high-risk typical scenes, constructing a grid disaster cooperative recovery model by taking the total weighted load recovery amount in a system full recovery period as a core optimization target to maximum, constructing a multi-dimensional dynamic toughness index system based on grid frame robustness, system self-recovery capacity and post-disaster repair capacity, evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid recovered after disaster cooperatively, and outputting the priority ordering of an optimization strategy. By evaluating the toughness level of the large-scale urban power grid which is cooperatively recovered after the power grid disaster, the overall process performance of the recovery can be comprehensively quantized, the advantages and disadvantages of strategies can be effectively distinguished, the recovery speed and the recovery degree can be accurately quantized, and therefore an effective recovery strategy can not be adopted, and a reliable basis is provided for the disaster prevention and emergency of the power grid.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Rock slope instability change intelligent early warning and monitoring device, system and method with weak interlayer under heavy rain condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of geotechnical engineering, geological disaster prevention and intelligent monitoring and early warning, in particular to an intelligent early warning and monitoring device, system and method for instability change of a rock slope with a soft interlayer under a heavy rain condition, wherein the device comprises a self-adaptive deformable boundary model box, a slope model, a rainfall simulation unit, a multidimensional fusion monitoring unit and a cloud intelligent early warning unit; the model box is used for constructing a dynamic boundary through the servo adjusting component and the pressure sensor, the slope model and the soft interlayer are made of high-similarity-ratio materials, the rainfall simulation unit can accurately reproduce multi-stage rainfall, the monitoring unit synchronously collects multi-parameter data such as strain, stress and displacement, the cloud side realizes four-level early warning based on an LSTM-CNN algorithm, and the model box is suitable for slope safety monitoring and disaster prevention and control in the fields of highways, water conservancy and the like.

title_en: Mine underground debris flow disaster risk analysis test device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mining engineering, and particularly discloses a mine underground debris flow disaster risk analysis test device. The device is characterized in that a debris flow material bin I and a debris flow material bin II are arranged in parallel, an migration channel I is arranged on one side of the debris flow material bin I, a migration channel II is arranged between adjacent debris flow material bins I and II, a migration channel III is arranged on one side of the debris flow material bin II, a plurality of inlet ports are formed in the side walls of the debris flow material bins I and II facing the migration channel at intervals, sensor monitoring units are respectively arranged in the debris flow material bins I and II and the migration channels I, II and III, a high-speed image acquisition unit is arranged on the outer side of the migration channel III, and the high-speed image acquisition unit and each sensor monitoring unit are electrically connected with the computer. The utility model combines the pressure, impact force, acceleration and flow state characteristics of each sensor and image acquisition real-time monitoring debris flow, can accurately simulate the dynamic migration process of the underground debris flow, and has the characteristics of flexible structure, comprehensive data and high experimental repeatability.
assignees: KUNMING ENGINEERING & RES INSTITUTE OF NONFERROUS METALLURGY CO LTD

title_en: Hospital disaster computer system
title_ko: 병원 재난 전산 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 병원 내외 재난, 사고 등이 초래될 경우를 대비한 훈련과 실제 재난, 사고 등의 발생에 있어 의료서비스의 중지 및 혼선이 없이 상시적으로 병원 내외 재난훈련을 가능토록 하여 병원 관계자들에게 명확한 역할 부여 및 이에 따른 상황 대응, 지휘체계, 협업, 평가 및 미비점 보완 등이 이루어짐에 따라 실제 재난, 사고 발생시 즉각적인 대응 및 의료서비스의 지속성을 유지하는 병원 재난 전산 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교육자로 하여금 재난상황 설정 및 피교육자로 하여금 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능하게 하여 실시간 재난상황 훈련과 소통을 가능하게 하는 입력부(100); 입력부(100)에 입력된 교육자의 재난상황 설정 데이터 및 피교육자의 대응 데이터를 저장 및 관리하여 성과 평가와 개선을 가능하게 하는 서버부(200); 서버부(200)에 저장된 데이터를 적어도 한 구역 이상 분할된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자 및 피교육자로 하여금 가시적으로 재난상황 및 재난상황에 대한 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 출력부(300);로 구성되며, 상기 입력부(100);는, 재난상황 설정과 피교육자에 대한 임무를 할당 가능한 교육자입력부(110); 교육자입력부(110)에 의해 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능한 피교육자입력부(120);로 구성되어 교육자가 설정한 재난상황에 대하여 피교육자의 대응능력 및 피교육자들간 소통 협업을 이루어지도록 하고, 상기 교육자입력부(110);는, 재난상황의 명칭, 장소, 시간, 목표, 교육자 정보가 포함된 기본정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 기본정보입력부(111); 재난상황 교육내용, 시간, 진행 교육자 정보가 포함된 교육프로그램 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 교육프로그램입력부(112); 재난상황 발생 및 각 재난상황에 대한 안내 메시지를 순차적으로 발송하고 발송되는 메시지의 저장 및 수정, 발송 순서를 입력 가능하게 하는 메시지입력부(113); 재난상황 교육이 실시되는 병원 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 병원정보입력부(114); 재난상황의 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 포함하는 피교육자정보를 입력 가능토록 하고 입력된 피교육자정보를 수정 입력이 가능한 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난상황에 대한 요약정보를 입력 가능하게 하여 피교육자로 하여금 재난상황을 문자로 확인할 수 있도록 하는 재난정보입력부(116); 재난상황 하에 피교육자의 활동 팀과 임무를 입력 가능하게 하는 팀및임무할당부(117); 재난상황 하에 활용 가능한 물품의 종류와 수량을 입력 가능하게 하는 물품입력부(118); 피교육자들의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하게 구성하는 사고조치입력부(119);를 포함하며, 상기 피교육자입력부(120);는, 재난상황의 대응 내용을 작성 및 전송 가능하게 하는 피교육자메시지입력부(121); 피교육자에게 할당된 임무와 설정된 팀의 변경, 자구 수정 입력을 가능하게 하는 정보변경부(122);를 포함하고, 상기 피교육자메시지입력부(121);는, 재난상황 발생시 메시지 전송으로 피교육자간 소통을 위한 문구를 설정 및 추가 입력을 가능하게 하는 입력설정부(121a);를 더 포함하고, 상기 출력부(300);는, 입력부(100)에 교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자의 재난상황 설정과 피교육자의 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 교육자출력부(310); 입력부(100)에 피교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 피교육자간 대응과 임무의 완수하도록 하는 피교육자출력부(320);로 구성되어 피교육자간 협업과 재난상황 훈련이후 피교육자의 훈련성과 평가 및 개선점을 파악할 수 있도록 하며, 한편, 상기 교육자입력부(110) 상에는 피교육자입력부(120)와 달리 피교육자입력부(120)에 비해 추가로 재난상황에 능숙한 전문가를 구별할 수 있는 사용자 인증이 추가로 이루어지고, 또한, 상기 교육자입력부(110)의 각 기본정보입력부(111); 교육프로그램입력부(112); 메시지입력부(113); 병원정보입력부(114); 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난정보입력부(116); 팀및임무할당부(117); 물품입력부(118); 사고조치입력부(119);에는 데이터를 입력하기 위해 각각 분할된 화면이 제공되고, 공란에 데이터를 입력하는 방법으로 각각의 기본정보, 교육프로로그램 정보, 피교육자정보, 병원정보가 입력됨과 아울러 출력부(300) 상에도 입력이 필요한 정보를 공란으로 설정하고 이에 대한 데이터 입력이 가능한 화면을 제공하며, 그리고, 피교육자정보입력부(115) 상에는 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 작성 가능한 문서를 제공하는 문서제공부(115a); 문서제공부(115a)의 제공 문서에서 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책에 대한 기재내용을 문자판독하는 문자판독부(115b); 문자판독부(115b);에 의해 판독된 문자를 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책별로 구분하여 입력되도록 하는 판독문자자동입력부(115c);를 더 포함하고, 또한, 상기 교육자출력부(310) 상에는 기본정보입력부(111)에 입력되는 기본정보를 토대로 교육목록을 출력하는 교육목록출력부(311); 기본정보입력부(111)의 기본정보에 포함된 교육자 정보를 토대로 교육자목록을 출력하는 교육자목록출력부(312); 메시지입력부(113)에 저장된 메시지를 출력하는 교육메시지출력부(313); 피교육자정보입력부(115) 및 팀및임무할당부(117)에 입력된 피교육자별 팀과 임무를 구분하여 표 형식으로 출력하는 피교육자및부서출력부(314); 피교육자의 접속 여부를 확인 가능하게 출력하는 접속출력부(315); 피교육자별 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 구성하고 대응내역을 일지로 구성하여 출력하는 일지출력부(316); 사고조치입력부(119)의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하도록 출력하는 사고조치출력부(317);를 더 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: KNL CO LTD;KIM YOUNG JIN;CHOI DAI HAI

title_en: Smart restore and recovery
abstract_en: The present inventors devised technological improvements that substantially speed up data recovery. Disclosed techniques include on-demand rapid recovery based on restoring metadata from backups before restoring payload data according to certain preferences and priorities. Disclosed techniques further include predicting how long a restore job might take based on simulated restore operations, and using the predicted restore times to generate a “smart recovery planner” or “recovery playbook” that is designed to optimize massive data recovery after a catastrophic data loss event, such as a disaster, ransomware attack, malware infection, etc. The disclosed techniques are especially well suited to optimizing large data recoveries and improving the user experience by prioritizing preferred data sets.

title_en: Urban flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood real-time dynamic risk assessment method based on multi-source data fusion, belonging to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of smart cities; the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting physical perception data, virtual perception data and forecast data in parallel, then generating a dynamic flood deep water field with high space-time resolution through fusion and simplification of hydrodynamic model simulation, data assimilation correction and video and social multimedia ponding information identification, further carrying out real-time dynamic risk assessment by combining multidimensional disaster-bearing body data such as population, infrastructure and traffic to generate a comprehensive risk index, and finally visualizing the result and issuing early warning. The method effectively solves the problems of lag evaluation and low space precision of the traditional method, realizes accurate and dynamic sensing and evaluation of urban flood risk minute-level updating by introducing a multi-source data fusion and feedback learning mechanism, and remarkably improves urban flood prevention emergency response capability.
assignees: SUZHOU JIUZHANG TONGSUAN INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Coastal city ponding intelligent prediction method based on optimized dispatching of fusion brake pump
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent prediction method for coastal city ponding by fusion brake pump optimal scheduling, which relates to the technical field of urban drainage and waterlogging prevention, and solves the problem of optimal scheduling rule selection in pareto solution set by establishing a coastal city brake pump joint optimal scheduling model and taking the minimum disaster-causing economic loss of waterlogging as a principle; the method comprises the steps of establishing an intelligent prediction model of waterlogging ponding in coastal cities, introducing an attention module, optimizing a loss function, enhancing learning ability of a U-Net model on complex spatial features of the cities, generating training samples by utilizing a hydrographic hydrodynamic coupling model, enabling prediction results to effectively integrate engineering scheduling effects, and realizing dual improvement of prediction precision and calculation efficiency. According to the method, the tidal level jacking effect, the gate pump optimal scheduling effect and the learning capability of complex spatial features of the coastal cities are fully considered, the accuracy and the calculation efficiency of the waterlogging and ponding prediction model are effectively improved, and the reliability and the applicability of the coastal city waterlogging prediction are further improved.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Near goaf medium-thickness blind ore body mining method based on upper exploring lane cooperative utilization
abstract_en: A method for mining thick blind ore bodies in near goaf based on cooperative utilization of upper exploratory drift includes utilizing exploratory drift pre-tunneled in upper part of blind ore bodies or upper disc surrounding rock as detection operation platform, constructing encrypted detection drilling group, accurately defining boundary adjacent to goaf and space form of blind ore bodies by combining in-hole detection technology, constructing active isolation barrier, partitioning ore bodies, constructing rock stratum reinforcing system consisting of anchor rods and anchor ropes downwards, and implementing step-by-step stoping and subsequent filling. According to the invention, through multi-stage utilization of single upper mining roadway engineering, from accurate detection of resources and disaster sources, active isolation of old goafs and stress partition to step stoping, influence of high stress of the goafs on adjacent engineering structures is blocked, the whole flow is safe and controllable, tunneling quantity of newly added special engineering roadways is reduced, construction period is shortened, safety ore pillars which are regarded as necessary sacrifice in the traditional method are converted into safe and controllable recoverable resources, and dilution and loss of ores are reduced.
assignees: YUNNAN XIYIN LABORATORY CO LTD;KAFANG BRANCH YUNNAN TIN COMPANY LTD

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method based on deep learning under large-scale uncertainty scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness evaluation method under a large amount of uncertainty scenes based on deep learning, which aims to solve the problem that the existing power system lacks effective evaluation on various uncertainty scenes. The toughness evaluation method of the electric power system comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the electric power system in a target area, secondly, simulating and generating resistance distribution of a power transmission tower in the electric power system by utilizing Monte Carlo, constructing a power transmission line damage scene, simulating power transmission tower damage based on random fields, thirdly, performing recovery simulation on the power transmission tower in the electric power system based on a function loss value, determining a toughness evaluation index, fourthly, establishing a toughness evaluation proxy model of the electric power system under a large number of uncertain scenes based on deep learning, and obtaining the toughness evaluation index of the electric power system based on the trained deep learning model. The method can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of the target power network under various actual uncertain typhoon disaster situations and uncertain power transmission tower damage situations, and improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Roadbed slope protection composition based on solid waste-geopolymer and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of roadbed slope protection, and discloses a roadbed slope protection composition based on solid waste-geopolymer and a construction method thereof, aiming at solving the problems of high carbon emission, low solid waste utilization rate, strong ecological destructiveness and weak disaster resistance of the traditional roadbed slope protection material. The invention takes fly ash, desulfurized gypsum, mineral powder and pretreated red mud as core raw materials, and is matched with a geopolymer excitant and a heavy metal stabilizer to form a cement-free flow state system with high solid-waste mixing ratio, a sleeve is not required during construction, the fluidity of a solidified body is utilized to be naturally attached with soil through a drilling-layering pouring process, a multi-shape solidification structure without rigid fracture is formed, the structure can enhance the scouring resistance and collapse resistance of a roadbed side slope, effectively resist the damage of natural disasters such as flood and the like to the roadbed, and simultaneously has the ecological compatibility of mechanical property and plant root penetration rate.
assignees: BEIJING JUHE NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel ventilation control system and control method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel ventilation control system and a control method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of ventilation control, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an unsteady state computational fluid dynamics model based on three-dimensional linear parameters of a tunnel in a tunnel design stage, calculating turbulence structures under different traffic conditions through a large vortex simulation method, and determining an optimal space configuration scheme of a fan group according to speed field and pressure field distribution; in the tunnel construction stage, multiple sensor arrays are arranged in layers along a tunnel vault and side walls, in the tunnel operation stage, real-time vehicle track and speed distribution information of a traffic monitoring system are acquired, a ventilation demand dynamic prediction model based on space-time correlation analysis is established, a fan cooperative control model considering air flow organization optimization is established, an optimal operation strategy is solved by adopting a multi-target self-adaptive weight distribution algorithm, and when fire disaster characteristic signals are monitored, multiple groups of fans are coordinated to form relay smoke exhaust air flow organization.

title_en: Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis method and a Bayesian network-based large-scale liquefaction disaster quick response analysis system, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering earthquake resistance and comprise the steps of carrying out earthquake risk decoupling on an area to be analyzed based on CPSHA, and determining the magnitude and the midrange of a plurality of earthquake events; the method comprises the steps of simulating by adopting a kinematic mixed seismic source model of fault physical rupture to obtain seismic parameters of an area to be analyzed, constructing a liquefaction sample library, constructing soil liquefaction evaluation parameters, carrying out standardized treatment on the soil liquefaction evaluation parameters to obtain raster data, respectively extracting numerical values from the raster data and the liquefaction sample library to form a sampling table, carrying out accuracy analysis and data training on the sampling table to form a conditional probability table, and calculating liquefaction probability and non-liquefaction probability of the area to be analyzed through a naive Bayesian probability model and a weighted naive Bayesian probability model based on the conditional probability table. The invention relieves the technical problems of high cost and time consumption in the prior art.

title_en: Vehicle management and control method and system based on highway storm disaster classification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle control method and a system based on highway storm disaster classification, which belong to the field of road traffic safety, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a finite element model, wherein the finite element model comprises a vehicle laminated glass model and a stone model, and setting material parameters and constraint conditions of the finite element model; based on the finite element model, simulating a dynamic impact process of the stone model impacting the vehicle laminated glass model under different wind speed conditions to obtain a damage state of the laminated glass model, dividing wind speed grades according to the damage state, determining a corresponding wind speed range, and realizing vehicle control based on the wind speed threshold. The invention solves the problem that the conventional method for controlling the classified vehicles by using the strong wind depends on a single wind speed and cannot comprehensively consider the influence of the strong wind on the road vehicles in multiple aspects.
assignees: XINJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD;XINJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;XINJIANG TRAFFIC SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Decision method for improving toughness of highway network in strong-earthquake mountain area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving and deciding the toughness of a road network in a strong earthquake mountain area, relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction and emergency management of traffic infrastructure, solves the problems that the study on the toughness of the road network is limited, the road network is focused on local independent points of the road network, the attention to the road network connectivity is influenced by single-point damage of the road, and the influence of the position of the road network topology on the whole connectivity of the road network is not fully considered, so that the treatment resource allocation is unreasonable. The method comprises the following steps of S1, digitally modeling a road network and a disaster-bearing body and setting a toughness target, namely constructing a road network topological structure model comprising road sections, bridges, tunnels and slopes, a disaster-bearing body database along the road, and setting a quantized road network toughness target. According to the invention, through simulating the main aftershock sequence and dynamic traffic distribution, the evolution process of the hill road network function under strong shock is reflected more truly, so that evaluation and decision are closer to actual disaster conditions, and the prospective and accuracy of decision are greatly improved.

title_en: Multi-fusion intelligent recognition and early warning method and system for coal mine disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-fusion intelligent recognition and early warning method and system for coal mine disaster risks, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent recognition and early warning for coal mine major disaster risks. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-index data of a coal mine working face as an initial data set, preprocessing time sequence data by utilizing a one-dimensional depth channel attention residual convolution-LSTM model and a chained multi-interpolation model, carrying out pearson correlation coefficient and spearman level correlation analysis on the preprocessed data to determine different major disaster risk monitoring and early warning index sets, analyzing and marking risk precursors, interference and noise signals of different indexes, inputting a sample enhancement model based on denoising and diffusion probability to complete sample expansion and training a MACN model, and establishing a multi-index risk fusion judgment method and a comprehensive early warning rule based on MAKER for each major disaster. The method has the advantages of dynamic adaptability, configurability, high interpretability and reliability under a small sample.

title_en: Tunnel water-inrush mud-bursting disaster source drilling and grouting integrated device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for integrating drilling and injection of a tunnel water and mud bursting disaster source, which overcome the technical bottleneck of remote treatment of the tunnel water and mud bursting disaster source. The tunnel water-flooding mud-bursting disaster source drilling and injecting integrated device and method provided by the invention are used for performing disaster source advanced treatment based on directional long drilling, have the obvious advantages of longer detection distance, and are capable of effectively detecting and treating longer distances. According to the integrated device and method for drilling and grouting the water and mud surge disaster source of the tunnel, provided by the invention, directional drilling construction, disaster source while-drilling detection, disaster source while-drilling treatment and grouting effect evaluation are completed in the directional drilling process, and drilling, detection, grouting and evaluation are realized by one pass of drilling, so that the treatment efficiency of the water and mud surge disaster source of the tunnel is obviously improved, and the integrated device and method are suitable for industrial large-scale use and popularization.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Electrical equipment fire-fighting automatic fire extinguishing system based on intelligent fire-fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting automatic fire extinguishing system for electrical equipment, which relates to the technical field of automatic fire extinguishing of electrical equipment, and comprises a data acquisition unit, a scheme generation unit and a simulation exercise unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring point cloud data of a machine room space and each electrical equipment inside, generating a virtual three-dimensional model through three-dimensional modeling software, extracting insulation material high-temperature degradation data of each electrical equipment, line connection point loosening oxidation data, machine room ventilation system fault data and corresponding times and parts causing fire disaster from a historical database, generating a corresponding fire extinguishing scheme according to the actual condition of the electrical equipment, performing simulation execution, comprehensively considering dynamic differences of fault evolution stages, and effectively reducing the wave rate of fire extinguishing resources by confirming and optimizing execution time of the fire extinguishing scheme, so that the fire spreading rate is reduced, and the excessive coverage of the whole machine room is avoided.
assignees: SHANXI ZHIYUAN GAOCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway tunnel explosion-proof toughening and performance evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground engineering protection and geological disaster prevention and control, and provides an explosion-proof toughening and performance evaluation method and system for a subway tunnel, wherein the method comprises the following steps of step 1, obtaining key parameters and determining equivalent explosion impulse and performance targets; the method comprises the steps of selecting toughening materials, determining a gradient structure, constructing the gradient structure, controlling quality, collecting structural response data, periodically updating surrounding rock parameters, establishing a numerical model, performing simulation analysis and check on a tunnel structure, calculating a toughness index R and a damage grade D, performing grading evaluation, and performing inversion check and adaptability verification optimization, wherein the step 5 comprises the steps of selecting the toughening materials, determining the gradient structure, the step 3 comprises the step of constructing the gradient structure, performing quality control, the step 4 comprises the step of collecting structural response data, and performing simulation analysis and check on the tunnel structure. The scheme solves the key bottlenecks of insufficient rigidity thickening energy consumption, fragile and easy peeling interface, impervious and toughening and disjointing interface, lack of unified index of energy-toughness and closed-loop evaluation in the prior art, and forms a generalizable and standardized explosion-proof toughening engineering solution.

title_en: Hydropower station underground plant flooding fault rapid simulation prediction method and prediction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower station safety, and discloses a hydropower station underground factory building flooding fault rapid simulation prediction method, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a rapid simulation analysis model, wherein a parameter system of the rapid simulation analysis model comprises geometric parameters, hydraulic parameters and disaster parameters; the method comprises the steps of S2, dividing the space of the hydropower station underground factory building of the rapid simulation analysis model into a plurality of reservoirs, establishing a water balance equation, S3, calculating the drainage capacity of a drainage system of the rapid simulation analysis model, S4, establishing a leakage risk point leakage model of the rapid simulation analysis model, calculating inflow water flow, S5, simulating the whole process from initial leakage to complete flooding by adopting a time stepping algorithm based on a mass conservation equation and a momentum conservation equation, and outputting a prediction simulation result. According to the space structure characteristics of the underground plant, the flow rate and the water level elevation penetrating into the plant are accurately simulated and predicted, so that the emergency decision accuracy and the response speed are improved.
assignees: SILIN POWER PLANT OF GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: System and method for simulating disaster scene fidelity of coal and gas outburst
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst catastrophe scene fidelity simulation system and method, which comprises an outburst induction module, a fluid filling module and a multifunctional monitoring module, wherein the fluid filling module comprises a water filling module, a slurry filling module, a gas pumping and discharging module and a Marsan filling module, the water filling module is used for carrying out slotting, fracturing and anti-reflection on a large-volume coal body in a fracture development area, the slurry filling module is used for carrying out bottom plate drilling and high-pressure-resistant hole sealing, the Marsan filling module is used for filling and reinforcing the coal body behind the fracture development area, the gas pumping and discharging module is used for further pumping, releasing and anti-reflection and filling high-pressure gas into the fracture development area to enable the outburst, the multifunctional monitoring module is used for providing a judgment basis by monitoring drilling air pressure, fracture development condition and coal body deformation into fluid filling degree, and further the outburst induction module is used for inducing coal body breakage of a tunneling surface in a large-area fracture development area.

title_en: Embankment underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed optical fiber acoustics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dyke underwater piping detection positioning system integrating distributed fiber acoustics, which relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring and comprises a voiceprint signal perception primary screening module, a primary filtering module and a secondary filtering module, wherein the voiceprint signal perception primary screening module is used for acquiring original acoustic vibration signals in a strong noise environment, primarily purifying and separating the original acoustic vibration signals to acquire eigenmode functions of different frequency bands, and separating weak piping suspected signals submerged in background noise. According to the invention, by introducing a digital twin technology, the inferred seepage network is mapped into a high-precision fluid-structure coupling model, and the evolution process of water level abrupt change and other extreme working conditions is simulated in a virtual space, so that the system can calculate the final form, size and position of a burst, the consequences of piping disasters are pushed from fuzzy qualitative judgment to precise quantitative prediction, and the dynamic deduction and quantitative prediction of the piping disaster process based on a physical mechanism are realized.

title_en: Substation network topology disaster recovery optimization method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation network topology disaster recovery optimization method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, which comprises the steps of modeling a heterogeneous graph of the transformer substation network to obtain a heterogeneous graph neural network model with multiple types of nodes and multiple relation edges, constructing a multiple-time-slice graph under normal and abnormal evolution scenes to record the time characteristics of the network, performing inverse fact simulation evaluation by using the heterogeneous graph neural network, defining inverse fact knockout influence by the reduction of toughness indexes after nodes are removed and the reduction of toughness indexes after edges are removed, training the heterogeneous graph neural network model according to the impact, and performing topology reconstruction optimization on the trained heterogeneous graph neural network model through a mask mechanism. The method utilizes the heterogeneous graph neural network to encode the graph structure and the multi-type characteristics thereof, carries out soft selection on the nodes and links with larger potential influence, combines the micro-optimized objective function and the constraint condition, and outputs an executable topology reconstruction and link weight adjustment scheme.

title_en: Earthquake-landslide chain disaster simulation method based on FEM-SPH self-adaptive coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computational mechanics and geological disaster simulation, and discloses a whole-process numerical simulation method suitable for simulating continuous medium damage to discontinuous medium movement. Aiming at the problems that the calculation efficiency and the large deformation precision are difficult to be simultaneously considered in the prior art, and the evolution process of the side slope from the continuum to the cracked body cannot be reflected dynamically, the novel chain disaster simulation method is provided. The method is characterized in that dynamic criteria are set based on real-time damage variables of units, invalid Finite Element (FEM) units are adaptively converted into smooth particle fluid dynamics (SPH) particles, physical states of the SPH particles are accurately mapped, and further a virtual particle coupling algorithm is adopted to process two-domain interfaces, so that bidirectional transmission of mechanical parameters is realized. The method is circularly executed, dynamically simulates the whole process of continuous deformation-fragmentation flow of the side slope, realizes high-precision integrated simulation of a disaster chain of 'seismic source-propagation-response-movement' in the same frame, and provides a high-efficiency tool for disaster risk assessment and prevention.

title_en: Post-disaster psychological intervention model training method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of model training and provides a training method of a post-disaster psychological intervention model, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining sample medical record data, extracting triple content from the sample medical record data, S2, determining scene categories according to patient complaints content, distributing scene labels and scene knowledge bases for the sample medical record data, S3, obtaining diagnosis results and illness state severity scores according to scene category combinations with maximum word frequency, S4, verifying the logic consistency of the diagnosis results obtained in S3 and clinical diagnosis extracted in S1, obtaining logic deviation degree, executing S5 if the logic deviation degree and illness state severity are smaller than or equal to a threshold value, otherwise returning to S3, and S5, based on the diagnosis results, generating an integrated treatment scheme of a drug therapy and a psychological therapy. The invention effectively solves the pain points that the number of professional psychological doctors is limited and the requirements of large-scale psychological assistance after disaster cannot be met, so that psychological intervention resources can break through the limitations of time, geography and manpower resources, and high-efficiency allocation is realized.

title_en: Method for predicting thermodynamic parameters and propagation states of new energy automobile fire in tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting thermodynamic parameters and spreading states of a new energy automobile fire disaster in a tunnel, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent prevention and control of tunnel fire disasters, and the method is based on fire dynamics simulation, establishes a time sequence database covering heat release rate, temperature and spreading states in a single vehicle fire disaster and fire spreading scene, and establishes a regression prediction task of a continuous numerical label based on the database; the method and the system can synchronously predict the heat release rate, the temperature and the spreading risk of the new energy automobile fire in the tunnel in high precision and real time, and provide key information support for emergency smoke discharge and evacuation decision of the tunnel fire.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method for unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task allocation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-agent reinforcement learning, in particular to a multi-agent reinforcement learning method for unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task allocation, which comprises the following steps: and integrating multi-mode data such as electromagnetic interference spectrograms, fault voiceprints, inspection images, dynamic events and the like in post-disaster task distribution of the extra-high voltage junction station, and constructing a high-fidelity multi-agent simulation model based on the graph neural network. As a design verification engine, when the global design performance index changes during simulation evaluation, the prediction error of the simulation model and the optimization potential of the collaborative strategy are accurately decoupled and quantized by using a counter fact attribution analysis technology. Finally, according to the two decoupled errors, independent loss functions are respectively defined, and the simulation model and the collaborative strategy are subjected to parallel targeted updating. According to the invention, the synchronization and accurate optimization of the simulation model and the collaborative strategy are realized by establishing the quantization attribution path from the global performance change to the model and the strategy error.

title_en: Avalanche susceptibility intelligent assessment method integrating depth residual error network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an avalanche susceptibility intelligent assessment method integrating a depth residual error network, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk assessment. The invention has high space precision, can accurately identify the influence of micro-topography on snow stability by adopting a 12.5m high-resolution DEM and 10 multisource evaluation factors, has an avalanche point hit rate of 82.5 percent which is far higher than that of the traditional method (generally <70 percent), has excellent model performance, not only reserves the interpretability of a shallow model by integrally learning a two-stage framework of a primary model and a residual network, but also improves the AUC= 0.8496 of ResMLP by more than or equal to 4 percent compared with the primary model by the nonlinear interaction between depth network capture factors, has strong generalization stability, reduces the prediction variance by about 12 percent on the premise of not increasing training cost by introducing a TTA mechanism of high-noise, is particularly suitable for a high-altitude small sample area, and effectively relieves the fitting problem.

title_en: Mine geological disaster identification survey equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surveying equipment, in particular to mine geological disaster identification surveying equipment. The electric sliding rail comprises a frame body, wherein a first electric sliding rail is arranged in the frame body, a first motor is arranged on a sliding block of the first electric sliding rail, an output shaft of the first motor is connected with a butt joint, and a splicing rod is arranged on the butt joint. According to the invention, by arranging the feeding mechanism, the rotating mechanism, the sliding frame, the clamping assembly and the screw rod motor and matching with the lifting and rotating actions of the first electric sliding rail and the first motor, the splicing rod can be automatically grabbed from the feeding frame, rotated to align and finish the butt joint and locking of the butt joint head and the underground drilling rod group, the whole process of the splicing rod avoids frequent complicated operations such as manual alignment, rotation fastening and the like in the prior art, the time of the splicing rod is obviously shortened, the integral efficiency of deep sampling operation is improved, the non-effective energy consumption of a driving system is reduced, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, and the technical development direction of energy-saving mining mechanical equipment is met.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fidelity simulation method and system for mine catastrophe scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a fidelity simulation method and a system for a mine disaster scene, which relate to disaster simulation, and are characterized in that historical data of mine disasters are obtained, statistical analysis and feature extraction are carried out on the historical data by adopting a multi-dimensional correlation analysis algorithm to obtain a main control element type set of the mine disasters and weight coefficients of all main control elements, an underground disaster scene reproduction scheme of each main control element type is set according to the main control element type set, disaster process monitoring data are collected in a target simulation area, a mapping relation model between the main control elements and disaster feature parameters is established by a machine learning algorithm, and an arrangement scheme of an underground disaster simulation device is generated according to the mapping relation model. Aiming at the defect that the mine catastrophe simulation in the prior art lacks physical mechanism constraint, the application improves the generalization capability of the simulation under different geological conditions and exploitation modes by introducing residual errors of a gas diffusion equation, a heat conduction equation and a fluid dynamics equation as physical constraint loss items in the neural network training.

title_en: Operation panel of simulation earthquake calamity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an operation table for simulating earthquake disasters, which comprises an earthquake simulation vibration table, wherein a house model is arranged at the top of the earthquake simulation vibration table, a support column is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the earthquake simulation vibration table, a bottom support plate is connected to the bottom of the support column, the house model consists of a plurality of floors, a bridge plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of each floor, the operation table relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster simulation, earthquake waves are simulated through a simulated earthquake signal generator in the earthquake simulation vibration table by arranging the house model on the earthquake simulation vibration table, so that the disaster condition of the house model under an earthquake can be simulated, and a plurality of dampers are hinged among all floors together, so that corresponding swing amplitude and corresponding directions appear on different floors during the earthquake simulation, and the disaster condition of each floor with different height can be simulated.
assignees: LIAONING EARTHQUAKE SAFETY EVALUATION CO LTD;Liaoning Earthquake Emergency Service Center;LIAONING ZHENZAI RISK CONTROL CENTER

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to reproduce a realistic disaster scenario and provide effective training to a user.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a disaster scenario generation unit, a disaster reproduction unit, and a training provision unit. The disaster scenario generation part generates a disaster scenario by using the generation AI. The disaster reproduction unit reproduces a disaster on the Metaverse based on the disaster scenario generated by the disaster scenario generation unit. The training provision unit provides training to the user for the disaster reproduced by the disaster reproduction unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: SPH-based debris flow flume experimental simulation method
abstract_en: The invention particularly discloses an SPH-based debris flow flume experimental simulation method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster simulation and fluid dynamics. The method comprises the steps of S1, inputting water tank size parameters according to experimental requirements and generating water tank model topography, S2, inputting debris flow rheological parameters and generating solid-liquid two-phase SPH particles, S3, applying wall repulsive force according to water tank and stacking area geometric forms to set normal boundary conditions, defining initial speed field and hydrostatic pressure distribution, adopting an improved solid phase fraction coupling friction-turbulence model to couple and solve with an SPH method, calculating debris flow and interaction, and S4, outputting simulation results. The method solves the problems of high cost, complex operation, long period and potential safety hazard of the traditional physical experiment, accurately characterizes the rheological property and the motion rule of the debris flow, provides a high-precision numerical simulation means for the experiment, and helps the research of disaster mechanism and the formulation of disaster prevention and reduction measures.

title_en: Mine disaster prediction and risk assessment method based on AI
