abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine disaster prediction, and discloses an AI-based mine disaster prediction and risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of deploying a multi-source sensor network, wherein the sensor network comprises a microseismic monitoring sensor, a gas concentration sensor, a stress sensor and a hydrological sensor and is used for acquiring microseismic waveform data, gas concentration time sequence data, stress data and hydrological parameter data of a mining working face, a roadway and a geological structure area; and carrying out space-time alignment processing on the microseismic waveform data, the gas concentration time sequence data, the stress data and the hydrological parameter data to generate a space-time aligned heterogeneous data set, and carrying out encryption characteristic interaction with an external system through a federal learning framework. By constructing a multi-mode deep learning model, the microseismic waveform, the gas concentration time sequence and the geological structure space correlation characteristics are respectively extracted, and rock mechanics equation constraint conditions are injected in model training, so that the identification capability of the rock stratum fracture precursor signal and the disaster chain coupling process is remarkably enhanced.
assignees: GENERAL PROSPECTING INST CHINA NATIONAL ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Auxiliary device based on navigation teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary device based on navigation teaching, which relates to the technical field of navigation teaching and solves the problems of insufficient immersion and realism, and comprises a base, wherein a standing board is fixedly connected to the left side of the top of the base, a display screen is fixedly arranged on the top of the right side of the standing board, the invention creates an omnidirectionally fused visual, audible and somatosensory simulated driving platform environment for students by arranging the display screen, a VR helmet, a lifting mechanism and a vibrating motor which can simulate ship movement, the student can be immersed in the virtual navigation scene from the first person view angle, and feel fluctuation and swing of the ship in person, so that the gap between theoretical cognition and actual experience is effectively closed, substitution sense and psychological adaptability of training are greatly improved, jolt and vibration under different sea conditions can be simulated, and critical body balance capacity, instrument operation stability and emergency response capacity under a complex environment of the student in real navigation are specially trained.

title_en: Building indoor design layout optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building indoor design layout optimization method, which relates to the technical field of indoor modeling and layout optimization and comprises the following steps: and acquiring building structure boundary data and current situation arrangement information, constructing an indoor three-dimensional space model and finishing marking node traffic attributes and space topological structures. On the basis, crowd behavior data of daily scenes and emergency scenes are collected, behavior features such as walking speed, obstacle avoidance response, congestion sensitivity and the like are extracted, and a walking feature model for simulating individual movement trends is established. And respectively executing multi-scene simulation under daily events and emergency evacuation events by using the walking characteristic model, calculating performance indexes such as traffic time, local congestion degree, key node congestion probability, total evacuation time and the like, and identifying a congestion sensitive area. Further constructing a multi-objective evaluation model comprising traffic efficiency, congestion degree and evacuation performance, and performing global optimization on layout adjustable parameters by adopting an algorithm to obtain a candidate layout scheme set.
assignees: HUBEI URBAN CONSTRUCTION VOCATIONAL AND TECH COLLEGE

title_en: Intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in limited space
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent collaborative supporting and recycling method for incomplete mining of special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, and belongs to the technical field of mining engineering. Aiming at the problems of narrow space, complex stress, high safety risk and the like faced by the recovery of the special-shaped ore pillars in a limited space, the method constructs an intelligent closed loop system of perception-decision-execution-feedback. The method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic digital twin model by utilizing LiDAR and GPR fusion detection, carrying out extraction-support collaborative optimization design based on numerical simulation and AI algorithm, carrying out accurate segmented extraction by adopting low-disturbance blasting and miniature intelligent equipment, synchronously implementing 'extraction-support-charge' cyclic operation, quickly constructing an artificial key layer by utilizing quick-setting expansion materials, and finally realizing multistage intelligent early warning and dynamic regulation through a multi-element sensing network. The invention can obviously improve the recovery rate of the residual mine resources to more than 90%, effectively control the ground pressure disasters and realize the green, safe and efficient recovery of the mine resources.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Landslide motion simulation method taking terrain reconstruction into consideration
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide motion simulation method considering terrain reconstruction, which solves the logic contradiction of the traditional method that the terrain simulation is performed after landslide. The method collects high-precision terrain, square quantity, geological parameters and rainfall data after landslide, iteratively corrects the terrain before landslide by volume conservation, reasonable flow direction and flow rate and rock-soil body strength adaptation constraint by taking the terrain after landslide as a starting point, and forward simulates the landslide movement process, inversion speed, acceleration, stacking depth and other information based on the reconstructed terrain by coupling rainfall infiltration, pore water pressure evolution model and a material point method. The invention eliminates initial condition errors from the root, has high simulation precision, and provides a scientific tool for landslide mechanism research and disaster prevention.

title_en: Intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data drive
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent landslide rainfall simulation system and method based on AI historical rainfall data driving, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. Through automatic fusion of multisource monitoring data and space-time feature extraction and combination of deep learning and physical mechanism modeling, dynamic coupling analysis and high-precision simulation of rainfall process and slope stability are realized. The system can sense rainfall, soil moisture content and slope deformation multi-class data in real time, intelligently identify landslide induction risk, output grading early warning information and support digital twin and self-adaptive risk optimization decisions. The landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning accuracy and response timeliness are remarkably improved, the landslide hazard risk assessment and early warning method has good intelligence, expansibility and practical application value, and is widely applicable to the fields of geological disaster prevention and control and engineering safety monitoring.

title_en: Disaster emergency treatment method and system based on large event awareness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency treatment method and a disaster emergency treatment system based on large event awareness, which relate to the technical field of disaster emergency treatment in the sanitation industry and comprise the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data according to a set collection period; the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data corresponding to historical large disaster events, extracting disaster abnormal characteristics, training a large disaster event perception model based on the disaster abnormal characteristics, constructing a large disaster event knowledge base, obtaining large disaster event early warning information according to the acquired multi-source heterogeneous data, the large disaster event perception model and the large disaster event knowledge base, matching a corresponding emergency treatment plan from a pre-constructed emergency treatment plan base according to the large disaster event early warning information, re-planning an environmental sanitation vehicle route, obtaining a corresponding emergency treatment plan according to the re-planned environmental sanitation vehicle route and the corresponding emergency treatment plan, monitoring the corresponding emergency treatment plan in real time, and generating feedback information to update the corresponding emergency treatment plan.

title_en: Digital twin river basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin-basin geological disaster early warning prevention and control system which comprises monitoring data such as rainfall, soil humidity, air temperature, earthquake, landslide, debris flow and the like, a risk judging module, a digital twin modeling module and a simulation system, wherein the monitoring data is used for collecting geological structures, land utilization conditions and vegetation coverage data in a current basin, the risk judging module is used for analyzing the collected data to judge whether geological disaster risks exist, the digital twin modeling module is used for constructing a virtual basin geological disaster model by utilizing various collected data, simulating various disaster scenes occurring in the current basin and comprising landslide, debris flow and flood.
assignees: INST OF GEOLOGY AND NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION GANSU ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Method and device for evaluating and early warning low-temperature cold injury risks in flowering phase of refined economic forest fruit
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-temperature cold injury risk assessment and early warning method and device for a refined economic forest fruit in a flowering phase, and relates to the technical field of disaster assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a multi-source historical data set corresponding to a research area, and planting economic forest fruits in the research area; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a multi-source historical data set to obtain characteristic quantities matched with a forest fruit growing area and a forest fruit flowering period of economic forest fruits, determining event levels corresponding to low-temperature cold injury events occurring in a research area based on preprocessed historical single-station low-temperature cold injury event data, training a neural network model based on the characteristic quantities of the economic forest fruits and the event levels corresponding to the low-temperature cold injury events to obtain a cold injury risk assessment early warning model, wherein the cold injury risk assessment early warning model is used for assessing and early warning the event levels corresponding to the low-temperature cold injury events occurring in the forest fruit growing area in the forest fruit flowering period. The invention can obviously improve the fineness and accuracy of low-temperature cold damage risk assessment and early warning.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION METEOROLOGICAL SCIENCE INST;BEIJING HONGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire monitoring and analyzing method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle forest fire monitoring and analyzing method relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and unmanned aerial vehicle application. The technical scheme includes that real-time video data of a forest area are collected, real-time video streams and position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle are output, a forest fire data set obtained through training is combined, a fire detection result comprising a fire boundary frame is output, a context feature interaction and attention mechanism is combined, pixel level segmentation is conducted on the fire area, a flame segmentation result is output, an actual flame area is calculated according to a flame pixel ratio, unmanned aerial vehicle flight height and camera parameters, flame area data and flame point positioning information are output, visual display of a fire condition is achieved through a cloud platform, and alarm prompt and emergency response information are generated when the flame area exceeds a threshold value. The forest fire monitoring system is suitable for forest fire real-time monitoring, positioning and fire analysis.

title_en: Drilling slot depth determination method based on wave velocity test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine pressure relief, and discloses a drilling slot depth measuring method based on wave velocity test, which comprises the following steps of testing the horizontal distance between a slotting drilling hole and a hole wall between a guiding testing drilling hole; erect fixed platform, adjust a plurality of supporting legs, observe the bubble condition of centering on the fixed platform, make the upper plane keep the level, pass the propulsion hole on the fixed platform with the push rod, make mark line and propulsion hole downside mounting fixture mark line parallel and level on the push rod. The method for measuring the depth of the drilling slot based on the wave velocity test can overcome the defect that a mechanical measuring device cannot penetrate into a thinner slot rock wall or cannot be tested when rock slag is blocked, solves the problem that a cross-slot test cannot be carried out due to narrow drilling space, utilizes the conventional guide test hole to complete the slot depth test in a matching way, does not need to additionally drill a hole, and therefore realizes the detection of the slot depth in a fractured drilling hole, and is beneficial to improving the disaster treatment effect of a hard roof.

title_en: Quick calculation method, system and storage medium for urban large-scale space personnel evacuation time
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban emergency management, and particularly relates to a method, a system and a storage medium for rapidly calculating personnel evacuation time in a large-scale space of a city. Dividing an urban large-scale space evacuation scene into two stages of gathering from a local area to an adjacent road and transferring from the road to an evacuation point, wherein the first stage is used for subdividing the evacuation process into two sub-stages of contraction and queuing by establishing a local evacuation area model, obtaining an empirical regression equation based on Pathfnder simulation data fitting, realizing quick calculation of the evacuation time of the first stage, establishing a discretization evacuation flow model, calculating the number of evacuees in unit time by an integral mode as an output batch, establishing a road section evacuation model in the second stage, calculating the dynamic speed of the batch passing through the road based on GREENSHIELDS traffic flow model, calculating the transit time and the waiting time by combining the road capacity limit, and finally obtaining the whole evacuation time of each area. The invention can obviously improve the calculation efficiency of the evacuation time.

title_en: Container formula fire control simulation practical training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, in particular to container type fire-fighting simulation training equipment, which comprises a container and a training assembly, wherein the training assembly comprises a plurality of door plates and collapse simulation parts, each collapse simulation part comprises two mounting parts, a rotating part and a floor plate, when the fire-fighting simulation training is carried out, the collapse simulation parts are mounted at proper positions in the container, the mounting parts are used for supporting the rotating parts, the floor plates can be rotated by the rotating parts to enable the floor plates to be at different inclination angles, the inclination angles of the floor plates are adjusted in advance according to training requirements, when a building fire disaster occurs, the situation after the floor plates collapse is simulated, then fire fighters can open the container, pass through gaps between the floor plates and the container after entering the container, pass training aiming at the situation after the floor plates collapse, and the search and rescue efficiency of fire fighters when the fire disaster occurs really is improved.
assignees: KUNMING XISHAN DISTR FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE KUNMING XISHAN DISTR FIRE RESCUE BUREAU

title_en: VR simulation training equipment of compressed air foam vehicle controller
abstract_en: The utility model discloses VR simulation training equipment of a compressed air foam vehicle controller, which particularly relates to the technical field of VR simulation training equipment, and comprises a VR head display and a physical console mechanism, wherein the physical console mechanism is arranged above the VR head display, the physical console mechanism comprises a vehicle control component, a system initialization component, a seat component and a display screen, the side surface of the vehicle control component is provided with the system initialization component, the display screen is arranged above the system initialization component, the seat component is arranged at one side of the system initialization component far away from the vehicle control component, the seat component comprises a vehicle seat and a vibrating motor, the vibrating motor is arranged below the vehicle seat, and the real-time of a complex scene is improved by adopting a light fire disaster model through the physical console mechanism, and the computing model is optimized while the basic physical characteristic simulation capability of a fire disaster is maintained.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM;GUANGDONG WANQU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION INVEST CO LTD;JIANGSU CUMT DAZHENG SURFACE ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Container for fire-fighting exercise
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting exercise facilities, in particular to a container for fire-fighting exercise, which comprises a container body and a composite exercise mechanism, wherein the composite exercise mechanism comprises a bottom layer box, a creeping drill hole assembly, a corridor assembly, an upper layer box, two escape windows, a rope-forming self-rescue assembly and two partition boards, when the fire-fighting exercise is carried out, an operator enters the container body to conduct the exercise of bombing fire and bed fire, then leaves the container body, enters the bottom layer box from an exercise inlet, conducts the exercise of a tunnel field through the creeping drill hole assembly, continues to advance, conducts the exercise of a post-disaster dark environment, conducts corridor escape exercise through the corridor assembly, enters the upper layer box, simulates the fire scene escape under the action of the two partition boards, conducts the window-breaking exercise through the two escape windows, finally reaches the upper layer box from the corridor assembly, conducts the rope-forming escape exercise through the rope-forming self-rescue assembly, and obtains the effect of increasing the harvest.
assignees: KUNMING XISHAN DISTR FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE KUNMING XISHAN DISTR FIRE RESCUE BUREAU

title_en: Mobile platform of goaf three-dimensional laser scanner
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a movable platform of a goaf three-dimensional laser scanner, which belongs to the technical field of general investigation of hidden disaster-causing factors of strip mines and comprises a vehicle body and an operation table, wherein a rubber gasket is arranged at the inner bottom of the vehicle body, two fixed steel plates are fixedly connected to the top of the rubber gasket, a fixed frame is arranged at the inner side of the fixed steel plates, a winch is arranged in the fixed frame, a drilling goaf scanner cable is arranged at the outer side of the winch, four supporting legs are fixedly connected to the bottom of the operation table, a control box is arranged at the top of the operation table, a probe rod is arranged at the right side of the fixed steel plates, the operation steps are basically only carried out two steps of assembly and scanning after the integration, the operation efficiency is improved by more than 1 time, the opened trunk tail door can also be used for assisting an operator in sunshade and rain-shielding, the humanization and comfortableness of the operation are greatly improved, only one main operator and one auxiliary operator can easily finish the operation after the integration, the manpower is reduced, the detachable connection mode is adopted, and the vehicle can be quickly restored to the original vehicle state, and the normal use of the vehicle is not affected after the restoration.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability optimization evaluation method driven by geological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide vulnerability optimization evaluation method driven by geological data, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction. According to the invention, geological data is preprocessed and features are extracted through a Deep Neural Network (DNN) feature extractor, and super-parameter tuning is performed by combining a Bayesian optimized LightGBM (LGB) model, so that an efficient DNN-BO-LGB integrated model is constructed, and the accuracy and stability of landslide susceptibility assessment are remarkably improved. The model training and verification process is scientific and reasonable, the prediction results are graded by using a natural breakpoint method, an intuitive landslide disaster susceptibility prediction graph is generated, and powerful technical support is provided for accurate evaluation and effective prevention and control of geological disasters.

title_en: Sensor optimization layout method and emergency response method in passenger cabin of hydrogen energy vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal layout method and an emergency response method of sensors in a passenger cabin of a hydrogen energy vehicle, comprising the steps of identifying the leakage risk of hydrogen and setting the leakage working condition; the method comprises the steps of carrying out leakage simulation based on the leakage working condition, determining the optimal sensor arrangement position based on the comprehensive effectiveness of three dimensions of the leakage simulation result, integrating space, time and frequency, arranging the sensor based on the optimal sensor arrangement position, collecting concentration signals in real time and executing an emergency response strategy. The invention realizes automatic linkage control from hydrogen leakage detection, alarm prompt to ventilation and exhaust and hydrogen source cut-off, overcomes the defects that the existing hydrogen energy vehicle hydrogen leakage detection is mainly concentrated on the outside of the vehicle or equipment level and lacks a systematic detection and emergency treatment scheme in the passenger cabin, and realizes high-efficiency detection and rapid safety response to hydrogen leakage in the passenger cabin.

title_en: Karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under dynamic and static load coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physical simulation of geotechnical engineering geological disasters, and discloses a karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under the action of dynamic and static load coupling, which comprises a test box, a vacuum corrosion simulation system, a dynamic and static load loading system, a comprehensive monitoring system and a central control system; A covering layer for simulating karst is filled in layers in the test box, a plurality of karst cavities are arranged in the covering layer, the top of the test box is connected with a moving platform in a sliding mode, a dynamic and static load loading system is arranged on the moving platform, a comprehensive monitoring system comprises a mechanical sensor array, a negative pressure sensor and a visual monitoring unit, the mechanical sensor array is buried in the covering layer, and the negative pressure sensor is arranged in the karst cavities. The invention can simulate vacuum corrosion, apply independent or coupled static and dynamic load with adjustable size and position to the karst covering layer, accurately simulate the formation, development and dissipation process of vacuum negative pressure in the karst cavity, and improve the reality and accuracy of simulation.

title_en: Traffic data fusion method and system based on multi-source high-precision perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic data fusion method and a traffic data fusion system based on multi-source high-precision perception, and relates to the technical field of traffic data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of connecting a traffic monitoring platform integrating a panoramic image acquisition device, a directional image acquisition device and a high-precision laser radar; the method comprises the steps of collecting static scene data of a target traffic scene, constructing a static model of the target traffic scene, carrying out traffic simulation to generate simulated traffic feature data, collecting dynamic traffic data to obtain real-time traffic feature data, carrying out traffic feature comparison, locating traffic feature deviation areas, carrying out directional monitoring on the traffic feature deviation areas, and generating traffic emergency response instructions when traffic abnormality is monitored. The invention solves the technical problems that the traffic monitoring in the prior art depends on a single data source, can not provide comprehensive perception of traffic scenes, further can not accurately identify abnormal conditions in a short time, and affects the timeliness and the effectiveness of emergency response.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation method for progressive destruction of rock burst coal rock mass based on stress field coupling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster prevention and control and virtual simulation, and discloses a rock burst coal rock mass progressive damage three-dimensional simulation method based on stress field coupling, which is based on a Unreal Engine 5 three-dimensional engine platform, the comprehensive index evaluation, critical mechanical criteria, high-precision three-dimensional scene construction, real-time triggering judgment of mechanical criteria and multi-physical-field coupling simulation are integrated, so that full-flow high-fidelity simulation and visualization of rock burst disasters from static load accumulation, dynamic load triggering to catastrophe evolution are realized. The coal mine rock burst simulation method can obviously improve the calculation efficiency and the visualization effect on the premise of ensuring the simulation authenticity and the physical accuracy, is suitable for multiple application scenes such as deep coal mine rock burst mechanism research, disaster early warning, prevention and control measure formulation, emergency exercise and the like, realizes accurate deduction and immersive simulation of coal mine rock burst disasters, and has stronger universality and engineering practical value.

title_en: Multi-disaster-oriented environment-coupled power grid vulnerability assessment method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-disaster-oriented environment coupling type power grid vulnerability assessment method and system, which relate to the technical field of fault assessment, wherein the power transmission line is decomposed into electric tower nodes and virtual nodes, so that the calculation complexity of linear damage is reduced, the second-level time sequence simulation of a power grid is supported, and a multi-disaster unified coupling mechanism is constructed, namely a geographic matrix, an environment matrix and a meteorological matrix are constructed, various disaster damage models are driven, and the joint quantification of a 'disaster chain' physical process is realized; and finally, taking the topological power supply availability and the cascade failure fault condition as damage measurement indexes, and respectively carrying out grid vulnerability assessment under the earthquake disaster scene and the storm disaster scene, thereby solving the problem of underestimation of faults caused by neglecting power redistribution in the traditional model.
assignees: PLA INFORMATION SUPPORT FORCE ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Hydropower unit fault diagnosis method based on GAN and edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydroelectric generating set fault diagnosis method based on GAN and edge calculation, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a lightweight WGAN model under physical constraint, 2, deploying the lightweight WGAN model obtained in the step 1 on edge equipment, finishing preprocessing of a hydroelectric generating set vibration signal, enhanced data generation, physical constraint verification, safety processing and transmission and disaster recovery and state monitoring through edge calculation, and realizing fault real-time diagnosis, 3, adopting a federal learning framework to realize collaborative training and knowledge sharing among multiple edge nodes, and each edge node is based on a local data training lightweight WGAN sub-model, uploading, polymerizing and issuing through model parameter gradients.

title_en: Comprehensive control method for controlling coal mine rock burst and gas disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated control method for controlling coal mine rock burst and gas disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing gas extraction holes in roadway side parts, then reaming the gas extraction holes and performing gas extraction, reaming sections of the gas extraction holes are used for stress relief of coal bodies, non-reaming sections are used for extracting gas from the interiors of the coal bodies, achieving multiple purposes of one hole, completing construction of large-diameter pressure relief holes between adjacent gas extraction holes according to the impact risk level of a current roadway area, combining the large-diameter pressure relief holes with reaming sections of the gas extraction holes to achieve pressure relief of the roadway side parts, constructing directional long drilling holes in top plates and performing hydraulic fracturing on the directional long drilling holes, achieving pressure relief of the top plates of coal seams, achieving pressure relief collaborative cooperation with the pressure relief of the roadway side parts to achieve rock burst control, then performing collaborative cooperation with the gas extraction of the gas extraction and the roadway side parts to achieve gas disaster control, and finally dynamically monitoring stress conditions and performing pressure relief to ensure the rock burst control and the persistence of the gas disasters.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;UNIV HEILONGJIANG SCI & TECH;ZHONGKUANG DINGBEI TECH XUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for simulating damage of fluid impact building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of graphic processing and three-dimensional modeling, and discloses a fluid impact building damage simulation method and system, wherein the method comprises solid-liquid mixed virtual simulation, building crushing virtual simulation and impact judgment virtual simulation, the solid-liquid mixed virtual simulation comprises solid modeling, liquid virtual simulation, particle mixing and buoyancy setting, the building crushing virtual simulation comprises building modeling, building pre-crushing and crushing threshold setting, and the impact judgment virtual simulation comprises polyhedral partition division and force field judgment. The fluid impact building damage virtual simulation method has the advantages of good effect, reduced calculation cost, improved frame rate during virtual simulation and strong universality. The virtual simulation method considering the mixed condition of the solid phase and the water phase realizes the mechanism virtual simulation of carrying the solid phase by the water phase, reduces the pressure brought by the detection of collision points of the liquid and the solid on models such as buildings and the like, and can be used for virtual simulation of disasters such as virtual simulation flood, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Goaf disaster simulation and prevention technology verification platform and goaf disaster simulation and prevention technology verification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a goaf disaster simulation and prevention technology verification platform and method, and relates to the field of mine safety and disaster prevention. The verification platform comprises an experiment box body, a variable angle supporting mechanism, a multi-medium injection system, a sensing monitoring system and a central control cabinet, wherein a heterogeneous porosity goaf is arranged in the experiment box body. The variable angle supporting mechanism can drive the box body to rotate so as to simulate different inclination angles. The multi-medium injection system can inject gas to simulate disasters and inject liquid nitrogen, inert gas, foam and other mediums for prevention and control through multiple ports such as top, side wall, bottom, working face tugboat and the like. The sensing monitoring system monitors a temperature field, a concentration field and a pressure field in real time. The method comprises the steps of model preparation, environment initialization, disaster simulation, prevention and control medium injection and effect evaluation on a verification platform. The invention can simulate and reproduce the goaf multi-field coupling disasters with high efficiency, quantitatively verify the effectiveness of various prevention measures and provide data support for mine fire prevention and extinguishment.

title_en: Multi-mode fusion intelligent system with body under complex scene and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode fusion intelligent system with a body under a complex scene and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of artificial intelligence and robots. Aiming at the problems that the existing intelligent agent perceives lag, task is split and an open instruction cannot be understood in a dynamic complex environment, a complete perception-decision-execution closed loop is constructed by integrating core modules such as multi-mode perception, open vocabulary target detection, dynamic semantic mapping, natural language instruction analysis and multi-mode decision. The system adopts a vision-language embedding, cross-modal attention fusion and intelligent obstacle avoidance mechanism to realize multi-dimensional understanding and self-adaptive path planning of the environment, and optimizes the model performance by utilizing a two-stage training strategy. The invention obviously improves the accurate response, the multitasking collaborative execution and the dynamic obstacle avoidance capability of the intelligent agent to the natural language instruction in the unknown scene, can be widely applied to the fields of military reconnaissance, disaster relief, urban security and the like, and has high practicability, adaptability and expandability.

title_en: Post-disaster building damage detection method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster building damage detection method based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of small target detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a post-disaster building damage data set and carrying out data preprocessing, constructing a double-flow detection network, inputting the pre-disaster/post-disaster data set into the double-flow network, designing a two-stage feature fusion module, embedding the two-stage feature fusion module into the double-flow network, designing a Gaussian priori branch, predicting a spatial position priori map, carrying out multi-scale feature fusion and guiding enhancement, training a double-flow detection network model based on a training set to obtain a trained double-flow network model, and testing the double-flow network model based on a testing set to obtain a detection result. The invention solves the problems of weak characteristics of small damaged targets, easy loss of information, easy pseudo-change interference of complex background after disaster, low change signal to noise ratio and the like in the remote sensing image, realizes the automatic, rapid and accurate assessment of damaged buildings, and has important application value and wide application prospect in the field of emergency response after disaster and accurate disaster assessment.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of performing integrated and efficient disaster countermeasures by each local government and realizing quick and effective disaster countermeasures.SOLUTION: A means for collecting disaster risk information, past disaster data, geographic information, and infrastructure information, a means for analyzing disaster risk based on the collected data, a means for creating and proposing a risk report based on the analysis result, a means for automatically generating a disaster countermeasure plan, a means for constructing a training plan based on the generated disaster countermeasure plan, and a means for monitoring the training implementation status and effect in real time; The system includes a means for performing adjustment as necessary, a means for quickly starting a countermeasure based on a previously proposed countermeasure plan when a disaster occurs, and a means for collecting data after the disaster countermeasure, evaluating the effect of the countermeasure, and making an improvement proposal for the next disaster countermeasure.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Digital twin-based equipment fault diagnosis and insulation degradation prediction system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 계통고장 검출장치류;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시용 센서류; 상기 계통고장 검출장치류, 방재감시용 센서류로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 가상시스템 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 파라미터 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Camer with auto focus and light image stabilization function
title_ko: 자동 초점 및 광 이미지 안정화 기능을 갖는 카메라
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 또는 빌딩제어시스템 내부에서 아크카운터 및 새그카운터로 부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 고장검출장치;와 화재 및 지진(진동)발생시 상황을 검출하여 재난상황을 예측, 진단할 수 있도록 센서로부터 획득한 데이터를 센서 데이터 처리모듈로 송신하여 저장하는 방재감시장치; 상기 고장검출장치, 방재감시장치로부터 생성된 데이터를 수집하여 DB에 저장하고, 필요 정보를 현장 모니터에 표시하는 설비이상 진단장치; 상기 설비이상 진단장치를 통해 고장원인을 포함하는 고장 데이터를 통신으로 전송받아 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템에 정보를 제공하는 통신모듈;을 포함하고 상기 디지털 트윈 가상 시스템은 센서 데이터 처리 모듈에서 제공하는 데이터를 기반으로, 열화경향 예측, 화재감시 및 예측 그리고 설비이상 진단을 위한 시뮬레이션을 시행하는 가상 시뮬레이션 모듈; 상기 시뮬레이션 모듈에서 시뮬레이션을 시행할 시 조건값, 경계값을 설정하는 셋업모듈; 시뮬레이션을 통해 이미지를 디스플레이 하도록 데이터를 가공처리하여 현장 설비운영자에게 정보를 전달하는 디지털 트윈 그래픽 생성모듈;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 디지털 트윈 기반 설비이상 진단 및 절연열화 예측 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system including means for acquiring past disaster information from an external database or an API, means for acquiring a floor plan of an office, evacuation route, and stock information from an in-house database, means for generating a virtual disaster scenario using a large-scale language model, means for creating an evacuation simulation video based on an actual office environment using a video generation artificial intelligence, means for integrating the generated simulation video and scenario and outputting as augmented reality content, and means for allowing a user's terminal to download the augmented reality content and view and experience.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Micro-vibration probe mounting device and mounting recovery method
abstract_en: The invention provides a microseismic probe installation device and an installation recovery method, which belong to the field of coal mining and comprise a sleeve, wherein the sleeve is inserted into a drill hole; the device comprises a casing, a clamping device, a push rod, a recovery piece and a drill hole, wherein the clamping device is arranged in the casing and used for clamping a microseismic probe, the first end of the push rod is connected with the microseismic probe, the push rod is used for inserting the microseismic probe on the clamping device, one end of the recovery piece is connected with the microseismic probe, and the other end of the recovery piece extends to the outside of the drill hole. The method aims at solving the problems that the monitoring cost is high and overhauling and replacement are impossible due to the fact that a microseismic probe in the prior art cannot be recycled. The method has the advantages that the method realizes the quick and convenient recovery of the microseismic probe, and can be overhauled or replaced even if the microseismic probe fails in a drilling hole, so that the probability of partial monitoring gear failure is reduced, the continuity and the integrity of microseismic data are increased, and the reliability of disaster early warning is further improved.
assignees: LIUJIA COAL MINE INNER MONGOLIA PINGZHUANG COAL IND GROUP CO LTD;TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;CCTEG COAL MINING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Mine water burst and sand burst disaster early warning method and system based on tracing monitoring
abstract_en: A mine water bursting and sand bursting disaster early warning method and system based on tracing monitoring comprise the steps of collecting mine potential dangerous source areas and multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data in related mine channels in real time, conducting noise reduction and standardization processing on the multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data to generate a standardized characteristic data set, inputting the standardized characteristic data set into a water bursting and sand bursting early warning model to output water bursting and sand bursting occurrence probability and disaster scale prediction results, and generating and sending early warning information when the disaster scale prediction results or the water bursting and sand bursting occurrence probability reaches an early warning threshold value, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data processing and early warning module, and the data acquisition module comprises an intelligent rock particle assembly, a multi-sensor integration module, a measurement while drilling unit and a time domain reflection monitoring unit. Therefore, the design can realize early warning of mine water burst and sand burst disasters.
assignees: HUBEI EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION INST OF EARTHQUAKE CHINA EARTHQUAKE ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Test system and method for simulating water and mud bursting of submarine tunnel under vibration effect
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering model test, and discloses a test system and a test method for water and mud burst of a submarine tunnel under the simulated vibration action, wherein the system comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom servo feedback vibration module, a multi-directional vibration loading platform and a motor current signal feedback module, wherein the multi-degree-of-freedom servo feedback vibration module is used for providing a multi-directional vibration loading platform and feeding back a motor current signal in real time; the system comprises a vibration table, a visual geotechnical water burst simulation and multi-field loading module, a hierarchical multi-source data acquisition module, an intelligent control and risk assessment analysis module, a disaster state inversion module and a disaster state analysis module, wherein the visual geotechnical water burst simulation and multi-field loading module is arranged above the vibration table, is used for accommodating samples and applying confining pressure and hydraulic pressure loads, the hierarchical multi-source data acquisition module is communicated with a discharge port and an observation window, acquires a protruding mixture and monitors physical field data, and the intelligent control and risk assessment analysis module is connected with the modules to regulate loading parameters and invert disaster states based on feedback data. According to the application, by constructing the self-adaptive optimizing loading mechanism based on the improved particle swarm algorithm, the cooperative progressive regulation and control of pore water pressure and vibration frequency parameters is realized, and the critical threshold point of occurrence of water and mud bursting catastrophe can be accurately captured.

title_en: Foot-type bionic robot cluster collaborative trapping system based on wolf's group vision system characteristics
abstract_en: A foot-type bionic robot cluster collaborative trapping system based on the characteristics of a wolf's cluster vision system is characterized in that a bionic vision sensor array is constructed by simulating the wide-angle vision and multi-mode sensing mechanism of the wolf's cluster, sensing data are collaborative fused, a trapping strategy is designed by combining reinforcement learning and Apollonius circle theory, efficient tracking and autonomous trapping of a moving target by the foot-type robot cluster in a complex dynamic environment are achieved, meanwhile, dependence on a single sensor is reduced, the cooperative response speed and obstacle avoidance capability of formation are effectively improved, and technical support is provided for multi-robot collaboration in the scenes of military reconnaissance, disaster rescue and the like.
assignees: CHINA NORTH VEHICLE RESEARCH INST;CHINA NORTH INTELLIGENT INNOVATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Biological disaster prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a biological disaster prediction method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S100, integrating multi-source remote sensing and environmental data and field investigation samples to construct an initial data set, S200, training a spatial prediction model set and a time sequence prediction model based on the initial data set, wherein the spatial prediction model set comprises at least two abnormal detection models, S300, selecting the abnormal detection model with optimal performance in the spatial prediction model set, and S400, outputting a prediction result based on the abnormal detection model with optimal performance and the time sequence prediction model. By the arrangement, timeliness, precision and adaptability of locust disaster prediction are obviously improved, and the method is widely applied to agricultural disaster prevention, grassland ecological monitoring and disaster early warning platform construction.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Simulation environment construction method and system for dispatching automation test verification
abstract_en: A simulation environment construction method and system for dispatching automation test verification aims at optimizing power grid fault emergency response and load transfer strategy through simulation means. The method comprises the steps of collecting a data set containing multiple voltage classes and multiple types of equipment, generating a controllable scene, generating an extreme fault scene through a control variable method, screening the extreme scene set, constructing a causal chain sequence according to historical fault events of a power grid, training a time sequence prediction model, generating a fault chain through the model, forming a composite fault scene, extracting a panoramic fault scene from the load fault scene, injecting the panoramic fault scene into a simulation platform, simulating a load transfer strategy, evaluating the generated load transfer strategy through a reward function, and constructing an event causal model strategy to optimize the event causal model strategy. And finally, analyzing the dependency relationship between the nodes through the fault tree and the Bayesian network, and optimizing the load transfer strategy. The application provides powerful technical support for the cooperative treatment and optimization decision of the faults of the main and distribution integrated power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Soil slope instability early warning method based on active waveguide acoustic emission technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earth slope instability early warning method based on an active waveguide acoustic emission technology, which comprises the following steps of drilling holes in a potential sliding surface area of an earth slope, and arranging an active waveguide structure; the method comprises the steps of collecting acoustic emission signals based on an active waveguide structure, extracting and analyzing parameters of the acoustic emission signals, carrying out mutation analysis, constructing an early warning interval, and outputting multi-level early warning based on the early warning interval. According to the invention, the active waveguide structure containing discrete filling particles is distributed in the soil slope, the acoustic emission signals in the sliding deformation process of the slope are collected, the evolution rule of acoustic emission parameters is analyzed, the gray-sharp point mutation model is combined to construct an early warning interval, and finally, the multilayer early warning of soil slope instability is realized. The method solves the problems of large signal attenuation and low early warning precision in the traditional slope monitoring, can accurately capture the deformation precursor in the slope, pre-judge the instability risk in advance, and provides reliable technical support for preventing and controlling the geological disasters of the soil slope.
assignees: UNIV HEBEI ARCHITECTURE;CCCC LUJIAN TRAFFIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and geological disaster early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, and the method comprises the steps of setting a geological disaster monitoring area, arranging a data terminal and a plurality of monitoring sensors in the set geological disaster monitoring area, setting a collection period at the same time, periodically collecting historical geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area, processing the collected historical geological disaster data in a data processing mode, and analyzing the processed historical geological disaster data in a data analysis mode after the processing is completed; meanwhile, a geological disaster simulation prediction model is constructed based on the analyzed historical geological disaster data in a data fusion and digital twin mode, finally, the geological disaster data in the geological disaster monitoring area are collected in real time and input into the geological disaster simulation prediction model, and geological disaster early warning is carried out according to an output result, so that accuracy of the geological disaster early warning is improved.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY SOUTHWEST SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling network vulnerability recognition method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying electric power-traffic coupling network weak points, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, coupling an electric power network and a traffic network to form a graph model, wherein the graph model comprises a node set and an edge set, constructing an adjacent matrix and a node characteristic matrix based on the node set and the edge set, S2, inputting the adjacent matrix and the node characteristic matrix into a graph convolution neural network model, carrying out characteristic extraction model training through a semi-supervised learning mechanism, and outputting an updated node characteristic matrix, and S3, utilizing a deep Q network learning optimal strategy to identify a vulnerable node sequence through interaction with the environment. The method breaks through the traditional single network evaluation mode, realizes accurate quantification of the cross-network coupling effect, can capture complex topology information, realize intelligent dynamic identification, reduce dependence on artificial experience, can support decision visualization, has strong system practicability, and can be applied to disaster scenes of the electric power-traffic coupling network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Virtual oil depot emergency drilling system, generation method and drilling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual oil depot emergency drilling system, a generating method and a drilling method. The system comprises a data acquisition layer, a dynamic model base, an AI emergency event engine, a task generation interface layer and a scoring and reporting module, wherein the data acquisition layer, the dynamic model base, the AI emergency event engine, the task generation interface layer and the scoring and reporting module are used for acquiring parameters of oil depot equipment, pipeline topology and personnel information, constructing an interactive oil depot twin model, enabling the AI to generate an emergency event which accords with the risk characteristics of the oil depot, dividing the task according to the personnel level, synchronously operating linkage influence, and generating a report from multidimensional evaluation. The generating method constructs a device twin model by collecting data, modeling, associating device states and embedding interaction logic. The exercise method comprises the steps of model initialization, event generation, task splitting execution and report generation. The invention is attached to the actual management logic of the oil depot, improves emergency response efficiency, avoids misoperation, and provides a quantization basis for training improvement.
assignees: CHENGDU BRANCH CO CHINA NATIONAL AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Fireproof design method for aluminum alloy door rigid structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fireproof design method of an aluminum alloy door rigid structure, which belongs to the technical field of building construction and comprises the following design steps of determining the component temperature of a component when the fireproof time is set by using a fire simulation tool according to the distance between an aluminum alloy component and a fire source, carrying out a tensile test on a component test piece after heating according to the component temperature in S1 to confirm the component height Wen Caixing value, and carrying out component strength and deformation check by using a formula calculation based on the component high-temperature material value obtained in S2. According to the invention, the high-temperature strength and the elastic modulus of the 7075-T6 aluminum alloy section are measured by adopting a high-temperature material property test through the FDS simulation tool according to the fire disaster high-temperature load of the member when the distance between the aluminum alloy member and a fire source is kept, and whether the strength and the deformation of the member at high temperature meet the requirements is checked by taking the high-temperature strength and the elastic modulus into a calculation formula, so that the fireproof design of the aluminum alloy door rigid structure is rapidly completed.

title_en: Regional gas disaster early warning system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a regional gas disaster early warning system and a regional gas disaster early warning method based on deep learning, wherein the regional gas disaster early warning system based on deep learning comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a deep learning model training module, a real-time early warning analysis module, an early warning information release module, an early warning result visualization module and a data iteration optimization module, and the data acquisition module comprises a distributed multi-source sensor network and a data acquisition substation; the data acquisition module is deployed to an underground air inlet roadway, an underground air return roadway and a working face; the data preprocessing module, the deep learning model training module and the data iterative optimization module are deployed to the ground GPU server; the real-time early warning analysis module and the early warning release module are deployed to the ground early warning server, and the early warning result visualization module is deployed to the personal terminal. According to the invention, through multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and deep learning combined model construction, early identification and accurate early warning of gas disaster precursors are realized, and sufficient emergency treatment time is obtained for coal mine safety production.

title_en: Fire disaster early warning cooperative system composed of thermal imaging double-spectrum intelligent ball, intelligent analysis platform and fire extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster early warning cooperative system composed of a thermal imaging double-spectrum intelligent ball, an intelligent analysis platform and a fire extinguishing unmanned aerial vehicle, which is applied to the technical field of fire disaster early warning and comprises the following steps of integrating two sensors of visible light and thermal imaging of the thermal imaging double-spectrum intelligent ball, and carrying out omnibearing and all-weather monitoring by adopting a double-spectrum fusion monitoring technology; the intelligent analysis platform simulates a fire spreading path based on a fire spreading prediction model of a fluid dynamics and machine learning algorithm, generates a three-dimensional fire disaster thermodynamic diagram, completes a full-flow response from regional early warning to decision making of a command center and then to task dispatching of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster through a multi-level early warning mechanism, and adopts a multi-machine collaborative operation system to meet fire extinguishing requirements of different fire scenes. The invention can quickly and accurately identify fire hidden danger when facing complex and changeable fire scenes and realize the efficient disposal of fire extinguishing operation.
assignees: HEBEI BRANCH OF HUANENG RENEWABLES CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Device and method for detecting strength of member after fire disaster based on rebound method
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for detecting the strength of a member after a fire disaster based on a rebound method, wherein the device comprises a sliding rail arranged on the outer wall of the member to be measured, a moving device is arranged on the sliding rail in a sliding fit mode, a rebound instrument is arranged in the moving device through a first telescopic rod, a grinding wheel polishing device is arranged in the moving device through a second telescopic rod, a percussion drill for drilling the surface of the member is arranged in the moving device, a cleaning system for cleaning the drilling hole is arranged in the moving device, a reagent spray head is arranged in the moving device and connected with a reagent storage arranged in the moving device, a carbonization depth measuring instrument is arranged in the moving device through a third telescopic rod, and a measuring ruler for measuring the drilling depth is arranged at the head of the carbonization depth measuring instrument. According to the data information of the rebound value data acquisition system and the carbonization depth data acquisition system, the residual bearing capacity of the component is accurately estimated, so that the subsequent repair and reinforcement work of the component is facilitated, the operation is simple and convenient, and the safety of field personnel is ensured.

title_en: Test device and method for simulating influence of loess collapsibility on pile-tunnel structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to a test device and a test method for simulating the influence of loess collapsibility on a pile-tunnel structure. The device comprises a model box, a tunnel model and a pile foundation model which are buried in soil in the box, a water immersion system and a data acquisition system. The water immersion system is integrated with a top precipitation simulation layer, a bottom water level control layer and an underground pipeline rupture simulation layer, and can accurately simulate various water immersion conditions such as surface precipitation, underground water level change, pipeline rupture and the like. The bottom water level control layer can realize local or whole soaking through the water through holes which can be independently controlled, and the underground pipeline fracture simulation layer can dynamically adjust the fracture opening according to the water pressure. The data acquisition system monitors the tunnel lining stress, pile foundation bearing characteristics and soil deformation in real time. The invention realizes the fine simulation of the mechanical response of the pile-tunnel structure system under the coupling action of various water environments, and provides an important test means for the prevention and control of underground engineering disasters in loess areas.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA STATE CONSTRUCTION SILK ROAD INVEST CO LTD;SHAANXI HYDROGEOLOG ENGINEERING GEOLOGY AND ENV GEOLOGY SURVEY CENTER

title_en: Distribution system recovery scheduling method for coping with simulation reality gaps
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system operation optimization, and discloses a power distribution system recovery scheduling method for coping with simulation reality gaps, which is used for executing recovery scheduling by cooperating with recovery scheduling agents and comprises the following steps of constructing a multi-stage random optimization model of the power distribution system after-disaster recovery scheduling based on multi-source uncertainty in the power distribution system and multidimensional constraints of a physical layer and a management layer in a disaster scene; the method comprises the steps of designing a simulation environment for post-disaster recovery scheduling of a power distribution system comprising a state interface, an action interface and a rewarding interface based on a multi-stage random optimization model, respectively constructing a pre-disaster simulation scene set and an in-disaster simulation scene set according to the time evolution and the disclosure characteristics of multi-source uncertainty to jointly form a pre-disaster two-stage training frame, and effectively solving the problems that decision failure and increased safety risk are easily caused in a real disaster scene due to the fact that a simulation-reality gap exists in the prior art.

title_en: Rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid emergency decision method and system for sudden natural disasters of electric power, and belongs to the technical field of emergency decision of electric power disasters. The method comprises the steps of deducing disaster intensity through superposition of early warning information and real-time states of a power grid, obtaining a predicted fault probability set, obtaining experience data through a matching history case, generating a defensive plan, carrying out feature extraction on multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data collected in real time, obtaining a confirmed fault equipment set based on evidence fusion, constructing the real-time states of the power grid by combining a CIM model, carrying out plan primary selection on the defensive plan and the real-time states of the power grid through multidimensional quantitative comparison, carrying out processing decision based on a matching result, and outputting an emergency disposal plan after simulation verification. Based on digital twin and multi-source data fusion, the method realizes equipment-level disaster damage prediction, minute-level situation awareness and second-level scheme generation, and continuously improves the disaster prevention and quick recovery capacity of the power grid through self-adaptive optimization.

title_en: Multi-index evaluation system for seismic stability of side slope-bridge coupling structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-index evaluation system for seismic stability of a side slope-bridge coupling structure, which relates to the technical field of risk evaluation of a side slope and a bridge structure by a seismic disaster, and comprises a processor, a database and an information acquisition module, wherein the processor acquires side slope and bridge information according to the information acquisition module, and constructing a first numerical simulation model of the bridge-slope coupling structure based on the Flac3D, and iterating the first numerical simulation model by the processor based on the environmental information acquired by the information acquisition module to create a second numerical simulation model corresponding to the environmental information. According to the invention, the first numerical simulation model and the second numerical simulation model for constructing the side slope-bridge coupling structure are designed, so that the function of automatically optimizing modeling parameters is realized, the problems that evaluation deviates from reality and the coupling effect is difficult to quantify due to dependence on static models and parameter fixation are solved, model parameters can be adjusted in real time, the influence of environmental changes on the model is quantified, and the efficiency and accuracy of stability evaluation are improved.

title_en: Landslide surge prediction method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide surge prediction method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster related fields. The method comprises the following steps of 1, realizing a digital model of a physical entity by a physical layer L1, 2, calculating the stability of a landslide and landslide surge by the model layer based on related data of the physical layer, 3, carrying out early warning prediction decision on a calculation result of a decision layer base model layer, and 4, carrying out new prediction calculation to evaluate an updated plan and disaster prevention measure effect. According to the invention, the physical layer is used for sensing the states of the rock mass and the water body of the landslide surge hidden danger point in real time, and the model layer is updated in real time by utilizing the information interaction capability of the digital twin model, so that the calculation model can perform simulation calculation according to the real working condition of the landslide surge hidden danger point, and further, the landslide surge hidden danger point can be more accurately early-warned and predicted. The invention also relates to a landslide surge prediction system based on digital twinning.

title_en: High space-time resolution leakage behavior modeling and simulation method and platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a high space-time resolution leakage behavior modeling and simulation method and a platform, which are used for initially positioning a leakage-prone area and identifying hot spots, adopting an unmanned plane and a ground inspection vehicle to implement differential multisource monitoring on the ground/underground and collecting environment and concentration data, fusing a transposed convolutional neural network and a convolutional long-short-term memory network to construct a space-time prediction model, dynamically simulating and predicting leakage positions, strength and diffusion trend, and outputting visual early warning. The method solves the problems of response lag, insufficient space coverage and poor adaptability to complex environments, and improves the recognition of leakage behaviors and the accuracy of emergency response.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Mountain avalanche element characteristic ladder coupling discrimination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain avalanche element characteristic step coupling discrimination method, and relates to the technical field of mountain disaster space intelligent evaluation. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a 'terrain-earth surface-weather' 12.5m resolution factor grid, then carrying out balanced sampling under an elevation-gradient double-step frame to form a 1:2 positive and negative training set, then outputting first-level posterior probability in parallel through a Platt calibrated extreme random tree and CatBoost, XGBoost ternary heterogeneous learner, splicing the first-level posterior probability with original features to form high-dimensional meta features, inputting the meta features into a 'factorizer+residual MLP' dual-channel lightweight depth network to complete secondary coupling and noise suppression, and finally enhancing and generating a 12.5m avalanche susceptibility probability map through multi-scale testing. The invention remarkably improves the accuracy and the robustness of small samples, high dimensionality and strong autocorrelation scenes while keeping the interpretability of the GIS, and can be widely applied to avalanche risk management of western communication hallways, skiing fields and national defense channels.

title_en: Method for treating regional rock burst by utilizing multi-branch well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling regional rock burst by utilizing a multi-branch well, which comprises the following steps of firstly, designing a multi-branch horizontal well for controlling the rock burst, secondly, constructing a multi-branch horizontal well for controlling the rock burst, wherein the multi-branch horizontal well comprises a main well hole and a plurality of branch well holes, the multi-branch horizontal well comprises the main well hole and the plurality of branch well holes, after each well hole of the multi-branch horizontal well is completed, staged fracturing is carried out, different multi-branch horizontal well layout and branch layout forms are designed according to different working surface positions, and the multi-branch horizontal well is constructed by respectively sidetrack to one side or two side parallel working surfaces through a shared vertical well shaft, so that the regional coverage of the single vertical well shaft to the hard rock stratum on the top plates of the working surfaces at the two sides of a central large roadway of a mining area is realized, the drilling cost is effectively reduced, the number of well sites of the ground well is reduced, the problem of difficult layout of well sites under complex terrain conditions is solved, and the disaster control cost is reduced.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INST OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semantic interactive extreme scene generation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster simulation and safety analysis of an electric power system. The method comprises the steps of receiving natural language input of a user, converting the natural language input into structural parameters comprising time, quantity, intensity levels and geographic positions through semantic analysis, dynamically selecting and calling a specialized neural network model corresponding to the intensity levels or generating typhoon full life cycle parameters based on an empirical track model according to whether the specific intensity levels are specified, further simulating typhoon wind fields and rainfall fields, calculating influences of the typhoon wind fields and the rainfall fields on a transmission tower, an overhead conductor and a wind power field, obtaining response data of a power system, and finally simulating and generating a power system extreme scene under the action of typhoon through Monte Carlo. The method realizes the whole-flow intelligent generation from natural language driving to controllable-intensity typhoon scenes, improves the accuracy, efficiency and usability of scene generation, and is suitable for the elastic assessment and disaster prevention decision support of the power system.

title_en: Flood simulation method fully utilizing topographic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood simulation method fully utilizing topographic data, which belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering flood simulation and flood control and disaster reduction, and comprises the following steps of step 1, rasterizing topographic data; step 2, dividing unstructured grids, step 3, analyzing the topological relation between grids and grid space, step 4, solving the water level-storage relation of unstructured grid units, step 5, calculating the elevation of grid nodes, and step 6, constructing a discrete format of a flood simulation model. The method is based on the thought of water level-storage, can fully utilize all high-precision topographic data under the condition of not increasing calculated amount, completely delineate local micro-topography and water storage capacity in each cell, improve flood simulation precision and provide scientific basis for flood control and disaster reduction.
assignees: CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Earthquake scenario simulation system, method and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a seismic scene simulation system, a seismic scene simulation method and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of seismic emergency. The system comprises a natural language interaction layer, a central scheduling module, a multi-source data fusion layer, a professional computing layer and a visualization and decision support layer, wherein the earthquake scene simulation system is used for receiving natural language instructions based on the natural language interaction layer under the condition of earthquake scene simulation, the central scheduling module is used for sequentially sending trigger instructions to other layers of the system based on structural instructions, the multi-source data fusion layer is used for inquiring earthquake data and obtaining a unified earthquake feature data set based on association and integration of knowledge maps, the professional computing layer is used for generating a structural decision scheme and determining earthquake intensity and earthquake loss assessment results, and the visualization and decision support layer is used for constructing urban three-dimensional scenes and generating multi-class earthquake thematic diagrams. The system can improve the scientificity and timeliness of the earthquake disaster coping decision.
assignees: CHENGDU CITY SAFETY AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT RESEARCH INST

title_en: Intelligent geological disaster early warning equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of early warning equipment, in particular to intelligent geological disaster early warning equipment, which comprises a mounting box, wherein a detachable collecting box is arranged at the bottom side of the inside of the mounting box, a heating wire is arranged in the collecting box, a guide hole is formed in the upper end of the collecting box, and a drainage structure is arranged in the inside of the mounting box corresponding to the upper part of the collecting box. According to the smoke rapid-release type smoke rapid-release device, smoke sequentially passes through the overflow groove of the guide block, the first connecting block, the second guide cylinder and the guide barrel, and is finally discharged in an accelerating way through the air outlet structure, the arc design of the guide block is beneficial to reducing smoke residues, the guide barrel can filter large-particle impurities, meanwhile, the fan blades are driven to rotate through the first servo motor to generate air flow to accelerate smoke diffusion, a real disaster scene is simulated, the structural design enables the device to perform daily early warning exercise, the running state of a system is checked, the exercise effect is improved through realistic smoke simulation, and an effective training means is provided for emergency response.

title_en: Method and system for post-disaster node disturbance quantification and energy storage optimization configuration of power grid
