abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for quantifying node disturbance after a power grid disaster and optimizing energy storage, wherein the method and the system are used for randomly simulating disturbance influence of the typhoon disaster on each node of the power grid based on historical typhoon data by using a Monte Carlo method to obtain probability that each node is influenced by small disturbance under the typhoon disaster condition, and the method is used for reserving equivalent disturbance intensity of the nodes after reduction based on probability equivalent calculation by using a Kron reduction method, constructing a system state-space model based on the equivalent disturbance intensity, constructing an energy storage configuration optimizing problem based on the system state-space model and inertia values which can be provided by a distributed energy storage system to be configured, solving the optimizing problem by using a projection gradient descent method to obtain an optimal energy storage configuration result, accurately quantifying the disturbance intensity after the disaster on each node, effectively reflecting the influence of the disaster on the power grid node, and obviously improving the recovery capability of the power grid in case of frequency change and power disturbance after the disaster, thereby effectively improving the recovery capability and stability of the system when the power grid faces the disaster.
assignees: ECONOMIC RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for training and evaluating agent under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: An agent training and evaluating method and system under typhoon disasters. And selecting a large language model and optimizing through double-stage training of supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Generating a treatment flow reasoning plan by using the optimized model, inserting an original sample to form a complete reasoning sample, analyzing disaster descriptions to extract a reasoning target, generating a multi-hop reasoning chain according to treatment priority and logic constraint and mapping the multi-hop reasoning chain to a knowledge map, identifying a subject entity in the reasoning process, and outputting an answer entity by combining parallel and sequential sampling and a semantic similarity expansion reasoning path. And finally, building a question and answer simulation platform and a question library, asking questions for the reasoning intelligent body and evaluating the reasoning capability of the reasoning intelligent body by adopting multi-angle similarity. The method can improve the automatic reasoning and decision level of the emergency treatment of the power grid in typhoon scenes.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Real-time data processing system for special physical training
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of firefighter weight training, in particular to a real-time data processing system for special physical training, which comprises a multi-source signal synchronous acquisition module, a body segment posture data stream and a control module, wherein the multi-source signal synchronous acquisition module is used for acquiring body segment posture data stream according to original readings of sensors deployed on a trunk and legs. According to the invention, in the aspect of posture stability evaluation, subjective observation is not relied, step frequency and support swing time are calculated by identifying peaks and zero points of periodic movement signals of legs, and symmetrical difference of double-side gait is quantized, so that early warning of unbalance risk caused by fatigue is realized, a traditional framework for only checking single task performance is jumped out in evaluation of task conversion efficiency, and transition stages among tasks are defined by synchronously analyzing whole-body dynamic sequences and heart rate data, so that strain capacity and physical energy recovery efficiency of firefighters in task switching can be objectively described.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM;NANJING JIANKUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Calculation method and calculation system for ventilation network system with connecting flue for improving smoke exhaust toughness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calculation method and a calculation system of a ventilation network system with a connecting flue for improving the toughness of smoke exhaust. The anti-interference capability and the self-adaptability of the tunnel smoke exhaust system in the case of local failure in sudden disasters are improved by utilizing the redundant path design of the connecting flue. The method comprises the steps of constructing a tunnel ventilation network calculation model containing a connecting flue through branch wind pressure by using a ventilation network diagram, constructing an independent loop wind quantity correction equation based on a Scott-Hinsley iteration method, establishing an equation set by combining a wind pressure balance law and a resistance law, dynamically calculating wind pressure, natural wind pressure and fire wind pressure iteration coefficients of a fan, extracting fire section temperature field data through numerical simulation, dynamically correcting branch density and wind resistance parameters, and realizing iterative calculation to output branch wind quantity, wind pressure and fan configuration parameters. The invention can be adapted to the complex tunnel ventilation design with the vertical shaft and the multiple communication flues, and provides a high-toughness smoke discharging solution for the complex tunnel ventilation design with the vertical shaft and the multiple communication flues.

title_en: Fire control comprehensive training combined module
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting comprehensive training combined module, which comprises a two-layer building main body, wherein a first-floor window breaking and disassembling module, a concrete slab breaking and disassembling module, a portal breaking and disassembling module and an anti-theft lock breaking and disassembling module are arranged on the front surface of the building main body, and a second-floor window breaking and disassembling module is arranged on the front surface of the building main body. The left side one deck is provided with horizontal wood cutting module, hydraulic pressure and cuts and expands pincers training module and hydraulic pressure ejector pin training module, and the back is equipped with horizontal log cutting module, and the right side is equipped with ground deep well passageway training module and leaking stoppage training module. The inside of the building main body is also provided with a labyrinth type search and rescue module in a narrow space and a vertical shaft descending search and rescue module. Through integrating multiple training projects, firefighters can carry out comprehensive training such as breaking, cutting, searching and rescuing, plugging and the like in one facility, simulate real rescue scenes, comprehensively improve actual combat capability and rescue efficiency of firefighters, enable firefighters to cope with more complex and changeable rescue environments, and greatly guarantee life safety of firefighters in actual rescue.
assignees: DAPU FIRE RESCUE GROUP DAPU FIRE RESCUE BUREAU;MEIZHOU HAOFANGZI DECORATION DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: System for dynamically managing urban emergency response
abstract_en: A method for measuring disaster resilience of urban public services includes the following steps: constructing a residence-service-transportation space network under normal conditions; removing, through disaster simulation, failed road segments and function nodes to construct a damaged residence-service-transportation space network; calculating a per capita accessible public service of each residential node to represent network performance; calculating a change rate of the per capita accessible public service level before and after the disaster; and drawing a relation curve between the change rate and the disaster intensity to measure the disaster resilience of the urban public services.

title_en: Multi-event superimposed disaster indirect economic impact assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster indirect economic impact assessment method based on multi-event superposition. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster condition data of multi-disaster events in a target area, constructing a simulation framework based on an improved inter-area dynamic input-output model, dynamically tracking the conduction of economic losses in an industrial chain network by taking day as time resolution, introducing an excess capacity mechanism into the model, only allowing production departments in the disaster-affected area to operate under overload under the driving of reconstruction requirements, realizing the internal simulation of a post-disaster recovery process, forcibly superposing new external disturbance at each disaster occurrence time point in the simulation process, realizing continuous disturbance simulation of the multi-disaster events, and effectively capturing accumulated pressure and nonlinear amplification effects generated by the interruption of the recovery process. By comparing single disaster benchmark scenes, extra economic cost brought by disaster superposition is quantified, and scientific basis is provided for improving regional economic toughness.

title_en: Urban waterlogging dynamic early warning method integrating multisource data and high-performance numerical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic early warning method for urban inland inundation integrating multisource data and a high-performance numerical model, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood control and disaster reduction and disaster early warning, and comprises the following steps of step 1, multisource data acquisition and preprocessing; step 2, constructing a high-performance urban flood coupling model, step 3, integrating Kalman filtering assimilation correction, step 4, rolling prediction and dynamic updating, and step 5, risk identification and early warning release. The method can fully integrate advantages of multi-source data, solves the problems of inaccurate rainy condition and unclear waterlogging condition in quick early warning of urban waterlogging, realizes minute-level rolling simulation and dynamic correction through multi-source data integration and real-time assimilation correction of a high-performance numerical model, can forecast regional refined ponding risk in advance, overcomes the problems of low early warning precision, delayed updating, lack of self-updating capability of the model and the like in the prior art, and has remarkable practical value.

title_en: Multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-degradation flame image recovery method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a smoke sample and a flame real image of a cable fire in real time by simulating the situation of a high-voltage cable fire of an underground pipe gallery in reality, constructing an atmospheric scattering model, combining the smoke sample characteristics of the cable fire, generating smoke degradation images under various working conditions based on the flame real image, constructing and training a smoke image enhancement model based on an improved DCGAN framework, wherein the smoke image enhancement model comprises a generator and a discriminator, the generator is used for reconstructing the smoke degradation image to generate a flame restoration image, and the discriminator is used for carrying out true and false judgment on the flame restoration image and the real flame image, so that the difference between the flame restoration image and the flame real image is ensured to be continuously optimized by the generator. The invention effectively removes the dense smoke interference, restores the occluded image details and provides clear and reliable visual information for the subsequent fire disaster identification.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;FUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-user anti-interference decision method based on sparse strategy propagation, which comprises the steps of 1, determining the number of sub-slots of a user according to interference detection history, 2, determining the information transmission rate of sub-slots according to a spreading factor, 3, determining system throughput and an optimization target according to a signal-to-noise ratio of a receiving end, 4, determining a state space, an action space, a state transition probability matrix and rewards in a decision process, 5, obtaining lower-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, 6, obtaining upper-layer main network parameters according to experience samples and a loss function, and 7, obtaining an optimal anti-interference strategy according to iterative training. The application reduces the decision complexity and avoids dimension disasters.

title_en: Fireproof channel gas non-return adjusting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for regulating the gas non-return of a fireproof channel, and relates to the technical field of fire safety and ventilation control of buildings, wherein the method is used for collecting the gas pressure, temperature, wind speed and harmful gas concentration data inside and outside the fireproof channel in real time by simulating the fire disaster and emergency smoke discharging environment of the building; the method comprises the steps of processing collected data by utilizing differential, space-time registration, moving average and normalization weighting methods, calculating a countercurrent risk index, a boundary layer wall-attached effect coefficient and a turbulence disturbance coefficient, comparing and analyzing with a preset threshold value, judging whether countercurrent, wall-attached countercurrent and turbulence disturbance risks exist in a channel, generating a corresponding non-return strategy according to abnormal conditions, carrying out secondary collection and calculating a comprehensive feedback effect index after implementing the non-return strategy, evaluating the integral effect of the non-return strategy, and carrying out overall linkage optimization adjustment if the integral effect is unqualified. The method realizes the real-time monitoring, risk quantitative evaluation and intelligent non-return adjustment of the airflow of the fireproof channel, and effectively reduces the countercurrent risk.
assignees: GUANGDONG YAO AN IND CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster assessment method and system based on unmanned plane and brain-like pulse network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a torrential flood disaster assessment method and system based on an unmanned plane and a brain-like pulse network, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prediction. Collecting multisource remote sensing data, infrared soil humidity data and rainfall data of a research area, preprocessing multisource data, constructing a brain-like pulse network SNN, preprocessing the historical unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data and the field disaster investigation data by using the collected historical data as input, taking the time-space characteristics preprocessed on the historical data as output, training an SNN model, inputting the preprocessed real-time multiserver unmanned aerial vehicle data into the trained SNN model, outputting the risk level of each space grid at a moment t by the model, eliminating isolated abnormal values on the risk levels of adjacent grids by adopting space autocorrelation analysis, and obtaining a mountain torrent risk spatial distribution map of a research area. The invention realizes wide coverage, low energy consumption and high precision (the accuracy is more than or equal to 92%) of mountain torrent evaluation, and is suitable for disaster prevention and reduction decisions in remote mountain areas.
assignees: SHANDONG FENCER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of landslide early warning and risk management and control research, and particularly discloses a landslide prediction and early warning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of dividing rainfall events, marking positive events and negative events, and dividing historical landslide data into an initial landslide set and a newly-added landslide set; generating an initial landslide vulnerability map, updating the initial landslide vulnerability map based on a new landslide set, generating an updated landslide vulnerability map, constructing a deep learning sample set, training and predicting a comprehensive sample set by using a deep learning model, wherein the deep learning model comprises a convolutional neural network and a long-short-period memory network, the deep pregnancy disaster environment characteristic in multidimensional static space data of the convolutional neural network is used for extracting dynamic time sequence characteristics, and the long-short-period memory network is used for outputting landslide probability through a classifier after fusing the two characteristics. The application can realize high-precision and dynamically updated rainfall landslide probability prediction and provides direct decision support for landslide early warning.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN;ZHEJIANG GEOLOGICAL INST

title_en: Cloud component identification method and cloud component detection laser radar system
abstract_en: The invention provides a cloud component identification method and a cloud component detection laser radar system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining and processing a rice scattering polarization signal and a fluorescence spectrum signal of a target cloud body in the atmosphere; the method comprises the steps of quantitatively inverting the processed signals to obtain observation characteristic parameters required by cloud component identification, wherein the observation characteristic parameters comprise fluorescence spectrum characteristics, depolarization ratio and attenuation backscattering coefficient, inputting the observation characteristic parameters into a trained machine learning algorithm, and outputting cloud component identification results of a target cloud body, and the training method of the machine learning algorithm comprises the steps of carrying out model training by taking the attenuation backscattering coefficient, the depolarization ratio and the fluorescence spectrum as characteristic vectors based on a pre-constructed fluorescence spectrum database and adopting a random forest classifier. The invention introduces new dimension of fluorescence spectrum, combines with machine learning, effectively solves the difficult problem of cloud component identification, and can provide important technical support for the fields of cloud microphysics research, artificial influence on weather, disaster prevention, disaster reduction and the like.

title_en: Simulation drilling command scheduling method and system based on multi-role collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation exercise command scheduling method and system based on multi-role coordination. The distributed participants access the system through a communication network, and the role management module distributes equiangular color rights of the general command, the pilot tone personnel and the emergency group for the distributed participants. The pilot can set disaster parameters and inject emergency, and the general command can check command and dispatch instructions in the scene state in real time. And each group of terminals execute virtual operations such as disaster treatment, evacuation guidance, emergency treatment, public opinion control and the like according to the instructions, calculate the influence of the virtual operations in real time through a disaster model and synchronize the influence to all terminals. The data recording module collects the whole process event, and generates a quantitative evaluation report and three-dimensional compound disc content after the drilling is finished. The method realizes cross-region, multi-role, high-simulation and quantifiable emergency exercise, and effectively solves the problems of single role, weak interactivity and lack of evaluation capability of the traditional exercise.

title_en: Nuclear emergency response and decision analysis method based on Gaussian mixture atmospheric diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of atmospheric environment simulation and nuclear emergency management, and particularly relates to a nuclear emergency response and decision analysis method based on a Gaussian mixture atmospheric diffusion model, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring space-time characteristics and corresponding environmental parameters of pollution source items, and processing the space-time characteristics to obtain standardized input data containing time dimension information; S2, constructing a Gaussian mixture atmospheric diffusion model, S3, inputting the standardized input data and the corresponding environmental parameters obtained in the S1 into the Gaussian mixture atmospheric diffusion model, iteratively updating model parameters based on the diffusion consistency constraint loss function until a preset termination condition is met, and S4, inputting the standardized input data and the corresponding current environmental parameters into the Gaussian mixture atmospheric diffusion model after nuclear or radioactive emergency occurs, so as to obtain a prediction result of the space-time distribution of the pollutant concentration. The method can accurately describe the non-uniform diffusion behavior of complex weather and under the terrain.

title_en: Drainage basin flood control scheduling decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control scheduling decision method for a river basin, which comprises the steps of 1, collecting river basin weather and hydrologic data by using monitoring equipment and transmitting the data to a data center for preprocessing, 2, selecting a flood forecast model according to characteristics of the river basin, inputting the preprocessed data to obtain flood forecast information, 3, synthesizing multiple factors, generating a flood control scheduling scheme by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm, and 4, evaluating the scheme by using simulation software, and adjusting the result to be satisfactory. The method solves the problems of unscientific decision and the like of the prior decision, improves the scientificity of the decision, realizes multi-objective coordination optimization, can dynamically adjust and adapt to different flood scenes, realizes information integration and sharing, reduces flood disaster loss, and ensures the safety of the river basin.
assignees: TAIAN HYDROLOGY CENTER TAIAN SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION MONITORING STATION;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Intelligent storm disaster early warning method and system based on risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster intelligent early warning method and system based on risk assessment, which relates to the technical field of storm early warning, and comprises the steps of 1. Data acquisition, 2. Evacuation strategy generation and 3. Linkage control and optimization, wherein a ponding converging path and a water inlet source are traced back by acquiring multisource information of key areas of stations along the line of a motor car and utilizing a three-dimensional digital twin model along the line of the motor car and a hydrodynamic simulation engine thereof, the evacuation channel plugging risk is evaluated, a real-time optimal personnel personalized evacuation path and an emergency guiding instruction are generated and issued, the operation mode and the flood control equipment operation along the line are adjusted in a linkage mode, the evacuation efficiency is evaluated, the follow-up strategy is optimized, the problems that the plugging risk is inaccurate in research and judgment, personalized evacuation and closed loop optimization are lacking in the prior art are solved, and the storm disaster early warning and emergency handling capacity of each station along the line of the motor car is effectively improved.

title_en: Intelligent science popularization content generation method and system integrating multidimensional disaster data
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent science popularization content generation method and system integrating multidimensional disaster data, wherein the intelligent science popularization content generation method comprises the steps of acquiring original disaster defense data of a target area in a preset monitoring period through data acquisition nodes deployed in a disaster monitoring network, obtaining a standardized disaster data set through data cleaning and format standardization processing, carrying out space-time feature extraction processing on the set to generate a multidimensional feature vector set, inputting the multidimensional feature vector set into a dynamic disaster scene generation model to carry out fusion calculation and scene simulation, outputting a three-dimensional dynamic simulation result in a disaster development process, carrying out science popularization knowledge element analysis and recombination based on the result to generate a structured science popularization content frame, carrying out self-adaptive rendering according to personalized demand parameters submitted by a user terminal, generating customized disaster science popularization content, and pushing the customized disaster popularization content to the target user terminal, so that the cognition and coping capacity of the public on disaster risks can be improved.

title_en: Crop meteorological disaster remote sensing and forecasting method based on multi-source data and mechanism model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crop weather disaster remote sensing and forecasting method based on multi-source data and a mechanism model, which integrates the multi-source data, the system comprises sentinel No. 2 multispectral data, ground surface temperature data, rainfall and temperature data of meteorological sites and crop growth vigor and disaster point data of ground actual measurement. Based on the crop growth mechanism and the crop weather characteristics, the crop planting area is accurately extracted by analyzing the vegetation index growth curve of corn and soybean. And respectively calculating a water sensitivity index and a drought sensitivity index by combining the occurrence mechanisms of flood and drought disasters, and introducing surface temperature data to assist in judging the degree of the disasters. And by using a random forest model, taking a disaster sensitivity index and the earth surface temperature as characteristic variables and combining a ground actual measurement disaster point training model, the disaster range extraction, the grading evaluation and the yield loss estimation are realized. The invention can quickly make disaster prevention and reduction measures for the agricultural management departments.
assignees: ZHONGKE FENGTU HANGZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method and system based on linear alternating current power flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method and a scheduling system based on linear alternating current power flow, which belong to the technical field of electric power, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting a probability threshold value based on a vulnerability curve of real-time disaster data, and screening to form an expected initial fault set; modifying the power grid topology according to fault and overload information, preferentially searching and identifying isolated islands according to breadth, calculating the expected lowest frequency of the isolated islands and executing recovery operation, calculating power flow based on a linear alternating current power flow model, simulating relay protection and self-installation operation, identifying overload branches according to overload severity indexes and circularly processing, and executing an optimal scheduling strategy to eliminate overload. The method solves the problems of low cascading failure simulation accuracy, unstable tide solving and the like under extreme disasters, improves the authenticity of failure simulation and the dispatching reliability, can effectively block cascading failure propagation, reduces load loss and provides support for stable operation of the power system in the disasters.

title_en: Water-electricity coupling system toughness assessment method considering drought risk evolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness evaluation method of a water-electricity coupling system considering drought risk evolution, and relates to the technical field of water-electricity coupling systems. The method comprises the steps of S1, modeling a water-electricity coupling system network, S2, modeling drought risk propagation of the water-electricity coupling network based on seepage, and S3, performing system simulation and toughness assessment on the water-electricity coupling system network based on the two models. According to the method, a heterogeneous weighted double-layer network model is built, a trans-scale dynamics modeling method is developed, a seepage theory and physical flow are dynamically combined, a disaster cascade propagation bi-directional seepage equation is built, a toughness assessment framework based on the seepage theory is provided, the laws of different coupling effects of the hydro-electric system are revealed, and scientific basis can be provided for risk assessment, toughness improvement and emergency management strategy formulation of key infrastructure.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system according to an embodiment provides information and training for quick and appropriate evacuation in an emergency situation.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes an information generation unit, a navigation unit, a voice guide unit, and a training unit. The information generation unit generates information corresponding to the emergency situation scenario. The navigation unit displays an evacuation route based on the information generated by the information generation unit. The voice guide unit performs voice guidance based on the evacuation route displayed by the navigation unit. The training unit provides training in a virtual reality space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to improve disaster prevention awareness by displaying a simulation of an earthquake in real time.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes an acquisition unit, a reception unit, a generation unit, and a display unit. The acquisition unit acquires earthquake data. The reception unit receives information on a place designated by the user. The generation unit generates a simulation of an earthquake based on the information obtained by the acquisition unit and the reception unit. The display unit displays the simulation generated by the generation unit in real time.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge collapse disaster early warning method and system, and relates to the technical field of bridge monitoring. The bridge damage evolution prediction method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source health monitoring data of a bridge in real time, including strain monitoring data, displacement monitoring data, sedimentation monitoring data, vibration monitoring data, crack monitoring data, environment and load data, carrying out data fusion after preprocessing operation on the multi-source health monitoring data to obtain multi-source fusion data, constructing a bridge damage evolution prediction model based on a long-short-time memory neural network by taking the multi-source fusion data as input, predicting a bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, calculating collapse probability of the bridge in different time scales by adopting Monte Carlo simulation and combining static risk reference values and the bridge dynamic damage evolution trend, and setting a critical threshold value, wherein when the collapse probability reaches the critical threshold value, triggering an early warning signal and carrying out graded early warning. The method and the device identify the collapse precursor signal in advance, and early warning is accurate and efficient.
assignees: RESEARCH INST OF HIGHWAY MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT

title_en: Integrated intelligent evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for geological disaster risk of photovoltaic station
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of geological disasters of a photovoltaic station, and discloses an integrated intelligent evaluation method, system, equipment and medium for the geological disaster risk of the photovoltaic station, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring evaluation factor layer data and constructing an evaluation index system; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing evaluation factor layer data based on an evaluation index system, extracting key influence factors based on the preprocessed evaluation factor layer, constructing a total data set and a comprehensive data set, grouping the comprehensive data sets, respectively training a basic prediction model to obtain a dangerous probability value, constructing a convolutional neural network element prediction model based on the dangerous probability value and combining with a real label, constructing an integrated intelligent evaluation model based on element prediction models obtained by training all the comprehensive data set groups, evaluating based on the integrated intelligent evaluation model and combining with the total data set, realizing evaluation of site disaster dangers, improving geological disaster prediction precision, and improving reliable and effective decision support.
assignees: HUADIAN GUIZHOU NEW ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Quantitative characterization device capable of being used for researching karst collapse and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physical simulation, monitoring and early warning of karst geological disasters, in particular to a quantitative characterization device capable of being used for researching karst collapse and a use method thereof. Through the cooperative operation of the system, the physical process of 'differential pressure collapse' induced by rapid elevation of the underground water level can be simulated, the quantitative data acquisition and fusion analysis of the whole process of differential pressure in a cavity, internal stress strain of a soil body and surface deformation are realized by means of an integrated multi-dimensional synchronous monitoring network, the dynamic mechanism and key threshold value of differential pressure collapse are revealed, and a reliable experimental platform and quantitative basis are provided for the mechanism research, risk assessment and early warning prevention and control of karst collapse.

title_en: ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization CGFDM seismic wave solver and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CGFDM seismic wave solver and a simulation method for ARM architecture-oriented hybrid precision and vectorization collaborative optimization, which aim to break through the memory bandwidth and calculation efficiency bottleneck of ARM platform seismic simulation. According to the method, firstly, the key physical quantity is adapted to the FP16 range through dimensionless reconstruction of an elastic wave equation, and the mixed precision strategy of FP16 storage and FP32 calculation is adopted, so that the memory consumption is reduced by about 50% on the premise of ensuring the precision. Secondly, aiming at ARM Scalable Vector Expansion (SVE), CGFDM differential templates are mapped to vector registers, SIMD parallel computation is realized, and throughput is remarkably improved. Finally, the FP16-SVE solver realizes data rearrangement and conversion between FP16/FP32, solves the alignment and efficiency problems in mixed precision operation, and realizes synchronous improvement of storage and calculation efficiency. Tests show that the method can maintain the accuracy, simultaneously halve the memory and obtain a speed-up ratio of approximately 3 times, and provides an efficient scheme for ARM platform large-scale earthquake simulation and real-time disaster evaluation.
assignees: NAT SUPERCOMPUTING CENTER IN SHENZHEN SHENZHEN CLOUD COMPUTING CENTER

title_en: Geological disaster test system
abstract_en: The application discloses a geological disaster test system which comprises a base frame device, a supporting device, a chute device, a rainfall device and a visual device, wherein the base frame device comprises a base and a base frame connected with the base, the supporting device comprises a first adjusting mechanism and a supporting plate connected with the first adjusting mechanism, the first adjusting mechanism is connected with the base and used for adjusting the angle of the supporting plate relative to the base, the chute device comprises a second adjusting mechanism and a plurality of chutes connected with the second adjusting mechanism, the second adjusting mechanism is connected with the supporting plate and hinged with the second adjusting mechanism, the second adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the angle between the adjacent chutes, the chute is used for accommodating soil, the rainfall device is arranged on the base frame and used for simulating rainfall, the visual device is arranged on the base frame and used for collecting images and can improve the accuracy of geological disaster tests simulating different geological features.

title_en: Urban waterlogging online prediction method and system based on spatial attention and depth fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging prediction method and system based on spatial attention and depth fusion, and relates to the technical field of city waterlogging prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing monitoring points in a risk area easy to waterlog to construct a dense sensing network; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic space attention network, quantifying rainfall-ponding space association, calculating dynamic influence weight through a learnable weight matrix, generating an attention weight matrix to represent the influence of rainfall points on ponding points, training a long-period memory network model, fusing characteristic representation of space association information and a historical ponding depth sequence to conduct ponding depth time sequence prediction, extracting, physically guiding diffusion and converting point time sequence prediction data based on topographic features, expanding topographic guided point-surface data, and generating a surface area ponding risk map. Through the integration of a spatial attention mechanism and deep learning, the spatial heterogeneity association of rainfall-ponding is effectively captured, the accuracy and timeliness of urban waterlogging prediction are improved, and scientific decision support is provided for urban flood control and disaster reduction.

title_en: Multi-disaster-coupling emergency drilling simulation system and method for chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of chemical emergency management, and discloses a multi-disaster coupling emergency exercise simulation system for a chemical park. The system comprises a digital twin model, a multi-disaster coupling model, a VR/AR interaction device, a data acquisition module, an intelligent evaluation system and a report generation system, wherein the digital twin model is used for constructing a three-dimensional scene of a park through laser scanning and aerial mapping, the multi-disaster coupling model is used for simulating linkage evolution of fire, explosion and toxic gas leakage based on hydrodynamics, combustion and toxicology theory, the VR/AR interaction device is used for providing an immersive exercise environment and supporting fire-fighting equipment operation simulation, the data acquisition module is used for recording action tracks and operation data of participants in real time, and the intelligent evaluation system is used for carrying out quantitative evaluation based on multidimensional indexes and generating the report. The invention realizes the high-simulation multi-disaster coupling scene simulation, reduces the drilling cost by more than 60%, shortens the emergency response time by 40%, improves the operation accuracy by 25%, and remarkably improves the emergency management capability of a chemical industry park.
assignees: JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD;JINCHUAN GROUP CHEMICAL NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Wind speed and wind direction combined prediction method suitable for bridge structure monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind speed and wind direction combined prediction method suitable for a bridge structure monitoring system, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting time sequence data of wind speed and wind direction in the bridge structure monitoring system, carrying out normalization processing, S2, calculating dominant wind direction of bridge structure monitoring points according to historical wind direction data, decomposing wind speed into a crosswind component and a longitudinal wind component along the dominant wind direction, S3, respectively building an LSTM neural network model for the crosswind component and the longitudinal wind component, and carrying out training, S4, respectively predicting the crosswind component and the longitudinal wind component by using the trained LSTM model, and S5, combining the predicted crosswind component and the predicted longitudinal wind component to obtain a wind speed and wind direction prediction result. The wind direction prediction method can remarkably improve the wind direction prediction precision, has real-time performance and engineering applicability, is suitable for the safety precaution of the strong wind monitoring and the structure operation in the bridge structure monitoring system, and is also applied to the disaster prevention safety field of other infrastructures such as high-rise buildings, railways and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL ACADEMY BUILDING RES GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a fire monitoring method, which comprises the steps of carrying out data acquisition on mountain forest fire scenes through data acquisition equipment, scanning the mountain forest fire scenes according to flame color distribution and outline shapes, generating an initial fire feature matrix by combining motion track fluctuation and regional heat aggregation dynamic features, simulating the influence of a chemical environment stability test on smoke diffusion rate by adopting a solution concentration proportioning technology after acquiring a fire risk distribution map, adjusting key parameters in the fire feature vector to obtain optimized fire state description, and analyzing the change trend of smoke concentration gradient in a fire disaster area according to the dynamic boundary of the fire disaster area by fusing logic of boundary heat flow analysis and solvent volatilization rate to generate the fire diffusion prediction sequence.

title_en: Disaster prevention and reduction decision method and system for natural disasters and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of intelligent emergency, and discloses a disaster prevention and reduction decision method, a system and electronic equipment for natural disasters, wherein the decision method comprises the steps of constructing a prediction set, a training set and a condition vector; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first prediction set corresponding to real-time data based on a training set and a stacked long-short-time memory network, generating an countermeasure network by using conditions, obtaining a second prediction data set by combining a condition vector, carrying out weight fusion on the second prediction data set by using a self-adaptive deep convolutional neural network to obtain a fused space-time data sequence, and generating a future N-hour disaster risk distribution map by combining a multi-scale space-time convolutional neural network based on the fused space-time data sequence. The decision method and the decision system disclosed by the application have the advantages that the accuracy and the adaptability of filling the missing data are improved, the occurrence and the development of disasters are precisely matched in the space dimension and the time dimension, and the recognition and prediction accuracy of disaster situations is improved.

title_en: Personnel evacuation mixed reality experiment method and system influenced by fire smoke parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a personnel evacuation mixed reality experiment method and system influenced by fire smoke parameters. The method comprises the steps of selecting fire smoke parameters to be researched, setting a plurality of working condition levels, obtaining smoke data through fire simulation, establishing a smoke-vision equivalent model, mapping the data into visual information, utilizing a virtual reality engine and a particle system to construct a high-reality fire smoke virtual scene, carrying out spatial registration on mixed reality equipment to form an experimental environment, carrying out evacuation experiments by wearing equipment by experimenters, recording three-dimensional track and gesture data of the experimenters in real time, carrying out double denoising on the data, outputting effective time sequence data, analyzing the effective time sequence data to obtain a fire smoke parameter and evacuation efficiency formula, and providing an evacuation model under the action of the fire smoke parameters. The invention designs experiments around fire smoke parameters, provides a high-reality fire smoke experimental environment, and researches the influence mechanism of fire smoke parameters on evacuation behaviors.

title_en: Maximum wave height forecasting method based on wave energy spectrum and deep learning model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of marine environment prediction, and discloses a maximum wave height prediction method based on a wave energy spectrum and a deep learning model, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical actual measurement maximum wave height and historical actual measurement or prediction wave energy spectrum density data and carrying out standardized pretreatment on the historical actual measurement maximum wave height and the historical actual measurement or prediction wave energy spectrum density data; the method comprises the steps of calculating zero-order moment of an energy spectrum through numerical integration, obtaining effective wave height according to a physical formula, constructing a deep learning model, taking a standardized energy spectrum as input, taking a nonlinear transformation value of an effective wave height ratio obtained by actually measuring the maximum wave height and the formula as a training target training model, enabling the nonlinear transformation value to learn nonlinear mapping from the energy spectrum to a target variable, obtaining a transformation value prediction result by inputting the standardized energy spectrum to be predicted into the model, obtaining a wave height ratio prediction value through inverse transformation, and multiplying the wave height ratio prediction value with the effective wave height to output a final maximum wave height prediction value. The invention fully utilizes energy spectrum information, improves forecasting precision, particularly improves extreme sea state forecasting performance, and can be widely applied to the fields of ocean engineering, shipping safety and disaster early warning.

title_en: River course flood evolvement simulation method based on improved Ma Sijing root segmentation continuous algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river flood evolution simulation method based on an improved Ma Sijing-segment continuous algorithm, which comprises the steps of dividing calculation unit segments according to river channel topography characteristics, determining parameters, determining Ma Sijing-method parameters K and x based on energy conservation, momentum conservation and measured data, continuously calculating flood evolution of each calculation unit segment, considering flow continuity and boundary conditions, coupling calculation results of each calculation unit segment, obtaining a river channel flood evolution process, reasonably adjusting branch junction data, correcting the result, correcting simulation results by using the measured data, and adjusting the parameters to minimize errors. The invention can improve the simulation precision, enhance the adaptability and improve the calculation efficiency, and provides a reliable basis for flood control and disaster reduction decisions.
assignees: TAIAN HYDROLOGY CENTER TAIAN SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION MONITORING STATION;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Control method for balancing cost and loss of service system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method for balancing cost and loss of a service system, which comprises the following steps of S1) constructing a service loss quantification model based on service influence analysis, converting service interruption time and data loss into economic losses and constructing a loss function, S2) constructing a technical cost quantification model comprising redundant resource cost, recovery operation cost and network bandwidth synchronization cost, constructing a cost function, S3) solving a multi-objective optimization function by adopting a balance algorithm engine, introducing constraint conditions to minimize total cost, dynamically generating an optimal RTO value and RPO value combination, S4) dynamically distributing disaster-tolerant resources based on service importance level hierarchical design, S5) simulating a disaster scene through a high-availability test, verifying actual RTO value and RPO value, and feeding back to the balance algorithm engine for parameter calibration. The invention can dynamically generate the optimal RTO/RPO combination, obviously reduce the comprehensive cost and improve the disaster recovery efficiency.
assignees: CHINA PACIFIC PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic prediction and self-adaptive optimization system for pipe network disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of safety monitoring, and discloses a dynamic pipe network disaster prediction and self-adaptive optimization system which comprises hardware and software supporting modules of a supporting layer, a data acquisition and preprocessing module of a data layer, a prediction and risk analysis module of an algorithm model layer, a disaster result evaluation and self-adaptive optimization layer, a disaster result evaluation and iteration module, a disaster damage quantification and tracing incentive, and a data layer cleaning rule and algorithm model layer parameter iterative optimization, wherein the hardware and software supporting modules of the supporting layer are used for providing hardware equipment and software environments required by system operation, the data acquisition and preprocessing module of the data layer is used for acquiring corresponding data, cleaning, normalizing and multi-source data integration are carried out on the acquired data, the prediction and risk analysis module of the algorithm model layer is used for realizing pipe network vulnerability analysis, risk classification and post-disaster rerouting path calculation through multi-mode fusion prediction, dynamic weight self-learning and emergency rerouting simulation algorithm.
assignees: WANJITAI SCIENCE AND INDUSTRY GROUP DIGITAL CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Investigation system for house earthquake disaster risk hidden danger treatment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of house hidden danger treatment and discloses a house seismic disaster risk potential treatment investigation system which comprises a multi-source data acquisition module, a big data storage module, an AI risk analysis module, a dynamic early warning generation module, a multi-channel early warning module, an emergency response linkage module, a user feedback module and a visual management and decision support module. The intelligent monitoring system based on the multi-source data acquisition module is used for accurately capturing hidden risks, realizing omnibearing and real-time monitoring of house structure safety and environmental parameters, eliminating monitoring blind areas of a traditional single sensor, dynamically adapting to complex scenes such as building aging, environmental change and the like through AI risk analysis, improving early warning accuracy, solving the problems of high false alarm rate and the like of a traditional threshold method, realizing risk visualization and dynamic simulation through an intelligent platform integrating monitoring-analysis-early warning-decision full flow, and providing scientific basis for emergency command.
assignees: NINGXIA HUI AUTONOMOUS REGION SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Power distribution rush repair construction method optimization method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution rush-repair construction method optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of a power distribution line in a disaster area, and constructing a basic power grid topological graph for post-disaster rush-repair according to the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a basic power grid topological graph, combining rush repair operation to obtain a topological evolution tensor, obtaining a preset atomic operation set to generate candidate work method sequences, evaluating the candidate work method sequences, calculating comprehensive scores of each candidate work method sequence, sequencing the candidate work method sequences by utilizing the comprehensive scores to obtain a preferable work method sequence, executing a power restoration operation according to the preferable work method sequence and the topological evolution tensor, carrying out on-line monitoring, establishing a digital twin model to simulate, correcting deviation of a monitoring result and a simulation result, optimizing the power restoration operation, and maintaining continuity and stability of voltage and current in the power restoration process.

title_en: Disaster physical simulation test multidimensional scheme definition method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional scheme integrated definition method and system for disaster physical simulation test, and relates to the technical field of disaster physical simulation and test scheme definition of deep engineering. Based on the technical architecture of flow driving, sequence forcing, data linkage and space-time unification, a set of standardized definition flows covering geological conditions, environmental application, engineering activities and monitoring arrangement are constructed. By establishing a strict logic dependence and data transmission mechanism, the follow-up steps are ensured to be executed on the basis of data generated in the preceding steps, randomness and discreteness in the scheme definition process are fundamentally stopped, the integrity improvement of the test scheme in the aspects of systematicness, consistency and feasibility is ensured, and a reliable basis is provided for the physical simulation test of the deep engineering disasters.

title_en: Storm surge three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling forecasting method considering topographic abrupt change effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean numerical simulation and disaster prediction, and discloses a storm tide three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling prediction method considering a topography abrupt change effect, which is based on a non-static pressure ocean dynamics theory and a topography self-adaptive grid technology, establishes a storm tide three-dimensional non-static pressure coupling prediction system, is internally provided with a data acquisition module, a topography data preprocessing module, a non-static pressure three-dimensional hydrodynamic module, an atmosphere forced coupling module, a tide level boundary condition module, a topography abrupt change detection and correction module, a data assimilation module, a regional decomposition module, a prediction output module and a visualization module, the three-dimensional hydrodynamic model considering the non-static pressure effect is established through multi-source data acquisition and terrain mutation identification, a sigma coordinate system and a split format algorithm are adopted to accurately solve a speed field and a pressure field, the atmospheric forcing and tide boundary conditions are combined, the initial field is optimized through a data assimilation technology, and finally the forecasting results of storm surge tide level, three-dimensional flow speed and temperature and salinity are simulated effectively.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG YANTAI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Underground goaf characteristic parameter inversion method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for inverting characteristic parameters of an underground goaf, which belong to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting multisource monitoring data of the surface of a target mining area, wherein the multisource monitoring data comprise InSAR image data and UAV-LiDAR data; and carrying out inversion on the characteristic parameters of the underground goaf based on a WOA optimization algorithm to obtain the characteristic parameters of the goaf. The invention combines the integrated subsidence basin data fused by InSAR and UAV-LiDAR, optimizes the minimum difference between simulation and actual measurement subsidence as a target, improves the applicability of complex deformation scenes, and compared with a genetic algorithm, a whale algorithm can reduce the problem of local optimization and has better precision in inversion of key parameters such as thickness and depth. The invention can accurately invert parameters such as length, width, height, center coordinates and the like of the mining area, provide reliable data for subsequent secondary disaster early warning and mining supervision of mines, and assist sustainable development of mining areas.
assignees: YUNNAN DIANDONG YUWANG ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Edge electric vehicle fire disaster identification system based on constraint evolution algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an edge electric vehicle fire disaster recognition system based on a constraint evolution algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of fire disaster image recognition and public safety. The core innovation is that the model optimization module constructs model identification precision, reasoning delay of heterogeneous edge hardware and model complexity into constraint multi-objective optimization problems, obtains a pareto optimal solution set through NSGA-II algorithm solution, realizes collaborative optimization of identification precision and reasoning efficiency, and meanwhile generates training data containing a hard negative sample through innovative image data enhancement strategy to solve the problem of feature confusion. The invention can adaptively match the calculation power of different edge hardware, obviously reduce false alarm rate and missing report rate, improve early fire disaster identification capability, and is suitable for edge scenes such as public charging facilities and the like.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XIAOZHUPANGPANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Residual service performance and toughness assessment method for tunnel grouting reinforcement surrounding rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating residual service performance and toughness of tunnel grouting reinforced surrounding rock, and belongs to the technical fields of tunnel engineering safety and disaster prevention and reduction. Aiming at the problems that the prior art only pays attention to a single static strength index and cannot evaluate temperature-impact coupling damage and quantized toughness and dynamic performance, the method comprises the steps of preparing a representative sample, simulating fire high-temperature damage and dynamic impact damage, performing static and dynamic mechanical tests, extracting key parameters, establishing comprehensive residual service performance indexes and temperature-impact coupling toughness indexes, and evaluating the performance and toughness. The invention can scientifically and systematically quantify the comprehensive performance degradation of the grouting surrounding rock under complex load after fire disaster, and provides accurate and reliable technical support for safety evaluation, toughness repair and performance improvement design after tunnel fire disaster.
assignees: EAST CHINA INST TECHNOLOGY;China railway 11th bureau group co ltd;China railway tunnel group co ltd;UNIV FUJIAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Ground disaster rescue method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a ground disaster rescue method and a ground disaster rescue system, which belong to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time geological environment data of a geological disaster area, including geographic data, meteorological data and geological data, and constructing a digital twin model corresponding to the geological disaster area based on the real-time geological environment data; the method comprises the steps of inputting real-time geological environment data into a digital twin model for virtual simulation, obtaining expected change conditions of a geological disaster area, planning a search path according to the expected change conditions of the geological disaster area, sending the search path to an unmanned aerial vehicle, receiving trapped personnel information on the search path returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, planning a rescue route based on the trapped personnel information and the expected change conditions of the geological disaster area, and sending the rescue route to an execution terminal to guide rescue. The application can provide real-time and accurate rescue paths according to the change condition of geological disasters.
assignees: CHINA TOWER CO LTD;TOWER ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue scheme optimization method and system for electric ship fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescue scheme optimization method and system for electric ship fire, wherein the method comprises the steps of running event queues in a discrete event simulation framework based on a rescue force agent model and a fire environment model, simulating a fire development process and a multi-agent cooperative rescue process, generating simulation state data in real time, evaluating comprehensive rescue efficiency of a rescue scheme in a plurality of preset rescue indexes based on the simulation state data, generating a rescue regulation and control instruction for optimizing a regulation and control strategy of at least one rescue force agent based on the comprehensive rescue efficiency, converting the rescue regulation and control instruction into at least one rescue regulation and control event, inserting the at least one rescue regulation and control event into the event queues for execution, performing closed-loop optimization on the multi-agent cooperative rescue process until the comprehensive rescue efficiency corresponding to the optimized multi-agent cooperative rescue process meets a preset efficiency threshold, realizing a dynamic closed-loop simulation framework integrating simulation, evaluation and regulation and control, and improving the scientificity and efficiency of rescue scheme optimization.

title_en: Auxiliary decision-making method based on dynamic knowledge updating
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environment emergency assistance, in particular to an assistance decision-making method based on dynamic knowledge updating, which comprises the steps of obtaining environment disaster event data in a plurality of time periods, analyzing early warning features and diffusion evolution features of the environment disaster event in each time period, constructing a knowledge graph, dynamically updating the knowledge graph to obtain latest data, carrying out simulation according to the knowledge graph, automatically generating an emergency scheme, carrying out treatment scheme optimization according to the emergency scheme by introducing a multi-objective gray wolf optimization algorithm to generate an optimal treatment scheme for environment emergency decision-making assistance, and therefore improving the real-time performance, reliability and global optimality of decision-making in environment emergency treatment.
assignees: JIANGSU QUANBO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional level electricity-heat-disaster storage post-intelligent recovery method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent recovery method and system after regional electricity-heat-disaster storage, belongs to the technical field of power grid planning, and solves the problem that a power distribution network cannot recover autonomously under an extreme event. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical data related to power grid equipment fault diagnosis, preprocessing, extracting features, constructing various extreme event scenes, evaluating survivability index prediction redundancy requirements, constructing island division and path optimization scheduling models and constraint conditions thereof to optimize load recovery efficiency, constructing a graph neural network model to predict energy storage configuration requirements, energy storage types and energy storage time windows, and constructing an area level recovery mechanism oriented to an electric-thermal-storage multi-energy system to generate a step recovery sequence through state vector modeling, block autonomous judgment, rule engine reasoning and state evolution simulation. The energy supply maintainability of the load points is measured through the viability index, and the recovery path is dynamically optimized by combining a strategy scoring mechanism, so that the autonomy, self-healing and efficient scheduling of the post-disaster system are realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Gas explosion simulation experiment device under goaf natural ignition environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas explosion simulation experiment device under a natural ignition environment of a goaf, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine goaf gas explosion disaster prevention and control, and comprises a goaf coal spontaneous combustion simulation system and a gas explosion simulation system, wherein the goaf coal spontaneous combustion simulation system comprises a gas cylinder, a temperature programming box, a gas chromatograph and a computer, the gas explosion simulation system comprises a spherical explosion device, a cavity heating and temperature controlling device, a gas distribution device, a vacuum pump, a control box and an ignition energy generator, and the computer is connected with the control box.
assignees: SHANXI LUAN ENV ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Experimental device for simulating slope evolution development of particulate body under real topography
abstract_en: The utility model provides an experimental device for simulating slope evolution development of a particulate body under real terrain, which comprises a test system, a detection system and a control system, wherein the detection system is connected with the control system and comprises a camera assembly, a signal acquisition assembly and a three-dimensional scanning assembly. The test system comprises a model box, a sliding acrylic plate obliquely arranged at one end of the inner side of the model box, a material source replenishing plate fixed at the upper end of the sliding acrylic plate, and a sliding plate adjusting frame connected with the outer side of the sliding acrylic plate, wherein a stacking acrylic groove is formed in the inner side of the model box and close to the bottom end of the sliding acrylic plate. According to the experimental device for simulating the slope evolution development of the particulate body under the real terrain, provided by the utility model, the development evolution process of the slope disaster of the particulate body is researched under different terrain conditions, so that important guiding significance is brought to actual engineering production and life.

title_en: Geological disaster treatment anchoring device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of landslide management and discloses a geological disaster management anchoring device, which is characterized in that soil is hooked by a triangular block structure, an adjusting structure is complex, the anchor body is required to be installed in a downward pressing mode, the installation is laborious, the technical scheme of the utility model comprises a first anchor body, a drill bit is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the first anchor body, a first spiral blade is fixedly arranged at the periphery of the first anchor body, a second anchor body is arranged above the first anchor body, a second spiral blade is fixedly arranged at the periphery of the first anchor body, the screw directions of the first spiral blade and the second spiral blade are opposite, a connecting structure is arranged between the first anchor body and the second anchor body, the connecting structure enables the first anchor body and the second anchor body to be incapable of rotating relatively, and the first anchor body and the second anchor body are fixed through screws She Shixian with opposite screw directions, so that the structure is simpler and the use is convenient.
assignees: NO 7 GEOLOGY GROUP SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES THE 7TH INST OF GEOLOGY

title_en: Emergency response decision-making supporting system and method for shortage of water
title_ko: 물 부족 비상 대응 의사 결정 지원 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 개시는 물 부족 비상 상황에 대응하여 최적의 물 배분 결과 등 의사 결정 지원 정보를 협의체 구성원들과 공유할 수 있는 물 부족 비상 대응 의사 결정 지원 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 발명이다. 
본 개시의 일 실시예는 해당 지역에 관한 수자원 관련 자료 및 모형 구동을 위한 입력 자료를 수집하고 물 수요 공급 시나리오를 생성하는 자료 수집부, 상기 물 수요 공급 시나리오를 입력 받아 제1 물 배분 결과를 도출하는 물 배분 모형(WAM), 상기 물 수요 공급 시나리오에 협의체 구성원들의 의견이 반영된 협의된 시나리오를 생성하는 의견 반영부, 상기 협의된 시나리오를 입력 받아 제2 물 배분 결과를 도출하는 비전 공유 모형(SVM), 상기 제2 물 배분 결과 및 상기 협의체 구성원들의 의견에 기반하여 의사 결정 지원 정보를 생산하는 자료 가공부 및 상기 협의체 구성원들로부터 상기 협의체 구성원들의 의견을 수신하고 상기 의사 결정 지원 정보를 상기 협의체 구성원들에게 송신하는 통신부를 포함하는 물 부족 비상 대응 의사 결정 지원 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Subway station fire safety toughness evaluation method based on fire prevention and control full-period simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway station fire safety toughness evaluation method based on fire prevention and control full period simulation, which comprises the steps of considering the fire prevention and control full period, selecting a system according to toughness dimensions to be evaluated, and defining a primary index and a secondary index of primary toughness evaluation of the subway station fire safety. The method comprises the steps of carrying out numerical simulation on fire dynamics simulation software FDS and evacuation simulation software Pathfinder in a fire prevention and control full period, obtaining data corresponding to each evaluation index by setting the same scene of different schemes, carrying out objective quantitative analysis on the discrete degree of each index data by using an entropy weight method to obtain index weights, obtaining subjective index weights by using a hierarchical analysis method, carrying out analysis scoring on the basis of multi-scene simulation results by OptiSLang, determining a combination weight by establishing minimum relative information entropy, carrying out quantitative evaluation on the safety toughness grade of a subway station by using a Topsis method according to the scheme standard value and the index weights, and carrying out technical improvement and performance optimization on a fire protection system according to the evaluation results.

title_en: Digital twin simulation and early warning system for leakage and diffusion of dangerous chemical storage tank
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin simulation and early warning system for leakage and diffusion of a dangerous chemical storage tank, and relates to the technical field of dangerous chemical leakage monitoring. The digital twin simulation and early warning system for leakage and diffusion of the dangerous chemicals storage tank comprises a multi-source live acquisition module, an air mass sinking modeling module, a dynamic situation assessment module and an emergency response control module, wherein the multi-source live acquisition module is used for forming inlet state data and preprocessing the inlet state data, the air mass sinking modeling module is used for identifying air mass leading-in trends based on the inlet state data, the dynamic situation assessment module is used for judging retention distribution trends according to leading-in path states and dividing risk areas, and the emergency response control module is used for executing response priority ordering by combining risk grades and space positions. The problem that the path of the high-concentration leakage air mass sinking into the underground passage is not simulated, so that secondary leakage propagation cannot be monitored is solved.
assignees: HANGZHOU YINGSIPU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-element coupling type surface flood full-flow dynamic simulation analysis system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-element coupling type surface flood full-flow dynamic simulation analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of urban flood control and hydrologic simulation. The method comprises the following steps of S1 regional topographic feature analysis, S2 surface coverage space-time transfer analysis, S3 water-collecting region yield flow analysis and S4 node inundation analysis. The invention realizes the coupling simulation of the deep fusion of the terrain and the coverage data and the flow-converging process, solves the problems of data fracture, simulated disjoint, fuzzy cause diagnosis and the like in the traditional method, has high model verification consistency, strong universality and high application value, and can effectively support urban flood control and drainage planning, waterlogging emergency response and sponge urban construction.

title_en: Test system for testing influence of external environmental pressure on development of gas outburst disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a test system for testing the development influence of external environmental pressure on a gas outburst disaster, which comprises a test body chamber, a test simulation device and an outburst test device, wherein the test body chamber is provided with an outburst opening, an opening and closing device is arranged at the outburst opening, the test simulation device comprises a stress loading device and an inflating device, the stress loading device is arranged on the test body chamber and is used for loading horizontal and vertical stress to a test coal body in the test body chamber, the inflating device comprises an air storage container, the air outlet end of the air storage container is communicated with the inflating opening of the test body chamber and is used for filling test gas into the test body chamber, the outburst test device comprises a piston container, and the first end of the piston container is communicated with the outburst opening of the test body chamber. The test system can be used for carrying out coal and gas outburst occurrence experiments, and can be used for researching the development influence of different environmental pressures on the gas outburst disasters.

title_en: Fault water and mud bursting prediction method and system based on deep learning and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a fault water bursting and mud bursting prediction method and system based on deep learning and image recognition, relates to the technical field of water bursting prediction, and aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, the calculation efficiency is low, the time consumption is long, the real-time prediction requirement of engineering is difficult to meet, the feature excavation of historical disaster case data is insufficient, and the disaster mode recognition precision under complex geological conditions is insufficient.
