According to the method, geological parameters and tunnel engineering parameters of a fault fracture zone are obtained, a DEM-CFD coupling fault water inrush calculation model is built, water inrush and mud inrush process simulation is carried out, a speed field, a displacement cloud picture and numerical simulation data are extracted, water inrush and mud inrush disaster data and an image database are built, a water inrush and mud inrush regression prediction model is trained based on the database, and disaster scale prediction is carried out. The invention realizes real-time and accurate prediction of the fault water and mud bursting disaster scale under the complex geological condition, and improves the prediction efficiency and the prediction precision.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIVERSITY QIHE NEW MATERIAL AND INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT RESEARCH INST;UNIV SHANDONG

title_en: Power grid emergency material scheduling method under rain, snow and freezing disasters based on robust optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power grid emergency material scheduling method under a rain, snow and freezing disaster, which comprises the steps of obtaining meteorological data and traffic facility information under the rain, snow and freezing disaster, constructing a line fault probability prediction model, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a disaster scene, obtaining a typical disaster scene set through a scene reduction technology, constructing a joint scheduling optimization mathematical model which considers emergency material allocation and emergency equipment allocation and comprises a pre-disaster pre-deployment stage and an in-disaster dynamic response stage, adopting an improved column and constraint generation algorithm to solve the two-stage robust optimization problem, gradually converging to a robust optimal solution, outputting an optimal emergency material and emergency repair team scheduling scheme, determining a repair target and an optimal driving path of the emergency repair team, generating a post-disaster grid and traffic system cooperative recovery strategy, realizing quick recovery and reasonable configuration of emergency resources, and further improving the emergency response speed and recovery capacity of the power grid under the snow, freezing and the rain disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;UNIV FUZHOU

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for evaluating risk of transmission and distribution electric towers in mining subsidence areas of mountainous coal mines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk evaluation, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for evaluating the risk of a transmission and distribution electric tower in a mining subsidence area of a mountain coal mine. Acquiring multi-dimensional geological environment data of an evaluation area, extracting multi-dimensional geological environment data corresponding to sample points and marked collapse sample data as training features, generating a dangerous prediction model through training, carrying out dangerous grade identification on each space unit in the evaluation area by the dangerous prediction model to form an area dangerous distribution result, acquiring an accumulated vertical displacement value at the position of a pole tower, combining pole tower damage state samples of field investigation, establishing a probability distribution relation between the accumulated vertical displacement value and pole tower damage grade, calculating pole tower equivalent damage probability under different accumulated vertical displacement values, generating a damage probability curve according to equivalent damage probability fitting, and substituting the accumulated vertical displacement value of each pole tower into the damage probability curve to calculate a damage probability value.

title_en: Marine product typhoon disaster risk assessment method based on raft culture and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine product typhoon disaster risk assessment method based on raft culture and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of assimilating multisource measured data into an environment model through a data assimilation algorithm, and simulating an environment field of a target culture sea area according to the assimilation corrected environment model; applying the environmental load corresponding to the environmental field to a structural model of the raft culture structure for dynamic response analysis, calculating a structural strength index according to an analysis result, calculating a vitality index of marine products according to a preset environmental factor, and determining the risk level of the valve culture structure through a random forest model according to the structural strength index, the vitality index of the marine products and the disaster-causing factor. The invention can realize comprehensive and objective risk assessment and can improve the accuracy of assessment.

title_en: Repose angle measuring device for detecting loess structural attenuation and measuring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of repose angle measuring devices, in particular to a repose angle measuring device for detecting loess structural attenuation and a repose angle measuring method. The device mainly comprises a supporting frame, a lifting cylinder structure and a detection module, wherein the lifting cylinder structure and the detection module are arranged on the supporting frame. The lifting cylinder structure consists of a chassis and a cylindrical side wall which can descend at a constant speed and is used for forming loess accumulation bodies. The detection module collects images of the accumulation body by using a camera and a light supplementing lamp which are arranged in an orthogonal mode, and the angle of repose is obtained through computer analysis. The invention further integrates a controllable axis compression component, and can quantitatively compress soil samples to simulate different engineering disturbance, thereby realizing accurate quantification and evaluation of loess structural attenuation process. The device simple structure, convenient operation, measuring result is accurate directly perceived, provides effectual technical means for loess area geological disaster prevention and cure.
assignees: XINJIANG RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF BUILDING SCIENCE LIMITED LIABILITY CO

title_en: Multifunctional emergency shower vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional emergency shower vehicle, which comprises a heat-preservation box body, wherein the heat-preservation box body is longitudinally and sequentially divided into a front equipment cabin, a middle shower unit and a rear changing room, and the middle shower unit comprises a central corridor and a plurality of shower rooms on two sides. The skirt side cabins are respectively arranged at the lower parts of two sides of the heat preservation compartment body, each skirt side cabin is respectively provided with a plurality of connected compartments, and the inside of the shower room floor with the double-layer structure is provided with a fuel oil warm air blower, a cold water pipe, a hot water pipeline and a sewage pipeline. A generator set lifting device comprising a lifting oil cylinder, a mounting back frame and a generator set bracket is arranged in the generator set cabin, the invention provides reliable logistic guarantee for field rescue, resident training and combat for civil and military use. The lifting device of the generator set rapidly and flexibly realizes the startup use and rapid storage and cabin entering after the generator set leaves the cabin, thereby effectively avoiding the noise and vibration transmission of the generator set during startup and improving the comfort level of personnel in the invention. The multifunctional emergency bathing vehicle is suitable for infrastructure-free environments such as disaster relief, military field operations and the like, and has the characteristics of high efficiency, safety, freezing prevention, low noise and the like.
assignees: JIANGSU JIECHENG VEHICLE MOUNTED ELECTRONIC AND INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system and method based on multilink multiband signals, wherein the heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel monitoring system is built by combining a channel monitoring module, a data communication module and a data processing module, an objective function is built by combining monitoring data, an evaporation waveguide section model and an electric wave propagation model through multilink multiband actual measurement path loss and simulation path loss, an optimal group of heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristic distribution is searched and solved through an optimization algorithm, a nonlinear likelihood model between optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics and signal propagation path loss is built, probability distribution of the optimal heterogeneous evaporation waveguide channel characteristics is calculated, and confidence interval of the probability distribution is estimated. The invention improves the reliability and robustness of the inversion result of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the complex ocean environment, realizes the long-term real-time, efficient and high-precision inversion of the non-uniform evaporation waveguide channel characteristics in the large-area sea area, and provides full-time data support for the detection of the offshore beyond-view radar, the evaluation of the electromagnetic environment and the disaster early warning.

title_en: InSAR time sequence analysis and finite element method-based multi-seismic-area ice shingle bank risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-seismic regional ice shingle bank risk assessment method and system based on InSAR time sequence analysis and a finite element method, comprising the steps of carrying out InSAR time sequence analysis and deformation characteristic extraction on a multi-scene SAR image to obtain a freeze thawing deformation index FDI of ice shingle bank, adopting a finite element simulation method to simulate a three-dimensional finite element model of a moraine dam, calculating mechanical response inside the dam, calculating to obtain a seismic response index SEI, establishing a risk index RI model, adopting a risk index RI model with determined weight coefficients, carrying out risk assessment on working conditions of ice shingle bank in different monitoring intervals, and determining weak parts of the ice shingle bank and a comprehensive risk index RI of the moraine dam. According to the invention, the deformation information of the surface of the moraine dam obtained by InSAR and the mechanical response of the interior of the dam body simulated by a finite element method are comprehensively utilized, so that quantitative evaluation of the risk of the moraine dam in a multi-seismic area is realized, and a scientific basis is provided for safety monitoring and disaster early warning of ice shingle bank.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency disaster response-oriented scheduling task session processing method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a scheduling task session processing method and a scheduling task session processing system for emergency disaster response, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current scheduling instructions and historical scheduling task feedback information input by a user in an emergency disaster response page, carrying out semantic understanding mining by analyzing resource demand keywords and disaster scene description phrases in the instructions and combining emotion tendencies of the feedback information to generate emergency scheduling intention semantics, carrying out session interaction reasoning by combining emergency disaster state information and emergency resource configuration state information, identifying matched conflict points, constructing a rule base based on historical success cases to solve conflict to generate an initial scheduling scheme set, simulating execution flow determination evaluation results of each scheme, screening out target scheduling schemes meeting resource constraint and aging requirements, and outputting the target scheduling schemes to a scheduling task display area of the emergency disaster response page.

title_en: Method and system for determining emergency response alarm area of leakage accident of high-sulfur gas field
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining an emergency response alarm area of a leakage accident of a high-sulfur-content gas field. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time leakage alarm information and analyzing the real-time leakage alarm information to obtain leakage source data files of toxic gas diffusion, obtaining three-dimensional diagnosis wind field files according to digital elevation data, land utilization data and current real-time meteorological parameters, calculating grid concentration values of toxic gas at different time by using a Lagrange Gaussian model based on the leakage source data files and the three-dimensional diagnosis wind field files, converting the grid concentration values into influence range vector polygonal data, visualizing the influence range vector polygonal data, and determining an emergency response alarm area through cross verification. The system comprises a leakage acquisition module, a leakage analysis module, a boundary layer wind field diagnosis mode numerical calculation module, a gas diffusion simulation module, a GIS visualization module and a cross verification module. The invention can effectively control the damage caused by the diffusion of harmful gases and is beneficial to solving the key problem of emergency management of the high-sulfur-content gas field.

title_en: Multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring system of fire-fighting facility
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring system of a fire-fighting facility, which is used for collecting multi-mode data of the fire-fighting facility in real time through a sensor array, constructing a building digital twin model based on three-dimensional point cloud data and a BIM model, training in combination with a generated countermeasure network GANs, carrying out simulated simulation on a fire development trend, grading and risk assessment on the fire, formulating dynamic linkage rules of the fire-fighting equipment, respectively controlling linkage of different fire-fighting equipment based on different risk degrees of the fire and in combination with the self state of the fire-fighting equipment, optimizing the linkage rules of the fire-fighting equipment based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and remotely monitoring the self state of the fire-fighting equipment in real time, and timely processing if the state is judged to be abnormal. The fire disaster identification accuracy is improved through multi-mode data linkage, the processing efficiency is improved based on digital twin dynamic mapping, and the linkage rule is intelligently adjusted according to the fire disaster and equipment states, so that multi-mode linkage control and remote state monitoring of the fire fighting equipment are realized.

title_en: Agricultural drought grade prediction method and device integrating meteorological data and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to an agricultural drought grade prediction method and device integrating meteorological data and machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prediction. The method comprises the steps of constructing an LSTM model and a random forest RF model, taking historical meteorological data and agricultural drought grade observation values of corresponding years as training samples, performing machine learning and drought prediction, distributing weights according to Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) after prediction of each model, deducing weight parameters of a weighted average method of each model, carrying out weighted summation on grade probabilities output by the two models according to the weights, obtaining a preliminary drought grade, and optimizing and correcting according to the errors. The method solves the problems that the existing agricultural drought prediction depends on single meteorological data, has poor model generalization, cannot dynamically update the grade and lacks an error correction mechanism.
assignees: SHANDONG FENCER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Class-domain increment learning method for power distribution network environment ground feature element extraction model
abstract_en: The invention provides a class-domain increment learning method for a power distribution network environment ground feature element extraction model, which is characterized in that a temporary style encoder is introduced in a training process, a backbone network of the ground feature element extraction model is used as a content encoder, and through applying orthogonal constraint to the output of the temporary style encoder and the backbone network, effective decoupling of disaster remote sensing image content and styles is realized, so that domain specific style characteristics are maintained in the whole increment learning stage, and then stored old domain styles are projected to new domain content to generate old domain characteristics for supporting old knowledge retention, realizing expansion of new classes to the old domains and promoting old class learning on the new domain image, and in addition, a class-aware style randomization strategy is integrated to enhance the image feature decoupling capability and improve the quality of synthesized characteristics. The method enhances the generalization and application capability of the ground feature element extraction model in complex and diverse power distribution network scenes, and is suitable for power distribution network disaster monitoring tasks.

title_en: Multi-pole weather high-risk scene set generation method for generating countermeasure network based on joint training
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy meteorology and smart power grids, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for generating a multi-pole weather high-risk scene set for generating an countermeasure network based on joint training. The method comprises the steps of constructing physical information comprising a generator, a discriminator, a predictor and a physical constraint module to generate an countermeasure network frame, designing a multi-objective loss function integrating the countermeasure loss, the prediction loss, the physical consistency loss and the task performance loss, adopting a training strategy combining meta learning initialization and incremental learning to jointly optimize parameters of the generator and the discriminator in stages, generating extreme risk scene data of specified disaster types, seasons and intensity levels through condition vector control, and storing the extreme risk scene data in a high risk scene library after physical consistency verification. According to the invention, the multi-pole weather high-risk scene set with statistical authenticity, physical rationality and task correlation can be directly generated, the risk identification, dispatching optimization and toughness assessment capability of the clean energy base under extreme weather conditions is remarkably improved, the problems of sample scarcity, model fitting and lack of physical constraint in scene generation in the prior art are solved, the high-risk scene is efficiently and automatically generated, and reliable data support is provided for the power grid toughness assessment and dispatching decision of the clean energy base.

title_en: WGAN-DEL-based transmission tower typhoon-landslide disaster chain risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WGAN-DEL-based transmission tower typhoon-landslide disaster chain risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of preprocessing weather, geography and electrical data, wherein the electrical data comprise whether a transmission tower is damaged, taking the preprocessed weather and the geography data as samples, training WGAN by utilizing landslide disaster samples to generate landslide disaster samples, wherein the landslide disaster samples refer to the damaged samples of the transmission tower, quantitatively assessing the quality of the samples generated by WGAN in the training process, if the quality of the samples is qualified, reaching WGAN performance, and constructing a stack deep integration learning model DEL by taking a random forest based on Bagging and a gradient lifting decision tree based on Boosting as a basic learner and a neural network as a basic learner so as to effectively quantify the influence of typhoon-landslide disaster chains on the transmission tower. The invention provides a WGAN-based deep integration learning model (WGAN-DEL) for realizing the accurate quantification of the influence of typhoon-landslide disaster chains on a transmission tower.

title_en: Puncture-resistant test device for fire protection clothing
abstract_en: The application discloses an anti-puncture test device for fire protection clothing, which comprises a supporting table, wherein a supporting frame is installed at the upper end of the supporting table, an installation plate is rotatably connected to the inner side of the upper end of the supporting frame, a hydraulic rod is installed at the upper end of the installation plate, a positioning plate is installed at the upper end of a ring-shaped groove piece, a through groove structure is formed in the inner side of the positioning plate, an installation plate is arranged on the upper side of the positioning plate, a plurality of positioning needles are uniformly fixed at the lower end of the installation plate, and a hole structure corresponding to a spike at the lower side of a puncture mechanism is formed in the inner side of the installation plate. According to the puncture resistance test device provided by the application, the puncture conditions of different densities can be simulated by arranging the positioning needles with different distribution densities, so that the puncture resistance performance of the firefighting protective clothing under different conditions can be comprehensively tested. In addition, the fit of the mounting ring type groove piece and the filling groove in the device enables particles to be filled in the testing process, so that the actual use environment is further simulated, and the testing authenticity is improved.
assignees: HUANGSHAN BOSHENG FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Living space based fire training device
title_ko: 생활 공간 기반 화재 훈련장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 증강현실 기술을 이용하여 실제 생활공간에 대한 실감형 소방안전 훈련 콘텐츠를 제공하는 생활 공간 기반 화재 훈련장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Augmenting Training Data for Disaster Information Detection
title_ko: 재난정보 탐지를 위한 학습 데이터 증강 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난정보 탐지를 위한 학습 데이터 증강 방법으로서, 재난 현장에서 촬영된 손상 객체가 포함된 기준 이미지를 입력받는 단계; 손상 객체의 종류를 설명하는 제1 프롬프트, 손상 객체가 위치한 배경 및 주변 맥락을 설명하는 제2 프롬프트, 손상 객체의 형상 및 환경을 설명하는 제3 프롬프트, 및상기 제2 및 제3 프롬프트의 반영 비율을 나타내는 제4 프롬프트를 포함하는 복수의 텍스트 조건을 입력받는 단계; 상기 복수의 텍스트 조건 및 기준 이미지를 기반으로, 인공지능 이미지 생성 모델을 이용하여, 기준 이미지에 포함된 손상 객체 또는 배경이 변경된 학습용 증강 이미지를 생성하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire evacuation performance analysis system and method through agent-based human behavior simulation with visual perception
title_ko: 시각적 인지 기능을 갖춘 에이전트 기반의 인간행동 시뮬레이션을 통한 화재 대피 성능 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 시각적 인지 기능을 갖춘 에이전트 기반의 인간행동 시뮬레이션을 통한 화재 대피 성능 분석 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 BIM의 건물 레이아웃과 소방설비 데이터를 기반으로 하여 화재 환경을 모사하고, 시각적 인지 기능을 갖춘 피난자 에이전트를 활용하여 화재 환경에서의 대피 행동을 시뮬레이션 함으로써 피난 동선 및 혼잡도와 관련된 이미지 데이터 및 피난 거리, 피난 시간, 화재 연기 노출 시간을 포함한 정량적 데이터를 활용하여 화재 대피 성능을 정확하게 분석할 수 있도록 하는 시각적 인지 기능을 갖춘 에이전트 기반의 인간행동 시뮬레이션을 통한 화재 대피 성능 분석 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire simulating method of various fire scenario using the fire simulating device
title_ko: 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용한 화재 상황 재현 시, A급화재(일반화재) 상황, B급화재(유류화재) 상황 또는 C급화재(전기화재) 상황 별로 가장 적합한 시험 대상물 모형을 제작한 후 상기 각 화재 상황별로 가장 적합한 시험 대상물 모형을 선택적으로 교체하여 화재 상황을 재현함으로써, A급화재, B급화재 또는 C급화재 등 다양한 화재 시나리오에 대해 더욱 현실감있는 화재 상황을 재현할 수 있도록 하며, 이로 인해 각종 소방 훈련, 체험, 교육 등의 효율을 더욱 향상시킬 수 있도록 하고, 또한, 본 발명은 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용한 화재 상황 재현 시, 무선 리모트 컨트롤러를 통해 화재 상황 재현장치의 제어부를 조작하여 발화·인화성 유체의 공급량 및 점화장치의 작동 등을 상기 화재 상황에 맞게 최적화하여 제어함으로써 화재 상황 재현장치의 사용을 더욱 안전하고 간편하게 할 수 있도록 하면서도 화재 상황에 대한 현실감을 더욱 극대화시킬 수 있도록 하는, 화재 상황 재현장치를 이용하여 다양한 화재 시나리오로 화재 상황 재현이 가능한 화재 상황 재현방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: ALLBE SOLUTION CO LTD;LEE KI WOO

title_en: Simulation combat training system capable of tactical command
title_ko: 전술지휘가 가능한 모의 전투훈련 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전술지휘가 가능한 모의 전투훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자에 장착되고, 음성 송수신 장치가 마련되는 통신부; 상기 사용자에게 전투훈련 프로그램의 배경화면을 제공하는 스크린부; 상기 사용자가 소총수인 경우 사용되며, 소총 형상으로 마련되고, 상기 사용자에 의해 조작되어 격발됨으로써, 제1 격발정보를 생성하는 제1 총기부; 상기 사용자가 저격수인 경우 사용되며, 저격소총 형상으로 마련되고, 상기 사용자에 의해 조작되어 격발됨으로써, 제2 격발정보를 생성하는 제2 총기부; 상기 사용자가 소총수인 경우 사용되며, 지면과 단차를 가지도록 형성되고,  상기 스크린부가 설치되며, 상기 사용자에게 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행을 위한 공간을 제공하는 제1 스테이지부; 상기 사용자가 저격수인 경우 사용되며, 지면과 단차를 가지도록 형성되고,  상기 사용자에게 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행을 위한 공간을 제공하는 제2 스테이지부; 및 상기 통신부와, 상기 스크린부와, 상기 제1 총기부와, 상기 제2 총기부와, 상기 제1 스테이지부와, 상기 제2 스테이지부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 전투훈련 프로그램에 대한 데이터가 저장되며, 상기 스크린부에서 표시되는 상기 배경화면을 변화시키고, 상기 제1 격발정보 및 상기 제2 격발정보에 따라 상기 전투훈련 프로그램을 진행시키는 연산부를 포함하고, 상기 연산부는, 상기 사용자가 지휘관인 경우, 상기 스크린부에 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행 상황을 전체적으로 파악할 수 있는 전술지휘용 화면을 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 가상의 화면을 이용함으로써, 다양한 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 실전적인 모의 전투훈련 프로그램을 진행할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Flood disaster cascade event evolution prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood disaster prediction and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event. According to the method, entity nodes and relationship types in a river basin are built into knowledge graphs updated along with time, the evolution of a flood disaster cascade event is reflected in real time by utilizing a node attribute dynamic update and a relationship edge weight dynamic adjustment mechanism, meanwhile, time features are embedded into the knowledge graph nodes and relationship edges, the time dependence represented by the nodes is enhanced, finally, a relationship evolution graph convolution neural network is adopted to infer the knowledge graphs, information of neighbor nodes is aggregated through the graph convolution neural network by utilizing each relationship edge, and respective propagation intensity is adjusted based on the relationship types, so that the result output by the graph convolution network is focused on the structural relationship among the nodes, the edge weight is adjusted according to the change of the node attribute, and the development venation of the flood disaster is accurately simulated.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD;CHINA INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Power transmission line deicing jump tripping risk early warning method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring of icing disasters of power transmission lines, in particular to a power transmission line ice-breaking jump tripping risk early warning method, a system, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of capturing a motion track of a wire and a ground wire in real time, calculating a space distance, constructing a three-dimensional power simulation model of a power transmission line, simulating and calculating a wire jump process after ice removal, fusing distance data obtained by two means to form a minimum insulation distance, judging the occurrence of an ice removal jump event through multi-source data cross-validation based on wire tension change, ice coating thickness mutation and wire displacement characteristics captured by the visual monitoring device, calculating a discharge voltage according to the minimum insulation distance and combining a standard discharge characteristic curve when the ice removal jump event is judged to occur, comparing the discharge voltage with the line operation voltage to obtain a voltage margin, carrying out tripping risk grading evaluation based on the voltage margin, and outputting corresponding early warning information. The method solves the problem that the traditional static monitoring can not capture the dynamic process.

title_en: Elastic power distribution network power supply recovery method considering micro-grid interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of distribution networks and discloses a method for recovering power supply of an elastic distribution network by considering micro-grid interconnection, which has the technical scheme that an objective function taking the maximum weighted load amount as a core is constructed; establishing a father node model of a node, establishing a line interconnection time sequence model, establishing a line power supply state decision variable model, checking the feasibility of a power supply recovery scheme through a dynamic frequency simulation model, determining an interconnectable micro-grid boundary based on boundary search after a disaster, introducing auxiliary variables to establish an elastic power distribution network sequence recovery model for calculating micro-grid interconnection, and finally analyzing and verifying the feasibility of the scheme through dynamic frequency simulation, and simultaneously combining the father node model of the node, the line interconnection time sequence model and the line power supply state decision variable model to achieve the aims of improving the integral inertia and frequency supporting capability of the system, improving the recovery efficiency of a power grid after the disaster and guaranteeing the safety of the recovery scheme.

title_en: Storm strong wind short time approach prediction method based on ENetwork evolution network and Uformer network mixed architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm high wind short time neighbor prediction method based on ENetwork evolution network and Uformer network mixed architecture, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical live data, including radar echo sample data sets, extremely high wind speed data sets and lightning data sets, generating a latticed storm high wind label data set based on the extremely high wind speed and the lightning data, constructing ENetwork evolution network and Uformer mixed model, carrying out space-time extrapolation on input data by the evolution network to generate a prediction field, uformer fusion of extrapolation results and the historical data to output the storm high wind prediction field, training the model through a loss function, and inputting real-time data into the training model to output the latticed prediction field. The method effectively improves the accuracy and timeliness of thunderstorm wind forecast within 0-2 hours, has the spatial resolution of 1 km, has better prediction performance on strong echo and extreme wind speed than the traditional method, and provides high-precision technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Organ transplantation transfer medical kit combined with reversible electroporation and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical equipment, and particularly discloses a medical box for organ transplantation transfer combined with reversible electroporation and application thereof. On the basis of the original design, the novel electric pulse device is added to the medical kit for organ transplantation, so that a large number of emergency reactions generated after organ transplantation can be obviously reduced, and the survival rate of the organ is improved. The novel electric pulse device is designed to be attached to the inner wall of the box body, the designed electric pulse electrode plate is attached to the buffer cushion, the buffer cushion is made of insulating nontoxic heat-preserving materials, and organ preservation liquid is arranged in the organ preservation bag. The medical kit for organ transplantation can utilize the additional electrode to apply electric pulse to the organ in the organ preservation bag, promote the medicine in the organ preservation solution to enter the organ, confirm the optimum pulse intensity applied by combining with the cell experiment, and simulate and confirm the potential distribution condition by combining with the simulation software, so that the emergency response generated after the perfusion can be reduced, thereby ensuring the normal function of the organ and improving the success rate of the transplantation.

title_en: Landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in mountain canyon region
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide hazard source identification and dynamic risk assessment method in a mountain canyon region, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1 regional pregnancy mode analysis and identification target region definition, namely constructing a comprehensive vulnerability evaluation model, and defining investigation target regions with different priorities by combining InSAR deformation monitoring; S2, fine identification of potential sliding sources, namely accurately identifying landslide boundaries and deep structures by adopting a star-machine-ground cooperative technology combining multi-stage LiDAR terrain change detection, unmanned plane multispectral and thermal infrared detection and geophysical exploration, and S3, dynamic risk assessment, namely establishing a dynamic and static load coupling stability model considering heavy rain and earthquake working conditions, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to calculate instability probability, and combining disaster-bearing body vulnerability analysis to realize quantitative risk classification. The method realizes early identification, accurate positioning and dynamic risk quantification of landslide hazard sources, and improves the prevention and control capability of landslide disasters in the high mountain channel Gu Ou.
assignees: The First Geological Brigade of Sichuan Province;SICHUAN INST OF GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIGATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Pressure relief and shock absorption method for ultra-long hole of thick and hard top plate of island working face
abstract_en: The invention provides an island working face thick and hard top plate superlong hole pressure relief and shock absorption method, which comprises the steps of confirming positions of a main key layer and a plurality of sub-key layers of a thick and hard top plate above an island working face, collecting microseismic data of the top plate of the working face during working face mining, identifying positions of the key layers of main induced rock formations above the island working face, constructing a overlying strata structure model corresponding to abnormal mining pressure induced by key layer breaking energy transfer of the island working face, judging an induced rock formation induced impact mechanism, determining a disaster-causing main control layer and a plurality of disaster-causing sub-control layers, and performing superlong drilling construction pressure relief operation on the disaster-causing main control layer and the disaster-causing sub-control layers. According to the method, a key layer theory and microseismic data analysis are utilized to identify a key layer where a shock inducing rock stratum in a thick and hard top plate of an island working surface is located, a cover rock structure model above the island working surface is constructed, a disaster inducing sub-control layer and a disaster inducing sub-control layer are distinguished for a plurality of shock inducing rock strata, and therefore ultra-long drilling arrangement and pressure relief operation are carried out.

title_en: Model test device and method for simulating disaster of underground building structure with ground crack movement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model test device and a method for simulating catastrophe of a building under ground fracture activity, which relate to the technical field of geological engineering and comprise a base; the model box comprises a bottom plate, a coaming and a flexible layer, wherein the bottom plate comprises a plurality of sub-bottom plates, the coaming comprises a plurality of sub-coamings, at least one part of the sub-bottom plates is arranged on the driving device, the flexible layer is paved on the bottom plate, two adjacent sub-coamings are flexibly connected, a test soil layer is paved on the flexible layer, a test building structure is paved on the test soil layer, a positioning device is respectively connected with the model box and the test building structure, and a monitoring device is arranged in the test soil layer and on the test building structure. The model test device for simulating the catastrophe of the building under the ground fracture movement can simulate the catastrophe process of the building under various ground fracture movement modes, and has the advantages of strong applicability, reliable results and the like.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;SHAANXI GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION SHAANXI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER CENTER

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide susceptibility evaluation method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and prevention, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining digital elevation model data and multi-source data after target area pretreatment, dividing the pretreated digital elevation model data based on preset geographic software to obtain evaluation unit data, training a preset depth integration model based on the evaluation unit data, determining the evaluation unit data with high training precision as target evaluation unit data, determining landslide influence factors based on the target evaluation unit data and the multi-source data, inputting the landslide influence factors into the preset depth integration model to obtain a preliminary evaluation result of landslide susceptibility of a target area, and obtaining the landslide susceptibility evaluation result of the target area based on the preliminary evaluation result. The landslide disaster risk partition and prevention and control scheme can be accurately recommended.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS SECOND HIGHWAY SURVEY DESIGN AND RESEARCH INST

title_en: Maximum wave height intelligent forecasting method, system, equipment and storage medium based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine environment prediction, and discloses a maximum wave height intelligent prediction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing an intelligent prediction system, arranging an acquisition unit, a fusion unit, a preprocessing unit, a training unit, an error correction unit, an evaluation unit, an early warning unit, a guarantee unit and a visualization unit in the system, sequentially connecting and cooperating the units through a standardized data interface, the system solves the problems of insufficient data utilization, insufficient model precision and timeliness and disjointed forecasting results and application scenes faced by the traditional method in maximum wave height forecasting, and finally provides scientific, reliable and efficient decision support for marine disaster prevention and reduction, engineering safety operation and navigation safety guarantee.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG YANTAI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency training situation deduction method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of industrial digital twinning, and mainly relates to an emergency training situation deduction method based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of deploying a plurality of types of data sensors in a chemical plant, collecting equipment states and environment parameters in real time, fusing plant design drawings, and constructing a high-precision digital twinning body consistent with a physical field; a fault propagation mechanism is established, so that the simulation situation can automatically and intelligently dynamically evolve according to initial conditions; the method includes continuously integrating real-time sensor data into a digital twin body, driving a virtual model to synchronously update the state, adjusting a disaster evolution path and key parameters according to real data flow, enabling a training person to operate virtual equipment on the spot by combining an AR technology, and identifying potential hidden hazards of a factory by combining an AI algorithm.
assignees: BEIJING ANJIU QIUSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating spontaneous combustion risk of fire disaster in limited space
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating spontaneous combustion risk of a limited space fire disaster, and relates to the technical field of fire disaster evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a ceiling impact fire disaster model based on a limited space, wherein optimized discretization parameters of the ceiling impact fire disaster model are determined by simulating and verifying free fire plumes based on an open space in advance; based on the simulation result, extracting the concentration distribution data of unburned fuel and the flue gas temperature distribution data at the position of the ceiling, comparing the concentration distribution data of the unburned fuel and the flue gas temperature distribution data with corresponding combustion thresholds, and evaluating the spontaneous combustion risk of the limited space according to the comparison result. According to the invention, the assessment of the spontaneous combustion risk of the fire disaster can be accurately quantified, and the serious dependence on manual experience is avoided.
assignees: HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY;HARBIN INST OF TECHNOLOGY ZHENGZHOU RESEARCH INST

title_en: Landslide accumulation prediction method based on generation countermeasure network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide accumulation prediction method based on a generated countermeasure network, which is applicable to the field of landslide prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a two-dimensional section of a landslide body to be predicted, filling corresponding image features for each layer in the section based on rock-soil materials of geological units of each layer in the landslide body, comparing the corresponding relation between the preset rock-soil materials and the image features, generating a landslide front image corresponding to the landslide body, inputting the landslide front image into a trained landslide accumulation prediction model constructed based on a generated countermeasure network, and obtaining a landslide rear image, wherein the landslide rear image comprises the two-dimensional section of the landslide body after landslide, and each layer in the section retains the image features of each layer before landslide. The invention converts the numerical simulation problem into the image generation problem, improves the calculation efficiency, greatly shortens the prediction response time, and is beneficial to promoting the floor application of the numerical simulation problem in scenes such as major engineering disaster prediction, emergency response decision support and the like.

title_en: Urban rainfall pattern recognition method based on clustering and discriminant analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban rainfall pattern recognition, and aims to solve the problems that the existing method depends on an empirical formula, rainfall classification is unstable and interpretation is insufficient. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-station long-time actually measured rainfall data, identifying independent rainfall events based on rainfall interval threshold values, extracting and standardizing multidimensional features such as rainfall duration, peak rainfall intensity and the like, adopting Ward minimum variance method hierarchical clustering, combining Calinski-Harabasz indexes and the like to determine optimal cluster numbers to obtain a rainfall mode, training a Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) model by taking a clustering result as a label, verifying and rapidly classifying new rainfall events, and using the result for flood control scheduling, flood risk assessment and the like. The invention improves rationality based on measured data, integrates clustering and discriminant analysis, improves classification stability, has strong expandability, and supports intelligent disaster prevention.

title_en: Lightning disaster monitoring lightning protection grounding device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightning disaster monitoring lightning protection grounding device which comprises an insulating plate, wherein the upper surface of the insulating plate is fixedly connected with a monitoring device, the bottom surface of the insulating plate is fixedly connected with four sliding rods, the outer surface of each sliding rod is connected with a lifting plate in a sliding manner, the upper surface of the lifting plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the bottom surface of the lifting plate is inlaid with a first bearing, and the inner ring of the first bearing is fixedly connected with a connecting device. This device drives connecting device, earth crust and drill bit through the motor and rotates to push down the lifter plate, make the drill bit drive earth crust downwardly moving, thereby bring the earth crust underground, shortened the time of burying earthing device underground, pull out the limiting plate, through rotating turning handle, bull stick and arc baffle, make the pointed end displacement of electrically conductive pointed cone outside the earth crust, carry out multipolar diffusion current through the pointed end of earth crust and electrically conductive pointed cone, make the effect of uninstalling the electric current better, reduced the influence of thunder and lightning.

title_en: Drainage pipeline risk early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent water affairs and urban disaster prevention, and provides a drainage pipeline risk early warning method, system, equipment and medium, comprising the following steps of dividing a risk area by combining pipeline GIS data and historical faults, and differentially distributing temperature and strain sensing optical fibers to form a double-parameter network; synchronous sampling by a demodulator, processing data by a dynamic self-adaptive sliding window with a preset threshold value, and identifying abnormal fragments; after multi-source fusion correction, the initial evaluation event type and risk of the pre-trained CNN-LSTM model are input, pipeline digital twin simulation results are used for medium and above risks, four-level risks are judged, early warning is pushed according to grades, response is triggered, treatment feedback is collected, model parameters and risk threshold values are dynamically adjusted through incremental learning, accurate capture of micro-anomalies of the drainage pipeline and real-time quantitative evaluation of risks are achieved, meanwhile, the life cycle of the system is prolonged, operation and maintenance cost is reduced, and intelligent safe operation and maintenance of the drainage pipeline are achieved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD;TIANJIN DRAINAGE MAN TRANSACTION CENTER

title_en: Data acquisition device suitable for mountain region photovoltaic digital twin disaster-resistant simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data acquisition device suitable for mountain photovoltaic digital twin disaster-resistant simulation, which comprises a case shell, wherein a bearing mechanism is arranged at the rear side of the case shell, an adjusting mechanism is also arranged at the rear side of the case shell, a driving mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the case shell, an assembling mechanism is fixedly connected to the outer side of the driving mechanism, the driving mechanism is used for driving the assembling mechanism to rotate, and the adjusting mechanism is used for pressing the assembling mechanism. According to the invention, by arranging the screwing motor, the output rod, the extension rod, the connecting sleeve and other parts, through the transmission fit of the screwing motor and the output rod and the extension rod and the sliding fit of the guide groove and the guide block, the connecting sleeve can drive the screwing wheel to precisely move and rotate through the rotation of the extension rod and the guide of the guide groove, so that the effect that the device can replace manual operation through mechanical transmission and automatically dock external wiring harnesses of different monitoring devices is achieved.
assignees: MCC WUKAN ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring river bank cracks and bank slope instability based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring river bank cracks and bank slope instability based on image recognition, which belong to the technical field of river dynamics and geological disaster monitoring, and comprise the steps of acquiring river bank images through arranging multi-angle camera equipment, and constructing a training data set through frame extraction and labeling; the method comprises the steps of carrying out crack and shoreline identification by adopting a ResU-Net model with a residual structure and an attention mechanism introduced, improving segmentation precision through super-parameter optimization, calculating the distance from the crack to the shoreline based on an image identification result to determine an evaluation section, calculating a shoreside stability safety coefficient by adopting a limit balance method, and finally dividing risk grades according to the safety coefficient to realize monitoring of river shoreside instability. The method and the device remarkably reduce construction and maintenance difficulties, improve evaluation efficiency, simplify the early-stage preparation flow of the bank collapse monitoring, and solve the problem of field complex condition limitation in the bank collapse monitoring.

title_en: Rainfall loss parameter verification optimization method based on soil humidity grading
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall loss parameter verification optimization method based on soil humidity grading, which relates to the technical field of disaster assessment and comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of soil hydrodynamic parameter units, constructing a dynamic parameter mapping matrix, including initial loss coefficients and initial loss indexes, conducting disturbance combination to generate a plurality of regional soil composition scenes, after taking a plurality of groups of initial loss parameters, conducting weighted linear fusion to output a plurality of fusion loss parameters, conducting heavy rain flood peak flow simulation to output a plurality of flood peak flow predicted values, taking a plurality of flood peak flow actual measurement values, calculating a plurality of predicted deviation vectors, conducting multi-scenario parallel loss parameter iterative correction to output a plurality of groups of correction loss parameters, and conducting parameter directional replacement. The method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the model is mostly calculated based on static soil parameters and an empirical formula, and real-time monitoring and dynamic change of soil humidity are ignored, so that the space-time precision and adaptability of disaster early warning are poor.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Cascade machine learning-based hydrate region seabed landslide risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydrate region submarine landslide risk assessment method based on cascading machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of marine geological disaster prediction. The landslide risk prediction method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining historical landslide data, hydrate occurrence data and various environmental characteristics of a research area, preprocessing, constructing a hydrate occurrence data set based on local hydrate data and the environmental characteristics, training a neural network model fused with physical constraints, predicting occurrence depth of all-area hydrate and generating a distribution map, finally fusing the predicted depth serving as a key characteristic with the environmental characteristics, constructing an enhanced landslide data set, training an integrated learning model by adopting a dynamic weight integration strategy based on a geological landscape unit, and finishing landslide risk prediction. According to the invention, the prediction bottleneck caused by the scarcity of the hydrate data is effectively solved through the cascade architecture, the rationality and the robustness of the model are improved through physical constraint, and the high-precision and interpretable evaluation of the submarine landslide risk of the hydrate region is realized.

title_en: Earthquake numerical prediction method based on nuclear density and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting earthquake values according to nuclear density and machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake prediction. The method comprises the steps of performing magnitude standardization and energy association processing on original seismic catalogue data to form standard seismic catalogue data, determining minimum complete magnitude of the standard seismic catalogue data through completeness processing, screening to obtain complete seismic catalogue, determining first and second bandwidths of the complete seismic catalogue through nuclear density bandwidth sensitivity testing, calculating seismic frequency and energy nuclear density distribution of a target area by combining time and magnitude sliding windows, obtaining nuclear density abnormal distribution data by making difference with long-term average nuclear density distribution, inputting the nuclear density abnormal distribution data of a target magnitude range under multiple time scales into a pre-training random forest model, and outputting a prediction result of occurrence of a target seismic under the target area. The method improves the spatial accuracy and timeliness of earthquake prediction and provides technical support for prevention and control of earthquake disaster risks.

title_en: Directional fracturing system and method for hard super-thick top plate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional fracturing system and method for a hard super-thick top plate. The system constructs a targeted injection channel through directional long-hole intelligent drilling and directional perforation cluster technology, solves the problem of small treatment range of traditional shallow hole fracturing, adopts induced particle-containing fracturing fluid pre-fracturing combined with microseismic monitoring to form a main fracture, injects supercritical CO2 to induce a large number of secondary fractures, constructs a complex network of the main fracture and the secondary fracture to weaken a top plate uniformly and eliminate water-sensitive damage to realize zero pollution of a reservoir, starts an adaptive adjustment mechanism based on microseismic signal inversion, dynamically optimizes injection parameters, inhibits secondary fracture development to concentrate energy to expand the main fracture when the fracture excessively branches, enhances supercritical CO2 injection to reduce expansion resistance and promote deep extension when the fracture expansion is insufficient, ensures accurate matching of the fracture expansion and a designed pressure relief range, and avoids resource waste and secondary disasters. The method can effectively treat the disaster of the hard and super-thick top plate, and simultaneously improves the gas extraction efficiency, and has economical efficiency and safety.
assignees: HENAN INST ENGINEERING;UNIV CHONGQING;HANCHENG ZAOZHUANG IND CO LTD

title_en: Loess landslide risk prediction method and device terminal, medium, and program product
abstract_en: Constructing a pregnancy factor system of loess landslide, determining a final pregnancy factor of a loess landslide risk prediction model of a research area as a training sample, dividing the final pregnancy factor into a training set and a testing set, and training and calibrating a basic learning frame constructed based on an RF model and a XGBoost model to obtain the loess landslide risk prediction model of the research area; based on loess landslide information of the region to be detected, outputting a loess landslide risk estimation result of the region to be detected by utilizing a loess landslide risk estimation model with research distinction, and realizing loess landslide risk estimation of the region to be detected. According to the scheme, a disaster pregnancy factor system of loess landslide is constructed, a training sample is determined by utilizing multi-source acquisition information, a stacked integrated frame is utilized for training, a calibrator is overlapped to form a final model, and accuracy of landslide risk prediction is improved.

title_en: Mountain area slope stability analysis method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain area slope stability analysis method based on multi-source data fusion, which particularly relates to the technical field of slope engineering simulation by a digital twin technology, and is used for solving the problem that an optimal treatment scheme is difficult to quickly search for due to calculation and combination explosion in emergency response of sudden geological disasters in the existing digital twin, wherein forward stability analysis is carried out by constructing the digital twin of a slope, key geological structure units are identified and targeted emergency treatment measure combinations are generated when the safety coefficient is lower than a threshold value, space-time conduction effects among measures are evaluated to screen efficient synergistic target combinations, and finally the digital twin is used for calculating and predicting the safety coefficient and selecting the optimal emergency scheme to realize active prevention and control of slope risks and quick decision support.
assignees: ANHUI WATER CONSERVANCY TECHNICAL COLLEGE;UNIV TONGJI;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Fiber bragg grating inclinometry data correction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering geological monitoring and geological disaster early warning, and discloses a method and a system for correcting fiber bragg grating inclinometry data, wherein the method comprises the following steps that a, temperature data and strain data of a fiber bragg grating sensor acquired under non-deformation conditions and deformation conditions are acquired, and then time sequence normalization and data standardization processing are carried out; the method comprises the steps of (a) constructing and training a temperature compensation model, establishing a mapping relation from temperature to strain drift, obtaining strain data after temperature correction by using the trained temperature compensation model, c, removing impulse interference caused by rainfall in the strain data after temperature correction by adopting an interference removal algorithm, d, verifying the strain data after removing impulse interference caused by rainfall, and outputting the strain data after removing impulse interference caused by rainfall after verification. The invention solves the problems of low inclinometry accuracy and the like in the prior art.
assignees: WUHAN GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CENTER OF CHINA GEOLOGICAL SURVEY ZHONGNAN GEOLOGICAL SCIENCE AND TECH INNOV;INST OF ROCK AND SOIL MECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Summer precipitation prediction correction downscaling method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a summer precipitation prediction correction downscaling method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of weather prediction and climate simulation. Aiming at the technical problems of systematic deviation and space detail deficiency in forecasting, a deep learning scale-down model is built by combining summer multi-mode climate forecast data issued 6 months in advance with high-resolution observation data and terrain data, deviation correction and space super-resolution reconstruction are carried out on a summer rainfall forecasting result, and a target area kilometer-level summer rainfall field is output. The model improves the space feature capturing capacity of the multi-scale climate elements through an attention mechanism, and realizes the self-adaptive fusion of the climate elements and the topography factors through a topography sensing module, so that the medium-long-term prediction accuracy of summer precipitation in a complex topography area is enhanced. The invention can effectively integrate global climate information and local topography characteristics, and provides high-precision technical support for regional summer precipitation medium-long-term prediction, flood season disaster prevention and reduction and water resource scheduling.

title_en: Mine disaster self-rescuer AI video identification training system
abstract_en: The application discloses an AI video identification practical training system for mine disaster self-rescue devices, which belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety simulation, and comprises a shooting simulation module for simulating an underground environment, an operator wears a mine disaster self-rescue device in the simulated environment, shoots the wearing process and the simulation process, a video optimization module for optimizing video frame images with poor image quality, an action analysis module for conducting key point detection and action identification on the video after the optimization processing, acquiring operation steps of the operator, judging whether the action is completed or not, and a multidimensional scoring module for constructing a quantitative scoring model according to time dimension, action specification dimension and component operation dimension, scoring the operation process of the operator, so that the operator can practice in the actual environment, the operation proficiency and psychological quality of the operator in an emergency scene are improved, emergency operation errors caused by insufficient environment adaptation are avoided, the action judgment accuracy is improved, and comprehensive and objective quantitative basis is provided for practical training effect evaluation.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic risk simulation method and system based on intelligent agent interaction modeling
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a dynamic risk simulation method and a system for urban flood disasters based on intelligent agent interaction modeling, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster prevention and control. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the active response behaviors of residents in disasters (such as early returning home, reducing going out and the like) are truly depicted by constructing an intelligent body interaction model and utilizing crowd position service data and interest point data, and the behavior mechanism is embedded into a dynamic risk simulation process based on intelligent bodies, so that a more realistic individual exposure estimation result is obtained. Compared with the traditional method for regarding population as a static and passive exposure disaster-bearing body, the method can effectively improve the accuracy and reliability of risk simulation results.

title_en: Machine learning and multi-source data fusion-based rainstorm flood risk early warning method
abstract_en: The application discloses a rainstorm flood risk early warning method and a system based on machine learning and multi-source data fusion, which belong to the technical field of flood prediction, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing multi-source sample data based on flood disaster history data; the multi-source sample data type comprises rainfall characteristic data, hydrological characteristic data, topography and topography characteristic data, earth surface attribute characteristic data and socioeconomic characteristic data, a XGBoost integrated learning algorithm is adopted to construct a risk prediction model, training and evaluation are carried out based on the multi-source sample data, a historical storm flood event record is used as a label in the training process, the risk prediction model is quantified and applied to be verified, the risk level probability output by the risk prediction model is calibrated based on the risk level distribution probability of the historical disaster data, real-time prediction is carried out based on the optimized risk prediction model, and a spatially refined storm flood risk level early warning map in a future preset period is generated in a rolling mode by the prediction result.
assignees: NAT SATELLITE METEOROLOGICAL CENTER NAT SPACE WEATHER MONITORING & WARNING CENTER

title_en: Power grid composite chain disaster multi-source monitoring damage assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source monitoring damage evaluation method and a system for a composite chain disaster of a power grid, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a reference geographic coverage area to generate a plurality of independent analysis units, attributing each three-dimensional discrete point to a corresponding independent analysis unit, and calculating to obtain a unit space calibration coefficient; the method comprises the steps of carrying out regional correction on a fused disaster monitoring image data set by using a unit space calibration coefficient to obtain calibrated disaster monitoring image data, extracting disaster damage characteristics through a deep learning semantic segmentation network based on the calibrated disaster monitoring image data, carrying out space diffusion path simulation and time evolution process analysis of disaster influence based on the disaster damage characteristics to obtain disaster space-time evolution characteristics, carrying out comprehensive quantitative evaluation on damage degree and risk level of power grid facilities, and generating a comprehensive damage evaluation result. The method and the system improve the accuracy of monitoring and evaluating the disaster damage of the power grid and enhance the risk early warning and coping capacity of the power grid facilities.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Rainfall time sequence prediction method integrating ancient model
abstract_en: The application discloses a rainfall time sequence prediction method fusing a paleo-model, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ERA5-REANALYSIS data and ERA5-Land data of a target area, constructing a time sequence prediction data set through normalization, cleaning and normalization, constructing a rainfall time sequence prediction model based on a dish archaic weather large model, respectively extracting earth surface and atmosphere characteristics through a 2D and 3D embedding module, fusing time sequence-space characteristics, utilizing the time sequence data set training model to combine weighted sampling to improve extreme rainfall prediction capability, inputting latest T-hour data of the target area into the trained model, and outputting the rainfall N hours in the future. The method solves the problem of time sequence information fracturing in the traditional method, effectively captures the time-space dependence of rainfall, improves the prediction precision and the prediction capability of the extreme rainfall, and can provide scientific support for flood control, disaster reduction, agricultural production and the like.
assignees: ZHONGTU KEXIN DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Wide remote sensing image semantic segmentation method based on multi-scale image pyramid cutting
abstract_en: The invention provides a semantic segmentation method of a wide remote sensing image based on multi-scale image pyramid cutting, and aims to realize pixel-level refined interpretation of a large-scale remote sensing image. The method comprises a four-step core process, namely a first step of multi-scale pyramid cutting of a wide remote sensing image, a second step of long-distance context dependent representation and modeling, a third step of high-efficiency semantic integration of cross-scale characteristics, and a fourth step of integration of local reasoning results. The invention overcomes the bottleneck that the traditional broad remote sensing image semantic segmentation model is difficult to capture the long-distance context semantic feature association, effectively solves the problems of high computational complexity, large video memory occupation and insufficient precision of the traditional broad remote sensing segmentation method, has the advantages of high segmentation precision and high training reasoning efficiency, and can be widely applied to the fields of homeland space planning, ecological environment monitoring, agricultural resource investigation, natural disaster assessment and the like.

title_en: Agricultural drought prediction method for interpretive deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to an agricultural drought prediction method for interpretive deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining agricultural drought related data of a research area, identifying drought events for soil volume water contents of different depths, respectively and independently constructing GRU models for soil layers of different depths, training the GRU models based on the agricultural drought related data, predicting the soil volume water contents based on the trained GRU models, and performing interpretive analysis on drought event identification results, namely outputting weather input characteristic importance time sequences by adopting an expected gradient method, identifying soil layer driving differences, seasonal factors and typical dynamic response types, and analyzing an internal state updating mechanism of a gating circulation unit in the GRU models by combining an additive decomposition method. The invention can improve the transparency and the credibility of the model while maintaining the prediction precision, and provides scientific basis for the mechanism research of agricultural drought and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Large-model fine-tuning intelligent disaster recovery large data early warning analysis method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large model fine tuning intelligent disaster tolerance large data early warning analysis method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster index data from each distributed data center, and carrying out clustering cleaning on the data by adopting a clustering algorithm to form a standardized clustering data set; the method comprises the steps of mapping data of different disaster grades into calculation tasks, quantifying calculation force requirements of each task by combining calculation force efficiency values, performing three-stage fine adjustment on a basic large model based on a standardized data set and the calculation force efficiency values, including preliminary training by ridge regression, intensive training of difficult data, generation of a special small model and joint fine adjustment according to the disaster grades, and outputting occurrence probability and final early warning result of each disaster grade by adopting a longitudinal joint prediction algorithm and combining homomorphic encryption and private information retrieval technology. The system comprises a data preprocessing module, a calculation force quantification module, a large model fine tuning module and a combined prediction and early warning module. The invention improves the accuracy, the instantaneity and the privacy protection capability of disaster recovery early warning.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-azimuth detection system and method for electric spark seismic source based on polarization effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-azimuth detection system and method for an electric spark seismic source based on polarization effect, comprising a seismic source drill rod, a capacitance drill rod, a conductive drill rod and a control console, wherein the discharge electrodes are respectively corresponding to excitation ports with different orientations, three space orthogonal excitation ports are formed in a mode to perform time-sharing excitation, three transverse wave sources with known and pure polarization directions are manufactured, detection precision is improved for subsequent inversion analysis, three-component seismic trace record data sets corresponding to the three seismic sources are further obtained, then three sets of azimuth data are obtained after the data sets are processed, then model parameter vectors are defined, full-waveform inversion functions are determined, gradient directions for enabling an objective function to descend are obtained by adopting a concomitant state method, model parameters are iteratively updated by utilizing an L-BFGS algorithm, and finally full-waveform inversion is performed by utilizing optimal solution and combining the three sets of azimuth data, so that azimuth anisotropy information of a detection area is obtained, and accurate identification of disaster bodies in the detection target area is realized by fusing the multi-azimuth detection data.

title_en: Heat radiation test device with adjustable test stand
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire cause investigation, and particularly discloses a heat radiation test device with an adjustable test frame, which comprises a heat radiation frame and a test frame; the test rack is in a portal shape, sliding supports with adjustable heights are respectively sleeved on the left end and the right end of the test rack, locking assemblies are arranged on the sliding supports, the test rack further comprises a rotating rod which is horizontally arranged, two ends of the rotating rod are respectively connected to the two rotating rods, a rotating assembly is arranged on the rotating rod, the rotating assembly rotates along the circumferential direction of the rotating rod, and a fixing frame is arranged on the rotating assembly and is used for fixing samples. Through adjusting the height of sliding support, and then reach the effect of adjusting the whole height of mount, rotate the angular adjustment of subassembly to the mount in the cooperation for the sample can carry out the test of heat radiation with the radiation source with different angles, makes operating personnel can more accurately simulate the state that the sample is located according to the data after the disaster and test data.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM

title_en: Landslide hazard susceptibility intelligent evaluation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent landslide disaster susceptibility assessment system and method, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and assessment. The landslide susceptibility prediction method comprises the steps of preprocessing multi-source geospatial data by using a Geographic Information System (GIS), extracting a plurality of factor layers influencing landslide occurrence, directly using original geological factor data, fusing and learning geological factor characteristics through a deep learning network without weighting treatment, constructing a base model comprising GBDT, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) and an Adaboost algorithm, inputting a prediction result of the base model as characteristics into the deep learning fusion model for training, analyzing landslide susceptibility of a target area by using the trained model, and dividing the susceptibility result into five grades (extremely low, medium, high and extremely high) by a natural breakpoint method to generate a landslide susceptibility prediction map.

title_en: Method for evaluating dangerousness of suspended roof in pillar mining coal goaf
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating dangerousness of a suspended ceiling of a pillar mining coal goaf, and belongs to the geological field of mine engineering and the mining engineering field. The method comprises the steps of measuring the initial concentration of radon gas before coal exploitation in the same mining area, determining a key layer of a goaf, sampling the key layer, measuring the tensile strength, calculating the crack density of an evaluation object through radon gas concentration data, evaluating the tensile strength by combining the current crack density of the key layer, further calculating the ultimate tensile strength of the key layer, and evaluating the safety of the suspended roof of the goaf.
