The method is not dependent on a large number of drilling engineering, can be rapidly and economically implemented on the ground or underground, realizes quantitative evaluation of the stability of a key layer, and provides scientific basis for prevention and control of suspended roof disasters of the coal goaf.
assignees: SHAANXI 185 COALFIELD GEOLOGY CO LTD;SHAANXI GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION SHAANXI PROVINCIAL GEOLOGICAL DISASTER CENTER

title_en: Multi-scale remote sensing three-reference unified alignment and lightweight change detection method and system
abstract_en: Constructing a unified frame of space-spectrum references, carrying out unified fusion processing on multi-source data to obtain unified data, and carrying out primary identification on disaster areas by adopting physical characteristics aiming at mountain fires and flood disasters based on the unified data to generate identification results; based on the identification result, a hierarchical collaborative perception system of 'satellite census-unmanned aerial vehicle detailed investigation-multisource fusion accurate judgment' is constructed, census data and detailed investigation data are obtained through satellite census-unmanned aerial vehicle detailed investigation, multisource data fusion is carried out on the census data and the detailed data, a monitoring result comprising a fine disaster boundary, a quantization index and a thematic product is generated, a risk prediction model is obtained through analyzing operation parameters and environmental factors of a transformer substation and a power transmission line, the monitoring result is input into a mountain fire spreading prediction model, and dynamic simulation and prediction of a mountain fire spreading process are achieved through a discretized grid cell structure.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;WUHAN BRANCH OF CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST

title_en: Drilling blowout prevention early warning and control system and method based on microseism monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drilling blowout prevention early warning prevention and control system and method based on microseism monitoring, wherein the early warning prevention and control system comprises a linkage control module, the input end of the linkage control module is respectively connected with a signal processing and early warning module, an orifice environment monitoring module and an orifice active prevention and control execution module, the orifice active prevention and control execution module is simultaneously connected with the output end of the linkage control module, the output end of the microseism monitoring module is connected with the signal processing and early warning module, and the connection modes among the modules are all wired or wireless. The invention realizes early warning of disasters in minute and earlier by capturing microseismic precursor information generated by coal rock mass before the occurrence of the spray holes, constructs an analysis framework of multisource information fusion, realizes a multi-layer and deep defense system of early warning-speed reduction-negative pressure increase-emergency shutdown-multi-stage pressure relief from risk recognition to prevention and control measure execution, realizes early recognition, early warning and early treatment of spray hole phenomena, and improves the safety and efficiency of drilling construction.
assignees: CHINA COAL ENERGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD;CHINA COAL ORDOS ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Helicopter cockpit personnel water emergency evacuation time simulation evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of man-machine integration, and particularly relates to a simulation evaluation method for water emergency evacuation time of helicopter cockpit personnel. The method comprises the steps of S1, determining a cockpit emergency evacuation program, S2, constructing an emergency evacuation action and a gesture of cockpit personnel, S3, conducting a typical gesture conversion test of the cockpit personnel, measuring gesture conversion time in a test mode, obtaining personnel motion data, S4, conducting water emergency evacuation time analysis of personnel influenced by coupling wave periods, obtaining personnel emergency evacuation time influenced by the coupling wave periods, S5, integrating analysis results of the evacuation time at each stage, and combining to obtain total emergency evacuation time.
assignees: CHINA HELICOPTER RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT INST

title_en: Urban waterlogging refined simulation method based on surface DEM correction and image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city waterlogging refined simulation method based on surface DEM correction and image recognition, and relates to the technical fields of city hydrology and disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of carrying out image recognition on satellite remote sensing image data by utilizing an improved U-Net model, extracting data of different land utilization types, fusing drainage pipe network ground surface elevation data with original DEM data, carrying out interpolation screening and ground object hydrologic correction to generate DEM correction data, and finally constructing a ground surface production confluence model, a city one-dimensional drainage model and a two-dimensional ground surface flooding model to realize one-dimensional and two-dimensional coupled city waterlogging fine simulation. The invention improves the recognition precision of small-scale ground objects by improving the model, breaks through the limitation of a single data source, enhances the characterization accuracy of the complex underlying surface of the city, has accurate and reliable simulation result, and is suitable for the fields of city waterlogging simulation, city planning, flood control, waterlogging drainage and the like.
assignees: ZHENGYUAN GEOMATICS GROUP CO LTD;China Metallurgical Geology Bureau

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of the system according to the embodiment is to continuously improve and maintain the disaster prevention awareness of employees.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a simulation unit, an education unit, and an information sharing unit. The simulation unit provides a disaster simulation. The education unit provides an education kit based on the simulation provided by the simulation unit. The information sharing unit shares the latest disaster information based on the education kit provided by the education unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Quantum algorithm-based damage prediction method for power distribution tower under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting damage of a power distribution tower under typhoon disasters based on a quantum algorithm, which comprises the steps of constructing an original data set, preprocessing the original data set to obtain a training set and a testing set which are suitable for model input, establishing a hybrid prediction model, specifically, performing preliminary training on the training set by using a classical random forest algorithm to obtain a preliminary prediction result aiming at the damage state of the power distribution tower, fusing the preliminary prediction result with preprocessed original feature vectors to construct a new input feature set, constructing a quantum random forest prediction model, processing high-dimensional feature data through quantum parallelism to complete the damage prediction of the power distribution tower, comparing the prediction performances of the quantum random forest prediction model and the classical random forest algorithm by adopting preset evaluation indexes, and selecting or determining an optimal prediction model for practical prediction according to the evaluation result. The method combines random forest and quantum computation, and the prediction precision is obviously improved.

title_en: Construction method and application of multi-task conjoined SCD network MSINet applied to environment monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and application of a multi-task conjoined SCD network MSINet applied to environmental monitoring. The method comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a shared weight double encoder. And 2, deploying a learnable multi-scale difference convolution module. And 3, deploying a selective feature fusion decoder. And step 4, deploying a cross-task interaction module. And 5, constructing a multi-task loss function and training optimization. And 6, network reasoning and result output. The method has good universality while ensuring the detection precision and stability, and can be further applied to the fields of extraction of other remote sensing semantic information and intelligent decision making such as post-disaster evaluation, urban planning and the like.

title_en: Fuzzy-CA toxic gas leakage risk assessment method based on large language model and Fuzzy reasoning
abstract_en: The invention provides a Fuzzy-CA toxic gas leakage risk assessment method based on a large language model and Fuzzy reasoning, and relates to the field of dangerous chemical accident risk assessment and emergency management. The method aims at solving the problem that the existing model is difficult to consider physical diffusion and toxicology characteristics, and is characterized in that firstly, a diffusion process after toxic gas leakage is efficiently simulated based on a cellular automaton, then, toxicology parameters and diffusibility attributes of the toxic gas are automatically extracted by using a large language model, corresponding fuzzy rules are generated, and finally, a global risk distribution map is output by integrating concentration distribution, toxicity intensity and diffusibility factors through a fuzzy reasoning system. The invention can realize rapid, steady and interpretable risk assessment under the conditions of multiple toxic gases and multiple scenes, and is suitable for personnel evacuation, path planning and area management and control in emergency response.

title_en: Fluidized mining method for coal pillars in room-pillar goaf
abstract_en: The room and pillar type goaf coal pillar fluidization exploitation method comprises the following steps of 1, detecting a target room and pillar type goaf to obtain detection content, 2, carrying out goaf disaster management based on the detection content, then arranging vertical drilling holes, arranging detection sensors to the goaf through the drilling holes, 3, injecting microorganism strains, nutrient solution and pH value adjusting buffering agents for decomposing coal into the goaf through the drilling holes, 4, after the microorganisms decompose the coal pillar, extracting fluidized products after decomposition and conversion from the goaf through the drilling holes, and 5, conveying the extracted fluidized products to a ground factory building to carry out separation and purification operation to obtain the target products. The room-pillar goaf coal pillar fluidization exploitation method solves the problems of high-quality coal resource loss and waste caused by low coal seam exploitation rate in the existing coal seam exploitation technology.
assignees: CHINA COAL ENERGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD;CHINA COAL ORDOS ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evaluation method, device, computer device, readable storage medium, and program product for disaster combinations in nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The application relates to a disaster evaluation method, a disaster evaluation device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for disaster combination in a nuclear power plant. The method comprises the steps of simulating a target equipment fault in a three-dimensional model of a nuclear power plant, determining a combination of an accompanying disaster, a causal disaster and an independent disaster caused by the target equipment fault, determining a disaster combination list through the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power plant based on the accompanying disaster, the causal disaster and the independent disaster combination, performing functional evaluation on equipment in the nuclear power plant through the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power plant based on the disaster combination list, performing barrier evaluation on barriers in the nuclear power plant, and generating safety evaluation of the three-dimensional model of the nuclear power plant based on the functional evaluation and the barrier evaluation. The method can be used for efficiently and conveniently carrying out safety evaluation on the disaster combinations in the nuclear power plant.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER DESIGN CO LTD SHENZHEN;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Steel structure fire disaster early warning method and system based on vibration time-frequency and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a steel structure fire disaster early warning method and system based on vibration time-frequency and deep learning, which are used for solving the problem that the prior art cannot carry out rapid, nondestructive and real-time safety assessment on a fire steel structure. The method comprises the steps of establishing a member damage criterion through thermal-force coupling numerical simulation, determining a structural damage level from a simulation result based on the criterion, simultaneously extracting acceleration time-course data, generating a wavelet time-frequency diagram through wavelet transformation, directly taking the damage level as a label to form a training sample set, training a convolutional neural network by using the sample set to obtain a deep learning model, collecting field acceleration signals, converting the field acceleration signals into a real-time wavelet time-frequency diagram, inputting the trained model to obtain a attribution probability vector, and finally triggering collapse risk early warning of a corresponding level according to a preset decision rule. The invention deeply fuses the physical mechanism and the artificial intelligence, and realizes second-level, advanced and intelligent evaluation and early warning of the damaged state of the fire-receiving steel structure.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM

title_en: Attention mechanism-based Sentinel-2 remote sensing image water body region identification method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Sentinel-2 remote sensing image water body region identification method based on an attention mechanism, which comprises the following steps of (1) obtaining and preprocessing a Sentinel-2 multispectral image, cutting to generate a multi-scene sample comprising a mountain area tiny river, an urban punctiform water body, cloud and fog interference, an island-containing large-range water body and the like, constructing a water body region data set, (2) embedding Coordinate Attention (CA) in a U-Net semantic segmentation network, (3) constructing an attention-enhancing water body region segmentation network, training on the data set and evaluating a model by MIoU, MPA, recall and Precision, (4) verifying the Sentinel-2 multi-complex scene image by adopting a U-Net+CA model, and obtaining a water body region segmentation result. The invention can obviously improve the recognition precision of the water body region in the small water body region and the complex background, has smoother boundary and stronger robustness to cloud and shadow, and is suitable for monitoring flood disasters and managing water resources.

title_en: Mountain area river basin flood real-time forecasting and urban risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for forecasting flood in mountain areas and urban risks in real time, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting historical hydrologic data of a river basin where a target mountain area along a river city is located and inputting the historical hydrologic data into a distributed hydrologic model for initial flood forecasting; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time hydrologic data, enabling the real-time hydrologic data to serve as input features of a deep learning model, carrying out error correction on the real-time hydrologic data, constructing a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model by utilizing the real-time hydrologic data after error correction, carrying out flood evolution and flooding simulation, outputting dynamic flood flooding information, constructing a dynamic risk assessment system of flood disasters according to the dynamic flood flooding information, carrying out comprehensive risk calculation, calculating risk grades by utilizing the real-time hydrologic data, and realizing dynamic grade assessment of flood disasters. The invention can improve the forecasting precision and real-time performance in the flood early warning, carry out the submerged simulation more finely, enhance the risk assessment real-time performance and have the dynamic characteristic.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation path optimization method and device under flood scene and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an evacuation path optimization method and device in a flood scene and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining building space parameters of a target building, carrying out hydrodynamic simulation on a preset flood scene based on the building space parameters to obtain flood data, collecting spatial position distribution information of objects to be evacuated in the space of the target building, constructing a point queue prediction model based on the spatial position distribution information and the objects to be evacuated, constructing a prediction control optimization model aiming at the target building in the flood scene based on the flood data, the spatial position distribution information, the point queue prediction model and a preset MPC model prediction control frame, and obtaining evacuation prediction control optimization results of the target building in the flood scene through the prediction control optimization model and an interior point method-based mixed solution frame optimized by using a speed pause particle swarm algorithm, wherein the evacuation prediction control optimization results are based on the evacuation prediction control optimization results and the evacuation indication information is sent to the objects to be evacuated.

title_en: Half-arc type hole sweeping device for zero-degree dip angle blasting holes in high-stress coal seam environment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of coal mining and blasting, in particular to a half-arc type hole sweeping device for a zero-degree dip angle blasting hole in a high-stress coal seam environment, which comprises a holding pipe, wherein the rear end of the holding pipe is fixedly connected with a stud, the outer wall of the stud is in threaded connection with a threaded pipe I, the rear end of the threaded pipe I is fixedly connected with a cylinder body, the inner wall of the cylinder body is attached with a connecting column, a guide mechanism and an elastic piece are respectively arranged between the connecting column and the cylinder body, the rear end of the connecting column is fixedly connected with a sector plate, the edge of the upper part of the outer wall of the sector plate is attached with an arc shell, and a fixing mechanism is arranged between the arc shell and the sector plate. The device can scrape off the coal rock fragments of the upper half circumference of the drill hole, scrape off the coal rock fragments of the lower half circumference of the drill hole from the drill hole, has better cleaning and dredging effects and simple operation, and reduces the problems that the explosive charge is not in place in the later stage, the explosion engineering is towed, the labor is wasted, the disaster management engineering difficulty is increased and the like.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHENGTONG COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Storm weather forecast system and method based on majority mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm weather forecasting system and method based on a majority mode, and aims to solve the problems that the existing storm weather forecasting is low in accuracy and lacks of multi-mode integration and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a model training module, a storm typing module, a north-south wind index calculation module and a prediction output module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring various numerical weather forecast mode data and historical observation data, the data processing module is used for interpolation, time sequence matching and correlation analysis, the model training module is used for training a neural network model based on the historical data to generate an intelligent multi-mode storm forecast model, the storm typing module is used for typing a storm process according to high altitude and ground system configuration, the north-south wind index calculation module is used for determining storm falling area probability, and the forecast output module is used for outputting storm falling area probability distribution. The accuracy and the reliability of storm prediction are obviously improved through multi-source data fusion, intelligent model training and refined parting analysis, and powerful support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.
assignees: METEOROLOGICAL BUREAU OF TONGREN CITY GUIZHOU PROVINCE

title_en: Control method and system of fire-fighting training rope climbing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a fire-fighting training rope climbing machine, which are characterized in that action parameters are defined according to abnormal action difference and training time of a firefighter, action levels are defined according to the action levels corresponding to a plurality of detection intervals, an action level set is constructed according to the action levels corresponding to the detection intervals, subsequent training levels of the firefighter relative to the fire-fighting training rope climbing machine are defined according to the action level set and the training levels of the fire-fighting training rope climbing machine, so that subsequent training of the firefighter is conveniently and properly regulated, the action level set and the training levels of the fire-fighting training rope climbing machine are fully considered, suitability of the firefighter in subsequent training is guaranteed, meanwhile, corresponding guiding videos are matched according to the subsequent training levels of the firefighter relative to the fire-fighting training rope climbing machine, action optimization information is presented according to the guiding videos and the corresponding detection intervals, and training actions of the firefighter are conveniently and timely controlled, and training actions of the firefighter are optimized in subsequent training.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM

title_en: Ocean disaster risk photo identification method based on deep artificial neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine disaster risk photo identification method based on a deep artificial neural network, and belongs to the technical field of photo data intelligent processing. The method comprises the steps of determining a disaster-bearing body land block through remote sensing images and shooting at multiple angles to obtain a ground collected photo data set, constructing a marine disaster risk photo sample library through visual interpretation and inspection of tag consistency and marking of tag land objects, constructing a scene classification model based on a transducer framework and a target detection model based on a self-attention mechanism, training a model through the sample library, processing the sample library through momentum contrast learning and ConvNeXt model, constructing a marine disaster risk knowledge graph, integrating the trained model and the knowledge graph to form a complete identification model, and inputting unclassified block image spots into the model to complete automatic identification. The invention is mainly used for automatically identifying the high-risk disaster-bearing body photos of the marine disasters in coastal areas.
assignees: GUANGDONG INST OF LAND AND RESOURCES SURVEYING AND MAPPING

title_en: Urban flood simulation and safety assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood simulation and safety assessment method, and belongs to the technical field of hydrologic data processing and flood previewing. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting DEM data in a range to be processed, projecting and filling depressions through ArcGIS software, calculating flow direction and flow rate, extracting river network, constructing a water collecting area and a rainfall flood model, then carrying out rainfall simulation and one-dimensional hydrodynamic calculation through SWMM software to obtain time sequence flow rate of river channels and nodes, then inputting the flow rate data into HEC-RAS software, completing two-dimensional hydrodynamic simulation through combining terrains to obtain flood submerging range and depth, and finally repeatedly simulating rainfall in different reproduction periods, and dividing the flood risk area according to indexes such as a water depth threshold value, a submerging area and the like. The invention realizes the full-flow automatic processing of rainfall input to flood evolution, improves the timeliness and precision of flood previewing, and provides support for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Tunnel disaster identification method and system based on geological inference process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel disaster judging and identifying method and system based on geological deducing process, relating to the disaster judging and identifying technical field, the invention sets a tunnel monitoring area, installs geological detection equipment around the tunnel monitoring area, sets the acquisition period of the geological detection equipment, acquires the historical geological data around the tunnel monitoring area based on the set acquisition period, after the acquisition is completed, the historical geological data around the tunnel monitoring area is processed in a data processing mode, a tunnel disaster simulation model is built in a data simulation mode based on the processed historical geological data after the processing is completed, finally the geological data around the tunnel monitoring area is acquired in real time, and the tunnel disaster judgment is carried out on the tunnel monitoring area through a time sequence prediction algorithm based on the built tunnel disaster simulation model, so that the real-time performance of the tunnel disaster judgment is improved.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating vulnerability of electric pole under fluid geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of an electric pole under a fluid geological disaster, and relates to the technical field of disaster evaluation. The method comprises the steps of defining a fluid geological disaster load physical calculation model, describing a disaster body dynamics evolution process, constructing an electric pole-soil system coupling finite element model, simulating a real nonlinear dumping process through contact pairs, determining soil constitutive characteristics and random variables and obtaining calibration data, performing parameterized quasi-static dumping analysis based on the model, determining critical dumping loads of different soil parameter combinations through combining failure criteria, constructing an agent model through a response surface method, calculating electric pole failure probabilities under different disaster intensities through probability sampling, and generating a vulnerability curve. According to the invention, the rock-soil-structure coupling effect is considered, the load calculation and vulnerability assessment precision is improved, the accurate technical support can be provided for disaster resistance design and disaster risk prevention and control of the electric pole, and the method has important engineering application value.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Storm surge disaster key defense area selection method and system based on quantitive method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for selecting and dividing a storm surge disaster important defense area based on a fractional method, which relate to the technical field of disaster management and comprise the steps of aiming at a global area to be managed, carrying out multi-scale simulation based on atmospheric circulation, near-shore hydrodynamic force, regional inundation and building damage, and constructing a multi-scale nested twin model; constructing a quantile curved surface based on quantile dimension, constructing a simulated divider by using the multi-scale nested twin model and the quantile curved surface, carrying out double-pass simulation deduction and quantile decision on a source data set from a multi-monitoring source end, determining a defending area, carrying out visualization on the defending area on a terminal interface, and carrying out disaster prevention and control early warning management, so as to solve the technical problems that an intelligent and flexible disaster deduction decision system is lacking in the prior art, solve the problem that the selecting and dividing precision of the defending area is limited, and cause poor emergency response capability of disaster prevention and control, and effectively improve the selecting and dividing precision of the defending area.
assignees: SHANDONG MARINE FORECAST AND HAZARD MITIGATION CENTER;SHANDONG WUNIU TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir emergency prediction and management method and system based on cloud data and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a reservoir emergency prediction and management method, a system and electronic equipment based on cloud data, which are used for solving the problem that reservoir emergency prediction precision is reduced due to insufficient generalization capability of a prediction model in the traditional method when complex environments and extreme events are processed; according to the invention, firstly, multisource data such as weather, hydrology, remote sensing, historical disasters, geology and the like are acquired through a cloud data access gateway, space-time grids and time granularity are unified, a complex environment feature subset and an extreme event index subset are constructed, an environment variation mode is mined, an extreme sample is enhanced, an extended training set is formed, layered verification is carried out, a deviation mode knowledge base is extracted and coupled with prediction logic, self-adaptive correction and risk deduction are carried out on real-time data, and instructions such as flood discharge scheduling, reservoir capacity control, personnel transfer, material transfer and the like are automatically generated and issued in a multi-channel mode, so that prediction precision and emergency decision reliability under complex environment and extreme event conditions are improved.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;HENAN CHENGTOU PROJECT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for comprehensively evaluating debris flow prevention and control based on toughness disaster reduction
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of toughness disaster reduction, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for comprehensively evaluating debris flow prevention and control based on toughness disaster reduction. The evaluation method comprises the steps of obtaining historical core element data, determining element weights by an entropy method, calculating contribution degrees of elements to toughness disaster reduction under different dimensions, weighting and averaging to obtain disaster reduction toughness, distinguishing first element data directly related to the disaster reduction toughness and second element data indirectly related to the disaster reduction toughness according to the contribution degrees, associating the first element data pairwise to generate third element data, and finally constructing a structural equation model, and generating a prevention and control comprehensive evaluation model for preset area evaluation by utilizing the data and disaster reduction toughness training. The method has the advantages that the weight is objectively distributed through the entropy method, subjective deviation is avoided, multidimensional factors and association thereof are comprehensively considered, disaster reduction toughness is accurately quantized, the built model can systematically evaluate the prevention and control conditions of a preset area, scientific basis is provided for debris flow prevention and control, and the rationality and effectiveness of prevention and control decisions are improved.

title_en: Control method and system of fireman stair climbing training machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a system for a firefighter stair climbing training machine, which are used for switching training scenes of the firefighter stair climbing training machine based on a to-be-trained program and matching corresponding training programs, so that the training programs are updated for the firefighter stair climbing training machine, the to-be-trained program of the firefighter is adapted, in addition, the training states of the firefighter are defined based on a plurality of training parameters, training abnormal factors of the firefighter are defined according to the training states of the firefighter and the training scenes presented by the firefighter stair climbing training machine, and the dynamic regulation and control of the firefighter stair climbing training machine are triggered according to the training abnormal factors of the firefighter, so that the firefighter is in a dynamic balance relation with the firefighter stair climbing training machine in the training process, the matching of the firefighter in the firefighter stair climbing training machine is guaranteed, the safety of the firefighter in a high-strength training process is improved, and the training balance relation between the firefighter and the firefighter stair climbing training machine in the training process is guaranteed.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM

title_en: Power system vulnerability assessment method and system considering extreme weather influence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system evaluation, and discloses a method and a system for evaluating vulnerability of a power system in consideration of extreme weather influence, wherein a line time-varying fault probability under the dynamic weather influence is determined by constructing a line fault probability model of the power system under the extreme weather, and an countermeasure network model and a Monte Carlo simulation generation typical scene are generated through time sequence relativity matching with gradient penalty; the method comprises the steps of taking a generated typical scene as input, simulating cascade fault evolution through an alternating current cascade fault model, and outputting a cascade fault evolution path, and further realizing multi-level vulnerability quantification of the power system by combining severity analysis, structural vulnerability assessment and causal-probability prejudgment through a spectrogram theory and a Bayesian network based on a fault evolution result, solving the problems of insufficient single-level assessment and neglecting causal association in the prior art, and improving the risk assessment precision and disaster prevention capability of the power system under extreme weather.
assignees: STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LIMITED;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Fire extinguishing performance testing device for fire extinguishing system of electric vehicle shed and operation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire extinguishing performance testing device of an electric car shed fire extinguishing system and an operation method, wherein the fire extinguishing performance testing device comprises a combustion chamber for testing, an electric car shed simulation device, a ventilation device, a heating device, a fire extinguishing device, a data acquisition system and a video recording system are arranged in the combustion chamber, at least three electric car models are arranged in the electric car shed simulation device, a lithium battery pack is arranged in the electric car models, and the lithium battery pack is connected with the heating device positioned outside the combustion chamber through a wire. The device can truly reproduce the spraying fire, re-burning and spreading process in the lithium battery fire disaster, has the adapting capability of a plurality of fire extinguishing systems such as total flooding, local application and the like, can simulate the fire extinguishing effect under the ventilation condition of a semi-open shed, is suitable for multi-dimensional evaluation of fire extinguishing performance, and comprises safety factors such as temperature change, a flame spreading path, the ignition risk of adjacent vehicles and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHIP ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RESEARCH INST CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION NO 726 RESEARC

title_en: Mountain area low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle anti-interference navigation method based on Beidou and visual SLAM fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a mountain area low-altitude logistics unmanned aerial vehicle anti-interference navigation method based on Beidou and visual SLAM fusion, and relates to the technical field of low-altitude logistics. The method comprises the steps of S1 collecting flight control data and navigation data and preprocessing, S2 training an LSTM model and deploying, outputting the probability of emergency response of 50ms in the future and a bandwidth preemption time window, S3 triggering the pre-caching of the navigation data according to a prediction result, S4 constructing a linear extrapolation prediction model, generating a predicted value of the navigation data when the current is cut off, S5 using measured data when the current is not cut off, and using a continuous sequence formed by the measured data and the predicted data to conduct fusion navigation switching decision when the current is cut off. The invention can accurately pre-judge the emergency response of the flight control and the bandwidth preemption period, efficiently complement the cutoff data, improve the anti-interference capability and the positioning stability of the navigation system, and ensure that the unmanned aerial vehicle safely and efficiently completes the logistics transportation task in the complex environment of the mountain area.
assignees: YUKUAICHUANGLING INTELLIGENT TECH NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster and fire extinguishing simulation system and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire disaster and fire extinguishing simulation system and a simulation method. The fire disaster and fire extinguishing simulation system comprises a combustion chamber, a combustion simulation module and a control system, wherein the combustion chamber is provided with a closed cavity, the combustion simulation module comprises a plurality of combustion parts and a plurality of gas supply pipelines for supplying combustible gas, the combustion parts are arranged in one-to-one correspondence with the gas supply pipelines, the combustion parts can ignite the combustible gas supplied by the corresponding gas supply pipelines and form flames, each gas supply pipeline is provided with a first flow regulating valve, each first flow regulating valve can control the on-off state between the corresponding gas supply pipeline and the corresponding gas supply pipeline, the combustion parts are all arranged in the cavity and are distributed in rows and columns, and the control system is in communication connection with the first flow regulating valves. The technical scheme of the invention can solve the problem that the existing fire simulation system is difficult to truly reproduce the complex fire scene in the limited space.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Building damage detection method, system, medium and product
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system, a medium and a product for detecting building damage. In the method, a detection system firstly establishes a first three-dimensional digital structure body by combining the last measured first deformation data based on a design drawing of a building to be detected and building material information, and ensures that the first three-dimensional digital structure body can accurately reflect the real state of the building before disaster. The detection system acquires the second deformation data after the disaster to generate a second three-dimensional digital structure body, so that the digital correspondence of the disaster pre-disaster state and the disaster post state is realized. And then, the detection system compares the two structures to obtain a difference part and a difference value, and repeatedly simulates the damage position and the damage degree in the first structure according to the difference part and the difference value until the coordinate difference of the two structures reaches a preset threshold value. The method avoids the problems that the traditional discrete detection only depends on limited measuring points and is easy to miss diffuse damage, can fully cover the potential damaged area of the building, and improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the post-disaster building damage detection.
assignees: CHENGDU ACADEMY OF BUILDING RES ENGINEERING QUALITY INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Power supply capacity improving method and system for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply of a power distribution network, and discloses a power supply capacity improving method and a power distribution network power supply capacity improving system, wherein a basic network containing multi-source resources is firstly built by relying on topology data of the power distribution network, and a multi-constraint multi-period optimal scheduling model is built with the aim of minimum loss of load loss; and then realizing topology dynamic reconstruction by a Big-M method, introducing a dynamic shortest path algorithm to acquire a mobile energy storage optimal migration path, establishing virtual power flow consistency constraint, forming a post-disaster power supply capacity optimizing and scheduling model, then adopting a mixed integer second order cone planning and solving mode to solve the post-disaster power supply capacity optimizing and scheduling model under a rolling period frame, dynamically updating a traffic and node state parameter solving model, generating a multi-source collaborative scheduling scheme, and finally applying the scheme to disaster scenes to carry out simulation verification. The method and the system realize the coordination of mobile energy storage and topology reconstruction, and improve the key load recovery rate and the system power supply toughness.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Space-time hybrid early warning system capable of accurately predicting mountain torrent mud-rock flow in small river basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time mixing early warning system capable of accurately predicting mountain torrent mud-rock flow in a small river basin, and aims to solve the problems of time lag, insufficient precision, insufficient coverage and failure notification under the condition of three-break of the existing early warning system. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a disaster mechanism analysis and model construction module, a storm mountain and flood hydrodynamic model module, a PINNs precision lifting module, a critical rainfall calculation module, a refined early warning system module and a system module for shouting and waking up a response. And driving SAWT a model and a space-time variable source mixed runoff model through multi-source precipitation data, simulating flood evolution by combining a two-dimensional shallow water dynamics equation, calculating critical rainfall by utilizing PINNs fusion physical rule and AI optimization convergence and a distance weighted inverse proportion method, and finally realizing the whole process accurate simulation of the small-river basin mountain torrent, thereby providing intelligent support for the control of the small-river basin mountain torrent.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGCHUANG XINGWU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scene generation method and system
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a scene generating method and system, in a virtual reality model of a target three-dimensional space, in response to a user's demarcation instruction for a fire region within the target three-dimensional space, generating a target scene range (a stereoscopic region range for defining a fire spreading boundary), determining a position parameter of a fire occurrence, a fire intensity parameter, and a demonstration parameter of a firefighter model based on user's interactive operation, to generate a target firefighting demonstration animation scene (a firefighting simulation scene interactively operable in the virtual reality model of the target three-dimensional space, for driving rendering of a fire to dynamically spread within the target scene range and in response to a user's firefighting interactive instruction). Therefore, the simulation of the fire-fighting safety education scene with immersive and interactive experience is realized, and the fire-fighting safety education effect is improved.

title_en: Quasi-static load loading device with condensed explosive as explosion source
abstract_en: The utility model provides a quasi-static load loading device taking a condensed explosive as an explosion source, which converts shock wave load generated by the condensed explosive explosion into quasi-static load by adopting the condensed explosive as the explosion source and combining with the structural design of a porous plate, effectively simulates the load characteristic of combustible gas explosion, can utilize a solid explosive to simulate the load action form of the gas explosion, obviously reduces the experiment difficulty of the gas explosion, provides an experiment detection platform for the structural failure effect under the action of the gas explosion load, obviously improves the explosion overpressure on the basis of ensuring the quasi-static loading, and solves the problems of excessively small explosion overpressure and incapacity of the structure in the original gas explosion experiment. Meanwhile, the homogeneous fine sand layer can be used for absorbing shock wave load transmitted by holes in the porous plate, so that the quasi-static load loading effect of the lower part of the porous plate is guaranteed, the pressure sensor can be protected, and an efficient and reliable experimental means is provided for explosion disaster protection research.

title_en: Seepage internal erosion evolution experimental equipment capable of controlling position height of seepage outlet
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geotechnical engineering, in particular to seepage internal erosion evolution experimental equipment with controllable seepage outlet position height, which comprises a box body, a water storage box, a partition board, a seepage inlet, a soil box, a seepage outlet and a collecting box, wherein the inner cavity of the box body is divided into the water storage box and the soil box through the partition board, the seepage inlet is arranged in the middle of the partition board, a plurality of seepage outlets are arranged below the right side wall of the soil box at intervals along the vertical direction, the collecting box is arranged below the seepage outlet, the water storage box is supplied with water through an upstream water level control device, the water level in the water storage box and the sand height in the soil box are larger than the height of the seepage inlet, the height of the seepage inlet is larger than the height of the seepage outlet, and plugs are arranged on the seepage inlet and the seepage outlet. The utility model simulates the development process of sand seepage internal erosion and particle migration disasters under laboratory conditions by changing the height of the position of the seepage outlet.

title_en: Geological disaster index model construction device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a geological disaster index model construction device, which relates to the field of geological models and comprises a main board, wherein a fixing frame is arranged on the upper surface of the main board, a mountain simulation board is arranged on the upper surface of the fixing frame through a pin shaft, a soil layer is paved on the upper surface of the mountain simulation board, a pavement simulation layer is paved on the upper surface of the soil layer, a water sprinkling assembly is arranged on the upper surface of the main board, and the water sprinkling assembly is positioned above the mountain simulation board. This geological disaster index model construction device through the mountain body simulation board that is equipped with in the device, under the cooperation of soil layer and road surface simulation layer, can carry out the simulation of mountain body landslide to obtain the various indexes of geological disaster, and at the in-process of simulation, promote the kicking block through two first electric putter of installation and control and remove, and under a plurality of backup pads supporting effect, can adjust the inclination of mountain body simulation board, thereby can simulate the landslide condition of different slope mountain bodies.
assignees: HENAN URBAN AND RURAL PLANNING DESIGN RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: System and method for establishing disaster recovery plan based on digital twin using disaster resilience index evaluation
title_ko: 재난회복력 지표 평가를 이용한 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 디지털 트윈 기반 재해 복구 계획 수립 시스템은 재난 피해 지역의 위치 정보와 피해 현황을 포함하는 피해 정보를 입력받아 상기 피해 지역의 3차원 디지털 트윈 모델을 생성하는 디지털 트윈 생성부; 상기 디지털 트윈 모델로부터 피해 시설물의 물리적 제약 조건을 추출하고, 복구 공법 데이터베이스를 조회하여 적용 가능한 복수의 복구 공법을 자동으로 추출하며, 각 복구 공법을 적용한 복수의 복구 시나리오를 자동으로 생성하는 시나리오 생성부; 상기 복수의 복구 시나리오 각각에 대하여, 재난 저항성, 복구 속도, 탄력성 및 유지보수 용이성을 포함하는 재난회복력 지표와, 안정성, 경제성, 시공성을 포함하는 일반 평가 지표를 이용하여 정량적 평가를 수행하는 시나리오 평가부; 및 상기 평가 결과에 기초하여 최적의 복구 시나리오를 추천하는 추천부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire smoke analysis control strategy system applied to urban subway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban rail transit fire safety, in particular to a fire smoke analysis control strategy system applied to urban subway tunnels, which is used for rapidly positioning a fire source through sensor data and estimating initial power, then respectively calculating required critical wind speeds for two core strategies of upstream ventilation and downstream ventilation in parallel, taking the critical wind speeds as target ventilation parameters, driving a fire dynamic prediction model, and prospectively simulating the spatial-temporal distribution of temperature and smoke concentration in the tunnels under the two strategies. And finally, calculating the heat exposure and smoke exposure risk possibly born by the personnel on each corresponding evacuation path through quantifying the safety risk integral, and automatically selecting and executing the optimal strategy with the lowest overall safety risk. The ventilation control and the personnel evacuation safety are deeply coupled, the ventilation decision taking the safety of the evacuation path as a core target is realized on the system level, and the secondary risk that the ventilation force drives the smoke to the evacuated crowd is effectively avoided.
assignees: POWERCHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION INVEST GROUP CO LTD;SINOHYDRO BUREAU 7 CO LTD;POWERCHINA RAILWAY CONSTRUCTION INVEST GROUP CHONGQING CO LTD

title_en: Thermal coupling response analysis method and system for concrete structure fiber unit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal coupling response analysis method and a thermal coupling response analysis system for a fiber unit of a concrete structure. The method comprises the steps of firstly establishing a fiber unit numerical model of a concrete structure according to a required analysis structure, secondly establishing a concrete section heat transfer analysis object, calculating and outputting section temperature field data based on the concrete section heat transfer analysis object, then carrying out stress or disaster working condition simulation treatment on the fiber unit numerical model of the concrete structure to obtain a treated fiber unit numerical model, finally reading and mapping the section temperature field data to the treated fiber unit numerical model, carrying out coupling calculation of a temperature field and a mechanical field, and obtaining and outputting a thermal coupling response analysis result of the concrete structure. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of both precision and efficiency.

title_en: Landslide susceptibility evaluation method based on optimized non-landslide data selection and SHAP value
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control engineering, in particular to a landslide vulnerability assessment method based on optimized non-landslide data selection and SHAP values, which comprises the steps of firstly selecting corresponding environmental factors according to geological characteristics of a research area, calculating values of the factors by adopting frequency ratios, screening landslide negative samples by Acrmap10.8 software, constructing Random, buffer, IV-Buffer three sample data sets, obtaining the sample data sets, realizing LR, SVM, DT and XGBoost classification models based on python, carrying out vulnerability assessment analysis on the area, simulating the three data sets in the assessment analysis, and judging model performance by utilizing ROC curves and four performance indexes; and selecting an optimal model in the four machine learning models to conduct the vulnerability mapping, classifying the optimal model into 5 types of vulnerability grades, comparing the advantages and disadvantages of various models, quantifying the importance of influence factors by adopting a SHAP method, and revealing the contribution mechanism of each factor to landslide occurrence through a dependency graph and a bias dependency graph.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;NANNING GUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster coupling risk early warning method and system for power grid
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-disaster coupling risk early warning method and system for a power grid, and relates to the technical field of safety protection of power systems; based on full-dimensional power grid environment situation awareness data, dense ground empty data points positioned at the tower foundation coordinates of a power pole tower, the outline vertexes of substation equipment and the joint positions of underground cables are extracted in a main area of a power grid corridor to form a near-field coupling base area of a high-dimensional space of a risk perception triangular pyramid, and sparse high-altitude data points positioned at the ground penetration points in hyperspectral satellite image characteristic wave band pixels, laser radar point cloud data and vertical section characteristics in weather radar three-dimensional lattice point data are extracted to form a far-field correlation top area of the high-dimensional space of the risk perception triangular pyramid. The method can realize accurate early warning of the power grid risk through multisource data fusion and disaster chain evolution simulation.
assignees: POWER EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Strip mine slope deformation attribution method for comprehensive space-time factor quantitative evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a strip mine slope deformation attribution method for comprehensive space-time factor quantitative evaluation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a deformation time sequence data set and a deformation space sequence data set of a research mining area, eliminating influence factors from candidate influence factor space-time data sets, performing regression prediction training after time alignment of the influence factors and the deformation time sequence data set, obtaining time sequence scores of the influence factors by means of residual mean square error and SHAP values and weighted fusion, performing space alignment and layering treatment of the deformation space sequence data sets and the candidate influence factor space-time data sets, obtaining space interpretation force q values of the influence factors by means of a geographic detector method, and obtaining comprehensive scores of comprehensive space-time factors by means of weighting treatment of the time sequence scores of the influence factors and the space interpretation force q values. The method can accurately quantify the comprehensive scores and the importance of different influence factors, provides a reliable influence factor attribution evaluation method for slope disaster early warning, and is beneficial to improving the slope deformation prediction precision.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;XINJIANG INST ENG

title_en: Emergency ward manpower equipment overall configuration method based on intelligent simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster medical rescue resource allocation, in particular to an emergency ward manpower equipment overall allocation method based on intelligent simulation, which aims at solving the problems that the existing emergency ward resource allocation depends on static assumption and has poor dynamic adaptability, builds an intelligent interaction model which covers wounded, medical manpower and medical equipment based on AnyLogic multi-intelligent modeling technology, realizes the accurate overall allocation of manpower and equipment resources under different disaster loads through multi-scene simulation and data iterative optimization, comprises four core steps of wounded intelligent attribute modeling, modularized ward structural design, multi-scene simulation verification and optimal allocation scheme output, and can clearly determine the optimal medical condition proportion and layered equipment allocation standard of light, medium and heavy wounded ward, obviously improve the utilization efficiency and the response speed of emergency rescue resources, and provide scientific and quantized resource allocation basis for disaster medical rescue.
assignees: The Third Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: OLED lighting rate prediction method based on improved transfer learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of OLEDs, in particular to an OLED lighting rate prediction method based on improved transfer learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining an OLED image, establishing a moisture absorbent micro-nano structure image, a source domain set and a target domain set corresponding to the OLED lighting rate, inputting the source domain set into a standard VGG16 network, training weight parameters by using the standard VGG16 network, transferring the training weight parameters into a VGG16 network embedded with self-attention, calculating the average attention intensity of each convolution block, comparing the average attention intensity with a thawing threshold, and determining whether to freeze the weight parameters of the corresponding convolution blocks. The method solves the problems of unstable training, insufficient cross-domain alignment, slow model convergence and forgetting disaster existing in the conventional migration learning strategy.

title_en: Method, system and equipment for extracting road topology structure of remote sensing image through multitasking cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, in particular to a method, a system and equipment for extracting a road topological structure of a multi-task collaborative remote sensing image, which comprise the steps of data preparation, model training and road extraction, wherein a multi-task collaborative mechanism is introduced to fuse segmentation tasks with topology modeling tasks, and the process from feature extraction, key point detection and dynamic prompt generation to topology restoration forming end-to-end collaborative optimization is realized, so that unified modeling of road mask segmentation and topology structure reconstruction is realized, the topology connectivity and structural consistency of a road network are obviously improved while high segmentation precision is maintained, and the method has the advantages of clear structure, high calculation efficiency, strong generalization capability and the like, and can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent traffic, urban planning, disaster emergency, map automatic drawing and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster intelligent prediction method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent geological disaster prediction method based on multi-source data fusion, which aims to realize high-precision vulnerability prediction of geological disasters such as landslide and the like by integrating multi-source geospatial data and combining a random forest and deep neural network (RF-DNN) model. The method comprises the steps of data acquisition and preprocessing, disaster causing factor extraction and screening, feature fusion and enhancement, deep neural network modeling and training, prediction result visualization and the like, and shows excellent prediction performance in an application example of Zangchang city left tribute county (the geographic coordinates are east longitude 97 degrees 06-98 degrees 36', north latitude 28 degrees 30-30 degrees 28'), AUC value is up to 0.9012, accuracy rate is up to 0.8277, and scientific basis and technical support are provided for prevention and management of geological disasters.
assignees: GUANGDONG CHINA COAL GEOLOGICAL ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning, which is oriented to a complex environment with dynamic tasks and space risk constraints. The method constructs a layered collaborative decision framework, and performs decoupling modeling on system-level task scheduling and individual-level continuous control, namely, a graph structure and an attention mechanism are introduced into a scheduling layer, global optimal allocation of multiple unmanned planes and multiple tasks is realized, continuous control actions are generated by adopting a deep reinforcement learning strategy based on local observation at a control layer, and the scheduling and execution collaborative property is improved through joint training. The method can remarkably improve the task completion rate and the emergency response efficiency, optimize the energy utilization, reduce the system vibration, and is suitable for the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative operation scene such as disaster monitoring, emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Modularized electric control box with multi-loop intelligent monitoring function
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electrical control and discloses a modularized electrical control box with a multi-loop intelligent monitoring function, which comprises a box body, a gas monitoring device, a concentration monitor and an electrical loop, wherein the box body is used as a basic component of an integral device and is used for bearing and assembling each processing mechanism and a subordinate structural member of each processing mechanism, the gas monitoring device is arranged in the box body and is used for monitoring gas in the box body in real time, the concentration monitor is communicated with the gas monitoring device through a self-cleaning structure and is used for monitoring the gas concentration in the box body in real time, the electrical loop is arranged in the box body and is used for supplying power for a load, and an internal integrated monitoring unit of the electrical loop is used for collecting key electrical parameters of each loop in real time. The monitoring unit comprises a high-speed synchronous data acquisition module which is used for acquiring and reconstructing the electrical parameters of each independent electrical loop in parallel. And (3) simulating a future multiple probabilistic evolution path of the system by constructing a random power system model and applying a path integral control theory, and calculating a risk spectrum evolving to a disaster state and an optimal intervention strategy.
assignees: JIANGSU MAIRUIFU ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ecological protection construction method for high-fill slope
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method for ecological protection of a high-fill slope, and relates to the technical field of slope protection engineering. The construction method comprises the following implementation steps of step 1, preprocessing a side slope, firstly shaping and trimming a high-filling side slope, cleaning surface layer floating soil, broken stone and weed, synchronously presetting a through drainage system at the top, the waist and the foot of the side slope, step 2, constructing a composite support system, and laying anchor rods, grouting and fixing the anchors, a lattice Liang Jiaozhu and a geogrid, drilling holes on the trimmed side slope surface, laying the anchor rods, casting to form a lattice beam fixedly connected with the anchor rods, and then laying the geogrid in the coverage area of the lattice beam and completing double fixation. The invention enhances the anti-slip stability of the slope body, the geogrid can disperse the load of the slope body, improves the shear strength of the soil body on the surface layer of the slope, remarkably improves the overall stability of the high-filling slope, and effectively prevents the occurrence of geological disasters such as landslide, collapse and the like of the slope.

title_en: Urban hydrologic situation awareness and identification method, system and readable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city-oriented hydrologic situation awareness and identification method, a system and a readable medium, which comprise the steps of constructing a city hydrologic emergency knowledge system, including the construction of a city hydrologic emergency plan library, a city hydrologic event library and a city hydrologic simulation model library, analyzing natural language inquiry input by a user, searching and fusing the city hydrologic emergency plan library and the city hydrologic event library based on the city hydrologic emergency plan library to construct a specific hydrologic event scene knowledge sub-library, carrying out self-adaption matching and simulation on the specific hydrologic event scene knowledge sub-library and the city hydrologic simulation model library, fusing a simulation result and knowledge rules, and generating an early warning rule related to a specific hydrologic event scene. The invention realizes the unification of hydrologic situation dynamic sensing and accurate identification, improves the timeliness of emergency response, and can provide scientific and intelligent support for urban hydrologic disaster management decision. The invention is supported by the state important research and development subject complex space scene situation identification and virtual-real mutual feedback (2022 YFB 3904104).

title_en: Construction intelligent management control platform and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction intelligent management control platform and a construction intelligent management control method, wherein the construction intelligent management control platform comprises an emergency response simulation module, an AI decision support module, a cost optimization maintenance module, an environment adaptation protection module, a data transmission module, a risk assessment module and an alarm processing module, wherein the emergency response simulation module is used for simulating a plurality of emergency scenes of a construction site, performing exercise through a virtual reality technology, supporting multi-user collaborative participation, and recording exercise data to optimize an actual response strategy, the AI decision support module is used for analyzing real-time data based on a machine learning algorithm to generate intelligent decision suggestions, including risk priority ordering and automatic response path recommendation.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 23 BUREAU GROUP NO 3 ENG CO LTD

title_en: Cable pit earthquake collapse simulation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable trench earthquake collapse simulation system, which belongs to the technical field of disaster simulation and comprises a demonstration device and a power device, wherein the demonstration device is connected with the power device, the power device can drive the demonstration device to move, the demonstration device comprises a fixed support and at least two movable plates, the fixed support is connected with the movable plates through hinges, the power device comprises an upper push rod assembly and a lower push rod assembly, the upper push rod assembly and the lower push rod assembly are respectively connected with different movable plates, and the upper push rod assembly and the lower push rod assembly can drive the different movable plates to move. According to the utility model, the movable plate and the fixed support are connected through the hinge, the fixed support provides rigid support for the whole body, and the movable plate can move in multiple angles and multiple directions under the constraint of the fixed support, so that the collapse process of the cable trench is simulated more truly. The flexibility of plate movement can be ensured through hinge connection, and the safety and controllability of the system are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG NIKOLA ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a geological disaster monitoring and early warning device which comprises a drill bit, a mounting barrel, a mounting plate and a drilling barrel, wherein a first helical blade is arranged on the outer side of the drill bit, N groups of tension and pressure monitoring mechanisms and a corrugated pipe are arranged between the bottom of the mounting barrel and the drill bit, a solar panel is arranged at the top end of the mounting barrel, an inclination sensor, a microprocessor, a rechargeable battery and a wireless communication module are arranged on the front surface of the mounting plate, the drilling barrel is in threaded connection with the outer side of the mounting barrel, and a second helical blade is arranged on the outer side of the drilling barrel. The drilling machine has the beneficial effects that the drilling machine is directly screwed into the mountain body by utilizing the matching of the drill bit and the drilling barrel, so that a worker is not required to transport the drilling equipment to the mountain for drilling, the hole is not required to be backfilled with soil, the device is convenient to install, and the labor capacity of the worker for transporting the drilling equipment is reduced.

title_en: Multipurpose training frame
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multipurpose training frame, and belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting training equipment. The training frame solves the defects that the traditional training frame in the prior art has single function and cannot be suitable for various log sizes. Its major structure includes the frame, and the frame upper end is provided with first roof and second roof, and the side of first roof passes through the hinge to be connected with a side of frame is articulated, and the side of second roof passes through the hinge to be connected with another side of frame, and cutting fixed establishment who is used for practicing cutting technique is installed to first roof upper end, and the minor diameter fixed establishment who is used for practicing motor chain saw fast cutting technique is installed to second roof upper end, and the centre of frame is provided with the transverse fixed establishment who is used for the firefighter to use motor chain saw transverse cutting log exercise, and the below of frame is provided with the longitudinal fixed establishment who is used for the firefighter to use motor chain saw longitudinal cutting log exercise. The utility model is mainly used for training firefighters by using a motor chain saw.

title_en: Rock burst risk grading prediction method based on improved LSTM neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst risk grading prediction method based on an improved LSTM neural network, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting rock burst influence factor data, S2, preprocessing the rock burst influence factor data, S3, constructing an improved LSTM, residual connection and SVR collaborative fusion neural network model, S4, model training and super-parameter optimization, S5, carrying out double-label coding on rock burst risk grades, S6, evaluating and optimizing model performance, and S7, and applying the rock burst risk grading prediction. The invention can realize accurate, efficient and dynamic grading prediction of the rock burst risk, is suitable for grading prediction of the rock burst risk of deep underground projects such as tunnels, pits, underground workshops and the like, can provide accurate technical support for construction safety decision-making and protective measure formulation, and effectively reduces casualties and property loss caused by rock burst disasters.

title_en: Dam blocking and dam bursting disaster chain prediction method and system based on landslide river blocking form
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam break disaster chain prediction method based on landslide river blocking, which comprises the steps of analyzing the surface deformation of the whole area to be predicted in a set time period, performing geocoding on deformation monitoring results to obtain a time sequence deformation map, finding out disaster points with landslide hidden danger according to the time sequence deformation map, obtaining and processing landslide data with the disaster points with the landslide hidden danger to obtain a landslide key parameter table and related engineering charts, calculating stability calculation results according to the landslide data, constructing landslide deformation scenes, calculating the river blocking height of a dam, forming the dam according to the landslide river blocking, performing two-dimensional simulation of flood evolution, and performing disaster evaluation and analysis before and after the flood break according to the flood evolution results to obtain analysis and evaluation results. The method can not only realize dynamic prediction of the dam break to the whole link of the disaster chain, but also accurately invert the dynamic process of the disaster chain, provide scientific and comprehensive basis for disaster prevention and reduction decisions, and furthest reduce disaster loss.

title_en: Nuclear emergency path and opportunity decision method based on reinforcement learning and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a nuclear emergency path and opportunity decision method based on reinforcement learning and deep learning, which comprises the steps of taking minimized exposure dose and evacuation time as targets, adopting a deep reinforcement learning A3C algorithm to make decisions on evacuation of an agent to be evacuated, obtaining a plurality of evacuation paths and corresponding action opportunity schemes as candidate schemes, establishing a training set based on the candidate schemes and decision samples formed by corresponding decision variables and multi-source environment information, training a deep learning model formed by a transducer and a random forest from an environment state tensor to the candidate schemes, outputting priori scores, adopting linear weighting of scoring weights to obtain weighted scores of the candidate schemes, fusing the weighted scores and the priori scores to obtain comprehensive scores, and determining an executable scheme from the candidate schemes based on the comprehensive scores. The invention solves the defects of the prior art in the aspects of self-adaptability, instantaneity and benefit cost analysis capability in nuclear accident emergency decision and path planning.

title_en: Three-river parallel-flow water stir-frying power generation flood control protection method
