abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-river parallel-flow water-frying power generation flood control protection method which comprises the steps of arranging a horizontal tunnel and a water diversion pipe step, comparing a ventilation window with a water pipe V water tank of the water-frying tunnel, changing the section of the tunnel, centrifugally discharging sand of a river channel, discharging sand of a straight-line river channel, arranging a sand-blocking half sluice, comparing the sectional condition of the tunnel, arranging a sand-discharging pump at a water inlet and a floating platform, and arranging a water diversion pipe funnel, a screen and a hexagonal screen. The three gorges can have more time to increase the water level of the reservoir and generate more power, prevent flood by reducing the water level, have the values of flood prevention, namely, the three gorges are attacked to break a dam, the damage of flood to the downstream is reduced, the attacked value of the three gorges is reduced, namely, the risk of attack is reduced, the flood disaster is faced, the flood is prevented by the downstream, the red package can be collected, the water is most suitable for being used as the red package in rainy seasons, and the three gorges are helped to break the dam and exercise controllably.

title_en: Side slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake induction slope disaster early warning. The corresponding method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of seismic records of a side slope and a plurality of first displacements of the side slope corresponding to the plurality of seismic records, carrying out background grid strain on initial object particles of the side slope according to a preset strain softening constitutive model of the side slope to determine final object particles of the side slope, determining a plurality of second displacements of the side slope under different characterization parameters according to the final object particles, and generating a displacement prediction model according to the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements to predict the displacement of the side slope corresponding to the seismic acceleration time course, wherein the displacement prediction model is generated by training the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements based on a deep learning algorithm. The invention can reduce uncertainty of earthquake induced soil slope displacement prediction and improve displacement prediction precision.
assignees: YAJIANG CLEAN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH BEIJING CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Method and system for analyzing icing of power transmission line under micro-topography and micro-meteorological influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an icing analysis method and system for a power transmission line, which relate to the technical field of power transmission line risk prediction and comprise the steps of collecting and fusing original meteorological data of an area where a power transmission line is located, generating micro-meteorological field variables based on topographic parameters extracted by a DEM model, obtaining three-dimensional micro-meteorological field data based on the fused data and the micro-meteorological field variables through a hydrodynamic model, correcting the three-dimensional micro-meteorological field data by using topographic parameters obtained by the DEM model, adjusting by using an exponential weighted moving average method to obtain accurate three-dimensional micro-meteorological field data, obtaining icing thickness by using a physical-empirical mixed icing growth model based on the accurate micro-meteorological field data, and adjusting the output icing thickness in real time by using a dynamic correction algorithm to obtain a final icing simulation result. The method and the system improve the accuracy and the emergency response flexibility of the ice coating disaster prediction of the power transmission line.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV CO;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Mountain slope collapse influence range prediction method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster prediction and prevention and control, in particular to a mountain slope collapse influence range prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining dangerous rock characteristic parameters of a target hidden danger point and three-dimensional terrain data of a corresponding area of the target hidden danger point, inputting the dangerous rock characteristic parameters into a neural network model trained in advance, obtaining a horizontal movement distance predicted value when the target hidden danger point collapses, determining boundary conditions of discrete element simulation based on the horizontal movement distance predicted value when the target hidden danger point collapses, constructing a side slope discrete element model containing a discrete fracture network based on the three-dimensional terrain data, simulating a collapse process by taking the target hidden danger point as a collapse source, obtaining an actual movement track and a final accumulation range of a collapsed body, and carrying out space superposition and fusion analysis on the final accumulation range and the three-dimensional terrain data to generate a three-dimensional collapse influence range map with risk grade attributes. The application provides a direct basis for disaster risk assessment and prevention and control decision.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Goaf collapse evaluation method based on multi-source collaborative calibration
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of goaf geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a goaf collapse evaluation method based on multi-source collaborative calibration, which comprises the steps of obtaining geophysical prospecting data, drilling data and roadway water outlet point data of a mining area to be detected, and carrying out collaborative calibration and cross verification on the geophysical prospecting data, the drilling data and the roadway water outlet point data to obtain static space parameters and hydrogeological parameters of the goaf; the method comprises the steps of inputting static space parameters into a geological background quantization model to obtain geological background indexes, simultaneously, obtaining aging stability coefficients of a mining area to be detected based on hydrogeological parameters, obtaining real-time multi-source dynamic monitoring data of the mining area to be detected, carrying out weighted fusion on the multi-source dynamic monitoring data after normalization to generate dynamic monitoring comprehensive indexes, coupling the geological background comprehensive indexes, the aging stability coefficients and the dynamic monitoring comprehensive indexes to obtain goaf collapse probability, and carrying out grading early warning according to the collapse probability. The application can accurately simulate the collapse risk of the stoping old mining area.
assignees: BEIJING INST OF GEOLOGICAL DISASTER PREVENTION

title_en: Geological disaster full-spectrum remote sensing response simulation method for coupling surface process model and three-dimensional radiation transmission model
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster full-spectrum remote sensing response simulation method for coupling a surface process model and a three-dimensional radiation transmission model, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing and disaster simulation. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a digital elevation model, disaster elements and priori knowledge, secondly constructing a terrain grid and registering, calculating disaster frequency and erosion deposition quantity by combining drainage basin analysis to generate a surface change DEM before and after the occurrence of the disaster, then inputting the change DEM into a three-dimensional radiation transmission model, constructing a multi-time phase scene and inputting component spectrum parameters, carrying out overall process simulation to generate a remote sensing reflectivity image covering the whole spectrum range from visible light to microwaves, and finally verifying accuracy by using real data and outputting a result. The invention realizes the physical coupling of the earth surface dynamics and the radiation transmission process, can effectively simulate the comprehensive remote sensing signals generated by the earth surface morphology and structure change caused by disasters, and provides high-fidelity and multi-phase data support for disaster mechanism research and monitoring and early warning.

title_en: In-situ physical simulation test device and method for coal and gas outburst
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal and gas outburst simulation tests, and relates to a device and a method for in-situ physical simulation test of coal and gas outburst, wherein the test device comprises a tunneling assembly, a power control assembly, a monitoring assembly and a control assembly; the system comprises a tunneling assembly, a power control assembly, a monitoring assembly and a control assembly, wherein the tunneling assembly is used for simulating tunnel tunneling and inducing coal and gas outburst in a coal seam site, the power control assembly is used for driving the tunneling assembly and regulating and controlling tunneling parameters of the tunneling assembly, the monitoring assembly is used for monitoring disaster parameters including gas pressure, coal powder impact force and gas concentration in the outburst process in real time, and the control assembly is used for receiving data of the monitoring assembly and dynamically regulating and controlling the power control assembly based on the data so as to realize the safety control of the outburst. According to the invention, the tunneling drill bit is directly utilized to simulate the tunnel tunneling to induce the outstanding disasters in the coal mine site, so that the actual reproduction of the original complex occurrence environment of the coal seam is realized.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING GROUP CHONGQING RESEARCH INST

title_en: Tunnel karst prediction method, system, equipment, medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering, in particular to a method, a system, equipment, a medium and a program product for estimating karst of a tunnel. The method for estimating the karst of the tunnel comprises the steps of S1, collecting basic karst data, S2, detecting the rock mass, including geophysical prospecting and drilling, S3, judging whether the risk of water and mud gushing exists according to detection results, if the risk of water and mud gushing exists, carrying out tunnel construction, and if the risk of water and mud gushing exists, carrying out treatment until the risk of water and mud gushing is eliminated, and carrying out tunnel construction. Under the condition of finishing the remediation, evaluating the remediation effect, if the remediation is effective, carrying out tunnel construction, if the remediation is ineffective, detecting the remediated rock mass, updating the remediation scheme, and carrying out iterative remediation until the risk of water and mud gushing is eliminated. According to the invention, through fusion of various detection means, multi-dimensional and multi-parameter comprehensive identification of the rock solution in front of the tunnel face is realized, misjudgment or missed judgment is effectively overcome, and the identification accuracy of karst key disaster causing elements is remarkably improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 2 GROUP;CHINA RAILWAY ERJU SECOND ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent judging method for stability of highway slope rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent judging method for stability of a highway slope rock mass, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass displacement and moisture content of the highway slope rock mass, obtaining a rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram through finite element simulation, comparing the rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram with historical geological data, dividing the rock mass into a high uncertainty area and a low uncertainty area, extracting a deformation monitoring sequence from the high uncertainty area, classifying to obtain a deformation trend classification result, fusing the deformation trend classification result with the mechanical property of the low uncertainty area to generate a slope stability index map, updating rock mass fracture density and permeability, combining the updated fracture density, permeability and deformation trend, obtaining a instability probability distribution curve through probability simulation, generating an early warning signal according to whether a curve peak probability point is located in a safety interval, and outputting a slope stability judging report. The method improves accuracy and instantaneity of slope stability evaluation and obviously reduces geological disaster risks.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electric vehicle transportation fire cause analysis method based on coupling model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle transportation fire cause analysis method based on a coupling model, which comprises the steps of collecting fire scene ablation form, combustion product data and transportation condition logs, fusing to obtain a scene characteristic data set, extracting characteristics by a convolutional neural network to determine a fire development path, matching vehicle attributes when thermal diffusion is abnormal, integrating electrochemical reaction data, constructing a multi-physical-field initial coupling model, analyzing simulated vibration and temperature influence by finite elements, positioning a thermal runaway trigger point, reversely mapping a calibration model to obtain a refined cause mechanism, determining a preventive threshold value if the transportation condition is a dominant factor, and applying the preventive threshold value to real-time monitoring and fusing model output to realize risk dynamic assessment. The method can accurately position the trigger points, analyze the multi-physical field disaster-causing mechanism, improve the cause analysis precision and the fire prevention rate, and is suitable for the transportation safety control of the multi-scene electric automobile.
assignees: RESEARCH INST OF HIGHWAY MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT

title_en: Photovoltaic power station meteorological disaster risk assessment method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power station weather disaster risk assessment method based on multi-source data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining grid point weather, ground observation and geographic information data, constructing a basic weather data set, extracting three-dimensional terrain parameters such as altitude, gradient and the like based on the geographic data, constructing a terrain-weather mapping model by taking the three-dimensional terrain parameters as constraints, analyzing weather element response rules and generating disaster-causing factor global space distribution data, analyzing a disaster-causing factor damage mechanism, determining a risk weight coefficient, configuring a comprehensive risk quantization model by utilizing the risk weight coefficient, inputting disaster-causing factor data, carrying out aggregation operation, outputting a comprehensive risk index and dividing a risk area. According to the photovoltaic power station risk assessment method, coverage and accuracy of the photovoltaic power station risk assessment are effectively improved through multi-source data fusion and terrain constraint simulation.
assignees: CENTRAL SOUTHERN CHINA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA POWER ENG CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Deep learning-based building fire prediction and intelligent decision optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based building fire prediction and intelligent decision optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting building monitoring data, preprocessing and constructing a multivariate time sequence sample, constructing an improved TimeMixer model to obtain a risk prediction result and a risk trend sequence, adopting sharpness perception minimization training to obtain target model parameters, inputting the parameters with the target model to obtain the prediction result and the risk trend of a building, constructing an emergency decision optimization state vector, determining candidate linkage actions, solving the candidate linkage actions to obtain linkage control instructions, and issuing an evacuation guiding scheme to complete emergency treatment closed-loop control. According to the invention, the fire risk prediction and risk trend generation of the building multisource time sequence monitoring data are realized by constructing the improved TimeMixer model and adopting the sharpness perception minimization.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHUOYUE FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hospital service-oriented server and storage virtualization system integration and disaster recovery reconstruction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage virtualization, in particular to a server facing hospital business and a method for integrating and reconstructing disaster recovery systems of a storage virtualization system, which comprises the following steps of constructing and deploying hierarchical integrated construction of a simulation system, constructing a resource pool infrastructure with deep coupling of calculation and storage and optimization for medical business load; the progressive online migration technology based on the service portraits realizes the controllable and smooth seamless migration of the risk of the service system from the physical platform to the virtual platform, the old machine room is reconstructed into a degradation type disaster recovery center, the old machine room is transformed into an economic and practical disaster recovery site meeting the core service recovery target, and the method has the advantages of remarkably improving the resource efficiency and the economy, improving the average resource utilization rate from less than 20% to more than 60% through deep resource pooling, reducing the purchase quantity of new equipment, fully utilizing old assets and reducing TCO.
assignees: THE SECOND CONSTRUCTION LIMITED CO OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION EIGHTH ENGINEERING DIVISION

title_en: Synchronous monitoring device for stress and rotation angle of mine roof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a synchronous monitoring device for stress and rotation angle of a mine roof, and belongs to the technical field of monitoring of rock stratum movement of the mine roof. The device comprises a plurality of monitoring sensors and a connecting rod, wherein the monitoring sensors are sequentially connected end to end, two adjacent monitoring sensors are connected through the connecting rod, each monitoring sensor comprises a pipe body, a strain flower used for collecting stress data is arranged on the outer surface of each pipe body, a three-way angle meter used for collecting angle data is arranged in each pipe body, hole sealing rings are arranged at the head end and the tail end of each pipe body in the circumferential direction, a grouting module is further arranged on each pipe body, slurry in each grouting module can flow to the outer surface of each sensor pipe body through a liquid discharge hole, the inner wall of each monitoring drill hole and a sealing space between the two hole sealing rings, and after the slurry is solidified, the device and a rock stratum are integrated. The utility model can synchronously monitor the stress and the rotation angle of each rock stratum of the top plate in real time, accurately and continuously, and provides more detailed rock stratum information for mine disaster prevention and control.
assignees: SHANDONG JINING CANAL COAL MINE CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Charging pile shed safety prevention and control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety prevention and control system for a charging pile shed, which comprises a shed main body, wherein a charging socket for charging a vehicle is arranged on the shed main body, a fire-fighting pipeline is arranged at the top of the shed main body, a measuring device and a fire extinguisher are arranged at the outer side of the fire-fighting pipeline, a plurality of visual recognition cameras are arranged at the top of the shed main body, a control box for controlling equipment is arranged at one side of the shed main body, a double criterion for triggering and adding AI visual secondary confirmation by adopting a sensor threshold is adopted, the false alarm rate is reduced to be less than 2% from 15% of the traditional scheme, the mechanical evacuation is preferentially started before the fire extinguishing, the mechanical parts are prevented from being frozen by the fire extinguishing agent, the time delay is optimized through fluid mechanics simulation, and the threshold is enabled to adapt to long-term interference such as day and night temperature difference and season change through LSTM prediction environmental parameter base line.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: The system includes a means for collecting and processing disaster prediction data and geographical information, a means for evaluating a disaster risk on the basis of the data, a means for simulating the optimum arrangement of electric private cars on the basis of the disaster risk evaluation, a means for instructing the movement of the electric private cars on the basis of the simulation result, and a means for supplying power by making the electric private cars go to a base station when a disaster occurs.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method, medium and equipment for simulating and calculating temperature rise of DCS (distributed control system) cabinet of nuclear power plant during fire smoking
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, medium and equipment for simulating and calculating temperature rise of a DCS cabinet of a nuclear power plant during fire smoking, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a DCS cabinet model during fire, obtaining external environment temperature t2 of the DCS cabinet, obtaining total heat load value phi 0 of the DCS cabinet, calculating the highest temperature t1 in the DCS cabinet according to a calculation formula of convection heat dissipation heat phi 1 of the DCS cabinet, a calculation formula of radiation heat dissipation heat phi 2 of the DCS cabinet, a calculation formula of conduction heat dissipation heat phi 3 of the DCS cabinet and a calculation formula of conduction heat dissipation heat phi 3 of the DCS cabinet. The method provided by the application obtains the highest internal temperature of the smoked DCS cabinet in the fire disaster period through modeling and calculation, thereby accurately judging whether the DCS cabinet and the internal equipment thereof are damaged in the fire disaster period, fully proving that the DCS cabinet can safely and reliably work after the fire disaster, and avoiding the influence of the whole replacement of the DCS cabinet on the huge progress and cost of engineering projects.
assignees: CGN LUFENG NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image semantic change detection method based on text assistance and contrast learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a semantic change detection method based on text assistance and contrast learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining remote sensing images collected by the same region in different time phases, inputting a twin multi-scale encoder with shared parameters to extract multi-level features, secondly introducing a pre-training visual-language model and a text encoder in a training stage to generate a text describing changes and injecting the text into a high-level visual feature to obtain migration features and construct a reconstruction constraint based on contrast learning, thirdly, adaptively fusing the multi-scale features by a construction context and channel perception fusion module, fourthly, designing the multi-scale decoder to recover spatial resolution and output a semantic change graph, and fifthly, adopting a joint training target consisting of spatial mask supervision loss and reconstruction loss to optimize the network end to end. The method is suitable for scenes such as remote sensing monitoring, disaster assessment, urban dynamic analysis and the like.

title_en: Class increment learning method based on feature correlation and space structure maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a class increment learning method based on feature correlation and space structure maintenance, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning. Aiming at the problems that the disaster forgetting problem relieving effect is limited in sample-free type incremental learning and the type discrimination in an embedded space is difficult to maintain, a type incremental learning model based on feature correlation and space structure maintenance is built, a trained type incremental learning model is obtained by training the type incremental learning model through an incremental task, after each incremental stage is completed, a final type incremental learning model is obtained by testing the trained model, the type incremental learning is carried out through the final model, the limitation of a traditional classification method in a dynamic learning environment is overcome, the effective learning of a newly added type and the long-term maintenance of historical knowledge are realized, and more flexible and robust incremental learning capability is provided for the model.

title_en: Disaster recovery resource scheduling method and device based on heterogeneous cloud environment
abstract_en: The application discloses a disaster recovery resource scheduling method and device based on a heterogeneous cloud environment, and the method comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional resource portrait model and a cross-cloud network topological graph in the heterogeneous cloud environment, generating a standardized resource vector set and a topological affinity scoring matrix, aggregating a local SLA default risk prediction model of each cloud node through federal learning, performing fine tuning through migration learning to obtain a global prediction model, calculating load fluctuation entropy based on an SLA constraint template and real-time load data, inputting the global model prediction to obtain an SLA default probability set, constructing a dynamic weight multi-objective optimization function, solving to obtain an optimal taking over cloud node list and a migration strategy identification set, determining a target cloud node and a migration strategy through SLA simulation verification, and calling an adaptive execution adapter to complete cross-cloud arrangement deployment of virtual machine increment snapshot migration or containerization service. The application realizes the intelligent and automatic scheduling of disaster recovery resources, and improves the fault take-over speed and the cross-cloud resource utilization rate.

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN, and belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle and power grid interactive scheduling. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting EV charge and discharge data and power grid operation data, accurately grouping EV users by utilizing MEAN SHIFT and K-means++ combined clustering algorithm to reduce decision dimension, then constructing a dynamic excitation electricity price and user response uncertainty model based on a Logistic function, then establishing a hierarchical optimization model, finally constructing a Markov decision process based on the model, and performing strategy optimization training by adopting DQN to generate a specific scheduling scheme. The method effectively solves the problem of dimension disaster caused by large-scale EV access, achieves the dual goals of obviously reducing peak load of the power grid and optimizing and reducing charging cost of users, and improves the running stability and dispatching economy of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER;LUOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method and system for evaluating state of ultra-long tunnel geologic body fusing geophysical-geomechanical-drilling data
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for evaluating the state of a very long tunnel geological body by fusing geophysical-geomechanical-drilling data, and relates to the technical field of tunnel construction safety. The method comprises the steps of collecting geophysical detection data in front of a tunnel working face, lithology data disclosed by drilling and measurement while drilling data, obtaining preliminary spatial distribution of rock mechanical parameters through inversion of a petrophysical model, correcting and spatially interpolating the preliminary spatial distribution through a machine learning model to construct a three-dimensional geomechanical model, constructing a finite element-discrete element coupling numerical model based on the three-dimensional geomechanical model, analyzing catastrophe evolution mechanisms of surrounding rocks through simulation of a tunneling unloading process to obtain a numerically-simulated catastrophe high risk area, and carrying out spatial superposition and coupling analysis on an abnormal area, a parameter weakening area and the catastrophe high risk area to obtain stability classification and disaster risk early warning results of the geological body in front of the working face.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;YSD RAIL TRANSIT CONSTRUCTION CO LIMITED;BEIJING QINGYAN ZHENGDE INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tsunami disaster risk assessment method, system and medium based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a tsunami disaster risk assessment method, system and medium based on cloud computing. The method comprises the following steps of accessing and converging data of an earthquake monitoring system, a satellite remote sensing system, a tide level monitoring device and a historical tsunami event library to obtain a multi-source heterogeneous tsunami original data set, carrying out format standardization, time synchronization and semantic annotation processing on the multi-source heterogeneous tsunami original data set to obtain a unified data model, establishing and registering a data service interface based on the unified data model to obtain a data service set, and calling the data service set to obtain tsunami propagation simulation input data. According to the invention, through multi-source data standardization and semantic fusion, cloud computing parallel processing, multidimensional index analysis and dynamic visual display, the high-efficiency, accurate, real-time and operable comprehensive management of tsunami disaster risk assessment is realized.
assignees: INST OF GEOMECHANICS CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Dynamic earthquake casualties prediction method and system based on improved case reasoning-neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake casualties prediction, and provides a dynamic earthquake casualties prediction method and system based on an improved case reasoning-neural network, comprising the following steps of step 1, collecting and establishing an earthquake casualties data set; the method comprises the steps of step 2, simplifying a seismic casualties data set by adopting a principal component analysis method to establish a case set, step 3, screening the case set by utilizing a weighted K-NN algorithm, collecting historical cases with high similarity with a prediction target to establish a training sample, step 4, acquiring real-time indexes of the prediction target as correction parameters, wherein the real-time indexes comprise disaster-stricken population, house destruction rate, the number of death on the same day as the earthquake and the number of injury on the same day as the earthquake, and step 5, inputting the training sample and the correction parameters into a PSO-BP neural network prediction model to predict the casualties. The invention can predict the casualties of earthquake better.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar target identification method based on cross-modal dynamic resolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground penetrating radar target identification method based on cross-modal dynamic resolution. Aiming at the problem of feature blurring caused by modal information splitting and resolution fixation, a collaborative mechanism of dynamic resolution optimization and cross-modal attention fusion is provided, wherein image degradation features are analyzed through a time sequence convolution network, multiscale resolution parameters are dynamically generated, target density self-adaptive feature enhancement is realized, a cross-modal attention module is designed, decoupling intensity and Doppler features in a feature pyramid, double-modal complementary fusion is realized through channel weighting and space focusing, and cross-scale semantic interaction is optimized based on the bidirectional feature pyramid. By integrating a lightweight target detection architecture and a multitasking collaborative training mechanism, the inference efficiency is optimized while the accuracy of tiny target identification in a complex scene is ensured, and the method is particularly suitable for perception scenes with strict requirements on time efficiency, such as intelligent driving, geological disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Coal mine working face compaction time advance prediction method based on support resistance time-space characteristics
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a coal mine working face compaction time advance prediction method based on support resistance time-space characteristics. The method comprises the steps of constructing a support resistance space-time feature matrix, solving pressure labels and incoming pressure feature parameters of a mined working surface, constructing a support resistance real-time advanced prediction model by taking the support resistance space-time feature matrix as time stamp data, constructing and training a grid unit pressure label real-time classification model, constructing an incoming pressure feature parameter prediction model with three stages of information of a stabilization-destabilization process and incoming pressure as input, and carrying out advanced prediction on a target coal mine working surface when compacting to obtain advanced prediction grid unit feature values, advanced prediction grid pressure labels and advanced prediction incoming pressure feature parameters of the target coal mine working surface. The invention provides basis information for the advanced prevention and control of the overlying strata unstable disasters in the coal mining process, and perfects the intelligent prevention and control links of the coal mine disasters.

title_en: Cabin type oil tank area fire accident simulation environment simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of security engineering and computer application, and particularly relates to a cabin type oil tank area fire accident simulation environment simulation method and system. The method comprises the steps of adopting exhaustive combination simulation to fire disaster of the oil tank area, realizing simulation experience of any fire point in the oil tank area at any observation position, calculating the current space position and direction of an experimenter in a virtual scene through a virtual scene follow-up visual angle virtual-actual mapping algorithm, calculating the heat radiation value and the wind direction sensed by the observation point of the experimenter, and controlling a fire accident environment simulation cabin according to a calculation result to enable the fire accident environment simulation cabin to generate accident scene wind, heat and smoke effects sensed by the experimenter at the position. According to the fire accident simulation environment simulation system, oil tank area fire accident environment simulation and interaction experience are realized from four entity perception dimensions of VR, smog, wind and heat radiation.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC SAFETY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: TBM tunnel rock mass integrity grade identification method and system based on rock slag image and SI-VGG19 network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TBM tunnel rock mass integrity grade identification method and system based on a rock mass image and an SI-VGG19 network, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and corresponding rock mass integrity coefficient data of a TBM tunnel (hole), and establishing a data set after grading; and training the SI-VGG19 network with enhanced SE attention to obtain a rock mass integrity grade identification model based on a rock mass image, so as to realize accurate identification of the rock mass integrity grade of the TBM tunnel (tunnel). The invention realizes the accurate identification of the rock integrity of the TBM tunnel (tunnel) based on the rock slag image, not only identifies the rough surrounding rock grade or the custom category information, and can provide fine and scientific guidance for the disaster early warning, the tunneling control and the supporting decision of the TBM tunnel (tunnel) construction, thereby guaranteeing the safe and efficient tunneling of the TBM.

title_en: Drilling platform auxiliary positioning early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of household daily necessities, and provides an auxiliary positioning and early warning device for a drilling platform. The drilling platform auxiliary positioning early warning device comprises a rectangular long frame, a water flooding detection mechanism, a GPS positioning module, a 4G transmission module, a controller and an alarm mechanism, wherein the front end face and the rear end face of the lower end of the rectangular long frame are fixedly sleeved with U-shaped mounting plates. According to the auxiliary positioning early warning device for the drilling platform, provided by the utility model, through the cooperation of the floating ball and the waterproof pressure sensor, the wave instantaneous interference is avoided, the water flooding condition can be accurately detected, the false alarm problem of the traditional water level sensor is avoided, meanwhile, the position of the platform is monitored in real time by combining with the GPS positioning module, once the position exceeds the safety range, the deviation early warning is immediately triggered, the multi-dimensional safety monitoring is realized, the water flooding warning and the deviation early warning are operated simultaneously, the risk can be analyzed in a linkage manner, whether the water is fed due to the drift or not is analyzed, the decision time is shortened, and the emergency response can be optimized.
assignees: HUBEI HONGHUA CHANGJI ELECTROMECHANICAL CO LTD

title_en: Rock drill for geological disaster management
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of geological disaster management, and discloses a rock drill for geological disaster management, a drilling rod is connected with the side edge of a hand-held gun body in a transmission way, a sliding frame is arranged at the top of the hand-held gun body in a sliding way, the top of the sliding frame is provided with a telescopic water delivery mechanism, the outer side of the sliding frame is provided with a limiting mechanism, the side edge of the telescopic water delivery mechanism is provided with a rotary communication mechanism, and the side edge of the rotary communication mechanism is fixedly communicated with a water inlet pipe. According to the technical scheme, the water collecting pipe and the spraying pipe at the top of the sliding frame can be horizontally adjusted, the spraying position of the spraying pipe is adjusted, and meanwhile, under the action of extension deformation of the first corrugated hose, dust-settling water can still be conveyed into the water collecting pipe and the spraying pipe, so that the spraying pipe can discharge and spray the dust-settling water, and the influence on the dust-settling quality of spraying caused by the fact that the spraying position is too far or too close to a drilling point is avoided.

title_en: Method and system for predicting water and mud inrush risk of deep-buried long diversion tunnel
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering geological disaster prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the water and mud bursting risk of a deep-buried long diversion tunnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining regional historical research data, stratum lithology survey data, geological structure survey data, hydrogeological survey data, geological exploration test data and geophysical exploration data of a region where a target tunnel is located, extracting mud bursting characteristics in the regional historical research data, the stratum lithology survey data, the geological structure survey data, the hydrogeological survey data, the geological exploration test data and the geophysical exploration data, and determining real risk labels of mileage samples along the target tunnel based on the mud bursting characteristics; and inputting the mud bursting characteristics and the labels into an extreme gradient lifting tree model for learning, training to obtain three kinds of risk prediction probability vectors aiming at mileage samples, namely high, medium and low, and introducing a geological mechanism constraint item into a loss function. According to the method, the learning of the extreme gradient lifting tree model is carried out based on the multi-source data, so that the prediction output of the extreme gradient lifting tree model accords with the geological evolution law of the water and mud gushing, and the accurate prediction of the water and mud gushing risk of the deep-buried long diversion tunnel in the early geological survey stage is realized.

title_en: Test method and system for realizing exhibition of three-dimensional complex structural surface of dangerous rock body by adopting 3D printing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and geological disasters, and discloses a test method for realizing the spreading of three-dimensional complex structural surfaces of dangerous rock bodies by adopting a 3D printing technology, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring multi-source detection data of dangerous rock bodies, wherein the multi-source detection data comprise external three-dimensional point cloud data, drilling exposure structural surface data and inversion data of a transient electromagnetic method; S2, performing geological interpretation on inversion data of the transient electromagnetic method based on the data of the exposed structural surface of the drill hole, deducing geological properties of the hidden structural surface, and fusing all the data to construct a three-dimensional digital model containing geometric information of the structural surface and deduced geological properties. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and geological intelligent interpretation, a three-dimensional digital model containing attribute inference of the hidden structural surface is constructed, and high-precision and full-space digital reproduction of a complex structural surface system of a dangerous rock body is realized.

title_en: Nuclear fuel refueling operation simulation interaction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation interaction method and a simulation interaction system for nuclear fuel refueling operation, which relate to the technical field of nuclear reactors and comprise the steps of collecting nuclear fuel position state data, constructing a nuclear fuel state mathematical model by abstracting a nuclear fuel state into a fourth-order tensor, constructing a state conversion mathematical model according to multidimensional matrix control of simulation state conversion, constructing a dynamic mathematical model of fuel based on simulation and prediction of dynamic behaviors of the nuclear fuel, and outputting a nonlinear dynamic state vector by constructing a simulated nonlinear dynamic behavior model. According to the invention, the nuclear fuel state is abstracted into the fourth-order tensor, so that the precision and the efficiency of the refueling operation are improved, the dynamic behavior of the nuclear fuel is simulated and predicted through the high-order differential mathematical model, key information is provided for dynamic management and emergency response in the nuclear reactor, and the invention has better effects in the aspects of the precision, the running stability and the safety of the refueling operation.
assignees: HUANENG HAINAN CHANGJIANG NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban land planning analysis method based on neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a city land planning analysis method based on a neural network, which relates to the technical field of land planning and comprises the steps of carrying out risk scoring on each grid according to risk indexes, marking grids with risk scores larger than a risk threshold as target areas, obtaining multisource data sets and disaster and toughness data of the target areas, constructing a disaster risk prediction model to output a disaster risk map, constructing a toughness association model to output a toughness coefficient according to the disaster risk map and disaster and toughness data, setting a plurality of objective functions according to the disaster risk map and the toughness coefficient of the target areas to obtain candidate planning schemes, carrying out microscopic environment evolution and disaster dynamic simulation on each candidate planning scheme to obtain evaluation scores, determining a final planning scheme, combining the disaster risk map and the toughness coefficient, realizing optimal balance between environment sustainability and disaster toughness, dynamically identifying causal relationship between microscopic environment and disaster risk, and carrying out accurate prediction to realize long-term scientific planning.
assignees: JINING SURVEY INST;JINING LAND RESERVE AND PLANNING AFFAIRS CENTER JINING NATURAL RESOURCES ASSET SERVICES CENTER

title_en: Multi-source weather refined prediction method based on physical offset model
abstract_en: A multisource weather refined prediction method based on a physical offset model introduces a double-channel space-time coding, a physical priori guided attention mechanism, a multiscale sliding window input and gating feature fusion strategy into a model framework, and combines the technologies of Bayesian optimization driven super-parameter automatic search, self-adaptive mixed loss function, uncertainty quantization, physical consistency post-processing and the like, thereby remarkably improving modeling capacity and prediction robustness of the model on complex weather processes (especially extreme events). Whether based on simulation testing of analysis data or in verification of a real meteorological observation site, the method shows prediction accuracy, stability and interpretability superior to those of a traditional numerical mode and a single deep learning model. The invention provides reliable technical support for refined weather service, disaster weather early warning and energy scheduling decision, and has important application value and popularization prospect.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Geological disaster risk analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk analysis method and system based on big data, which relate to the field of geological disaster management and comprise an acquisition module, a data analysis module and a data analysis module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring three-dimensional structures of geological bodies in a target range, real-time stress fields and extreme weather process data, and associating historical disaster occurrence positions, influence ranges and spreading paths to generate multidimensional geological data with space-time labels; the invention effectively improves the accuracy and usability of data by integrating and optimizing the multidimensional geological related data, can accurately simulate the physical state and potential deformation of the geologic body, clearly clears the starting condition, response logic and risk superposition effect of disaster induction factors, realizes scientific grading early warning by combining regional characteristics, and provides timely and accurate reference for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.
assignees: Fengcheng Natural Resources Affairs Service Center;LIAONING NO 7 GEOLOGY BRIGADE CO LTD

title_en: Catastrophe chain analysis method and device for structural deformation in foundation pit excavation process, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a catastrophe chain analysis method, a catastrophe chain analysis device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for structural deformation in a foundation pit excavation process, which relate to the technical field of geotechnical engineering and underground space development and comprise the steps of establishing a coupling numerical model comprising a supporting structure, a soil body and a building; the method comprises the steps of simulating a foundation pit excavation process based on a coupling numerical model to obtain a first numerical simulation result, carrying out iterative updating on parameters of the coupling numerical model until the errors are lower than a preset threshold value if the errors between the first numerical simulation result and deformation data acquired at a foundation pit excavation site exceed the preset threshold value, simulating the foundation pit excavation process under a non-support working condition based on the coupling numerical model to obtain a second numerical simulation result, and determining catastrophe chains of the foundation pit excavation process according to the second numerical simulation result. The invention overcomes the inherent defects of the traditional pure simulation method and the on-site monitoring and disjointing, and the disaster chain in the foundation pit excavation process obtained through numerical simulation result analysis is more accurate.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING MUNICIPAL ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine robot collaborative path planning method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine robot cooperative path planning method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of mine robot cooperative control and intelligent decision-making, and comprises the following steps of constructing a refined environment representation based on multi-source sensor information through a terrain cost modeling module, and calculating terrain cost value; the method comprises the steps of carrying out path planning by adopting a centralized training-decentralized execution mechanism through a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, monitoring and solving motion conflicts among robots in real time through a dynamic conflict resolution module, and realizing cross-robot knowledge transfer and strategy migration through a knowledge sharing unit. The invention effectively improves the path planning efficiency, cooperative work safety and learning adaptability of the multi-robot under complex dynamic environments such as mine disaster and the like, and is suitable for cooperative detection, rescue and transportation tasks of the multi-type mine robots.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method and system based on dynamic downscaling and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional high-resolution atmospheric analysis data construction method based on dynamic downscaling, which aims to improve the depicting capability of a medium-small scale weather process. The method takes global analysis data as a background field, fuses multisource observation data and high-resolution land utilization information, and gradually constructs an analysis data set with resolution of an hour level and a kilometer level by constructing a multi-layer nested WRF area mode and executing multi-time short-period simulation in combination with an assimilation strategy of analysis Nudging and observation Nudging. Through comparison and verification of multisource observation data, the constructed data set is obviously superior to ERA5 in the aspects of ground meteorological elements and vertical profile structure restoration, and has stronger regional adaptability and simulation precision. The method is suitable for various high-resolution weather application scenes such as regional artificial intelligent weather large models, urban fine weather service, high-impact weather disaster early warning, regional weather change evaluation, energy weather resource evaluation and the like.

title_en: Wind power cabin fire disaster identification positioning method and system based on diffusion model
abstract_en: The invention provides a wind power cabin fire disaster identification positioning method and system based on a diffusion model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a fire disaster scene adaptive diffusion model by utilizing an image-text pair data set containing wind power cabin scene images and fire disaster scene text descriptions based on a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model, generating a fire disaster synthesized image with real wind power cabin scene characteristics by combining a noise inversion technology and/or a spatial structure control network, carrying out quality scoring screening on the fire disaster synthesized image, reserving images with scores higher than a set threshold value, carrying out fire disaster area automatic marking on the screened images by utilizing a vision-language model to form a marking data set, and training a fire disaster identification classification model and a fire disaster area positioning model by utilizing the marking data set. The problem that high-quality fire training data of a real wind power cabin scene is difficult to acquire is effectively solved, and the fire recognition and positioning accuracy is improved.
assignees: LONGYUAN BEIJING NEW ENERGY ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD;LONGYUAN XIAN NEW ENERGY ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Protection channel abnormity analysis and evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to protection channels of power systems, and provides a protection channel abnormality analysis and evaluation method and system based on multi-source data fusion, which are used for collecting historical multi-source data of the protection channels of the power systems and constructing training samples; the method comprises the steps of training a large model by utilizing historical multi-source data of the electric power system, enabling the large model to learn association relation among alarm frequency statistics, time association analysis and device state verification three-stage judgment logic, inputting real-time data of a protection channel of the electric power system to be analyzed into the trained large model to obtain an abnormality type of the protection channel, and obtaining the abnormality level of the protection channel of the electric power system according to the abnormality type of the protection channel, weather disaster level, channel interruption duration and associated line importance. According to the invention, a large model is introduced into a protection channel anomaly identification scene, the limitation of traditional rule matching is broken through multi-source data semantic fusion, and the accurate transition from 'whether anomaly' to 'what anomaly' is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG UNIV ELECTRIC POWER TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Seepage field evolution device and method for simulating TBM tunneling process of water-rich layer surrounding rock tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a seepage field evolution device and a seepage field evolution method for simulating a TBM tunneling process of a water-rich layer surrounding rock tunnel, the device comprises an angle-adjustable layered surrounding rock model box system, a gravity type constant seepage field loading simulation system, a TBM cutterhead tunneling and supporting simulation system and a surrounding rock seepage and deformation monitoring system. The model box system is designed based on a geometric similarity ratio of 1:10, the inclination angle is adjustable, the seepage loading system is communicated with the model box up and down to realize stable gravity seepage application, the tunneling and supporting system is embedded in the model box along the horizontal direction to restore dynamic tunneling and synchronous supporting, and the monitoring system is respectively arranged in a seepage channel and a tunneling influence area to realize synchronous collection of multiple parameters and deformation. The method comprises the steps of model design, material preparation, seepage loading, tunneling support simulation and data acquisition and analysis. The invention realizes multifunctional coupling, has clear structure and controllable operation, and provides an effective experimental platform for researching seepage disaster mechanism of construction of the water-rich layer surrounding rock tunnel.

title_en: Waterlogging disaster prevention and control method based on digital twin and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a waterlogging disaster prevention and control method based on digital twinning and related equipment, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target farmland area information and a training sample set, preprocessing the training sample set to generate the training sample set with target feature data, obtaining a preset waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model, processing the preset waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model based on the training sample set with the target feature data to generate a target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model, processing the target farmland area information based on the target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model to generate attribute information of the target farmland area, and processing the attribute information of the target farmland area based on the target waterlogging disaster damage amount prediction model to generate waterlogging disaster management information of a monitoring point to be predicted.
assignees: HUBEI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES INST OF FOOD CROPS

title_en: Geophysical prospecting device for geological prospecting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geophysical prospecting device for geological exploration, which comprises a detection box, a detection device and a detection device, wherein two pairs of drilling fixing structures, a protection structure and a replacement type drilling detection structure are arranged on the detection box; the invention has the beneficial effects that the detection box is fixed on the mountain body through the drilling expansion of the drilling fixing structure, the mountain body is drilled through the replaceable drilling detection structure, so that the detection equipment is inserted into the inner side of the mountain body, the geological defect below the ground is detected, the ground is reacted before the ground collapses and the mountain body slides, the loss caused by natural disasters is reduced, and meanwhile, the detection equipment is expanded and protected through the detection assembly, so that the damage of the detection equipment is avoided.

title_en: Coal rock dynamic and static load self-adaptive multi-field coupling testing device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rock mechanics technology, which is used for solving the problems that when coal and rock bodies in an unknown coal and rock body environment are mined, mining difficulty, mine cave collapse and the like are easy to occur, and the surrounding environment is easy to pollute, in particular to a coal and rock dynamic and static load self-adaptive multi-field coupling testing device and method, comprising an axial loading device, a confining pressure loading system, a biaxial shearing system and a pore adjusting system; according to the invention, a multi-physical field coupling test of stress, temperature and seepage of the coal and rock mass is realized through the pore gas loading system, the pore water loading system and the nano-coil high-temperature system, the phenomenon of solid, liquid, gas, thermal multiphase and polymorphic redistribution and migration of the coal and rock mass under the influence of mining disturbance is simulated, the problem of one-sided and inaccurate detection of the existing experimental instrument is solved, a novel test means is provided for revealing the coupling action mechanism of coal, gas and water under the three-dimensional stress condition, and a reliable test basis is provided for preventing and controlling gas disasters and researching gas extraction.

title_en: Ground feature intelligent classification method based on self-adaptive ground point filtering and multi-channel DSM image
abstract_en: A ground feature intelligent classification method based on self-adaptive ground point filtering and multi-channel DSM images is characterized in that a real ground structure under complex topography is reserved through self-adaptive grid filtering, multi-channel input is built by combining elevation, strength, point density and derivative morphological characteristics, end-to-end semantic segmentation is carried out by combining an encoder-decoder deep convolution network, cross entropy and Dice loss are combined in the training process, L2 regularization and morphological post-processing are introduced, the problem of class imbalance is effectively relieved, and the recognition accuracy of small targets is improved. And meanwhile, the classification result is subjected to semantic correction by fusing the prior rules of the power engineering, so that the output of the space logic conforming to the actual operation and maintenance scene is ensured. The invention provides high-reliability basic geospatial data support for key tasks such as intelligent inspection, safe distance early warning, cross-span analysis and the like of the power transmission line, and has important application value for guaranteeing safe operation of power grid facilities and improving geological disaster response capability.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Combined training system of long-distance artificial intelligent model
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined training system of a long-distance artificial intelligent model, which is characterized in that intelligent computing centers which are mutually independent are arranged in different position areas of a preset geographic range, the intelligent computing centers are mutually connected through long-distance RDMA parameter links and long-distance RDMA data links, when calculation tasks are jointly executed by a plurality of intelligent computing centers, the intelligent computing centers realize cross-region real-time parameter synchronization through the long-distance RDMA parameter links, data exchange is realized through the long-distance RDMA data links, and the types of the calculation tasks comprise the calculation tasks of the artificial intelligent model. The disaster tolerance of the whole calculation networking is improved, and the total calculation scale of the city can be effectively enlarged.
assignees: SHANGHAI ADC TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based agricultural disaster prevention and control method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a digital twinning-based agricultural disaster prevention and control method and related equipment, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target farmland area information, a target event set and a training sample set which are matched with the target farmland area information, preprocessing the training sample set to generate a training sample set with target feature data, processing a preset disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model based on the training sample set with the target feature data to generate a target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model, processing the target event set to generate farmland ecological early warning information of the target farmland area, processing the target farmland area information based on the target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model to generate attribute information of the target farmland area, and processing the attribute information of the target farmland area and the farmland ecological early warning information of the target farmland area based on the target disaster distributed ecological hydrologic model to generate farmland early warning information of a monitoring point to be predicted.
assignees: HUBEI ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIENCES INST OF FOOD CROPS

title_en: Fire control drill steel anchor point recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting steel drill anchor point recovery device which comprises a straight hand rod, wherein a rotatable U-shaped clamping piece is arranged at the front end of the straight hand rod, the opening direction of the U-shaped clamping piece is perpendicular to the straight hand rod, a rotatable sleeve is arranged at the top end of the support rod, the sleeve is sleeved on the straight hand rod and fastened through a T-shaped screw, and a base is arranged at the bottom of the support rod. The base comprises a ball groove and a bottom plate which are fixed integrally, a ball head is arranged at the bottom end of the supporting rod, and the ball head is positioned in the ball groove for rotation. The sleeve is provided with two T-shaped screws in threaded connection. The rotating surfaces of the U-shaped clamping pieces and the sleeve are overlapped. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the straight hand lever is connected with the supporting rod in a lever type, the supporting point can be adjusted, the base can adapt to uneven terrain, the operation is labor-saving, the steel drills can be pulled out quickly and easily, and the work load of firefighters is reduced.
assignees: MOYU FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE MOYU FIRE RESCUE BUREAU

title_en: Method of firefighting training using a mixed reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to training simulators for practicing fire suppression techniques. The method of firefighting training comprises scanning the room with AR glasses, creating a 3D model of the room, placing a fire source on the 3D model, real-time visualization of the flames, smoke, and extinguishing agent stream to the user's AR glasses. Interaction between the trainee and the system's logical- mathematical model is by using a fire nozzle simulator. A logical-mathematical model of flame and smoke propagation from the fire source, and temperature changes within the 3D room model is generated in real time. The logical-mathematical model of flame extinguishing by applying the extinguishing agent is generated, material types are mapped on the 3D model, which is generated as a 3D matrix of cells. Each cell is assigned a type: air, wall, solid surface, and parameters: size, temperature. The trainee's physiological parameters are monitored using a heartbeat sensor. The trainee interacts with the simulator via Al-processed voice commands. The technical result of the invention is a more immersive training simulation that closely approximates the simulation to real firefighting environment.
assignees: OBSHCHESTVO S OGRANICHENNOJ OTVETSTVENNOSTYU VI AR EHJ AR FAJER TEKHNOLODZHIS

title_en: Training device and a method of using the same
abstract_en: There is provided herein a training device, which can be used to advantage for the physical and professional training of fire fighters, specifically for training them in the chopping of wood with an axe. The device employs a weight sled, such as a common gym sled used in physical training exercises. The device has two elongate members emanating upwardly from the weight sled and a cross beam having an upper side and a lower side, the cross beam connecting by its lower side a set of two upper ends of the elongate members. The device also contains a housing affixed to the upper side of the cross beam, the housing having an open central portion and two opposing open receptacle end caps the open receptacles of the end caps facing each other along a longitudinal length of the cross beam, one of the opposing open receptable end caps having a door and a lock for the door. The method comprises providing a piece of wood inside the housing and engaging in cutting the same with an axe to provide for rigorous physical exercise and realistic training in ax techniques used by firefighters when fighting a fire.

title_en: Coal mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on pre-training large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine dynamic disaster early warning method based on a pre-training large language model, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine dynamic disaster monitoring. Aiming at the technical problems that the prior early warning method has poor generalization capability and strong dependence on scene annotation data and is difficult to effectively fuse multi-source monitoring information and complex working conditions, the method is realized by the steps of acquiring and preprocessing a coal mine multi-source monitoring time sequence and a work log, constructing a multi-dimensional feature vector and an aligned dangerous sequence, constructing a training sample by utilizing a sliding window, extracting working condition features and fusing and encoding the working condition features and the monitoring features into a sequence-working condition fusion embedded sequence, finely adjusting a pre-trained large language model with frozen sequence input parameters, inputting an adaptation layer and a pre-measuring head, optimizing through a composite loss function to obtain a prediction model, and finally realizing multi-step online prediction and early warning of future disaster dangers.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE SAFETY EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT INDUSTRY TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST

title_en: Synergistic disaster-stricken test device for simulating high-temperature drought of crops in field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a synergistic disaster-stricken test device for simulating high-temperature drought of crops in a field, which relates to the technical field of crop test devices and comprises a test box and a connecting channel, wherein a crop cultivation box is detachably arranged in the test box, soil samples and crops for simulation are arranged in the crop cultivation box, an illumination simulation mechanism is arranged in the test box, ventilation openings are formed in two sides of the test box, and when the connecting channel is arranged on one side of the test box, the inside of the connecting channel is communicated with the inside of the test box through the ventilation openings. The invention can dry air by arranging the crop cultivation box, the air supply structure and the drying structure, thereby simulating the drying environment for test, can provide a light source by the operation of the plant growth lamp by arranging the illumination simulation mechanism, and drive the movement control motor to work so as to drive the movement control gear to rotate, and can lead the roller to roll in the arc-shaped slideway under the meshing coordination of the structures.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Tunnel train fire smoke spreading prediction method based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tunnel train fire smoke spreading prediction method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of S1, carrying out numerical simulation in Fluent, realizing variable speed movement of a train and a fire source through a User-Defined Functions (UDF) technology, recording the temperature change condition of a key point position along with time, automatically solving multiple working conditions through an supercomputer platform and PyFluent technology, automatically storing data, obtaining temperature distribution and smoke concentration of key evacuation positions, providing a learning sample for a rapid prediction technology of evacuation conditions in a railway tunnel, and S3, training a cyclic neural network model, and realizing rapid prediction of critical point position disaster causing parameters. The invention has higher reduction degree, is more suitable for actual conditions, and can realize the spreading condition of the smoke in the tunnel by selecting the CNN-LSTM model obtained by training the key input variables.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CARS RAILWAY ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster comprehensive risk prediction method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting comprehensive risk of a mountain torrent disaster based on multi-source data, which relate to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster risk prediction, the method comprises multi-source data acquisition, multi-source data analysis and mountain torrent disaster prediction feedback, the state corresponding to a region is further evaluated by precisely acquiring multi-source data, whether the mountain torrent disaster and disaster level occur in the region are predicted, early warning maintenance of the mountain torrent disaster corresponding to the region is obtained by analysis, and executing negative hidden danger cost pre-simulation of the maintenance set under the mountain torrent disaster risk level, evaluating the cost of the mountain torrent disaster corresponding to the region for early warning maintenance, and screening the adaptive early warning maintenance under the mountain torrent disaster corresponding to the region, thereby realizing accurate prediction of the mountain torrent disaster risk corresponding to the region, timely carrying out effective measure prevention on the prediction result, and reducing the dangerous influence and the risk loss caused by the mountain torrent disaster.

title_en: LSTM-based coal seam gas pressure while-drilling in-situ measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an LSTM-based coal seam gas pressure while-drilling in-situ measurement method, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas control.
