The method aims at the problems of long pressure measuring period, high hole sealing requirement, high interference by geological conditions, low automation degree and the like of the existing gas pressure measuring technology, a gas emission amount theoretical calculation model is established, the geology of a coal seam of a mining area and gas parameters are combined, a emission amount time sequence data set covering different gas pressures is generated through theoretical calculation, on-site actual data are collected and aligned with the data set, a dual-channel LSTM neural network model integrating time sequence dynamic characteristics and static priori knowledge is constructed for training, and finally the trained model is embedded into an anti-explosion edge calculation terminal, so that the gas pressure can be quickly inverted in situ while drilling. The invention realizes the quick, accurate and automatic measurement of the gas pressure, obviously reduces the interference to the mining operation and improves the efficiency of preventing and controlling the gas disasters of the coal mine.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING GROUP CHONGQING RESEARCH INST

title_en: Intelligent flood prevention method for hydraulic engineering
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent flood prevention method for hydraulic engineering, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering. The method comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twin model of the hydraulic engineering and establishing a digital map, acquiring the engineering running state and meteorological hydrologic data of an area where the hydraulic engineering is located in real time, extracting the change characteristics of water yield, rainfall and engineering conditions, updating the state of the digital twin model, simulating the running process of the hydraulic engineering to predict the flood situation and disaster development trend, timely sensing possible abnormal conditions by monitoring the surrounding environment of the hydraulic engineering in real time, carrying out real-time analysis and optimization decision, providing timely and effective flood prevention suggestions and automatically triggering flood prevention measures when necessary, periodically updating and optimizing the digital twin model, combining the actual running data and new technical progress, continuously improving the accuracy and reliability of the model, and ensuring that a flood prevention system is always kept in an optimal state.

title_en: Multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation method for hydraulic slotting coal body effect under true triaxial condition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine gas disaster prevention and control, and relates to a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation method for hydraulic slotting coal body effects under a true triaxial condition. According to the invention, the true state (sigma  1 >σ 2 >σ 3 ) of the underground coal body is simulated in the true triaxial stress environment, so that the accurate evaluation of the hydraulic slotting effect is realized. Firstly, compared with the traditional conventional triaxial test, the method adopts an independent three-dimensional stress loading system, combines a raw coal sample of a prefabricated drilling hole, more accurately restores a complex underground stress field of a coal mine, and avoids deviation between an evaluation result and an actual working condition. Meanwhile, the method integrates dynamic monitoring and static inspection, and the method can cover from mechanical behavior to seepage characteristic in all directions, so that the defect of the existing single index evaluation is overcome.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING GROUP CHONGQING RESEARCH INST;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Special ignition of training cabin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a special ignition device for a training cabin, which comprises a rack, wherein the rack comprises two parts, a first part of the rack is provided with an air supply system communicated with an external combustion air source, a second part of the rack is provided with a combustion system, and the air supply system is connected with the combustion system through a pipeline provided with a flange. According to the utility model, the fire intensity of the combustion system can be controlled by adjusting the propane flow according to the actual fire-extinguishing training requirements, so that the purpose of meeting the training requirements of different scenes is achieved, and the fire-extinguishing system can be widely applied to the field of fire-fighting and disaster-relief training of ships.
assignees: WUHAN HAIYI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A Risk Management System for Monitoring and Prediction of Hazardous Chemical Substance Risk Situations utilizing Machine Vision
title_ko: 머신비전을 활용한 유해화학물질 모니터링 및 예측을 위한 위험관리시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유해화학물질 취급 현장의 위험을 관리하는 자가 진단 및 자율 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 위험관리시스템은 Wi-SUN Mesh 네트워크 기반 지능형 센서 네트워크부, 영상 데이터 수집부, 중앙 처리 서버를 포함한다. 중앙 처리 서버는 IoT 센서의 시계열 데이터, CCTV 영상의 공간적 특징, 네트워크 상태 데이터를 융합하여 확장된 상태 벡터를 생성하는 다중 소스 데이터 융합부와, 디지털 트윈 환경에서 강화학습을 통해 누적 위험 회피 보상을 최대화하는 최적 대응 정책을 자율 학습하는 강화학습 기반 자율 대응 결정부, 및 실시간 컨텍스트 정보를 반영하여 동적 표준 운영 절차(SOP)를 생성·전파하는 전자 SOP 실행 및 상황 전파부를 포함한다. 
본 발명은 위험 예측 기반 선제적 통신 관리를 통해 골든타임 내 안정적 대응을 보장하며, 사전 정의된 시나리오에 의존하는 종래 기술의 한계를 극복하여 복잡한 재난 상황에서도 진정한 자율 대응을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Real-time emergency detection and customized emergency response system based on wearable device
title_ko: 웨어러블 기기 기반 실시간 응급상황 감지 및 맞춤형 응급대응 시스템
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 기기와 스마트폰을 이용한 AI 기반 실시간 응급상황 감지 및 맞춤형 응급대응 방법에 있어서, (a) 서버가 웨어러블 기기로부터 심박수, 체온, 혈압, 활동량을 포함하는 생체신호를 실시간으로 수신하고, 스마트폰으로부터 GPS 위치 정보 및 가속도 데이터를 수신하는 단계; (b) 서버가 신경망 모델을 이용하여 상기 수신된 생체신호의 시계열 패턴을 분석하고, 사용자별 의료정보를 참조하여 개인화된 임계값과 비교함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계; (c) 서버가 응급상황으로 판단하는 경우, 의사결정 알고리즘을 통해 사용자의 기저질환, 복용약물, 과거 병력을 포함하는 의료정보와 현재 감지된 응급상황 유형을 기반으로 최적화된 응급대응 시나리오를 선택하는 단계; (d) 서버가 선택된 응급대응 시나리오를 스마트폰으로 전송하여, 상기 스마트폰이 TTS(Text-To-Speech) 엔진을 통해 음성으로 변환하고 스피커를 통해 단계별 응급처치 가이드를 출력하도록 제어하는 단계; 및 (e) 서버가 119 응급구조 시스템, 사전 지정된 보호자 단말기, 의료기관 단말기에 사용자의 위치정보와 응급상황 정보를 자동으로 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 할 수 있다.

title_en: Dynamic emergency resource scheduling method, system and medium based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method based on multidimensional data analysis, which belongs to the technical field of emergency management and resource scheduling and comprises the following steps of S1, multidimensional data acquisition and fusion, S2, disaster chain network construction, construction of a disaster chain evolution network model based on data of the step S1, calculation of node degree, medium centrality and weakness, identification of key risk nodes and evolution paths, S3, dynamic risk assessment, quantification of current risk level and prediction of future risk situation, S4, emergency resource optimization scheduling decision, priority blocking of a high risk chain propagation path according to a risk assessment result of the step S3, and scheduling implementation feedback regulation. According to the invention, through effectively fusing multidimensional dynamic information such as real-time weather, infrastructure states, social disaster-bearing bodies and the like, dynamic simulation and risk assessment of a disaster chain evolution rule are actively carried out, disaster spread is effectively controlled, and overall loss is reduced.
assignees: URBAN SAFETY AND ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INST BEIJING INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Flood disaster range monitoring method and system based on satellite remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood disaster range monitoring method and system based on satellite remote sensing images in the technical field of natural disaster monitoring and artificial intelligence intersection, and the method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining a large number of historical SAR satellite remote sensing images to construct a data set, S2, training a flood segmentation model through the data set, optimizing model parameters through a joint loss function in the training process, S3, deploying the trained flood segmentation model, S4, obtaining target SAR satellite remote sensing images, inputting the flood segmentation model to infer so as to obtain a water body distribution map, S5, carrying out differential operation on adjacent water body distribution maps so as to obtain a newly increased flood disaster range, S6, generating a time-sequence flood range map based on each flood disaster range, calculating flood characteristic parameters, and carrying out dynamic monitoring and early warning based on the time-sequence flood range map and the flood characteristic parameters. The flood disaster monitoring system has the advantage that the accuracy and the timeliness of monitoring the flood disaster range are greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SIJI DIGITAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD;BEIJING STATE GRID INFORMATION TELECOMMNICATION GROUP ACCENTURE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Flood forecasting method based on mountain torrent disaster coupling mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrologic simulation and disaster prediction, in particular to a flood forecasting method based on a mountain torrent disaster coupling mechanism, which comprises the following steps that S1, a critical rainfall threshold value for triggering mountain torrents is determined through Bayesian frequency analysis based on historical mountain torrent disaster data and rainfall observation sequences S2, introducing a linear amplification coefficient alpha to quantify the amplification effect of the mountain torrent disasters on river channel flow, and constructing a flood flow correction model, and S3, adopting a heteroscedastic transfer function and a first-order autoregressive model (AR 1) to jointly optimize residual distribution, and eliminating residual heteroscedastic and autocorrelation. The dynamic coupling mechanism of the torrential flood disasters is constructed, the physical consistency of the model is improved, the dynamic influence of the disasters on the flood flow is quantized through the combined action of the critical rainfall threshold and the linear amplification coefficient, the problem of prediction deviation caused by neglecting the torrential flood flow amplification effect in the traditional method is solved, and the model is more attached to the actual hydrologic physical process.
assignees: GUANGXI YOUJIANG WATER RESOURCES DEV CO LTD;PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC RESEARCH INST OF PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Rapid and accurate quantitative evaluation method for coupling effect of power transmission tower line system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid and accurate quantitative evaluation method for coupling effect of a power transmission tower line system, and belongs to the technical field of power engineering structure simulation and safety evaluation. The method comprises the steps of rapidly modeling a power transmission tower, rapidly modeling a power transmission line, rapidly assembling a tower line system formed by three power transmission towers and two transmission lines to obtain a tower line system assembling model, performing high-precision simulation on wind load and applying the wind load to the tower line system assembling model, and performing simulation on the tower line system assembling model to obtain a displacement time course curve at the position of the tower top of the middle tower, so that the coupling effect of the tower line system is rapidly quantitatively evaluated. The method has the advantages of high modeling efficiency, real boundary condition, high wind load loading efficiency and creatively provides coupling effect indexes, and can realize the rapid quantitative evaluation of the coupling effect of the power transmission tower line system with different spans and heights under the action of different wind direction angles. The method is suitable for wind resistance design optimization of high-voltage/extra-high-voltage circuits, safety evaluation of ice-covered areas and disaster chain failure prevention and control.
assignees: XUZHOU HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN CO LTD;XUZHOU HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD INSPECTION BRANCH;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Aviation fire extinguishing simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aviation fire-extinguishing simulation method, belongs to the technical field of aviation emergency rescue, and solves the technical problems that an aviation water-throwing fire-extinguishing effect simulation method in the prior art lacks of systematicness and accuracy and cannot effectively guide resource deployment and strategic planning. The aviation rescue water-throwing fire-extinguishing simulation method integrates various key factors such as airplane type, fire disaster type, meteorological conditions, geographical environment and the like, and can more accurately reflect the actual effectiveness of aviation fire extinguishment.

title_en: Power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery collaborative decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative decision method and a collaborative decision system for power grid cascading failure deduction and elastic recovery, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a state model of each power grid element in extreme weather, and acquiring the state transition probability of each power grid element in continuous time according to the state model; the method comprises the steps of constructing a system cascading failure evolution model under extreme weather according to state transition probability, calculating line real-time outage probability under a wind power grid-connected scene according to the system cascading failure evolution model, constructing an optimal power flow model according to the line real-time outage probability with minimized load shedding amount as a target, simulating a derating operation response process after grid failure to obtain a load reduction strategy of a system under each failure state, establishing a post-disaster emergency recovery model based on the load reduction strategy and system topology constraint, and determining a fault repair time sequence and a load recovery sequence. The invention can obviously improve the risk perception capability, decision scientificity and recovery efficiency of the power grid in an extreme event.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood prevention capacity of transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional quantitative dynamic checking method for flood control capability of a transformer substation based on digital twin and multisource coupling, belongs to the technical field of evaluation and checking of flood control capability of the transformer substation, integrates multidisciplinary theories and technologies such as hydrology, hydraulics, geographical science, artificial intelligence, digital twin and the like, integrates multisource data such as high-resolution satellite remote sensing, unmanned plane laser radar, GIS space analysis, hydrologic monitoring and the like, builds a digital twin and distributed hydrologic-hydrodynamic coupling model of the transformer substation, builds a disaster-causing mechanism three-dimensional quantitative index system covering dangers, expositions and vulnerabilities, realizes a whole-flow technical closed loop from data acquisition-model simulation-quantitative checking-three-dimensional visualization-dynamic early warning, adapts to different scenes such as a lack of data area, a transformed transformer substation and the like, and accurately outputs a transformer substation flood control capability level, a thin-state distribution and flood risk evolution situation, and provides scientific support for flood control reconstruction design and emergency treatment.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INSTITUTE;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing image building segmentation method based on deep learning technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a remote sensing image building segmentation method based on a deep learning technology, which comprises the following steps of (1) collecting and preprocessing remote sensing image data, constructing a training set, a verification set and a test set containing building labels based on the remote sensing image data, (2) constructing a building segmentation model based on an improved HR-Net, (3) introducing a pseudo convolution attention module PCAM into an encoder, (4) introducing a dynamic mixed cavity convolution module DMAC into a decoder, (5) training the building segmentation model by using the training set, and (6) performing performance verification on the trained building segmentation model by using the test set, and outputting a building segmentation result. The invention has the advantages that in sudden disaster relief, the building segmentation model can play the key roles of rapidly positioning a disaster-affected building, evaluating disaster influence, guiding a relief path and distributing relief resources, improve relief efficiency and effect and reduce casualties and property loss.
assignees: QINGDAO LIMAP HI TECH INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Local fire disaster damage simulation device of reticulated shell structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a local fire disaster damage simulation device of a reticulated shell structure, which relates to the technical field of reticulated shell structure testing and comprises a device table, wherein a first motor is fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the device table, the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first gear, the outer surface of the first gear is meshed with a second gear, the lower surface of the second gear is fixedly connected with a gear and penetrates through the device table, and racks are symmetrically meshed on the outer surface of the gear. This local conflagration of net shell structure destroys analogue means, can adjust the position of fixation clamp through the cooperation of third gear and rack, simultaneously, through first gyro wheel and second gyro wheel, realize that the extrusion piece can test net shell structure's different positions, through the cooperation of screw thread gear and screw thread post, can more accurate test net shell structure's tolerance, simultaneously, can be through the display numerical value on the observation scale groove, quick effectual pressure of confirming net shell structure's bearing.

title_en: LiDAR-Based Urban Flood Prediction System and Flood Prediction Method Using the Same
title_ko: 라이다 기반 도시 홍수 예측 시스템 및 이를 이용한 홍수예측방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 LiDAR 데이터를 활용하여 도시의 지형·건물·식생 정보를 정밀 추출하고, 이를 수문·수리모델의 파라미터로 자동 변환함으로써 종래 기술의 경험 의존성과 해상도 민감도 문제를 해소한다. TRI, Porosity, TCC, h_mean 등 구조지표를 dstore_perv, n_perv, K_sat과 직접 매핑하여 예측의 일관성과 정확도를 높이며, PCSWMM과 통합된 시뮬레이션을 통해 홍수심·침수범위·첨두도달시간을 현실적으로 산정할 수 있다. 또한 IoU 기반 공간일치도 평가로 신뢰성을 확보하고, 도시 구조가 홍수 확산에 미치는 영향을 분석하여 도시계획·배수설계·재난대응 등 다양한 정책 의사결정에 활용되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for structuring disaster information based on symbolizing disaster damage progression patterns
title_ko: 재난 피해 전개 양상의 기호화에 기반한 재난 정보의 구조화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 재난의 발생과 이로 인한 피해 상황 시나리오를 시계열적 인과 관계를 기반으로 시각적으로 표현하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 재난 정보 관리 장치가 재난 정보를 구조화하는 방법은, 재난 피해 이력 정보를 입력받고, 입력된 재난 피해 이력 정보로부터 기호화 모델을 이용하여 재난으로 인한 피해의 상황과 흐름을 시나리오의 형태로 시각화함으로써 재난 피해 시나리오를 생성하며, 기호화 모델은 위험요인(Hazard), 노출(Exposure) 및 영향(impact)으로 분류된 구성요소로 표시된다.

title_en: Integrated control system for smart safety management
title_ko: 스마트 안전 관리 통합 관제 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 안전 관리 통합 관제 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 실시 예에 따른 스마트 안전 관리 통합 관제 시스템은, 디지털 트윈으로 분석된 건물의 3D 모델에 포함되는 복수의 이동경로에 대한 대피 시뮬레이션의 수행 결과 및 CCTV 카메라로 촬영한 복수의 이동경로에 대한 CCTV 영상 분석을 통해 산출한 군중 밀집도를 기반으로 복수의 이동경로 중 최적의 대피경로를 생성하는 대피경로 관리 모듈과, 건물로부터 수집한 환경 센싱 데이터를 디지털 트윈에서 분석하여 건물의 물리적 자산 및 시설물 관리에 필요한 인프라 관리 데이터를 생성하는 인프라 관리 모듈과, 건물의 주변 및 내부의 CCTV 영상 분석을 통하여 객체를 식별하고 객체가 이상행동을 수행함을 탐지함에 따라 객체의 이상행동 영상 및 캡셔닝된 텍스트를 포함하는 이상행동 탐지 데이터를 생성하는 이상행동 탐지 모듈과, CCTV 영상 분석을 통하여 건물 내의 위험 지역을 출입하는 작업자에 대한 안전장비 착용 점검, 출입 통제, 출입 기록 및 실시간 모니터링을 통해 출입 관리 데이터를 생성하는 출입 관리 모듈을 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: I CAPTAIN CO LTD;KOREA MACHINE EQUIPMENT INC

title_en: Smart disaster monitoring and prediction system
title_ko: 스마트 재난감시 및 예측시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난을 감시하고 예측하기 위한 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 다양한 재난상황에 대하여 종합적으로 대응할 수 없는 한계가 있었던 종래기술의 재난예측 시스템 및 방법들의 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 각종 재난감시 기관들로부터 제공되는 공공데이터로부터 각종 재난발생 정보를 수집하고, 인터넷 뉴스기사 등의 민간데이터에 대한 데이터 크롤링을 통해 각종 재난발생 정보를 수집하여 특정 시설이나 지역에 대한 각종 재난발생을 감시하고 인접지역에서 재난상황의 확산에 따른 위험여부를 예측하는 처리가 수행되도록 구성됨으로써, 공공데이터와 민간데이터의 결합을 통해 다양한 재난상황의 발생을 종합적으로 감시하고 위험상황을 예측하여 각종 재난으로 인한 피해를 보다 효과적으로 방지할 수 있도록 구성되는 스마트 재난감시 및 예측시스템과, 이를 이용하여 각종 재난상황에 대한 대비훈련을 수행할 수 있도록 구성되는 재난대비 훈련시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Smart earthquake measurement monitoring system to be connected to measuring instruments and apparatus based on IoT device equipped with sensor
title_ko: 센서와 IoT 디바이스 기반 계측기와 연동된 스마트 지진 계측  감시 시스템
abstract_ko:
센서와 IoT 디바이스 기반 계측기와 연동된 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템이 개시된다. 센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 지진 발생 시, 안전 관리 대상 시설, 위험 시설, 건물, 댐, 교량 등의 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점에 설치되며, 진동/변형률/변위/경사/균열 중 어느 적어도 하나 이상의 감지 신호를 감지하는 센서와 제어부와 저장부와 통신부를 구비하는 계측기; 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점의 센서를 구비한 계측기의 설치 위치별로, 실시간으로 진동/변형률/변위/경사/균열 멀티센싱 융합 신호를 센서 설치 위치별 빅 데이터를 수집하고 분석하여 계측 데이터와 지진 재난 위험 이상 징후를 판단하며, 상기 계측 데이터의 관리 임계치 초과 시 알람 이벤트를 발생하여 긴급하게 경보를 발생하고, 지진 발생 정보와 위치와 시간, 계측 데이터의 통계 정보를 제공하며, 안전 감시 대상 시설 및 위험 요소 분석, 지진 재난 위험 예측 시뮬레이션을 제공하는 지진 계측 감시 시스템; 및 상기 지진 계측 감시 시스템에 유무선 통신망을 연동되는 사용자 단말을 포함한다.  
센서를 구비한 IoT 디바이스 기반 스마트 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 안전 관리 대상 시설, 건물, 댐과 교량, 도로, 지진 발생 지역 등의 위치에서 지진 가속도계, 변형률계, 변위계, 경사계, 균열계 등의 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점에 설치된 센서가 탑재된 IoT 디바이스로부터 여러 지역의 다 측정 지점의 지진동 신호를 IoT 디바이스의 통신부을 통해 지진 계측 감시 시스템으로 전송하며, 지진 계측 감시 시스템은 계측 데이터 빅 데이터를 분석하여 통합 대시 보드에 표시하며 계측 데이터의 임계치 초과 시 지진 발생 몇 분 전에 알람 경보를 발생하며, 빅 데이터 분석을 통해 지진 발생 정보와 계측 데이터의 통계 정보를 데이터 시각화하여 제공하여 신속하게 지진 재난대응 조치를 취하여 원자력 발전소 등의 안전 관리 대상 시설, 위험 시설 점검, 건물 붕괴, 댐 붕괴, 교량 파괴, 도로 파손으로부터 시설과 재산 및 인명 피해를 줄이게 되었다.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for generating an emergency response scenario using generative artificial intelligence; means for constructing a virtual environment based on the scenario using virtual reality technology; means for recording user behavior; and means for evaluating the behavior and providing an evaluation result as feedback.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Estimation method, estimation system, and program
abstract_en: To provide an estimation method or the like capable of accurately estimating a sediment disaster risk area at an arbitrary point including a point where a building does not exist in the vicinity.SOLUTION: The estimation method is executed by an estimation system 1 for estimating a landslide disaster risk area C on a map image P having topographical information and building information. The estimation system 1 includes a training step of inputting a map image P and performing training of a deep learning model 10 that determines whether or not each point on the map image P to be input is a landslide disaster risk area C using a training image set TR that is a set of a map image T for training and a designated image R indicating a landslide disaster risk area C on the map image T, an image generation step of generating a composite image CP in which a virtual building image BI is added to a part of the map image P to be estimated, and a determination step of inputting the composite image CP to the deep learning model 10 and determining whether or not each point on the map image P to be estimated is a landslide disaster risk area C.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis
abstract_en: A virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis belongs to a virtual environment simulation technology, and comprises a fire-fighting rescue robot performance simulation, a fire-fighting rescue scene virtualization simulation and a performance analysis method. The invention solves the problems of robot humanization simulation, firefighting rescue scene virtualization simulation, performance test and the like, and provides a test basis for later development and shaping of robots.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM;UNIV NANKAI

title_en: Geophysical-based mine water distribution prediction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geophysical-based mine water distribution prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a time sequence signal of resistivity data acquired by a mine area by a direct current resistivity method, carrying out feature extraction on the mine area resistivity data time sequence signal obtained in a monitoring period to obtain feature information, constructing a weighted feature vector according to the feature information and dividing according to a time window to form a structured time sequence matrix, obtaining a mature prediction model according to the time sequence matrix through joint training, predicting an area where water damage is likely to occur, developing a set of visual monitoring prediction working system, reflecting the monitoring prediction result obtained by the underground system to a ground dispatching center in real time, and facilitating the development of real-time rescue dispatching by ground personnel. The method can rapidly and accurately predict the water inrush accident possibly existing on the coal seam working face, further realize the dynamic disaster early warning in the coal mine production work and guarantee the safe production. The method is used for predicting the specific condition of the mine water disaster.

title_en: Deformation monitoring and early warning method and system for slope disaster early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformation monitoring and early warning method and system for slope disaster early warning, wherein the system comprises a geological grid and mark layout module, an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection planning module, a model training module, an early warning judging module, a matching degree interval, a normal, concerned and early warning interval, a fixed triggering condition, three-time concerned and starting encryption inspection, and single early warning triggering alarm. The invention can timely start encryption inspection or early warning according to the matching degree interval and the triggering condition, and effectively ensures the accuracy and timeliness of slope safety monitoring.

title_en: Face mining speed determination under rock burst mine stress and energy dual constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the mining speed of a working face under the double constraint of stress and energy of a rock burst mine, which comprises the steps of firstly, determining the propelling speed of the working face under the loading and unloading action of mining stress domination; the method comprises the steps of determining the advancing speed of a working face under the loading action of the fracture leading of the overburden, assigning weights under different types of constraints, determining water injection weakening coefficients, determining drilling pressure relief coefficients, determining coal and rock attribute regulation coefficients, and determining the mining speed of the working face under the double constraints of rock burst mines. The method adopts multi-source data fusion to realize quantitative diagnosis of disaster types, determines static load safety speed through loading and unloading rock mechanics experiments aiming at mining stress, inverts dynamic load safety speed through physical similarity simulation experiments aiming at overburden fracture, and finally synthesizes a decision mathematical model to output a complete algorithm system of scientific propulsion speed through a working face mining speed formula under double restriction of rock burst mines.

title_en: Risk assessment method and device for ice-breaking jump of power transmission line, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of power grids, and particularly relates to a risk assessment method and device for ice-breaking jump of a power transmission line, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining risk influence factors influencing ice-removing jumping of a power transmission line, constructing an original parameter data set comprising a plurality of ice-removing working conditions, establishing a wire ice-removing model under the ice-removing working conditions, performing simulation to obtain risk result indexes, constructing a standardized decision matrix, respectively calculating the contrast intensity and conflict of each risk influence factor, calculating the comprehensive information quantity and objective weight of each risk influence factor to obtain an objective weight vector, identifying key leading factors based on the objective weight vector, and combining the risk result indexes under the ice-removing working conditions to perform working condition optimization to obtain the optimal ice-removing working condition with the lowest comprehensive risk. The CRITIC method is applied to the ice-removing jump risk assessment of the power transmission line, and is favorable for selecting ice-removing working conditions with small risk.
assignees: EAST CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rock burst danger space-time early warning method and system based on multi-source image data fusion, storage media and equipment, wherein 1, multi-source heterogeneous data are acquired, 2, data preprocessing, 3, gridding cloud pictures of various data are constructed, 4, a rock burst early warning model based on an MSA-Unet encoder-decoder network structure is constructed, 5, model training and optimization are carried out, 6, early warning areas and data are dynamically updated, 7, end-to-end reasoning is carried out to generate a rock burst danger early warning cloud picture, and 8, a cyclic early warning mechanism taking time or a footage distance as a trigger condition is established. The multi-source heterogeneous data are converted into uniform image representation, so that the problem of multi-source data fusion and utilization of rock burst disaster geological data, microseismic monitoring data and the like is solved, meanwhile, the rock burst danger early warning and evaluation of the advanced area of the mining working face are realized based on the space-time division of the data, and the rock burst danger space-time dynamic early warning of the coal mining working face is realized.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Method for judging fracturing multi-parameter effect of top plate directional long drill Kong Shuili
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety exploitation and roof disaster prevention and control, and discloses a roof directional long drill Kong Shuili fracturing multi-parameter effect judging method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining surrounding rock background data before fracturing, carrying out real-time dynamic monitoring by using pressure flow, water reflection and microseismic in fracturing, carrying out static comparison and judgment by using transient electromagnetism and peeping after fracturing, and verifying pressure relief effect by using bracket resistance and microseismic data in a stoping stage. And finally, cross verification is carried out from the fracturing radius, the pressure relief effect and the water injection effectiveness dimension based on multi-parameter data. The method realizes double-period accurate monitoring during fracturing and recovery, overcomes the limitation of single means evaluation, and improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of discrimination of the roof fracturing effect.

title_en: Fire extinguishing test system and method for offshore platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire fighting of offshore platforms, in particular to a fire extinguishing test system and a fire extinguishing test method for offshore platforms; the fire disaster model can simulate the combustion characteristics and fire disaster scenes of various combustible matters, and can be used for carrying out tests aiming at the fire disaster situations of various combustible matters, and the tests can obtain key parameters such as combustion behavior, fire spreading speed, heat release and the like of the different combustible matters in the fire disaster, so that scientific basis is provided for parameter setting of a fire disaster fire extinguishing system of the turbofan.
assignees: SHENGDONG RUDONG OFFSHORE WIND POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;HUANENG POWER INT JIANGSU ENERGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD CLEAN ENERGY BRANCH;HUANENG OFFSHORE WIND POWER SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Ammonia fuel safety control system
abstract_en: The central safety control unit of the invention is used as an intelligent brain, integrates data from five core link monitoring modules of filling, storing, air supplying, consuming and discharging, and receives signals of a global environment monitoring network covering a full ship dangerous area. Based on the real-time information, the central control unit performs risk simulation and evaluation through a built-in digital twin risk early warning model, drives a linkage emergency response executing mechanism and executes accurate emergency actions. The high-efficiency ammonia leakage neutralization treatment module is integrated, and the safety and the efficiency of leakage emergency treatment are greatly improved by combining a directional water curtain and a negative pressure drainage technology. The safety challenges of the ammonia fuel ship in the aspects of complexity, toxicity and corrosiveness are systematically solved, and key safety guarantee is provided for decarburization in the shipping industry.

title_en: Model training method, disaster information processing method and equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a model training method, a disaster information processing method and equipment, wherein the model training method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of disaster element reference texts and a plurality of dialogue samples respectively related to the plurality of disaster element reference texts, wherein the plurality of dialogue samples comprise at least one dialogue sentence with expression defects, simulating a disaster reporting party and a disaster processing model to simulate a disaster wiring party through a large language model based on the disaster element reference texts and the plurality of dialogue samples for each disaster element reference text, executing multiple simulation tasks of disaster reporting to obtain a task track group related to the disaster element reference texts, wherein each simulation task comprises a disaster reporting dialogue, disaster element extraction and scoring of the disaster processing model, and carrying out parameter adjustment on the disaster processing model according to the plurality of task track groups. Therefore, a disaster situation processing model capable of carrying out efficient dialogue and improving information processing accuracy is provided for disaster situation reporting dialogue and disaster situation information processing.

title_en: Drought and waterlogging emergency disaster simulation test method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drought and waterlogging emergency disaster simulation test method and system, which are applied to the technical field of drought and waterlogging stress research. The method comprises the following steps of formulating an index system of drought grade division and waterlogging standard, setting control variables of drought and waterlogging, planting winter wheat in a barrel-measuring cultivation mode, setting a cultivation scheme, adopting a drought-first waterlogging-later stress mode, firstly applying drought stress, then converting into waterlogging stress, recovering conventional water management after completing a complete drought-waterlogging alternate stress period, measuring growth character indexes, wheat yield indexes, water level dynamic, drought tolerance, meteorological elements and wheat quality of the winter wheat in a test process, and checking data significance by using a principal component analysis method. According to the invention, the growth characteristics and yield factor data of winter wheat are tracked and determined through a drought and waterlogging emergency disaster simulation test, and a data base is provided for analysis of the influence rule of drought and waterlogging stress on the growth characteristics and yield of winter wheat.

title_en: Medical building horizontal and vertical conversion standardized design method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a standardized design method and system for medical building horizontal and vertical conversion, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving original input parameters of medical building horizontal and vertical conversion, combining a preset standard parameter library, automatically cleaning and mapping the original input parameters, outputting structural calculation parameters, calling a space planning engine to operate based on the structural calculation parameters to generate an initial space layout scheme, calling an electromechanical configuration engine to operate based on the structural calculation parameters to generate the initial electromechanical configuration scheme, constructing a quantized balance model containing time, cost and risk indexes, taking the quantized balance model as an optimization objective function, performing collaborative iterative computation on the initial space layout scheme and the electromechanical configuration scheme to generate a candidate design scheme set, performing automatic compound rule verification and performance simulation on the candidate design scheme set, screening out an optimal scheme and outputting structural design results, and remarkably improving emergency response efficiency of a medical building.

title_en: Pollutant diffusion determination method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a pollutant determination method, a pollutant determination device, pollutant determination equipment and pollutant determination medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing an initial multi-medium diffusion simulation model based on basic behavior parameters of various pollutants and environmental medium information of an area to be monitored, acquiring preset extreme climate events, adjusting medium diffusion coefficients and medium migration coefficients in the initial multi-medium diffusion simulation model based on the preset extreme climate events to obtain a corrected simulation model, simulating to obtain three-dimensional concentration distribution of the various pollutants in all environmental mediums of the area to be monitored based on the corrected simulation model, determining comprehensive risk indexes of the various pollutants based on the three-dimensional concentration distribution, generating a pollutant risk thermodynamic diagram representing risk levels of the area to be monitored, and generating corresponding early warning information in response to the risk index of any pollutant in the risk thermodynamic diagram exceeding a preset threshold. The application can improve the space-time resolution and emergency response capability of the multi-medium pollution risk early warning.

title_en: Urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering function decline of water treatment plant
abstract_en: An urban water supply system earthquake resistance evaluation method considering the function decline of a water treatment plant belongs to the technical field of urban water supply network earthquake resistance analysis. The method comprises the following steps of utilizing Monte Carlo to simulate sampling, generating earthquake damage scenes of various pipelines in the water supply network under the action of an earthquake, quantitatively determining the residual functional state of the water treatment plant after the earthquake through the vulnerability curve of the water treatment plant, establishing a coupling analysis model of the water treatment plant and the water supply network, realizing the coupling of the functional change between the water treatment plant and the network, integrating the damage of the network and the functional attenuation of the water treatment plant, and calculating the earthquake resistance index of the urban water supply system. The method quantitatively reflects the function attenuation of the water plant after earthquake by introducing the vulnerability curve of the water plant, and combines the water plant-pipe network coupling model, so that the whole earthquake resistance of the urban water supply system under earthquake disasters can be more scientifically and comprehensively estimated, and the method has important theoretical and practical significance for guiding earthquake resistance design, toughness improvement and emergency decision of the urban water supply system.

title_en: Landslide body water-entering surging overall process simulation method
abstract_en: The application relates to a landslide body water-entering surge whole process simulation method which comprises the following steps of establishing a geometric modeling and calculating domain, establishing a geometric model of the calculating domain in three-dimensional modeling software based on actual topographic data, dividing and locally encrypting grids of the calculating domain, setting physical models and material parameters, setting a discrete meta model in the EDEM, establishing a particle model of the landslide body, setting a fluid dynamic model in Fluent, setting EDEM-Fluent coupling, establishing bidirectional coupling through a coupling interface of the EDEM and Fluent, setting initial conditions and boundary conditions in the Fluent and the EDEM respectively, starting an EDEM and Fluent solver simultaneously for transient coupling calculation, and carrying out post-processing and result analysis, wherein the whole surge disaster chain process is estimated through analysis carried out in the EDEM and Fluent post-processing respectively.

title_en: Management system of cluster energy storage equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system of cluster energy storage equipment, which comprises a data acquisition module, a probability prediction module, a system simulation module, a safety management module and a safety management module, wherein the data acquisition module determines the arrangement state of the energy storage equipment, collects state data of each energy storage equipment unit in real time, the probability prediction module predicts fire risks of the energy storage equipment units, determines various emergency conditions and probability weights corresponding to the various emergency conditions, the system simulation module constructs a simulation model of the cluster energy storage equipment, performs simulation analysis under various emergency conditions through multiple physical fields, determines the spreading trend of disaster conditions under the various emergency conditions, and the safety management module generates a corresponding emergency response plan according to simulation results and controls the safety management equipment deployed on the cluster energy storage equipment when the disaster occurs. The invention provides a cluster energy storage equipment management system capable of real-time monitoring, accurate prediction, scientific simulation and effective management, fills the blank of the prior art, and meets the urgent need of energy storage equipment safety management.
assignees: HUANENG CLEAN ENERGY RESEARCH INST;HUANENG POWER INT INC SHANGHAI SHIDONGKOU SECOND POWER FACOTRY;HUANENG LONGDONG ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Railway disaster knowledge graph intelligent construction method based on fine tuning Qwen model
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of knowledge graph construction and discloses an intelligent construction method of a railway disaster knowledge graph based on a fine tuning Qwen model. The method comprises the steps of carrying out format unified conversion and deep cleaning on a multi-source railway disaster text to obtain sentence-level corpus, inputting Qwen a model, carrying out triple crude extraction, carrying out fine adjustment training by adopting a LoRA low-rank adaptation method, carrying out batch reasoning on the whole corpus, carrying out de-duplication standardization according to a minimum editing distance and Jaccard similarity fusion algorithm, and importing a Neo4j graph database to construct a railway disaster knowledge graph. The application improves the automation degree, knowledge extraction accuracy and map structure normalization of the construction of the railway disaster knowledge map.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;CHINA RAILWAY ZHENGZHOU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Flood vulnerability identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrology and discloses a method and a system for identifying flood liability, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flood point data, initially constructing a meteorological factor, a topography factor and an environmental factor data set which influence flood, screening factors which influence flood liability through Spearman rank correlation coefficient, tolerance and variance expansion factor, evaluating flood liability of a research area through an information quantity model to obtain a disaster liability partition map, selecting non-flood points in a low-incidence area and a lower-incidence area to construct a non-flood point data set, constructing a coupling information quantity model and a machine-learned flood liability model by utilizing the flood points and the non-flood point data, constructing a sample set of the non-flood data and the flood data, identifying an optimal flood liability model, and constructing a flood liability model from two angles of uncertainty of model simulation and uncertainty of data according to the invention and research on flood protection of different decision areas.

title_en: VOD remote sensing data downscaling model construction method based on physical constraint
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and remote sensing science and technology, and particularly discloses a physical constraint-based VOD remote sensing data downscaling model construction method, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting SMAP-IB VOD and SM data and multisource driving variables; preprocessing, generating a daily NDVI by adopting a FSDAF algorithm, calculating physical parameters based on RTM, simulating a transmission process of a microwave signal, constructing a PIDNet model, training the model through a joint loss function, and generating 1 km high-resolution VOD data. The method solves the problems that the spatial resolution of the existing VOD product is low (9-36 km) and the downscaling result lacks physical consistency, and the generated 1 km VOD has fine spatial details and physical credibility, can support the scenes of field-scale agricultural moisture management, community-scale ecological hydrologic simulation and the like, and provides high-quality data support for global carbon circulation assessment and drought disaster monitoring.
assignees: Hubei Luojia Laboratory;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Geological disaster engineering investigation rig stabilising arrangement
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a stabilizer for a geological disaster engineering investigation drilling machine, which comprises a support frame, a sliding frame and a fixing component, wherein the support frame comprises a guide cylinder and a bottom plate, the fixing component is connected with the bottom plate in a matched manner, a limit bolt is screwed through the depth of the bottom plate according to the state of the surface of a stratum so as to ensure the balance and stability of the position of the bottom plate, a buffer cushion is arranged at the bottom of the limit bolt and is supported on the surface of the stratum, the support frame and the sliding frame are provided with a buffer shock protection function during the operation of the drilling machine, an anchor nail extends into and is fixed in the surface of the stratum, a limit rope is connected between the anchor nail and an adjacent positioning bolt, the bottom plate is pressed down by the limit rope, the stability of the fixation of the bottom plate is improved, the stabilizer is also applicable to the state of the stratum with gradient, and the drilling machine axially moves along the guide cylinder through the sliding frame so as to ensure the stability and controllability of the drilling direction.
assignees: HUBEI GEOLOGICAL EXPLORATION INST OF SINOCHEM GEOLOGICAL AND MINING ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation image generation system, method and medium suitable for well site
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional simulation image generation system, a method and a medium suitable for well sites, which relate to the technical field of petroleum drilling, wherein the system comprises a position acquisition module and a data processing center which are connected in sequence; the system comprises a well site, a position acquisition module, a data processing center and a three-dimensional modeling software, wherein the well site is used for acquiring a target position and a parameter corresponding to an infrastructure in the well site respectively, and the data processing center is used for generating a three-dimensional simulation image based on the target position, the parameter and the three-dimensional modeling software. Therefore, on one hand, the accuracy of the three-dimensional simulation image is improved, and meanwhile, the overall layout and equipment distribution condition of the drilling site can be visually and three-dimensionally checked, so that more accurate virtual inspection and operation planning are performed, the operation efficiency and the safety are improved, the layout and the logistics cost of the infrastructure are optimized, and the emergency response capability is enhanced. On the other hand, remote monitoring and command scheduling are supported, management efficiency is improved, and intelligent and digital transformation of drilling operation is promoted.
assignees: SINOPEC OILFIELD SERVICE CORP;SINOPEC SHENGLI PETROLEUM ENG CO LTD;INTELLIGENT INFORMATION TECH SUPPORT CENTER OF SINOPEC SHENGLI PETROLEUM ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Thunderstorm early-warning model training and thunderstorm early-warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of meteorological disaster early warning, and discloses a thunderstorm early warning model training method and a thunderstorm early warning method and device, wherein the thunderstorm early warning model training method comprises the steps of acquiring a historical thunderstorm data set of a region to be predicted; the method comprises the steps of respectively analyzing thunderstorm record data of each thunderstorm to obtain thunderstorm characteristics of each thunderstorm, wherein the thunderstorm characteristics comprise spatial thunderstorm characteristics at a plurality of moments and time sequence thunderstorm characteristics at a plurality of characteristic positions, the spatial thunderstorm characteristics are constructed according to distances between each monitoring site and the coordinates of the center of mass of the thunderstorm and monitoring data sets of each monitoring site, the time sequence thunderstorm characteristics are constructed according to the monitoring data sets of the characteristic positions at different moments, a training set is established according to the thunderstorm characteristics of each thunderstorm and thunderstorm early-warning parameters, and a preset model is trained by using the training set to obtain a thunderstorm prediction model. According to the invention, through double analysis of thunderstorm data in time sequence and space, accuracy of thunderstorm prediction is increased, and further, the thunderstorm early warning efficiency is improved.
assignees: HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for constructing prediction model of locust adAN_SNtive area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for constructing a prediction model of a locust adAN_SNtive area, and relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and animal husbandry. The method comprises the steps of constructing a maximum entropy model based on a monitoring index set, constructing a training sample based on a sample value set of the monitoring index set in a sample area and a label of whether locust disasters exist in the sample area, and training the maximum entropy model based on the training sample to obtain a prediction model of a locust-suitable area. The method constructs the maximum entropy model based on the monitoring index set, realizes the accurate simulation of the relationship between the space-time distribution of the locusts and the monitoring index, and is beneficial to improving the prediction accuracy of the prediction model of the subsequent locusts suitable zone. The prediction model of the locust-suitable area can accurately predict the occurrence of locust disasters in a large space range, and improves the efficiency and the accuracy of monitoring the locust disasters.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INST CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: BIM and virtual interaction-based gas accident disaster simulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas accident disaster simulation and discloses a method and a system for simulating gas accident disaster based on BIM and virtual interaction. The method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time acquisition signals of electric equipment, a gas sensor and a temperature sensor in a region to be tested, executing disaster simulation operation based on an evaluation model when abnormal signals are identified, outputting simulation evaluation results, checking the simulation evaluation results to output evaluation results with credibility, constructing an evaluation model by extracting common information of known gas accidents, and determining evaluation nodes based on equipment grades to load the corresponding evaluation model. According to the invention, by constructing the evaluation model, executing differentiated disaster simulation operation and checking the result, accurate sensing and early warning of disaster precursors are realized, and the accuracy and reliability of the evaluation result are ensured.

title_en: Post-disaster Internet of vehicles resource allocation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster internet of vehicles resource allocation method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance, which relates to the technical field of internet of vehicles, and comprises the steps of firstly constructing a system model integrating perception, communication and calculation, establishing an optimization problem aiming at the perception task completion rate, and solving by jointly optimizing a vehicle scheduling sequence and a task unloading proportion; the problem is modeled as a Markov decision process, and an improved TD3 algorithm, namely ACBC-TD3 algorithm, is adopted to solve, so that early strategy convergence is effectively accelerated, and training stability is enhanced. The invention suppresses the Q value overestimation through the double Critic network structure and the delay updating mechanism, improves the initial exploration efficiency through behavior cloning, and improves the performance after convergence through the self-adaptive optimization mechanism and the cosine annealing strategy. Experiments show that the method can obviously improve the task completion rate and the system resource utilization efficiency in a post-disaster emergency scene, and has good application prospect.

title_en: Mobile life detection method, system and device based on migration learning mechanism and UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile life detection method, a system and a device based on a migration learning mechanism and a UWB radar, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and emergency rescue, and have the technical key points that the mobile life detection method and the system construct a simulation-migration-real-time reasoning technical system, generate a large amount of diversified training data with labels through high-fidelity physical simulation, and pre-train a deep neural network model by utilizing the data; after the mobile platform enters a real disaster site, the invention adopts a transfer learning technology, and the pre-training model can be quickly fine-tuned by only collecting data of a very small amount of non-living areas on site or simply calibrating the data, so that the model is suitable for the current special environment. In this way, the invention can realize high-precision mobile life detection and provide powerful support for emergency rescue work.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue multi-level off-site collaborative command training method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine emergency rescue multi-level remote collaborative command training method and system, which belong to the technical field of emergency rescue training and comprise the steps of integrating a disaster physical engine based on a mine three-dimensional model, simulating dynamic changes of disaster conditions to construct a digital twin model of a dynamic disaster scene, generating tactical advice and rescue behavior options according to mine emergency rescue terms and a historical case library, generating simulated different rescue schemes according to the tactical advice and the rescue behavior options by the digital twin model, evaluating the rescue schemes by using a tactical evaluation algorithm, generating a quantized comparison report, deploying a main control engine, uniformly managing global logic and data, generating a multi-terminal collaborative sand table interactive tactic according to the quantized comparison report, acquiring cross-department disaster conditions and resource states in real time, improving the feasibility of the plan, synchronizing tactical decisions and execution, and reducing the cost of the plan exercise and reproduction.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command training guiding method and system based on rule engine
abstract_en: The application discloses a rule engine-based mine emergency rescue command training guiding method and system, which belong to the technical field of emergency rescue training and comprise the steps of obtaining mine rescue history cases, calculating case similarity of the history cases based on disaster condition features and environmental features, generating a case database according to calculation results, structuring the history cases in the case database, carrying out rule regulation on mine rescue rule terms, constructing a rule base, generating dynamic treatment flow guiding mechanisms according to various rules in the rule base, generating prefabricated typical case flow templates of different mine disasters based on the dynamic treatment flow guiding mechanisms, selecting the prefabricated typical case flow templates by a user, automatically loading corresponding rules and physical parameters by the system, generating corresponding mine emergency rescue treatment flows, realizing intelligent guiding of the mine emergency rescue command training treatment flows, improving the authenticity and effectiveness of training exercises, and improving the standardized operation capability of rescue workers.

title_en: Construction method and system of ice coating analysis database of micro-topography micro-meteorological transmission line
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method and a construction system of an icing analysis database of a micro-terrain micro-meteorological transmission line, and relates to the technical fields of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems and electric network meteorological application. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on original DEM data and original analysis meteorological data of a complex mountain area to obtain a basic data set, carrying out dynamic downscaling simulation by taking re-analysis meteorological data in the basic data set as a large-scale background field and boundary conditions and taking DEM data in the basic data set as a terrain forcing field, carrying out vertical gradient correction aiming at the actual height of a power transmission line based on boundary layer theory, extracting micro-topography factors of a corridor area of the power transmission line, carrying out local micro-scale topography effect correction by utilizing the micro-topography factors, and constructing an icing analysis database of the power transmission line based on the micro-topography factors and the high space-time resolution analysis meteorological data. The method solves the problem that the existing icing prediction of the complex mountain area is low in accuracy and precision.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic system toughness enhancement and restoration method based on safe linear interval
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for enhancing and recovering toughness of an urban traffic system based on a safe linear interval, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a time-varying traffic network diagram of an urban road network, identifying bottleneck links of each OD pair, defining limiting links, calculating demand weighting coefficients of the limiting links, providing the safe linear interval for describing the change rule of link quality improvement contribution to network toughness in different intervals, establishing a linear relation between link quality improvement quantity and toughness gain in the safe linear interval, combining the demand weighting coefficients and static connectivity, optimizing weight parameters of a matrix by combining a double-objective optimization method, thereby constructing a traffic network weight matrix, simulating node competition interaction, identifying key nodes, and finally simulating node removal and recovery processes. The invention quantitatively improves the disturbance rejection and recovery capacity of the urban road traffic system, and provides a unified and efficient toughness enhancement and recovery scheme for daily disturbance and post-disaster interruption.

title_en: Active prevention and control method for deep water shallow layer flow drilling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active prevention and control method for deep water shallow layer flow drilling, which belongs to the technical field of petroleum exploitation and aims to solve the problem that a well wall is easy to collapse after a shallow layer flow stratum is drilled, wherein the active prevention and control method for deep water shallow layer flow drilling comprises a first mode or a second mode, the active prevention and control method for deep water shallow layer flow drilling is used by matching a drilling tool, a casing pipe, a well cementation cement slurry system and the like, the casing pipe and a drill bit enter the shallow layer flow stratum at the same time, the safety and the efficiency of drilling the shallow layer flow stratum can be effectively improved, a shallow layer flow section is effectively sealed, the stability of the well wall is improved, and disasters caused by high shallow layer flow pressure are actively prevented and controlled. Thereby realizing safe and efficient drilling of shallow water flow stratum in the drilling process.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;CNPC ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY R & D CO LIMITED;CHINA NAT OIL AND GAS EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT LTD

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for monitoring and early warning of earthquake safety of dam and evaluating earthquake damage
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam earthquake safety monitoring and early warning and earthquake damage assessment method, a system, equipment and a medium, which belong to the technical field of dam safety monitoring and comprise the steps of adopting a time domain time-varying mode identification method to process vibration observation data in real time, extracting time-varying mode parameters of a dam and storing the time-varying mode parameters into a time-varying mode library, assessing the safety state of a dam structure according to the time-varying mode parameters, extracting earthquake source information according to earthquake early warning information, predicting earthquake vibration characteristic parameters, judging whether the earthquake source information is in a strong earthquake simulation library, directly calling a corresponding dam earthquake response simulation result when the earthquake source information is in the library, determining optimal input earthquake vibration through similarity matching when the earthquake source information is not in the library, calling the corresponding simulation result to serve as early warning information, extracting earthquake vibration time course characteristics according to dam foundation actual measurement earthquake vibration data, and carrying out earthquake damage rapid assessment by combining the time-varying mode parameters and an earthquake vulnerability function. The method realizes real-time monitoring of the structural state of the dam, rapid early warning of earthquake disasters and rapid evaluation after earthquake.
assignees: FUJIAN HUADIAN FURUI ENERGY DEV CO LTD ANSHA HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT

title_en: Ground-air transient electromagnetic data rapid inversion method based on long-short-time memory network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration and discloses a ground-air transient electromagnetic data rapid inversion method based on a long-short-term memory network, which comprises the following steps of constructing a ground-air transient electromagnetic training data set, generating resistivity and thickness parameters through a random layered model, and generating corresponding transient electromagnetic response data based on forward modeling; the training data set is preprocessed, including normalization, time sequence remodeling and data set division, and a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention mixed neural network model is constructed, wherein the model comprises a CNN feature extraction module, a BiLSTM time sequence modeling module, an Attention mechanism module and a Seq2Seq decoder module which are connected in sequence. According to the ground-air transient electromagnetic data rapid inversion method based on the long-short-time memory network, the trained network is utilized for reasoning, the single-measuring-point inversion time can be shortened to the second level, the traditional interpretation period of several days is compressed to the hour level, and the response speed of geological disaster monitoring and investigation is greatly improved.
assignees: SHAANXI GEOLOGY AND MINING GEOPHYSICAL AND GEOCHEMICAL PROSPECTING TEAM CO LTD

title_en: Causal inference method and causal inference system for agricultural meteorological disaster loss evaluation
abstract_en: A causal inference method and system for evaluating agricultural meteorological disaster loss belong to the field of agricultural meteorological disaster prevention and reduction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source space-time data comprising time sequence data, static data, disaster data and crop yield observation values, carrying out time sequence processing on the time sequence data to generate depth time sequence characteristics, generating attention weights corresponding to time steps in the time sequence data through a multi-head self-attention mechanism, inputting the depth time sequence characteristics and the static data into a first regression for training, carrying out time step weighting on the time sequence data according to the attention weights, inputting the time sequence data and the static data into a second regression for training, carrying out interpretation analysis on the second regression by adopting an SHAP interpreter, quantifying the influence of environmental characteristics on the yield, taking the disaster data as intervention variables, taking the time sequence data and the static data as the covariates, and carrying out causal effect evaluation according to the intervention variables, the covariates and the crop yield observation values to obtain corresponding crop yield variation under different disaster grades.
assignees: INST OF ENVIRONMENT AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT IN AGRICULTURE CHINESE ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL SCIEN

title_en: Underground space energy management system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The application provides an underground space energy management system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a data processing module, a disaster prevention prediction module and a disaster prevention management module, wherein the data processing module is used for collecting operation data and layout data of an energy system of an underground space, constructing a digital twin body according to the operation data, the layout data and a preset simulation model, the disaster prevention prediction module is used for carrying out simulation deduction on a monitored disaster scene through the digital twin body to generate a disaster prevention prediction report, and the disaster prevention management module is used for generating a disaster prevention scheduling strategy according to the disaster prevention prediction report.

title_en: Nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on self-adaptive depth assimilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on a self-adaptive depth assimilation network, which comprises a data receiving module, an initial radiation field prediction module, an ADAN module, an intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and a real-time updating and visualization display module, wherein the data receiving module, the initial radiation field prediction module, the intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and the real-time updating and visualization display module are all connected with the ADAN module. The model utilizes a self-adaptive depth assimilation network to fuse and feedback and correct the real-time gamma radiation monitoring data and the data of the nuclear accident radiation field prediction model, thereby realizing high-precision dynamic prediction of radiation field distribution. The method comprises the steps of carrying out a depth assimilation process, wherein an adaptive parameter optimization and prediction result feedback correction mechanism is introduced in the depth assimilation process, so that a model can dynamically adjust assimilation network parameters according to real-time monitoring data, and carrying out iterative correction on the prediction result of an initial physical model chain, thereby forming a closed loop updating mechanism of radiation field prediction, assimilation correction and feedback optimization. The method is suitable for the fields of nuclear emergency management, nuclear accident result evaluation, radiation diffusion simulation and the like, and has the remarkable effect of improving the accuracy and timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for nonlinear simulation and prediction of transmission line galloping based on micro-topography multi-source data driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission line galloping nonlinear simulation and prediction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on micro-topography multi-source data driving, which comprise the steps of analyzing a transmission line GIM model and geographic elevation data to construct a three-dimensional digital twin model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a macroscopic meteorological wind speed, obtaining a wire local flow field by introducing a micro-topography correction factor to conduct scale-down correction on the macroscopic meteorological wind speed, then establishing a 3-DOF coupling dynamics equation comprising vertical, horizontal and torsion degrees of freedom based on nonlinear aerodynamic characteristics of the icing wire, finally solving a wire galloping track and amplitude through a time integration algorithm, and issuing risk early warning based on a phase-to-phase distance threshold. The method can truly reflect the coupling mechanism of the micro-topography wind field effect and the multiple degrees of freedom, remarkably improves the prediction accuracy of the galloping disasters of the power transmission line, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention of the power grid.

title_en: Three-dimensional simulation image generation system suitable for well site
abstract_en: The utility model provides a three-dimensional simulation image generation system suitable for a well site, which relates to the technical field of oil drilling, and comprises a position acquisition module, a position acquisition module and a position acquisition module, wherein the position acquisition module is arranged in the well site and an infrastructure in the well site; the data processing center is connected with the position acquisition module and is arranged in the central control room. Therefore, on one hand, the data processing center can generate the three-dimensional simulation image, the accuracy of the three-dimensional simulation image is improved, and meanwhile, the overall layout and the equipment distribution condition of the drilling site can be visually and three-dimensionally checked, so that more accurate virtual inspection and operation planning are performed, the operation efficiency and the safety are improved, the layout and the logistics cost of the infrastructure are optimized, and the emergency response capability is enhanced. On the other hand, remote monitoring and command scheduling are supported, management efficiency is improved, and intelligent and digital transformation of drilling operation is promoted. In addition, the three-dimensional simulation image is not interfered by human factors, and the objectivity of the three-dimensional simulation image is improved.
assignees: SINOPEC OILFIELD SERVICE CORP;SINOPEC SHENGLI PETROLEUM ENG CO LTD;INTELLIGENT INFORMATION TECH SUPPORT CENTER OF SINOPEC SHENGLI PETROLEUM ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent coordination system and method for cross-enterprise emergency linkage exercise in chemical industry park
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management of chemical industry parks, and discloses an intelligent coordination system for cross-enterprise emergency linkage exercise of a chemical industry park. The system comprises a park-level emergency linkage platform, a task allocation module, a real-time monitoring module and a drilling evaluation module. The platform integrates emergency resource information of each enterprise through a standardized interface, centralized management is achieved through distributed storage, a task allocation module automatically generates a cross-enterprise rescue scheme based on an intelligent algorithm and based on factors such as accident positions, resource matching degree and rescue paths, a real-time monitoring module collects exercise data through a sensor network and video equipment, and an evaluation module generates a visual report and gives out optimization suggestions according to a quantitative index system. The method realizes the efficient coordination and intelligent scheduling of the cross-enterprise emergency resources, remarkably improves the emergency response speed and the co-processing capacity of the park, shortens the emergency response time by more than 60%, improves the resource allocation accuracy by more than 20%, and forms a continuously optimized emergency management closed loop.
assignees: JINCHUAN GROUP CO LTD;JINCHUAN GROUP CHEMICAL NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Transmission line early warning method, device, equipment and medium considering wind-ice coupling factor superposition
abstract_en: The application discloses a power transmission line early warning method, device, equipment and medium considering wind-ice coupling factor superposition, relates to the technical field of overhead line risk prediction early warning, is well adapted to complex and changeable meteorological environments, is good in early warning accuracy and timeliness, and improves disaster prevention and reduction capacity of a power grid in coping with ice-removing jump disasters.
