The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time meteorological data of an environment where the power transmission line is located when the condition that the power transmission line starts to generate icing is detected, inputting the real-time meteorological data into an icing thickness prediction model for predicting the icing thickness to obtain a future icing thickness change trend, carrying out deicing jump numerical simulation on the power transmission line by utilizing a plurality of pieces of preset working condition information to generate an icing thickness threshold result set, extracting a target icing thickness threshold value in the icing thickness threshold result set based on the real-time meteorological data, evaluating the future icing thickness change trend by utilizing the target icing thickness threshold value, and carrying out deicing jump risk early warning on the power transmission line according to the obtained evaluation result.

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for hidden disaster risk of mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method for hidden disaster risk of a mine, and belongs to the field of mine safety monitoring. The method aims at the problems of inaccurate early warning and low reliability caused by data isolation and physical mechanism deletion in the prior art, an encoder-decoder neural network model which takes multi-source fusion characteristics as input and takes grid space coordinates and stress tensors as output is further constructed by establishing a mine three-dimensional geological grid model and collecting historical monitoring data and disaster records, physical constraint training is carried out on the model by fusion data fitting, a stress balance equation and a weighting loss function which is guided based on a historical disaster mechanism, and finally real-time data is inverted by utilizing the trained model to obtain a full mine stress field and converted into shear stress concentration factor distribution, so that dynamic early warning is realized on a risk overrun region. The method is mainly used for realizing real-time quantitative evaluation and early warning of hidden risks such as mine rock burst, water burst and the like.

title_en: Dormitory building fire evacuation path optimization coupling simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimized coupling simulation method for a dormitory building fire evacuation path, and belongs to the fields of safety science and engineering. The method comprises the steps of establishing a fire cause model to lock risk nodes through fusion of double theories, collecting personnel data under a fire situation and carrying out simulation parameterization treatment, utilizing Revit to establish a BIM model, coupling a fire simulation result with evacuation simulation software to establish an evacuation simulation model, simulating three core threats of multi-floor fire scene identification temperature, toxic gas concentration and visibility through Pyrosim by combining parameters, establishing the evacuation simulation model by coupling Pyrosim with Pathfinder software, analyzing the association relation between personnel evacuation timeliness and escape path smoothness and fire source position, and providing an evacuation path optimization scheme based on the simulation result. The invention can accurately lock the evacuation key risk nodes, improve the accuracy of evacuation simulation, establish the coupling relation between the fire environment and personnel evacuation, and improve the safety of evacuation paths.

title_en: Power transmission and distribution line simulation evaluation method under disaster condition
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of point cloud model construction, in particular to a power transmission and distribution line simulation evaluation method under disaster conditions, which comprises the steps of scanning the environment where a power transmission and distribution line is positioned to generate point cloud containing reflectivity and color information; classifying point clouds, marking each object, calculating a first characterization value, a second characterization value and a tower evaluation value of each object, marking an object corresponding to a power transmission tower, calculating a wire evaluation value of each object, marking an object corresponding to a power transmission and distribution line, determining a rejection coefficient of each point cloud, identifying and rejecting abnormal point clouds on the object corresponding to the power transmission and distribution line, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the object corresponding to the power transmission and distribution line after refilling the point clouds, performing simulation on the reconstructed three-dimensional point cloud model under disaster conditions, and evaluating the running state of the power transmission and distribution line. The three-dimensional reconstruction method and the three-dimensional reconstruction device can improve the three-dimensional reconstruction precision of the power transmission and distribution line and improve the evaluation accuracy and reliability of the operation state of the power transmission and distribution line under disaster conditions.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for coal-rock gas dynamic disaster risk hole-roadway information fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a coal rock dynamic disaster risk hole-roadway information fusion intelligent evaluation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting drilling associated data in a coal rock hole drilling process, extracting characteristics of operation data to obtain drilling associated characteristic data, inputting the characteristic data into a pre-trained disaster risk advanced evaluation model to obtain a first disaster evaluation result, inputting the characteristic data into a pre-trained current dangerous state real-time evaluation model to obtain a second disaster evaluation result, and optimizing the disaster risk advanced evaluation model and the current dangerous state real-time evaluation model according to the first disaster evaluation result and the second disaster evaluation result. The method has the advantages that various drilling associated data are synthesized, the characteristics are extracted, the factors of coal-rock gas dynamic disasters are comprehensively considered, and the risk of the disasters can be accurately estimated through the evaluation and model optimization of two different functional models, so that misjudgment and missed judgment are reduced.
assignees: CHINA COAL RESEARCH INST;CHINA COAL RESEARCH INST

title_en: Slope instability year occurrence probability evaluation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a slope instability annual occurrence probability assessment method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of fitting a annual highest underground water level sequence based on a preset generalized extremum distribution model, obtaining water level distribution type and parameters, establishing an annual overrun probability function of underground water level, dividing the value range of the function to determine a representative annual overrun probability value, a representative underground water level value and annual occurrence probability of each underground water level scene, constructing a slope stability analysis model by combining investigation data and the representative underground water level value, calculating slope condition failure probability of each underground water level scene according to the slope condition failure probability, and finally obtaining the annual instability probability of a slope region according to the slope condition failure probability and the annual occurrence probability. Therefore, the problems of complex unsaturated seepage simulation, high calculation cost and dependence on soil unsaturated hydraulic parameters which are difficult to acquire in the related technology are solved, the calculation cost is reduced, the calculation efficiency is improved, and key indexes are provided for disaster prevention and reduction decisions and risk management and control of the side slope.

title_en: Electric power facility earthquake disaster risk assessment method and system based on earthquake deformation field
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating earthquake disaster risk of an electric power facility based on an earthquake deformation field, wherein the method utilizes earthquake parameter data obtained based on an inner network unidirectional data isolation transmission mechanism to complement the geometrical parameters of an earthquake source fault, and introduces an elastic dislocation model to perform forward calculation to obtain three-dimensional earth surface deformation parameters of an earthquake region; based on the acquired digital elevation model data, fault node data and the three-dimensional earth surface deformation parameters, respectively calculating to obtain a topographic gradient parameter, a fault distance parameter and a deformation gradient characteristic quantity, mapping the deformation gradient characteristic quantity, the topographic gradient parameter and the fault distance parameter into a pre-constructed three-dimensional evaluation matrix, and determining the earthquake disaster risk level of the position of the electric power facility, thereby solving the technical problems of the traditional earthquake emergency tool in aspects of insufficient timeliness of data, simulation loss of earth surface deformation, weak evaluation capability of earthquake disaster risk quantification of the electric power facility and safe isolation and transmission of the electric network.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Mining working face coal and gas outburst risk real-time evaluation method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining working face coal and gas outburst risk real-time evaluation method based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of mine gas control. The method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source information, S2, extracting precursor characteristics of gas emission information, S3, extracting precursor characteristics of coal and rock fracture microseismic signals in the mining process, S4, building a real-time evaluation model of coal and gas outburst risks of a mining working face, training the model, and S5, carrying out real-time evaluation of coal and gas outburst risks of the mining working face by adopting the model trained in S4. The invention realizes real-time intelligent evaluation of coal and gas outburst risk of the mining working face by fusing the multi-source precursor information of coal and gas outburst and combining a neural network algorithm, has the advantages of high evaluation accuracy, reliable evaluation result and the like, and can be applied to gas disaster prevention and control in high-outburst dangerous areas.
assignees: HUANENG YUNNAN DIANDONG ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;CHINA COAL RESEARCH INST

title_en: Coal and gas outburst risk area refined prediction method based on improved distribution center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal and gas outburst risk area refined prediction method based on an improved distribution center, and belongs to the field of coal-rock gas dynamic disaster prediction. The method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-index system for predicting the outburst risk of regional coal and gas, S2, constructing a prediction model of the outburst risk of coal and gas, S3, constructing a prediction database of the regional, S4, performing prediction model training to determine an optimal prediction model, S5, designing a classification probability distribution index calculation method based on an improved distribution center, additionally considering the comprehensive influence of the corresponding probabilities of other types on the prediction result on the premise of ensuring that the conventional maximum probability membership principle is unchanged, so that the prediction result floats around the distribution center in an outburst threat index interval, S6, constructing a category index interval, and S7, calculating the outburst risk index distribution of a field coal seam. The method can improve the targeted refined prediction capability of the critical prominent dangerous area.
assignees: HUANENG YUNNAN DIANDONG ENERGY CO LTD;HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;CHINA COAL RESEARCH INST

title_en: Disaster weather intelligent prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster weather intelligent prediction method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, and belongs to the technical field of weather prediction and artificial intelligence. Aiming at the problems that data fusion is incomplete and physical mechanism combination is not deep in medium and small scale disastrous weather prediction of traditional numerical weather prediction, a space-time consistency database is constructed by collecting ERA5 wind field, FY-4B full-channel cloud image and solar altitude angle data and performing space-time alignment, a standardized data set is generated by adopting multi-step long light flow calculation and normalization processing, a deep learning model comprising a Conv-LSTM module and a UNet module is constructed, and a future time prediction cloud image is output through feature fusion and different time step mixed training strategies.

title_en: Trampling-prevention simulation training device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-trampling simulation practical training device which comprises a practical training device body, wherein a base is arranged below the practical training device body, the bottom surface of the practical training device body is connected with an adapter seat, two groups of limiting sliding grooves are formed in the inner wall of the base, limiting sliding blocks are connected to the inner wall of each limiting sliding groove in a sliding mode, and two groups of limiting telescopic rods are connected to the inner bottom wall of the base. This device is through the collaborative operation of electronic hydraulic telescoping rod, spacing telescopic rod and spring, but accurate simulation ground is in the fluctuation that tramples the accident and produce, cooperation smoke generator, the smog environment that the board was spouted to the even cigarette was constructed to and the alarm sound that the voice alarm sent, true accident scene is restoreed to the multidimension degree, let the experienter obtain the immersive training experience of being personally on the scene, effectively make up the defect that traditional static training lacks the sense of reality, illumination warning light and the evacuation direction indicator lamp in the device can provide clear evacuation guide for the experienter in complicated simulation environment.
assignees: JINSHI SHANZHI TIANJIN EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation system using digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈을 이용한 대피 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따르는 디지털 트윈을 이용한 대피 시스템은, 건물 내부 또는 외부에 배치되어 재난상황을 감지할 수 있도록 형성되는 복수의 제1 감지부; 상기 제1 감지부를 통해 기설정된 재난상황이 감지될 때, 근접한 대피자들에게 수신된 이동경로를 전달하는 복수의 알람부; 상기 재난상황의 유형 및 시간별 변화를 파악하고, 이를 토대로 상기 이동경로를 산출하여 상기 알람부들에 전송하는 시뮬레이션 서버; 및 상기 이동경로를 따라 이동하는 상기 대피자들의 상태를 감지하는 제2 감지부를 포함하고, 상기 시뮬레이션 서버는, 상기 이동경로를 따라 이동하는 상기 대피자들의 상태를 토대로 상기 대피자들마다 각각 최적화된 이동경로를 산출하여 전달하고, 외부의 응급대응기관에 상기 대피자들의 상태를 전달할 수 있다.

title_en: Automated review system for evacuation regulations and BIM simulation bar method for urban development projects including high-rise
title_ko: 초고층을 포함한 도시정비 사업을 위한 피난법규 자동화 검토 시스템 및 bim 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 건물정보모듈이 대상 건물에 대한 건물정보파일(IFC)을 생성하는 단계, 초고층 건축물여부 확인 모듈(100)이 상기 건물정보파일(IFC)에서 층수 및 건물높이에 대한 정보를 추출하여, 상기 대상 건물이 초고층 건축물인지 여부를 확인하는 단계, (c) 방화구획 분석 모듈(200)이 상기 건물정보파일(IFC)에서 최대층면적, 구조부의 구조와 자재, 방화구획의 높이와 면적과 자재, 상기 층수, 스프링클러의 존재 여부 및 각 층의 층고에 대한 정보를 추출하여, 방화구획의 이상여부를 확인하는 단계, 피난안전구역 분석 모듈(300)이 상기 건물 정보파일(IFC)에서 상기 층수 및 피난안전구역에 대한 정보를 추출하여, 피난안전구역의 이상여부를 확인하는 단계, 직통계단 및 출구설치 기준 분석 모듈(400)이 상기 건물정보파일(IFC)에서 직통계단 및 상기 각 층의 층고에 대한 정보를 추출하여 직통계단 및 출구의 이상여부를 확인하는 단계, 및 비상용승강기 분석 모듈이 상기 건물정보파일(IFC)에서 상기 건물높이, 각 층의 바닥면적, 상기 층수 및 비상용승강기 개수에 대한 정보를 추출하여 비상용승강기의 이상여부를 확인하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는, BIM을 이용한 초고층 건축물의 피난법규 자동화 검토 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Development of a digital twin-based 3D building energy monitoring system
title_ko: 디지털 트윈 기반 3d 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템 개발
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 3D 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템 개발에 관한것으로서, 건물 내 전기, 화재, 열, 공기 정보를 실시간으로 수집이 가능한 센서를 구축하고 구축된 센서 데이터를 바탕으로 전기 에너지 수용량 및 효율분석, 건물 공간별 공기질 분석, 화재 대피를 위한 시뮬레이션 기반 대피로 분석 등 다양한 분석 서비스를 제공하고자 한다 
또한 디지털 트윈 환경 내 가상 설비 배치 기능을 제공하여 건물 내 공간별 에너지 최적화 방안을 도출하는 서비스를 제공하고자 한다. 
본 발명은 디지털 트윈 기반 3D 건물 에너지 모니터링 시스템을 개발하는것으로 건물 도면 및 전력 정보, 건물 전체 에너지 소비율 분석, 에너지 사용량 시각화, 상세정보 등을 제공하므로써 건물 에너지 절감이 가능하다 
또한 가상 환경내 설비 배치를 통한 효율 최적화 서비스를 제공하므로써 설비 배치 시뮬레이션을 통한 예상 전력 사용량 및 피크 전력량 초과등 전력망 부하관리가 가능하다. 
또한 건물 전체 에너지 사용량 분석 기반 에너지 최적화 히트맵 정보와 에너지 낭비, 누수 알림, 장애 등 에너지 사용량에 따른 에너지 최적화 개선 피드백이 가능하다.

title_en: System and method for fire protection of drillship and drillship including the same
title_ko: 시추선 소방 방재 시스템과 방법 및 동 시스템을 포함하는 시추선
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 시추선의 드릴 플로어에 대한 화재 모니터링을 수행하는 다수의 제1 모니터링부와, 화재 모니터링 결과에 따라 화재 발생이 감지되는 경우 화재 발생 구역에 소방수를 분사하도록 제어하고 화재 발생 구역의 모니터링 결과에 따라 소방수의 분사량 및 분사 위치 중 어느 하나 이상을 조절하며 화재 발생 구역의 화재 진압이 완료된 것으로 판단되는 경우 소방수의 분사를 중단하도록 제어하는 제어부와, 그리고 제어부의 제어에 의해 화재 발생 구역의 모니터링을 수행하는 다수의 제2 모니터링부를 포함하는, 시추선 소방 방재 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for disaster management at power generation facility construction site
title_ko: 발전 설비 공사 현장의 재해 관리 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈 기술을 활용하여 발전 설비 공사 현장의 재해 발생을 예측하고 관리할 수 있는 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 재해 관리 장치는 수행중인 공사 단계, 공사 영역, 작업자 작업 현황, 공사 달성 정도, 및 공사기간 단축/지연 상황 중 적어도 하나에 대한 정보를 수신하여 현장 정보를 생성하는 현장 관리부; 현장 정보 및 공사 계획 정보를 기초로 공사 단계 별 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 재해 발생 종류 및 가능성을 예측하며, 예측된 결과를 기초로 재해 정보 및 안전 정보 중 적어도 하나를 생성하는 시뮬레이션부; 및 재해 정보 및 안전 정보 중 적어도 하나를 작업자에게 전송하는 작업자 관리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue training inclined building after simulated earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model provides a simulated post-earthquake rescue training inclined building, which relates to the technical field of rescue training buildings and comprises casting concrete, wherein a movable groove is formed in one side of the top of the casting concrete, a slight vibration device is arranged in the movable groove, the training inclined building is installed at the top of the slight vibration device, a fixed groove is formed in the other side of the top of the casting concrete, and an anti-falling device is arranged in the fixed groove. According to the utility model, through the arranged slight vibration device, the two sides of the connecting plate and the training inclined building are slightly vibrated by the two large lifting hydraulic rods at the two sides to simulate the effect of slight aftershock after earthquake disaster, so that the effect of rescue personnel in the training process is better, and through the arranged anti-falling device, the rescue personnel accidentally falling in the training process is buffered by the resilience force of the damper and the spring, and the rescue personnel is prevented from being damaged due to larger impact force caused by accidental falling in the training process.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD

title_en: Dangerous water flow simulation device
abstract_en: A dangerous water flow simulation device comprises a first ramp and a first observation box, wherein a water outlet height difference of the dangerous water flow simulation device forms a rolling flow, a blocking wall is arranged on the second ramp and the second observation box, a swirling flow is generated after water flow is impacted, a triangular barrier-shaped cylindrical barrier, a left barrier-right barrier, a diagonal shield barrier-flat shield barrier and a sinking barrier-flat are arranged on any ramp, the triangular barrier-flat forms an inverted V flow, the cylindrical barrier-flat forms a smile flow, a positive V flow is formed in a gap between the left barrier-right barrier-flat shield barrier-flat, a frowning flow is formed by the diagonal shield barrier-flat shield barrier-flat, and bubbles are generated by the sinking barrier-flat. According to the utility model, various dangerous water flows are simulated through the observation box, the ramp and the barrier, so that firefighters can intuitively observe the flow state characteristics in a safe environment, the rescue judgment and emergency capability are improved, and the device is suitable for water area rescue training and teaching demonstration.

title_en: Subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit and discloses a subway station fire dynamic evacuation path planning method which comprises a fire simulation module, a network topology construction module and a global path planning module, wherein the fire simulation module is used for constructing a fire simulation model of a subway station, acquiring whole station railway scene data and extracting disaster causing factor change data at key evacuation nodes again, the network topology construction module is used for establishing a network topology diagram of 'starting point-key evacuation nodes' according to pedestrian distribution and the key evacuation nodes, and the global path planning module is used for planning key node selection of each crowd by using Dijkstra algorithm based on the network topology diagram. And the grid topology construction module optimizes local path details among the key nodes through a Q-learning algorithm on the basis of global planning. And the path reconstruction module is used for reconstructing the evacuation path in real time in different development stages of the fire scene by combining the available time of the key evacuation nodes. The method can be used for planning a safer evacuation path for escape passengers according to the dynamic evolution condition of the fire scene while relieving the congestion.

title_en: Dynamic optimization device and method for mechanical smoke discharging system parameters based on pavement clear height
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building fire engineering, and particularly relates to a mechanical smoke exhaust system based on pavement clear height Parameter dynamic optimization device and method. The device comprises a data extraction module, a parameter calculation module, a multi-sensor fusion monitoring module and a liftable smoke outlet. The invention automatically extracts the net height data H of the target pavement based on the BIM model and calculates the initial state of the smoke outlet Parameter values, acquiring multi-source sensor data in real time when a fire disaster occurs, and adjusting in real time by controlling a servo motor to drive a smoke outlet to vertically move according to the acquired data Generating a db parameter recommendation interval aiming at the target pavement through FDS simulation and calculating the obtained initial value according to the recommendation interval And verifying and correcting the parameter values to finish dynamic optimization of the db parameter. The invention has the advantages of obviously improved smoke discharging efficiency and obvious energy consumption optimizing effect, is suitable for complex scenes such as special-shaped walkways, large-span spaces and the like, and effectively ensures the safety of personnel evacuation.
assignees: SHAANXI METALLURGICAL DESIGN & RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Core network disaster recovery switching evaluation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a core network disaster recovery switching evaluation method, a device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of communication. The method comprises the steps of executing multidimensional simulation based on disaster recovery switching evaluation requirements to obtain simulation results, evaluating signaling impact quantity, network element bearing capacity and service recovery degree of a target network-related network element of disaster recovery switching based on the simulation results, determining evaluation results representing influences of the disaster recovery switching on the target network, and representing service realization capacity, network element impact resistance and network element capacity bearing capacity of the target network by the evaluation results, wherein the evaluation results are used for providing decision basis for network optimization. The application can solve the technical problems that the prior proposal lacks the special evaluation capability for the disaster recovery switching scene and can not evaluate the affected degree of the related network elements of the core network in the process of disaster recovery switching, and pushes the network security prevention and control in the disaster recovery switching scene to be changed from passive response to active pre-judgment and prevention and control, thereby remarkably improving the stability and service continuity of the core network.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE GROUP DESIGN INST;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic prediction method for strong wind disaster risk of power grid facilities in loess plateau region
abstract_en: A dynamic prediction method for the risk of strong wind disaster of power grid facilities in loess plateau areas includes such steps as obtaining the geographical and power grid information of target area, inputting it to a pre-built dynamic prediction model to obtain high-resolution dynamic wind field and turbulence parameters, dynamically calculating load effect and structural resistance by high-resolution dynamic wind field and turbulence parameters, calculating the safety margin of each failure mode by load effect and structural resistance, and determining the risk level of target area. The method is designed aiming at the geographic climate characteristics of the loess plateau complex mountain land and the wind-induced disaster mechanism of the power grid facilities, solves the problem of difficult landing of a macroscopic meteorological mode, and reduces the simulation deviation of the wind field of the complex mountain land by coupling the micro-topography power effect and the local thermal power process.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RESEARCH INST CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: SAR image classification method and system based on scattering prompt and optimal transmission
abstract_en: The invention relates to a SAR image classification method and a system based on scattering prompt and optimal transmission, belonging to the technical field of synthetic aperture radar image classification, and comprising the following main steps of carrying out threshold segmentation and connected domain analysis on SAR images and extracting coordinates of an image scattering center; based on the normalized coordinates of the scattering center, a scattering prompt text and a prompt vector sequence are generated, a scattering perception text characteristic vector and an image characteristic vector are obtained, cross-modal alignment is achieved, uniform edge probability is introduced to supplement global category constraint, clean and noise samples are dynamically separated, and robust SAR image classification is achieved through joint training of optimization model parameters. According to the invention, by introducing the specific scattering structure priori knowledge of the SAR image and combining the cross-modal capability of the vision-language model, the classification accuracy and robustness under the noise label condition are effectively improved, and the method is suitable for complex remote sensing scenes such as disaster monitoring, military reconnaissance, ocean monitoring and the like.

title_en: Meteorological data acquisition system for early warning based on meteorological disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological data acquisition system for early warning of meteorological disasters, which relates to the field of meteorological data processing, and is used for acquiring historical disaster image data of a target area and time labels, constructing a training sample set, training a depth image discrimination model based on the sample set and used for identifying disaster cloud cluster forms in real-time images, acquiring image data streams uploaded by a plurality of image acquisition nodes and inputting the image data streams into the model to generate a preliminary discrimination result, calculating disaster similarity based on the discrimination result, constructing an image risk thermodynamic diagram, screening out high-risk nodes, carrying out sampling frequency scheduling on the high-risk nodes, improving image updating frequency, further extracting multidimensional features such as wind fields, cloud system forms, bright-warm gradients and the like, and generating a feature vector set.
assignees: ANKANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NANJING YIBO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on particle swarm optimization neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering disaster prediction, and discloses a soft rock tunnel large deformation prediction method based on a particle swarm optimization neural network, which comprises the steps of selecting geological construction characteristic parameters such as surrounding rock water content, construction method and the like as input factors, and establishing qualitative index and quantitative numerical mapping; the method comprises the steps of constructing an engineering sample data set based on orthogonal test design and numerical simulation, carrying out normalization processing, carrying out global iterative optimization on initial connection weight and bias of an error back propagation neural network by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal initial value by taking a network error as an fitness value, finally inputting data training to generate a mature model, outputting a predicted deformation value and carrying out engineering early warning by combining a double verification mechanism. The method solves the problems of slow convergence and easy sinking into local optimum caused by random initialization of parameters of the traditional neural network, and effectively improves the prediction precision of the large deformation of the soft rock tunnel and the reliability of engineering early warning.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 8TH ENG DIVISION;CHINA CONSTR CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Time sequence killing network generation method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time sequence killing network generation method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Aiming at the problems of resource allocation and multi-target hit success rate optimization in multi-task combat, the invention adopts a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning technology, generates a dynamic time sequence killing network by constructing an agent system facing hit tasks and combining an online training mechanism, optimizes an agent decision process to adapt to complex battlefield situations by introducing a combat capability probability function with force changing along time in nodes and edges, designs a reward mechanism integrating task execution time, priority and deadline, realizes cooperative scheduling among multiple agents, reduces task miss rate, supports online learning and strategy self-adaption update, avoids dimension disasters, has stronger dynamic response capability and flexibility, and further improves the overall efficiency and hit success rate of the combat system.

title_en: Hot melt slump susceptibility assessment method and device based on multispectral and digital elevation model state space network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geology and geological disaster remote sensing control, and particularly relates to a hot melt collapse susceptibility assessment method and device based on a multispectral and digital elevation model state space network. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a high-resolution multispectral image of a research area and a digital elevation model constructed by a stereopair, generating a pixel-level label based on an existing hot-melt slump vector list, cutting a training sample on a source domain image in a sliding window mode, constructing a feature extraction trunk based on a state space network, coding multispectral and elevation raster data, expanding local features into a sequence, modeling long-distance space dependency relationship in a state space unit, highlighting spectrum and topography features related to hot-melt slump by using an attention enhancement module, inputting the labeled source domain sample and the unlabeled target domain sample into a shared network at the same time, respectively extracting task related features and domain related features by using a feature decoupling module, introducing correlation alignment loss based on covariance alignment between the domain related features to realize cross-region feature distribution alignment, carrying out sliding window prediction on the whole image of a target area and carrying out weighted fusion on an overlapping region after model training convergence to generate a continuous hot-melt slump probability map. According to the invention, the multisource remote sensing information is utilized, a state space network and a cross-region characteristic alignment mechanism are introduced, and the precision, the space continuity and the cross-region generalization capability of the permafrost region hot melt collapse susceptibility assessment are remarkably improved.

title_en: Coal mine safety data set quality optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality optimization method of coal mine safety data sets, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of cleaning multi-source heterogeneous coal mine safety data, adopting a field rule and interpolation algorithm combination strategy to complement missing values, utilizing an improved Z-score algorithm to combine with a coal mine safety regulation threshold value to detect and reject abnormal values, combining redundant data based on a spatial clustering algorithm, adopting an SMOTE-ENN hybrid sampling algorithm to balance the cleaned data, generating a class balance data set conforming to a preset proportion, controlling the proportion of various classes of samples to be within 1:5, automatically marking the data by using a risk class and disaster-caused type semantic tag based on a coal mine safety field pre-training model and the coal mine safety regulation threshold value, and manually assisting in correcting samples with marking confidence coefficient lower than the preset threshold value to optimize marking results.

title_en: Cable tunnel space fire experiment device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a cable tunnel space fire experiment device which comprises a cable tunnel experiment space, wherein a transverse cable bridge for placing a cable, a burner for igniting the cable, an image acquisition module for acquiring real-time images of cable combustion, a temperature acquisition module for acquiring temperature data of each temperature measuring point in the cable tunnel experiment space, a smoke analysis module for analyzing smoke conditions when fire occurs in the cable tunnel experiment space, and a fire extinguishing module for extinguishing fire in the cable tunnel experiment space are arranged in the cable tunnel experiment space. The utility model can simulate the situation of the cable space when a fire disaster occurs, and can be used for carrying out experiments on the characteristics and the dangers of the temperature field and the fire extinguishing effectiveness when the fire disaster occurs, thereby providing references and bases for the fire fighting design, the fire disaster control and the fire fighting rescue of the cable tunnel space.

title_en: Fire-fighting safety system for vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle fire-fighting safety system which is characterized by comprising a fire early warning module, a fire extinguishing module, an emergency evacuation module and a fire-fighting training module. The fire early warning module is used for detecting fire occurrence signals and giving an alarm, and transmitting the detected fire occurrence signals to the fire extinguishing module, the fire extinguishing module is used for triggering built-in fire extinguishing measures to extinguish fire according to the received fire occurrence signals, the emergency evacuation module is used for deploying safety emergency marks and safety emergency tools so as to assist rapid evacuation of personnel in a vehicle, and the fire-fighting exercise training module is used for setting corresponding fire-fighting exercise courses for the personnel to carry out fire-fighting exercise training.
assignees: HUNAN CRRC ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid toughness assessment method and system based on urban lifeline cross-system interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating toughness of a power grid based on cross-system interconnection of urban lifelines, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a communication network model of the power grid to be evaluated in a target area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fault propagation on a power grid to be evaluated under a preset disaster situation through a preset cascading fault mechanism to obtain a fault propagation result, carrying out recovery simulation on the power grid to be evaluated under the preset disaster situation through a preset recovery mechanism to obtain a recovery simulation result, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined structural toughness index to obtain the structural toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, analyzing the fault propagation result and the recovery simulation result based on a predefined functional toughness index to obtain the functional toughness of the power grid to be evaluated, fusing the structural toughness and the functional toughness to obtain comprehensive toughness, and completing the toughness evaluation of the power grid to be evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device remarkably improve the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the power grid toughness evaluation.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Bridge demolishs and uses breaker with function of making an uproar falls
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crushing device with a noise reduction function for bridge dismantling, which relates to the technical field of bridge engineering and comprises support columns, wherein fixed transverse blocks are fixedly connected to the inner sides of the two support columns, drilling rigs are fixedly connected to the bottoms of the fixed transverse blocks in a penetrating manner, supporting frames are fixedly connected to the tops of the fixed transverse blocks, extension columns are fixedly connected to the tops of the supporting frames, hydraulic splitting bars are fixedly connected to the tops of the extension columns, connecting columns are fixedly connected to the two sides of the fixed transverse blocks, and arc angle adjusting blocks are fixedly connected to one sides of the connecting columns, which are far away from the fixed transverse blocks, so that the problems that a large amount of explosive is detonated in the blasting dismantling process of a large bridge, a large amount of noise and vibration are generated, the surrounding residents are possibly damaged in sputtering, and the surrounding buildings and facilities are possibly collapsed, and ground or geological disasters are possibly caused due to excessive explosive amount when the explosive amount is in error are caused.
assignees: SHAANXI ROAD & BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Open disaster scene-oriented rapid point cloud instance segmentation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid point cloud instance segmentation method for an open disaster scene, belonging to the technical field of three-dimensional data processing; the method comprises the steps of carrying out voxelization on point clouds, extracting features and central position prediction through a sub-manifold sparse convolution network, then inputting the features and the central position prediction into a core sparse point cloud decoder which is assisted by facing the central position, carrying out efficient interaction and sparse decoding on the features and the position information through the synergistic effect of a self-attention layer, an asymmetric attention layer and a leachable embedded score screening layer by the decoder, outputting final embedding, and finally carrying out central point, category and mask based on a prediction example. The invention effectively utilizes the sparsity of the point cloud through the unique decoder structure, solves the key problems of weak model generalization capability, slow training convergence and insufficient reasoning speed faced by the prior art in an open disaster scene, and remarkably improves the precision and efficiency of segmentation.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE INST FOR METROLOGY & MEASUREMENT TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Cable channel single-phase grounding arc ignition time simulation calculation method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to a simulation calculation method and a system for ignition time of a single-phase grounding arc of a cable channel, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a simulation model of the single-phase grounding fault arc of the cable; the cable single-phase earth fault arc simulation model comprises a cable two-dimensional geometric model, material physical characteristic parameters and physical field coupling boundary conditions, arc current and voltage waveforms in half periods under different working conditions are extracted, average arc energy and average arc power in the duration of the half periods are calculated through numerical integration, a cable tunnel model is built, material parameters of the cable and the optical cable are configured, monitoring equipment is arranged at the same time, average power in the arc duration of the different working conditions is used as a fire source heat release rate to be input into the cable tunnel model for simulation, and monitoring data of the monitoring equipment are recorded. According to the technical scheme, the accurate simulation calculation of the ignition time and the fire disaster of the single-phase grounding arc of the cable channel can be realized.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Training system for temporary housing facility installation and operation using the metaverse
title_ko: 메타버스를 이용한 임시주거시설 설치 및 운영 학습 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 개시에 따른 메타버스 기반 학습을 제공하는 전자 장치는 적어도 하나의 명령어를 저장하는 메모리, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 명령어를 실행하는 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는 입력 데이터에 기초하여 재난 시나리오를 판단하고, 상기 메타버스 상에서, 상기 재난 시나리오에 대응되는 리커버리 설치 학습을 제공하고, 상기 메타버스 상에서, 상기 재난 시나리오에 대응되는 리커버리 운영 학습을 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV;UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV MIRAE CAMPUS

title_en: Survival Belt No. 18
abstract_en:
The invention provides a Survival Belt No. 18 that straps across the waistline worn as a belt. The structure is made up of varies fabrics, nylons or leather. The belt features eighteen compartments for items: double pocket cell phones, guns, knife, hammer, flashlight, nails, rope, and bullets slots. The Survival Belt No. 18 provides emergency and disaster equipment readily and available in times for safety. Security is a major safety issue whether on the go or at home or camping out will sustain a consumer's life. Natural disasters are on the rise, protecting and supporting is vital for families to survive emergency. The Survival Belt No. 18 will also be used in tactical training law enforcement with additional items. With the increasing crime rates, the public will be forced to defend themselves in order to survive. 
     Having vital items during an earthquake, blackouts, and emergencies will determine one's safety.
